rja he ma mā li nā/ /da do rā chen char/ /ska bas/ gsu ma pa/ra 'os rta dag ni/ /gser gyi 'phreng 2 ldan bcas/ des/ byin/ /dpa/ga tshad dza ga dzee bra hma ra thā khyu ya ngu/ ro dha se/ /yo dza nā rmā sha tai tūrṇa me brgyar ni mgyogs nga/ ru/ /nyi ma gcig bis 'gro ba gang / /rgyal ngo/'i glang chen mdun na 'don//ke nā ddhā pra yā ti yaḥ / / ta smi sa ma/thi ti dṛ ṭwā rādzñā bha dra gi ri ga tshangs pa'i shing rta jes nga/ra byin4 / /rgya' po/'i glang chen bzang ngo/'i ri/ /de 'a yang dag satad mthong dzee / /a byud duḥpra sa ho rā dzā tata spri hā kṛṣṭa mā na saḥ/ /pra yā te nas/ / /rgyal po thin tu bzod dala' der/ /chags nga/sa drangs nga/'i yid du gyur/ /de nas sa bdag ṣa tha bhū pe ṣā bi smi te khum kha shrī yā// / sa marngi/ ti yadzha pha le bhārga mchod sbyin gyi/ /dang/'a kyis/ ya mtshan gshegs gyur cing / /sa yi 5 spyo da nga/sa ma/chod sbyin 'bras / /j-i ( bā ya ma tī bhu dzā/ /ta mu bā tsa sa ma bye tya swaste bā da pu raḥpa ram̐/ /ma rī gu'i bu la gtad nga/'i tshe/ / ma/ rī tsi 1 sgo ba thub nga ni/ /ma/chod dang sta/na thob bā tī la /yang das tsi shi khyo bā tī kaḥ sthā pta pū dzā sa no mu niḥ / / rā dzanda dhya ya na sngadhe 'ongs nas shis pa'i tshig /ma/ngon du btang nas de 'a smras / /rgya' ngo/ slo ba gnyer gang bi mthar//gu rurme gu ru dakṣi rde/ /yī ha te pa ri tsaryādhī sā mā n+ya dza na durla bhā/ /bdag gi bla ma bla ma'i yon/ /g.yo ga 'khor don du skye bo ni/ /thun mo/nga ba la sa/ 1rnyed da7'a bzhed //e kasta rnge ba bi dhi nā nirmi to durla bha pra daḥ / /ba ha bo dzā tu dzā sgrub byed khyod nyid gcig pu yis/ /rnyed dka' rab tu sbyin pa sprul / /dpag bas ma rkang 'thung 'jig 95—4 1

yadhe na lo ke kalpa pā da pā/ /de bee padmā ba ti pu tra sa hi ta gu ra be rten na/ /nam yang mang po skye mi 'gyur/ /bdag gi bla ma dka' thub kyis/ /nyam chung rgas pa'i g.yog ma ma/ /ta paḥkṛ sha ya bṛdhe ya dī ya tī pa ri hā ri rmā/ /i rkyuste mu ni nā rā 'khor du/ /padma ldan pa'i lha mo ni/ /bu dang bcas pa gnang bar mdzod/ /thub pas de brjod rgyal po dzā da yi tā bi pra yo ga rdzu/ /ru dzee saṃ sta bhya ma na sā ta mū tse byerya bhū ni / /brtan pa sa/ 'dzin btsun mo dang / /'bral la sa skyes/ pa'i mya ngan la sa// /yid ni brtan pas de dha raḥ/ / pra yasgo mi mu ṣpe tu bye mispru tī gu ru dakṣi rde/ /sa hi tsā la smras / /dga' ma srog 'a sa mngon par lhag /rgya' tshab dag dang bcas nga/ ni/ /mngon pa/ra 'dod yu ba rā dze na dzre bi tā bhya dhi rmā pri yī/ /i kyukta sa su tī tasmi da do padmā nga/ bla ma'i yon/ /jub pa/ khyed la rab tu sbyin/ /de ska da brjod nas/ mi bdag jis / /pad ldan sras ba ṭī dṛ paḥ / / swa dzre bi te pi ni ste hasgyu gi sa twa ma yātpa rmā/ /bcas/ de la byin1 / /sems dang/'a tshul ldan bdag nyid rnams / /rang srog la yang chags med gtong //ā dā ya rā dza dā yi hūṃ bi ra ha kle sha kā ta dzā/ /sa pu tā mā shra rmā bral ba'i nyon mo/ngas kyis skra ga pa/'i/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo sras dang bcas / /blangs te gnas su/ so nga ga twa pra da do gu ra we mu niḥ/ /a tā nta re duḥ pra sa haḥku ru rā nas ni/ /thub nga sa bla ma la rab phul / /na bas der dregs bcas/ ku ru'i rgyal / /shin tu bzod dzaḥkṣi tī shwa ram̐/ /dṛsto pa yā tse dru te na bhū hye bha dra gi ri ga dzee/ /pu da7'a na sa dbang 'a / /glang chen bzang po'i ri bo ni/ /'byor phyir pho nyas nye bar blangs 4/ /mdun ro hi tā bye tai rā dza na da do dī ra rda ya dā/ / ta dā bi pu la bee bye na 'don la byin zin pa'i/ /so gnyis rgya' pos ma byin gang / /de tshe rang nyid mang po'i sdes//na swa yo yoju sa mā ya yo/ /ba li nā ku ru rā dze na ru snye pu ra 6 g.yu la ni rab tu 'gyed du 'ong 5/ /ku ru'i rgyal po'i dpung rnams kyis/ /grong khyer lam rnams bkag 695—42

baṭwā su/ /ba bhū ba bhū mi pa khā su mee tyā ra ṇa ra soṅgha ṭi/ /sa bī ra kuñdza pa la/ /sa gzhi skyong ba'i dmag gi tshogs/ /g.yul du 'jug pa rab spror gyur/ /dpa' bo glang chen ra ha riḥ sha sto gya ri bi dā ra ṇi / / dza na kṣa ya bha yo byi sna ཿ kā seng ge de/ /dgra ni rnam 'joms nus gyur kyang / /skye bo 'dzad 1 pas 'jigs shing 'khrugs/ /snying ru sgyuta sa ma tsinta yata/ /a ho3nu kyu la mi tram̐ me rā dzā duḥpra sa haḥpa ram̐/ /rje la sa ni yang dag bsams/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka' ni/ /bdag gi rjes mthun grogs/ kyi mchog/mā tai ga lo bha mo he na sa ha sā sha tru tram̐ ga taḥ/ /ste hāddhāḥsu dza ṣpeḥsne glang po dag la chags rmongs pa2 / /kye ma 'phral 'a dgra nyid gyur/ /dam pa'i mdza' ba mdza' ba'i hā ni ste hā khye : ma dhya miḥ / / du rdza ṣpe sgo rā bee rā tī bha ba dhi mtha' / /bar ma rnams kyis/ mdza' med mtha'/ /ngan pa rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa/sa / /shin tu pā ṇa hā ri ṇaḥ/ /a ho bi bha ba lo bhe na kṣa ṇa kṣa yi ni dzre bi te/ /'jigs rung dgra mtha' yin/ /kye ma 'byor pa la chags/ pa/sa/ /bdag ji yang das sbyo ra ba 'di//sa murya mo ya masmra shaṃ pa ra pā ṇa ni pā ta ṣpe/ /ho sa yā pa pra sāddhā srog ni na da cig 'jigs 4ldan zhing / /gzhan kyi srog ni gcod nga/ la 'o/ /'tshe bas ngal 'a rab chags āoṃ shaghā dzā ka li karma su/ / ra ṇa raghā ste ṣighra rna bha kta tho yo shing / /g.yu 'a gyi khrag gis mngon bkrus pa'i/ /sems can yang dag sbyo ra ba 'di/ /zas don rtsod sa murya maḥ/ / se bā bi yī ta dzī bā dzā tsaṇḍa rpāṇḍabee na ma yi/ / ka pa'i las la 'o/ /g.yog 'khor gtum drag phra ma can/ /srog rnams/ 5 'tshong zhing kha zas/ dag /don la ho daḥs haḥkrorya pi shu nā rmā shu na mi ba/ /a ho bi bha ba lu pa dhī dzā pa gnyer rnams kyi rtsod pa ni/ /khyi rnams kyi bzhin bzod par dka'/ /kye ma rdzas la chags pa/'i blo/ /pha ra saṭwā pa shī ta lāḥ/ /swa su kha ma ba dhwa brnyi dṛ shaṃ sa tsa ri to bye yaḥ/ /ye rol gdung bas bsel gyur pa/ /rang nyid bde ba kho na'i phyir/ /ma rungs spyod la rab tu rgyug /gang 95—43

yudhi sedhi sanda ddhā ralnga dhe khyuñdza te shri yo/ / ku taḥhrū ra tā re te ྾ zhig g.yu la grub go bgos shing / /khrag gis sbags pa'i dpal za ba/ /de snying rab tu drag po la//j-i da ya kā ru ṇa ka ṇaḥ/ /e ṣa dund+ra sa ho rā dzā lusgo bi bha ba mo hi taḥ/ /snying rje'i cha 1 ni ga la zhig /rgyal ngo shin tu bzod dka' 'di/ /rnam par 'byor la chags shing rmongs//na ba rgyaḥ sā pa rāsgo pi kā ru zla ya ta rna ma ma/ /i ti tsinta ya ta bdag gi snying rje'i yu/'a gyur pas / /gnod byed gyur kyang gsad mi 'os// /de ltar bas mas shing snying sta su kā ru rgyuta kā na nai ṣi ṇaḥ/ /pra hye ka buddhābya twa raḥswa yam̐ byo: sa rje la sa / /nags ni 'tshol byed de yi bee da/ /rang sa ngas/ rgyas ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rang nyid mkha' la sa/ mā ya yuḥ/ /pāpta pū dzā ma nāḥkhru tā sarba dzhasta ta sā mbi hi tai/ /rā rnyeḥpra yang dag 'ongs / /kun ma/khyen mchod dang stan thob cing / /dang bas/ rab zhi ngang tshul can/ /rgyal po 4sha ma shī la su pra sand+ra sta twa mū tsi re/ / saṃ mo ha pa ṭa lādhe 6 saṃ yang dag bzhed pa/ de/ /thos nas de nyid rab tu gsu/ngas// /'khor ba kun rmongs/ rab rib kyi/ /lo nga 5sā ri 6 da yā lu tā/ /sho bha te ta ba bhū bī la sa twa lo ka bi bee ki naḥ/ /bar brtse ba dang ldan pas / /sems nga/ 6snang ba'i rnam rig can/ /sa skyong khyod ni mdzes par gyur//kri ya tā mbi dhī tai rā dzan bo dhi budhirni dhī ya tsā/ /saṃ pra ti pra ti ro byesmin rgyal ngo/ dgyes pa/ra mdzod cig dang / /byang chub tu ni blo gros/ tshugs / /da lta 7rab tu 'gog nga/'i tshe//ba na mee ba bi gā khya tī / /smi ra nisgo ra rdzu kā ra tīṇḍi saṃ to ṣa sbo ka nags nyid du ni 'gro bar byas/ / /chu rgyun rab gas la lhung lhung sgrog/ /yang dag sem byed zigs/ pa/ rāḥ / /bi bikta kā na nodhe sha sha mi na me ba pabee bhāḥ/ /i kyughā nu can / /dben pa'i nags kyi sa phyogs de/ /zhi ba rnams kyi dga' bskyed 7nyid/ /rjes su bzung blos gra ha bye yā bi dha yā su bi yaṅga ti/ / pra bhā pra sā di ta di shaste 'di gsungs nas/ /de la mkha' gshegs bsgrubs byas te/ /'od kyis phyogs rnams rab gsal zhing //95byed44

te na sa nyi tā ya yuḥ / /yā te 6 swa pa rda te 6 nyi ma ba tta ṭa kā de dang lhan cig de rnams gshegs/ /de rnams rang rang gnas gshegs te/ /sa skyong gangs can ngos na rna/ /saṃ pā pya thra zi bī pā laḥpra yanda pra sha mo bha bta/ /bi be ka bi ma la kyi nags / /yang dag thob pas rab dang zhing / /rab tu zhi ba dag tu gyur/ /snying stobs ldan rnams/ nang na ni//sta gya bye yaḥs twa ba tā mi ba/ / : ba bhū pri ya ni buḥpūṇḍi nirpā bye ba na byu ma yaḥ//wo bar 'der dzwaba' ba'i char gyi 〉 da dob yi sa 'bru sum chad pa ma dpe ma ra 'a sa ma snyed pa pre ya ri rmes pa 'ji 'dar ma sa sasar du bcus pa rgya dpe snyed na ngadrung de blo dbeen zhing dri ma med/ /dga' ba'i char ni rdzogs pa/'i sa / /nags kyi sa gzhi bzhin du gyur//bhū dha dzā ta ri te ta smin sa ha sā bhū pa bhā swa ti/ /shu shu burmo ha ti sa bdag 'od lda na 'phral la ni/ /sa 'dzin dag 1 gis bsgribs nga/ der/ /gti mug mi ra pābee sho ka pra dzāḥpra dzāḥ/ / ta tastata sa tsi bā ga ke ma rī rab rib thob pa/ yis / /mya ngan 'gro tshogs skye rgu na nyal / /de nas thub nga ma rī tse'i/ /dbus 4su tse mu ni mā shra me/ /shashrī rābye gya rakṣu yi rā dza pu tram̐ ya yā tsi reḥ/ /mu de yi blon ngo/ so nga / /rgya' srid bsru/nga bar nus gyur nga 'i/ /rgya' ngo/'i sras ni rab tu barṣa ngas / /thub ni nā nirngi kā re ṇa datta mā dā ya madhri ṇaḥ/ / rā dza su rnu swa na ga re nga/sa rnam 'gyur med nga/ra 6 byin/ /blon ngo/ yis ni blangs byas te/ /rgyal sras rang si grong khyer du//tsakruḥmee n+ya sa myurya rma/ /ta taḥsri n+ya sa mudmā ha i ba rā dza ba rātpa dzaḥ/ /dmag tshogs yang dag ldan par byas / /de nas/ dmag sde'i spro ba bzhin/ /shin tu dpa/'a ba sngo na 'gro ba//su bha ṭā gre sa raḥpā puḥku ru rā dzee ra bhā dzi re/ /sa te na ha ta bi dhwasta bhasna rgyal po mchog gi sras po yis/ /'khrug sar ku ru'i rgyal/ po sleb/ /de yi shing rta glang po che/ bcom sanda na kuñdza raḥ/ /ba khā ya na pa ri tā ṇaḥpra ya yo haste na pu ram̐/ /zhing rnam bshig bcag pas de/ /'bros pas yongs su skyob byed byung / /haste na yi grong du song //95byed45

ba li nā rā dza pu tre ṇa dzi te dund+ra sa te yu bye/ /madhri bhista rtse dza n+ya stobs ldan rgyal po'i sras po des/ /shin tu bzod dka'i g.yu la bcom la// /blon pos de dpung sa stu bhū mi na she ṣa bye ti ya yo / / rā zlo du dzra sa ha snga tha kā le brkod pas/ /lhag ma can bzhin dga' bar gyur—) / /de nas dus kyis sdig bdag nyid/ /rgyal po na ka lu ṣātpa naḥ/ /ba bhū ba dṛṣṭi dubhikṣa ma ra ko pa bla baḥpu re/ /sa bi shin tu bzod dka' yi/ /grong du char med mu ge dang / /yams/ kyi nye bar 'tshe ba byung / /mi bzad tsintu nu tā pārta st+ri bye dza na pa dā pa rda/ /na bi be da pa ri tā rde grong rda' 2 rgud pa dag /bsams pa/sa rjes/ su/ gdung bas/ gzir/ /dge ba'i bya ba 'bras med des//bi pha la swaste kaḥkri yaḥ/ /thraṭwā bi pata pra tī kā re te nā mā tyāsta mū tse re/ /yongs su skyob pa na rig ma gyur/ /rgud pa sel byed de yis dris / /blon ngo/ rnams kyis de 'a smras //duḥs ho yasma hā rā dza dza na bya sa nobye baḥ/ /ma ṇi tsū ḍa gya bhū bhartarya rgya'/ ngo/ chen ngo/ bzod dka' 'di/ /skye bo gdung ba yang dag bskyed/ /sa/ bdag gtsug na rin chen gyis/4//di tso ḍa ma ṇi pra sgo/ /la bhya te sa su ṅgāsudhī te ṣpe yo tīrya te bi pata/ /jo bo ga' te gtsug gi nor/ /bdud rtsi'i brlan 5ldan rnyed na ni/ /de yis rgud 6pa 'di la/sa/ thar//tsā re bhyaḥshu ta masmra bhiḥs rā dza hi ma batta ṭi/ /sbi taḥsaṃ sā ra bee mu gangs can ngos na rgyal po de/ /dben zhing dri bra' bas ma pa/ yis / /'khor ba'i 7la sa/ ni phyir phyogs khyaḥbi be ka bi ma lā sha yaḥ/ /athi taḥ sa da dā hye ba bi shwa tsiddhā gnas / /bdag gis bya ma rta la sa thos// /kun gyi yid bzhin nor bu deḍa / /bsla ngas na nor bu ma ṇirma ṇi/ /pu tra dā ra sha rī rā di na de yo ta su ki tsa na/ /i ti madhri ba tsaḥster ba nyid/ /bu dang chung ma 'u sa la so gas/ /de yi 1 sbyin min ci yang med/ /de skad blon po'i tshig shu tā ta the tya ra dhwa rya tse ta se/ / sa dī dzādma ṇi yadzñā yi bi sa sardza thos nas/ /sems la de bzhin brtan 1 byas te/ /de yis slong phyir bram ze rnams/ /de yi drung du 95—46

ta darnyi shaṃ/ /asminda ba sa re rā dzā ma ṇi tsū ḍa : ren pa ṣpe/ /ma rī tse rā brdzangs/ pa/ra gyur/ /skabs 'dir rgyal po gtsug na ni/ /nor bu nags su rgyu ba yis/ /thub pa ma rī shra mo pānta ma bā pa bi pu lam̐ mu ṣpeḥ/ /de ste padmā ba tī ta tra pha la mū khā tse'i 3 gnas kyi/ /nye 'khor yangs par phyin par gyur/ /der ni lha mo padma ldan/ /rtsa ba 'bras za'i dhri ti bra tā/ /pra dzaṭī bi dza ṣpe ddhā tā bi pe ṣpe mu ṣpe shā sa nāta/ /sa brtul zhugs bzung / /mi med nags/ su/ thub pa yis/2 / /bstan pa la sa ni 'jigs shing song / /rngon ba rimṛ ga yā yā tai j-i ṣṭa ka ṣṭa da shaṃ sh-i tā / /dzi 1 kṣu rnyiḥ kadza mā la 'gro ba'i sha ba ris / /sdug bsngal gnas 〉 bas/ bsten nga/ mthong / /'dzin par 'dod pa/sa 'dar nā tsu kro sha ka ru ṇa swa ram̐/ /ā kasbya ka ru zla krasdo ku ra lī kyu dzi to gyur cing / /snying rje rje 〉 da cho nges/ btab/ /kyi hud rgyal ngo/ gtsug na nor/ /zhes dang skyabs shes mi pa oṃ/ /hā rā dzadma ṇi tsū ḍi ti tra ya swe ti ra duḥs haṃ/ /sa ha sā bhi bzad nga/4/ /bya ni ku re re sgrogs/ bzhin/ /snying rjer cho nges grags 5pa/ thos / /mi bdag rgyugs/ pa/'i dru ta kādzñā da darsha dṛ pa tirni dzā/ /rāhu saṃ tā se ta gyesdorlu timbi pa nyi 'phral 6la ni/ /rang gi mdzes ma mthong gyur te/ /zla ba sgra gcan gyis skra ga pa/ /'od ni rnam par tā mi ba / /bī ta rā gī ga ba sa dzñā ni rañdza na pa ri gra haṃ / /nyams nga/ bzhin/ /chags/ bral lus kyi gos 'dzin cing / /mig sma na yongs su 'dzin dang bra' / /ba dadhī mi baṃ saṃ sgo ga saṃ yo gā nā ma mbi tya tī/ /tī rā dza haṃ sa su ga rdzogs pa'i lo ngas spyod kun sbyor rnams/ /mi rtag nyid du smra ba bzhin/ /rgyal po ngang pa bde bar tsā bi hā ra sta na mā ṇḍa dzee / / a shu kā ṣā ya nā ya dzee bi lo gshegs—/ /nu ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gnas/ /'dren byed mchi ma'i ngur smrig can/ /snying rje'i kya ka ru zla ba dī/ /saṃ sā ra tsa ri tābyarya bi tsa re ṣṭa pi karka shaṃ/ /kṛ sa de rnam gzigs nas/ /'khor ba'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /rnam par spyod la sra gyur kyang / /sa 95—47

pā kṛ pā bhā nidzee na mi ba khyu pa terma naḥ/ /e kā ki rgo ba ṣpe de bī bi bdag yid ni brtse ba yi/ /chu gris nges par bcad pa bzhin/ /lha mo mgon med lta bu yis/ /nags ga tatstsha tra tsā ma re/ /dṛṭī nā tha ma nā bye ba lo ka nā dzee ta thā ga tai/ /su mgon po gcig pu nyid/ /'jig rten mgon po de ltar song / /gdugs dang rnga yab bral mthong nas//tabyi yo ga bi ṣā krānta tadrwarsha na ra sā ku lā/ /sho ka harṣa sa mā tīrṇa ba de bral dug gis non pa dang / /de mthong nyams dga' rgyas pa dag /mya ngan dga' ba yang dag rdzogs//byu ba j-i sha bi two khā/ /sāmbi tāḥs ba rā rā rnye shā pa dī ta pra du dru myur du rnam par 'khrugs par gyur/ /rgyal po ①zhi bgyis sha ba ri/ /dmod pas 'jigs nas rab tu shuḥ / /na nā ma byu da ye bhā no nd+raṣṭi sa pra ti sgo ta maḥ/ /a tānta re sha bros—/ /nyi ma mngon par 'char ba yis/ /mthu ldan mun pa dman gyur mthong / /bar 'dir zhi la ma dwo ྾ sarba bhū tā sha yā sha yaḥ/ /mā raḥpu ru ṣa rū pe ṇa sa me sdang ba'i bdud/ /'byung po kun gyi bsam par gnas/ /skyes bu'i gzugs kyis yang dag 'ongs/ /mi tya dṛ pa ma shra bīta/ /rā dzā: dzre ba na ya rmā thra yī pra ṇa yi bhā mi rmā/ /na tyathi bdag la ni smras par gyur/ /rgyal po chu skyes spyan ldan dag /mi med nags su dga' ma ni/ /phreng ldan marta gya dza ṣpe ba ṣpe ba na dza lo tsa na/ /i yo hi te ma no thra ti mig can ④mnyes gshin ma/ /'di ni gtang ①bar mi 'os so/ /rgyal srid longs spyod kyis spangs nas//ri ba niḥsu kha hūṃ ga tā/ /brdzi tā rā bye sgo ge na rā dza rā dza na rā dza te/ /nges par bde med gyur pa 'di/ /khyod kyi yid kyi spyod tshul bzhin/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po mi mdzes so//e ta dā kabye dṛ pa tiste bi dzñā ya ma no byu ba/ /anta rā yi bi be ka gya de dag thos shing dbeen pa yi④/ /bar du gcod byed yid byung ⑤du/ /rnam par shes te mi bdag gis//pā tya bhā ṣi ta sa smi taḥ/ /dzā nā mi tā ma haṃ kā ma ma kā oṃ sha ma saṃ ya me//'dzum bcas de la lan smras pa/ /dul la zhi ba mi 'dod pa'i/ /'dod pa khyod ni bdag gis shes//95—48

saṃ to ṣa bā saṃ ko nā pa bha ba tā na bi mo hi taḥ/ /i ti bā di ni bhū pā le rab tu sim par 'dod pa rnams/ /su zhig khyod kyis rnam mi rmongs/ /sa skyong de skad brjod pa yis//sa ha sānta ri tai sma re/ /ba bhū ba bi kla bā de bī tabhā bi ra ha ba sgo 'phral la 'dod pa mi snang gyur/ /'bral ba'i me yis gdungs pa yisahu)/ /lha mo shin tu rnam par nda—/ /duḥkhi tāddhā marta duḥkhā pa ti sgo ga pi yo gi mee/ /u bā tsā 'khrugs/ /yid byung ①las rgyal rgyal po yi①/ /btsun mo bdag po longs spyod bral/ /sdug bsngal mi shwa sa ya ṭwā dzā dzā yī dzi ta ma no bha ba/ /de ba dhahma kṛ ya yulnga na sho ka 'os sdug bsngal ldan/ /de la dbugs ni 'byin zhing smras/ /lha mo chos ni bya bar rigs/ /mya ngan bya kartu marta si/ /duḥkhā pa pa ni bi ra saḥsabaṃ yo su kha bi bhra maḥ/ /de hi bar mi 'os so/ /bde bas rnam par 'khrul pa yis④/ /ro bral mjug ni sdug bsngal yin/ /lus can dzā da yi tā saṃ gāsta ram̐ ga ta ra lā yu ྾/ /lo la padma pa lā shā gra slu ladzdza ma tshe ni rgyug chu 'dra/ /g.yo ba rnams kyi snying sdug grogs/ /padma g.yo ba'i 'dab rtse na/ /'breng ⑤ba'i chu la bā ku khāḥ/ /i mā rū snurta nārta kyaḥkāl me gha ta ḍilla tāḥ/ /saṃ thigs lta bu yin/ /dpal 'di yud tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin glog 'khyug pa dang / /'khor sā ra sadzee ra sa nā bi lā sa tsa pa lā shri yaḥ/ /sgo ga kṣa kho ṣpe ba bi yo ga ro gāḥba'i sbrul gyi duro 'dzin ni/ /rnam par rtse bzhin ④rab tu g.yo/ /longs spyod skad cig kho nas 'bral bi khyu ta yaḥswasna bi bā ha tu spyoḥ/ /bā tā ha tā dī pa shi khā su kha shrī ba'i nad/ /'byor pa rmi lam bag ma len dang mtshungs/ /bde ba'i dpal ni rlung bsnun mar me ④rtse//tudmatta dṛtrī bha ba thratta me tata/ /sarbo pa jo byā ka ru ṇa na lasmri sadhend+ra srid pa'i spyod tshul 'di dag smyon pa'i gar/ /snying rje kun byis bsten bya dpal 'byor min/ /dam chos pra kā shaḥs tan na dī pāḥ/ /ya shaṃ si ra myu ni na yo ba nā ni sbi rā ṇi rtag tu gsal byed ⑨mar me min/ /grags snyan rnams kyis dga' ldan na chung min/ /bsod nams dag 95byed49

pu rgyu ni na dzre bi tā ni/ /sa tya pra tastu mi ti sā twa yi tā bi mṛ bye ni brtan ldan 'tsho ba min/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ni de la de skad gdams/ /drang srong chen dzā yo ni la yasma hasteḥ/ /tsa tsā ra saṃ sā ra pa rārlu khā ram̐ saṃ to po'i 'dul ba btsun mo rnams btang nas/ /'khor ba las ni phyir phyogs rnams kyi dka' thub nags//ṣa pu bye 6 ta po ba ṣpe 6 / / ta thā ga tā ste twa ra yā yang dag bsel ①byed bsod nams ldan par rgyu zhing song / /rgyal po shin tu bzod dkas myur bar bi mṛṣṭhaḥpañtsa dī dzā dund+ra sa he na rā dzñā/ /ta mabee nā me ka ma kā gnyis skyes lnga/ /rnam par btang zhing de bzhin song bas ①des/ /rnam dag snying stobs slong ba rnams la bahūṃ bi shudha satwa da dṛ shurba nārnyi/ /te swaste bā rda sa na ṣperbi dhwa kyi ni/ /dus med gnyen gcig po de nags mthar mthong / /'jigs nas brtan pa rnam par btang ba ya bi shasta byerlu i ba sa dhwa se na/ / ta spru tsi re sru tsi ta tī bra bzhin—/ /de dag gis ni sgra bskyungs shis brjod bsgrubs/ /shugs ring ①ring zhing dro ba'i rjorlung dag tā pā dīsgoṣṭa ni shā sa sa mbi ra ṇi na/ /rā dza na pu re duḥpra sa ha su rā dzñāḥgis—/ /mi bzad gdung ba bsal ⑤byas de la smras/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka'i grong khyer du//ku ro pa sargahai ta shānta brgaḥ/ /dza naḥkṛ taḥkṛtta sa mapta kā maḥpra rgyal po drag po'i rjonyer 'tshes dge tshogs bcom/ /skye bo'i 'dod pa mtha' dag chad par byas/ /rab kā ma mārta swa na mā tra she ṣaḥ/ /a she ṣa do ṣa pra sha bee ka he tuste lo 'dod gzir ④ba'i sgra tsam lhag mar gyur/ /skyon rnams ma lus zhi ba'i rgyu gcig pu/ /'jig rten kya rakṣa pra thi ta pra bhā baḥ/ /tsū ḍā ma ṇirde ba bha ba dī dī ṇaḥka ro ti gsum bsrung grags pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /gtsug gi nor bu lha khyod gnang ⑧ba na/ /de yis rjonye bar 'tshe ta spyo pa ni pā ta shārnyi ma/ /da yā dzu ṣabyunda na palla bādroḥswatshwa sha yā byand+ra rnams zhi bar bgyid/ /brtse bas bstan ⑩pa tsandan yal 'dab brlan pa dang / /dri med bsam pa zla 95—50

ma ṇi pra kā shaḥ/ /saṃ tā pa kā le sha ra rde dza nā dzā bha ba byi dhwa ba'i nor bu rab gsal ba/ /khyod nyid lta bu yongs su gdung ba'i dus su ni/ /srid par ①skye bo rnams e ba bha be bha brnyi/ /i tyabee taste ra bi lupta satāḥsaṃ pūrya mā ṇaḥkyi skyabs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de dag gis ni de skad bslangs la snying stobs rnams④/ /rnam par ma bri ka ru shā ra se na/ /u bā tsa saṃ tsind+ra dza no pa tā paṃ saṃ krānta mantaḥsnying rje'i ro yis yang dag khengs/ /thos pa'i lam nas skye bo'i nye bar gdung ba dag /khong du yang dag shu ti ba tpa ṣpe ba / / a ho sa rā dza sa ha te ka tha nda de bo zhugs bzhin legs par bsams nas smras/ /kye ma ma la nye bar 'joms pa'i las kyis ni/ /nges par pa ghā te na ni spru ḍi tā rmā/ /nirda ri tāntaḥka ra rṇa pra dzā rmā bi yo gzir ba'i skye rgu ④bral ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /rab skyes cho nge'i sgra ni nang gi byed pa dag /nges par ga duḥkhodzha ba mārta nā rda/ /a yi ma ṇisthāsta ka spru la dzadmā naskṛ tya 'joms pa rgyal po des ni ji ltar bzod/ /bdag gi mgo yi rtsa ba las skyes nor bu 'di/ /myur du nges tūṇḍi pra ti kṛ khya tī me/ / dha sngasmi ya byebee dza na gya duḥkha kṣa ye par chod la rab tu bzung rjobar gyis/ /gal te skye bo slong ba'i sdug bsngal 'dzad ⑤pa yi/ /rgyu nyid du kṣa rṇa kā ra ṇa tsā bra dzā mi/ /i kyukta mā tre ba su dhwa dhi pe na jo ra dha ni skad cig bdag 'gro bdag legs so/ /nor 'dzin bdag pos de skad smras tsam la/ /sa 'dzin chu dzā bo dhi ma tī dha ri ṭī/ / tsi ram̐ tsa kambi tsa ki te ba ta su shi rasta ṭotyā gter dang bcas 'dzin ma ni/ /de yi spyi bo 'gems pa'i sdug bsngal dag /drag pos 'jigs pa bzhin ṭa na tī bra duḥkhāta/ /ta taḥkṛ pā ko ma la tsitta thrantist+rikyā shasterba tsa sā 1 du ring zhig 'dar/ /de 'og mi bdag thugs spyod brtse ba yis/ /mnyen pa'i gsung gis rab rno mtshon pa gya/ /su tī kyā sha tra da pi tīkyā tsittaḥswa yo shi raḥpā ṭa yi rtu pra thraṭwāḥ//pas kyang / /rno ba'i sems ldan de rnams mtshon rnon gyis/ /rang nyid spyi bo 'gems la rab tu zhugs//95byed51

ta duḥka ram̐ karma na re shwa ra gya byosna bi mā nairna li nā sa nā ryaḥ/ /su rig 'dzin grub pa sgrub hubacas lha rnams ni/ /padma'i stan sogs mkha' yi gzhal yas nas/ /mi rāḥs bi byā dha ra sedhe sā rgyaḥs mā ya yudṛju ma lubee sa two/ /bi pā rgya mā dbang de yi dka' spyad mdzad pa la/ /snying stobs ma zhum blta phyir yang dag 'ongs/ /'phral la spyi bo ṣpe shi ra se sra sa hra ratna pra bhā bi bhra ma mā da jo ṣpeḥ/ /sa rakṣa pū ri ra bhe rnam par bkas pa yis/ /rin chen 'od du rnam par 'khrul 'dzin pa'i/ /khrag gi rgyun gyis mngon ṣikta kā yaḥse te bya thā mabee su khe pra dṛtta ཿ/ /bi lo kya tai sa twa gtor lus can de/ /slong ba'i bde la rab zhugs gdung ba bzod/ /sdug bsngal drag po'i shugs kyis ni padha byerya tī bra bya tha bee ga ni mbi li tā kṣ-i/ /ya yurngi rā rmā na dṛ shaṃ pra mig zum zhing / /brtan pa'i ②snying stobs kyis bcings de mthong ste/ /skad cig srin po nyid ni thob pa bṛbyebee pāḥkṣa rte rākṣa sa tā ma bābhāḥ/ /bi tsārya rā dzā swa sha rī ra duḥbazhin—/ /gtum spyod bram ze dga' dang bral ma gyur/ /rgyal pos rang lus sdug bsngal rnam dpyad pas//khaṃ saṃ sā ri rde gre sha mā yo sha rī ram̐/ /e baṃ bi byerduḥkha sa ha sra lakṣe 'khor ba pa rnams nyon mongs rang bzhin lus/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i sdug bsngal stong 'bum gyi④/ /zil rā krānta mi tyārta ta ro ba byu ba/ /so tsinta ya da de ha ni badha radmā gyis mnan ces ④rab tu gdung bar gyur/ /des bsams lus bcings rin chen byin khyepa las//dā ṣpe yahphu 5 pha lasma yāste/ / te no gra duḥ khaṃ ka la yā mi mā bsod nams 'bras bu bdag (7gis gang thob des/ /bsod nams min smin dmyal bar mi rnams kyi⑦//byu pu sgo pā ke na ra ke na rā rde/ /sa murjo te rakta bā sā ba siste tasmidma ṇi drag po'i sdug bsngal cha yang med par gyur/ /khrag dang zhag gis nges bran nor bu de/ /g.yo med mtshog 2nibya la tā lu mū khāta/ /mūrngo ku lo pi tra ya yo sa harṣa saṃ pū ra bee nābee ma'i rtsa ba las bton pa'i/ /brgyal bas 'khrugs kyang slong ba'i re ba dag /yongs su rdzogs pas de ni 95—52

ma no ra the na/ /sa kadza mā ram̐ gu li pabee bee na da tā swa haste na ma ṇi dī rab dgar gyur/ /gnyis skyes rnams la rang gi lag sor byu①/ /yal 'dab 'dar bzhin nor bu byen dze bhyaḥ/ /ni mbi la yan santa ma se na lo ke pa ta tihūṃ shu ri bā ti raktaḥ/ /nas de/ /yang dag mun pas 'jig rten 'dzum byed cing / /tsha zer can bzhin shin tu dmar bar lhung ③//a lupta sa te pa ti te thra thi dhyā tasmin su rā rde sa ha puju barṣaḥ/ /ma ṇi sa lha rnams me tog char dang lhan cig tu/ /snying stobs bri ba med pa'i ①sa der lhung / /gnyis skyes de mā dā ya yurdi dzāste rūrghaṃ pu ram̐ dudzee sa ha gya rā dzhaḥ/ /sa te na sarya sa rnams nor bu yang dag blangs/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka'i grong khyer song / /de yi ④ 'phral la nye bar mi to pa sargaḥsargo tsi tā sā di tasgo ga brgaḥ/ /tasgo bye satwa gya sa 'tshe rnams zhi/ /mtho ris 'os pa'i longs spyod tshogs rnams thob/ /sems can mtha' dag yang dag mabee satwa sant+ra ra rjahaṃ pra shaṃ sa two/ /a tā nta re ki tsi da bāpta saṃ sgrol 'os pa/ /byang chub sems de'i snying stobs de yis bsngags/ /skabs 'dir mi dbang 'du shes cung snyo na re shwa re bikhru ta ratna dā rna/ /sa mā ya yuṭwārga ba gau ta mā byā zad thob/ /ji gu'i bu dang go'u ⑤ta ma ⑥sogs/ /ma rī tse dzeesogs thub pa nags tshal las/ /rin ma rī tse mu khyu mu na yoḥb ṣpe bhyaḥ/ /ma rī tse me bā nu ga ta tsa de bī padmā chen byin ⑧pa thos nas yang dag 'ongs/ /lha mo pad ldan ma rī tsi ⑨nyid kyis/ /rjes bzhin song bas ba tī bīghra pa ri kā tarnyi/ /sasmo ha bee gā snyi ha tā pa pā ta kṣa rde kṣi to yongs brlag ⑨de mthong nas/ /kun rmongs shugs kyis mngon bcom sa la ni/ /'khri shing gzhon nu ba la la tai ba phru nā/ /di ganta saṃ tsā ri ṇi tsā ra shā rmā na bha swa rā rde dṛ bcad bzhin skad cig 'gyel/ /de nas mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha rnams kyi⑪/ /mi bdag legs brjod phyogs pa sā dhu pā de/ /sa rā dza pu tāḥs ha madhri mu khyeḥpra dzā na tha ma tho ba dzagruḥ//mthar rgyu ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po'i sras de blon dang lhan cig tu/ /skye rgu skye rgu'i ⑫mgon can nye bar song //95—53

bīghra kṣi tī shaṃ kṣa ta dzo kṣi hūṃ ga ma kṣi ṇa sa two pa ti lta thra thi rghaṃ/ /thra thu khrag gis lus bsgos snying stobs ma zad cing / /sa yi dbang po sa la 'gyel mthong nas/ /nyon mongs bya thā kle sha dzu ṣe dza nā nā ma khyu da byu tāza bi kalpa dzalngaḥ/ /ku ṣṭha ri kaiḥgadung ba che ldan skye bo rnams/ /yang dag min ①don rnam rtog brjod par gyur①/ /rang don la chags kaibye da ho da yādzraḥsaṭwāzi pe byaḥs ra laḥsu bṛ taḥ/ /du rādma rnyiḥmangon sbyor bdag nyid ngan/ /shing gcod ①'ga' yis snying rjes brlan ldan zhing / /slong kun gyis swārja la bā bhi yuste: yā ta ruḥkaṣṭa ma yo ni kṛttaḥ/ /a ho pa rā tho spru bsten drang zhing legs spyod pa'i/ /kye ma nyam dungar grib bsil shing 'di bcad/ /kye ma pha rol don du ta dzre bi to yi pa ram̐ tsa maṭwā ra da shaṃ pra yā taḥ/ /sa sau ra bha khyunda ta nu rgi hūṃ tai srog gtong 'di/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gnas skabs dag tu song / /shin tu dri bzang rang gi lus gcod bha ba tyā dā ra sa hā kā ra e ba/ /lubha su na swaḥswa dza no pi dzarnyorna kā ma pa—/ /yid 'ong shing ni sa ha ka ra nyid/ /brkam chags srog chags rang gi yin yang rang ma yin kā ma gya dha de nu ro dhaḥ/ /sarpādma nā satwa nyi todma ta su de ho pi 'dod pa'i du'adod pa nor ngor min/ /sems can kun la phan brtson bdag nyid can/ /brtse ldan de na sgo ha pa rda da yā loḥ/ /ye ṣā kṛ ti n+ya ma yi pra yā ti sarpārba nābhābee dza yi lus kyang chags gnas min/ /gang don slong skye 'di ni slong ba'i dngos/ /kun don gnyer la zhum rjonobee bhā ram̐/ /ta e ba dī nodha ra ṇa pra tā rmā pā ṇḍaḥpa ri tā ṇḍa pa ṇi tro rja ni/ /par rab 'gro ba/ /zhum pa 'don pa'i brtul zhugs can gyi srog /de nyid yongs su skyob zong rtswa lta yin//i ti pra bā de bi bi dhwa nu bhā pe bi dzrembha mā ṣpe mu ni maṇḍa la gya/ /byu pā la de skad rab brjod rnam mang mthu yis ni/ /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phel ba'i tshe/ /ma rī tse ⑦ma bye tya sa bātpa tsakṣuṣṭha nind+ra rī tseḥpra ṇa yā du bā tsa/ /a ho nu nishī ra ṇa thub mchi mar bcas pa'i spyan/ /chags pas sa skyong la ri mngon phyogs smras/ /kye ma ma la rgyal po'i skye 95—54

bantu bhā ba mā lo bya rā dzan da ya yā dza na gya/ /pra dzā pa ri tā ṇa ni dhwa na byu mi rgu ①rnams/ /yongs skyob ⑤gter gyi sa gzhi 'gro ba yis①/ /rgyu med gnyen gyi dngos por bsten byas ta nusta ye yi tro ṇa bad bi tīrṇa/ /kṣa yo pra thratta ni ra pekṣa thrasbyista nas—/ /khyod kyi dubartse bas lus 'di rtswa bzhin byin/ /slong ba'i gnyen khyed ⑤rang nyid srog la yang //bā— brnyoni dzā dzre bi te pi/ /ya de ṣa kā ma ka ma lā ni kā yaḥkā ltos pa'i spyod tshul zad par nges rab zhugs/ /gang zhig dpal 'byor gnas kyi lus 'di ni/ /khyod yasta yā pā ya pa de ni yuktaḥ/ /a pyaste rā dzan su kri ta bra te smin pha la kyis gnod pa'i gnas su yang dag sbyar/ /rgyal po legs byas brtul zhugs bsod nams kyi/ /zong 'di smṛ hā pā ṇḍa pa ṇi pi kā tsita/ /a gyabee te tosta ba tā lu bhe da khe dāta bi las kyang 'bras 'ga' bzhed las drang rjo/ /slong ba'i rgyus kyang khyod kyi mtshog ⑦ma phye/ /skyo las thugs kā ram̐ bha dza te na tse taḥ/ /i tyabyu tā bi skṛ ta mā na se na mu —nd+ra ma bye kyi rnam 'gyur ma bsten nam⑧/ /thub dbang dbus su thub pas de skad du/ /rmad byung ⑨mtshar ba'i mu ni nā sa thraṣṭaḥ/ /u bā tsa saṃ ste bhya ru dzee pra yaṭwā da raghā bhi ṣis+ho ba yid kyis dris pa des/ /'bad pas ngal dub bzod byas khrag gis ni/ /mngon par sbags pa'i bzhin da rna pra mṛ bye/ /pha la smṛ ha nā ste mu ṣpe ma mā n+ya kirnye ka e ba pra ras ⑩phyis nas smras/ /thub pa bdag la 'bras 'dod gzhan ma mchis/ /'on kyang mngon 'dod gcig tsu ro bhi lā saḥ/ /yad gho ra saṃ sā ra ni masna dzantu saṃ ta ra ṇa ma ba bha be nyid rab tu mang / /gang zhig srog chags 'jigs rung 'khor bar bying / /sgol byed nyid du srid par bha bee yi/ /abee pre ye de ha bi dā ra ṇi mirje bāste me ko pi bee kā ra le bdag gyur cig /slong ba dga' bar lus ni rnam bcom 'dir/ /rnam 'gyur cha shas gang yang med pa shaḥ—/ /ya bye ṣa sa tya sa ma yom yoghrasta dastu swasru ma rda sha rī ram̐//nyid / /gal te ngas brjod dam tshig 'di bden na/ /de yis ⑪lus 'di rnal du gnas gyur cig/95byed55

i kyukta mā tre sa ha dzā nu bha be sa two tsi te sa tya dha no na rā dzñā/ /a bhūdma rgyal po bden nor ldan 'di brjod tsam la/ /snying stobs la 'os lhan skyes mthu ldan pa/ /bden pa'i pu sa tya ba le na ta gya ru zwa bra rde ta1 ṇa dzā ta rasne/ /ta taḥsu riḥstobs kyis de lus rma bsos ①shing / /de tshe skyes pa'i rin chen ldan par gyur/ /de nas brgya byen sha kra bee ri tsi mu khye dzā ta pra harṣarmu ni bhebyu sabyeḥ/ /a sgyubee to pi tshangs sogs lha rnams dang / /rab dga' skyes pa'i thub pa thams cad kyis/ /sa skyong slad du mngon kṣi ti pā la nā ya sgo gā bye khā sī na ba byu ba bhū baḥ/ /a pāpta saṃ dzñā mu ni par gsol btab kyang / /sa bdag longs spyod mngon par bzhed ma gyur/ /dran rnyed padma dang ldan nā pra mulnga padmā ba tī rā dza su te na rmā shaṃ/ /pa ti ya yā tse bi ra ho thub pa yis/ /rab bskul rgyal po'i sras dang 'grogs nas ni/ /skye rgu'i ②seng ge'i khrir bzhugs bde pa shābye dzi hā sa na kārnyi su khaṃ pra dzā rna/ /ta tasta ma bye tya kṛ pā ku lā ste ba la/ /'bral ba zhi slad bdag la gsol ba btab/ /de nas rang rgyal de rnams mngon phyogs te//pra hye ka buddhā dza ga to hi tā ya/ /de ha pra bhā pū ri ta disbi bhā gā ba 'gro la phan phyir brtsebs 'khrugs gyur te①/ /lus kyi 'od kyis phyogs cha khengs pa ni/ /dgyes pa bhā ṣi te harṣa mi boṅgi re taḥ/ /tsi rā da bāste bi ra hā ba sā de pu naḥpā gsal bar mdzad bzhin de la smras/ /bral ba'i mjug ni ring zhig lon nas thob/ /yang ni yongs ri tyā ga da shā ma sa dhī/ /na rā dza pu traḥs ha te na de bī duḥkhā nu gtong gnas skabs bzod dka' ba/ /gang phyir lan gcig min ltung sdug bsngal bcings/ /bzod pa brjo khya pa kṛndi pā taḥ/ /swa mabee ṣpe yaḥpra da dā ti de ha mā panda duḥkha pra sha rgyal po'i bus min lha mos min/ /rgud ldan sdug bsngal rab zhi'i rgyu gcig phu/ /rang lus slod la gang mai ka he tuḥ/ /ka rja sa kurlu ta swa dza ṣpe pyu pekṣ-i dasmo pya yo ya su gis rab sbyin zhing / /gang 'di buchos 'di'ang bugazhan don nyid na de/ /rang gi rjomi la'ang btang 95—56

pa rāza e ba/ /i hphuste mā kasbya na re shwa rastesta the ti ni— tya bye yā ka baṃ tsita//snyoms ji ltar bya/ /de dag gis ni brjod thos ①mi yi dbang / /blo yis de bzhin zhes des ji ltar yang //byo: bi mā ṣpeḥswa pu rī ma bā su sgo dza ni dzee rā bye pa rda sa pu tāḥ/ /i ti mkha' yi lam nas rang gi grong khyen phyin/ /sras bcas rang gi rgyal srid gnas rnams bsten/ /de ltar sa bi pu la satwaḥ satya ban bo bye satwaḥ su tsi ra pi nyi ta rā byeḥde ni snying stobs yangs shing bde ldan byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /shin tu yun ring rgyal srid bzung zhing sau ga tā nā ma sgo dze/ /dzi na pu ra ma ṇi tse tya tstsha tra ratna bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas bsten nas/ /rgyal ba'i grong khyer rin chen mchod rten gdugs dang rin pra dī pa pra ka ṭi ta bi bee dha shrīrla kṣa rja bhyasta bo dhiḥ/ /i chen sgon ma ni/ /rab tu gsal ba rnam mang dpal gyis mtshan pa'i byang chub goms par gyur/ /yang tyā ha bha ga bān bu dhaḥ swa dṛ ṭwā nta ni darsha naiḥ / / dā no dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dge slong rnams la sbyin pa'i gdams ngag tu/ /rang gi pa de sha rnyi khyu rde sa mya kle bo bye si dha ye / / i ti spyod tshul mtha' ni dper mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'di ⑤skad gsungs/ /zhes pa kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa ①brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las/ma ṇi tsū ḍā ba dā rna nā ma tro tī ya pabee baḥ// //gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ④ste gsum pa'o// //sho bhadhe byu ba ṣpe 6 bha bya ma na saṃ yand+ra ka kāddhā ka ra gang zhig mtho ris mdzes ma'i lag pas mchog tu rab bskyod mdzes pa'i rnga yab dag dang ni//95—57

thra rto da— ta tsā ru tsā ma ra se ta tstsha tra smi tāḥsaṃ pa daḥ/ /gdugs dkar 'dzum pa'i phun tshogs dag gis 'jig rten na ni legs ldan thugs ni rnam mdzes dang //yastsotparba ti tabee ta khru nyi ya shaḥ kathu ra pū rodzdza lo swalpa dā nā ka gang yang grags snyan ga pur rgyun gyis khyedri med thos pa sim byed rab tu 'phro ba dag /sbyin pa'i cha shas de ṇa su tatpa la ma ho dā āoṃ ni dā na shri yaḥ/ /a bhū du po ṣa sgo nā ma 'bras shin tu chung ngu'o e ma sbyin pa dpal gyi dang po'i rgyu/ /'o ma'i mtsho ⑤las bdud rtsi bzhin//bhū j-itpa su bi bhā ba te/ /bi bu dhwa bhi ma tā tīrtiḥsu dhwa dusto da mkhas rnams mngon 'dod grags pa yis/ /gang zhig rnam gsal sa 'dzin ni/ /gso sbyong 'phags zhes ①dhe ri ba/ /ba su ṅgā ma ba to ya mya ba su dhwa ma ba taḥpu raḥ/ /na nā ma bya ba byung / /nor 'dzin bsrung ba nor dang ni/ /gzi brjid ldan pa gang mdun du/ /mi yi bdag pra ṇa to ka gya na nā ma dṛ pa teḥshi raḥ/ /shuddhā dhī ri ba dharme ṇa dā ṣpe ṣpe ba po'i spyi bo dag /nges par phyag la sus ma btud/ /chos kyis dag pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /sbyin pas brtse da yā lu tā/ /bi bhū tebee na ye ṣpe ba bhū ṣi tā ye na bhū ra bhūta/ /gu ba ldan nyid bzhin/ /dul bas rnam par 'byor pa bzhin/ /gang gis sa ni brgyan par gyur/ /yon ṇi naḥpri shu baṃ sha su ba bhū bend+ra dku teḥsbi taḥ/ /ya su sarpā ta pa tra mya mūsnyi tan kun ldan rigs su mtho/ /kun gyi gdung skyob zla ba'i 'od/ /gang gi gnas pa'i spyi bor gyur/ /sa saza ma tī dzdza tai/ /ya phye shwa ra shi raḥsthā yi shu rja gi gā dza lodzdza lo//yi bdag po kun gyi'o/ /gang gi ④grags pa 'jig rten rgyan/ /dkar zhing dbang phyug spyi bor gnas//bhra me tyad rja lo ke 6 bhū ba nā bha ra khaṃ ya shaḥ/ /kartuḥkra tu sa ha sru rghaṃ sa dri med gang bā'i chu bo ni/ /rab mang 'jig rten rnams su rgyu/ /mchod sbyin stong gi byed pa po/ /mig ha sru 7 bye ka shri yaḥ/ /ya su ṣakhye sa ha sru ṇi ka la tram̐ su dṛ shā ma khyuta/ /ka stong pa las lhag pa'i dpal/ /gang gi btsun mo lha mjos ni/ /stong phrag drug cu byung bar gyur/ /nam 95—58

dā tsi ta mu ni rakṣa yi rakṣi kṣa ya kṛ ta kṣa ṇaḥ/ /bi tsa tsā rā shwa mā ru zhig drang srong bsrung ba'i phyir/ /srin po gzhom ①par dam bcas nas/ /dka' thub nags kyi ⑤sa la khya sa ta po ba na bhū mi 6/ /ta tra rā dzākṣi bhiḥkai —ta pu treji ka la shaṃ dhri de—/ /rta la zhon nas rnam par rgyus/ /rgyal po ①drang srong 'ga' yis der/ /bu yi mchod sbyin bum pa tai—/ /dru rā dhwa shra ma santa ptaḥpa pa yaḥpūrṇa mā pa po/ /bi dza na sā di tai bzhag /lam ring gis ngal dub pa des/ /chu yis gang ba 'thungs par gyur/ /skye bo med par rnyed pi tā sa mant+ra ka la shātpa yaḥ/ /rā dza dhwa dī sa mā sā rya garghaṃ le bhe pa'i chu/ /sngags kyi bum pa las 'thungs nas/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'ongs pa na/ /sa yi bdag pos bi khyusgo baḥ/ /swasna mā yend+ra dzā lā di ya gyaḥkau tu ka bi pru ṣaḥ/ /dza ya tyad mngal thob gyur/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig rjo'aphrul sogs/ /gang gi dultad mo'i zer ma ni/ /rmad byung yang bhu ta saṃ bhā ra bhū miḥsā bha bi ta bya tā/ /bi dherbi bi dha bai tsi tya tsi dag tshogs pa'i sa/ /brnag par bya ste ⑥rgyal gyur cig /mtshar ba'i las kyis rnam bskrun pa/ /sgrub tra karma bi dmā yi naḥ/ /a stsarya re khā bi tyā saṃ kaḥpa ritstshabhu mbi shwa raḥ//byed sna tshogs rnam par bkra/ /ngo mtshar ri mo bkod pa la/ /gcod par byed pa'i dbang phyug ⑦su//kā le nata gya mūddhā oṃ rnyi tā bā lopho shu mā ni ba/ /rū bhā bra ṇa gya sa ha sā di dus kyis de yi spyi bo ni/ /rdol nas byis pa nyi ma bzhin/ /mdzes sdug 'od ldan skyes gyur te/ /'phral bye dku ti ra dzā yata/ /tai rā dzā dzā yā dza kṛ hurdza gta sa spra bye lakṣa la rma ni rab tu bsos⑧/ /bsod nams gzugs la brten pa bzhin/ /'gro ba'i yang dag rgyal po'i ṇi—/ /bātpa lya pra stu ta kra bāḥpu bye mūrta mi bā shri tai/ /rmā dhwa ra yi mtshan—/ /ldan pa de ni mnyes gshin las/ /nu zags rgyal po'i btsun mos blangs/ /byis pa bsngags 6 ti shi shuḥshā bhyo ya dza na byā pa de/ /i ti tā sī mi tho bā kyesthāddhā tā 'os 'di yi ni/ /ma yi gnas su bdag gyur ces/ /de rnams phan tshun tshig gis ni/ /rgyal sras nga 95—59

byu ta dṛ pādma dzaḥ/ /ta gya pra badzha mā ṇa su bā la spri ḍā bi khā se naḥ/ /ṣa ḍind+raḥlas ①nu zhes gyur/ /dbang po drug ni rab 'das dus/ /bsod nams kyis rtsen ①mi zad tshe/ /de ni pra ya yo kā la pu rgya shrī ḍā kṣa yā yu ṣaḥ/ /na ba yo ba na mā rū byeḥrab tu bskyed ldan zhing / /byis pa'i rtse dgas rnam par rol/ /lang tsho gsar par ①rab zhugs te//saza beebyā su pā ra gaḥ/ /sa yā te pi ta ri swargo bhe dze rā bye kra mā ga rig gnas kun byi pha rol phyin/ /yab ni mtho ris gshegs la nges/ /rim pas 'ongs pa'i rgyal srid tai—/ /yasgo di bo ka so nā ma su kṛ te dī sa hūṃ ga taḥ/ /a bhi bzung / /legs byas kyis duni 'bangs gyur pa'i/ /gnod sbyin mkha' yi khyim zhes pas/ /de yi ṣe ko pa ka ra khaṃ di bye ta sro pa nī ta bān/ /sa swartezadha mu ku dbang bskur yo byad rnams/ /mchog ni nye bar bsgrubs par gyur/ /gser gyis bcings pa'i cod pan ṭaḥkalpi to: ṣa she ṣa raḥ/ /sa ra da bhā ba tai pa gya me roḥsho bhā ma dang / /gtsug tor zur phud byas pa des/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi rna cha can/ /lhun po'i mdzes pa thob bāpta bān/ /sapta ratna ni ta snga tha pā duspyo tā ni ta1 bee/ /tsakrā shwa ma ṇi haste dang ldan/ /de nas de yi rin chen bdun/ /de tshe byung gyur 'khor lo rta/ /nor bu glang po bud med byā kṛ ha se nā gra gā n+ya pi/ /ba bhū ba tsā su pu rpā rde tu phya dang / /khyim bdag dmag dpon sngon 'gro ba'o/ /sa bdag 'di yi bu rnams ni/ /gzugs dang byu pa ba lo dza sī/ /sa ha sri bi dzi tā rā tespyo dzā nā mi ba bhū bhu dzaḥ/ /stobs dang gzi brjid mtshungs/ /dpung pa bzhin du dgra 'joms pa/ /stong phrag dag ni byung bar gyur//ba sundha dzā sa mabhātri bee khā kā li ta le kha dzee/ /ni khi dzee bi da dhe lhag ma ngal bas bder gnas pa/ /mtha' dag chu gter rlabs kyi ni/ /ske rags ldan pa'i nor 'dzin doṣṭi she ṣa bi shārnyi nidṛ hūṃ/ /bhu ba nā ta pa saṃ nadhaḥpra tya gra ka ma / /ma lus dpung pas bzung bar gyur/ /sa ni bsrung bar chas gyur cing / /rab tu gsal ba'i 95—60

ma khā shra yaḥ/ /tsakra brti sa su kṛ taibeesgo ka ra i bā ba bye/ /tri dpal la gnas/ /'khor los sgyur de legs byas kyis/ /khyab 'jug lag pa bzhin du mdzes/ /grags dza gadzdza tna bi tīrteḥpra bhā bā bha ra rja shri yaḥ/ /so yo su kṛ ta ballī rmā pa 'gro gsum gang gā dang / /mthu yis rnam par brgyan pa'i dpal/ /'di de bsod nams 'khri shing gi//pra tha maḥku su moṅga maḥ/ /sa ka dā tsidma nārnye 6 bi kā si ku su ma shri yaḥ/ /me tog rab 'thon dang po yin/ /de ni nam zhig nags kyi mthar/ /blon po dag dang lhan cig tu//ru tsi dzā sa tsi baiḥsārnyombi tsa tsā ra bi lo ka yan/ /da darsha ta tra nitpakṣan me tog rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal/ /mdzes pa lta zhing rgyu bar gyur①/ /der ni 'dab ma med pa'i bya//bi ha shān pā da tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /byo ma mārga ga ti smṛ tyā pra yā tān kṛ sha tā mi rkang pas 'gro rnams mthong gyur te/ /mkha' yi lam bgrod dran pa yi/ /shin tu ring bar ①gyur pa ba—/ /pakṣa tī nā na ga ti kān thratrī kṣi rja: rasba rān/ /da ri bzhin/ /'dab mas dman zhing bgrod byed min/ /'tsho ba zad cing lus g.yogs med/ /de rnams dru ni ba tān bīkṣu thra ba tsa kṛ pa ya dṛ paḥ/ /a ho bā rā kai bi hā giḥki dbul po bzhin mthong nas/ /mi bdag brtse bas rab smras pa/ /kye ma sdug pa'i bya 'di rnams/ /ngan mi taiḥku kṛ tai kṛ tai/ /ya de te pakṣa bi ka khāḥkṛtstshartso ra ṇa tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /i pa'i bya ba ci zhig byas/ /gang las 'di dag sgro dang bral/ /dka' las rkang pas rgyu bar grur/ /snying kyuste bhū mi pa ti nā ka ru ṇḍa ku li tātpa nā/ /phu rasbi to ma hā mā tyaḥrjes 'khrugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /sa bdag gis de brjod pa la/ /blon po chen po bden pa'i sde//sa tya se nasgra ma bra bīta/ /khru ta me tad ma yā da ba ka tya mā rmā ba ṣpe tsā reḥ/ /mdun du 'dug ste de la smras/ /lha gcig 'dab chags rnams kyi 'dab/ /gang las bye bar gyur pa'i rgyu//kā ra khaṃ pakṣa pa da ṣpe ya da bhūtpakṣi rja mi ha/ /sarnyi pañtsa sha tā n+ya tra nags na spyod rnams gleng gyur pa/ /de dag bdag gis rab tu thos/ /dka' thub kha ton nus ldan pa//95—61

pu ju dhwasdi ta bo ba ṣpe/ /ta paḥswā dhyā ya shalnga rmā mu smi rghaṃ dī pta te thub pa gzi brjid 'bar ba ni/ /lnga brgya ①bsod nams gnas gyur pa'i/ /dka' thub nags tshal 'di dza shā/ /te ṣā ma rgya ya na dhyā na dza pa bi sna bi ṅgā yi naḥ/ /e te ko lā na yod/ /de dag gi klog bsam gtan dang / /zlos rjopa'i bgegs ni sgrub byed pa/ /shing gi nags la ha lo tsa kru kha gasta ru ba ṣpe sa dā/ /tamee bee ha ga saṃ ghā ya karte kā ya pa bya 'di rnams/ /rtag tu ca co sgrogs par gyur/ /rna bar mchog tu gnod pa dag /shin tu yang dag re khru te/ /a bhi saṃ badhe mā nā ya tsu ko pa mu ni maṇḍa laḥ/ /ta dusgru ta rgyas byed pa/ /bya yi 'dus pa de dag la/ /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor khros par gyur/ /des bskrun chen ma hā shā pa tā pa bla ṣa ṇa saza taḥ/ /kṣa ṇi na pakṣi rja pakṣu bya po'i dmod pa ni/ /sreg byed gdung ba thams cad du/ /gnod pa byas pa'i bya rnams kyi/ /'dab sīryanta kṛ tā sha sī/ /ta e te bi ha gāḥpakṣa ra nyi tā kṛsgo brti gshog skad cig gis zags gyur/ /bya ni 'di rnams de ①dag ste/ /sdug bsngal gyis 'tsho 'dab gshog naḥ—/ /swata bi bakṣa i ba ba ṣpe shāntabyu ra ṇa tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /ma hā mā bye na bral—/ /khyod kyi mi mthun phyogs bzhin du/ /ngal zhing nags su rkang pas rgyu/ /blon po chen pos ka thi tai ni sha bye tad ma tī ba tiḥ/ /u bā tsa ka ru ṇḍa krānta stabee shā pe brjod de dag /thos nas sa yi bdag po ni/ /bya rnams dmod pas gdungs pa la/ /snying rjes rab tu na pakṣi ṇḍi/ /a ho te dzaḥpa ri ṇa tai shānta nā ma pi kā na ṣpe/ /saṃ gā rā ṇḍi non pas smras/ /kye ma thub pa sol ④ba rnams/ /zhi bar gyur kyang nags su ni/ /yongs su gyur pa'i mu nī dzā tsa da ha hye bā ni bā ri tai/ /mi byā ta pa sri bhiḥki taiḥswa su me dag gis/ /mi zlog sreg par byed pa nyid/ /rang nyid bde phyir gang gi rjoyid/ /khro bas gdung la khā ya na yeḥkṛtaḥ/ /ma na sa ko pa tapta su pa ri ṣe kaḥkṣa rmā bhu bheḥ/ /pra sand+ra bhānd+ra bzod pa yi/ /chu yis rjoyongs su bran ma byas/ /log pa'i dka' thub can des ci/ /rab dang blo dang 95—62

no mi tram̐ da yā dā rna da maḥkṣa mā/ /ye ྾ te ྾ ta pa shā khye she byams pa'i yid/ /brtse ba'i sbyin pa dul zhing bzod/ /gang de dka' thub bsngags par 'os/ /lhag ṣa rde kā ya sho ṣa rde/ /ki ta po bhiḥs ko pā dzā bi plu tā dzā ba ṣpe na ma lus ni ①skoms pa nyid④/ /'jig tshogs 'dzin pa'i dka' thub ci/ /rnam par bslad la nags kyis ki—/ /bi bha beeḥki sa lo bhā āoṃ dudṛṭwā rmā shu te na ki/ /e baṃ ka lu ṣa ci—/ /chags dang bcas la 'byor pas ci/ /spyod tshul ngan la thos pas ci/ /de ltar sdig pa'i sems tsittaste tī bra mand+ra pa rā ma shāḥ/ /duḥs hā e ba mu na yaḥpra yāntu bi ldan zhing / /khro ba ①drag pos bskyod pa yi/ /bzod dka' thub pa de dag nyid/ /bdag gi yul nas ṣa yādma ma/ /i kyughā pā hi ḍoste bhyaḥsande shaṃ pu ru ṣi sgo pa/ /yā ba tī 'gro gyur cig /'di brjod de la mi bdag gis/ /ji srid bdag ni dbang ba'i sa/ /de srid gtang madma sā byu mistu ba tī tya dza tā mi ti/ /bi haṃ ga pakṣa pā te na ku bar byos shig ces/ /skyes bus 'phrin ④ni bsrings par gyur/ /bya yi 'dab gshog bye ba yis/ /khros pi ta mya ma tī pa teḥ/ /saṃ de shaṃ mu na yaḥkhru tā bi lakṣu sa ma tsinta yan//pas dhis yi bdag po de'i/ /'phrin buthos skyengs par gyur pa yi/ /thub pa rnams kyis yang dag bsams//tsa tuḥs mu dra pa ri khā me kha khā yāḥkṣi teḥpa tiḥ/ /na rejo yo kwa gatshwa maḥko rgya mtsho bzhi yi 'obs kyi ni/ /sko rags ldan pa sa yi bdag /yul gang mi bdag mi dbang la⑦/ /gang de she gye ba se na yaḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya mu na yaḥpārsha ka na ka khyu j-i taḥ//zhig bdag cag gang du 'gro/ /de ltar bsams nas thub pa rnams/ /gser gyi sa 'dzin dag gi ngos//su ra sernyi sa mā tīṇḍi dzo byu khaṇḍarnyi ka ya yuḥ/ /a tha ta gya ma tī bhartu lha dang grub pas yongs gang ba/ /dzasru'i phyogs dang nye bar song / /de nas sa yi bdag po de'i//pra bhā be na ma tī ya sa/ /a byu da kṛṣṭa sa tsu byu rarlobya raddhāsba ra pra sruḥ/ /mthu ni shin tu che ba yis/ /sa ni ma rmos byun byed cing / /mkha' yang rin chen gos skyed 'gyur①//95—63

pā ka shā sa na bai lakṣa ka ra ṇasta gya shā sa nāta/ /sabhā haṃ te ma smin pa gsod byed skyengs par ni/ /bgyid par de yi bstan ①pa las/ /sprin tshogs 'bebs par ba bṛ 6rme ghāḥsaṃ ghā ta barṣa ṇaḥ/ /sa pra bhā bee na ma hā tā sa ha bee byerna bgyid rnams kyis/ /zhag bdun gser gyi char pa phab/ /de yi mthu ni chen po yis/ /sde dang lhan cig sgo ga tiḥ/ /tsakra pūrba bi de hā khye dī paṃ di bya dza āoṃ ba she/ /ba khyu pu mkha' la phyin/ /shar rmi lus 'phags zhes bya'i gling / /mchog gi skye bo dbang du byas/ /de yi dmag ra gre bee n+ya sbyi ta saurya ba lo dza sī/ /bha ṭā rmā byo ma ga ma ṣpe ta dpon mchog dag ni/ /rtul phod stobs dang gzi rgyas pa/ /dpa' bo bye ba phrag bco brgyad/ /mkha' sngaṭwā da sha ko ṭa yaḥ/ /go dā nī yo ta to dī pa ma thotta ra ku rū na pi/ /pārsha ni la sngon du 'gro bar gyur/ /de 'og ba glang ④spyod gling dang / /de nas byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /lhun po yi sa su me robya sa shā sā ha ta shā sa naḥ/ /su khaṃ bi ha rasta sta mya ni ngos rnams kyang / /nyams med bstan nas bsrungs par gyur/ /brgya byin mang po 'das gyur dus//me roḥka na ka pā nu 6/ /ba hu sha kro ya yo kā labya tudī pa ma tī pa teḥ/ /sa lhun po gser gyi spyog la ni/ /gling bzhi'i sa yi bdag po de/ /bde ①bas rnam par rab tu rtse/ /nam ka dā tsita su rān dṛṣṭi byosnra gatstshan su ro pa maḥ/ /tsa kā ra bhā zhig lha rnams blta rjobazhed pas/ /lha bzhin mkha' la gshegs bzhin dude'i/ /sprin sngon gyis bzhin la dza la da byāpta i ba ga dzirdi shaḥ/ /a tha te hūṃ ni rasthā dzā me ru pārsha glang po yis/ /phyogs rnams rab tu khyab par gyur/ /de nas thub pa bskrad de rnams/ /lhun po'i ngos ta pa su hūṃ/ /mu nī nā ma pata ta rūtri tad ga dzā shwa pa kṛji baḥ/ /ta ta ste la dka' thub kyis/ /gnas pa'i spyi bor mkha' las ni/ /de yi rta glang sbangs rnams lhung / /de las kro dha santasnya dṛ shā byo mā ba lo ki naḥ/ /tsakruḥdzi ga pra bhā palli de rnams khro bas gdungs/ /mig gis mkha' la lta byed cing / /ser skya'i 'od kyis du'akhri shing gi⑦//95—64

ka lā pa ka pi lnga di shaḥ/ /ki me tasko pa i kyukṇiḥshā pāghi si tshogs kyi ①phyogs rnams ser skyar byas/ /de rnams 'di ci zhes brjod khros/ /dmod pa'i me ni spro srekṣa yā/ /a bye tya de ba dru tastun pra harṣa ku li to ba data/ /e ṣa niḥshe ṣa 'dod der/ /lha yi pho nya mngon phyogs te/ /rab dga' rnam par rgyas pas smras/ /'di ni sa skyong ma bhū pā la mo li bi shānta shā sa naḥ/ /pā ka shā sa na tu khya shrīsthā nānta thra lus kyi/ /mgo la bka' ni ngal gso ④zhing / /brgya byen dag dang mtshungs pa'i dpal/ /sa yi bdag thi bī pa tiḥ/ /na bha sā na ra de bo yo sa ha mee bye pra sarba ti/ /ya sde tīrta na dha po nga las nu/ /mi yi lha ni nam mkha' la/ /sde dang bcas pa rab tu gshegs/ /gang gi drag po'i tshig bye yo bā ṭwā pu dhyā bye mā ni nī/ / na dṛsgo ya gya ni dṛ ṣṭa sadzee 'di sngags①/ /bsod nams mngon pa'i nga rgyal ldan/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde ba'i dpal/ /sbyin lo ka su kha shri yaḥ/ /mo ha saṃ bidma ya sre ba bee bha bi ma daḥ/ /byed gang la 'byor pa yis/ /rab bskyed rgyags pa ma mthong ste/ /yang dag rig la gti mug bzhin//kau bee ram̐ dha na da byasgyu kau wā ram̐ shasti matta yā/ /i shā ram̐ thra ṣa bha yo nor 'dzin gsal bas ku be ra/ /stobs dang ldan pas gzhon nu ste/ /khyu mchog ldan pas dbang phyug gāta beeṣṭa baṃ shrī sa mā ga māta/ /pra tā pa pra sā rā ta sau ra minda baṃ dza dang / /dpal dang 'grogs pas khyab 'jug dang / /'od rab spro bas nyi ma dang / /skye bo dga' bas na nanda nāta/ /ind+ra dṛṣṭa ba latstsha dāta di bye rū paṃ bi bhartu yi/ /zla ba dang / /mthong bas stobs gcod dbang po yirjo/ /gzugs mchog 'di yis rnam par 'dzin//ba liḥpra yā tā pā tā lo da dhī tso pyasbi she ṣa tsā/ /a gya tyā ge na dza ṣpe bhiḥstobs ldan sa 'og rab tu zhugs/ /da dhī tsa yang rus lhag nyid/ /chu gter ding yang 'khrug mi 'dor//sgo bha ma byā bi nodzu nyi/ /shu two ti de ba dru ta gya ba tsa āoṃ mu ni ma dhya gaḥ/ /'di yi gtong bas yin nam snyam/ /de skad lha yi pho nya'i tshig /thos nas thub pa'i dbus son pa'i//95—65

sa sardza dund+ra kho nā ma mu niḥshā pa dza lo di ni/ /pra ha sanda tha tai pra ha bzhin ngan zhes bya thub pa yis/ /dmod pa'i chu ni mkha' la gtor/ /de nas sde dpon yongs 'dren se nā mbi pa ri shā ya kaḥ/ /ma harṣa saṃ ha ra ru ṣe mā kṛ thasta pa saḥkṣa gyis—/ /rab tu bzhad cing de la smras/ /drang srong chen po khro ba thong / /dka' thub zad par yongs ma yi—/ /bai pha thuphol rdzu shā bo yo yā su tya gre ma tī pa teḥ/ /na te ba mdzad—/ /sa bdag mdun du dmod pa 'di/ /'bras med ngo tshar ①'gro bar 'gyur/ /khrod kyis gang yo kha ga ye hūṃ yu yo pakṣa ya bya māḥ/ /i kyuste mai n+ya pa ti nā gis ④'dab gshog zad/ /bzod pa'i bya de bdag cag min/ /de skad sde dpon gyis smras tshe//shā pa staddhā ma bhā ki sthā/ /dṛṭwā gre bidma mā dru tse ki mi ta di ti bhū dmod pas bzung ba'i dpung tshogs la/ /mdun du sa bdag gis bltas nas/ /ya mtshan pas ①'di ci pa tiḥ/ /saṃ rasgo tha sa ma bye tya se nā pa ti ru ba tsa lta/ /te hūṃ de zhes gsungs/ /de nas sde dpon khro ldan pas/ /de la yang dag mngon phyogs smras/ /lha gcig drang ba ma hakhyi rde shā pā bee bye na sarba ti/ /i dañtsa tsakra rahūṃ te srong de dag gisadu/ /dmod pas dpung 'di mi bgrod rjodo/ /khyod kyi 'khor lo rin chen 'di'ang //byombi shā pa bee gyuṇḍi tai/ /dhetta dza la da saṃ rudha tigla dī dhi ti mkha' la dmod pas ⑥rnam par 'khyam④/ /sprin gyis yang dag bgags pa yi/ /tsha zer can dang tu thu tsā/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tind+ra ṣṭha tsā gre ta dzee ba tata/ /dṛ mtshungs par bzung / /de dag thos shing mi bdag gis/ /mdun du de ltar mthong nas kyang / /mig shi ba bi da dhe shā paṃ bi pha lotstshaṇḍa bi bla baṃ/ /de ha kṣa yi ma nyid kyis bsgrubs dmod pa dag /'bras med rab gtum bslad par ro/ /snying rje'i tshogs kyis lus hadhī rde pa ri rakṣan kṛ pā ku lāḥ/ /dza ṭā n+ya pa nyi ya ta byu mo sa 'jig pas/ /yongs bsrungs de yi kyal ka'i bkas/ /dman pa'i ⑧drang srong che rnams kyi/ /ral 95—66

li lā la sa shā naḥ/ /a dzi ta kro dha mo ha ram̐ bhā ra byu tā bṛ thā ba yo/ /i tī pa sa la lhung ①bar gyur/ /khro dang rmongs pa mi thul na/ /bdag cag don med khur gyur ces/ /de dag ba ladzdza yā te ྾ lī nā kshi ti ta le dza ṣpeḥ/ /a tha me ru shi raḥpā bya n-i paḥsu ral pa ngo tsha nas/ /sa gzhi la ni 'byar ba bzhin/ /de nas mi bdag lhun po'i rtser/ /phyin nas lha ra ni ke ta rna/ /pu ram̐ su dersha rna nā ma da darsha pri ya darsha rna/ /nā gāsta rnams gnas pa ①ni/ /grong khyer lta ①na sdug ces pa/ /blta na mdzes pa mthong bar gyur/ /der ni tra kṛ tā rakṣuḥpra khyu ta da ka ni shri tāḥ/ /ka ro ṭa pā ṇa yo yakṣuḥrol mtsho las 'thon pa'i/ /klu rnams dag la rab brtsams nas/ /gnod sbyin lag na gzhong thogs dang //su ra mā lā dha rā bhi dhwaḥ/ /sa dā maṭwāsta thā de bāḥkro dhotta bhi ta mee ni kāḥ/ /'phreng bu'adzin zhes pa'i lha dang ni/ /de bzhin rtag myos zhes pa'i lha/ /khro bas sdom byed sde rnams dang //tsā turma hā rā dza kā yi kā khyu sted shā ba la batta rāḥ/ /ma hā rā dzā : tā raḥrgyal chen bzhi yi ris zhes pa/ /shin tu stobs ldan skabs gsum pa/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams//sandargyu ka ba tsā yu dmāḥ/ /dzi tā rā dzā pra bhā bee na ṣpe dza se nā go bgos mtshon thogs g.yul zhugs pa/ /rgyal po'i mthu yis pham gyur nas/ /rang sde rnams kyi sngon gra gāḥkṛ tāḥ/ /ta taḥkalpa dru mo dā ra ko bi dā ra ma no ha ram̐/ /da darsha pā ri 'gro byas/ /de nas rgya che dpag bsam shing / /yid 'phrog ko bee rā ra nirjo/ /yongs 'du zhes pa yā tā khya saṃ shra yo tri do bo ka sī/ /me rormyarje ta taḥshu bhra pra bye mthong bar gyur/ /lha rnams kyis rjoni yang dag bsten/ /de nas lhun po'i rtser 'od zer/ /'phreng ⑦mā lā mi bā ma dzee/ /su dhasthā khyu sa bhā pā pa swa pra bhā boddhā ṣi tsā ba dzā/ /ba bzhin du dri ma med/ /mkha' ni rang 'od kyis ⑧gsal ba/ /chos bzang zhes pa'i mdun sar phyin//he ma bi dru ma bee ḍūrya stambha saṃ bhā ra bhā swa raḥ/ /pā sā do bai dza yand+ra khyaḥgaser dang byu ru bee ḍūrya'i/ /ka ba'i tshogs ni gsal zhing mdzes/ /khang bzang rnam par rgyal zhes pa//95—67

pra khya to ya tra rā dza te/ /ya tāñdzirba da ṣpej-i gi ra la kaistu lya tsā grags pas gang las ①rnam par mdzes/ /gang du chu skyes bzhin ras dang / /bung ba lan bus mtshungs ga tāḥ/ /padme n+yaḥsu ra na rī rde padri nī rmā su ram̐ ga rmā/ /bimbi toste da shirya tra gyur pa/ /lha yi bu mo'i ④pad ljon dang / /padma'i shing gi ①lha mo'o/ /nor bu'i zhal zhal ka ba sa//ma ṇi bhū stambha rnyisbyi 6/ /su ra lo ko bi bha bye ko pya ṣpe ka su ra lo ka hūṃ/ /gang du lha yi gzugs brnyan byis/ /lha yi 'jig rten gcig nyid kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten du ma 'dzin//ratna to ra ṇa hathre shu ni ba hairya tra tsi tri tāḥ/ /byābhā bi bhārnyi ka ku rin chen rta babs ba gam gyi/ /'od kyi tshogs kyis rnam bkra gang / /phyogs rnams mjos pas khyab gyur bhaḥsha krā yu dha sha tai ri ba/ /ya tra bā lā ni lā lo la kalpa te—/ /brgya phrag brgya byin tshon ④gyis bzhin/ /gang du rlung gzhon gyis bskyod pa'i/ /dpag bsam pa da pa palla baiḥ/ /1tta dheṭwā i bā bhadhi nandi byo nanda na shri rkang 'thung 'khri shing gis/ /dga' ba bskyed dude dga' ba'i dpal/ /'gyur zhing rab bsgyur bzhin du yaḥ—/ /ya tra tsi tra ra dzee nā ma de borlu na ma no ra oṃ/ /dhaste ni rkyotpa ba pre mi mdzes / /gang na shing rta sna tshogs zhes/ /lha yi skyed tshal yid dga' ba/ /rtag tu spro bas dga' ma kā ma kā ma baṃ sha ta yoḥ/ /sarba kā oṃ sarba su khaṃ sabyurtu ku su dag /'dod dang so ka'i ⑥bzhed pa bzhin/ /'dod pa kun dang bde ba kun/ /dus tshigs kun tu modzdza lo/ /sarpā ti shā yi tai dṛṭī de bā āoṃ sa da rgo dzre paḥ/ /rū me tog 'bar/ /lha rnams gnas ni thams cad las/ /khyad 'phags rgyal pos mthong gyur nas/ /yud snurta bisma yā sunda sā nanda sdigha lo tsa naḥ/ /a tsidha yata su tsam ya mtshan g.yo med cing / /'dzum pa'i spyan dang kun dgar bcas/ /legs byas rnams kyi bsod kṛ ti nā mi māstuḥpha la byu ma yaḥ/ /e rā ba khaṃ su rā pa terlo lā le ba la nams kyi④/ /'bras bu de ni 'di zhes bsams/ /lha yi bdag po'i sa srung ④ni/ /sred len bung ba'i 95—68

yā ku lo/ /da darsha ta tra sā mo rda sā kā ra mi ba nanda dzwa/ /pu ranta rasta tshogs rgyas pa/ /dga' tshal rnam pa dang bcas bzhin/ /der ni dri bzang ldan pa mthong / /de nas sa to dzñā tā pāsta khyu mi pu randa ram̐/ /pra kyurya yo pra mu di taḥs ha yi dbang po ni/ /'ongs par shes nas dbang po ni/ /lha yi tshogs dang bcas pa dag /rab dga' sabyend+ra ruṅga ṇiḥ/ /pū dzi taḥsu ra rā dze na ratna rā dza bi rā dzi tsā/ /ldan pas bsu ba byas/ /rin chen 'phreng ①bas rnam mdzes pa'i/ /mdun sa'i sa gzhi rgyal po yikhye //rā dza rā dzaḥs bhā bhū mi bhe dze bi ra dza sādza raḥ/ /tri da she 6 pa biṣṭi 6 rgyal po lha yi rgyal po yis/ /mchod pa rdul bral mchog gis bsten①/ /rin chen stan gyi 'phreng ④ba la//ratna pa.oṃ ka paṃ tta 6/ /u pā bi shra1 paḥshrī mā nā sa nārte sha ta skabs gsum pa rnams nyer bzhugs shing / /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i stan phyed la/ /mi yi bdag po dpal kra toḥ/ /e kā sa na dzu khosta tra su rend+ra ma nu dzend+ra yoḥ/ /rū pa ldan bzhugs/ /der ni stan gcig dul 'dug pa'i/ /lha dbang mi yi bdag po dgarjo /yon tan gu ṇa ga kho dā ram̐ nibee she ṣa ma dṛ shya ta/ /ta taḥsarba su rosmṛṣṭa spaṣṭa tshogs ni rgya che ba'i/ /gzugs ni khyad par med par mthong / /de nas lha kun gyis spyos pa'i/ /rab lo tsa na ṣatpa deḥ/ /rpā ya mā na mu khāsto dzee bha dza hā ra ha ri dṛ paṃ/ /gsal mig ni rkang drug pas/ /bzhin pad 'thung ldan ④mi bdag la/ /'phrog byed kyis ni yang dag smras//a ho pa do yaḥshā gyaste dza sā te dza sī ni dhe/ /bha ba tā bhū ṣi tā kye ma gzi bajid gter gyi gzi/ /gang zhig bsngags 'os mngon par 'char/ /khyed me kyis sa ni brgyan bhū mirdzu bya de ba na bhā swa tī/ /a byunda ta pra bhā bo yi la sata gyur cing / /'od ldan lha yi stinam mkha' yang / /mthu yis rab mtho grags snyan dag /gsal ba'i si ta yā shaṃ shu ka/ /sthā dza te te tri bhu ba ṣpe sā mā bye bi dza ya dhwa dzaḥ/ /twata gos can sa gsum du/ /yang dag rgyal po rnam rgyal ba/ /khyod kyi rgyal mtshan 'di mdzes so/ /khyod 95—69

ka thā mṛ ta pā na su twata darsha na ra sa su tsa/ /prerya te rnge tra ṣpe tre ṇa gtam bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang / /khyod ni blta ①ba'i ro la yang / /rna ba mig kyang rab bskul cing //su khā khyu ṣpe sa ra swa tī/ /sbi rī kṛ tasta ma bā yi su kṛ tāpta bi bhū ti nā/ /bde ba'i sgra la dbyangs can no/ /las rnams 'bras bu rtsod pa yi/ /the tshom chad cing nges pa 'di//karma hūṃ pha la bā da mya nibya yasbyinda saṃ sha yaḥ/ /a ta e beedzre ya 'byor pa legs byas kyis thob pa/ /khyod nyid kho nas brten ④par byas/ /bsod nams 'os pa'i kun gā me tsagru re ba smṛ haspa rda/ /pu byeḥpu stso tsi tā tsā ra dṛ shyadhe spyod ldan/ /khyod lta bsod nams kyis mthong gang / /'di nyid phyir na ①dbang po yi/ /tshogs las mi ④yadha babyi dhwa/ /i kyuste tri da shende ṇa mā nā tā ya sha sāmbi dhiḥ/ /nyid dga' ba'i gnas/ /lha yi dbang pos 'di brjod tshe/ /grags pa'i gter ni nga las dunus//twadzra sā da pra bhā bo yo bi tyā bā tsa na tā na naḥ/ /i hye baṃ pū bye mā na gya mthu 'di khyod kyi dudrin no zhes/ /smras nas gdong ni dud ④par gyur/ /de ltar de ni lha rnams kyisadzee//ta sru ni tyā da riḥsu riḥ/ /ṣa ḍind+ra pra ya yo kā lo tri di pe ba sa taḥrtag tu gus pas mchod ldan de'i/ /lha yul bzhugs shing gnas pa las⑨/ /dbang po drug gi ⑩dus sa taḥ/ /ta ta pa rā kra ma bi shwasta sa mabhā su ra maṇḍa laḥ/ /ba khyu ba su 'das gyur/ /lha min dkyil 'khor mtha' dag ni/ /de yi pha rol gnon pas nyams/ /lha yi rgyal po ra rā dza su ni ra pā yo da yo dza yaḥ/ /dībee dā na ba saṃ gā me te su 'tshe med cing / /dar ba dang ni rgyal bar gyur/ /gzi ldan g.yul du gzhu 'dzin lha'i/ /dpung pa'i saurya ma hā ta roḥ/ /bi shātwo bhā dzi re de bā bhu dzātstsha yo pa dzre bi bad/ /ta grib mas nyer 'tsho rnams/ /dpa' bo ljon pa chen po de'i/ /ngal gso ⑪dag ni bsten par byed/ /de su pu 5 pa ṇa kṛ tai bhuṭwā na snga kṣa oṃ su khaṃ/ /kā la pra bā he ma ha ti pra yi bsod nams tshong zong gis/ /myos ⑫pa mi zad bde spyod pa'i/ /dus kyi rgyun ni che ba la/ /brgya 95—70

ya yuḥṣahphu randa rāḥ/ /saṅkarma pha la sgo ga su dzee tstsha rgo bi ma lasma naḥ/ /kā byen drug ni 'das par gyur/ /dam pa'i las 'bras spyod pa yi/ /rtags ni dri ma med pa'i yid/ /de lu tyādzdza ya te ta gya pra tyā sanda pa ri kṣa yaḥ/ /a tha kā le na kā lu 6 ka ni rnyog par gyur pa las/ /rab tu nye bar yongs zad gyur/ /de nas dus kyis khyes bdag ni/ /nyes li ta khya ma no ra thaḥ/ /a bhūkhro bhā bhi bhū ta gya bhū pa te ra nyi mā ni pa'i rnyog pas rab bsgos shing / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal chags pa yis/ /zil mnan snyiyid la 'dod paronaḥ—/ /trid shā nā mi yo la kṣa mbind+rabye ju ba la pā li tā/ /ta de gyur—/ /skabs gsum pa yi dpal 'byor ni/ /bdag gi 1dpung pa'i stobs kyis bskyangs/ /de las khumānda sa he tā ba daddhā sa na bi ḍalnga dzā/ /a ha me kaḥsu ra pa tiḥre zhig stan phyad kyis⑤/ /bag 'khums 'di ni yongs mi bzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi lazhwakhur 'dzin pa//pra bhā bā nu bha bā mi ke/ /a yasma ma bhu dzaḥsattha dza gadzha ra bha ra kṣa maḥ/ /bdag gi dpung pa 'di yis bzod/ /bdag rang gcig pu lha dbang du/ /mthu yis 'gyur ba min pa ci⑦//tsā ba yi tā su rā dhī shaṃ swarga sā mā bye saspa rda/ /e kā ta pa tra ti lha yi dbang po nyams byas nas/ /mtho ris rgyal srid phun sum tshogs/ /gdugs gcig nyid kyi thig la rmā swa yi grwa ho tsi tī bha dze/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta gya sha kra dro le ni/ /rang nyid 'dzin par 'os pa bsten/ /de ltar bsams shing khyebargya byen la/ /'khu bar mngon hā rnyi lā ṣi ṇaḥ/ /shu bhra pra bhā pra bhā ba sthārmā le ba smu na tsā ya yo/ /par 'dod pa de'i/ /dkar ba'i 'od ldan mthu yi dpal/ /'phreng 67 ba bzhin du nyams par gyur//gha no da ya sa mutpa ghra sau dza n+ya ta ṭa pā ti mbi/ /lo lo ka lu ṣa stug pos ⑪rgyas par bsams pa yis/ /skye bo legs pa'i ngogs gcod pa'i/ /g.yo ldan dpal ni sred ya hye ba mā na saṃ shrī ram̐ gi bhā/ /pra ma dā bi pa dzā dru tī duḥs ha ma bcas kyis⑪/ /yid kyi rdzing bu dri mar byed/ /bag med rgud pa'i pho nya ni/ /che rnams kyis kyang 95—71

ha tā ma pi / / ku sha lond+ra la nā li tsa kilbi ṣā ku li bzod par dka'①/ /rigs ni nyams pa nyid kyi slad/ /sdig pas ④'khrugs pa'i blo gros so/ /sdig pa rnam tā ma tiḥ/ /pā pa saṃ kalpa mā tre ṇa kṣi to kṣi ti pa ti kṣa rjata/ /pā pa ta bi shrī bha pha par brtags tsam gyis/ /sa bdag sa la skad cig gis/ /lhung skeste 'bras bu rnam lhung ④zhing //lasbyinda mū la i ba dru maḥ/ /hadhi bi byā ma na sgyu saḥshri yo harnyi ma do da rtsa ba bcad pa'i ljon pa bzhin/ /ma goms pa yis rig pa 'joms/ /rgyags pa rgyas pas dpal 'byor yaḥ / /bi dī ṣaḥsā dhu tsā hadhi harnyi lo bha sa muṅgi ti/ /a ho ba 'joms—/ /rnam sdang gis ni legs nyid 'joms/ /chags pas yang dag mtho ba 'joms/ /kye ma kwa te ma hoṅkaste shri gā ro ho ma ho da yaḥ/ /bi bha bodzha ba maṭwā rmā pa ye dar rgyas che/ /che zhing mtho ba'i rtser 'dzegs pa/ /'byor pas rgyags pa skyes pa rnams/ /'phral ha bee ba pa ta tya dhaḥ/ /te na sarpā bi byurwa ma pū dzi taḥpūttha dzadma ni/ /tatpa la nyid du ni 'og tu lhung / /de yi ⑤skye ba snga ma la/ /thams cad zil gnon zhes bya mchod/ /lha dbang dāpta ba na rā rdzu smṛ ha bhā ma rutpa teḥ/ /su rā dhi pā dhi baḥko pe pra rgyal srid bsten 'os ni/ /de yis 'bras bu rjothob gyur cing / /gang yang lha dbang las lhag pa/ /mthu bhā bo bisma yā ba haḥ/ /a nalpasta snga bhū ta pā tra dā rmā sha saṃ bha baḥ/ /bantu ni ya mtshan ldan pa dag /de yi ⑦snod la sbyin pa'i chas/ /bskyed pa mi nyung skal bar gyur/ /gnyen ①ma tya bhi ṅgā nā yī na garyā mu tsi taḥshu tsiḥ/ /ba ni guṅka ri ko nā ma so bha ba ldan zhes ni bya ba yi⑨/ /grong khyer 'os shing gtsang ba ru/ /tshong dpon ud ka ri ka zhes/ /de yi sngon hphuttha dzadma ni/ /bi pa dhī nā ma bhikṣa ma samyakshi budhe hūṃ ga taḥ/ /bi be sha gyi skye bar gyur/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /nyid du gyur cing sems can kun/ /sgrol ba la tasgo haṃ sadzee satwa saṃ tā ra khodmā taḥ/ /pā tre ta su sa ni kṣe pa brtson rnam gzigs mtshan/ /bsod snyoms slad du de khyim zhugs/ /de yi snod du dang ba'i blos//95—72

muṅga muṣṭispra sanda dhīḥ/ /pha lā ni ta tra tsa tā ri pe tuḥshe ṣā ṇi khyu ta le/ /sran ma chag ①gang de yis 'phangs/ /de las ②lhag ma bzhi dag ni/ /sa yi gzhi la lhung bar gyur④//te na dā na pra bhā be na mant+ra tā thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /sarba dī pa pa ti byu twa shakrāddhā de yi sbyin pa'i mthu yis ni/ /sa yi bdag po nga las nu/ /gling rnams kun gyi bdag gyur nas/ /brgya sa na māpta bān/ /muṅga she ṣa sgo to yasmrata khyu mo ta myu n+ya tse ta saḥ/ /ta dā byin stan byed thob par gyur/ /de yi sems ni gzhan gang las/ /sran ma lhag ma sa la lhung ④/ /de tshe sau pha la paryarnye pa ti ste da shā la yā ta/ /lu ṭha ti bee ka la kaspra 'di ni 'bras bu'i mthar/ /skabs gsum pa las lhung ⑤bar gyur/ /gang zhig rmi lam sgyu ma'i gnas ya tra saṃ ka lpa mā lbo sgu ra ti na tsa ka dā tsita swa sna mā yānta skabs su yang nam yang mi 'phro ba'i/ /rnam rtog 'phreng spyob cung zad 'khrugs pas gang la nye bar rab re yā/ / bha ba ti bi bha ba sgo gā sgo gi dī bhā gya bhā dzā ma tu sbyar ba/ /'di ⑦ni sbyin pa'i dpag bsam shing gi 2mtshungs med 'bras bu rab rgyas tshe/ /'byor pa'i la pha la ta nyiḥsā dā na kalpa dru maḥ/ /i tyā ha bha ga bān budha longs spyod spyod pa nyid du skal ba bsten pa rnam dag grur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dges ⑨pa yis/spru tya dā na pha lo shri yo/ /ni dza dzadmānta rā khyu ṣpesgokhyu zla ma nu shā sa rang gi skye ba gzhan brjod cing / /dge slong rnams la rjes bstan du/ /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu'i dpal 'di ṣpe—/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsiṭwā yi bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa gsungs—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam la tā yī mārnya tu ra ba dā rna tsa turbaḥpalla baḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las/ nga las nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi pa'o// //du ddhā dhi rbi bu dhwa za nā ti bi dhu rāḥ gru bha stsa hūṃ pe tsi re lha rnams kyis bslangs bsrubs pas shin tu 'khrugs shing 'o ma'i chu gter ring zhig 'dar/ /rang 95—73

kadzan te tsa ni sarga taḥki la ka lotparge 6 kalpa dru māḥ/ /e kaḥko pi sa dzā bzhin nyid kyi ①'bras bu rab tu gtong tshe dpag bsam shing yang 'dar ro lo/ /gang zhig lus ni rab tu ya te ta nu sha tai ra bhyasta dā na sbi tiniṣkasthā pu la koṅka ram̐ ba ha ti yaḥgatong yang spu long tshogs 'dzin 'dar ba mi mnga' ba/ /su zhig gcig pu de ni lus brgyas ④sbyin pa'i kā yo pra dā ṣpe ṣṭa bi/ /aste kai lā sha ha si tyā mutta ra snga ma nutta rā//lugs ①'di goms par gyur pa yin/ /kai la shas mtshon byang phyogs na④/ /bla na med pa'i grong khyer ni//di shi bha dra shi khā nā ma bhu ba nā bha ra rde pu rī/ /ya sde si ta ya shaḥputpaḥs bzang po'i brag ces bya ba ste/ /sa yi rgyan du gyur pa yod/ /gang du grags snyan me tog dkar/ /phun pha lāḥsarbha saṃ pa daḥ/ /dā nodmā na la tāḥdī hye ba bhū bu pu ra bā si rmā/ /tshogs kun byi 'bras bu bzang / /sbyin pa'i skyed tshal 'khri shing ni/ /grong khyer pa rnams dga' beed gyur//ya tra tri pu ra dzinde tra shi khi trasto ma no bha baḥ/ /a ba lā bhe tsa la grwa ḍā grong khyer gsum durgyal mig gi mes/ /gang du skrag pas yid 'byung ni/ /stobs med g.yo zhing rtse bub yi//zla lha gi re ba rakṣe ta/ /mukta dzā lodzdza lā ya tra bhā ti he ma kṛ ti smin ma 'khyog po nyid kyis bsrungs/ /gang du gser gyi khang pa'i 'phreng ⑦/ /mu tig tshogs rab 'bar ba lī/ /me roḥshi ṣa ra mā le ba bi sgu rata mbi ta tā ra kāḥ/ /ta sngañtsand+raḥpra bhā bas mdzes/ /lhun po rtse yi 'phreng ⑧ba ni/ /rgyas pa'i rgyu skar 'phro ba bzhin/ /der ni dpal ldan zla shrī mā na bhūta bhū mi j-i hūṃ ba raḥ/ /kai khā sa i pa yaḥkādhyā tsa kā ra di na ba'i 'od/ /sa 'dzin rnams kyi mchog tu gyur/ /nyin mo'i zla 'od mdzes pa yis/ /gang zhig kai la sha tsadhri rmā/ /ya su de ha pra bhā pū riḥbyurtend+ra dku ti hā ri rnyiḥ/ /niḥshā su bzhin byas/ /gang gi lus 'od zla nya yi/ /'od ltar rdzogs pa'i 'phrog byed kyis/ /gsal byed can dī pa kā bhā su nā byuta sne ha gu ṇa kṣa yaḥ/ /sma ra dzwa ram̐ bha dzarnye su min snang ba'i mtshan/ /byams pa'i yon tan zad ma gyur/ /'di mthong nyid na ⑨rgyu skar rnams//95—74

darsha ṣpe ṣpe ba tā ra kāḥ / /i titstsha tra tstsha la da myatstsha di tai kha 'dod pa'i rims ni bsten 'gyur ①zhes/ /mkha' la gdugs kyi zol dag gis/ /'di ni zla bas mi beend+ra nā/ /pra ti sha bye ṣa sa ta tai shri yo masko sha saṃ yī/ /i bsgribs pa bzhin/ /dam pa'i mdzod na gnas pa'i dpal/ /rtag tu 'di yis rab ster zhes/ /gang tī sha darsha ṣpe gya saṃ ko tsa mā pa padri nī/ /se nā haṃ kā ra mudṛ bye tyā ga shu zhig mthong la padmo can/ /zum par rab tu thob pa bzhin/ /sde yi nga rgyal rab btang nas/ /gtong ba bhra shri yā shri yaḥ/ /niji ṭwāḥtstsha tra mu ku ṭa pra ka ṭa ཿpu ra bā dkar ba'i dpal gyis ⑤dpal/ /gdugs dang cod pan rab gsal rnams/ /grong khyer pa rnams dag si rmā/ /shu shu bhe bi bha bsta su pu sgyu lo kṛ tonda teḥ/ /ā ro ha ti la btang / /de yi 'byor pa dul ba yis/ /dpal gyis brgyan cing mtho ba mdzes/ /gzhu ltar gug pa'i pa dzā ko ṭī na mra gya dha nu kho gu ṇaḥ/ /tsa tā ri shata sa ha sru ṇi batpa rā hūṃ yon tan rgyud/ /gzhan dag rtse ru 'dzegs pa nyid/ /stong phrag bzhi bcu dag dang ni/ /brgya phrag dag sha tā ni tsa/ /ba byu ba de hi nā mā yusta su kā le ka li dī ṣaḥ/ /ta mya ṣakhyu gi lo rnams kyang / /lus can rnams kyi cher gyur pa/ /de dus rtsod la sdang ba byung / /'jig rten skyong sa hā sru ṇi pu rī hūṃ pūrṇa saspa dzā/ /ba bhū burlo ka pā la gya lo las lhag pa'i dpal/ /'jig rten skyong de'i grong khyer ni/ /phun sum tshogs pas gang ba dag /stong ka pā lā dhi ka shri yaḥ/ /ya rnye naḥtīrti ti la kasta su pu rgya bi khyu ṣa ṇḍaḥ/ /phrag drug cu byung bar gyur/ /mchod sbyin byed po de yi dpal/ /grags pa'i thig le bsod nams brgyan//yarnye dhū ma la tā rghaṃ girba bhūdhī lā la kāḥshri yaḥ/ /ta tyā sadzata ku mu di mbi mchod sbyin du ba'i 'khri shing dag /'khyog pas ①g.yo ba'i lan bu mdzes/ /de yi blon po zla chen po//bi kā sa na sa do di taḥ/ /a byu ta ma hā tsand+ra:nd+ra lo ka i bodzdza laḥ/ /rab 'bar zla ba'i snang ba bzhin/ /phun tshogs ku mud ldan pa ni/ /rtag tu rnam par rgyas bgyid gyur//95—75

ya yo/ /ind+ra dzā la pra yo ga dzhaḥs kṛ tā pra sha mo tsi tai/ /bee shaṃ ka lu ṣa bar gyur/ /mig 'phrul sbyor ba shes pa de/ /rab tu zhi zhing rigs pa'i chas/ /byas shing sdig pa'i kun saṃ kalpa pu rī shā pa ma tī pa teḥ/ /asmin bha ba ba ṣpe ni bye gu ṇa do rtog ldan/ /sa bdag grong khyer sleb par gyur/ /srid pa'i nags 'dir rtag tu ni/ /yon tan skyon ṣa sa mā ku le/ /kalpa dṛkṣuḥpra dzā yadhe dzā yadhe tsa bi ṣa dru maḥ/ /a byis yang dag gang / /dpag bsam shing rnams rab skyes te/ /dug gi shing rnams skyes par gyur/ /ma she ṣa nā sha pi shu beesgo ra sarja sa kā ri bhiḥ/ /durni miste ri ba kha leḥlus nyams pa mtshon byed cing / /'jigs rung skrag par byed pa dag /ltas ngan lta bu'i mi bsrun ①pas//ṣe daḥka gya na dī ya te/ /gu ṇi dzwa ṣaḥpra kṛ hye ba pra kā sha pa ri padzre su la nyon mongs skyed mi byed/ /yon tan ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /dgrar gyur rab gsal mi mthun naḥ—/ /do ṣā shra ya su ko bhe daḥkha la gya ti mi ra su tsa/ /swatstshanda ghā tī phyogs—/ /skyon la brten par mi bsrun ①dang / /rab rib dag la dbye ba ci/ /legs pa rnams kyi sā dhū dzā bi dre ṣa bi ṣa duḥs haḥ/ /dīspyo pakṣa kha la byu la yid gcugs ①'joms/ /rnam par sdang ba'i dug bzod dka'/ /logs ring skye bo mi bsrun rjosprul//ka rā laḥke na nirmi taḥ/ /tasmin pra biṣṭi na ga re rū bi bhā su ra de ba tā//'jigs su rung ba su yis sprul/ /grong khyer der ni rab zhugs tshe/ /grong khyer lha ni gzugs can ma//ba tsā bhya tya bhū pā lo sant+ra sa ra le kṣa ṇa/ /shi ro yā tsa ka e ṣa hūṃ skrag pa'i mig ni g.yo ba yis/ /sa skyong la ni mngon phyogs smras/ /tshangs pa'i gnyen ni mgo slong ba//bra hma bantu ru pā ga taḥ/ /ba rmyo sau dzre bi to tstsha dī dza ga to dzre bee ta su te/ /'di ni khyod can nye bar 'ongs/ /'gro ba'i 'tsho ba khyed kyis ⑤ni/ /'tsho ba gcod byed 'di gzhom 'os//ni rurnyo na ga ra dā ri sa ma yā ma li nā sha yaḥ/ /ma ma ta da drakṣe taste bdag gis bsam pa dri ma can/ /de ni grong khyer sgo ru bkagadu /de mthong ba na dubadag gi yid//95—78

j-i ti na la bha te ma naḥ/ /i ti khru bā rde bhū pā la thra bā tsa su ra de ba tsā/ /abee skrag cing dga' ba ma thob po/ /'di smra grong khyer lha mo la/ /slong ba bkag hukyepas ngo tsha dag /rab saṃ ro dha saṃ dzā ta lasto tsa na mi tā na naḥ/ /de bi yāsgo bhe yā to sau pra skyes bzhin ras dman gyur pa'isde/ /sa skyong gis ni rab tu smras/ /lha mo slong ba mngon 'ongs pa//bi sha twa ni bā ri taḥ/ /dīsgotyā saṃ sa te nā hā mā sā bee pha lya 'di ni ma zlog nang du thong / /slong ba'i bsam pa 'bras med pa'i/ /shugs rings ①bdag gis yongs mabee naḥ/ /yāsgo pra ṇa yi nā maze pu rgya pāptasta nu bya yaḥ/ /yu ga mi bzod/ /slong ba don gnyer rnams don du/ /lus nyams bsod nams rab tu thob/ /gang phyir saṃ khyu ma pi spri tā bi pa ryarnye ti de hi naḥ/ /e ta de ba su dzā tā rmā lus ni dus bzhi'i grangs/ /gnas kyang rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /slong ba re ba nyams pa dag/sgo rdzu dza ga ti dzre bi tai/ /ya de ṣā ma gra to yā ti nādhī bhasna ma no ra 'di rnams mdun du mi bgrod gang / /de nyid skye bo legs rnams kyisasde/ /'tsho ba 'gro bar mchod par thaḥ—/ /kri ya tā mā nu ku bye me bha ba tyā ku sha lo tsi tai/ /ā sā bi ghā te 'os—/ /bdag gi rjes su mthun pa ni/ /dge bar 'os pa khyod kyis ⑤mdzod/ /de yi bsam pa rnam saṃ tā pasta mya tūrṇa ni bārya hūṃ/ /i ti byu mi z-i taḥkhru tā ba tso nibacom pa'i/ /gdung ba myur du zlog rjopar mdzod/ /de skad sa bdag tshig thos nas/ /g.yo ba med bye la nibya yi/ /dza gā mā darsha dzwa de bi tsirsā saddhā pa mā na sā/ /a thā ya par nges pa yis⑦/ /bsam pas yid ni rab gdung ba/ /lha mo snang ba mun par gyurablu/ /de nas gya yo pa ku ṭi la kha la kra ka tsa tseṣṭi taḥ/ /dā ru ṇaḥs ra la sri ba tstsha dā gyu can de 'ongs/ /mi bsrun khya sog le'i spyod tshul can/ /mi bzad drang po'i shing dag ni/ /spyod ⑫la ya swa ya murya taḥ/ /tasmi1 pa kṛ haṃ pāste bi dṛ ta dā ra mabee rmā/ /bhūr byu rang nyid sbyor ba bzhin/ /slong la sgo ni rab bye ba/ /mi bdag khang pa der ⑪'ongs la/ /sa bdag 95—79

gya me brahmandabee nā marba sedha ye/ /nirbi kaspo pa ka ra khaṃ bya yi yā ti legs 'tsho dag /slong ba rnams kyi don grub slad/ /rnam par mi rtog yo byad du/ /zad 'gyur bram ze su dzre bi tai/ /ka dā pā shāḥpa rābee me pra yāṭī ma no ra thaḥ/ /ki me tā bdag legs so/ /bdag srog pha rol don du ni/ /nam zhig 'grur zhing ①re ba yod/ /gal te khyod ni na pu sgyu ni pābyernye te ya di twa yā/ /a ho pa ka ra ṇa se: kyis de bslangs ⑤pa/ /'di ni bsod nams cis ma yin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni slong rnams la//shārgyu me kṛ khya tī shi raḥ/ /tata ta de ba sbi ra lo ke yad ya dbee pa mabee gang gang byin pa de de brtan/ /grub pa'i yo byad bdag gi mgo/ /bsngags par 'os pa gzung bar tai—/ /i kyuste harṣa yuste na bhū bhu dzā sa twa shā li nā/ /ta mū tsa tasma mdzod—/ /sa spyod snying stobs legs ldan pa/ /rab dga' ldan pas 'di brjod tshe/ /blon po chen po hā mā rkyo ma hā tsand+ra ma tī dha ro/ /ni dza dzre bi ta rakṣe ba dhand+raste pra tha maḥpra zla chen dang / /sa 'dzin dag gis de la smras/ /rje bo khyod kyi chos dang po/ /rang gi srog ni bsrung ba sgo—/ /twa yi dzre ba ti dzre brnyi sarbe dza ga te dzanta baḥ/ /nā dā tu marta nyid / /'gro bar ①khyod ni 'tsho ba na/ /srog chags thams cad 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir khyed lus si shi raḥsarpā dhwa ra nyi te ba suḥ/ /dī ya tai brahma shā yāsmi te ma ratna ma kun gyi gzhi/ /mgo bo sbyin dhipar mi 'os so/ /rin chen gser byi rang bzhin mgo/ /bram ze 'di la yi shi raḥ/ /sarpādzee rabee sārja dzā pūryadhe yind+ra no ra thāḥ/ /te ྾ saṃ sbyin par mdzod/ /slong ba'i don mthun re ba dag /gang gi ④don kun gyis rdzogs pa/ /de dag yang rakṣa ṇi ṣpe ba sabaṃ bha ba ti rakṣi tai/ /saṃ kaspo yi dī dza snga su dag bsrungs pa yis/ /thams cad bsrungs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i sems lnga ma sanyis skye sa 'di'i//spyu raḥka lu ṣa tse ta saḥ/ /mū lotstsha do pa dzī byo hi na kalpa ta ru rabee rnam rtog 'di ri 'jigs su rung / /gang phyir slong ba'i dpag bsam shing / /rtsa bcad nye bar 'tsho bya 95—81

dzñā / /he ma ratna shi raḥpā gya yā two ṣa shi ra sā gya ki/ / tsiddhā ma ṇibee min—/ /rin chen gser gyi mgo thob nas/ /'di ni 'gro 'gyur mgo yis ci/ /bkres pa rnams kyi ①ni tpa 6 bhu bye te na bu bhu kṣi tai ཿ / / i kyu ste ma rnyi mu khyu bye te yid bzhin nor/ /rnam par brtags nas bgam bya min/ /blon po'i gtso bos 'di smras tshe/ /rin ma ratna la yo shi raḥ/ /sirnyo ṣpe bo pa yo gyi tadma me ti zwahma kho bra bīta/ /chen gser gyi rang bzhin mgo/ /de ni bdag gis 'grub khyepa la/ /nyer mkho med ces bram zes smras//a thozlu mo tsa dṛ pa tirmu ku ṭi moste rmā shu bhiḥ/ /shi ro bi ba ha duḥkhe de nas cod pan mi bdag gis/ /rab bkrol mu tig 'od (kyernams ni/ /mgo dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal na sā khru dhwa ra mi bā ti ta ཿ / /mu ku ṭā ni kṣa ṇi ta smin ni pe gyis—/ /kun nas mchi ma'i rgyun bcas bzhin/ /skad cig de la grong khyer ba'i/ /cod pan rnams ni tuḥpu ra bā si dzā/ /dibyā hokhru ka tu spyo bhi rulbā bhiḥs ha bhū ta lo/ /rā sa gzhi la/ /phyogs ni bsreg (dnghamatshungs mgal me dang / /skar mda' dag dang lhan cig lhung / /rgyal dzñā bra dā ṣpe shi ra saḥsarba thā pa ri kalpi te/ /to tsakra tasta nu tyā shaṃ madhri pos mgo ni rab ster ba/ /rnam pa kun tu yongs brtags ⑤te/ /mthong bar mi bzod blon po ni/ /de ṇi dbyu ma kṣa mo/ /ratna garbha mi thodmā āoṃ pra bi shya thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /dag lus ni btang 67ba byas/ /de nas skyed tshal rin chen nang ⑦/ /zhugs te sa yi bdag po yis⑧//uhphulla tsadza ka snga dhaḥshi rabyehūṃ sa murya yo/ /udmā na de ba tā dṛṭī tai rab rgyas tsam pa ka 'og tu/ /mgo bo gcod du yang dag gshegs/ /skyed mos tshal gye lhas mthong nas//shi rabyebhu murya tram̐ / /mā kṛ thā sā ha saṃ rā dzambi kyu bā tsa shu tsa ku mgo bo gcod par brtson de la/ /rgyal po thub chod ma mdzad ces/ /mya ngan dag gis 'khrugs par (khyalā—/ /kadza nāḥpra mā pi n+yasta maṭwā li ku la swa ṣpeḥ/ /n+ya bā ra yinda smras—/ /'dar ldan 'khri shing rab smras pa⑪ / /bung ba spyos tshogs sgra dang ni/ /yal 'dab rab tu 95—82

ba la tā lo la pa lla ba pā ṇi bhi ཿ / / so pi byi : la saṃ kalpa ཿg.yo ba yis(1/ /lag pa dag gis bzlog 2 pa bzhin/ /rnam par brtags 1 pa g.yo med des2 //sra sā byodmā na de ba tī/ /bi ma dzee bo bye mā lo bya ba bhū ba pra ṇi dhwa na bān/ /skyed tshal lha yang dang byas nas/ /dri med byang chub la dmigs pa'i/ /smon lam dag dang ldan par gyur//asmin ratna ma yodmā ṣpe pu sgo rā shi sa munda tai/ /stu pa mastu pra ṇa grong dang rin chen rang bzhin tshal/ /'di ni bsod nams phung pos mtho/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ma stu sa twa sa ddhā ra kho tsi tai / / yaṅgi ñtsa da rji tai bu bye saṃ kaste 'os pa/ /ston pa'i mchod rten 'byung gyur cig /bdag gis brtag pa 'di yis ni/ /bsod nams na ma yā mu nā/ /bha bantu te na saṃ sā re niḥsaṃ sā rāḥsha rī ri ṇaḥ/ /cung zad gang bsgrubs pa/ /de yis 'khor bar lus can rnams/ /'khor ba med par 'grur bar shog /dhyā two ti tsadza ka ta roḥshā khā yī dṛ pa tiḥshi raḥ/ /pa dhwa ka tsa ka lā se de ltar dmigs nas mi bdag gis/ /tsam pa ka shing lo ma la/ /skra tshogs kyis btags bcad nas mgo//nastso tā pā dāddhā dzadma ṣpe/ /a tha na ra pa teḥs twond+ra ha sgu ṭa pra ṇi ṅgā na gnyis skyes la ni rab tu byin/ /de nas mi yi ⑤bdag po'i snying stobs spro zhing gsal ba'i smon lam dang //taṅgi ma pi bi ma leḥpu rgyu lo kerdi ganta pi sā ri bhiḥ/ /bi ga li ta ma hā gang yang dri med bsod nams snang ba phyogs mthar rnam par 'phro ba yis/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen rnam mo ha ghāntaḥshri taḥpa ri dridṛ ti pra bee ra ta bha bā sgyu sā yā paḥkṣa rja par sel zhing yongs su myang 'das la brten nghru dang / /srid par goms pa'i ngal ba rab sel 'gro la skad da bha badzdza naḥ/ /i ti pāstsadma bṛsgyunta ka tha yā bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /bhekṣu cig dag gis gyur/ /de ltar sngon skyes spyod pa'i mtha'/ /bshad nas bcom ldan rgyal ba yis/ /sbyin rde bi da dha shudha rā na sadherma de sha dzā/ /i ti kṣe mende na bi ra pa dag pa'i dam chos dag /dge slong rnams la bstan pa bsgrubs/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas 95—83

tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na ka spra la tā yī tsand+ra pra bhā ba dā pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rtogs pa rgo pañtsa maḥpalla baḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga pa'o// //dā narya tā nā thra thu bīryā bhā rdzu shuddhādma rna satwa ma ho da bye dzā/ /sbyin pa la brtson brtson 'grus rgya che'i gnas/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid snying stobs rgya mtsho dang / /a ho ma hotstsha ha ba ṭwā pa raze bha baṃ tya tsidhyā ni sa mā hi tā ni/ /hadzee ro ha ṇa spro ba che ldan rnams ni gzhan don la/ /kye ma bsam gyis mi khyab bzhed pa yin/ /gang zhig mkhar rnyog he la yā ya da ba lāḥ swa byeḥ sa hā bye li hā yabye gotpa da lī la yā dza ri bo sul bcas dag la rtse dgas pa gam la 'dzegs 3dang / /gang dag chu tshogs 'khrug 27cing gyen la bha ra kko sgodha tāḥsinta baḥ/ /la bhyadhe bha ba na stha lī ka la na yā 'thor rgya mtsho dag la rol pas ba lang rjes/ /gang yang nags tshal stug po'i khyon ḍasne3la dga' bder khang ye tsā ḍa bī dzā ta ṭa ste bye rya gya ma hā dma rmā bi la sa ta ཿ sa twordzi pa'i thang bzhin 'god byed pa/ /de ni bdag nyid che rnams snying stobs kyis bsgrubs rgyas pa'i brtson tai sgurdzi tai/ /pu rā hi bha ga bān budhaḥshra bahūṃ pu ra bā si rmā/ /'grus rnam rtsen yin/ /sngon ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /man ngag rab tu gsal ba yis//u pa de sha pra kā sha na dza hā rā dzñā na dzee ta maḥ/ /dzhagru saṃ s+hoḥpa ri dṛ taḥmanyan yod grong khyer ba rnams kyi/ /mi shes las skyes mun pa bsalasti/ /de ni nam zhig ma ga dhar//pa kā tsidma ni gyu naiḥ / / kṛ tā nu yā tro ma ga dhwa ta swa yo tsa ri dge slong tshogs kyis yongs bskor cing 'a/ /tshong pa'i skye bo'i rjes 'brang bcas/ /rang nyid rgyu zhing ka yā ya yo / / ma hā ṭwā nu ga tai pra dzee tai ba na ba ṭwā nā/ /gshegs par gyur/ /nor chen don mthun rjes 'brang zhing / /nags kyi lam nas gshegs pa de//95—84
