oṃ ku li sha ya te/ /dwoṣa dwo ṣa tu ra phye ba tsanda rna da na ya te/ /tirlogla dug nyid bzhin du spyod/ /me tog rdo rje bzhin du spyod/ /tsandan sreg byed bzhin du spyod/ /byang chub ni ga ta sgyu pi bo bye sa twa pa da sbi teḥ/ /kā ru bye mi tri mukta mya sems dpa'i go 'phang gnas/ /snying rje byams pa dag dang ldan/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas song gyur kyang //nāghirda ha nyi bi gra haṃ/ /pu rā ka lo ga dṛ pa tiḥkhaṇḍa dī pā bhi sgo ba mbi/ /lus ni me yis mi 'tshig go /ka ling ka yi mi bdag sngon/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams 'joms pa la/ /da dā ha mṛ ga saṃ ghā āoṃ saṃ kṣe pā sa sa murya taḥ/ /kā na ṣpe dzwa li te yang dag brtson pas dum bu'i gling / /zhes pa'i nags tshal bsregs ①par gyur/ /nags tshal rab tu tasmirje kastenti ri sha ba kaḥ/ /mi byu bo dhi sa mā lo bya da ha na pra 'bar ba der/ /byi'u ②ti ti ri gcig pu/ /byams pa'i ①byang chub la dmigs pas/ /sreg byed rab sha oṃ bya pāta/ /tasmra da dro ha ma na saṃ na bha paṃ bi bye te kwa tsita/ /thra tu zhi bar bsgrubs/ /de las du'akhu med yid ldan rnams/ /gang du yang ni 'jigs pa med/ /snying ya tī sa two sa dzaste ri da ma n+yatstsha kau tu ki/ /a bṛbye bi ṣa me kā le stobs phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /dge mtshan 'di dang gzhan yang nyon/ /char med mi bzad dus su ni//mu naḥka su tsi dā shra me/ /ma nu 6 sa dṛ shā lā paḥsha sha kaḥsu tsi ram̐ sbi taḥ/ /thub pa 'ga' yi bste gnas na/ /mi dang 'dra bar brjod pa yi/ /ri bong zhig ni yun ring gnas/ /gruta kṣa mambu ni mā lokya pha la mu la pa ri kṣa yāta/ /u bā tsa tsa la saṃ kalpastabye 'bras bu rtsa ba yongs zad pas/ /ltogs rid thub pa mthong gyur nas/ /bsam pa de yi gdung bas gzir//thā bya thi tā sha yaḥ/ /bha ga bān ma ma mā se na saṃ pra ti pā ṇa bsto rgo/ /g.yo med kun tu rtag par ⑤smras/ /bcom ldan bdag gi sha dag gis/ /da ni srog gi rten po dag /kri ya hūṃ rakṣa bhā yo te sha rī ram̐ dhadzre sā dha āoṃ/ /ikyughā dā ba she ṣā sgo mdzod cig chos ni sgrub ⑥bgyid pa/ /khyod kyi ⑦lus ni bsrung bar 'os/ /'di brjod nags sreg mjug 95—127

bi kṣe pa sha sha kasta sum̐/ /bārta mā no pi yasne na pra ṇa yāta mu gi mer/ /thub pas ①byams pas yang yang du/ /'bad pa yis ni bzlog gyur kyang / /ri bong gi ni ni nā mu huḥ/ /ta su sa twa pra bhā bee na dzā la dzā lā ku lo na laḥ/ /pra lus po 'phangs/ /de yi snying stobs mthu yis ni/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis dkrigs pa'i me 'jam ya yo mañdzu shi dzā na bhra ma dzā bye dza khaṇḍa tī/ /so pi di bya ba pu sta tra ka ma pa'i sgra sgrogs bung ba can/ /padmo'i rdzing bur rab tu gyur/ /de yang lha yi lus kyis der/ /padma chen po le ma ha ti dzre taḥ/ /pra ṇa mya mā no mu ni ni bi da dhe dharma de sha rmā/ /i ti bo dhi dag la gnas/ /thub pas ⑤phyag 'tshal ldan pa la/ /chos rnams rab tu bstan pa byas/ /de ltar byang pra dṛṭwā dzā na ba snerna bee ṣāta ba yo/ /bha ga bān ka tha yi two ti chub zhugs pa rnams/ /'jigs pa mes ①min dug gis min/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das//shrī gupta bha ba 8 ya yo/ /ta tra te na pra bi bye ba bi ni kṣiste dakṣi ṇi pa de/ /dpal sbas kyi ni khang par gshegs/ /des ni de ru zhugs nyid na/ /zhabs ni g.yas pa bzhag pa yis//ba bhū bāghi kha dā mañdzu kṛ dzata j-i ga sa ro dza nī/ /dṛsgo ba biṣṭi shrīguste me yi dong ni mtsho skyes can/ /bung ba 'jam sgrogs ldan par gyur/ /mtsho skyes khri la bzhugs pa de/ /sbe sa ro ru ha bste re/ /tad dṛṣṭi naṣṭa kā lu 6ཿsro bā tsa tsa ra ṇa na taḥ/ /dpal sbas kyis ni mthong gyur nas/ /de mthong sdog pa nyams pa yis/ /zhabs la btud de rab tu smras//bha ga bān ma ma pā pa su kṣanta byo yo bya ti kra maḥ/ /mo hādhe pa ti bcom ldan bdag ni sdig can gyis/ /rim las 'das 'di bzod par bgyi/ /gti mug gis long lhung tai ru tsu kā ru ju ma bye rka sa tī/ /ma mā ka stso ṇa mi tre ṇa yo yo pā chags la/ /dam pa rnams ni thugs rjes ④lhag /bdag ni mi dge'i bshes gnyen dag /rab tu pa pa the kṛ taḥ/ /u pa de shaḥpra mo he ṇa ta tra tā khaṃ bha bta smṛ tiḥ/ /bi ṣa rmongs pas sdig pa yi⑤/ /lam la nye bar gdams pa byas/ /de la khyod nyid dran pa skyabs/ /khyod kyi 95—128

digha ra saṃ sadzre sgo rdzu te kalpi tasma yā/ /a ho ma mai ba saṃ krārnye zas dang btung ba kun/ /bdag gis ①dug gis bsgos pa byas/ /phyi nas gdung ba'i rang bzhin dug /pashātna pa ma yo bi ṣe/ /i ti shu pā hūṃ shrī gubye sā khru ṣpe tra kṛ bā ni kye ma bdag nyid rang la 'pho/ /'di brjod dpal sbas mchi ma dang / /bcas pa'i mig la snying rje'i byeḥ —/ /dṛṭī ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān bhikyu saṃ gha gya shri ṇa taḥ/ /gter—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas gsungs/ /dge slong dge 'dun nyan par byed/ /bee ṣā dasmra kṛḥtha sā bho na ba yi bi mu khā sta yi/ /gho ra bai ra bi ṣa tya gāta legs pa yi mug ma byed cig /bdag cag khyod la phyir ma phyogs/ /'jigs rung khon gyi ①dug spangs na bāsmran tā pa te bi ṣi/ /bā rā ṇa sde bu rā shrī mān bra hma dasto bha bta pas—/ /nged la dug gis gnod pa med/ /khrod ni bā rā ṇa sīr ④sngon/ /dpal ldan mi bdag tshangs dṛ paḥ/ /a khyu da nu pa mā nā ma ta sba pra ṇa sa mā shri yā/ /su baṇḍi bhā sa saṃ dzha byin gyur/ /de yi srog dang mnyam pa yi/ /dga' ma dpe med ma zhes pa'o/ /de nas de yi grong khyer gya ta ta pu rānta ba na sbi teḥ/ /ra basma yu ra rā dza gya sā ka dā thā sh-i mtha'i / /nags gnas rma bya'i rgyal mo ni/ /gser du snang ba zhes pa'i sgra/ /de yis nam zhig thos kho ta/ /sā ta gya shapta mā kasbya bai re bī ṇa sra no pa oṃ/ /ki me ta di ti sa pratstsha par gyur/ /gling bu pi wang gdangs lta bu/ /de yi sgra ni thos gyur nas/ /dge mtshan ldan pas 'di ci na ra nā zi sa kau tu kā/ / rā dza ba dha nāsta sminda ste ratna tstsha rda zhes| /mi yi mgon la de yis dris/ /rgyal pos smras pa nags mtha' 'dir/ /rin chen sgra ④ldan rma shi khāe/ /ma dhu re byu ba na byā pi ya sri tata kaṇḍa kyu dzi tai/ /i ti bya yod/ /gang gis dumagrin nas bsgrags pa 'dis/ /'jig rten rnams ni snyan pas khyab/ /de skad shu bā kho dṛ pa tistatpandarsha na mabee taḥ/ /pre ma pra yasneḥpre ma snga pra smras pa'i mi bdag gis/ /shin tu mdza' sdug rab 'bad pas/ /de mthong don du gnyer ba la/ /rab 95—129

mā nā yā tad beethra te ṣpe ba sa hi to ya yo/ /sa ta tāntaḥsu re ni bye sa bkug ste de'i ①khyim du/ /de nyid dang ni lhan cig song / /pho brang nang der rtag tu de/ /sa bdag bhābye ṇa me tī byu dzā/ /pū bye mā na pa ri tsa yā u bā sa bi mṛ tā da raḥ/ /btsun mor ⑤bcas pa yis/ /mchod cing yongs su 'dris ①pa las/ /gus pa gyernam par spro zhing gnas//sdirbha snga rmā bu da te 6 pā lbo la ma ṇi beedre su/ / tsi tra pa tra ru tsā tsakre mthon mthing nor bu'i khang pa ni/ /'jam ldan chu 'dzin 'od de la⑤/ /'dab ma mdzes bkra dbang saṃ sastend+ra yu dha bhra oṃ/ /a tha dig dza ya yā tra yo ka dā tsid ba su dmā bye po'i gzhu/ /chags pa lta bur 'khrul pa byas/ /de nas de yi rim gro la/ /gus dang bcas pas lha mo paḥ / /ya yo ta du pa tsā rā ya de bī mā di shya sā da raḥ/ /ta tartswa nu pa mā de bī bskos—/ /phyogs las rgyal ba'i bgrod pa la/ /nam zhig sa yi bdag po song / /de nas lha mo dpe med ma//pa rkyo yā te bra mā di bhā/ /rū pa yo ba na darpānt+ra nā lu lo ke ku bdag po song bas bag med cing / /gzugs dang lang tsho'i dregs ⑥pas long / /rigs kyi lugs ni la sbi ti/ /ta ru ṇi pre ghra rā gi dhyāsta suḥshaṃ darba bi bla be/ /byu ya mthong ma gyur/ /gzhon nu 'bangs la chags ldan ma/ /'dod pas rnam par bslad ma de'i/ /ngo tsha shin pa lo bha dī te ba laspyo dru ra ta ram̐ ya yo/ /ma li naḥku ḍi last+rikyāḥkarṇa tu ring song ste/ /yang yang dmigs pas 'jigs ⑦pa bzhin/ /dri ma ldan zhing gya gyu rno/ /rna ba dag saṃ sparsha no tsi taḥ/ /tsa ba labya pa lāspyi rde su dṛ shī sa dṛ shaḥkra maḥ/ /bi bi la reg par bzod/ /g.yo ba g.yo ba'i mig can dang / /mig ni legs pa rim pa mtshungs/ /'khor ba sgodma da kā ri sgoḥsaṃ sā ra ma ka rā ka re/ /tsa radhi pā ṇa hā ri rgyaḥkā la chu srin 'byung gnas su/ /rnam pa mang pos myos byed cing / /srog 'phrog nag po brtsegs pa yi/ /ri kyu ḍa tstsha dāḥste yaḥ/ /ku su māta su ku mā ra su kru ra gya kra ka tsā da pi/ /ko mo ⑧bud med rnam pa ⑨rgyu/ /me tog pas kyang shin tu 'jam/ /sog le bas kyang shin ⑩tu rtsub/ /bud 95—131

dzā nā nyi pa ritstsha rda ste rde tsi tra su tsa ta saḥ/ /ba hu raspyu phri lnga kabyu kṛ med sems ni bkra ba dag /su yis ①yongs su gcod pa shes/ /mang ①chags dga' mas mgu ①byas tā ye yādhri nidṛ ti / / shī ta dzee bi ma dzee sna — kha ṅga dhwa dzā nas—/ /gang gi ④dga' bar bgrod byed de/ /bsil zhing dri med 'jam pa yisadu/ /ral gri'i rno rgyun pi beenta te/ /sā tsinta yata sbri ti sha lya ma yo mantaḥpu re ma ma/ /ma yur 'thung bar byed/ /des bsams bdag gi pho brang na/ /rma bya'i rgyal mo tshul khrims shes/ /skyes bu'i rā dzaḥshī la dzhaḥpu rū ṣā lā pa beeṣṭi taḥ/ /ka tha yi 6 tya ba bye me lugs bzhin kun brjod pa/ /zug rngu 'di ni gnas par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod 'di sa bdag la/ /dṛtta me ṣa ma tī ba teḥ/ /ni sri karma kṛ tai tā ba dā dhwa nā ki ka ro mya haṃ/ /gdon mi za bar 'chad par 'gyur/ /las ni smad 'os re zhig byas/ /da ni bdag gis ci zhig bya/ /āsgo ba re rnyi ta dzha tī marma rnyo sau bi dakta dhīḥ/ /dzā tā me kṛ ta pā pā yāḥ'adi ni gnas spyo shes mchog gi blo/ /pha rol zur gyis 'dzin lta zhig⑦ /bdag gis byas pa'i sdig pa shaṃ kā ni bye ta ṣpe ṣṭa pe / i ti saṃ tsind+ra sā ta su bi ṣe sgo yis(nye—/ /dogs pa sems med rnams la'ang skye/ /de ltar bsams nas de yis ni/ /de la dug ldan dza āoṃ da do/ /rā ga maṭwāḥkha khā yaṭwāḥki ki kubyurnyi na ste yaḥ/ /te yo pā bza' ba byen/ /chags stsos mi bsrun ⑨dbang gyur pa'i/ /bud med ci dang ci mi byed/ /de yis nye tsarya mā ṇa su ba bi ṣeḥpā na sgo dza ṣpe/ /bi thraddhā brti rā dza gya ru ru bar sbyar ba yi⑨/ /bza' dang btung ba dug ldan gyis/ /rma bya'i rgyal mo rnam rgyas shing / /mdangs tse ru tsi rā ru tsiḥ/ /swasgra mā lokya tai di bī ra ha spyosgo da saṃ ka bzang yid 'ong mdzes par gyur/ /lha mos rnal nas ⑪de mthong nas/ /gsang ba rab mched dogs pa tā—/ /sha naiḥsho ka ma ya gra pā trastu ta tyā dza dzī bi lta/ /e baṃ ta gya bi ṣe yis—/ /dal bu dal bus mya ngan gyi/ /nad kyis bzung nas srog btang gyur/ /de ltar de yi dug gis 95—132

ṇḍa pi ṣpe pa glu ni ra dzā ya ta/ /ma hā tsā tsitta bai ma bye nirbi ṣi ku ru kyang / /nad dang ldan pa nyid ma gyur/ /chen po rnams kyi ①sems yangs pa/ /dug gis ṭwādug med te bee ṣi/ /rā go bi ṣe bi ṣe mo ho dre ṣastsa bi ṣa oṃ bi ṣi/ /busgo nyid du bgyid/ /'dod chags dug yin gti mug dug /zhe sdang dag kyang mi bzad dug /sangs rgyas dharmasta thā saṃ ghaḥs bye tsa pa ra mā mṛ tai/ /gho re bi ṣe thra dza ti chos dang de bzhin du/ /dge 'dun bden pa bdud rtsi'i mchog /gti mug chu tshogs chen po 'jigs su mo ha ma hāmbu rā shi gho ram̐ bi ṣi sre dza nyi rā ga ma ho rā gabya/ /gho ram̐ rung ba'i dug rnams spyo/ /chags pa'i ltos 'gro chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i dug rnams spro/ /sdang ba'i bi ṣe kṛ dza ti bee ra ba nā ba ni: dzadma kra moste bi ṣa ma gya bi ṣa pe nags kyi phreng ba 'jigs su rung ba'i dug rnams spro/ /mi bzad dug rnams skye ba'i rim pa gzhan ni yod nā byeḥ/ /dhand+ra kā ma kṛ ta bā ṣpe ba me bā tyā dzadma ni/ /shrī gubhoghi khā dzā saṃ pi ma yin①/ /'di bzhin skye ba gzhan la yang / /dpal sbas kyis ni me yi dong / /chos ni 'dod ma de la ta sgyu bhūta sa ha gyasti nī/ /i kyukta bha ga bān sa myakka ru rja lo byas—/ /de yang 'phral la pad ldan gyur/ /de skad brjod nas bcom ldan 'das/ /yang dag snying rjes kā rmā bu rbhaḥ/ /tsa kā ra bī ta ra dza saṃ shrī gupta shā sa norlu khaṃ/ /ka gzigs pa'i chus/ /bstan pa dag la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /dpal sbas rdul dang bral ba byas/ de li ku sha laḥshrī gusto tha prakā sha ba dāpta ye sha ra ṇa ga ma nā bye ba nas dpal sbas dge ba shes pas rab tu gsal ba'i gnas thob phyir/ /dri med dran pas skyabs su 'gro ba ṭī ṇi sma ran bi ma la smṛ tiḥ/ /dzi na pa ri tsa yāta pu sgo le bhe pa tsā hi lo gsum nyid dran gyis bugazhan ma yin/ /rgyal dang yongs su 'dris pas bsod nams 'thob (sheste gang phyir ka rgo bha ba ti ma ha te ka sthā rja ya pra mo da su khā ya tsa/ /shrī gupta gya dam pa rnams/ /mthong bar grur pa dge ba che dang rab tu dga' dang bde ba'i slad/ /mi shes rmongs pa 95—133

ni kā ra ki lbi ṣa dzu sngo byā dzñā na mo hā pa ha ཿ kṛ tā ba shya ma bar 'dir 'bad pa'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad pa ma dpe rnams las ma rnyed par a pa bye gyi a shwa dang mtshalas sbyar bye gyi klad skor ma srog med la a nu'i a drangs pa'i dngos bstan pa byu ma'i 'bru gsum po 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/sel ba'i bcom ldan 'das ni snying rje khyabasod nams la brtson pas/ /gnod byed ①sdig pa bsten pa'i nu gra he ṇa bha ga bān kā ru stsorya taḥ/ /dīkṣu rde bha ba saṃ kṣa yā ya dpal sbas kyang ni 'bad pas rjes su bzung ①byas nas/ /'ching ba'i khang par yang srid 'dud stipa 'di bi da dhe nidzee ra tā shā sa rna ye ṣpe ta na bha brnyi brnya bha ba ṣpe byu yo bha ba dag rnams su gang gis mi 'gyur ba/ /srid pa yang dag gzhil slad dge slong rnams la khon dang bral ba'i grabye ya/ /i nyi kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kabee bstan pa bsgrubs/ /zhes pa 1dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod khyapa la tā yī shrī gubhā ba dā na ma ṣṭa ma palla baḥ// //dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dpal sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad pa'o// //dha tyā nā ma shi baṃ bi bharti shu bha hūṃ bha bya swa bha bortse ba mūkhro hūṃ ku sha lo pra skal ldan rnams la mi shes pa ni legs pa'i rang bzhin las byung dge nyid gyur/ /rmongs pa rnams yā tya hi ta tā mi hye ṣa laghraḥkra maḥ/ /mee shī gharnyi mi rāndha mo ṣa dhi la dge ba mi phan nyid 'gyur 'di ni rim pa 'di yis mtshon/ /mtshan phyed smag rum myun pa sman gye nags ba na snga tyanta kārnyi pra da me dastso lu ka ku la dṛṣṭa ha ta ye sarba tra me la mchog tu mdzes pa rab tu ster/ /gang yang nyi ma'i gzi byin 'ug pa'i rigs kyi mig ni kun tu nyams trasma haḥ/ /pu ra rā dza kṛ hā bhi khye bimbi sā ra su khyu pa teḥ/ /a khyuta par byed/ /sa bdag gzugs can snying po yi/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces pame/ /rab bzang zhes po ra su bha dā khyuḥpa ri pūrṇa kṛ ha sbi teḥ/ /mokhyeta mo ha pra palla su sarba darsha pa'i grong khyer ba/ /yongs rdzogs khyim na gnas pa byung / /lta ba kun la rnam sdang zhing / /gti mug rab 95—134

na bi dwo ṣaḥ/ /ta su kṣa pa ṇa ke ṣe ba ba khyu bā sgyu bhi ka da raḥ/ /ta gya tu rgyas pa des/ /rmongs las zad byed pa nyid la/ /mngon par gus pa lhag par gyur/ /de yi chung ma pa tya ba tī nā ma dzā yā ti dza na shā li nī/ /gasgo mā dha tu pūrtend+ra bisbe po rānda cho rigs can/ /bden ①ldan ma zhes bya ba yis/ /mngal bzung zla ba nya ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor shar gyi ri ba di ka /ka landa ka ni bā pā khyu be rku kā na na saṃ shra yaḥ/ /ka phyogs kyi 1bzhin/ /ka lan da ka'i gnas zhes (1pa/ /'od ma'i tshal du yang dag gnas/ /sangs dā tsita bha ga bān budhe pāptaḥpiṇḍa ya tad kṛ haṃ/ /pū rdzu sa bhārya kṛ tāsmi rgyas bcom ldan bsod ④snyoms la/ /nam zhig de yi khang par gshegs/ /de ni chung mar bcas pa yis(khya//pa tai sa pratstsha sā da raḥ/ /gasgo sbi ta ma pa hye lata ki rū paṃ ta bha bi 6 ti/ /de la mchod byas gus bcas pas/ /bu ni mngal na gnas gang de/ /ci yi gzugs 'gyur de la dris/ /sau ba data saṃ pa rda bhu bye pu traste di bya mā nu ṣi/ /bra bra bye yā shā sa ṣpe me de yis bka' stsal khyod kyi bu/ /lha mi'i phun sum tshogs spyad nas/ /nga yi bstan la rab byung nas/ /saṃ yusto mutta me 6 ti/ /yā ti bha ga ba ti spaṣṭa mi tyā di shya ni yang dag ldan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /de skad gsal bar bka' ⑥stsal nas/ /bcom ldan rang gi gnas dza shra oṃ/ /a sgyu ya yo kṛ ha pa tespyo ri kaḥkṣa pa rṇa kṛ haṃ/ /bha ga bta su gshegs/ /khyem bdag khang par zad byed pa/ /bhu ri ka ni mngon par 'ongs/ /bcom ldan 'das byu ṣi tai tatse su bha dre ṇa ni bee di hūṃ/ /shu tā kṣa pa ṇa kaḥkṣi pre ma kyis gsungs pa de/ /rab bzang gis ni smras par gyur/ /zad byed pas thos myur bar ni/ /khong khro'i byuta dzwa ṣā bee ṣā ku laḥ/ /ga ṇa yi tā sa su tsi re gra ha dzñā na kṛ ta shya yaḥ/ /dug gis 'khrugs par gyur/ /shin tu yun ring des brtsis (gyenas/ /ngal bas gza' ḍakyeni shes byas te//yo de bos+ho bha ga ba tā prashrī pa shanta thā bi sgo/ /so tsinta ye da ho sa tya dris lan bcom ldan gyis gsungs gang / /de lta'i rnam pa kho nar mthong / /des bsams kye ma the tshom 95—135

muktarnye na na paṃ sha yaḥ/ / ta ta pra bha bo pa ma dā ya kirlu sa bye dag /med par de yis bden par brjod/ /'on kyang de yis smras pa'i dngos/ /gzhil slad bdag ni ba dā mya haṃ/ /ta su sarba dzha tsā bisti su bha dro ya di mata gi rā/ /ta de ṣa mi bden brjod/ /bdag gi tshig gis rab bzang gis/ /gal te kun mkhyen de rig na/ /de las dge kṣa pa ṇa shrazlo tyabhya ti shra ma ṇa da rāta/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya pā marshaḥs su sbyong la gus 'dis/ /zad byed la dad gtong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar bsams nas khro ldan pa/ /de yis bha dra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a sa tya me tata ka thi tai te na sarba dzha mā ni nā/ /ma nu rab bzang dag la smras/ /kun mkhyen nga rgyal can de yis/ /'di dag mi bden pa nyid brjod/ /lha yi 6ཿka tha māsno ti de bārta di bya baṃ ba rda/ /pra bra dzñā ki tu pa hye ba phun tshogs lha la 'os①/ /mi yis ji ltar thob ②par 'gyur/ /'on te rab byung ldan spyonyid na/ /de kartudhe nā snga byurnyi tā/ /spyi ṇaḥgru du pa tasto tsā ya gya nāst+ya n+ya to ga tiḥ/ /yi sti'adi ni bsam par bya/ /dbul dang ltogs pas gdungs pa 'am/ /gang la 'tsho thabs gzhan med pa//ta su ta su su sgyikṣuhaṃ sha ra rde shra ma ṇa bra tai/ /pa shā mya haṃ kṛ ha pa te skya rgyal 'os pa de de yis/ /skyabs ni dge sbyong brtul zhugs yin/ /khyim bdag bdag gis mthong ba ni//bra mā khaṃ ya di madma tsaḥ/ /pra kyu tā yo shi shudzā taḥku lo saṃ tā pa yi6 gal te bdag gi tshig tshad na/ /bzlog par bubyis pa 'di skyes pas/ /rigs ni yongs su gdung bar nyiske/ /i kyu dīrya kṣa pa ṇa ke pā te kṛ ha pa nyi — ram̐/ /bi tsārya bi da 'gyur—/ /'di brjod zad byed pa song tshe/ /khyim bdag gis ⑥ni yun ring du/ /rnam par dpyad nas bye hūṃ tsā yukṣiṃ garbha ni pā ta ṣpe/ /ya dā dra bya pra yo ge ṣā ṣpe ba gasgo mngal lhung slad/ /sbyor ba de dang de dag bsgrubs/ /gang tshe rdzas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mngal ni yongs su pa ri sgo taḥ/ /ta dā sri pasnri ma ba dhī de kādhe ha ṭha marda ṣpeḥ/ /ta taḥshī ma g.yos nyid/ /de tshe 'di yis bden ⑦par ni/ /chung ma drag pos mnyes te ④bsad/ /de nas sdig 95—136

ta ba rna ta sde thra shā rna te na pā pi na/ /pra pi tā yī kṣa ba rja kastabye ddhā can de yis de/ /bsil ba'i tshal gye dur khrod du/ /rab tu bskyal tshe zad byed pa/ /de yis gtam nandi ta dza guḥ/ /a ho ba tā bo sarba dzhaḥshi sho sa hye ta dukta bān/ /mee yo thos dga' nas smras/ /a ho kye ma kun mkhyen 'dis/ /byes pa la brjod de bden ldan/ /bu ni ma sru no ra dzā te snga dza na mbi pañtsa hūṃ ma tā/ /i yo sā shrīḥshi sho di byādhe noṭwā skyes ma dag ni/ /lnga pa nyid gyur ①'di de yin/ /de yis brjod pa'i byis pa yis④/ /lha mi'i dpal di bya ma nu ṣi/ /i yi tsa sā su pra bra rje yadkukṣiṃ ni dha rna ga taḥ/ /i te te ṣe mchog de ni 'di/ /'di yi rab byung de yang 'di/ /gang zhig dkur ni shi gyur pa'o/ /de skad de dag pra ba de na so pa hā me na sarba taḥ/ /thra shā na darsha nā mee ba ba byu ba rab smra zhing / /nye bar dgod pas thams cad ni'u/ /dur khrod blta ④ba kho na'i phyir/ /skye bo yang dza na saṃ ga maḥ/ /a tānta re di bya dṛ shā bha ga bān khyu ta bhā ba naḥ/ /dag 'dus par gyur/ /skabs der sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'byung po dgongs pas lha yi ni//sadzre bi dzñā ya tabyedhaḥ pra da rmyo pa smi taḥkṣa rṇa/ /a ho mo hā nu spyan gyes de skad ⑤kun mkhyen nas/ /'dzum pa dang ldan skad cig bsams/ /kye ma gti mug gis ba dhe na dru ra sbi ra pi de hi rmā/ /ā lo kashā rya te spruṇi rme ghi bcings pas/ /rmongs pa ring du gnas pas kyang / /lus can rnams la snang ba sgrib/ /sprin gyi rnam ri ba kā ri bhiḥ/ /shu dzha kṣa ya pa ya tā te na kṣa pa ṇi na sa mukta dhīḥ/ /a ho par 'gyur bas bubazhin/ /kye ma dge ba zad byed pa'i/ /zad byed pa de sdig pa ⑦ las/ /khyim bdag kṛ ha pa ti pā pā da kārya ma pi kā ri taḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsint+ra bha ga bān dman pa'i blo can las2/ /bya ba min pa khyebyed du bcug /ces tu 7bsams snying rje rab rgyas pa'i//swa yo bhikyu ga ṇibye taḥ/ /ya yo shī ta ba āoṃ kṣi shaṃ thra shā dzwa ka ru rja bcom ldan rang nyid dge slong gi /tshogs kyis bskor nas myur bar ni/ /bsil ba'i tshal gye dur khrod 95—137

ku laḥ/ /thra shā na tsā ri rmā dzñā tā rā dzā bha ga ba taḥswa yi/ /dzi bi swa raḥgashegs—/ /bcom ldan rang nyid dur khrod na/ /rgyu ba shes nas rgyal po ni/ /gzugs can snying po sa hā mā hyestu ṣpe ba bhū ba mā ya yo/ /ta taḥs ta tra dzā yā yī rna kṣibhā blon dang bcas/ /sa de nyid du 'ongs par gyur/ /de 'og rab bzang chung ma no/ /sreg pa'i me la yo tsi tā na le/ /ku kṣiṃ bhi tāmbu dzā rpā naḥshi shuḥsurya i borya yo/ /dzā li tā na bcug pa dang / /chu skyes la gnas byis pa dag /dku brtol nyi ma bzhin du 'thon/ /me 'bar dbus la madhya sbe tai kabye gra tīrya dā/ /ta da dza na sa mū ha su hā hā kā ro ma hā na gnas pa de/ /gang tshe sus kyang ma blangs pa/ /de tshe skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /hā hā zhes pa chen na byuta/ /ta ta dzee paṃ tra mā beeddhā ga tiḥsu ga ta sha sa nāta/ /ku por gyur/ /de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bkas/ /'tsho byed ces pa'i gzhon nu bsos①/ /rmongs mā ra j-i tro dza grwa ha dzre bā khya ku mā ra/ /dzi nā ba lo ka ṣpe ṣpe ba pa lta bu (snyerang 'gro yis/ /gzhon nu 'od ldan de blangs gyur/ /rgyal bas gzigs pa nyid kyis ni//bā la ka gra ha ṇa kṣa ṇi/ /a bhūñtsi tā na lanta su ha ri tsanda na shī ta lāḥ/ /dzre byis pa rab tu len pa'i tshe/ /ro sreg ①me dag de la ni/ /ha ri tsandan ltar bsil gyur/ /byis pa 'tsho brnye dzwa la nārlu ste ru tsi re bīghra dā ra shaṃ/ /bai labye ṇa kṣa pa ṇa kāḥkṣa rte zhing me las grol/ /rab tu mdzes pa mthong gyur nas/ /skyengs pas zad byed pa rnams ni/ /skad cig tasgru mṛ tā i ba/ /ta taḥsu bha dre bha ga bān sarba byu ta hi te ra taḥ/ /shi ba bzhin du gnas/ /de nas rab bzang ya mtshan rmis/ /rnam par 'khrul la bcom ldan 'das//ba bhā ṣe bisma yota sthārnyi pu tro yo kṛ khya tā mi ti/ /sa tu do lā ku la ma tiḥ'abyung po kun phan la ④dgyes pas/ /bu 'di blang bar gyis zhes gsungs/ /de yang the tshom dag las blo//ki ka ro mbi ti saṃ sha yāta/ /kṣa pa rja dzā mu khā bye ba shikṣu yi kṣa ṇa ci bya snyam pa'i khyogs la ⑤'phyang / /zad byed rnams kyis bzhin dag ⑥la/ /bslab pa'i slad du skad 95—138

mi ghra ta/ /te ta spru tsu na bā lo yo grwa khyaḥdre shā na balbo dzaḥ/ /ya tā yo tiṣṭha ta cig bltas/ /de la des smras dur khrod kyi/ /me skyes byis pa 'di mi blangs①/ /gsal bar gang du 'di byalte na bha ba hye ba tabye nyi/ /i ti te ྾ gi ra rūkhoḥs dza gā ha na tai ya gnas pa/ /de khyim brlag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de skad de dag tshig gis de/ /rmongs pas gang tshe de ma ta / /ta dā kṣi ti pa tirpā la mā da de dzi na shā sa nāta/ /byo tirma byu dā bābee blangs—/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i bka' yis ni/ /sa yi bdag pos byis pa blangs/ /me dang mtshungs pa'i gya te ྾ tsā sa dri sha tī ṣa/ /byi nyi dza i ti nā mā su tsa kā ra bha : te ྾ sogs byed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i bod skad mi 'dug pa za hor bandes bsgyur ba slar ma dpe rnyed na dpyad/'od ldan pa/ / gsal bas de rnams bar khyab pas/ /gyede yi ming ni me skyes zhes/ /bcom ldan nyid ga bān swa yo/ /ta gya bra barbha mā na gya byu bā la bha ba ṣpe shi shoḥ/ /de shā nā kyis mdzad par gyur/ /sa skyong khang par byes pa ni/ /rab tu bskyed par gyur pa de'i/ /zhang po yul ra ga taḥkā le mā tu laḥs mu pā ya yo/ /sa bi di tā swa su bṛhaṃ ni gzhan song ba dag /dus kyis 1yang dag 'ongs par gyur/ /de yis khrusring mo shi ba dang / /bu skyes dha ṣpe pu tra dzasdi/ /ko pāta su bha dra ma bye tya ke ba mā naḥs ma bhya jota/ /spyod tshul rig gyur nas/ /khro bas 'dar zhing mngon phyogs te/ /rab bzang la ni yang dag smos⑤//rūkho kṣa pa ṇa bhaste na tata gi rā ha ta yo ṣi tā/ /twa yā tyakta swa pu tre ṇa rmongs pa zad byed la gus shing / /de yi tshig gis chung ma bsad/ /khyod kyis (⑥ rang gi bu dor naklu//kind+ra ma su kṛ ta kṛ tai/ /nibye ta nāḥswa bha bee na pa ra oṃ tra pa mudzre legs byas ming ni ci zhig byas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sems med cing / /gzhan gyi sngags kyis kun tu tāḥ—/ /ha sadho pe bi ni ghrarnyi bee tā ḍā i ba durdza naḥ/ /a dhu ṣpe slad⑧—/ /skye bo ngan pa dgod '-i)na yang / /rnam par 'joms ⑩byed ro langs bzhin/ /gal te rgyal ba na kṛrje pi ya di ra dza kṛ hāta su tai/ /taste ṭwā ba bha murgyu 6 kā ra yā po'i khab nas bu/ /da lta nyid du mi len na/ /bud med bsad pa bsgrags nas de/ /khyod nor chad 95—139

myadzee ni gra hi/ /i kyuktaste ta ta dī tyā pa byu pa ti kṛ hāta su tai/ /ā pas gcod du 'jug /de yis ①de skad brjod pa ⑤des/ /'jigs nas sa bdag khab nas bu/ /len ni nā tsi rā ta mukta ma kā me na ma tī bhu je/ /ta taḥsu bha dre kā le na du bcug pas sa bdag ni/ /'dod dang ldan pas ring nas ①gtad/ /de nas rab bzang dus kyis ni//kā la gya ba sha mā ga te/ /a byuta ni dhibee byu tī ram̐ bye tiṅgārga i ba tī ྾/ /dus kyi dbang du song bar gyur/ /me skyes rnam par 'byor pa'i gter/ /'od kyis ④nyi ma bzhin du gyur//abee kalpa dru maḥpā pya sadza rda di bya mā nu ྾/ /sa budha dhand+ra saṃ gha slong ba rnams kyi snyedapag bsam shing / /lha mi'i phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 6 shar bye ṣṭa ka ra to ma ti/ /tata bhathi pa na tai di bya ratna saṃ tsa ya ma da bhu 'dun gye/ /skyabs la de yi (6blo gros byas/ /de la gus pas nyer bsgrun pa/ /rmad byung lha yi rin chen haṃ / /pa da do rnyi kṣu saṃ bhe bhyaḥpu rgya ratna rdza norya taḥ/ / ta su tshogs—/ /bsod nams rin chen sgrub brtson des/ /dge slong dge 'dun rnams la phul/ /chu gter de ba ni kā ye bhyaḥsāstsaryā bi bi dharngu yaḥ/ /swa ya me bā ya yurbethra ma ho da cher ni chu bo bzhin/ /de lta'i khyim du lha'i ris las/ /rnam mang phun tshogs ngo mtshar can/ /rang nyid bye mi bā pa gāḥ/ /tro ṇi rasne tsa pa ma dhīdngha ga bā na pi tadṛ he/ /tsakra kho na 'ongs par gyur/ /de yi khyim du bcom ldan 'das/ /rtswa ⑦dang rin chen mtshungs blos kyang / /de ta da nu ro dhe na ratna sā tra pa ri gra hi/ /sa di bya bant+ra yu ga waṃ ya yi ngor ni rin po che'i/ /snod (3ni yongs su bzung bar ⑨ mdzad/ /des ni 4 bye lha yi gos zung dag /sha sā mu pa mā kṣa saṃ/ /pā pa pu bye pa na kshi tai ni dzee gī la mi bā rang gi khyim 47bzhin dri ma med/ /grags pa rnams kyi dper bzod pa/ /bsod nams zong gis stsos spyom lo/ /ka dā tsi da tha tad bste sta nānd+ra n+yasta mā ta pe/ /sa mbi ra nas thob/ /de nas nam zhig de yis ⑫gos/ /bkrus nas brlan pa nyi ④'od bkod/ /yang dag g.yo 95—140

ṇi nā pa z-i tai n+ya pa tata rūdhri byu pa teḥ/ /bi lokyā pūdzee tu tsi ram̐ byo tiṣka bas rab bskyod nas/ /sa yi bdag po'i spyi bor lhung / /me skyes de yi she7gos dag ni/ /sngon med rab gya ta rda shu rka /di bya shrī bi smi to rā dzā tri rde me ṣpe ni dza shri yo/ /sgohūṃ mdzes mthong gyur nas/ /lha yi dpal la ya mtshan pa'i/ /rgyal po rang dpal rtsa bzhin sems/ /zas ni madhri taḥpā pya ta su ratna ma yo kṛ haṃ/ /dṛ pa tiḥswarga mā dzñā sī la mgron gnyer mi yi bdag /me skyes khyem na gnas pas de'i/ /rin chen rang bzhin khang pa dag /byo tiṣka bha ba desbi taḥ/ /a tha kā le na bhū pā laḥpu tre ṇa dzā ta sha tū shā/ /mthong nas mtho ris yin par sems/ /de nas dus kyis sa skyong ni/ /chos kyi ngang tshul ma skyes (kyidagra//tstshadma khā rā bye luste na dharma shi lo ni pā ti taḥ/ /a tī te sad gu ṇi rārnyi bu ni rgyal srid la chags pa'i/ /g.yo yis nges par bkrongs par gyur/ /rgyal po yon tan dam pa can//tasmin kṛ ta yu go pa mo/ /a dharma i ba ba pā pa rā rdzu rā dza ba rāta ma dzaḥ/ /sa rdzogs ldan lta bu de 'das tshe/ /rgyal po mchog gi bu de yis/ /chos min bzhin du rgyal srid thob/ /me khyu j-idrurla dzha dṛṭī byo tiṣka gya kṛ he shri yo/ /ta mu bā tsa se ma bye tya skyes dag gi khyim phyi dpal/ /sa bdag la dkon des mthong nas/ /yang dag mngon par song ste smras//ma ta pi tā two bi badhi taḥ/ /blu tā ta bā haṃ dhadzre ṇa bi bha bāsgo pra yatstsha me/ /khrod ni pha mas rnam par bsos①/ /khyod dang pha spun chos dag gis/ /'byor pa phyed ni bdag la stsol//na tse bhā ga dha na dro hāta ka li re ba pra dzā ya te/ /i kyusteste na kau ṭi sthāta bye gal te min na nor skal la/ /'khu las rtsod pa nyid rab skye/ /gya gyus sdang bar byed pa des④/ /de skad tiṣkaḥspyu ra kā ri rja/ /ratna sgoṇi kṛ ha tasmin da tā pra yāta pa ram̐ kṛ haṃ/ /sā brjod pas me skyes ni/ /khang pa rin chen gyis gang ba/ /de la byin nas khyim gzhan song / /lha yi rin di bya ratna ru tsi ra sbi tā lo ko pa kā ri bhā/ /byi tiṅgā me pā nu ya yo shrīḥchen yid 'phrog rgyas/ /'jig rten phan byed dpal 'byor de/ /me skyes kho na'i rjes su 'brang / /nyin 95—141

pra ti bhe ba di bā ka re/ /pu n+yastaghra pi bā saspata sapta kṛ twaḥpra bhā ba tī/ /mor byed la 'od zer bzhin/ /yang yang me skyes kyis spangs kyang / /phun tshogs de ni lan bdun du//byo tiṣka ma smṛṣṭa dṛ ba sā dhī ba nyi mi ba ya yo/ /sarba thā ha ra khodkus+ho da me skyes can song ①mi bdag gis/ /ma reg chung ma khyo can bzhin/ /chom rkun la sogs rigs pa yis//gya tso rā di yutta bheḥ/ /byo tiṣkaḥku pi ta dzñā tā nirbirṇaḥs ma tsinta rnam pa kun tu 'phrog brtson cing (she/ /khros par shes nas me ①skyes ni/ /yid byung gyur pas yang dag yata / /a pu ju pa ri pā ke na pra dzā rmā dza na ko pa maḥ/ /sī yā ta smṛ te she bsams—/ /bye rgu'i (gebasod nams ma yin pa/ /yongs su byun pas pha lta bu/ /rgyal po mnyes gshin ⑤ṣa two rā dzā bātpa thu pe sha laḥ/ /kau n+yastata sa dṛ shosmi:rgya dza sha ra le yangs pa ni/ /dran pa'i lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /'di na zol med drang po la/ /skye rgu dudabugs phyung pha pra dzāḥ/ /pi ta ri ba kṛ tā shā paḥsu kha rā tri 6 she ra te/ /dha ni naste ṇa ma bzhin/ /mtshan mo bde bar nyal byed pa/ /de dang mtshungs pa gzhan pa su/ /nor ldan rtswa bzhin bta pā byāḥpra pyarnye ratna bad bu dhwaḥ/ /a mṛ tā da pi duḥpā paḥsau dza n+ya sha ra bsgrub par bya/ /blo gros rin chen bzhin du thob/ /skye bo dam pa drang po ni/ /bdud rtsi bas kyang rnyed lo dza naḥ/ /byārgya dza bai dasbya dzu ṣā ma mukta sha ra lātpa rmā/ /a pa dka'/ /zol min mkhas pas (rngu bsten pa dang / /rmongs min drang po'i bdag nyid dang / /ma nudha tonda tā dzñā tsa bi ra lo dzanma tā dṛ shī/ /a dhu nā dī ṣa dudṛttaḥpra brtsigs mthon po nyid dag kyang / /de ltar skyes pa shin tu nyung / /da ni mi bdag zhe sdang gis/ /tshul bṛtta ni kṛ ti dṛ paḥ/ /pā pa pā ke na lo kā nā ma kā li ka li rā ga ngan gnod byed la rab zhugs/ /'jig rten rnams kyi sdig byun gnas⑧/ /dus min rtag ⑨tu rtsod ldan taḥ / /mi tre dza ga ti yā teste tasmin bhā swa ti byu ba to/ /do kho da yaḥ'ongs—/ /'gro bar khya7 sa bdag 'od ldan pa/ /bshes gnyen de ni nub pa'i tshe/ /de sras skyon skyed ⑪95—142

pra dṛsgo ya manta kā ra ya tahphu taḥ/ /zla rgo pa tā ma tī tā dzā niṅgā ra mtshan mo ni①/ /mun pa'i slad du rab tu rgyas/ /mi bsrun ①dam pa 'das rnams kyisazhu / /rgyu med ṇa su z-ita kha laḥ/ /yad bṛtta pa raḥbhā ge na ya shaste ྾ pra kā sha te/ /snying sdug yin nam snyam/ /gang zhig ④spyod tshul gzhan cha las/ /grags pa de dag rab gsal byed//tasmra di yi pa ri tya dzñā dṛ pa tya byekhyu tā ma tī/ /kā le ka lo kṣi tī she de slad mi bdag ngan pa yis/ /byin brlabs sa 'di yongs gtang ⑤'os/ /rtsod ldan dus kyi sa dbang tsa dza nā dzñā dzre bee tai ku taḥ/ /ba ra pa ri tsa yo dā rā dā rāḥs hūṃ la—/ /skye bo rnams ni ga la 'tsho/ /mchog tu yongs 'dris yid 'ong chung ma dam pa rnams kyis ⑪rab gu zla dzā gu rjaḥ ku la ma bi ka lo bha byā byu ti rya shaḥ sha shi sambi sbyangs yon tan dang / /'chol ba min pa'i rigs dang legs ldan sa bdag ri bong can mtshungs grags lha —/ / sbri ti sa mu tsi tai bṛ trī bi hūṃ ni mitta ma nā pa dzā gu ṇa pa dang / /lugs la yang dag 'os pa'i spyod tshul dag dang phongs med rgyu yi ༷)nor rnams te/ /mi pa ti dṛ pe sa baṃ bha ba tya bi paṃ ṣṭha lo / / dha rma dru ma bdag yon tan ldan na skyes bu rnams kyis ④thams cad rnam bslad rjomin par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rtsa ba su dha na mū la sa murga ta gya nirdo ṣa kā ma ku su ma pā pa ro dzwa la sru/ /nor gyi ljon pas yang dag bskyed gyur pa/ /skyon med 'dod pa rnams kyis me tog rgyas shing rab 'bar ba//lo kaḥsu khā ni ki la pu ju pha lā bhuste ha tā na tse ta ku dṛ pa tibee bsod nams 'bras bu bde ba nges par 'jig rten longs spyod de/ /rnam par ltung byed ⑪rgyal ngan rlung nirpā tai bā taḥ/ /ka liḥkā laḥpa tirpā la stata pra tā pabye tā na la/ /gis gal te ma bcom na'o/ /rtsod ldan dus dang bdag po byis/ /de yis ⑪rab gdung bsreg ⑫pa'i me//a kā la pi bla poṣṭha la kha la beeṭwā la saṃ ku laḥ/ /thra tibee ṣaṇḍa khind+ra dhīḥdus min rnam bslad rab tu drag /mi bsrun spyoro langs tshogs kyis gang / /dga' ba yid byung blo gros 95—143

su kha shrī ya ta yo ba dzñā/ /a thu nā bee bha bā sgo ge sgo ga yo ge bskyod—/ /bde ba'i dpal gyi lang tsho song / /da ni 'byor pa longs spyod rnams/ /spyod dang ldan la na me ru ཿ/ /dha āoṃ bhū mispyo haṃ dā raḥsu tā z-i tyā pa ritstsha dāḥ/ /a ho ni ra bdag mi sred/ /nor dang khyim dang chung ma dang / /bu dang g.yog po yo byad rnams/ /mtha' med nad ba byeḥsum̐ sī mā bye byā di pa ri gra haḥ/ /ya thā ya thā bi brjadhe shrīkhrorja bi dang gdung ba ste/ /kye ma skyes bu'i yongs 'dzin nosti/ /so ga'i tsha ba mi bzad dpal/ /ji lta ji ltar ṣa māḥshri yaḥ/ /ta thā ta thā dzwa la hye ba treṇḍa tā paḥsha rī ri rde/ /pra dṛdhi rnam 'phel ba/ /de lta de ltar lus can rnams/ /sred pa'i yongs su gdung ba 'phel/ /skye ba kun tu ra pi bidho ghi rā dzatho pārdzi taidṛ rde/ /la ba shā: ri ba dza lebee dṛbye nyer bsgrubs pas/ /nor gyi tshogs pa rab rgyas kyang / /lan tshu'i mtsho yi chu yis bzhin/ /mi rnams ṣpe ba dzā ya te/ /nāste nāst+ri tya saṃ to ṣād ya e ba dha ni ram̐ dza paḥ/ /pu narbha bee sred bral nyid ma yin/ /gang zhig nor ldan tshog khyemi shes/ /med do med do zhes zlos pa/ /gal te de bha beeta ko ba sa e ba pra sha mārya di/ /ṣpe biste rduni mirteḥka li ka la ha yis rab zhi na/ /yang srid dag tu su zhig 'gyur/ /rtsod dang 'thab mo zongs dang chags pa chen po rjes mo ha lo bhā nu bṛste ཿki sgo gibee pa yo girgya sa na sha ta pa ta nā sgyu pa su 'brang ba'i ltas ngan nor gyis (she/ci/ /rgud pa brgyar lhung yang dag chags pas nad skyed ④ 'bral bar saṃ sakta ro giḥ/ /ki bā mi byā bhi mā nairnar pa ti sa da na pābee 'gyur ba'i longs spyod dag gis ci/ /yid nyams g.yog la mi bdag khengs khyepa thob pa'i mngon pa'i nga se pā ba mā ṣpe rasmin bee rā gya me ba kṣa ya sa ma ya bha ye sgo gya mā ro gya rgyal dag gis ci/ /'dir ni chags bral kho na 'jig dus 'jigs par nad med longs spyod dag tu 'os yo gyi/ /a ti krādhe kā le swa dza na su z-i dā lo ka bi ma le sa pa yin/ /rang gi 'uskye bo snying sdug dri med snang ba'i dus ni 'das gyur cing / /lhag par mi bsrun ⑦95—144

mā pande mo ha pra ba la kā lu 6 ma li ṣpe/ /su khā shā saḥsum̐ sī pra sha sdeg pas rgyas pa'i rmongs pa yang dag 'ongs pa na/ /ngal dub yongs btang skye bo med pa'i nags kyi ma pa li la sthā ta ma na sī pa ri tyakta yā se bi dza na ba na bā se pa ri tsa gnas la yongs 'dris pas① / /yid ni rab zhi'i chus bgrus skyes bu rnams kyi bde ba'i dbugs 'byin yaḥ ske/ /i ti saṃ tsintu pa tsi re pa re bee rā gya ma ya yo/ / duḥkhaṃ yin—/ /de ltar yun ring de zhubasams nas/ /mchog tu 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ /sdug bsngal mo hā ya mūkhro rde bi bi kā ya tsa dhī ma tsā/ /sa da tā sathra mabee bhyaḥrmongs pa'i gti mug dang / /blo ldan rnams kyis blurnam 'byed beed/ /slong rnams la des kun byin nas//bra ya yo su ga tā shra oṃ/ / shrī shri kha lā nyiḥ kṛ bye na dhi sa tya su bde gshegs gnas su rab tu song / /gang phyir bden pa'i bder mngon phyogs/ /dpal gye lcags sgog khozlu khāḥ/ /ya de ba rā dza haṃ se na smarya te shu rtsa ma nā saṃ/ /sa de bāsmi ba su ma gis mi khugs/ /gang tshe ngang pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rdzing bu gtsang ma dran pa na/ /de tshe nor gyi blo gros ma//tī sa ra sī bi na ro tsa te/ /yā te duḥs ha mo ha dhū ma ma li ṣpe sgo gā nu rā gā ro ldan la yang nga ④ mi sred/ /longs spyod dag la rjes chags me ni bzod dka' rmongs pa'i du ba 'khyems na le sadho ṣā mṛ ta nidzha re ṇa ma na se pāpta sha ṣpeḥbhā ta tsā/ /ṣpe tāḥgyur pa/ /chog shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis yid la bsil ba nyid ni dal bus thob gyur name/ /btung bas chu pā na ma do tu re ga bi tsa lasgye dzā ga nā rbha gu ra byu dzha ga kṣa ṇa saṃ ga māḥmyos shing rab rgyug rnam par g.yo rgyun na chung g.yo ba'i byun 'khyog kyecan/ /skad cig 'grogs pa'i dpal sha ma ba hūṃ kurbarnyi bi rgyu shri yaḥ/ / sarba dzha shā sa na bi na ṣṭa bha bā mo 'di dag zhi ldan rnams kyi bgegs ni byed ma yin/ /srid pa'i lam gyi sdug bsngal rnam ④nyams thams dhwa kaṣṭaḥpra bra bye yā bi ma la me baṃ ba rda pra biṣṭaḥ/ /sā pā bya sarba cad mkhyen pa'i bka'/ /dri med nyid kyi gnas su rab tu byung bas rab tu zhugs/ zhi ba nyid ni thams 95—145

ga dza dhwa dza ma ṇi tstsha tra tsā ma ro dā ra yā shri yā/ /tai dṛṭī pū dzi tai rādzñā glang po rgyal mtshan nor bu gdugs/ /rnga yab rgya che'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /rgyal pos mchod pa de mthong tsiṭwā rta byu da āoṃ ga na ཿ / / ta gya sa tā ba dā ta su pa kṣa nas—/ /ma bsdams bsam pa 'khrugs par gyur/ /snying stobs dkar bar gyur pa de'i/ /rgyal ba pā tī sha ta kra tuḥ/ /tsa kā ra di byā ya lasgyu swa hā khra dzi na pū dza ṣpe/ /mchod la 1shestong grogs ni/ /phyogs bdag mchod sbyin brgya pa yis/ /lha yi dpal 'byor rnams kyis byas//sa ta yā di bya yā byu tyā bha ga banta ma pū dza ya ta/ /ya dā gre tsakra baṭī de yis lha yi 'byor pa des/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mchod gyur pakhru/ /gang mdun 'khor los sgyur ba'i shrī ladzdza bhā dza na tai ya yo/ /rasneju kṣa ta tsand+ra srurya bhā na bā shaṃ bar 'der 'od zer gyi skad dod yig 'azu bzhi chad pa ma dpe rnams las ma rnyed pa bhā na bā zhes pa 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/dpal—/ /ngo tsha yis ⑦/ni snod nyid gyur/ /nyi zla'i 'od zer nyams byed rin chen rnams dang sa srung rgyatī ra ṇi rā ba ṇa ste ra smrasba ra gandha mā lya sha ba leḥ kalpa dru mā rde 'od ldan glang po dang / /dri med gos dang spos 'phreng ⑤khrus dang dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu rnams ⑥pha leḥ/ /bhatta pra hra shā ṭī pi lā sa tsa la nā he lotshwa sadzñā ma ram̐ te dag gis⑦/ /bde sogs gus btud rol pas g.yo zhing dal bus rnga yab dag ni rab bskyod par/ /de nā bhyartsi ta mā ka la gya su ga tai ladzdza na to bhūta dzra paḥ/ /i ti ba hu yis bde gshegs mngon mchod mthong nas mi yi bdag po ngo tshas dman par gyur/ /de ltar ston pa la ta re bhasgyu shāstuḥpha lo ya da rna ga naḥshu bha pa ri ṇa toḥpu stso dā raḥpu rā sa gus dge ba yongs smin 'bras bu rab mang dag /gang zhig bsod nams rgya chen rdokhyam bsdams pas sngon 'u/ma papta bān/ /bi ma la ma na pasta sri bā sau kṣa ṇa pra ṇi dmā na taḥpa ra yang dag thob gyur cing / /dri med yid ldan de yis ⑩ skad cig smon lam nyid las de nyid ni/ /mchog i pa ra beesbyo tisko bhūta pa e ba pa da shri taḥ/ /i tyā ha bi ma la dzñā na pra gi nyi ma bzhin du dpal 'byor gyi gnas me skyes 'dir gyur to/ /'gro gsum dri med ye shes kyis/ /rab 95—147

kā shi ta dza gand+ra yaḥ/ /pra ṇi dhwa no ba de shā ya rnyigru rde bha ga bān tu gsal mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas dge slong rnams la ni/ /smon lam gdams ngag de skad dzi naḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa tā ba da na kalpa la tā gsungs—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam yī bye tiṅgā ba dā rna nā ma na ba ma palla baḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las me skyes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu pa'o// //rtsa pho pārnye bi ma la na li bhā tī ra pa ryanta bā sbo shāstu pūrbe 'jig rten mtha' dag nye bar gzung 3snaslad rab zhugs ston pa dag ni sngon/ /grong khyer tsam pa pa ka la byu ba nā nu gra hā ya pra bṛttaḥ/ /kṛṣṭa sparsha ba ga ti ru tsi nā dang nye dri med padma'i brdzing ngogs 'gram na bzhugs/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba reg na bde ba'i 'od bhekṣu shā nanda nāsthā garsā ram̐ bhāta pra j-i ti dza na tā dzadma bṛtrī dza ga da/ /ldan dge slong gis/ /dris nas mngal brtsams (1la sogs skye bo'i tshogs kyi skye ba'i ④spyod tshul gsungs//shudzeeḥ kṛste ཿ sha ba la ru tsi bherde ti rmā karma sru treshyi tram̐ lo ke ba hu 'jig rten du ni dkar nag 'dren ma'i 'od can las skud kyis bkra ba'i/ /lus can rnams kyi skye ba'i spyota ra shaṃ dṛ shya te dzadma bste/ /dzīrṇa snga pi bya pa na ma li na sne ha li naḥgos ni rab mang gnas skabs mthong gyur te/ /shin tu 'bad pas gang zhig yun ring yongs sgyur srul 'u pra yasne ya gya tyarnyi tse ra pa ri ṇa tirne ba nirlu ti rā gaḥ/ /sum̐ saḥshu por gyur mod kyang / /gdung ba'i dri ma snum chags tshon ni med pa nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /skyes pa bud kre pi ga li ta j-i te rārta paṃ yo ṣi tabya sparsha bee sha bya nyi ka ra dzre ṣeḥmed dag kyang 'dzin pa rnam ⑦ nyams reg par zhugs byas shing / /sbyor ba bsten pa'i khu ba zla mtshan yang saṃ ga me saṃ ni pā tāta/ /e tī bhū tai pra dza ti ni ya māta ka mya tsi bī dza bhā baṃ dag 'grogs la ltung gyur pa/ /gcig tu gyur cing nges pa 'ga' las sa bon dag gis dngos por gyur⑧//95—148

podhestasmin bha ba ti sa ha sā paṃ ni kā she ya yāsneḥ/ /rā gojo raḥsthā ṭi su zhig khong der 'phral la 'jug ste dper na bsrubs pa'i me bzhin no/ /shel dum dag la tshon gyis ① ka sha ka lo me gha masto dhi bā thaḥpubee mo daste la ka mi bā sha ṣpeḥkāstsa rna bāsni tā paḥ//rab dbye sprin la chu yi gter gyi chu/ /til la me tog dri bzang gser la me yis gdungs bzhin dal bu yis//so yo garghaṃ bi sha ti ni ya tai ra gya saṃ laghra bṛtrī rpā yurgamee ri ba ba dri rnams kyis sdebazhin rnam pa mang po'i las kyis bsgos par gyur pa'i rlung / /spyod tshul byed po yis hu bi byeḥkarma bhirpā su mā naḥ/ /tasmin sughra kra ma pa ri ṇa tidhī na kyang yang ①dag mi mtshan 'di de nang du 'jug /der ni phra ba'i rim pas yongs su 'gyur zhing rang parluṣṭa ka so nā nā kā ra pra tsu ra ra tsa nā tsi tra rū po su lakṣuḥ/ /bzhin kyis btsir 'dir④/ /ji srid dus su rnam par 'gyur ba med pa bzhin du rnam 'gyur 'dzin//shaṃ tsi ta kā lo ba ha ti bi kṛ ti nirbi kā rā ya mā nā mā yuḥrāṇḍi dza la ma ya rnam pa sna tshogs rab mang bkod pa bkra ba'i gzugs ni mi mtshon te/ /rma bya'i sgo nga chu yi ⑤ rang bzhin i ba byakta bhattarma yu raḥ/ /ta tā dhwa nāta gha na ka la la tā sha lya pa shā rma bya'i rnam par dumi gsal bzhin/ /der ni mer mer nur nur nar (7nar gor gor la sogs gnas rya ba sthā tya ghā tā stu dza ṭha ni te noṣṭha ṇa pa tsu mā na ཿ / / pūṇi skabs bzung / /de dang de dag lto yis bskyed dzu pa'i drod kyis smin cing btang phyo7byas nas/ /zla ba mā mairna ba bhi ra tha bā brta karma kra mo po kle shaṃ bhuste ki ma pi bi kha mi rdzogs pa'am yang na dgu yis 'khyel pa'i las kyi rim pa 'di/ /sdug bsngal 'du shes rab ldan ci yang duḥkha saṃ dzñā pra bandaḥ/ /kā lya dṛṭwā ta swa ya mi ba pha lo bi rjo tai kahma rung ba'i mi bzad nyon mongs spyod/ /dus su yu ba dag las 'bras bu rang nyid beeng bzhin ⑩mngal smin pā kāta taṭwā lobye ra bi ha ta dza beeḥpre ri taḥbla ti bā teḥ/ /laghra sgyu pas—/ /de dus langs pa'i ma yi rlung ni mi dman mgyogs pas rab bskul nas/ /mtshon cha nyu7goms 95—149

pā ya ta na sa tsi bee rā tsi taḥkarma bandenirya bye taḥsha ra i ba dha pa'i gnas kyi grogs po 'ching ba'i las kyis ①rdzogs gyur pa/ /gzhu yi 'khrul 'khor bkang nas btang nuryant+ra ṣperyant+ra muktaḥ/ /uṭwā na suḥ pa ra la ra sa nabyu bu kā ba'i mda' bzhin nang nas phyir 'thon 'gyur/ /gan rkyal kha gdangs ro 'dzin drag pos nu tog ④rtse la gre li hā no naste mā tuḥbi ba ti ya da sau ṣpe ba karte nā nākyā/ /dzadmā 'dzin byed cing / /ma yi nu zho 'thungs pas ①gang 'di ④rna bas min zhing mig gis min/ /skye bar sgyu sa bya pa na ba ta nā yā sa saṃ bā sa lbo nā sā ta snga gre sa ka la ka la nā goms pa'i gdung bas bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gnas pa'i rol pa des/ /de yi mdun du spros pa mtha' de shi mbi ba pā ṣpe ba / /sru tai ranta bee bi ṣa ya swā da saṃ bā da dag ston byed bag chags kho na'o/ /rnam mang yul gyis ⑤ nyams spyong bskyed pa'i dbye bas grub pa ⑥nang bhe de rgyu staḥsubye rbi ṣa pa i ba byakta tai tu pra tā ṣpeḥ/ /mū bhāḥso khyab pa/ /gsal bar skud pa rab tu rgyas par legs sbyar pad rtse'i cha shas bzhin/ /de nas rang bzhin tha pra kṛ ti pa tsi bee redzre yirdatta saṃ snyoḥsta tyā khā pā kṛ ti pa re ma ma sparsha dbang po'i grogs kyis dzee'adu shes byen pa'i rmongs pa de/ /nu ma'i don du brjod cing yongs su mnye ba'i ṣpebeenti dhwa trī/ /ha stu kakṣeḥsha ya na ba pa nā gharṣa ṇiḥrpā ḍā mā naḥreg pas ma ma rig /mal stan gos rnams lag pas bskyod pa'i 'dar byed dag gis mnan pa dang //sthā ṣpe sgra ṣpe ta ra li ta ta nuḥtī ṭa kairbha kṣu mā ṇaḥ/ /ni tyā krañdzu ba gnas dang gnas su ya yor 'gyur lus srog chags rnams kyis ④ zos gyur pas/ /rtag tu ngu zhing tshig tsa na bi ra hāta kā ya kau kle shi lo kasgo byu te bi ṣa ma bi pa dā māspa da two pra dang bral bas lus kyi nyon mongs brgyud ⑨ma ni/ /su la smra ste mi bzad rgud pa nyid kyi gnas su rab tu yā taḥ/ /rpā to dwarnyezi ri ta pa da naḥthratstsha lata spyi ra stu ri ruṭwā 'gyur—/ /ltung ba tshu/skyugs shing rab 'thob 'o ⑪ma'i tshogs kyis bzhin ni sbags gyur te⑫/ /gan rkyal 95—150

no rasta la ni pa ti tai rukṣi to lakṣu te sau/ /mā yā ba ṅgāḥsma ra ṇa ha ra ṇa thra bhā brang gi dbus su lhung bas mtshan pas bran ①par gyur pa 'di/ /sgyu ma'i bud med la 'grogs mchog tu rtse ke lī bi khā se ha pe ṣpe balbu ri ta ru tsi nā niṭwā ra byāpta kā yaḥ/ /so tha dga'i rol pa dran pa las/ /dgod pa'i 'od zer shin tu gsal bas ⑤rab tu khyab pa bzhin/ /de bas 'a pāste li pi pa ri tsa ye he la yā datta hasteḥsaṃ sā resminda bi tsa la ta de ni rtse bas yig 'phreng ④yongs 'dris dag la lag gtad thob/ /'khor ba 'dir nyani g.yo med 'ching yā banta le khya kri yā su/ /dzadmā brte ni dza mi ba la khan dīsgo mo kā ra mā do ba'i rtsibs kyi ⑥ri mo'i las dag las④/ /rang gi skye ba'i 'khor 57mo ring du 'bri bzhin oṃ yig la sogs brge brge bi ra ti ma ti sgo ga sarge ni biṣṭaḥ/ /pāptaḥprasnyoḥka tha ma pa—/ /sde dang sde la blo gros rab gsal longs spyod spros pa nges par 'jug /ji zhig ltar yang byis pa'i pi ga labye la bhā ba pra mo haḥka mokhru kyāta pu na ra pi pa ri yo ba ṣpe dngos po'i rab rmongs bral nas shes rab 'thob⑨/ /slad nas kyang ni lang tsho dar la 'dod pas rab naṣṭa saṃ rnyeḥ/ /nisthā re 6 bya pa na bee la sad me gha sau dā mi byā dzā ba dhwa basbang 'du shes nyams/ /sdug bsngal mdzes pa'i sprin glog blu 7 bud med rnams kyi rtse dga' rol pa dag/tyahūṃ sbi ra ta ra dhi ya yo ṣi tsā bi bhra me 6/ /bā tsi sho tram̐ ba pu ra bi tsa khā snying po med la rab tu brtan pa'i blo yis mngon par 'dod pa bcings/ /bud med rnams kyi tshig la rna ba lo ga de ṣi dza nā dzā ghā rde bakṣ-i pa ba pa ri mā le swa da rna tad ra se tsa/ /pā lus ni g.yo med 'khyud pa la/ /kha yi chang gi dri la sna dang de yi ro la myong byed dang / /bzhin la mig tri kuzan dṛ sha ma pi mu ṣe supta sarba kri yo po dhaste ma tram̐ sta nu pa ri ṇa tsā mbi kyang snod du bgyis nas bya ba thams cad bsnyal ba 'di/ /lus ni yongs su 'gyur ba'i dbang po thams sarben tri yā ṇi/ /dīṣṭi sdirghaṃ pa ri tsi ta pa ri dre ṣa shī laḥs kā mbi cad tshod dag 'dzin pa bzhin/ /sdang la mdza' zhing yongs su 'dris la yongs sdang ngang tshul 'dod ldan de//95—151

baṃ tstsha tya no na ba na ba ra paḥpa pra yotna n+ya kā rmā/ /i tya byo tyā gsar pa gsar pa la chags 'bad bcas gzhan gyis sti'adod ma gzhan dag 'dod/ /de ltar phan tshun nu tsi ta tsa ri tā lakṣa bee laghra pākṣu hā tyā yi ba pra kṛ ti bi ra pashyi rigs /khumin spyod pa mtshon nas skyengs pa ① mthong gyur pa/ /'di yi 'dod pa rang bzhin ro bral bkra tra tai tro gya kā maḥ/ /a snga dhwa re bi ṣa ya dza la dhi madzdza teḥsadzdza tabya ba'i rgyud 'dis bzhad stislad nyid/ /nyin zhag dag ni nyung zhig gnas pa'i lang tshos long bar byas gyur dhra ṣṭa gya pra ti ha te ga teḥ kuñdza ra sre ba kaspe / / ki karta byā cing 'aste/ /'dam la glang po bzhin du yul gyi chu gter dag ni mtha' de spyol/ /bying zhing mtha' la rab ba ga ti ra hi tā dzā ya te mo ha rūstso bhā ta snga: ka ti ba ya di na sthā yi nā yo lhung 'gro ba dag ni rab tu nyams pa 'di/ /ci zhig bya zhes nges pa'i shes pa dang bral rmongs pas brgyal ④ba ṣpe na/ /yā bta kha lo bhra ma ti tsa la nyi pri ya tai dzo bha te sau sme bar 'gyur/ /ji srid 'di ni rtse zhing 'khyams ⑧dang g.yo dang dga' dang glal ba dang / /'dod pas ram̐ sme ram̐ ba da ti da nā li ma gi tai ram̐ ga dzha giḥ/ /tā batta spyo pa ri pa ri pa 'khyud pa'i lus ni 'khyog pas 'dzum zhing 'dzum zhing smra byed pa/ /de srid de yis ⑨steng du dus kyis rab ta tya bā kā la pra mushaṃ pra le yā lbo dha ba la pa li ta tstshadma nā ba 'phangs gsod ⑫ rtags me tog 'phreng ⑪/ /kha ba'i 'phreng ⑩ba ltar dkar skra dkar⑫ zol gyis yongs su dhya mā nā/ /kā le kā le kṣa ṇa ka la na ya mo nyi ni dru ba se na pāste nāsmin 'bab pa nyid/ /gti mug gnyid la chags pas dus dang dus la skad cig ltar shes shing / /lus 'dir ba su ṣi su ṣi su kṛ ta ṣpe ba dahaṃ na bhuste/ /idzee tso ri ri ba sa mu ṣi ta —ste legs byas ma thob byin pa nyid min spyad pa nyid min pa'i④/ /rgyu 'dis de ni rkun pos brkus bzhin snyug yabye ba duḥkhāta saṃ rūṭwā nā ma nu sha ya pha laḥpā ba sā daḥ pra mā bsngal dag la stsosems pa nyid/ /kun tu rmongs pa rnams kyis nyams ⑩nyes bag med 'gyod pa'i 'bras bu 95—152

daḥ—/ /tasmin yā te la li ta ba ni tā putpa ballī bā sarnye duṣkarmāpta can—/ /las ngan gyis ①thob nor dang mtshungs pas lang tsho rmi lam du rtag 1pa/ /bud med 'jo dra bi ṇa tu la yā yo ba ṣpe swasna kaste/ /naṣṭa she ṣa pra kṛ ti ra khi tha khe di tram̐ sgeg sos ka'i ①me tog 'khri shing song ba de yi tshe/ /yan lag ma lus skyo ④zhing chags dang bral bas rang girbi rakṇi rā bye rja pe na thra ba i ba su khaṃ po tha sho tsa tya tī tai/ /bzhin mtha' dag nyams/ /rgyal srid las nyams mi bdag bzhin de de nas bde ba 'das pas gdung //ā yudhī tai na tsa pa mu tsi tai yā tsa kā yo pa bhā tai nā glu: tai di shi di bdag gi tshe btang slong ba rnams la yang dag 'os pa'i sbyin ma btang / /phyogs phyogs rab ⑤tu grags shi yā shaḥsatpa dzee na pra tī tai/ /spru tai yadzñā bi ṣa ma dhi ma tai sbyi pa'ang ma bskrun legs pa'i lam ni ma rtogs shing / /slong duba'i dug 'thungs tsha dang grang ba yongs su ta saṃ tā pa shī tai dī tsā pā bāta ki ma pi na ma yā yatta de ba pra ṭwā tai/ /kā rgyas pa lhag par thob/ /sdig las ci yang 'jigs par ma gyur gang zhig de nyid kho na bgyis/ /gser sau he ma dru ma ru tsi ha rā hā ri ṇi yo ba na shrī kā yaḥkā yo kṛ mi ha ta gyi ⑦ljon pa'i 'od 'phrog yid 'phrog lang tsho'i dpal ni sgegang na ste/ /smin zhing mdzes bral srin bus ta ru zwa ya bitshwa yā pā kaḥ/ /dru rā de tāḥpa ri kṛ ta dṛ sha kau na bcos pa'i shing mtshungs lus 'di ga la zhig /na chung 'di dag mig gis ring nas yongs spong zur na lī rna ta ru juḥshusko shi tai tu ra mi ba ba ṣpe bā na re rmā ba darnyi/ /zhen gyur pa/ /bdag la nags kyi spre'u bskams ⑨shing 'khyags pas 'khrugs pa bzhin zhes smrasakṛbye //so yo kā yaḥshra ya ti bi la yo ṣpe ba mā yā ti kā ya shrastaḥsabee da sha na ma ṇa yaste lus 'di rnam par 'jig pa bsten te sgyu ma'i tshogs ni ma yin nyid/ /so yi nor bu kun dang skra de lhung ste tsa ke shā na do ṣāḥ/ /gā troṣṭha he pra ha ra ti ma run ṣpe ba mo ha pra ro he ṣṭha ṇa phye skyon ni ma yin nyid/ /lus kyi brtson 'grus rlung ni rab tu stor te gnyi mug myu gu min/ /mal stan la yo sha ya na sha ra ṇa sgyu pi treṣṭha kṣa yā me/ /baṃ tsikhye ti pra mṛ ta bi ṣa brkyangs ⑪zad par gyur kyang bdag gi sred pa zad ma yin/ /de ltar bsams nas mi bzad dbugs 95—153

ma shā sa hikrā di te po pa rya st+ya hūṃ tsi ra pa ri ti tā murya to lo brtsegs hig sogs rab tu rgyas gyur pas/ /'di ni yun ring 'dris pa'i 'jig rten spyod tshul 'phral ①la ka yā tram̐/ /rū tī bhū taḥsā dza na bi ra haṃ dhyā ya ti dhwasta hairyaḥshatta tstsha tā gtong rtsom ste/ /lkugs gyur rang gi skye bo dang bral sems shing nus pa chad pa las/ /bstan pa nyams dṛ ṇa mi ba ma hata pāpta kā lo da ri draḥ/ /byu mo ge haṃ ba su pa ri dza dzwa bu gyur dus la bab pa dbul ba ①bu lon chen po bzhin/ /re zhig sa dang khang pa nor dang g.yog 'khor bu tra dā rā di tsā n+yaddhā baṭwā baṅka la ya ti bye yā pā ṇa paryanta kā le/ /yā badzdzadma dang chung ma dang / /srog ni mthar thug dus su blo yis de snyed gzhan yang bsams byas pa/ /ji srid skye n+ya pi pu na ra tso sne ha mo hā nu bameesteste rantaḥkṛ ta pa ri tsa yastadma ba la yang 'di nyid ①slad nas chags rmongs 'ching ba dag /de des nang du yongs su 'dris byas de yi yī bhā pa me ti/ / duḥkhaṃ duḥs ha pā pa kand+ra dza ni haṃ kumbhi sa ha rang bzhin ngo bor 'gro/ /zangs chen stong phrag nang du sdig las kyis bskyed bzod par dka' ba'i sdug pānta re bhūkta ro ra ba kā la sru tra na ra keṭī brta te yo ni 6/ /yabye bsngal dag /spyad nas ngu 'bod beeg nag dmyal ba rnams kyi skye gnas dag tu 'khor gyur cing / /gang pu ju ka nārdzi tai su kha pa rda tad saṃ kṣa ye duḥkha rda pā nā gā mi yang bsod nams chas bsgrubs bde ba'i gnas de yang dag zad nas sdug bsngal ster④/ /de slad phyir mi pha lapta ye bi ma la dhīstasmrata sa mā dhī ya lta/ /i ti dhī ma bha rpā sgo bye 'ong bcas 'bras thob slad du dri med blo yis ting 'dzin mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi dge thob slad//saṭwā ra ṇa kṛ ta pra taḥ/ /sa mā di de sha bha ga bān sa tā rmā ku sha de skad srid pa'i chu gter ni/ /'jigs rung las sgol brtul zhugs mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lngasta ye/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa twa ba dā na yang dag bshad/ /ces ⑤pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa kalpa la tā yī gasgo ba krarnyi da sha ma palla waḥ// //dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mngal nas 'byung ba bstan pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu pa'o// //95—154

te kepi sa twa hi ta sarja hi tā nu ka pā bha bya bha badhe bhu ba ṣpe gang zhig mnyes gshin byams pa'i blo yis dge ba'i slad du ni/ /srid pa'i 'jig rten skyes bu bha pa tī ti bhā rdzu/ / bātpa lya be sha la dhi yaḥ ku sha khā ya sum̐ sī rnams kyis stimachog tu rjes 'dzin dag /'bad pas mdzad pa de dag sems can rnams la snying rje dang //kurbharnyi ye pa ra ma nu gra ha mā gra he ṇa/ /n+ya gro dhwa rā ma ni ra haṃ drabyu rjes su brtse bas khye nye bar gnas pa'i legs ldan su zhig lags/ /ser skya'i gzhi la n+ya gro dha'i/ /kun ka pi la bāstu ni / /bha ga bārnyi ya yo mandaḥ shākya rā dza su taḥpu dga' rar bzhugs bcom ldan 'das/ /blta phyir shākya'i rgyal po'i ①bu/ /dga' bo song bar gyur te ④ rā —/ /naiṣka mya de sha nā mant+ra ka thārnye pu raḥsbi tai/ /u bā tsa sngon—/ /nges 'byung gtam dang gros dag gis⑤/ /gtam mthar mdun na gnas pa la/ /rab tu byung bha ga bān bye tyā pra bra bye gri khya tā mi ti/ /pra sā rya bhi ni tyā gya tai ba mdzod cig ces/ /bcom ldan dgyes pas bka' stsal to/ /de yi drin la mngon dga' nas/ /na ndaḥ pra tya bhā ṣa ta / / bha ga ba na pu 5 la bhā pi pra pra dzñā bha dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /bcom ldan bsod nams 'thob mod ⑥kyang / /rab byung bdag ni ma tā na me/ /ta bo pa stha ya ko bhū tā bhikṣu saṃ rghaṃ ya dzeedzre taiḥ/ /sarbo pa ka ra mngon mi 'dod/ /khyod kyi nye ⑦ /gnas su gyur nas/ /yo byad ci ⑤ltar bzhed kun gyis/ /re zhig dge bee stu ba ta bhasthā pa ri tsa rā mya haṃ/ /i trukta ratna mu ku ṭi smṛṣṭa slong dge 'dun la/ /gus pas bdag ni ⑨rim gro bgyi'o/ /'di brjod rin chen cod pan byus/ /de statyā da pi ka dzaḥ/ /rā dza pu traḥswa bha ba āoṃ ya yo dza yā sa murlu kaḥ/ /sa punda yi zhabs pad la reg nas/ /rgyal po'i ⑩bu ni btsun mo la/ /chags pas rang gi khyim du song / /de ni rī sa mā sā rya da yi hūṃ ra ti punda ri/ /bi dza hā ra ba rodmā rna mu mdzes ma yid 'ong ma/ /dga' zhing mdzes dang yang dag phrad/ /yud tsam 'bral bar mi bzod pas/ /95—155

snurta bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsita bha ga bān pra kṛ hye ba gu ṇi skyed tshal mchog tu rnam par rol/ /de nas nam zhig rang bzhin byis/ /yon tan ldan dgyes ①bcom pri yaḥ/ /swa yo nanda gya bha ba rna rnyi gru saṃ s+hoḥs hā ya yo/ /sā ldan 'das/ /dge slong tshogs dang bcas pa dag /dga' bo'i khyem du rang nyid gshegs/ /kun nanda ba da naḥkṛ twa nandastatpa da banda rmā/ /ta ma hā dhwa sa nā si rna dga'i bzhin ldan dga' bo yis/ /de yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / /cher 'os stan la bzhugs de la//pū dza yi tā bya dzi dzhapata/ /ke ྾ pu ju pra ro hā rde pa ri bā ko ya mbi mchod pa byas nas rim gro bskyed/ /gang zhig bcom ldan rang nyid kyisa'age / /gzigs pas rjes su bzung dri shaḥ/ /kṛ to yi yad bha ga ba tā darsha nā nu gra haḥsra yi/ /sga ra byas pa/ /'di 'dra bsod nams myu gu rnams/ /gang zhig yongs su smin pa'i 'bras/ /bdag nyid ṇi shra ba rde bā pi darsha dzwa bā ma hāttha ram̐/ /se yo ku sha la ballī rmā ma chen po rnams dran nam/ /thos pa dang ni mthong gyur pa/ /'di de dge ba'i 'khri shing gi/ /'bras bu ha tī pha la sarnyiḥ/ /a gya mi tra su ma ha tasta dā lo kā gya darsha nāta/ /hri da chen po dag gi rgyunaldu / /khyod kyi snang ba byams pa ni/ /chen por gyur pa 'di mthong nas④/ /snying gi yāstsa bi ka sa shrīḥka gya nā ma na dzā ya te/ /da na da pi thra ya ta re chu skyes rgyas pa'i dpal/ /su zhig gis choni mi bskyed spyo'agyur/ /bdag nyid che rnams mthong ba ni//pu rgyu dā pi ma hā pha lo/ / sa da tsā ra da pi shra rgyu ma ha tsā ki sbyin pa bas kyang shin tu dka'⑦/ /bsod nams pas kyang 'bras bu che/ /spyod dubazang pas kyang la darsha dzā/ /i ti ta gya bru bā ṇa mya bhatta pra ṇa ya se sha lo/ /a bhe bsngags par 'os/ /de skad brjod de'i gus pa dang / /mdza' zhing byams pa nyid dag dang / /sngon du nanda pu raḥpū rdzu bha ga bān gantu murya yo/ /a nu bā bra dza tai nandaḥmachod la mngon dgyes nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ni gshegs par brtson/ /dga' bo de yi rjes 'brang ba//95—156

swatstsha ka na ka bhā dza ṣpe/ /ba ro pa tsā ra ma dā ya ma dhu ram̐ swa mi ba sha yo/ /rang gi gser rmi snod du ni/ /mchog gi nyer spyad dngar sti/po dag /rang gi bsam ①pa bzhin du blangs //pabyend+ra dza nta mā lo kya bhasthā bha ga ba taḥpa ti/ /na rekṣu ta ka ṭākṣe ṇa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes bzhin du/ /gus pas bdag po bgrod mthong nas/ /'bral ba mi bzod mdzes punda ri bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /gu rū khyo ma gre sā sa ra la ta ra lā lo tsa ma yis/ /zur mig gis ni nges par bltas/ /bla ma rnams mdun mig gi 'gros chani drang zhing rab tu g.yo na ga to bi hā ye ba rgya shā tsi ta mu ku li tā spyi pri ya ta oṃ/ /ni rīsthā ba dag /yangs pa nyid kyis sdezur mig rab mdzes cung zad bye bas mdzes pa'i mchog /blta bya bltas la sgyi ya ta kṣa ṇa ma ba na tā byutta da bye ka na ganta bye nā the tya ba da di ba mo nā nas gang zhig skad cig tu spyogyur de phyir lhag par ni/ /'gro bar mi bya mgon po zhes ni thub pa tshig med da ba tsa āoṃ/ /nandaḥpra ṇa yi ni dṛṭwā sosgo tsā tsa li tā na nāḥ/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ /mdza' mo shugs rings ⑥ldan pa la/ /dga' bo bzhin ni phyir phyogs nas/ /a yā mā la ta e bā ha mi bi tsā rā di tya bhā ṣata/ /ta taḥswa mā shra mo praste bdag ni ring por ⑦mi thogs par/ /'ong ba 'di nyid ces rab smras/ /de nas bcom ldan rang nyid kyi//bha brnya kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /bra dzā mi swa kṛ haddhā ba da tyā ha bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /gnas su byon la thal sbyar nas/ /re zhig rang khyim mchi'o zhes/ /'bral ba bzod pa med pas smras/ /ta tasta mā sa nā sī naḥpra ṇa tai bha ga bān pu raḥ/ /u bā tsa sa smi ta ke yo ga de nas khrir bzhugs bcom ldan gyikhye/ /mdun du rab tu btud de la/ /'dzum dang bcas gsungs da ma ṣpe saṃ pra ti twa yā/ / bi ṣa yā swā da sau hā rda saṃ mo hā bye lta nyid/ /myur bar 'gro ba 'di ci zhig /yul gyi ro la gcags khyepa yi/ /kun rmongs kyis gzir tse ta saṃ/ /a ho kṛ ha su kha swe ba nirbe da bi mu khā ma tiḥ/ /gu rja bha sems ldan ⑩rnams/ /kye ma khyim gyi bde ⑩/ nyid la/ /yid 'byung las ni phyir phyogs blo/ /tshe yi rgyan ni 95—157

ra ṇa me bā yurbi bee kā bha ra ṇa gu ṇaḥ/ /pra sha mā bha ra ṇabyu sau bai rā gyu bha ra ṇaḥyon tan te/ /yon tan rgyan ni dben pa'o/ /'di yi rgyan ni rab zhi ste/ /zhi ba'i rgyan ni chags bral sha maḥ/ /tadzdza hūṃ ta da sa khya sha lya sha la shaṃ n+yaste su z-ibye ta si pāzlostaṅga lo—/ /snying sdug sems la bkod pa'i blun po de dang bzod dka'i zug rngu'i dum bu ste①/ /blo ldan ṇi tai bi tsā ra sa ma ye bai pha lya me bā yu ṣaḥ/ /yabye rā gya pi be ka shu n+ya rnams kyis de ni rnam par dpyad tshe tshe ni 'bras bral nyid du brtsis/ /gang yid phyugs bzhin chags bral ma na sa me te sa shu rmā ya thā yārgyu yārnyi tsa tsakra ṣpe me tsa la nairni dben pa yis stong mtshan nyid med pa rnams dag gis①/ /skad cig 'di dag 'ong dang 'gro ba yang ni lakṣa ṇa āoṃ kṣa ṇaḥ/ /pu bye sa twa ba tsā khru tasma ti ma hūṃ shi lo tsa bi 'khor lo'i mu khyud g.yo ba bzhin/ /snying stobs ldan pa'i bsod nams blo ldan gyis thos ①rig byed ldan byā ba tī sa baṃ bhā gya ba hūṃ su khaṃ sha ma ba hūṃ ṣpe ba kwa tsi durla pa'i tshul khrims dang / /skal ldan dag gi thams cad zhi ldan rnams kyi bde ba 'gyur ④yang rnyed dka'i ⑤bhi / /du1 dhastu sa mapta bstu ba sa teḥswawaṃ sha ke byā yu ṣastarya gya min—/ /mtha' dag dngos po'i rten gyur tshe ni shin tu chung ba'i cha yang ⑥ rnyed dka' ste/ /'bras med kṣa ya me ti nisga la ta yā sho tsā ya tasmi na maḥ/ /bā mā bste bi ṣa ya nyid kyis gang gis zad 'gyur mya ngan 'os pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul gyi chu gter g.yon ma'i klong ⑦dza la sgo purṇa lā ba bye sa re dbyotpa pyabyi ṣa ma ma ka ram̐ kodha ba khyo ba 'khyel 'jo sgeg chu yis gang gyur pa/ /dregs pa mi bzad chu srin rab langs mtshan ma ske'akhrugs pa ⑨bhya mā ṣpe/ /ni tyā sanda pra tsa la bi ra ha brakhro pabye ḍa bldi sum̐ sī se tusta rab bskyed cing / /lhag par 'bral ba'i rta gdong me ni rab 'bar rtag tu gnas pa la/ /skyes bu rnams ra ṇa sa ra ṇi tī bra bee rā gya me ba/ /tasmata gri hā ṇa pra bra rdzu rā ni sgrol lam chags bral drag po kho na bsdams pa'i stegs/ /de slad rab byung gzung bar mdzod/ /rgyal 95—158

dza pu tra dzi tedhri yaḥ/ /e tāḥste ya i ba kṣi pre sa mā ga su khāḥshri yaḥ/ /po'i sras ni dbang po thul/ /bud med bde dang dpal 'byor 'di/ /myur du yang dag 'grogs pa bzhin//kṛ ya tsā ku sha lā yi ba brahma tsarya pa ri gra haḥ/ /tya dza tā me ṣa niḥsā ra kṛ dge ba nyid slad tshangs pa yi/ /spyod pa yongs su bzung ①bar mdzod/ /'khor ba snying po med pa'i khyim//ha saṃ sā ra durga haḥ/ /i ti khru twa bha ga ba taḥka ru rja bha ra rde gdon ngan 'di ni gtang bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan gsung ni snying rje yis/ /brgyan pa 'di skad khyothos ba tsaḥ/ /pra tya bhā ṣa ta tandandaḥpū bye pra ṇa ya yadhri taḥ/ /sa dā gyur nas/ /don gnyer mchod 'os kyis gdams ①pa'i/ /dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /rtag tu bha ba du pā yo ba pra bra bye bha ga bādma ma/ /bhi kṣu saṃ gho pa kā rārte kṛ khrod nyid bsnyen pa nyid/ /bcom ldan bdag gi rab byung yin/ /dge slong dge 'dun rim gror ni//ha e bā da ra pa re/ /i tyā ghābha ga ba bākya ma ti krāntu ma bhā shwa 'os pa'i khyim la mchog tu gus/ /de skad smras nas bcom ldan gsung / /bsgom bya'i dbang phyug min pa raḥ—/ /kri 6 mā ṇaḥpre yā presla so bhūjo lā ku lā sha yaḥ/ /pu na ཿpu nabya dang / /dga' ma la dgas drangs pas 'di'i/ /bsam pa khyogs la phyang mo yug /yang dang yang du kā rā su bha ga bān bra ta de sha rmā/ /u pa kā rorya tāḥsaṃ tabyenta bcom ldan gyis/ /'di la brtul zhugs nyer bstan mdzad/ /phan par brtson pa'i dam pa rnams/ /mi yahaṃ na yo gya tī/ /ya dā ṣpetstsha ti nandaspyo pra braṅgā ma dze tidhri yaḥ/ /ta dā gya 'os pa nyid mi bsam mo/ /dbang po ma thul dga' bo duni/ /gang tshe rab byung mi 'dod pa/ /de tshe de bha ga babye kya sa pa tata ba pu ṣi swa yo/ /muṇḍaḥkā ṣā ya paṇḍi naḥpā yis ⑤lus la de/ /bcom ldan gsung gis rang nyid lhung / / der ni de tshe spyo ngur sprig gos/ /mgo tra bā ṇaḥta ta kṣa ṇa/ /ba rbha tsa mbi ka ra ru tsirma hā pu ru ṣa lakṣa ṇiḥ/ /klum lag na lhung bzed can/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams kyis/ /gser byu 'od zer lta bur mdzes//95—159

sa sha sa nādzhai na myu byu dā ra rgya biṇḍaḥpā ti kaḥ/ /a bā rā da nā gārya tī pra dgon pa pa dang bsod snyoms par/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yis der gyur to/ /khyim las khyem ni med nyid yā taḥrpā shu ku li kaḥ/ /pri yā mu bā ha sa ta tai shā oṃ pra bra dzi to dang / /phyag dar khrod pa nyid du gyur/ /de ni rab tu byung gyur kyang / /snying la yang dag gcags stipi sa/ /sha shā ka i ba saṃ blte j-i da ye khāñtsha natstsha bo/ /ma na saḥspa pa yis/ /sngo bsangs dga' ma rtag tu 'dzin/ /zla ba'i mtshan ma mdzes pa bzhin/ /gang yang sems ḍi ka sri ba na beedmaḥke na baṭwā nā/ /rā gaḥko pi bi sha tyantaṭwā pe te kyi chags pa dag /bkrus kyang 'dag pa min pa gang / /lam ni gang nas lam ①du zhugs/ /shel gyi kṣa li to bi yaḥ/ /bi ra ha pāṇḍa ra ru ཿsaṃ saghra ru ṇa ṭī ba raḥ/ /sa sand+ra bzhin du mi shes so/ /bral bas skya bor gyur pa'i 'od/ /chos gos dmar po yang dag chags/ /de ni bhra da lo ka gya dza hā ra sha shi niḥshi yo/ /bi tsa ran bi ha ran kṣa maḥthun mtshams sprin dum gyis/ /mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dpal 'phrog gyur/ /nags na rgyu zhing rol byed la//sa bi smri ta dhri tirba ṣpe/ /dzadma bi rya ma āoṃ ga gya na bi sa smra ra sunda rī/ /rid cing 'dzin pa brjed pa de/ /lus med skye ba'i rig byed kyis(kye/ /mdzes ma dag ni brjed ma gyur//saṃ pūrṇa tsand+ra ba da nā ba da na dhyā na nispru laḥ/ /a tsinta dhañtsi ram̐ tatta rdo ba'i gzhi la bsdad nas ni/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba'i bzhin ras kyi④/ /bzhin la bsam gtan g.yo du pa bi shya shi khā ta le/ /a he bha ga bā tā pre ṣa kṛ to yatna da med kyi/ /yun ring dag tu de de bsams/ /kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /'bad pas rjes bzung nu gra haḥ/ /nā yā ti ma ma bee mya bye rā gā byeṣṭha ta tse ta saḥ/ /khru 'di dag kyang / /chags pas byin brlabs bdag gi sems/ /dri ma dang bral nyid mi 'gyur/ /'khor tai saṃ sā ra tsa ri tai niḥsaṃ ga bra ta mā shri tai/ /ta thā pi mṛ ga sha bā ba'i spyod tshul thos gyur cing / /grogs med brtul zhugs bsten mod kyang / /ri dwags gzhon nu'i mig 95—160

kṣinda bisma ra ti me ma naḥ/ /kādhwa rku ku ma lasna rā ga su bha ge can ma/ /bdag gi yid la brjed pa med/ /mdzes ma'i gur gum gyis reg chags pa'i skal bzang lus gā tre kri tai ṭī ba ram̐ tasmi na sta na maṇḍa la pra ṇa yi nā pā tram̐ dhri taspra la snam sbyar legs par bgos/ /de yi nu rgyas dkyil 'khor rab tu nyed pa'i lag pas lhung bzed legs ṇi nā/ /rā ga yo ma ma brta te gya ya di bā tyā phye ba bridhiḥpa ram̐ yasgo par bzung / /gang zhig byang chub gegs su gyur pa stide la dmigs pa'i nyin mtshan bsam gtan can//bye bya ba dhwa na byu ta ma ni shaṃ dhyā ram̐ ta da lo ba rna/ /kṣa ṇi na rmā krāpta ma bdag gi chags pa dag ni gal te 'phel na mchog tu rigs pa nyid du 'phel/ /mdzes ma skad cig gis ni bee hi muste tā me ba mukta ga ma ṣpe pu rastuta/ /a ho ma yā darsha na bispyo byu bdag 'ong zhes/ /sngon ni de la de ltar 'ong bar brjod/ /kye ma phrad pa'i bgegs gyur brtul zhugs tai partswata kṛ tasna bra ta me ta dās+ho/ /no ganta bya mi ti pra kadza ta 'di—/ /byas pa mi gzo ①bdag gis phyi ①nas blangs/ / gang de'i ④rab tu 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i tshig ra khā bākya ya du tse na sa saṃ tya bye bya dza āoṃ spru te gu ru dza ṣpe dza grwa ha parde gis 'gro bar mi bya zhes smras shing / /bla ma'i skye bo gnas tshe gang zhig rlung yab dor te thu ba nas kyang ⑤tsa lo/ /yatpa de na li khanda pi kṣi te ta lo mā mokṣa tā la kṣi tā bzung / /gang zhig rkang pas sa la 'dri duzhing mthong ba min ④yang bdag la zur mig mtshon/ /dgag te nā bye ni ṣe dha mukta bi bye na baspyonta yā me ma naḥ/ /mabee yughān sā nu āoṃ pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i rim pa de yis bdag gi ⑤yid ni de yis bsdams/ /bdag bral ri dwags mig she te sho ka pra lā pi byā/ /su li ṣpe tsakra bā tī ba habye ha ri ṇa lo tsa can de/ /'jug ngogs ngur pa mo bzhin du/ /ba gam can na mya ngan dag /sgrog cing mi nyal yod dam na spyo/ /hā pri ye tyakta sa bye na ki ta bee ṣpe ba ke ba lo/ /shri tai snyam—/ /kyi ⑨hud dga' ma g.yo can gyis⑫ / /'ba' zhig pa bzhin bden pa btang / /khyod kyi 95—161

twañtsitta tso re ṇa bi byā bra ta mi dasma yā/ / ta kta bra ta mi daddhā ba sems kyi (77chom rkun ngas/ /rdzun gyi krubartul zhugs 'di la brten/ /re zhig brtul zhugs 'di btang ta ga sgo mi dā yi ṭwā kai / / a nu rā gā ghi ta bhā rna ta pa stu nas—/ /mdzes ma'i gan kyedu 'gro bar bya/ /gang phyir chags pa'i mes gdungs pa'i④/ /dka' thub po hi duḥs haḥ/ /rā dza pu ṭī tsi rā yā tai 1 shaṃ sa ma ba lokya oṃ/ /gdung ba bzod par dka'/ /sdig can yun ring nas 'ongs pa/ /bdag mthong rgyal po'i bu mo de/ /marlu nā na ba lasne na na dzā ṣpe ki ka ri 6 te/ /na sarba tra bi kā rā ya ni gsar du skyes pa'i khro ba yis/ /ci byed par 'gyur yongs spyomi shes/ /mdza' la chags pa'i rdul gyi cha//kā raḥpre ma duḥs haḥ/ / durni pā ro bha ba hye ba sde ha li no ra dzaḥganod cing dga' med bzod dka' ba/ /nges par zlog ⑥pa dka' ba nyid/ /kun tu rnam 'gyur ka naḥ/ /yasmin kṣa ṇi bha ga ba tā pa shya mi ra hi tai ba rna/ /ma yā nyid kyis bslad1she/ /gang gi dus na bcom ldan gyis/ /nags 'di btang bar mthong gyur pa/ /de tshe ta de ba ganta bya kṛ ha ma hye ṣa nibya yaḥ/ /asmirje ba shi lā parbhe ru kho na bdag khyim du/ /'gro bar bya zhes 'di nges so/ /da ni dga' ba'i dmigs rten du/ /rdo yi tsi rigi ri dhwa tu bhiḥ/ /le kha mi hūṃ sha shi mu khāe saṃ pra tyā lasba rgo dhri teḥ/ /a tha glegs bu 'di nyid la/ /ri 'ayi khams ni yid 'ong gikhye /zla bzhin ma de bdag gis bris⑫/ /yang na bā ka tha mā le khya bi ṣa yi yā ti sā pri yā/ /sondarlu binda bo ya sngaḥsu gang gis mdzes sdug thigs/ /bdud rtsi'i 3skye.utpal zla ba 'dra/ /mdzes ma de ni ri mo yi/ /yul du ji dhwa ku ba lenda baḥ/ /dṛṣṭirmugha ku ram̐ gī tsa la da li byastohphe lā brti ni ltar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog ri dwags mig ni bung ba g.yo bas khyab pa'i utpal 'khyil ba bzhin//lā ba stso da bye ku la bi dru ma ba rna bisthā dha ro gra two ṣaḥ/ /nirdo ṣā mṛ ta 'jo sgeg chu gter 'gram du byu ru'i nags ltar mchu ni bim pa'i 'od rab gsal/ /gang yang kha yi 'od de 95byed162

rasmi sārja sha ra ṇiḥsā kā pi baghrarlu tiḥpundarya ka tha me ti tsi tra pā da bī skyon med bdud rtsi'i zer byu don ①mthun dag gi ⑤lam/ /mdzes ma 1lus ni ngo mtshar snying po ri mo'i mashārya pā ram̐ ba puḥ/ /i te sa tsiṣṭha pa sha ṣpe ra li le kha shi khā ta lam du ji ltar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di bsams de yis ④rdo gzhi la/ /mchi mas bkrus shing 'dar ba le—/ /punda rī ma ka tha ma su shu sthā ta ke rpā ku dzee gu liḥ/ /sa saṃ kalpa yis—/ /'khrugs pa'i sor mos ji ltar yang / /mdzes ma dag ni dal bus bris/ /de yis rtog spyopas sa mud gīṇḍi pra ti bisba mi bā shri tsā/ /kṛ twa pu raḥthra ya ta mā ma tsā gsal byas pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu la brten par⑥/ /sngon du byas nas mdzes ma la mchi mas darpātpa gaṅga daḥ/ /thra yā mā li khya haṃ ni khi la su kha bṛṣṭi na ya na yorna 'dzer 'dzer skad du smras/ /mig gnyis ma lus bde ba'i char rgyun ston ka'i ⑦zla ba'i bzhin ras can//pa shya myubyetpaḥkṣa ṇa ma pi sha rastsond+ra ba da rmā/ /a yontu rde ta rtswa mdzes ma bdag gis bris te mig chus rgyas pas skad cig kyang ma mthong / /gzugs can ma dang bral la bi ra ha na pe kṣu bra ta ba taḥsgu ranta baḥsha paḥki ma bi ma ma pā bā duḥltos ④med brtul zhugs ldan pa bdag la ni/ /sdig las ci yang gdung ba rab bskyad ⑨dmod pa zug pa pa na taḥ/ /phu llī sgo dza ba na tī ṣā smṛ ha dwa shā sakyā su tā yo ba pustuṅka lo ma yin nam/ /rgyas pa'i chu skyes nags kyi 'od 'dra dga' ba'i mig gis rjes su chags pa'i lus/ /de yi pa ga tānta rā ya dza ni taḥko paḥs mudṛ bye hūṃ/ /haṃ ho bunda ri de nyi me pra ti dus na nye bar gyur pa'i bar chad kyis ⑩bsgrun khro ba yang dag thong / /kwa ye mdzes ma bdag la tshig lan ba tsata ki mo na mā labee se sa bye twanma ya rā ga ṭī ba ra mi baṃ tsinta byin cig mi smra bar ni ci la 'dug /bden par bdag kyang khyod la chags pa'i chos gos 'di bsam bra tai me bra tai/ /i ti bru ba khaṃ tai dṛṭī dru rā dā le khi tai ma rgo/ / brtul zhugs spyobartul zhugs so/ /de skad smra zhing bud med dag /bris pa ring nas mthong gyur nas//95—163

pā sru yā bhi kṣu bo bye tya bha ga ban tai ba bhā ṣi te/ /bha ga ban dubee byā ta khro ldan dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs smras/ /bcom ldan khyed kyis ma gya bādma sthā de ba ke ba lo/ /shu naḥku su ma mā le ba pra bra bye yo twa dul la/ /mnyes gshin 'ba' zhig pa nyid las/ /rab tu byung ba 'di byen te/ /khyi la me tog 'phreng ①yarbi tā/ /ā le khya punda rī ma kha nanda swe re shi lā ta le/ /tand+ra khā ba dza pā ba bzhin/ /mdzes ma bris nas dga' bo ni①/ /rdo ba'i gzhi la dal bu yis/ /de brjod bzlas pa la sabyi dhyā nā lasba na tī ga taḥ/ /e ta dā kabye bha ga bāndanda mā chags shing / /bsam gtan la ni dmigs par 'gyur/ /de dag thos nas bcom ldan gyis/ /dga' hā yā kā na nāta/ /ki me ta ri ti sa pratstsha thra yā bi ra ha mo ti tai/ /so ma bral ba'i ①rmongs gyur pa'i/ /dga' bo nags nas bos nas ni/ /'di dag ci zhes rab tu bris//de ④bra bī ta bha ga ban sa bye kāntarakta gya me pa ram̐/ /sgyigru hūṃ sasma te su smin smras bcom ldan bden par ni/ /mchog tu mdzes ma la chags bdag /dge slong rnams ni 'dod grur ba ṣpe na ra ma te ma nyiḥ/ /i di nanda ba tsaḥshu tā ta rū tse bha ga bān kyang / /nags tshal 'di la blo mi dga'/ /de skad dga' bo'i tshig thos nas/ /zhal gyi zla ba'i 'od dzi naḥ/ /mbi la yande ba bstend+ra kāṣṭha rā ga sa ro tu haṃ/ /sā dho zer gyis/ /'dod chags chu skyes 'dzum pa bzhin/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas de la gsungs/ /kun tu bha ba na yuste saṃ rā gā da nu tsi tā ma tiḥ/ /bi sneṭwā kṛ 6 te tse taḥka chags las mi rigs blo/ /dam pa khyod kyi rigs ma yin/ /dge la mngon par dga' ⑤rnams kyis//sthā ṇa bhi ni bee shi ram̐/ / kā yi yo ga sta nu tre ṇa tu khā tya kta sems ni bgegs rnams kyis ⑥mi khugs/ /longs spyod rtswa yi gzegs mem dang mtshungs btang la mngon sgo gā bye yo ga ཿ kwa yo ni bye ཿ kṣa ṇa su kha la bā swā da saṃ bā sbyor rigs pa 'di ni gang / /skad cig bde ba'i cha yi skero myang tshogs dang 'grogs pa smad 'os 'di ni 95—164

daḥ / /dzā hye bā yo ha ra ti ku sha lo dusta ro mā ra mārgaḥpre māddhā gang / /chags pas long ba ①rnams ni gang du 'phral la 1nga byed bzod dkar gyur pa yi/ /bsgral nā bha ba ti sa ha sā duḥ sa ho ya tra yā ta ཿ / /i tya gya bha ga dka' bdud kyi lam 'di rigs nyid kyis ni dge ba 'phrog par byed pa yin/ /de skad de la chags bral bān kṛ tā tsi ram̐ bee rā gya de sha rna/ /ta jo ta byā mi te kyukta swa kṛ tyā dag /yun ring bstan par mdzad nas ni⑤/ /'dug bya zhes brjod bcom ldan rang ⑦/ /rang gi bya ya swā yo ya yo/ /ta me bā ba sa rarjandaḥsaṃ tsi tya ga ma ṣpe tsi tai/ /ba'i slad du gshegs/ /mdzes ma lta la chags pa yi④/ /dga' ldan dga' bo'i ⑤ gnas skabs der//pra tasbe swa kṛ haṃ hriṣṭaḥpunda rī darsha nokhru kaḥ/ /bra dzan dā ri pi ṅgā nābyebee 'gro bar 'os par ⑥bsams nas ni/ /rang gi khyim du chas par gyur/ /gtsug lag khang ni mang po yime//hā rirba hu bhibya rāta/ /na ga rā bye mu khaṃ mārge ka dzee tsi da bābee sgo rnams bcad pas yun ring na/ /grong khyer mngon phyogs lam dag ni/ /ji zhig ltar stes thob nas bān—/ /a tha bee dzñā ya sarba dzñaste rā gā ta gantu murya tai/ /u ba tsā 'grome—/ /de nas chags las 'gro brtson de/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan byis/ /mkhyen nas bye tya bha ga bān nanda tūṇḍi kwa ga mya te/ /sa dza gā da ba rgo tā badha mngon phyogs bka' stsal pa/ /dga' bo mgyogs par gang du 'gro/ / de nas ⑨bcom ldan re zhig ni/ /ga band+raste me ra tiḥ/ /na khya bi shānta tsitta rmā kri yā kā tsita pra sī da nyi/ /nags na bdag la dga' ba med/ /sems ni ngal bsos min rnams kyis/ /bya ba gang yang dag pa min//sā shrīstsa ma ra hā se mbi ma ṇi mā yī sā ra mya ha rmya ba lī sā dpal ni rnga yab bzhad ldan de dang nor bu'i rang bzhin dga' ba'i ba gam 'phreng ⑪ ldan de/ /a phra'i bā khā ni la lo la tsū ta la ti kā kāddhā na boryā na byuḥ/ /sā ta nī ku 'khri shing rlung bzhon gyis bskyod skyed tshal gsar pa'i sa gzhi mdzes pa de dang ni/ /me tog mda' can 95—165

su me 6 kārmu ka la tā kṣa mo da rī punda rī no dzadmānta ra bā sa nā i ba ma gzhu yi 'khri shing gzugs bzang lto ba phra ba'i mdzes ma de dag la/ /skye ba gzhan gyi bag chags bzhin du na ཿ sa ste pi muñtsarnyi me / / sā rā ge ṇi ba ma na sā bra hma tsa dro bdag gi yid ni chags las rnam par mi grol lo/ /yid ni chags bcas kho na yis/ /tshangs par spyod pa tsa rā mya haṃ/ /bra ta pañdza ra badhe na bi haṃ ga i ba yadhritaḥ/ /bdag gis spyad/ /brtul zhugs 'ching ba'i gzeb dag gis/ /mkha' la 'gro ba bsdams pa bzhin/ /takta bra dzā mi pra bra bye mastu me na ra ke kṣa yaḥ/ /na bī ta rā ga tā me gos ni tshon ①gyis dmar ba yis/ /'dod chags bral ba nyid mi 'gyur/ /rab byung btang nas bdag ti mañdziṣṭha rakta saṃ shu kaḥ/ /i ti bru bā ṇa ma sa kṛ ta swa pa rda 'gro'o—/ /bdag gi dmyal ba zad gyur cig /de skad lan gcig ①min smra zhing / /rang gnas 'gro gantu murya tai/ /ni bāryā nu gra ha dhi yā ta rū tse bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /mā bar brtson de la/ /ldog ① cing rjes bzung blo gros kyis/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /shes kṛ thā bi sla baṃ nanda nindi tai bi shu ta shu taḥ/ /bibo ta dza no pa tujon ya ldan skye bo nyer sten ④la/ /so so'i skye bor mi 'gyur bzhin/ /dga' ba ⑤thos pas rnam par grags//thā yā ti thra thagyu naḥ/ /bi bee ka byasta do ṣā hūṃ bi du ྾ shī la shā smad cing bslad pa ma byed cig /rnam par rig pas skyon bshig cing / /tshul khrims ldan pa mkhas li dzā/ /niḥsā ra su kha lo bhe na na kābye dhi pra brta te/ /gā zwa rā ga kṛ tī ta rnams blo/ /snying po med pa'i bde ba la/ /chags pas bya min la mi 'jug /mchog tu smad pa'i khang su dzu gubee yā ta ṣpe pa re/ /dza ga n+ya karma tyā sastiḥki ladzdza dza na nī par ni/ /ngan pa'i las la kun tu chags/ /rgya chen 'dod chags 'dzin pa khyod/ /ngo tsha skye ba min pa te / /yo ni dza yo ni saṃ saktaḥsta na pā sta na mji naḥ/ /a ho ra ta na lasgoste ci—/ /skye gnas las sdeskyes skye gnas chags/ /nu ma 'thungs pa nu ma nyed/ /kye ma ngo tsha mi byed pa//95—166

dzadma bye ba la yo ga taḥ/ /sa dā sadzdzan brdzi tāḥdza na byā dza gha nā sasti/ /skye ba nyid la brlag par 'gyur①/ /rtag tu dam pa'i skye bo spangs/ /ma yi sgom la chags gyur pa//saṃ mo hā ha ta tsiṭwā āoṃ pa shu na me ba dṛ byu te/ /rā mā ra ma ṇa mā no sems ni kun rmongs kyis bcom pa'i/ /phyugs rnams nyid la mthong ba yin/ /bud med skyes pa'i nga yi bi ra mya tya bye tsā twa yā/ /sgo giḥ sa ha bhu dza gā ram̐ dṛsgo bha rgyal 'di/ /khrod kyis dga' dang bral nas thong / /srid pa'i khung bur lag 'gro rnams/ /longs spyod ba bi le kṣa yaḥ/ /dza gha tyā dza na ya bye ba na ka gya bi ra two ra tiḥ/ /dang bcas 'jig pa mthong ①/ /sgrom las skyes pa'i dga' ba dag /su yi yid 'byung skyed mi bskyed⑪//ya sde bha ba nyi paryadhe sha pi nā ma pa rādru khaḥ/ /kṛ ha dzā la pi muktaspyo kint+ra gang gi mjug tu khyi rnams kyang / /nges par kha ni phyir phyogs 'gyur/ /khyim gyi rgya las rnam grol khyod//de bā bhi dhwa ba ta si/ /na hi nirga tya ba ram̐ gaḥpu narngi sha ti bā gu dzā/ /i de nyid du mngon rgyug pa ci/ /gang phyir ri dwags thar gyur pa/ /beer yang rgyar ni 'jug pa min/ /de ti bākyā ta bha ga ba taḥshā sa ṣpe na bi yadhri taḥ/ /tsinta yan punda rī nandaḥskad bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa'i/ /bka' yis nges par gdams ④pa yi/ /dga' bo mdzes ma sems pra bi be shā shra ma pu naḥ/ / ta taḥka dā tsi dā di shya manda mā shra byed cing / /slar yang gnas su rab tu zhugs/ /de nas nam zhig dga' bo la/ /gnas khang phyag dar ma mārdza ṣpe/ /ā sa nā nu gra ha bya graḥpra ya yo bha ga bān pu nāḥ/ /bsgos ⑤nas ni/ /phongs pa'i ⑥rjes 'dzin la brtson pa'i/ /bcom ldan slar yang rab tu gshegs//tasgo sa nāta pra britta gya nanda snga shra ma sho dha ṣpe/ /na bhū ta lā da pa ya yo de yi ④bka' yis gnas khang ⑧dag /spyod la rab zhugs dga' bo yis/ /bsams ⑨pa las ni 'dod ra rdo rā ga i bā sha yata/ / ta snga hahūṃ ga ta sngarja sha li lo pā chags bzhin/ /sa las rdul rnams yongs khya 7ma song / /yongs su spyod pa'i chu dag ni/ /len du song 95—167

ri sgo gi shaṃ /mu huḥpūrṇa sa mutrīptaḥshu bye e ba bha bta gha ṭaḥ/ /te na bisna na bar gyur pa de'i/ /yang yang bkang zhing rab blangs tshe/ /bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ /bgegs ni de ga ma ṣpe su ta dzā khinda mā na saḥ/ / takta tu pra ya yo nandaḥpunda yis yid dag ni/ /shin tu skyo nas 'gro ba'i slad/ /mdzes ma blta ①bar 'dod pa 'di④/ /dga' rī darsha nodru kaḥ/ /a tha bee dzha ya sarbaste yarghaṃ di bya tsagru ṣā/ /ba bhā bos ①btang nas rab tu song / /de nas re ba brtan pa yis/ /'gro ba de ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /lha yi ṣe sa ha sā bye tyaste bha mā na ma no ra thaḥ/ /pa tra yo ge na tapta gya spyan gyis mkhyen gyur nas/ /'phral la mngon phyogs bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma mdza' ba'i snum gyi dri/ /shā ma rakta ru tseḥpa ram̐/ /a ho sne ha ka lo kaste dī pa gya ba na shā mya ti/ /snod du sbyar bas tsha byed cing / /khyod kyi duchags pa mtshan mo'i 'od/ /mar me bzhin du zhi mi 'gyur//a lo bā mā rnyi la ṣe ṇa byā lbo rā ga i bai ṣa te/ /saṃ saktaḥko pi z-i da g.yon ma mchog tu mngon 'dod pas/ /ci yang khyod snying la chags 'di/ /da dung yang ni ⑤mi 'bral ye yanda byā bye bi ra bye se/ /arnyi ka ro ti pra ram̐ bhe ra tistata kā la te—/ /gang zhig rams kyi tshon bzhin no/ /chags pa rab tu brtsams pa'i tshe/ /de dus 'jigs shing ka ta re/ /ā liṅga ti dzu gusme ba pra briste mu khye ga saṃ ga me/ /bi ṣa long bar byed/ /yan lag gtsor bgrod rab zhugs tshe/ /smad pa nyid kyis kun tu 'khyud/ /yul gyi ya swā da saṃ ge na pa pā mi tre ri beedzre yiḥ/ /duḥs ha bya sa nā brte yā nyams myong dang 'grogs pa/ /sdig pa'i grogs lta'i dbang po yis/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'khyil ba tya te na ra ke na raḥ / / a dhi bā sa ya ti sparsha le she nā yis—/ /dmyal bar mi rnams 'phen par byed/ /'grogs ⑥ngan reg ⑦pa'i cha yis kyang / /lhag par pi ku saṃ ga maḥ/ /pra klinda matpa ku ṇa pā ta pū ti garnya i boṅga taḥ/ /ka sthā rab tu sgo bar byed/ /nya dang ro ni rul pa yisape/ /dri nga rab tu ldang ba bzhin/ /dge ba'i grogs 95—168
