ṇa mi tra saṃ parkaḥsarba thā ku sha la ba haḥ/ /shu bha mo da i ba byapta yaḥka ro kyis reg gyur pa/ /rnam pa kun tu dge ba 'dzin/ /dge ba'i dri bzang gis khyab bzhin/ /gang zhig tī ma hārta hūṃ/ /i hphuste ta su bha ga bā na sā kṣu ta sa da sa twaḥ/ /pa thiḥrin ni chen por byed/ /'di brjod de la bcom ldan gyis/ /dam pa dam pa min pa'i lam/ /mngon du spasgo na saṃ dbye tsakre ta྾ ga re sha rmā/ /a tha nandi sa mā da ya reg pas dri bstan nas/ /grogs ni de dag bstan pa mdzad/ /de nas dga' bo bcom ldan byus//bha ga bān garnya ma da ni/ /ya yo gī ridzee tsa ma rī bā la bya dza na bī dzi khyer nas ri yi dbang po ni/ /spos ngad ldang ba'i ①ri dwags kyi④/ /rnga ma'i rlung yab g.yob par tai—/ /ta tra dā bā na la pluṣṭa ma niṣṭa kliṣṭa bi gre haṃ/ /kā rde marka ḍi ka ma gye gshegs—/ /der ni nags mes tshig gyur cing / /mi sdug shin tu rid pa'i lus/ /spra mo zhar ma de la ni//darsha yi twa ba dalja naḥ/ /i me ba shya pi ki nanda mābye nibye ta rā kṛ bstan nas rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /dga' bo 'di ni mthong ngam ci/ /dman ①pas shin tu smad pa'i ti—/ /kasmi tsi du tsi tā tse yo ro tsa ti thra ya darsha nā/ /saṭwā sa da sa yid④ —/ /'di la'ang su zhig 'os pa yi⑤/ /dga' mar mthong nas sred pa yin/ /legs dang mi to nāst+ri rā gaḥpa byu ti ra mya tī/ / sa ta su kha li to lo ke yo legs yod nyid min/ /dga' ba nyid du chags pas lta/ /'jig rten na ni skye bo gang / /gang gi ya gya da yi to dza naḥ/ /bakṣa pā tai sa muta thra bye sa hye nanda twa yo tsu tī/ /a myusta dga' de de yis dga'/ /'di dang mdzes ma de yi ni/ /mdzes pa'i bar na khye7 ci zhig yod/ /dga' bo myubyu punda ryā lā ba ju gya ki manta re/ / a na rmi twa dma yo ṣpe ba khyod kyi phyogs lhung dag /rab tu thong la bden par smros/ /bdag gis don du ma gnyer slad/ /sau nda ryā nda ra be di na ཿ / / abee thra ya twa ma yā ti tsa tsā tu mdzes pa'i khyad nyid rig pa med/ /don du gnyer na dga' bar 'gyur/ /dga' ba nyid na mdzes pa 95—169

tai—/ /pa shā mya haṃ bi she ṣe tu nā su ta subya kri tsa na/ /ra mya two rmā sa tsarmā nyid—/ /'di dang de la khyad par dag /ngas ni cung zad ma mthong ste/ /sha pags ①rus pa'i 'khrul sbi yadhe sa ma yā mā tra rmā/ /i ti thrasgo bha ga ba tā nanda ste pra tya 'khor la/ /dga' bar dam tshig byas tsam nyid/ /de skad bcom ldan gyis dri ba/ /shin tu rigs min bhā ṣa taḥ/ /a tyand+ra nu tsi ta prashāḥko pi go ra ba yadhri taḥ/ /ki me dris gyur cing / /gang yang bla mas gdams ④gyur pa'i/ /dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /bcom tata bha ga bān batta ke lo sho ke bi ḍadza nāḥ/ /ka pya bā bi shwa gu ra bo bi ni yā pra ldan de skad ci la gsungs/ /gang 'di mya ngan la co 'dri/ /kun gyi bla ma gtso bor ni/ /gyur pa su yis bha baṃṣṭa baḥ/ /ra tiḥsā bye pundaryāḥpa ra bha ge na rā bye te/ /yo dṛṣṭa dza ga rnam par dul/ /mdzes ma yi ni dga' ba de/ /mchog gi cha la ①mdzes pa ste/ /'gro las rgyal ba'i hūṃ dze tā na ra ti sma ra ti sma raḥ/ /byesgo ye ba na taṅkadhyā mo da te ku dran pa yang / /gang mthong dga' ma mi dran no/ /de yi mdzes pas ku mud tshal/ /dga' bzhin zla mu dā kā raḥ/ /gu rjanta ram̐ na dza nā ti pra sirnyi sha ra ḍo dza naḥ/ /ba ba'i 'od kyis khyomin/ /grags pa'i lam 'gro blun po yis/ /yon tan khyad par yongs ⑤mi shes/ /de rtanta yā ba da na sau ra bha sā ra tso ra mā lokya putpa ni tsa yi pri thu ke yis spyome tog tshogs rnams bzhin gyi dri bzang nor la ni/ /brkus ④par mthong nas rab tu rgyas pa'i skra sha pa she/ /ma bye bi lā sa ga ti lo tsa na kārnyi tso riddhā bye ba tshogs dag la bcings/ /'jo sgeg 'gros dang mig gis mdzes pa dag la brkus ⑧gyur pa'i/ /ngang pa haṃ sa ha ri ṇirba na me ba yā tai/ /a nadzee ཿsaṃ kasterba hu bi dha ri dwags 'jigs bzhin nags nyid du ni bros sam snyam/ /ri dwags mig can dpe med ma de yongs bee kabye ra nu pa mā na sā gā ram̐ gākṣi li khi tu ma pi shākya pa ri tsi taiḥ/ /'dris brtag pa mi nyung zhing / /rnam mang rnam par rtog pas kyang ni dri ⑨bar nus pa nyid ma yin//95—170

tu lnga ro he ya gya ba da na pa ra bhā ge la ghu ta yā sa byu dzwa tā rā shā ga ga na gang gi bzhin mdzes dag dang srang la gzhal tshe yang ba nyid kyi ①na/ /rgyu skar bdag po de ni mkha' la ma bye rū zwaḥpa ri bṛ snyeḥ/ /pu ju pra bye la li ta pa li ta byu la tā lā mya lbo lhag par 'dzeg ④pa ma yin nam/ /bsod nams kyis 'thob yid 'ong smin ma'i 'khri shing g.yo ldan sgeg lā ra bye ta snga ya di na ba da rna nanda 8 la bhya te tata/ /pra bra bye cing rol/ /de yi bzhin ni yid 'phrog dga' dang ldan te gal te ④mi 'thob na/ /rab byung 'dis yo su kṛ ta ma bye shaṃ ki ka ri 6 to me kasmra de tai bra ta pa ri ka ram̐ bhā bdag legs byas lhag par ci zhig bgyid 'gyur 'di yi sbad/ /brtul zhugs yo byad khur du gyur pa 'di ra khyu ram̐ ba hā mi/ /i ti nanda ba tsaḥshu tā bha ga bān rā ga nirbha ram̐/ /dag ci sbad bdag 'khur dulags/ /de skad dga' bo'i tshig thos nas/ /chags pa rab tu rgyas pa de//uspyo su pra bha be na tai ni nā ya su rā la yi/ /a darsha patstsha ta tra gya lī bcom ldan rang gi mthus blangs nas/ /lha yi gnas su phyin par gyur/ /brgya byin dga' tshal de ru ni//lorya ṣpe sha ta kra toḥ/ /su dmā mand+ra sa mudhū tāḥkānd+raste da sha yo ṣi taḥ/ /bdud rtsi bsrubs las rab 'khrungs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo mdzes pa dag /de la rab tu bstan par gyur//a ru ṇiḥkārnyi sarja ṣpeḥbā da padma ba no di taiḥ/ /a nu yā tā i bī sgo bye rkang pa pad tshal las 'khrungs pa/ /mdzes pa'i rgyud ni dmar po yis/ /chu gter ngogs kyi byu ru yisabu//kyu la bi dru ma kān ṣpeḥ/ /bi shā la khā su sa tsi baiḥpa ṇi bhirbi dzi tsā nags kyi rjes su 'khrid pa bzhin/ /yongs 'du lhan cig skyes pa yis⑥/ /yal 'dab chags pa ltar bu dzāḥ/ /saṃ sakṇiḥs ha dza sri ba pā ri dzā ta gya palla baiḥ/ /kārnyirma dhurya gyur pa/ /rol zhing ⑦sgeg pa'i grogs po yis⑤/ /lag pas chu skyes dag las rgyal/ /mdzes shing yid la li tairma da nā nanda bārnya beeḥ/ /he la ni mbi li tsā sgo dza ba da ṣpe 'ong rol pa dang / /'dod pa kun tu dga' ba'i grogs/ /chu skyes bde blag nyid du ni/ /'dzum byed 95—171

byand+ra sau da reḥ/ /sasmo ha ṣpeñdzu ba ṣpe: kṛṣṭa sā rirbi lo ka ṣpeḥ/ /zla ba'i 'gran zla dang / /kṛṇḍa ①sā ri'i ①mig dag dang / /kun rmongs gso bas nag mo ni//ka la ku ḍatstsha ḍa smṛbye ra mṛ to ghi ri bā bṛ tāḥ/ /pūrṇa yo ba na brtsegs pa'i ri mos reg pa yis①/ /bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis dhibaskor ba bzhin/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho lā ba byeḥs ha mee ba bi lokya tāḥ/ /nanda sā nanda ba da naḥswe da rdzogs gyur pa/ /de dag mthong nas 'phral nyid du/ /kun dga'i bzhin ldan dga' bo ⑤ni/ /rdul sthā ta i bā bhā bta/ /padma na nā su bi pu lotpa la lo tsa nā su kunda mi tā pu byis bkrus pa bzhin du gyur/ /padmo'i bzhin ras dang ni utpal rgyas pa'i mig /kun da'i 'dzum dang me ni bee ḍa sta ba kasta mbi 6/ /nanda gya tā su z-i da yo yu ga pa ta ni pa ta do lā bi tog tshom bu'i nu rgyas can/ /de dag rnams la dga' bo'i snying ni cig car du/ /phyogs lhung bung ba rol khā sa ta ra lā lbo tu lā ma bā pa/ /ta taḥpro bā tsa bha ga bān nande taṅga ta mā na saṃ/ /cing g.yo ba dang mtshungs thob/ /de la yid song dga' bo la/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs//a snga saṃ darsha ṣpe nanda thra tya te ra ma te ma nyiḥ/ /ā sī ta gya: pundarya dga' bo 'di dag mthong ba dang / /chags pas khrod blo dga' 'am ci/ /'di rnams dag dang mdzes ma khā ba ṇi ki ya danta ram̐/ /uṅkasteḥpa ra bhā ge na sgu ḍa e ba bee bha de'i—/ /mdzes sdug khyad par ji snyed cig /gzhan gyi cha las rab gyur pa/ /gsal ba kho nar rtogs bye te/ /ni rasta punda ri byu paṃ rū ba mabee ra rpā ya di/ /ta de tā e ba kā le na par bya/ /gal te lha mo rnams kyi gzugs/ /mdzes ma'i gzugs pas lhag pa na/ /de phyir de dag kho na ka ri6 mi two da shra yāḥ/ /ā ra ge ṇi ba ma na sā bradmā tsa bye pra sadma nyid—/ /dus kyis khyod la brten par byas/ /re zhig rab tu dang ba'i blo/ /yid ni chags bral kho na byeḥ—/ /tsa ra tā batta taste haṃ dā su myabee ra tsā ga ṇi/ /e baṃ bha ga ba yis—/ /tshangs spyod spyod cig de nas ngas/ /lha mo'i tshogs ni khrod la byinarjo/ /de ltar bcom ldan 95—172

to bākyān nandaḥsaṃ dzā ta nibya yaḥ/ / ta the trukta bra te tse tabya kre gsung gi ①ni/ /nges pa skyes pa'i dga' bo yis/ /de bzhin zhes brjod brtul zhugs sems/ /mtho swa.āoṃ ga nā shā yā/ /manda da raḥswa dā re gu swa bhuttahūṃ ga rpā tstsha yā/ /ris bu mo'i bsam pas byas/ /de dang ②'grogs 'dod gyur pas desal/ /rang gi chung ma la gus dman//gu ṇa pa rgya tu lo bye tertswaste sne ha su sa tya tā/ /a ho bee smṛ ta saṃ ba yon tan zong mtshungs dga' ba yis/ /mdza' ba bden pa nyid ma yin/ /skyes bu'i goms skyes mdza' sa pra ba sa pa ri sho ṣi tā/ /sum̐ sā mā sgyu si tī spru tiḥs ha pā n+ya tra dhwa ba ni/ /gzhan du yongs su dman pa yis/ /kye ma gnas ni brjed gyur nas/ /'phral la gzhan du rgyug ba ti/ /kṣa ṇa yo ba na ra myu ṇi pre ma ṇi pra ṇa ya bya yiḥ/ /na pa dhwa ni na pa nyid/ /skad cig lang tsho dga' ba yis④/ /mdza' ba gcugs pa nyams pa yis/ /bden pa ma yin ni tyā ni su khā ni ba sha rī ri rde/ /ta to bha ga ba tā nandaḥkṣa rjambi rtag min te/ /lus can rnams kyi bde ba bzhin/ /de nas dga' bo bcom ldan gyis/ /skad cig gis ta swa mā shra saṃ/ /tambi: yātthahma tsaṅgi tsa tsā ra ni ya ta bra taḥ/ /sa ni rang gnas khyer/ /des pa de yis tshangs spyod ni/ /dul ba nyid kyis sdebartul zhugs spyad/ /mdzes bi sa smra ra pundaryāḥkārnyi sa pa da ma n+ya dhīḥ/ /kṣa ṇa pra mu ṣi tā spru ti ma ma'i mdzes sdug phun tshogs pa/ /gzhan byi blo des brjed spyopar gyur/ /skad cig rab nyams dga' ba ni//khā ni yā ti gu ṇi ṣa pi/ /ta taḥka da tsibyi tsa ra na nandaḥkā pi bya lo ka yon tan la 'ang dman par gyur⑦/ /de nas nam zhig dga' bo ni/ /rgyu bas rab 'jigs dmyal ba'i ya ta/ /ka rā la na ra kā sakta dī mā kusnyi z-i tā bhu baṃ/ /tai bi tshogs—/ /'jigs rung zangs chen 'dzin pa yang / /'ga' zhig dag tu mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong lo bye ba sā kadzaḥki me ta di ti duḥkhi taḥ/ /sapa pratstsha ta rā sakta na nyid la sgesdug bsngal zhing / /'dar bar gyur pas 'di ci zhes/ /de yis de nas khyatshogs pa yi//95—173

gho ran na ra ka ki ka rān/ /te ta mū tsu ri yi khyu mista pa na kusnyi sha tā tsi 'jigs rung dmyal srung rnams la dris/ /de la des smras tsha ba'i sa①/ /zangs chen rgya ④ni rdzogs pa tā / /kalpi tā rā dza pu tra mya nanda snga tanda rā gi ṇaḥ/ /mi byā bra taḥb nā byā 'di—/ /shin tu chags ldan rgyal po'i bu/ /dga' bo la ni byas pa yin/ /chags bral nyid ni da dung bi bha dza te bī ta rā ga hūṃ / / bra hma tsazlo tsa ra hye ba swarga byā yang / /brtul zhugs log pa de mi sten①/ /mtho ris bud med 'grogs bsam ④pas tshangs par pa ga mā sha yā/ /mi byā pra tā rmā luddhā rmā rā ga dwo sha ka ṣā yi spyod ⑤pa spyod pa nyid/ /brkam ⑥chags log pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /chags sdang snyigs ma can rnams dzā / /e to su ni tya tabhā su kusnyi ṣe bā kṣa yaḥkṣa yaḥ/ /i ti nandaḥs māghra kyi—/ /rtag tu tsha ba'i zangs chen ni/ /'di dag 'jig pa med pa'i gnas/ /de ltar dga' bos yang dzā ta ro rmā tsa rka tsu kaḥ/ / ta tra rjo tā mi ba ta rnu partswaṭwā pā da dag thos/ /spu long gos ltar rgyas gyur cing / /der ni rjes su gdung ba yis/ /lus po dum bur gyur ma tyā ta/ /sa ma bye tya tyakta rā ga saṃ bā sa bā sa naḥswa yi/ /ba bzhin sems/ /gnas su mngon song 'dod chags kyis⑦ / /bag chags zhen pa btang byas nas/ /bla byu bā nutta ra brahma tsarya paryāpta saṃ ya maḥ/ /gha na mo hi kṣa yātta gya med tshangs par spyod pa ni/ /yongs su rdzogs shing dul bar gyur/ /nang du the tshom rnam grol cing ④ //bi muste saṃ sha manta taḥ/ /ma na pra sā da ma pe de sha ra dī ba da dī pa yaḥ/ /stug po'i rgongs pa zad las de'i/ /yid ni rab dang thob gyur te/ /ston ka'i klung gi chu bzhin no//niṅgā maḥpra sha ma pāst+ya pa re nijo mu pā ga taḥ/ /shudhe dhīḥs ma bye tya bha 'dod pa med cing rab zhi thob/ /mchog tu nges par der zhugs pa/ /dag ⑨pa'i blo yis bcom ldan la//ga banta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /nābee ro tirna pundarlo bhā ga ban kṛ tya maste me/ /yang dag mngon du phyogs te smras/ /bcom ldan bdag la bya ba ni/ /lha mos yod min mdzes mas min//95—174

e tāḥparyānta bisgo yaḥpā pa thā bi ṣa ya shri yaḥ/ /ya thā yā the yo bhā bā dzā gnod pa dang bcas yul byi dpal/ /'di dag mjug ni mdzes dang bral/ /ji lta ji ltar dngos rnams bhā bya te niḥswa bhā bā tā/ /ta thā ta thā pra sbo darnyi ni rā bā ra ṇa britta kyi—/ /ngo bo nyid med 'di bsgoms pa/ /de lta de ltar sgrib pa dang / /bral ba'i spyod tshul rab gsal yaḥ / /i ti nanda su ba da taḥprapta sngartata pa dam sha naiḥ/ /bha ga bān pa gyur①—/ /de skad smras pa'i budaga' bo dag /rim gyis dgra bcom gnas thob pa/ /yongs su mya ngan ri ni rpā ṇa shu rghaṃ sedhi ma ma n+ya ta / / ke ྾ ku sha la phru khā dzā 'das 1pa dag/ /'grub par bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag gi④//nande nā sā di tai pha lo/ /i ti bhekṣu bhi ra bye tya thraṣṭa ta na ba daljo naḥ/ /'bras bu dga' bos thob gyur ces/ /dge slong rnams kyis mngon phyogs dris/ /rgyal bas de la bka' stsal pa/ /dzadmā nta rā rdzi tai ཿ pu bye ཿ su kṛ tā bhya sa kā ri rja / / pā bee ku skye ba gzhan bsgrubs ⑤bsod nams kyis/ /legs byas goms par byas gyur pa⑥ / /dga' bos dge sha la spru lā ram̐ nande na pha la sadza taḥ/ /bi pu la bi ma le baṃ she dzadma sma ra ba'i rtsa ba yi⑦ / /'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /dri med yangs pa'i rigs su skyes shing dran pa'i pra ti mā ta nu su kha dza na sa khāe lakhro thratrīḥpri yā sa ta haṃ sa tām/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i lus/ /dpal 'byor skye bo bde ba'i grogs mo spyod tshul dam pa rtag tu dga'//pra sha ma sa li la sthā tai tse taḥswa bhā ba ga tirga tiḥku sha la ku su ma su sems ni rab tu zhi ba'i chus bgrus rang bzhin lugs kyi 'bros ⑧ldan 'di/ /skyes bu rnams kyi dge ba'i yo sum̐ saṃ bi shā la pha loṅga tiḥ/ /stu bee bee pa bye naḥsamyaka sa budha gyarda raḥpu rā/ /me tog dag gi rjo'abras bu cher 'khrungs yin/ /a ru ṇḍa ldan grong khyer du/ /sngon tshe sa bdag a ru ṇḍas//na garlu ma ru rja ba kyā mā ru ṇi na ma hi bhu dzā/ /kri ya mā ṇa ma dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten ni/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin 95—175

ṇi ma ma maitro nā ma dī dzādma dzaḥ/ /ma ha taḥpu bye sgo ga su bhā gī kā ra byed pa la/ /byams ldan zhes pa bram ze'i bu/ /bsod nams chen po'i bgo skal gyis①/ /skal ldan ka tai ya yo/ /sa e pa bhigru saṃ gha gya dzeddhā ka sthā na pa tra kṛta/ /tata byed po nyid du gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun bsro khang sbyin khrus byas/ /de yi pu ju pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na dzā to kṛ ha pa ti ku le/ /sa pu byu shi laḥpra hye ka bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /khyim bdag gi ni rigs su skyes/ /bsod nams ngang tshul de ni sngon//busgo pa sthā ya kaḥ su rā/ / stu paṃ tsakre sho bha na ste mā khā bhi bha rang sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas gyur/ /mdzes ldan 'phreng dhibs mngon brgyan pa'i/ /rab 'bar mchod ra ḍo dzā lo/ /tata pu rgya pra ṇi dhwa de na kṛttaḥkā shi pa tiḥsu taḥ/ /so bha rten dag kyang byas/ /de yi bsod nams smon lam gyes/ /de ni legs skyes zhes bya ba/ /kā ①sha'i ba tarlu ti mān nā ma di bya la kṣa ṇa la kṣi taḥ/ /kā shā pa khyarta taḥbadag po kṛ tī'i ④ bu/ /gsal ba'i mtshan kyis mtshan par gyur/ /dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs sa myahūṃ bu dha snganta dṛdṛ to/ / sa pta ratna ma ma stu pe kṛ te rgyas—/ /'od srungs mya ngan 'das pa'i mthar/ /mchod rten rin chen bdun rang bzhin/ /kā ⑤shi'i kā shi ma tī bhu dzā/ /tarlu nu rlu ti ma na hi ma tstshattha mā ro pya bhā swa re/ /sa yi bdag po'i sdebyas/ /de yi bu ni legs skyes kyis/ /'od gsal gser gyi gdugs dag btsugs//dzā tastand+ra ṇi jo ṣpe na nanda shākya ku le dhu nā/ /i ti su kṛ ti sa mubye ཿdga' bo de yi smon lam gyis/ /da lta shākya'i rigs su skyes/ /de ltar sngon skye'i rim pas thob pa legs purba dzadma kra māptaḥki ma pi bi pu la pu ju re ba nandaḥpā pe de/ /ku la byas kyis babeeng ba'i/ /gang yang yangs pa'i bsod nams kho nas dri med rigs dang ni/ /yid 'ong ma ma la mu da ram̐ rū pa ma gyi tsa sgo shaṃ sha ma pa ri tsi ta madhe satpa gzugs dang longs spyod mchog dang zhi ba yongs 'dris mthar/ /dam pa'i gnas su legs par 'gro ba 95—176

da so ga tai/ /ka tha yi twa ti bha ga bān nanda ka spyo ṇa kā ra rṇa/ /dag kyang dga' bos thob/ /dga' bo dge bar mdzad pa la/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan gyis//tsa kā ra bhi gru saṃ gha su tsā tī su kṛ ta de sha dzā/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra dge slong gi ni dge 'dun la/ /legs byas de de bstan par ①mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā pa dā na kalpa la tā yī punda rī nand+ra ba byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mdzes dga' bo'i du dā na me kā da shaḥpabee waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gcig pa'o// //a ro ha ti pa da munda ti ma ma la ma tibee ma la ku sha la so pā ṣpeḥ/ /na ra gong na med pa'i gnas su dri med blo/ /dri ma dang bral dge ba'i skas la 'dzegasakhya/ /blo gros dri ka ku ha re 6 ni pa ta ti ma li na ma ti gho ra ti mi re 6/ /shākyā rmā na ga re ma can ni dmyal ba'i khung / /④'jigs rung mun pa 'azibs pa dag tu lhung ⑤/ /shākya rnams kyi grong pūrbambi te ka pi la bstu ni/ /ma ha taḥshākya mu kha su su mu khāe dā pa ka khyer sngon/ /ser skya'i gzhi ni rab rgyas par/ /shākya'i gtso bo chen po yis⑥/ /'bangs kyi bu mo bzhin n+ya kā/ /shāste kṛ ta shra mā sarba ka la kau sha la shā li bhā/ /mkhra kā nā bzang ma/ /bstan bcos dag la ngal ba byas/ /sgyu rtsal kun la mkhas dang ldan/ /yon tan rigs ma kā ma su mā li ke ba gu rte tsi ta/ /pra sgo gi rā ba rodmā ṣpe ku ldan 'phreng ④can ma/ /zhes pa 'dod pa'i 'phreng ⑧ba bzhin/ /skyed tshal mchog na rje bo yi/ /tshig su mā ba tsa yorya taḥ/ /bhra marnyi sa mā yārnyi da darsha su ga tai pu raḥ/ /gis me tog 'thu brtson pa/ /de yi mdun du bde gshegs ni/ /'chag cing yang dag 'ong ba mthong //ta gyarnye mā lo kye ta pra sanda ma bha badma naḥ/ /sha rad kā la i ba swatstshaḥpra pā de mthong nyid na de yi yid/ /rab tu dang ba dag tu gyur/ /ston ka'i dus ni dri med kyis/ /yid ri 95—177

da ya nyi mā na saṃ/ /so tsitta yatta dā lo shaṃ pā tyā z-i di kṛ tā su dā/ /rab tu dang ba bzhin/ /de mthong las stibasgrubs dga' ba dag /gnas par byas pa des bsams pa//su kṛ te piṇḍa pā tai me kṛ sgo yā ta bha ga bān pi/ /bi rnye ya ta suḥsarba rnye bdag gi bsod snyoms legs byas kyis/ /bcom ldan len par 'gyur ④na zhes/ /snying rje rgyas pa'i kun saṃ kadzee ka ru rja ku laḥ / / pā hūṃ pra mārdzu bha ga ba na bha dre mkhyen rmis/ /de yi brnag pa kun mkhyen nas/ /lhung bzed bstan nas gabacom ldan gyis/ /bzang mo ④de tī tyā bā tsa tī/ /da tā pra ṇa mya bā ta sri pa ri pūrṇa ma no ra thaḥ/ /pra ṇi dhwa byin zhes de la gsungs/ /re ba yongs su rdzogs pa de⑤/ /de la phyag byas phul nas ni/ /'bangs mo'i āoṃ pra bi da dhe dā gya duḥkha ni bṛtta ye/ /ta taḥka dā tsi dā ya taḥpi sdug bsngal zlog 67pa'i sbad/ /smon lam dag ni byas par gyur/ /de nas de yi pha yi grogs/ /gnyis tusta suḥs khā dī dzaḥ/ /bee minti ka ste pra de sha dṛṭī bithra to ba da ta/ /skyes nam zhig 'ong ba ⑦yis/ /mtshan ma ldan pa'i phyogs mthong nas/ /ya mtshan gus ④ pas de la smras//a ho kṛ ha pa te ta su pu ṭī two shrī ma taḥsu tā/ /bandha tī nā ga ta dā kye ma dpal ldan khyim bdag de'i/ /bu mo gnyen ⑨dang bral gyur cing / /nor dang longs spyod spangs sri dha na sgo ga bi brdzi tā / /a ho mo ha gha nā rambha kṣa ṇarya ta nas ni/ /bu mo khrod ni 'bangs mor gyur/ /kye ma gti mug sprin dag gis/ /brtsams pa'i ⑩skad cig na bidku taḥ/ /saṃ sā ra sarba sa ra nā bee lā sa tsa pa lā shri yaḥ/ /ka stso gsal ba'i glog /'khor ba sbrul gye lce dag gis⑪/ /rol pa bzhin du dpal 'byor g.yo/ /dge ma khaṃ mā kṛ thashyidzñā dzā ṣpe haṃ hasta lakṣa ṇiḥ/ /a tsi re ṇi ba byu brturbabee dogs pa ma byed cig /ngas shes lag pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /ring po min pa nyid na khrod/ /sa yi bhā two bha bi byā pi/ /i dadza shā mi te pā ṇi lasmre ka ma la ko ma le/ /bdag po'i dga' mar 'gyur⑫/ /khyod kyi lag pa dpal mo yi/ /pad ltar mnyen pa'i 'phreng ba dag⑫/95—178

mā la tsashrī ku sha kā ra mi kyukta pra ya yo dī dzaḥ/ /a tha madma tha saṃ 'khor lo lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'di mthong / /de skad brjod nas gnyis skyes song / /de nas yid srubs sgo ga swa z-idme dhū pa ba rnya ba ཿ / / la tā lo ga na sau bhā gya bha longs spyod grogs/ /sprang rtsi 'thungs pa ①rnams kyi gnyen/ /skal bzang 'khri shing 'khyud byed pa//byo dṛ shya ta ma dha baḥ/ /ma sgo ki sha ri ṇasta gya kānta mā na dī pa legs ldan dpyid ni mthong bar gyur⑤/ /mdzes ma'i nga rgyal gnyis 'thung dgra/ /dpyid ni ral ba ldan dwo ṣaḥ/ /bi ba sgo j-imbha mā ṇa gya dzi dhwa bā shwa ka mañdza rī/ /bā la ka po la pa dag /glal bar byed pa'i lce bzhin du/ /mya ngan med pa'i dog pa mdzes/ /gzhon nu'i 'gram pa khā ba rgya tso rabyadza ka saṃ tsa yaḥ/ /su dṛ shaṃ ke sha pā she bhu ya yo mjos pa yis⑦/ /rkun po tsam pa ka yi tshogs/ /mig bzang ④ma yi skra zhags la/ / bcings par ⑤brnya na yo gya hūṃ/ /sa ha kā beebee ra hi ddhā ni dha rna bi da dhe ma dhuḥ/ /ni 'os pa nyid du gyur/ /dpyid kyi 0a mra'i me tog gis/ /khyo dang bral rnams pha rol bsgral/ /mthu ra pe kṣaḥpa ra ba dhe bi dhu rāḥpra bha biṇḍa baḥ/ /ya yurma dhu la hūṃ tsu ta ldan rnam par ma thul ba/ /gzhan dag 'joms la ltos ⑦ pa med/ /sbrang rtsi 'thungs pas a spo yiske//la tā nirbha ra sgo gya tī / / sa ha mee ba bee daddhā nā mi ba mugha bi 'khri shing mchog tu spyad ⑨byar gyur/ /yid 'ong longs spyod mkhas rnams kyis/ /'phral nyid gcad rmye byu ta yaḥ/ /tsū tā yu dhabyu ta la tā tsā pa ṣpesta shī li mu khaḥ/ /dza ya tī par bya ba bzhin/ /a mu'i 'khri shing gzhu la mda'/ /bkod pa a phra'i mtshon dang ldan/ /rgyal grur ti dza go ba bandi kandargya gye ba ko ki laḥ/ /asminda ba sa re shrī mān cig ces bdag dregs la/ /slong ⑪mo ba bzhin khu byug sgogs/ /skabs 'dir ko sa la yi dbang //ko sa lend+ra pra se na dzita/ /mṛ gā yā nirga to shwa na ju taste de sha mā ya yo/ /dpal dang ldan pa gsal rgyal ni/ /ri dwags 'ded du song ba dag /rta yis khyer nas yul der 'ongs//95—179

beenda ma no bha bā kā raḥso ba tīrya tu ram̐ ga māta/ /da darsha na n+ya lā ba rgya gzhu ldan yid 'byung rmyernam pa can/ /rta las babs par gyur pa das①/ /mdzes ma dga' ma gzhan pa ra ti mi bā pa re / / ta ju lo ka na bi rgyu rte ma na sta bzhin—/ /mdzes sdug gzhan yod min pa ④mthong / /mig gi lam nas ya mtshan las/ /yid 'byung ④gya ma hāttha naḥ/ /pisma diṣṭa mārge ṇa pra bi bee sha ma no bha baḥ/ /hūṃ lardzu rab tu zhugs gyur te/ /bdag nyid chen po de yi yid/ /de la lta 'dod rnam par rgyas/ /'phral la ba na tsā dṛ ṭī sa ha sod byu ta sā dhwa rmā/ /a tsinta ye randa ra 'jigs pa snyerab gyur cing / /ngo tshas gdong btud de mthong nas/ /mdzes ma'i rlabs can gyis pa ti ཿ kādhī ka khro li — z-i ta ཿ / / ke yo na bā sha shī mu khāe byā phrogs pa'i⑥/ /mi yi bdag pos bsams ⑦ par gyur/ /gang gi mdzes pas nyin mtshan du/ /mig gi mā ta ra khā ta rakta/ /yaṭwārnyirni shaṃ ṣpe tra sha ta pa tra bi kā shi bee/ /ba 'dab brgya rnam rgyas byed/ /gzhon nu zla bzhin sngo bsangs ma/ /mig 'bras g.yo ldan ma 'di su/ /pā ku khā mo da bi bhānta bhra ma re pā ṭa khā dha re/ /kārnyi ba sarnyi pa shya mi mu ḍa la mchu ba ⑧ ku la'i/ /dri bzang la ni bung ba bzhin/ /'di yi bzhin la me tog mtshon/ /dpyid khe sngaḥku mu dā yu snye/ /a ho khā ba rgyu ma smra rna tā ru rgyu bha ra rṇa ta dang mdzes pa mthong bar gyur/ /kye ma mdzes sdug mi dman zhing / /lang tshos ⑨rnam par brgyan ⑩pa'i noḥ—/ /dhī ra sgyu bi j-i tibye na shaṃ ke shaṃ ka le te ba me/ /a honda ma lus—/ /brtan ldan bdag gi'ang brtan pa ni/ /gang gis brkus pa bzhin du dogs/ /kye ma sbrang rtsi'i dhū mañdzarluḥpra raste surtse to gu ṇaḥ/ /ye na gabye na shagho ṣatpa do bi dog ⑪pa dag /rmad byung yon tan rtsom pas kyang / /rkang drug pas kyang rkang las rkang / /gang gis pa dā ta pa rda/ /i ti saṃ tsind+ra bhu pā la ste ma tā ba na de ba tā/ /bṛṣṭa 'gro ba'ang tustem nus so/ /de ltar bsams nas sa skyong gis⑫/ /de mthong nags kyi lha ru shes/ /de 95—180

bi be da tabyerghaṃ kra me ṇa ka thi tai ta ya/ /ta tasta tra kṛ tā ti justa yā yis rim gyis bshad pa yis/ /de yi spyod tshul rnam par rig /de rjes der ni gus byas te/ /de yis palla ba bi dza ṣpeḥ/ /shu tsi shī tebya sha li leḥprapta bān nidṛ tai dṛ paḥ/ / yal 'dab rlung yab dang / /gtsang zhing bsil ba'i chu yis kyang / /mi bdag bde ba thob par gyur//shāntaḥsaṃ bā te na ta gya ta yā tsa ra ṇa padma yoḥ/ /kṛ te kā rākta saṃ spasgo sa ni de yi zhabs kyi padmo ① dag /de yis mnyes shing lag pa yi/ /chu skyes reg pas ngal ba de/ /'phral la ddhā sa ha sāpta bān/ /kṣa bee na pra ti busgo tha pa shānta mṛ ga yā shra maḥ/ /gnyid dag thob par gyur/ /de nas skad cig gis rab sad/ /ri dwags bdas pa'i ngal ba bsos//de bya spasgo na tsā me ṣpe ra to rū dzā tā rā ga tsā/ /ma hā na pi ta taḥshākya de ni lha yis reg pa yis/ /dga' ma gzugs gzham/ gyur par 1shes/ /de nas shākya chen pos kyang //saṃ pāste ko sha le shwa ram̐/ /khru tā tai de —ga ma bhe tya pū dzārta tai ma byu dza ta/ /ko sa la dbang 'ongs pa dag /thos nas de la mngon phyogs te/ /mchod par 'os pa de la mchod//sā da re ṇḍabee tārnye na swa su ta mi ba mā li hūṃ/ /raddhā dhwa ya da do tasmi gus bcas blangs pa'i 'phreng ①can ma/ /'dod pa'i bkra shis me tog 'phreng ④/ /de yis rang gi bu mo sma rā rmā ga la ma li rmā/ /tā mā da ya ma no dzadma bai dza yarnyi si tā bzhin / /rin chen 'os rjopa de la byin/ /'dzum dkar yid las skyes pa yi/ /ba dan de ni blangs smi tsā/ /ni rdza dza gā ma na ga re ga dza mā ru khya bhu pa tiḥ/ /tarmin nā ga na byas nas/ /sa yi bdag po glang po la/ /zhon nas rang gi grong khyer song / /glang po ri bo'i steng de na//gohūṃ ge pa lo lā la ka ṣatpa daḥ/ /ba rbha rā dza ba senta na saṃ ga tā na ba mā lan bu g.yo ba'i bung ba can/ /rgyal po dpyid dang 'grogs pa yispye/ /gsar pa 'phreng mecan ma de li kā/ /rā dzā dhwa no pa mā sā rya pundaryā sa hi tasta yā/ /ratna harmya ka ro dā ra mdzes—/ /mdzes ma de dang lhan cig tu/ /rgyal po'i pho brang phyin nas de/ /rin chen ba gam 'od zer 95—181

mandi re bi dza hā ra saḥ/ /barṣa kā rā bhi dhwa de bi rādzhaḥpra tha ma can—/ /yid 'ong khang par rnam par rol/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo sngon ma ni/ /lha mo dbyar gyis rnam pabee bhā/ /a bhin na thratrī tā me no rā dza lasmri mi ba kṣi two/ /di bya spasgo pa'i ming ①/ /spyod tshul tha dad nyid min sems/ /rgyal po'i dpal mo sa gzhi bzhin/ /de ni de yis ①na sā ta suḥsā tsā snga ru pa saspa dā/ /pa raspa ra gu rtoṅka rṣa bisma reg pas dang / /de dang ①de yi gzugs bzang gis/ /phan tshun yon tan phul byung bas/ /mchog tu ya mā ya tuḥ/ /di bya rū pa ba tī byejo di bya sparsha ba tī pa ra/ /i ya mtshan ldan par gyur/ /sngon ma lha yi gzugs ldan dang / /phyi ④ma lha yi reg ldan zhesarjo/ /ngo ti pra bā daḥpābyabyesta yo lo ke 6 pa pra je/ /a tānta re ta yordi bya mtshar ldan pa de dag gtam/ /'jig rten dag tu rab tu grags/ /bar der de dag lha yi ni//rū pa saṃ sparsha kā ra khaṃ/ /ā shra me bhigru bhiḥpriṣṭaḥpro bā tsa bha ga wā gzugs dang yang dag reg pa'i rgyu/ /gnas su dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas rab na dzi naḥ/ /pu rā khru ta bā rā khya su dī dza su kṛ ha me dhi naḥ/ /kānd+ra shi rī ṣa tu gsungs/ /sngon tshe thos mchog ces bya ba/ /gnyis skyes khyim par gyur pa yi/ /chung ma mdza' bo bukā tse ti thra ye bhārle ba khyu ba tuḥ/ /sa ka dā tsi da thā kānta yā tra pra bra dzee yā mdzes ma dang / /shi ri ṣa ⑦ka zhes par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig mdzes ma yi/ /ming po rab byung khad sha ṣpeḥ/ /pra hye ka budha hūṃ yā taḥswa surbha ba na mā ya yo/ /tre mā bi ko kyis ni/ /nyi che'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur pa/ /sring mo'i khang par 'ongs par gyur/ /bdag po'i bka' pa tsā re ṇa sa ta yā pa tyā rā dzha yā/ /bhabhya ni madhri tistaspo tata pa pasngu yis de yi ⑧de/ /zla ba gsum byu rim gro yis/ /gus pas mgron du gnyer te gnas/ /de yi chun ma ba sgo dzi taḥ/ /te tsā ru mṛ du bher sgo gista ma sgya phywa n+ya dzadma ni/ /dzā te dhu nā yis kyang mchod/ /mdzes 'jam longs spyod dag gis testi/ /de dag gis mchod skye ba ni/ /da lta lha yi 95—182

tsā tu rū pa de bya saṃ sparsha saṃ yu te/ /kṛṣṭi 6 pra tha oṃ pra yukta gzugs mdzes dang / /reg pa yang dag ldan par skyes/ /dang po ① 'dul ba dag dang rab ldan phun bi na yā mā dā ya go sadza dā saṅge tre 6 ta paḥpra tabee ta nu 6 pāste ṣa sum tshogs pa'i go bzung rmos byas shing / /dka' thub dag gis rab gdungs lus kyi zhing bzang shin tu tī bā du tsā / /yaṭwā le shu bha bī dza supta mu tsi tai saṅka nd+ra sha steḥgashin par gyur pa la/ /gang gi ②dus su dge ba'i ④sa bon rigs btab de ni mbin cing rab 'bar ba'i//pa ram̐ byu byedhe pha la saṃ pa daḥsu ma ti bhista sri ba pa ko dzwa khāḥ/ /i ti sarba 'bras bu phun tshogs mchog tu dam pa'i las la chags pa'i blo bzang rnams kyis spyod/ /de skad thams snyo pa tsa dzwa ta bya mā kakhyu bhekṣa baḥ/ /tatta je ti bi ni: tya ba bhū cad mkhyen pa'i gsung / /bden pa dge slong rnams kyis thos/ /de de bzhin zhes nges byas nas/ /zhi nuḥshānta saṃ shra yāḥ/ /a tha kā le na bhū bhartu rmā li kā yā ma byu ta su taḥ/ /ba la ni brten ④par gyur/ /de nas dus kyis sa bdag giphyi/ /sras ni 'phreng ‘kyecan ma la gyur//bi rū bhā kā khya nā mbi ya tshe khyo bi byā su tsa kṛ ta shra maḥ/ /thra yastu lya ba yasta mya pu tshe bar 'dir zhes bya ba'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum ma tshang ba ma dpe rnams la sa ma rnyed pa shā sī ya zhes pa 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe dhed na dpyad/'phags skyes po zhes bya ba ste/ /rig dang sgyu rtsal rab sbyangs pa'o/ /de yi mdun na 'don gyi bu/ /ma ro hi ta su pu to bha bta/ /mā turduḥkhe na dzā tra twad bi shu to duḥkha mā tri yis ④sdug bsngal gyis btsas pas/ /ma la gnod ces rnam grags pa/ /na tshod mtshungs pa dāmadza' bor kaḥ—/ /ka dā tsita sa nyi taste na ha yā rū phyo bi rū zwa kaḥ/ /pā pa shākya pu rodmā rna gyur—/ /nam zhig de dang lhan cig tu/ /'phags skyes po ni rta la zhon/ /rtse zhing sngon la song ba dag /sbo ga yā ke nirga taḥ/ /n+yakka rañtsa kri re ta tra shākyasta srodma tā yu ṅgāḥ/ /a shākya'i grong gi byed tshal phyin/ /'di ni nged ⑨kyi 'bangs mo yi/ /bu zhes dregs pa rab smra ba'i/ /shākya yo dā rpā su tāsma ka mi ti darngu pra bā di na/ /ga twa swa su re te bye bai rnams kyis ⑩mtshon bzung nas/ /der ni de la tho 'tshams ⑪/ byas/ /rang gi grong khyer song nas des//95—183

randa bya ma tsinta ya ta/ /ku la darpā pa do nyi sha lca to daḥsha rī ri ṇḍi/ /de ni ①khon lan bsam par gyur/ /rigs kyi dregs pas smad pa ni/ /lus can zug rngu lcags kyu yin//ta gye ni rda khya mā na gya tata pra tī kā ra byunta yā/ /rā dzñā pa dzā tā dza na ke dzre de la lan bya'i bsam pa yis/ /yid ni nges par bsregs pa de/ /yab ni 'tsho duyang rgyal srid la//ba tya pi pa raḥspro hā/ /sa tsā rā ya ṇa mu khyu ram̐ marnyi rde sha ta pañtsa ka/ /mchog tu 'dod pa skyes par gyur/ /de yis ①ring spyod la sogs pa'i/ /blon po brgya phrag lnga dag ni//swa ba shaṃ pi tu rā kṛ 6 bi da bye bhe da yutta bhiḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsi ta saṃ dzā ta pha las spyad ④nas dbye ba yis/ /rigs pa rnams kyis rang dbang byas/ /de nas nam zhig sa yi bdag /bi bee kaḥthra thi bī pa tiḥ/ / dharmo pa de sha shra ba ṇi baspyo mā nā da gsal rgyal rnam rig yang dag skyes/ /chos kyi gdams ngag mnyan pa la/ /gus pa mchog 'phel legs raḥpa ram̐/ /tsā rā ya ṇa kṛ tī tā shwa ra tha mā tu khya saṃ ya taḥ/ /drahūṃ dza shā ma bsdams pasaskye/ /ring spyod kyis ni rta bzung ba'i/ /shing rta dag la zhon nas ni/ /thams cad mkhyen sarba dzhai bha ga ban tai pra se na dzi ta/ /pā snga shra me bha ga ba taḥpa bcom ldan 'das/ /blta ba'i beed du song bar gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas phyin tedu//kṛ tā bā dā bhi banda rna/ /dharma nā yo sa shu shā ba tasthā sā da pra sanda byeḥ/ /zhabs la mngon par phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi drin byis dang ba'i blos/ /chos kyi rjes 'gro de yis thos//tsā rā yā rto byā shu ga tā ra the na na ga ram̐ dza bāta/ /a ka re danta re tasmin mgyogs pa nyid du ring spyod kyang / /shing rtas grong khyer myur song nas/ /skabs der rgyal po'i bu dag ni//rā dza pu tā bhi ṣe tsa rna/ /bha ga banta ma thā marja dṛ pa nyirgantu mudma mngon par dbang ni bskur bar byas/ /de nas bcom ldan la zhus nas/ /mi yi bdag po 'go brtson traḥ—/ /da darsha nā nu ga na gre na ra dzee na tsa madhri rṇa/ /sa babhyo me pas④—/ /mdun du rjes 'brang mthong ma yin/ /shing rta ma yin blon po'ang min/ /rkang pa nyid kyis 95—184

ba sha na kaiḥpra sbi tai thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /dru rā da pa shya dā yarnya barṣa kā rā sa bdag de/ /dal bus rab tu 'gro ba yis/ /dbyar gyi rnam pa 'phreng ①can mar/ /bcas pa ring sa mā li rmā/ /te thraṣṭa taṅgi rā dzñā tā so bhi ṣikta bi rū zwa shaṃ/ /bi sa nas 'ong ba mthong / /'phags skyes po ni dbang bskur ba/ /der ②dris de yi tshig gis shes/ /bu yi sardza su tai shwarya pa ri sgo gā ya mā li rmā/ /barṣa kā rā sa mā dā ya sa dpal 'byor yongs spyad slad/ /'phreng ṣpecan ma ni de yis btang / /de yis dbyar byi rnam pa bzung //mi tra gya ma tī pa teḥ/ /a dzā ta sha tro na ga re shā pa rā dza kṛ hā nyi snye/ /grogs po sa yi bdag po dag /ma skyes dgra yi grong khyer ④ni/ /rgyal po'i khab ces brjod par phyin//sa taptabyu tra bi ra hāta kṣuhphi pā sā shra mā nī taḥ/ /ya yo ba mambi ṣatshwa saṃ gdugs dang bral bas de gdung zhing / /bkres skom ngal ba dang ldan pa/ /rnga yab rlung dag ring po yis//dirbhe: ma ra mā ru taiḥ/ /su kha mambha li tai ke na pābee ka snga yu rā ya rna/ /shugs ni gtong ⑤ba bzhin du gyur/ /'jigs med bde ba su yis thob/ /tshe ni su yi dbang du gyur//na ka sthā nu pa de dṛṣṭaḥs pa di sadza daḥ/ /sa dzrerṇa rū la ka bhughā su la duphun sum tshogs pa ni/ /myur bar dzeerjes su nyams ma mthong / /de yis las kyi rtsa ba bzhin//karma mū la mi bā ya tai/ /kṣa ram̐ bī tā tsa pā bhā ya pa pā tāpta bi su tsi kaḥ/ /ring ba'i la phug rnying pa zos/ /chu yang 'gyur byed 'thungs pa yis/ /gnod pa kun gye tshogs gyur pa//a ni tya tā ma bi dzñā ya mo hā ya ba ta te dza naḥ/ /sa tsā pā ya ni kā ya gya kā lus kyi thabs la sred pa yis/ /mi rtag pa nyid mi shes par/ /rmongs pa'i slad du skye bo 'bad/ /ma ya phyo pā ya dṛṣṭa yā/ /a dzā ta shatruḥkhrute ba ko sha le shwa ra mā ga tai//zhu'i nad kyis ⑧thebs nas 'gyel/ /ma skyes dgra yis ko sa la'i/ /dbang po 'ongs pa thos gyur nas//a bye tya dzā shu pūrṇa sri bi ga tā sum̐ da darsha tai/ /ta gya dzā yā nu yā ta gya sa song nas ⑨rdul gyis kha gang zhing ⑩/ /srog dang bral ba de mthong gyur/ /btsun mo rjes su zhugs pa de'i//95—185

kṛ tā de ha sad kri yī/ /bha ga brnyi ya yo drabye su ga tai duḥkha shānta ye/ /lus ni legs par bya ba byas/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i beed du de/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs lta ru song //sa tai pra ṇa mya pra bā tsa bha ga bān ko sha le shwa raḥ/ /pu radzre su dṛ daḥpā bya de yis de la btud nas smras/ /bcom ldan ko sa la yi dbang / /grogs po bdag gi grong khyer du//nisgo no ni dha āoṃ ga taḥ/ /byedmā ma sadza rda pā paṃ mo hā da ya sha saḥpa 'ongs nas nor med gum par gyur/ /gang gis grogs la phan pa dag /byas pa min pa'i dpal 'byor rda—/ /bi bha bo ye na nai ba yi mi tro pa ka ra ju kṛ taḥ/ /j-i da ye 'di—/ /bdag dang phun tshogs smad cing sdig /rbongs las grags pa min pa'i sbad①/ /rgud tshe snying bi ni bee shā shaṃ praptaḥsu dzdza da mā ba di/ /su z-irje pha spyo mā yā te yā mya kidhe la re ba dag /rnam par bkod nas grogs thob pa'i/ /grogs po 'bras med nyid gyur te/ /gang zhig na dzre ba tā/ /mi tro pa ka ra khaṃ lakhyi dī no pa ka ra khaṃ dha āoṃ/ /dhwa to 'tsho ba de yis ci/ /grogs la phan pa'i dpal dang ni/ /phongs la phan pa'i nor dag dang / /'jigs pa ka ra khaṃ pā ṇḍa ye hūṃ te ྾ su dzre bi tai/ /ku karma ki kṛ tai te na bha ga ban la phan pa'i srog gang yin/ /de dag 'tsho ba legs pa yin/ /bcom ldan skye ba snga ma la/ /de yis las pūrba dzadma ni/ /ya su sā ke na paryarnye pra pe de po pi durda shaṃ/ /a ngan ci zhig bgyis/ /gang zhig sman 1nas mjug tu ni/ /des kyang gnas skabs ngan pa thob/ /sa nyi dṛṣṭaḥkṣi ti she na bha ga bān pā khru tsagru ṣā/ /tā mu tse tā pa sha ma 1 bdag mig ni mchi ma dang / /bcas pas 'di dris bcom ldan gyis/ /gdung ba zhi byed tshems kyis ④ni//di shan da sha tsadhri ke/ /mā shu tsa dṛ thi bī pā la swa bhā bo yo bha ba sbi teḥ/ /zla 'od spro zhing der bka' stsal/ /sa skyong mya ngan ma byed 'di/ /mbid par gnas pa'i rang bzhin no//e baṃ bi bye ba bhā bā na ma sa tyā nā ma ni tya tā/ /bi pā ri sa sā ra ba nādhe rnam pa 'di ltar dngos po ni/ /bden pa min rnams mi rtag nyid/ /'khor ba'i nags nang rnam par 95—186

smin ṣpe sarga lo laḥtī la kā la j-i gaḥ/ /swa tstshanda yā tī dza na pubee dzre ba ki yangs pa 'dir/ /rang bzhin gyes g.yo dus kyi bung ba dag /rang dgar 'bab pas 'gro srog me tog gi//dzalpa sum̐ dzi ka pa li ka ro tu/ / ta ram̐ gā to sgo ga: ki ta ha ge sar tshogs la kham zas ①byed pa nyid/ /longs spyod rba 0rlabs dag dang mtshungs shing ri dwags ri bhā lo tsa na tsa laḥkṣa ṇa lasthā lasmrirdza na dza la da bi byo ta nata ḍi 'jigs pa'i mig ltar g.yo/ /dpal 'byor skad cig mtshon bya skye ba'i ①chu gter rnam par gsal ba'i ta—/ /sha rī rādzdza bā la ta pa tsa pa la rā tsā na ba ba yaḥkṣa yi yā glog /lus kyi padmar dulang tsho gsar pa'i nyi 'od gzhon nu dmar ba g.yo/ /srog gi zigs pa sred pa'i ti kṣi shaṃ bha ba ma ru ta ḍi jo bi ka ṇaḥ/ /ma no mai tri pā tram̐ pa ra hi ta ra ti rnyond+ra mya ngam buthang la myur du 'jig par 'gyur/ /yid ni byams pa'i snod gyur gzhan la phan pas dgyes shing dha na tā ma dosgo dostso da kṣa ma sa ma bi tsā re pa ri tsa yaḥ/ /chos kyi nor/ /rgyags pa'i tshogs rnams rab bzod gcod cing ⑥rnam par spyod la yongs su 'dris//a yo ta twa nī ṣṭa bi ṣa ya su kha bee mu khyu su khi nā ma sā re saṃ sa ri pa ri 'di ni yul gyi bde las phyir phyogs bde ldan de nyid tshol rnams kyi/ /snying po med pa'i 'khor bar rnam z-i ta bi kā raḥpa ri ka raḥ/ /dza na sho tsa ti duḥkhe kṣi kshi ha ta i bā bhothra nā/ /'gyur dag dang bral ba'i yo byad min④/ /rdo yis myur du bcom pa bzhin/ /skye bo sdug la mya ngan byed//na ka ro ti pu naskyi bra ta dā pā ta pra ti kri yī/ /pa shya to pi bha bā ya sa phongs pa drag po de zlog pa'i/ /bya ba slar yang mi byed do/ /srid pa'i ngal dub mthong gyur kyang //nirbi bee ka su sarba thā/ /kṛ ya te ki dzā na snga su mo hā da ku sha la smṛ shaḥ/ /pu rnam kun dben pa med pa yi/ /skye bo 'di dag rmongs pa las/ /mi dge 'dod par byed pa ci/ /bram ra bi praḥsu sharmā khya ku ta— ta pā pya rū la kai/ /bi dmā ya dza na nī haste ya ze rab bde zhes pas sngon/ /'ba' ⑧ zhig las rnyed la phug dag /ma yi lag tu bzhag nas ni/ /khrus 95—187

yo rtswa tsu na dī pa ṭi / /sā pi pra hye ka busgye ya tī pāpta ya ta danta la klung ①gi ngogs su song / /skabs der ma dudag 'ongs pa yis①/ /phyag na lhung bzed rang sangs reske/ /pra ṇa tā pā tra hasta ya ta debā bhi ma tai da do/ /a tha bā rtswa rgyas—/ /de nyid mngon par bzhed gyur pa/ /des kyang rab tu btung nas byin/ /de nas de yi bu sa ma yā tadhe na bu tastu ri tai kṣu dhwa/ /dza na mbi sgo dza nā ram̐ bhe ya yā tse ni bkres nas/ /rings par khrus byas yang dag 'ongs/ /zas ni rtsom par byed pa'i tshe/ /ma la rang gis dza mū la shaṃ/ /pu bye pu tā nu mo da pā tadma yā ti tha yephobee tai/ /i ti mā turba tsaḥl phug blangs/ /bdag gis mgron la de byin bu/ /dge la rjes su yi rang byos/ /de skad ma yi tshig khru twa so bhu bridhe i bee 6 ṇa/ /sa spyo bi sru tsa kārta su masgo la ka thos nas/ /de ni mda' yis phug bzhin gyur/ /mgron khyod 'phral la ma zhu bas/ /gzir cing dku ④ma nalpi shaṃ/ /ku kṣi bhi tā bi nirlu tu pā ṇiḥs ha tā bā ti theḥ/ /i ti ni phug gyur nasathu/ /mi chung bdag gi la phug dag /srog dang lhan cig phyir 'byung shog /de skad ta sngasta pā pa gya bākrā tu bye ṇi bhu ya sā/ /bi stu tsi kai ba paryadhe ba bhu bā pa sdig pa thob pa de'i/ /shin tu rtsub pa'i tshig de yis/ /mjug tu ma zhu'i nad nyid ni/ /skye ba gzhan pa ra dzadma su/ /pāspu khyunta ra pā ke na sa e bā rya pra pe na dzita/ /bi pu rnams su gyur/ /de nyid da lta gsal rgyal te/ /snga ma'i bsod nams gzhan byun pas/ /rgyal srid lo rā bye mā pā rya ta yi bādhe kṣa yi ga taḥ/ /saṃ sā ra pa tha panda na me ba yangs pa thob gyur nas/ /mjug tu de nyid kyis zhig gyur/ /'khor ba'i lam byi mgron po la/ /dge karma shu bhā shu sgo/ /sā ze ya me ba hasta sbe sgo gā ma bo ba ba rya dang mi dge'i las kho na/ /longs spyod slad du nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /lam brgyags ⑥bzhin du lag na te / /i ti shu tā bha ga ba tasta bye pa byañtsa tadma tsaḥ/ /e ba me gnas—/ /de skad bcom ldan de yi gsung ⑦/ /thams cad bden pa skethos nas ni/ /de de bzhin 95—188

ta di ti dhyā twa tai pra ṇa mya ya yo dṛ paḥ/ /a tānta re pāpta rā byeḥzhes sems byed cing / /der phyag 'tshal nas mi bdag song / /skabs 'dir rgyal srid thob pa yi//shākya bai ram̐ bi rūbhā kaḥ/ /pu ro nyi ta su te ṣpe khya smra ri tasta1 yorya taḥ/ /'phags skyes po ni shākya'i khon①/ /mdun na 'don gyi bu song nas/ /sbran dzu pas de dag brlag brtson pa//pra ya yo shākya na ga ram̐ ga dzā shwa ra tha re rku nā/ /me he na de sha kurban glang po shing rta rta rdul ①gyis/ /rmongs pas blo bzhin phyogs rnams ni/ /rnam dbye min spyopa nyid byed dhi yā mi ba nibee be kā hūṃ/ /sarba rnyo bha ga bān dzñā tā ta gya tadru ṣṭa cing / /shākya'i grong du rab tu song / /de yi spyod tshul ma rungs dekhye/ /bcom ldan kun mkhyen byus tseṣṭi tai/ /ga tā shākya pu ro pādhe tasgo shuṣka ta ro ra dhaḥ/ /dru rātta tra mkhyen nas/ /shākya'i grong dang nye bar ni/ /gshegs nas shing skam 'og tu bzhugs/ /ring nas de na sbri tai dṛṭī tai mā gatstshan bi ru bhā kaḥ/ /a ba tīrya ra tha da gra ma bye bzhugs pa de/ /'phags skyes po ni 'ongs pas mthong / /shing rta la babs mdun du ni/ /mngon tya pra ṇa to ba data/ /sahphu snagha pa lā she 6 gha natshwa ye 6 shā khe 6/ /phyogs rab tu btud nas smras/ /'dab ma snum pa'i yal ga can/ /grib ma stug rnams yod pa la//bha ga banda tra bi shārnyiḥki shuṣka ta ro ra dhaḥ/ /i kyuktaḥkṣi ti pā le na der ni bcom ldan mi bzhugs par/ /shing skam 'og tu ci zhig mdzad/ /sa skyong gis ni 'di brjod tshe//tai pā ha bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /dzñā titshwa yā na ra pa te tsanda na da pi shi ta lā/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas der bka' stsal/ /mi bdag gnyen byi grib ma ni/ /tsandan pas kyang shin tu bsel//nā snyi dzñā ti sa oṃ bi rghaṃ nā ste dzñā ti sa mā dhri ti ཿ / / nā ste dzñā gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i nor rdzas med/ /gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i dga' ba med/ /gnyen dang ti sa mā tshwa yā nā ste dzñā ti sa ma ཿ pri yaḥ / / ma mi te bhū pa mtshungs pa'i mdzes ma ⑥med/ /gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i mdza' bo med/ /sa bdag shākya 'di dag 95—189

te shākya dzñā ta yastata pu rarnyi kai/ /dzā taḥthra yo yo tata spru tya shuṣka sha gnyen—/ /de la dga' bas de dag gis/ /grong 'gram 'dab ma bskams pa yi①/ /rkang 'thung 'di khā bee pā da paḥ/ /shu tī tabyir tā maste shākyā rmā pakṣa pa ti rna/ /bha ga la dga' ba skyes/ /de dag thos nas bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya'i phyogs su lhung bar ni/ /rig nas khro brnye bee di tī ba n+ya brte na bi byu bye kaḥ/ /bha ga bān pi shākyā dzā dang bral ba yikye / /'phags skyes po ni log par gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /shākyar dzha tā ga mi bha yi ta taḥ/ /shri ya se shudhe sa tā rmā bi da dhe dharma de sha 'jigs pa 'byung mkhyen nas/ /sems pa ①dag pa rnam dudag la/ /dge legs slad du chos bstan rna / /sgo tāste pha lo kaibye ta sa kṛ dā gā mi tsā ba riḥ/ /a nā ga mdzad / /kha cig gis ni rgyun zhugs 'bras/ /gzhan gyis lhan ⑤cig phyir 'ong dang / /phyir mi 'ong mi pha lo tsā byeḥsaṃ pābye ta su shā sa nāta/ /she ṣastu spru zwam ta yaḥshākya 'bras gzhan gyis ni/ /de yi bka' yis yang dag thob/ /lhag ma blo gros blun rjopo yis/ /shākyas pā purna tatpa rda/ /shārnyi ke pi kha gā ye ྾ bā sa re ti mi robho baḥ/ /rgo dṛtta gnas de ma thob ste/ /gang zhig nyin par rab rib dag /'byung ba'i bya ni 'ga' zhig yod/ /de nas snga tha dṛ pa teḥpu ro hi ta su tasta taḥ/ /bee ra sarba gya supta su bi da dhe mi bdag log pa yis/ /khon gyi sbrul dag nyal ba dag /mdun na 'don gyi bu yis ni/ /rab tu sad pra ti bo dha rna/ /sa te na pre ri ta: kre ma ti shākya ku la kṣa ye/ /bai rā pa rnam par bsgrubs/ /de yis bskul bas shākya'i rigs/ /gzhom pa'i blo ④gros de yis byas/ /khon gyi na lo pra tsa la rna ka ro ti pi shu nā ni laḥ/ /sgo ra durdza na madhe ṇa sa ha so me ni rab 'bar bar/ /phra ma yi ni rlung (nyegis byed/ /'jigs rung skye bo ngan pa yis/ /sngags kyis ttha pi tāḥkha khāḥ/ /bee tā khāḥkshi nyi pā lābya na ka gya pā ṇa hā ri ṇa/ /mee bye 'phral bslad mi bsrun pa'i/ /ro langs dang ni sa skyong dag /su yi srog ni 'phrog byed min/ /de nas 95—190

ga dza ra tho da gre ta tasta pra sarba ti/ /ba bhu ba pu ra saṃ sgo bhaḥde yi dmag dpung ni/ /glang po shing rta'i mchog rab dkrigs/ /lam bkag shākya rnams kyi 4)ni//shākyā rmā rudhe waṭwā rmā/ / ta smin bha ga bān bi shākya rna rakṣu pā grong khyer yang dag 'khrugs par gyur/ /der ni bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /shākya bsrung slad phyogs te rna/ /sa mudma tai ta tra ma hā moṅga lya ya na ma bra dī ta/ /shākyā rmā karma do ṣṭa lhung zhing / /yang dag brtson pa mo ⑧ga la/ /chen po dag la bka' su pa pa/ /shākya rnams kyi las kyi yo sarba thā sa mu pa sbi taḥ/ /ta tra rakṣa bi dhwa rna te ga ga ṣpe se tu skyon—/ /rnam kun nas 'di nye bar gnas/ /de la bsrung ba sgrub byed pa/ /nam mkha' la ni bgrod bandha āoṃ/ /sum̐ sā ma tsidhyā bi bha bā ni shu bhā shu bhā ni yārnyi pra yārnyi tsa mu stegs ①brtsigs/ /skyes bu rnams kyi bsam yas 'byor pa dge dang mi dge dag /'ong dang rab tu 'gro hurni ra pa gra hā ṇi/ /karmā kṣa ra ṇi ni dza dzadma pa da swa hasta nastu yang yud tsam rang dbang med pa ni/ /las kyi yi ge rang gi skye ba'i gnas la rang lag gis/ /bkod pa ni nā ma na bha brnyi ni rarja kā ni/ /i nyi pā kyāta bha ga ba tastasmin yā te dag ni nges par don med can du 'gyur ba ④min/ /de skad bcom ldan gsung gis ni/ /de la phyag pra ṇa mya tai/ /tsa kri re saṃ bi rda shākyāḥpra tyā sanderbi rū 6 kai/ /ho 'tshal der phyin te/ /'phags skyes po ni nyer lhags pas/ /shākya rnams kyis bgro ④ba byas/ /srog sā smra rnyirna karta byā pā ṇi ma tra su na su tsita/ /sha rāḥsha rī ra masmra dang ldan tsam su la yang / /yu ⑥ cag 'tshe bar ④mi bya'o/ /dgra yis rab tu 'phangs pa'i mda'//shaṃ bi shadhwa ri sa mbi ri tāḥ/ /i ti saṃ bi da mā dhwa ye te tu pā yaṣṭi pā ṇa yaḥ/ /yu skecag lus la 'dzugs su bas/ /de dag de ltar gros bzung ste/ /khro bas lam ⑨na mdung bzung ste⑩//dhī rāḥpa rorya me tasbra ra bā ra yi ta kārmu kāḥ/ /a tānta re kārma yo gzhu ni rab tu bdungs ⑪byas nas/ /pha rol 'jug la brten ⑫pas gnas/ /skabs der don gyi sbyor 95—191

gāndi dza de sha na ba spru taḥ/ /a dzñā twa saṃ bi rda shākyaḥshaṃ pā kaḥs mu pa ya yo/ /ba las/ /rang gi yul na mi gnas pa/ /shākya sham pa ①ka yis gros/ /ma shes pa ②ni yang dag 'ongs//sa dṛṣṭa na ga rā brja sandarghaṃ ba su dha dhi paṃ/ /ko pā de ka: kā rā su de yis spyos bdag go bgos pas/ /grong khyer bsdams pa mthong nas ni/ /khros te gcig pus g.yul du ra bee su bha ḍa saṃ kṣa yo/ /yudhe pu ru ṣa dzi he na ha tā ste bī ra phyin—/ /de yi dpal rnams brlag par byas/ /g.yul du skyes bu seng ge yis/ /dpa' bo glang po de kuñdza rāḥ/ /pra ya yuḥspyo ha ṭwā ya two ya sho bhirmo tta kai ri ba/ /sa ko pi ta dag bsad/ /mu tig gis bzhin grags pa yis/ /dga' bar byas pa ④nyid du gyur/ /gzhan la khros su dza dzwa la ko pi ta mya pa ri ra si/ /sa ya yo yata pra tā pe na bi pu par gyur pa de'i/ /ral gri de ni ci yang 'bar/ /gang gis khyerab tu gdung bas des⑥/ /dgra yi chu dzee ri pu bā nyi ṇi/ /bhabhe pra yā te swa pu ri naṣṭidhwa te bi rū bhā ke/ /pra bo ⑦yangs par song / /'phags skyes po ni spro ba nyams/ /'pham ④nas rang gi grong khyer song / /dgra be shaṃ na da duḥshākya sasthā ka gya dī hūṃ ba dhwata/ /swa dza no pi pa ri tyaktaḥsha tairti ni bsad pas sham pa ⑨ka /shākyas nang du 'jug ma ster/ /sdig las kyis de de dag gis/ /nang mi snga sha karma rja/ /nirdzi te pi bi mu khāḥkru re sā dha bo dharma bānt+raḥ/ /yin yang yongs su btang / /dam pa chos kyi gnyen ldan rnams/ /rang gi'ang ma rungs la phyir phyogs//dha nā da bee pa da n+ya two su kṛ tai swa dza nā da pi/ /sa ta mo tsirya ni tyā nā mā dam pa 'os ⑪ nyid rtag pa rnams/ /nor rdzas las ⑪kyang gtong phod dang / /nang mi bas kyang legs yu kho pi ya shaḥpri yo/ /nirpā saṃ taḥ sa taiḥpāptaḥsha ṣperbha ga ba byas dang / /tshe srog pas kyang grags pa dga'/ /de dag gis ni bskrad pa de/ /mthar gyis bcom ldan tornyi ka/ /ya yā tse bhū da ya yi ba tai ki tsimbi dza dzee tstsha rna/ /rirgyu bha drung du phyin/ /de la dge legs slad nyid du/ /rang gi mtshan ma cung zad blangs/ /bcom ldan 'das 95—192

ga ba tā tatta ni dza ke sha na khaṃ sha shaṃ/ /sa dza gā mā sa mā mā dā ya bā ku ḍi kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rang gi dbu skra sen cha byen/ /de yis blangs nas ba snu ḍa/ /zhes pa'i dkyil nā ma maṇḍa lo/ /ta tra pra dzñā pra bhā be na sauzlond+ra ha gu ṇi na tsa/ /sa pā pa 'khor dag tu song / /der ni shes rab mthu dag dang / /rtul phod spro ba yon tan gyis/ /de yi rgyal rārdzu dhī rā rde sarba tra su khā bhaḥshri yaḥ/ /dakṣa rde lakṣa rde lasmreḥs ha srid thob ste dpal/ /blo ldan rnams la kun tu mod/ /dpal 'byor grung ①po'i mtshan nyid de/ /grags dzee bi du ྾ ya shaḥ/ /n+ya ba sā ya sa hā yā hūṃ ka la tram̐ sarba sedha yaḥ/ /ta pa mkhas pa'i lhan skyes yin/ /grub pa thams cad chung ma ni/ /rtag 'grus ldan pa rnams kyi yin/ /de trasbi to bha ga ba taḥso tha ke sha na khaṃ sha ke/ /stu pa pra tiṣṭha ma ka rod nas der ni der gnas te/ /bcom ldan dbu skra sen cha la/ /rin chen mchog gis rab mdzes pa'i//ba ra ratna bi rā dzi hūṃ / /bi rū bye ki pi shākyā rmā bai ra pā ra mchod rten rab tu gnas par byas/ /'phags skyes po'ang khon gyis ni/ /pha rol bsgral 'dod sbad tīrya yā/ /su narlubhya pu ram̐ dā ra bhe de na ha sā bi shata/ /ha tā ta tra sa ha pā nas yang / /sgo dbye'i rig ①pas 'phral nyid la/ /shākya rnams kyi grong du zhugs/ /der ni shākya stong phrag ṇi shākyā rmā sapta sapta tiḥ/ /ba dha ka tyā ku mā rā rde sa ha sra ma dag /bdun cu rtsa bdun rab tu bsad/ /de nas bu mo gzhon nu rnams/ /stong phrag de yis thā ha rata/ /sha tā ni pañtsa shākya rmā ga dzeerlo tebya marda ṣpeḥ/ /saṃ pra bcings nas khyer/ /shākya brgya phrag lnga rnams ni/ /lcags dang glang po'i 'joms byed kyis/ /rab tu mṛ dzre pu rī tsakre kṛ tānta na ga rī mi ba/ /bha ga bān pi shākyā dzā bcom nas grong khyer ni/ /mthar byed grong khyer bzhin du byas/ /bcom ldan gyes kyang shākya rnams//sha tū rde bha de rgo kṛ te/ / karmā nu ba rghaṃ bi dzñā ya ba byu ba bi dgra rnams kyis ni brlag byas pa/ /las kyis ①rjes su bcings ④mkhyen nas/ /skad cig thugs ni 95—193

ma nā kṣa rde/ /pa prasgo sta sa ma bye tya bhikṣa baḥka ru zla ku lāḥ/ /ki 'byung ra1bar mdzad/ /snying rje rgyas pa'i dge slong rnams/ /de la mngon du phyogs te dris/ /shākya karma bi hi tai shākyesgo ram̐ ya gye dṛ shaṃ pha lo/ /bha ga bā ni te taiḥrnams kyis las ci bsgrubs/ /'jigs rung gang gi ④'bras 'di 'dra/ /de skad des ①dris bcom ldan bṛ ṣṭaḥ sarba dzñastu na bhā ṣā two/ /ni dza karma bi sa ken shākyā rmā me 'das4—/ /thams cad mkhyen pas der bka' stsal/ /rang gi las kyi rnam byun gyis/ /shākya rnams ṣa saṃ kṣa yaḥ/ /kṛṣṭi pu ra ma hā mahpho dhi ba riḥs ri tonta rāta/ /sa dā ni ni brlag pa 'di/ /nya pa rnams kyis ⑤chu nang nas/ /sngon tshe nya chen gnyis shig drangs/ /nya ni rtag kṛ to matpa gya bhū yastabye tha ya na to/ /kā le na tso ra tsā yā taiste re tu rab bcad pa'i/ /gdung ba chen po dag gis bsad/ /dus kyis ⑥skye ba gzhan la ni/ /de rnams bā pa ra dzadma ni/ /ha to gri ha pa tī daddhā tā be ba dha na hā rī ddhāḥ/ /to chom rkun nyid gyur pa/ /nor ni 'phrog pas de dag nyid/ /chos rkun du gyur bsregs nas bsad/ /nya madmo to kṛ ha sbo bi rū bhā ka pu ro nyi to/ /dā sā rmā taska rā hūṃ tsa de dag dang khyim bdag de/ /'phags skyes po dang mdun na 'don④/ /nya ba ⑧dang ni chom rkun pa'i//shākyā rmā mṛ hphu tsā gto/ /i ti shu tā bha ga ba taḥ karma rde pha la shākya rnams kyis bsad par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨'di thos nas/ /dge slong rnams kyis las santa ti/ /a bi paṃ bā di ni me ba me ni re sarba rnyikṣa ba// /bi rū zwa ko ko tha rnams kyi/ /'bras bu'i rgyu ni bslu ba dag /med pa nyid du nges par gyur/ /de nas rgyal bas ngan swa pu ram̐ drwabee bi dza ya durma daḥ/ /dze tā nāsnra su te noktaḥpra ḍā yajo rgyags pa'i/ /'phags skyes po ni rang grong song / /bu ni rgyal byed ces bya ba'i⑩/ /byis pa rtse bas la lī la yā/ /de ba ki ni hi tāḥshākya ta tesmra kai kṛ tā sha saḥ/ /i ti bru mdza' la smras/ / lha gcig /meshākya ci la gsod/ /des ni su la gnod ⑫ma bgyis/ /de skad brjod 95byed194

bā ṇa ma ba dhī na ni dza sru nu bi ru bye kaḥ/ /ni pā ta ma ti mṛdmā ti ni nyinta pa'i rang gi bu/ /'phags skyes po yis bsad par gyur/ /myos thob gnod pa goms pa las/ /glang bo na ka ro ti ka/ /ma da labha ba dha ya sādmā tai ga i ba durdza nāḥ/ /sa dza bzhin du skye bo ngan/ /nges par sdang dang nyed ①pa dang / /'joms pa nyid du ci ①mi byed/ /rang gi ⑦gā da sa bhā si naḥswa byu dza ba lo ka yan/ /a ho nu ma hā pākṣiṃ dri dpung pa lta byed cing / /mdun rjosar 'dug nas des ⑤smras pa/ /kye ma bdag gi gzi byin ⑥mer//ṣabyeḥs la bhā yi tai/ /kṛ tānta to ra ṇastasto pā khyo ma ma bhū dzā bi dgra rnams phye ma leb ltar bcom④/ /bdag gi dpung sgram 'di gnyis ni/ /mthar byed rta babs ka ba mo—/ /niḥshe ṣa ba dha dīkṣa yo shākya rna gu ru tai ga to/ /tsā ta su bi kra ma shārgyu ste—/ /shākya rnams ni ma lus pa/ /gsod ⑤pa gdams byed bla ⑨mar gyur/ /de yi rtsal la bsngags pa z-i tā stuḥshākya ka n+ya kāḥ/ /khru tā ba bhā ṣa re tī bra mubye gā na tā de—/ /shākya'i bu mo bzung ⑩ba des/ /thos nas yid 'byung ⑪drag po yis/ /gdong ba btud nas rab na naḥ/ /karma pā sha ni baddhā dzā kha gā nā mi ba de nyi dzā/ /ni jo nowaṃ gha shaste smras pa/ /las kyi zhags pas bcings pa yi⑫/ /lus can rnams la bya bzhin du/ /'chi ba bsgom pa'i nāsnyi pa kṣa tsa tā ma pi / / ye na ghi ཿ sha ma me ti ta ṅgi la dza lo nus pa dag /gshog pa ldan yang yod ma yin/ /gang gi ⑫me ni zhi bar byed pa'i rgyu de dag ni rta gdong mārtswa tya lo bā ḍa bstergyu sho gra ha rṇa ka ro nyi sa ma ye he lā ba le rdzu ta maḥ/ /paryā gis za lospyo/ /'bad rtsol chung ngus za ba'i mun pa spyodus su tsha zer ldan pa 'dzin par byed/ /yongs su lo tsa na baṭwā nā ma bi ṣa yi sābyurya tsarya pa rda sarba kārmi ka tant+ra yadhri ta mi blta ba'i lam byi yul min ngo mtshar dang bcas spyod pa dag gi gnas/ /las dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi rda kaḥ ka gya kahūṃ kṣa maḥ / /e ta dra kasbya dṛ pa tiḥpa dārnya ra gdams ⑩pa 'di kun ⑩su yi bya bar bzod⑫/ /de dag thos nas mi yi bdag /rkang pas bcom pa'i 95—195

i bo ra gaḥ/ /ka rastso do di de sha su sgo ra marṣa bi sngoṣka ḍaḥ/ /tī re ltos 'gro bzhin/ /'jigs rung khro ba'i dug rgyas nas/ /'di yi lag pa chod ces bskos/ /gang gi ya myuḥkṛ tai tā paṃ pā ṇitstsha da na bai sha saṃ/ /sā byā pi hasta garbhe nyi khyu tā 'gram du de yis ni/ /lag ①pa gcod pa'i sdig las byas/ /rdzing bu lag pa'i snying po zhes/ /da lta puska ri bhā bhū bi/ /la tā swa pi ku kyu khāspyo kra ka tsa na li dī ṣṭa pi/ /ma lā su yang ni sa la grags/ /'khri shing la yang lci snying me②/ /pad ldan la yang sog le'i so/ /'phreng ①ba bi shi lā badzee pā ta yakhye bā nij-i rjaḥ/ /tābyunda pā ṇi ka ma khāsta la yang rdo rje'i char/ /brtsa ④med 'bebs su 'jug pa nyid/ /lag pa'i padmo bcad de rnams/ /der tra tī bra bya thā tu rā/ /bha ga badhe bye yā dhya tā sha ra ṇi sha ra rṇa ya yuḥ/ /ni gdung ba drag pos gzir/ /bcom ldan skyabs 'os blo yis ni/ /bsgoms nas skyabs su song bar gyur⑦//tā spru bi dzñā yā sarba dzñā tī bri marmā ha ṭī bya tsā/ /sha ṭī ma tsitta yedrwa de dag gnad bsnun gdung ba rjoni/ /drag po kun mkhyen byis mkhyen nas/ /de dag yang dag dbugs 1 ta tpa mā shā sa no tsi tsā / / ta ta spa rsha dzā ta ha stusngasteja bya 'byin par/ /'os pa bde sogs lha mor bsams/ /de yis reg pas lag pad ④skyes/ /de yis ④lha ba sa nā bṛ tāḥ/ /ya yubyutta pra sā de na tāḥswarge tyakta bi gra hāḥ/ /yi gos kyis g.yogs/ /de dag sems ni rab dang bcas⑨/ /lus btang mtho ris song bar gyur//de ba kaspra tā mā sarya di bya padmotpa dzee ki tāḥ/ /dharma de sha na yā shānt+rastuḥlha pad utpal gyes mtshan lus/ /lha yi bu mo nyid thob nas/ /ston pas chos 'di ⑩bstan pa yis/ /de pā pu bi pu la pa rda/ /ttakṣu bhirbha ga bān thraṣṭa stad karma pha la ma dag yangs pa'i gnas su song ⑪/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /de dag las 'bras mngon bhya dhwata/ /pā ṇi tsā ba la me ta rnyiḥkṛ tai bhigru pi ḍi ba ṣpe/ /karma ṇasta par gsungs/ /'di dag lag pa g.yo bzhin du/ /dge slong dag la tho 'tshalas ⑪byas/ /de yi las kyi 95—196

su pā ke na bi shā se pa ti tāḥpa re/ /ma yi tsitta pra sā de na pābhābye tāḥrnam smin gyis/ /mi 'dod par ni ①rab tu thong / /nga la sems ni dad pa yis/ /'di dag dge ba'i khyeshu dzñā ga ti/ /i kyukta bha ga wān karma pha la pā ka bi tsi tra hūṃ/ /bhekṣu hūṃ 'gro ba thob/ /las 'bras mbin pa rnam bkra nyid/ /de skad brjod nas bcom ldan gyis/ /de yi zhar la tand+ra saṃ ge na bi da dhe dharma de sha dzñā/ /a tānta re gru bye tsa rī rā dge slong dag /rnams la chos ni bstan par ① mdzad/ /skabs 'dir rgyal pos btang ba yisde//dzñā pra ṇi hi tabya raḥ/ / bha ga btsu ri tai dzñā twa bi byu bhā ka mu gsang gnas spyod spyopa'i nyan rna yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyo spyod shes nas/ /'phags skyes po dang pā ya yo/ /so ba dadre ba bhikṣu khaṃ te ṣpe rda ka thi tai pu ram̐/ /swa nye bar song / /de ⑦smras lha gcig ⑧dge slong rnams/ /mdun du de yis 'di skad gsung ⑨/ /sa karma pha la mā sa.oṃ ta su pa shā mi bhū pa te/ /sabhā te nāsni nā daghaḥbadag de yi rang las kyi/ /'bras bu nye bar bdag gis mthong / /blon po mdun ⑩na 'don bcas te//sa pā mā tya pu ro hi taḥ/ /a bī tsi nāmbi na ra ga duḥs te ni pa ti 6 zhag bdun na ni mes tshig nas/ /dmyal ba mnar med ces bya ba tshokye / /bzod dka' dag tu lhung bar ti—/ /i ti tata ba tsa rna khru twa dṛ pa tiḥs pu ro hi taḥ/ /yatna du 'gyur—/ /de skad de yi ⑫tshig thos nas/ /mi bdag mdun na 'don dang bcas/ /chu yi 'khrul ⑫pa sa sapta haṃ dza lo ta tra kṛ hānta re/ /kṣa shā ba she ṣe sabhā he 'khor khang nang du/ /zhag bdun 'bad pas gnas par byas/ /zhag bdun mjug na skad cig la//tasmintaḥpu re ga te/ /srurya kāntarka saṃ tā pa yo gāta dza dzwa la pā ba kaḥ/ /u pho brang 'khor du song ba des/ /me shel nyi ma'i 'od dag gi /sbyor bas me ni rab tu 'bar/ /'jig da j-i te na pra la ya sa ba nā brti ṣpe ṣpe ba be bāmbi dasgo so dha gi pa'i rlung gis gtsubs pa lta bur rab tu 'bar ba rtse mo can/ /rdeg ④ces sgrogs pas de ni myur bas ⑫95—197

ti shi khi nā nā ra kai mā pa ba sna/ /asmin lo ke dzwa la na dza ḍi lā pā pi rmā pre nges bsregs dmyal ba'i me dag thob/ /sdig ①can rnams la 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du'ang phyogs tya rā gā ཿ sa rba tre ba sbi ra su kha rta ba ཿ shī ta lāḥ pu rgya bhā kun 'bar bas khengs/ /bsod nams bsten ①la thams cad kho nar brtan ①zhing gdung ba'i sa gzhi dzee / /i nyi kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la bsil—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam tā lnga bi rū bhā kā pa dā dzā dā da sha palla waḥ// //gye 'khri shing las 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //duḥkhaṃ nu darnyi su kha sadza da ma di sharnyi saṃ dzre ba yarnyi dza na tsā ti dam pa bdud rtsis brlan ④pa'i zhal dang ri bong can zer dag /sdug bsngal zhi byed bde ba phun mi ram̐ ha rarnyi/ /sadmā na sa gya ka la yarnyi bi kā sha hā saṃ santa su sum tshogs pa sbyin par byed/ /skye bo rnams ni yang dag 'tsho byed rab rib 'phrog par byed/ /dam pa'i dhadre ba da naḥsha shi naḥka ra:/ /bimbi sā raḥkṣi teḥsā re pu re rā dza kṛ yid kyi mtsho ni rnam par rgyas shing dgod par byed/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces pa/ /sa yi snying por duhā bhi dhe/ /sā raḥs mapta bhū pā nā ma bhū ta bhū mi pu randa raḥ/ /kṣa mā ṅgā re gzugs can snying / /mtha' dag sa bdag snying po ni/ /sa yi brgya byin byung bar gyur/ /gang gi dpung byu dze ya su kṣa ma dhwa re tsa tse ta si/ /bā khyaḥs mabee tsiṭwā rmā mā shu n+yastapa sa yi rten/ /sems ni bzod pa'i rten dag la/ /khur ni bkod pa'i skye bo rnams/ /bsam pa mtha' ka ro dza na/ /kurba tasgyu ga saurlu shā mā shā yā pa ri pu ra rṇa/ /dag phyi rol gyur/ /gang gis ⑥gtong dang rtul phod kyis/ /re phyogs yongs su rdzogs byed cing //pā ṇi bi myusto rasgo ghi swa bsgo khyu da si gra te/ /ka dā tsi ta bha batta su lag pa rin chen tshogs la yang sti/ /ral gri 'dzin la dam par gyur/ /nam zhig de yi ④grong khyer du//95—198

bi bla bo na ga re gu ru/ /na bā byu da ya saṃ dzā ta darba kā la i bā ku laḥ/ /nye bar 'tshe ba phyi ba byung / /mi bsrun gsar du mngon dar bas/ /kun tu dregs skyes bzhin du 'khrugs//tamā sthā na sa mā sī rna dza na tsiddhā kṛ ta kṣa khaṃ/ /bya dzi rnyi pa ta sau ra dza na skye bo'i bsam pa'i skabs phye ste/ /mdun stisar yang dag bzhugs ①pa ni/ /skye rgu'i ①pha ltar gyur de la//pra dzā rmā dza na ko pa oṃ/ /de ba de byi pra bhā ba gya ni ya ta shā sa ṣpe na te/ /dza naḥgrong khyer pa yi skye bos ④zhus/ /lha gcig ⑤lha yi mthu ldan pa/ /khyod kyi bka' yis dul ba yi/ /skye bo sa dā sa mu dro yo marlu dzā nā ti brta te/ /dza na myu gya pra kṛ ta saṃ thratta rtag tu rgya ldan 'di/ /lugs la ⑥rab tu mi 'da'o/ /dam pa'i lam nas rang bzhin gyis/ /rab su sadmārge sarga taḥ/ /u pa sargo da ga māḥkasma dasmra da ya mā ga taḥ/ /swa zhugs skye bo 'di dag la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba ⑦rab rgyas 'di/ /glo bur dag tu ga du nas 'ongs/ /rang dhand+ra saṃ thraste na karma ṇḍa sharma ṇa dṛ rde/ /su dzre pe ṇa tsa gu tyā rmā gi chos la zhugs dga' ba'i/ /las dang rgyal po bzang pos kyang / /sbas par gyur pa'i mi rnams ni//nā pa tarnyi bi parta yaḥ/ /j-i yadhe naḥpra sru tā dzā kṛ nyi ddhā āoṃ kṛ he/ /rgud pa dag tu ltung ba min/ /bdag cag rnams kyi khyim khyim du/ /sbrum ma btsas pa'i bu tsha rnams//a pa tyā ni pha lā nī ba sa྾ yā ṇa ma saṃ ya mā ta/ /ki tu bhū tai na bidmastan bya ba legs pa'i 'bras bu dag /ma bsdams pa las bzhin du 'phrog /de ci mi shes 'byung po 'am//mā yo tsā pi ma tī ya rpā/ /yata pra bhā bee na bhā yadhe ku khā ni ni ra pa tya hūṃ/ /i yang na shin tu che ba'i rgyu/ /gang gi mthu yis rigs dag ni/ / bu brgyud ⑨bral ba nyid du byed/ /de ti te ྾ gi rā byu j-i da bhū ta saṃ krānta tabye thaḥ/ /pa re duḥkhaṃ bi sha tyantaḥs dag tshig des sa bdag la/ /de yi gdung ba 'phos ⑩par gyur/ /dam pa'i nang du pha rol gyi/ /sdug tī ka dā ra ba re bta/ /sarpā ga byā pi nā te na dza na duḥkhe na khyu ya sā/ /bsngal zhing la chu bzhin 'jug /yan lag kun la khyab byed pa/ /skye bo'i ⑪sdug bsngal chen po des//95—199

pi ṣa ṇi bā thra ta swa bhū duddhānta j-i da yaḥkṣa rṇa/ /so bra bī tā ki ka ro mya dug gi ①bzhin du bsgrubs pas de/ /skad cig snying ni rab 'khyam gyur/ /de ②smras dpung pa'i dbang tra byu dzā dhī ni bi po tu ṣe/ /kand+ra nā ma pra brte te durlakṣe 6 pra ti kri dang ni/ /skyes bu min pa 'dir ci bya/ /mi mtshon pa de phyir bcos pa/ /ji ltar kho nar ①brtsam par yā—/ /di na me kai bra dzee twa rya bha brnyo ni dza maspa da/ /sa bra ta—nta bya—/ /khyod rnams de ring nyi ma gcig /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar byos/ /khrod kyi bu tsha 'jig ④yā bye ba ras+ho baḥpra sa ba kṣa ye/ /i ti rā dza ba tsā khru tā z-iṣṭaḥbasrung ba/ /brtul zhugs bcas pas nges par bsam/ /de skad rgyal ba'i gsung ⑤thos nas/ /grong po ra ma hatta maḥ/ /dza ga duste sa mā badza pū dza bye dza na oṃ dza bo/ /de pa chen po mgu rnams kyis/ /mchod pa gsal byed thal mo dag /yang dag sbyar nas de la smras/ /lha ba twa da ba dhwa ṣpe na pra ṇa ya karna ṣpe na tsa/ /twa yi bi n+yasta tsirsā gcig khyod kyi ⑥nges 'dzin dang / / khyams dang ⑦rjes su thos ⑤pas kyang / /khyod la bsam pa rnam rmā nāsmra ka ma dhu nā shra maḥ/ /a nudha ta mu dā re tsa twand+ra sā bkod pa⑨/ /bdag cag da ni ngal ba med/ /khyod kyi bka' drin mi rtsub cing / /yid du 'ong bas dā bā lo ka rna/ /i da me ba dza na snga gya dzī bi ta byā ba bste ti/ /ki pu rab gzigs pa/ /'di nyid skye bo 'di dag ni⑪ / /'tsho ba nyid kyis ⑪char 'bab bzhin/ /ci yang naḥbri ya me taste rpā yu ṣa sa dṛ shaṃ ba tsaḥ/ /tā pā pa haṃ mṛ du swā khyod kyi gsung 'di dag /bdud rtsi dag dang mtshungs shing dga'/ /gdung ba 'phrog byed 'jam zhing du ki ki na bee da dhwa ti naḥ/ /kṛ tī kri ta snyoḥka ru rgya ni dhiḥsu mnyen—/ / nged kyis ⑫ci dang ci mi sgrub⑫/ /mkhas shing byas shes ⑫snying rje'i gter/ /mthong ba la bha darsha naḥ/ /la bhya te bhā gya sgo gye na sau dza n+ya sha ra la pra bhuḥ/ /spru yu rnyed sla drang por gyur/ /skye bo legs pa'i rje spyobo ni/ /skal ba spyod pa dag gis thob/ /dam pa'i 95—200

ṣā da ti pe sha laḥ pa ri tsa yaḥ shra bye ba tsaḥ pañtsa mā dā tsaḥ raḥsems la gnas pa'i dam pa rnams kyis ①yongs 'dris bdud rtsi dag pas kyang / /shin tu mnyes gshin sha ri rda du bṛnda ma hā so snga nanda sasdo ha daḥ/ /sa:ste ba sa tsā sā tsā tshig ni lnga pa bas kyang mnyan 'os ②ston zla'i 'od tshogs pas/ /spyod pa'i kun dga'i tshogs ster ①gzhan ki ma pa ra puṣṭhadma naḥko ma lo sau dza bye ha ri tsandan ā da pi pa re santa pa pa ci zhig yid ni me tog pas kyang 'jam/ /skye bo legs pa ha ri tsandan pas kyang yongs gdung mchog tu nirpā pa hūṃ/ /i kyukta pra pa ya yuḥpo rātsū pra ṇa mya pra sā di ni/ /ki ranta stad zlog dupar byed/ /ces brjod drin dang ldan de la/ /phyag 'tshal de yi yon tan ni/ /yid 'ong bume gu ṇi dā rā mā shā ku su ma mā li tsā/ /rā dzā pi na ga re kṛ twa bhu ta tog phreng ba dag /phyogs su 'grems shing grong pa song / /rgyal po yis kyang grong khyer du/ /'byung po pū dza bi dhi kra me/ /shārnyi swaste ka saṃ bhā re tsakra ra ni ya ta pra taḥ/ /mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim/ /byas nas zhi dang shis pa yidu/ /tshogs kyis ⑦nges pa'i brtul zhugs byas//yakṣi hā ri ti kā nā ma bā la kān pu ra bā si bhā/ /ha ra tī ti sa shu shā 'phrog ma zhes pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /grong khyer gnas pa'i byis pa rnams/ /'phrog ces grong khyer lha dag ba pu ra de ba ta yo di tai/ /ta taḥpo ra dzabyeḥsārghaṃ sā mā tyaḥthra thi bī gis—/ /brjod pa de yis thos par gyur/ /de nas sa bdag blon dang bcas/ /grong khyer skye bos lhan pa tiḥ/ /ka lo da ka ni bā pā khye sbri tai bee rku ba nā shra mai/ /bha ga brnya cig tu/ /ka lan da ④ka'i gnas zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal gyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /sdug bsngal rim ya yo drahūṃ su ga tai do ṣa bānta ye/ /sarba duḥkha dzwa rā yā sa dzu gyis gdung ba dag /bsten pa kun gyi mi tsha'i sman/ /bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /skyon ṣa ma ka ṭu kau ṣa snye/ /tai dṛṭī dzu pa tirdu rāta pra ṇa mya thra ya darsha rnams zhi slad blta ⑨ru song / /mthong ba dga' ste ⑩mi bdag gis/ /ring nas mthong nas phyag 'tshal 95—201

rgo—/ /u pa bi shā gra tastasmi bo ra duḥkhaṃ n+ya bee da yata/ /bha ga wā na bi bi dzñā ya te / /mdun du 'khod nas de la ni/ /grong khyer pa yi sdug bsngal smras/ /grong khyer pa yi brgyud dag ni//po rā hūṃ santa tikṣa yo/ / tsiddhā nibya la hūṃ kṣi paṃ mu ba hā ka ru ṇa ni nyams pa mkhyen nas snying rje'i gter/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang myur bar ni/ /thugs ni g.yo ba med nyid byeḥ / /sa bi pri bye dza gabosnuḥs dṛ paṃ sau ra maṇḍa lo/ /pā tra 'dzin—/ /'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor mi bdag dang / /bcas pas bskul nas 'gro ba'i gnyen / /①de ni ṭī ba ra ma dā ya ya yo yakṣi ṇi ke ta rna/ /ta yā bi ra hi tai shā pya lhung bzed chos gos bzung / /gnod sbyin mo yi khang par gshegs/ /de yis dben pa de yi ni/ /khyim tadzdza haṃ bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /pri yi ka rā khya tahphu tram̐ ni nā yi ka ma darsha rna/ /du bcom ldan rgyal bas byon/ /dga' byed ces pa de yi bu/ /gcig ni snang ba min par mdzad//yā te bha ga ba te kṣ-i pre yakṣi swa kṛ ha ma ga tā/ /pra bhū ta pu tā nā pa bcom ldan gshegs nas gnod sbyin mo/ /myur bar rang khyim 'ongs pa yis/ /rab mang bu las dga' shya thra yi pu tram̐ thra yo ka re/ /ta mbi kṣa mā ṇa pā bee shā kṛ ta bahphe ba'i bu/ /dga' byed dag ni mthong ma gyur/ /de ni 'tshol snezhing rbongs bcas pas/ /drus ma bee'u ba dhe nu kā/ /ba bhā ma saṃ blu motna rsā sā dza ṣpe 6 pa ṣpe 6 tsa/ /hā stor ba bzhin/ /'jig rten dang ni nags rnams kyang / /rings pa ①rab 'khrul de yis bskor/ /kye dupri yi ka ra hā pu tra kwa nu pa shā mi te mu khaṃ/ /i ti pra lā pi nī tā ram̐ niḥhud dga' byed kye ⑤hud bu/ /khyod kyi bzhin ni dugar mthong na/ /zhes pa che bar rab sgogs shing //she ṣaḥsā ya yo di shaḥ/ /sā pi tsidhyā shu sarpā sā ni ra shā pu tra darsha ṣpe/ /de ni ma lus phyogs su song / /de yis ⑦phyogs kun mgyogs btsal nas/ /bu ni mthong re med pa yis//kre shadhī sarba ta dri pa sa mu dra ba la yi ya yo/ /mju bhū mi ma ti kra mya mya ngan byed cing ri dang gling / /rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dag tu song / /mi yi sa las 'das nas ni//95—202

gho re 6 na ga re 6 sa/ /swargodre she ṣa shi kṣe 6 bi mā noṅku na shā li 'jigs su rung ba'i grong khyer dang / /mtho ris phyogs ni ma lus pa/ /gzhal yas khang dang skyed tshal 6 —/ / shānta kwa tsinda bi shānta ya ti bhā pra ṇi yā ti —/ /pu gnas①—/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i grong khyer du'ang ②/ /ngal zhing gang du'ang ngal mi gso/ /phyogs tra ma nī 6 nā pa shya ta lo ka pā la pu re 6 tsa/ /ku bee ra snga tha pa tsa sā ga ni 'tshol ①zhing rab song ste/ /btsal yang bu ni rnyed ma gyur/ /de nas lus ngan tshig gis ni/ /bde tā tsa su ga tā shra oṃ/ /bha ga brnye bi yo gatta sha ra bye sha ra rṇa ya bar gshegs pa'i gnas song ste/ /bcom ldan skyabs su 'os pa la/ /'bral bas gzir ba skyabs su yo—/ /ta yā tad duḥkha thrarghaṃ tai sa ni sha mya ni bi di tai/ /tā ma bo song / /der ni de yis rang buspyod mtha'/ /nges par bshad pa des khyegasan nas/ /cung zad 'dzum tsa ta sho tsidzñā ki tsita smi ta si tā dha raḥ/ /hā rī ti ta baḥpu tā hūṃ sarnyi gyi dudakar ba'i mchus/ /mya ngan can ma der bka' stsal/ /'phrog ma khrod la bu dag spyoni/ /kye ma brgya pañtsa sha tā n+ya ho/ /i ya ti ki bi yo gārti re kasmirje ba hā ri ti/ /i ti te phrag lnga dag ⑧yod/ /gcig nyid kho na stor ba la/ /'di snyed bral ⑨ba'i sdug bsngal ci/ /zhes des nokta mā kasbya yakshi duḥkhā kṣa tā ba data/ /pu tra lakṣa pi bha ga ban bka' stsal sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyams pa gnod sbyin mos thos smras/ /bu 'bum yod kyang bcom ldan sa tyā ṣpe ka pu tra kṣatiḥ/ /pu tā ta pi ya ta ram̐ nā n+ya ta ki duḥ'adas| /bu gcig brlag pa yongs ⑩mi bzod/ /bu las mchog dga' gzhan na med/ /bu chags khaṃ ta1 yā ta ba ram̐/ /pu tra bā ṣpe ba dzā nā ti pu tra sde ha pi ṣa bya shaṃ/ /sa ha dug gis gdung ba ni/ /de brlag las gzhan ⑪sdug bsngal ci/ /bu dang ldan pa kho nas shes/ /rgyu med dzee ba su ta dzre ti ra ka ra ṇa ṇi bandha nā/ /ma li no bi ka la spyi ṇaḥka mya ṣpend+ra nges par gdams pa yi/ /bu yis dga' ⑩ba lhan skyes nyid/ /ma tshang rid dang dri ma can/ /su yi bu ni 95—203

sa maḥsu taḥ/ /i ti yakṣa ba dhu bā kyi shu tā batpa bee bi hwa lo/ /zla mi mtshungs/ /de skad gnod sbyin chung mi'i ①tshig /mnyes gshin gyis 'khrugs gsan ①gyur nas//byu tā nu kaspri bha ga bān sa smi tastu ya bhā ṣa ta/ /sho ko yo ba snu tā yā bcom ldan 'byung po la brtse bas/ /'dzum bcas de la bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyi bu ni mang po las//ya bye kā bi ra he ta ba/ /z-i te twa ma ka batyā rghaṃ pu tra ke kau dṛ shī bya thā/ /gal te gcig bral mya ngan 'di/ /bu gcig rnams kyi bu khyod kyis/ /phrogs pa'i gdung ba ci zhig 'dra//two pra bi shya sa dā ge haṃ ste rmā pu tra nā lakṣi tā/ /a sha nā si pu tram̐ mā tā pi byā rtag tu khyim du ma mthong bar/ /khyod zhugs bud med rnams kyi bu/ /bu yi mas kyang stag mo yis/ /ri spyi ba mṛ ga shā ba kān/ /ye na ye na swa de ha su duḥkhaṃ yā kyus sgo ga hūṃ/ /dwags rnams kyi bu bzhin zos/ /rang gi lus la gang gang gi①/ /sdug bsngal nyer spyod nyid 'gyur ba//na tata pa ra gya kurbi ta saṃ mā narjo bha ba shu tsā/ /two bu— dhand+ra saṃ ghā rmā ṭī mya ngan nyams myong mtshungs pas na/ /de ni gzhan la bya ba min/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gyirjo//ṇi shi kṣu sa dā ni tse ta/ /kṛṭwā si ho sā bi mu khyi tasthā sno se thra yi su bslab pa'i gzhi gsum gal te khyod/ /'dzin cing 'tshe las phyir ldog na/ /dga' ba'i bu de khyod kyis tai—/ /i kyukta sā bha ga ba tā prasbi shikṣu pa dā ta taḥ/ /ho sā bi 'thob—/ /de skad bcom ldan byis bka' stsal/ /de yis bslab gzhi bzung de nas/ /'tshe ba spangs ra māttaṅgañtsa pu tram̐ pā pa pri yo ka ram̐/ /taspru gyudma thraṭwāntarnyi ta suḥkarma las dga' byed bu/ /de yis byin nas thob par gyur/ /de yi skye ba snga ma yi/ /spyod mtha' yas ⑤kyi pha khā na yi/ /bhikṣu bhirbha ga bān thraṣṭastabyettanta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pu rāsminde rjes 'gro de/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /spyod pa'i mtha' de bka' stsal pa/ /sngon tshe grong ba na ga re po raḥke pyu pa sgo gi na/ /sarba todmā na yā tā yī bi dza khyer 'di nyid du/ /grong pa kha cig longs spyod can/ /ri dang skyed mos tshal 'gro zhing / /gar dang 95byed204

hma narta bā di teḥ/ /a tha te na pa thā kā pi go pā kāntagha na sta byā/ /ma thi tai rol mos rnam par rtse/ /de nas lam der ba rdzi yi/ /mdzes ma su zhig nu rgyas shing / /ri dwags mig pa ju mā dā ya ha ri ṇḍaspyi sa mā dā yo/ /garbha bha rā la sa ga tiḥpra hphutyā ldan dar ba dag /khyer nas 'tshong du yang dag 'ongs/ /rang bzhin gyis ni glang po'i 'gros/ /mngal ga dza ga mi ni/ /pa sha ṣpe rū pa sarbaṭī sasmṛ haṃ tā na bya lo ka yata/ /khur le lor bgrod ldan ma①/ /de yi dal bus nyer bgrod cing / /chags bcas de dag rnams la bltas//ta snga ba na mṛ gī mughi rā ba dasterbi lo ka ṣpeḥ/ /a saṃ bṛṭwā lā ṣādzre nags kyi ri dwags ltar mjos ma/ /yid 'ong ma de'i lta tshul ni/ /mngon 'dod ma bsgribs brlan pa pi soṅka ṇḍa tsā ya yuḥ / / pā tairno madhri tā tra ma da na khye ba des/ /de dag rnams kyang sred ldan gyur/ /'dod pas stsos pa nyid gyur cing / /ngang tshul 'phral la tsā ga tā/ /hā ri hūṃ sa hā sā shī lo na bi bee da pra ma di mbi/ /ta taste nyams pa dag /ma rig bag med pa de ni/ /de dag rnams kyis der don gnyer/ /de nas de dag 6 pra yā te 6 ta snga ra ti shra ma ta/ /pa pā ta sa ha byemee ṇa garbha ko rab song tshe/ /chags pas ngal nas de yi mngal/ /khros pas dmar por gyur pa bzhin/ /brtan pa pā di bā ru ṇaḥ/ /a tānta re sa mā yā tai tahphu ñtsiste na batpa nā/ /pra dang ni lhan cig lhung / /skabs der de yi bsod nams kyis/ /lam de nas ni rang sangs rgyas/ /lus bye ka burghaṃ sā dākṣi ta kā ya tsitta pra sā da rna/ /sāsmi ma zi ta spyu spyopta dang sems ni rab dang ba/ /legs par 'ong ba de yis snemathong / /dar ba'i rin gyis thob pa yi//ma mā shā sha ta pañtsa ka/ /dru rāta pra rngo ma bi na tā ma na mai ba n+ya bee da yata/ /a za lnga brgya de yis ni/ /ring nas phyag 'tshal rnam ④btud nas/ /yid nyid kyis ni de la phul//ta tra pu sgyu ṛdhi ma tya smin dzā ta yakṣa ku le dhu nā/ /dzā ta mā sprarba ṇi nā pya pu bsod nams de las gnod sbyin rigs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan 'dir da lta skyes/ /a za phul bas 'di la bu//95—205

tā rde sha ta paṃ tsa rka/ /ho sā ba tī pa pa tyā ga shrī la bi sma ra ṇata pa re/ /lnga brgya dag ni skyes par gyur/ /ngang tshul brjed nas bdag po dag /btang bas 'tshe ba ldan gyur sngon//pra hyeka budha pra ṇa teḥpābhā shikṣu pa dā rya sā/ /i ti bee bi dha bi rang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal bas/ /de yis bslab ①gzhi de ring thob/ /de skad der ni gnod sbyin pā ka kand+ra tatram̐ bi tsi tram̐ ki ma pi sa ka tha yi tā ta tra yaspyo ga nā yāḥ/ /ka mo yi las kyi zhurgyud ci yang / /rnam mang rnam smin rnam par ①bkra ba dag ni bka' stsal nas/ /'jig li ta ku sha la se tuḥsaṃ bha bāsgo dza nā nā ma kṛ ta su kri ta tsirghaṃ sarba lo ka rten kun gyi legs byas bsams ④byas ston pa de yis ni/ /skye bo rnams kyi srid pa'i mtsho la dge ba'i zam gya shāstu/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī stegs mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag ha rī ta kā da ma nā ba dā rna tra yo da sha palla waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las 'phrog ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gsum pa'o// //yaḥsaṃ kalpa pa thā si nai ba tsa ra ti thra dzrembha mā ṇabyu tai swadzee rya gang zhig rtog ⑤pa'i lam du'ang rgyu ba nyid min rmad ⑥byung rab tu 'phel dang ldan/ /rmi lam byis gya na saṃ ga tiḥpa ri tsa yo yasminda pūrba kra maḥ/ /bā ṭwā mo na ba tī tsa ya tra nyi kyang gang dang 'grogs min gang la yongs 'dris sngon chad med pa'i rim/ /gang la mi rnams tshig ni mi smra dṛ rde yaḥrnge tra ṣpe tā ti thiste nirgyu dza dza na bra bhā ba bi bha baṃ mā ṣpe ra me yanda nyid dang gang zhig rna ba mig gi mgron/ /rgyu med skye bo'i mthu ni 'byor pa tshad kyis gzhal bya min pa de la maḥrka/ /pu re rā dza kṛ hā bhi khye dzi bi sā re ṇa khyu bhu dzā/ /pū bye mā rna dzi bstod—/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces par/ /sa bdag gzugs can snying po yis/ /'od ma'i tshal na rgo dṛ ṭī sbi haṃ be rku ba dzā shra me/ /mātpa rya bi ṣa saṃ ta ṭwā mūkhroḥbazhugs pa yime/ /rgyal ba mchod pa mthong gyur nas/ /rmongs pa kun mkhyen nga rgyal can/ /phrag dog 95—206

sarba dzha mā ni naḥ/ /na se hi re ta duṭwārṣa pra kā sha mi pa kau shi kāḥ/ /dug ①gis rab gdungs ④pas/ /de yi khyad 'phags ma bzod de/ /ko'u ①shi kas snang ba bzhin//ma li ṣpeḥswa bi ni shā ya pa ra bhā go di taiḥpa dā/ /kri ya te bā sa ra spazlu nub mor gyur pa'i rab rib tshogs/ /dri ma can ni shar cha nas/ /'char bar ④rtag tu nyin par la//sharba riste mi roṅka riḥ/ /maska rī saṃ dza yī bee rā da dzi taḥka ku dasta thā/ /rang nyams bya slad 'gran par byed/ /gnag lhas bu dang yang dag rgyal/ /mi pham nog can de bzhin du//pū ra ṇa dzha ti pu tra rya rūkhro kṣa pa ṇa kāḥs re/ /spru tsudṛ pa ti ma bye tya rdzogs byed gnyen gyi bu la sogs/ /rmongs pa zad byed gzhan dag kyang / /bdud kyi sgyu mas rmongs byas mā ra mā yā bi mo hi taḥ/ /saṃ ghakṣe dzwa ṣa do ṣe ṇa dhū me ṣpe bārnya shing / /'gran 'dod zhe sdang skyon gyis ni/ /du bas bzhin du mun gtibs pas/ /mi bdag la mngon kā ri tāḥ/ /e ṣa sarba dzha tā mā na ba ṣpe yaḥshra ma ṇaḥsbi taḥ/ /ṛdhi phyogs nas smras/ /nags na 'dug pa'i dge spyong gang / /'di ni kun mkhyen nga rgyal can/ /khyod kyis pra bhā bo bha ba tā tasmra ke tsa dṛ shya ṭwā/ /ṛdhi pra bhā brtso yaṅgi:ta dza na de dang nged rjornams kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu ni blta bar byos/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu las gang cung zad/ /skye bo byā bā dza nordzi tai/ /dbye te ma ha dābyatram̐ pā nyi hātram̐ ta du tsu te/ /shattaḥmagu bar dhirab spel ba/ /ngo mtshar che ba mthong grur pa/ /de dag cho 'phrul zhes su brjod/ /rgyal po saṃ sa di ya sgyusnyi pā ti hārya gya darsha ṣpe/ /asma rka ta gya bā rā dzan snyu bdag cag gam dang ⑦de/ /mdun sar cho 'phrul ston pa yi/ /nus pa gang la yod gyur de/ /'gro ba bye sastu dza gattha ye/ /i ti te hūṃ ba tsa shu tā tajargya bi mu kho dṛ paḥ/ /gsum du mchod 'os 'gyur/ /zhes pa de dag tshig thos nas/ /mi bdag de dregs las phyir phyogs//u bā tsa rpāsgo ke yi baḥpa shu dzā gi ri lo gha ṣpe/ /a pa saṃ dza pa mo bai tata smras pa khyed bsam 'di ci zhig /'phye bo ri la 'dzeg ⑧par 'dod/ /'di ni rigs min phye ma leb//95—207

rdza te dzaḥsadzdza na brdza rgo bi sgo/ /tīddhā bhi dha na ma khi lo pra yā mgu ba yis①/ /rang gi gzi brjid rab gsal mdzod/ /mu stegs zhes pa ma lus pa'i/ /mun pa tu pra la yi ta maḥ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsa khru tā nirbi gā ra ma hā sha yaḥ/ /brlag par rab tu thob du/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /bsams 1pa chen po rnam 'gyur med/ /bha ga bān bee ra ta marṣa pa gharṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzanda byo pa 'gran bzhed khro ba dang bral ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis der bka' stsal/ /rgyal po gzhan dag nyer marwa ya bi bā dā ya ma dā ya bā/ /bi bee kā bha ra ṇardo yi kṛ ya gzhom dang / /rtsod dang rgyags pa'i phyir yang min/ /rnam dben rgyan du 'os pa yang ④/ /yon tan te gu ṇa saṃ gra haḥ/ /mātparya ma li ṣpeḥki tairbi tsā ra bi gu ṇirgu ṇiḥ/ /'di ni gzung bar bya/ /'gran pa'i rgyu yis rab bsgrubs gang / /pha rol bsngags 'phrog yon tan ni/ /ye ha rarnyi pa roṅkarṣa spaddhā brnya pra sā ri taḥ/ /gu ṇa tstsha da na ma n+ya mya phrag dog dag gi dri ma can/ /rnam dpyad yon tan bral des ci/ /gang zhig rang gi yon tan gyis/ /swa gu ṇi na ka ro ti yaḥ/ /dharma ste nā pra shaste na swa ya me ba ni dma ti taḥ/ /gzhan gyi yon tan sgrib byed pa/ /bsngags par 'os pa min pa des/ /rang nyid kho nas chos chud gson//sad gu shā rmā pa rī kṣe ba pa re bai lakṣu kā ri bhā/ /u tsi ta na hi shuddhā rmā yon tan dam pa yongs brtag nyid/ /mchog tu skyengs par byed pa yin/ /gang phyir dag pa srang la ni/ /tu la ro ha bi ḍi ba nā/ /gu ṇa bā na pi nā yā ti yaḥpa re ṣṭa pra gzhal ba'i tho 'tshams ⑤rigs pa min/ /gang zhig yon tan ldan na yang / /gzhan la rab dngas dusanda tsā/ /sa dī pa hastastad pā tra sgo ya yā ma li byā kṛ tāḥ/ /lo ke ta e nyid mi 'gyur/ /lag na mar me thogs de de'i/ /snod kyi grib mas mun par byed/ /de nyid 'jig rten ba sarba dzha bidmaḥki ma dhi shaṃ pa ya/ /pa rā bye mā nā bhe bha ba mā gaspyo na kun mkhyen/ /bdag gis lhag pa ⑦ci zhig rig /pha rol mngon khengs zil gnon par/ /rtul ba 95—209
