swa pa rā bha baḥ/ /i ti khru tā bha ga ba taḥpra sha ma bhi ma tai ba brtan pas rang zil gnon/ /de skad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /rab zhi mngon par bzhed thos tsaḥ / /j-i sha ma bhyarja rmā rā dzā tsa kā rābyurya darsha ṣpe/ /ta taḥkṛdzdzata nas—/ /rgyal pos ngo mtshar bstan pa la/ /mchog tu mngon par zhu ba byas/ /de nas tshogs ①kyi bha ga ba tā kṛ tāhphu pa ga mo dṛ paḥ/ /rā dza dhwa no ya yo z-iṣṭaḥsabhā bcom ldan gyis/ /zhal bzhes mdzad pas mi yi bdag /mgu bas zhag bdun dus btab ste/ /rgyal hā ba dhī saṃ bi dā/ /asmindab sa ra bhā tā byu mi bhartu ra po da raḥ/ /tsa po'i pho brang song bar gyur/ /skabs der sa yi bdag po yis②/ /ma gcig min pa'i spun zla zhig /pho tsā rāntaḥpu ro pārnye pā sā da ta la baṭwā nā/ /sa lbo la bra dza tasta mya brang 'khor dang nye ba yi②/ /khang bzang gzhi yi lam nas rgyus/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /karma bā tai ri bee ri tā/ /ku su ma sraspa shaṃ tai she rā dza pasnri ka radzñā rgyal po'i btsun mo'i lag nas 'phos/ /rtse dga' dang bcas 'gro ba de'i/ /phrag par me tog 'phreng ba tī / /ta su bi dzñā ta do ṣa su do ṣi saṃ bhā byā pākṣi bhiḥ/ /pi shu nāḥki ba lhung / /skyon ni rig par gyur pa de'i/ /skyon rnams dbang pos bsal ④byas nas/ /phra ma mkhan gyis darnyi hūṃ tsa kri re rā dza gā mi nā/ /sbyi tra malpa ma pi pā pya kṣu druḥsarpā pa gtam de dag /rgyal po yis ni rtogs par byas/ /rje bo'i bsam pa stong par ni/ /chung yang bu ga kā ri ṇaḥ/ /dī dzi hāḥpi shun pra bi shan pra bhū rmā shu n+ya mā sha yi/ /pi shu ṇa pre rnyed par gyur⑤/ /gnod pa kun byed lce gnyis pa/ /phra ma rab tu 'jug pa nyid/ /rgyal po phra mas ri to rā dzā sthā tu rīdhya bi kho lwa ṇaḥ/ /tstsha rda pā lā di sha shu pā ṇi pā da su bskul ba yis/ /phrag dog dug rgyas rgyal ⑥gyur pas/ /spun zla'i lag pa rkang pa dag /myur du chod ces mūdhri taḥ/ /ni kṛtta pā ṇi tsa ra ṇaḥku mā raḥkarma bi bla bāta/ /pa yang dag bsgos/ /lag pa rkang pa rnams ⑦bcad pa'i/ /gzhon nu las kyi ⑧rnam bslad pas/ /gsod 95—210

ba dhya ba su dhwa shā yī bi be sha bi ṣa mā pa rda/ /ti pra bya baṃ pa ri thra tai pa'i nor 'dzin la nyal te/ /mi bzad rgud par zhugs par gyur/ /ma dang gnyen ni mya ngan can/ /sho tsa ṅgha rmā tro ba na dhū bhi ཿ / / da tre shu ste kṣa pa ṇa kā ཿgdung ba drag pos yongs bskor te①/ /skad cig mig ni g.yo ba yi du/ /zad byed rnams kyis mthong kṣa rṇa/ /tān sa ma bye tya sho kārta ste rā dza su ta bā na bāḥ/ /dza ga bar gyur/ /de ni yongs bskyabs gal chags shing / /kun la phyag 'tshal mya ngan gyis/ /gzir ba'i dusta ta pa ri tā ṇa lubhāḥsarba pā ṇi naḥ/ /a do ྾ ni kṛ tī to yo rgyal bu gnyen de rnams/ /de dag la mngon phyogs nas smras/ /kā ④la zhes pa mi bdag bu/ /skyon med kā lo nā ma dṛ pādma dzaḥ/ /sarba rnye bā di no yu yo pra sā do gya bi dhī ya tsā/ /'di ni chad pas bcad/ /khyed rnams kun mkhyen smra ba po/ /'di la bka' drin bsgrub par mdzod⑤/ /i ti taiḥpra sa rabye྾ rarja mā nāḥpra lā pi rnyiḥ/ /tai mo ni no nind+ra ti bhā de skad mchi ma rab zags shing / /rab smras 'ude yis gsol btab pas/ /mthu med de dag mi smra zhing / /bee lakṣu da n+ya to ya yuḥ/ /a tha te na pa thā ya to bhi kṣuḥsu ga ta shā skyengs nas gzhan du song bar gyur/ /de nas dge slong kun dga' bo/ /bde gshegs bka' yis lam sa nāta/ /a nasdo bi da dhi gā ni ta su sa kyo pa yā tsa nāta/ /rā dza pū de nas/ /'ongs te bden pa'i byin rlabs ④kyis/ /de yi lus ni rnam par bsgrubs/ /rkang lag yang drastu saṃ dzā ta pā ṇi pā daḥpra sanda dhīḥ/ /dzi na sha ra ṇa ma bye tya ta du pa dag skyes pa yis⑤/ /rgyal po'i bu yang dang ba'i blos/ /rgyal la skyabs su mngon song ste/ /de yi nye ji ya ko bha bāta/ /sapta rā tre bya tī te tha pā tī hā bye kṛ haṃ ma hata/ /dṛ gnas dag tu gyur/ /de nas zhag bdun bzlas byepa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /cho dhi bha ga ba to drahūṃ ma tī pa ti ra kā ra yata/ /u pa biṣṭi dṛ pe ta tra 'phrul blta 'dod sa bdag gis/ /khang pa chen po byed du bcug /der ni zad byed pa sogs dang / /95—211

sa ha kṣa pa ṇa kā di bhiḥ/ /kalpa dṛkṣi ki tā byu mi ra bha ba ta su ga lhan cig mi bdag bzhugs pa la/ /bde gshegs bzhed pas sa gzhi dag /dpag bsam shing gis tetstsha yā/ /ta taḥmāste gu de bee 6rdahūṃ bha ga ba taḥpra dzñā/ /ratna brgyan par gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①mthu/ /lta ru lha rnams 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan pra di paṃ bha ga bān bhe dze sau hā sa rna ma hata/ /te dzo dhwa rtu pra banda su ta su 'das kyi 0seng ge'i khri/ /rin chen rab 'bar che ba bsten/ /me yi khams la rab zhugs pa/ /de yi gaṇḍa sa muṅga teḥ/ /byastaḥpā tsa ka saṃ ghā tai ra juta bhu ba na maṇḍa laḥ/ /'gram pa las 'khrungs pa'i/ /me yi tshogs kyis 1srid pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag — khyab par gyur/ /sha dhe sha ṣpe ཿ kā ma la kā na na sa ni kā she ba rno sa ma pta khyu srid par gnas pa mtha' dag 'jig dupa'i 'jigs pas ⑤dal bu yis/ /padma'i tshal dang mtshungs pa'i ba na sbi ta sgo ga bhi tyā/ /de tītta to bha ga ba taḥka ru ṇḍambu ra sheḥpū1 mṛ me ni zhi bar gyur pa la/ /de rjes bcom ldan sku ni snying rje'i chu yi phung po las/ /bdud rtsis 0gang ba'i tormi bi ma khā ru ṇa yaḥpra su sruḥ/ /khā ba khyu sā ra dzi ti tsand+ra sa ha sra kārnyi te rba ⑦rlabs dri med 'od zer rab tu 'phros/ /stong phrag zla ba'i mdzes pa las rgyal mdzes pas khengs gyur dza pra tā na bi pha lbo kṛ ta srurya tsakre / / tai nā ga nā ya kā cing / /gzi brjid rab tu rgyas pas nyi ma'i 'khor lo 'bras med mdzad/ /'dren pa de ni skye bo'i ⑧ni kā ya bi lo tsa nā ni spru tyā pa puḥsu kṛ ta labha ma pūdzee harghaṃ/ /tshogs kyi rnam par lta byed kyis/ /legs byas kyis thob sngon ⑨med mgu zhing dga' bas 'thungs par gyur/ /bai ḍūrya nā la bi pu lā ru ṇa ratna pa tra kārnyobee saṅka na ka ke sa ra kaṇi chu ba bee ḍūrya ldan rin chen dmar po'i 'dab ma yangs/ /mdzes shing rab tu 'bar ba'i gser gyi ge sar ka ni/ /a byurya yuḥkshi ti ta lā da tha tatpa mbi pe padmā ni sau ra bha ze 'bru can/ /rkang drug pa rnams dri bzang tshogs kyis 'bod pa'i padma ni/ /de nas de yi drung du sa 95—212

rā hu ta ṣatpa da ni/ /te 6 pa bi ṣṭa ma tha kāñtsa na tsa rurnyi sdiste gzhi dag las mngon 'khrungs gyur/ /de dag rnams la nye bar bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs 'khor lo ni/ /kṣa ṇa su ga ta tsakra ma dṛ shya tā rāta/ /spru yu ṣa pe sha la sha shi gser 'od mdzes shing 'jam pa'i rgyan ①ldan de nas nye bar mthong / /bdud rtsi mnyes gshin ri bong can byu ti shī ta le na ya sro da ye na sa ha pā su khā mā pa lo kaḥ/ /te 'od bsil bar gyur pa dag /gang zhig shar bas 'jig rten dag gis 'phral la bde thob gyur/ /de ྾ pra bhā ba bi bha baṃ bha ga bān ba bhā ra ma bye dhi rka ka na ka shi la i pā dag dbus na bcom ldan 'das ni mthu yi 'byor pa dag /ri rnams dag las gser gyi ri bo bzhin du tsa la rgo/ /su skarnya brnya ra gha na blu ti sambi bee shaḥpre shu su rakṣi lhag par 'dzin/ /phrag pa legs mtho sdug ②cing mjos par yang dag gnas pa ni/ /lha yi ser ②skyes ti ru hā mi ba pā ri dzā taḥ/ /swaṅgā ga nā ka ra ku she sha ya tīrya ma rnams las yongs 'du bzhin du rab tu mtho/ /mtho ris bu mo'i lag pas me tog rnams ni gtor gyur ṣpe ra smra na mā bee ba la maḥka li totta rmā gāḥ/ /ta sthā na ram̐ bu pa'i—/ /mi dman 'phreng ba'i tshogs kyis yan lag mchog rnams rgyas gyur cing / /de zhal chu skyes rnam dza bi lo ka na ni rni me ṣa markyo a pi kṣa ṇa ma bā pu ra mju bhā paṃ/ /par blta ④la mig ni 'dzum bral bas/ /mi rnams dag kyang skad cig mi yi dngos min thob par 'gyur/ /byo rmā ga ṇi ṣa su ra rdu du rnyi shaṃ kha tū.oṃ gho ṣā thra te ku su ma barṣa ma de nas lha yi rnga chen dung dang rnga sgras khyab gyur cing / /me tog char pa gad rgyangs cher bzhad nam mkha'i hāṣṭa hā sa/ /gandharbha kinda ra mu nī shwa ra tsā ra rja rmā spyi tabya tsā ra bha ga do rar ni/ /dri za mi 'am ci dang thub pa'i dbang phyug spyod rnams kyis/ /bcom ldan bstod pa'i tshig gi ban stu ti bā da nā daḥ/ /ta tā ru ṇa dha ra da khā dṛ sha ram̐ shu shu bhraḥbyā tīrṇa sgra ni bsgrags par gyur/ /der ni bcom ldan zhal gyi padma mchu yi 'dab dmar zhing / /'od zer dkar 95—213

ke sha ra ku lā da sha nā ra bind+rata/ /sashlau ra rghaṃ bha ga ba taḥswa ra sambi bas kun dkris ①so yi ge sar rdzogs pa las/ /bsod nams kyis gtsang shin tu dngar ②ba'i gsung gi bṛ rghaṃ dha n+yaḥ sa surma dhu ra bādma dhu pu rgya su lta / /pā paṃ bi sum̐ sbrang rtsi ni/ /rang nyams dang mthun dam pa'i dri bzang skal dang ldan pas 'thungs/ /sdig pa'i tha ba tsa ta ni ṣi tsa ta pu ju bī dzee bai ram̐ pa ri tya dza ta shā mya su khaṃ bha dza bye/ /thong la bsod nams dag gis ①sa bon thob/ /khon ni yongs su dor la zhi ba'i bde ba bsten par byos/ /dzñā nā mṛ tai pi ba ta mṛ ta bi ṣā pa hā ri bee yo ta nuḥ ku sha la 'chi ba'i dug ni nyams byed ye shes bdud rtsi 'thungs shig dang / /dge ba'i grogs por gyur pa'i lus karma sā khāe tsi ra ya/ /lasmi: khā ta ru ṇa tā tsa dza rā nu yā tā kā yo 'di ring po mi gnas so/ /dpal 'byor g.yo zhing lang tsho nyid kyang rga bar rjes su 'gro/ /lus kyang bya pā ya ni tsa ya su ni kā ya i ba/ /mā rjaḥsha rī ra ka ku ṭī mu byurta gnod pa'i tshogs rnams dag gi gnas nyid gyur pa yin/ /srog ni ngan pa'i lus kyi khyim gyi yud tsam pa nd+ra ni rkyo da ye ku ru ta dharma ma ye pra yatna ཿ / / i tyā di mgron yin pas/ /chos kyi rang bzhin rtag tu skyed la rab tu 'bad par mdzod/ /de la sogs pa'i ⑤bherbha ga ba ta pra bi bhakta dipta dzñā nairbi be ka bi ma loḥku sha lo pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis nyer bstan ye shes kyi/ /snang ba dri ma med pas dudaben zhing dge ba'i mthu stobs sheḥ—/ /badzre ri bā shu da khā shaḥpra ya yo dza na saṭwā ya dṛṣṭi ma ma bo sha kyis—/ /skye bo'i ngar 'dzin 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri bo'i rtse mo ni/ /nyi shu rdo rjes bzhin du myur bcom tro sh-iṅga shi laḥ/ /ṛrnyi pra bhā bha ga ba taḥpra bi bhā pya tīddhā mant+ra rab tu pyazhi bar gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul 'od ldan bcom ldan 'das kyi mthu stobs ⑧mu stegs rnams/ /sngags ha tā pi ṣa dha rā i pa bhasna darpāḥ/ /di pā e bārka ki ra ṇa pra ti kyis bcom pa'i dug 'dzin bzhin du dregs pa nyams gyur cing / /nyi ma'i 'od kyi mthu yis mar me bzhin 95—214

bhā ti bhu tā bye trarbi tā i ba ya yu— ra ni: la two/ /a tārnya re du zil gyis mnan/ /yun ring g.yo ba med pa ri mo bkod pa bzhin du gyur/ /skabs der gnod sbyin bha ga ba taḥs ta tai bi pa kṣa na sarpādma nā kṣa pa ṇa ka na ba dhwarma lag na rdo rjes ①zad byed pa rnams ni/ /bdag nyid kun gyis rtag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi 'umi mthun yakṣaḥ —/ / kṣipta shra bāta bri ta ba ste bha ribya kā ra bi dā bya randha phyogs—/ /yin par shes nas 1 drag po'i rlung gis dkris pa'i char dag spros/ /rnam par rmongs nas sa sha ra shā na bhu bee badzra pā ṇiḥ/ /urnyi shya ta na tha kṛ pādzra bha yā sha ra rgyaḥyi khung bur bskyabs ④pa dag tu byas/ /de nas de dag la mtshon bcom ldan skyabs 'os snying rje yis/ /sarbo pa de sha bi ṣa yo bha ga bān ba bhā ṣe/ /bhū z-ita ba nā pa ni ma nirbi ba brlan par gyur pas nye bar bstan pa kun gyi yul bka' stsal/ /ri dang nags dang sa dang rlung dang rā di sabaṃ te ṣpe tad bha ye 6 sha ra ṇi ki la kā ta rā rde/ /burnyi bra khungs ⑤la sogs/ /'di kun nges par sdar ma rnams kyi 'jigs la skyabs mi 'gyur/ /rab tu sad bo dha ma ma dhwambi ni dhwa ya burnyi dhadzee sa saṃ gha ma pi ye sha ra khaṃ pa'i rang bzhin gnas la blo gros bskyed byas nas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas la gang zhig pra pand+ra ཿ / / te ྾ dza ga ta kṣa ya bha ye ṣṭa pi niste yā rde ṣpe bā skyabs song ba/ /de dag 'gro ba 'jigs pas 'jig 'u pa la yang 'jigs pa med/ /dman pa yongs n+ya taḥsha ra ṇa de n+ya pa ri gra hoste/ /durpā re pa ra lo ka tī bra ti mi re dharma 'dzin skyabs ni gzhan na yod pa nyid ma yin/ /'jig rten pha rol mi bzad mun pa zlog ⑦dkar chos ni pra bṛrnyo shu mān dā dzwa duḥ sa ha pā paṃ tā pa bi pa dā ma byuṅga me ba rab rgyas tsha zer can/ /bzod dkar sdig pa'i gdung ba phongs pas mngon par bskyed pa 7sbyin pa chu ri daḥ/ /pradzñā mo ha ma hā pra pā ta bi ṣa ma shwa bye ka rā lalba na de gter yin/ /mi bzad gti mug g.yang sa chen po'i gcong ⑨la shes rab lag pas 'chel ⑩ba ste/ /kun 95—215

tyā lnganta bi tī na me ba sha ra rṇa sarba tra pu tram̐ dzu khaṃ/ /i ti ti mi ra tu mi rnams kyis sdeni bsod nams kho na dman dang cho nge bral ba'i skyabs/ /de ltar rab rib kyis dṛ tā kshi tsa kṣu ru dhī la nā rta da sha na ma ṇi ma rī tsa bya bye bsgribs mig can rnams kyi mig ni dbyer 'os shing / /tshems kyi nor bu'i 'od zer dag ni rab gsal mā na pra kā shaṃ / / sa bha pi su ga ta tsand+raḥ shudha dharmo pa de shaṃ ldan pas gsal byas nas/ /mdun sar bde gshegs zla bas dag pa'i chos ni nye bar bstan pa dag /spru ra pa da mi ba kṛ tā kā na rna swa dza gā ma/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra brtan par gyur pa'i gnas bzhin mdzad nas rang gi nags busu gshegs par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī pra ti hā tyā ba dā dbang pos byas pa'i byang zub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las cho 'phrul gyi āoṃ nā ma tsa turda shaḥpalla wa// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //dza ya ta ma hā hūṃ pra bhā baḥpa: da gre tsa brta mā nā yāḥ/ /dza rjes dang mdun dang mngon du gyur par yang / /skye bo'i dge ba'i las kyi lam dag ni/ /gsal na ku sha la karma sha ra ṇiḥpra kā sha ratna dī pa i baḥ/ /pu rā su ra pu re bar byed pa bdag nyid chen po'i mthu/ /rin chen sgon ma lta bur chargyal gyur cig /sngon tshe lha yi grong pāṇḍa kasbra spyo khye shi lā ta khā/ /sa mbi pi pa ri dzā ta gya ko bi dā ra gya su pra bhe/ /khyer du/ /yongs 'du ko bi da ra'i drung / /la ba dkar po zhes bya ba/ /'od bzang rdo leb steng du ni/ /kṛ tā tri da sha saṃ ghā dzā bha ga bān dharma de sha rmā/ /a nu gra hā bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs gsum pa'i/ /tshogs la chos ni bstan mdzad nas/ /mi rnams rjes su ya madhyā rghaṃ dzee rū dī pa ma bā ta ra ta/ /a ma ri ra nu pā ta myu gzung ba'i slad/ /dzamyu'i gling du babs par gyur/ /sa la babs par gyur pa de'i/ /rjes su 'chi 95—216

ta su ba ta ra to bhu baṃ/ /bi mā na kā na nā kāṇi ba bhū ba bhū ba ram̐ ga ṇaḥ/ /med rnams 'brangs ①pas/ /gzhal yas khang gi tshogs kyis ni/ /sa gzhi mnyam pa khengs par gyur/ /ta su rda tai shu saṃ tā ṣpe ru pa de sha mi bā tsi tai/ /dza gā ha tsand+ra ru tsi re zla ba'i 'od ldan rnga yab ni/ /de yi tshems kyi 'od rgyun gyis/ /rgyas pa'i nye bar bstan pa bzhin/ /tsa ma re tsa tu rā na naḥ/ /tstsha tram̐ sha ta sha lā rka ka ma dzwa ke rna ka gdong bzhi pa yis blangs par gyur/ /thur ma brgya yis mtshan pa'i gdugs/ /mtshan med ri dwags pā rku ram̐/ /pra sā da mi ba sā kā ra mā da de su pu re da raḥ/ /shaṃ mtshan ltar dkar/ /de yi bka' drin rnam ②bcas bzhin/ /brgya byen byis ni blangs par gyur/ /grong ka shya na ga ro pānta kā na no dusba dzā ti ke/ /a ba tīrte su kṛ tri naḥsā khyer shang kā ④byu yi 'gram/ /u dum bā ④ra'i nags drung du/ /babs pa de la legs byas ldan/ /kun nand+ra ste ba bandi ri/ /tasmind+ratpa la parṇa khya bhikyu tī dza na saṃ ga me/ /dga' ⑤bcas pas phyag 'tshal gyur/ /skye bo'i tshogs der dudage slong ma/ /utpal mdog ma zhes pa yis/ /a laddhā ba sa rā tibye dṛ pa rū pa mu pa da de/ /pra dīpta ratna mu blta ba'i gnas skabs ma thob nas/ /mi bdag gzugs ni nye bar blangs/ /rin chen cod pan rab ku ṭi ga ṇḍa tā ṇḍa bi ku ṇḍa lo / / z-i dzee bā su na baṃ rū paṃ dza gsal zhing / /rna rgyan 'gram par rab mdzes pa/ /de yi gzugs gsar mthong gyur nas/ /gtsug hā so: ṣa pabee ba/ / sā tsinta yadhī bā yo dza ṣpenirbi ba raḥsu tor yal 'dab dgod pa bzhin/ /de yis bsam pa shin tu yang / /skye bo'i mdun 'di ⑦bar mtshalas raḥ —/ /anta ram̐ dṛ pa rū paṃ me troṣṭa dā gya ti sā da ra/ /a med/ /bdag gi ⑧rgyal po'i gzugs mthong nas/ /gus bcas skabs ni ⑨ster bar 'gyur/ /'di to n+ya thā tubha ga bta pra ṇa tirma ma durla bhaḥ/ /na gu ṇḍi go ra ba las gzhan yang bcom ldan la⑩/ /phyag 'tshal bdag ⑪gis rnyed par dka'/ /dbang phyug la dga' skye 95—217

sthā na mbi sharya pra ṇa yī dza naḥ/ /a ho z-i ṇa tu la lo leniḥpā ra bi ra sed bo yis/ /yon tan zhes pa'i gnas ma yin/ /kye ma rtswa mtshungs g.yo ba'i nor/ /ro bral snying po med dha ṣpeḥ/ /z-i ya te bā sa nā sgyu sāta nibee tsā ra ta yā dza naḥ/ /daṭwānta rā saṃ sa pa yis/ /bag chags goms par gyur pa las/ /ma dpyad nyid kyis skye bo ①'phrog /'phral la skye bo'i ②hā sa dza ṣpe na dṛ pa go ra bāta/ /lo khā hā ram̐ bha ga ba te pra ṇa mi bdag la/ /zhe ④sar byas nas skabs byin ④des/ /do shal g.yo bas bcom ldan la/ /mdun du ma ma ka rota pu raḥ/ /asminda ba sa ra bhikṣu ru dā yī nā ma saṃ ba di/ /tī phyag kyang byas par gyur/ /gnas skabs der ni mdun sa ru/ /'char ka zhes pa'i dge slong gis/ /de bi lokya ta thā rū pā ma ba data sa smi tā na naḥ/ /i ma mutpa la barṇa khyu lta'i gzugs de mthong gyur nas/ /bzhin ni 'dzum pa dang bcas smras/ /mi bdag gzugs can dge bhikṣu tī dṛ pa byu pi ṇḍi/ /ṛdhyā bha ga ba taḥpā do banda te dza na bandi slong ma/ /utpal mdog ma skye bo yis/ /phyag byas ma 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bcom ldan zhabs la phyag tā —/ /utpa khā mo da barṇa dzñā bi dzñā te yo ma yā pu raḥ/ /i kyukta 'tshal byed/ /utpal dri dang mdog dag gis/ /bdag gis 'di ⑤ni mdun du shes/ /de skad brjod bi ra te tasmin bha ga bā na pya bhā ṣa ta/ /a yukta me ba rbhagru kyā dkyā nas 'dug pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan gyis kyang bka' stsal pa/ /dregs las rdzu 'phrul rab ston pa/ /dge dṛdhi pra kā sha āoṃ/ /ka ro ti pra sha maglu ni ma bhi mā ṣpe na tsu dzu raḥ/ /i slong ma yi rigs min nyid/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rims gsar gyis/ /rab tu zhi ba nad par byed/ /de kyughā bha ga bān kṛ ṭwā hūṃ tsā ku sha la de sha āoṃ/ /prithra bye de bā na ya yo swa skad brjod nas bcom ldan gyis/ /dge ba de de bstan mdzad nas/ /lha rnams bzlog ste dge slong dang / /pa rda sa ha bhikyu bhiḥ/ / ta tro pa bi ṣṭaḥmṛṣṭasteḥpra ṇa taibhikyu tī lhan cig rang gi gnas su gshegs/ / de ni nyer bzhugs bude dag gis/ /rab tu ④dris shing kun 95—218

ka shaṃ/ /mābyādma karma sasbarghaṃ sarba dzñāstu ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bā rā mkhyen gyis/ /sngar skyes ①las kyis yang dag bsdams/ /dge slong ②ma de'i gtam gsungs pa/ / bā rā ṇa snga ma bhuta pūbaṃ sāza ba ho ma hā dha naḥ/ /sasbyi dha na ba tī nā ma ta gya pā ṇa ṇa sīr 1sngon byung ba/ /ded dpon nor ni chen po yi/ /chung ma nor ldan ma zhes pa/ /de yi srog dang sa ma bha bta/ /pā ṇi palla bi mbi ta dzñā yo ba nodmā na mañdza rī/ /mtshungs par gyur/ /gzugs bzang lag pa'i yal 'dab ldan④/ /lang tsho skyed tshal snye ma dang / /pha lo pubee tī kā le sā ta sthāta garbha ma dā de/ /a tānta re dza la ni dhi 'bras bu me tog ldan dus su/ /de yis de la ⑤mngal bzung gyur/ /skabs der chu gter gling la ni/ /dī pā nu ga ma norya tai/ /pra tyā sanda bi yo gārte sā palla bha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ki rjes su 'gro bar brtson pa yi/ /khyo bul rab tu nye ba dag /'bral bas gzir ba de yis smras/ /ji ya tī dha na sasbranti thra rnyi ma byā pi nī ya te/ /ya ta kṛ to gho ra gi bhā ram̐ snyed nor ni phun tshogs shing / /da lta yang ni 'phel ba thob/ /gang gi ched du 'jigs rung ba'i/ /tīrya te ma ka rā ka raḥ/ /ba hwa pā yi dha nā dā rna ni ra pā yo gu rjardza chu srin 'byung gnas zab mo brgal/ /nor ni 'dzin pa gnod pa mang / /yon tan sgrub ⑦pa gnod pa rgo—/ /swa de shā ta pa ra lo rka hi gatstsharnyi dra bi rjabee naḥ/ /ke tsidruḥkhāmbi med| /nor ni don gnyer rang phul ⑧nas/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ /kha cig ring du song brtanta dru re ga twa pi ni spa khāḥ/ /nistsa la dha ni nabya bye karma shā me nas kyang / /sdug bsngal las ni 'bras med ldog /gzhan ni g.yo med nor dang ldan/ /'di yi nges pa ṣā nistsa yaḥ/ /i ti thra yā ba tsaḥshu tā sarba pa ta ra bhya dhwata/ /musnye las rnams so/ /de skad dga' ma'i tshig thos nas/ /don mthun bdag pos ⑨de la smras/ /mdzes ma saṃ bhā ba nā pā tram̐ bha ba bye baṃ dha norya taḥ/ /dha nārdza rna bi hā nā nor dag ⑩bsgrubs pa ni/ /bsngags pa'i snod nyid kho na yin/ /bder gnas nor sgrub ⑪kyis dman 95—219

dzā saṃ gu bta rū la bhakṣa ṇata/ /a rya shā naḥsu khasthā rmā rbha giḥs ha pa ri rnams / /rtsa ba zos pa'i 'bye bo bzhin/ /de ring sang la longs spyod dang / /lhan cig yongs su zad kṣa yaḥ/ /swa kṛ te pi da ri dru rde dza naḥkra ka tsa nibye raḥ/ /dha ni ram̐ par gyur①/ /rang khyim du yang dbul rnams la/ /skye bo sog dzeele bzhin du rtsub/ /'jig rten gzhan pa ra lo ko pi pre ma sdisnya dza rmā bhu baḥ/ /khye ṇa ma srutpa tai thra: na bee sum̐ du'ang nor ldan ni/ /skye bo rnams kyi mdza' sdug sa/ /'phel bar rtsom slad zla tshes ni/ /phra mo la yang brnya te dza naḥ/ /na tu sa pūṇḍi ma sudhe pra tyā sanda pa ri kṣa yi/ /rūkho pi skye bo 'dud/ /mthar ni yongs 'dzad rab ④nye bas/ /yongs su rdzogs pa la yang min/ /skye bo mngon bi du ྾ baṃ ryaḥsdi rghaṃ dṛrnyo pi ba khru bhaḥ/ /llī bo pi pe byaḥshu rā hūṃ mā par dar la nye/ /rbongs pa'ang mkhas pas phyag byar yod④/ /rgan yang mo yi yid du 'ong / /ma ning sarjo byu da yo dza naḥ/ /ke na n+ya ka ra rṇa jughā bī tā kā byā mṛ tā ni bāta/ /yin yang dpa' bstan ⑤'os/ /mkhas kyang bkres dang skom pa la/ /sgra 0yi bstan bcos zos pa 'am/ /kṣa khaṃ bi tsakṣa ṇi nā pi kṣuhphi pā se bi brdzi te/ /ya sngarbaḥs gu ḍonda snyan ngag bdud rtsi 'thungs pas ni/ /skad cig su yis rnam par rgyal/ /gang la nor yod de ni yon taiḥ kṛ ta nu ti ཿ ka sbra na dharte gu rte dā ri dhyā da ya do ṣi du tan gyis mtho ⑦bstod byas yon tan dag kyang cis mi 'dzin/ /dbul las nyams pa'i skyon gyis gzi byin ṣi ta ru tsā nirmā bee tu spyo gu ṇḍaḥ/ /biste ṣpe ba gu rja gu ṇi na ru dha rna sun phyung yon tan me tog snying mtshungs nor gyis ⑧ni/ /yon tan nyid de yon tan la ni nor min nor ⑨dha byo dha nī no gu shlau kā yā duḥkṛ ta sa: pā ta sha ma nā dā yurgu ldan bsngags 'os yon tan ldan pa min/ /slong ba'i ngan byas tshogs rnams zhi ba dag las nor ni yon tan ḍā rmā dha rna/ /i ti pā ṇḍa bye kārba su pa kyu rā kasbya sā ba tsaḥ/ /sī dza rnams kyi tshe srog yin/ /de skad srog las nor lhag pa/ /de yis bdag po'i tshig thos nas/ /'khri shing 95—220

nā shu ka rtotrīrṇa la te ba bhu ta ṣatpa dā/ /a tha pra ba ha dzwa bhe dze rkang drug pas brgyan ①bzhin/ /mig dman dzeedang bcas mchi thigs rgyas/ /de nas de dang lhan cig tu/ /sārja nā thasta yā pa ha/ /tī bra dṛṭwā kṛ tī tā rna hasta pā tram̐ ma ho don mthun mgon gyi snegru gzings bsten/ /sred pa drag po 'dzin rnams kyisadu/ /chu gter chen po lag da dhiḥ/ /ta gya dzā yā sa kha snga sau kasthā bā tā nu baṭī naḥ/ /a bha bye ta pa'i snod/ /las rjokyi rlung gi rjorjes zhugs pa/ /chung ma'i grogs ldan de yi gzings/ /yid la re ba pra ba ha khaṃ sa ma no ra tha dzī bi tai/ /ta taḥpha la kā bāsgyu bha ga she ṣārtso srog dang bcas/ /chu gter du ni zhig par gyur/ /de nas las kyi longs spyod kyi/ /lhag mas shing dum kand+ra ṇaḥ/ /ka she ru dī pi mā sā rya tatpasbyi na bya ba ryata/ /a nā tsā ta tra sho bzung gyur pas/ /ka se ru yi gling phyin nas/ /de yi ⑦chung ma shi ma gyur/ /der ni bsam pa nyams tsarnyi bi haṃ gaḥpu ru ṣā kṛ tiḥ/ /tā mā pa pā da dīrṇa shaṃ su parṇa gyur cing / /mgon med mya ngan byed de dang / /'dab bzang rigs las skyes pa'i bya/ /skyes bu'i ku la saṃ bha baḥ/ /sa kārnye su mu kho nā ma tā mu ba tsa ru tsā kṛ taḥ/ /dbyibs can phrad par gyur/ /mdzes pas phrogs pa bzhin bzang ming / /de yis mdzes ma ⑧de la smras/ /sa mā shwa se hi lo lā kṣi nirbha yo yo ta pā shra yaḥ/ /de bye yi su bha gā byu mig ni g.yo ma yid brtan mdzod/ /gnas 'dir ⑨spyod la 'jigs pa med/ /'di ni skal bzang mchog mi ba yo twa ta pra ṇa ma ṣi ṇaḥ/ /pu nadzā tā si ka spyo ṇi gho ro gi sa/ /bdag ni khyod kyi 'dod pa 'tshol⑩/ /chu srin 'byung gnas 'di 'jigs rung / /dge ma khyod yi ma ka rā ka raḥ/ /i kyuktate na sha na kaidwo tā ratna la yo kṛ haṃ/ /saṃ ni yang skyes so/ /de yis 'di brjod dal bu yis/ /rin chen rang bzhin khang par phyin/ /mngal ni pūrṇa gaṭwā ta na yo tsā ru rū pa ma pū ta sā/ /badzha mā na shi sho ta smin sā yongs su rdzogs de la/ /gzugs mdzes bu dag btsas par gyur/ /byis pa de ni cher skyes tshe/ /rim 95—221

sha ṣpeḥsri ya bā di nā/ /mukta te na bi dasnye na saṃ sgo gā bhi mu khāe kṛ tā/ /gyis snyan par smra byed pa/ /mkhas pa de yis mdzes ma de/ /longs spyod dag la mngon phyogs byas/ /sa ra la tāsmṛ du tārtso sa mbi pa pra ṇa yī dza naḥ/ /swa ya mā lighra te sdi drang nyid phyir dang 'jam nyid phyir/ /mdza' gcugs nye ba'i skye bo la/ /bud med rang nyid 'khyud gyur bhirya tā bhi ra ba pā da paḥ/ /di byodmā ṣpe 6 sā te na ra ma mā ṇḍa gha na sta de① —/ /rkang 'thung dag la 'khri shing bzhin/ /de yis mchog gi dhiskyed tshal du/ /nu rgyas de la rol pa nī—/ /ku mā ra ru tsi rā kā re su 6 be sa tro shaṃ pi tuḥ/ /tasmin padma mu las—/ /gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rnam pa can/ /pha dang mtshungs pa btsas par gyur/ /padma'i bzhin zhes khā bhi khye yo ba nā lam̐ kṛ tā kṛ to/ /su mu khaḥpakṣi hūṃ rā dzwa kā le bya ba de/ /lang tsho'i rgyan byus brgyan pa yis/ /dus su 'dab chags rgyal po ni/ /bzhin bzang 'jig lo kotta ram̐ ya yo/ /ta taḥpadma mu khaḥshrī mā nā sa sā da pa rda pi tuḥ/ /gu ṇi rten gzhan du song / /de rjes dpal ldan padma'i bzhin/ /pha yi gnas ni thob gyur zhu te/ /yon tan nā ma bi bā de na swa bye nāḥku la sadza daḥ/ /pāste shwabye ta ma ba data bi can la rtsod med du/ /rigs kyi phun tshogs ④rang dbang 'gyur⑤/ /kun tu de yi mthu dag ni/ /gtso dza ṣpe dza na nī su tai/ /taza bhā ba su saṃ bhā bya sarba tra pra bha biju tai/ /pu bo'i nus ldan nyid shes nas/ /dbang phyug thob pa'i bu de la/ /skye bo med par 0ma yis smras/ /bu tra pāṭwā nā ya la smre ri yo ni dza ku lo tsi tā/ /a yo tu sārja bā hādme gcig rang rigs la 'os pa'i/ /dpal 'byor 'di ni khyod kyis thob/ /ded dpon las skyes bdag gi bu/ /dzā taḥpu tro ni ram̐ sha kaḥ/ /bā rā ṇa snga ma yo rā dzā swa shasthā kṛ ya tsā twa yā/ /'di la skal ba yod ma yin/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑦rang stobs kyis/ /khyod kyi ⑧'di ni rgyal por gyis/ /spru ti saṃ bā da sā swā daḥswa de she swe ba sam pa daḥ/ /i ti mā turgi rā pakṣi rang yul nyid du phun tshogs pa/ /dga' ba nyams myong ro dang bcas/ /de skad ma yi tshig gis byas⑨/ /95—222

pakṣa pā te na bhu ya sā/ /skadhe bhā ta ra mā ro gya byo: bā rā ṇa sī ya yo/ /ta gshog rlabs shin tu che ba yis/ /spun zla phrag pa la khyer nas/ /mkha' las bā rā ṇa sīr ① song / /de tra sau hā sā nā sī āoṃ bra hma darte ma tī pa to/ /sa dza sthā ṣpe kā de na badzo nas sa bdag tshangs pas byin/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa dag /drag rno rdo rje'i sder mo rnams/ /de gra na kha riḥkha riḥ/ /a bhi ṣi tsā gra dzee pūrte tambinde ba dṛ pā sa yis lan gcig ①bsnun nas bsad/ /rgyal po'i stan ni de nyid la/ /phu bo rdzogs par dbang bskur ṣpe—/ /ā mā tyā na po ba data bhi tān sa ma grwa na gra bi kra maḥ/ /ya gya rā nas—/ /blon po 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtsal mchog ldan pa des smras pa/ /bdag gis rgyal zlo bhe ṣikta gya ma yā yaḥpra tsa li ka raḥ/ /so pya tī ta pra sgo bhabhya ta me por dbang bskur 'di/ /gang gis rab tu skyod byed na/ /de yang ②rje la gus pa yis/ / 'das pa ④bā nu ga mi 6 ti/ /i kyughā pra ba rā mā tyā na sri ri bi haṃ ge puṅga baḥ/ /ya yo de rjes 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rab mchog blon la dal bu yis/ /'di smras bya yi gang zag ni/ /spun la sgyu ta ra mā mabye pu narde sha na saṃ bi dā/ /sa e ba bra hma dasto ya mi phyis kyang phrad pa yi⑤/ /'gro ba zhus du nas song bar gyur/ /tshangs byin de nyid 'di'o zhes/ /blon po ti madhri ṇa marnyi rṇa/ /sa dri pa byu ti mā ye de swa dza ṣpe 6 pa re 6 tsa/ /a rnams kyis bgros pa las/ /rang gi skye bo gzhan la yang / /mi bdag de ni grags pa thob/ /skabs tānta re sa mā nī tā gaṭwā hasnyi ṭī ba nā ta/ /na mu mo tsārbha nirya tai der nags nas blangs pa yi/ /mngal dang bcas pa'i glang mo zhig /mngal ni nang nas bkag pa bzhin/ /garbha rudha mi bānta re/ /sā dhī ka rā gra saṃ sparsha di yo gasgo bee muñtsa ti/ /phyed ni phyir byung grol ma gyur/ /bud med dag pa'i lag rtse yis/ /reg pas mngal ni ④grol bar gyur/ /i ti mū tūrte kā diṣṭi rāzlo madhri n+ya bee da yata/ /shā sā nā da tha byu bhartuḥces pa ⑧rtsis pas bstan pa ni/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal la smras/ /de nas sa yi bdag po'i bkas/ /95—223

spyoṣṭa ha ste na ha ste nī/ /antaḥpu dzā ga nābyu krusta tra sa rkyo pa yā tsa pho brang 'khor gyi bud med kyis①/ /lag pas glang mo sdel reg nas/ /der ni bden pa'i byin brlabs rna—/ /tā sā sa tya gi rā garbha nā bhya dzata ka ri bhā ya dā/ /ta dā bi lakhyuḥsarbo byu ta byas—/ /gang tshe de dag bden tshig gis/ /glang mo'i mngal — ma grol ba/ /de tshe rgyal po'i pho brang gi①/ /byu yā māntaḥpu re dza naḥ/ /a tha tsā rpā ga nā bye tya shī la sa rkyo pa yā rtsa rna/ /skye bo thams cad skyengs par gyur/ /de nas ba glang rdzi mo zhig /mngon phyogs ngang tshul bden pa'i tshig /kṛ tā ba sparsha ka ri khro ye nā sau garbha ma bhya dza ta/ /ra dzā pi ni dza dzā yā shā smras nas glang mo la reg pa/ /gang gis mngal 'di grol bar gyur/ /rgyal po'ang rang gi btsun mo rnams//dzñā tā shrī la da ri dra tsā/ /me ṣpe go rpā madma me ba hūṃ dza gasti ta yi pi tī/ /tshul khrims kyis dbul nyid shes nas/ /ba glang rdzi mo de nyid ni/ /'gro ba gsum na dag par sems/ /sa sa tī dzā ti lo bhe na so susthā nā ma tata su tai/ /pa ri bhā yā nī nā yā gre te dag pa'i rigs la chags pa des/ /de yi bu mo so sum bā/ /zhes pa mdun du yongs blangs pa/ /lha bī shasda gya pā dra hūṃ/ /ta suḥsaṃ tsi tya la ba bye tsa pa latwo tsa yo ṣi tsā/ /mo'i sgra yi snod nyid gyur/ /bud med g.yo ba nyid dag dang / /de yi ④mdzes pa bsams rjopa las/ /sa sarba gā mi dī ni dā ma pi ta tyā dza shaṃ ki taḥ/ /asminda ba sa re duṣṭi dogs pa'i kun tu 'gro ba yis/ /gnyid kyang de yis btang bar gyur/ /bar skabs der 0ni spun zla la//bhā ta ram̐ bi haṃ gā dhi paḥ/ /ya yo bha dra mu khaḥste hā da ti sha yorlu kaḥ/ /mdza' las shin tu gcugs pa yi⑦/ /bya yi bdag po padmo'i bzhin/ /de la blta ⑧ru 'ongs par gyur/ /khyu pā lo pi ta ma bo gya sī tyā bi hi ta sadṛ tiḥ/ /bi dza ṣpe swa ka thā masmi sa bdag gis kyang de la 'khyud/ /dga' ba yis ni bkur ste bsgrubs/ /skye bo med sar de la ni/ /ni bee rya pu na ra bra bīta/ /shi la sa tya tu lā ro hāta dṛṣṭa do ṣe ṇa yo rang gtam bshad nas yang smras pa/ /ngang tshul bden pa'i srang gzhal bas/ /bud med rnams kyi skyon 95—224

ṣi tsā/ /ma māntaḥpu ra bee mu khyuta bi bā ho bhi na baḥkṛ taḥ/ /mthong nas/ /bdag ni btsun mo'i tshogs las phyir/ /phyogs te bag ma gzhan gsar blang ①/ /rū pa yo ba na gā mi dzñā ta myu ma pi na me j-i tiḥ/ /e ka tra dṛṣṭa do ṣā rde gzugs dang lang tsho 'gro ldan ma/ /de la'ang bdag ni mi ston te/ /gcig la skyon ni mthong ba rnams/ /sarba tā shaṃ ka te ma naḥ/ /tasmratta ba pu re hūṃ tarnirmā nu bye ni dī ya tram̐/ /shrī kun la yid ni dogs pa skye/ /de slad spun zla khyod kyis ni/ /grong khyer mi med dag tu bzung / /ngang la saṃ kā pa ri tyā bye bha bā mi bi ga ta dzra raḥ/ /tasmra ta pra ti ni shaṃ pakhye tshul la ni dogs btang nas/ /bdag ni rims dang bral bar 'gyur/ /de las de ni mtshan de bzhin⑦/ /shā sa nāṭwā ba mad kṛ haṃ/ /pā pa yi 6rnyi tai sī ra mi tya yi me ma no khrod kyi bka' las 'dab chags kyis/ /dal bus khyer nas bdag khyim du/ /'ong bar 'gyur ba 'di ra thaḥ/ /i ti bhā turba tsaḥkhru tā ta mu bā tsa bi haṃ ga maḥ/ /irnyuḥshaṃ kā bdag ①'dod/ /de skad phu bo'i tshig thos nas/ /mkha' la 'gro bas de la smras/ /dogs pa'i dri mas ka lo ke na rā dzambi bye ba mā kṛ thāḥ/ /na nā ma ra ma ter bye nā swā rda besti phrag dog ni/ /rgyal po rdzun pa nyid ma byed/ /phrag dog dug gis rtag gzir ba/ /dga' bar bya ba sgo dza ṣpe/ /na pa shya ti na ni dra ti ni tya mbimyu bi ṣā tu raḥ/ /kli baḥkā des mi dga'/ /bza' ba rnams kyi ro mi rig /blta ④ ba ma yin gnyid ma yin/ /ma ning 'dod mbi su khāe bi dān dha nī na mraḥpra byuḥkṣa mi/ /adhī mā n+yaḥkha laḥsnaghaḥshā ldan bde ldan mkhas/ /nor ldan dud pa rje bzod ldan/ /slong ba khengs pa mi bsrun ⑤des/ /bud sa tī ti ka dzee ba kā/ /sa ra la twa pi ku ṭi khāḥsthā pi byo bee ti rtsa tsa laḥ/ /ku med dag ces gtam nyid ci/ /drang po la yang gya gyu can/ /gnas pa na yang shin tu g.yo/ /rigs lī nā a pi pārhasthā mā dzi shaṃ hye ba khā la tāḥ/ /dṛjirlo lā dha ro rā ldan yin yang logs gnas pa'i/ /bud med 'khri shing 'khyud par byed/ /mig g.yo mchu ni chags dang 95—225

gi bhūrbaghra ka thi nista no/ /dṛ shya te ṣpe ba ni rdo ṣaḥrgyu shā ma ba ya bee bcas—/ /smin ma 'khyog cing nu ma sra/ /bud med rnams kyi cha shas la'ang / /skyon med mthong ba nyid khya pi/ /bhu rdzu te ku sha le'ishā mā bhā ma bha ma ra bi sgyu miḥ/ /mū khā dzwa ྾ sa yod min/ /mkhas pas g.yo ldan bung ba yi/ /rnam par rol pas bud med spyad/ /mtsho skyes rtsa ba ro dza tyāḥpaṃ ke ṣpe bo pa li pya te/ /ṣpe kasmin bisma ya bhu rpā pa smi btsal ba na/ /'dam gyis nye bar gos pa nyid/ /'dzum bcas ya mtshan dag gis ni/ /gtsang sbra ngang tā dzñā ni yant+ra dhe/ shu tsi shī la bi rā ma rde rā mā rde ra ma ṇi ma tiḥ/ /ta thā tshul dag dang bral/ /bud med rnams ni nges bsdams pa'i/ /dga' ba gcig ① la blo ma yin/ /de lta pi ya di nirbandhaḥkri ya hūṃ dā dhīspru tai/ /pra tya haṃ ma ta pu roṭwā ṣpe na yang gal te 'bad/ /gang zhig mngon par bzhed bupar mdzod/ /nyin re bdag grong skyed mos tshal/ /nirja na sā ni dhī ya tsā/ /i tyāktaḥpakshi rja bhā tā dṛ pa tirngi pa sardza hūṃ/ /tsā tī skye bo med sa de gzhag bya1 / /spun zla 'dab chags kyis de smras/ /ka se ru ka'i gling du ni/ /de dang ka she ru ka dī pa tai tsa saskṛ tya sā da raḥ/ /pā pi pra ti ni shaṃ byosna kha mdzes ma mi bdag gis/ /gus bcas bsnyen bkur byas te btang / /de yang gling du skyes pa yi/ /dri gā rū ṭwā sa mā ya yo/ /di bya gant+ra ma yī mā khā mā dā yā dī pa saṃ bha mchog rang bzhin 'phreng ba blangs④// /bya la zhon nas mtshan re zhing / /nam mkha' las ni 'ongs par ⑤rpā—/ /pā ri dzā tā nā ya ta ro ṭwā ni puṣṭha rgya bā pa sā/ /byu tā ni ti mi rā gyur—/ /yongs 'du'i rjes 'gro ljon pa yi/ /me tog de dag de yis thob/ /bung ba g.yo ba'i mun ṇi bhra ma ta dzre gāndha ka rā taḥ/ /a tha bā rā ṇa sī bā sī kā dā tsidmā na gtibs pas/ /grags pa yi ni rab rib bzhin/ /de nas nam zhig mā na ba/ /zhes pa gnyis skyes bā bhi dhaḥ/ /pra ya yo sa mi dha hā rī dī dzadmā kā na āoṃ yu bā/ /ta tra kinda ra kā gzhon nu ni/ / bā rā ṇa sīr kwa gnas pa cig⑦ /nags nas yam shing len du song / /der ni mi 'am ci 95—226

mi tyā sa tri ṣṭaḥ spa ṣṭa madma thaḥ / /ya gya saṃ darsha ṣpe ṣpe ba sā bha mo yis/ /yid srubs ①gsal ba de mthong gyur/ /gang zhig mthong ba nyid kyis de/ /dran pa rnam par bta bi smṛ ta smṛ tīḥ/ /ta sri ban bā bhi khā ṣi ṇa dza na ke ṣpe ba sabee tā/ /kānta brjed par gyur/ /gsar du mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /phas bzhin de la de gtad nas/ /mdzes kārnyi ma yī nā ma bi dza hā ra gu hā kṛ he/ /ta tā bha ra ṇa rarja shuḥldan zhes pa'i mjos ma dang / /phug gi khang par rnam par rol/ /rin chen rgyan gyi 'od zer gyis/ /rpā ta ti mi roṅka re/ /ra ma mā rja tsi rarnye na kā le pu tra ma bā pa pā/ /ba la rab rib tshogs ni des bsal te/ /de dang yun ring rtses pa las/ /dus su bu ni de yis thob/ /bu de bān ma ru ta dza baḥs bā byo pi ya dā shi shuḥ/ /ta dā su mā tā saṃ dzñā shī ghra ga byes pa nyid la yang / /gang tshe stobs ldan rlung ltar mgyogs/ /de tshe ma yis de yi ming / /myur 'gro i tya sā dha bhū ta/ /sā nirbisna saṃ sgo ga su khā j-ibhā gu hānta re/ /zhes par bsgrubs par gyur/ /bgegs med longs spyod bde ba yis/ /ngoms med de yang phug gzhan du/ /pri yi j-i tā ba dā yā ti pi dhwa ya shi la yā kṛ haṃ/ /ka dā tsi da tha bṛṭwārnyi mdza' bo bzhag ④nas rdo ba yis/ /phug ni bsgribs shing rtag tu 'gro/ /de nas nam zhig pha yis ni/ /ni dzi pi tā ni bi de tai/ /ā kasbya shī ghra gabyenta bismra yā ku li to ba da rang gi spyod pa'i mtha' rnams bshad/ /myur 'gro yis thos bsam pa ni/ /ya mtshan dag gis rgyas pas ①ta—/ /shi lā ni badha dā re sminda tha ka gye ma gre hānta re/ /a ho sde ho bye yi smras—/ /khyim gzhan sgo ni rdo ba yis/ /long ba bzhin du bsdams pa 'dir/ /kye ma yab khyod mdzes tā ta ta ba barsā na hūṃ ga taḥ/ /e hi bā rā ṇa sī me ba gatshwa bste ni pas kyang / /bcings pa 'di nyid dag tu gyur/ /tshur shog ④khyod kyi rang gi gnas/ / bā rā ṇa sī dudzā spa rda/ /bi su lā ma pya yo me na shi khā muṭwā ra yā mya haṃ/ /swa de sha bi nyid du 'dong / /che yang 'bad pa med par ni/ /rdo ba bdag gis bsal bar byas 0/ /rang yul bral 95—227

ra ha gre shaṃ duḥs haṃ sa ha se ka rja/ /taste na shakya te kai— da di ba'i nyon mongs ni/ /bzod par dka' ba ji ltar bzod/ /rang gi lus bzhin yul dag ni/ /sus sho de ha i ba swa kaḥ/ /bhā ram̐ dra bi rde saṃ bhā ram̐ beeti grabyu gu ṇa gu rde/ /kyang gtang ①bar mi nus so/ /rang yul bral ba'i skye bo rnams/ /nor gyi tshogs ni khur po dang / /sgo ga ni ru pa yo gañtsa swa de sha bi ra tī dza naḥ/ /i kyukta sa gu hā ge longs spyod nye bar longs spyod min/ /yon tan thag ⑤pa'i mdud par rig /ces smras phug gi khang pa hā dutyā rya bi pu khā shi dzee/ /kṛ tā byu ta ga me nā shu dza na ke na ya yo nas—/ /rdo ba chen po des ①bsal nas/ /khas blangs pa yi pha dang ni/ /lhan cig mgyogs par song sa hā/ /pra yā ta yothorte sa ma bhe tyā tha kinda rī/ /shā bye dṛṭī gu ha bar gyur/ /de dag myur du song de nas/ /mi 'am ci mo mngon par 'ongs/ /phug khyim stong pa mthong ge haṃ nirbe dā di tya tsinta yata/ /a hotre bee smṛ ta sne haḥs ga taḥkwa pi gyur nas/ /snying mi dga' ste 'di ltar bsams/ /kye ma bdag la gcugs pa brjed/ /skye bo ngan pa de durdza naḥ/ /dī dzi hā rmā bhū j-i gā rna kau ṭi sum̐ bā ki ma da byu tai/ /na ra madhe pa gar song / /lce gnyis pa dang lag 'gro yis④/ /gya gyu nyid la'ang rmad byung ci/ /bde la chags ldan khā yarnye saryadhe su kha rā gi ṇaḥ/ / tsi rasthā a pi niḥsne hāḥshu ka mjug tu ni/ /dga' bar mi byed 'gros ⑤par byed/ /ring du gnas kyang mdza' gcugs med/ /skye i ba dī dza ta yaḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsidhyā sā pa hphurni kā rā ta dī ti ma tya dzata/ /gnyis ldan pa ṣpe tso bzhin/ /de ltar bsams nas de yis ni/ /gnod las khyo la dga' ba btang / /pusgo sa mā ni sre mā ṇi na sa hadhe ka daza rmā/ /bi byā gu ṇi na kai nā sau me tog lta bu du mdza' ba yis/ /gnod pa bzod pa ma yin no/ /bdag gi bu ni ⑦rig byed dang / /pu tro mai bhu bi dzi ba ti/ /a ti dhyā tā sa khri haste tasmi bī shā di de sha sā/ /yon tan gang gi ⑧sa la 'tsho/ /zhes bsams ⑨grogs mo'i lag tu ni/ /de la de yi ⑩rgyud mang springs/ /95—228

saṃ sgo ga su kha pa bye ba sī tiḥpa ti 6 yo ṣi tsā/ /a parlu ṣa ta bātpa longs spyod bde ba'i zong dag gis/ /bud med rnams ni khyo ①la dga'/ /mnyes gshin yongs su ma pyuḥpu tra spru tistu nibyu lāḥ/ /dza bee na gra dza tosturṇa ta yosdordza n+ya ladzdza nyams pa/ /bu la dga' ba g.yo ba min/ /de dag tshul ngan ngo tsha nas/ /mgyogs pas myur du 'gro ba yā—/ /shī ghra gā ya da do bī khaṃ tatpa khāe bee ga ga mi smi/ /ā byā tadhri ri yo nā la/ /de yi grogs mo mgyogs 'gro mas/ /myur 'gro la ni rgyud ②mang byin/ /'di yi rgyud ni dang po myuḥspaṣṭa byā bisna kā ra bhā/ /i tyā bhā 6 ta yā dahūṃ spru hūṃ shā pya dza 'dir—/ /reg par mi bya gegs snebyed yin/ /de skad smras nas de ④byen pas/ /rgyud mang blangs nas gā ma sāḥ/ /ta taḥswa de she dza na kai swa kṛ te bi ni bee byu saḥ/ /bī ṇḍa pra spru ṇaḥde song gyur/ /de nas rang yul rang khyim du/ /de yi pha ni bzhag byas nas/ /rgyud mang bgrengs pa ⑤pa ṭu sarba tra khā rghaṃ pū dza bāpta bān/ /ta taḥka dā tsi: ni dzā oṃ bu bye dī pa mkhas pa yis/ /kun tu rnyed dang mchod pa thob/ /de nas nam zhig tshong pa dag /chu gter gling du gā mi nā/ /a ro pi taḥpra ba ha khaṃ di bya bī zla nu ra gi ṇḍa/ /bī ṇa sprusgo 'gro ba rnams/ /lha yi rgyud mang la chags pas/ /de ni gzings la skyon 0par gyur/ /de yis ⑦rgyud na yā ta su sho tra rpā yu ṣa dhwa ra yā/ /kṣa ṇi kṣa ṇi sa mu dro pi nista mang yid 'phrog pa/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi'i ⑧rgyun dag gis/ /skad cig skad cig rgya mtsho yang / /rlabs dzā ga i ba bha bta/ /a thā rya ta ṭī saṃ sparsha dutparjo pa sla bodzre te/ /ni med pa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dang po'i rgyud dag la/ /reg pas nyer 'tshe rab bskyed de/ /bhasne bra ba ha ṇi sarba ba ni dzā ma bha ba1 yaḥ/ /ta taḥpha la ha kā bsgyu gzings ni rab tu 'phar zhing chag⑨ /tshong pa thams cad brlag ⑩par gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag ma yis/ /pa ba na sre ri taḥkṣa ṇḍa ta/ /ka she ru dī pa mā be de kand+ra she ṣe ṇa shī ghra gaḥ/ /myur 'gro yis ni shing dum thob/ /rlung gis bskyod nas skad cig gis/ /ka se ru yi gling du phyin/ /95—229

ta tābhi kyu la saṃ lī rna di byodmā rna pra bi shya saḥ/ /shā rmā da darsha so sum̐ bā der ni chu gter ngogs 'gram gyi/ /skyed tshal mchog tu rab zhugs des/ /nu ma me tog chun po dag /musgonda sta ba kasta nā/ /gā tna tīrnyi mi rā khyu rmā puṣka nā mudzdza la shri yo/ /rab rgyas bud med so sum bā/ /me tog dri sar zhes bya ba'i/ /'phreng ba rab 'bar rgyud byed cing / /ni bandha rna ta nu gu rdeḥkurpā ṇa ma pya tsi ta rpā/ /sā pi tai ru tsi rā sems med rnams kyang lus kyi ni/ /yon tan rmis nges 'ching byed mthong / /des kyang mdzes pa'i rnam kā ram̐ dṛ ṭī bisma ya mā ya yo/ / dhī ram̐ shi sha ba tā ru rgya sarnyi pa can/ /brtan pa byis pa lang tsho yis①/ /mtshams kyi dbus gnas ②nyid gyur pa/ /de mthong ya ma dhya sthā tā ga tai/ /mā ra mā ru ta saṃ pā tsa sa kalpa ka ra palla bā/ /mtshan dag tu gyur/ /'dod pa'i rlung gis rab bskyod pas/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab g.yo ldan zhing / /sā shirṇa shī la ku su mā la te ba pra ṇa nā ma tai/ /sa ha sā tsi rā rū bye ba sbyi ngang tshul me tog lhung ba des/ /'khri shing bzhin du de rab ①btud/ /'phral la yun ring 'grogs pa tiḥpro bhā ta yo ra bhuta/ /sthāsngadmasne ha paṃ lī rna na muñtsa ti ma bzhin—/ /de dag mchog tu mdza' bar gyur/ /skye ba snga ma'i mdzar gcags ④pa/ /yid kyis yid ni nasma naḥ/ /ra ma mā ṇa di bā te na ni shā yī tsa ma tī bhu dzā/ /ma ṣpe mi mthong ngo / /nyin par de dang dga' byed cing / /mtshan mo yang ni sa bdag dang / /sbas ⑤pa'i tsā ri ta ba ma tāta thra yo gru bhā kā mu ka/ /te ṣpe ba bā rā ṇa sbo gantu 'dod ldan mdza' bor ni/ /g.yon ma'i spyod pa nyid la bubasams/ /spyod tshul shes pa ⑦des de la/ /dzñā rtu bṛste nā sābee tā/ /tambi nā ya kha gā rū ṭwā taṅgi rā mbi li te kṣa ṇi/ / bā rā ṇa sīr 2 'gro don gnyer/ /de yi tshig gis mig btsums nas/ /bya la zhon nas de yis phyin/ /bā ri to pi byosdi na ya podmā la ṣpe ta yā/ /so bha bta sa ha si bārnya de yis zlog ⑨par gyur mod kyang / /mkha' la mig ni phye ba yis/ /chu gter g.yo ba'i bsgribs pa'i mig /95—230

tsa pa lābyi thra te kṣa ṇaḥ/ /sā ta mantaḥbu rodmā ṣpe ni dhwa ya bha ya kā ta rā/ /de ni 'phral nyid long bar gyur/ /pho brang 'khor gyi skyed tshal du/ /de yis de bzhag 'jig ① pa yis/ /bi bee sha sho ka santabhā shayā beshra ma tī pa teḥ/ /dru ya mā ṣpe na ma na skrag cing mya ngan gyis gdungs pas/ /sa bdag gzims pa'i khang par zhugs/ /yid ni shin tu gdung sā ra dza bhā ma ti bā khya tsā/ /pā tarna gabye na sthā ḍū tsiddhā krāddhā ba yis/ /mtshan mo de ni 'das bubyas nas/ /tho rangs bsam ④pas zil non ④des/ /'gro dang sdod sha sha ka sā/ /a tānta re sa mudhū ta tsū ta sau ra bha nirbha raḥ/ /ma dhu par nus ma gyur/ /skabs der tsu ⑤ta dri bzang gi/ /tshogs ni yang dag rgyas gyur cing / /me tog mā bo bi lā sā rmā yo ba rna putpa dha na naḥ/ /ko ki lā li ku ku leḥgazhu can rtse dga' yi khya/ /lang tsho dpyid kyi zla ba ni/ /khu byug zung ⑦bas gnag gyur cing / /dus kyi ⑤ kā laḥkā laḥkā lo bi yo gi dzā/ /tīrṇa sho ka na bā sho ka duḥs haḥpra tya dṛ shya te/ /bral ba rnams kyi ⑨dus/ /bzod dka' mya ngan 'grems byed pa⑩/ /mya ngan med gsar rab tu mthong / /rā dza pya bi ra tohphu kyā dudmā ṣpe gantu mudma taḥ/ /di na me ke na ta tyā 'dod pas rmongs pa'i rgyal pos kyang / /sred dang ma bral skyed mos tshal/ /blta ⑪bar brtson pas nyi ma dzā sau shusthā kā ma mo hi taḥ/ /sa ta yā sa ha rā ga su ma da su ma da na gya gcig /so sum bā ni btang ⑫ma gyur/ /de ni de dang lhan cig tu/ /chags dang rgyags dang 'dod pa tsa—/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba bi shā ti pa da putpa ba rna ya yo/ /ta tra bā yis⑫/ /'khor ba bzhin du ngal gso'i ⑫gnas/ /me tog gi ni nags su song / /der ni rlung khā ni la lo la la tā bai lakṣu ka ri khye/ /pa shyan pra mo da mā pe de da gzhon gyis bskyod pa'i⑫/ /'khri shing skyengs par byed pa yi/ /btsun mo mthong nas sa yi bdag /rab yi tā me ba byu pa tiḥ/ /a n+ya rā ga bi ṣā krānt+ra pā gya bhūdmā li na smṛ tiḥ/ /tu dga' ba nyid du gyur/ /gzhan chags dug gis zil mnan ⑩pas/ /de yang dran pa zums ⑩par gyur/ /95—231

su kha ma pya su khaṃ benti tsiṣṭha sha spyo ku lasma naḥ/ /antarga ta bhu rdza ga bsam pa'i zug rngus dkrugs ①pa'i yid/ /bde la'ang bde ba min par rig /lag 'gro nang du song ba rnyiḥ.āoṃ rnyi ra tyanda rā gi ṇaḥ/ /kabye kṛ tā bhi dṛ tyarnyi mā khā bhi yis②| /bud med kyi ni 'phreng ba ①bzhin/ /mgrin par byas pas rmongs byas pa'i/ /shin tu chags ri ba mo hi tāḥ/ /ta tre kānta la tā kuñdza ni kuṭwā na nyi tasbi tiḥ/ /ldan bro gar byed/ /der ni dben par 'khri shing gi/ /tshogs kyis bsgribs ④par gnas byas pa0/ /arnyaḥsau ra bha mā sthā ya so shusthā ti mi ra pra dzaḥ/ /sa ha bee ba bi kā re ṇa rā gā long bas so sum bā yi ni/ /dri sar 'phreng duba'i dri bzang tshor/ /'phral la nyid du chags pa yi/ /rnam ta bi smṛ ta saṃ thra tiḥ/ /a gā yadma da na spyi bā ga ṇa yan ti bha yi ku taḥ/ /'gyur las ni sbas pa brjed/ /glu blangs 'dod pas myos pa rnams/ /'jigs pa dag gis ⑦ga la rtsi/ /ta nu pa bta bi lā beeḥtīrya mā ṇa thra yā sāḥs ma da ba da na padmā dman pa'i rlung gi rol pas ⑧bskyod par gyur pa'i ⑨dga' ma yis⑫/ /bzhin ni sgos ldan padma'i dri mo da paṃ bā da sā raḥ/ /ti mi ra ku su ma garnyaḥso ya mā yā ti dru rāta khyu bzang tshogs pa'i snying po can/ /dri sar me tog dri de ring nas 'ongs par ⑪gyur pa 'di/ /bung ba'i ma ra ba ra ṇi bī ṇa bi bhra mā rā bar myaḥ/ /khru tā z-i da ya saṃ bā da gī tai tatta su bhū lam ni rgyud mang du ⑫'khrul sgra yis dga' bar 'os⑫/ /sa bdag gis ni de yi glu/ /snying la 'bab pa de pa tiḥ/ /udmān bi tsa yi kṛ tā tai da darsha la tānta re/ /gā bye ro thos nas/ /skyed mos tshal dag btsal byas pas/ /'khri shing nang du de mthong gyur/ /chags pa drag tsa ma da kṣi baṃ sa tai sa pratstsha shaṃ ki taḥ/ /a pi dzā nā pi so sum̐ rpā ta su bā lakṣa pos myos de la/ /dogs par gyur pa de yis dris/ /so sum bā 'am de yis ⑫ni/ /lus kyi mtshan nyid rde ta noḥ/ /so bra bī ta kinda dzwa nā mi so sum̐ bā bisbra pā ṭa le/ /u pa bisgo khyod shes sam/ /de smras so sum bā dag ni/ /ci phyir mi shes gang gi ⑫mchu/ /bim pa dkar dmar 95—232

dha re ya snga rā ga rā bye ma no bha baḥ/ /n+yaste sma re ṇi ba ta dru ru mū le chags pa yis/ /rgyal srid la ni yid 'byung zhugs①/ /'dod pas bkod bzhin de yi brla rtsa na ༷/ /le khāe ma yo swaste ka maste kārghaṃ/ /ā birta sho bhā sta na maṇḍa le bā khā ba ri mo'i 1rang bzhin bkra shis mdzes pa yod/ /'khyil pa sdug gu mdzes pa'i 'khor lo khyo'adra/ /de yi nu rgyu kakhro la ni bhā sbi ta sngaḥ/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tiḥs rya saddhā pa sho ṣi tai/ /ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la'ang yod/ /de dag thos nas mi bdag ni/ /yongs su gdung ba drag pos nyen/ /mu mo tsa rā ga ku su oṃ nirmā lya bi tse ta saḥ/ /so bra bīnd+ra ste nā rī rde yid kyi chags pa me tog ni/ /rnying ⑤pa bzhin du dor bar gyur/ /de yis smras pa mi mo rnams/ /shi li rakṣu sha tai ra pi/ /kha putpa mā le ba sa tī sarba thā ṣpe ba dzā bsrung ba brgyas dukyang tshul khrims minathu/ /nam mkha'i me tog 'phreng ba bzhin/ /dag pa rnam kun nyid ya te/ /i kyukyādhe na sa hi hūṃ dṛ pa.āoṃ sa bhū ba hūṃ/ /garda bhā ro du med/ /rgyal pos 'di brjod long ba dang / /lhan cig dur khror nags la de/ /myur du bong bu la pi tsā tūrṇa ta tyā dza na ga rādma hiḥ/ /pā te na sa ha nirlasbyo bra dza: di na bskyon nas/ /grong khyer las ni phyir bton gyur/ /ngo tsha med par ④de dang de/ /lhan cig 'gro bas saṃ kṣa ye/ /a ṭa bye tso ra pa ti nā pāste sabhi ba saspa dā/ / dza nyin ⑨'das tshe/ /nags su chom rkun bdag po yis/ /phun tshogs dag dang bcas nyid thob/ /'phral ṣpe ra dha dru te tasmin sa ha sā tso ra maṇḍa le/ /ni ra ba rā dha e bārnyastso ra la chom rkun dkyil 'khor dag /sngon ⑫bros de tshe skye bo yis/ /long ba nyes pa med pa nyid/ /chom rkun bhādhyā ni pā ti taḥ/ /tso ro pi hūṃ ni shaṃ bhūghā so sum̐ bā kṣa ṇa saṃ ga taḥ/ /dag tu 'phrul ⑩nas bsad/ /so sum bā de rkun pos kyang / /skad cig 'grogs pas mtshan spyad nas/ /kṛ hi tā bha rā rja n+ya snga dza gā modhīrya nadzre hūṃ/ /kā raṇḍa bī yāḥs ri tasta de yi rgyan rnams blangs nas ni/ /chu bo rab tu brgal nas song / /chu klung ka ran da ba de'i/ /'gram 95—233

myu st+ri re ni rasba ra/ /shu shotsa sī dza ṣpe rā khru dza le sā ma li nasta byā/ /ta du gos dang bral ba des/ /mig sman dang bcas mchi ma'i chus/ /nu ma snog ①cing mya ngan byas/ /de smin kṣa ṇi mu khā sha kshi rmā sa muskṛ bye dzee bu ke/ /yā te dza lond+ra tai mabye ta da yi dus na wa skyes shig kwa /kha yi sha ni rab btang nas/ /chu la 'phar ba'i nya la song / /de ni dumakha' hāryābyi haṃ ga maḥ/ /maṣṭha ni laghi sa ha sā kha ge na pi se te z-i te/ /sa ba bhu la 'gro bas khyer/ /nya ni 'phral la gting du song / /sha ni bya yis phrogs pa'i tshe/ /gnyis ka ④nyams bo bha ya rja sāstsoddhā nistsa la lo tsa naḥ/ /ta sngasta bīghra duḥkhe pi mu khe pas de yis ni/ /bsams (dzwapa mig ni g.yo med gyur/ /de mthong de yis bubazhin la ni/ /sdug kyang smi ta ma dṛ shya ta/ /hā saḥs re 6 snga yi te 6 srurlo ba ra dzā yā te/ /'dzum pa mthong bar gyur/ /gzhan dag gi ⑨ni 'khrul pa la/ /'chir nye rnams kyang dgod pa yin/ /sa tsā bai lakṣu ku pi taḥpro ba tsā nu tsi ta sī tai/ /a ho ha sa si rmā lo ke skyengs pas khros pa de yis ⑧ni/ /mi 'os 'dzum pa de la smras/ /kye ma 'jig rten gad mo yi⑩/ /hā myu ya ta na tsā ga tī/ /dṛ pa ti tyaghā ga sngarnya tyaghārnya tso ra mā gnas gyur khyod nyid ⑩bdag la dgod/ /mi bdag btang nas long bar phyin/ /long ba btang nas chom shri tā / / ta bā ha mu bha ya bhraṣṭi tri bhra ṭwā yāḥsmi tā spa rda/ /ā༈ rkun bsten/ /gsum char nyams pa khyod kyis ⑩ni/ /'dzum pa'i gnas ni gnyis nyam nga / /yongs su bā pa ri hā so yo tai yusgyu ka ro mi te/ /kha khāste bee ṣa ma sthā rmā bgad ⑫pa 'di ni chog ⑫ /bdag ni rigs pas khyod phan bsgrub④/ /mi bzad gnas la gang zhig ni/ /ye bi ḍasbra na paṇḍi tāḥ/ /i tyāghā na ga ri ga tā sa dṛ pā ya n+ya bee da ya tā/ /co 'dri'i mkhas pa de mi bsrun⑫/ /'di brjod grong khyer song nas ni/ /klung gi ngogs na so sum bā/ /so shusthā ste na dī tī re ta so yuspri ti sadma tiḥ/ /a tha ni nā ya hūṃ dka' thub rigs pas (7gnas so zhes/ /blo gros bzang mos rgyal la smras/ /de nas gos dang rgyan 95—234

rā dzā bi tī tyā bha ra rja sba dzā/ /do ṣā māsgo da ya hye ba rā ga she bskur nas/ /de ni rgyal pos blangs par gyur/ /lus can rnams kyi chags pa yis/ /lhag ma 47skyon ṣaḥsha rī ri rde/ /bee bā drorba la brte ya mu dā yī shrī ghra go pya sau/ /pāstsadmānta ni sgrib pa nyid/ /da lta'i utpal mdog 'di de/ / 'char ka 'di yang myur 'gro de/ /nyasngon tshe la1gzhan ra pu bye na bhikhyi bra ta mu pā ga to/ /a bha ba da ti ra sārda mā gyi bsod nams kyis/ /dge slong brtul zhugs nye bar thob/ /'di yi yid ni gang zhig chags pas sbyor na saṃ rā ga yo ge la da ma da na bi dhe yi rā ga yus+ho ya da sngaḥ/ /la nyams kyis rab brlan 0dang / /rgyags pa dang ni 'dod pa'i dbang gyur chags dang ldan pa nyid du gyur/ /bi ra ta sha ma bi tsā ra te na tasmi namu pho rte kṛ ta na ra pa ti rū pā des na de tshe yud tsam zhi ba rnam par dpyod pa dang bral nas/ /mi yi bdag po'i gzugs byas kun dga' nandi bhā rmā ba bande / /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ldan pas bdag la phyag 'tshal gyur/ /zhes (brupa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ba dā na kalpa la tā yī de bā ba tā rā ba dā rna pañtsa da sha pabee waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las lha las babs pa'i ༷yal 'dab ste bco lnga pa'o// //ba la ma tu la bye rya bī bye sā: tram̐ bha ba ti sa bra bhā bā mthu ldan rnams kyis ⑦ mtshungs med brtan pa dang / /brtson 'grus stobs ni ngo mtshar bcas pa rmā—/ /ma ha tā shra ya yo gāta yasmi sarbo ma hi ma twa mā yā ti/ /yin—/ /chen po nyid la brten 'apa'i sbyor ba las/ /gang phyir thams cad chen po nyid du 'gyur⑨/ /pu rā ku shi pu rī ra rgyu malbā rna ba la shā lī rna/ /swesgo bi hā ri bha ga sngon ni stobs ldan gyad kyi gnas/ /ku sha'i grong khyer dga' ba ru/ /rang dgar rol pa'i bcom ldan bān pra ta ste su ga taḥswa yo/ /te ta dā ga ma rgo shu tā ka spyo khaṃ 'das—/ /bde gshegs rang nyid gshegs par gyur/ /legs par byon pa de thos nas/ /rim gro dag 95—235

ku sha le ṣi ṇaḥ/ /watpa saṃ sho dha āoṃ tsakru ru pa tsā ra pa dorya tāḥ/ /de shaṃ byu la rab brtson pa/ /dge ba 'tshol ①ba de dag gis/ /lam ni legs par sbyang ba byas④/ /rtswa dang tsher ṣa ya hūṃ te ྾ saṃ ses+ho tsanda no da kaiḥ/ /tre ṇa kalco ka pā ṣā ṇa sarka ma rdo ba dang / /gseg 1ma rdul dag ④bsal byas nas/ /tsandan chu yis legs bran te/ /yul ni rā re rku brdzi tai/ /ma bye sa mā ya yo byu mi ni maghā ma ha tī shi lā/ /mdzes pa de dag gis⑤/ /dbus su 'bigs byed rgud ༷gyur pa'i/ /chung ma gting du zhum pa bzhin/ /a ba sand+ra bi sanda su ba dhu bi bye gi re ri ba/ /tā mutyā ta ya hūṃ te ྾ gting du bying ba'i rdo chen ni/ /sa las yang dag byung bar gyur/ /'byor dang dpung pa thag pa yis/ /kubyā la byu dza radzu nyiḥ/ /mā so dza gā ma na twa sngaḥs ha nd+ra she gya byu ta kṣa tiḥ/ /a tha de ni sol la de dag rnams/ /zla ba song yang de yis ⑦ni/ /stong phrag cha yang zad ma gyur/ /de nas saṃ sā ra saṃ tā pa pra sha mā mṛ ta dī dhi tiḥ/ /ā ya yo bha ga bān saza 'khor ba'i yongs gdungs khyedag /rab tu zhi byed bdud rtsi'i zer/ /kun gyi yid ni dga' ba'i gnyen//mā na solbā sa ba ndha baḥ/ /gha nārnya kā ra bi ra ti byaktaḥs pha la bcom ldan 'das ni byon par gyur/ /stug po'i mun pa dag dang bral/ /gsal zhing mthong ba 'bras darsha naḥ/ /pra sā da saṃ bi bhaghā shaḥpra kā sha i ba shā ra daḥ/ /sa tān dang bcas/ /rab dang phyogs ni rnam par bye⑨/ /rab tu gsal ba ston nyid ⑫bzhin/ /'bras med dṛṭī pa ri shraddhān bi pha la kle sha rpā ḍi tān/ /khru tā tsa tabye ba si nyon mongs kyis gdungs pa/ /yongs ngal de dag des gzigs shing / /de dag gdungs gyur thos nas tai taza tse pra ṇa tā na nān/ /a ho kle sha pha khā ram̐ bhaḥsra yā sa kyang / /phyag 'tshal bzhin ldan der bka' stsal/ /ngal dub 'bad rtsol ldan pa khyed/ /'khor ba yis ⑪bya ba sā yi ghā/ /saṃ sā ra karma bhā tsasmin byā pā re baḥs murya maḥ/ /pā ra bhe ni las la bzhin/ /bya ba 'di la rab brtson pa/ /kye ma nyon mongs 'bras bu rtsom/ /brtsams na 2/ mi 95—236

bi ṣa ma kle shaṃ kṛ ya mā rde sa saṃ sha yi/ /sidha ma pya nu pa de yo na bzad nyon mongs dang / /byed pa na yang the tshom bcas/ /grub kyang nyer mkho med pa'i las/ /shes pādzñāḥkarma kuttha te/ /i kyughā tsa ra rde guṣṭha ghaṭi tāsthā ma pā ṇi nā/ /rab ldan rnams yongs mi byed/ /de skad gsungs nas che ba'i rdo/ /zhabs mdzub kyis phyung g.yon pa yi//bi n+ya gya dakṣi ṇi pā ṇi bha ga bān bi pu la shi dzee/ /bi mṛ rdzu bra hma lo phyag gis g.yas pa'i phyag tu ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bkod mdzad nas/ /mtha' med pha rol gnon kanta ma paryanta pa pa rā kra maḥ/ /tsa kā rābyurya tsaryā yā dū tī mi ba pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthar btang ste/ /'gro ba gsum du ngo mtshar gyi/ /spyod pa pho nya dza gattha ye/ /kṣibhā yī sa ha pā ta sde te nā tyad bhū ta kā ri shā/ /ud ju bzhin du mdzad/ /shin tu rmad byung mdzad pa des/ /de ni 'phangs pa'i 'phral nyid la/ /rlung ni rab ta ga ga nod khyu ta i ba byāṭwā dza naḥswa naḥ/ /a ni tyāḥsarba saṃ sthā ra i tya tu langs pa bzhin/ /skye bo khyab pa'i sgra rab byung / /'du byed thams cad mi rtag nyid/ /'di ni bhānta bi ṅgā yi naḥ/ /sarba dharma ni rādma naḥshāntadngharpā ṇa me ba pata/ /i 'khrul pa med par byed/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med dang / /zhi ba myang 'das kho na yod/ /de ti sgu ṭo di te shasde shi khā bha ga ba taḥka re/ /gi rīnd+ra shi ṣa rā kā rā sbi skad gsal ba'i sgra brjod de/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo ba ni/ /ri dbang rtse mo'i rnam pa can/ /slad tā pu na ra dro shya ta/ /kṣa ṇi na sā bha ga ba tā kṣiste ba da na mā rū taiḥ/ /nas kyang ni gnas par mthong / /skad cig gis de bcom ldan gyi/ /zhal gyi rlung gis gzhig byas te/ /kṛ ta bi sā ri ṇi digru ba ra mā rku pa re pa rā/ /pu na re tī kṛ tā me mchog gi ngo mtshar brgyud ma ni/ /phyogs rnams kun lngotu bkram pa byas/ /slad nas phra rab rdul rnams ba bha ga bān pa ra mā rku bhiḥ/ /shi lā ma n+ya tra bi da dhe bisma yo nidzu —/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gcig nyid byas/ /gzhan du rdo dang 'gro gsum du/ /ma ①mtshan dag 95—237

tsa dza ga nd+ra ye / / ābyarya ni bya la dṛ sha sta to ma lbā ba lombi kyang bzhag par mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan brtson 'grus dang / /stobs ni rdzogs pas ①gyad rnams tai—/ /bīrya bha ga ba to bīghra pra ṇa tāste ba bhā ṣi re/ /a ho ma hā bhā bo yo dag /ngo mtshar mig ni mi g.yo bas/ /mthong nas phyag 'tshal der gsol pa/ /kye ma khyod kyi mthu chen pa la bītram̐ da yasta ba/ /ni: yā bye ga me ya gya na pra galhaḥsu rā po—/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus rgyas pa 'di/ /gang zhig nges par rtogs dupa yi/ /nus pa lha rnams a pi/ /a nu gra ha pra bṛste na pa le na gu ru shā ta ba/ /a bho ga ti ni la yang med/ /khyed ①kyi stobs dang ④bla ma ni/ /rjes su 'dzin la rab zhugs pas/ /rdo ba bying zhing masne yo dza na te bo rje tā shi lā/ /bīrya pra dzñā ba lā dī dzñā pra gting dag tu/ /song 'di skye bo ④bzhin du bton/ /ngo mtshar mchog mdzad khyod kyi ni/ /brtson mā shā ba bye nibya yi/ /a pi dzā nā ti te kabye dābyerya ta ra kā ri ṇaḥ/ /'grus shes rab stobs sogs kyi/ /tshad kyi mtshalas ni nges pa dag /su zhig gis kyang cang shes sam/ /i ti bru bā khyo nābyarya mbi : khā ba lo kya tān/ /ta sde shi lā yā mā sī naḥde skad smras khya zhing ngo mtshar ni/ /g.yo med de rnams la gzigs nas/ /rdo ba de ④la rab bzhugs ④te/ /pro bā tsa bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /ba lo ya te tī bhū tā rmā byu tā rgo bha ba na tra bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /srid gsum 'byung po rnams kyi stobs/ /gcig nyid du ni gyur pa ya / /su ga ta su ta de ka gya lo ke ṣpe ba saṃ gi shaṃ pa lo/ /e rbha pi kuste gang / /bde gshegs gcig gi stobs de dang / /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa min/ /chu gter chu ni rasto dherdza garnyi pa ra mā rku bhiḥ/ /shakyā n+ya lo ga ṇa yi tsu pra bhā bum pa dang / /'gro rnams phra rab rdul dag gis/ /bgrang ⑨ba ru ni shin tu nub⑫/ /bde gshegs bo ra tu sau ga taḥ/ /saṃ khye su me rorlo betrī tu la mā ṣpe na ta twa taḥ/ /su ga mthu ni ma yin no/ /gang gi khwa/ srang gi tshad kyis ⑫ni/ /lhun po'i de nyid grangs rig pa/ /des kyang 95—238

tā rmā na dzā nā ti so pi sad gu ṇa go ra baṃ/ /ka tha yi te ti bha ga bān bde gshegs yon tan ni/ /dam pa'i phyi ba nyid mi rtogs/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das①/ /saṃ pāste su ra maṇḍa le/ /sa shakra padma ni la ye tsakre ku sha la de sha rna/ /brgya byin padma'i gnas dang bcas/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor 'ongs pa la/ /dge ba dag ni bstan pa mdzad/ /mallasta du pa di she na tatta da bo bye sa ma shā yāta/ /sa shā ba kā khye pra tya ka de yis de de nyer bstan pas/ /gyad rnams byang chub la brten nas/ /nyan thos zhes bya nyi tsher bcas/ /samyahūṃ budha tsā ya yuḥ/ /sgo taḥpāste pha lo kai— ta sa kṛ dā gā mi yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid gyur/ /'ga' yis rgyun zhugs 'bras bu thob/ /gzhan gyis lan gcig bye tsā pa riḥ/ /a nā gā mi pha lo tsā byeḥpāpta martata pa rda ba riḥ/ /i phyir 'ong yang / /phyir mi 'ong 'bras gzhan gyis te/ /gzhan gyis dgra bcom gnas thob gyur/ /de tyā sha yā nu sha ya dhwa tu ga ti ni rī kṣu dzñā tā ta thā pra kṛ ti ma ltar bsam pa phra rgyas khams dang 'gro ba gzigs gyur cing / /mkhyen nas rang bzhin de ltar mtshungs pa pra ti mo pa de shaṃ/ /te ྾ tsa kā ra bha ga bībya tu rārya pa tya sa med pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po yang dag rab gsal snyedri med pa/ /de dag myaspra kā sha bi sha rda ku lo da yā ya/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā rnams kyi dge ba spel slad bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang yī bo bye sa tā ba dā sna ka lpa la tā lnga shi la ni kṣe pā ba chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las brag nges par 'phangs pa'i rtogs pa dā ni sho ḍa sha pabee waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu drug pa'o// //a saṃ ga mo nā ma bi shu rnyi yā ma gre yī se sru te ku sha chags pa med rnams nges par rnam par dag pa'i gnas/ /dge ba mngon 'dod 'khor ba'i g.yon 95—239

khā bhi kā maḥ/ /saṃ sā ra bā maḥsu kṛ tā bhi rā maḥm no ma ledzee dang legs byas la/ /mngon par dga' zhing yid kyi dri ma rnams ①dag gi/ /khon gyi rdul dang bral ba ra ra dzo bi rā maḥ/ /pu rā gi gā ma nudhīrya nā gā ram̐ pha ṇa se tu nā/ /dge legs bskyed pa yin/ /sngon tshe klu rnams gdengs ka yis⑤/ /zam pas gaṅgā legs par bsgral/ /bha ga bā na su ga ta su pā pya bhikṣu na bhā ṣa ta/ /e ha ratna ma bcom ldan bde gshegs pha rol tu/ /byon nas dge slong rnams la gsungs/ /'dir sngon rin chen rang ya pūbaṃ yu po byu dbye tablu tiḥ/ /darsha yā mi ta ma tre ba trahūṃ baḥbazhin gyicha/ /mchod sdong rmad byung mdzes pa byung / /gal te dge mtshan khyed blta ④na/ /'di nyid du kau tu rka ya di/ /i byughā bha ga bān bhū mo pā ṇi nā di bya lagla rja/ /de bdag gis bstan/ /zhes gsungs sa la bcom ldan gyi/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa'i phyag dag gis/ /smṛṭī nā ga ga ḍo ta kṣibye ratna yu pra ma darsha yata/ /tai dṛṭī snyikṣa reg pas klu yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /rin cen ⑤mchod sdong blangs 'unas bstan/ /dge slong thams cad paḥsarbe nadmā nidmā me kṣa ṇḍabye ram̐/ /ba byu pu— tra li khi ta i ba nistsa de mthong nas/ /yun ring krumig ni mi 'dzum zhing / /lus ni g.yo ba med pa dag /ri mor ⑤bris pa la ni gra haḥ/ /taṅka thā ma thā taiḥthraṣṭaḥbro bā tsa bha ga bān pu naḥ/ /a tī bzhin du gyur/ /de dag gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /de gtam slar yang rab gsungs te/ /'das tā nā ga ta dzñā rgo danta lo kaiḥki rambi pa/ /de ba pu tra pu rā kashyi ta dang ma 'ongs mkhyen pa ni/ /tshems kyi snang bas 'grems pa bzhin/ /sngon tshe lha yi bu 'ga' zhig /kā le swarga pa ri tsu taḥ/ /ma hā pra ṇa da nā mā byu ta dzre pa tiḥsha kra shā pa dus kyi mtho ris las yongs 'phos/ /brgya byin bka' las mi yi bdag /mang pos bkur ba zhes par nāta / /dhadzre bṛṭwā nu sa ra zla sma ra ṇa ya ma tī ta le/ /u tsi tai lakṣa rde ki— ta gyur—/ /sa yi gzhi la chos kyi ni/ /spyod pa rjes 'jug dran pa'i slad/ /de yis mchod sbyin brgya pa la/ /95—240

pa ya yā tse sha ta kra ḍū/ /ta taḥsu ra pa terpākyāji shwa kand+ra tadā la ye/ /rig ①pa'i mtshan nyid cung zad blangs/ /de nas lha yi bdag po'i bkas/ /bi sho ② karmas de gnas su/ /bhā shwa re bi da dhe ratna yu paṃ pu rgya mi bonda tai/ /ta tastajarsha na paste 'od ldan rin cen ①mchod sdong ni/ /bsod nams bzhin du mtho ba bsgrubs/ /de nas de ni blta ④ la dza na kau tu ka nibyu le/ / kṛ gro di karma rgyu tstshanda rā snyoḥ ko ṣa chags—/ /skye bo dge mtshan g.yo ba med/ /rmos sogs las rnams rgyun chad pas/ /rgyal po'i bang kṣa yo bha bta/ /ta taste na kṣi ti bhu dzwa kṣisto yo dzā tna bī dza le/ /tiṣṭha tya byā pi mdzod zad par gyur/ /de nas sa bdag de yis de/ /gang gā ⑤yi ni chu la 'phangs/ /da lta yang ni sa pā tā le rasneḥsrurlo ri bā tsi taḥ/ /bha bi 6 tya gya kā le na pa 'og na/ /rin cen gyis brgyan dunyi mas bzhin/ /dus kyis de ni yongs chad ⑦nas/ /yongs su rikhyundaḥpa ri kṣa yaḥ/ /na tadzdza ga ti nā māste pa ri ṇa me ya da kṣa yi/ /'jigs dhipar 'gyur ba khya yin/ /yongs su gyur pas mi 'jig gang / /'gro na nges par de yod min/ /ā gā mi sa ma ye sum̐ sī barṣa shrī ti sa ha sra ke/ /shaṃ kha shu bhra ya shaṃ shaṃ kho ma 'ongs dus na skye rgu ⑫lo/ /stong phrag brgyad cu pa yi tshe/ /rgyal po ⑫grags pa dung ltar dkar/ /nā ma rā dzā bha bi 6 ti/ /pu sgyu lapta mi yo yu paṃ dṛ paḥkalpa dru mo dung zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi bdag dpag bsam shing rta des/ /mchod sdong bsod nams kyis pa maḥ/ /sa pu ro nyi ta pu tā ya mai tre yā ya pra dā mya ti/ /bee tre yo 'thob 'di/ /mdun na 'don gyi bur gyur pa/ /byams pa la ni rab sbyin 'gyur/ /slong ba'i ⑫yid pya ya mā dā ya kṛ tā sa pa di khaṇḍa shaḥ/ /atho tsinta ma ṇirlo ka ma da ri bzhin nor gyur pa/ /byams pa yis kyang 'di blangs nas/ /'phral la dum bur byas nas ni/ /'jig dre ka ri 6 ti / / yu paṃ da tā tha mi tre yaḥ samyahūṃ budha tsā ga rten dbul po med byed 'gyur/ /byams pas mchod sdong byin de nas/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid 95—241

taḥ—/ /a nutta ra dzñā na ni byerbha bi 6 ti su rartsi taḥ/ /shaṃ kho rā dzā 'thob—/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes gter/ /lha rnams kyis ni mchod par 'gyur/ /btsun mo blon po'i sa ha sru ṇḍa ma shī tyā pa ri ta ཿ / / sānta pu ra mā tya ga ḍo tshogs dang bcas/ /stong phrag brgyad cu dag gis ni/ /yongs su bskor nas dung zhes pa'i/ /rgyal rā dzā bi pra bra dzi 6 ti/ /pāstsadma pra ṇi dma ṣpe na shaṃ kha mya ku sha lo da yoḥ/ /po'ang rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skye ba snga ma'i smon lam gyis/ /dung gis stidage ba rgyas pa dag /kṛ ta snga pa shā sgo gya tāta pa ri shā me pha li 6 te/ /ma rgya de she pu rā rā dzā byas pa nges par longs spyod slad/ /'bras bu yongs su byun par gyur du/ /yul dbus su sngon rgyal po ni//bā sa bo bā sa po pa maḥ/ /dha na sasma ta nā mā tsa dṛ po byu dutta rā pa the/ /nor lha'i bu lta khyenor lha'i bu/ /byang phyogs su yang mi bdag ni④/ /nor gyis bkur ba zhes pa byung / /ta yorbi bha ba saṃ ghasgo bhū da bee rāsni ta pta yoḥ/ /a khyurlu dha pa 'byor pa 'gran gepa las 'khrugs kwa)pa/ /khon gyi mes ④gdungs de dag gi.ayo/ /yid ni g.yul dag mā ram̐ bha saṃ bhā ra ra bha masma naḥ/ /na ga re tsa pra pi shā tha ba me rtsom pa la⑨/ /lhag par rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /de nas nor gyis bkur ba 'ongs/ /grong khyer du tya dha na pasma taḥ/ /tsakre ga dza ra thā mbi ṣpe shaṃ bā tī re ni ram̐ ta baṃ/ /ta tra yang rab tu zhugs/ /glang po shing rta'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gaṅgā'i 'gram ni bar med byas/ /der ni ratna shi khāe nā ma samyakshi budha ྅ ga taḥ / /dṛṣṭa ste nābyo mā dzwa rin cen ⑫gtsug ces pa/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid thob/ /brgya byin tshangs sogs lha rnams mbi bra hma sha krā di bhiḥsu riḥ / /so tsinta ba dagho rā dzā bā sa baḥkyis—/ /zhabs la mchod ldan de yis mthong / /des (1/bsams rgyal po nor lha'i bu/ /kye ma bsod pri thu pu ṭu bān/ /bi ṣa yārnye ba pa bye ṣa ya gya tri da sha bandi taḥ/ /ta nams chen por ⑫ldan/ /gang la skabs gsum pas phyag byas/ /'di ni yul byu khong ⑨na gnas/ /de 95—242

tasta snga nu bhā ba na ta tra khyu pā la yo sta yoḥ/ /ya yo bai ra ra dza shī tyā mi tho mo ha nas de yi mthu yis ni/ /der ni sa skyong de dag gis/ /khon gyi rdul ni zhi ba yis/ /log par rmongs pa pa ri kṣa yo/ /kṛ ta sarnyiḥpa re shā tha bā sa baḥpri thi bī pa teḥ/ /bha yongs zad gyur/ /de nas sa bdag nor lha'i bus/ /pha rol dang ni bsdums byas nasarmye/ /bcom ga bahaṃ sa ma bye tya sadzee sgo gi ra pū dza ya ta/ /pra ṇi dhwa dzwa tsa bid ldan 'das la mngon phyogs te/ /longs spyod kun gyis mchod pa byas/ /mchod pa'i mjug tu bdag phyag dha sgo dza dhe pra ṇa mya tai/ /a haṃ ku sha la mu le na snga me te na ma hā 'tshal—/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis/ /bdag ni chen por gyur cig ces/ /smon lam dag kyang byas ni ti/ /asmi ṣpe na pa sa re bhā paṃ shaṃ kha shande sa muṅga te/ /pro bā par gyur/ /skabs 'dir shin tu che ba'i sgra/ /dung las yang dag 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /phyag 'tshal tsa tai ratna shi khāe pra ṇa tai su ra ta sbi tai/ /shaṃ kho nā ma ma hi pā labyakra mdun du duganas de la/ /rin cen gtsug gis bka' stsal pa/ /dung zhes bya ba'i sa skyong ni/ /'khor brta bha bi 6 ti/ /paryarnye bo bye yukta: ku sha la sa ma bāsgu bee/ /los sgyur bar spyod 'gyur te/ /mjug 3tu byang chub ldan pas kyang / /dge ba yang dag thob par 'gyur④//e baṃ sattha ṇi dhwa na taḥkṣ-i ti pa nyiḥpu bye da yā dā sa baḥshaṃ kho nā ma dṛ paḥs de ltar dam pa'i smon lam bsod nams rgyas pa la 'uni sa bdag nor lha'i bu/ /mi yi bdag po dung zhes ratna shi khi nā diṣṭaḥshri yo srublu ti/ /mo tre yaḥpra ṇa yāta ka ri 6 nyi bya bas blo gros thob 'gyur khye rin cen gtsug gis bstan/ /de bzhin byang chub tu ni rnam dag blo gros ta thā bo sgo bi shudhe dhi ye ka spyo shā bhi ni be sha pu rgya sha ra ṇi rā rya hi byams pas byams las mdzad par gyur/ /gang gi 0dam pa'i grogs ni dge la mngon 'jug bsod sahūṃ ga maḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na nams lam gyi sdedang po yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa 95—243

kalpa la tā yī mai tre ya bya ka ra rja pa da dzā nā ma sapta da shaḥpabee baḥ// //brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las byams pa lung bstan pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu bdun pa'o// //tsitta pra pā da pa la la pra ṇa ya dzwa la snga swalpa su da na ku su ma sems ni rab tu dngas pa'i 7dri med mnyes gshin rab 'bar ba/ /shin tu chung ba'i sbyin pa'i me su pha dzee sha ke na/ /he mā dri ro ha ṇa na gadhe su dhwasgo dā na samyutpa tog 'bras bu'i cha shas ni/ /ri dbang gser ri ro ha na dang bdud rtsi'i gter sbyin 'upa'i/ /'bras bu lo na hi tu khā ka la na mu bai ti/ /pu rā ma no zlo sand+ra dzhaḥbyu phun tshogs dag dang mtshungs pa nyid du nyer mi 'gro/ /sngon ni kun mkhyen dgongs pa che/ /yid 'ong bahūṃ dze ta kā na ṣpe/ /a nā tha paṇḍi dā rā me bi dza hā ra ma hā ya shaḥ/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal/ /mgon med zas sbyin dag gi ni/ /kun dga' ra bar bzhugs par 'gyur2/ /ādro ma hā kā shya pā khyastastso6ཿka ru rja ni byeḥ/ /na ga ro pa ba na gyarnyi de yi slob ma snying rje'i gter/ /'phags pa 'od srungs che zhes bya/ /grong khyer nye ba'i nags kyi mthar/ /dza na tsā ri kā yā ya yo/ /ta tra su durga ti yo ṣi ta na ga rā shra ba lambi ljongs ni ④rgyu zhing gshegs par gyur/ /der ni grong khyer mthar brten pa/ /shin tu ngan 'gro'i bud kā—/ /a pa shyata kuṣṭha ro gāsbyo kā shya pa ti ya dṛtstsha yā/ /sā tai dṛṣṭa med dag /mdze yi nad kyis gzir ba yis/ /'od srungs de ni ci 'dod mthong / /de yis de mthong pra sā di tyā shradhe yā sa ma tsinta ya ta / / pā tre su pi ṇḍa pā tā rta rab dang zhing / /dad pa dag gis yang dag bsams/ /'di snod stibasod snyoms su 'os pa/ /bsod ki na dzā nā smi pu sgo taḥ/ /bi dzñā ya ta gyaḥs:rya shradha yulte sma no ra dzee/ /nams las ni cis khyam skyes/ /de yi 'dod pa ngo mtshar can/ /dad pa dang ldan rnam mkhyen nas/ /pra sa rya pa tram̐ dza gra ha pi ṇḍa tai kri pā ku laḥ / / nyi bra tsitta snying rje rgyas pa'i ④lhung bzed dag /rab tu brkyangs ⑧nas bsod snyoms blangs/ /sems ni dang ba 95—244

pra sā de na bhakta sa ra ma marba ṇi/ /kuṣṭi n+ya ni pa phru tā suḥpā tre shiṇḍi ka ram̐ drag po yis/ /'bras chan rab mang phul ba'i tshe/ /mjo mo de yi lag pa yi/ /sor mo brul nas snod du gu liḥ/ /ta taḥpa pā ta ka mi ba tyaghā ni tya ka ḍi ba ram̐/ /de bā āoṃ tu ṣi tā khyu lhung / /de 'og de yis sdig pa bzhin/ /mi rtag lus dag dor nas ni/ /dga' ldan zhes bya lha rnarmes dzā ni la ye sa ma dzā ya te/ /shakra sta dbye tai dzñā tā dā na pu byo di di ta kyi—/ /nang du yang dag skyes par gyur/ /rmad byung de shes brgya byin ni/ /sbyin pa'i dge la gus rgyas raḥ—/ /yatnata kā shya pa satpa tram̐ su dha ya sa pa pū ra yata/ /su dhattha pas—/ /'bad pa'i ①'od srungs dam pa'i snod/ /bdud rtsi dag gis yongs su bkang / /dge slong ṇi pya sau bhigrurni spri haste ṇa lbo la yā/ /pra sha mā mṛ ta saṃ pūrṇa :kre rab zhi'i bdud rtsi yis/ /khengs des bdud rtsi byin la yang / /dga' med rtswa yi rtse mo yis/ /lhung pā tra ma sgo mu khaṃ/ /bha dzadhe pra ṇa ya spru ti kri pa ṇi 6 kri pa ku bzed thur du kha bstan gyur/ /dam pa'i kwa snying rje rgyas pa rnams/ /dman la mdza' gcugs dga' ba khāḥ—/ /saṃ taḥsaspata sa mā ddhā ta ba da de mbi li tā da raḥ/ /shu tā hūṃ tu stenasne—/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'bar ba yis④/ /bzhin la gus pa dman par gyur/ /de ni dga' ldan ṣi to de ba ni kā ya ni ra shā dṛ paḥ/ /pra se na dzi ta bha ga ba ta: kre lha tshogs na/ /gnas pa thos nas mi yi bdag /gsal rgyal gyis ⑤ni bcom ldan gyi/ /mchod ston sgo dzñā dhi bā sa rmā/ /rā snyosta phya kṛ he dṛṭī lasmri mā:rya ka ri ṇaḥ/ /lhag par gnas par byas/ /rgyal po de yi khang pa ni du/ /dpal 'byor ngo mtshar byed mthong nas/ /ātyā nande na bha ga bān thraṣṭasta ta pu rgya ma bhya dha ta/ /pu ru kṛ ha pa teḥ'aphags pa dga' bos bsod nams de/ /dris shing bcom ldan gyis bka' stsal/ /sngon ni khyim bdag sru nu dī rī drubyā sa tī ga taḥ/ /kṣe tra kand+ra ṇi saṃ saktaḥkṣu ta kṣu cig ④gi bu/ /dbul ba las ni 'bang khya nyid gyur/ /zhing las dag la yang dag chags/ /ltogs shing 95—245

maḥklarnyi mā ya yo/ /sa dza tyā mā nī tī niḥsde ha la ba khaṃ tsi rata/ /kalbā rid pas khyangal bar gyur/ /yun ring zhig na ma yis ni/ /snum dang tsha med gzan chang zhig du /khyer ṣa piṇḍi mā sā rya sgohūṃ sā da ra ma ya yo/ /sgo na hasta kṣa ṇi tasmin nas 'ongs pa des thob nas/ /gus dang bcas pas za ru song / /lag pa bkrus pa de yi tshe/ /ci saṃ prabhā ya ya dṛtstsha yā/ /da do pra bye ga budha ya hūṃ pra sadzre na tse ta sā/ /dgar yang dag 'ongs pa yil / /rang sangs rgyas la de nyid ni/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis byen/ /dzā taḥs a ba kā le na bhu ba lo yo pra pe na dzita/ /ta gya dā na ka ṇa gye yo de nyid dus kyi sa skyong ni/ /gsal rgyal 'di ru skyes par gyur/ /'byor pa 'di ni sbyin pa yi/ /thigs bi bhu tiḥpra tha oṃ pha lo/ /shu tī ti bha ga badmā kyi bhi kṣurbasma ya ma ya yo/ /pa de yi dang po'i 'bras/ /de skad bcom ldan gsungs ngu thos nas/ /dge slong dag ni ya mtshan gyur/ /rā dzā pi pi pu dzee bu rdzu bi da dhe bha ga ba taḥpu raḥ/ /rā dzārte ra khi lesgo geḥrgyal po yis ⑤ kyang yangs pa yis dwa/ /mchod pa bcom ldan mdun du byas/ /rgyal pos longs spyod ma kṛ tā bhaspyi ni be da rgo/ /sa ko rgya tai lo kumbha rmā dī pa mā lnga ma kalpa ya lus pas/ /gus pas zhal zas phul byas nas/ /'bru mar bum pa bye ba yis/ /mar me yi ni 'phreng ba taḥ / /dī pa me shaṃ da do ta tra swalpa kai durga shā ga nā/ /sne yakṣa yāta pra ya te byas—/ /der ni dbul mos mar me ni/ /shin tu chung ba dag cig phul/ /thams cad snum ni rab zad 6 sabye 6 ṇa dza gā ma yaḥ/ /tsernyi ༈ bra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na ta yā bi ma la tse nas—/ /rab tu bzlas (rkyetshe gang ma song / /de yi sems ni dri med kyisadā / /smon lam de yis rnam ta pā/ /bhā bi nī shākya mu ni tsā sattha zlo sngaḥs ma bhya dhwata/ /ratna dī pā ba bsams pa/ /shākya thub pa nyid du ni/ /'gyur bar kun mkhyen gyis bka' stsal/ /bcom ldan mdun li da tā rā dzā bha ga ba taḥpu raḥ/ /u pa bi shya pra ṇa myu gre ṇa pra ṇa du rgyal po yis/ /rin cen sgron me'i 'phreng po7 phul nas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mdun bsdad de⑫/ /gus 95—246

yātrī bya dzi snyo pata/ /bha ga bta pra ṇi dmā ṣpe na tattahphu dhyā nu bhā ba taḥ/ /pa yis ni der gsol pa/ /bsod nams de de'i mthu dag las/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi stismon lam gyis/ /na ga sthā nutta rā sa myakshi bo dhirbha ga ba tabee tā/ /bha bta pra sā da pra ṇa ya bla med yang dag rdzogs byang chub/ /khyod kyis ( su la ster mi bgyid/ /khyod kyi bka' drin brtse ba las/ /pāpta mitstsha mi tā ma haṃ / /nibee kalpa pha lnga bas+ho se byarnye kalpa pā de ni thob par bdag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par mi rtog 1 'bras thob slad/ /dpag bsam rkang 'thung bsten dā paḥ/ /i ti rā dzā pa tsa khru tā bha ga bān swa ya ma bha ṣaṭa/ /durla bhā pa lags/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bla med yang nutta rā samyaka saṃ bo byeḥthra thi bī pa two/ /sugrwa mṛ rja la tantu bhyo gi ri bhyo dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub sa bdag rnyed par dka'/ /padma'i skud pa bas kyang phra/ /ri bo las ④pi ga ri ma rpā/ /sa mu dre bhyo pi shaṃ dī rā sā su khe na na labhya te/ /na da ṣperba kyang shin tu brling / /rgya mtsho bas kyang zab pa ste'7/ /bde blag tu ni 'thob ma yin/ /bdag gis skye hu bhirlabha ma yi bā bye 6 dzadma su/ /tsitta pra sā da bi ṣa rda dzñā rna taṭwā ra rṇa ba gzhan rnams su/ /sbyin pa rma nga pos thob ma gyur/ /sems ni rab dang dri med kyi/ /ye shes de yi rgyu dza guḥ/ /tsa turdi pa bye pa hye na ma yā mant+ra j-i dzadma ni/ /tsi ram̐ dā na pha lo ru gsungs/ /nga las nu yi skye ba la/ /bdag gi gling bzhi'i bdag po yis/ /yun ring sbyin pa'i 'bras zuste bo byerwa pi ga tā tu pā/ /dā ṣpe na tsakra brti shraḥsā su darsha dzadma bu spyad/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /blta sdug skye bar sbyin pa yis/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal ni / /jukta ma yā ma ha tī bo byertswa pi gā tā tu pā/ /pu rā da tā ga dzā byoṣṭi de ni/ /shin tu che ba bdag gis srud/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /gnyis skyes skye ba bee la 0mar/ /be lā ma dī dza dzadma ni/ /ma yā pāptasma hahphu bye bo byeza pi ga tā tu pā/ /glang po brgyad ni sngon byin pas/ /bsod nams chen po bdag gis thob/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /95—247

ku rū pa ku sha lādmo haṃ rā dzā pu traḥpu rā bha baṃ/ /yaḥbi shā tso ya mi gang zhig rang gi chung mas ①'di/ /sha za zhes brjod rnam par spangs/ /dge ba'i bdag nyid rgyal po'i tyākta ni dza pasbya bi brdzi taḥ/ /po: shri sgoji byu tyā ge bye tirya gya bu—/ /gzugs ngan du ni sngon bdag gyur/ /dpal la dpal dang dpung par sa/ /gtong ②la dga' pa dāsbyi tā/ /sa duḥkhāe rū pa bai ka spyo ta kwa ba sarba gu rto da yaḥ/ /ba rtag gnas gang / /de ni gzugs dman sdug bsngal ldan/ /su zhig yon tan thams cad rgyas//tai rū pa bi ra he de ha tyā gā rū bhā sha ṭī pa teḥ/ /di bya tsū ḍā ma ṇiḥd twa gzugs bral lus ni gtong ba la/ /zhugs de bde sogs bdag po yis/ /lha yi gtsug gi nor byin nas//tsakre pañtsa sha ro pa oṃ/ /ṣabyeḥsu ra sa ha sra ṇi ta gya ya zlo 6 pa dzwa mda' lnga pa dang mtshungs par byas/ /mchod sbyin byed de'i mchod sbyin la/ /grong khyer stong phrag drug cu laḥ—/ /te ma yu pā bhi rū pa ṇi pā pumbi ru ba la shri yo/ /tasmidma yā ni—/ /gser gyi mchod sdong ltar sngon ⑦ gzugs/ /ri bo lhun po'i dpal thob gyur/ /dge ba'i skye ba ti dā nādre su kṛ te ku sha la dzadma ni/ /tā ni pu rgyu ni khābhā ni bo de la ni/ /bdag gis ④ mchog tu sbyin sogs byas/ /bsod nams de dag rnams kyang thob/ /byang dhirna bye ga tā tu pā/ /hā tā pa tya pra bhā be na tri shaṃ ku dṛ pa dzadma ni/ /ma yā chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /rtse gsum rgyal po'i skye ba la/ /bdag gis bden pa'i mthu yis ni/ /char med bṛṣṭaḥs dubhi kṣa bo byertswa bye ga tā tu pā/ /mi thi lā yī ma hā de ba dṛ pa dzadma mu ge dang bcas bcom/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /mi thi lar ni mchod sbyin byed/ /lha chen rgyal ni ya dzwa yā/ /ma yābee pu 5 sadzatrīrbo byerna dhi ga tā tu pā/ /mi thi lā po'i skye ba la/ /bsod nams phun tshogs bdag gis thob/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /sa skyong ni yi pu rā pu bye ni mi byu pā la dzadma ni/ /pābye da na ta po yadzhairbo dhiṭwā mi'i skye ba la/ /mi thi lar sngon dka' thub sbyin/ /mchod sbyin rmis ni bsod nams thob/ /byang chub de 95—248

bye ga tā tu pā/ /pu rā nanda su dṛ pa te: tā raḥpi shu nāḥsu tāḥ/ /ba byu pu rā ni thob ma gyur/ /sngon ni mi bdag dga' bo la/ /phra ma ①ldan pa'i bu bzhi dang / /lnga pa dag kyang me darsha mu khaḥpañtsa mabyu gu shā bye kaḥ/ /ka le nā panda paryantaḥs bhu pa ti ra tshinta long bzhin/ /yon tan lhag pa byung bar gyur/ /dus kyi mthar ni nye ba'i tshe/ /sa yi bdag po de yis yata—/ /e te ma darnye tsa tā ro rā rdzu nārtarnyi karka shaḥ/ /pu tre ma mā darsha bsamasadu—/ /bdag gi mthar ni rgyal srid la/ /rtsub mo 'di bzhi 'os pa min/ /bdag gi bu ni me mu khe rā dzñā shrīḥ pra ti bi mbiḥtā ཿ/ /su thradhe la bha te sho rja bra dzñā long bzhin/ /legs spyod shes rab dri med dang / /ldan byepas rgyal srid dag gi dpal/ /gzugs bee ma lya shā yi ni/ /dhyā two tya mā tyā na sau bā dīta sa bha babyertswa re shwa rāḥ/ /brnyan mdzes pa thob ④pa yin/ /'di bsams de yis blon la smras/ /skye gnas kyis bslang btsun mo yi//kā yontaḥsu ra brge ṇa yo rgyujo ṣpe na pū bye te/ /mo lirna kadza te ya tshogs kyis mchod par 'gyur ba ⑤dang / /gang gi dbu rgyan mi g.yo la/ /nor bu'i rkang rjes dag la'ang su pa me ba ma ṇi pa du ke/ /dwa ra dru mā dri bā rpā 6 ni bye ṣasko tsa pa shya mnyam—/ /sgo yi ljon pa'i bang so la/ /gter drug mthong bar gyur pa ni/ /khrod kyis mi yi dbang por ti—/ /i kyukta tri di paṃ yā te dṛ pa to madhri ṇaḥkra māta/ /ta dusterlakṣa bya—/ /zhes brjod mi bdag mtho ris su/ /gshegs tshe blon pos me long bzhin/ /de yis ⑥brjod pa'i ṇi byukru rā darsha mu kha mbi shwa ram̐/ / dha nd+ra niṇḍi ya kābye 6 yo pā mtshan nyid kyis⑦/ /rim pa rnams kyis khyadabang por byas/ /chos ni nges pa'i 1bya ba la/ /rgol dang di pra ti ba di naḥ/ /bee lo kyai pa swa yo ta sgruju khre dza ya ma pa ra dza ye /phyir rgol rnams kyis gang / /mthong ba rnams kyi ⑩rang nyid ni/ /rgyal pham rigs pa dag la gnas/ /pu rā ni rā bhi sarnya na pābee bee sha pa kilpa ṣe/ /zwahma khaṃ daṇḍi rna nā ma sngon ni ⑪rgyu mtshan med pa ru⑫/ /mi 'dod sdig pa thob gyur pa/ /bram ze dbyug can zhes pa la/ /95—249

ga na byakta bai ma phya bhā rdzu nisto dzā nanda ju mirbha ba ti bha ba ta mabye di gsal dri ma med pa dag gis bsten/ /zol med kun dga'i sa gzhi de ni srid pa'i mun pa gcod byed nyin nā sā di na shrīḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba da na mo'i dpal 'byor yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa 7kalpa la tā yā mā darsha mu khā ba dā na maṭwā da shaḥpabee baḥ// //dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las me long gi bzhin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bco brgyad pa'o// //ṣpe rda banturno su z-isgo da ra ba ṣpe dasmra tā si tā bā a ka ro ti/ /gang yang ye shes slob dpon dge ba'i rgyu/ /'khor ba'i chu gter zam pas gang bsgrubs pa/ /yahūṃ sā rī sgo bye se turngi dhaste dzñā nā tsaryaḥko pi ka spyo ṇa te tuḥ/ /ka lanta 'di ni gnyen dang mdza' bshes spun zla dang / /ma dang pha dag gis kyang byed pa min/ /rgyal po'i khab ka ni bā pā khye ra bye bi rku ba nā shra me/ /bha ga bān bi ha ran budhaḥpu kyi grong khyer gyirngo / /ka lan ta ka'i gnas zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal gnas dga' bar sngon/ /sangs re rā dzā kṛ he pu rā/ /kau li tai tso pa ti 6ñtsa do pa ri pā dza kau pu rā/ /rgyas bcom ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal te/ /kun tu rgyu ni gnyis po sngon/ /pra parjo bhi kṣu bhā bee na tsa kā ra sha ma dṛ to/ /ta ta: shā ri pu tra gya dge slong dngos por rab rdzogs pas/ /zhi ba dag tu zhugs par byas/ /de nas yang dag bstan mdzad bhikhyoḥsaṃ de sha rmā bya pāta/ /ya yā bā kṣata kṛ tarta twaḥso bhud mokṣa ga ti pas—/ /dge slong shā ri'i bu dag ni/ /gang gis dgra bcom mngon byas te/ /de ni thar par 'gro kṣa maḥ/ /ta su tai mad bhu tai dṛṭwā dha ṣpe tī sattha bhikṣa beeḥ/ /sa pratstshaḥbazod gyur/ /de yis snyirmad byung bsngags 'os de④/ /dge slong kun gyis mthong gyur nas/ /de la purba bṛṭwā āoṃ sa tsā ta bhyo bhā ṣi ta / /krāhma ṇa khyaghi mi tra su bhārya sngon gyi spyod mtha' dris/ /des kyang de dag rnams la gsungs/ /bram ze me peyi grogs po yi/ /chung ma 95—251
