gu ṇa pa rā bha pata/ /srubee ke ti kṛ tai pi tā 1 ḍā nā ma tsa bi bhra tī/ /1 yon tan mchog gyur pa/ /pha yis rtsed ①mor ming dag kyang / /sur pi ka zhes btags par gyur/ /de tā pra tha ma shī lā khyaḥta suḥsrurpā pa bi paḥ/ /pra hye ka budha ṭwā yā tā ka yi ming po srur 0pā pa/ /zhes pa rang sangs rgyas nyid gyur②/ /dang po'i tshul khrims zhes bya ba/ /nam dā tsid kṛ ha mā ya yo/ /sa ta yā bhartu rā de shāta kṛ ha bhasgyu bye pa se tāḥ/ /zhig khyim du 'ongs par gyur/ /de yi ④khyo yis bstan pa las/ /khyim pa'i gus pas de mgron gnyer/ /pra ṇa tiḥpra ṇa yā tsa ri sto ṣi taḥpa ri tsarya yā/ /ka dā tsi— pa re ta gya rab btud gus pa'i spyod pa dang / /rim gro ⑤dag gis tshim par byas/ /nam zhig chos gos drub pa wī 7/ /kuddhā ṇa gya bi pā tra rgo/ /sru ṭī kand+ra bā shāta dṛṣṭa pra ṇi ddhā na sa mā da dhe/ /bya ba dag ni byed pa de'i/ /khab kyi las dbang mthong gyur nas/ /smon lam dag ni gus bcas pas /ya je yo karta rī ti1 ya tha gi bhā ra gā mi mbi/ /sru tsi ta thā ma ma pa ram̐ ji ltar chen po rno 'di dang / /ji ltar zab mor 'gro ba'i khab/ /de ltar bdag gi ⑦shes rab ni/ /pradzñā snga di ti sā da rā/ /pra hye ka budha bi na yāta pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na te na tsa/ /mchog tu gyur ces yang dag btab/ /rang sangs rgyas la gus pa dang / /smon lam dag ni de yis kyang / /bee bāsmin dzadma ni ga tā sa pradzñā shā ri pu tra tai/ /sa e ṣa shā ri pu tro rya bhekṣu shes rab ldan pa shā ri'i bur/ /skye ba 'di la de ⑤gyur to/ /dge slong shā ⑨ ri'i bu 'di de/ /da lta kṣuṇḍa ta rā gra dhīḥ/ /ka spyo ṇa pā tra hūṃ yā taḥkalpa ballī hi sadma tiḥ/ /bā rab rno blo mchog ldan/ /dge ba'i snod gyur gang gi phyir/ /dam pa'i blo ni dpag bsam shing / /bcom kyi bha ga ba taḥshu tā pa prasbrebhi kṣa baḥpu naḥ/ /kasmrinda rgya ku le dzā taḥldan 'das kyi ⑪gsung thos nas/ /dge slong rnams kyis yang zhus pa/ /mi las smad pa zlos gar mkhan//shā ri pu tro na rā dha me/ /ta tastan bha ga ba byu tse pūtthasminde ṣa dzadma ni/ /rigs su shā ri'i bu cis 'khrungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis der/ /bka' stsal skye ba sngon nyid la//95—252

a byudma hā ma tirnu ma rā dza pu tram̐ sa hūṃ ma taḥ/ /shrī ma to pi ma tista gya blo gros chen po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal bu dam pas 'dod par gyur/ /dpal dang ldan yang de yi blo/ /pra bra rje yā ma dzā ya ta/ /pa ri ga mi pra sand+ra rmā kā nu byā ya na saṃ pa daḥ/ /rab tu byung la phyogs par gyur/ /rab tu dad pa yongs byun la/ /phun sum tshogs pas sgrib mi byed/ /pra bra dzñā rā dza pu tā rde yu nā ṣpeb ku lo tsi tā/ /i sgokta dza na kaḥspru rgyal sras gzhon nu rnams ①dag ni/ /rab byung rigs la 'os min nyid/ /ces brjod pha yi ⑦byams pa tyā lta yasne na n+ya bā ra yata/ /ka dā tsita kuñdza rā rū bhāḥs pra dza ba na baddhā yis—/ /'bad pas de ni bzlog par gyur/ /nam zhig glang chen la zhon nas/ /skye bo'i khrulam du 'gro ni / /dṛṭī da ri dro bee bi ram̐ kā ru sgyu di da ma pra bīta/ /a dha n+ya dha ni ba des/ /rgan po dbul po mthong gyur nas/ /snying rje las khyo ni 'di dag smras/ /skal med nor ldan no lo ke ba ntu ba rnya na yarnyi tā / / pra bra rdzu nā snu ba bye pa two 'jig rten na/ /gnyen byi 'ching bas bsdams rnams kyis/ /rab byung thob 'upa min pa nyid/ /khyod tu ke na ni bā ri tāḥ/ /so n+ya bed yadmed ri dra gya na pā tram̐ na tsa ṭī pa re/ /kyang su yis rnam par bzlog /des smras dbul po bdag la ni/ /lhung bzed med cing chos gos med//bha no pa ka ra ṇḍa bye ba sha mo pa ka ra ṇa n+ya pi/ /rā dza sru nu ri ti khru tā ga zhi ba'i yo byad dag la yang / /nor ni nye bar mkho ba nyid/ /rgyal po'i sras kyis de thos nas/ /thub tā mu ni ta po ba na/ /pra bra rghaṃ kā ra yi tā su pra da do pā tra ṭī pa re/ /pa'i dka' thub nags song ste/ /de ni rab tu 'byung bcug nas/ /lhung bzed chos gos rab tu byen//so tsi re ṇi ba kā le na yā taḥpra byu ka budha hūṃ/ /rā dza pu hūṃ sa ma bye yun ring min ⑥pa'i dus kyis de/ /rang sangs rgyas ni nyid gyur nas/ /rgyal po'i sras la mngon phyogs tya di bya mṛ dhi ma darsha ya ta / / ta su pra bha ba ma lokya sa pra da te—/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog rnams bstan par gyur/ /de yi mthu rnams mthong gyur nas/ /mi yi stibadag 95—253

bye dṛ pādma dzaḥ/ /a ho ma ho da ya tādme pra pra dzñā durla bhā bha bta/ /dā po'i sras des bsams/ /kye ma dar ba che nyid phyir/ /bdag la rab byung dkon par gyur/ /dbul ri dhya da bi bee kastso dī tsā nā ma pi durla bhā/ /dzā ye yo ya rya dha ma zhing rnam 'byed med las ni/ /dman rnams kyis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /des na dman rigs rnam ku le tasmra dasmi bi bee ka bān/ /sa e pa shā riḥ pu tro yo dzā tastata pra ṇi dha 'byed rmyedang / /ldan par bdag ni skye bar shog /de yi smon lam dag las ni 0/ /de nyid shā ri'i bu na taḥ/ /pra bra dzi to bha ga ba tā kā shya se nā n+ya dzadma ni/ /te nā 'dir skyes/ /skye ba gzhan du bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs kyis ni rab tu phyung khya/ /bden pa'i yo ni ya ma pri yi ṇi bi na yī sa myaspra sā do da yā dī diṣṭaḥku sha khā ya gter de nges par dgyes pas 'dul ldan 'di ni dge ba dag gi beed/ /yang dag rab tu dang ba rgyas pas satya ni bye nā pradzñā ba tā ma gra bhāḥ/ /kā le shākya mu nirbha bi ṣe ta ma taḥshi 6 twa yo dus su shes rab ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /shākya thub pa'i slob mar 'os pa dag las mchog tu bzhed par gāta pa ram̐ mo ṅgā lya ya ṇa e ṣa tsā tra ka thi ta ཿ sa mbidma yā rmā ba 'gyur bar bstan/ / mo gal bu 4'di'ang 'di ru gsungs zhes yang dag rig pa'i rang bzhin ldan rnams dāḥ / /a n+ya dzadma ni da ri dā kāmbi kaḥka na tsita pa da ya yā ma habhā shā/ /datta smra—/ /skye ba gzhan du dbul po las byed la2/ /drang srong chen po 'ga' zhig brtse ba yis/ /lhung pā tra ṭī pa ro bha bandadhi tadhi ra tu la pra bhā ba bān/ /i ti kṣe bzed chos gos dag ni byin gyur nas/ /mtshungs med rdzu 'phrul mthu yang rab tu bstan/ /zhes pa dge me nd+ra bee ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yi shā ri ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las shā ri'i pu tra pra bra dzñā ba dā nand+ra mo na bo sha tiḥpabee baḥ/ //bu rab tu byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu dgu pa'o// //95—254

sa ko pi pu sgyu ti sha yo da ya gya ba ra pra bhā ba pa ra ma kṣa yo yaḥ/ /gang yang mchog tu mi zad mthu ldan gang / /de ni bsod nams phul byung ①dar ba'i mchog /pra tyakṣaḥlaglaḥshu bha pakṣu sā kṣi dzadmarnya re lakṣa ṇa tā mu bai ti/ /ra bye mngon sum gyis mtshon dge ba'i phyogs kyi dbang / /skye gzhan mtshan nyid nyid du nye bar gyur/ /sngon tshe pu rā bha ga pa ti shā bahūṃ dze ta kā na ṣpe/ /a nā tha piṇḍa dā ra mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal/ /dga' bar ②mgon med zas sbyin rmi/ /kun dga' ra bar bcom ldan ma bi hā ri ṇi ta thā ga te/ /ba bhū ba bā sa ba grwa me ba la se 'das—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par gyur/ /khyim bdag stobs kyi sde zhes pa/ /grong ni nor nā bhe sgo kṛ tī/ /sgo ri tā shaḥpha la pta ribyu yo ta ru bi dhabee nā/ /las byung bar gyur/ /'bras bu'i tshogs kyis slong ba yi/ /phyogs rdzogs krugrib bsil ljon pa bzhin/ /dzā yā yī dza ya se nā yī ka le ka ma la lo tsa naḥ/ /a dzā ya ta su tasta gya de yi btsun mo rgyal sde la/ /dus su padma'i mig can gyi/ /bu zhig bsod nams dag gis btsas/ /pu byejusto i botpa baḥ/ /sa ha dzā ratna di partsi ra byuta karṇa gya kaṇi kā/ /dga' ba dag ni gzugs can bzhin/ /lhan skyes rin cen sgron ma'i 'od/ /de yi rna ba'i rna rgyan gyur//nā bhū ta rū lha tu la yā su he ma ko ṭi sha tai ra pi/ /shra ba ṇa nakṣa tra dzāto sau gser ni bye ba brgya yis kyang / /gang gis ④rin la mtshungs ma gyur/ /'di ni rgyu skar gro bzhin skyes/ /ratna ko rgyarta kaṇḍi kaḥ/ /sa sho ṇa ko ṭī karṇa khyaḥku mā ro khyuta gu kho tsi taḥ/ /sa ni1 rna ⑤rgyan rin cen bye ba ri/ /gro bzhin bye ba rna zhes de⑥/ /gzhon nu yon tan ldan par gyur/ /de ni ṣa ru tsiḥkāntaḥ ka la bhi pa ri pu ri taḥ/ /a mand+ra nanda ni 6ndi dri med gsal zhing mdzes/ /cha rnams kyis ni yongs su rdzogs/ /mi dman kun dga' rgyas gyur pa/ /na ka srend+ra ri bā bha bta/ /na yu bā bārya ma rto pi pi tā dha na da sadza dā/ /dza na su yi zla ba bzhin ma gyur/ /mig ni mchi ma ldan pa'i ma/ /mchog tu rtsub pa'i tshig dag gis/ /snyan smra 95—255

mbi sā khru na ya nā pa re pa byu ṣa yā gi rā/ /pri yaspa do pi nirbhaṣṭha bi yin yang smad bya stetsho/ /zla bas dug gi char phab bzhin/ /nor sbyin lta bur phun tshogs pa'i/ /pha ṣa ba dhī pa tsand+ra mā/ /ma hā sāze na ratna bee du ra dī panta ram̐ ya yis bzlog kyang gzhon nu de/ /rin cen don gnyer don mthun ni/ /chen pos gling gzhan rings par ④yo / /ma ka rā ka ra muṭīrya pra dza tasta gya nirdza ṣpe/ /karmormi bi bla song / /chu srin 'byung gnas rab bsgral nas/ /skye bo med pa'i lam bgrod de/ /las kyi rlabs kyis bee nā byuta swa pārja bi ra ha pa thi/ /sāsgo pi ta ma nā sā rya bi ni rnam 1 basbad pas/ /rang gi don mthun bral ④bar gyur/ /don mthun gyis kyang de ma rnyed/ /mya ngan thrattaḥshu tsā sha ṣpeḥ/ /swa de sha maspru taḥgre shaḥbra bi be sha bi shri kha laḥ/ /gyis zlog ⑤dal bu yis/ /nyon mongs bsgrubs nas rang yul du/ /'ching dang bral bar rab tu zhugs/ /po pi tapta ma ru she bhā lakṣa rde dakṣi bhā di shaṃ/ /shāntaḥpra shanta bi shārnyirpā de yang ngal zhing ngal gso ༷dang / /rab tu bral bas chu tshogs brgal/ /gdung ba'i mya ngan 'phreng ⑦ba pi gā ha bya gā ha ta / / so tsinta ya da ho bi ste pa ti pi tta dzdza yis—/ /mtshan pa lto yi ⑤phyogs su song / /des bsams nor ni chen po dag /yod la nor sgrub ⑨la nodma maḥ/ /ma mā ya mā na ye ṣpe ba dzā ta kle sha pa lo da yaḥ/ /a ho brtson pa/ /nyon mongs 'bras bu dar ba 'di⑩ / /bdag gi tshul min nyid kyis ⑪bskyed/ /mi rnams dha nārdza nā be shaḥsarnyo ṣa bi ra nāta dṛ rde/ /sarpā pa ba da saṃ bā da kau rya chog shes bral ba las/ /kye ma nor sgrub la 'jug pa/ /gnod pa thams cad 'byung ba yis/ /smad 'os dzā bi pa dzā pa rda/ /he mā tsa le pi sa pābhe na paryasterbha nardza ṣpe/ /rgud pa dag gi ( —5gnas/ /'khor bar nor ni sgrub rngo 3pa la/ /bag chags goms las lus can rnams/ /saṃ sā re bā sa nā bhya sā de ṣa mo haḥsha rī ri rde/ /thra thu pra yā sa bi ra sā rmongs pa 'di ni gser gyi ri/ /thob kyang yongs su tshim pa med/ /ngal dub rab rgyas ro dang bral/ /95—256

dibhā shri ri bā yata/ /trobye ta no ti ni ta rā mi yo ma ru ma tī ma 'og gi mya ngam ①sa gzhi 'di/ /'bar ba'i dpal bzhin rings par duni/ /bdag gi sred pa rab rgyas la—/ /a ho ba ta ku ram̐ gā ṇa dṛṭīnt+ra na pa de pa de/ /ma me bi dza na byed②—/ /kye ma gnas dang gnas rnams su/ /ri dwags skom pas long ba bzhin/ /mya ngam ④ gyi ni yabye ta mo haṃ ma ru ma rī tsi kā/ /i yo dṛṭī shra maspru ya mi mā ni byug rgyu yis/ /bdag la rmongs pa bskyed pa nyid/ /skom pa 'di dang ngal ba 'dis/ /chu ni med pa'i ru da gā ju baḥ/ /ki ka ro mi kwa gasgo mi pa shā mi dzwa li tā di shaḥ/ /i ti saṃ sa gzhi ni⑤/ /phyogs ni 'bar bar bdag gis mthong / /ci zhig bya zhing gang du 'gro/ /de ltar bsams ⑥tsi tya pa sha ṣpeḥpra sarban sha li lā sha yā/ /ā yā sa mi bā sā kā rja da darsha shing dal bus de/ /chu yi bsam pas song ba na/ /ngal dub rnam pa dang bcas bzhin/ /lcags kyi grong pu ra mā ya paṃ/ /sgo ram̐ dā ri sbi tai ta re paṃ tras gye ba sod ram̐/ /da khyer mthong bar gyur/ /shin tu skrag pa'i spun zla bzhin/ /'jigs su rung ba'i skyes bu ni/ / dus darsha pu ru ṣe kā le ka rā lo rakta lo tsa rgo/ /sa te na thraṣṭaḥpā bhā yo ltar rtag ⑦cing mig dmar ba/ /sgo der gnas pa mthong bar gyur/ /de yis de la btung ba dris/ /ya dā no bā tsa ki tsa na/ /ta dā swa yi pra bikhye na pre ta lo ko bi lo ki taḥ/ /gang tshe ci yang mi smra ba/ /de tshe rang nyid nang zhugs pas/ /yi dwags 'jig rten rnam par mthong / /dagha kāsgo pa rmā dhū lbo ma la libhāmbi rasba rān/ /puṅgāsbi rtswa yu she rus pa chu rgyus lhag lus bskams du / /gos med rdul byu 'phreng bas gos/ /shing bsregs lta bu'i yi ྾ gān pre tān dṛṭī sa bi bya the/ /tairyā tsi taḥs pā ni yo pā ni ya bi dwags rnams/ /mthong bas de ni gdung bar gyur/ /chu dang bral bas gzir de la/ /de dag gis ⑨ni ra hārdi taḥ/ /pa ri tya dza ni dzā māsto ma khyuttadruḥkha duḥkhi taḥ/ /tī bra chu bslangs pas/ /rang gi gdung ba yongs btang ste/ /de yi sdug bsngal gyis gzir gyur/ /gdung ba 95—257

tre: tu rā nu tse sa te nārta pra lnga pi naḥ/ /ma māsmidma ru kāddhā ra niḥkṛ rab smra skom pa ni/ /drag pos gzir de la des smras/ /brtse med bdag la mya ngam ①gyi/ /dgon pa pa gya ku taḥpa yaḥ/ /kṛsgo smin duḥkha sa he n+yastuḥke yu yo ke na karma shā/ /'dir ni chu gang las/ /khyed su las ni ci zhig gis/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'di la bkod/ /yuṣṭhad prakri yā ba rnyabya taḥ kṛtstsha twa re tra haṃ / /ni dā niḥsha lya khyed rnams phyir bcos 'bras med pas du/ /'di las bdag rgo mya ngan byed/ /gzir ba ma mthong mthong kalpa su su kha seste ba ta su yaḥ/ /nārtan pa shya ti dṛṭī bā te ṣe gre sha yang gang / /de dag nyon mongs 'joms bzod pa/ /zug rngu med par brtag pa de'i/ /gnyid ni bde kṣa ye kṣa maḥ/ /te ta mū tsubee rusne na karma rja kṛ ta sharma rja/ /a ni bas bran pa bzhin/ /de la des smras bdag cag ni/ /thar med ma snyiyin 'gal ba'i las rmongs pa baju ba yo mjuḥkṣibhā bya pa na saṃ ka ṭi/ /a bye kṣe pākhye pa kṣa las ni rab bsags pa④/ /gdung ba mi bzad gnas su 'phangs/ /lhag par smod cing smod pas gzhan pi ta pa ra hai rlend+ra da bha rā da nā ma sthā se ste bya sa na bhi ra gyi bstan pa nyams byas rgyags pa rgyas ⑤pa las/ /'phags pa min zhing phrag dog dag gis gdung ba rnam bārya bya ti ka riḥ/ /kṛ tāsthā bhirni hye su dza na z-i da ye nirda ya ta yā par brtson pa ma bzlog pa/ /bdag cag rnams ni brtse ba med pas skye bo legs pa'i snying la rtag tu ni//ba tso bhirtswa rā tsibee ṣa pa ri tsi taiḥshā lya ka la nā/ /da rna na daddhā z-i ta me tshig gi lcags mda' dug gis yongs su bsgos pas zug rngu rab tu zug par byas/ /sbyin pa ma byin nor ni ba tsihaṃ ho sā ni mistso kṛ ta me ba tsitrī/ /asmra bye ram̐ gibee hi tā bi kā rāḥphrogs pa nyid/ /'tshe ba'i slad du sems ni byas pa nyid/ /bdag cag lus kyis gzhan gyi chung ma dag /pa ra gya dā rā pa dzdza ti pra kā raḥ/ /te ba yo ku ha kā shaghra dakṣuḥgru dre 'phrog pa'i rnam 'gyur rab tu byed pa bsgrubs/ /de dag dman pa la chags shing / /ngan pa'i las la 95—258

6 karma su/ /pra yā ta pre ta na ga re gho re smin kle sha pā tra tai/ /mkhas gyur pa①/ /yi dwags grong khyer 'jigs rung 'dir/ /bdag cag nyon mongs snod nyid gyur/ /i ti te ྾ ba tsaḥshu tā so n+ya tra tsa ta thā bi dhan/ /pre tān dṛṭī na bye pre ta nā de dag tshig de des thos shing / /gzhan du'ang rnam pa de lta yi④/ /yi dwags mngon par mi 'dod pa//ka ru ṇa ku li to bha bta/ /nirga mya durga māttasmra ta pu rāta pu rgya ba le mthong nas snying rje rgyas par gyur/ /ngan 'gro'i grong khyer de las ni/ /bsod nams stobs kyis thon na saḥ/ /bi ma lo shī ta latstsha ya mā sa sā da ba nānta re/ /a tha du rā dhwa saṃ nas de/ /dri med grib ma bsil ba yi/ /nags kyi nang du phyin par gyur/ /de nas lam ring gis taptaḥpa ri shantaḥsha ṣpeḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /ni pa pā tā tsa lā dalja tro ṇḍa ṭwā dub cing / /yongs ngal dal bu dal bu yis/ /skom pas yongs gdungs long ba bzhin/ /'od byed ri i ba bhaska raḥ/ /di ṣpe pu rgya i ba spyi bee ni she ṣā shā pra kwa sha ke/ /las lhung bar gyur/ /ma lus phyogs rnams gsal byed pa'i/ /bsod nams bzhin du nyin zad tshe/ /saṃ mo ha ma li rgo lo ke ta maḥpā pa mi bodma yo/ /li na j-i ga bi haṃ gā ram̐ kun ①rmongs nag po'i mun pa dag /'jig rten du ni sdig bzhin byung / /bya dang bung ba chags gyur pa//na li — dzā pra saṃ gi bhā/ /bi kā sha saṃ pa dā mu dā ni dre ba sa ma dzā ya padmo can gyi phun tshogs rgya④/ /rnam rgyas rab tu 'grogs pa yis⑤ / /gnyid bzhin yang dag byung bar ta—/ /kā ru rgya di ba shī hūṃ shu byebyā mṛ ta sha lā ka yā/ /smra ra tā ram̐ dza gyur—/ /snying rjes ⑥las bzhin bsel zer gyi/ /zla 'od bdud rtsi'i thur ma yis/ /rab gsal skar ma garje tram̐ tsakre bi ti mi re ta taḥ/ /kṣa yo da ya pa rā bṛrte dargo ta ṣpe ka 'gro ba'i mig /de nas rab rib bral bar byas/ /'khor ba nyin mo nub mo yi/ /'char nub gzhan du bi bhra oṃ/ /saṃ sā ra di na yā midmordza hā se ba su dhwa ka raḥ/ /ṣpe tra nanda gyur pa dag /rnam 'phrul du ma mthong ba las⑦/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od ni rgod ⑧pa bzhin/ /mig ni kun 95—259

su dhwa bakṣe su kha sga le ni shā ka re/ /disba dhū ba da na dasgo hakṣe dga'i bdud rtsi'i char/ /reg bde mtshon kha/byed phyogs kyi ni/ /bu mo'i bzhin gyi me long dag /dga' mū ṭwā i bo di te/ /sho ṇa ko ṭi da dasgye gre bi mā na mā na rgo dku teḥ/ /ba gzugs can bzhin shar tshe/ /ltad mo la ni gzhan gzugs kyis/ /mtho ris sa la 'ongs pa yis 0//kau tu kā da n+ya byu pa ṇa swargata bhu ba mi bā ga tai/ /tasminda pa shyatpa ma mdzes pa'i gdong bzhin gzhal yas khang / /gro bzhin ①bye bas mdun du mthong / /der ni lha yi bu mo dībya ta srast+ri da shrī gā nā/ /di sha:rjo da yā nanda bi ha ra ye ba dag /rgyags pa dang bcas bzhi mthong ste/ /zla ba shar ba'i kun dga' dang / /rnam par rtse phyir saṃ ga tāḥ/ /tā shā ma bye ba rā kā ram̐ ra ma mā ṇi ba lo ka yata/ /ta 'grogs pa bzhin/ /de dbus mchog gi rnam pa can/ /dga' ba dang ldan mthong gyur te/ /gzhon ru ṇa pre ma saṃ bha ra mi ba sā kā ra hūṃ ga tā ཿ / /nu'i dga' ba'i tshogs rnams dag /rnam bcas nyid du gyur pa bzhin/ /rin cen rna rgyan ces nas bos par gyur ra tna ku ṇḍa la ke yu ra ki rī ṭi ka tsi dzā gyi bar tshigs bcad gsum dhacha pā las 'gyur chad bsabs pa'o/ /rin chen rna rgyan dpung rgyan dang / /zur phud 'od shu bhiḥ/ /ā li khanta mi ba:rya ma marlu rda di shaṃ mu khe/ /ta zer ring po yi/ /mtshams las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar dag /phyogs kyi gdong la 'dri ba bzhin/ /der su tā mabye hūṃ dṛṭī saṃ sgo ga su kha saṃ pa rda/ /me na sa su kṛ tā khya ni legs byas las byung ba'i/ /ljon shing rgyas pa'i 'bras bu'i dpal/ /longs spyod bde ba phun sum su ta ro spyi shā pha la shri yo/ /spru tyā te na kṛ tā ti juḥswā du pā nā sha tshogs—/ /rmad byung de dag mthong bar gyur/ /de nas gro bzhin bye ba rna④/ /de dag dga' bas nā di rnyiḥ/ /hūṃ sgo ṇa ko ṭi kazlo tha ni nā ya ra dza shlau su khaṃ/ /tā rā mgron gnyer de/ zhim pa'i (shebaza' btung dag la ni/ /mtshan mo bde bar bos par gyur/ /de nas 95byed260

kṛ ti pa shu pā la kaḥ/ /pa shu dzā rmā sa muskṛ tya bi shrī tai sa ta tai ma sdig can phyugs dag skyong bar gyur/ /rtag tu bdag gis ①phyugs rnams kyi/ /sha la rab tu bcad nas yā / /piṇḍa pā tā ya saṃ pāsto mā maryaḥka ru rja ni dhiḥ/ /kā tyā ya nā khyuḥbatsongs( bye—/ /kā tyā ya na zhes 'phags pa/ /snying rje'i gter ni bsod snyoms la/ /byon pas bdag la pro bā tsa bi ra mā ta ku karma ṇaḥ/ /ho sā ma yaḥpra yā so yo duḥrab gsungs pa/ /las ngan 'di las rnam par log /bab col tshol ba'i nyon mongs rnams①/ /'tshe sa haḥs ha se ṣe rde/ /swa sha rī re ba ta hye ba stsonda mū la i ba dru maḥ/ /ba'i rang bzhin bzod dka' 'di/ /rtsa ba bcad pa'i ljon shing ④ bzhin/ /rang gi lus la rtsang ba nyid//i tyā haṃ bārya ma rto pi te na nātyāḥkṛ pātna na/ /ya dā na bi ra taḥpā pātta de ltar bdag nyid bzlog gyur kyang / /gang tshe sdig las ma log pa/ /de tshe 'phags min la brtse ba/ /dā sa pra ha rmā su naḥ/ /di bā two ku ru se ho saṃ saddhā thā ya di nirda yaḥ/ /de yis bdag la slar gsungs pa/ /gal te rnam kun brtse med khyod/ /nyin par dag ni 'tshe ba byos/ /ra dro shī la sa mā dā dzwa kṛ hā ṇa sa ma yāta ma ma/ /i kyughra te na yasne mtshan mo dag ⑤gi dam tshig las/ /tshul khrims sdom pa yang dag long / /sems can kun la phan bzhed na sa rbha sa twa nyi te ṣi shā / / da ṭwā shrī la sa mā dā na ma pa—/ /de yis 'bad pas de dubarjod nas/ /tshul khrims brang ba'i ⑦rang bzhin gyis④/ /bsod yī pu rgya ma tirma ma/ /kā le na ka la ba sha gaḥshāpta so ha mi rmā da nams blo gros bdag la gnang / /dus kyis dus kyi dbang song ste/ /bdag gis gnas skabs 'di dag shaṃ / / ta dzñā ga ra su dhwa barṣa ri ba kidzā di bā ni shaṃ/ /ra tro thob—/ /sol tshan bdud rtsi'i 6)char dag gis/ /nyin dang mtshan ni gtams pa bzhin/ /mtshan mo shi la sa mā dā na pha lo ho mā pha lo di ṣpe/ /masna mi pu bye pā pā tshul khrims blangs 'bras dang / /nyin par dag ni 'tshe ba'i 'bras/ /bdag spyod bsod nams sdig pa 95—262

bye pa ti taḥsu kha duḥkha yoḥ/ /ta gya me ku ru kā ru bye sa khe ka lu ṣa ka ri yis—/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dag tu dor⑫ / /bdag ni sdig pa byed de la/ /grogs po yis ni snying rje ṇaḥ—/ /ga twa swa de shaṃ ma ta pu tram̐ bru hi māta ba tsa sā ra haḥ/ /aste ma mdzod—/ /rang yul song nas bdag tshig gis/ /dben kwapar bdag gi bu la sgos/ /bdag gi khang kṛ ha ko nārnye ni khā tai te ma bhā dza ram̐/ /ta durje tya pa ri tyakta bā pā thratta pa'i zur mtha' na/ /gser gyi snod ni sbas nas yod/ /de ni phyung la sdig pa dag /yongs su gtong pi dhī ya hūṃ/ /ārya kā tyā ya no ni hye piṇḍa pā te na pū bye hūṃ/ /i kyuktaste ba'i bya ba sgrubs⑦ / /'phags pa kā tyā ya na ni/ /rtag tu bsod snyoms dag gis mchod/ /de ni ④dul na bi ṣpe yāta ta tho tyākta dza kā ma saḥ/ /sa da darsha bra dzan di bya baṃ mā bas de brjod tshe/ /de yis de bzhin zhes smras ⑤song / /de ni song bas mdun dudag tu/ /lha yi na ma ba rā bu naḥ/ /rasna pā tra la tā kādzñā dī tī ya mi ba nanda rna/ /gzhal yas khang pa gzhan/ /rin cen padma 'khri shing mdzes/ /dga' tshal gnyis pa lta bu mthong / /tasmin sī ga mi bā āoṃ gi saṃ ga lta di bya yo ṣi tā/ /a sa shyabye ba rā raste 6 der ni nyin mo rtsom pa nas⑦/ /lus med dang 'grogs lus can dubazhin/ /lha mo dag dang skyes bu ni//pu ru ṣa ratna khyu ṣi tai/ /te na sī tyā dā re ṇa kṛ tā ti byasta dzee ba saḥ/ /rin po che yis ⑨brgyan pa mthong / /de yis pyabade ba'i yo byad kyis/ /de bzhin nyid du der gus byas//di rmā ni nā ya dīrghadhwa kle sha ma bye su dhwa ma yo/ /a tha byo ma bi mā lam ring nyon mongs dbus su ni/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyin mo bzlas/ /de nas nam mkha'i gzhal no grwa ta pa nyi te padme mbi pa to/ /a pūrya ya ta dzā gā ta gho ri med (mekhang / /rtse nas pad ldan bdag lhung ⑫tshe/ /sdug bsngal gyis bzhin 'jigs rung gis⑫/ /mun ruḥkhe ri ba ta mo bha riḥ/ /ta taḥkṣa pā pa ti byetram̐ ba ma na ra sa tā dza ḍaḥ/ /pa'i khur gyis 'gro ba khyab⑫/ /de nas mtshan bdag zla ba'i 'od/ /sgyug cing nyams ldan nyid kyis bsil/ /95—263

sa na kaiḥpāṇḍa ro gī ba go radku ti dṛ shya ta/ /su ku mā re di nā lo kṣa 'od zer dkar ldan rim gyis ni/ /skye bo'i nad pa bzhin du mthong / /nyin mo'i snang ba shin tu ①gzhon/ /pa rākṣa sa yo ṣi tā/ /bhakṣi te lakṣa ta sha shī ka pā la da la sambi mtshan mo srin po'i dubud med kyis/ /zos pa'i thod pa'i dum bu bzhin/ /ri bong can ni ①snang bar bhaḥske/ /byaste tsadhri ka yā lo ke kā la tsanda na tsartsa yā/ /bi mā na ma ga gyur—/ /'jig rten dus kyi tsan dan gyis/ /byugs ④pa zla 'od dag gis khyab/ /gzhal yas khang dang ma ta krā pi sā tsa swarga mṛ ge kṣa rja/ /bi mā na pa ti taḥso pi pu ru ṣaḥsand+ra mtho ris kyi/ /ri dwags mig ni ga shed song / /gzhal yas khang nas skyes bu de/ /lhung bar gyur cing rū pa yā/ /sha ṣpeḥsapta bhi rā brteḥsha ta pa byā bi beeji ta taḥ/ /sā ta sbrul gzugs kyi/ /rtse spyobargya pas ni rim pa yis/ /lan bdun dkris shing rnam par bcings/ /de yi su rūrje bi ba re kri tā masteska sho ṇi tai/ /ā swā da ya: sha na kebya kā ra shu ṣi spyi bor bu ga pya dag /de yis byas nas klad pa khrag /za bar byed cing rim pa yis/ /mgo bo dag ni ram̐ shi raḥ/ /a thā ru ṇa ga ratstshanda sorsā pa ba da ṣpe di ṣpe/ /tshags mar byas/ /de nas skya rengs ⑦zer gyis bkab/ /nyin mo yi ⑧ni bzhin gsos shing / /bī bhatpa darsha na kle sha di ba sbo li ta tā ra ke/ /pā du rā sa na pu 'jigs rung mthong ba'i nyon mongs las/ /skar ma rnams ni mig zums ⑨tshe/ /yang ni lha yi gzhal nardi bya bi mā rna sā tsa kā mi ni/ /yu bā sa tsādku ta ta nu di bya bha ra ṇa byu ṣi yas khang / /lha mo de dang gzhon nu de'ang / /ma zad lus can lha yi ni/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa ⑩rab tu taḥ / /thrasbyo ti bigrwa yāste na swa thrattadha dza gā da saḥ/ /dī dzo haṃ bā sa byung / /shin tu mtshar la des ⑪dris shing / /rang gi spyod mtha' de yis bshad/ / nor las byung ba'i ba gā ma ni bā sī ma na sā bhi dhaḥ/ /ta ru bhā pā ti bi shya su pa mbi grong gnas pa'i/ /⑫gnyis skyes bdag ni yid ces bya/ /khyim mtshes ⑫dag gi chung ma ni/ /gzhon nu 95—264

ma la ya mañdza ri/ /a bhū ta ma ma bhū dza ga su swe ri ddhā balla bhā j-i shaṃ/ /pa ra tsan dan dog pa ma/ /g.yem ma lag 'gro bdag gi ni/ /shin tu yid du 'ong bar gyur/ /grong du da ra ra tergu me bya gā me ṣa ma terma ti/ /ni masthā bi ṣa ya krā me sa gzhan gyi chung mar dga'/ /lug blo 'khrugs pa dag rmyegi blo/ /mtha' dag yul gyi grong du ni/ /nges ma grwa me kṣa ya ga tā/ /ārya kā tyā ya naḥpā paṃ dzñā twa oṃ tsorya kā mu par byings shing ②brlag par gyur/ /'phags pa kā tyā ya nas bdag /'dod pa'i chom rkun sdig shes rka /da yā bi dhe yaḥka ru shā ta thra bā tsa bi dza ṣpe sha naiḥ/ /pa dzā ga nas—/ /brtse ba'i dbang gi ④snying rje las/ /skye bos dben par dal bus gsungs/ /blun po gzugs dzā ga saṃ saṃ ga spru tyā rū pa ra teḥkṣa yi/ /a rna gāsgo sa targhaṃ ga pa dga' gzhan gyi ni/ /bud med lus 'grogs dga' ba yis/ /lus med me la bye ngum leb 'bab tai ga i ba ma ga maḥ/ /sākta raghra dzā pa ta na sra ma di ram̐/ /bzhin brlag ⑤par ma 'gro zhig /kye ma 'dod chags la chags dang / /bag med rab tu lhung 'ub dag /kā mi rmā ho sa kā rghaṃ tsa pa ra da rā da raḥpa ram̐/ /shwa pa sra ma pa thra 'dod ldan 'tshe ba po dag las/ /gzhan 'joms chung mar gus pa mchog /sdang dang ngal dub che bar thu bee pa thu bee hwa la rna kṛ dzñā ga na mu kha ni khā ta na khā kṣa ta 'dar bas rnam par 'khrugs gyur cing / /bya rgod bud med kyis pyani sos rmugs khyasen mos nyams par rmā / /saṃ mo ha ṣpe pa ra ba dhū bi hi ta smṛ ha rde ro rmā tsa ka ri ṇi byed| /gzhan gyi chung mar dga' bsgrub ⑨rnams kyi spu zing byed pa yis⑫ / /kun tu rmongs pa dang ni pa ram̐ na ra ke tsa kā maḥ/ /tasmra dasmra: brta swa batpa kutrī ta karma ṇaḥ/ /dmyal ba'ang 'dod pa mchog /de slad mnyes gshin ngan pa yi spe/ /las 'di las ni phyir log khyod⑫//dzā ya te pā ta ka spasgo shu nā me ba shu tso ra tiḥ/ /i tya haṃ kṛ pa ya ti na mi gtsang sdig pa'i reg pa la/ /khyi rnams kho na dga' bar 'gyur/ /de skad de yis brtse bas bdag /95—265

ni ṣidhi bya shudhe dhīḥ/ /a ni rudhe na rā ge ṇa ba dhestu me ba nā tyabakag kyang rnam par ma dag blo/ /ma 'gags pa yi chags pa yis/ /bsdams pas de nyid btang ① ma dzee / /bi dzñā yā mā ma bi ra tai ta taḥkā tyā ya no da do/ /ma hūṃ bhā la sa mā byas—/ /de nas bdag gis ma gtang ba/ /mkhyen nas kā tyā ya nas ni/ /nyin mo'i spyod la phan da rgo di na tsarya hi todma taḥ/ /di ni shī la sa mā dra nā ta sa brtson pas/ /bdag la tshul khrims blang ba gnang / /tshul khrims yang dag blangs las ④nyin/ /gzhan ra byā ga ma nāndi shi/ / i ya dzre pu rgya pā pottha su kha duḥ kha ma gyi bud med bgrod las mtshan/ /bsod nams sdig las bskyed nas ni⑤/ /bde sdug rang bzhin du yī sbi tiḥ/ /ga te na bā sa ba gā oṃ bā tsuḥbu tro ma ma twa ya/ /su barṇa bdag gnas/ /nor las byung ba'i grong du khyod/ /song nas bdag gi ⑦bu la smras⑧/ /me yi gnas mabyā sha lā yā masnyi gu dngha dzdza ti ma yā/ /dṛbhiḥkāryā ta durje ta pū bye kā tya ya na bdag gis ni/ /gser dag sbas te bzhag nas yod/ /de byung 'tsho bar bubya ba dang / /kā tyā ya na na: saḥ/ /pra ṇa yā di nyi te nobeeḥsho ṇa ko ṭi ya yo ta taḥ/ /so pa shyaji pya de yang mchod/ /de yis gus pas de skad brjod/ /de nas gro bzhin bye ba song / /de yis mdun du la la nā ma gre ma ṇi bi mā na tsā/ /lasmri khā ba rgya duddhā ste ra nā yā nor bu yi/ /gzhal med ⑫khang gnas lha mo mthong / /mdzes sdug 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /ngal dub med soṅga two i ba/ /ta su bi mā na pā de 6 tsa tukhyo rtswa yu paṃ yu tai/ /bskrun dpal mo bzhin/ /de yi ḍa/1gzhal yas khang pa yi/ /rkang pa bzhi yortel yi dwags bzhi/ /sa da darsha ti durdarghaṃ badhe pre ta tsa tuṣṭa yo/ /sā pi tai pra tya bhi dzñā ya btags pa lta ⑫na mi sdug cing / /chu rgyus ldan pa de yis mthong / /des kyang de ni rab shes nas/ /saṃ bhā 6 sdisna yā gi rā/ /su ro tsi tai da do tasmi ra sa bta pā na sgo dza rgo/ /mdza' ba'i tshig gis yang dag bshad/ /lha la 'os pa'i btung ba dang / /ro ldan bza' ba de la byen//95—266

bhu dzā na saṃ rnye yā dru rā ta pre tairde bye na yā tsi taḥ/ /sa da do kṛ pa yā te bhyaḥza tshe yi dwags rnams kyi brdas/ /snying rje rje zhing ①ring nas bslangs/ /de yi )brtse bas de rnams lal / /kā ke bhya i ba piṇḍa kāḥ/ /piṇḍa bu ṣa twa me ka su pra yā ta n+ya gya lo bya rog la bzhin gzan chang gebyin/ /gcig gi gzan chang phub mar ⑤gyur/ /gzhan byi lcags kyi tho ha tsā/ /swa rmā saste tre tī ya gya tsa turja snga pra pū ya hūṃ/ /bi lo kya ta1 lum dang / /gsum pa yi ⑨ni rang sha nyid/ /bzhi pa'i khrag dang rnag nyid gyur/ /de mthong de dag pa bi ṣṭaḥ sa te ṣe kaṣṭa tseṣṭa yā/ / sapra tstsha ta mu khasgo yā bitstsha yi sdug bsngal gyi/ /spyod pas snying rje ldan gyur des/ /bzhin gyi ( padma mdzes pa dag /mdzes bral byas kṛ ta paṃ ka rdzu/ /sa te na thraṣṭa tattatta ma tsa tsakṣe mṛ ge kṣa rja/ /na sgo ṇa ko ṭi pa de la dris/ /de yis rmad byung de dris pas⑨/ /ri dwags mig can de yis lngasmras/ /gro bzhin bye rna ka rte ྾ da trī bha ba ti tre bee ye/ / prahma ṇa snga gya bhā ryā haṃ pūza 'di dag la/ /byen pas 0tshim pa'i don mi 'gyur/ /nor las byung ba'i grong gnas pa/ /bram ze pā dā lo bi naḥ/ /nanda nāsnaḥsu nanda khyu bā sa ba gā ma bā se naḥ/ /dga' ba zhes pa ni/ /dang po'i rkang pa la brten ⑫'di'i/ /chung ma rab dga' zhes pa bdag ⑫ /dī tī ya pa de saṃ saktaḥpu tro me niju rā bhi dhaḥ/ /pa:tyā dā ba lo bee no gnyis pa'i rkang pa la btags pa ④/ /bu ni gos med ces pa yin/ /rkang pa gzhan la btags ⑩'di dā spru tse yi sngu ṣa tsa me/ /nakṣa tra yo ga pū dzā dzee pu dzā sadzhai kṛ te dag /bdag gi 'bang ⑪mo mna' ma yin/ /rgyu skar sbyor ba'i mchod pa la/ /zas kyi nye ⑫sbyor bdag ma yā/ /sgosgo pa ha re me ge ha maryaḥkā tyā ya no bi shata/ /ma yā tsitta gis sngonaX/ / /legs par byas tshe bdag khyim du/ /'phags pa kā tyā ya 3na byon/ /bdag sems rab pra sā di snge pi ṇḍa pā te na sortsi ta ཿ / / kudzee mbi ba ya yo kādhyā tu dang ldan pasarte / /bsod snyoms kyis ni de la mchod/ /mdzes pas phyogs rnams dri med kyis 0/ /95—267

bai ma lya nu gra haṃ di shaṃ/ / ta taḥsna tā sa mā yā tathoṇḍi pa ti ra rjes su bzung ba mdzad bzhin gshegs/ /de nas bdag gi bdag po 'di/ /khrus byas mgyogs par yang yasma ma/ /ta྾ṇḍa pā ta mā kasbya pra mo da ya ma yo di tai/ /ko pā dag 'ongs/ /rab tu dga' slad bdag gis smras/ /bsod snyoms phul ba de thos nas/ /khro las du bā tsa rmā kasmra byi shi khaḥshra ma ṇaḥsha ṭhaḥ/ /a pū dzi te 6 pū byi 6 bdag smras mchod 'os rnams/ /mchod pa med par dge sbyong ni/ /skra med g.yo ldan gra phub (/)'os/ /bu ṣārdaḥpū dzi tasta yā/ /i ti mo hā da ṣpe noste pu tro bye ṣa dza gā da rmā/ /khyod kyis ci yi phyir du mchod/ /rmongs las 'di yis de ke byebarjod tshe/ /de bzhin bus kyang bdag la smras//pā ke pūdrwa sha na yo gyaḥs kind+rashātya yo gu ḍā ṇa/ /i yo snu ṣā me sa ta tai tshos pa thog mar za 'os te/ /lcags kyi tho 1lum cis mi za/ /bdag gi mna' ma 'di rtag tu/ /sngon pūttha bha kṣu ba lo ki bhā/ /ma yokta sha pa dzee tsa kre swa rmā sā da na pā di mbi/ /i la zas la longs spyod cing / /bdag gis brjod la mna' byed pa/ /rang sha za zhes smra ba mo/ /'bang ④yi tsa dā sī sgokṣu khaṃ tsorluta bya ya kā ri ṭwā/ /ā kṣibhā sa bye na ka ro ta pū ya mo 'di yang zas dag la/ /rku zhing nyams pa dag tu byed/ /smad tshe bden par byed pa ni/ /rnag khrag sho ṇi ta bā di rmā/ /ta tra te pre ta hūṃ yā tāḥswa bākya sa dri shā sa nāḥ/ /a haṃ za zhes smra byed yin/ /de dag yi dwags 'di dag gyur/ /rang gi ngag dang mtshungs pa ⑤za/ /bdag ni twarya pra sā de na di bya sgo go sa sgo gi mbi/ /twa yā swa de she nāste na 'phags pa'i bka' drin rmis/ /lha yi longs spyod nye bar spyod/ /khyod kyis rang yul phyin nas ni/ /bakta bya du hi tām ma/ /sarnyi he ma ni dā nā ni kṛ he tsa twa ri te pi tuḥ/ /ta bdag gi bu mo dag la wīsmros/ /khyod kyi pha yi mu khang pa na/ /gser gyi gter ni rnam bzhi yod/ /de rgyu dhri tya ya thā yo shaṃ bha dza swa swa dzadmasbi 1/ /pū dza byā yaḥpi tuddhā tu dag thon la ci rigs par/ /rang gi skye ba gnas par byos/ /pha dang ming po'i ming 23dag gis/ /kā 95—268

na: kā tyā ya naḥs dā/ /swa sho ṇa ko ṭī karṇa ste gatstsha de shaṃ tya dza shra rma/ /barṣa tyā ya na rtag tu mchod①/ /gro bzhin bye ba'i rna ba khyod/ /rang yul du song ngal ba thong / /khyod ni dā da sha saṃ pūrṇaḥswakṛ hā dzre rga ta su te/ /i kyughā sā mā di shya ta rang yul ayonas 'thon nas/ /lo ni bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs/ /de skad brjod nas de yis ni/ /yi gya pre ta tsa tuṣṭa yo/ /subee sri ba rū snuste shābhe ma kā ra ya ta/ /u྾ dwags bzhi po la bsgos te/ /nyal ba nyid na yud tsam gyis/ /de ni rang yul phyin par byas/ /de yang taḥso pi sa ha sā swa de shodma na kā na nāta/ /bi yo ga sho kāta pi ta ro shu shā 'phral la rang yul gyi/ /skyed mos tshal gyi nags las srilangs/ /pha ma bral ba'i mya ngan gyis/ /long la ban dhya mu ba ga to/ /bhekṣu dī dzā ti thi ga ṇi pū bye mā ṣpe su ra la ye/ /nye bar gyur pa srithos/ /dge slong gnyis skyes mgron po'i tshogs/ /lha yi gnas rnams mchod byed pa//swa kai pi tro di āoṃ dṛṭī pa ram̐ bisma ya mā ya yo/ /nistsa tya sabaṃ bhā bā dzā rang gi pha yi khyim mthong nas/ /mchog tu ya mtshan dag tu gyur/ /skad cig nyid phyir dngos po kun/ /kṣa ṇi ka tā da ni tya tsā/ /ste ha rā gi sa muskṛ bye ta dāsthaḥs ma tsitta mi rtag nyid du nges byas nas/ /mdza' dang chags pa kun btang ste/ /der ni gnas pas yang dag yata / /a ho saṃ mo na ni dre yo nirba kā ra ma di bā ni shaṃ/ /swasna mā yā baṃ bsams—/ /kye ma nyin mtshan mtha' med par/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i gnyid 'di ni/ /mi lam sgyu ma'i khā se tai ka ro tyabye ta bi khyu maḥ/ /dzadma baṭwā pra pā ma tā bi tā bī rol rtsed kyis/ /rmad du byung ba'i rnam 'phrul byed/ /skye ba'i lam rab ster ba'i ma/ /sa bon 'debs dza sha gya ta kha gaḥ/ /band+ra pū dzā sa rna kā yaḥko yi ni ya ma saṃ ga maḥ/ /nus bya 'dra'i ⑥pha/ /mgron po'i mchod dang stan lta'i lus/ /'di la nges pa'i tshogs ni gang / /shri yaḥ saṃ sā rā bhra bhra ma pa ri tsi tā rmā tsa na ru rtsa ṣṭa di ghā dpal 'byor 'khor ba'i sprin rum 'khyams 8byepar yongs 'dris gser gyi sred pa'i 'od/ /re ba phyogs 95—269

sa ba ddhā sta ḍi ta i ba ni dzre pa tsa pa khāḥ / /ba suḥ sarpā pā maḥrnams rdzogs par 'ching ba'i klog rmyebazhin reg pa med cing rab tu g.yo/ /lus ni gnod pa kun dang kṣa ya bha ya ni kā yiḥ pa ri ga tai dza ra ro gobye gista da bi na bi 'jig ( dang 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang rga dang na ba dang / /sdug bsngal dag gis yongs su 'gro ste de lta na rā gasta nu j-i tai/ /shri ye swaste sa mabee ma swa dza na snga ya mañdza liḥ/ /yang lus 'dzin yid mi 'byung / /dpal 'byor mtha' dag shis gyur cig /thal mo 'di sbyar nang mi la/ /dākṣi ju kṣa ma tai ste 6 pra byi ba thra yā ma ma/ /i ti dhyā tā sa pi ta bud med rnams la yongs 2bzod mdzod/ /bdag ni rab byung kho na dga'/ /'di bsam de yi ④pha ma ro sa mā shā sngapta lo tsa no/ /burnyo dharma pa the shudha sha ma dhwambi n+ya be dag—/ /yang dag dbugs phyung mig dag thob/ /chos lam dag cing zhi ba yi/ /gnas la blo ni bkod sha yata/ /sārja bhraṣṭashyi rā yā taḥkṛ sho pi su dza na gya tsa/ /a lupta par gyur/ /don mthun nyams gyur yun ring na/ / 'ong zhing ⑤rid kyang snying stobs 'byor/ /ma zhum ⑥sa twa bee bha banda kṛ pā spa da hūṃ ya yo/ /a nu ka gya ya bye ṣe saṃ pas na rang mi yang / /brtse ba'i gnas nyid du ma gyur/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs kyis rnams 'khrugs//sā ra kle sha bi hwa lo/ /sa taḥka snga nu ka snga ste sadza ta sasparga ni smṛ hā/ /pa de dag gal te brtse ba na/ /dam pa su la rjes mi brtse/ /de dag phun tshogs thob mi 'dod/ /phyugs shu pā la ka pi pra sdi saṃ de sha di ya tho di tai/ /ni ga rya de bhyaḥka na skyong bram ze bud med la/ /gser thob mngon sum mtshan nyid can/ /'phrin sogs ji ltar brjod pa ka pābhi pra tya ya lakṣa rde/ /shāntaḥkā tyā ya rna pra su bra dzhai sa sa mā da de/ /bzhin—/ /de dag rnams la bzlas byas te/ /kā tyā ya na dang phrad nas/ /zhi ba de yis rab byung blangs//muddhā dzā yabyi ṣā dā ya tand+ra sā da ya dhi ma hūṃ/ /sa sa mā sā rya bi ṣa rda sgo blun po rnams kyi sgyid lug rgyu/ / de ni blo ldan rab dang rgyu/ / 7de nas de yi ④rgyun zhugs kyi/ /'bras 95—270

ta pābhe pha lo ta taḥ/ /sa kṛ dā gā mya na gā mi pha la marta pha lo ta thā/ /bu dri ma med thob cing / /lan cig phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong / /'bras dang de bzhin dgra bcom 'bras//tre dhwa tu ko bī ta ra gaḥ sa ma loṣṭa thra kañtsa naḥ / / ā kā sha khams gsum dag la ①'dod chags bral/ /gser dang bong ba rdo bar mtshungs/ /nam mkha' lag pā ṇi tu spyo bhu twa si tsanda na yoḥs maḥ/ /shā babye bee rku ga ha ṣpe mazil mtshungs pa dang / /ral gri tsan dan mtshungs par gyur/ /de nas mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal/ /dzi ni dze ta ba ṣpe sbi tai/ /bha ga brnye ya yo drahūṃ so tha kā tya ya rna ga yā/ /sbyig ma'i nags na bzhugs pa yi/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba blta duru de/ /kā tyā ya na'i bka' yis song //pra ṇi sā tī kṛ ta ti juḥbri tya bha ga ba ta swa yo/ /tai sgo ṇa ko ṭi kardo tha phyag ni byas shing bcom ldan 'das/ /rang nyid dgyes pas dri ba byas/ /de nas gro bzhin bye ba rna/ /ba bha ṣe habee nirbha raḥ/ /bha ga bān dharma kā ye na dṛsgo saṃ sgo tra batpa na/ /dga' ba rgyas pas de la smras/ /bcom ldan chos kyi sku yis ni/ /thos pa'i lam nas mthong bar gyur/ /a dhu na rū pa kā ye na pu bye ra lo kya se ma yā/ /a nalpa su kṛ ta pra da lta gzugs kyi sku yis ni/ /bsod nams kyis ni bdag gis mthong / /mi chung bsod nams kyis thob 1su mi rda twa ja rsha na mṛ tai/ / rpā twa na tre bye mā yārnyi bañtsi ta e bya—/ /khyod ni mthong ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /'thungs nas ngoms par ma grur pa/ /de dag mchog tu ba te pa re/ /na smṛ ha myu bi te mutīḥku ru te ka gya na spri hūṃ/ /nirlebasrus pa nyid/ /chags pa med kyang khyod kyi gzugs/ /su zhig chags par mi bgyed lags/ /byugs pa snga pi te dṛṣṭi ra ho harṣa ṇa lidza ti/ /twaṅka tha twa da nu dhyā rna pa med kyang khyod kyi spyan/ /kye ma dga' bas byugs pa lags/ /khyod kyi gtam dang khyod rjes dran/ /twatthaste standi ṣe ba rgo/ /e taḥku sha la mū lā rmā sbyi taḥpha la sa mṛdhe yaḥ/ /khyod dang phrad dang khyod bsten pa/ /'di dag dge ba'i rtsa ba yi/ /'bras bu phun tshogs rgyas pa yin/ /95—271

kṛ ta bān bhū ya saṃ pu ② bā ni ti/ /sa 1 ṇa ko ṭi kazlo yo pu byeḥldan par ①bdag /gyur ces de yis smon lam btab/ /de ni gro bzhin bye rna 'di/ /bsod nams pāpta pa rda ma hata/ /tabyi dhe ṣpe ba saṃ yā taḥkaṇḍi byu ṣa ṇa lakṣa ṇaḥ/ /pra dag gi kwaganas chen thob/ /de lta kho na'i rna ba'i rgyan/ /mtshan nyid dag dang ldan par gyur/ /gang sthā na sa ma ye mā ta shra bi tā pa ru ṣe ba tsa/ /yasmra da ṣpe na te nā gya ba phyir 'gro ba'i dus su 'dis/ /ma yi ②tshig ni rtsub mo dag /thos par byas nas de yis ningu/ /ngal byu bā mya shra mo ma hān/ /ma bye 6 ma hā taḥshukla gu ṇa saṅkarma ba pa saḥ/ /kṛṣṭa dub chen po dag tu gyur/ /dag pa khyayon tan dam pa yisaX / /las kyi ras chen dbus su ni/ /nag kadzre la baṃ sho pi spu ṭa e bā ba dharya te/ /su kṛ ta sa tsi raḥs twotpa po'i las kyi tha chung yang / /gsal ba nyid du nges par zin/ /legs byas grogs ldan snying stobs spro ba ha ཿ pra bā sa sa khāe dṛ ti bi ṣa mi ta ra ṇi bī dro se dag dang khyim spangs grogs kyi — dga' ba dang / /mi bzad sgrol ba'i brtson 'grus zam stegs dag dang tubee pa rya dhi kṛ pā/ /sha ma pa ri tsi tā paryarnye tsa pra sā da ma yī phongs pa skyob pa'i brtse ba dang / /mjug tu yang ni zhi ba yongs su 'dris par gyur cing rab dang rang 6 ma tiḥpa ri ṇa ti ri yo pu rgyu pā byeḥ spu ra ta pha la sha li byā/ /i bzhin blo/ /bsod nams thob ⑫pa'i yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni 'bras bu rgyas par gnas pa yin/ /zhes ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi ta dzee bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī sgo pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gro ṇa ko ṭī ka1 ba da rna nā ma dzi sha ti ta maḥpabee waḥ// //bzhin bye ba rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu pa'o// //dī dzi hwa sa ge ka tha maste bṛti ra ṣpe ka nu khye ka tha maste sau khye/ /karmānta lce gnyis 'grogs la 'tsho ba ji ltar yod/ /gtso bo mang la bde ba ji ltar yod/ /las kyis 95—273

ki tāḥ/ /a bi she ṣa snyo: pa lā bhū pā khāḥkā ka shaṃ ki naḥ/ /pra sgobee rakta pa med/ /bye brag mi shes g.yo ba yis/ /sa skyong bya rog dogs pa can/ /ngo mebo chags bral rtags liṅgā ni bi lo kyā mā tya sum̐ ga baḥ/ /swa su to go pa sau hā khyo swa shaṃ kaḥrnams ni/ /rnam gzigs blon po'i gang zag gis/ /rang sras sa 'tsho seng ge zhes/ /bya la dogs mee ra ma bra bīta/ /dhūtaisgre bi ra tā shā saḥpi shu ṣpesgopa teḥkri taḥ/ /pra tya bcas dal bus smras/ /g.yo can phra mas mi yi bdag /bdag la yid brtan bral bar byas/ /snying ni yi ṣpe ti z-i da ye bi dārlu pi bra darsha te/ /bi raṅkaḥsru gi tā khā pa darsha rnam par phye bstan kyang ( sna/ /gcugs pa nyid du 'gro ma yin/ /chags dang bral ba'i jo bo ni/ /kun na shra ba ṇa pra juḥ/ /pa rā i ba bṛdzha gya ya taḥshi thi la tsā ma ma/ /bi brjod mthong thos bor ba de/ /bdag la lhod pa nyid gyur 1te/ /rgan po yi ni lus po bzhin/ /phra shu nodha ba bhenda gya prastaḥsadhi rna bi rya te/ /na ma ṇiḥshlau 6 ti pu naḥms tha dad rab bskyed pa'i/ /mdza' ba 'dum par mi 'gyur te/ /rdo yis ce dum bur byas pa yi/ /pa ṣa ṇa sha ka lī kṛ taḥ/ /dī dzi hwa ku ṭi lā krantaḥpra bhubyanda na pā da paḥ/ /nor bu slar yang 'byar ba min/ /lce gnyis gya gyus khyanon pa yisakye / /jo bo tsan dan rkang 'thung ni/ /pā yā tyarja kri yā kā rī gu ṇa bā na gya se bya tī/ /ka dzee dṛ pa ni ṅgā nādhī don bya byed cing yon tan dang / /ldan yang bsten bya nyid mi 'gyur/ /mi bdag gter ni don gnyer ba//ku sha lo bha dza te na raḥ/ /gho ra dzwa ṣa bi ṣā bi sha dza ṣa hā ghā tā 'jigs rung sdong ⑦ ba'i dug 'bebs pa'i/ /lce gnyis pas bcom rnam 'khrugs pa'i/ /mi ni ji ltar bi hwa laḥ/ /tasmradma dza maḥsaṃ tya bye dī ṣa do ṣe ṇa byu ba teḥ/ /shaṃ kā dge ba bsten/ /de slad yang dag btang nas 'gro/ / sa bdag sdong ba'i skyon 'a)gyis ni/ /gang na sha bee ma yī thrarterma smin de she na te na kim/ /dakṣa rakṣa kṣa maḥshu raḥdogs pa zug rngu yi/ /rang bzhin gyis 'tsho yul des ci/ /mkhas shing rtul phod bsrung bar bzod/ /95—275

pra bhū tā ṭwāḥsu saṃ ha tāḥ/ /santaḥ saste bi shā lā yi bā saste 6 ma nor mong 1legs par yang dag 'grogs/ /dam pa gnas pa'i yangs pa can/ /gnas der 'ubadag ni mesmi taḥ/ /i nyi khru bā ṇaḥbu tra rgyu ta the kyuktaḥs sa nu gaḥ/ /udma 'dod par gyur/ /de skad smras tshe bu dag kyang / /de bzhin zhes smras rjes 'brang nywabacas/ /skyed mos na ya tā bya dze na bra ya yo sa pa ritstsha daḥ/ /pra yārnyi dṛ pa tidzña twa ni tshal du 'gro zol gyis/ /'khor bcas de ni rab tu song / /'gro bar shes nas mi yi bdag /bzlog la brta na sa mudma taḥ/ /yasne na pi na sha tai pā pa noskṛṣṭi la bhya te pu naḥ/ /yang dag rab brtson pa'i/ /'bad pa yis ngukyang ma thob ste/ /rab tu spangs pa beer thob khru min/ /mūkhroḥsad su kṛ ta ba dzñā bi mu khyadhe kṣa ṇi na taiḥ/ /yā ti te ྾ tu sarba tra rmongs pa dam pa'i legs byas smod/ /skad cig de rnams blun par byas/ /de ni kun tu su zhig gis/ /ko na na tī kṛ tārja tām/ /dhi mā na mā tyaḥpāsto tha kṛsgo bai shā li kairga don gnyer don byas min par gyur / /yon tan gyis bkug blo ldan blon/ /'ongs pa yangs pa can pa ṇiḥrka/ /pū dzi taḥpra ṇa yā tsā riḥsaṃ gha mu khye pa de sbi taḥ/ /tabyernyi bi bha bābee yis—/ /gus pa'i spyod pas mchod de nas/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo'i gnas su bzhag /de nas de yi 'byor shriḥso tha tattha mu kho ga ṇaḥ/ /ka dā tsi da na ya nāta le bhe na pa rā pas dpal/ /des thob de yi gtso bos kyang / /tshogs pa nam yang tshul min las/ /gzhan gyi gnod bha pa sā tra tī/ /a tha ka le na sau ha gya madhri pū noḥka bhā yā paḥ/ /a dza yā pa'i snod bhum gyur/ /de nas dus kyis khyablon po'i bu/ /gzhan kepar gyur pa seng ge yi/ /bu mo yon ta su tā kāddhā tsi lā nā ma gu rto tsi tāḥ/ /dī tī yā tso pa tsa lā khyu su tā dzā tā su sunda tan ldan ma ⑫ ni/ /mdzes ma tsi la zhes pa btsas/ /de yi bu mo gnyis pa yang / /nye ba'i tsi la zhes pa rī—/ /dzadma bye ba tā yoḥpra ha ni mitta zlo bi tsa kṣa ṇaḥ/ /tsi khā yāsta na yo skyes—/ /mdzes ma'o de dag skyes nyid la/ /mtshan mkhan mkhas pas rab smras pa/ /tsi la'i bu ni pha 95—276

bhā bi pi tro ha tā ma ṭī pa nyiḥ/ /gu ṇa pa nu pa tse khā yāḥpuṇḍi lakṣa bsad nas/ /sa yi bdag po dag tu 'gyur/ /nye ba'i tsi la'i yon tan can/ /rdzogs pa'i mtshan ldan bā ni ti/ /dzresgo madhri su taḥsaurlu ta go paḥthra zwa ma dodhe taḥ/ /udmā 'gyur zhes so/ /blon sras thu bo 1sa 'tsho ni/ /dpa' bas cher 'urgyags ma bsdams pas/ /skyed tshal na marda na kṣe beerga shā dzā dwo 6 tai ya yo/ /ta྾ turgo ra bāta tasmi dkrugs pa'i gnod pa yis/ /tshogs rnams sdang 'os nyid du gyur/ /de dag de yi pha dag la/ /gus sā nu dzā yā bi ma n+ya baḥ/ /bi shā la shā la tā marnye dīrtedmā na dwa yo da duḥ/ /su ga pas khro bral de dang ni/ /nu bor bcas la skyed tshal gnyis/ /sā la ta ma che rgyas byin/ /legs byas ta pra ti ma tsakre ta tre kaḥsu kṛ to tsi taḥ/ /bi hā ra bai bha bo dā ram̐ rigs pa gcig gis der/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byas/ /'byor pa rgya che'i gtsug lag khang //bhu ba nā bha ra rṇa pa raḥ/ /a tha bi tā ba lo྾steḥsu taḥpra tyanta maṇḍa le/ /sa yi rgyan ni gzhan gyis so/ /de nas bas mtha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /pha yi 1stobs rgyas sa srungs bu/ /ga ṇa ko pa bha yāta go paḥkarmarnyo pārja ṣpe dhri taḥ/ /kā le na tri di baṃ tshogs pa'i khro bas 'jigs pa las/ /las mtha' nye bar bsgrub nguslad bzhag /blon po'i mchog de dus yā te tasmin madhri ba re ga ṇiḥ/ /ka byā yāta sa dhu tāta dzi hasta su pa kyis ni/ /mtho ris bzhud tshe tshogs rnams kyis/ /legs pa nyid phyir gzhan skyepa'i bu/ /seng ge de yi de rja taḥ/ /go paḥpi tu ra saṃ pā gya pa rda ga ṇa bi mā ni tāḥ/ /taddhā sha gnas su bzhag /tshogs pa gus du bral sa 'tsho yis/ /pha yi gnas ni ma thob nas/ /yul dang gnas bā sa bi ra saḥpa ri hā ra ma tsinta yata/ /bsta bye kaṇḍa kā tīrte ni de dag la/ /chags pa ⑦ yongs su gtang bar sems/ /tsher mas gtams shing stag gis snom/ /byā spyo sthā te ba rasba ṣpe/ /a ṣpe ka swā mi saṃ bhinda dza ṣpe na tre bi shri kha le/ /nags tshal mchog tu gnas par bya/ /rje bo mang pos rab phye ba/ /ma bsdams (3skye bo'i nang du min/ /95—277

na nā saskṛ yā lā baḥka tha mā rārgya te ga ṇaḥ/ /sa mbi hi tai ma de ka mya tha dad dam pa'i bya ba smrasasti/ /gang zhig gcig gis 'dod gyur pa/ /de la gzhan dag yongs ka mi sred//ta da n+ya smi na ro tsa ta/ /i ti mā ṭī pa saṃ tsi tya ga tā rā bye kṛ ha pu ram̐/ /tshogs pa ji ltar bsten par bya/ /zhes bsams nga rgyal can de yis/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu phyin//bimbi sā ram̐ na ra pa ti gu ṇa shri ya ma shi shi yata/ /sa te na mā ni taḥspru mi bdag gzugs can snying po yi/ /yon tan gyi ni dpal 'byor bsten/ /de yi dges ①pas de tyā ta gya bi shaṃ bha bhu ra bhū ta / / tsi ra rū tse ba taṭwā la mā bhā mchod nas/ /de yis yid brtan ④gnas su gyur/ /de dus yon tan gyis 'grogs pa/ /yun ring ti gu ṇa saṃ ga tiḥ/ /rā zlo tha bimbi sā ra su balla bhā pañtsa tsā ya yo/ /'dris pa bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs snying gisakhye/ /btsun mo lnga pa nyid gyur de'i/ /tabyi yo gāsni santa paṃ tai bi tsind+ra pa budhi mān/ /u pa tsi waṃ su hūṃ bhā tro 'bral ba'i me yis gdungs de dang / /nye ba'i tsi bul nu bo yi/ /bu mo btsun mor blangs ⑦'os pa/ /stabyi bā ho tsi hūṃ ba rja/ /gru bhā tsā rī ta dā de shāta bai sha la ka pu ri ya yo/ /blo ldan de yis rnam pyabasams nas/ /gsang nas rgyu zhing de yi bkas/ /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer song //ka n+ya ga kho pa sgo gye ba na kasmi tsita pra dī ya te/ /i ti bee shā li kaiḥpūbyu tshogs kyi nye bar spyad bya nyid/ /mdzes ma su la kwasbyin mi bya/ /zhes pa yangs pa can pas ⑫sngon/ /swa de she ni ya ma kṛ taḥ/ /tahphu re dwa ra rakṣa ma yakṣa sba nā ba lambi nī/ /rang gi yul du nges pa byas/ /de yi grong khyer sgo bsrung phyir/ /gnod sbyin gnas na 'phyang ba yi 0/ /ba ra pra de she ku ru te shabye gharbhe gha ṭī ya se/ /te pra bi shya ta to dhra dril bu shin tu gsang ba ni/ /pha rol zhugs tshe sgra sgrog ⑫byed/ /nu bo'i skyed tshal 'phreng bar ni/ /turgyu bhā mudmā na tsā ri shlau/ /u pa rtsa khā sa mā hahūṃ ga tabye khā ma bāpta bān/ /gros kyis 3gsang ste de 2rab zhugs/ /nye ba'i tsi la len pa la/ /phyin ⑩ pas tsi la thob par gyur/ /95—278

yā ta: ra tha mā ro gya ghaṇḍa shanda da bhe dru tān/ /sa ha tā bī ra pu ru de ni shing rta la bskyon ①song / /dril sgra las ni mngon 'ded 'upa'i/ /skyes bu dpa' rnams des bcom ṣā na bā pa dṛ pa teḥpu ram̐/ /ta spru tsa de ba ka bye yo prabhā bi ni ma nas—/ /mi yi bdag po'i grong khyer phyin2/ /de la des smras mdzes ma 'di/ /bdag gi bsam ④yātpa yā/ /thra tro haṃ twa su to khya myu ni mitta zlo na mū tsi taḥ/ /tasmra de ṣa pa min pa thob/ /'di yi bu yis pha gsod ces/ /gang phyir mtshan mkhan rnams kyis smras/ /de beed mi yi na ra pa te ma hi ྾ na ta bo tsi tā/ /twa yi dzre ba ti dzre badhi pra dzā dzā sattha bdag po ni'u/ /khyod kyi btsun mor 'os pa min/ /khyod ni 'tsho na skye rgu rka yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa saṃ pa daḥ/ /i kyuktaste na tī dṛṭī tyathi ṣpe ba sha shā ka saḥ/ /ni rudhe thams cad 'tsho/ /de yis 'di brjod tshe na des/ /de mthong gtang bar yongs ⑦ma nus/ /de gdong kadzre na bye ba tarlu khā le khya le kha yā/ /so ba da ta kwa ka dā dṛṣṭaḥpu tre ṇa la bris ri mo yis/ /las kyi slad nyid bcings pa bzhin/ /de yis smras pa bu yi 2 pha/ /gsod pa gang ni ha taḥpi tā/ /swa yi ma yā rnyi ṣikta byaḥsu to ya di bha bi 6 ti/ /i kyudhwa du gang tshe mthong / /gal te bu ni byung gyur na/ /rang nyid bdag gis dbang bskur bya/ /de skad dṛ pa tiḥka dzñā sa ri bhā yā bha ba ta mu khye/ /kṛ taḥkasmormi ni rmā ṇiḥbarjod nas mi yi bdag /mdzes ma len la dga' bar gyur/ /las kyi ⑪rlabs kyis sprul pa yis/ /pra bha brnyi na budha yaḥ/ /sgo gi nasta su kā le na ta sde su nu ra dza ya ta/ /phrogs pa'i blo la mthu yod min/ /dus kyis longs spyod ldan pa de'i/ /bu ni de las /ṣpeskyes gyur te/ /byo tiṣka tsa ri te ya mya thratrī mukta pi tro dru haḥ/ /ta po pa na mṛ ga ghā gang gi spyod tshul brtsis pa yis/ /pha ni gsod par brjod gyur pa'o/ /dka' thub nags kyi ri dwags na mṛ ga ya bya sa ṣpe ba ṣpe/ /e baṃ bee sgo hra byutta gya mu ni sha paḥsu rnams—/ /bsad phyir nags su rngon 3la zhen/ /de la thub pa'i dmod pa ni/ /bu yi dbyebs can 95—279

tā kṛ tiḥ/ /a tānta re ma hānda ma bee sha li ka ga ṇa gra ṇḍiḥ/ /ka n+ya 'di ltar gyur/ /skabs der chen po zhes bya ba/ /yangs pa can byu ① tshogs kyi gtsos/ /a mra'i mā mra ba nāta pā pa ka da lbo skadzha bi nirga tsā/ /sā ta gya bha ba ṣpekānta brja nags las chu shing giḍa 7/ /sdong po las 'khrungs mdzes ma thob/ /de yi khyim du mdzes ma de/ /dal bu mā nā sha ṣpeḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /bi da dhe bi pu waṃ spru ti da na tsirnyi tsa tse ta se/ /dal bus bskyed bsrings te/ /dga' ba che dang sbyin pa yi/ /bsam pa yis kyang sems ma bzung / /pra ṇa yā dā mra pā lbo ti bantu bheḥsā kṛ tā bi dhwa/ /su rku tī na mi ba tyakta gnyan 1gyi mdza' las de yi ming / /a mra skyong ma zhes su btags/ /bu mo dman pa bzhin btang nas/ /ba lya yo ba na ma da de/ /tabyi ba hodma ta snga tha na se te ta྾ turga ṇaḥ/ /lang tsho dag ni bzung bar gyur/ /de nas de gtong brtson pa'i pha/ /mdzes ma tshogs kyi ④ nyer spyad bya//ga rto pa sgo gyu ka bye ti sa ma ya gya bya ti kra oṃ/ /pi ta ram̐ duḥkha zhes pa'i dam tshig 'das gyur pa/ /tshogs pa dag gis bzod ma gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal gyis santa bye pa me tya tha dza gā da sā/ /bha bā mi ga ṇa sgo gye ba kirnye ṣa gdungs pa'i⑤/ /pha la btud nas des smras pa/ /bdag ni tshogs kyi spyad bya nyid/ /gal te 'on kyang sa ma yo ya di/ /e ka sro pa ri nā n+ya su pra bee shaḥsri pa desbi tiḥ/ /pa ṇaḥkārṣa dam tshig 'di/ /gcig gi /'usteng du gzhan dag ni/ /mi 'jug rang gi gnas su sdod/ /nyi ma re la pa ṇa sha taiḥpañtsa bhiḥpra tya ha ma ma/ /sabhā he bee ba bi tsa yaḥkārlo bee thra ni bdag gi zong / / karṣa pa ṇi spyobargya phrag lnga/ /zhag bdun dag ni khyim dag bye ni/ /rnam par blta bya nā n+ya dā/ /i tyasmin sa ma ye ba dhyaḥsand+ra sri ba bya ti kra mbi/ /i ti tata gzhan du min/ /zhes pa'i dam tshig 'di 'das na/ /kun gyi spyad bya nyid 'gyur ba'okhya / /zhes pa de sa ma yo dzñā tā ta྾ turba tsa sa ga ṇaḥ/ /a ka ro da bā bye mi kyughā dṛ yis nya snadam tshig dag /shes nas de yi phas smras parngo ge/ /tshogs kyis ( dzārung zhes smras nas ni/ /gus 95—280

ddhā nibya ya ma da rāta/ /ta taḥs ratna bha ba de ba rā bha ra ṇa bhū ṣi ta/ /pas nges pa brtan po byas/ /de ①nas rin cen khang par ②de/ /mchog gi rgyan byis rab brgyan cing //he ma harmya sa mā rū ṭwā di de sha di na tsarja rmā/ /ta taḥpā ṇi kṛ taḥkā mbi gser gyi ba gam khri stan la/ /'dzegs nas nyin par zla 'od byas/ /de nas 'dod ldan gang gang gis//yo yaspyo sa mu pā ya yo/ /ta gya ta snga bha batta gyaḥpra bha be kau dza saḥkṣa yaḥ/ /drasgo zong byin de can nye bar song / /de dang de yi gzi brjid ni/ /de yi mthu yis rab tu nyams/ /blta ba me ba na she kuste ki myu naḥsprastsu mā ku khāḥ/ /ju dzee ga sgo ga saṃ ruzlo tsā nyid du'ang mi nus na/ /reg pas 'khrugs ①pa slar yang ci/ /de ni tsan dan 'khri shing dag /lag tsanda na la ta mi ba/ /ta taḥs punda rī bhe dze yo ba na su bi yo ba āoṃ/ /'gros longs spyod bgags pa bzhin/ /de nas mdzes ma de yis 4ni/ /nu ma rgyas pa'i khur ⑤dag gis//gu ru nasta na bhā re ṇa ma rgya rghaṃ ga bha ya pra rda/ /sma ra saṃ sgo ga ra nyi lta rked 'khyog 'jigs pa rab ster ba/ /lang tsho yi yang lang tsho bsten/ /de yi gzugs ni rmad byung de/ /tatta snga rū pa maspyo tai/ /shwa bhra he ma la tā pu tpa mi ba —phe la 'dod chags rdzogs shing longs spyod bral/ /g.yang sa'i gser gyi 'khri shing gi6/ /me tog bzhin du tsā ya yo/ /kau tu kā shā bi no dā la nā nā de shānta rā ga taiḥ/ /a kā 'bras med gyur/ /ltad mo'i bsam pas rtsed mo'i slad/ /tha dad yul gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i ri mo rañtsi tra ka respyo pa la pra ti ma kṛ he/ /bhi dha ya tsi tra li khi tān pā kra mkhan gyis ⑦sa skyong gi/ /gzugs ni de yi khang par bris/ /mi dbang rnams ni ri mo la/ /bris shing me ṇa na re shwa rān/ /da darsha bimbi sā ra gya dṛṣṭi ra ti pa te ri bltas pas rim gyis dedu / /gzugs can snying po'i gzugs dag ni/ /dga' ma'i bdag po bzhin du ba—/ /ta mā lo kye ba sa ha sā sa mudhū ta ma no bha bā/ /sa ye na li khi mthong / /de mthong nyid na 'phral la ni/ /'dod chags yang dag langs par gyur/ /gang zhig lade ni 95—281

tasta tra tai pa pratstsha ku ru ha khāta/ /ko yo sa khe sri ti la tā mā dha bris de la/ /der ni dge mtshan dag las ①dris/ /gang gi bumadzes sdug bdud rtsi yis/ /yongs rgyas bo ba su ṅgā ba tsaḥ/ /bye ṇa ti lo tsa ṣpe ya gya su dhwa pa ri tsi tā ru ཿ/ /dha tyā mig gi dga' bskyed pa/ /dga' ma dag gi 'khri shing dpyid/ /grogs po sa bdag 'di ri su/ /gang gi kā nā ma byu bhartu ra su pra ṇa ya bha gi mbi/ /lagluḥsau bhā gya dzee garba dpal mo lha mo'i yang / /skal bzang las skyes dregs 'joms pa/ /sa bdag 'di yi mdza' gcugs kyi//musba sha z-i tai ya yā/ /i ti thraṣṭasta yā swe ra tā mū tse tsi tra ko bi daḥ/ /skal ldan bsod nams ldan pa su/ /de yis dris la 2dal bur ni/ /ri mo mkhas pas de la smras/ /bhū pa tibeedza sa ro yi sā ram̐ su kṛ ta saṃ ba dzā/ /saurya ru pa tu lā legs byas phun tshogs snying po 'di/ /sa bdag gzugs can snying po yi④ / /rtul phod gzugs ni srang ro he de bāḥke nā ka nā ya kaḥ/ /shaṃ ke ka ro ti ṣpe bā gya madma tho ba ma no gzhal ba/ /mtho ris 'dren pa'i lha su yis/ /'di las ⑤yid srubs dag kyang ni/ /re ba med pa nyid ra dzee/ /i hphuste te na pā ta sgo bhū pā la n+yasta lo tsa nā/ /sa ha mai bā bhi du dogs/ /de yis de skad brjod tshe de/ /mngon par 'dod pa gsar pa yis/ /'phral nyid mngon du lā ṣe ṇa na bi nā dzñā mu khāe kṛ ta/ /a tranta re bimbi sā raḥsī ra phyogs byas te/ /sa skyong la ni mig gtad nas / /skabs der gzugs can snying po yis/ /mi med bedre ni nirdza ṣpe/ /ka thādhe go pa ma ba data ki tsita rmi ta si tā dha raḥ/ /khang par dal bus ni/ /gtam gyi ḍapemajug tu sa 'tsho la/ /cung zad 'dzum dkar mchu yis smras/ /shu ya tsā yadma ma sa khe kiñtsisman se brta te/ /niryant+ra mi tra swatstshanda grogs po cung zad bdag gi ni/ /yid la gang zhig rgyu ba nyon/ /ma bsdams grogs po rang dbang du/ /bā daḥko bi su dhwa ra saḥ/ /bee sha li kaisthā ra ro ho ga ṇiḥpa dhwa ra ṇi kṛ tā/ /smra ba ci yang bdud rtsi'i ro/ /yangs pa can pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /thun mong du byas bud med mchog /95—282

re sgo hūṃ khru ya te kārnya ram̐ bha garbha sa mudha rpā/ /ta ta pra bha ba bi naṣṭa she mdzes ma byin pa chu shing 'dra/ /chu shing nang nas byung bar thos/ /gzi ldan snying sdug du 'os des3 / /ste dza sī pra ṇa yo tsi tā/ /sā tairna dru ṣi tā rya pi mā tai gi ri ba padme ni/ /de mthus re ②nyams de dag gis⑩/ /da lta yang ni su ④ma phyin/ /padma ldan pa glang pos bzhin/ /shra ba rja de ba sā nanda ma parlu ṣi ta kau tu kai/ /na ka ro ti ma naḥka gya bud med rin cen skye khyaganas las/ /ma skyes pa de thos nyid las/ /yid ni kun dgar bcas pa yis//tata ṭwā ratna ma yo ni dzee/ /a bhi la ṣi ma nasta sde dza tai me sa ha tsagru ṣā/ /dge mtshan mi gzhan 'usu mi byed/ /bdag gi mig dang lhan cig tu/ /yid ni de la mngon par chags//tad gu ṇa khru ti dha tyā ya sho tā ya smṛ ha yā mya haṃ/ /i truste byu mi pa ti nā de yi yon tan thos pa yi/ /skal ldan rna bar bdag dga' 'o/ /sa yi bdag pos 'di ⑦brjod tshe/ /go pasta pra tya bha ṣa ta/ /byu dza ga ga ṇa saṃ rudzhaḥs rā dza na mādma tho ni sa 'tshos de la lan smras pa/ /rgyal po 'dod chags gter de ni/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs kyis yang dag dhiḥ—/ /a tyalpabee li tai pra gya duḥs hā pa ta durga maḥ/ /e ṣa te bi ṣa bkag /shin tu chung ba 'khrul dugyur na/ /bzod dka'i g.yang sa ngan par 'gro/ /mi bzad lam 'di maḥpand+ra dalgi to bi ṣa me 6 ṇa/ /la bha tai sā ni rgabye na yus+ho khyod la ni/ /mi bzad mda' chen dag ⑨gis bstan/ /de ni blang du 'thob pa min/ /khrod kyang 'gro ga ma āoṃ tsa te/ /ki masmin bi ra to pā ye bee dā myu bha ya saṃ sha ye/ /i kyuktaste bar 'os pa min/ /gnyis ka the tshom thabs dang bral/ /'di la bdag ni ci zhig smra sko/ /de yis de na dṛ pa tirnoṅka ṇḍa gra ma tya dza ta / / bi hūṃ so myu tsi tsā ni tsā bajod mi bdag gis/ /'dod pa'i gdon ⑩ni ma gtang 8ste/ /'dod pas gzir na rigs pa'i lugs//na sma rarnyi sma rā tu rāḥ/ /bee sha li ka pu dī ga to go be na sa hi to tha paḥ/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang mi dran no/ /de nas sa 'tsho lhan ( 5cig de/ /grong khyer yangs pa can song nas//95—283

pra bi bee shā n+ya pe she na mandi ra ha ri ṇi dṛ shaḥ/ /pā tsi tra darsha ṣpe ṣpe ba ri dwags mig can khang par ni/ /chas gzhan dag gis rab tu zhugs/ /ri mo mthong ba nyid kyis ni/ /dṛṭī pa ri tsi ti dṛ shoḥ/ /na ra nā rja sa bee lasgyu shā lakṣa khaṃ kṣi ti bee kṣa mig dag yongs 'dris mi yi mgon/ /de yis mthong nas skad cig ni/ /skyengs pa dang bcas sa la ta / /laspyo ni rutta re ta gyeḥkaspa bya ti ka re pa ram̐/ /ra ṇaṭī ra pa nā bltas—/ /ngo tshas lan dang bral ba de/ /'dar bas rab tu bskyod pa yis①/ /dril chung sgra ldan mi tsa kre swa ga tai dṛ pa ti ri ba/ /bi lo kya dha n+ya tā mā nī tra twa tsi bdag la/ /legs par 'ongs sam 'dri ba bzhin/ /der ni rang lus ri mo la/ /skal bzang mthong pyatre ni dzi ba suḥ/ /tī khā ba rgya na dī rā dzā na ya rmā dza li nā pa po/ /nas khengs ldan pa'i/ /rgyal pos de yi zhumadzes sdug gi/ /chu rgyun 'dren ④byed snyim pas 'thungs/ /ladzdza be sha na sundaṭwā mā bhe dzā bye na bhū pa sto/ /ā padha mo na yoḥkṣi pre ngo tsha 'bebs pas mdzes ma dang / /mngon par mtho bas sa yi bdag /smra ba gcad las ⑤sa 'tsho yis//go ba.āoṃ mbi to ba data/ /a yo te tsi tra lī khi tā kā ra dhya na baḥjo 'dzum pas ༷myur bar de la smras/ /lha 'di'i rnam pa ri mor bris/ /bsam gtan nges par brjod pa nata—/ /byatta bhatta bi sha ṣe ṇa de baḥpra tya kṣa tī ga taḥ/ /twa yā twa yo li khi las—/ /khyod kyi gus pa'i khyad par gyis/ /mngon sum nyid du gsal bar gyur/ /khyod kyis 'di ni ri tashyi tre twa ma ṣpe na tu tse ta se/ /na dzā ṣpe yu ba yoḥko nu pra yā ta pre mo la/ /bris shing 'dis kyang sems la khyod/ /khyed gnyis mdza' ba'i ⑦pho nyar ni/ /su zhig rab song ma du ta tsā/ /i tyā di bheḥka thā brnyiḥpa ri pūrṇa pra mo da yoḥ/ /yad ngas mi shes/ /zhes sogs gtam gyi skyor khya ba yis/ /rab dga' yongs rdzogs de dag gis/ /gang ya ta sma rā diṣṭi tatta dā sra da hūṃ ga lta/ /ghaspyo ra bā ku le lo ke gang 'dod chags kyis bstan 1pa/ /de de nyams su stsong par gyur/ /dril sgras 'jig rten dogs pa skyes//95—284

rā dza pra tstshanda kā mu kaḥ/ /sabee rā tra mā nā lo kye tasbo tad bha ba ṣpe rgyal po 'dod ①ldan rab bsgribs pa/ /lta chabar mi 'os de yi gakhyim/ /dbeen par zhag bdun gnas ra haḥ/ /la te ba pu྾ tā kā le ta sthāṅgarbha ma bā gya sā/ /tsa kre bi di par gyur/ /'khri shing me tog ldan pa bzhin/ /dus su de las mngal thob des/ /ngo tshas dman zhing ta dṛṭwārghaṃ tai ladzdza ba na tā sha ṣpeḥ/ /ā sarje bedre bee tsa ye da tāsmi dṛ pa tirya dal bu yis/ /de la spyod mtha' rig par 'u byas/ /khyim ni spyod la nye ba na/ /byung na bu ni yongs shes yo—/ /bhā bee pu tra pa ri dzñā na pra tya ya rda gu lī ya ka /yā te bhā sota ba pu pa'i—/ /yid ches slad du sor gdub dag /de la byin nas mi bdag song / /mi bdag 'od ldan lus ṣi dṛ pa to sasma te lo tsa nā dzā sa ryaḥpro ryabyi ra ha ti mi na tta can mi rnams dag gis bkur ba gshegs gyur tshe/ /'phral la rab skyes 'bral ba'i rab rib kyis gtibs ba mbi larlu khāñdza/ /sā bhuta sā yanta na ta nu ta rā pā ra bā tā bhi bhū bzhin gyi padma zum/ /srod la char dang 'jam pa'i rlung gi bzil gyis mnan pa'i pad ldan bzhin/ /tā sa shotstsha sa bya ti ka rā ba tī harṣa tī nātta nī ba/ /ka po lo pā ṇi ta mchi ma dang bcas shugs rings ke tshorab ldan de ni dga' ba dman par gyur/ /lag pa'i stan gyis 'gram le na saṃ kaspe na ma tī pa ti/ /na baṃ tā na ra oṃ ge na ba hast+ri pa dang / /brtag pa yis ⑦ni sa bdag dang / /lus kyi pyagasar du nyam kyechung nyid/ /'dzin cing de ni mi mbi la sā/ /ta taḥkā le na ka lnga bhā pra ti bispo pa oṃ pi tuḥ/ /a jo dza ni nges par dman/ /de nas dus kyis dge ldan ma/ /de las ⑫bu ni btsas gyur te/ /pha yi gzugs nata sā ta na yi bi na yam̐ sā dhu dhī ri ba/ /brja mā ṣpe sha ṣpe stasmin brnyan dag dang mtshungs/ /legs pa'i blo bzhin rnam dul ba'o/ /de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /kā le beesba i bande bee/ /bimbi sā ra su pu tro ya mi ti lo ke6 pa pra rim gyis ⑩bskyed par grur pa'i tshe/ /'di ni gzugs can snying po yi/ /bu zhes 'jig rten rnams su 95—285

je / /a pa bā da pa risteste ste yā tya nu tsi terya dā/ /ba dhadhe shi sha baḥspye grags—/ /gang tshe rigs la mi 'os pa'i/ /ngan smras mda' ni de de yi/ /rtsed ①grogs byis pa khro ba ḍā bra saṃ gepho marṣa paṃ ya tāḥ/ /ta taḥsā pre ṣa yā mā sa pu tram̐ bi byārdza dang / /ldan pa rnams kyis smad ( )pa'i tshe/ /de nas rig pa bsgrub 'os bu/ /sor gdub dang bcas no tsi tai/ /ba ṇi ka sābeen ma ha tsā rpā gu li yo pi tuḥpa rda/ /bimbi sā pha yi ni/ /gnas su tshong pa'i tshogs chen la/ /de yis rjurab tu springs par gyur/ /gzugs can snying ro bi saṃ pā su sa dṛ shā kā ra mādma dzee/ /ha rṣadma tpaḥpa ri khya bye po dag gis kyang / /dbyebs mtshungs bu ni yang dag thob/ /yongs 'khyud dga' ba'i mchi ma yis//tsa kre ta gya bha yā bi bye/ /bṛṭwādhe bi shu te tasmind+ra mra pā spyoḥs kau tu ṣpeḥ/ /de ni 'jigs med rnam par bsgrubs/ /a phra skyong ma'i spyod mtha' de/ /thos nas dge mtshan ldan pa yi/ /bhigru bhirbha ga bān thraṣṭastaṅka thā ma ba dalja naḥ/ /pu re ḍā dza kṛ he rā dza dge slong gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas de yi gtam rgyud gsungs/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu ni//babee sgodmā na kā na ṣpe/ /ba bhu ba mā la tī nā ma pūttha mudmā na pā li kā/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo'i skyed tshal gyi/ /nags su skyed tshal bsrung ⑤ba sngon/ /'phreng ba can zhes bya bar gyur//sā ka dā tsiza sā dānd+ra pu raḥpradzhai ya dṛtstsha yā/ /pra bye ka burghaṃ rā dang bas brlan pa'i rang sangs rgyas/ /nam zhig 'dod dgar mdun du 'ongs du/ /rgyal po la 'os tsu dzārtebyu ta pu྾ ra pū dza yata/ /a yo ni dza dṛ pa gya haṃ pasni sthā mi tita yi/ /me tog rnams kyis de la mchod/ /der ni skye gnas las ma skyes/ /mi bdag btsun mor ta tra sā/ /pra ṇi dmā na pu ra: kre ta gya tsitta pra sā di nī/ /pu ju bdag gyur ces/ /sems ni rab tu dang ldan des/ /de yi mdun du smon lam btab/ /bsod nams putpapha la sgo ga shā li byā mee ba di bya ta nu rā mra pā li kā/ /i kyu dā ra tsa ri me tog 'bras bu'i longs spyod ldan/ /de nyid mchog gi ⑦lus ldan a za ⑧ skyong / /de skad rgya che'i spyod 95—286

tā ni ga mya te bhi kṣa baḥs bha pi bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi tshul thos gyur nas/ /dge slong de dag mdun ①sar ya mtshan gyur/ /zhes ②pa dge ba'i dbang pos rā tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee mā mra pā sthā ba dā na byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 1'khri shing las a mra skyong ma'i rtogs me ka birsha ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa ④gcig pa'o// //dṛ ṣṭi mu ṣṭi ni bi ṣṭa pā ra da ka khyo kā ra na rā ṇa nta na dha mi rnams nor ni dngul chu'i thigs pa khu tshur dag gis 5bsdams pa'i rnam par mthong / /dbul n+ya sau ya sha sā sa hā kṣa ya pa de yadma su bi dro ta te / / dī nā dang mgon med rnams la ster zhing nye bar mkho bar gyur pa rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal/ /bsod nams nā tha ga rto dma rto pa ka ra ṇḍi byu ta pra byu ta shri ya ཿ pu sgyu dga' tshal gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten bcom ldan sku gzugs rab gnas la sogs kyis 7/ /nor rā ma bi hā ra rtsa tya bha ga bi dma sbra pra ti jo di bhiḥ / / shri mān ldan 'di ni grags pas lhan cig mi bzad gnas su gang zhig gang gi rnam par mdzes/ /dpal ldan ba bhū ba shā babye dasto nā ma kṛ ha bye paḥ/ /su tasta su su dasto byu dā ka mnyan du yod par ni/ /khyim bdag sbyin pa zhes pa byung / /de yi bu ni rab sbyin shidag /bsod nams raḥpu sgo sadza dzā/ /sa ba la e ba lam̐ kā ra ya tsa ke bhyaḥs dā da do/ /praljaja phun tshogs 'byung gnas gyur/ /de ni byis pa nyid na rgyan/ /slong ba rnams la rtag tu ster/ /skye ba bā sa nā bhya saḥka su ke na ni bārlu te/ /ni tya mā bha ra ṇa tyā gāta sngar goms bag chags ni/ /su yi gang gis bzlog par 2'gyur/ /rtag tu rgyan rnams ster ba las/ /pa ram̐ pi tā ni bā ri taḥ/ /na dī pa mudha tā n+yasmi sa de bā nā n+ya darsha yata/ /pha yis mchog tu zlog 0pa na/ /klung las gter ni yang dag blangs/ /de la rab tu bstan par gyur/ /95—287

ni bye dargo sa sarba tra bi ta ri tri di baṃ ga te/ /dī nā nā tha pra dā ṣpe na pha ni mtho ris song ba'i tshe/ /kun tu gter ni mthong ba des/ /dbul dang mgon med la byen pas/ /ba bhū bā nā tha piṇḍa daḥ/ /kṛ ta dā naḥs kā le na pu tra bān pu tra batpamagon med zas sbyin zhes par gyur/ /dus kyis ①/sbyin pa byas pa des/ /bu ldan bu la mnyes 0gshin laḥ / /a byuhphu tra bi bā hābee ka n+ya nī ṣa ṇa yatna bān/ /ka n+ya kā pas—/ /bu yi khyim thab don gnyer zhing / /mdzes ma la/'bad pas 'tshol ④bar gyur/ /de nas bram yā tsi hūṃ hūṃ rtsa ta pu ram̐ rā dza kṛ haṃ ta taḥ/ /ma dhu skant+ra bhi bye dākṣa dha hma ṇa bi ba ze sprang rtsi yi/ /phung po zhes pa mkhas pa lal/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu ⑥ni/ /mdzes ma dga' zhig sar dza saḥ/ /ā sārya ma ga dhwan rā dza kṛ ha na ga ra me tya paḥ/ /ma ha dha rna kṛ slong du btang / /de yis ma ga dhar phyin nas/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong song ste/ /khyem bdag nor ni ha pa ti ya yā tsa ka n+ya rmā dī dzaḥ/ /a nā tha piṇḍa do na ma shā bast+ya chen po la/ /mdzes ma mchog ni bram zes ④bslangs/ /mgon med zas sbyin zhes ⑧bya ba/ /mnyan maste bi shu taḥ/ /tahphu tra ya su dzā ta ya ka dzñā de tī kyubā tsa saḥ/ /so yod na yod grags ldan de'i/ /bu ni legs par skyes pa la/ /mdzes ma byin zhes de yis smras/ /de bra bīdre sha sadzantaḥpa ra masmrata ku lo tsi taḥ/ /baṃ shesmra rka tu ka tyā dzā smras yul dang 'byel ba dag /mchog tu nged po7kyi rigs la 'os/ /nged kyi brgyud ⑫kyi bu mo rnams/ /shubo mā dī ya te ma hata/ /sha tai sha tai ra thā gā hūṃ ga dzā shwabyu tu ra su tsa/ /rin ni shin tu che ba stel 1/ /shing rta mchog ni brgya phrag dang / /glang po rta dang 'bangs mo dang / /dā sbo mbi tsa pa ni ska rmā dī ya tsā ya di shakya te/ /i sgoste te na tai bi praḥgaser srang rnams ni bzhi phrag brgya/ /gal te nus na sbyin par gyis/ /de yis de skad brjod de la/ /sa smin taḥpra bya bha ṣa ta/ /a nā tha piṇḍa da gre he dā phye phye ta dalpa bram zes 9'dzum zhing lan smras pa/ /de dag mgon med zas sbyin gyi/ /khyim gyi 'bangs kyi yin yang 95—288

ka—/ /zwa hma bee nā khi la ta smin ka tyā shulke pra ti shu te/ /ta mā da rāta kṛ ha chung / /bram zes ①bu mo'i rin rnams ni/ /ma lus kha yis blangs pa'i tshe/ /khyim bdag gis ngani gus pa tisgo dza nā ya n+ya saṃ tra ya ta/ /sa bhughā bi bi bye ta tra bhaghra sgo bye ma pa yis/ /de ni zas la zhumagron du gnyer/ /der ni de yis ma bsdams par/ /bza' ba bca' ba rnam yadhri taḥ/ /ra tre bi shu tsi kā krantabyu kro sha bi pu lo bya thaḥ/ /ye klinda shārnyi mang zos/ /mtshan mo ma zhu'i nad kyis btab/ /gdung ba chen po'i cho nge bton/ /gang zhig sred pas lo bye na ni shi ni drwa su khā ba haṃ/ /dzadma karma ka dzee kurluḥpa ra 'ju min zos/ /mtshan mo gnyid kyi bde min ④'dzin/ /'jig rten gzhan du bde beed de/ /skye ba'i lo ka su khā ya te/ /ta tyā dza shu tsi dī tyā tai kṛ hāta pa ri dza no ba ho/ /āsba las ni ji ltar byed/ /mi gtsang bas 'jigs khang pa las/ /de ni phyi ru 'bangs kyis dor/ /rang rda ṣpe ra peghra mya dza tyā dā sa dza naḥsha ṭhaḥ/ /shu bhe na karma rja ta su bzhin nyid kyis ma rabs rnams/ /g.yo ldan ltos (57pa med pa'i gnas/ /de yi dge ba'i las dag gis//saṃ prastaste na batpa nā/ /sa moṅga spyo ya naphosha ri pu traḥka ru ju pe sha laḥ/ /snying rjes gnyen pa shā ri'i bu/ / mo gal ⑥bu dang 'grogs nas ni/ /lam de nyid nas yang dag 'ongs//tai baṃ sha mi da lā gre ṇa nirli khya pi ta yā mṛ dā/ /pra kṣu bee dhand+ra mā de shya de dag gis ni dal bus de/ /sgyug ma'i rtse mo grol ba yis/ /phyis shing lan brgyar sa yis kyang / /to ta su ya ya tuḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /so pi tsirghaṃ ta yo ra gre pra sā rya tyakta bi gra haḥ/ /bkrus te de la chos bstan song / /de dag mdun du de yang sems/ /rab tu dang bas lus btang nas//tsa turma hā rā dzi ke ṣā de be 6 sa ma dzā ya ta/ /ta tra bi shra ba shā de shā ta rgyal chen bzhi yi rigs ⑦kyi ni/ /lha yi nang du skyes par gyur/ /der ni rnam thos sras kyi bkas/ /mi mju lo ke ni ke ta ṣpe/ /sa tsa kre shi bee dā re pū dzā byeṣṭha na saṃ ni dhi/ /yis 2'jig rten khang pa dang / /lha khang sgo ⑨ni mchod pa la/ /de yis lhag par nyer gnas byas/ /95—289

le kha bi dzñā ta sadzandha nibya yo tha ya tho rda tai/ /a nā tha piṇḍa daḥshulka de nas 'byel pa nges pa ni/ /spring yig gis shes brjod pa bzhin/ /mgon med zas sbyin rang nyid ni//mā da ya swa ya mā ya yo/ /sa saṃ brnyi kṛ haṃ pā gya da darsā byarya kā ri khro/ /rin rnams khyer nas 'ongs par gyur/ /'byel pa'i khyim du phyin pa na/ /rgyal po la 'os zas kyi tshogs//shi khā rā kā ra rā dzārta bhakṣu saṃ bha ra saspa rda/ /sa bismra yāta kṛ ha pa ti phun tshogs ri yi rnam pa can/ /ngo mtshar bskyed pa de yis mjong / /khyim bdag la ni ya mtshan las//pa pratstsha swatstsha mā na saḥ/ /byu ri sgospyotpa baḥko ya ma pi rā dza ni madhri taḥ/ /dri med yid ldan de yis dris/ /bza' ba rab mang bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal po mgron du gnyer ram ci//ba lta ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān budhe saṃ gha pa ri gra haḥ/ /ma yā ni madhri taḥde yis der smras sangs rgyas ni/ /bcom ldan dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ /bdag gis bdag gi dga' sa bye po yo ma ma ma hotpa baḥ/ /i ti budha bhi dha ṣpe na dzñā ta chen ni/ /rang gi ① bsod nams la bumagron gnyer/ /zhes pa ①sangs rgyas mtshan brjod pas/ /spu ro rmā tsa ka ṇa ṭu kaḥ/ /ind+ra srundi ri bā tīrṇaḥs ha se ba ba byu ba saḥ/ /a long gis ni rab rgyas te/ /'phral nyid zla ba'i khu ba yis/ /de ni yongs su bkang bzhin gyur/ /don bi di ta pa ra māze ka su tsita nā ma mā tre sgu ra ti sa ha dza bhā baḥko pi dzadmā dam rnam par rig min su zhig gi ni ming tsam las④/ /gang yang skye bas bcings pa'i lhan skyes dngos po nu brnyaḥ/ /a bhi na ba gha na nā de byakta ha rṣa bhi lā ṣaḥsmṛ sha ti la li rab tu rgyas/ /rab gsal 2 sprin gyi sgra la dga' zhing mngon 'dod gsar pa buyis/ /rma bya rol sgeg ta dṛ stoj-itta bṛtrī ma yu raḥ/ /so ba dadma da rmā sgo dza saṃ dzā ta bhi gar dang 'phyar ba'i spyod la reg par byed/ /'od zer rab gsal ( 7bzhin ras kyi/ /padmo las skyes na badku tiḥ/ /ka e ṣa bha ga bān budhaḥka: saṃ gho bhe dhī ya te/ /i ti thrasgo des smras pa/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan zhes pa su/ /dge 'dun zhes ni su la brjod/ /de yis 'di dris 95—290

kṛ ha pa ti ste na pro bā tsa sa smi taḥ/ /a ho ba ta na dzā mbi ṣe shāsthā ram̐ byu ba khyim bdag gis/ /'dzum dang bcas pas rab smras pa/ /kye ma sa gsum dag gi ni/ /ston pa khyod kyis na tra ye/ /saṃ sā ra pā sha dī tā rmā sha ra bye sha ra ṇi ṣi shā/ /mi shes sam/ /'khor ba'i zhags pas 'jigs nas skyabs/ /'tshol ①ba'i skyabs gyur rgyal ba de/ /dzi rna yasta na dzā nā nyi sa lo ke bo tsi taḥpa ram̐/ /ki te na mo ha lī ṣpe na 'jig rten na ni su zhig gis/ /mi shes pa de mchog tu bslus/ /skyabs kyi thabs ni mi shes par/ /bi pha li kṛ ta dzadma nā/ /a dzñā na sha ra kho bā yi ba yo ye na bya yī kṛ lta/ /gang gis na tshod zad par byas/ /gti mug gis reg skye ba ni/ /'bras med byas pa de yis ci/ /gotta mo bha ga wān budzha shākya rā dza ku lobye baḥ/ /saṃ budhe nutta go'u 0tam sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i rigs las 'khrungs/ /khyim spangs bla med dzā samyaka saṃ bo bye ma na ga ri kaḥ/ /pa:za bra dzi tā dzā tsa ta sri byang chub tu/ /yang dag rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa/ /de yis mchog tu rjes bzung bas/ /phyi ②nas bā nu grwa hāḥpa ram̐/ /bhi khyu rde ga ta rā gā rde sa mu haḥsaṃ gha u tsu te/ /rab tu byung gyur pa/ /'dod chags bral ba'i dge slong gis④/ /tshogs la dge 'dun zhes su brjod//sa e ṣa budha pra mu khaḥsaṃ bheḥswa ku sha le bi shā/ /ma yā pu sgo pa āoṃ sangs rgyas gtsor byas dge 'dun ni⑤/ /bsod nams zong gis rnyed gyur nas/ /rang gi dge ba 'tshol ( pā mya pra ṇa ye na ni oṃ tri taḥ/ /i ti tad ba tsa ṣpe shu twa tata smṛ tya na tha byed pa/ /bdag gi ⑦gus pas mgron du gnyer/ /de skad de yi tshig thos nas/ /mgon med zas sbyin piṇḍa daḥ/ /budha lasbra na bha bee na ni shi 'i ddhā sa mā ya yo/ /ra de dran zhing / /sangs rgyas la dmigs bsgom pa yis/ /mtshan mo gnyid du yang dag song / /mtshan dza dzñā yā ma she ṣā yī sa mā kṛṣṭa i borlukaḥ/ /pra bhā ta mi ti sa dzha twa mo'i lhag ma'i thun la ni/ /'dod pas yang dag drangs pa bzhin/ /tho rangs zhes shes kwagrong khyer gyi//95—291

pu ra dā re ṇa nirya yo/ /shi bi kā dā ra mā sā rya pa saṃ pā phye ba de ba hūṃ/ /ma dhu sgo nas de ni phyi rol song / /sgo yi lha khang du phyin pas/ /de yi ①lha dang yang dag phrad/ /sbrang rtsi'i skabye na ni diṣṭi gre yaḥsaṃ thā na māpta bān/ /bha ga bārnya ta taḥpā gya sa phung pos bstan pa yi1/ /mchog gi lam ni thob par gyur/ /de nas de yis bcom ldan thob/ /skom tre:rta i bā mṛ tai/ /ba bhū bā nu sa mā swārda pra mo dā mo dā nidṛ taḥ/ /pas gdungs pas bdud rtsi bzhin/ /rab dga'i dri bzang bde ba yis/ /nyams su myong ba dpe med gyur//tai dṛ: sā da ra du rātatshwa yā ta ru mi bā dhwa gaḥ/ /a bā pa ga ta lam mgron ④ skom pas gus bcas par/ /ring nas grib bsil ljon pa bzhin/ /zhi zhing ngal bsos saṃ ta paḥshākṣiṃ bi shrarnyi shī ta dzee/ /ta gya tad darsha de ṣpe ba le bhi ga tī bsel ba de/ /thob cing yongs su gdung ba bral/ /de yi yid ni dri ma dang / /bral ba de mthong nyid ma naḥ/ /sha ra ta sa mā ga me ṣpe ba gha na dhūdhostotain bhaḥ/ /sa ko kyis thob/ /nam mkha' ston ⑤dang phrad pa yis/ /sprin gyi tshogs dang bral ba bzhin/ /gang yang pi pu rgya shī lā nā ma nu bhā ba pra sā di byā/ /bha brnyi yata pra sā de na bsod nams ngang tshul dang / /bka' drin ldan pa'i mthu de ni/ /rang gi drin gyi sems kyis ⑥ni/ /nirbisnabyetta bṛtta yaḥ/ /so tsinta ya da ho mo ha bi byā naḥko gya la spyod tshul bgegs med 'gyur ba yin/ /de ⑦bsams kye ma bdag gi ni/ / yang dag 6)rmongs pa 'di ma naḥ/ /a nutstsha da bi kā ro yo dzā taḥpra sha ma sadza daḥ/ /baṃ tsi to dang bral/ /rnam 'gyur 'di ni rjes su bcad/ /rab tu zhi ba phun tshogs skyes/ /bcom ldan 'das smi na yata pūbaṃ dṛsgo yo bha ga bān ma yā/ /nā dha tyā nā mi yo yā ti mūnti 'di bdag gis sngon/ /gang zhig mthong bar ma grur bslus/ /sku 'di ⑫ skal ldan min pa yis/ /mig lo tsa na go tsa re/ /a mṛ ta ma hu ro dā rā dṛṣṭizlu tiḥ sha shi gi spyod tshul ⑩mi 'gyur ro/ /gzigs pa'i bcud kyi bdud rtsi yid 'ong rgya che'i ⑪ri bong can ltar nyams 95—292

pe sha la ta ru ṇa ka ru ṇa yaṭwā bṛsbyiḥpra sā da ma yī ma tiḥ/ /a ya su bde/ /spyod ①tshul snying rje dar la bab pa'i dbang gyur rab tu dang ba'i rang bzhin blo/ /'khor ba ma ti sha yaḥpra tyā sandaḥka ro ti bi rā ga tsā bi ga ta ra dza sī niḥsaṃ dag ni med par dgyes kyang yongs su 'dzin cing rab tu nye bar gnas/ /phul du byung ba 'di ni rdul bral sā raḥ pri yo pi pa ri gra ha ཿ / / i ti tsitta pra sā de na tsitta rnams kyi chags pa nyid dang bral bar bgyid/ /ces bsams kun dga' ldan pa des ④/ /nye bar yand+ra pa thra tya saḥ/ /bi da dhe ta su sā nandaḥpā da padmā bhi banda rgo/ /bha btud nas de yi ni/ /zhabs kyi padmar phyag 'tshal ba/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bsgrubs/ /der rngug bān pābhi tata pābye pra sā dā nanda lakṣa rde/ /u bā ha ba da nasgo yo ni 'ongs la bcom ldan yang / /rab dang dgyes pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /snying rje rdzogs pa'i pho nya yis//pūṇḍi kā ru 5 dru ti tai/ /dṛṣṭa mā shā sa dza na dī kā me kā ma pi ta bzhin ras mdzes pas bka' stsal pa/ /de yi dbugs 'byin skyed byapa'i sprun/ /skye rdul dag slad bdud su saḥ/ /bi sa sadzā dza dzee dzadma ra dzaḥshu: su bhā na dī/ /a thā surtsi yi/ /chu bo ⑤rab 'bar ci yang ni/ /nges par de la rnam par spros/ /de nas de la bcom ldan gyis//bha ga bān bha dre bi da dhe dharma de sha dzā/ /tsa turṇa mārya sa tyā dzā pra ti ba dhe bhe dha yi 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po rnams/ /rab tu rtogs pa sgrub byed pa/ /legs ldan chos ni ⑥bstan pa dī—/ /sa shā sa na nād byasta sa mapta kle sha sarnyi tiḥ/ /ni dzee dza dma ni mdzad—/ /ston pa'i bka' las nyon mongs kyi/ /rgyud ni mtha' dag zhig pa des/ /rang gi skye ba bi ryasmi pra ṇa ta sta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a ti krādho smi bha ga bān bha brjod byas nas/ /de la phyag 'tshal der gsol pa/ /bcom ldan bdag ni shin tu 'das/ /bcom ga badhe sha ra khaṃ ga taḥ/ /bi palla bā sa nā sgyu saḥsaṃ sā re na rā me pa ldan 'das la skyabs su song / /goms pa'i bag chags rnam par zhig /'khor bar ⑦ mchog tu bdag mi 95—293

re / /ka ro tya ku sha lo dru re shu bha mā shu pra satstsha ti/ /sru tsa ya hphu tsi tā dga'—/ /chen po rnams kyis ①gzigs pa ni/ /mi dge ba dag ring du byed/ /dge ba myur bar rab tsā ram̐ ma ha tā ma ba lo ka rna/ /su khāhaṃ te bi hā rā ya bi hā ra tu ster/ /rigs pa'i spyod pa gsal bar byed/ /khyed ni bzhugs slad gus pa las/ /gtsug lag khang ba ra mā dā rāta/ /ratna sā ra pu ro dā ram̐ swa pu re kā ra yāmya haṃ/ /mchog bder bye 'os pa/ /yid 'ong rin chen snying po'i gnas/ /rang gi grong du bdag bgyid do/ /ka ro tu ta tra bha ga bān sa ta tai sbi tya nu gra haṃ/ /dha bye rā mee bi to der ni skal ldan bdag cag gisakyi/ /mchod dang dngharim gros bsten pa na/ /bcom ldan rtag tu bzhugs sma bhiḥs paryā pa ri tsarya yā/ /i tyarja dzā tā the tya su bha ga bān pa yis/ /rjes su bzung ba dag tu mdzod/ /ces pa'i don gnyer de bzhin zhes/ /bcom ldan 'das pra tya pa rya ta/ /pra ṇa yi pārja rmā sgo ga pra gastso na nyi sā dha paḥ/ /bha ga kyis de la gnang / /gang phyir dge ba gus pa yis/ /don gnyer 'joms la bstan pa min/ /de nas banta ma thā saṃ rngu shra bast+ri sa pu rī ya yo/ /tā dā dīṣṭi na sa hi taḥshā ri pu bcom ldan la zhus nas/ /de yi bka' yis dge slong ni/ /shā ri'i bu dang lhan cig tu/ /de ni mnyan tre ṇa bhigru shā/ /ta tra dze ta ku mā re ṇa hi ra byerbhe ṇa byu ya sā/ /darghaṃ yod grong khyer song / /der ni rgyal byed gzhon nu yis/ /gser gyi rin ni chen po la/ /nags tshal kā na na mā dā ya bi ha ra ma sru tra ya ta/ /bhabyund+ra hā da thā rambha byin pa blangs nas des/ /gtsug lag khang gi thig rnams btab/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin ni⑤//kṛ ta sā hā ya kaḥsu riḥ/ /bi hā re tri di bā kā rā tsa kā rā nā tha piṇḍa lha rnams dag gis grogs byas pas/ /mtho ris rnam pa'i gtsug lag khang / /gus shing spyo bas durab tu daḥ / /ta tra dze taḥku mā ro pi bhabhya bha ga bā taḥpa re/ /ya shaḥbartsigs—/ /der ni rgyal byed gzhon nu yang / /mchog tu bcom ldan la gus pas/ /grags ⑦dang 95—294

pu rgya pra ti jo yi bi da bhe dā ka roṣṭha rka /a tha tīrgyu sta ma lo kya bibasod nams bsgrub pa'i slad/ /sgo yi khang pa byas par gyur/ /de nas rmad byung gtsug lag khang / /de hā rā ram̐ bha mabye haṃ / / sā pa bā da bi ba de na tsakre dī ṣā ku brtsams zhe sdang gis 'khrugs pa'i/ /mu stegs kyis mthong smod byas dzoshing / /'gal ba pyabarjod pas laḥka bo/ /raspyokṣa pra mu khaste ྾ mātpa tyāta gru dra paṇḍi taḥ/ /sa rtsod pa byas/ /de dag gis gtso mig dmar ni/ /sbrul nag 1phyogs dang bcas pa bzhin/ /ngan pa kṣa i ba kṛ ṇḍa hi bya ki ta sa daḥ / / rudhe bi hā ra saṃ bhā re mkhas dag gi phrag dog las/ /mdun sa dag ni 'jig par byas/ /de yis rtsod pa rgyal ba'i bar/ /te na bā da dza yā ba byeḥ/ /a nā tha piṇḍa da gi rā shā ri pu traḥs ma ya gtsug lag khang gi tshogs bkag tshe/ /mgon med zas sbyin tshig dag gis/ /shā ri'i bu ni yang dag yo —/ / raghra khyo tha ta mā tū ya pra bhā boṅka sgo darsha de / /ind+ra 'ongs—/ /de nas mig dmar dag gi 4mthu/ /khyad 'phags bstan phyir de bos nas/ /mig ⑤'phrul dzā la ba lohphudzee sa ha kā ra ma darsha yata/ /shā ri pu tra bhā bo dzre bee stobs kyis rab rgyas pa/ /sa ha ka ra'i ljon pa bstan/ /shā ri'i bu yi mthus babeengs ༷pa'i/ /rlung pu lestu mu lā ni leḥ/ /udhī la taḥsha ka la hūṃ tithrend+ra ha i bā pa saḥ/ /stug ④chen po che ba yisakhya/ /mu stegs byed kyi spro ba bzhin/ /rtsa nas 'thon zhing dum bur gyur/ /de rakyākṣa bi hi hūṃ kubee ka ma dzee padme 1 ta taḥ/ /paṃ ka she ṣā dī pa: kre shā nas mig dmar gyis sprul pa'i/ /me tog rgyas pa'i padmo can/ /shā ri'i bu yis rnam sprul pa'i/ /glang ri pu tra bi ni rmi taḥ / / raghā kṣa dī kṣa ni kṣi ptaḥ sa pta shīrṣa mo ho pos 'dam rdzab lhag mar byas/ /mig dmar stobs kyis bzhag pa yis⑨/ /ltos 'gro du chen po mgo ra gaḥ/ /shā ri pu tre ṇa ni kṣiptasturṣa pakṣu gra mā ru taiḥ/ /ta dā byu to tha bdun pa/ /shā ri'i bu yis (bya khyung gi/ /gshog pa'i rtse mo'i rlung gis 'phangs/ /de nas des bkug 95—295
