be tā laḥ sha ri pu tre ṇa tī li ta ཿ / / pre ri to mant+ra bīrle ṇa ro langs lalha/ /shā ri'i bu yi ༷phur bus btab/ /sngags kyi 'u brtson 'grus kyis bskul nas/ /mig raghākṣ-i hantu mudma yo/ /bee tā lā bhi ha tasthā san na shyadmā na ma da dzwa raḥ/ /dmar gsod du rab tu song / /ro langs kyis bcom skrag pa las④/ /nga rgyal rgyags pa'i ri zhi ⑤nas//sha ra rte pā da pa ti taḥshā ri pu tram̐ dza gā ma saḥ/ /raktakṣa te na sgo ge na de ni zhabs la gtugs byas te/ /shā ri'i bu la skyabs su song / /bcom pa de yi kwamig dmar de/ /sha ra bye sha ra rde ga taḥ/ /pra bra rjo yī bī ta rā ga sa shuddhā bo bye māpta skyabs 'os dag la skyabs song nas/ /rab tu byung ba ④'dod chags bral/ /dag pa'i byang chub thob bān / /tīddhā sta bye pa ri dwo ṣa kro dha pā ra ti tārsha baḥ/ /ta tra par gyur/ /mu stegs gzhan rnams yongs sdang dang / /khro ba'i pha rol bsgral 'dod pa④/ /dge slong kand+raka ra byā dzā tasbrabhikyu ba sgodma tāḥ/ /te tha dharma bru haḥkā le shā dag la gnod brtson zhing / /de na las byed zol gyis ⑨gnas/ /de nas de dag shā ri'i bus/ / dus ri pu tre ṇa lakṣ-i tāḥ/ /tadṛṣṭi bā ta mā tre ṇa ba khyu pumee tra mā na sāḥ/ /su de las 'khu shes nas/ /⑫ de yi spyan zur tsam nyid kyis/ /yid ni byams dang ldan par gyur/ /ā sha yā nu sha ya dhwa rtu pra kṛ ti tsa bi tsā rya saḥ/ /dharma de sha na yā te ྾ di khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /rang bzhin dag kyang spyad nas de.enyu/ /chos ni bstan pas de dag de shā nu tta ram̐ da shī / / a tha ta gya bee hā ra su ni mbi sna rnams—/ /bla med gnas skabs dag la bkod/ /de nas gtsug lag khang de'i las/ /brtsams pa ram̐ bha karma ṇi/ /a nā tha thraṇḍa rda pā ha shā ri pu traḥsmi tā na naḥ/ /bgegs dang bral ba'i tshe/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan shā ri'i bus/ /mgon med zas sbyin la smras pa/ /bi hā ra sru tra pā ta gya tu la e ba kṣa ṇi ma hān/ /he mo bi hā raḥsaṃ dṛttastu gtsug lag khang gi thig btab pa'i/ /dus mtshungs nyid du dga' ldan gyi/ /lha yi gnas su gser gyi ni//95—296

ṣi te de ba padma ni/ /e ta dā kasbya sa dzā ta pra sā da dī gu ṇa da gtsug lag khang chen yang dag grub/ /de thos she7gus pa nyis 'gyur gyisasnye7 / /rab tu dang ba yang dag raḥ / /he ma ratna ba rā gā ram̐ bi hā rā ma kā ra ya ta/ /bi bha bee ra tha skyes—/ /rin chen gser mchog khang pa yi1/ /gtsug lag khang ni de yis byas/ /de nas bcom ldan rā dzārte pa thi te no pa kalpi taiḥ/ /bi dzñābye st+ri de baiḥsārja mā ya yo bha ga rgyal ba la/ /gsol te lha dang lhan cig ni/ /lam du de yis nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /rgyal po la 'os bān dzi naḥ/ /ta dā ga ma nā hakṣe ṇa pra sarje bhu ba na tra cha/ /a nā tha piṇḍa 'byor pas byon/ /de ni byon pa la dga' nas/ /srid gsum rab tu dang ba'i tshe/ /de la mgon med dastasmi bā ri jo rā ma pā ta yata/ /ta smin ya dā na pra de she bā ri khye ra pa pā ta zas sbyin byis/ /chu yi rgyun ni rab tu bgrengs④/ /gang gi tshe na phyogs de ru/ /chu yi rgyun ni ma babs 'usā—/ /ta dā bha ga ba to bākyā da ba tahūṃ ta tā n+ya taḥ/ /tai dṛṭī kau pa—/ /de tshe gzhan du bcom ldan gyi/ /gsung las rgyun dang ldan par babs6/ /de mthong mtshar nas tu kā ta bṛsbyo rbhakṣu bhirbha ga ban pu raḥ/ /u pā tsa thra ya tā me tad bā dge slong gis/ /zhus shing bcom ldan 'das kyis slar/ /bka' stsal chu 'dir ⑦rengs pa yi / rgyu ri stambha gya kā ra rde/ /a ṣpe na pārba budhe bhyophosminde bee da māspa rda/ /ni rab tu mnyan par gyis/ /sngon gye sangs rgyas rnams la 'dis/ /gnas 'di yi ni 'di nyid du/ /pra ti pā di ta mi hye ṣa bā ri dhwa rā n+ya tabyu tā/ /a ṣpe ṣpe ba su rī sa myakshi rab tu byin par gyur to zhes/ /chu rgyun 'di ni gzhan du lhung( 7/ /sngon gyi yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//budha ya bi pa bye ṣpe/ /a ya me ba ba rā rā ma pra de shaḥpra ti pā di taḥ/ /rnam par gzigs la 'di nyid kyis/ /mchog gi kun dga' ra ba yi/ /sa phyogs 'di nyid rab tu byin//buddhā ya shi khi de pra dāta pu 6 dzadma n+ya yo pu naḥ/ /ta to da do bi shwa bhu be dzi nā rgyal gyi skye ba dag la yang / /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phul/ /de nas ra ghu'i skye ba la/ /rgyal ba 95—297

ya ra ghra dzadma ni/ /bha ba taṭwā bhi sgo bhū tā kra kutstshand+ra ya dāṭwā ya/ /da do thams cad skyob la phul/ /srid pas byin zhes gyur pa na/ /'khor ba 'jig la rab tu phul/ /chen po'i bṛ haspa tisgo twa ka na kā khyu ya tā yi ṣpe/ /kā shya pa ya pu nabya yo zwa dā dā ṣa ṭa bdag tu gyur pa'i tshe/ /skyob pa gser zhes bya la phul/ /ā ṣā ḍa yi skye ba la/ /slar yang 'od srungs la dzadma ni/ /a de ṣpe bā dhu na ma hūṃ de shwa yo pra ti pā di taḥ/ /kā le na su dha nā khro 'di phul/ /da lta nga la 'di nyid kyis/ /yul 'di dag ni rab tu byin/ /dus kyis nor bzang zhes pas ①yo mo tre yā ya pra dā su ti/ /sa twa bān kṣurnyi shī la tā— dhwa nā 'di—/ /byams pa la ni 'bul bar 'gyur/ /snying stobs bzod pa tshul khrims dang / /ldan phyir 'di bye ṣa ba shya ti/ /su ra: yo kṛ ha pa tispyo tā te ma pra dā bhe dhaḥ/ /tsakre yis gter rnams mthong / /sngon yang khyim gyi bdag po 'di/ /gser sbyin zhes par gyur pa na/ /rang pra hye ka budzha phya saṃ ska ram̐ pa ri nidṛ to/ /rasne kuste tad sbyi ni ni sangs rgyas ni mya ngan las/ /'das pa'i legs par bya ba byas/ /rin chen bum par de yi gdung / /dhri twa tata pra ṇi jo ta/ /a dhu nā ratna ko shārtaḥsaṃ dza to yi su baṇḍi ghāka /bcug nas smon lam btab pa las/ /da lta rin chen mdzod 'os pa'i/ /gser gyi snod du 'di gyur to//shu two ti shāstu rba tsa nā bhe jo rna te bye kṣa ba ཿ sār mi bā mṛ dge slong de dag rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhin/ /ston pa'i gsung gis ①mngon par brjod pa 'di ta su / / ka rtu ཿ pra ti jo rdzi ta pū ṇḍi pu ju pu ṣṭha bye bā se na thos nas/ /byed por ④rab gnas kyis bsgrubs bsod nams rgyas pa yi/ /me tog lhag par gnas pas bye sha na nand+raḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba mchog tu dga' bar gyur/ /zhes ⑤pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa bā na kalpa la tā yī dze ta ba na pra ti gra hā ba dā rna nā ma dā bo sha brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las rgyal byed kyi tshal yongs su bzung ba'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa bu95—298

tiḥpalla waḥ// //gnyis pa'o// //a ho ma harta ma bee badma ha two bha byā bha dzadhe gu ṇa go ra bee ṇa/ /kye ma legs ldan rin thang che ba'i chen po nyid/ /nor bu bzhin du yon tan bla ma nyid kyis 'thob//bi nā gu shā yadma pu྾ gu ru two sbra lo pa la na mi ba nisga lo tata/ /yon tan med par gang zhig lus kyi ① bla ma nyid/ /rdo las rags pa bzhin du de ni 'bras bu med/ /shrī mān pu rā shākya pu re na rend+raḥshurnyo da naḥshudhi su dhwa ni dhwa dzwa/ /bee ra shākya'i grong gi mi yi dbang po sngon/ /dpal ldan zas gtsang dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i gter/ /chags bral gya yo gāta su ga ta twa māpta smṛ twa su tai sokhru ka tā ma bā pa/ /bo tsitta ldan las bde gshegs nyid thob pa'i/ /sras ni dran nas 'dod dang bcas par gyur/ /de bsams yata pu rgya gu rja bye pā saṃ sa ra swa tī bā sa sa ro ru ha gre/ /ma bsod nams yon tan lhag buganas shing / /dbyangs can gnas dang mtsho las skyes pa'i dpal/ /yid naḥpra sā da su bi khā sa sau snye trasthā mi su norba da ram̐ ka dā haṃ/ /e tī ti tajarsha ni rab tu dang ba'i rtse dga'i gnas/ /bu yi bzhin ras gang tshe bdag gis mthong / /de ni blta rmibar na khā se na ye ye ma yā dze ta ba rna bi mṛṣṭaḥ/ /te te ta dā lo sred pas 'dir byon ces④/ /bdag gis gang gang rgyal byed tshal du btang / /de de mig mi 'dzums ke na nirdi me ṣa ta tre ba tikhye tya mṛ tai pi bantaḥ/ /saṃ pre ṣi tasta gya ma yā pas de blta 3zhing / /de nyid du ni bdud rtsi 'thung zhing 'dug /gang yang mdza' las bdag mtshungs sa mā ya yo pyatpa tu lyaḥpra ṇa yā du dā yī/ /sa le kha hastaste di ba bhi rā 'char ka ni/ /de dgug slad du bdag gis yang dag btang / /spring yig lag de lha rnams mngon dga' me ta tre ba le kha twa mi bā bhi ya taḥ/ /saṃ de sha bākyi pra hi tasma yā yata tabyi smṛ taib—/ /de nyid du ni lha nyid bzhin du gyur/ /de yi kha la bdag gi 'phrin ༷gyi tshig /springs pa gang de 95—299

mu dā yi nā sru tsi ta mā ka ma snga dza nata/ /dza gaṅga sum̐ byu mi pa tiḥku mā re kṛ ldan pa/ /'char kas legs par bshad la 17rab shes nas/ /gzhon nu 'gro ba'i bla ma de la ri/ /sa tāñdza liste pra ṇa nā ma dru rāta/ /a thā ba tīryārya dza nā nu yā taḥsaṃ pū bdag ring nas thal mo sbyar nas ( 7btud/ /de nas babs te 'phags skye'i rjes 'brang bcas/ /rgyal po bye ma nāḥpra ṇa ye na rā dzñā/ /spyita pra bhā bhā se ta disbi bhā tsā tyā gro dhi no ratna gus pas yang dag mchod sri gyur pa/ /phyogs cha gzi byin rgyas pas spyomadzes pa yis⑤ / /n+ya gro dha yi rin byu baṃ bi bee sha /ho mā sa rna shā sa na sadngha biṣṭa lo ka tra yaḥsaṃ ga ta pā chen sa gzhir byon/ /'jig rten gsum po bka' la legs gnas de'u/ /der ni rkang stegs ldan pa'i da bī rja/ /sa ta tra ratrī ku ra tsi tra pa tram̐ bhā swabee surme ru mi bā ru ro ha/ /gser gye khri/ /rin chen myu gu bkra ba'i 'dab ldan la/ /lhun po la ni 'od ldan lus bzhin 'dzegs/ /tadmā na send+ra na ya nā mṛ to hūṃ ma no ra tha pārba na yo sa yā tai/ /bi lo ka ya— yid kyi zla ba mig gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /yid la re bas don gnyer 'ongs ⑦pa de/ /dga' bas mig mi dṛ ti nirni e ṣaḥkṣa rde kṣi tī shaste da sha twa mā pa/ /pa tai dza ga dra shu ni 'dzums rmepar bltas pa las/ /skad cig sa yi dbang pos lha nyid thob/ /dga' ba'i ro las nang du rudha kaste soṅkarṣa harṣa ku li tai ku mā re/ /hā rā gra raṭwā pra tibisba zhugs pa bzhin/ /do shal rin chen mchog la gzugs brnyan chags/ /gzhon nu khyad 'phags dgyes pa satta pra bee sha yan pra ti ra sā di bāntaḥ/ /sarnyo ṣa shi tā tsa la swa bhā rgyas de la/ /mgrin pa ⑪mchi mas 'gags pa de yis smras/ /yongs tshim g.yo med bsel ⑩ba'i rang bā ta sabaṃ ra madhe ku sha la bee li 6/ /kṛ tasta yāsmra ka ma yo tu bzhin las/ /thams cad dge ba'i thang la dga' bar byed/ /yongs su gdung byed bral ⑨ba'i nyer kasmrata satru pa ka rī bi ra ho pa de shaḥ/ /sne hāta pra mo dāta gu ṇa go ra bstan 'di/ /bdag cag rnams la khyod kyis ci phyir mdzad/ /mdza' dang rab dga' yon tan la gus 95—302

bārtso dhīddhā ba ṭī yo twa yi me pra sa khya/ /ā lo ga nā ya sbi ra saṃ ga mā ya pas—/ /'khyud pa dang ni brtan par 'grogs pa dang / /zhabs la phyag bgyi'i beed du mnyam nyid du//pā da pra rja mā ya tsa tu lya me ba/ /yabyista ki tsitta di da tra ya me sho ta bdag gi blo ni ①'phral la khyod can rgyug /cung zad gang de bdag gis brjod pa 'di/ /bdag la bya me ba pra ṇa yo pa ro jota/ /gu khodzhai tai bā bi ra sa kra rma dā na sne ha byams ngor khyod kyis gsan par bya/ /yon tan spangs pa'i byechags bral rim pa ni/ /mdza' bas rmongs mo ha su bha ba tya bā hye/ /pra tyaṇḍi ratna pra ti bimbi tārka pro zwa pra bhā pra pas brjod bya min pa nyid/ /nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan (rwaldan pa'i rin chen gyis/ /legs spras lhag ④ pa'i ba ra shā n+ya rū ni/ /two he ma hadhyā ṇi bi hā ya kasmrata bi gā khya se shu n+ya ba nānta 'od zer rab rgyas pa/ /gser gyi khang bzang 'di dag ci yi slad/ /btang nas khrod ni nags na ⑤stong rā ṇi/ /kārsā ka rā brdzi ta he ma rku bhaḥsata sau ra hūṃ bhaḥpra sa tā rnyi ṣiktaḥ/ /par 'khyam/ /na chung lag pas gser gyi bum btud cing / /dri bzang chu yis mchog tu mngon bkrus pa//e kaḥg the rtswa si bi kā si dzā su yi tapta to yā su ma ru sbi lbo 6/ /gaṇḍa bee mya ngan thang la buyongs su tsha ba'i chu/ /rngul gyis klurgyas pas gcig pu ji ltar 'khru/ /rin chen mdzes la ta kuṇḍa la ratna kārnyi ki maṇḍa na me ba bo྾ / / kasmra da kasmratta pa'i rna cha 'gram par 'phyang / /rgyan rnams 'dor bar byed pa pya ci zhig rigs/ /ci slad bde med spyod ba niḥsu kha su na tsanda rna nanda na mind+ra shu bye/ /ma hā bi tra ṣpe sha ya ṣpe dṛ pārte she ni glo bur du/ /tsandan zla ltar dkar bas dga' ma yin/ /mi bdag la 'os khri stan bla re che/ /lhag ⑩ṣe ṇa ki she ṣa bi she ṣa shu bye/ /lakhye na bā bo ga na sgo ga yo gya ka rja ltar khyad par dkar la cis mi gzims/ /dpal mos gsar 'khyud longs spyod 'os gyur pa/ /khyod kyi ta nuste sa ha te ku sha llī/ /kānta smi tombi pra ti rmā shu kāhaṃ ki ṭī ba ra lus kyis stan ngan ji ltar bzod/ /mdzes 'dzum rlabs kyis gzugs brnyan gos 'os pa/ /lus 'di la 95—303

sro tsi ta me ta rda ge/ /pā rto tsa lī khā ka ma lā gya de smin pā tram̐ ka rja te thra ya ma rya ni chos gos ji ltar 'os/ /khyod kyi phyag ni padmo'i rol gnas 'dir/ /da lta stilhung bzed dga' ba ji dzā tai/ /a yo bi hā ra sta ba kaṇḍa rpā thaḥsoṅkaṇḍa kānta ju dza bandha nārtaḥ/ /ltar skye/ /khyod kyi mgrin pa rgyab kyi gnas 'di dag /sred ldan mdzes ma'i lag pas bsdams 'os pa/ /saṃ sgo ga lakhyiḥkṣa pi ta pra mo daḥka ro tya tīṇḍi pra ṇa yā ba sgo gi/ /longs spyod dpal mo'i rab dga' nyams gyur cing / /glo bur nyid du mdza' gcugs nyams par byed/ /rū paṃ bi lasmri kṛ te pubee tsā paṃ maste bha kustostso ku tsā bi bhu tiḥ/ /ra me tog gzhu ldan skyengs —7par byed pa'i gzugs/ /glang chen myos bum ltar mtho'i nu rgyas 'byor/ /lang terbi khā so pa ba āoṃ ba yabyu ke nā sa maste na ka li to bi rā gaḥ/ /khru two ti tsho dga' ba'i rtse sa nye ba'i nags/ /ci slad khyod kyi ④mi bzad chags bral byas/ /zhes gsan tshul tai shī la ni byerba bhā ṣe sha shaṃ ka le khā la li ta smi te na/ /saṃ krānta nā nā khrims gter kyis bka' stsal te/ /zla ba'i cha bzhin rol pa'i 'dzum dag gis/ /mi bdag sna tshogs dṛ pa ratna rā gi kurbanda lakṣu mi ba rā dza lasmri ma/ /rā dza na dza rā ro ga ha rin chen 'od 'phros pa'i/ /rgyal po'i dpal ni mi snang 'dzad ④pa bzhin/ /rgyal po chu rgyun ltar g.yo te ba na sru tu re ga lo khā ya di dzī ba dṛdhiḥ/ /taṅka su na snga da ni shaṃ pra harṣa 'tsho ba'i srog /gal te rga dang na bas mi 'joms na/ /rab ⑤ dga' bdud rtsi'i char lta'i yul rnams la//rpā yu ṣa barṣa bi ṣa yā bhi khā ṣaḥ/ /sha mā mṛ tā swā da na su sbi rā zla ma rtag tu su zhig mngon par 'dod mi bgyi2 / /zhi ba'i bdud rtsi nyams stsong brtan rnams kyis⑦/ /nags pa ti ni shu n+ya ba nānta bhū miḥ/ /bi byu ti lī khā ma da bi hwa khā rmā harmya nang stong pa'i sa gzhi gnod med yin/ /'byor pas rgyags shing rtse dgas 2'khrugs rnams kyi/ /ba gam ṇi paryanta ni pā ta nā ni/ /sa ku ma ku miḥsturnyi dṛ pāḥs yo bhiḥs rā ga tai maḥldan pa mthar ni rnam par lhung ⑨/ /gang zhig gur kum bidang bcas chus bkrus pa'i/ /mi bdag rtag tu 95—304

sa ta lta pra yārnyi/ /saṃ to ṣa shi lastu ma naḥpra sā da shurghaṃ bu sgo tā bee ma lī bha chags dang ldan par gyur①/ /yid ni rab tu dang ba'i chus bkrus pa'i/ /chog shes ngang tshul dri ma bral brnyi / /sho lta khru te ṣpe ba na kuṇḍa le na dā ṣpen pā ṇi rna tu rka ka ṇi na/ /bar 'gyur ༷/ /snying rje rgyas pa rnams kyi lus mdzes pa/ /gzhan phan gyis yin tsandan byugs 2pas min//bi bhā ti kā yaḥka ru zla ku khā dzā pa ro pa kā re ṇa na tsanda ṣpe na/ /e tā ni mo hā rna ba thos pas yin gyi rna chas khyomin/ /lag pa sbyin pas yin gyi gdub 2bus min/ /sa bdag gis spyad ha ta balla bhā ni saṃ sakta mutsū shu si ta smi ta ni/ /sa tai na sgo gyu ni lhag mar gyur pa'i rgyan/ /mu tig 'od chags dkar ba'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /rmongs pas dhidaga' ba ma bha brnyi byu j-i dustsoṣṭa shiṭwā ni bee byu ṣa shā ni/ /rā gā tu rā rde ri pu bcom 'di dag ni/ /dam pa rnams kyis ⑦spyad par 'os pa min/ /chags pas gzir dang dgra yis tā pi tā rmā ni dā dha na dhyā na ba tānda nā ma/ /sha yā su kha sparsha ba tī 6 rā gdungs 2gyur pa/ /nor gyi bsam gtan ldan pa'i rgyal po la/ /reg na bde ba'i lam khan gnyid yod dhī sand+ra tra shāntaḥsu kha me ba she te/ /nirmo ka kādhe na ba dzā shu ke na min—/ /zhi ba rnams ni kun tu bde bar gzims/ /lag 'gro'i spyod tshul sbrul shun mdzes pa yi/ /bhu dzee ga thratrīrna tu ṭī ba re ṇa/ /pā tra pa bi tā ṇi sa mā plu hā ni gos bzang gis min bu chos gos dag gis yin 7/ /lhung bzed kyis ni zas dag gtsang ba dang / /rpā yu ṣa mi tā rgya sha nā ni sru te/ /tstsha tā ṇi baghra dzdza ṣa ma pra kā shaṃ yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi'i grogs po nyid du bskyed/ /gdugs kyi bzhin ni mchog tu mi gsal zhing / /ma rto bi lo lo bya dza nā ni lo ghāḥ/ /saṃ sakta dzā bye dzdza da yi dṛ pā rde kuzanta hā rā rlung yab rlung gis yid ni rnam par g.yo/ /ha ri tsandan gyis brlan skedo shal gyis/ /mi bdag snying la ha ri tsanda nābyeḥ/ /bi yo ga ro gā nu ga tā bi bhu tiḥkāntaḥkṣa ṇaddhā bi ra so bi bsil ba reg par byed/ /'byor pa bral 'u ba'i nad kyi rjes su 'gro/ /rtse dga' ro bral mdzes ma skad 95—305

khā saḥ/ /yasminda pā yaḥs ta tā nu shā yī sa ka su sgo gaḥsu bha go pa yo gaḥ/ /cig mtha'/ /gang gi lus la gnod pa rtag gnas te/ /su yi longs spyod skal bzang nye bar rigs/ /dzā hūṃ sa dzre bha dza na ya tya dza sre ta no ti tro: bhra ma mo ha sprutstshaḥ/ /ka 'phral du zil gnon longs spyod nyer spyod ni/ /rgyun du glal bcas blun pa nyid bskyed cing / /sred ro tya sa hūṃ sa ra sa twa me ba sgo go pa sgo gaḥpra sa bha pi yo gaḥ/ /ya dā su 'khrul rmongs dang brgyal ba rgyas pa dang / /mi bzad chags dang bcas pa nyid du byed/ /gang tshe bde kha shrirna ba tsand+ra le khā pra bhā ta putpa n+ya pi yo ba nā ni/ /kand+rambi mā lā gra ha rṇa sha rī dpal zla tshes ri mo dang / /lang tsho yang ni snga dro'i me tog ste/ /lus ni las kyi rlabs kyis 'phreng ①ba ram̐ ta dā ma mā yo ga mi to nu rā gaḥ/ /satsā ma rāḥdhwa dza sum̐ dza paṭwā 'dzin—/ /de tshe bdag ni rjes su chags dang bral/ /rnga yab dang bcas dar dang rgyal mtshan thogs⑤//sa bā dzi bā la dri pa karṇa tā lāḥ/ /swa bha ba lo laḥki la rā dza lasmyuḥsabye rta dang bcas pa'i glang zhon rna ba'i stabs/ /rang bzhin gyes g.yo rgyal po'i dpal 'byor gyi①/ /longs bi la sā kṣa ṇa dzha ga saṃ gaḥ/ /kuste ti ta ta ta ta ku sha lā yā rā spyod thams cad skad cig 'jig pa'i grogs/ /rgyal po'i thugs ni rab dang mchog bsgrub ④cing / /dge dzñāshyitta pra sā rda pa ra oṃ bee dhwa ya/ /sa shārnyi kaslo la su jo pra bā haṃ ki ran dṛ shā ba'i slad du de de bka' stsal nas/ /zhi ba'i rlabs ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun rgyas shing / /de yi spyan gyes pārṣa da mā lu lo ke/ /ma nī ṣi rde shākya ku loṅga tā rna sabhā yu tā ni pra ti pā 'khor la rnam par gzigs/ /shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa ni/ /khri phrag bdun gyis chos ni ryadhadzre / /tsakri sa ha su ṇi sapta ta tra saṃ pāpta saryā pta bi she ṣa rtogs byas shing / /de la stong phrag bdun yang yongs rdzogs kyi/ /khyad par yang dag 'thob pa'i snod dzñā dzi/ /shuklo da nā ye ku sha lo sa brje ga ṇi tha tabhu lya sa ha sra nyid mdzad/ /de nas de dang 'a7 grangs mtshungs stong phrag tshogs/ /zas dkar la sogs rnams kyis dge 95—306

saṃ khyeḥ/ /tro kho da nā bye ra mṛ to da nā bye—tta pra sa daḥsu ma hā na baptaḥ/ /ba thob/ /bre bo zas sogs /ky-i7bdud rtsi zas sogs kyis— 3/ /shin tu che ba'i sems ni dang ba thob/ /ke tsidma yuḥshā ba ka bo dhi yukta pra hye ka bo sgo ni ra tābya ke tsita/ /samyakta thā kha cig nyan thos byang chub ldan par gyur/ /nyi ( che'i byang chub reg dang la la dag /de bzhin yang dag nutta ra bo dhi saṭwāḥpa re ba byu burga ga na pra sand+raḥ/ /sho taḥpa ri pāpta bla med byang chub zhugs/ /gzhan ni mkha' bzhin rab tu dang bar gyur/ /de nas gzhan gyis rgyun pha lo ta to bye sa sa kṛ dā gā mi pha lo ta tha bye/ /abye gya nā gā mi pha zhugs 'bras bu thob/ /de bzhin gzhan byis lan gcig phyir 'ong dang / /phyir mi 'ong 'bras de yang lo ta dā pu rartatpa lo kle sha bi mutta ra bye/ /e kastu ta tā dzi ta pā pa gzhan gyis te/ /nyon mongs rnam grol gzhan gyis dgra bcom thob/ / mdun sar de ni lha sbyin ④ gcig sha pasta maḥs mu ho pa nyi ta pra mo haḥ/ /mā yo ha mi tyā ha ha san dza pu zhig /mun pa'i tshogs kyis gtibs shing rab rmongs pasa'7 / /sdig dmod ma thul skye bo rnams kyi na rmā sa tya sbi to saṃ sa di de ba dattaḥ/ /dṛ paṃ tu bātpa lya ni lbo na me ba lugs—/ /bden pa la bkod 'di ni sgyu zhes smra bu/ /mi yi bdag kyang mnyes gshin gyis chags shing //pu tro da yāta pra byu ta dzā ta dadzre/ /moṅga lya bhikṣu dzi na shā sa ṣpe na ma hadhi sras ni dar las zlog par dogs ⑦skyes pa/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las dge slong mo gal ru7bus/ /rdzu 'phrul bhisthā ta ma rda tsa kā ra/ /dṛṭī phi rā dzā bha ga bta pra bhā pi na tyabyu chen pos rgyags dang bral bar kyebyas/ /bcom ldan mthu ni rgyal pos mthong gyur kyang / /shin tu rmad tai po ru ṣa me ba me ṣpe/ /a sgyu sa byā nā ni dza na gya byu rmā soṅkarṣa kṛ tyā ni na bisma byung skyes bu nyid mi sems/ /phul byung mdzad pa goms pas reg pa ni/ /nges par skye bo'i ya mtshan rgyu yā ya/ /a tha pa re dkurbha ga bān su rend+ra saṃ pa di te he ma ma hā bee mān/ /ma yin/ /de nas nyi ma gzhan la lha dbang gis/ /rab bsgrubs gser gyi gzhal yas khang chen du/ /95—307

su me ru shī rnyi sa ma kā sha ru tse ཿ sau ha lhun po'i spyog ltar lhun po'i spyog ltar sogs tshig rkang gcig gi skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar dpyad/ gsal zhing sa ṣpe ratna ma yi n+ya ྾ data/ /bra dmend+ra mu khe 6 ta taḥsru re mdzes pa yi①/ /rin chen seng ge'i khri la bcom ldan 'das/ /de nas der ni tshangs dang dbang po 6 ta tro pe biṣṭi 6 thra thu pra bhe 6/ /ba bhupta dukṇi ṣa shi khāe bi khā sogs—/ /'od zer che ba'i lha rnams nyer gnas tshe/ /de yi gtsug tor rtse las 'phros pa'i duphyogs/ /meebyasbyo shu mā lnga dza ṭi khā i bā shāḥ/ /a byo n+ya saṃ ghaṣṭa bi lo pa hā rirgha nā zla 'od 'phreng ba'i ral pa bzhin du mdzes/ / do shal phan tshun reg cing g.yo ba yis/ /kyelha rnams ba hā riḥtri da sherbi shaddhiḥ/ /ni radzñātsā bhu ba me ba rā dzā dā re 6 mānā stug por babs shing zhugs pa yis/ /bar mtshams ④ med pa'i sa der rgyal pos ni/ /sgo bzhi rnams su na tsa tukhyo le bhe/ /sa byu blu maste tra ku bee ra mu khyerni bārya mā ṇḍa bhi ma taḥpra lam nyid thob ma gyur/ /ku be ra sogs byun ma g.yo ldan pas/ /der ni mngon par 'jug 'dod zlog ⑤bee shaḥ/ /bi tshwa ya babhyaḥslu li tā bhi dhwayī khyu j-ita pa re nind+ra ti sgo ba bhū ba/ /gyur pa/ /bzhin ni mdzes bral brjod pa 'khrul gyur pa'i/ /sa bdag mchog tu gzi byin med par gyur/ /pra bi shi tasterdzi na shā sa ṣpe na ka dā tsi dā sha rya ta da gra byu mo/ /shurnyo rgyal ba'i bka' yis de dag rnams kyis btang / /ji buzhig ltar stes ⑦de mdun sa gzhi thob/ /zas da naste pra ṇi pa tya rūspyo tsitta pra sā de na pu re su taspyo/ /shāstu ta tasmi tsa gtsang spyi bos de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi mdun na rab dang sems kyis gnas/ /de nas ston pas de tu rā rya sa tya pra bo dha kṣiṃ dharma ka thāndi de sha /dzñā ṣpe na yā dzi sha ti la chos kyi gtam/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi rab tu rtogs byed bstan/ /gang zhig shes pas de yi shri ga ma gya saṅka ya treg bhū dha ra ma su dzñā kṣita/ /ta taḥs ga tā kṛ ta kṛ tya dzadmā 'jig tshogs la/ /lta ba'i ri rtse nyi shu dag kyang bcom/ /de nas skye ba'i bya ba byas pa de/ /song nas 95—308

shuklo da rgo pra bha dza swa rā rdzu/ /swa gya bra bītrī bha ga band+ra diṣṭi dasgo sa zas dkar la smras rgyal srid gzung ① / /des smras bdag ni bcom ldan gyis gnang ba/ /bstan pa la āoṃ mo da yi tai na rā rdzu/ /tro kho da ṣpe rā bye pa rā mu khe pi bai rā gya yo gā da dga' rgyal srid ma yin ༷no/ /bye bo zas kyang rgyal srid las 1phyir phyogs/ /bdud rtsi zas kyang chags mṛ to da na tsa/ /dza gā hā shuzlo da na saṃ pra diṣṭi hūṃ rā bye la smri ma tha bha tri kā bral ldan gyur tshe/ /de nas zas gtsang gis gnang rgyal po yi/ /dpal 'byor de ni bzang ldan zhes pas khyaḥ—/ /rā dzārta sgo gi ra tha pū dza yi tā dzi dzwa dza ṣpe shaḥshu tsi saṃ pra bhā taiḥ/ /bzung / /de nas rgyal pos longs spyod gtsang ma rnams/ /rab phul 'gro ba'i dbang gis rgyal ba mchod/ /n+ya gro dha dhwa ma pra ti pā rya tsā sri shurnyo da naḥshudzha ma no ra tho bhūta/ /trorto da na snga bi su n+ya gro dha yi gnas ni de khyo rab phul/ /zas gtsang yid la re ba dag par gyur/ /de nas bre bo zas kyi bu to yu bā no rā dzā rnye yā pre ra ṇa yā tsa mā tuḥ/ /e kasta yaḥpra dzi to ni gzhon gnyis/ /ma yis bskul bas de las gcig rab byung / /rgyal po'i bka' yis bkag pas gzhan rudhaḥpa ro ma hānd+ra ma kṛ tī ba bhu ba/ /a thā bha ba: ta se bha tri ka gya rā rnyo ma ni/ /chen po zhes pa khyim na gnas par gyur/ /de nas chags bral rgyal po bzang ldan gyi/ /yid ni bi rakta su ba nā bhi khā ṣaḥ/ /bi bee ga bhā rdzu pra sha ma pra bṛtrī na bā nags tshal mngon par 'dod par gyur/ /rnam rig ldan pas ⑤rab zhir zhugs pa'i yid/ /gsar pa'i pi lakhrorna ma no ru ṇadhi/ /ta taḥs mā hu ya sa de ba darja rarje bhi dpal 'byor gyis kyang khegs pa min/ /de nas de yis rgyal srid dbang bskur ni/ /'thob 'dod sems ṣe ka pra ti panda tsirghaṃ/ /u bā tsa me pra bra dza na mya ka la kra mā ga tai ki bha ba tā bi ldan lhas byin yang dag bos( — / /smras pa bdag ni rab tu 'byung ba'i dus/ /rim pas long ⑦ la khyod ni ci de yi/ /tai pra sgo bā tsātta bi be ka rda bhaḥsu saṃ bṛ taḥsaṃ sā ri de ba zhig brjod/ /dben pa'i tshul 'chos 'dzin pa'i lhas byin gyis/ /mdun sar legs bsdams de la slar 95—309

rmā—/ /saṃ sru tsi tā nā tya yī kā ni tant+ra ta thā bi dhwa bye ba hu lakṣa ṇa ni/ /bhū pa—/ /der ni rnam pa de lta'i gegs ①gyur pa/ /ngan pa'i mtshan nyid rnams ni yang dag bshad/ /de pa pra mo dā da tha bha dri ko pi tairde ba datta pra mu kheḥs hai ba/ /pra bra nas rab dga'i ges bdag bzang ldan yang / /lhas byin la sogs de rnams bcas pa nyid/ /rab byung bye yā ṭī ba ra bu tra yo gāstso kā ra bee rā gya ma yī bi bakshi/ /rā dzñāsta thā rā dza chos gos lhung bzed ldan gyur pas/ /sa gzhi chags bral rang bzhin byas pa bzhin/ /rgyal po dang ni de ku mā ra kā ṇa muskṛṣṭa hā dzā ga da kuṇḍa lā dzā/ /sā sro bi rā gā da ba tārya te bzhin rgyal sras dag /do shal dpung rgyan rna rgyan rab spangs pa/ /de dag rnams kyi skra lhung nye bar ྾ ke shā nu pā lbo ki la kalpa ko bhuta/ /mūkhoḥs byā tso bi dzi nā dzha yi 'khor—/ /'dreg mkhan chags bral mig chu ldan par gyur/ /de ni rmongs shing dman yang rgyal ba'i ba pra bra bye yā pū bye ta ro ba byu ba/ / tsitta pra sā da gya ba ra su ma bye bkas—/ /rab tu byung nas mchod 'os mchog tu gyur/ /sems ni mchog tu rab tu dang ba'i rgyu/ /na kā ra khaṃ paṇḍi ta tā na dzā tiḥ/ /sā mbi tsi kā yā ma tha bha dra go pi mkhas pa nyid min rigs ldan min nam snyam/ /de nas phyag la mi bdag bzang ldan gyis/ /'dreg dzñā tā dṛ paḥparsha di rka tai/ /bhā tsa gya pa do ka tha ma gya bande ma nyi pa mkhan de yang 'khor der 'khod shes nas/ /sa bdag gyur nas dman pa 'di yi ni/ /rkang la 'dud tiḥsambi ti nispru lo juta/ /ta ma bra bī da slu li tā bhi mā dzee bi kalpa bhi oṃ bha ga bān ces ji ltar ①g.yo med gyur/ /rnam par rtog ldan khengs dang ma bral ba/ /de la bcom ldan 'dzum zhing bi hā gya/ /pa bra bye yā mo hā nu brnyi saṃ tya bye te dzā ti ma yo bi bka' stsal pa/ /rmongs pas cher bsdams rigs las byung ba yis④/ /mngon par khengs pa rab tu byung mā naḥ/ /khru two ti rā dzñā sa ha rā dza pu treḥkṛ te pra ṇa me thra thi bī tsa kaspe/ /nas gtong spri / /zhes thos rgyal po'i sras bcas rgyal po yis/ /phyag 'tshal tshe na sa gzhi rab tu g.yos//95—311

na de ba datrī pa ru ṣā bhi jo yī pa do ba bande bha ga bān gi rā mya/ /kaspra ta kṣi bcom ldan gsung gis de yi rkang pa la/ /lhas byin tshig rtsub brjod cing phyag mi byed/ /de nas sa g.yos tebeesma ta mā na se na thraṣṭa sta to bhikṣu ga ṇi na shāstu/ /u bā tsa rā dzñā ki la kalpa ya mtshan yid can kyi/ /dge slong tshogs kyis dris shing ston pa yis/ /bka' pal rgyal po 07skye ba gzhan ka su dzadmānta re mya gya kṛ ta pra shā maḥ/ /pu ra yu rpā kā shi pu re bi lo kya la yang / /'dreg mkhan 'di la nges par phyag 'tshal byas/ /kā dushi'i grong du dbul po gzhon nu yis//bha dru bhi dhwa dzā ga ṇi rka da ri draḥ/ /se rpā bya dhwa tā punda ra kasta dā sri go smad 'tshong bzang mo zhes pa sngon 1mthong gyur/ /mdzes pas de tshe de yi g.yog rnams byas/ /gang phyir hi sarba bya sa no pa deṭwā/ /ta yā bi mṛṣṭaḥku su mostso yā ya pu naḥpu naz-iṅga chags pa dnghargud kun nye bar ston/ /de yis btang nas me tog btu ba'i slad/ /yang yang lhag par don i bā dhi kārbhe/ /tahūṃ ga mā rgo ga ma no ra je na shāntaḥs ba bhra ma ba nānta re 6/ /gnyer bung ba bzhin/ /de dang 'grogs pa'i lus med re ba las/ /nags nang rnams su de yis ngal a tā nta re shā nta ta ra ཿ kṣi tī sha ཿ pā sto ba na rnye mṛ ga yā ra zhing 'khyama'u/ /skabs der rngon (sgo la chags pas rab ngal zhing / /nags nang phyin par gyur pas ⑦sa se na/ /tai brahma dattaḥbra sha mbi kṣa gī tai ta gya sh-i rtota tstshanda ta nurla tā ddhāḥ/ /yi dbang / /lus ni 'khri shing gis bsgribs tshangs byen 2rmis/ /de ni rab mthong de yi glu dag thos/ /na pa na ba ku su mā sha yā ki me baṃ ma dhu ka ra tā pa ha to si gatstsha tūrte/ /me tog gsar pa gsar pa 'dod pas sbrang rtsi byed/ /ci ste de ltar gdung bas khrod 'joms myur du song //bi ka se ka ma lā na nañdzi bee sa bha ba ti hi saṃ ku tsi tā di bā ba sā ṣpe/ /bzhin ras me tog rnam rgyas chu skyes ldan pa de/ /gang phyir nyin mo'i mjug tu zum par gyur pa khya yin//te ṣpe te gī tai dṛ pa ti ni sha mya smi tasgoṣṭa gha ṭi ta hā ra kārnyiḥ/ /u ba tsa tai tri mi bdag gis ni de yi glu skad thos/ /'dzum zer do shal mdzes pa la reg cing / /der /3smras nyi 'od 95—312

bra ka rārka tā pe ko yo sa khaṃ gī ta rā sa bhi yo gaḥ/ /so gya bra bīta byu pa te na drag pos gdungs pa la/ /grogs po glu yi nyams dga' 'byor pa stici/ /des kyang smras pa sa bdag nges nā ma tasto ra bistabee ta rastu kā maḥ/ /swa karma duḥkhā ni bi harnyi lo ke par ni/ /nyi ma mi gdung 'dod pa mchog tu gdung / /'jig rten na ni rang las sdug bsngal 'dzin/ /na shrīṣṭha dakta ni ma ru sgra lā ni/ /i tyarba pabye kya gu rjarba ṣpe na sa bhū pa te babee so ka'i mya ngam thang ni sreg byed min/ /don ldan tshig 'di'i yon tan phul ba yis/ /de ni sa yi bdag bha tā ma bā pa/ /saṃ pā da saṃ sparsha su bhā ṣi lta hi ke ྾ tsa saṭwā ra pa rda po'i mdza' bor gyur/ /legs bshad yang dag brjod pas reg pa ni/ /su zhig dag gis ④bsnyen bkur na yā ti/ /te nā tha rā dzā bi dza ni shra mā tuḥshī to pa tsā ri ra pa nīta tā paḥ/ /gnas mi 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po ④mi med ngal gyur pa/ /de yi bsel ba'i rim gros gdung ba bral/ /spru tyā ta mā dā ya ta taḥs hai ba sa rā dza dhwa nī ma ga maskṛ ta dzhaḥ/ /ta tā gya dzre ba de nas byas shes de yis dga' bas de/ /blangs nas lhan cig rgyal po'i pho brang song / /de la 'di yis pra da i kyu datta sasgo ṣa saṃ pū ri ta tsitta bṛttaḥ/ /rā dzñārbhadā nā bhi srog rab byin zhes ④nas/ /lhag par tshim pas sems kyi spyod tshul rdzogs/ /rgyal srid phyed sbyin mngon mu khaḥs ta sgo tsitta nu thratta su ka marya de yo/ /rā bye bha dā na bra thra te tha phyogs de gnas te/ /sems rjes zhugs la sbyin min ci zhig yod/ /de ni rgyal srid byed sbyin brtson pa'i ta smin na tsinta yadrunda ra kaḥkṛ pā dzee/ /bha tram̐ bi nā rā dza su khe na ki me tshe—/ /mdzes pas mtshan mo bsams 3pa bdag la ni/ /bzang mo ( shemed na rgyal srid bde bas ci/ /dha byo hi tata spru ti su dmā bhi ṣiktaḥ/ /ma hūṃ na rā dzñā da bi ro tsa terta ma der mdza'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur skal ldan yin/ /rgyal srid las kyang byed la bdag mi sred/ /dpal khaṇḍi tāspra pi hi sho bha te shrīḥ/ /e kārba yo ge sa dā bibā dī dwa yodngha ni chung yang nyams pa med na mdzes/ /don gcig ldan pas /3rtag tu 'gal bar brjod/ /gnyis ka 95—313

sgo giḥka li re ba muṭwāḥ/ /tasmrad dṛ paṃ ku snye ma haṃ ni pā rya sa mapta longs spyod rtsod la ①gzugs can nyid/ /de ཿslad mi bdag nang ②nas bkum pa na/ /rgyal srid mtha' rā bye na bha bā mi pūrṇaḥ/ /kṣa rde bi tsind+ra tya nu tā pa taptasnyi gre dag gis ni bdag rdzogs 'gyur/ /zhes pa skad cig rnam bsams 'gyod pas gdungs/ /drag po'i ma rnaḥswa gya pu naḥpra da dzñā/ /kitsi ta tri tai no rya ta ram̐ ma yi tata ko yo shugs btang ④de yis slar bsams ⑤pa/ /bdag gis ci bsams mchog tu smad 'os 'di/ /nges par pra kā raḥkha lu tīkyā tā yāḥ/ /kṛ ta sna sa kalpa ka lo ka le pā da ho nu ladzdza ni dza tse ta rno ba'i rab byed 'di lta ci/ /las ngan rtog 0 pa'i dri mas rab bsgos pa/ /kye ma rang sems la yang ngo so pi/ /swast+yastu rā dzñā ya na maḥsu khe bhyaḥsaṃ mo ha mā tā kṣa ma hūṃ tsa re tsha/ /rgyal srid shis gyur bde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rmongs ma gcig ⑦dpal 'byor bzod par lasmriḥ—/ /ye ṣā ma nā swā di ta cirnyi tā nā me baṃ bi dmā dhīḥpra tha maḥswa bhā baḥ/ /mdzod—/ /gang dag nyams su ma myong bsam nyid na/ /dang po'i ⑧blo yi rang bzhin 'di ltar gyur/ /ba oṃ ni dhaste bi da dhwa tiju1 ni pā ta ya hye ba ta masta no ti/ /ā sthā kye ma dpal dang dug shing bsnams tsam gyis/ /skyes bu rnams ni rnam par nyams par byed/ /'khrul pa ta mā tre ba ka ro ti sum̐ sā ma ho bi nā shaṃ bi ṣa babee rī shrīḥ/ /tsi ram̐ bi tsibye skyed byed brgyal ba nyid du byed/ /rnam par lhung ⑨byed mun pa rgyas par byed/ /yun ring 'di bsams ti sa dzā ta tsittaḥpra byu ka bo bye bi ma laḥpra bhā te/ /a bhyargya mā no pi na re sho rang nyid byang chub la/ /chags bral de yi sems skyes snga dro ni/ /mi yi dbang ⑩pos mngon par gsol re ṇarā rdzu na grwa ha ni thratta khruṣṭaḥ/ /pra hye ka budha twa ma bāpta me rna btab kyang / /sred pa dang bral rgyal srid bzung ma gyur/ /dus kyis rang sangs rgyas nyid thob pa de/ /kā le na dṛṣṭa dṛ pa tirma hadhi/ /tatyā da padma sgo nyi mo le mā lha—tta rdzu 'phrul che ldan mi bdag gis mthong nas/ /mgo 'phreng de yi zhabs pad la 'phos pas /sems ni 95—314

pra sā do tsi ta mi tya bo tsata/ /sa ko pi saṅkand+ra bi pā ka dzadmā brjo bi dang bar 'os pa de ①dag smras/ /gang yang 1dam pa'i las kyi rnam smin skyes/ /rab zhi'i ④dbang be kaḥpra sha mā bhi ṣe kaḥ/ /ya su pra bhā bābyi ra ta spri ha rde tya bye ba raṭwā bskur dben de phyag byar 'os/ /gang gi mthu las chags pa bral rnams kyis/ /chu gter ske khyorags ka ra me kha lā bhūḥ/ /khru te ti rā dzñā ka thi haṃ ta darja dzā tai ta da bhyarja ma ldan pa btang ⑤bar 'os/ /zhes pa de don phyis du bskyed rgyal pos brjod/ /thos nas de don don du yā bi bhā ya/ /taṅkalpa kaḥshārnyi pa rda pra pe de se bānta ram̐ gaḥki la shaṃ gā pā gnyer nas bzung / /'dreg mkhan de ni zhi ba'i gnas thob nas/ /de nyid dman ⑦pa gang gā khyeskyong ba laḥ—/ /pābye ta ma pyutta ma kand+ra yo gāta pra bra bye yā sadzdza na pū bye bhā baṃ/ /po⑨—/ /mchog gi las kyi sbyor bas rab byung las/ /dam pa'i dngos po mchod 'os thob de hūṃ 7la'ang //rā dzā ba bande pra ṇa taḥthra the byaḥkadzasta dā byu da pi ṣaṭa bi kā raḥ/ /so yo rgyal pos rab btud phyag 'tshal de yi tshe/ /rnam 'gyur drug ldan sa yang g.yos par gyur/ /rgyal po rā dzā bi hi ta bee na ta rbha dṛ ko bra hma dasto pa bye pā lbo sa ki la rnams 'dud bsgrubs ⑫pa de ni bzang sbyin 3dag dang tshangs pas byin/ /gang yang nye bar 0/ 'khor de ku sha lī kalpa ko shaṃ hā pā laḥ/ /i tyārtswatram̐ bha ga ba du di tai rnyikṣa dge ldan 'dreg mkhan gang ④gā skyong ba po⑫/ /zhes pa'i ngo mtshar bcom ldan gyis gsungs dge slong de bste sha mya swa sbyi tsirghaṃ su kṛ ta sha ra ṇi me ni re he tu me ba/ /i ti dag rnams kyis thos/ /sems ni rab dang kho na legs pa'i lam la rgyu nyid yin par sems/ /zhes pa kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dzee dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las yab pi tā pu tra sa mā dā rna tra yo bo sha ti palla waḥ// //dang sras mjal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i ⑩yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa ⑫gsum pa'o// //95—315

tsiddhā ra tna de dhi ka ru tsa yaḥ sattha lo ke ṣṭa kau byā ba byo ste gang zhig sems can don rnams dag gi bu dang chung ma la sogs mchog tu ni/ /phangs pa'ang n+yaḥpu ru ṣa ma ṇa yaḥke khya pūttha pra bha baḥ/ /ye ṣārje ba thra ya btang nas dman pa'i pho nya ①bzhin ni log pa ༷gyur pa med pa nyid/ /yid bzhin rin chen las lhag ma pi pa ram̐ pu tra dā rā di da tā sa tā ṭwā nā bha ba ti ba da na smra mdzes shing 'jig rten kun gyis smad par mi 'os pa/ /skyes bu'i rin chen gzhan pa sngon med mthu ldan su na tā de n+ya rū tī/ /bha ga bān bhegru byeḥdṛṣṭaḥpu rā shākya pu re dzi naḥ/ /zhig de rnams phyag bgyi 2'os/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag tu sngon/ / lha sbyin chogatam gyi mjug thogs su/ /dza gā da pu za dṛ dzñā tai de ba da tta ka thā nta re / / pu rī ba dge slong gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas sngon byu spyod mtha' gsungs/ /dpal 'byor yid byu ba bi shā khyu bi shā sa ba sa tiḥsre yaḥ/ /bi jo pa kā ra sakta mya su gcugs gnas gyur pa/ /sna tshogs zhes pa'i grong khyer byung / /kun la phan pa'i nus pa can/ /legs kṛ ta gye pa dzadma bhūḥ/ /saṃ dza yā khro bha batta snga ma mi tra nyi mi dzā shu mān/ /byas skye ba'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /der ni mi bdag spyod tshul bkra/ /grogs min mun pa'i tsha zer can/ /ṣpe tā nanda su ṅgā sru to bi tsi tra tsa ri to dṛ paḥ/ /ta su bi shwarnya ro nā ma mig gi kun dga' bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /kun tu rgyal ba zhes pa byung / /de yi bu ni gtong phod can//ba dā n+yastan yo bha ba ta/ /a pūttha tya gi nā ye na kṛ tai kalpa ta thams cad sgol zhes bya bar gyur/ /gang gis (chosngon med gtong la ba yis/ /dpag bsam shing gi grags rorya shaḥ/ /yīsgo bi ra hi tā tustu lhi bi dasnye na pra sā ta dhi tāḥ/ /sa tya na bhā pa phrogs/ /phrag dog spangs nas dus mnyam du/ /mkhas pa yis ni rab brgyan pa/ /bden pa gang gi klu ra nyi ye na dā ṣpe na shrīḥkhru te na dhīḥ/ /abyā pi ya su diṅgāddhā kaṭwā bha ra ṇa tshig dang ni/ /sbyin pas dpal dang thos pas blo/ /gang gi grags pa ke ta ka'i/ /nang gi 'dab ltar 95—316

tī ga tai/ /bi bhā ti ke ta tī gasgoḥpa la sha bi sha rda ya shaḥ/ /sa ka dā byuji do dri med pa/ /phyogs kyi na chung rna rgyan du/ /gyur pa da lta'ang rnam par mdzes/ /nam zhig de yis slong di byaratna lo kā ra mabee ṣpe/ /ra baṃ bi dza ya sā mra rdzu ma no ra tha ha ram̐ ba la/ /shing rta rgyal srid rnam par rgyal/ /'od kyis yid la re ba 'phrog /rin chen mchog gis brgyan tī ṣā/ /daste ra ze ba ri tasmin bisma ye nā khi lo dza naḥ/ /ba bhū bā krānta j-i da pa byin/ /shing rta mchog de byin pa la/ /skye bo mtha' dag ya mtshan gyes/ /snying ni kun tu non gyur yabyentatta ya ba na re shwa raḥ/ /ma hā mā rtun thā tū ya harṣa tī no ma tī cing / /bsam pas kyang ngo mi yi dbang / /de nas sa bdag dga' ba zhan①/ /yid la re ba bsams (te pa tiḥ/ /u bā tso pa tsi tobye ga tsinta krānta ma no ra thaḥ/ /tasto ra thaḥku pas non/ /mi dga' ba ni nyer bsags pas/ /blon po che rnams bos te smras/ /shing rta chen po'i mā re ṇa sa dzee traḥsha tru maddhā naḥ/ /yattha bhā bārdzi tā se yi ma hā ra tha ba bde 'di 1ni/ /gang gi mthu yis rab bsgrubs pa/ /dgra 'joms rgyal bar byed pa yi/ /shing rta de ni rū thi nī/ /lasmraḥsu kha ni ṣaṇḍi me yā tā nibya la hūṃ dwa ye/ /ra gzhon nus byin/ /gnyis la bdag gi dpal 'byor ni/ /g.yo med gyur cing bde bar gnas/ /shing the saurya pa the tasmin dza ya kuñdzi ba kuspru re/ /i ti rā dzā ba tsaḥkhru tā ta rta rtul phod lam de dang / /glang po rgyal ba'i ④gter la 'o/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /blon ma bhā ṣanta madhri ṇaḥ/ /rā dzanda do ṣasta bee bā yi bātpa bye na pra mā rya taḥ/ /dhand+raḥpo rnams kyis der smras pa/ /mnyes gshin nas ⑤ni bag med pa/ /'di ni rgyal po khyod kyi skyon/ /chos ka mya na harya ya dā rgo ka su na sasma tai/ /kintu rū la ha tā thragrumbi ni su yi dga' ba min/ /sbyin pa su yi bkur bya min/ /'on kyang rtsa ba nyams pa yis )/ /shing las bstodhe pha lābee naḥ/ /bi 1 taḥpa ra de she tsa ra thaste na dri dzadma nā/ /'bras bu don gnyer ldog /gnyis skyes de yi ⑦shing rta yang / /gzhan gyi yul du btsongs par gyur/ /95—317

i rkyughā madhri ṇaḥsabye sha lya baddhā i pā bha ban/ /a tha kā le na saṃ pāste ces ①smras blon po thams cad ni/ /zug rngus zug pa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dge ba'i rnam smin bzhin//ba sadhe ma da notpa be/ /bi pā ke su kṛ ta gya ba z-i da yā nanda dā yi ni/ /snying la kun dga' ster byed pa/ /dus kyis ①myos byed dga' ba yi/ /dpyid ni yang dag byung gyur cing //swa yo gra ho pa jo bya gya ma dhorma dhu ka rābee naḥ/ /lo ke putpa ba ṣpe dpyid ni don gnyer bung ba rnams/ /rang nyid kyis bzung bsten 'os pa'i/ /me tog tshal gyi 1'jig yā teḥya sho bhi ri ba shu bhra tai/ /a sho ka lo ka satstsha ya mu pa kā ro rya rten ni/ /grags pa ④bzhin du dkar ba dang / /'gro ba ljon pa mya ngan med/ /'jig rten greb bsil tai dru rma/ /ma sgo bi dhwa ḍū sandadhe ka li kā lo kṛ ta dza gta/ /phan par brtson/ /me tog gzhon nus rab brgyan ⑤pa/ /dpyid kyis bsgrub 0par brtsams pa'i tshe/ /rā dzā pu tra sa mā ru khya kuñdza ram̐ rā bye barbha dzwa/ /ya yo phulbā na ba ṣpe duṣṭi rgyal sras slong ba'i dpag bsams shing / /rgyal srid 'phel byed glang po la/ /zhon pa ⑦me tog rgyas pa yi⑧//mabee kalpa ta rusta run/ /bra dzarnye pra ti sā marnya pra yulngaste dī dzāḥpa ljon pa gzigs su nags su gshegs/ /rgyal phran gzhan gyis btang ba yi/ /bram ze ⑨lam du bgrod de thi / /ba bhā ṣi re sa ma bye tya swasnyi bā da pu raḥs rāḥ/ /tsinta ma ṇigi la—/ /mngon phyogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig /sngon ⑩du btang nas rab smras pa/ /legs pa khyod ni ya se two shā bhyo dza ga ti dzee ga maḥ/ /ya mya sandarsha ṣpe nādhī gā 'jig rten na/ /g.yo ba'i yid bzhin nor bur ⑪sgogs/ /gang dang phrad pas slong ba rnams/ /dpal bhā mā lighra tre shri yā/ /dā bee ba bi shu toṅkasgo bi she sngo bha dra dzadma ni/ /gyi sha/shemachog tu 'khyud par gyur/ /phul phyin /5khyad par grags pa ni/ /gnyis nyid bzang po'i skye ba la//dā nādzra hasta ste lo ke ga dzertswa yo sbi ronda tiḥ/ /asma bhya su kṛ to dā ra sbyin pas lag brlan 'jig rten na/ /khyod dang mtho brtan ⑫glang 'di 'o/ /legs byas rgya che'i glang po 95—318

kuñdza ro da yo pra dī ya tsā / /twa da bye na ba dā bye na dā tu me 'di—/ /bdag cag la no gnang bar mdzod/ /khrod las gzhan kyis ①gtong phod ni②/ /'di ni sbyin me ṣa shākya te/ /i tyabee ta steḥsotpa hāḥs te bhyastu da do dī paṃ/ /sa dzre par mi nus so/ /de yis de blangs ①spro ldan de④/ /srog ldan yang dag rgyal srid bzhin/ /dung dang ba mi ba sā mā bye sa shaṃ kha dhwa dza tsā ma re/ /da tā bo bye praṅgā ṣpe na rgyal mtshan ⑤rnga yab bcas/ /gnyis 'thung de dag rnams la byin/ /byang chub gtso bo ⑦smon lam gyis//pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na shud dha dhīḥ/ /ra tha rarja dī pend+rañtsa so bhū dā nandirbha raḥ/ /rin chen mang ldan glang po'i dbang / /byen nas dag pa'i blo ldan de/ /kun tu dga' ba rgyas par gyur//khru tī ba dṛ pa tirdatrī bi khru tai dza ya kuñdza ram̐/ /rakṣu pra kā ra ra hi tī rgyal ba'i glang po byin pa yi/ /grags pa mi bdag gis thos nas/ /rgyal po'i dpal 'byor bsrung ba yi//rā dza lallī ma ma n+yata/ /sa rā bye bye sa dī te na ku pi te na ma tī byu thabs dang bral ba nyid du bsams/ /de nas sa bdag rgyal srid ni/ /nyams pas 'jigs shing khros pa dzā—/ /niḥkā se taḥku mā ro3tha pra tasbe pra ni pa tya tai/ /mā dru da yi ta yā yis—/ /nges par bskrad nas gzhon nu de/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni chas gyur te/ /btsun mo ma dris lha sārghaṃ dzā li ni nā ma dā ra shaṃ/ /kṛ: bhi dzñā ta thā ka tyā mā dā ya sa ya gcig ⑦des/ /gzhon nu dris ④ldan zhes pa dang / /de bzhin kṛṇḍa ⑨zhes pa yi/ /bu mo khyer nas yo ba rna/ /ba ṣpe pi she ṣa sa da do bā ha nā di ka mabee ṣpe/ /sa oṃ hi nags su song / /slong ba rnams la nags su yang / /bzhon pa la sogs lhag ma byin/ /gang phyir chen ma ha tsā sa tī saṃ pakhru tsa bi pakhru tsa/ /ma bye ka dā tsidmā tā yī putpa po'i snying stobs ri/ /phun sum tshogs sam rgud kyang snyoms/ /nam zhig ma dris ⑫me tog dang / /rtsa rū la pha khāpta ye/ /krāhma ṇaḥkashyi da bye bye rā dza pu tra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ba 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i slad/ /song tshe bram ze su zhig gis/ /rgyal po'i sras la mngon phyogs smras/ /95—319

pa ri dā ra ka tī shā ya tsa tu ro bā la kā bi mo/ /de hi ma hūṃ ma hā sa tā g.yog 'khor med pa bdag la ni/ /bu sring spyang po 'di dag blang / /gang phyir snying stobs chen po khyod//saza do khya saṃ bi khru taḥ/ /shu tī ta ra bi tsārle ba dā ra kau da yi to pa thams cad sbyin par rab tu grags/ /'di thos 'phral la ma dpyad par/ /mchog tu sdug pa'i bu sring ram̐—/ /da tā sa tasta smi sa hā sā se he tabyi ra ha bya dzee/ /dha na pu tra ka la tā di dag /de yis de la byen nas ni/ /de bral mya ngan bzod par byas/ /nor dang bu dang chung ma sogs//lo ke ka su rna balla sgo/ /dā nā da n+yadma dā tyā āoṃ da yi tai nā da yā ba 'jig rten pa yi mchog tu phangs/ /brtse ldan gtong phod can rnams la/ /sbyin pa las gzhan phangs pa tai—/ /a tha mā tā sa ma bye tya bā ma kau bā la batpa lā/ /a pa shyaṭī pu raḥmed / /de nas bu la mnyes gshin pa'i/ /ma dris ①'ongs pas bu sring dag /ma mthong shin tu brgyal pa kyuḥpa ti tā tpanta sprudhritā/ /sā la bha saṃ dzñā dīste na byāpta sho ka kṛ shā nu nā/ /nas ni/ /khyo yi mdun du 'gyel bar gyur/ /mya ngan me ni 'bar ba yis/ /khyab cing cho nge 'don pa de//shi shu pra dā na bṛṭwārnyi khru tā ba khyuttha khā pi nī/ /ta snga shwe ta si duḥ'adu shes rnyed pas bu sring dag /byin par gyur pa'i byung mtha' thos/ /khyo 0la mdza' bas rjes zhugs khāghi ra ba tya ste ha duḥs haḥ/ /thra ya pre mā nu dṛ bye ba pra ya yo pu tra pā de②—/ /bu la byams pa'i sdug bsngal me/ /bzod dka' de yi sems la ni/ /khong du rab tu 'bar ka hūṃ/ /a tānta re sa ma bye tya bi pra rū paḥsu re shwa raḥ/ /z-i tyābee bar gyur/ /skabs der lha yi dbang po ni/ /bram ze'i gzugs su mngon par 'ongs/ /rgyal po'i sras da yi tī pasna rā dza pu tra ma yā tsa ta/ /yā tsi taste na sa ha pā la btsun mo ni/ /sdug ma 'bangs mo'i ④don du bslangs/ /de yis bslangs pa'i 'phral la de/ /shu rtsa dzā yā bi yo ga dzā/ /dhī ya saṃ ste bhya satā bhiḥs tasmi bi tā ra hūṃ/ /btsun mo dang bral mya ngan dag /blo yis bzod byas snying stobs kyis⑤/ /chu gter de yis de la byen//95—320

sa ryaḥpra dā na ta ra dzee paṃ traspyo ha ri bhā mi ba/ /so ba da si tā mantaḥ'aphral la byen pas rab 'khrugs shing / /ri dwags mo bzhin rnam hu skrag pa'i/ /btsun mo la des byang ka la yasgo bye bā sa nā āoṃ/ / sa mā shwa si hi ka spyo ṇi na sho shaṃ chub kyi/ /bag chags nang du 'jog cing smras 'u/ /dge ma yang dag yid rton ①cig /mya ngan bya kartu marta se/ /swasna pra ṇa ya kaspo ya ma sa tyaḥpre ya saṃ ga maḥ/ /shu thrabar mi 'os so/ /mdza' ba 'di ni rmi lam 'dra/ /snying sdug 'grogs pa bden pa med/ /gnyis skyes ṣa yā dri dza sgyu su dhadzre te ra ma tsā ma tiḥ/ /bi lo la lo ka ya tā yī dhadzreḥ'adi la gus pa yis/ /khyod blo chos la dga' bar gyis/ /g.yo ba'i 'jig rten bgrod pa la/ /dam pa'i sbi ra su kṛ ta sa tsā/ /dṛṣṭaḥsabye swa dza na su dza nā bandha bā āoṃ nu byu chos ni brtan pa'i grogs/ /rang gi skye bo skye bo ④legs pa kun mthong gnyen rnams nyams su stsong bar tā n+ya stuḥ kaṇḍi kṣa ṇa pa ri ma la smra yi mbi mi tra mā lnga/ / dā re gyur/ /skad cig yongs su gyur pas dri ma can 'gyur grogs kyi 'phreng ba mgrin par bkod/ /lang tsho pu tre kṣa pi ta mā ni shaṃ yo ba rna dzī bi tañtsa pā sto nā pta sbi ra pa ri dang ni srog dag chung ma bu yis rtag tu zad pa nyid gyur cing / /chos las gzhan pa'i thob pa gang yang tsa yaḥko bi dhadzre tre te n+yaḥ/ /i kyughā balla bhālo bha pa ri tyā ga tu yongs su 'dris pa brtan pa nyid thum thob/ /ces smras btsun mo la chags pa/ /yongs btang de yi bā hā saḥ/ /byu ti ba da na padme na byerya bṛtta ñtsa tse ta sā/ /bi bzhin pad kyis/ /mdzes dang sems kyi brtan pa yi/ /spyod tshul dag ni de yis bzung / /'bral 'u yo ga sho ka bi ka waṃ ma dī dṛṭī kṛ bā ku laḥ/ /ni dzee rū paṃ sa ma ba'i mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i/ /ma dris lamathong nas snying rjes 'khrugs/ /bde sogs bdag pos rang dhwa ya sha tsi pa ti ru bā tsa tī/ /bi ṣā rda mā kṛ thāḥpu tri de bo haṃ tri da gi gzugs/ /yang dag bzung nas de la smras/ /bu mo mi dga' ma byed cig /nga ni skabs gsum 95—321

she shwa raḥ/ /abee bhya standa dā bye ṣa tasthā da se ma yābee tā/ /a dhū nā dbang po ①lha/ /'di yis slong ba rnams la khyod/ /ster gyur ②de slad bdag gis bslangs/ /da ni khyo ④sri ba ba kyu hūṃ tyā sī khyu tā ma yābee tā/ /tai da dā hye ṣa nā n+yasmi pa 'di nyid la khyod/ /bdag gis gtams par byas te gtad④/ /gzhan la 'di yis khyod mi ster/ /ji ra sī dī ya te ka dzee/ /ka ri tyā mi ta bā ba dhyā dā ra kā rgyu sa mā ga oṃ/ /ltar gzhan byu nor ster gyuradu/ /khyod ni bu sring gnyis po dang / /nges par phrad pa bdag gis bya/ /i tyā dīrya sa ha srukṣaḥs ha sānta ra dhī ya ta/ /a tha to dā ra ko bi praḥs zhes smras mig stong ldan pa ni/ /'phral la nyid du mi snang gyur/ /de nas bram ze dubu tsha dag /khyer mā dā yādzre libla yā/ /bi shā mi tre pu re ga tā lo bha ti kre tu murya to/ /nas nor ni 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad shes ⑦kyi grong song nas/ /chags pa las ni 'tshong bar brtson/ /bi shā mi traḥpa ri dzñā ya rā dza pu tra gya dā ra kau/ /dza gā ma ha tā bee na rgyal po'i sras kyi bu sring dag /thams cad shes kyis ①yongs shes nas/ /mig ni mchi mas 'gags pa bātpa sa rudha lo tsa naḥ/ /kā le na tri di baṃ yā te bi shā mi yis—/ /nor ni chen po dag gis bslus/ /dus kyis sa bdag thams cad shes⑨/ /mtho ris gshegs tri ma tī pa to/ /bhe dze bee shwanta ro rā rdzu yo rā mā tya ga shābee taḥ/ /tshe grong khyer pa/ /blon po'i tshogs kyis gsol btab nas/ /thams cad sgrol gyis rgyal srid bsten/ /rā bye bi ra dzasta su snga dā na bya sa ni naḥpa re/ /sa two na bandha ma nadhind+ra mchog tu sbyin pa la zhen pa/ /rdul bral de yi rgyal srid ni/ /phun tshogs snying stobs kyis rgyas pas/ /kabyeṭwā tsa ko bha bta/ /tabyi tta pūṇḍi bi bha bo zwa hma ṇaḥso pidzdza sgo kaḥ/ /kṛ su yang slong ba por ma gyur/ /nor des 'byor tshogs sdig pa can/ /bram ze dzdza tshu ka de yang / /bdag tasnaḥswa pra bhā bādme sadza di tya bhya jo dzdza āoṃ/ /bi shwanta raḥs e bā haṃ gi rang mthus phun tshogs zhes/ /skye bo dag la mngon par smras⑩/ /thams cad sgrol de nga nyid de/ /95—322

de ba dattaḥs tsa dī dzaḥ/ /uste ti tsa kra bha ga bākhyi khyu rjand+ra na de sha gnyis skyes de yang lhas byen no/ /dge slong rnams la bcom ldan gyis/ /'di gsungs sbyin pa bstan pa rmā—/ /ā lo ba na shwa bhra sha tā ba sā te gho rāndha kā re su tsi ra pra kā shaḥ/ /mdzad—/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten pha rol mi rnams gnyen/ /g.yang sa brgyar ①ni kun tu lhungs pa'i ② rten//ā shā sa dzwa duḥs ha duḥkha kā le dā — na rā bhā pa ra lo ka bantuḥ/ /'jigs rung mun par yun ring rab tu gsal/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal dus su dbugs 'byin no/ /i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi rā tsi tā yo bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing yī bi shwanta rā ba dā nand+ra ma tsa tudzre shaḥpalla waḥ// //las thams cad sgol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa ②bzhi pa'o// //ta pa ti sa ka la lo kā lo ka sa nā ya bhā nuḥpa ra ma ma mṛ ta bṛbye mtha' dag 'jig rten snang ba spro slad nyi ma 'od zer ④'gyed/ /bdud rtsi'i char mchog dbab slad pūṇḍi ta me ti tsand+raḥ/ /i ya ti dza ga ti pū rdzu dzadma kṛ ṭwā ti kashyibyi pu zla ba rdzogs pa nyid du 'gro/ /sems can bsgral ba'i slad du dge ba'i zam stegs chen po ni/ /kha cig la ku sha la se tuḥs twa santa ra shā ya/ /pu rā shusgo da naḥshrī mān rā dza shākya 'di snyed 'gro bar bsngags par 'os pa'i skye ba 'dzin/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag tu sngon/ /rgyal po dpal bu re bha bta/ /ya sha sha shāṅka dza na kaḥsu dhwa si nt+ra ri bā pa raḥ/ /ldan zas gtsang byung / /grags pa'i ⑤ri bong can bskyed pa/ /bdud rtsi'i chu gter gzhan pa bzhin//kha la saghā swa bhā be na lasmre ru ṇi ga zladzre tā/ /ābyarya kā ri ṇa ye ngo bos mi bsrun dhil chags dpal⑦/ /ngo mtshar byed pa su zhig gis/ /yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs la na kṛ tā sa tpa kṣa pā ti bhā / / a tyā pya khi la di spyu rja ba na gtad—/ /dam pa'i phyogs su lhung ⑧bar byas/ /da lta'ang ma lus phyogs dang ngogs/ /nags ⑨su 95—323

sastembi bee ke bheḥ/ /ya sho bheḥsho tsi bhārya gya mu ni bra ta mi bo bye te/ /chags shing dben ldan pa/ /gang gi grags pa rnam dag pas/ /thub pa'i brtul zhugs blangs pa bzhin//snga ma haṃ budha mā te ti pu rā pra ṇi bye taḥki laḥ/ /bi shwa kadzre su ta sangs rgyas ma ru bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam sngon btab pas①/ /dri med mdzes par mi yul martu mā dza gā mā ma ladku tiḥ/ /tīrtiḥsadru ru ṣa su ba ta sthā bhūtpalla bhā pa re/ /'ongs—/ /bi shwa karma'i bu mo lo/ /skyes bu dam pa'i grags pa bzhin/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul che zhes pa/ /ma hā mā yā bye dha de bī tsand+ra phye ba ku mudma tī/ /sā pa shyand+rarnyi āoṃ shwe tai swa bhe de yi yid 'ong mchog tu byur/ /zla ba'i ku mud ldan pa bzhin/ /de yi 'urmi lam dku nang na/ /glang po ku kṣiṃ bee hā yā sā/ /ga ti mā ro ha na shi lo pra ṇa tiñtsa ma hā dza nata/ /a dkar dang mkha' la 'gro/ /ri bo 'dzeg dang skye bo ni/ /chen pos rab tu 'dud pa mthong / /skabs tānta re bo dhi satwa stu ṣi te tri da shā la yāta/ /garghaṃ ta sngaḥs mā pa de der byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /rang nyid 'jig rten la brtsi bas/ /dga' ldan lha yi gnas dag las/ /swa yo lo kā nu kadza yā/ /ba haṭī bo dhi satwo sā garbha byu ba na nanda rgo/ /de yi lhums su yang dag byon/ /'jig rten dga' byed byang chub sems/ /de yis lhums su bzung ba ni//ind+ra duddhā bi bee le ba ba byu ba pāṇḍa ra dru tiḥ/ /i1 ku rā dza baṃ bye 'o mtsho'i rlabs kyi 1zla ba bzhin/ /dkar ba'i 'od dang ldan par gyur/ /bu ram shing skyes rgyal po'i na te na ga rsā sbi te na sā/ /bhurnyi dha na ba tī bā bhūrbha bya la brgyud④—/ /de ni lhums na gnas pas ṭwāde/ /gter dang ldan pa'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /dge ba'i mtshan kṣa ṇa lakṣi tī/ /ba bhu ba do ha dasta snga dā na pu rgya ma yo da yaḥ/ /e ku re nyid kyis mtshon gyur/ /de yi sred pa byung gyur pa/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams rang bzhin skyes/ /sa ha ka su bi saṃ bā di sa ha kā ra su sau ra sgo/ /a tha kā le na saṃ puṇḍi sā lumbi ni ra'i dri bzang ni/ /sol ba la yang slu du ba min/ /de nas dus kyis yang dag rdzogs/ /lumbi ni yi 95—324

ba ṣpesbi tā/ /a sru ta ta na yande bī di bā ka ra mi bā di tiḥ/ /mā turgarbha ma nags gnas pa'i/ /lha mo de la sras bltams te/ /a stidi ti las 2 nyin byed bzhin/ /ma yi mngal byi lā smṛṣṭi kukṣiṃ bhi tā sa nirga taḥ/ /tāñtsa kre tha swa bhā be na swa sde dri ma yis/ /ma reg de yi spyodaku brtol byung ④/ /de nas de yi 'urang bzhin gyis/ /gdung 'ubral gi bi ga ta bye tsā/ /nirga tstsharje ba rurnyo sau ba la dzi dzñā sa yā kṣa khaṃ/ /sha lus ni rnal gnas gyur/ /phyir byung nyid na brgya byin gyis/ /stobs shes 'dod nas skad cig ni/ /rdo kre ṇa badzra sā dzā gasta sde shākya twa mā ya yo/ /dzā tā mā traḥshi shurga tā swa yo rje snying po'i sku de bzung / /de ni nus med nyid du gyur/ /bltams pa tsam gyis khye'u de/ /rang gi ⑦sapta pa dā ni saḥ/ /di sha bi lo ka yand+ra tse su byaghra kṣa ra yā gi rā/ /gom pa bdun phyin nas/ /yi ge rab gsal tshig gis ni/ /phyogs su rnam par gzigs shing smras/ /i yo me nidṛttaḥbyuddhā ma ti lo ke 6 dakṣi shāḥ/ /ba— mā dzā ti ra bye 'di ni bdag gi myang 'das shar/ /'jig rten blo gros rjes mthun lho/ /'di yang skye ba'i mtha' dang ṣā saṃ sā rā di ya mutta rā/ /e ti ta gya bru bā ṇa gya thra thi bī sa ma kaspa ta/ /nub—/ /'di ni 'khor ba dag las byang / /de skad de yis brjod pa na/ /sa ni kun tu 'dar gyur te//ta ma sa kṣa ba lam̐ dhwaskyo ma shaste ba dza gaṅga dṛ/ /ij-i ta su ya shaḥshu rja 'gro ba'i bla ma mi zad ④stobs/ /de ni ⑨gzung bar ma ⑫/nus bzhin/ /mkha' yi chu rgyun gyis bgrus pa/ /satwa sme ram̐ sa tsā ma re/ /byo māsthā dhwa ra sgo ta gya dza kṛ hustatra de de yi grags pa dkar /⑪ba'i gdugs/ /snying stobs 'dzum pa'i rnga yab bcas/ /der ni lha rnams dag ba tāḥ/ /a sminda ba sa re bṛṣṭaḥswaḥgre ye ṇa se tā bhe dhaḥ/ /na ra de na pra dzñā dṛṭī gis bzung / /skabs der nag po zhes pa yi/ /thub pa kiṣṭi de yi rir/ /gnas la tsha bo mi sbyin gyis//kiskondha dṛspri to mu niḥ/ /ka sthā darga sha tā lo ka i bā lo ke pra dṛ shya 'od zer mthong nas rab tu dris/ /phug dang khang par bcas pa'i ri/ /gang gi ⑫mun pas dbul byed 95—325

te—/ /ta mo da ri dru ye ṣpe ti gi ra yaḥs gu ha kṛ hāḥ/ /bisma yā di ti te pa—/ /nyi ma brgya yi snang ba bzhin/ /snang ba mthong ba gang las lags/ /ya mtshan las des de skad noktaḥso ba daji bya lo tsa naḥ/ /dzā ta pu sgyu ba bhā so yo bo dhi satwa gya brjod—/ /lha yi spyan ldan des smras pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skye ba la/ /bsod nams snang ba 'di dzadma ni/ /a tsi re ṇi ba tai batpa draghra baḥku sha khāpta ye/ /i kyughā mu ni rā dag skyes/ /mnyes gshin mi ring nyid na de/ /dge ba'i slad du 'u cag blta/ /zhes brjod thub pa kun nanda bi shārnyi su khaṃ topho bha ba ta / /pu tra dzadma ni saddhārja sidhi dga' zhing / /ngal bsos bde ba nyid du gyur①/ /sras bltams don kun mchog tu ni/ /grub pa zas shuzlo da naḥpe dzā/ /dṛṭī sabyerja sesgo ya mi ti nā mā su nind+ra me/ /gtsang gis mthong nas/ /'di ni don kun grub pa zhes/ /de yi mtshan yang btags par gyur/ /shākya barbha na nā mā byudmakṣaḥshākya pu rā shra yaḥ/ /yattha shā me na shākyā rmā shi gnod sbyin shākya 'phel zhes pa/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag na gnas/ /gang la btud pas shākya yi/ /byis sha bo ni ru pa dra bāḥ/ /taje tyā pra ṣi tai pi tā pra rja mā ya sa gu he kaḥ/ /pa nyer 'tshe med par 'gyur/ /lugs des yab kyis buphyag 'tshal ba'i/ /slad du gtang chatshe gsang ba pa/ /two bo bye satwa mā lo kya ni pā pa tā gya pā da yoḥ/ /a tho྾ ge sa mā da de yis byang chub sems dpa' de/ /mthong nas de yi zhabs la gtugs④/ /de nas sa bdag dgyes pa ya z-iṣṭa ste thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /lakṣa rja ni ni mitta dzhai sta su de he bya yis—/ /de ni pang ⑤du blangs byas nas/ /de yi lus la mtshan rnams ni/ /mtshan mkhan dag gis lo ka yata/ /lakṣa ṇa dzñāsta taḥsabye dṛ pa rū tsaḥs bisma yāḥ/ /de ba rab tu bltas/ /de nas mtshan shes ya mtshan ldan/ /kun gyis mi bdag la smras pa/ /lha gcig ④di bya ku mā rolhayo lakṣa ṇi ru pa lakṣa te/ /dzā ya te lakṣa ṇi re tai gzhon nu mchog 'di ni/ /mtshan rnams dag gis nye bar mtshon/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag rnams kyis ni//95—326

bi shwa bi shānta shā sa na ཿ / / sha krā dhi pa byakra ba rte bha ga bānd+ra 'khor los sgyur ba brgya byin bdag /thams cad ngal gso'i hu7skal ldan nam/ /bcom ldan de bzhin ta thā ga taḥ/ /dīspyoṅga li da lo tsakra dzee tstsha kau su pra tiṣṭha to/ /gshegs par 'gyur④/ /'di yi zhabs ④gnyis rab tu mdzes/ /dmar zhing padma lta bur mnyen/ /a ru rto tsa ra khye ba khya kārnyo ka ma la ko ma lo/ /rā dza haṃ saṃ i sor mo'i 'dab ring 'khor lo yis/ /mtshan zhing ④legs par rab tu gnas/ /mtho ⑤zhing ngang pa'i ba shrī shu sa dzā lāṅga li palla baḥ/ /e ṇḍi dzwa nu yu gaḥshrī mā nā rgyal po bzhin/ /sor mo'i yal 'dab dra bar ldan/ /dpal ldan e ṣpe'i ⑥byen pa zung / /pus mo'i nu ju dza bhu ṣi taḥ/ /sa ko sha hasnyi gu khyabya n+ya gro dha pa ri maṇḍa laḥ/ /dakṣi bar du phyag gis brgyan/ /gsang ba sbubs bcas glang po bzhin/ /n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /g.yas ṇa brta ro maṅkaḥpa ri shā ha sa monda tiḥ/ /ra dzo ma la la bā smṛṣṭa su 'khyil ba'i spu yis mtshan/ /rgya khyon dag dang mtshungs par snang ⑦/ /rdul dang dri ma'i chas ma reg /stapta rdzu byu na da byu tiḥ/ /hasta pā dzā sha kākhye gra spaṣṭa sapta tstsha dā 'dzasru chu bo btso ma'i 'od/ /phyag zhabs phrag so mgrin pa'i mchog /rab gsal 'dab ma bdun pa'i kṛ tiḥ/ /sau ha pūrjadhe kā yabya dṛ hattha ṭwāṅga bi gra haḥ/ /tsa tā rī shatpadabyibs| /sku stod skedag kyang seng ge 'dra/ /lus kyi yan lag che zhing gsal/ /tshems ni bzhi bcu ma gre ta sapta danta su nā si kaḥ/ / dīsgo pra ta nu dzi hwa : me mnyam zhing dkar/ /bar mtshams med cing shangs dag mdzes/ /ljags kyang ring zhing srab pa ste/ /gha dund+ra bhi ni sra naḥ/ /a bhi bhā lākṣa go pahūṃ sa ha dzoṭī ṣa masta kaḥ/ /si 'brug dang rnga yi sgra lta bu/ /spyan mthing rdzi ma ba yi 'dra/ /gtsug tor lhan cig skyes pa'i dbu/ /dbu to:ṅka su ju bhā gaḥswasnyi ko raḥstha lodzdza la/ /le khā shri bāñdza hasto yo ni gdugs dbyibs byis pa 'di/ /mdzod spu dkar mdzes smin char mtshan/ /thugs kar bkra shis rab 95—327

tsakra baṭīshrīḥpha lo rje ṣāmbi na shwa rāta/ /a gya bo bye pra bhā te na saṃ sgyur ba'i dpal du brjod/ /'bras bu 'di dag bslu ba med/ /'di yis ①/byang chub snga dro yis/ /budhe khya mu khāmbu dzee/ /dha n+yaḥpadmā ka ra su ba ṣpe tra pā ṭī ka ri 6 rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i chu skyes zhal du / /padma'i 'byung gnas dag gi 1bzhin/ /skal ldan mig gi snod du ti—/ /bi buddhāḥshudha satwa su bo bye dusgo ma ho da dheḥ/ /dha tyā bā ga mṛ ta snga su gyur④—/ /byang chub 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /snying stobs dag pa 'di yi ni/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi mkhas pa bha bi 6 hphu pa dzre bi naḥ/ /pu ju bhā dzi dza gadma smarja ka e bāsmi dag /skal ldan rnams kyi nyer 'tshor 'gyur/ /gang gi dus ni yongs rdzogs pas/ /'di ni mthong ba pañtsi taḥ/ /e tata saṃ darsha āoṃ ya gya pūṇḍi kā la gya durla rbha/ /i tru ghā rnyed dka' ba/ /bdag nyid gcig pu 'gro ba ni/ /bsod nams ldan pa 'di na bslus/ /zhes smras mi dṛ pa mā sgyu ga tā byo : ta po ba rna/ /su pra panda ma naḥkṛ tā de bdag la spran nas/ /mkha' las dka' thub nags song ste/ /yid ni rab tu dang byas nas/ /lus ha tyā ga ma tsinta yata/ /sa paryadho pa de shā ya nā ra de nā bhi tso di taḥ/ /ni rab tu gtang bar bsamadu/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag ni/ /mi sbyin dag gis mngon par zhus/ /ta mu bā tsā mṛ tai batpa ku mā ra ka tha yi 6 ti/ /a bye ga myu mṛ tai tasthāta de yis de la smras pa bu/ /bdud rtsi gzhon nus ⑥ ston par 'gyur/ /rgyal sras de las bdud rtsi ni/ /dṛ pa sru no ra nā ma yaḥ/ /ta ri 6 se bha rpā sgo bye mi rkyughā ta nu ma rtogs nas nad dang bral ba khyod/ /'khor ba'i chu gter las sgol 'gyur/ /zhes pa smras te khyelus tya byeta/ /sha rī ra saṅgi yī ta su kṛ tā pa pa di nā ra daḥ/ /ya yo bā rā ṇa sī btang gyur/ /mi sbyin gyis ni 'phral la de'i/ /lus kyis rjolegs par bya ba byas/ / ka tyā skyeya na zhes se: la bha kā tyā ya nā bhi dhaḥ/ /brta mā naḥku mā ro tha sadzee bibyā thob nas/ /grub beed wa ra ṇa sīr ⑪song / /de nas gzhon nu skyed ⑫bsrings shing / /rig kun legs 95—329

su bā ra gaḥ/ /li bi pra bī rto3bhe na rpā li pi zwa1 nind+ra me/ /nā gā yu ta par pha rol phyin/ /yi ge mkhas pas tshangs pa yi/ /yi ge mngon gsar ①rnam par sprul/ /glang chen khri sa ma pā ṇi ta smin dza ga ti bi khru te/ /bai sha li kaiḥthra yā yā smi pre ṣi yi stobs mtshungs par/ /de ni 'gro la ①grags pa'i tshe/ /yangs pa can pas dga' ba'i sbad/ /de la to manta kuñdza raḥ/ /bha bi 6 nyi tsakra badhi tātta gya pāpta mu pa yarna/ /glang chen myos pa bsrings/ /'byung 'gyur 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyir/ /de la skyes bu ①'ongs pa yis④/ /de ba dattaḥpa ri dī ṣārghaṃ dza ghā na ma hā ga dzee/ /sgo lta tsa karṣa dī rda ta glang po che de lha sbyin ⑤gyis/ /yongs su sdang ba dag gis bsad/ /so gnyis rab tu lhung ba de/ /nandaḥsabee ba dā bhā tai/ /ku mā rastu ta duspyo su pā kā rādma nyi ra kṣi pata/ /dga' bos gom pa bdun du khyer/ /gzhon nu yis kyang de blangs nas/ /ra ba dag las phyi rol 'phangs/ /e ka nā ra tsa ni sgonda sabee tā la ma tī ta laḥ/ /tstsha rya bhe byā nt+ra shā ste 6 ta la bdun dang sa yi gzhi/ /mda' gcig gis ni nges par phug /gcod 'bigs mtshon dang bstan sa e bā ti sha yo ya yo/ / ta tastu tī gu rde pasna rā dza sru nurya bcos la/ /de nyid phul du phyin par gyur/ /de nas btsun mo yon tan mtshungs/ /grags 'dzin ma ni sho dha rī/ /a bā sa bi shu tai lo ke shudhe shī la i bonda 1/ /rgyal sras kyidu/ /dag pa'i khrims bzhin 'jig rten na/ /grags pas ④mtho ba blangs par gyur/ /a tānta re ma hā bā ta bibyu taḥsapta yo dza naḥ/ /sa raza bā ha saṃ ro dhe skabs der ④rlung ni chen po yis/ /shin tu che ba'i ljon pa ni/ /dpag tshad bdun pa rnam par babyel/ /bi dhe bi su la dru maḥ/ /sā sthā ra ta ru saṃ ru dhwa ro hi kā nā ma mu ni mṛ gā/ /chu bo'i srol ni 'gags par byas/ /thur bgrod ro nyi ka zhes pa/ /de ni shing chen gyis bkag pas/ /shī la bhaṣṭi pa ba ni tā pra ya yo pra ti lo ma tsā/ /rā dza pu tra sta muspyo pya ngang tshul nyams pa'i bud med bzhin/ /rgyun las rab tu bzlog ste song / /rgyal po'i sras kyis ljon pa de/ /95—330

khā la bā ku leḥ/ /naṭwā dṛbye kṛ shaḥkā yaḥshastirlupta ha tā shu tiḥ/ /'di ni smad ①par byed/ /lta byed nyams shing lus po rid/ /stobs ni zhum zhing ①thos pa nyams/ /ta thā pi mo hādṛbye ba bṛdhe gya ta ru bhā pri yā/ /dhaste dha ba la hūṃ briddhāḥ'on kyang rmongs las rgan po ni①/ /gzhon nu ma yis mdzes par mthong / /dkar po 'di nyid rngusmad pa ki rnge tā ma ti garte tsā/ /lo khā pa ram̐ bi rakta pi yarya snga ti bri ya nyid—/ /yin yang rgan po ci ste 'dzin/ /mchog tu g.yo zhing chags bral yang / /gang 'di lus la shin ta nuḥ/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta su nirbe daḥs ma dzā ya ta/ /ma n+ya mā na tu phangs/ /de ltar bsams shing lus dag ni/ /rgud pa rnams kyi tshogs gyur cing / /gnod pa dang gya sa pā yi kā ya ni tsa ya mā pa dzā/ /pu na: sa ma yephon+yasmi narsha bcas dgongs gyur pa/ /de yi thugs yid byung bar gyur/ /slar yang dus gzhan dag na des/ /rnam pa shyadhyā dhi tai na ram̐/ /bee pa kwa ku ṇa pa pā yo sa pū ya mi ba pāṇḍa re/ /par gyur pa'i ro 'dra ba/ /gnag ⑤dang bcas pa skya ⑥bo bzhin/ /nad kyis thebs pa'i mi zhig mthong / /sa pra dharmyo ta mā lo kya sa mudhi byu ni dzānta rnu/ /a ho nu sa ha dzee de yis de mthong rang nyid kyis⑦ / /lus la dmigs te rab bsams pa/ /kye ma lus 'dir nad kyi bāsmiṅgā ye ro ga ga rṇaṅga tiḥ/ /i da me ba ma hañtsi tram̐ḥmi yarja sa ma tshogs—/ /lhan skyes kho nar rab tu 'byung / /sha yi rang bzhin lus po 'di/ /dman pa yin yang skad yī ta nuḥ/ /nā yā ti kle da bai kla kṣa ma ṇa ma parlu ṣi te bi yata/ /i ticig gang / /nur zhing 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ba/ /'di nyid ya mtshan shin tu che/ /'di bsams spye ta sobye gaḥsha rī ra bi tsi kitpa yā/ /ba bhū ba rā bye sasto ga rā ge thugs ni byung ba ste/ /lus la the tshom zhugs pa yis/ /rgyal srid longs spyod chags pa la/ /gus pa bee ga li tā da raḥ/ /a thā smispyo ṇi mā lya baspyo tshwa di ta bi gra haṃ/ /dag dang bral bar gyur/ /de nas dus der phreng ba dang / /gos kyis g.yogs par gyur pa'i lus/ /95—333

da darsha deha sadku ra bya gra ban dhu dza rna sha baṃ/ /tai dṛṣṭa sa ha sobye ga da lus kyi bya bas gnyen 'dun gyi/ /skye bo 'khrugs pa'i ro zhig mthong / /de mthong 'phral la chags bral yā duḥkhā 1 shā ku laḥ/ / tsi ram̐ niḥ sā ra saṃ sā ra pa ri hā ra zhing / /brtsa ①ba sdug bsngal smod ①pas 'khrugs/ /'khor ba snying po med pa ni/ /yongs su gtang ①ma tsinta yata/ /e ṣa pre ta ba rna yā ti saṃ sast+ri z-i da ye ba han/ /dīrghaṃ bar yun ring bsams/ /las kyi rang bzhin lta bu yidu/ /phreng ba snying la reg par bzung / /ring du prasthā ṣpe yā tā yī mā dzee kand+ra mā yi mi ba/ /a ho nu bi ṣa yā sgyu sa bi 'gro bar chas gyur pa/ /'di ni yi dwags gnas su 'gro/ /kye ma yul la goms par ni/ /rtse dga' lā sa bya pā yi rmā/ /dṛ nā ma n+yakṣa ṇi kaṭwā kājo sā kha ṇa tu lya tā/ /dag la brtson pa yis⑤/ /mi rnams dus mthar 'o brgyal ⑥bas/ /shing dang rdo ba mtshungs pa nyid/ /ubye ga bā ri bha ba sā ga ra bubyu de smiṅgā lā ni lā ku li ta kand+ra la skyes bu rnams lus srid mtsho'i sdug bsngal chu yi chu bur dang / /dus rlung gis bskyod las kyi 'khri shing rtse tā gra pu྾/ /mā yā ba dhu na ya na bi bhra ma saṃ bi bhā ge sum̐ rmā ka e ṣa ba pu ṣi yi me tog dang / /sgyu ma'i bud med mig ni rnam par g.yo ba dag gi cha/ /'di la brtan pa nyid du mngon dzre rā bhi mā nāḥ/ /nolte ki tsita pa ra hi ta yu tai na shu tai dhand+ra yukṇi bee par khengs pa 'di ni ci/ /gzhan la phan par ldan pa cung zad ma brjod rigs pa'i chos ma thos/ /dge ba sthā taḥku sha la ku su oṃ sa tya rū panda dṛṣṭi/ /ṣpe ba spyoṣṭi sha ma pa ba'i me tog bsnams pa nyid min bden pa yi ni tshul ma mthong / /zhi ba'i gnas la reg pa min zhes da mi ti byakta mā sakta tsinta bi shādho yam̐ ba ha ti sa ha sā bai shā la two ga gsal bar bsams ⑦pa la chags shing / /ngal bsos ⑧srog song 'di ni 'phral la g.yo ba med nyid 'dzin tā yuḥ/ /rā dzā sru numbi dzibye ti sha rī ra bi sa rā ru tai/ /a she ṣa bi ṣa yā saṃ par gyur⑨/ /de ltar rgyal po'i bu yis ni/ /lus ni mi brtan pa nyid bsams/ /ma lus yul la chags 95—334

ge pa re niḥdzee ha hūṃ ya yo/ /a thā gre nind+ra ta de baiḥs shuddhā bā sa kā pa yi/ /mdza' ba mchog tu med par gyur/ /de nas mdun du gtsang ma yi/ /ris kyi lha rnams kyis yi kaiḥ/ /bya lo ka yand+ra bra dzi tai pā tra kā ṣā ya dhwa ri khaṃ/ /tai dṛbye ba bā bhū ba su sprul pa/ /lhung bzed ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ /rab tu byung ba mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong nyid na de pra bra dzñā bhi mu khāe ma tiḥ / /idzre tā lo ka na dī tyā swa bhā bo yi blo/ /rab tu byung la mngon phyogs ①gyur/ /gang phyir 'dod pa mthong ba ni/ /dga' bas rang hi bi bhā bya te/ /bai rā gya kā ra ṇa ta tra dṛ pa su noḥpa de pa de/ /bzhin rgyas par gyur④/ /gnas dang gnas der rgyal po'i sras/ /'dod chags bral 'gyur rgyu rnams ni/ /bi lo kya sā ra thiḥsabye kṣi ti pā ya n+ya bee da yata/ /ku mā ro tha bi tu bā kyādmā mthong ba thams cad kha lo pas/ /sa yi bdag po dag la bshad/ /de nas yab kyi tshig gi ①ni/ /mā lo ka na ko tu tī/ /bra dzaza thi ni dhwa nā ni bi bṛ tā ni bya lo ka gzhon nu grong gzigs dge mtshan la/ /'gro bas lam du gter rnams ni/ /sna tshogs bzhag pa mthong yata—/ /tadhūttha pu ru ṣa n+ya steḥ: ka ro྾ to pe tā ni/ /ya dā sa bar gyur/ /skyes bus ④sngon bkod bud med kyi/ /lag pas bton nas nye bar gnas/ /gang tshe de na grwa tītta ni ta dā bi bi shu ram̐ shu dhim/ /ta taḥs kaste kā na rpā shu byā pū pa ra yis ma blangs pa/ /de tshe chu yi gter du zhugs/ / de nas de yi zhing pa rnams/ /mgor ⑤skyes rdul shi ro tu hān/ /bi dīṇḍi pā ṇi tsa ra rjan gruta pi pā sha shā mā tu rān/ /ha lo kubyā byis gos shing skya/ /lag pa rkang pa rnam par gas/ /bkres dang skom pa ngal bas gzir/ /thong pa mi la bi ṣa molle kha pakṣa bra ’rdi tān/ /bi lokya gre sha bi ba shan bzad 'jor dag gis/ /rko 'brud phyogs ni rma yis nyen/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur mthong gyur nas/ /ba byu ba ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /bi ṅgā sa da ya yā te ྾ dra bee ṇi ra da ri dra tsā/ /snying rje rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /brtse bas de dag nor rnams kyis/ /dbul po nyid ni min par bsgrubs/ /95—335

sa bṛ ṣā rde bṛṣa ta bhā ra taḥkle sha mutta ma kā ra yata/ /ta taḥpra ti ni bsod nams dgyes des glang bu rnams/ /nyon mongs ①dag las grol bar byas/ /de nas rgyal sras rjes bṛsto tha sā nu gaḥpādzre bādma dzaḥ/ /ma dhyā tna pri thu sand+ra pe ta ra rto ta ra ṇi 'brang bcas/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer rab rgyas pa/ /nyin gung tshad pa chen po'i tshe/ /de nas ②phyir ni log tī ṣaḥ/ /ra tha gho khorlu kha shi khi shya mi kṛ ta di shī ta raḥ/ /swe da pā ri par gyur/ /shing rta'i sgra yis gtsug phud can/ /gyen phyogs phyogs na sngon por byas/ /rngul gyi chu yi ka shā shīṇḍiḥpā bha snaktab na sba lo/ /so ba ru hra ra thātta tra gaṇḍabee zigs rgyas pas/ /nags tshal gzhi ni baṅgal bar sleb/ /der ni shing rta las babs nas/ /snyan par li ta kuṇḍa laḥ/ /bee shādhri bi khru ta ya shā dzee pūsgo yā ma shi shri yata/ /grags shing rna rgyan ni/ /rnam par 'phyang des ngal gso'i slad/ /'dzam bu'i ①grib ma bsten par gyur/ /sa ba bhā ro ra si byast+ri swe dzā bu ka ṇa saṃ ta ti/ /pa ra sā bye kha la li tsā de yi ④rngul gyi chu thigs rgyun/ /gsal ba snying gar ⑤'dzin pa dag /do shal dag gi dhi'abrel pa ni/ /hā ra gya ba ku chembi mbim/ /sgo yā su pa ri dṛtta su sha na kaiḥsazla sā chags ldan sbyar bas mdzes pa bzhin/ /rim gyis shing rnams thams cad kyi/ /grib ma yongs su gyur khi dzā/ /ta gya dzambu ta rusgo yā na tsa tsā la ta nusta noḥ/ /sā ta su shī ta lasgo yā pa'i tshe/ /de yi ⑦ sku las 'dzam bu 'a3yi/ /grib ma chung ngu g.yos ma gyur/ /de yi grib ma bsil ba des/ /tā pa krānta ma bā ra yata/ /saṃ sā ra bi ra ta gye ba tī bra bai rā gya gdung bas nyen pa rab tu bzlog /chags bral drag po'i bag chags kyis/ /'khor bar ⑨dga' bral pa sa nā/ /pu tra darsha na soṅkaṇḍa stande sha ma tha khyu pa tiḥ/ /ā dza gā dag gi bzhin/ /da tu 3nas sa bdag phyogs de ru/ /sras ni gzigs par bzhed ldan pas/ /glang po che ma ga dzotparbha tra bhra ma ra gra sta tsā ma raḥ/ /sgo yo sa ni : laspyi ṭī ku mā ra la bung ba ni/ /rab 'dus rnga yab 'khrug cing 'ongs/ /gzhon nu'i mthu las grib ma ni/ /g.yo ba med 95—336

mya pra bhā ba taḥ/ /go ra bābye ta saṃ pābeeḥpra ṇa tai pra ṇa nā ma nyi/ /pa des ①mthong nas/ /gus pas ①rmad byung yang dag thob/ /rab tu btud nas der phyag 'tshal/ /ta taḥs sa nyi taḥbi tā na ga ra ge tu mudma taḥ/ /a pa shyahphu ra paryarnye de nas yab dang lhan cig de/ /grong khyer 'gro bar brtson pa de④/ /grong khyer mtha' yi dur khrod ni/ /shā ni sha ba saṃ ku lo/ /sa dṛṭī ku ṇa pā tīṇḍi ma shi baṃ shi ba kā na lda/ /ro yis yongs su gang ba mthong / /zhi ba'i nags ni mi shis pa/ /ro yis khengs mthong chags bral can/ /sobye gaḥsā ra thi pā hasba gi ta gyanda rgo kṣa ṇi/ /sā ra the pa shya dzee tū dzā de yi ④skad cig shing rta ni/ /bzung nas kha lo sgyur la smras/ /kha lo pa ltos srog chags kyis ⑤/ /kā yā pā ya ma yīnda shaṃ/ /dṛṣṭi da ma pi rā gādzre ma nā mo ha gnod pa'i rang bzhin lus kyi skabs/ /rmongs pas bag med rnams kyi yidakhye7/ /'di ltar mthong yang pra mā dī rmā/ /pa ra sdi darsha nā tre bye ṣpe tra mā swā rya sā ra ram̐/ /a chags pas brlan/ /gzhan gyi bud med bltas ma ngoms/ /mig ni gus dang bcas par myang ⑦/ /'di gya satya ba tī dzi hā pa shya kā ko na kṛ 6 te/ /a suḥsta na mu kha n+ya sta na yi bden ⑤ldan min pa'i lce/ /bya rog gis ni gcod la ltos/ /'di yi nu ma'i steng du ni/ /sen ⑨ khopre kha su khasbri tiḥ / /khaṇḍa ya tya dha ram̐ kṛ dhraḥkā mbi ba ma da dmugs dgod spyocing bde bar gnas/ /'dod pas rgyas pa'i bya rgod kyis/ /mchu gcod 'dod ldan ni rbha raḥ/ /e te dṛṣṭa ni ṣakta bā ya sa shra kṛ na nispyu bi naḥdag gis bzhin/ /rkang 'thung 'di dag g.yo ba'i bya rog chags pa'i phyi 4spebs sgyug cing brgyal ba dang / /pā da pā mutstshaṭī ba pi pā ka pū ya ku na pā sthā ṇi na niḥkyu ṇi tāḥ/ /dṛṭī kṛ bhra rnam par gyur cing rnags pa'i ro yi dri ngas nges par sgra ngan sgogs pa bzhin/ /lan cig ma yin bya rgod bi dārya mā ṇa ma sha kṛdkuṇḍidzra tarja sha baṃ barghaṃ bā ta bi lolla pabee ba ka kyis 'joms rlan ⑫ldan rgyu ma gzags /stepa'i ro mthong nas/ /rlung gis rnam par bskyod pa'i yal 'dab 95—337

niddhā ṇa shasde shu tī ba rā dza pu traḥs mbi hi tai/ /tai da dasgorlu khaḥpadma ba rgyal po'i ①bu yis 'dod pa'i sgra/ /mya ngan 'da' ba thos nyid na④/ /spyan gyi pad tshal ston pa bzhin/ /nā nī ba di shaj-i shā/ /sa ta myu ste na ba tsa sā ba pu ṣā tsa pra sā di taḥ/ /gyen du phyogs te de la bltas/ /de yi tshig dang lus des kyang / /rab tu dang bar gyur pa des/ /hā ram̐ su bṛtta— tañtsa bi kṣe pā sri ku nodzdza lo/ /ā lo ka nā nu kyu bye legs spyod yon tan 'bar ba yi/ /do shal sems kyang de la 'phangs/ /blta ④ba'i rjes su mthun pa na bhā ba bi dzñā ya bhū pa tiḥ/ /pu tra sde taḥpu ra pa de tā mā dā ya yis / /rgyal bu'i dgongs pa sa bdag gis/ /shes nas btsun mo'i tshogs gnas su/ /de ni blangs n+ya bee sha yata/ /ṣaṇḍi kāddhā sa ha sru rde bṛ ta mantaḥpu ram̐ ta taḥ/ /bi be sha rā nas bkod par gyur/ /de nas btsun mo stong phrag ni/ /drug gis gang ba'i pho brang du/ /rgyal po'i sras dza ta na yaḥpri yī shārnyi bi tsanta yo/ /a tānta re na ra pa ti pā hu: kyi duzhi ba ni/ /dgyes par rnam par bsams shing zhugs/ /skabs der mi yi bdag po la/ /mtshan mitta kāḥ sbu ṭa ma/ / mu nirpā tsakra ba ddhā ba pā ta ste bha bi tā su mkhan rnams kyis gsal bar smras/ /khyod kyi sras ni thub pa 'am/ /'khor los sgyur bar nang mor ⑤ taḥ—/ /ta taḥsakhyuṣṭha dṛ pa teḥpra bra dzñā tsa ki taḥpa ram̐/ /a kā ra 'gyur—/ /de nas mi bdag rab 'byung la/ /mchog tu 'jigs pas bsams nas ni/ /grong khyer sgo yahphu ra dā ra gudzhai ka ru dhwa ga mā ga mam/ /tro rṇa da na mu khādhwa j-i nd+ra re srung du'agro ba dang / /'ong ba rnams ni 'gags mepar byas/ /bye ①bo zas sogs spun zla rnams/ /de 6 bi ni be shya saḥ/ /na ga ra su swa yasma bye ta thā sā mā tya mee ni kaḥ/ /yi ⑨sgo rnams dag tu bkod/ /rang nyid grong khyer dbus su ni/ /dmag dang blon por bcas te gnas/ /rā dza pu tā da tha pāpta gasgo de bi ya sho dha rā/ /ba bhā ṣe sā ra bī ba rdzuḥde nas lha mo grags 'dzin mas/ /rgyal po'i bu las mngal thob pakhya )/ /zla ba rab tu nye ba yis⑪ /95—339

pra tyā sendand+ra pāṇḍa rā/ /a ka rā tā ba she ṣaphotha na ga re dā ra rakṣa ston ka'i mkha' bzhin rab tu ⑫mdzes/ /de nas grong khyer sgo srung 2 ba/ /zhag gcig lhag mar gyur ṇi / /sha ma pra dṛṭwārga ma byuttha bra dzñā bhi mu khaṃ di nam/ / tsi re bi tsarya pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma zhi bar rab zhugs shing / /nyin par rab byung blumangon phyogs gyuradu/ /nyi ma zhi bar saṃ sā ram̐ shārnyo yā te bi baṅgi te/ /kā ṣā yāsba ra mā lo bya ya yo song ba'i tshe/ /thun mtshams kyang ni 'khor ba las①/ /yun ring spyad ⑥nas ngur smrig gi/ /gos la sartsupa dṛ shya hūṃ/ /a she ṣā sha ta mo mo ha bi rā ma ni bi lo sha ṣpeḥ/ /i nd+raspyo brten de memi snang gyur/ /ma lus phyogs kyi mun pa yildu/ /rmongs pa 'joms bstan ⑨zla ba ni/ /dal mu di ta bya kre pūṭwā lo ka bi lo ki bhām/ /sa rā ga ta pe na bha bus shar ba ⑪nam mkha' dag /snang bas khengs shing gzigs par byas/ /chags dang gdung ba ldan sabyeta sī ba ga te ra bo/ /shudhand+ra z-i ya ya snga byuttha sā daḥko pya bi pa'i sems/ /nyi ma song tshe nam mkha' ni/ /zla ba dag pa'i snying ldan pas⑪/ /ci yang ma bslad rab sla baḥ / /a thāsmindanta re kāddhā santa tā ddhāḥpu ro da re/ /ratna dang gyur/ /de nas skabs der btsun mo'i tshogs/ /gnas pa'i pho brang 'khor gyis khengs ⑫/ /rin harmya pra bibyend+ra byu ti sande ha hā si ni/ /niḥsā ra bi ra saṃ sarde chen khang par zla ba'i 'od/ /rab zhugs the tshom dgod byed par⑫/ /ro bral snying po med gyur pa/ /rā dza sru nubee lo ka yan/ /dza ga da ga ga na swātstsha swatstshasdotstsha le ta smṛ tiḥ/ /kun la gzigs shing rgyal po'i bu/ /mkha' ltar dri med rang ④dbang du/ /dran pa rab tu rgyas pas smras/ /ga rto yo nā rī rde ma da na da ha no lbā pa ri ka raḥ pa ri tya bud med rnams kyi tshogs pa 'di ni 'dod pa'i me yi skar mda'i g.yog 'khor dang / /drag po'i sdug byest+ri dra bya sa na sha ta sand+ra pa sa tsi ba ཿ / / i dā dzā yughra bsngal brgya phrag dag gis gdung ba'i grogs yin yongs su gtang ⑩bar 'os/ /da ⑩ni khyim dag ⑫yongs 95—340

me ta ru ta la la tā shī ta la ta le pa ri tya ghā gā ra pra sha ma su kha sā su btang nas ljon pa'i 'og gi 'khri shing bsel ba yi/ /gzhi la rab tu zhi ba bde ba'i snying por bdag ni re pa ri ṇa teḥ / /e ta :nd+ra kyu ti ma da ma yo yā mi nārlo ba yongs su 'gyur bar 'os/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis rgyags pa'i rang bzhin mtshan mo lang tsho rgyas pa 'di la ni/ /ṣpesmin ni dru mu dā ni ya mi ta dṛ shaḥsaṃ sta ra srasta basthā ཿ/ /swa sgo 'di dag mig rnams gnyid ① kyi rgya yis 1 nges byas gos rnams mal stan dag la lhung / /rmi lam kyis tpand+ra nu tsi ta ba tsa naḥke sha saṃ sgo di tsā pāṭī ba shā sā ni la bi tsa li bskyed rigs pa min pa'i tshig smra skra yis (7phrag pa kun tu g.yogs/ /stsos pa'i dbugs kyi rlung gis bskyod tā na ladzdza yaṭī ba dī pān / / sa ra la srasta gā tā rde ni ladzdza pa'i mar me dag ni ngo mtshar ④gyur pa bzhin/ /lus ni bskyangs shing khyerang dbang min/ /ngo tsha med rgo bi ba pa sī/ /subhā dzā mṛ tā rmā tsa bhe daḥko nā ma de hi nā ma/ /i ti ta cing gos dang bral/ /lus can gnyid kyis log pa dang / /shi la nges par bye brag ci/ /zhes pa brjod gya bru ba ṇa gya saṃ dzā te ga ma nodma me/ /mi thāḥka tha sa la bha banda cing gshegs pa la/ /de ni brtson par gyur pa'i tshe/ /grong khyer sgo ni srung ⑥ba rnams/ /phan tshun ga ra dā ra rakṣi rde/ /sgo sgoḥkaḥko3tra dzā ganti dza gra tā nāste bi bla baḥ/ /pra khyu tsitta gtam dag byung gyur pa/ /kye kye su su 'dir 4)mel tshe/ /mel tshe ldan pa dunyes pa med/ /rje yi thugs gra ha bya grwaḥs ma grwa e ba dzā gra ti/ /dzā garbhe saṃ sā ra kṛ he ma bhā ྾ mo ngor 'khrugs pa yis/ /mtha' dag nyid ni mel tshe byed/ /'khor ba'i khang par mkhas pa mel tshe byed/ /hārnya kā re khya pi ti pra mattaḥ/ /pra dzā ga ro dzre bi ta me ba lo ke mṛ ta rmongs pa'i mun par bag med gnyid par byed/ /mel tshe rab ldan 'jig rten dag na 'tsho/ /shi dang gya supta gya tsa ko bi she ṣaḥ/ /i ti harmya sbi taḥkhru tā rā to rā tre rā dza su taḥka thāḥ/ /gnyid kyis log la bye brag ci/ /mtshan mo rgyal sras khang bzang na/ /gnas pas gtam de thos gyur nas/ /95—341

tsakri re bo bye satwa su swasgo nd+ra ha pra pū ra rṇa/ /tairde ba pu trabya twa raḥbyang chub sems dpa'i spro ba ni/ /shin tu chung ba rab rdzogs byas/ /de dag rnams kyis ①lha yi bu/ /sa mā dibye ma hā dza bāḥ/ /sa hā yā ga ma ṣpe tagya bhū shi khārnyidhri ti kṣa māḥ/ /sa ri chu gter 'dzin bzod pa/ /shin tu mgyogs par gyur pa bzhi/ /de yi 'gro ba'i grogs la bsgos(gye/ /sha krā diṣṭi na yakṣe ṇa pāñtsi ka khye na nimbi teḥ/ /sa hargyu sakta so pā brgya byin gyis bskos gnod sbyin ni/ /lngas rtsen zhes pas rnam sprul pa/ /khang bzang la reg them ①skas ṣpe ra ba tīrya bi nirya yo/ /swadzee sa ra thi mā dā yatstshanda kā khye bo bye saḥ/ /la—/ /babs nas de ni phyi rol byung / /'dun pa zhes pa'i kha lo pa/ /gnyid ni sad par byas te bos/ /und+ra na mi ba dza gā ha kabye kā khyi tu re ga me/ /tai tīkyā ru tsi re lasmri bsngags ④ldan zhes pa burta yi mchog /de yis ⑥spro ba bzhin du bzung / /dpal mo'i zur mig ltar g.yo ka ṭā kṣa ta ra lo ha ri ma/ /sa tsa kre saṃ ya mā li rgo rūrnyi saṃ smṛ byu bā ba'i—/ /rno mdzes 'phrog byed de la ni/ /de yi phyag gis srab skyogs nas/ /bzung zhing spyi bor reg ṇi nā/ /sha modma ma su ma na sā saṭwā suntattha hi sa maḥ/ /sa sha par byas/ /gang gi ⑦mthu yis phyugs rnams kyang / /g.yo ba dag ni rnam par gtong / /zhi brtson bo pi bi muñtsarnyi yattha bhā bee na tsā pa lo/ /ba la dzi dzñā sa yā n+yaste legs pa'i yid kyis des④/ /nang dang phyi rol gang du'ang mnyam/ /de nas stobs ni shes 'dod nas/ /te nā tha tsa ra rṇa kṣi to/ /na te kadza yi hūṃ she kudre ba pu tāḥs bisma yaḥ/ /de yi ⑨zhabs ni sa la bkod/ /ya mtshan ldan pa'i lha yi bu/ /de dag rnams kyis g.yo ma nus/ /tstshanda ke na sa hā ru khya nista re ga tu ram̐ ga maḥ/ /sa dza gā he ma habye ma bi 'drog pa med pa'i rta la de/ /'dun pa dang ni lhan cig zhon/ /rang gi bsam pa bzhin du ni/ /dri ma la swa mi bā sha yo/ /pra ya yo ta ra khā banti narbhe toṭī ṣa pabee baḥ/ /med che ba'i mkha' la gshegs/ /dpal gyi mya ngan shugs ring ⑩bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i rlung ni rab langs pa⑪//95—343
