saṃ sambi pa pa nolbā beeḥsho kotstsha mai ri ba shri yaḥ/ /ta myu dha ra ṇa raspya shu le gtsug tor thod kyi yal 'dab ni/ /g.yo zhing bsgyur zhing rab tu gshegs/ /de rgyan rin chen 'od zer khā bhiḥsha ba lo na bhaḥ/ /dza grwa ha sru tra pa tra li bi tsi tra oṃ ba gyi—/ /ri mos nam mkha' rnam par bkra/ /skud pa pa tra'i phreng ba yis/ /rnam bkra rnam ①sbyar blangs ṭī ba ram̐/ /tīṭwā shu bind+ra ka li lā bi lo la na ya notpa mā/ /pra bra dzarnyi da dṛ shu dṛ pa bzhin/ /bltar 'os pho brang 'khor gyi lha/ /'dren byed g.yo ba'i utpa la/ /mchi ma'i zigs rdzogs shyasta ma nta ཿ pu ra de ba tā ཿ / / saṃ sā ra mi ba bi st+riṇḍi pu re gang gyur pa/ /rab tu gshegs pa de mthong gyur/ /'khor ba bzhin du rnam rgyas pa'i/ /mi bdag sa dṛ pa bāndha baṃ/ /dru rānd+ra dakṣi ṭwā kṛ tya kṣa mya tā mi kyu bā tsa gnyen bcas grong khyer la/ /ring nas g.yas skor srimadzad nas ni/ /bzod par ①mdzod ces de yis saḥ / /kṣa pā yī kṣa ṇa she ṣa yī dza ṣpe ni dru bhi mu dri te/ /ta da darsha ma hā smras—/ /mtshan mo ④skad cig lhag ma la/ /skye bo gnyid kyis rgyas btab tshe/ /ming chen zhes pa ⑤rgyal nā ma pra busgo rā dza bānta baḥ/ /di bi dṛṭī pra dzanta tai sha shāṅka shaṅka po'i gnyen/ /rab tu sad pas dude mthong gyur/ /mkha' la 'gro ba de mthong ste/ /ri bong ducan du yā z-i taḥ/ /spru tse tsi re bi tsārlo : rpāṣṭhañtsi ta bi lo tsa naḥ/ / tsi dogs pas phrogs/ /yun ring dpyad nas mig dag khye ni/ /mchi ma rgyas pas skad cher smras/ /gzhon tra me tābyi raghra two bantu dzre bo pa ma su te/ /ku mā ra ru tsi rā kā ra na yus+ho nu mdzes pa'i rnam pa can/ /brtse dzī ba lta bu khyod/ /rigs pa byed pa'i chags bral nyid/ /ngo mtshar yukta kā ri ṇaḥ/ /baṃ shoṅkarṣa bi she ṣābye ni bsgye shaḥpi tsā twa yi/ /ka 'di ni rigs ma yin/ /rigs hu3 mchog khyad par don gnyer ba/ /re ba khyod la gtad pa'i yab re smrambi rā shaḥkri ya te sarpā shā bhā ra ṇa twa yā/ /i ti shākya su ma ha taḥkhru tā ba kun skong khrod kyis ni/ /ci slad re thag chad par byed⑪ / /ces pa shākya chen po'i tshig /mi bdag 95byed344

bā kyi dṛ pātpa dzaḥ/ /ta spru tse bāndha ba dī ti basmyo banta na shri kha lā/ /sras kyis thos gyur nas/ /des ①smras gnyen dang mdza' ba yi/ /'byel ba 'ching ba'i lcags kyi sgrog /a yo kā ya kṣa yi yā ti mi byā kṛ ha su kha pri yaḥ/ /bi ṣa yo gri bi ṣārta log pa'i khyim gyi bde ba la/ /dga' ba'i lus 'di 'jig par 'gyur/ /yul byi dug gis gzir rnams nā ma mṛ tā ya ta āoṃ ba āoṃ/ /ha stu kṛṣṭa ste pha ṇi pha ṇa z-idmasta la—/ /nags ni bdud rtsi'i khang pa yin/ /yul gyi tshogs kyi 'khor ba 'di na bag med rab tu dga' 'a7ka n+yasta mṛ tya karje bsgoṅka ṭa bi ṣa la to palla bā lo la mā laḥ/ /dīldan zhing / /gdengs can gdengs ka gsum pa lag pas drangs nas mgo la 'chi spyob bkod/ /drag dzñā gā ra pra ka ra ga ha rde gā ha te durghaṃ mārghaṃ saṃ sru re smimbi ṣa ya po'i dug gi 'khri shing yal 'dab g.yo ba'i phreng bas mgrin pa bltams④/ /sol ba 'bar ba'i tshogs ni tsa ye sa pra mo daḥpra mā dī/ /i kyu dīdhya bra dzabye sna bi laghra kyis rjogang ba'i ngan 'gro'i lam du 'jug par byed/ /mkha' la gshegs shing 'di smras nas/ /skad cig na ga ram̐ kṣa ṇa ta/ /ba hi: ta la ma bye tya sa ya yo bā dzi nā dza bta/ /ma gis ni grong khyer brgal⑥/ /phyi rol sa gzhir mngon gshegs te/ /de ni mgyogs pa'i rta la zhon/ /de ha tā shākya mu khye na bo dha sa tya su tha byu pa teḥ/ /antaḥphu re tsa kāṭwā na mudhū ta nas shākya'i gtso chen gyis/ /sa yi bdag po de la sbran/ /pho brang 'khor du btsun mo rnams/ /snying rje'i ka ru ṇaḥswa raḥ/ /a tha bradmend+ra dha na da pra mu khaṃste da shidzre taḥ/ /cho nge byung bar gyur/ /de nas tshangs dbang nor sbyin la/ /sogs pa'i lha rnams dag gis bskor/ /rā dza sru nund+ra dzwa shā ba ga tā dā da sha yo dza rna/ /a ba ru tyā tha tu rā dpag tshad bcu gnyis phyin nas ni/ /rgyal po'i bu yis ④nags tshal sleb/ /de nas rta las ⑧babs nas gaji mu sgo bha ra rja ni saḥ/ /u bā tsa sru tsi tā nanda tstshanda ka ba des—/ /rgyan rnams dag ni rnam par bkrol/ /bzhin gyi 'od kyis kun dga' ni/ /gsal bas 'dun 95—345

da na tī ṣā/ /kṛ tī tā bhā ra zla ni two ha yañtsa bra dza mandi ram/ /ṣpe dā dī maste pa la smras pa/ /khyod ni rta dang rgyan rnams dag /bzung ①la khang pa dag tu song / /sgyu ma'i 'ching ba me kṛ tya me tairmā ya ni banta naiḥ/ /ba ṣpe sminda ha me kā tī sha ma sadho 'di dag gis/ /da ni bdag la dgos pa med/ /nags 'dir bdag rang gcig pu nyid/ /zhi ba chog ṣa bāndha baḥ/ /e ka saṃ dzā ye ta dzantu re ka e ba bi pa rya te/ /bi shes gnyen dang ldan/ /skye bo ①gcig pur yang dag skye/ /gcig pu nyid du rnam par lhung ①/ /mi ṣa ma bi ṣa ya yo gisgo ga mudṛ bye ro ga sa ra sa ra ti bi she ṣa gre sha bzad yul dang sbyor ba'i longs spyod dag gi ④nad btang zhing / /ro ldan dga' ba'i khyad par nyon mongs sho ṣa pra thra tāḥ/ /pa ri bha ba bhu ba ṣpe ྈnde ṣa naḥse— bee shaḥsha mi skems par rab zhugs pa/ /yongs su zil gnon ⑤srid pa 'di ni ⑥'di nyid bdag gi gnas/ /'dod ta ma da na kārnyiḥshārnyi me ba shra yā mi/ /i kyughra bha ra rja n+ya su dīhūṃ bye ke mu pa'i mdzes pa zhi ba dag duni zhi ba kho na bsten/ /zhes smras de yis 'bar ba yi④/ /rgyan rnams de yi mo ba saḥ/ /tyakta sho kā ni hā mbi ba muspyo sakka ṇa pañtsa ye/ /tsū ḍi lag tu gtad⑨ / /mu tig mchi ma'i thigs tshogs kyi⑩/ /de dag mya ngan gtong ba bzhin/ /ral gris niḥkṛ tya khaṅge na sa bikṣe sa na bhasta le/ /shakrabyu tai sa mā dā ya ni gtsug phud bcad nas ni/ /nam mkha'i gzhi la de yis 'phangs/ /brgya byin gyis kyang de blangs nas/ /nā ya di ba mā da rata/ /ke shaḥkle sha i boskṛtta ya tra te na ma hāttha nā/ /gus pas lha yi gnas su khyer/ /gang du bdag nyid chen po des/ /nyon mongs bzhin du skra bcad pa/ /ke sha pra nyi gra haṃ tse tai saddhi sta tra ni bee shi tai/ /tstshanda ko pya shā mā dā der ni dam pa rnams dag gis/ /dbu skra blangs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs/ /'dun pa yis kyang rta ya pra yā taḥsapta bhedri ṣpeḥ/ /sha ṣpeḥpā bya pu ro pārnyi sho kārtaḥs ma blangs nas/ /rab tu song ste ⑪nyin bdun gyis/ /grong khyer nye bar dal bus phyin/ /mya ngan dag gis 95—346

rā gaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la nyid bsten to/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag tā yā ma bhe niḥkra ma rja ba dā rna pañtsa dzi shaḥpabee waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri 7shing las mngon par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //dza yarnyi te dzadma bha ya pra mughra bha ba pra ghā bā rnyi bha bā bhi myuspyoḥ/ /mdzes pa'i mig gi 'khor los snyesgyur ba'i bdud/ /gang gis bka' yi yul du bsgyur byas pa/ /yeḥpunda ri lo tsa na tsakra brte mā rāḥkṛ taḥshā sa na de sha barbhe/ /ta srid pa'i mthu yis/ zil mnan mngon par grol/ /skye ba'i 'jig ma snyelas rab grol de dag rgyal/ /de ta sta bo ba ṣpe smin bo bye satwo ta bo dzu ṣi/ / ta du pasthā yakṣa pañtsa nas dka' thub nags tshal der/ /byang chub sems dpa' ‘dnghadaka' thub bsten/ /de tshe de yi nye gnas lnga/ /bā rā ṇa sum̐ pra ba bra dzuḥ/ /smṛ ha ṭī yo mu mbibye hūṃ ma tha shākya mu niḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /swa wā rā ṇa sīr 75rab tu song / /de nas thub dbang 'dod 'os pa'i/ /shākya thub pa dal bu yis/ /sde yo se nā ya nī grwa oṃ dza na tsā ra ka yā yo yo/ /ta tra sa nā bhi dha na gya ka gdong dag gi grong 'u‘du ni/ /rang nyid ljongs ni rgyu zhing gshegs/ /der ni khyim bdag sde zhes pa'i(⑦/ /byo kṛ ha pa teḥsu te/ /nand+ra nanda ba lā khyu tsa tsā ru thraste ba bhū ba mngon par brjod pa'i bu mor 87ni/ /gzhon nu ma dag dga' ma dang / /dga' stobs zhes pa byung bar tuḥ / /shurjo da na su bhū bhaspru ste shu tā bi shu ta su tai/ /tsakrā ta daji ba hā sbyi gyur—/ /de yis sa bdag zas gtsang gil/ /sras kyi grags pa thos gyur nas/ /khyim bdag ⑫dag bra tai dā da sha bā bhā ke / / ā mo de nī dzā j-i da ye sa tu de bsgrub sbadakre / /brtul zhugs lo ni bcu gnyis byas/ /phreng ba lta bu'i gzhon nu ma/ /dri bzang dā sru tra ba dā sbi taḥ/ /mā lā nā mi ba bā khā nā ma bhe khā ṣaḥs bhā ba dzaḥ/ /dga' ldan snying la ni/ /mngon par 'dod pa rang bzhin skyes/ /skud pa bzhin du rtag tu gnas/ /95—348

dhe byu rmā pi ta duddhā dzā dugha ddhā rgyu pu naḥpu naḥ/ /kṛ tī tā spa ṭi ka sthā spyo yang yang 'o ma 'thungs pa yisahu)/ /ba rnams 'o ma de gnyis kyis/ /blangs nas shel gyi snod du ni/ /bra tārnye ba ya saṃ shu rghaṃ/ /bi bye badmā ya se sebye bi pra rū pa su re shwa dge ba'i 'o thug brtul zhugs mtha'(kye / /'o thug cho ga bzhin grub tshe/ /bram ze'i gzugs su lha dbang raḥ—/ /tai sa ma sgyu ya yo de shaṃ de ba: ka ma lā sa naḥ/ /harṣa da ti thi dang / /padma'i stan ldan lha dag kyang / /yul der yang dag mngon par 'ongs/ /mdzes ma de dag bhā ge tha ka n+ya kā ddhā sa mudhi te/ /sha kro ba datpa bye gu kho da yā dga' ba yis/ /mgron gyi tshe ①ni rab blangs tshe/ /brgya byin gyis smras yon tan kun/ / rgyal po spyo la yā gre pra dī ya tī/ /masto ya ma bye kastu babyehma pra tha ma ṇa te pi/ /i ni thog mas ⑤phul/ /bdag las re zhig tshangs pa 'di/ /lhag pas dang po nyid du 'os/ /lha yi kyuste su ra rā dze na pro bā tsa tsa tu rā nanaḥ/ /masto su bye ka de bā ste shusgye rgyal pos de brjod tshe/ /gdong bzhi pa yis rab smras pa/ /gtsang ma ris kyi lha de dag /bdag las bā sa kā yi kāḥ/ /i hphuste bra hma shā te pi dza ga durga ga na sbi tāḥ/ /sattha kyang ni lhag pa yin/ /tshangs pas de skad smras pa'i tshe/ /de dag gis kyang mkhar gnas smras/ /ni raspru pra ti bi shisgo sau bo bye satwa sta baḥkṛ shaḥ/ /na dho ni rā dza nā khyu yī bi na zhes pa yi⑨/ /klung du zhugs shing chur gnas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' dka' thub kyis/ /rid gā tyā sa li la sbi taḥ/ /e ta dā kasbya ka tyā sgyu mā byu ya ma ṇi sgo dza de/ /'di kun las khyad par 'phags/ /de dag thos nas gzhon nu mas/ /bos te tsurin chen snod du ni/ /a ba tī llīdzretai bhya bhyajaṭwā smi ma dhu pā ya paṃ/ /bo bye satwa sta dā dā ya phog nas blugs te gus pa yis/ /sbrang rtsi'i 'o thug de la phul/ /byang chub sems dpas de blangs nas/ /ratna pā tri da do ta yoḥ/ /dabho yi na pu na rgyu bye kyughā dza gra ha tu rje te/ /rin chen snod ni de la gtadazhi// /byin pa 'di ni sbar mi blangasakhya/ /zhes brjod de dag gis ma blangs/ /95—349

sā te na na dhī ni kṣibhā nā kaidhī tā pra bhā ba tī/ /bi sgo sgyu bhā z-i dā te bhyastukṣa 'od ldan de ni chu klung du/ /des ①'phangs klu rnams dag gis thob/ /rdo rje can gyis de dag las/ /rū pe ṇa ba dzre zla / / pra sā di bo bye sa two tha ka tyā yu mkha' lding gzugs kyis khye bskyod thob blangs/ /rab dang byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /de nas ga la mā sgyu pāta/ /dā na su pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na bha ba byoḥki sa mbi hi tai/ /te mdzes ma zung la smras/ /sbyin pa'i smon lam dag gis ni/ /khyed gnyis ci zhig mngon par 'dod/ /de ta rū tsa ru rā nanda ni dhiḥshurnyo da nātpa dzaḥ/ /saddhāza sisgo3bhe ma taḥl des smras zas gtsang sras/ /mkhas pa kun tu dga' ba'i gter/ /gzhon nu don kun grub pa de/ /ku mā raḥ pa ti rā ba yoḥ / / udma ma ka ma ra ha lī sa ra bdag cag bdag por mngon par 'dod/ /de dag tshig ni chags ldan zhing / /'dod pa'i rba rngurlabs santatpa tsasta yoḥ/ /na li lilba ma nasta gya padme da la mi bo da ka/ /sa dza gā da ku lhag pa des/ /de yi thugs la ma gos te/ /chu yis ④ pa dma'i 'dab ma ⑤bzhin/ /de yis smras pa gzhon mā ro sau na ki pra bra dzi taḥshu taḥ/ /na ta gya lo la na ya naḥpri yāḥshri ya i nu de/ /rab tu byung ba ma thos sam/ /de la bud med dpal mo bzhin/ /mig ⑥g.yo dga' ba dzeemed bste yaḥ/ /i tya bhā bee ta mā ka~X dīrghaṃ ni shwa gya ka n+ya ke/ /ā tsa turwa dam ci/ /zhes pa 'dod pa min thos nas/ /shugs ring phyungs te3snagazhon nu mas/ /smras pa (kyesbyin na dhand+ra yo si: ta spyi ba dzā ya hūṃ/ /a dṛṣṭa sne ha saṃ shlauṣṭaḥpra biṣṭintaḥpa'i chos 'di ni/ /de yi grub beed nyid gyur cig /ma mthong byams pa yang dag sbyar/ /nang zhugs phyi pa rārlu khe/ /na nā ma su tsi rā bhyastaḥpakṣa pā to ni bsto te/ /i rol phyogs tshe na'ang1 / /yun ring goms pa tsoskyunges par ni/ /phyogs su lhung ba mi zlogs so/ /de ti taṅka tsa āoṃ shu tā bo bye satwaḥpra sanda dhīḥ/ /pra ya taste sa mā mārgyu dag tshig de thos nas blo/ /rab dang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /nags kyi nang du ngal gso'i ⑩slad/ /95—350

bro nda nā ma na nā ma tsa / / tā ni tā ni paṃ mi tta ni pra bṛ tta zhing / /rab tu par zhes ṣpems (she1zhes kyang / /gang gi (kyebla med ye shes gter/ /'grub par 'gyur ni da darsha saḥ/ /ye ṣā ma nutta ra dzñā na ni dhwa na sā dha āoṃ pha lo/ /ni rañdza nā ba'i 'bras bu can/ /mtshan ma de dang de dag ni/ /byung bar gyur pa de yis mthong / /ni ⑦ rañdza na'i ya bhu ba ṣpe nā gornyaḥkā li kā bhe dhaḥ/ /busgotyā dāpta dṛzlameḥshasda mā kasbya sa gzhi la/ /nag po zhes bya long ba'i klu/ /sangs rgyas byung bas mig thob cing / /sa yi sgra thos nges ni dma yo/ / saza lakṣa ṇa sa dza.oṃ dī pta dzamyu na da byu sto/ / sa par 'thon/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rab rdzogs shing / / 'dzam bu (pyachu bo'i 'od zer 'bar/ /byang bo bye sa twa mā lo kya pro bā tsa ra tsi tāñdza liḥ/ /na le na na ya na kānta chub sems dpa' de (57 mthong nas/ /thal mo sbyar byas rab smras pa/ /padma'i spyan ldan mdzes pa khyod ni ste ba ṣpe yo ba ṣpe smin bi ha ra si bi ra hā rbhe sa dza dā ma bee yi lang tsho dar la nags tshal 'dir/ /phun tshogs rnams la 'bral ba'i gdung ba rab tu byin nas rnam par twa / / a sha ma sha ma bi she khodme ṣa sa rnyo ṣa te tu rbha ba si gnas / /mtshungs med zhi ba'i khyad par rab tu 'byed cing chog shes skye ba'i rgyu/ /khrod ni srid pa'i bha ba sa mu dre de hi rde sa tya se tuḥ/ /ya thā muñtsabye te bha ya ta ra mtsho las 5 lus can rnams kyi thu bden pa'i zam stegs 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'di na ri dwags 'di dag thams la tā ma tra ha ri shā ya thā lbo lā tsa kre bi ha ra ti sa mbi cad zhe'ajigs pa'i g.yo ba nyid ni btang byas shing / /ji ltar mkhar bgrod tshogs rnams rtse dga'i 'khor pe kha ga ga ṇaḥ/ / sa sa tā sa tā rmā ki ma pi z-i da yā shā sa sa los nye ba nyid du rnam par gnas/ /gang yang sems can rnams kyi snying gi yid brtan mtshungs pa nyid kyi da dzwa ta thā ma bye bo rghaṃ ba pu ram̐ da ma nā yā sa su kha rda/ / ka ri gnas gyur pa/ /de ltar 'di ni ngal dub med par bde ba sbyin pa'i sangs rgyas sku yin snyam/ /lag ldan 95—352

ka la dha gaḥpadma spru tyā ka ro ti ha reḥka ram̐ su kha ya ti shi khi sdiddhā phru ①gu padmo la dga' khyelag pa dag la lag pa 'jog par byed/ /gtsug phud ldan pa'i mjug rtse'i rlung lā saṃ ka lā pa shi khā ni leḥ/ /bha ba ti ha ri bhā lo lā dzeeṅgā pu raḥgis snyan pa'i sgra dang ldan zhing ①bde bar byed/ /mig zur g.yo ba'i ri dwags mo rnams mdun du gus pra ṇa yo rlu khāe pra sha ma sa ma ya phye yo pu ju pra sā da ma yi pas gyen du phyogs par gyur/ /bsod nams rab dang rang bzhin 'di ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba'i dus sbri tiḥ/ /a bye ba budhe twa ma bāsu shurghaṃ two bo dhi ye 6 tya khi dzee kyi lugs/ /de ④ ring kho na dag pa'i sangs rgyas nyid job nas/ /'jig rten gsum po khyod kyis ma lus 5 tri lo ki/ / saryaḥ pra sā da pra ma dā ba dā tī ku mudma ti sgoṇḍi i rtogs par bgyid/ /bdud rtsi'i ⑩ zer gyes 'phral la ku mud ldan pa ni/ /rab dang rab tu dga' ba'i bā mṛ tai shuḥ/ /a byo n+yandi na nā tha dīpta ma ha saḥs ryasta bā lo ka dkar ba rdzogs pa bzhin/ /nyin mo'i mgon bzhin gzi brjid rab 'bar khrod kyi (pyasnang bas 'phral la nāta lo kā ram̐ ka ma la pra bo dha ka la yā di bya pra kā sha smṛ shaṃ/ /nirlu phan tshun du/ /rab rgyas padma lta bus mchog gi snang ba la reg 'jig rten rnams (nyadag gis/ /sbrang rtsi tya dzdza da yārja ba dhe ma dhu pa gre ba saṃ bye ta na tra stunta rna pu na ཿ'thung ba'i phreng bzhin gdung zhing skrag par des bcings snyeng las po7phyir byung ba/ /gti mug mun pa'i ka ri 6 ti ba rda mo hānta kā ra ba li/ /i ti khru bā rde bee na yānd+ra ga rā dzee phreng ba slar yang nang du gnas ni byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /dul bas de skad smra ba yi/ /klu yi kwa/ rgyal la pra sanda dhīḥ/ /bo dhi satwaḥs mā bhā 6 sa mudhīrlu na dī ya yo/ /badzā rab dang blo/ /byang chub sems dpas phebs par smras/ /chu bo yang dag brgal nas gshegs/ /rdo rje sa na pa rda pā pya bo bye rū la ma nā ku lo/ /dakṣi khyo greḥku shibya kre gdan gnas byang chub kyi⑪ / /rtsa bar des phyin lhortam 'khrugs par/ /brgya byin gyis byin ku sha rnams/ /95—353

sha kra dasteḥs saṃ sta re/ /ta tro pa bi shya pazlo shaṃ baddhā ni: la ni: rtse mo g.yas bstan stimal stan byas/ /der ni skyil krung bcas mdzad nas/ /g.yo ba med par nges par yaḥ —/ /mjo ba sā na bi shāntaḥ sa su dhwadhi ri ba ba bye/ /a zhugasakhye —/ /bdud rtsi'i chu gter bsrubs pa yi/ /mjug snyitu ngal gso ④ bzhin du mdzes/ /brtan sā dhwa raḥkṣa mā dha raḥs dhī ra sa ra lā kṛ tiḥ/ /ru ru tse kāñtsa na ru tsiḥzhing drang po'i dbyibs ldan de/ /thun mong min par bzod pa'i rten/ /mi g.yo gser byu 'od ldan pa/ /sa ro me ru ri bā tsa laḥ/ /ā sru bakṣa ya parlunta pa.oṃsgo yasma ma sbi raḥ/ /lhun po gzhan pa bzhin du mdzes/ /zag pa zad pa ⑤mthar thug pa/ /skyil krung 'di la bdag gnas so/ /ba badhe ti sa saṃ kadzee kṛ tā pra ti mu khro smṛ tiḥ/ /a tānta re sa ma bye bye mā zhes pa'i brtag pa byas nas des/ /dran pa'i sgo ni rab tu bcings/ /de nas skabs der bdud dag ni/ /raḥsaṃ ya ma matpa raḥ/ /le kha hā rastandathoṇḍi bo bye satwa ma bhā ṣa zhi la phrag dog spring sdeyig thogs/ /myur ba nyid du mngon par 'ongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' la smras ta—/ /a kā ma kā ma hā ke yo lo ke bandha ba dā ma tā/ /a kā la ka li pa—/ /'jig rten gnyen la g.yon nyid dang / /'dod min 'dod pa 'di ni ci/ /dus min me tog kā kā ra ma tiste kā su bā ma nā/ /kṛ ṭī tai ha ta saṃ ke na de ba gzhon nu'i dbyibs/ /khyod kyi blo yang su zhig 'dod/ /dogs pa bcom pa'i lhas byin gyis/ /khyod kyi datta ta baḥpu ram/ /ni ruddhāntaḥpu ra gre ṇi badheḥshusgo da no dṛ paḥ/ /grong khyer rab tu blangs/ /btsun mo'i tshogs kyis phreng ba bkag④ /mi yi bdag po zas gtsang bcings④/ /i ti shu te ba ba tsa rna sho ka marsha bi sngodzhaitaḥ/ /a shi kṣi ta bee kā re ṇaḥzhes pa'i tshig ni hu3 thos nyid na/ /mya ngan khro ba'i dug spangs pa/ /de yi rnam 'gyur ma bslabs pa'i/ /tse ta sa bya tsinta yata/ /a ho ba tānta ra yo me mā raḥkaskyo sa mudma sems kyis ⑩rnam par bsams (/mepar gyur/ /kye ma bdag la bdud dag ni/ /bar chad bya bar rab tu 95—354

taḥ—/ /narta ya hye ṣa nidṛtaḥshi khaṇḍi spyo ḍa ya dza gta/ /mā rā mā ra brtson—/ /ngo tsha med ni ①gtsug phud ldan/ /rtse zhing spyo'agro la gar stabs sgyur①/ /mtha' ni 'chi bar bi rā maste dodzdza n+ya su na dzā ya te/ /e ke na ho sā ya zlo na pāste mi nus bdud/ /khyod kyis gnod par nus ma yin/ /'tshe ba'i mchod ④sbyin gcig gis ni/ /'dod yi ka ma tā twa yā/ /yadzñā dā na ta paḥshārgyunātpa naḥkakhyo mutpa he/ /pa nyid 'di khrod kyis thob/ /mchod sbyin sbyin pa dka' thub bsngags/ /bdag nyid la ni byed mi spro/ /swa gu rto dī ra ṇa sthā na pu bye puju hi shīsgo te/ /i ti nirbha ྾ste na tsitta rang gi yon tan bsgrags pa yis/ /bsod nams me tog rnyis ⑤shing 'brul/ /de yis de skad sun phyung ste naḥsha rī ri zla ma/ / sa mārṣaḥ pra ya yo mā raḥ sa mā rā bhādhū bas—/ /lus can sems ni 'phrog pa'i bdud/ /khro ba dang bcas rab song ste/ /rmad du ⑥sbyor ba torya maḥ/ /a thā dṛ shyanta la li tā khā lī tāñtsi ta lo tsa nā/ /bhra marjo yang dag brtsams/ /de nas tsu ta'i ⑦'khri shing bzhin/ /yid 'ong rab tu mdzes pa'i mig /g.yo ba'i ga ta re gi n+yaḥkāddhā 1ta la tā i ba/ /tsa ru ta tsa ri tā trebhāsnyi bung bas khrugayo ldan ma/ /yid 'ong mdzes ma mthong bar gyur④/ /spyod tshul mdzes pas ngoms gyur pa/ /srastuḥkā ma ka n+ya kāḥ/ /sa rā gi pā da na li tyā so: kruḥs ta po ba 'dod pa'i bu mo gsum po de'i/ /rkang pa padma ⑩can bkod nas/ /dka' thub nags 'di huskyechags ldan āoṃ—/ /bi lo tsa ṣpe na ha ri bhā kā ri dhī ga ti bee blu moḥ/ /ta tra tā bhe mu khaṃ sgo byas—/ /der ni mig gis ri dwags mo/ /'gying ba'i 'gros ⑫kyis glang mo dang / /de dag bzhin gye chu dzeerna li mbi mā li byā kṛ tā/ /yo ba nā bha ra ṇi ram̐ gi ra nu rā ga bi la pā skyes kyis/ /padma can ni dman par byas/ /de yi lus ni lang tsho yis/ /brgyan cing rjes su chags pas ṣpeḥ —/ /lā ba rgya ba sa nai tā sī kā mo byu da mya tse ta sī/ /badzā byugs—/ /mdzes sdug gos dang ldan pa yis/ /sems med rnams kyang chags par gyur/ /rdo rje'i 95—355

sa na mā dhwa na dhyā na ni: la lo tsa rna/ / tai bi lo kyā bha baṭwā sī gdan la bsam gtan la/ /mnyam gzhag ①g.yo med spyan ldan pa/ /de mthong nas ni de dag rnams/ /bisma ya dhyā na dhwa ra shā/ /tā bo dhi sa twa saṃ kaspradma da rā ga ma ya mtshan bsam gtan 'dzin par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag pa las/ /rgyags dang chags pa'i yo ba yaḥ/ /pa ri tya dzre ba sa ha sā sallasbyi bhe dzi re dza dzā/ /pra rang bzhin kyis②/ /na tshod 'phral nyid yongs btang des/ /dam pa'i ngo tsha'i rga ①ba bsten/ /de tī ya ga ma nārtswa sā ma tha bhasna ma no ra thāḥ/ /madma tha pra thi tā ra bha nas de dag phyir log ste/ /song bas yid ④la re ba chad⑤/ /yid srubs grags pa rtsom pa yis/ /si n+ya saṃ bhā ra mā da de/ /sattha pra ha ra ṇisto bye nā nā pā ṇi mu kherbha dmag gi tshogs pa bsdus par gyur/ /tha dad bzhin ldan srog chags dang / /mtshon cha kun gyi 'jigs yeḥ—/ /ṣast+ri sha ta ko ṭi bi pu lo ba lo ta su sa mudma yo/ /swa ya ma kaṇḍi nisgo ṣṭa pas khyab/ /bye ba phrag ni sum cu drug /de yi 'udapung chen yang dag rdzogs/ /rang nyid khro zhing drag po ko pa hrū ra sa rā sa naḥ/ /ma raḥspa ra bi kā re ṇa bo bye sa two yis—/ /rna ba'i bar du mda' bstan sti drangs/ /bdud kyi rnam 'gyur drag po yis/ /byang chub sems sa mā dra bta/ /shasta dṛṣṭi sta dudṛ ṣṭha sa ha shā shu bi ṣāthra bhiḥ/ /pra dpa' kun tu gtses/ /de yis rab 'phangs rdul dang ni/ /dug dang rdo ldan mtshon gyi char/ /mand+ra ldu ya yo bo dhi sa twa gya mand+ra rāmbu dza puñdza tam/ /pu nasthā ra ba lodṛṣṭa shant+ra ra dang padmo yi/ /tshogs su byang chub sems la gyur/ /slar yang bdud dpung gis 'phangs pa /bṛṣṭi dhri ta kṣa ma/ /tsakri re de ba tāsta gya badzra pra ti sa ma shra yo/ /mtshon gyi char ni 'dzin bzod pa/ /de la rdo rje ra ba'i gnas/ /lha rnams dag gis rab tu byas/ /sma ro pi naṣṭa saṃ kalpaḥs mā sgo sgo tra kaṇḍa rka/ /ghaṇḍa pa ṭu ra ṭatpand+ra brtags (rmyepa nyams pa'i dran pas kyang / /ting nge 'dzin byu rna ba'i tsher/ /shel gyi ljon pa 'dab ma ni/ /95—356

nind+ra mespa ṭika dru oṃ/ /taddhā ra mu kha ram̐ dṛkshi mā rañtsa sa ba khā yu dril bu gsal ba'i sgra ldan sprul/ /mu cor sgogs pa'i shing de dang / /bdud dpung mtshon dang bcas pa sgo / /tsakra bā ḍi sa musthā su tsakṣi pusbyo ma de ba tāḥ/ /bha ga bā na tha dag /nam mkha'i lha yis blangs nas ni/ /lcags ri'i phyi rol rab tu 'phangs/ /de nas bcom ldan saṃ shāpta pra sanda dzñā na nihma laḥ/ /saza beetparba gaḥsarba dzā ti smṛ ti pu ro ye shes ni/ /dri med rab dang yang dag thob/ /kun rig kun rtogs skye ba ni/ /thams cad dran pa ta bta/ /sa ta tā nutta ra dzñā na samyakshi bo bye mā shri taḥ/ /da darsha mchog tu gyur/ /der ni bla med ye shes kyi① / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes pa des/ /las kyi rba 2saza byu tā nī ga ti kasgrombi nind+ra tsā/ /a tha shā kya pu re mā raḥpra bā da ma rlabs kyis sprul pa/ /'byung po kun gyi 'gro ba mthong / /de nas shākya'i grong khyer du/ /byang chub sems mṛ dzandi ba ཿ / / bo dhi sa twa pra ya to ste ta pa ཿ kle sha ba shā di dpa' dka' thub kyis ①/ /nyon mongs dbang gis 'das gyur zhes/ /mkha' la ④bdud kyis rab tu ti—/ /ta tra shusgo do no rā dzā pu tra sne ha bi ṣā tu raḥ/ /ni pa pā ta bsgrags—/ /der ni rgyal po zas gtsang ma/ /de thos rdo rjes ⑤ bcom pa bzhin/ /bu la byams pa'i ta mā kasbyabaḥbadzra ha ta i ba kṣi to/ /antaḥpu re sa ha dṛ pe sthā dug ⑥gis gzir/ /sa la rab tu 'gyel bar gyur/ /mi bdag btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /srog ṇa tyā ga kṛ ta kṣa ṇi/ /su bṛtta pakṣa pā ti n+yasta mū tsabye ma de ba tāḥ/ /ni btang bar byas pa'i tshe/ /legs spyod phyogs su lhung ba yi⑦/ /nam mkha'i lha yis der smras pa/ /pu tra ta bā mṛ tai rpā tā samyakshi budhe hūṃ ga taḥ/ /te nā ba lo ka ta snga bdud rtsi gsol nas khyod kyi sras/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid gyur/ /de yis gzigs pa rnams pi nā ste mṛ tai bha yo/ / i ti sānta ཿ pu rā mā tya ཿ shu tā na ra la yang / /'chi bas ①byas pa'i 'jigs pa med/ /mi bdag blon po btsun mo dang / /bcas pas tshig 95—357

pa tizla tsaḥ/ /a bhūttha tya ga ta shā ṇaḥsu dhwa sikta i ba kṣa ṇata/ /ta de thos gyur nas/ /bdud rtsis bran bzhin skad cig la/ /srog ni slar yang byung bar gyur/ /kun smidma hotpa bā nande bo dhi satwa badhūḥsu ta/ /kanta ya sho dha rā mṛ ta dga'i dga' ston chen po der/ /zla ba sgra gcan gyes zin tshe/ /byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mo ni/ /rā hu gra ste ni shya ka re/ /rā hu lā khyaḥs bā lo bi dṛ ba tedzdzadma grags 'dzin ma la sras mdzes btsas①/ /sgra gcan zhes pa (33byes pa de'ang / /mi bdag des bskyed shaṃ ki te/ /dzan sde sa si laḥshud bye ni kṣiptambha si pra plu bee/ /bha dogs pa'i tshe/ /ma yis dag slad rdo dang bcas/ /'phangs tshe chu las ①'phyo bar gruradu/ /bcom ga bā na pi sabhā ha sbi to ni: la bi gra haḥ/ /badzra parlo ka badhe na de ldan 'das kyang nyin zhag bdun/ /sku no g.yo ba med par gnas/ /rdo rje byas krung bcings pa yis/ /bā dzā bisma yo bya bāta/ /sa brahma kā yi kā khyu dhī de ba tā dzñā bi bo dhi taḥ/ /lha rnams ya mtshan ldan par byas/ /tshangs pa'i rigs zhes bya ba yi⑤ / /lha gnyis kyis ni bskul ba na/ /a ba data pa ra mā nanda su dhwa sasdo ha punda raḥ/ /a ho ba ta ma yā dzñā tā mchog tu kun dga' bdud rtsi yispyo/ /tshogs ltar mdzes pas bka' stsal pa/ /lha dang lha min dbang pūthru ṣpe ṣā su kha sbi tiḥ/ /ya yā su rā su re shwarya su khaṃ duḥkha ga rja phyug bde/ /gang gis sdug bsngal du rtsi (kyeb/ /bde bar gnas pa 'di ni sngon/ /kye ma bdag gis shes ya te/ /lā pa bye bhaḥplu bi tsā gāsta ru rgyaḥpe yu ṣādroḥswarga saṃ sgo ga brgaḥ/ /ma gyur/ /mdzes sdug chus rgyas lang tsho ldan pa'i lus/ /bdud rtsis brlan pa mtho ris longs spyod tshogs/ /a tyā she ṣa byā ga te la su kha gya spaddhā badhe paṃ shu niḥsā ra e ba/ /saṃ ta stom lus btang gyur rtsol med bde 'di yis/ /'gran zla snying po med pa'i rdul nyid do/ /mi bzad yul gyi haṃ bee ṣa ya bi ṣa ma kle sha saṃ sā ra pānd+ra krāntaḥshaṃ tyā bri ti mu pa ga nyon mongs 'khor ba'i lam 'gon kun tu gdung gyur zhing dzee/ /nyon mongs can bdag zhi bas dga' ba 95—358

tā:nda nasgo ya ye ba/ /saṃ dzā te yi sa ka la ka ra ṇa yā yi mbi mbi dṛ tinyer ①gyur tsandan grib mas bzhin/ /dbang po mtha' dag tshim pa'i bde ba 'di yis bdag ni dga' ba mbi bee shāddhā ram̐ sha ma hi ma ba ṣpe ki su kha rdzu pa mā rgo/ /a sminda skyes—/ /zhi ba'i ①gangs ldan nags su ngal bsos pa rnams (gebade ba'i dpe ni ci/ /gnas skabs der ba sa re pu sgo ba ri pā ke na tadma sna/ /ba ni dzo thra thu sāze na pābho ni bsod nams dag /yongs su smin pas nags tshal der/ /tshong pa ga gon bzang po dag /don tra pu sa bhalli kau/ /de ba tā pre ri to bhasthā bha ga banta mutpa hye tai/ /mthun chen pos 'ongs par gyur/ /lha yis bskul ba de dag gis/ /gus pas bcom ldan la phyogs te/ /pra ṇa to piṇḍa pā to yo kṛ khya tā mi tya bhā ṣa tai/ /da yā bi bye yaḥphyag 'tshal nas ni bsod snyoms 'di/ /blang bar mdzod ces rab tu smras/ /brtse ba'i dbang gyur kun sarbha dzñā sta dā ka rdzu bee tsinta ya ta / / byubye ཿ pā tre kṛ tī to yo na mkhyen gyis/ /de ni gsan ④nas rnam bsams pa/ /snga rabs rnams kyis snod du 'di/ /blangs kyi pā rto pā tra balji te/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta gya ma hā rādzā bhi dhwaḥsu rāḥ/ /da tā snod spangs lag par min/ /de ltar bsams pa de la bee/ /rgyal chen bzhi zhes bya ba'i lhas/ /shel las spa ṭi ka pā tā ṇi tsa tā ri tri di ba ya yuḥ/ /kṛ tā tha bha ga bānd+ra tre byas pa'i lhung bzed bzhi/ /phul nas lha yi gnas su song / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /piṇḍa pā tra pra ti gra haṃ/ /a nu gra haṃ ta yo: kre sha ra ju tra ya shā bsod snyoms rab tu bzhes mdzad nas/ /skyabs ⑤gsum dag gi (khyabaka' yis ni/ /de dag rjes su sa nā ta / / bi ta ta su kṛ ta sā spyi pu sgo ni kṣe pa da kṣaḥ kṣa yi bzung ba ⑦mdzad/ /legs byas rnam par rgyas pa'i dbang po bsod nams ster 8la mkhas/ /rgud pa ma ta bi pa da she ṣaḥshārja nā kalpa bṛkṣaḥ/ /bha ba ti ku sha la rū leḥka gya tsiddhā gya lus zad byed don du gnyer ba'i dpag bsam shing / /dge ba yongs gyur bslab pa'i rjes mthun dam pa 95—359

bhā dzaḥ shu bha pa ri ṇa ti dīkṣu dakṣi ṇaḥ sā dhu saṃ gaḥ/ /i ti kṣe dag gis grogs/ /skal ldan 'ga' zhig dag gi dge ba'i rtsa bas thob ①par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satwa ba dā na kalpa khā tā yī mā rā bi dra ba shā dbang pos gru byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa zudapag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bdud ba dā āoṃ nā ma ṣadzhai shaḥpalla waḥ// //bcom pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa byedrug pa'o// //baṃ shaḥs ko pi bi su laḥku sha khā nu bañtsi yartswa ru dṛtta mu tsi tai mdzes pa'i spyod tshul dang ldan yon tan sdud par 'os gyur zhing thu/ /rin chen 'od zer rnam dag gu ṇa saṃ gra ha gya/ /rarja bi shubye ru tsi thra rtsi ta saza kā shaṃ mughā ma dam pa'i snang ba rgyas par byed/ /nad med mu tig rang bzhin 'gro ba'i rgyan ni skyed byed pa/ /gang zhig yo dza ga ta lo ka ra ṇa pra sru te/ /n+ya gro dhwa rā ma ni ra tai pu rā ka dge bas rjes 'brel ming chen rigs de 'ga' zhig yin/ /ser skya'i gzhir ni n+ya gro dha'i/ /kun dga' si la bstu ni/ /shākyaḥswa baṃ shaṃ pa prasgorbha ga brnyi ta thā ga tai/ /ra bar bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs la sngon/ /shākya rnams kyis rang rigs ⑥zhus/ /taiḥthraṣṭaḥswa ku lotpatrī sa moṅga spyo ya āoṃ pu raḥ/ /bakhye n+ya yīkta kṛ tā gya des dris des kyang mo gal bu/ /de la dri med ye shes kyis 7/ /gzigs pa bskyed nas mdun du ni/ /bi ma la dzñā na darsha rna/ /sa bi lo kya ya thā ta tā ma tī ta dzñā na tsagru rang gi rigs 'khrungs gsung bar bskos/ /de yi 2ye shes spyan kyis ni/ /'das pa de nyid ji bzhin ṣā—/ /tā na bo tsa ta saṃ smṛ tyā shu ya tsā shākya saṃ bha baḥ/ /a she ṣe smin dza la ma gzigs—/ /yang dag dran pas de rnams la/ /smras pa shākya byung (lkub nyon/ /ma lus 'jig rten 'di ye dza ga tya kaṇḍi be su rā/ /sbi te pa ba ṇa saṃ spa khyeta pa ya pa ya i bā ni sngon/ /chu yi rang bzhin gcig nyid du/ /gnas tshe rlung gis bsrubs pa las/ /chu ni 'o ma bzhin 95—360

bha bta/ /dza le ta smin gha na ta yā yā te ka thi na hūṃ sha ṣpeḥ/ /a bhūdmaṇḍi ra sa sparsha du gyur①/ /chu der stug po nyid kyis ni/ /dal bus sra bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /kha dog ro dang reg dang sgra/ /shasda ganta ma yi ma tī/ /ta snga mā bhā swa ra de babyutāḥkand+ra pa ri kṣa yāta/ /dri yi rang bzhin sa gzhir gyur/ /der ni las dag yongs zad pas/ /'od gsal lha las lhung khya gyur pa/ /tabhu lya ba ṇḍi saṃ bye tā satā ཿ sa twa ba lā bye kā/ /aṅga lya ra sa de mtshungs kha dog ①yang dag rgyas/ /sems can snying stobs stobs lhag pa/ /ro la chags pas rab mā swā rya tadhri : ti pra mo hi tāḥ/ /ā hā ra do ṣāta pāpurguru rūkṣa bi rmongs pas/ /mdzub mos ④ro ni myang khyabyas nas/ /kha zas skyon kyis lce ba dang / /rtsub cing kha dog baṇḍi hūṃ/ /anda pra sa bee mbi te ྾ kra me shā bhūta ba sundha rā/ /ta mo ngan par gyur/ /de dag rnams kyi sa la spyoni/ /rim gyis sā klu7lu 'khrungs par gyur/ /mun pas rnam bhebya bi lubhā dzā kṣe tā gā ra pa ri gra haḥ/ /ṣpe tā te ྾ kṣa ta tā rjata kṣa tri par bcom rnams kyis/ /zhing dang khang pa yongs su bzung / /de dag nyams srung sa skyong la/ /rgyal yaḥkṣi ti pā la ṣpe/ /ma hā sasmatta nā mā byudzdza na gya ma ha to ma taḥ/ /ta snga rigs tshul dang ldan pa ni/ /skye bo mang pos bkur gyur pa/ /kun kyis bkur ba zhes pa byung / /de yi na ya ma ha tyā sī1 baḥshrī mā nu po ṣa dhaḥ/ /a sthā na tībyā ku su ma rigs brgyud chen po la/ /dpal ldan mi bdag gso sbyong 'phags/ /grags pa'i me tog nyams med byung / /pa ri dzā ta e bo da dhi/ /tsakra btī su tasta su māddhā tā bhū da yo ni dzaḥ/ /chu gter la ④ni yongs 'du bzhin/ /de yi sras gyur 'khor los sgyur/ /skye shesnaganas skyes min nga las nu/ /dza ga bye ka ta pa tra su ya su baṃ sho ma ha na bhū ta/ /baṃ she sa ha sra baṃ sha gya gang gi rigs brgyud ⑫'gro ba na/ /gdugs gcig tuskyenyid ldan chen po byung / /de yi rigs ni stong phrag kṛ tīsta snga bha badzñā paḥ/ / tsitta pra sā da ma ka rod bha ga bān ya gi—/ /rigs las ⑫mi bdag kṛ tī khyestebyung / / gang gi thugs ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs dag 95—361

gya kā shya paḥ/ /i spyo ku ra na ye ta gya ta gya tsā byud bi rū bye kaḥ/ /dzwa tyā gis dang bar mdzad/ /de brgyud bu ram shing pa byung / /①de las yang ni 'phags skyes po/ /de yi cha kā ni ya sa sru no byoṣṭhaste na bi bā se tāḥ/ /e tī byu ya ta taḥsarbe swa de bu ni nu bo la/ /dga' bas phu ①bo gnas nas bskrad/ /de nas gzhon nu thams cad ni/ /gcig tu sha bi ga te smṛ hāḥ/ /ku mā raḥka pi lā khya gya ma harṣa rā shra oṃ ya yuḥ/ /dhyā 'dus nas rang yul la/ /chags dang bral bas thub pa che/ /ser skya zhes pa'i gnas su song / /byis na kā khānta rā yā zla bā myu du:ཿbra lā pi rna/ /so n+ya tra nind+ra me te ྾ pa sgra chen sgogs pa yis/ /bsam gtan dus kyi gegs sdebyed pa/ /de dag grong khyer gzhan du ni/ /pu ram̐ ka pi la bsteti/ /kā la na pu tra bātpa spyo da nu tā pa na byu pa tiḥ/ /ser skya'i gzhi zhes de yis sprul/ /dus kyi ⑤sa bdag bu la ni/ /mnyes gshin rjes su gdung ba yis/ /ā nī yadzñā ku ma rā ste sa tsi bā ni tya bhā ṣa ta/ /ta mū tsurmadhri ṇaḥsabee blon po rnams la gzhon nu ni/ /de dag khyer la shog ces smras/ /blon pos der smras rgyal po lags/ /rā dza na pāpta pu rotta maḥ/ /pra tyā ṣpe tu ma shākya ste dzā tā pa tyā thra thu shri yaḥ/ /de dag kun gyis grong mchog thob/ /bu tsha skyes shing dpal 'byor che/ /beer yang dgug ⑥par mi nus so/ /i ti te ྾ bi tusta tra shākyā shākya bi tsinta ṣpe/ /ba byu buḥshākya saṃ dzñāste dṛ de dag rnams kyi pha yis der/ /nus sam mi nus rnam bsams tshe/ /de dag shākya'i ming can gyur/ /de pu ra ste 6 baṃ sha kṛta/ /tadzee she 6 pañtsa pañtsa sa ha sra 6 ma tī bhu dzā/ /a rnams rigs la mi yi grong / /de yi rigs las ⑦ sa spyod ni/ /stong phrag lnga pa lnga 'das tshe/ /dpal tī te 6 kṣi ti pa tiḥshrī mānda sha ra thophobha bta/ /ta myu na ye sau ha ha nurba byu ldan sa yi bdag po ni/ /shing rta bcu pa byung bar gyur/ /de yi brgyud la seng ge (she'agram/ /sa yi ba thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /na ra bee sau ha mi ba yo se hi re rā dza kuñdza raḥ/ /byeṣṭhaḥshusto da bdag po byung gyur te/ /gang zhig seng ge bzhin du ni/ /rgyal po glang pos g.yul mi bzod/ /de sras thu 95—362

nasta gya su taḥshuklo da naḥpa raḥ/ /dro kho da nasta da nu dzaḥka bee yā na mṛ to da naḥ//bo zas gtsang ste/ /gzhan ni zas dkar de yi ni/ /rjes su skyes pa bye bo zas/ /bdud rtsi zas ni gzhon nu'o/ /ka n+yabyu ta sraḥshuddhā khyuḥshukrā dro shā mṛ tā ta thā/ /shusgo da na gya bha ga bān bu mo bzhi ste gtsang zhes dang / /dkar bye bdud rtsi de bzhin no/ /zas gtsang sras ni bcom ldan 'das//su nu rnandasta thā pa raḥ/ /shuklo da na su ta yo dwo ti byā khyophotha bha dri kaḥ/ /de bzhin gzhan ni dga' bo 'o/ /de nas zas dkar sras gnyis ni/ /skar rgyal zhes dang bzang ldan no//dro rto da na su dwo pu tā ba ni ru sgo ma hāsta thā/ /ā nanda de ba daṭwā khyu ba mṛ bre bo zas kyi sras gnyis ni/ /ma 'gags de bzhin chen po 'o/ /kun dga' bo dang lhas byin zhes/ /bya ba to da na saṃ bhā bo/ /shuddhā su taḥsu pra shudhaḥshukrā sru nu: mā lbo kaḥ/ /bdud rtsi zas las 'khrungs/ /legs par rab rtogs 7 gtsang ma'i bu/ /dkar mo'i bu ni phreng ba can//dro ṇa pu trastsa bha dru ṇi bee shā lya gya mṛ tā su taḥ/ /rā hu lo bha ga ba taḥsru nuryasmi j-ibazang po bye bo ma yi bu/ /yangs pa can yang bdud rtsi'i bu/ /gang la rigs ni rab gnas pa/ /sgra gcan shaḥpra tikhye taḥ/ /i tyādzdza lo dzñā na ma ye na te na baṃ shaṃ ya thā bta ka thi tai 'dzin ni bcom ldan sras/ /zhes pa rab gsal ye shes rang bzhin des3/ /rigs ni ji ltar bshad bzhin ḍo ni sha mya/ /shākyā ba byu burbha ga bta pra bhā baḥsasthā bi toṅkarṣa bi she ṣa shuddhāḥ/ /thos gyur nas/ /mchog gyur khyad par dag pa shākya rnams/ /bcom ldan mthu yis rab tu 'khrungs par gyur//i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī shākyotpaṣṭha zhes byapa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing ba dā rna nā ma sapta bo shaḥpabee baḥ// //las shākya byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa 6bdun pa'o// //sa ko pi sa twagya bi bee ka bsgoḥpu bye pa sanda su ma hā na pra bhā baḥ/ /na gos dag gla rtsi'i dri ngad ldan pa bzhin/ /skyes bu snying stobs dben pa'i gnyen ldan pa/ /bsod 95—363

so ti yaḥkā ya sha te 6 sum̐ saḥkatho ri kā mod i rpā shu kā gya/ /dzi na sazla nams nye bar rdzogs pa'i mthu chen gang / /ci yang de ni lus brgyar med mi 'gyur/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i dza gastontu saṭwā pa ka ru rja hra de/ /pu re rā dza kṛ he be rku ba nānta ra khab kyi ni/ /'od ma'i tshal gyi nags nang na/ /srog chags 'gro kun yongs gdung la/ /rgyal ba thugs bi hā ri ṇi/ /shrī mā na bhu da bhu pa ti:spra lnga po ta lā bhe dhaḥ/ /dza rje'i mtsho bzhugs tshe/ /gang gi nor gyis nor sbyin ni/ /nor gyi dregs pas long ba 'phrog /dpal hā ra dha na dasthālja dha de na dha ma da su yaḥ/ /a dzā ya ta su tasta gya ma no ra ldan gru 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /sa bdag tsam par byung bar gyur/ /de yi bu ni btsas gyur pa①/ /yid la tha sha tā nī taḥ/ /dha nā nā mbismitā bāpta su kha sa khro bi bhū ta yaḥ/ /shra re ba brgya ldan pa'o/ /nor rnams 'dod pas thob pa yi(snye/ /rnam par 'byor pa bde ba'i grogs/ /gro ba shā kṣa rde dzā ta gya sa sru no sta gya dzadma ni/ /spru tyā da do da ri dra mya bzhin dag las 1skyes gyur zhingathu/ /bu skyes pa yi ⑤tshe na dekhya/ /dga' bas ⑦bye ba nyi shu ni/ /ko ṭī dzā bo sha nyi ya dā/ /sa sho ṇa ko ṭī bo shā khyaḥshi shu byu tasta dā bha bta/ /bi bha dbul po la byen gang gi tshe/ /gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu zhes/ /de tshe byis pa de grags ⑤gyur/ /gang gi ⑨baḥsu kṛ te nai ba ye na baṃ sha bi bhū ṣi taḥ/ /pāpta bi ryaḥs saddhābeeḥrigs ni rnam brgyan pa/ /legs byas kyis ni 'byor pa bzhin/ /nor rnams kun dang lhan cig tu/ /sa ha bṛdhi mu pa gā taḥ/ /tsa kā ra su kha bi shādhi bya ba hā ra dhwa raḥpi tuḥ/ /rig pa thob cing 'phel bar gyur/ /pha yi lugs rnams bzung ba yis/ /bde ba nyid du ngal gso ⑩ byas/ /sa ka dā tsita pra bhā puñdza mi ba srurya gya maṇḍa lāta/ /a ba tīṇḍi pu ra pā ste nam zhig nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ / nyi ma'i /—7tshogs bzhin mdun du ni/ / mo gal 1lngagyi bu babs moṅga sthā ya na ma bra bīta/ /ko bha bā narka saṃ kā shaḥpra kā shi ta di ganta raḥ/ /nas—/ /'ongs pa la ni de yis smras/ /phyogs mtshams rab tu gsal byed pa/ /nyi ma 'dra ba khyod ni su/ /95—364

tri da she shaḥsha shāsko bā de bo bā dra bi rto shwa raḥ/ /sa tai pa bhā ṣe na su raḥskabs gsum dbang ngam ri bong can/ /lha 'am nor gyi dbang po 'am/ /de la ①des smras bdag ni lha/ /shi stso bha ga ba tasto haṃ/ /budha su bi bu dhwa dhī sha babye mā ṇa gu ṇa ma yin sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /yon tan dpal ldan lha dbang gis/ /phyag byed rte7dag gi slob shri yaḥ/ /swatstsha ta su pra yatstsha tai piṇḍa pā tai ma hā mu ṣpeḥ/ /sa twa shusgo da yā ma yin/ /thub chen de la khyod kyis 2ni/ /dri med bsod snyoms rab tu sprul/ /snying stobs dag cing bā ste sgo gye bha ga ba ta ཿ pri yo/ / i ti sho ṇa gya bha ga bānd+ra : rgyas pa las/ /thob pa'i longs spyod bcom ldan mnyes/ /zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan/ /gro shra ba ṇa ga mi nā/ /ra bi bhakta gya dzā tya pi ro māñtsa sa ma dzā ya ta/ /sthābazhin rna bar song ba yis/ /nyi ma la gus rigs yin kyang / /spu long rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /sngon gyudma bā sa nā skru taḥswa bhā po ya gya yaḥspru taḥ/ /sa ta spyo dī ra ṇi nā pi sgu skye'i bag chags kyis sbyar ba'i/ /rang bzhin gang la gang gnas pa'ikhu/ /de la de ni brjod pas kyang / /ṭa e ba bi bhā bya te/ /sa tasmi bo sha ti sthā lī pā shaṃ āoṃ ka dza no tse tai/ /pā nyi gsal ba nyid du rtogs par gyur/ /de yis de la tshos pa'i snod/ /mtho ris skye bo la 'os pa/ /nyi shu khodzhatta saṃ sakta shra sgye yuste na tse ta sā/ / tasta ste pre ṣi tai te na bha gus pas chags pa dang / /dad ldan sems kyis rab tu bskur/ /de nas gus pas phun tshogs des/ /ga bān bhasti saṃ sa dā/ /a nu gra hā gra ha bya graḥs ma gre swa ya ma gra springs pa de dag mtha' dag ni/ /lhag par rjes su 'dzin brtson pa'i/ /bcom ldan rang gis bzhes tī ta/ /a thāsminda pa sa re bha sgyu sthā li sā kai dṛ so tsi tai/ /sa mā dā ya par gyur/ /gnas skabs der ni gus pa yis/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po ni(khya/ /mi bdag la 'os swa yi rā dzā bi mbi sā ra sa mā ya yo/ /sho ṇa sthā hi ta sgo ga nā mā tshos pa'i snod/ /rang gis bzung nas byung bar gyur⑥/ /gro bzhin gyis springs longs spyod kyi()/ /dri 95—365

mo daddhā tra pābee baḥ/ /ā sthā ya sha kra bra hi tai sattha di bya ma ma n+ya bzang der '-i7ni sa bdag gis/ /tshor nas brgya byin gyis springs pa/ /thams cad mchog ldan yin par ta / /pā tra she ṣe bha ga ba tā datta mā swā rya khyu pa tiḥ/ /sgo rde bsams—/ /lhung bzed lhag ma bcom ldan gyis/ /byin nas sa yi bdag pos myangs/ /zas de gro na pre ṣi tai khru tā ta da nu bisma yo ya yo/ /bha ga bān tai pra ṇa myu tha bzhin gyis springs par/ /thos nas ya mtshan 'dzin par gyur/ /de nas mi dbang bcom ldan la/ /rā dza ṅgā no na re shwa raḥ/ /pra bi byā tsarnyi tasbyi hūṃ di dhyā sgo ṇa gya sasba phyag 'tshal rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /rab tu song ste gro bzhin gyis/ /phun tshogs mchog tu rgyas par rda—/ /gatshwa mi tai swa yo drabye draṣṭa byolhasau ma hā ya shāḥ/ /i ti nibye tya sa bsams(37—/ /rang nyid de ⑦ni lta ru 'gro/ /grags chen de ④ ni blta bar 'os/ /blon bcas de ltar tsi beeḥs yā tra rambha mā di shata/ /po ta laḥkṣi ti saṃ dzñā tā swa ya nges byas nas/ /de yis bgrod pa rtsom ⑤ par bstan/ /sa bdag rang nyid 'ong bar ni/ /brtson pa mā ga ya nodmā ram̐/ /nī ti dzñā pu tra me kādhe sgo ṇa ko ṭi ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pu tra lugs zhes ⑪gru 'dzin gyis/ /shes nas dben pa dag tu bu/ /gro bzhin bye ba la smras pa/ /mi bdag hūṃ dranghru mā yā ti basbyo shra ma gu ru dzra baḥ/ /i de ṣa z-i sha muṅkarṣaḥs rigs kyi rten pa'i ⑦bla/ /bu khyod lta ru 'ong zhes pa/ /'di ni mchog dang khyad par du/ /skyon dang do ṣaḥpra ti bhā ti me/ /kṣi tī sha la kṣa tai yā tai pakṣa yā todma tā i bcas par bdag gis rtogs/ /sa dbang mtshon cha ⑪nyid gyur na/ /gshegs ⑨pa sbyor bar brtson pa paṃ / /a bi lambi ta yāsnarnyi sha ra i ba gu ṇa sgo tāḥ/ /z-i tyā yang / /thogs pa med par 'joms 'gyur te/ /rgyud las 'phos pa'i mda' bzhin no/ /shin tu na ma bi bi dre pyo bha ba tya ti sha yonda tiḥ/ /a rnyi mā ṣpe ka sā rā rde khengs pa g.yog rnams kyi'ang / /dgra bo ⑩'os su gyur yin na/ /mngon par khengs pa gcig pu yi/ /95—366

ki pu naḥthra thi bī ju rdzu/ /rū pe ba ya se sau bhā gye pra bhā bee bi bha bee khru te/ /sa yi bdag po slar yang ci/ /gzugs dang na tshod skal bzang dang / /mthu dang 'byor pa thos lhapa la/ /swa pu ta snga pi saṃ ghaspyo ti noṅkarghaṃ sa ha te dza naḥ/ /dza ṣpe dzwa ṣa ma ye pu tra 'gran las rang gi bu dag kyang / /khyad 'phags skye bos mi bzod do/ /sdang ba'i rang bzhin skye bo la kwa/ /gu ṇa mātstsha rya jo bya te/ /ātshwa di ta gu ṇa padmaḥpri yast+rikyā ru tse ra pi/ /yon tan bsgribs pas 'tsho bya bu/ /yon tan bsgribs pa'i padma ni/ /tsha zer can gyi yid du 'ong / /udhe ta ka su na dri 6ཿpra ṇa ta ka su na pri yaḥ/ /dru oṃ pā ta ya tistabye na 'phyar ba su yis ①sdang bya min/ /rab 'dud su yis ④snying sdug min/ /ljon pa rengs pa rlung gis skyelakhru//dzee rakṣa ti ma ru taḥ/ /sa tsā bhi ga pyo bhū bā la tsū ya di swa ya me 6 ti/ /rab tu dud pa srung bar byed/ /mngon par 'gro 'os sa skyong de/ /gal te khyod can rang nyid 'ongs/ /ta de ṣa dasgo mo ha ste gre ya se na bha bi 6 ti/ /tasmra di taḥswa yo ga tā de la khyod dregs rjormongs pa 'di/ /dge legs beed du mi 'gyur ro/ /de beed 'di nas rang song ste/ /pra ṇa bye pra ṇa ma pra bye/ /nakṣa tra rā si la dṛ shaṃ da tā hā ra mu pa ya dzwa/ /rgyu skar phung po dang mtshungs pa'i/ /do shal skyes su ⑦ /byin nas ni/ /phyag 'os gtso la phyag 'tshal byos/ /pi tu shu two ti ba tsa āoṃ sgo ṇa ko ṭīrma tī pa ti/ /pra ya yo nā ba mā ru hra drahūṃ zhes pa pha yi tshig thos nas/ /gro bzhin bye ba rin chen gyis/ /rnam par brgyan pa'i gru zhon te/ /sa yi ratna bi ju ṣi taḥ/ /sa rā dza dhwa ni mā sā rya pā khya dṛṭī tsa bhū pa ti/ /da bdag po lta ru song / /rgyal po'i pho brang song nas des/ /phrad cing mthong nas rgyal po la/ /phyag do hā ram̐ pra ṇamyu smi harṣa hā sa mi ba shri yaḥ/ /tai dṛṭī swa ya mā yā tai 'tshal do shal de la phul/ /dpal ni dga' nas dgod pa bzhin/ /mi bdag mdza' ba'i spyan gyis ni/ /dṛ pa tisdigha yā dṛ shā/ /he ma ro māṅka tsa ra rde bisma yā di tya bhā ṣa ta/ /rkang pa gser gyi ba spus mtshan/ /rang nyid 'ongs pa de mthong nas/ /ya mtshan las ni 'di skad smras/ /95—367

ba kṣi to/ /bā ri te ṣṭa tha bste 6 di bya ba ste dṛta ma ṭī/ /a pra 'gebs pa zlog①/ /de nas gos ni bzlog pa'i tshe/ /lha yi gos kyis sa gzhi g.yogs/ /bsod nams yahpho pa ka ra rjaḥsadza daḥpu rgya shā li dzā/ /ni bā rya di bya basthā bee ldan pa'i nyer mkho rnams/ /'bad pa med par phun sum tshogs/ /lha yi gos rnams bzlog nas ni/ /bhū mo te nādzre te pa de/ /bi tsa tsā khā tsa lā thra dī sa she la ba na sā ga rā/ /de yis sa la rkang bzhag tshe/ /ri nags rgya mtsho dang bcas pa/ /g.yo med sa gzhi rnam par g.yos/ /ta taḥs bhū mi pa ti nā sa ha pā mya dzi nā shra rma/ /bha ga badhe bi lo kyā de nas sa bdag dang 'grogs te/ /rgyal ba'i gnas su phyin pa des/ /bcom ldan 'das la rab gya bi da dhe pā da banda rna/ /u pa piṣṭa gya ta snga gre z-iṣṭa snga lo ka bltas shing / /de yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal byas/ /dga' dang zhi zhing dben ldan pa/ /mdun na gnas nā mṛ taiḥ/ /tsakre sha ma bi be ka gya bha ga bān bhi ṣe tsa rna/ /pa de ①la ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs pa yis④/ /bdud rtsis mngon par dbang bskur mdzad/ /ā sha yā nu sha yo ddhā tu pra kṛ tiñtsa bi tsārya saḥ/ /sa tya sandarsha nā yā khams dang bsam ⑤pa bag la nyal/ /rang bzhin dag kyang spyad nas de⑩/ /bden pa yang dag rtogs gya bi da dhe dhand+ra de sha rmā/ /saṭwā ya dṛṣṭi shi lophogya ta yā bo sha ti shriṅga bān/ /bya'i sbad/ /de la chos ni bstan pa ⑦mdzad/ /de yi 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri/ /rtse mo nyi shu ldan pa ni/ /dzñā na badzre ṇa nisgondaḥshri taḥpābhi pa da smṛ shaḥ/ /pra pra rje yi ta no ta su dzā tā ye shes rdo rje de yis bcom/ /rgyun du khyezhugs pa'i gnas la reg /de nas de yi lus la ni/ /rab ( 97 yī sa ha sā swa yo/ /bha ga bahaṃ pra ṇa myu tha bismi taḥpra ya yo dṛ paḥ/ /byung skyes tshe mi yi bdag /ya mtshan gyur pas bcom ldan la/ /phyag 'tshal 'phral la rang nyid song / /tī bra bra te pi sgo ṇa su ka dā tsitpa mā dzā ya ta / / bā sa nā she gro bzhin brtul zhugs drag ldan yang / /bag chags lhag pa'i ⑩'du byed las/ /nam zhig gnyen dang 95—369

ṣa saṃ sthā rāta bantu sgo ga su kha smṛ tiḥ/ /sa ta mā snu ya bha ga bān bi longs spyod kyis①/ /bde ba dran pa skyes par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'dzum dang bcas pa des/ /skyengs lakṣ-i pā ha sa smi taḥ/ /ko yi pa ri bi targaste pra ti saṃ lī na tse ta saḥ/ /pa de bos bka' stsal pa/ /sems ni kun tu yongs zhum ②pa/ /khrod kyis ⑦ yongs su rtog 'di ci bu/ /bi shlauṭwā tyanta kṛṭwā bā tadhri bha ba nyi bi swā rā/ /sa mā mā dhu rya mā yā ti dral ba'am shin tu drangs pa yi2/ /rgyud mang ⑥dbyangs dang bral ba yin/ /mnyam pa las ni sgra snyan ta smrata sa sum̐ sa mā shra yeta/ /i tyā de shāta bha ga ba taḥsaza sā mya mu 'gyur—/ /de beed mnyam pa bsten par bya/ /zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas/ /phyi nang ④gdung ba pa ga taḥ/ /sa pā pa bi ma la dzñā na pabyutta pa bi paspru taḥ/ /ta gya tā mabye rnam par spangs/ /thams cad zhi ba nye bar gyur/ /de yis skedri med ye shes thob/ /de yi rmad byung tsā sernyi bi lokya thra thu bisma yāḥ/ /sa prasgosgokṣa ba sabye bha ga brnye sa tsā grub pa de/ /mthong nas ya mtshan che ba yi/ /dge slong kun gyis bcom ldan la/ /dris shing des kyang bhya dhwa ta/ /sho ṇa gya thra yo tsā gre yaḥkadzre dzadmā nta rā rdzi tai/ /na khya bka' sprul pa/ /gro bzhin gyis ni dge ba'i las/ /skye ba gzhan la bsgrubs pa nyan⑨/ /gang phyir pu rgya nu bhā bā rmā bha barmyabyu ta sadza daḥ/ /bi ba bye bha ga bān bsod nams min pa yi/ /mthu ldan rmad byung phun tshogs min/ /sngon tshe yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /samyakshi budhaḥsu ga taḥpu rā/ /pu rīsbantu ma tī nā ma dza na tsā ri bcom ldan bde gshegs rnam par gzigs/ /gnyen ldan zhes 0 pa'i grong khyer du/ /ljongs ni rgyu zhing ka yā ya yo/ /ta tra bhakhye su kṛ ti bhirbhaghā yo ba ni madhri taḥ/ /bā gshegs par gyur/ /der ni legs byas gus pa yis/ /gzan ⑪la nye bar mgron du gnyer(ga / /nyin re ṇa pra tya haṃ ge haṃ ya yo te ྾ sa hā nu gaḥ/ /ta to da ri dra saṃ pāpta re res kyis de dag girsha5 / /khyim du rjes 'brang bcas pa gshegs/ /de nas dbang po'i zla zhes pa/ /95—370

bā re zwahma ṇa dā ra ka /ind+ra so mā bhi dhastsa kre yadzñā tadmo ga sgo dza ṣpe/ /sa pra bram ze'i bu ni dbul po yi/ /res la bab tshe 'bad pa yis/ /de la 'os pa'i bza' ba sbyar/ /de yi yasne na ma ha tā sgo rdzu bhatta sa bi tre tai/ /ātstsha rya bsterba su bye pra 'bad pa chen po yis/ /gus pas gtsang mar sbyar ba'i zas/ /gos kyis nor 'dzin g.yogs byas nas/ /hwaptasmi n+ya pe da yata/ /tasgo sa pra ṇi dhwa de na dzā taḥso yo ma hā dha naḥ/ /so baddhā rab tu btud de de la phul/ /longs spyod de yi smon lam kyis/ /gro bzhin bye ba lha lta bu/ /gser gyi spu 3 ro ma tsa ra ṇaḥsgo ṇa ko ṭī su ro sa maḥ/ /na bant+ra ra hi tā byu miḥsmṛṣṭha ṣpe na ka yi rkang pa can/ /nor can 37'dir ni de gyur to/ /gos dang bral ba'i sa gzhi la/ /'di yis nam dā tsa na/ /kasbastastso ra ṇa spakhye da ta e bā bha ba ta bhū baḥ/ /i ti su yang rig pa med/ /'di nyid phyir na de yis snyeni/ /rkang pas reg la sa g.yos gyur/ /zhes —pa bde ga ta ba tsaḥsu dhwa ba dā tai da shanam yu ṣa mi bombi ṣata swa bhā baṃ/ /gshegs gsung ni bdud rtsi ltar dkar ba/ /tshems kyi 'od bzhin rab tu gsal/ ba'i rang bzhin dag /pra ṇi hi ta dṛ da yaḥb re ni rpā ya sgri ra ku sha lā ya ba bhū ba bhekṣu saṃ dge slong tshogs kyi thugs ni rnam par mi g.yeng bas/ /mchog tu 'thungs nas dge ba brtan ḍasnyepa'i beed du ghaḥ—/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā pa dā na kalpa la tā dzee gyur—/ /zhes ⑥pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi rnge ṇa ko ṭī dzi shā ba dā na mabye birshaḥpalla baḥ// //'khri shing las gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa pyabargyad pa'o// //dodzdza n+ya duḥs ha bi shā la kha khā pa kā ri dzee pā sha ye bi kṛ ti raste mi bsrun ⑧skye bo ngan pa'i gnod pa bzod dka' chen po yis/ /bsam pa che rnams bsam pa rnam ma hā sha yā ram̐/ /byā lelba ṇa kṣi ti bye dā ku li to pi sentusna potpa par 'gyur ba nyid ma yin/ /sbrul gyis rab bskor sa 'dzin dag gis dkrugs par gyur mod kyang / /rgya 95—371

sadzdza z-i da yā da mṛ ta swa bhā baṃ/ /pu re pu ra rā dza kṛ he bha ga mtsho snying las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rab tu gtong hu ba min/ /sngon tshe grong khyer rgyal po'i khab/ /ka bān bee rku ka na ṣpe/ /ka landa ka ni bā sa khye bi dza hā ra ma no ha re/ /lan da ka'i gnas zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal ni yid 'phrog na/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rnam par bzhugs/ /ta tra bi tra si tā ṣpe ki sha tru nisbyi sha bāndha baḥ/ /a dzā tā sha tru nā ma der ni rgyal po dgra mang rnams/ /rnam par skrag byed ral gri'i gnyen/ /gzugs can snying po dag gi rjubhūta bimbi sā ra su to dṛ paḥ/ /shākya baṃ shaḥswa z-itta su de ba datta bhi tolhabha ba bu—/ /ma skyes dgra zhes bya bar gyur/ /lhas byin zhes pa shākya'i rigs/ /de yi snying gi ⑩grogs por ta / /gru dra mabye ṇa ya snga sīta sa bee tā la i boṅka ṭaḥ/ /sa ka dā tsita su gyur—/ /gang gis pya ngan pa'i sngags kyis de/ /ro langs bzhin du drag por gyur/ /de yis nam zhig khā sī rgo rahaḥpā ha ma tī pa ti/ /na rā dzan pha li tophorya pi ma mā pi twad sa yi bdag /mdun sar bde bar 'khod khyel smras/ /rgyal po bdag gis khyed bsten pa'i/ /'bras ni (sgyes mā shā yaḥ/ /mi byo pā tsa ra ra hi taḥsu kha niryant+ra tant+ra yoḥ/ /mi da dung grub pa med/ /bde bar yid gcugs grogs dag ni/ /phan tshun yid la re ba skong / /rdzun tho ma no ra tha tā ṇambi tra shaldaḥpra brta te/ /ya e ṣa shākya shra ma ṇaḥgyis 37rim gro bral ba la/ /grogs kyi sgra ni rab tu 'jug /gang 'di 'od ma'i nags tshal na/ /su kha be rku ba ṣpespru ta/ /tai ha tā pābee misgo mi tatpa dande ba ba na di tai/ /shākya'i dge sbyong bder gnas pa/ /de bsad lha yis phyag byas pa/ /de yi gnas ni thob par 'dod/ /kṣi ya te na ya yā sha trurlu bhya te na ya yā ya shaḥ/ /badzha te na ya yā mā naḥgang gis dgra bo mi choms dang / /67gang gis grags pa mi 'thob dang / /gang gis khengs pa mi 'phel kinta yā mi tra saspa daḥ/ /ma hā dha nā bhi dha ṣpe na ta ta so re ṇa ni ba—/ /grogs kyi phun tshogs de yis ci/ /nor can khye zhes pa'i grong khyer bas/ /de ni zas la ⑩mgron 95—372

madhri taḥ/ /sa bu ram̐ pā ta rā gaddhā dāmbhi kaḥs hā bhikṣu bhiḥ/ /rā dza mārga du gnyer/ /tshul 'chos can de dge slong dang / /lhan cig nang par grong khyer 'ongasahu7 / /rgyal po'i lam pra bi sha taḥs ta su byā la kuñdzaraḥ/ /uskṛ bye tā ma tta mu khaḥkro dhwasgo du rab zhugs pa/ /de la glang chen nor skyong ni/ /khro bas long bzhin ⑤ gtum pa de/ /mngon sum (1snadha na pā la kāḥ/ /i sgoste de ba daste na dṛ pa timbi tra batpa laḥ/ /rab tu gtang bar byos/ /lhas byin gyis ni de smras tshe/ /mi bdag grogs la mnyes gshin pas/ /budha pra bha baṃ sañtsirgyu no tsi ki— na da bādru khaḥ/ /de ba dabho pi ni rga sangs rgyas mthu ni bsams byas nas/ /gdong smad ci yang mi smra shegyur/ /rgyal po'i grogs kyis ngan tya rā dza sau hāddhā dund+ra daḥ/ /pra ha haste ma hā mā tram̐ hā re da tā gya to rgyags pa'i/ /lhas byen dag kyang phyir byung nas/ /glang po'i blon po chen po la/ /do shal rngan par byin ṣa rde/ /shra ma shāḥkrā ta ra gaddhā pu re bhikṣu sha tebye taḥ/ /bye rā nas smras/ /dge slong dge sbyong brgyas bskor nas/ /nang par grong khyer 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de ⑤ la rji yasta yā tasmi ga dza i tyā ha bhū pa tiḥ/ /de ba datta ba tsaḥkhru tā khyod kyis glang po che/ /gtang ⑥bar byos shig khyes bdag gsung / /lhas byen tshig thos gnyis 'thung gi/ /ta the kyu:dzwa pā dhi paḥ/ /gre bhā hi me ṣa mū khro ṇa me ka yā tā nu pā ti bdag pos de bzhin zhes pa smras/ /gang phyir lug dang rmongs pa'i phreng / /gcig song rjes su lhung ba mbi / /dzñā tā pi tā ma bhi pā yo saza dzñāḥpā ba tse ta sī/ /pā taḥs nyid—/ /thams cad mkhyen pas sdig can gyi/ /sems kyi cha bsam pa mkhyen mod kyang / /dge slong lnga mā ya yo saddhā bhe kṣu rde pañtsa bheḥsha taiḥ/ /a tha haste pa kotthaṣṭi kṛṣṭa pā brgya dag dang ni/ /thabs cig yang dag byon par gyur/ /de nas glang chen bdag po yis/ /gnad du sā da pā da baḥ/ /ta ma bhya dhwa ba dā bhedhaḥkro dhwarnyaḥku ra kuñdzaraḥ/ /bsnun bkye glang po che/ /drag po khang bzang rkang 'thung 'joms/ /khro bas long bas de mdun rgyugs⑨/ /95—373

a nā yattaḥpa ri tsa yā rda ku sha su gu ro ra pi/ /kha la bidmā ni ba dwo ྾ yongs su 'dris hūṃ las lcags kyu ni/ /phyi ba yis kyang / gyedabang mi 'gyur/ /mi bsrun 1rig byed ldan pa ma de na ma li dī kri taḥ/ /se bā bya sa na sakta nā ma sa kṛṅkaṇḍi bzhin—/ /sdang dang rgyags pas dri mar byas/ /lan cig ④min par rna bskyod pas/ /brten khyepa'i tsa pa lāta/ /pā shā pa hā ri byeṅgā rde z-i tyā nā mi ba dubee tiḥ/ /gdung ba la chags pa/ /bung ba rnams kyi srog 'phrog 6)byed/ /bdag po ngan pas g.yog gi bzhin/ /mandi ro pa dra bee ta smin dru ma dro hi sgo bhi dru te/ /bi dru te sa ha sā lo khang pa'i nyer 'tshes ⑦shing rnams ni/ /'joms pa de yis mngon par brgyugs/ /'jig rten 'phral la ke hā hā kā ro ma hā na bhūta/ / ta gyañtsata kaṇḍi tā khā ni la tu le bros pa'i tshe/ /hā hā zhes pa chen po byung / /de yi rna ba rab bskyod stabs kyis blangs pa'i rlung gi ④rab ta sa rata sānd+ra send+ra ra byu riḥsaṃ pūrte rā dza maṅge sgo ta tsa ki ta ba dhū rakta bsta zags li khri'i rgyun gyi tshogs/ /bud med 'jigs pa'i gos dmar lhung ba lta bur spyod pas rgyal po'i lam sa mā ṇiḥ/ /ujaṇḍistsoṇḍa puṇḍa bhra ma ṇa ba ra la sa ta sā dhwa pā yā se ni khengs gyur zhing /khya/ /rab gtum dbyug pa blangs ⑩'dra'i sna ni g.yab mo'i tshogs 'gyed phyogs kyi bud tā shā yo ṣi khro khā la kā bha bhra ma ra bha ra mi la byi bhra ma ཿ saṃ med 'jigs pa yis/ / gdung bar /—nyugyur pa'i lan bu'i 'od ltar bung ba'i tshogs gtibs rnam par bhra mopho bhūta/ /pū ra pra mā tha bya thi te dza ṣpe ko la ha la ku le/ /'phrul ba 7kun rmongs gyur/ /grong khyer bcom pas rab gdungs te/ /skye bo ku cos ⑫'khrugs pa'i tshe /ā ru ro ha ma hā ha bye de ba dattaḥpra matta dhīḥ/ /bha ga bsgra ha rde drabye rab stsos blo ldan lhas byin ni/ /ba gam che ldan steng du 'dzegs/ /de ni bcom ldan 'dzin pa la/ /sophosgo bad z-i sha muhphu kaḥ/ /und+ra la ṣpe na gu ṇi rmā matta ṅgaḥb ri tu mchog tu blta ni spyo'adod par gyur/ /yon tan can rnams rab bcom pas/ /gtum po dag ni yongs 95—374

6 ti/ /bi dru te 6 ga dza tā satta sarbe 6 bhi kṣa 6/ /ā nanda e ka su tshim/ /der ni glang pos rab skrag nas/ /dge slong thams cad bros pa'i tshe/ /dge slong kun dga' e bā bhūta bhikṣu rgyu ga ba tophornyi ke/ /ta tra palnga na nāḥpañtsa nirya gcig pu nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nye 'khor gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag las der/ /gdong yurbha ga ba taḥka rāta/ /ka rā la ke sa ra sa ṭā stunda khye shu tsi tā i ba/ /lnga ldan pa lnga 'thon te/ /'jigs su rung ba'i ral pa can/ /de yi sen mo'i sti'od tshogs bzhin/ /dripastaṅgandha mā sgyu ya daspyo pa smra ra bā ra rte/ /a bhuta khru ta sha kṛta rū dregs ①pa'i rjed byed zlog byed pa/ /de yi dri tshor ①gnyis 'thung ni/ /chu dang gci rdo9ba zag byed cing / /tra sa ha bee ba pa rādru khaḥ/ /dza be na bi dru tasta tra daṭī dadru dari 'phral la nyid du phyir phyogs gyur/ /so ldan dregs pas dbul ba nyid/ / thob cing lamagyogs par bros dra tsā/ /pāptaḥpra dīpta da ha nāḥs da darsha di sho da sha /sa pi lo pas der/ /phyogs bcu rnams ni sreg byed kyis/ /rab tu 'bar ba ⑥mthong bar gyur/ /de yis 'gro kya dzā latpa : dzwa la dzā lā ku lo dza gta/ /pā da padmarnyi kai shāstuḥb me 'bar zhing / /'bar ba'i dra bas dkrigs mthong nas/ /ston pa'i zhabs kyi padma'i drung / /shrī ta lo sa mu pā ya yo/ /saṃ ko tsā bhe ru tseḥs tsinta ma na saḥpra dhwasta bsil ba dag tu nye bar song / /sred pa sngon ༷zhum yid ni bsam gtan zubazhin kyi mdzes pa rab tu baghradku taidzhai tyā sanda bi tī na da na ma dhu pa pā dha ko lā ha laḥ/ /nyams gyur cing / /nyon mongs dro ba'i dbugs rgod de yi lag pa chags pas long ba dag gis ⑨ni/ /lo bhārnya su ma hā bya yotpa ba i ba kli shoṣṭha ni shā si na stu snga byu ta mang du mdzad pa rtsom bzhin bkren pa nyer gnas sbyin pas dman pa'i sbrang rtsi 'thungs⑫/ /ca co sgogs pa ri tā ba ni shra tha ga ter bhā rā ya mā ṇaḥka raḥ/ /tai pā da rū par song ⑪zhing yongs gdung dman par song ste khur ltar spyod par 'gyur⑫/ /ston pa thugs rje'i rgya mtsho 95—375

raḥ—/ /bi dza hā ra pa ro dzi bye haṃ sā dzā pañtsa sha taiḥ/ /pūttha pu bye nu bhā de—/ /ngang pa dag ni lnga brgya dang / /mtsho skyes can der rnam par rol/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthu be na tai rū pā ti sha yodzdza lo/ /da darsha karyā rgyuskṛ bye dza no bhya bya yis ni/ /khyad 'phags gzugs rab 'bar ba de/ /bya ba dor ba'i ①skye bo yisarngu/ /g.yo med mig la lo tsa naḥ/ /lta shu two bhū ba tista tra sbri tai tajarsha norgya kaḥ/ /ku sha gis mthong bar gyur/ /de ni der gnas sa bdag gis/ /thos nas de dag blta 'dod pas/ /rgya yis lān gra ha ṇi ta gya rya mṛ dza dzā la dzre bi naḥ/ /tasmin kṛ tī te na li dī lī 'tsho ba'i ①mkhas pa dag /de bzung slad du btang bar gyur/ /padma can gyi rol pa'i 'dzum/ /dkar khāsmi ta shi ta tī ṣi/ /sha tā ni pañtsa haṃ sā dzā tyakta tai pra ya yurdza bāta/ /ba'i 'od zer de bzung tshe/ /ngang pa lnga brgya dag gis ni/ /de btang mgyogs par rab tu song / /e kastu ta gya sau dza tyā da ba sgo pi su ba dha ba ta / / ta da rba gcig ni de la gzhung mebazang bas/ /bcings pa med kyang bcings pa bzhin/ /mdza' ba'i zhags ⑤ bya thi tasta sbo pre ma pā sha ba shī kṛ ta/ / ta tasteḥpā pi tai rā dza pas dbang byas nas/ /de yi don du gdung zhing gnas/ /de nas rgyal pos ngang pa yi/ /rgyal po de haṃ saṃ bi lo kya tai/ /sne ha padhe dri tī yañtsa bismi tāstu ba lo tsa yata/ /yis bzung ba dang / /gnyis pa mdza' bas bcings pa yang / /mthong nas ya mtshan de dag btang / /haṃ saḥpūṇḍi mu khaḥsophoha mā nandasta gya tsā nu gaḥ/ /ga tāsta da rya tsa tyaghā ngang pa gang ba'i bzhin de bdag⑥/ /de yi rjes 'brang kun dga' bo/ /des na deng ④yang bdag rmā haṃ sā e ba rnyi kṣa baḥ/ /pūza smin na bha baṭwā le bā rā ṇa sde ma ṭī btang nas/ /song ba'i dge slong ngang pa nyid/ /gang gi ①grags pa pha rol gyis/ /yid kyi glegs bu la pa tiḥ/ /oṣṭa nā ma ma naḥbarbhe li khi tai yadma shaḥb riḥ/ /sa ha sra yo dhasta bris pa/ / wā rā ṇa sīr ⑨sngon dus na/ /sa bdag a ṭa zhes pa byung / /stong dang g.yul 'gyed lho 95—379

su bhū dakṣi rja kyo ni ra tya yaḥ/ /ka ra daṇḍi ti bi spyo taḥsaṃ grwa mā gre sa phyogs pa/ /g.yul gyi dus su sngon 'gro zhing / /lag pa'i mtshon zhes grags pa ni/ /de yi bslu med raḥpri yaḥ/ /ka dā tsita gho ra sa ma re pañtsa mā tya sha tā ni tai/ /dṛ paṃ grogs por gyur/ /nam zhig 'jigs rung g.yul zhugs tshe/ /blon po lnga brgya dag gis ni/ /mi bdag tyaghā ya yuddhā tya ka ra daṇḍi tu nā tya dzata/ /a ha me ba sa byu pā la de btang 'jigs nas song / /lag pa'i mtshon gyis gtang ①ma gyur/ /sa skyong de ni nga nyid de/ /blon sa tsi ba te tsi bhikṣa baḥ/ /ka ra daṇḍi sa e ba ya mā nasdo na dza hā ti rmā/ /po de dag dge slong rnams/ /lag pa'i mtshon de kun dga' bo/ /'di nyid nga ni gtang ⑤ma gyur/ /dzadmānta ri pi sau ho haṃ kyu pa ni pa ti taḥpu rā/ /u pe sti taḥkṣa shābye hyeḥsngon gyi skye ba gzhan la yang / /bdag ni seng ge khron par lhung / /wa skyes g.yog gis skad cig la①/ /shri gā lerlerya dzhakṣa baḥ/ /e ke na tsa nā khiḥkhā tai dīrghaṃ kṛ tāsmi mo kṣe spangs pa gang de ④dge slong rnams/ /wa skyes gcig gi sder mo yis/ /ring du brkos ⑤ nas bdag thar taḥ—/ /dzambu ke na sa e bā ya mā nasdophorya ma mā nu gaḥ/ /kyu ṭa pā sha ni bzlu byas—/ /de nyid kun dga' bo 'di ste/ /da lta bdag gi rjes 'brang gyur/ /sngon tshe ri dwags khyu yi gya mṛ ga yu tha pa teḥ pu rā/ /lubha kā ga ma na tra bādzdzaglustad bdag /rgya yi zhags pas bcings par gyur/ /de yi rjes 'brang ri dwags rnams/ /sred ldan 'ongs nu gā mṛ gāḥ/ /a nu raspyo na ta tyā dza tai mṛ gī sā khru lo tsa nā/ /dī ti pas khyeskrag nas bros/ /mig chu ldan pa'i ri dwags mo/ /rjes su chags pas ma btang ste/ /mdza' shri kha la yā ba ddhā yā tā ni gyanda tā mi ba/ /a tha lubha ga ma yā tai ba'i lcags sgog gis bcings pas/ /g.yo ba med par gyur pa bzhin/ /de nas sred ldan 'ongs gyur zhing tso)//dṛṣṭa mṛ ga ba byedma tai/ /sā pa data ma ma bā ṇi na pra tha ma ha ra ṭī bi ri dwags gsod par brtson mthong nas/ /de yis spras pa thog mar ni/ /mda' yis bdag gi khya'atsho ba 95—380

tai—/ /i ti spaṣṭa gi rā ta sngaḥsne te na tsa pa bi smiḥ/ /mu mo tsa luddhā kaḥphrogs—/ /zhes ①pa de yi gsal ba yi/ /tshig dang mdza' bas mtshar skyes pa/ /rngon pa de ni byams pa pyo sgyu ha ri khaṃ ha ri bhā sa khaṃ/ /mṛ ga yu tha ba ti so haṃ mā nandaḥsā ku ram̐ yis—/ /ri dwags ri dwags mor bcas btang / /ri dwags khyu yi bdag de nga / /ri dwags mo de kun gi kā/ /i hye ṣa spru nyi sadzarpāḥsthādṛtta ma nu ba rta te/ /khru two ti dga' bo/ /de ltar mdza' ba'i 'byel pa 'di/ /sngon gyi spyod pas rjes su zhugs/ /zhes 5pa bde bā kyi su ga ta gya sabye ladzdza ni lbo bhā i ba bhikṣa pa ste/ /ā nanda mā gshegs gsung thos dge slong ni/ /de dag thams cad ngo tshas zhum pa bzhin/ /'dod pas brlan pas na nda mu khā ra bi oṃ pra bhā snyi rā oṃ da dṛ shuḥ smṛ hā dre ཿ / /i ti kun dga' dang bcas par/ / 'od kyis mngon 1dga' kun dga'i bzhin pad bltas/ /zhes pa dge kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī dha na pā lnga ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las nor skyong ba dā rna u na birshaḥpabee waḥ// //gi ④rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa 'udagu pa'o// //dza ya ti sa satwa bi she ṣaḥsatwa ba hūṃ sattha satwa su kha he tuḥ/ /gang zhig snying stobs ldan pa'i snying stobs kyispyo/ /khyad par sems can thams cad klu bde ba'i rgyu/ /de ha da la ṣpe pi sha ma ya nyi ko pāsgo shārnyi myu:ryaḥ/ / dhambi pa de lus ni zhig kyang khro ba'i me rnams dag /mchog tu zhi bar 'gyur de rgyal gyur cig /chos bstan pa la she bha ga bān kauṇḍi n+ya sgyu gra barbhe naḥ/ /bhi kkoḥka thā pra saṃ ge na thrasgo bhekyu ba mngon (kye'adug pa/ /dge slong kauṇḍi n+ya yi/ /gtam gyi zhar la dge slong gis/ /dris shing bcom ldan bhe ra bya dhwad/ /brahma datta gya ta na yo bā rā ṇa sri ma tī pa teḥ/ /kā shi punda gyis bka' stsal/ / wā rā ṇa sī ⑨dag tu ni/ /sa bdag tshangs pas byin gyi bu/ /kā shi mdzes pa zhes 95—381

ra rja ma tsa kā la bhu: ba bhū ba tuḥ/ /yo ba rā bye bha be kārtaḥku mā ra kā shi punda pa dang / /dus kyi sa zhes bya ba byung / /rgyal tshab dbang ni bskur 'os pa/ /gzhon nu kā shi mdzes pa raḥ —/ /dhasthā dhand+ra ma yo rā rdzu bi tsārya tsinta yañtsi re/ /kṣa ṇa kṣa yis—/ /rgyal srid chos dang chos min gyi/ /rang bzhin yun ring dpyad nas bsams/ /lang tsho skad yi ṇi tā ru bye dzre bi ti bī tsi tsañtsa le/ /rā dzre swa sna bi bā he rmin mo ha rū cig 'jig pa dang / /srog ni chu rlabs g.yo ba'i tshe/ /rgyal srid rmi lam bag ma len/ /rmongs pa'i rtsa le na me ma tiḥ/ /rā ga pra lā pa ba hu le mā yā mo ha ma he mu huḥ/ /'dir bdag blo med/ /chags pa'i cho nge rab mang zhing / /yang yang sgyu dang rmongs rang bzhin/ /bee shya ru da ta niḥsā re saṃ sā re nāsnyi sa tya tā/ /pra bra dzā mya na ghāstasmra 'khor ba snying po med pa la/ /'phyon ma ngu zhing ① bden pa med/ /de slad khyim nas khyim med par/ /dā gā rā da nā gā ri ke/ /nisto sha bṛsti saṃ saghra bhiḥrā ga ki bi bhu bdag ni sdig med rab tu 'byung / /ral gris gcod ⑤la reg gyur pa'i①/ /rnam par 'byor la chags ti bheḥ/ /rā dza su nu bi tsikhye ti bi bee ka bi ma lā sha yaḥ/ /u bātsā pas ci/ /de ltar rnam bsams rgyal po'i bu/ /dri med dben pa'i bsam ④pa can/ /nags su 'gro bye tya byu pā la ma ra ju ga ma nokhru kaḥ/ /ma ma sasto ga brgo yi rā bar 'dod pa yi⑤/ /sa skyong la ni mngon phyogs smras/ /rgyal po bdag la longs spyod rjokyis/ /tshogs dzarje bo pa yu bye ta/ /yo ba rā dzñā bhi ṣe karta sa ma rasto ni bārya 'di ⑦nye bar mkho khyab med/ /rgyal tshab dbang ni bskur 'os pa'i/ /kun tu rtsom pa'i zlog ⑫par tsā —/ /ko sāghi ta beeḥsu ta rā me tā stu ta ma me ma tā ཿ/ /ba mdzod—/ /yab lags gsod 'ching 'jigs dang rdung ⑩/ /skyed byed rgyal po'i phun sum tshogs/ /khro dha brnya bha yā yā sa dza na byo rā dza sadza daḥ/ /byāptaḥkru ra ta rā tsā ridzwa ba'i me yis rab gdungs pa⑪/ /'di dag bdag ni yongs mi 'dod/ /dur khrod me ⑫yi rtse mo bzhin/ /95—382

li taḥsābee ba shi yaḥ/ /kuzarnyi ta gya nobye shaṃ thra shā nāghi shi khā i ba/ /shin tu drag po'i spyod pas khyab/ /rab tu 'bar ba ①sa bdag dpal/ /su yi chags bral skyed mi byed/ /tsha tra saṃ tsā di tā lo kārtswa ma rā ni la lo li tāḥ/ /pa tarnyi pā ta ka shwa bye gdugs kyi snang ba yang dag bsgribs/ /rnga yab dag gi rlung gis bskyod/ /rgyags pas myos pa sa yi ma daspyo bāḥkṣi tī shwa raḥ/ /mṛ du sgo tsā shu kā sgyu sa su ku mā re dbang / /sdig pa dag gi g.yang la lhung ④/ /'jam pa'i longs spyod gos goms pa/ /shin tu gzhon ma tī bhu rdzu/ /kā ye pa tarnyi paryadhe kle shāḥku li sha dā ru rgyaḥ/ / tsiddhā pa sa bdag gi①/ /lus la mjug rjotu nyon mongs kyikhye/ /rdo rje mi bzad 'bab par gyur/ /rgyun du ⑥santa ta santa pa tī bra dṛ: pra lā pi dzā/ /rā bye dzwa ra dzu ṣā bee ྾ bsam pa'i gdung ba dang / /sred pa drag po'i cho nge can/ /rgyal srid rim bsten 'di rnams kyi/ /mo ha musko ni brta te/ /baspyo rde ratna dīṭwā āoṃ dī dzi hā āoṃ pa de rmongs shing brgyal dzeeb mi zlogs so/ /gnas dang gnas su lce gnyis pa/ /'khrog ④cing rin chen sgron pa de/ /tshi tra saṃ dadhi rmā rādhī byā pā raḥpa ra mā ra rde/ /dṛdzñā dṛ ba sha ma can/ /skyon khungs la blta ⑨rgyal po yi⑪ / /bya ba gzhan dag gsod pa yin/ /mi bdag brgya lhag to sbyiṣṭi ma n+ya te mā ma na n+ya tsā/ / i tī ba shrīḥ kṣi tī shā dzñā dregs ldan ma/ /bdag la ⑪gzhan du mi 'gror sems/ / zhes bzhin sa dbang /⑫ dag gi dpal/ /do hā ra tsā ma ra hā pi byā/ /byañdzi ta bya dza nodzñā sā lasmrirmughā khru santa shal rnga yab dag gis dgod⑫/ /'das pa'i sa bdag dran pa las/ /rgyal po'i dpal ni rmongs pas tiḥ—/ /rādhī mo hā j-i tā tī ta byu pa ti sma ra ṇa di pa/ /tasmradhra bsgribs—/ /rlung yab kyis gsal shugs ring ⑩dang / /mu tig mchi ma'i rgyun ldan bzhin/ /de beed dzā mi pra pra bye bi baspru ta dza nasbi nyiḥ/ /sadho ṣa shrī ta lasgo yo rab tu byung ba yis/ /skye bo'i ⑫lugs ni rnam spangs nas/ /chog shes bsel ba'i grib ma can/ /95—383

saddhā pa sha ma āoṃ ba āoṃ/ /a bi shānta mya saṃ sā rā pa tha pand+ra gya yongs gdungs khyesna zhi ba'i nags su 'gro/ /rtag tu gnod pa'i lus 'di yang / /ngal gso med pa ①duza haḥ/ /kā yo gya yo sa da pā yaḥki pu naḥthra thi bī bha raḥ/ /i ti pu tra 'khor ba yi/ /lam gyi 'gron pos bskur dka' na①/ /sa yi khur lta slar yang ci/ /zhes pa mchog ba tsaḥshu tā byu pa tidṛ sha ma pri yo/ /pra pra bye shapta tsa ki taḥsobye gasta ma tu mi snyan pa/ /bu yi tshig thos sa yi bdag /rab tu 'byung ba'i sgra yis 'jigs/ /mya ngan ldan pas bhā ṣa ta/ /a su baṃ sha gya ma hā taḥsā spra bye gya tsa bṛdha ye/ /ā shā de la smras/ /chen por gyur pa'i rigs 'di dang / /yang dag rgyal srid 'phel ba'i slad/ /rgan po ni badha bṛsnye na twa yi pu tra ma yā pa ram̐/ /batpa saṃ kalpa bhaṅge me na bdag gis bu khyod la/ /re ba mchog tu rnam par bcings/ /mnyes gshin ④bdag gis dubartag pa ni//kā le kartu ma rta si/ /i danta ba nasgo yo yo ba āoṃ na ba no tsi tai/ /dus min nyams par bya mi 'osa'u/ /nags su khyod kyi lang tsho 'di/ /gsar du mdzes pa ④'os ma yin/ /sadmarja sgyu sa yughā rmā shaghā nā sī dhu darsha ṣpe/ /dzi tedzre yā rde saza tra dṛ dam pa'i sngags kyi du goms par ldan/ /legs pa'i lta ba la chags pa/ /dbang po thul ba'i mi bdag ni//pā nā ma ba rna ta paḥ/ /swa pa de pi sa ro dza gya niḥsaṅga sa li la sbi teḥ/ /kun tu nags med dka' thub yin/ /rang gnas yin yang mtsho skyes ni/ /gos pa med par chu la gnas/ /dṛṭwā ba de su sho ka gya la la nā tsa rā ṇḍa ha tiḥ/ /swa ge ha su la byesgo nags nang yin yang mya ngan med/ /bud med rkang pas bsnun pa mthong / /rang khyim rnyed sba'i ⑨longs geryā badṛṣṭi bi sru tsi kā/ /tā ba de te pa ri tyakshi shakyarnye bi ṣa spyod kyis/ /ji srid mig ni rmus chung lngo)ba/ /de srid yul ni 'di dag rnams/ /skad cig yongs su yāḥkṣa khaṃ/ /su kha mantaḥpa ri tya bye swa dza na kṛ ha ni rga taḥ/ /a bhyasta gtang bar nus/ /rang gi ⑫skye bo nang gi ni/ /bde ba yongs btang khyim las 'thon/ /nyams stsong 95—384

sgo ga bi ra ha kle shaṃ na sa ha te dza naḥ/ /shu ya te smarya te dhadzre kri ya te longs spyod bral ba yis①/ /nyon mongs skye bos mi bzod do/ /khyim du chos ni bde ba yis/ /nyan dang tsa su khāta gre nyi/ /ba ṣpe shu byurnyishuṅgā rde shra ba ṇa sma ra ṇa kri yāḥ/ /kṣa dran dang sgrub par byed/ /nags su skam po rnams kyis srini/ /nyan dang dran dang bya ba bskam(de// /rtswa rata kṣa ta dza pā da gya darbha sandarbha shu tsi bheḥ/ /ta taḥkiḥduḥkha ma pā yi ④tshogs kyi khab rtse yis/ /rkang par rma khyeskyes zag byed pa/ /de las 'jig rten pha rol du(stesna/ /ram̐ pa ra lo ke bha bi 6 ti/ /bhuñdzu dzā dza na sbo kṣurnye yāta:rmāsbri sha ṣa hūṃ/ /sdug bsngal gzhan pa ci zhig 'byung / /skye bo za ba rnams la ltachu)/ /pags pa rus pa'i lhag mar gyur/ /pa ra datrī sa dāshārnyi pre tā i pa ta pa sri naḥ/ /ba ṣpe ni ba sa āoṃ pu tra dzā rtag tu gzhan gyis byin pa za/ /dka' thub can rnams yi dwags bzhin/ /bu kwa snyinags na gnas pa ni/ /shu pā ba ra rṇa sa oṃ/ /pā la dzwa brahma tsarya gya ma ka ra ka ra sho ṣa rde/ /rdul gyi ⑨gos dang mtshungs pa ste/ /tshangs par spyod pa skyong ba ni/ /chu srin 'byung gnas skems pa yin/ /dā pāghi dhū ma bi ka ṭa bru ku ṭi myu khe 6 go nā sa bā sa gha na ghu ka gu hā nags sreg ⑪ me yi du ba rab rgyas khro gnyer ldan pa'i bzhin/ /pha wang gnas dang 'ug pa'i phug ni stug kṛ te bhu/ /sau hā ha ta dī ra da lo hi ta lo hi te 6 tya ghā kṛ por gyur pa'i khyim/ /seng ges bsad pa'i so gnyis khrag gis dmar pos byas gyur pa'i/ /nags su haṃ bha ba ti ka su dṛ ti rba ṣpe 6/ / kā mbi saṃ ya ma mi sbyi te khyim btang nas ni su zhig dga' ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dod ldan dag ni dul ba 'dod cing dul ba sma ra ti tsa shā mā ra teḥsaṃ ya mbi trobeeste bra ta ra bra te 6 ra te bhakshi kṣu dhwa dang ldan sngo bsangs rtse dga' dran/ /tshim pa shin tu drag po'i brtul zhugs la dga' bkres par gyur pa tsā kṣa ti/ /e kā tī dza na mbi ha te dza na ba nobye gī ba āoṃ bāñtsa ti zas dag 'dod/ /gcig pu dag ni skye bo'i tshogs 'dod skye bo'i tshogs kyi yid 'byung tunyunags tshal 95—385

tya lnga nī ṣa ṇa ta tpa raḥ pu na ra pi pā bee ba ma ni dza nāḥ / /'dod—/ /de ni mchog tu 'tshol ①ba yongs su btang nas ④beer yang skye bo ①smad par gyur pa buthob/ /na rmā pu tā pa ri tya bye ga ha rna gantu marta si/ /bha bantu ta ba sha tru rde bdag ni yongs su bor nas bu/ /nags su 'gro bar mi 'os so/ /khyod ni nags na gnas pa dag /ba na sa ma no ra thaḥ/ /byakta mosti ka hā se n+yaḥka ra bā la la tā i ba/ /dgra rnams yid la re ba yin/ /mu tig gsal bar dgod rjobyed pa/ /rgyal po'i phun tshogs nga rgyal can//tyaghā na pu na rā yarnyi mā ni byo dṛ pa saspa daḥ/ /i kyusto gya sa kṛta pi tā btang nas ⑥beer yang mi 'ong ste/ /ral gri dag gis 'khri shing bzhin/ /pha yis lan mang de brngod kyang //nibya yanda tsa tsā la saḥ/ /badzra ratna shi khā kalpaḥsaṃ kaspo hi ma hātpa dzā/ /de ni nges pa las ma ④g.yos/ /bdag nyid chen po'i brtan pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen ⑧rtse mo mtshungs/ /dza na nī bhi ra mā hye: bantu po ra ma hatta moḥ/ /sa pābee to gya bhūdmo mbi ma dang blon po rnams dang ni/ /gnyen dang grong pa che rnams kyis/ /gsol ba btab kyang nyin gsum de/ /ni rā hā ro di na tra yo/ /rā dza sgo gī ta pa sī bā dzre ba te ṣani dzatstsha yā/ /zas dang smra ba med par gyur/ /rgyal por spyod dam dka' thub can/ /'di ni rang gi 'dun pas 'tsho /kā mā nu baṭī lo ko ya mi sgo tsuḥs tsi bā dṛ baṃ/ /sa ka thañtsi da nu dzñā taḥ'ajig rten 'di ni 'dod rjes 'jug /ces pa blon pos rgyal la smras/ /mchi ma dang bcas sa skyong gis/ /sā khru ṣpe tre ṇa bhū bhu dzā/ /ya yo po ra dza nā kranda mo bee mu ni ta po ba ji zhig ltar stes ⑨gnang nas desalku/ /mi smra grong khyer ba rnams ngu / /thub pa'i dka' thub nags su rgo—/ /bee rā gya pa ri pā ke na ta tra mi tri pa bee tra tsā/ /bha dze sa song / /chags bral yongs su byun pa yis/ /der ni sems can thams cad la/ /byams pas ⑪dag sadzee sa two 6 bi bee ka da yi hūṃ da yī/ /ba bhū bu stata pra bhā be na ta pra sadzee byas brtse ba dag /dben pa'i grogs su de yis bsten/ /de yi mthu yis de dag tu/ /nags na gnas 95—386

ba no ka sī/ /dzā ti bai rā nā la tya gshī ta khāshyitta bṛtta yaḥ/ /taste pa thams cad kyis①/ /rang bzhin khon gyi me spangs nas/ /sems kyi spyod tshul baṅgal bar gyur/ /ri pā ṇi ba dhwa pra sa kta ha ri bhā thra ṣpe ཿ pu li dzee ཿ pa re sau tai ddhā dwags tshogs la rab chags rngon pa rnams kyi ④srog chags gsod pa rab btang zhing / /seng ges glang ra ṇa dā ra ṇa blu pa ra me sadrwaṅga sadhī kṛ te/ /mā yu dzā ba ra chen 'joms pa dang bral yan lag kun gyis 'grogs par gyur pa la/ /der ni rngon ①pa'i bud med mu ṇirda ri dra dza gha nā mughra ka lā podzhai tāsta trotshwa sa bee rā ga shu 6 a da dha tig tshogs rnams spangs pa'i rked duskabs rma bya yi/ /gos kyis dbul zhing shugs rings dang ldan chags ra tā ཿ ki rā tā ṅga nāḥ / / kṣa me tya ghā bhi ra sa āoṃ sattha byu ta bral mchu ni rab tu bskams ⑦par gyur/ /chu gter ske burags can sa btang / /'byung kṣa ma shi taḥ/ /sophobha ba ta kṣurnyi bā dī ti bi khru ta kā shi punda raḥ/ /po kun la bzod pa bsten⑦/ /bzod pa smra ba zhes par ni/ /kā shi'i mdzes pa de grags gyur/ /a tānta re ma tī harghaṃ brahma daste di baṃ ga te/ /ubye ga i ba khyu tā skabs der sa gzhi mgu ba yi/ /tshangs pas dhibyin ni mtho ris song ⑨/ /'byung po rnams kyi mya ngan ram̐ byu pā laḥkā li bhū ra byuta/ /a thā da bhra bhra marjeṅga snru bhaṅga ma mi bzhin—/ /dus kyi sa ni sa skyong gyur/ /de nas rab mang ⑪ bung ba'i tshogs/ /g.yo ba'i smin 'khyog ⑩nā na naḥ/ /mu ni saṃ ya ma bi dī ṣe ba santaḥbra bye dṛ byu ta/ /ma da bzhin ras log /thub pa'i dul ba la sdang ba'i/ /dpyid ni yang dag byung bar gyur/ /ri dwags nodmā da bhū ta gya thrasgruta gya mṛ gi dṛ shi/ /mā na bi bye sa dru ta gya tsū ta mig can khengs pa dag /nyams pa'i pho nya tsū ⑫ta ni/ /rab tu rgyas dag ⑫chags pa yis/ /stsos pa'i su ru ru tse ru tsiḥ/ /raghra sho ka su parshasba la tā ling gan shaṃ ki taḥ/ /rgyu yi ⑫'od kyis mjos/ /mya ngan med pa dmar po la/ /logs gnas 'khri shing gis 'khyud dogs/ /95—387

nābyetta dadzee ṇa mādzdza rna/ /ta tre ba ni: lasta sbra stabye tā li khi ta i ba/ /de mthong rgyal po'i btsun mo'i tshogs/ /de dag ri mor bris pa bzhin/ /de nyid du ni g.yo med gnas/ /pra burnyophotha dṛ paḥkṣi pre nā pa shyadrwa yi taḥpu raḥ/ /da darsha ba na ma nī 6 de nas mi bdag myur sad pas/ /mdun du btsun mo mthong ma gyur/ /nags su bltas pas thub pa la/ /ba ri ba ryā sbi tā mu kau/ /bhu dzee ga sta bi lo bye ba shwa sambi dhya yongs su bskor nas gnas pa mthong / /de mthong nyid kyi hukyelag 'gro ni/ /dbugs rgod ⑤phrag dog bi ṣā ku laḥ/ /bee sa sardza ba tso rū pe hā la ha la mi boṅka ṭi/ /kaste mu dug gis 'khrugs/ /ha la ha la bzhin du ni/ /rab grags ①tshig gi tshul gyes spros/ /thub pa'i mtshan ni byañdza na yā tsi tra kṛ tri ma mā tra yā/ /muṭwā se mukta dṛ da yā nu mar bcos pa yi/ /chas kyis mtshar ba khyod 'dra su/ /blon ④po rnams kyi snying 'phrog ⑤khyod/ /nges rna nā ri pra tā ra kaḥ / /pa ra ste ha ra ṇi dhya dzwa dza pastaju sna par bud med rnams la 'bridaspyo/ /gzhan byi bud med 'phrog bstan nam⑦ / /de yi bgegs zlog ④ba ra ṇi/ /dhūtwo dzwa pa ra mo pā yaḥpa re lā shwa sa na ta paḥ/ /mu kha bzlas pa dang / /drang po'i yid rton dka' thub ni/ /g.yo sgyu du/can gyi thabs mchog yin/ /kha dngar ⑩mā dhurya dhūrta su kṛtta rbhalka li nasta ba/ /a ho nu mo ha dza na byā ba ṣpe sgyu ldan shing shun can/ /khyod kyi pags pa nags kyi ni/ /dug gi ljon pa bcad pa bzhin/ /kye ma bi ṣa ta ro ri ba/ /mu ni kaspo sa mā kalpa: ri tai pu na rī dṛ shaṃ/ /rmongs pa skyed ⑪pa yin/ /thub par brtag hu9pa lta bu'i chas/ /spyod ⑫pa slar yang 'di 'dra ⑫ba/ /da mbha sa sgyu bi ta sbra bee sbyi ka sta twa mā nta ram̐ / / i kyu ste bhū bhu nang gi de nyid tshul 'chos hustekyis/ /bsgrubs ⑫pa'ang su zhig dag gis rig⑩ /sa bdag khro bas 'di dzā kro dhwa da kro dha ma dhu rāsha yaḥ/ /nirngi kā re ṇa ma na pā kṣurnyi bā dī dza brjod tshe/ /khro med phan pa'i bsam pa can/ /bzod pa smra bas rnam 'gyur dang / /bral ba'i yid kyis 95—389

kau—/ /pu dī pra yā te ra dza pā sho ka sthā ṣpe ba bhū ra juta/ /ta ta stadruḥkha ku pi par—/ /grong khyer song tshe rdul gyis tsho)sa/ /mya ngan byed bzhin dri mar gyur/ /de nas de yi bzod pa'i tā rāzlo taṣṭharnyi de ba tā/ /tsa kre na ga: dubhikṣa ma ra kā dṛṣṭi bi bee lha—/ /de sdug bsngal bas rgyal la khros/ /grong khyer du ni mu ge dang / /yams dang char med nyer 'tshe baṃ—/ /ṣpe mitta ko bhyo mi dzñā ya rā dzā mu ni ba rā bha bta/ /de ba tā ko pa dzee do byas—/ /rgyal pos thub la gnod byas las/ /lha rnams khros te bskyed pa'i skyon/ /mtshan ma mkhan las ṣe tai pra sā da yi ḍū ya yo/ /ni pa tya pā da yosta gya kṣa ma swe tya shes nas ni/ /de la dad par byed du song / /de yi zhabs gnyis la btud nas/ /bzod pa mdzod bhi dhwa ya saḥ/ /pastsatta pa bi ṣā de na nibye ta na i ba bha bta/ /ta ma ces brjod nas de/ /phyi nas 'gyod pa'i mya ngan gyis/ /sems dang bral ba bzhin du gyur/ /bzod pa bra bīta kṣurnyi bā dī rā dzan marlund+ra mephokhyo pi/ /kand+ra re kha pa ritstsha dā dī smra bas der smras pa/ /bdag la khro ba chung ngu'ang med/ /las kyi ri mos yongs bcad pas/ /rgyal po dṛ shi bha bi ta bya tā/ /sabye ṇi mbi ga ṇa ya ti swatstshanda bha bi ta bya tā/ /na bye: 'di 'dra stsong bya nyid / /thams cad za ⑤byed rang dbang du/ /nges par stsong bya rtsi ba ni/ /brtan min na gu rṇa nārja na ta po nā pi go ra baṃ/ /anda dzre ta pra pa ba bi dza pa radza ra yon tan min don min/ /dka' thub ma yin rje sa min/ /skye ba'i blu gzhi la rtsa ba'i stobs che ldan pa ṇi bhinda ni kā la ba ri pā ka bi tsi tri tā ni/ / dzadma stha le bi rang gi lus/ /gsar ④skyes dag gi 'bras bu dus kyis yongs su smin pa ni/ /rnam par bkra zhing tha pu la mū la ba la gya dzabye byeste pa lā ni ni dza kand+ra ma hi ru ha gya/ /twa dad gyur pa brgyud mar skyes ⑤ pa yi/ /sa ⑥bon nang na gnas pa skye bo rnams kyis ⑦ spyod pa yin/ /de yi tasmanda me kashyita bi kā roste ma hi pa te/ /sa hye nā ṣpe na me pa shya slad sa bdag khyod la bdag /rnam 'gyur ci yang yod ma yin/ /bden pa 'di yis bdag gi khrag /95—391
