ba ma na sā myu yan rā dza jo dzā dṛ bo bya gāta/ /kṣurnyi bā dī sa e bā haṃ kauṇḍi n+yaḥganas su mi bdag kyang / /de nyid yid ①la sems shing song / /bzod pa smra ba de nyid nga / /dus sa kā la bhu ra yo/ /ā sā rya sa myahūṃ bo bye murje to3 yi ma yā dhu nā/ /i nyi su kauṇḍi n+ya 'di/ /da lta yang dag rdzogs byang chub/ /thob nas bdag gis 'di bsgral to/ /zhes pa bde ga ta mu khā ra binda nirmata ma dhu ra ma dhu pra ti rma ba tsaḥpra sa.oṃ/ /gshegs zhal gye padma las 'khrungs pa/ /yid 'ong sbrang rtsi'i gzugs brnyan rab tu dang ba'i gsung / /bhra ma ra bha ra i bo di ta pra mo daḥki ma pi ba byu ba ni rpā ya bhekyu bung ba'i tshogs bzhin dge slong tshogs kyis rab 'thungs nas/ /rab tu dga' ba rgyas pa ci yang byung saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la bar gyur/ /zhes dāpa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag tā yī kā shi punda rā ba dā rna nā ma tri shaḥpabee waḥ// //bsam khyegyi 'khri shing las kā shi'i jemadzes pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu pa'o// //band+raḥko bi sa sa twa pā ra sa ra laḥsau dza n+ya pu rgya lji timbi byeḥko pi sems can snying po drang zhing legs spyad 7bsod nams gnas de su yang phyag byar 'os/ /chos lam sa dha nd+ra mārga ga ma ṣpe bi snaḥ kṛ ta snaḥ pa re/ / tsi tram̐ yastso ri tai bgrod pa'i gegs ⑥dang shin tu ngan par spyod de su yang smad par 'os/ /gang gi spyod pa bkra ba rnam bi tsārya su tsi ram̐ ro māñtsa tsastsortsi ta stu bye yā ti dza naḥs bātpa na ya nastadmadapyad yun ring spu long rgyas pas byugs gyur pa/ /de dag bsngags na skye bo mig chu ldan zhing mi smra nyid ṇḍi na spru ka tī/ /de ba datta pra seṅga na bhekyu bhesgo ga bān pu rā/ /du mtshungs par gyur④/ /dge slong rnams kyis (milhas byin gyi/ /zhar la mngon 6/dris bcom ldan gyis/ /thraṣṭaḥka thā ma ka tha yata pūdzee dṛttarnye saṃ shra yi/ /ma hend+ra se nā nā mā bhū sngon gyi ⑪ byung ba'i mtha' dag la/ /brten 6nyepa'i mtha' ni bka' stsal pa/ / bā rā ṇa sīr yortemi yi 95—393

ta bā rā ṇa sde na ra shwa raḥ/ /ya yuḥkṣi nyi shwa raḥsabye ya gya lasmyu dbang / /dbang po'i sde chen zhes pa byung / /gang gi dpal byus sa yi dbang / /thams cad skyengs pa bi lakṣa tai/ /tsand+ra pra bhā bha batta gya di bī tīrnyi ri ba thra yā/ /ya sgyuḥs tya pra bhā nyid du gyur/ /de yi lha mo grags pa bzhin/ /yid 'ong zla ba'i 'od ces gyur/ /gang gi bden pa rmobee na swa snaḥs tya twa mā ya yuḥ/ /ba byu ba sa ma ye tasmin mṛ ga yu tha pa mthu yis ni/ /rmi lam bden pa nyid du gyur/ /dus der nags su ri dwags kyi/ /khyu yi bdag po byung nyirba ṣpe/ /su baṇḍi pārsha i tyāpta nā ma he ma ma yatstsha biḥ/ /mbi la ratna gyur pa/ /gser gyi logs zhes bya ba'i ming / /thob cing gser gyi rang bzhin snang / /mu tig do shal da ra sthā ra myukta hā ra ni bha pra bhāḥ/ /ba bhūdṛ ṣṭa tstsha ṭā ya mya byu ṣa gsal ba'i khongs/ /rin chen mazing gis spras 'dra'i 'od/ /gang gi mig gi rdzi stim ni/ /nags kyi rde kā na na shri yaḥ/ /pra bā la ballī shriṅga su tsi tra ratna tsi ta twa tsaḥ/ /ta dpal gyi rgyan du mdzes/ /byu ru'i 'khri shing rwa co dang / /rin chen bkra ba'i pags pas zhurgyas/ /ngo sngabyarya su dzñā sgo dhī la ha rī ru ru tsi ru tsi/ /bo bye satwa ba ta ra su mtshar bdud rtsi'i sdechu gter gyi/ /rba ⑤rlabs de yi 'od zer mdzes/ /byang chub sems dpar zhugs ta su kā nta ma bhū tpa pu ཿ / / pū rde su kṛ ta tsi tra gya la kṣa rde gyur pa/ /de yi gzugs ni mdzes par gyur/ /gang phyir legs byas ri mo yi/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid hi su byu pa tā/ /dīrgha dṛṣṭi rba byu bā gya ba ya sro dṛbye bā ya gya/ /lubha gzugs bzang nyid/ /de yi grogs po bya rog ni/ /rgan po ⑥ring du mthong bar gyur⑦/ /rngon pa kā dzwa ṣa ṇa tā gye disbi lo ka na tatpa raḥ/ /to ka thā bhimbi thaḥpra tyā 'tshol 'u bas 'jigs pa yis/ /de ni mchog tu phyogs rnams lta6tre/ /de dag phan tshun dga' ba yi⑩/ /bi biste 6 bi dza hra tuḥ/ /pāklu byedzā ya te bā bhā ti rartswa ma pi mā gtam gyis dben par lho1 rnam par rtsen/ /dud 'gro la yang snga ma yi/ /bsod nams rnams kyis ⑫mi 95—394

nu ṣi/ /sa ka dā tsidzdza lā nī ṣi yu thā nā thaḥs hā nu giḥ/ /ta ṭi tyāḥskad 'byung / /nam zhig chu ni 'tshol ① byed cing / /khyu yi mgon de rjes 'brang bcas/ /phru ba'i phreng bee na mā li n+yaḥpu li rgo sa mu pā ya yo/ /ta tā pa shyata pra bā ha ṇa rngi ya ldan chu klung gi/ /'jug ngogs dag tu song bar gyur/ /der ni dgra rnams kyis bcings nas/ /chur mā ṇa ma tī ya sā/ /sa sha tru bhirga le badha kṣibhā ma krandi rgo na ram̐/ /'phangs cho nge ④'debs pa'i mi/ /shin tu che ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /khyer nas 'gro ba de yis mthong / /ta gya ta ra ta ram̐ khru tā dīrghamā kranda ni swa rna/ /ha ri ṇḍi du dru buḥsabye shrī de yi cho nge'i sgra dag ni/ /shin tu che zhing ring ba thos/ /ri dwags thams cad mgrin pa ni/ / 'khyog bā ba la na bi bhra miḥ/ /su baṇḍi pārshastu ta dā kṛ pā pā sha ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /pa'i ④ rnam 'phrul ldan pas bros/ /gser gyi logs ni de yi tshe/ /brtse ba'i zhags pas spyodabang du byas//ta tre ba nibye lasta sgo mand+ra bidha i be 6 shā/ /ta dudhe ra ṇa sandarghaṃ mda' yis gnad du phug pa bzhin/ /de nyid du ni g.yo med gnas/ /de ni gdon par chas pa dag /dīrgha dṛji bi lo kya tsā/ /kā kaḥpro bā tsa na sa khe yustophoyarnye sa mudma maḥ/ /bya rog ring du mtho ba niskye / /mthong nas de la smras pa grogs/ /khyod kyi brtson pa 'di mi rigs/ /pusgo pa mā bi paṭwā le kṛ tāṭwāḥku li sho pa mā/ /kṛ ta me te na ma n+yadhe swa rgud pa'i dus na me tog mtshungs/ /don byas pa na ⑥rdo rje 'dra/ /mi bsrun ⑦rang gi lus kyi grogs/ /kā ya su z-i daḥkha lāḥ/ /i tya sau bārma mā rto pi kā ke na ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /'di dag byas pa mi bsam mo/ /de dag bya rog gis brjod 9snyekyang / /snying rjes rgyas shing drang ba de/ /a ba tirlu shu pa ri tai sa ra lasta ma tā ra yata/ /bi mu tsu bandha nā n+ya gya sa chu bo la ni myur ba ru/ /zhugs nas de ni thar par byas/ /dogs med de yi ru dag gis/ /de yi shriṅgā sgyu ma shaṅgi taḥ/ /tai pā da pa ti tai dī na ma ba daṅgabye mudma tai/ /bcings pa rnam bkrol nas/ /zhan cing rkang par gtugs byas te/ /'gro bar brtson pa de la smras/ /95—395

bee sgo mṛ gaḥ/ /abyarya ra tsa nā kṛṣṭa lo tsa nartswa ru lo tsa naḥ/ /ri dwags rnyed ma gyur/ /mig ni ngo mtshar bkod pa yis/ /'gugs pa rab tu mdzes pa'i mig /swasna saṃ panda rū po sau nyi ra rgya ha ri ṇaḥku taḥ/ /ma no bi no da ni gser gyi ri dwags rmi lam du/ /yongs rdzogs gzugs 'di ga la yod/ /lha gcig ①gal te yid kyis (snyeta smin ya di de ba pra sbo da nyi/ /kurband+ra kāñtsa na mṛ ga ku sha lāḥke bi shi lpi ni—/ /dge mtshan de la dgyes pa na/ /bzo bo mkhas pa kha cig dag /gser gyi ri dwags bgyid du naḥ / /i ti khru twa sa dṛ pa tirda dan ba hu ta ram̐ dha rgo/ /mṛ ga nī ṣa ṇa stsol—/ /zhes ①pa thos nas mi bdag de/ /nor ni rab mang ster byed cing / /ri dwags 'tshol ba'i saṃ katse ba bhū bā bhi ni bee sha bān/ /ta taḥku ṭi la kophobye hye dṛ saṃ shu tā brtag spyopa la/ /mngon par zhen pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas nor mang ster thos nas/ /rngon pa bas kyang ba hu pra rda/ /u bā tsa dra bi zla dā ṣpe lubha ke bhyo pi lubha dhīḥ/ /pra sā daḥnor len la/ /brkam chags blo ldan gya gyu can/ /mi bdag la mngon phyogs nas smras/ /lha gcig kṛ ya hūṃ de ba mṛ gi sandarsha yā mya haṃ / /dṛṣṭaḥ ka na ka sā raṅgaḥbaka' drin mdzod cig dang / /ri dwags bdag gis bstan par bya/ /gser gyi ri dwags ri dwags de/ /sā raṅgaḥs ma yā ba no/ /i tyā kakhyu kṣi nyi pa tiḥpra hasgohphu bee lo tsa nags su bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /zhes khye pa thos nas sa yi bdag /rab tu dga' ba'i mig rgyas naḥ—/ /bha dra sandarsha ya kā sau kā sā bi tya ba dadru huḥ/ /ta me bā gre pa ram̐ kṛ tā pas—/ /bzang po ston cig gang ⑥na de/ /gang na de zhes yang yang smras/ /ri dwags lam ni ston byed mṛ ga mārgha bra darsha ka/ /sa mee n+yaḥs ya yo swatstsha tra tsadzdza da yā tsa pa—/ /de nyid ④sngon du 'gro bar byas/ /dpung bcas de ni dri med gdugs/ /zla shar ri bo bzhin du laḥ—/ /dīrgha dṛṣṭirda darsha tha kā kasta ru shi raḥsbri taḥ/ /ga dza bā dzi song / /de nas glang po rta 'gros kyis/ /basbangs pa'i rdul gyis nags khengs pa/ /shing rtser gnas 95—397

bra dzo dīṇḍi re rku pā ba ra khaṃ ba rna/ /su paṇḍi pārsha sa bye tya dza gā pa'i bya rog ni/ /ring du mthong bas mthong bar gyur/ /de yis ri dwags khyu yi bdag /gser gye da mṛ go yu tha paṃ/ /hi ta mukṇi ma yā pūdzre na khru tai na kṛ tai twa yā/ /logs la mngon phyogs smras/ /bdag gis phan pa sngon ①brjod de/ /khyod kyis mnyan min byas pa min//sa e ṣa pu ru ṣaḥpāptaḥsandabye sa ha dha nī bhiḥ/ /ma yā ni bā ri te nā pi ya bdag gis bzlog kyang khyod kyis ni/ /gang la srog ni byin pa ste⑤/ /skyes bu 'di de ①go bgos shing / /gya pā ṇasta yādzre tāḥ/ /a dhu nā kwa nu ganta bye ki kārta bya bha yodha bee/ /gzhu bzung rnams dang lhan cig 'ongs/ /da ni 'jigs pa byung tshe kwa'i/ /gang du 'gro bya ci zhig bya/ /hi tai ki ma nu parta bye tu bye marta bya me ba bā/ /kṛ ta snaḥkru ra tsa ri taḥphan pa (zhwaci zhig spro bar bya/ /mnyam du 'chi bar bya 'am ci/ /byas pa mi gzo ⑤ma rungs gcod⑥/ /kṣu dro yo sakta pā ta kaḥ/ /twa yi bātpa bi nā shā ya rakṣi to bi ṣa pā sdig la chags pa'i ngan pa 'di/ /khyod kyis bdag nyid nyams bya'i slad/ /dug gi rkang 'thung bsrungs da paḥ/ /swa sha rī ra pā da snga pi saṃ hā re ṇa na tro pya te/ /sa sa twa sā par gyur/ /byas pa mi gzo'i ⑦rta gdong me/ /rang gi lus kyi gnas dag kyang / /yongs su spyad pas ga ra grwa saṃ kṛ tosna ba ḍa bā na laḥ/ /u pa kā raḥkṛ tasne 6 bi shā mi ngoms te/ /srog chags bcas pa'i rgya mtsho 'thungs(kye/ /byas mi gzo ⑨la phan pa dang / /gya gyu'i saḥku ṭi lādma su/ /u pa de sha: rūkhe 6 kakhyordo ṣā ke ba lo/ /bdag la yid gcugs ⑩dang / /ngan pa rnams la gdams ngag ni/ /byed po'i skyon ni ⑪'ba' zhig yin//i ti kā ke na ka thi te pra tyā sande tsa pābee be/ /a tsinta yata pāpta kā lo hi tai zhes pa bya rog gis bshad tshe/ /sa yi bdag po nye bar 'ongs/ /khyu la phan pa'i dus la ni/ /bab ⑫pa yu tha gya yu tha paḥ/ /su bha ṭā hā mi yo se nā bi gā he ga ha rna ma hata/ /khyu yi bdag pos bsams/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi sde 'di yis/ /nags tshal chen po bskor nas ni/ /95—398

ka ro ti mata pra saṅge na mu snutī ṣpe ba nimṛ shaṃ/ /ta smrata bee n+ya pra ṅgā na gya bdag gi zhar la ri dwags rnams/ /yud tsam nyid kyis med par byed/ /de slad dpung gi gtso bo dang / /gasgo mi swa ya manta ka/ /e ka sri ba ba bho mistu sazla jo ba twa mbi mṛ gāḥ/ /nye bar rang nyid 'gro bar bya/ /bdag nyid gcig pu gsod gyur la/ /ri dwags 'di kun 'tsho gyur cig /i nyi byi— tya sa ya yo sa mbi paṃ bhū pa tesmṛ gaḥ/ /pa ra pā ṇa pa ri tā ṇi de ltar des byas ri dwags de/ /sa bdag dang ni nye bar song / /gzhan srog yongs su skyob tshotrepa la/ /tro khaṃ pā zla ma hadma rgo/ / ta mā yādzha dru lta dṛṣṭaḥ ku ṭi la kaḥpu bdag nyid che rnams srog ni rtswasti/ /mdun du mgyogs par 'ong ba de/ /mthong nas gya gyu can dga' raḥ / /so ya mi tyā shu pā ṇi rgyu rā dze dru ro da darsha yata/ /taṅgha ṇi dro ṇa shā pe bas—/ /rgyal la mgyogs par de 'di zhes/ /lag pa dag gis ring nas bstan/ /de tshe bya rog dmod na badzra ṇi ba ṇi pā ti nā/ /ka ro pa ri sgo to ta gya pā pa pā da pa palla bo/ /pa ni/ /rdo rje lhung ba lta bu yis/ /de yi lag pa sdig pa yis1/ /rkang 'thung yal 'dab yongs su lhung ④)//tabyetrī bismi taḥshu tā mṛ ge na ka thi tai dṛ paḥ/ /a bhūta kṛ ta sna tsa ri te ri dwags kyis bshad de yi spyod/ /mi bdag ya mtshan ldan pas thos/ /zhal nas byas pa mi gzo (snyeba'i /byeṅgā ra mu kha rā na naḥ/ /ta taḥkṣi ti pa ti spru tya bee byu tya sa ra yā mṛ gi/ /tai spyod tshul smad ces mu cor gyur/ /de nas sa bdag dgyes pa yis/ /rje sa shin tu che ba dang / /'byor ni nā yā swa na ga rī go ra be na ga rī ya sā/ /rā dza dhwa mbi ma thā sa rya pa mchog gi spyo ri dwags de/ /rang gi grong khyer dag tu (pekhyer/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho brang phyin/ /de tasmi ratna sa rgo dṛ paḥ/ /da tā sāntaḥpu rā mā tyasta snga gre sa mu pā bi shata/ /nas (snye)rin chen khri stan phul/ /de yi mdun du mi yi bdag /btsun mo blon po'i tshogs bcas 'khod/ /sa bo bye sa tā ha ri ṇasta sri paste di di bya dhīḥ/ /dhadzre di de sha ye nā byang chub sems dpa' ri dwags de'i/ /mchog gi blo yis mdun yo7sa der/ /chos bstan gang gi skye bo 95—399

khyudzdza naḥshikṣu pa dā nī taḥ/ /su baṇḍi parshaḥ sā raṅgāḥso ha me bā rnams—/ /bslab pa'i gnas dang ldan par gyur/ /nga nyid sngon gyi dus na ni/ /ri dwags gser gyi bha baṃ su rā/ /yophobha bta ku ṭi laḥkru ro de ba dattaḥs tsā dhū nā/ /i ti su kṛ logs der gyur/ /ma rungs rgya gyu can gyur gang / /de yang da lta lhas byen no/ /de nas bcom ldan ti tsi tai bha ga ba tā bha ba dī ti bhi dā ka thi ta mu dā ra sa twa ru tsi ra gya srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'byed par byed pas snying stobs ni/ /rgya che mdzes pa'i spyod tshul legs spyad la 'os ta tatso ri tai/ /pra sha ma ma yo ni sha mya ku sha lā ya sa bhi gru ga ṇaḥrab zhi'i rang bzhin dag /de skad bshad pa thos nas bsod nams dag ni yongs su smin gyur pa'i/ /ki ma pi ba bhū ba pu sgo pa ri pā ka bee bee ka ru tsiḥ/ /i nyi kṣe mend+ra dbeen pas mdzes pa'i dge slong tshogs de dge ba'i slad du ci yang gyur/ /zhes 47pa dge ba'i dbang pos bee ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī su baṇḍi pabye ba byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser byi logs kyi rtogs dā na me ka tro shaḥpalla waḥ// //pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa byegacig pa'o// //pra tya kṣa la kṣa ṇa pa ri kṣi ta e ṣa lo ke saṃ la kṣu te su dza na 'jig rten dag na yongs su mtshon byed mngon sum mtshan nyid kyis/ /skye bo bzang dang ngan pa'i dudzdza na yobee she ṣaḥ/ / karkaḥpra kā sha bi sha rda bi da jo ti bi shwa khyad par 'di dag legs par mtshon/ /nyi mas thams cad dri med rab tu gsal ba rnam par sgrub①/ /madhri ka ro nyi ni khi lo dza ga dandha kā raḥ/ /sattha snyoḥsgottha bṛṭwānta ma smag rum mun pas 'gro ba ma lus mun nag ldan par byed/ /thams cad mkhyen pas ④ sngon byung mtha'/ /she ṣa ma ba lo ka yan / / a sminde ba ka thā raste bha ga bān pu ma lus nges par gzigs byed cing / /gtam 'di nyid las ⑤rab brtsams te/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 95—400

na ra bra bīta/ /dṛ paḥpā ṭa li pu tā khye su re byu mi pu randa raḥ/ /a byuta ta pu slar gsungs pa/ /grong khyer pa ṭa lngoli yi bu/ /zhes par mi bdag sa yi ni/ /'byer ṛ da ro nā ma mandi ram̐ pu rgya sadza rda/ /ka sthā ṇa kā ri ta snga bhūta sru 'jig 'byer 'jig ces bya ba/ /bsod nams phun tshogs gnas su gyur/ /de yi sras po 'a3yon tan gyi//nurgu ṇa ga rtonda taḥ/ /a ka spyo shā bhe dhwa nabya dī tī yo ni rgu ṇaḥsu taḥ/ /ka tshogs kyis mtho ba dge byed dang / /gnyis pa yon tan med pa yang / /mi dge byed ces bya bar gyur/ /dge spyo ṇa kā ri sazlubee ka ru rja kalpa pā da paḥ/ /tstsha tā ba sha ṣā ma ka rota dā byed slong ba thams cad kyi/ /snying rje yi ni dpag bsam shing / /sbyin pa'i tshul gyis yab kyi dpal/ /na shi laḥshri yo pi tuḥ/ /tasmi ma no ra oṃ nā ma pu ju se no ma tī pa tiḥ/ /gdugs kyi lhag ma nyid du byas/ /de la ①sa bdag bsod nams sdes/ /yid dga' ma zhes bya ba yi/ /dru tai bi mṛ bye le khe na swa su tai ba tsa sā da do/ /pra tyā sanda bi pā hophotha dṛ saṃ rang gi bu mo spring yig dang / /tshig gi ④pho nya btang nas byin/ /de nas len la nye ba'i tshe/ /rgyal la rā dza su to bhya dhata/ /pā pāḥpa ri ṇa yasta ta saspra hye ṣa na me ma taḥ/ /rgyal sras kyis smras pa/ /yab gcig ⑤bag ma len pa 'di/ /da yolta bdag la thob 'dod med/ /bātpa lya pe sha la ta yā ma dādhī pra kṛ ta shri yaḥ/ /ma yā dā na bya ba ni mnyes gshin yangs pa nyid kyis ngan⑦ / /bdag ni sbyin la zhen pa yis/ /dga' bas dpal 'byor drag 3snanā ko ṣaste shu ṣi rī kṛ taḥ/ /ta smrata pra ba ha bee nā haṃ sa muṭī rya tu blangs/ /khyod kyi mdzod ni stong shakyepar byas/ /de beed chu gter chen po ni/ /gzings kyis yang dag ma ho da sgo/ /ratna dī saṃ bra dzā bye ba di bya raṭwādzdza nodma taḥ/ /di bya bsgral nas bdag /mchog gi rin chen sgrub brtson pas/ /rin chen gling du nges par 'gro/ /mchog gi sadza da mā sā rya ka ri ྾ dā ra saṃ gra haṃ/ /ka la tra ma kṛ tārja su tā sa phun tshogs thob nas ni/ /bdag gis chung ma blang bar bgyi/ /nor med dag gi chung ma ni/ /bde ba'i 95—401

ram̐ su kha sadza dzā/ /i kyughā sa pi tu pā gyaḥshā sa rgo tsa ra ṇa na taḥ/ /phun tshogs skrag pa skyed①/ /ces brjod de yis ② yab kyi bka'/ /thob nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /dza ga he dza la dhi lo la kaslo lā liṅgi tālba re/ /sthā tā tai ma nu ba zwa dza sau rba ①rlabs g.yo bas nam mkha' la/ /'khyud pa chu yi gter du zhugs/ /yon tan med pa yon tan la/ /dza n+ya bya dza nolhanu dzaḥ/ /nirgu ṇaḥs gu ju dwo ṣajo ha mantambi tsinta sdang bas nang du 'khu sems shing ④/ /gzhung bzang du ston rjes skyes pa'i/ /spun zla de ni der rjes yan—/ /byeṣṭhaḥtam bra bīdmatpa sa mu dre kand+ra bi bee bta/ /sa haṃ gā khya ste 'brang / /thu 'a3bos de la smras pa bu/ /rgya mtshor las kyis rnam bslad pas/ /gzings ni zhig par gyur yāskarnyi dzā te pra ba ha ṇa kṣa ye/ /i ti bhā tā kṛ tā shwa sasta je kyu pa na/ /khyod kyi phrag 67par bdag blang bya/ /zhes pas spun zla ④yid brtan byas/ /de bzhin zhes tse sa tai sha ṭhaḥ/ /do ṣa rya taḥpra ṇa yi tsā kha laḥs ma ma lasba te/ /ta taḥdes de la smras/ /skyon rtsom g.yo khyacan mi bsrun po7pa/ /rab dud nyid la yang dag brten/ /de nas pra ba ha ṇa ru bhāḥs pa ṣpe ra nu ku la hūṃḥ/ /yā taiḥpu bye ri ba pā mya gzings la zhon byas te/ /bsod nams bzhin du rjes mthun par/ /'gro ba'i rlung gis rin chen gling / /ratna ju paṃ dṛ pātpa dzaḥ/ /di bya ratna ni saṃ pra pya tyā bṛdhe ta taḥsha mi yi bdag po'i sras kyis ⑫ thob/ /rin chen mchog rnams rab rnyed nas/ /rgyal po'i sras dag dal bu naiḥ—/ /rā dza pu tre pra ba ha ṇi dru ga ba bhañdza pra bhañdza naḥ/ /bhasne pra pa ha ṇi ta smin yis—/ /beer log tshe na gzings dag ni/ /rlung gi stobs kyis myur du zhig /gzings ni zhig pa de yi bhā ta re pūzla sambi dā/ /sa dza grwa ha sha ṭhaḥkabye tai bhu dzee ga i bā nu tshe—/ /sngon byu gros kyi lhomespun zla de'i/ /mgrin par lag 'gro lta bu yi/ /rjes skyes g.yo ⑫can de yis dzaḥ / /kand+ra bā te ri tathorghaṃ ku lo sthā pya dṛ pādma dzaḥ/ /a bā pa sa ha sa bzung / /las kyi rlung gis myur bskyod pas/ /rgyal po'i bu yi ⑫ngogs phyin nas/ /long ba'i pho nya dang 95—402

ni dā mārtse bra tha ma dru ti rmā/ / tasu supta su ratna ni dṛṭī badhe n+ya po nyid/ /'phral la gnyid du song bar gyur⑨/ /nyal ba de yi rin chen ni/ /bcings rnams nu bo ma thā nu dzaḥ/ /pra harba bya sa nakhyu dre spyu raḥs mu pa tsakra me/ /utyā rungs des/ /mthong nas gdung ba'i khung bur ni/ /rab tu 'phrog pa'i bya ba brtsams/ /de yis rgya gā bhā badha gya sa ta su na yo rmā bu dze/ /tai tā ra ka bha yī sgo dhi brtan par bcings pa de'i/ /mig gi chu skyes rab phyung nas/ /'jigs pa'i mtsho las sgol byed de'i/ /tsa kā ra ga ta tā ra shaṃ/ /a tu rasne ga te tasmi na rā dzā sru nurga tadku tiḥ/ /mig gi 'bras bu med par byas/ /rin chen khyer nas de song tshe/ /rgyal po'i bu ni gzi byin nyams/ /ma tasgond+ra li tī sgo dza i bā bhūṅka ma lā ka raḥ/ /sa ba byu ba ni rā lo kaḥglang pos chu skyes dkrugs pa yi/ /padma'i 'byung gnas bzhin du gyur/ /nyi ma zla ba spangs pa yizhu/ /sho ka tī bra ta mo dṛ taḥ/ /kṛṣṭa pakṣa kṣa pā rambha i ba srudmend+ra badzhai taḥ/ /nag phyogs mtshan mo rtsom pa bzhin/ /mya ngan mun pa drag pos bsgribs/ /de ni snang ba med par gyur//a tānta re sa ma yā taste de shaṃ go ku lā bye paḥ/ /rā dza pu tram̐ bee lokyāndha ma de nas ba glang rdzi bo'i ①bdag /gnas der yang dag 'ongs pa yis/ /rgyal sras long ba mthong nas ni/ /byu྾ krānta tabye thaḥ/ /sa tai bhā tā swa ni la yo pa ri tsatyā pa raḥpa raḥ/ /de yi gdung ba 'phos par gyur/ /de ni de yi krurang gnas blangs/ /rim gro mchog gis rab tu bskyangs/ /ta myu sīṅga ṇa so dza n+ya sne hā bi sha ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /ta tra sho ka ru rdzu de yi yon tan legs spyod dang / /mdza' ba 'bebs pas (5dbang byas gyur/ /der ⑪ni mya ngan nad shādhri sa dā tse te bi no di dī/ /bī rde swa re pra bī kho sau byuddhā bhyasta zhi'i slad/ /rtag tu sems ni dga' byed pa'i/ /pi wang gyesngon du goms gyur pa/ /dbyangs la mkhas ma ba da yata/ /sadmaṅga maḥthra thu bee be ka ka thā bhi yo gaḥkā byā pa pa de yis blangs/ /dam pa'i grogs dang rgya che ri 7dben pa'i gtam gyi mngon sbyor dang / /snyan ngag 95—403

baḥpri ya su j-ita pra ṇa yo bi hā rāḥ/ /bi rja swa naḥku su ma kānta ba nānta btung ba snying sdug grogs rnams mdza' bas rtse ba dang / /pi wang ⑫sgra snyan me tog mdzes pa'i nags kyi sa (khye bā saḥsho kāsni tabee ma na sā ma mṛ ta ba ga haḥ/ /ta gya go ba pa teḥganas pa/ /yid ni mya ngan me yis gdungs rnams bdud rtsir zhugs pa yin/ /ba glang ①rdzi yi bdag pasbyi gī ta bī rja bi tsakṣa shā/ /pa shādhī rā dza ta na yo pra ya yo sā bhi po de'i/ /chung ma pi wang ④glu mkhan mas/ /rgyal po'i bu mthong de ⑤nas ni/ /mngon par 'dod ldan lā ṣa hūṃ/ /kṛ to pa de shā sa ta tai ku ṭi lā bī ṇa ye ba sā/ /mutstsha nyid du gyur/ /rtag tu spyogya gyu ldan ma de'i/ /pi wang ④gis ni gdams byas bzhin/ /chags pa ṭī na ba rā ge ṇa soṅkasthā sa ma tsinta yata/ /su bha go yi ma mā tī ba dṛ gsar pas brgyal byed cing / /'dod dang ldan pas yang dag bsams/ /skal bzang 'di la bdag gi ni/ /shi tsiste ba brta te/ /ni brta te na me tā paḥprekṇi tsenda pra bsto te/ /mig dang sems kyang shin tu chags/ /gal te mdza' bar ma gyur na/ /bdag gi gdung ba zlog mi 'gyur/ /dha bye yo na kha saṃ pā taiḥkwa ṇa: rā gi bhā mu huḥ/ /yā tā su babee tī pu yang yang sen mos khyebatab pa yis/ /sgra byed chags ldan pi wang ⑨'di/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'di yi bye raṅgā ro ha ṇa yo gya tsā / / i ti saṃ tsidhri sā sī re ta mu phang / /'dzeg 'os nyid gyur ⑨ skal ba bzang / /zhes bsams de yi ⑪dal bu yis/ /'dar bcas bā tse sa bi bhra ma/ /smṛ byurnyi taṅka ram̐ sgo rdza sa kadza ka ra palla bā/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab kyis/ /de ⑫lag pad la reg byed ⑫cing / /rnam 'gyur ldan pas de la smras/ /la la nā su la bhā lasbyo ma me rda twaṅga ta ma naḥ/ /a kṛ ta snyo i ba spru ti khyod la song ba'i bdag nyid 6'di/ /mdza' bo byas pa mi shes bzhin/ /bud med rnams la rnyed sla ba'i/ /na saṃ sma ra ti mā na da/ /na shī lo na ku khā tsā re nā bhe mā rna na saṃ sha yi/ /legs ster ngo tsha mi dran no/ /'dod pas 'phangs pa'i bud med ni/ /ngo tsha bral ba'i ltos pa dag /95—404

a pe kṣurnye sma rakṣibhā bai laghra ha ri tāḥste yaḥ/ /pra ṇa khādma ma saṃ kadzee rigs spyod la med khrims la med/ /the tshom la med khengs la med/ /bdag gi brtag pa mdza' ba yis/ /sa pha lo kartu marta si/ /bha babye mā ni tāḥspru hye de ba tā i ba yo ṣi 'bras bu ldan par bkyi bar 'os/ /bud med rnams ni bsten khyepa na/ /lha bzhin gcugs pa nyid du taḥ / /i ti ta gya ba tsaḥkhru twa byenda swa rā bi sh-iṅga lo/ /tsa pa dzee rā dza 'gyur—/ /zhes pa dbyangs dang bral gyur zhing phu/ /ma bsdams de yi tshig thos nas/ /g.yon ma de la pu trast+ri tra stuntaḥka ra rtophob data/ /ṣpe yo mā taḥs mu tsi tā sa taḥrgyal po'i bu/ /nang gi byed pa skrag pas smras/ /yum gcig (snyetshul khrims yongs gtong ba/ /'di ni shī la pa ri tsu tiḥ/ /byekkilbi ṣa bi ṣa smṛṣṭi naṣṭa shī la su dzī bee tai/ /dam pa'i rigs ④pa min/ /sdig pa'i dug gis reg gyur pa/ /tshul khrims nyams pa'i skye ba smad/ /pa rāṅga nā pa ri ṣṭaṅga mamee radhī ka ro ti yaḥ/ /ā liṅga ti pa tai go yo gang zhig gzhan gyi ⑤bud med la/ /lus kyis yongs 'khyud bdag gir byed/ /'di ni dmyal ba'i me lce na ra kāsni shi khaṃ pu naḥ/ /pa ro pa kā ra ṇi ra taḥpa ra dā ra ni rā la—/ /phye ma leb bzhin slar yang 'khyud/ /gzhan la phan pa la chags shing / /gzhan gyi bud med la dā rāḥ/ /ye pya ho sā bya sa ni napta dzī badhe mṛ tāḥpa raḥ/ /i ti te nokta mā kardzu gus bral/ /gang yang 'tshe med la chags pa/ /de dag 'tsho la gzhan ni shi/ /de skad de yis brjod sā bhūdzhasna ma no ra thā/ /ni dha nā bhya bye kai dī ti pra ti ṣe sgo nyi yo thos nas/ /yid kyi shing rta chag par gyur/ /gang phyir bud med mdza' ba ni/ / bzhag sa ⑥shi ba nyid ṣi tsā/ /ta taḥsri pa ti ma bye tya byu dzee gī bhaṅga mā ga te/ /ma no ra the ma rgyu bi ṣe las lhag /de nas yid la re ba dag /nyams par gyur tshe lag 'gro ma/ /de yi ()7rang bdag la phyogs ba maṭī ba dza gā da sā/ /pa ra batpa la tā sāsgo do ṣā ya pa ra la te—/ /khro ba'i dug skyug bzhin smras pa/ /dge ba drang po khyod kyis ldu ni/ /mchog tu mnyes gshin skyon 95—405

su ra su ma tī pa teḥ/ /kā le na sthā sa dru rā dhwa kle sha pra sha ma brnya baṃ/ /nams sde yi grong khyer ni/ /lam ring lngonyon mongs rab zhi ba'i/ /grogs po dus kyis thob par gyur/ /a tānta re pu tā ta tra ma hi bhaturma no ra lā/ /dā tsā daṭwā pu rā ya smi gnas skabs der khyeni de dag tu/ /sa bdag sras mo yid dga' ma/ /gang la tshig gi khyasngon byin pa/ /tambindabhi tsu te khru te/ /ā tū te 6 na rebye 6 ni biṣṭa 6 ya thā kra oṃ/ /ā de ni chu gter lhung thos tshe/ /mi yi dbang po rnams bos te/ /rim pa ji bzhin 'khod pa la/ /rin ru khya ratna shi bee rmā swa yalba ra byu baṃ ya yo/ /bi lo ka yaṭībyu pā lān cen bzhon par ④zhon nas ni/ /rang nyid khyo 'dam sa ru 'ongs(7 / /dal bus mig ni mdzes ma des/ /pā sha ṣpertswa tu lo tsa nā/ /ya dṛtstsha yā ga tanta tra rā dza pu tram̐ da darsha tai/ /sa skyong rnams la bltas pa na/ /de ⑪ni 'dod dgar song gyur pa/ /rgyal po'i sras de mthong bar gyur/ /astso pi ta suḥs ha sā sa ya yo pri ya tsā dṛ shoḥ/ /gra ha ma bye ku mudma tyā me de ni long yang 'phral la de'i/ /mig gi ⑦snying sdug nyid du gyur/ /sprin gyis long yang gza' nang na/ /ghārnya pi pri yaḥsha shī/ /dṛ pe 6 pra ti yā te 6 bee la kṣe ṣṭa phalā ga māta/ /ku mud ldan la zla ba sdug /long ba gdams pa ⑧ mi bdag rnams/ / 'ong ba ⑨'bras bu med pa las/ /ma tī pa tiḥsu ta manta ba ra ṇi na bi nirga tai/ /sā pi hā ram̐ pā ri kṣi bya skyengs shing log nas song ba'i tshe/ /bu mo sa bdag gis phyir bskrad/ /mig yangs ma des do shal yang / /kabye ta gya ya tekṣa shā/ /sha na kaidzre dhu rā lnga ba twadma shāsmre byu bā tsa de yis ⑩mgrin par yongs 'phangs nas/ /de la dal bus snyan pa'i sgra/ /bdag ni khrod kyi dbang zhes tai—/ /spyi bṛtta tsa ki taḥso bi bi dza ṣpe tā ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pādzñā da ri smras—/ /de yang bud med spyod tshul gyis/ /'jigs te dben par de la smras/ /bud med shes rab dra yā ṣpe rda ṭwā yā multo kṛ haṃ twa yā/ /sma ra sau hārja mi tre 6 padma kyis dbul na⑪/ /khyod kyis 'dir spyoni rigs ma byas/ /rgyal po dran pa'i snying sdug grogs/ /padma'i 95—407

ṣpe tre 6 rā dza su/ /spru te 6 band+ra dzadmānt+ra kasmra da mbi dṛ tosta yā/ /spyan rnams 'khod pa'i tshe/ /skye ba don med long ba khye7bdag /khyod kyis ②ci yi slad du gdams/ /a n+ya bkyā ba lo ki byo dzā yābyakṣuṣṭha tā ba pi/ /ba dhū ki pu na ranta mig ldan rnams kyi'ang chung ma ni/ /gzhan gyi bzhin ras rnam par lta/ /long ba'i chung ma nyin mo yang / /su di ṣpe bya tyā bhi sā ri kā/ /la la nā bhend+ra me kṛ hye pra tya yasthā pu nāste me/ /gzhan la mngon bgrod smos ci dgos/ /bdag la bya med bud med kyis/ /de la bdag ni yid ches med/ /ku la ku la ni pā ti byo ni mā gāḥku ṭi lāḥsdi yaḥ/ /i tyāghā te na pa bud med thur bgrod gya gyu can/ /rigs dang 'jug (kyengogs rtsang bar byed/ /ces pa'i tshig rtsub des ru ṣe lasbyo lo khā dṛ padma dzā/ / ta mū tse nā tha sattha tra na shaṃ rmā smras pas④/ /mi bdag bu mo ngo tsha g.yos/ /des ⑤smras mgon po thams cad du/ /dogs pa bgyi bar kartu marta si/ /dṛṣṭa do ṣaḥkwa tsandarja ya di twa ma ti shaṃ ki taḥ/ /a duṣṭa mi 'os so/ /gal te bud med 'ga' la skyon/ /mthong bas shin tu dogs pa khyod/ /de yi ⑥khyab pas ṇa mi rda tadhyā byu kri ya te ka dzee/ /twa yī ba ya di pri ti ra na n+ya sha skyon med la/ /sun 'byen 'di ni ji ltar byed/ /gal te khyod nyid la dga' zhing / /yid kyi skyabs ni ra ṇi ma naḥ/ /te na sa bye na te ṣpe tra me kai bha ba tu nirma lo/ /i tyākta mā gzhan med na/ /bden pa de yis khyod kyi mig /gcig ni dri ma med gyur cig /mig bzang mas ni ④tre su dṛ shā dakṣi ṇanta su lo tsa āoṃ/ /a nu bhā ba byutpa tya pra buddhā ka ma lo brjod tsam las(7/ /de yi lta 67byed g.yas pa ni/ /padma rgyas pa lta bu dag /bden pa'i mthu yis byung pa oṃ/ /rā dza pu traḥpra z-isbyo tha tai pra sā rya su lo tsa rgo/ /a bā tsa tambu khaṃsgo bar gyur/ /de nas mig bzang ma de la/ /rab tu dad nas de yi bzhin/ /chu skyes mdzes sdug yon dza lā ba rgya gu ṇa bisma taḥ/ / ka spyo ṇa kā rī su bha ge e bā haṃ tan gyis/ /mtshar bskyed rab dga' rgyal bus smras/ /gang la bla ma'i tshig gis sngon/ /khyod ni rab tu 95—408

dṛ padma dzaḥ/ /yasmi pu rā tī gu ru shā ba tsa sā pra ti ya di tā/ /sa e bā haṃ ya byen gyur pa/ /skal ba bzang mo rgyal po'i bu/ /dge byed de ni nga nyid yin/ /de nyid bdag yin mig di pa ram̐ nibye raḥpā ṭa ṣpe dṛ shoḥ/ /te na sa hye na na ya āoṃ swa dzee bha ba tu phyung la/ /gal te nges par khon med na/ /bden pa de yis bdag gi mig /gzhan pa rnal du gnas mephopa ram̐/ /sa rkyo pa yā tsa ṣpe ṣpe ti sa ha si bā gya lo tsa rgo/ /dī tī ya ma pi bai gyur cig /ces pa'i bden pa brjod pa las/ /'phral la nyid du de yi mig /gnyis pa'ang sems dang ma lya ma pāpta sa ha tse ta sā/ / ta to bee di ta bṛste na pu ju se lhan cig tu/ /①dri ma dag dang bral ba thob/ /de nas spyod tshul rig pa yis(37/ /sa la spyod pa ṣpe na byu bhu dzā/ /kṛ ta sā hā ya kaḥpā sa swa rā rdzu sa pri yā sa khaḥ/ /ka bsod nams sdes/ /stong grogs byas te rang gis srini/ /rgyal srid mdzes ma ldan des thob/ /gang spyo ṇa kā rī yaḥso haṃ de ba daṭwāḥs tsā nu dzaḥ/ /te na pūdrwa nu bhā be na tabee bye a zhig dge byed de ni nga / /nu bo de yang lha sbyin te7/ /sngon gyi mthu des da lta yang / /rnam pa dag ni byā pi brta te/ /i kyu dā ra mu pa kā ra nidzre lo bo bye sa twa tsa ri tai ni shamya te/ /de ltar gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni/ /dri med rgya cher phan dang mi bsrun 'a7pa'i/ /bhikṣa baḥkha la bi tseṣṭa tañtsa tabhu lya ma pra ti ma bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /i ti spyod tshul ngan pa thos nas dge slong rnams/ /de la mtshungs par mtshungs med ya mtshan gyur/ /ces pa kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ka lya dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dge ṇa kā rya ba dā rna dā tri shaḥpabee wa// //byed kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //bā māḥ sa dzdza na bā māḥ drwa ye ṇa bha ba rnyi mbi tsa rā gi sgo ཿ / / skye bo dam pa'i ⑥g.yon phyogs g.yon pa ⑦ rnams/ /phal cher dman la chags dang ldan par gyur/ /95—409

ti mi rorlu khāe sa rā gā kṣi pa ti ra bo bhū ṅgā rā ta saṃ dhya/ /de mtshams ni dmar ldan mun pa mngon phyogs pa'ilha// /sa 'dzin dag las ⑤nyi ma 'phen par byed/ /skye ba datta gya tsa ri ta ba hu dzadmānta rā shra ye/ /ka thi te bi pu naḥsthā ha bha ba gzhan mang la brten pa/ / lha sbyin zudag gi spyod pa ni/ /bshad kyang bcom ldan ye shes kyi/ /rgya ga bān dzñā na sā ga raḥ/ /pu rā ka ling ka bi ṣa ye dzra pa tiḥsha tru bhi ga krita/ /shri mtshos slar yang bka' stsal pa/ /ka ling ka yi yul du sngon/ /mi bdag dgra ni nyams byed pa/ /grangs mā na bhū da sho kā khya pra khya tā saṃ khya bi kra maḥ/ /tai su shā khāḥpra shā khabyu med rnam gnon byegrags pa can/ /dpal ldan mya ngan med ces gyur/ /de yi sras ni mtshungs pa bzhi/ /tā raḥs dṛ sha su tāḥ/ /a nu shā kho bi shā khabye tya bha bān bhu pi pi khru hāḥ/ /tā ru lo ma rab tu lo ma dang / /rjes su lo ma khyad par gyi/ /lo ma ⑤ sa la grags par gyur/ /lang tshos ju maṭwāsta pi tā sa pasbyi kāḥpa bā se tāḥ/ /sa bi kā ra ni ka re ṇa pu rgyags pa de dag rnams/ /chung mar bcas pa pha mas bskrad/ /rnam 'gyur gnod pa ldan pa yisanya/ /tre ṇa pu tre sne ho pi na shya ti/ /te sha naiḥkhye ṇa pā je yā dudngha shā bu yis bu la byams pa'ang 'jigs⑦/ /de rnams rim gyis lam brgyags ⑧zad/ /bzod dka' gnas mi pa duḥs hūṃ/ /bi ka ṭā ma ṭa bo bra pya kṣuta kṣu māḥs ma tsinta yan/ /skabs ngan pa bzhin/ /nags tshal stug por phyin gyur nas/ /bkres pas nyen pas yang dag bsams/ /e tāḥste yo pi bi paṅka le gulpa bandha na shri kha khāḥ/ /kṛtstsha larbhe tsa bhā gi n+yaḥrgud ༄kyedus bud med 'di dag kyang / /long bu 'ching 17ba'i lcags sgrog ste/ /bu yis 'bad rnyed lo ma yispeme//sbi tāḥpa shlau sha ṣpe pi naḥ/ /i ti tsinta ya tā mā sīta te ྾ ste ba dha zas la'ang skal ba 'dzin cing ⑫'khod/ /de ltar bsams nas de rnams kyis6rta / /bud med bsad par ni: yaḥ/ /duddhā shā dagha bhā gyu dzā gho ra saṃ dzā ya te ma tiḥ/ /te ྾ nges pa byas/ /skal ba gnas skabs ngan pa yis/ /bsregs la blo ni 'jigs rung skye/ /sdig pa'i 95—410

ma dhyāji shā khartu pā pa saṃ kalpa shaṃ ki taḥ/ /bhāryā mā dā ya kṛ pa yā pa spyo bya brtag pas 'jigs pa yi/ /khyad par lo ma de nang nas/ /brtse bas chung ma khyer nas ni/ /tha dad pra ya yo thra thaka /sā ka ladku da tī nā ma bye shaṃ bai kla bya mā ga ṭwā/ /dru rā dag tu bros te song / /skyon ldan ma zhes bya ba de/ /mchog tu rnam par 'khrugs gyur cing / /lam ring ( 1 dhwa dhwa ba nā shāṭwā mūdhri tā n+ya pa tabye bee/ / ta taḥsā ka ru rjadzre ṇa brgyugs pa'i ngal dub kyis/ /brgyal nas sa la nges par 'gyel/ /de nas de yi ḍanyasrog 'jig tshe/ /bhaspyo pā ṇa kṣa ya kṣa ṇi/ /shi rā bya dha sa mudhū ti pā yi tā ni dza sho ṇi tai/ /bdag po snying rjes brlan pa yis/ /spyi bo phug pa las byung ḍa7ba/ /rang gi khrag ni 'thung du bcug /tai rakta pā na saṃ prabee dzre bi hūṃ sa twa sā ga raḥ/ /swāṅgadzreḥkṛ tya rmā se khrag 'thungs ④ 'tsho ba thob gyur tekhye/ /snying stobs rgya mtshos rang nyid kyi/ /yan lag nges par bcad na pā ṇa bṛtrī ma kā ra yata / /ni dzdza yi sgo ra kānt+ra re sa mudhī rya pa yi/ /sha yis srog ni brten par byasakhye/ /chu med 'jigs ⑦rung dgon pa dag /rim gyes bsgral kra me na to/ /pratshwa ya pā da pa shā mo prasto gi ri na dī ta ṭi/ /bi shānta nas de dag gis⑧/ /shing gi grib mchog sngo bsangs can/ /ri yi klung gi ngogs su sleb/ /de dag der yosta yosta tra kṛtta pā da ka ro na raḥ/ /tī zwa krāṭī na dī bee ge no bye ni ngal gso ⑨tshe/ /rkang lag bcad pa'i mi zhig ni/ /chu bo mgyogs pas khyer bzhin du/ /cho nge drag mā naḥs mā ya yo/ /dṛbye ba ka ru shā shlau ṣṭaḥkaṣṭi bee sa dmā shi ta/ /pos 'debs shing byung / /'o brgyal 'phangs ⑫pa la brten de/ /mthong ba nyid ni tu7snying rjes 'khyud/ /bee gā hra sa ri tī dodzñā bi shā khasta ma tā ra yata/ /ta taḥpra tyā ga ta pā khaṃ khyad par lo ma chur zhugs nas/ /dpung pa dag gis thar par byas/ /de nas chu dang rtsa ba dang / /to ya mū la pha la di bheḥ/ /sa tai tsakre di ṣpe re ba saṃ rū shwe tstsha da nirgya 'bras bu dag gis srog slar byung / /nyi ma 'ga' yis bcad pa gsos⑫/ /de yis de ni gdungs ⑫med 95—411

baṃ / /swasthā pi ga ti bai ka spyon bee ba gabye kwa tsita kṣa maḥ/ /sa tosbo byas—/ /gsos ①kyang bgrod pa ma tshang bas/ /gang du yang ni 'gro ma nus/ /der (kyini der gnas ta tra tatpa tū kā le ka li ta sgo dza naḥ/ /rā dza pu trastu dzā yā yā ma bhūju ra la dus su ni/ /de yi chung ma snyibaza' ba ster/ /rgyal po'i bu ni chung ma la/ /yang dag 'grogs pa nyung saṅga maḥ/ /sau hālpa ra ta yaḥshu rāḥpā ye ṇa bi dzee gi ṣā baḥ/ /di byo ṣa bye bar grur/ /phal cher rgyal 'dod dpa' bo ni/ /seng ge bzhin du 'khrig pa nyung / /dal byis sman ra sā hā ra ba ri pūṇḍi ta nuḥsha naiḥ/ /tatpasnri bi ka khā yāsmi tsa kā mchog ro dang ni④/ /zas kyi lus ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /nyams gyur de dang de yi ni/ /chung mas 'khrig ra su ra ta smṛ hūṃ/ /ste he na no pa le pyarnye na ba dhyadhe gu ṇi na tsa/ /go re la chags par byas/ /mdza' ba'i snum gyis ma byugs shing / /yon tan srad bus ma bcings la/ /rjes ⑤be na tsa sadzdzarnyi swetstsha sparsha su khaḥste yaḥ/ /sa te na ni shi niḥshasde ra ma bla mas ma smad pa/ /bud med rang 'dod med spyopas bde/ /mtshan mo sgra med nu rgyas ma/ /de ni de mā ṇa gha na sta mbi/ /niḥshaṃ ku su ra tā tre bhā ba two bi sgo ma ma n+ya ta/ /dang rol ba na/ /dogs med 'khrig pas ma tshims ⑦par/ /bdag po gegs ⑧su gyur par bsams/ /sa pa kyuḥswe ri dhī te na bi da dhe ba dha sambi rda/ /pā pe 6 shikṣu ku sha de nas ⑪bdag po g.yem ma des/ /gsad ⑪ pa'i gros ni byas par 'gyur⑪/ /sdig pa dag la bslab khā ka lu ṣāḥki la yo ṣi taḥ/ /swa shi raḥbyu la ma tu lo ba daṭī swa gya mkhas pa/ /bud med sdog pa can rnams lo/ /rang gi mgo bo mtshungs med ni/ /na bar ston ⑫cing sgra sa swa nā/ /tsa kre li khi ta pā pā gya la lā ṭi paṣṭa brnya ram̐/ /ta gya shi ro ldan des/ /dpral bar sdig pa bris pa bzhin/ /ras kyi 'dab mas bcings pa spyobyas/ /de yi mgo yi ru dzā tī bye byati taḥpābee bātpa dzaḥ/ /kā ru rgya tta ttha tī kā re tsā tsā nad kyis ni/ /rtag ⑫tu gdungs pas spyos bdag sras/ /snying rjes de slar bcos pa yis/ /rig ⑫pa 95—412

byu na mu pa de shaḥkṛ twa na yā/ /durbi zlo ya pra ta ta ma ti bhiḥswasna saṃ kalpa pa la/ /'di yis gdams ngag byas min nam/ /rab rgyas blo yis rtogs par ①dka' zhing rmi lam kun kaspra rā ga dī ṣa bya sa na bi ṣa mā yā sa bi sde sa salnga ཿ / /rtog dang mtshungs la/ /chags dang sdang ba'i gdung ba mi bzad nyon mongs rnam par 'god ⑤la chags/ /kā māṭwā mi sa ka la dza na tā mo ha āoṃ saṃ pra bṛṭwāḥpā tā ma ba kṣa ṇa pa ri tsi nges par 'dod pa las ni skye bo mtha' dag rmongs par rab 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma bud med dag ni skad cig ta snga pi mā yāḥspyo yābyu/ /i ti saṃ tsiddhā yande ba na dī pe ge na khyu ya sā/ /yongs su 'dris pa'ang ltung bar byed/ /de ltar nges par sems byed cing / /shin tu che ba'i chu yi rgyun/ /pā si taḥsu kṛ te ṣpe ba sa pu rī puṣka rā ba ṭī/ /tasminda ba sa re ta tra niḥpu legs byas lta bu'i ①grong khyer ni/ /pu skar can du de yis phyin/ /gnas skabs de yi tshe na der/ /mi tre dṛ ba to mṛ te/ /ni mitta dzhaidma hā mā hye spyo tī taḥ sa su lakṣa bdag sras med nongs gyur pa'i/ /blon po chen po mtshan mkhan gyis/ /mtshan bzang ldan pa de bzung ṇaḥ / /a bhe ṣiktaḥs testa tra bi bye badmaṅga lo da kaiḥ/ /a byuju bā ha bi gyur—/ /de dag gis de cho ga bzhin/ /bkra shis chu yis de rngu dbang bskur/ /rmad byung bud med spyod dī ṭī dṛṣṭa sdi tsa ri tārtse taḥ/ /ka lo ka ba tya pi gi ro bo bye sa twa bi mthong bas/ /bag ma len la sdang bar gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑤spangs pa yis/ /ri la sman ni brdzi te/ /manda bīrdzu ṣa byeḥkā la dṛtta tstsha dā ku khā bha bta/ /skandhe bhasnaṅga nus pa zhan/ /dus su skyon ldan ma dag kyang / /'tsho ba chad pas 'khrugs par gyur/ /grong dang grong mā ro bya sā gā ma pu ra ba ṭwā su/ / dza dzwa pa ti bra tā smre ti gi khyer lam du des/ /phrag la yan lag nyams pa bkod/ /bdag po'i brtul zhugs ldan tshig gis/ /skye rā ttakṣa ma yā tsa ta/ /pa ti bra ta go ra bee ṇa sadzeesta sri da do ba hu/ /bo rnams la bsod snyoms bslangs/ /bdag po'i brtul zhugs la gus pas/ /kun byus de la mang du byin/ /95—414

mi byā shi la pra ba do pi pū ti bi pa di sadza rda/ /a ṭast+ri sa sha beeḥpādzñā log pa'i tshul khrims brjod pas kyang / /rgud pa la ni 'byor pa bskyed/ /dag byed kun gyi ①phyag 'tshal na ga rī puṣka ra ba ti/ /sa tī ti beenda tā sabye sgo pa dā radhi ke ya yo/ /ma—/ /de yis dal bus bskor zhing phyin/ /grong khyer pu skar can du ni/ /mi bdag sgo dang nye bar song / /rā dzā sdi thratta bi dzwa ྾ banda te tu pa ti pra tai/ /i ti saṃ tsadhyā tata rgyal po bud med spyod la sdang / /bdag khrims ldan la phyag 'tshal 'gyur/ /zhes bsams de la gus pa yi2//bhasgyu dṛ paṃ pra ha pu ro ti taḥ/ /dru ra de shānta rā de ba pābhā kā pi pa mdun na 'don gyis rgyal la smras/ /lha gcig ①yul gzhan ring po nas/ /bdag po'i khrims ldan su ti pra tā/ /ya ye yi tsa ra ṇa tyā meesgo ta ṅgā ṭī pa bi tri tā/ /de ba zhig 'ongs/ /gang zhig rkang pa bkod pa yis/ /'byung po'i yum ni ④dag par byed/ /lha gcig pa shya hūṃ sā dhī skant+ra ro pi ta bhaj-i rmā/ /pa ti bra ta pra rja me na bdag po phrag bkod pa'i/ /gtsang ma de la gzigs par mdzod/ /bdag khrims ldan la rab btud nas/ /sum̐ sā mā yubee parta te/ /dṛ paḥpu ro hi te ṣpe ti ta྾ darsha na mabee skyes pa rnams ni ⑤tshe 'phel 'gyur/ /de skad mdun na 'don gyis de/ / blta bar zhus (nyapa'i mi bdag taḥ—/ /ta mu bā tsa na dzā dī ṣe zwahma ṇa sa ra lo bha bān/ /sdiddhāsdi ti pra bā gis—/ /de la smras pa bram ze dag /drang po khyod kyis yongs ⑦mi shes/ /bud med mdza' zhes 'di do yo nirgyu dze ti ma ti bhra maḥ/ /sa tī nyi byo ma pund+ra bhe pā pā byā ti rab grags/ /zol med ces pa blo gros 'khrul/ /gtsang zhes mkha' yi me tog job/ /bud med sdig nā saṃ sha yaḥ/ /niphe lngabyambi ro hi sgoḥs ra khā dza na saṅga me/ /nārlo be ta ces the tshom med/ /'bras bu med cing bcad la skye/ /skye bo 'grogs la drang por 'gyur/ /'byel pa rtsa sa ballarya i ba nirmu la bant+ra naḥ/ /bhe da dro hai ka shī lā bhyo duḥshī med bud med ni/ /be ta sa yi 'khri shing bzhin/ /'byed 'khu gcig po'i 37tshul khrims can/ /rang 95byed415

khā bhyaḥ swa bhā ba taḥ/ /na maḥrgyu bhyo na maḥbyā bhyo na maḥbyā bhyo na mo bzhin nyid kyis tshul khrims 'chal/ /bud med la 'dud bud med 'dud/ /bud med la 'dud 'dud do na maḥ/ /dṛṣṭa ṭwā z-itta do ṣā ya tañtsiddhā bya thi tātpa ṣpe/ /a gye 'dud—/ /bud med spyod tshul skyon kye7mthong ba/ /de bsams snyegadung ba'i bdag nyid can/ /bdag ni ṣa thra thi bī mya hūṃ ratna pūṇḍi na ro tsa te / / na ga mṛ ga ba dhū rin cen gyis gang ba'i/ /sa gzhi 'di la'ang yongs (7mi srid/ /ri yi ri dwags chung ma ltar rmongs pha muddhā ddhā ṣṭhaḥpa ram̐ pa ra pañtsaṣpe ta nu bi ta ra ṇi sāghraḥsum̐ sī ha rarnyi tsa dzre bi tai/ /da rol bslu chol mchog tu sgrin/ /lus ni rnam par sbyin la chags shing skyes bu rnams kyi srog kyang 'phrog /me pa ti tsa bha yo pubye yā te bi sharnyi tsa sā ba kai sa ra la ku ṭi lā ṣpe ba tog lhung la 'jigs par byed cing ma choyi nang du'ang rnam par 'jug /drang zhing gya gyu bud med rnams dzñā tā bi tsā ra sha tai ste yaḥ/ /ta tha bi ya di nirba ndasta ba pa shā mi tsā pri yo/ /ni rnam par dpyad pa brgyas spyimi shes/ /de lta na yang gal te khyod/ /'bad na bud med de blta ⑦bya/ /i hphughā harmya mā ru khya tī da darsha na re shwa raḥ/ /tā me ba sa pa ri dzñā ya zhes brjod mi yi dbang po yis/ /yang thog 'dzegs nas de la bltas/ /yan lag bcad pa'i grogs ldan pā rpā kṛhūṃ ga sasgo dzā/ /sa tsi bee bhyaḥkṣi ti pa ti staj-itta haṃ n+ya bee da ma—/ /sdig can ma de yongs shes nas/ /blon po rnams la sa bdag des/ /de yi spyod mtha' nges par yata—/ /dṛ paṃ sā bi pa ri dzñā ya pā pā kṣa ṇa ma dho mu khāe/ /ni rastu pra ya yo bshad—/ /des kyang mi bdag yongs shes nas/ /skad cig gdong dud sdig can ma/ /skye bo rna ba bsgribs tūṇḍi bi hi ta shra ba beerdza naiḥ/ /bi shā kha nā mā na ra nā tha sru nuḥso haṃ ba dhuḥsā gya rnams kyis/ /myur du bskrad de rab tu song / /khyad par lo ma zhes pa'i mi dbang sras/ /de bdag de yi chung tsa de ba dattaḥ/ /khru two ti thratta ka thi tai dzi ṣpe na byekṣu pra dza stastso ri tai ni ninda/ /ma de lha sbyin5/ /zhes pa'i byung tshul rgyal bas bshad jos nas/ /dge slong rnams (kyekyis de yi spyod pa smad//95—416

i tikṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī bi ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa hushedapag bsam gyi 'khri shing shā khā ba dā 8 dra ya dhī shaḥpalla waḥ// //las khyad par lo ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i 5yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //sa ko pi pu rgya pra sha mā nu bhā baḥshuddhātpa nā masgyu mṛ ta swa bhā baḥ/ /ya bsod nams rab zhi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mthu/ /de ni dag pa'i bdag la ci yang yod/ /gang gya pra bhā bee nā bha brnyi sa ryaḥspyu ra i pi kro dha bi ṣa pra mughāḥ/ /pu rā ta thā ga gi mthu yis ma rungs pa rnams kyang / /'phral la khro ba'i dug ni rab tu gtong / /de bzhin gshegs pa te dze ta ba nā rā mā bi hā ri ṇi/ / ta dā dzñā yā bhi 6 ga ṇi gi ri rgyal byed tshal/ /kun dga' ra bar sngon bzhugs sha17shing / /de yi bka' yis dge slong tshogs/ /ri kā na na tsā ri ṇi/ /su me ru pa ri ṣaṇḍa yī sbi tā dhyā na pa rā ya ṇaḥ/ /ā dang nags la rgyu ba'i tshe/ /ri rab lhun po'i ngos la ni/ /'dug nas bsam gtan skyong byed pa/ /dge ya yustikṣa baḥpaṇḍa bi tstsha ya ba da nāḥkṛ shāḥ/ /te tha kṛ tā bha ga ba taḥslong nyam chung bzhin ras ni/ /mdzes bral skya dnghabo rnam dag 'ong snye/ /de nas bcom ldan zhabs pad la/ /pā da padmā bhi nanda rmā/ /spru tsi re bhikṣa bhiḥpriṣṭa de ha dorba lya kā ra mngon par phyag 'tshal de dag gis/ /lus ni nyams rtsal chung ba'i rgyu/ /dge slong rnams kyis dris nas khaṃ—/ /su me sum̐ tri gu shā dṛ tyā beeṣṭa yi tā bya ba sbi to/ /a dṛ stso smras—/ /mkha' lding gis kyang gzhom dka' ba'i/ /klu ni dga' bo nyer ('udaga' dag /lhun po la ni bai na te ya gya nā go nosdo ba nanda kau/ /to sa dā tri bee sngodzñā saṃ mṛ lan gsum du/ /bskor cing ḍapebacings nas rnam par gnas/ /de dag rtag tu dug gi dbugs/ /me dza taḥtīṇḍi sā ba shaṃ/ /bha brnyi bhasma spasgo na sa ha so ba shi khā a pi/ /yis rgyas pa lan gsum khro/ /reg pas (nya rdo ba rnams po7dag kyang / /'phral ⑩la nyid du thal bar byed/ /95—417

— — —— byed——— ——byedab yanta dzre ṣa bee shā meembi da ddhā dhyā na yo gi naḥ/ /bi baṇḍi ba da nasgo de yi dug gi dbugs kyis ni/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba bdag cag bsregs/ /bzhin mdzes kha dog bral yāḥkai ba lam̐ kṛ sha hūṃ ga tā ཿ / /i nyi taiḥ ka thi te shastu bhi gru si ba dang / /rid pa 'ba' zhig nyid du gyur/ /ces de ①bshad tshe dge slong gi/ /tshogs kyi mdun ghārji taḥpu raḥ/ /nā ga yorda ma ṣpe yo gyi moṅga spyo ya na mā di shata/ /sa su me sum̐ bzhugs rnguston pa yis/ /klu dag ①'dul ba la 'os par/ /mod gal gyi bu la bstan/ /sbyor bas mi sa mā sā rya shrimee rā li ṅga hūṃ sba ram̐/ / su sto da darsha nā gi jo yo snang dbyebs can des/ /lhog gis mkha' la 'khyud pa yi/ /ri rab lhun por yang dag phyin/ /klu ge nāntarti tā 1 tiḥ/ /bo dhya ma kau sha ṣpeste na bu bu dhwa te ya dā na to/ /ta dā dbang dag ni nyal ba ④mthong / /de yis dal bus bslang ba las/ /gang tshe de dag ma sad pa/ /de tshe ma hā nā ga ba puspyo tā sa sa ma bee ṣṭa yata/ / pra busgo sī ḍi to te de ni 2klu chen gyi/ /lus su gyur nas yang dag bcings/ /de yis bsdams pas rab sad de/ /na dṛ ṭī ddhā ṣa shā kri ti/ / bi dru to na ra rū pa ṇi ta stha turbha 'jigs rung dbyibs de mthong gyur nas/ /'jigs pas rnam par 'khrugs gyur te/ /mi yi gzugs ya bi hwa lo/ /nā ga rū pa pa ri tya bye kṛ tā byu paṃ swa ko ta taḥ/ /pa lā ya mā kyis rab tu bros/ /de nas phan tshun 'bros byed pa/ /de la mo gal gyebyi bus/ /klu yi gzugs ni nā ba byo n+ya to moṅga spyo ya kau ba data/ /nā go kwa ga mya te byuṇḍi bha yo yongs btang nas/ /rang gi gzugs su byas te smras/ /klu dag mgyogs par gang du 'gro/ /'jigs saṃ tya dza tā mi rda/ /na sa nā gaḥsbi ta sta tra ye na bi dra bi to yu rpā/ /sasba pa 'di ni yang dag thong / /gang gis khyed cag 'jigs byed pa'i/ /klu de de na mi gnas so/ /de yi thā ya di nāste pa tabye ya ta yu ba yodhri tiḥ/ /kṛ ya te ki ka ra ju su 'jigs pas gal te khyod/ /rnam kun brtan pa med nyid na/ /skyabs su 'os pa sangs rgyas la/ /95—418

shri mān pā razla sde na re shwa raḥ/ /kā shā pā khyubye ga ba taḥpāpta bān dhadzre shā sa rna//dpal ldan kṛ ki zhes pa sngon/ /bcom ldan 'od srungs zhes pa las/ /chos kyi bstan pa thob par gyur/ /a mā tya yoḥs bi tyā su rārdzu nasdo pa nanda yoḥ/ /ba bhū ba bo bye saṃ saktaḥde yi lho)blon po dga' bo dang / /nye dga' dag la rgyal srid gtad/ /byang chub la ni yang dag chags/ /sa tya darsha ṣpe nidṛ taḥ/ /dharmā dhadzre ma yi rā rdzu kṛ tā to ta su marnyi bden pa mthong la dga' bar gyur/ /de yi blon khyedes rgyal srid ni/ /chos dang chos min reja bzhin rṇa / /sasbo ba ka ra ṇirlus+ho bi hā rja kā shya pā ya tsa/ /kā le na dzā dang / /'od srungs la yang gtsug lag khang / /yo byad kun dang ldan par (kyebyas/ /dus kyis 'di dag to nā gebye bee to nasdo pa na sdo kau/ / bi hā rādzee ṇa bye na pa rda dga' bo dang / /nye dga' klu yi dbang por skyes/ /gtsug lag khang phul bsod nams kyithu/ /lhun po me ru byu j-itta yo/ /i ti dzi na ni gā di ta pha ṇi ba ra tsa ri tai pa ra ta sa 'dzin de yi gnas/ /de ltar gdengs can mchog gi spyod pa lus gzhan dag /yongs grur legs spyod kezhe(nu pa ri ṇa ti pa ri tsi ta su kṛ tai/ /shu ta ba ti sha ma na ya mu ni pa ri ni ba he yongs 'dris rgyal bas gsungs pa dag /zhi ba'i tshul ldan thub mchog tshogs kyis thos gyur te/ /dug bi ṣa dha ra ni ya ma na gu ṇa nu ti ru di bhūta/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye 'dzin nges par zhi ba ḍūsnayon tan bstod par gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī na sdo pa na nd+ra ba dā 8 tsa tu sto sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dga' bo nye dga'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal shaḥpalla waḥ// //'dab ste sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //dattaḥpa ra hi ta bhā ba na yā ya di ta nu dha na ka ṇa she ṣaḥ/ /a gang zhig nor gyi cha shas chung ngu'i lhag /gzhan la phan par bsgoms pas byin gyur pa⑦/ /yon 95—420

pa ri kṣa ya gu ṇa kalpa na ya bha ba ti su pu ju bi she ṣaḥ/ /a thā bya tī te tan brtag pa yongs su mi zad pas/ /bsod nams de ni khyad par gyur pa yin/ /de nas 'ga' zhig kasmirmya ta kā le bha ga ba tophornyi ke/ /nasdo pa nanda yorbhand+ra de sha nā yī sho tu 'das dus na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du ni/ /chos ston pa la dga' bo dang / /nye dga' nyan dumābee yoḥ/ /rā dzā pra se na dzi dzrabye bha ga banta mu pā ga taḥ/ /ta sgyu ma kṛ 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan la/ /blta ba'i slad du nye bar 'ongs/ /de dag gis ni ta saṭwā ra pra ṇa ma ko sa mā ya yo/ /sa pra ṇa mya dzi dzwa ga tā pra da bsnyen bkur ①dang / /phyag ma byas pas thos thupar gyur/ /rgyal la phyag 'tshal de song nas/ /de dag sgo ni gra haṃ ta yoḥ/ /shant+ra dṛṣṭi saṃ mṛ dza taste tsa tasmi bye : ga to/ /chad pas gcad zhupar bsams/ /de dag gis kyang mkhar song ste/ /de la mtshon gyi char pa phab/ /sand+ra dzha pre ṣi tasgruṇḍi moṅga spyo ya naḥpra tya hūṃ/ /shant+ra dṛtrī na ra pa te kun mkhyen byis bskul mgyogs par ni/ / mo gal khyogyi bu song nas/ /mi bdag gi ni mtshon char de/ /byakre padmotpa khā pa lo/ /pu nargatā bha ga ba taḥs mbi baṃ thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /padma ⑤utpal phreng bar byas/ /slar yang sa yi bdag po yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin/ /saṃ pāsto kṣa mā ya mā sa ta dā de shāta pa bhā shwa ro/ /a thābee taḥsābee gdengs can dbang po 'ongs pa la/ /de yi bka' yis bzod gsol byas/ /de nas sa bdag gis bee na bha ga bān rā dzā mandi ram̐/ / bhas+ho pū tai ya yo sgohūṃ bhas+ho gsol te/ /rgyal po'i khang par bcom ldan 'das/ /dge slong tshogs bcas gus pa yis/ /gtsang ma'i bhikṣu ga ṇiḥs haḥ/ /bhazlu 6 pa tsu mā ṣpe 6 rā tre ta tāsni bi bee paḥ/ /bshos ni gsol du gshegs/ /kha zas 'tshed par byed tshe der/ /mtshan mo me yi khyanyer 'tshe skyes/ /dzā to dzi na pra bhā bee na sa ha sā shārnyi mā ya yo/ /byughā ga ti bha ga ba ti kṣi 'phral la rgyal ba'i mthu yis ni/ /rab tu zhi ba nyid du gyur/ /bcom ldan gsol nas gshegs pa'i tshe/ /95—421

ti sāḥswa su rephobhya dhwata/ /dzwa la na dzwa le na rā tro bā ra khaṃ daṇḍa saṃ bi dā/ /rang gi grong du sa bdag gis/ /mtshan mo me ni ⑨ 'bar ba la/ /chad pa'i gros kyis dgag pa smras/ /a tānta re kṛ ha pa tiḥsu datta sngadma dzo yu bā/ /mi byā do ṣādhri dhi ba lo skabs der khyim bdag legs sbyin gyizhu/ /bu ni rdzu 'phrul stobs zhes rngupa/ /lang tsho ldan pa rdzun skyon nā ma rā dzñā bye ga ti taḥ / /pūdzee bha ga ba taḥshāstuḥshā sa nā nu gyis—/ /rgyal po yis ni mngon par bsad/ /sngon du bcom ldan ston pa yis④/ /bstan pa rjes su gra he na saḥ/ /la bye dzñā na dhri ti pu tra duḥkhe gya rpā da duḥkhi taḥ/ /a pu tra swa bzung bas de/ /ye shes brtan thob bu yi ni/ /sdug bsngal gyis kyang sdug min gyur/ /bu spyomed rang gi dha rna byu ri dī ṣpe bhyaḥpra ti pā rya saḥ/ /tsa kā rā ti ra sā de ka pa ṇa she ṣe nor mang po/ /bkren pa rnams la des rab byin/ /shin tu chags las )dal bus dpal/ /pa na sha ṣpeḥshri yaḥ/ /pa ṇa lā bha kṛ tā she ṣa dharmaḥswalpa pra do tha saḥ/ /a bhūsgri gcig gi lhag mar byas/ /de nas pa na'i rnyed pas chos/ /ma lus chung ngu byin nas byas/ /de ni khyim ha su daṭwā khyo kṛ haṃ hi swalpa mu tsu te/ / ka dā tsidrwarsha nā yā tai bha legs ster zhes lhigyur/ /khyim na rngushin tu chung ngur brjod/ /nam zhig blta ⑨ba la 'ongs shing / /ga bān pu ra taḥsbi tai/ /tai swalpa dā na nāsne ba lalja tai da ya yāphob data/ /mdun 'khod chung ngu kwa/ sbyin pa yi/ /ming gis ngo tshar rdokhyershagyur de la/ /bcom ldan brtse bas bka' stsal pa/ /alpa dā nasgo ha pa te na ladzdza kartumarta si/ /yā ti shraddhābee to dā na khyim bdag sbyin 4—pa chung ngu la/ /ngo tsha bgyi bar mi 'os so/ /dad pas sbyin pa byin ⑫pa'i zigs/ /ka ṇaḥka na ka shi la hūṃ/ /pu rā ba hu ta re trī be la me na dri dzadma nā/ /gser gyi ri bo mtshungs par gyur/ /sngon tshe gnyis skyes be la mas/ /shin tu mang ba rab tu byin/ /shrasgye bi ra ha sā mā tyānda ta thā dṛrnyi ma ya yo/ /yaḥsabaṃ sgo dza ye dad pa dang bral thun mong bas/ /de bzhin du ni 'phel ma ⑫gyur/ /su zhig 'dzam gling gtogs pa yis⑫/ /95—422

bha sthā dzee bu dī pa ga tai dza āoṃ/ /yabye kai bo dhi saṃ yulte ta gya pu bye ta tolha bye rka/ /'gro kun gus pas gsol byed dang / /su zhig byang chub ldan zhig (tel/ /de yi bsod nams de bas lhag /i ti bā kyi bha ga ba ta sta bye shu tā bi na bye tsa/ / ni dza ge haṃ ces pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /bden pa thos nas mngon dga' zhing / /de la phyag 'tshal kṛ ha pa tiḥpra ya yo pra ṇi pa tya tai/ /dī paṃ da tā pa ṭha na rā treta tra khyim bdag ni/ /rang gi khang par rab tu song / /mtshan mo mar me btang nas der/ /bcom ldan rjes buddhā nu shā sa dzñā/ /dāṇḍa ya rā dza pu ru ṣeḥs mbi tophoghi pra brta nāta/ /daṇḍa bstan klog pa na/ /me ni rab bsgrubs chad pa'i slad/ /de ni rgyal po'i skyes bus bzung / /chad pa'i gya sambha bāta pasgo brnya nā gā ra batrī āoṃ/ / ta dṛnghru mā ya yu de bā dngos po med pa 'u na/ /btson khang dag tu bzhag ste (snye bcings/ /mtshan mo brgya byen tshangs pa krusogs/ /rā tre shakra bradmā da yaḥ/ /sa tairbha rna kṛ hā bee ti prabee to nā gra hādma dā/ /lha rnams de la blta 'uru 'ongs/ /de dag gis gsol nor long zhes/ /gang tshe de yis ma blangs pa/ /ta dā dhasgro pa de shā yo pra thrarghaṃ ta gya mandi ye/ /rā dzā pi tattha bhā bee na de tshe de yi khang par ni/ /chos bstan pa las bsags pa 'phel/ /de yi mthu yis rgyal pos kyang / /dṛṭwā bra dzā li tai pu ram̐/ /mulnga tai banta nā gā rānda da darsha na lo kwa tsita/ /grong khyer rab tu 'bar mthong nas/ /btson ra nas ni de btang tshe/ /gang du'ang me ni mthong ma gyur/ /sa ga taḥsu ga tai dṛhūṃ ka dā tsittahphu raḥsbi taḥ/ /dṛ baṃ dzi na pra shā mā ya nam zhig bde gshegs blta ⑥ru ni/ /phyin nas de mdun 'khod pa des/ /mi bdag rgyal la phyag 'tshal pāpta pa rtswa bye lo ka ya ta / /a gre bha ga ba ta :kre pra ṇa yo na sa slad—/ /phyi ⑦nas 'ongs pa mthong bar gyur/ /de yi 'asngon du bcom ldan la/ /phyag byas sa yi bdag byu teḥ/ /dza gahphu bye su pu ra taḥpū dza marta ti nā pa raḥ/ /dzi na ma mabye la min/ /'gro bas mchod 'os sngon du ni/ /gzhan la mchod par 'os pa min⑨// /mi bdag rgyal la 95—423

dṛ ba tiḥpra ṇa taḥswa pu raṅga taḥ/ /bi bā pa dzee kṛ ha pa te rā di de rab btud nas①/ /rang gi grong khyer dag tu song / /khyim bdag rang gi grong khyer las/ /gzhan du sha ni dzāta pu rāta/ /pra sā di ni su datta su de ba tā dṛ ba sto ta taḥ/ /sprugs zhes 37bka' yis bsgos/ /de nas legs sbyin dag la lha/ /rab tu dang bas mi bdag la/ /kṣu dra dzantu bhi rusmṛṣṭibyakre rda sha bee ṣā ku lo/ /sa trastastej-i paḥpābeeḥsrog chags phra mo rab spros tegru/ /so yi dug gis 'khrugs par byas/ /de dag gis btab mi bdag de/ /sā mā tyantaḥpu rā nu gaḥ/ /ga tā pra sā da yā mā sa su darghaṃ dzi na shā sa blon po btsun mo'i rjes 'brang mebacas/ /phyin nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa las/ /legs sbyin la ni dad nāta / /i ti sa sa ta ta pra tyā sadhyā pa rā mṛ ta nisgo ram̐ bha ga ba du di tai par byas/ /de ltar rtag tu nye bar gnas pas /ltamachog gi bdud rtsi dag gi tshogs/ /khyim gyi bdag po legs shīrnyi ste dze su datta kṛ hā dhi paḥ/ /swa mi ba la bha te bisna yā sa pra yā sbyin de yis bcom ldan gyis gsungs zhi ba bsten/ /dri med yid ldan rnams kyi mtha' ru gnas pas dben sa bi brje tai bi ma la ma na sā marnye bā sbo bi bee ka ma hā ni bye ma/ /pa'i gter chen ni/ /rang gi bzhin du gegs 67dang nyon mongs ngal dub rnam par spangs pas 'thob/ /i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yo ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing kṛ ha pa ti su daṭwā ba dā dzwa pañtsa tri shaḥpalla waḥ// //las khyim bdag legs sbyin kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //pha lo sa mā rna la bha ta sa dā turyā ti kṣa ṇa dā na sa hā ya tai yaḥ/ /sbyin pa'i grogs su skad cig su gyur pa/ /de dag sbyin bdag 'bras bu mtshungs pa 'thob/ /pa ro pa kā ra pra ṇa yorya tā rna nā pu bye karmā sa tsi ba twa me ti/ /gzhan la phan par brtson par zhugs rnams kyispyi/ /grogs su bsod nams las med mi 'gyur ro/ /95—424

rā bye pu rā bha ga ba te shra ba hūṃ dze ta kā na ṣpe/ /a nā tha piṇḍa dā rā bcom ldan rgyal ba mnyan yod kyi/ /rgyal byed tshal ni dga' bar sngon/ /mgon med zas sbyin gtsug ma bi hā rā bye ra ti dzi ṣpe/ /kau shām bye batpa dṛ pa tirba khyu bo da ya lag khang / /kun dga' ra bar mngon 47dgyes tshe/ /rka shām bir /37 bad sa yi/ /mi bdag 'char byed nā bhi dhaḥ/ /gā ya byu tyā yatrīrghaṃ bi byā dha ra ba dhu dza naḥ/ /a bha ces pa byung / /rig 'dzin bu mo'i skye ba rnguyis/ /da lta'ang gang gis (chogrags pa sgrogs/ /de yi babeeṣa ye ta gya kasthānta ka ra dzre ba naḥ/ /kṛ ha sāḥsu dha no nā ma yul du khyim pa ni/ /las mtha'i 'byung gnas kyis 'tsho ba/ /nor bzang zhes bya nor dag ni/ /sgrub la dha āoṃ dhwa na bi tsakṣa ṇaḥ/ /dṛ paḥka dā tsi dā sthā ṣpe tai kātyābee na mā ga tai/ /rnam par mkhas par gyur/ /nam zhig bya ba don gnyer zhing / /mdun 'usar 'ongs pa mi bdag gis/ /ba tsa se ba pa ri dzñā ya dza gā da bi hi tā da raḥ/ /dzā nā mya haṃ kṛ ha pa te hūṃ tshig nyid kyis ni yongs shes nas/ /gus pa bskyed de de la smras/ /khyim bdag gser ni yongs bsags hi ra stso pa tsita swa ram̐/ /bi pu laḥpañtsa ya dzha gya su ba ṇḍi ni bye pa—/ /khyod kyi dbyangs ni bdag gis shes/ /gsog ⑥pa shes pa khyod la ni/ /gser gyi gter chen raste te/ /i tyāktaḥs smi lta rā dzñā sa ta mū tse kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /sa tya maste yangs pa yod/ /rgyal pos 'dzum bcas 'di brjod tshe/ /de la thal sbyar des smras pa/ /rgyal po bdag ba me rā dzan kṛ he kāñtsa na sañtsa yaḥ/ /sabye tta tsiddhā ni ra te de be gi khyim na gser/ /bsags pa bden par yod pa nyid/ /mnyes gshin yangs pa dam pa yi/ /spyod bātpa lya pe sha le/ /kisthā nāste dza na snga su pi ta ri twa yi gopta ri/ /dha ni no yārmya tshul bsam pa la chags lha/ /yab khyod kyis ni bsrungs pa yi/ /skye bo 'di la ci zhig med/ /gal te mi dha na tī ni dha rna yārnyi tsā dha nāḥ / / byā ghra hūṃ yā ti tsebye j-i dā bdag brtse ba med/ /zang zing la snom stag ltar 'gyur⑩/ /nor ldan rnams ni nor med 'gyur/ /95—425

mi ṣā sthā ṇa nij-i ṇaḥ/ /ni shaṃ kai rardzu te bitta mardzi tañtsa bi bha bye te/ /nor med rnams ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mi bdag chos kyi nor ldan na/ /dogs pa med pas ①skye bo rnams/ /bi bha s+ho bhu bye te spa ṣṭi dza ṣpe rbha nd+ra dha ṣpe dṛ bai / / u pa pa rja nor bsgrub (37bsgrubs pa'ang 'god byed cing / /bgos pa gsal bar longs spyod byed/ /blo ldan de yi snyeb tsaḥshu tā dhī ma tasta su bhu pa tiḥ/ /ta mū tse da sha no bye tiḥpra sa tshig dag ni/ /phun tshogs sa bdag gis thos nas/ /so yi 'od kyis ④bka' drin ni/ /gsal bar rda darsha yarnyi ba/ /ma ti mān kārya sa tsi ba ste me bha bi tu marta si/ /dhī dhū bee byed bzhin de la smras/ /bdag gi bya ba'i blon por ni/ /blo gros ldan pa khyod 'gyur 'os/ /blo stobs stabeebye re ba dhwarlu te dha ra bhā bha raḥ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsaḥshu tā ldan pa khyod lta bus/ /'dzin byed khur ni snye'adzin par byed/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /nor su dha nasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /na ba yo rā dza se bā su sa bhā maṇḍa na paṇḍi tāḥ/ /bzang gis ni de la smras/ /bdag ni rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor la/ /mdun 'usar mdzes pa'i mkhas pa min/ /swātstshabhyodmā na bi tstsha daḥsu ni dra su kha bi kra yaḥ/ /se ba hi thu sī saṃ g.yog ni skyes bu rnams dag gi3/ /rang dbang skyed tshal rnam par gcod/ /bde ba'i gnyid dang bde sā ra duḥ kha de n+ya bha ya kra yaḥ / / yī shwa rirma sta ka n+ya sta tsa ba 'tshong / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bkren 'jigs nyo/ /g.yog po dag ni rkang stegs bzhin/ /rtag ra ṇaḥkṛ ta kṛ tya tsā/ /pā da pi ṭha i bā yā ti se ba kophoha dzre taḥs dā/ /se tu 'og na gnas pa yi/ /mgo la dbang phyug zhabs bkod na/ /bya ba byas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /g.yog bā yā sa pra yā se na pāṭwā na ma pi saṃ pa dzā/ /saṃ sgo gaḥpi shu na gi nyon mongs ngal dub kyis/ /phun tshogs thob pa'ang ⑧longs spyod kyang / /phra ma can dang 'grogs pa saṃ gi pra bhu zla bha ṅga bha dku ra ཿ / / e tā swa nā ba ti ṣṭha rnye pra yi—/ /rje bo'i ⑨byun ma 'khyog pos g.yo/ /gzung 1 stedaka'i gdon bzhin mi bdag gi /phun 95—426

yasne na j-i tā a pi/ /dbo gra durga ha grwa ha durga hā dṛ pa sadza tshogs drag rtag ①gzung dka' ba/ /'di dag rab tu 'bad pa yis/ /bzung yang nges par mi gnas daḥ—/ /kṣa rṇa na ba na ba bye ṣa bi bye ṣa pra ṇa yodma tāḥ/ /a bā ra bā so—/ /'byor pa gsar pa gsar pa ni/ /'du 'bral mdza' gcugs rtsom pa dag /mi bzlog 27smad ra ra ma bhā ra ma bhā yā bi byu ta yaḥ/ /i trukta pra ti ṣe bye pi 'tshong mdzes pa khye bzhin/ /skad cig dga' bar bya ba yin/ /zhes smras rab tu bkag gyur kyang / /sa rā dzñā sa tsi baḥkṛ taḥ/ /a ti krā ma ti ko nā ma pra bha beekṣiṃḥs mbi hi tai/ /rgyal pos de ni blon por byas/ /jo bo mchog tu bzhed pa la/ /nges par su zhig 'da' bar byed/ /pāpta thra zwa pa rda rā dzñā mbi tai saddhā bye kā ri tī/ /bi dzwa ṣa du ṣi tāḥsarbe rgyal pos kun gyi gnyer gtad cing / /shin tu che ba'i gnas thob ste(pya/ /rnam par sdang bas sun 'byen marnyi ṇa na ste si hi re/ / dha dzre dzi dzñā sa yā rā dzñā pi shu na pre pa'i—/ /blon po rnams kyis bzod ma gyur/ /phra ma can gyis bskul ba yi/ /rgyal pos chos ni brtag ri te na saḥ/ /ṣpe pā ka ro da saṭwārya ni yusto pi pu naḥpu naḥ/ /ā ghā haṃ pre kṣi 'dod nas/ /dam pa'i bya ba min pa'i las/ /yang yang bskos kyang des ma byas/ /de nas mi bdag khro taḥsophotha mi byā ko ba na byu ju dzā/ /ta thā pya dhand+ra saṃ yutta na shā sa rdzun gyis/ /de ni gsod (srosnadu bskul bar gyur/ /de lta na yang chos min dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i na ma n+ya tā/ /e ka dzadma su khā yi ba ba hu dzadma sha tārdi rtu/ /na sā dhu bka' ma mnos/ /skye ba gcig nyid bde ba'i slad/ /skye ba brgya mang nyams 'gyur ba/ /smad pa'i las ninda tai ka1 ka ro mbi ti dzā ga da saḥ/ /bha ya dharmo pa dhwa shudheḥpra nyi ni dge ba bdag /mi bgyid do zhes de yis smras/ /chos kyis 'jigs shing cho 'brang gtsang / /de ni sa muktaḥs bhū ju dzā/ /dā na sha tri ma beestsorja ma ka ro da khi labee rmā/ /sarba bdag gis rab btang / /slong ba rnams ni ma lus la/ /rgyun chad med pa'i sbyin khang byas/ /grags 95—427

tra bi khru te ta su dā na sha tri ya sha sri naḥ/ /kalpa bṛkṣu da raḥsum̐ sī pa snyan ldan pa de yi ni/ /sbyin khang kun tu grags pa'i tshe/ /dpag bsam shing la skyes bu rnams/ /gus ram̐ pra ta nu tī ya yo/ /a tā nta re mu ni ga ṇast+riṭwāṭwā dakṣi rja pa (3)mchog tu chung bar gyur/ /gnas skabs der ni thub pa'i tshogs/ /'jug ngogs don gnyer lho pa thāta/ /ā ga ta kṛsgo kāddhā ra ma pi shan ni rdza rna ba āoṃ/ /ta tra j-iṣṭhartu phyogs nas/ /'ongs pa 'brog dgon nyam nga ba/ /skye bo med pa'i gnas su zhugs/ /der ni thams rā ཿ sa rbe mū tstsha tā ཿ sha ya na shri tā ཿ / / a yā tsinta dza lo mo cad skom pas gzir/ /brgyal zhing mal stan la brten pas/ /sems med la yang rgongs pa las/ /hā dru:rnibye ta nā ma pi/ /de ba gandhaza nā ge bhyaḥkashyidmolhatra da yī bu dhiḥ/ /skad chen (zhe7chu ni rab tu blangs/ /lha dang dri za klu rnams las/ /brtse ba'i chu gter su zhig 'dir/ /sbi ta pra yatstsha tu dza lo sophosmra ka mi ti te bru ban/ /ta taḥs ratna ka yu raḥgang gnas de yis bdag cag la/ /chu rab rtsol zhes de yis ①smras/ /de nas rin cen dpung rgyan rjokwa ṇa ka kaṅka ṇa dhwa niḥ / /bhu dzā sakta ho ma z-i ṅgā rasta ru ma can—/ /gser byi dril chung sgra sgrogs shing / /lag pas gser gyi chu snod gzung / /shing gi dbus nas dhyaji nirya yo/ /te tasmra da mṛ tā swa rda pā ṇi padmā ba na mi tāta/ /ā kaṇḍi byung bar gyur/ /lag pa'i padmas btud de las/ /bdud rtsi myang ④bzhin de dag gis/ /mgrin pa'i sa li lo rpā tā dza dzdza 6rluddhā dzre bi tāḥ/ /pra thi taḥpu na ra bye tya pa bar du chu 'thungs nas/ /'tsho ba thob cing dga' bar gyur/ /ya mtshan ldan pa de dag rnams/ /chas prasgoste sa bisma yāḥ/ /a dṛ shya bṛkṣa ni la yā dusgo tai ko bha ba ni ti/ /te slar yang mngon phyogs te⑥/ /mi mthong shing gi gnas dag las/ /des 'thon khyod ni su zhes dris/ /sophobra bīta bi shu ta ya shāḥshra bsgyu mā shra yaḥshri yaḥ/ /a nā tha piṇḍa do nā ma de yis smras pa mnyan yod na/ /snyan par grags pa dpal gyi meganas/ /mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya ba/ /95—428

da bye kumbha pra tsā ra kaḥ/ /tasgo dza nadhe saṃ shāpta swalpa she ṣānda sgo dza zho yi bum pa 'grim byed cing / /de dag gsol ba mthar phyin tshe/ /zas lhag chung ngu za bar ṣpeḥ—/ /rbhakhyu ṇi go ra bo dā ram̐ dṛṭī haṃ rā dza sgo dza rna/ /ātpa nartswanda pakṣu gyur①—/ /dge slong rnams la rgyal po'i zas/ /zhe sa rgya che ldan pa dang / /bdag nyid la ni zas ngan ra ma bha ba khinda mā na saḥ/ /a nā tha paṇḍi da gi rā sgo dza ṣpe go dag /mthong nas bdag yid buskyo bar gyur/ /mgon med zas sbyin tshig gis ni/ /zas la gus pa'i ra bā sha yāḥ/ /ta to ma yābyeg yulte kṛ tī tai po ṣa dzha bra tai/ /a bsam pa yis/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gso sbyong gi/ /brtul zhugs de nas bdag gis blangs/ /de sa mābee pra te nā tha bhuste lo lyadma yā ni shi/ /te nā ha ma bha paṃ lo ke nas brtul zhugs ma rdzogs pas/ /sred pas bdag gis spyomatshan mo zos//de yis bdag ni 'jig rten bi dzñā ta khaṇḍa po ṣa dhaḥ/ /khaṇḍi nā pi bra te na haṃ de ba pu tra twa du—/ /gso sbyong nyams par rnam par grags/ /brtul zhugs nyams pa de yis kyang / /bdag ni lha yi mā ga taḥ/ /i ti te tadma tsa khru tā mu na yoḥbismi tā ya yuḥ/ /a byudha yan pra bu nyid gyur/ /de yi tshig de thos gyur nas/ /thub pa de dag ya mtshan gyur/ /de dag 'gro zhing rab dzanta ste tī bre ṇa ta pa sā ba yo/ /su tsi ram̐ ke ba lo kli ṭwā nā bsams pa/ /dka' thub drag pos bdag cag rnams/ /yun ring nyon mongs 'ba' zhig gyur/ /da byā pi ku sha la spri shaḥ/ /ma dhū nā po ṣa sgo pābye bra ta me ba ya tā ma he/ /dung dge la reg pa med/ /da ni gso sbyong brtul zhugs nyid/ /rab tu bsgrub la 'bad par bya/ /ni ra pā ya su kho pā ye swa hi ti ka gya nā da raḥ/ /i ti sa:nta yanta ste gnod pa med cing bde ba'i thabs/ /rang la phan la su mi gus/ /de ltar bsams shing de dag ni/ /ko shaṃ bī ma bye to ga taḥ/ /su dha na mya kṛ haṃ pā purbi khru tai kṛ ha me ko'u shām bīr gtad nas song thu/ /khyim na gnas pa nor bzang gi④/ /khyem ni grags dang ldan 95—430

bye naḥ/ /ta tra te na kṛ tā ti bya ni bi byāsmi ta dand+ra tai/ /a nā tha paṇḍi rda dṛhūṃ par phyin/ /des der mgron gyi bya ba byas/ /de la rmad byung de dag bshad/ /mgon med zas sbyin blta te nai ba sa hi ta ya yuḥ / / shra ba sgyudhe sa mā sā rya pū dzi tā ste ba'i slad/ /de dang lhan cig ①nyid du song / /mnyan yod du ni yang dag phyin/ /de rnams de yis na sa da ram̐/ /asmi n+ya be da yan sarde ya thā dṛṣṭi ya thā khru tai/ /sa tā na gus bcas mchod/ /de la ji ltar mthong ba dang / /ji ltar thos pa thams cad bshad/ /brtul zhugs pra tabee naḥsarpān su dṛ rda su dha nañtsa tai/ /ni nā ya dhadzre sa bi tsaḥdon gnyer de kun dang / /grogs po nor bzang de yang ni/ /chos kyi grogs dang ( 7mdza' ba yis/ /bye ti bha ga ba tornyi ka/ /bha ga bā na pi tabye kyāstsokre ta ṣā ma nu gra haṃ/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du khrid/ /de yi tshig gis de dag rnams/ /bcom ldan kyis kyang rjes su bzung / /sa tya darsha na saṃ budha ye na te su ga ti ya yuḥ/ /te 6 yā te 6 gang gis de dag bden pa mthong / /yang dag rtogs shing bder bgrod gyur/ /de dag song tshe bcom su dha rna pa kṣa pā tā rngu ya dṛ sha /bi lo kya bha ga bān samyaka bi ldan gyis/ /phyogs lhung brlan pa'i spyan gyis ni/ /nor bzang nyid la rnam gzigs nas/ /yang dag da dhe dzñā na bhā dza 8/ /sa tya saṃ darsha nā bābee bi she ṣa ku sha lo da yaḥ/ /ga twa ye shes ldan par mdzad/ /bden pa yang dag mthong ba thob/ /khyad par dge ba rgyas pa de/ /song nas dzi nā ya kau shaṃ sde sa bi hā ra ma kā ra yata/ /yasmrabye ga ba tā diṣṭa rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang / /ko'u rngushām bīr byed du bcug /gang phyir bcom ldan gyes bskos pas/ /ta smin yā taḥs hā ya tī/ /byekṣubyund+ra bhe dhasta smrata so bhūdzunda bi hā ra der ni grogs byal 'ongs gyur pa/ /dge slong skul byed de phyin des/ /skul byed (ltagatsug lag khang zhes bhuḥ—/ /rā dhwa bhi dhwa da dbyā sī bi hā ra pa ri tsā ra kā/ /da ya yā bha ga gyur—/ /gtsug lag khang skyong 'bangs mo ni/ /mgu byed ces pas phul ba yi(6she/ /gos hrul de la brtse 95—431

dharma dru to yaḥs e bo da ya no dṛ paḥ/ /saṃ dzñā ni de ba ko ya: ku ku raḥsu kyi ①pho nya gang / /de nyid mi bdag 'char byed yin/ /gang zhig brda ni rig (byebyed pa'i/ /khyi de yang ni dha no pi saḥ/ /rā dzñā gho ṣe ṇa bi dzñā to gho ṣi la pa ra nā mā bhū ta/ /tsa ri nor bzang ngo / /rgyal pos zhustegadangs las shes pas na/ /gdangs can zhes pa ming gzhan gyur/ /de ltar ta mi kyu tsi tai bha ba bhe di nā bha ga ba tā ka thi tai ki la bhekṣa baḥ/ /yid ni legs pa rnams kyi spyod pa dag /rigs par srid pa 'bigs byed bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /su kṛ ta sau ra bha sā ra su dhwa ra saṃ su ma na sā shra ba shā ñdza li bheḥlegs byas dri bzang snying por ldan pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsan pa'i snyim pas 'thungs pa puḥ / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra bee ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa tā ba dā na par grags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa rnyidapag kalpa la tā lnga gho ṣi khā ba dā dzā ṣast+ri shaḥpalla waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las gdangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa 57drug pa'o// //bi budhe sa ra si padma sho bha te saṅka dzadmāḥshu tsi pa ri sa ra dzā tsā smṛ lha yi rdzing bu dag tu 'dam las skyes pa'i chu skyes mdzes/ /yongs bskams gtsang 'usar skyes pa'i shya te na stha la dzdza/ /sa ha dza pa ri tsi tā dzā ni tya mantarga tā dzā bha ba ti si padma dag la reg mi byed/ /lhan skyes yongs su 'dris shing rtag tu nang na —gnas gyur pa/ /dkar ba'i ḍakyitā gu rja rghaṃ ka ra rte nai ba dzā tiḥ/ /shra bahūṃ sadzee satā rghaṃ swa sti yon tan rnams kyi byed po rigs ni min pa nyid6sna/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal na sngon/ /sems can dhyā na pa ra ya ṇi/ /dzi na kalpa dru ma dze ta ba nā rā masbi ti pu rā/ /kun la shis pa yi/ /bsam gtan rjes su skyong byed cing / /rgyal ba dpag bsam shing bzhugs tshe/ /shurpā ra kā khye na ga re ratna pañtsa ya sā ga raḥ/ /bha bo nā mā bha band+rarba grong khyer slob ⑩ma lta bur ni/ /ded dpon blo ldan rnams kyi mchog /rin chen bsags pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /95—433

pa tirma tai ma hūṃ ba raḥ/ /bha bi lo bha ba bha drabya bha ba nadhī tsa bi khru tāḥ/ /ke ta rkyu 'byor pa zhes pa byung bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma ke ta ki/ /zhes pa la ni bu gsum byung / /'byor len ①ta gya dzā yā yī ba zla busta na yant+ra yaḥ/ /ro ga yo gā du pa ga taḥ dang ni 'byor bzang dang / /'byor pa dga' zhes grags pa'o/ /nam zhig de ni nad kyis btab/ /sa ka dā tsirlu rūrṣa hūṃ/ /pā ru 6j-i sha mubeesne ཿpasbyi pu tre ru bee kṣi 'chi ba 'dod cing nye bar gyur/ /mchog tu rtsub cing chags bral bas/ /chung ma bu rnams dag gis taḥ / /bhasgyu dā se tu ta sri kā pa ri tsatyā pa ra pa ram̐/ /malli kā khya bha baṭwā spangs—/ /de yi (②'bangs mo phreng ldan ma/ /zhes pa gcig gis gus pa yis/ /ji srid rnal du gnas bta sa ya bta swāsbya ma yayo/ /sne ho pa kā ra pra ṇa taḥkṛ ta dzhaḥpa ta yā gyur pa/ /de srid rim gro mchog tu byas/ /mdza' zhing phan pas rab btud kyepa/ /byas shes de ni de nī taḥ/ /ṛ to saṃ ga ma bye tya ta ta sngaḥpu tra ma dzre dza na ta/ /ya dā tasgo ni pi tuḥdang ldan/ /zla mtshan dus su 'grogs gyur pas/ /de la bu ni btsas par gyur/ /gang tshe de skyes pha yi saddhāṭwāḥpurṇa tai ya yuḥ/ /sa ta dā puṇḍi nā mā bhūbye laḥpūrtend+ra punda raḥ/ /ni—/ /nor ④kun gang ba nyid du gyur/ /byes pa zla nya ltar mdzes de/ /de tshe gang po zhes par gyur/ /dzrejont+ra yaḥkṛ tobye ha ya yu rabhi rnya nābee naḥ/ /pūṇḍistu bhaṇḍa shā lā lnga phu bo gsum gyis chung ma blangs/ /rgya mtshor nor don gnyer du song / /gang pos pha yi tshong khang du/ /pi tubya kre dha nā rja dzwa/ /ta taḥpra ti ni dṛṭwāste pābhāṭwāḥsā ga rākhru naḥ/ /'dug nas nor gyi bsgrub pa byas⑤/ /de nas de dag nor thob ste/ /rgya mtsho las kyang grong khyer du/ /ga ṇa rpā he ma lakṣu rde kṛ tā swa mu di re pu re/ /sa mu dra ga ma ṣpe te beer log gser ni 'bum phrag rnams/ /bgrang bar byas te dga' bar gyur/ /de dag rgya mtshor bgrod ṣe yā bā nā sīdzha nā ga maḥ/ /pūṇḍi gya swa kṛ he pa byerba khyu bā bye dhi kasta taḥ/ /pa la/ /nor ni ji snyed byung gyur pa/ /rang gi khyim du gang po la/ /de las lhag pa zong gis byung / /95—434

tī—/ /so pi pūṇḍi dha naḥkā le shī ta saṃ ku tsi tai pa che/ /da darsha kṛṣṭha byas—/ /de yang nor gyis gdung ①dus su/ /lam du so ka'i ①tsha ba la'ang / /grang bas 'khongs kyetā pe pi bi ba shaṃ dā ru bhā re rka /a dā ya dā ru rū phye na sa tasmra ta shing nyen pa yis/ /shing ni khur ba dag gcig ④)mthong / /de yis de las shing gi ni/ /rin gyis shing dā ru bhā ra shaṃ/ /di bya tsanda na ma dru khye ta da ha na snga pi shī ta rda/ /su kṛ te ṣpe gi khur po blangs/ /sreg byed la (sheyang bsil ster ba/ /lha yi tsandan dag tu mthong / /legs byas chen ba ma hā ta te na la ddhā ma hā dha naḥ/ /sa se byaḥsārja bā hā ram̐ pū bye po nyid kyis bzhin/ /de yis nor chen thob pas de/ /ded dpon rnams kyis bsten bya ste/ /sa yi bhudṛ thi bī pa teḥ/ /ratna ka ra pa ṣaṭa kṛ twaḥpra yā taḥsazla dophobee dzā/ /bdag pos mchod byar gyur/ /slong ba rnams la kun ster des/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lan drug bgrod/ /tsa kā ra sand+ra bā ni rdzu ta ra shulbā rya nu gra haṃ/ /shā bste bā si bhiḥsārja tshong pa kun gyi gru btsas dang / /sho gam la sogs rjes bzung byas/ /slar yang mnyan yod na gnas pa'i⑥//ba ṇisgoḥpu na rabee taḥ/ /ya yo pra ba ha rja rū bhāḥs mu dra dī pa mā don mthun tshong pas gsol btab nas/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du mgyogs par de(kye/ /gzings la rab tu zhon shu saḥ/ /pra tyā thraste pra ba ha ṇi so3tha shu shā ba gā ya hūṃ/ /ba ṇi rdzu nas song / /de nas gzings ni slar log tshe/ /tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i phyiradu/ /bde gshegs sthā ba rī shi la gā thāḥsu ga ta saṃ shra yāḥ/ /ka sri tā i ti te te na thraṣṭha sattha la brten tshong pa rnams/ /glu ru len pa de yis thos/ /'di ni su yis zhes des ⑨dris/ /de dag kun ba bhā ṣi re/ /e tā bha ga ba tā gī tā gā thā budhe na dhī ma tā/ /gyis legs smras pa/ /'di dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /blo ldan gyis gsungs tshigs su bcad/ /i ti buddhā bhi ṅgā me ba khru tā harṣa ma bā pa saḥ/ /sum̐ sī swa bā sa nā rū ces pa sangs rgyas mtshan thos nas/ /de yis dga' ba thob par gyur/ /skyes bu rang la bag chags 95—437

bhā byatta mā yā kyu dī ri tai/ /taibeesta re ṇa ka thi tā mā kakhyu bha ga gnas—/ /brjod pas gsal ba nyid du gyuraṭwā/ /de dag gis ni rgyas bshad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das wa ta ka shaṃ/ /sophobha battaṅga ta ma nā ta darsha na sa musgo kaḥ/ /sa sha ṣpespyo kyi gtam dag des/ /thos nas de la yid song ste/ /de ni lta (mibar 'dod par gyur/ /rim byis khyim ha mā ga tya tyaghā sadzee pa ri tstsha rda/ /a nā tha piṇḍa rda drabye shā ba du 'ongs nas des/ /yo byad thams cad yongs btang ste/ /grogs po mgon med zas sbyin ni/ /lta ru āoṃ su j-i rda ya yo/ /a bhi lā ṣe ni bee ryasmi pra bra dzñā yī dzi tend+ra yaḥ/ /dza mnyan du yod par song / /rab tu byung khrobar mngon 'dod pa/ /de la dbang po thul bas bshad/ /de gā ma sa hi taste na bhasthā bha ga ba tornyishaṃ/ /dṛbye be ta tra sarba rnyi dag lhan cig gus pa yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song / /gti mug mun pa nyin mor byed/ /mo ha dhwanta di bā ka re/ /tatyā da baṇḍi ṣpe ṣpe ba me ṣpe sa kṛ ta kṛ tya hūṃ/ /kun mkhyen der ni des mthong nas/ /de yi zhabs mthong nyid na des④/ /bya ba byas pa nyid du bsams/ /bi pta ya ta gya bha ga bān saṃ kalpanta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /de sha na byosgo ya kutthan de yi brtag ⑤pa bcom ldan byis/ /rnam par mkhyen nas de la ni/ /phyogs rnams chems kyi zla 'od kyis/ /bi bee ka bi ma lā di shaḥ/ /e nyi bhikhyo ni rā rmā kṣe nirbi bakṣe kṣa dri med dben par mdzad cing gsungs/ /dge slong tshur shog dogs med cing / /mi mthun phyogs bral yo zlo te/ / ā khyu te dha nd+ra bee na ye bra hma tsabye tsa re spru tai / /nyams pa spangs/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul la/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad 'dod pa'o/ /i ti pra sā da shī le na dzi ṣpe no dī ri te pu raḥ/ /pra bra bye sa ha mee bā gya zhes (khye pa rab dang ngang tshul gyis/ /rgyal bas sngon du brjod pa'i tshe/ /de yi lus la 'phral nyid du/ /pa pā tā lakṣi tā ta no/ /ta taḥs sha tro mi tre tsa pra sha mā ta sa ma hūṃ shri taḥ/ /mtshon pa med par rab byung lhung / /rab tu zhi las dgra dang ni/ /grogs la mtshungs par bsten pa des⑦//95—438

shastuḥshā sa na mā dā ya pra ṇi pa tya dza gā ma tai/ /sho rja pa rānta ka mā ma de ston pa'i bka' ni rab bzung nas/ /de la phyag ni btsal ①te song / /sro na'i pha rol 'gram zhes yul/ /shaṃ hrū ra dza nā shra yo/ /swa yo pa rīkṣi ḍū kṣurnyi dzee ṣpe na sa ha sa mā ya yo/ /ma rungs skye bo'i gnas su ni/ /rang nyid bzod pa yongs rtog cing 7 —sna/ /skye bo dag dang lhan byug song / /ta tā dṛṭwā ta ma yānti mṛ ga yā yā maṅga lo/ /lubha kabyu sa mā kṛ 6 ri dwags shor ba la mi shis/ /de ni de nas 'ongs (7mthong nas/ /rngon pa rnams kyis ④gzhu bkang ste/ /habye kro dhwa ta sa mu dra bta/ /nibee kā ram̐ ni rubye shaṃ sa tai bi ga ta sā dhwa saṃ/ /khro bas gsod par yang dag gzas/ /rnam 'gyur med cing mya ngan med/ /'jigs pa dang ni bral ba stertesnye/ /pra ha re ti bru bā ṇañtsa dṛbye ba sha mā mābee bān/ /shā mya tasta gya sa ha gya pra snun cig ces kyang brjod mthong nas/ /de dag zhi ba thob par gyur/ /rngon pa 'phral la zhi gyur pa/ /sā dī lubha ka gya saḥ/ /dhadzrendi de sha ye nā sau bo dhi pā ba sa hā nu giḥ/ /de la rab tu dang ldan ⑥des/ /gang gis de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /byang chub rtogs byed chos bstan to/ /sa ta tra su ga tāṭwā rde sarbo pa ska ra sadza dām/ /sha tā ni pañtsa ra myu rde der ni bde gshegs la 'os pa'i/ /yo byad thams cad phun tshogs kyi⑦/ /gtsug lag khang ni nyams bi hā rā rja ma ka ra yata/ /sgozlo pi dzñā na saṃ pūṇḍi prasta ste da sha dga' ba/ /lnga brgya dag ni de yis 'u7byas/ /gang po'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs/ /skabs gsum pa yis pū bye tām/ /bai rā gya laglu yusto bhūn mu mbi dzñā smṛ ha rji ya yā/ /a tha mchod bya thob/ /thub pa rnams kyis posna dgyes bya ba/ /chags bral dpal dang ldan par gyur/ /de nas ta snga gra dzā ju tā bha pi laḥspyi ṇa bitta hūṃ/ /kā le no pa ga taḥpra ya ta sa de yi ⑪ sngon skyes spun/ /'byor ldan dus kyi nor rnams ni/ /zad pa nyid du rab gyur te/ /nor gyi mu dro dra bi shā sha yā/ /ta taḥpra ba ha shā rū byeḥso3nu kyu rṣas mbi ra ṇiḥ/ /go bsam pas rgya mtshor song / /de nas de ni gzings la zhon/ /rjes mthun yang dag g.yo ba yis go 95—439

shirṣa tsanda na ba rna pra pi ta swalpa bā sa riḥ/ /ku bye ri ka sha testa smin pañtsa shīrṣa yi tsandan nags1/ /nyi ma nyung ngus sleb par gyur/ /sta re thogs pa lnga brgya yis/ /der ①ni bhibyetta mu rya te/ /tastsonda na ba dzwa di bye bhu dza ga ga ṇa saṃ ku lo/ /ta mchog gi tsandan nags/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyas gyur pa/ /de la gcod par zhugs pa'i tshe/ /de taḥswā mi yakṣa se nā dzā ma he shwa ra i ti shu taḥ/ /ko pā du da sri dza tai gho re kā nas gnod sbyin sde yi rje/ /dbang phyug chen po zhes grags pa/ /khros te 'jigs pa'i rlung chen ni/ /ka li kā khye ma hā ni lo/ /ma ru tā te na ma hā tā pā pi tāḥpā ṇa saṃ sha yo/ /tsa krand+rattha li ka zhes bya ba spros/ /rlung ni chen por gyur pa des/ /srog la the tshom thob gyur pa/ /tshong pa kun gyis (kyiṇi dzaḥsabye shadzee sha kra mu khān su rān/ /tā nārtu ra ba mu kha rān bha bee laḥ0dbang phyug dang / /brgya byin la sogs lha rnams bos/ /mu cor gdung sgogs de dag la/ /don mthun sārja nā ya kaḥ/ /u bā tsa sañtsirgyu tsi ram̐ pa:ṭwā pa sa mā ku laḥ/ /'dren pa 'byor len ni/ /rjes su gdung bas 'khrugs pa yis/ /yun ring bsams nas rab smras pa/ /sgoṇḍiḥka byā yān 1 tā so hi tai ྾ rmā pu rā ba data/ /ba hu kle shopholpa su khaḥspun zla gzhon pa gang po des/ /phan 'dod bdag la sngon smras pa/ /nyon mongs mang zhing bde ba nyung / /kwa nu ganta byasta dzee bu byeḥ/ /a kṛ tādhī ma tasta gya ba tsa rna sa tya dargo naḥ/ /chu gter du khyod gang (snyel 'gro/ /blo ldan bden pa mthong gyur pa/ /de yi tshig ni ma byas pas/ /tsu tophohaṃ dha na lo bhe na sgo resmin bya sa nāṇḍi bee/ /shu two tadma ṇi dzaḥsarbe 'jigs rung sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir/ /nor la chags pas bdag lhung ngo / /de dag thos nas tshong pa bra bhā baṃ lo ka bi khru tai/ /pūṇḍi gya mā na sā rmya tā ta me ba sha ra khaṃ ya kunaske/ /gang po'i mthu ni 'jig rten du/ /rnam par grags pa yid la bsgoms/ /de nyid la ni skyabs yuḥ / /na mastu bye dza gasgre sha pi ṣa do ṣā sa ha ri ṇi/ /puṭwā yo su song / /'gro ba'i nyon mongs dug gi skyon/ /'phrog cing snying rje rgyas pa ⑥yi/ /bdud rtsis yang 95—440
