dīṇḍi ka ru rja su ṅgā saṃ pūṇḍi tse ta su/ /i bye ka swa rā ra bee ṇa te ྾ dag rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /gang po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa de dag rnams kyi sgra/ /dbyangs saṃ pū ri te ྅sbare/ /kṣa ṇi na ga tā taj-itrī pūṇḍi pā ha swa de ba tā/ /sgo gcig gis ni mkha' khengs tshe/ /skad cig la phyin de yi spyod①/ /gang po la smras rang gi lhas/ /sro ṇa pa rānta ka ga taḥshu tā te ṣe sa bee sla baṃ/ /byosna sa mā bye sandadheḥna'i pha rol 'gram gnas pa/ /de yis de dag bslad thos nas/ /ting 'dzin bsgrubs pas nam mkha' la/ /pā pa pra ba ha rde kṣa rjata/ /tasmin pa.oṃ ka babye na spru to me ru ri bā tsa laḥ/ /skad cig gis ni gzings can phyin/ /der ni de yis skyil krung bcas/ /lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo bas/ /pra la yoṭwā la bee ga gya ga ti bā yodzdza hā ra saḥ/ /pūrje na pa ba ṇi rurghaṃ dzñā 'jig dus rlung tshub ④lta bu yirngu / /rlung gi shugs kyis 'gro ba phrogs/ /gang pos rlung ni bkag pa dang (snye//tā yakṣa ga ṇa gra bhāḥ/ /tai pra sā da ya yo tyaghā te bhyastsanda na kā na oṃ/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyi gtso bos shes/ /de la dang bas tsandan nags/ /de dag rnams la btang nas song / /pūṇḍi pra sā dā dā dā ya bha bi la:nda na dru mān/ /z-iṣṭa ste ṣpe ba sa hi gang po'i drin byis tsandan shing / /'byor len dag gis blangs nas ni/ /rang gi ⑤grong khyer slob spyom taḥshu pā ram̐ swa pu re ya yo/ /pūrjephotha sasmaste bhā tu sta tra go shiste tsanda 'drar—/ /dga' bas de dang lhan cig song / /de nas gang pos spun la bgros/ /go shīrṣa lkuyi tsandan naiḥ—/ /tsakre tsanda na mā lā khye pra sā rda su ga to tsi tai/ /ta tra pūrje byus—/ /bde gshegs la 'os khang bzang der/ /tsandan phreng ba zhes pa byas/ /der ni gang pos na bha ga bān dhyā tathoṇḍi bi hā ya sā/ /sa mā ya yo dze ta ba nā bsams ④pa na/ /bcom ldan mgyogs par nam mkha' las/ /rgyal byed tshal nas dpag tshad brgya/ /duwaṃ sgya sha ta yo dza bhā/ /ā gatstsha to bha ga ba taḥpu raḥpra thra ta yā dza 'das nas yang dag byon par gyur/ /bcom ldan byon pa'i sngon du ni/ /sku yi 'od zer rab 'phros ky-ikye95—441

bha ba kle sho sbyi tai shri ta ཿ / / i ti pra ghā baṃ ka thi lta dzi ṣpe na rnams—/ /ma lus spangs pa'i dgra bcom bsten/ /de ltar bsod nams bsags pas rab bskrun pa/ /sgoṇḍi gya pu byo pa tsa ya pra bhā tai/ /shu tād ju tai saṃ sa di bhikṣu saṃ ghaḥpu gang po'i mthu ni rmad byung rgyal ba yis/ /mdun sar bshad pa thos nas dge 'dun stitshogs/ /bsod sgo pra saṃ shā bhe ra to ba bhu baḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye nams bsngags la mngon par dga' bar gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā lnga pū shlau ba dā rgo sa pta tri sha ཿdpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam rmi 'khri shing las gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu palla waḥ// //rtsa 27bdun pa'o// //ā kiñtsi n+ya su khā ya ni smṛ ha ta yā ba rā gya lakhro dzu ṣaḥ sarde ci yang med pa'i bde beed chags pa med pa 1chags bral dpal 'byor sten byed pa/ /thams cad yādhi bi hā ya kā ya sa tsi bāḥsantaḥpra shā: ba na/ /ta tā si bra ta ḍadza re btang nas lus kyi grogs ldan dam pa rnams kyi ④zhi slad nags su 'gro/ /der yang tshul 'chos brtul pa ri ka rā rartswa ya tsita pañtsa yastata kaḥko sha pa ristso do pa ka ra ṇiṅge zhugs dag la yo byad rtsom pa gal te gsog (snye byed na/ /mdzod kyi yo byad nyer mkho de dag rnams kyis khyim he3pa rā dhaḥkṛ taḥ/ /dzi ṣpe dze ta bā nā rā mā bi hā rā bhe ra taḥpu raḥ/ /du gnod pa ci zhig byas/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed gtsug lag khang / /kun dga' ra bar sngon bzhugs pas/ /shākya rā dza ku mā rā rde pra bra dzñā dzu ྾ pu raḥ/ / tsi tra ṭī ba ra satyā tra mdun du shākya'i rgyal po 6sternams/ /rab tu byung ba bsten pa yi/ /bkra ba'i gos dang dam pa'i snod/ /yo ga pa ṭwā di sañtsa yo/ /pra bhū ta ta ra mā lo kya bha ga bān sa ma pus 'khyud la sogs bsags pa dag /rab tu mang po gzigs gyur nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang 95—444

tsinta yata/ /a ho ba te ྾ nā rya pi bandha he tumbi babye/ /a bye mā na dag bsams/ /kye ma 'di dag da dung yang / /lus la sdug pa'i 6sheyo byad 'dzin/ /mngon par khengs ma yaḥkā ye pri yaḥpa ri ka ra gra haḥ/ /kā ye kā ya pa ri sthā rasta spyo pa pa'i rang bzhin gyes/ /'ching ba'i rgyu ni yongs dum zlog /lus la lus kyi chas rnams te/ /de la nye ka ra ṇa ba lbo/ /ta sngaḥpa ri kā rā dā na ma ho nu bandha shri kha lā/ /i ti bar mkho ba'i bsred⑦/ /de yi yo byad 'dzin pa ni/ /kye ma 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog yin/ /de ltar saṃ tsirgyu bha ga bān ṣpe kānta bi hi tasbi taḥ/ /kā ru bye du ba sand+ra byā bsams nas bcom ldan 'das/ /dben par gnas pa bsgrubs pa yis/ /nyer 'dzin rnams la snying rje ku sha khā ya sa mudma taḥ/ /mā pa tra ya mu ba sthā rgo kasto bye ye na las—/ /dge ba'i slad du yang dag brtson/ /dge slong rnams kyis mi mthong twoslad/ /zla ba gsum du ke na tsita/ /a darsha nā ya bhi gru shā ma ka ro di ti saṃ bi rda/ /pra dṛste ni la me bdag la ni/ /sus kyang nye bar gnas mi bya/ /zhes pa'i bgro ba mdzad par gyur/ /nges pa de la rab ta smin bhikṣu rā ra rgya ka bra taḥ/ /ā ya yā bu pa se nā byuḥkāryā zhugs tshe/ /dge slong dgon pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /chos gos dman ldan nye ba'i sde/ /zhes pa dzee ta nu ṭī ba raḥ/ /pra bā ri taḥs saṃ pā pya dha n+yaḥsu ga ta darsha rna/ /dgos pa'i sbad du 'ongs/ /rab zlog ⑤skal ba ldan pa des/ /bde gshegs mthong ba yang dag thob/ /kṛ ta kṛ tyaḥkṣa rṇa sbi twa sra ta sbe pa ṇi ba tya tai/ /bra dzanta me tya ba prasgo bya ba byas te skad cig 'dug /de la phyag 'tshal rab tu song / /dge slong rnams kyis bgrod de la/ /byekṣa baḥpa ri bārya tai/ / ta bārya darsha na ma ho datrī bha ga ba tā ka yongs bskor sngon rjodu phyin te dris/ /'phags pa khyod la bcom ldan gyis/ /kye ma mthong ba ji ltar rja / /mā sa tra yo darsha ṣpe gya ni ya maḥshā sa ṣpe na yaḥ/ /sa ka dzee bha ba tā gnang / /'di yi bka' la zla gsum du/ /dge 'dun dag gis mthong med pa'i/ /nges pa gang de lam 95byed445

bhasnaḥsaṃ gha phyodmārga gā mi nā/ /shu two ti pa tsa rna te ṣā mu pa se naḥmin nas/ /bgrod pa khrod kyis ji ltar bshig /de dag tshig de thos gyur nas/ /lhag par 'dzum zhing smi totta ram̐/ /tā nu tse na ma yā kabyeta kṛ taḥs ma ya bi bee baḥ/ /a ha musto nye sde yis/ /de dag la smras bdag gis ni/ /nges pa gang yang ①nyams ma byas/ /bdag ni blta ④bha ga ba tā darsha nā ba sa re swa yo/ /ā ra rgya ka gya me bhikkorje ba'i gnas skabs na/ /bcom ldan rang gis bka' stsal pa/ /dge slong dgon pa pa rnams ni/ /lta ba ṣe bye nāste darsha ṣpe/ /pa ri tstsha do pa ka ra ṇa tyā ga nirmukta brnya nāḥ/ /bdag ①gis bkag pa med/ /yo byad nyer mkho yongs btang zhing / /'ching ba dag las nges grol ba/ /a bārya darsha na bṛkṣa rū li kaḥpaṃ shu kyu li kā/ /i da ma rya pa ram̐ pā ta ri shing drung phyag dar khrod pa dag /lta ba dag ni bzlog ④pa med/ /lhung bzed chos gos tshogs rnams la/ /ti ye pañtsa ye re tāḥ/ /pā tra ṭī ba ra baṅge 6 te ྾ naste ha darsha rna/ /'di deng nang par gzhan no zhes/ /gang zhig bsags pa la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dir ni mthong ba med/ /sā tho dzhaḥ pra sa rabhu ṣā ra shi shi ri skṛ : tu raste pa ram̐ te nirngi gang zhig rab zhi'i brtul zhugs yo byad dag la 'bad pas mngon par khengs 'dis ⑤'ching / /de dag ghā ni dhwa na dhwa mbi bi thra to de tyā da lo du rga tā / / te ྾ tsandan rkang 'thung dag las yang dag gdung byed me ni nye bar bskrun⑥/ /kha bas rab rgyas tsa nda na pā du pā na ta ཿ sa nta pa ka ཿ pā ba ko ye re ṣa pā bsil ba'i chu rnams dag gis de dag mchog tu skom pas gdung / /myang 'das gegs mesha ma bra to pa ka ra ṇi brnyo bhi mā na gra haḥ/ /i kyukta mu pa se ṣpe na med gter gyi gnas la de dag bkren zhing phongs pa nyid du gyur/ /nye sdes de skad brjod thos nas/ /shu tā te shākya bhekṣa baḥ/ /bai la ghra kṣa yi tond+ra hāḥs ha se ba bya sbub yata/ /shākya'i dge slong de dag rnams/ /skyengs pas spro ba zad gyur pas/ /'phral la nyid du rnam par bsams/95—446

ga tā kā le su 6 be di bya lakṣa khaṃ/ /u da kā khyuḥs ba lo3bhūta saṃ dzā taḥs li lta bu'i bu/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa btsas par gyur/ /chu nang du skyes byis pa de/ /chu skyes zhes ni bya khānta re/ /bsgo mā ṇaḥpi tustu bye yo ba rā dzu ma no ra dzeeḥ/ /sha tā ni pa.āoṃ mā bar gyur/ /yab kyi rgyal tshab bzhed pa dang / /mtshungs pa nyid du che bar skyes/ /de ni skyes pa'i nyin tyā ram̐ ta gya dzadma di rgo sa rma/ /a bā pustu lya rū pa hūṃ pu tā rde par la/ /blon po lnga brgyas mtshungs par ni/ /gzugs ni mtshungs pa'i bu rnams dag /lnga brgya rab sha ta pañtsa shaṃ/ /ni dzee dzā ti sma raḥsmṛ tā pāspruṣṭi shi shuḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /a tsinta tu thob par gyur/ /rang gi skye dran byis pa des(17/ /rim gyes sngon byung dran gyur nas/ /bdag nyid yata pāpta kā lo hi tai su kṛ ta mātpa naḥ/ /ṣaṣṭha barṣa ṇi kṛ tā tu yo ba la phan legs byas kyi rī/ /dus la bab par yang dag bsams/ /lo ni drug cu tham par sngon/ /bdag rā bye ma hā pu rā/ /a bha baṃ kṛsgo saṃ taptashyi ram̐ na ra ka saṃ ka ṭi/ /gis — rgyal tshab byas pa na/ /mi bzad dmyal bar (thuyun ring du/ /nyam nga'i sdug bsngal gdung ba thob/ /dzadma n+yasminda pi bu narlo ba rā bye mu pa spru tai/ /sattha thā zwargya ma kho pi na beed nas skye ba 'di la yang / /rgyal tshab dedag ni nye bar gnas/ /rnam pa kun tu gsol btab kyang / /ka ri 6 mi bā ta shaṃ/ /i ti sañtsidhya sa tsi ram̐ rā bye sgo ga pa rādru bdag ni sdig pa mi byed do/ /zhes pa de yis yun ring gyebasams/ /rgyal srid longs spyod las phyir khaḥ / /pi tu rubye ga dzan bhā ma gra tī ta paṃ gu rū ka tsā/ /sathra la kṣa phyogs—/ /pha ni yid 'byung skyed )snabyed pa'i/ /lkugs pa 'phye bo bzung bar gyur/ /mtshan nyid thams ṇa yusto pi rā dza bṛ ste ra bhā dza rgo/ / sa mū ka paṃ gu nā ma byud cad ldan mod kyang / /rgyal po'i lugs kyi snod ma gyur/ /gnyen rnams sdug bsngal skyed 3byed de/ /ba ju dzñā duḥ kha ba sgo naḥ/ /pā ste 6 madhri su te 6 shant+ra shānt+ra ba lo lkugs pa'i 9sna'aphye bo zhes par gyur/ /mtshon dang bstan bcos stobs rgyas pa/ /blon po'i bu rnams kyis 95—448

kiñtsi ta bee tuḥpu raḥ/ /ta taḥkhyu ta pra ti kṣe pe ta myu diṣṭi ma tī byu dzā/ /so pha yi mdun du cang mi smra/ /de nas de la sa bdag gis/ /bshad pas rab smad bstan pa'i tshe/ /de ba da6 bā rā dā ṣpen baṅgi pabye pra dzā mi tsa/ /a thā su rā dzñā z-ibye na ba ra yis smras pa mchog ster 3na/ /bdag ni smra zhing rkang pas 'gro/ /de nas rgyal po dgyes pa yis/ /de dā ṣpe pra ti khru te/ /sa pargyu swa ya ma bye tya spaṣṭi pi ta ra ma bra bīta/ /la mchog ster rjes thos tshe/ /rang gi rkang pas mngon phyogs te/ /gsal bar pha la de yis 3smras/ /nā haṃ saṅgarna mū kolhahaṃ ṣpe ba tsā haṃ dza ḍā sha yaḥ/ /kintu dzadmānta ra kle bdag ni 'phye min bdag lkugs min/ /bsam pa blun bo'ang bdag min te/ /'on kyang skye ba gzhan shaṃ smṛ tā bee hwa lya mā shri ta ཿ / / yo ba ra bye su khaṃ bhu ghā ṣa ṣṭi nyon mongs/ /dran zhing rnam par 'khrugs la brten snye/ /lo ni drug cu bdag gis sngon/ /rgyal tshab pa /barṣa rgya haṃ pu rā/ /ṣaṣṭi bste sa ha sra ṇi n+ya ba san na ra ko da re/ /rā bde ba longs spyad ‘snyenas/ /lo ni stong phrag drug cu dag /dmyal ba'i nang du gnas par gyur/ /de dza dī tya ma yā tasthāta kṛ te yo mū ka saṅga tā/ /pra bra bye yā brahma tsa dro tsa beed bdag ni rgyal po yis/ /'jigs nas lkugs 'bye 'di nyid byas/ /rab byung tshangs par spyad pa dag/rā mye ṣa ba ro ma ma/ /i ti te nokta mā kasbya ta mu ba tsā tsa ma tī pa tiḥ/ /spyod pa 'di ni bdag gi mchog /ces pa de yis brjod thos nas/ /ma lkugs zhes pas dga' thob cing //a mū ka i tyā sta dṛ timbi rakta i ti duḥkhi taḥ/ /dhand+ra rū la mi rda rā rdzu chags bral zhes pas sdug bsngal ba'i/ /sa yi bdag pos de la smras/ /chos kyi rtsa ba rgyal srid 'di/ /pu tra na tyathi marta se/ /ya dzñā dā na pra dzā tra ṇiḥpu bye pūshlau dṛ pa shri bu kye btang bar mi 'os so/ /mchod sbyin sbyin pas skye rgu skyob 'u/ /mi bdag dpal ni bsod nams yaḥ / /e ka pu trasta yā pu tra pa ri tyā ga ra sā da haṃ/ /ni dru rdzogs—/ /bu gcig sa ‘)bdag bu khyod kyis/ /chags pa yongs su btang ba las/ /gnyid kyis kye795—450

da ri dra tsā mbi taḥsho ka sha spra sa mā shra yaḥ/ /saṃ puṇḍi tsand+ra ru tsi ram̐ byakta dbul ba thob gyur cing / /mya ngan mal stan dag la brten/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba ltar mdzes shing / /musti ka hā se shlau/ / ka rja saṃ pa da mu ta mṛ bye pra bra dzñā bhe ma tā mu tig gsal bar dgod 4 pa can/ /phun sum tshogs/ pa spangs nas khyod/ /rab 'byung ji ltar mngon ta ba/ /ka dzee sha beeḥpa ri tya bye pā bye rā bye su kha tsi tāḥ/ /ba nānta par 'dod/ /rgyal po la 'os bde ba yi/ /mal stan mchog ni yongs btang nas/ /nags mtha'i sde bā sa bya sa byā se ba se dzā shu khā sgra lbo/ /kāddhā lbo khā mu ku ra ma ṇi madmandi gnas la zhen pa yi1tsho/ /rdul khrod sa gzhi ji ltar stan4/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes ma rol/ ba'i me long rī rā dza dhwa nī me tī tya ghā na nu ba na bhu ba ཿ saṃ pa ta bye ghra gho nor bu dang ldan khang pa ni/ /'di dag btang nas nags kyi sa gzhi 'jigs rung stag ni yang dag rgyu byed rā ཿ / / se ba pri hye dza ra da dza ga rā shā sa bi plu ṣṭa shlau ṣṭa cing snyetsho/ /brtan pa'i sbrul ni rgan po'i dbugs kyi bsregs 6pa dang ldan grib ma 7dman gyur pa/ /kli ṣṭa tshwa ya pra bi ra la la tā stuḥ ka thadhe bha ba rnyi / / pi tuḥ shu two ti 'khri shing nyung ba de dag rnams kyis mnyes gshin khyod kyi dgyes pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa yab kyi tshig ba tsa dzwa rā dza pu trasta ma bra bīta/ /danta kāddhā dha ra ru tsi bee rā gyi grwa thos nas/ /rgyal po'i bu yis der smras pa/ /mchu mdzes so yi 'od kyis 9 ni/ /chags bral len du hā yandi bā/ /shī ta la nirma la dza khāḥsarnyo ṣa sha shi shī ta lāḥ/ /ba ṣpe bee rā 'jug pa bzhin/ /chu ni bsel zhing dri ma med/ /chog shes ri bong ldan pa bsel / /chags bral skal ba gya su bha gā bhu baḥka su na balla bhāḥ/ /pa ra dā ra i ba kṣi pra su khā bambi ta bzang po'i sa/ /nags tshal la ni su mi dga'/ /gzhan gyi chung ma dag la bzhin/ /bde myur ngan pas durdza nāḥ/ /na ra ka pra tya yā yā me sā pā yā na pri yāḥpri yāḥ/ /dhyā ma btang ba/ /gang zhig dmyal rkyen gnod bcas kyi/ /dga' ma khornams la bdag mi dga'/ /bsam 95—451

āoṃ mant+raḥpa ri dzñā na mind+ra yā zlañtsa nirdza yaḥ/ /rā dzñā ho sāphopra yasne na yo gtan sngags dang yongs shes dang / /dbang po rnams ni thul ba dang / /'tshe bas rgyal po'i sbyor ba 'di/ /go yo na ra ka pra rda/ /ha sand+raḥsaṃ sā ram̐ ku su ma ka li khāḥkā na na bhū baḥ'abad pa med pas (dmyal ba ster/ /nags kyi sa gzhi me tog rab rgyas 'khor ba dag la dgod (dzwapa 'dra//swa bhā bee na pyo ti bi da dha ti bu dhwa ram̐ sha ma ma yī/ /dṛ dngha byu1 shāṭwā bya dza na pa ba ngo bo nyid kyis mkhas pa rnams la zhi ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba skyed/ /bsam pa yi 1ni mchog tu ngal zhing no sgo sa ba hu khā bi bhu tisgo pā dzā bha ba ti kha lu ṣpe yo su kha sa rlung yab rlung gi shugs rings krumang / /sa bdag rnams kyi 'byor pa 'di ni nges par bde ba'i grogs ma khāe / /a nu dzā byā hi rmā tā ta bra dzā mye ṣa ta po ba āoṃ/ /dza mbi hi yin—/ /yab gcig pasnyebadag la rjes gnang gsol/ /bdag ni dka' thub nags su 'gro/ /mi rtag pa sattha bhā bā dzā shi raḥshakta ma ni tya tī/ /i ti pu tra ba tsa rna khru tā tatta the nyid dngos kun gyi/ /rtse mor chags pa mkhyen lags sam/ /zhes pa bu yi tshig thos nas/ /de de bzhin ti tsinta yan/ /u pā tso pa tsi tā:ryaste ma mbi ྾ ma tī pa tiḥ/ /bi bee zhes rnam par bsams/ /sa bdag mkhas pa ngo mtshar ni/ /rgyas par gyur pas de la smras/ /dri med ka bi ma lo pu tra twa mitstsha se sa tserja rna/ /hi tā me saṃ sha yi tā ba ta pabya dben pa'i nags tshal du/ /bu khyod gal te 'gro 'dod na/ /re zhig bdag gi the tshom gsol/ /phyi nas drutta ka ri 6 si/ /bra dza tā ba dhya ba su bye tirya gulte sta yā ba tsaḥ/ /pra tsu rigs par khyod 'gyur ro/ /khyod ni gsod sar 'gro ba yis/ /'khyog po dag tu tshig mang po/ /smras pa re ta da bhi mā yi bathi marta si ta twa taḥ/ /i ti kṣi ti bhu dza thraṣṭaḥsophobra de dag dgongs pa ni/ /de bzhin nyid du brjod par 'os/ /sa yi bdag pos dris pa dang / /des bīrtadma yo di tai/ /ba sa tya tra na kashyita tā mabo dhwarjo ni brta te/ /smras bdag gis brjod pa des/ /'di na 6su zhig bdag gsod las/ /khyod kyi radzwa zlog pa mi gnas sam//95—452

su kṛ tī dzre ba ti sha baḥs pā pastu mṛ tophomṛ taḥ/ /pāklu rgya bhaghra te mū lāta sa legs byas dag gi ro yang gson/ /sdig ldan shi ba min yang shi/ /bsod nams snga ma'i rtsa ba spyod/ /dha ṣpe rje n+ya rā shi ba ta / / i tyā sha yādma yā ta du s+ho ba tsa āoṃ pra nor ldan rnams kyi 'bru phung bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bsam pas kṣebadag gis ni/ /tshig ni gsum po de dag yo / /i ti khru tā kṣi ti pa tiḥtai pa ri ṣa bye sā da raḥ/ /u tsi tai kre brjod—/ /ces pa thos nas sa yi bdag /de la yongs 'khyud gus bcas pas/ /bu gcig dge ba'i ya tsā pu tra ku sha lā ye tya bhā ṣa ta/ /ta taḥs pi tā nu dzñā taḥsā shu ṣpe tre slad du ni/ /rigs pa mdzod ces rab tu smras/ /de nas yab ni mig chu dang / /bcas pas rjes ṇa kā na rgo/ /pra ya yo madhri pu tā rde sa hi taḥpañtsa bhiḥsha taiḥ/ /ma hastso gnang nags tshal du/ /blon po'i bu ni lnga brgya dang / /lhan cig rab tu song bar gyur/ /der ni drang rarnyi ke ta tra pra bra dzhai pā pya sā nu gaḥ/ /te ྾ kā le na so pa shya srong che drung du/ /rjes 'brang bcas pas/ rab byung thob/ /dus kyis de dag ril/ ba dang / /shing shun kuṇḍa babee la sañtsa yo/ /ta taḥs saṃ tsa ya dī ྾ ta da darsha na saṃ bi dā/ /e bsags pa de yis mthong / /de nas bsags pa la/ sdang des/ /de dag mi bltar —nges byas nas/ /blo kā tī bi dza ṣpe ta sbo kañtsita kā lo ma hā ma tiḥ/ /darsha nā bhā ṣa ṇi badha ni gros chen pos ji tsam dus/ /skye bos dbeen par gcig pur sngubasdad/ /mthong dang smra ba nges pa yis/ /ya mo pi ya dṛtstsha yā/ / pā ste su ga ta mi tru ghā pa pratstshaḥ ku sha lo bsdams kyang 'dod dgar 'ongs pa yi5/ /ri dwags la ni dge ba dag /legs par 'ongs zhes smras mṛ shaṃ/ /pu nabya pū dzi tai dṛṭī mu nidhe na spyo ga bra tai/ /a mā tya nas dris/ /beer yang thub pa ri dwags kyi/ /brtul zhugs de yis mchod mthong nas/ /blon po'i bu ta na yāḥsabye bi lakṣuḥs ma tsinta yan/ /mṛ go mṛ ga bra tabyu yo pū rnams thams cad ni/ /skyengs par gyur pas 7yang dag bsams/ /nags su yongs 'dzin med pa yithu/ /95—453

dzi to ni ཿ pa ri gra ho / / e tai bā nā dzi nā da ṇḍa sa sgyu rā ḍa sba ri dwags ri dwags brtul zhugs 1 'di/ /gos dang dbyug pa'i tshogs dag gi/ /phung po spangs (snyepa rozlo to/ /e ta darba ma ṣpe nāsma dadhī na ni ya maḥkṛ taḥ/ /pra to ba 'di dag mchod/ /de yi don du 'di yis ni/ /bdag cag blta la nges pa byas/ /brtul zhugs jeyo ka ra ṇa bya grwa ta nu na ma snga pi bā ra yeta/ /i ti sañtsint+ra sarde te bra byad bsags pa na/ /'di dag gis kyang 5bzlog gam snyam/ /zhes pa bsams nas de dag gis/ /to ba sthā ra sañtsa yo/ /na bye pra kṣi pya bā rā yī ya yuḥ shu ddhā sta darnyi brtul zhugs 5/yo byad bsags pa kun/ /chu yi klung ) du rab spangs nas/ /dag pas de dang nye bar shaṃ / / tya kta gra ha bhu dzā te ṣā mā sha yā nu sha yo tsi hūṃ / / sa phyin—/ /'dzin pa spangs pa 8 de dag gisapa9sna/ /khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen nas de'i3 / /bsam dhwa hūṃ pra kṛ ti dzñā tā bee di dhe dhand+ra de sha rmā/ /rā dza pu traḥs e bā haṃ shākya ste pa bag la nyal dag la11/ /'os pa'i chos ni bstan pa mdzad/ /rgyal po'i bu de nga nyid de/ /blon po'i madhri sru na baḥ/ /pu nasgyu go pa de sho ya ma byā sre ྾ ma yā kṛ tāḥ/ /i ti bu dag nyu shākya rnams/ /da lta rto1bdag gis de dag la/ /gtong ba nyer bstan 'di slar byas/ /zhes pa shākya ku mā rabṛtta me taṅka thi tai bhigru ga ṇaḥ swa ya dzi ṣpe na/ /a bi shākya gzhon nu rnams kyi sngon byung ni/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa de dag nges bzung ste/ /rten rngubyed dhwarya pa rā ma pū dza ya ta tsā kā ru ṇa mā shri ta ba tpa lya su ta su/ /rnams la mnyes snyegashin ldan par gyur pa de'i/ /thugs rje de ni dge slong tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa ṭwā ba dā na ka lpa la ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing tā yī mū kā baṅgā ba dā na maṣṭa trirshaḥpalla waḥ// //las lkugs pa 'phye bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa mebargyad pa'o// //95byed454

te dza yarnyi j-i ti shā li naḥb ram̐ nimbi kā ra ru tsi sru bi tasgo tāḥ/ /brtan pa'i khur kyis mi gdung lhag ma bzhin/ /legs byas bzod pa gang gi skyabazod pa 'dzin/ /she ṣa bta thra thu la bhā ra ṇirgya thā ye ba harnyi su kṛ takṣa maḥkṣa rmā/ /pu ra rnam 'gyur med pa'i mdzes pa rmad byung bskyed/ /brtan ldan de dag mchog tu rgyal gyur cig /sngon gye pund+ra pu rgya bi sarya se na ri suḥpra dzā dzā dza ni ta pra kadza/ /u dusthā nā mā bsod nams phyin ci lo ga pas sngon/ /gnod sbyin 'dir skyes skye rgu 2rnams kyi dgra/ /u dum pa zhes bya ni bi ḍo pa tā bairyakṣaḥkṣa yā mee ba kṛ ta kṣa rtodhu ta/ /a kā la kā lo ta ma nā tha ba drag por ni/ /gdung bas 'jigs la dus byas bzhin du gyur/ /'jig rten la brtse mgon med ba ntu lo kā nu kambi bha ga bā na sa bye/ / shikko pa de shaṃ sha ra rde rnams kyi gnyen / /bcom ldan zhi ba 4brjod pas 'phral 'a/ ni/ /dus min dus der babeeb pa nyer pra parja sha mā bye dhwa yī bi na ye n+ya yukta/ /tasmin pra shārnye bhu ba no ba tā bstan cing / /skyabs 'gro rab ldan 'du' ba dag la/ brkod/ /srid pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi ba de/ /se dṛṣṭi pra z-iṣṭaḥsu ga tai sa me tya/ /sañtsa ri rde nā ka pa tiḥpra ṇa mya bde gshegs de dus 'dzum skyes rgyu ba la/ /rab tu dga' bas lta 5ru 'ongs gyur pa/ /mtho ris bdag taṭwā la dzā tasmi ta mi hphu bā tsa/ /kasmra da kasthā ta smi ta tsand+ra le khā mu khāmbu dze bhā ti pos phyag 'tshal 'di skad smras/ /ci bee/da glo bur 'dzum pa'i zla ris kyis/ /khrod zhal chu skyes rmad byung ta bābye tā ya/ /a kā ra khaṃ sa twa su dhwa sa mu dra na lo ka sa mā n+ya ta yā ha slad du mdzes/ /snying stobs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rgyu med du/ /'jig rten thun mong bzhin du bzhad ma sarnyi / /khru two ti bā kyi tri da she shwa ra su tai sazla dadhī bha ga bān lags—/ /skabs gsum dbang phyug tshig de thos gyur nas/ /bcom ldan thams cad gzigs pas der ba bhā ṣe/ /asmind+ra de she ni dza pūzla bṛtrī smṛ tā smi tai dzā tai mi rda ma mend+ra/ /gsungs pa/ /phyogs 'dir rang gi sngon byung dran 6gyur nas/ /dbang po bdag 'a 'dzum pa 'di skyes so/ /95—455

pu ra mu niḥkṣurnyirpā di ba ṣpesmin nu bā pa nirpā se ta ro ṣa do ṣaḥ/ /yo3bhūbye be sngon tshe nags tshal 'dir ni gnas gyur pa/ /khro ba'i skyon spangs thub pa bzod la dga'/ /chags rdul rā ga ra dzaḥswa bhā bee bi dī ṣa bā nind+ra ram̐ bā ra beende/ /a thotta rā shā bye pa tizla rang bzhin srid la sdang ba gang sna/ /padma dag la zla ba bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dpyid ka byang phyogs sadhe ba nānta rā lo ka na kau tu ke na / / santa ཿ pu raḥ ke li su khā bdag po ni/ /chags ldan btsun mo'i tshogs bcas rtse dga'i slad/ /nags kyi nang rnams blta zhing dge ya kā mi ta dā shra yo pānta ma tī ma bā pa/ /rā gī kā lirwa ma sa bhū mi pā laḥmatshan gyis/ /de yi bste gnas nye ba'i sa gzhir 'ongs/ /chags ldan sa skyong rtsod ldan zhes pa des/ /pā da pra hā rerba da na sa baibya/ /le bhe bi lā se ṣā ni tambi byā nā ma sho ka rtse dga' la ni bud med rnams zhe dag gis/ /rkang pas bsnu na dang kha yi chang gis kyang / /mya ngan med sho hūṃ ba ku la shri yaḥ / / di shasta bo lo pa thra thu pra ko pa byu bhaṅga mdzes ba ku la dpal thob/ /der 1ni phyogs rnams dka' thub pa rnams kyis4/ /dka' thub nyams thraṣpe ri ba ta pā sa dzñā/ / ta tra bhra maddhirbha rirba bhu puḥkā mabyā dhū mi byed khro chen smin 'khrog gi/ /tshogs kyis bzhin dang 'dod me'i du bas bzhin/ /bung ba 'khor bas ri ba sāndha kā rāḥ/ /li la pi lo lāḥs ba nā ku lā dzā stan ba na spraḥsta ba mun pa dang bcas gyur5/ /rlung gis bskyod pa rtse dgas g.yo ba dang / /me tog phun bus dud pa nu ka na tā āoṃ/ /rakta dha rāḥsā ṭa la palla bā dzā pra purngi lā saṃ la la nā la tā mas sgu6 / /yal 'dab dmar po dang ldan mchu sgros dmar/ /'khri shing rol rtsed bud med rnams kyis ram̐ / /rā dzāṅga nāḥko tu ka bi blu me ṇa pa ṣpe tsa radhyasta mṛ ṣi bi lokya/ /thob—/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo dge mtshan rnam 'phrul la/ /nags su rgyu bas chags las rnam grol zhing / /a tsañtsa la dhyā na sa mā dhi salte bi mukta rā ge pa ri bārya tasbraḥ/ /taddhā sha g.yo med bsam gtan ting 'dzin la chags pa/ /drang srong de la yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /de nas 95—456

ma bye tya na re shwa ropho tha dṛṭī ba dhū bheḥpa ri bā ri tai tai/ /idhyā pra mi dbang phyogs der mngon phyogs pas/ /bud med rnams kyis yongs bskor de mthong nas/ /phrag dog ko pā na la durni rīghraḥ tsitstsha da ta snga shu sa pā ṇi pā rda/ /tshind+raṅga brgo bi sa nithi khro ba'i me ni blta dka' des/ /de yi lag pa rkang pa myur du bcad/ /brtan par sna rnam 'gyur med des kā rabyu ko pa bhū pā ya nā ma dhī raḥ/ /n+ya bā ra yata krudhe ta rañtsa tasmi yan lag tshogs/ /bcad kyang sa yi bdag la nges ma khros/ /dri za gnod sbyin lto 'phye lha tshogs kyis/ /gandharbha yakhyo ra ga de pa saṃ ghaḥ/ /ta taḥpra yā te dṛ pa to pu ri swe sa me de la khro ba drag po dag las bzlog /de nas mi bdag sde rang gi grong song tshe/ /nags nas 'ongs pa'i tya sabye mu na yo ba ṣpe bhyaḥ/ /tai ta tra kriṭwā ba ya baṃ bi lokya kṣuddhā a bi kro dha dhu thub pa thams cad kyis/ /der ni yan lag bcad pa de mthong nas/ /bzod ldan dag kyang khro bas tā ba bhū buḥ/ /shā sa pra dā nā bye mu khān ni bārya kṣuntabya mi hye ba sa tā 'dar bar 'gyur/ /dmod pa 'debs la mngon phyogs de dag la / /bzlog nas bzod par bya zhes de nu bā tsa/ /kṣa mā sa mā liṅgi ta mā na sā rmā ko pa kri yā byeḥya te na saṃ gaḥ/ /yis smras/ /bzod pas yang dag 'khyud pa'i yid ldan rnams/ /khro ba'i las kyis chags par mi byed do/ /bi kā ra be go pi na pā ṇi pā da tstsha de ma mā bhūrya di bī ta ma byoḥ/ /sa hye na te khro bral bdag gi rkang lag bcad gyur kyang / /gal te rnam 'gyur shugs ldan ma gyur na/ /bden pa de nā kṣa ta de ha e ba snga mi tya ba dī sa su naḥpra sā dī/ /ta taḥkṣa shā ta saṅga yis nyams med lus ldan par/ /bdag gyur cig ces rab dang des sbar smras/ /de nas bden tshig ta pā ṇi pā rda rū rte bra rṇa ba tya sa do da ye na/ /a byu dza yata kṣun ti gu brjod pas skad cig la/ /lag pa rkang pa 'byar zhing rma dag gsos thu/ /lha yis bzod pa'i yon tan de 5rja sta be na tai de ba tā sa twa se taibya pu྾ཿ/ /rā dzā pi ta ta kilbi ṣa kā bstod cing / /snying stobs dkar ba'i me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /rgyal po'ang de sdig nag po brtsegs 95—457

la ku ṭa bi spo ṭa saṃ ghaṣṭa bi na ṣṭa tseṣṭaḥ/ /pū yoṅka ṭā brta bi brta mā lta bus/ /chu bur kyis gtams spyod tshul rnam par nyams/ /rab drag rnag gi 'khor mor rnam 'khor na ཿ saṃ ba rta pā kai na ra shaṃ dza gā ma/ / yopho bhūhphu rā kṣu rnyi ra ti dzre zhing / /'jigs 3byed byun pa'i dmyal bar song 3bar gyur/ /bzod dka' 1drang srong chen por gang hakṣiḥsophohaṃ ka liryatso sa de ba datta ཿ/ /a tī ta dṛtta sma ra ṇi shakra nā sngon byung snye/ /nga nyid rtsod ldan gang de lha sbyin 3no/ /brgya byin 'das pa'i spyod tshul dran pa la/ /kā ra rde dzā ta mi rda smi tai me/ /i tī bha ga ba taḥshu tā bā kyi bismi ya mā na bdag gi 'dzum pa 'di skyes rgyu med min/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gsung khye thos ya mtshan dag dang ldan pa'i saḥpra ma da bi ka tsa byastodmā hā ba handa ya nā ma lboḥ/ / ta ra ṇi ki ra yid / /rab dga' rnam rgyas spros pas 7gsal ba'i spyan gyi phreng 'dzin cing / /nyi ma'i 'od zer reg ṇa spasgo ṣpe ba sgu ṭaḥka ma khā ka ra ste da sha ba sa ti thra taḥpā yā pa tiste di bo ka pa/sa padmo'i 'byung gnas rgyas pa bzhin/ /lha rnams bdag po dga' bas skabs gsum gnas su song bar shā / /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā gyur / /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam byi yī kṣu nt+ra ba dā na mū nā tsa tā ri sha pa lla wa ཿ / / / /'khri shing las bzod pa la dga' ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //a tyanta munda ti ma tsā ma ha tī bi na sha do 6 gya durdza nā sa mā ga ma chen po khyad 'phags mtho ba rnams ni nyams par 'gyur ba yire / /skyon gyi rgyu ni skye bo ngan 7 dang e ba he tuḥ / / ku la dru māḥ ki la pha la pra sa bai sa hai ba sa ryaḥ'agrogs pa kho na yin/ /'jug ngogs shing ni nges par 'bras bu skye bas lhan cig nyid/ /chu dang ba ta rnyi dza la saṅga ti bhinda mū khāḥ / / ru tsi rā gā ra shā li khye bha 'grogs pas rtsa ba phyung nas 'bral la 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sngon/ /chu 95—458

ga bān pu rā/ /balgu ma tyā ta ṭi na tyā bi tsa tsā ra ta thā ga taḥ/ /bo yid 'ong kyeldan pa'i ngogs/ /khang bzang 2mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ /yangs pa can na rnam par rgyu/ /ta sngaḥkai brta saze na gaspyi rertswa se dusta ra/ /ka dā tsid gho ra ma ka raḥnya pa'i tshogs kyis de yi chu/ /bsgral bar dka' zhing zab pa las / /nam zhig rgya ni 'phangs pa na/ /kṣi two dzā lo sa mu rje ta ཿ / / a ṭwā da sha shi rāḥ sau ha dī pa dī 'jigs rung chu srin yang dag 'thon/ /mgo bo bco brgyad seng ge dang / /gnyis 'thung stag dang bung 4pa kha rā na naḥ/ /dṛ rde sa hā sre rā kṛṣṭaḥsattha tā kā ra bi gra haḥ/ /tai dṛṭī ta tra bu'i bzhin/ /lus ni ri yi rnam pa can/ /mi ni stong phrag dag gis drangs/ /der ni de mthong rnam bi tra stuḥsradzñā kasgo ṇa radzdza baḥ/ /ābyarya ni: la dā shā na ta sbyand+ra ya par skrag /'dren pa'i thag pa chad gyur cing / /ngo mtshar g.yo med nya pa rnams/ /ska da cig sdod min yu kṣa ṇi/ /ga ṇa ni ga ha nā:rya bi she ṣa sha ta shā li ram̐/ /saṃ sā re 'gro ba min/ /'khor ba las kyis rnam bkra bar/ /rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar zab mo ni/ /brgya dang ldan kand+ra bai tsi bye bi kā rā rde ka ro ti kaḥ/ /a tranta re ta mudre shaṃ bha ga bān pa'i khyad par rnams/ /su zhig gis ni rtsi bar byed/ /skabs/ der de yi ched du ni/ /'byung po 5byu ta bhā ba naḥ/ /dzi naḥs mā ya yo sadzee dza na tā ṇa kṛ ta kṣa ṇaḥ/ /dgongs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /skye bo thams cad skyob 6pa la / /dus mdzad rgyal ba yang dag byon/ /sa bradhe bā la la la rgo dza rgo kau tu ka saṃ ga tai/ /dṛṭī ta tra ka rodhī re rgan po byis pa bud med bcas/ /ltad mo la 'tshogs skye bo dag /bcom ldan gyis gzigs 'jug ngogs bha ga bā nā sa na gra haṃ / / bhi kṣu saṃ bhe ཿ pa ri bṛ tai dṛ stso der / /stan tsu/ ni yongs su bzung ba mdzad/ /dge slong tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /de bzhin ta tra ta thā ga tai/ /dza no bhūstozlu khaḥsazlaḥpra tyā bṛtta i bo da byeḥ/ /gshegs pa der mthong nas/ /chu gter phyir la log pa bzhin/ /skye bo thams cad der phyogs gyur/ /95—459

tai bi lo bye ba bi na tāḥke baddhā pra ṇi bandha dzwa/ /bi shā lo dzā lo sa ha sā de mthong nyid kyi rte'aphral la ni/ /nya pa rnam par dud pa yis/ /srog chags 'ching ba yangs pa'i rgya/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba ta tya dzuḥ/ /maṣṭha kuspyi ra na krā di saṃ bhā ram̐ taṅgi dzā bha se/ /'khor ba lta bu 2 btang bar gyur/ /de yi gsung gis chu la nya/ /chu srin na kra la sogs tshogs/ /tyaghā te bi ra ta ko sa ba bhū buḥkilbi ṣa dī ṣaḥ/ /tairtsu ste bha ga bān dṛṭī btang nas de dag khro bra' bas/ /sdig pa yi ni dgra bor gyur/ /de dag gis bkod chu srin che/ /ma hā ma ka ra ma gra taḥ/ /tai dza gā da sre dzadrwanta kābye ba ka ru ṇa na do/ /mdun du bcom ldan gyis gzigs nas/ /tshems kyi mdzes pa snyesgyusnying rje yi/ /chu bo spro bzhin de la smras/ /a pi two ka bi laḥpu tra kinda sma ra se duḥkṛ tai/ /pa tso dubya ri ta snga ya ma bu kye ser skya khrod kyis ni/ /nyes pa 4byas pa mi dran nam/ /'di yang ngag gis 5nyes spyad dag /smin pi bā kophonu bhū ya te/ /sā gya ka spyo ṇa mi tradhe dza na ṣpe kā rya brta te/ /sazla pa nyams su myong ba yin/ /khyod kyi mi dge'i grogs gyur pa/ /ma de da lta gang 6na gnas/ /thams zlo ṣpe tya bi hi taḥsmṛ tā dzā ti mu bā tsa saḥ/ /bi sgo bha bā mi ka pi laḥcad mkhyen pas 'di nyabarjod tshe/ /de yis skye ba dran nas smras/ /khyab bdag bdag ni ser skya yin/ /sma rā mi ni dza duḥkṛ tai/ /ba tso du: ri ta snga yo pa ri pā ko nu byu ya te/ /rang gis nyes pa byas pa dran/ /ngag gis nyes byas 9yongs smin pa/ /'di ni nyams su myong bar gyur/ /dzā tā me na ra shā de tā na ra kā de shi mbi pu raḥ/ /i trughā ma ma kasta tra ru ro dmyal ba ston byed bdag gi ma/ /sngon du dmyal ba dag tu skyes/ /zhes pa smras nas chu srin der/ /nga da pa ru ṣa swa ram̐/ /tai sho ka sā ga re mahūṃ ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān bu naḥ/ /a ro drag pos rab tu ngus/ /mya ngan rgya mtshor bying de la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dud kā le ki ka ro mya rya tiryaglo ni ga ta su te/ /apu ju pā raste ra bha 'gro'i skye gnas song 1 khyod la/ /dus min de ring ci zhig bgyi/ /bag med rnams kyi bsod nams min 95—460

sa ha se tolbā sa bi hi ti pra matā dzā yā te na ra ka pa ri sā ka pra pa'i rab tu rtsom pa gzu rte lums dag /dgod 2 cing rangs pas bsgrubs pa dmyal bar yongs su smin la ṇa yi tsā / / a shānta ཿ saddhā paṃ ru di ta sha ra shā dzā pra ti ni shaṃ j-i chags gyur tshe/ /nyon mongs 'beebs pa dug da dang mtshungs pa'i rjes su 'gyod pa ma zhi bas/ /ngu 'a/ shaṃ kle shā bi shirdi sha ti bi ṣa tu bye ra nu sha yaḥ/ /kṣa ṇa duḥkha kṣa yā ⑪ ba skyabs gnas chornams la mtshan mo so sor mchog tu gdung bar byed/ /sdug bsngal skad cig gis 'jig ma yi tsirghaṃ tra sā da ya / / pra sa nda mā na sa ཿ kā le yā gya bee sbad—/ /bdag la sems ni dang bar byos/ /dang ba'i yid kyis dus byas nas5/ /lha yi gnas su tri da shā la yo/ /sh-i rku batpa hi tartse rda bee tsārya ku ru tse ta se/ /a khyod bgrod 'gyur/ /mnyes gshin phan pa 'di yang nyon/ /rnam par dpyod la yid la gyis/ /'du ni tyāḥ sa zla saṃ sku rāḥ shābye ni ddhā ṇa ma kṣa yo/ / i tyā dzha yā bha ga byed thams cad mi rtag cing / /zhi ba myang 'das 'jig pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' 'di ba tastasmin yā te pra sanda tai/ / dza na saṃ ghaḥ sa su tsi ram̐ ba byu bābyarya yis / /de ni rab dang gyur pa'i tshe/ /skye bo'i dzwatshogs kyang yu/na ring du/ /ngo mtshar g.yo ba med nibyalaḥ / /ātyā nandaḥpra ṇa yi nā dza ṣpe nā bhyabee tasta taḥ/ / tabyund+ra par gyur/ /de nas skye bos gus par ni/ /gsol btab 'phags pa kun dga' bos/ /bcom ldan bṛrghaṃ pa pratstsha bha ga brnyi kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /sa te na thraṣṭa pro bā tsa bee ma la dzñā 'das la thal sbyar byasashe / /de yi sngon byung rab tu dris/ /de yis dris la 7ye shes spyan/ /dri med de na lo tsa naḥ/ /a snga ku sha la shī la gya bṛṭwā ntaḥshu ya tā ma yo/ /yis rab tu gsungs/ /sdig pa'i ngang tshu' 'di yi ni/ / byung ba'i 11mtha' 'di mnyan par gyis/ /bha dra kā khye su ra kalpe barṣa yu ta yu gā yu ṣi/ /dza ṣpe ba bhū ba bha ga bān bskal pa bzang po dag la sngon/ /skye bo tshe lo khri phrag zung / /thub tshe bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /95—461

kā shya pā khyasta thā ga taḥ/ /kṛ shīrwa ma ma tī pā laḥkalpa shā la i bābee dī/ /a bha batpa 'od srungs zhes pa byung bar gyur/ / bā rā ṇa sīr shede dus su/ /sa skyong kṛ tī kyezhes bya ba/ /slong ba'i ma ye ta smin bā rā ṇa sngalba hu pra daḥ/ / ka dā tsiji bu khye sthā ṣpe sa dpag bsam shing lta bu/ /mang po rab tu ster ba byung / /nam zhig mkhas pa'i gnas su ni/ /mig ha srukṣa mi pa pā re/ /ā sbo ṣpe bā di sau hā khya tai bibye nā ya yo dī dzaḥ/ /stong gzhan pa bzhin du gnas/ /der ni gnyis skyes rig byed ldan/ /smra ba'i seng ge zhes pa 'ongs/ /a bi la mbi ta saṃ pāpta darsha nā sa na sadṛ tiḥ / / sa ta dā shīnd+ra ra thogs pa min par phrad pa dang / /stan dang bsnyen bkur yang dag thob/ /slob ma'i 'phreng ༄ snabs pa ti shi 6 sre ṇi thra to bya dhwa ta/ / swaste swaste ma te bu dhwa dhī pa sa bskor ba des/ /de tshe rgyal la shis brjod pa/ /khyab bdag mkhas pa'i bdag po mdun ④ sar 'dug bha ya tu bye bi sgo lu ddhā ཿ sa stso ri tā mṛ te ta ba pa re sa nda rsha 'os shis ldan khyod ni shis gyur cig /khyod kyi legs spyod bdud rtsi dag la mchog tu sred ldan yang dag ṣpe rā gi ṇaḥ / / sa dzwa ṣāḥpa ra bhū pa nāmbi mu kha rāsta gu ḍo dī ra blta 5la chags/ /sa bdag gzhan gyi ming la sdang 5ldan yon tan brjod la mu cor che bar sgogs/ /ṇiphokasmata sazla gu ṇa shra me ṇa bha ba tā do ṣerba yo yo dzi tsā/ /yadmā tsa kā a yon tan kun gyi rten gnas khyod kyis glo 7bur nyid du bdag la skyon rnams sbyar/ /gang zhig slong 8/ba pi ni ra nta ra ra tna ba kṣe nā nā bee sā rja pa ri pū ra ka tsā pā rnams kyang bar med rin chen char phab pas/ /sna tshogs slo nga ba'i don mthun yongs su tshim par byed yādhi / / sa baṃ bha bā nu sa ma pu ju ni dhe ba dā n+ya ni rde n+ya dā na gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad gtong phod dang ldan mtshungs med bsod nams gter/ /khyod kyi sbyin pa bee bha ba su bee j-isnyi tai twa ta/ /rā dzan kibyeta pa ri tsi ta gu ṇiḥse ba bkren med 'byor pa'i rnam par 'phel/ ba yin/ /rgyal po yon tan cung zad yongs su 'dris pa bdag gi she 95—462

yā saṅga ru bhyaḥpāptasthā byerngi bu dha bi dza yi ko pi bee bye sha le shaḥ/ /a sde bla ma dam pa dag /bsten nyalas mkhas pa rgyal byed rig pa'i cha yi cha shas 2 ci yang thob/ /yid 'ong rtebi dwad ka ma la bha ra so mya pra bhā sa bhā yī ta spyoṅka rde ka ti pa ya pa mkhas pa'i padma'i tshogs kyi 'od 4dang ldan pa'i mdun (5 sa 'dir/ /de yi tshig ni phul du byung ba'i yid rda pra tya yo darsha ya maḥ/ /ni dza gu ṇa ga ṇa ṣpe dhīrludzdza te sadzdza nā dzā mu kha ra ya ches 'ga' zhig bdag gis bstan/ /skye bo dam pa'i blo ni rang gi yon tan brtsir ngo tsha/ /de lta na yang ti ta thā bi pro shwe bā dā bhe lā ṣaḥ/ /i ya ti dza ga ti rā dzan kṣi pra ma nī smra 'dod drag pos myu cor sgog tu bcug /rgyal po 'gro 'di dag na bdag gi tshig lan la sred pa'i/ /6 tī me pra ti ba tsa na ru tsiste daste kashyidri pabyeta/ /sandasgorgaste gambhi ra mi nyi gal te mkhas pa yod na myur ba nyid du brtag par gyis/ /zhes 6 pa de yi gzhung gi tshig /drag por ta spyoṅka ṭa sba tsaḥ/ /shu tā kṣi ti pa tiḥkṣi pre bee lakṣaḥs ma tsinta yad/ /snyems shing zab pa dag /thos nas/ sa yi bdag 7po ni/ /skyengs pas myur bar yang dag bsams8 / /a pāpta pra ti maslo yo ya di yā yata ma dodha taḥ/ / ta de ṣa ma ma de sha gal te lan ni kem thob par/ /rgyags shing 'phyang 'di song gyur na7/ /de lta na ni 1bdag yul gyirta/ /su ya shaḥkhaṇḍa na ḍiṇḍi maḥ/ /gu rja ba mā na kṛrya tra mūrte bha ba ti bhū pa grags pa min pa sgrog pa'i rnga/ /gang na sa bdag blun por gyur1 / /yon tan can rnams dman par tiḥ / /na ka ro ti dza nasta tra bee tyādzdza na pa ri shra oṃ/ /bi be ka bi ma la lo ke byed—/ /de na skye bo rig byed 'a / /yongs su ngal ba byed ma yin/ /sa bdag chos kyi 5kun dga' ra/ /dhasthā rā me ma hi pa to/ /lo ke bee tyāḥpra brtadhe sa dā tsā ra kri ya i ba /dri med dben pa'i snang ba can/ /'jig rten rig byed la/ 'jug ste/ /dam pa'i bya ba'i spyod la/ bzhin/ /tasmra da su pra yasne na kaste byo ma da ni gra haḥ/ /bi tyā da ri dra tā de she de beed 'di yi rgyags pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas tshar gcad bya/ /yu la ni rig byed kyis dbul ba/ /95byed463

do ṣa e ba baṃ shī pa tiḥ/ /i ti sañtsind+ra dṛ pa tibee pra kaza ṭa bā se āoṃ/ /rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyi skyon/ /de ltar bsams nas mi bdag gis/ /bram ze kar pa1pa ṭar gnas pa//ā ni nā ya ma hā mā hye ra nī 6 bi du ྾ gu ldu/ /byu dzdzata sa bha mu sā dhyā yaḥmakhas pa'i bla ma rnam dpyad nas/ /blon po chen pos 'gugs su bcug /mkhan po rtog ge rno ldan pa/ /pra tya ta tarna targa shaḥ/ /tsa kā ra bā di sau ha su dadzee ke sha ra karta āoṃ/ /sa bdag mdun —sa der 'ongs nas/ /smra ba'i seng ge dregs pa yi/ /ral pa dag ni chad par byas/ /ta su te na dzi ta snga shu bi dzi tā she ṣa pā di naḥ/ /mo na mu tram̐ sa ma pe de myur bar smra ba ma lus las/ /rnam rgyal de yis pham pa de'i/ /dbyangs can ngo tshar gyur pa bzhin/ /ladzhai te ba sa ra swa tī/ /ā rū bhāḥpra bhra ma ha saṃ nakṣa tā rja mi bo da yāḥ/ /smra bcad rgya ni yang dag thob/ /skar ma rnams ni 'char ba bzhin/ /mkhas pa gzi byin che rnams kyis/ /u parlu pa ri dro 6rnye gu ṇaskorṣa ma byā ṣi rde/ /bā di sau haṃ bee mṛ rje tha da yon tan khyad 'phags la gnas pa/ /gong nas gong du mthong ba yin/ /de nas nor mang mi bdag gis/ /tā bhū ri dha dzwa dṛ paḥ/ /da do dī dzā ya dza yi ṣpe kattha ṭi na ga ro pa me/ /laddhā byin nas smra ba'i seng ge btang / /grong khyer lta bu kar pa ṭa/ /gnyis skyes rgyal ba dag la byin/ /de rā dza ga dzā shophotha tsā ru ke yu rā kai ka rṇaḥ/ /u pā dhyā yaḥswa bha ba rna nas rgyal las glang po rta/ /dpung rgyan gdu bu mdzes pa thob/ /mkhan po dpal dang lhan cig tu/ /pra bi bee sha sa ha shri yā/ / byu dzārje tā mi bhū rdzu ba ni rdzu sā ga rang gi khyem du rab tu zhugs/ /rgyal po'i dpung pas bsgrubs pa dang / /tshong pas krurgya mtsho nas rāmbi tā / / bi byā ba tī bi rā dzadhe gu rtoṅka rṣambi tā ཿ shri yaḥ / /bsgrubs dang / /mkhas pa'i yon tan khyad 'phags kyis/ /bsgrubs pa'i dpal ni rnam par mdzes/ /kā le na shri ma dasta su pu tra dzahphotpa bo bha bta/ /su khe pi su kha saṃ patrīrlu dus kyis dpal dang ldan pa de/ /bu skyes kun tu dga' bar gyuraphya7/ /bde la'ang bde ba phun distsakraste bhasbya pra ṇa nā ma saḥ/ /tsakre ta sro pa biṣṭa gya bha ga bān dhadzre bkang / /de yis de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / nyer 'khod hude la bcom ldan gyis/ /chos ni rab tu de sha rghaṃ/ /ya yā sgo taḥpha lo pā gyas tya dadhi dza gā ma saḥ/ /tro ṇa bstan pa mdzad/ /gang gis bden mthong rgyun zhugs kyi/ /'bras bu thob nas de song gyur/ /de ltar mi ba gu ru kā rlo plu : ta ཿ pā pa pa ṅgā di ti sa dza na kā ya ཿbya ba dka' yang de ni rtswa bzhin sdig pa'i 'dam dag las/ /bton cing skye bo'i tshogs pa de dag kyang ste so pi duḥkhārdza ṣpe na/ /bya sa na ni pa ti tā dzā lbo la yā pu ju shī sdug bsngal bsgrubs pa yis/ /gdung bar nges par lhung ba rnams kyi nyon mongs rtsa ba mtshungs med dag /lā ni khi la ma tu la mū lo kle sha muzlu la yarnyi/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ma lus bsod nams ngang tshul rnams kyis bde blag nyid du 'joms par byed/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang ra tsi tā dzee bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ka pi lā ba dā sum̐ pos byas pa'i byang chub sems/ dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ser skya'i rtogs pa nā ma tsa tā ri shaḥpabee waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //tu lya me ba pu ru ṣe ṇa byu bye te kā ya bhā dza na ga tai shu bhā shu bhaḥ/ /de hi lus kyi snod son dge dang mi dge ba/ /mnyam pa nyid du skyes bu longs spyod den/ /lus can dzā bi bi dha kand+ra dzee pha lo khya bhukta mu pa yā ti saṃ kṣa yo/ /bha ga bān su rnams kyi rnam mang las skyes 'bras/ /gang phyir ma spyad kun tu zad mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan bde bar ga taḥpūrde pu re rā dza kṛ hā bhi dhe/ /ka lānda ka ni pā pā khya pi dza hā ra gshegs pa sngon/ /gong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi ni/ /ka lan da ka'i gnas zhes pa'i/ /nags kyi nang na ba nānta re/ /bimbi sā raḥkṣi ti pa nyi ta tā bhūtri khru taḥshri yā/ /raṭwā rnam par gnas/ /gzugs can snying po sa yi bdag /der ni dpal gyi rngurnam par grags/ / rin 95—473

ka raḥ sa twa raddhā rghaṃ ratna ka ra i bā pa raḥ / /ba bhū ba sa ma ye chen kun gyi 'byung gnas gyur/ /rte rin chen 'byung gnas gzhan pa bzhin/ /dus der grong khyer sgra tasmin ro ru kā khye pu re dṛ paḥ/ /shri mā nu dru ya ḍo nā ma ya sha:nd+ra ma ho da sgogs zhes / /bya bar mi bdag dpa' dang rkeldan/ /grags pa zla ba'i chu gter che/ /u dru ya na zhes pa byeḥ / /ta mya tsand+ra pra bhā nā ma pasnri tsabye na nā bha bta/ /shi khaṇḍi yu ba rā byung / /de yi btsun mo zla ba'i 'od/ /ces pa zla ba'i bzhin ras can/ /sras ni drag po'i rwartsal dang dzaspru sru nuje kra ma karka shaḥ/ /hi ru ko bhi ru kabye ti ta snga mā khyo ba bhu ba tuḥ/ /ldan—/ /rgya' tshab gtsug jephud can zhes gyur/ /te ru ka dang bhi ru ka /zhes pa de yi sheblon po gnyis//ga ṇa nī yo na bi na ye ya yo shu kra bee ha ma tī / / dzā tā bhū mi bhu dzoḥ'adul ba 6dkar po phur bu dag3 /bgrang bar bya ba min par gyur/ /sa bdag lha yi 'od zer can/ /pri tirle khebye kha tī ṣasta yoḥ/ /a pi du ra spru yo rarka ka ma khā ka ra yo ri ba/ /de gnyis spring yig gis mdza' gyur/ /ring du gnas kyang 8 nyi ma dang / /padma yi ni 'byung gnas bzhin//a pūzla ratna ni tsa yo pre ṣa nai rba hu gasta yoḥ / /pa ri pūṇḍi pa re de gnyis mang 9 du pho nya yis// /sngon med rin chen tshogs dag 1 dang / /grogs nyid mchog tu yongs pra pa sa khye pre ma ni dhwa na tai / / dru ra sthā pi pa re spru ti ཿ sa rdzogs pas/ /mdza' ba'i gter ni thob par gyur11/ /dam pa'i mdza' ba ring gnas kyang / /mchog tsā tītī ri bā kṣa yā/ /saṃ saghra pi kha la spru ti tre ṇa dzā le ba na spru tu mi zad grags 'bar bzhin/ /mi bsrun 15mdza' ba nyer gnas 1 kyang / /brtan pa ma yin rtswa 'bar rā / / ka dā tsij-i bya ratnaṅka ka ba tsa kāñtsa nodzdza lo/ /pā hi rdo bi mbi bzhin / /nam zhig gzugs can snying po la/ /mchog gi go cha gser 'od 'bar/ /lha yi rin chen sā rā ya sā ra mu dru yā ṇa dṛ paḥ/ /bee ṣa shasthāsni rakṣurta bi tsi tra ratna kyis mtshan pa/ /mi bdag u dru ya nas springs/ /dug mtshon me rnams bsrung 'os pa/ /rnam bkra rin 95byed474

shaṃ ka ṭi/ /su z-i ta pre ṣi ta mā bā ya thra bā tsa sa tsi bān dṛ paḥ/ /i rda chen go cha ni/ /grogs kyis springs pa legs blangs nas/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras/ /sa bdag me pra hi tai te na sau dza n+ya mi ba bhū bhu dzā/ /sazla rakṣa kṣa oṃ band+ra gā snya de yis lugs bzang bzhin/ /lhag par mdza' ba go byed cing / /thams cad bsrung 1bar bzod pa yi/ /pre ma ni bi de shaṃ/ /na pa shya mya su sa dṛ shaṃ pra ti de yo ta to bye shaṃ/ /alpa go cha 'di ni bdag la springs/ /'di la la/na du sbyin 'os pa/ /de las lhag pa ngas ma mthong /phan pra ti kri yā sha lya mu pa kā ro pa kā ra yoḥ/ /u tsi tai tsint+ra tsā kiñtsita pre ṣa dang gnod pa dag la yang / /lan ni chung ba zug rngu yin/ /'di las lhag pa cung zad cig /bskur ṇḍi ya ma to bye shaṃ / / sa bye rbha ba bye ri tru ghā dṛ pa bye ddhā ku 'os 3sna khyed rnams thams cad kyis/ /bsam par mdzod ces brjod nas ni/ /mi bdag bsam pa lo bha bta/ /a tha dhī mān ma hā mā tyabye ram̐ dhya tā ta ma pra bīta/ /barṣa kā ra 'khrugs par gyur/ /de nas blo ldan blon po che/ /dbyar gyi rnam pa zhes bram ze/ /rig kun legs bhi sgo bi praḥsabyu bi tyā su pā ra gaḥ/ /a to ba hu gu rde rā dzan ṣpe ka par pha rol phyin/ /yu na ring bsams nas de la smras/ / 'di las yon tan mang ba'i skyes/ /rgyal po me babyu pā ya rna/ /ta su saṃ pre ṣa ṇi yata naḥkri ya hūṃ yo di shakya te/ /ya e gcig kyang yod ma yin/ /gal te nus na 'bad pa yis/ /de ni rab tu spring bar mdzod/ /gang zhig ṣa bha ga bān bu dhe sbri ta sta byi ṣa yārja ka / de bā nā mā da ra sthā bcom ldan sangs rgyas 'di/ /khyod kyi yul na nye bar gnas/ /lha rnams dag gi lus 4gnas kyi/ /rgo pa ṭa stattha ti maṅgi taḥ/ /a she ṣa lo ka ka spyo ṇa ka li kā kalpa pā da thang ka de yi gzugs kyis mtshan/ /ma lus 'jig rten dge ba yi/ /me tog gsar 5ba'i dpag bsam baḥ / / tsi tre swasne tha saṃ kaspe thra thu pu byeḥs dṛ shya te/ /i ti mdzee ba tsaḥshing / /ri mo rmi lam kun rtog la'ang / /de ni 3bsod nams che bas mthong / /zhes pa blon po'i tshig 95—475

e taste pra hi tai hi tai bha ba ma hā mo hā ma ye bhe ṣa dzee ra ga dzwa ṣa bi ṣā pa ri bong mtshan ma'i 'od ldan bcom ldan sku gzugs chags sdang dug ni nyams par byed/ /sred pa yang haṃ bha ga ba to bi mbi sha shā ṅka tī ṣaḥ / / tro ṭwā paṃ sha ma rde pra dag zhi byed srid pa'i rmongs chen nad kyi sman dang phan pa dang / /rab dang mngar ba'i bsod nams sanda ma dhu ram̐ twadzre tra pā tā mbi tai dha n+yaḥpu sgo rā sa ya ṣpe pi ba ha lbo bcud len khyod kyi mig gi snod du rab blugs pa/ /'di ni khyod la rab springs skal ldan mgrin pa'i bar du dā kaṇḍa muṅkarji ta/ /sadmāsgo bi ni yo dza na gu ṇa ga zla dhwa ṣpe sa dā dhyā rab tu 'dod pas 'thung / /dam pa'i lam la rnam par ṭwā sbyor zhing yon tan tshogs rnams 'dzin pa rtag pa rgo dubya sā ra ni bā ra rde sbi ra su kha sthāsto pa ri pre ra khaṃ/ /nirgyu dzo tu slob/ /bya ba ngan las rnam par zlog cing brtan pa'i bde ba 'thob la mchog tu bskul/ /rgyun chad pa kṛ to ni ranta ra ta yā sarpāttha nā batta dzee kardo bye ki mataḥpa ram̐ thra ya hi med pa nyid du bdag nyid kun gyi 2zol med phan pa skyed rngubyed pa/ /dam pa'i dge ba'i grogs kyi ④yid tai ka spyo ṇa mi treḥs tsā/ /i ti le khārja mā swā rya su z-ita pre mā mṛ 'ong phan pa 'di las mchog ni ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa'i spring yig grogs mdza' ba'i/ /bdud rtsi la 'os to tsi tai/ /rā dza ga dzā bye rū shwe gya pa ṭa pra ya yo pu raḥ/ /a bhi nabye ta don myangs nas/ /glang po la gnas thang sku yi/ /sngon du rgyal po rab tu song / /blon bcas mdun na mā nanda ta sā mā tyaḥ sa pu ro hi taḥ/ /te ma sau hā sa nohūṃ ge sa 'don bcas tekhye / /mngon par dga' nas kun dga' las/ /gser gyi seng ge'i khri steng du7khya / /de pra sārya n+ya bee sha yata/ /lā ba rgya pu rgya ni la yi dṛṭī tashlau ga tai ba ni rab tu bkram nas bkod/ /mdzes sdug bsod nams dag gi gnas/ /bde gshegs sku de mthong gyur puḥ / /na mo na maḥpra busgye ya buddhā ye tya ba dadzdza naḥ/ /buddhā bhe dhwa nas—/ /skye bos sangs rgyas rab rgyas la/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal zhes pa smras/ /sangs rgyas mngon 95—477

nidṛ ti mā satta / /kā le na bee hi to sthā po de hādhe dzñā ti bhista yoḥ/ /ngan 'das pa thob/ /dus kyis de yi 77gnyen rnams kyis/ /lus kyi mjug 2tu mchod rten bsgrubs/ /tand+ra ma tsiddhā ba byā pi ba nda rnye tsi tya ba nda kāḥ / / de byā byand+ra pra bhā de ming gis mtshan da lta yang / /mchod rten phyag byed ‘ phyag 'tshal byed/ /btsun mo'i 'khor du dge yāstsa shi khā khyu sā pi bhikṣu bhā/ /kra me zlantaḥtsa kre sa ta tai dhand+ra de sha rmā/ /slong ma/ /ri ma zhes ni bya bas kyang / /rim gyis lha mo zla 'od la/ /rtag tu chos ni bstan pa mdzad/ /ka dā tsi da tha byu pā laḥ1 ḍā gā ra ga taḥpri yo/ /ta ma dzñā sbodzre mitta dzñāḥde nas nam zhig sa skyong gi(je/ /rtse dga'i khang par song gyur pa/ /mtshan ma shes pas de yis 3ni/ /sabhā hā ba bye dzi bi tī/ /dzñā ta saṃ sā ra tsa ri ta sta taḥtā ba su dhwa bye 'tsho ba zhag bdun mtshams su rigagye /de nas 'khor ba'i spyod tshul shes/ /nor 'dzin bdag pos de paḥ / /a nu dza zlo shu bha pa rda pā tsū pra bra bye yā pu raḥ/ /swā khyu te la ni/ /sngon la rab tu byung gyeb yis/ /dge ba'i gnas thob rjes su gnang / /legs par gsungs dhand+ra bi na ye bhekṣu kyā dṛ pa to gi rā/ /de bī pra bra dzi tā de haṃ di ṣpe ta pa'i chos 'dul ladwa / /mi bdag tshig gis dge rlo nga mas/ /lha mo rab tu phyung ba'i lus/ /nyi ma bdun tyā dza sapta me/ /tsa turma hā rā dzi ke 6 de bee 6 sa ha mee ba sā/ /pra yā ta de ba ka pa nyid la btang / /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams su/ /lha yi bu mo nyid du ni/ /'phral nyid rab tu gyur tyā hūṃ dza gā ma dzi na kā na rgo/ /ta tra pūrtend+ra ba da nā di byā ra ṇa bhū ṣi tā/ /pa de/ /rgyal ba yi ni nags su song / /der ni zla nya'i bzhin ras can/ /lha yi rgyan gyis brgyan pa des/ /dṛṭī shākya mu kau z-ibye sha ya pā tā su pā da yoḥ/ /pra tī khaṃ di bya putpayā shākya thub pa mthong gyur nas/ /dga' bas de yi zhabs la gtugs/ /lha yi me tog rab 'thor la9 / /sta snga:kre ta thā ga taḥ/ /dhambi pa pā da rna ye na dṛṣṭa sa tyā dza gā ma de la de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /gang gis bden pa mthong byed pa'i/ /chos ni bstan mdzad de song 95—479

sā / /sā ga tā na ga ram̐ pa hphubyo: mūrbhe ri bairde bī/ /bi bo rgya ni shi gyur—/ /de yis mkha' la zla ba yi/ /gzugs bzhin bdag po'i grong khyer phyin/ /mtshan mo nyal ba subee gya tsakre bo bye pra kā sha rgo/ /yā tā ya swa pa rda ta sde pra bhā te ba bslangs 1nas ni/ /byang chub rab tu gsal bar byas/ /de ni tho rangs rang gnas su/ /song ba'i tshe su dhwa bye paḥ/ /pra bra dzñā bhi mu khaḥpu tra ma rnyi ṣi tsu shi khaṇḍi āoṃ/ /na nor 'dzin bdag /rab ⑤ byung mngon par phyogs pas suzhu/ /gtsug phud can ni dbang bskur te/ /pra dzā tā zla ya ni kṣi su tai ma hā mā tya yosta taḥ/ /dṛ pa terbimbi sā ra gya su de nas blon po dag las krude/ /skye rgu shebaskyab pa'i phyir gtad nas/ /de ni mi bdag gzugs can snying / /z-i daḥs ya yo pu ram̐/ /bi mbi sā rasta mā yā tai bi ga tatstshattha tsā ma grogs po'i grong khyer dag tu song / /gdugs dang rnga yab dang bral ba/ /de 'ongs gzugs can snying po ram̐ / /dzre po pa tsā riḥpra ṇa taḥspru nyi pū tai ra pū dza ya ta/ /bi shānta yis—/ /rab btud mi bdag nyer spyad ni/ /mdzes shing gtsang ma rnams ⑥ kyis mchod/ /ngal bsos mā sa nā se dzwa sa ta mū tse ba bi sma yaḥ/ /j-iṣṭaḥsaṃ darsha ṣpe nā su shrī bee khri la 'khod de la/ /de dang phrad pas rab dga' zhing / /dpal dang bral bas sdug bsngal ba'i/ /ya yo ge na duḥkhi taḥ/ /rā dzanda nanta sā manta mo li bi shānta shā sa naḥ/ /mtshan ldan pa de yis smras/ /mtha' yas kun byi mgo bo la/ /rgyal po'i bka' ④ni ngal gso ④ba/ /pā ka shā sa na tu lya ste ka tha me ba mu pā ga taḥ/ /a bhinda baghra pra kṛ brgya byin dag dang mtshungs pa khrod/ /'di bzhin nye bar ji ltar gyur/ /rang bzhin bzhin ras ma bral tergubee mant+ra gya dhī ma taḥ/ /pa re ṇa rā bye ha ra rde bī ra saṃ bhā bya te zhing / /blo ldan don po—ni sbas pa can/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi rgyal srid ni/ /gzhan gyis grogs po ⑩srid na te/ /i ti thraṣṭaḥs su z-i dā sasmi tasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzan dṛddhā ma yin/ /zhes pa lho1grogs kyis dris la des/ /'dzum bcas de la rab smras pa/ /rgyal po 'byor pa 95—480

bi bhū tirma na thra yā sadzee gī mi nī/ /bi ṣa yā swā da bee mu khyud bi thams cad du/ /'gro zhing rgan la bdag (mi dga'/ /yul nyams myong las phyir phyogs su2/ /sred trosgo na ma yā swa yi/ /udṛṣṭa mi ba saṃ tyakta mi shwadzre sgo ga bhā dza dzee/ /dang bral ba bdag rang gis/ /dbang phyug longs spyod snod dag ni/ /lhag ma bzhin du yang dag btang //twa yā ka stso ṇa mi tre ṇa su ga ta bra ti mā pa ṭaḥ/ /yo sau hi tā ya pra hi taḥdage ba'i grogs po khyod kyis ni/ /bde gshegs sku gzugs thang ka gang / /phan slad rab tu springs pa de/ /sa bai rā gya gu rusma ma/ /a dhu nā twattha sā de na ga tā bha ga ba tornyi bdag gi chags bral bla mar gyur/ /da 37ni khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung phyin ke—/ /i tshwa mya bābye pra bra dzñā ma gā rā da nā gā ri shaṃ/ /i nyi sa khyund+ra nas —/ /khyim nas khyim ni med nyid du/ /rab byung 'thob par bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa grogs kyi tsaḥkhru tā tatta the ti bi tsind+ra tsa/ / sā da rasta byi bee ke na bee mbi sā tshig thos nas/ /de de bzhin zhes rnam bsams te/ /de yi dben pa la gus ldan/ /gzugs can snying rasta ma bra bīta/ /dha byo ba hu ma tubyu pi sā shā thra thi bī pa teḥ/ /saṃ sā ra bi pos de la smras/ /sa yi bdag po khyod kyi blo/ /dam pa mang pos bkur yeb yang / /'khor ba las ni mu khāe ka dzee dzā tā te ma ti rī dṛ shī/ /sadho ṣa bi bha bā sgo ga su bha phyir phyogs pa/ /skal ldan 'di 'dra ci 6ltar skyes/ /chog shes 'byor pa thob gyur pas/ /skal ba gaḥsho bha se pa ram̐/ /lakṣa khaṃ shudha sa tā dzee bai rā gyu bha ra ṇa ma naḥ/ /bzang po mchog tu mdzes/ /yid ni chags bral gyis brgyan pa/ /sems can dag pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /kim sā spra bye ma ho dza sā sa ra dza sā duḥsā dha ṣpeḥsā dha ṣpeḥki sgo ge kṣa ṇa sgo dam pa rnams ni 'khor ba nye bar zhi slad rmongs chen myu gu nyams byed pa/ /skye ba gzhan 'a/ nyer bsgrubs dza ṣpeḥka lu ṣa deḥki sakta duḥkhaṃḥsu khiḥ/ /saṃ sā ro sa ra mā ya tse ta se sa chags bral gnas ni gal te yid la byed pa na/ /rgyal srid chen po gzi chan ༄7rdul bcas kyis ni bsgrub 8 95—481

hūṃ dzadmānta ro pārdzi tai bee rā gyi ku ru te ba rda ya di ma hā mo ha pra ro dka' sgrub byed rnams kyis ci/ /longs spyod skad cig spyod rnams kyis ci sdig ster sdug ldan khye/bde ba hā ba haṃ/ /ye na pā ṇa ya rde pri yā ba su ma tī saṃ tya bye te lbo la yā rnams kyis ci/ /gang gis nor mchog srog las phangs pa'i nor ldan ma ni bde blag nyid du gtong / /tre lokyā bhi ma te pi yaḥsma ra su khe bai mu khya dīkṣu gu ruḥ/ /saṃ mo ha gang zhig 'jig rten gsum po 'dod kyang 'dod pa'i bde la phyir phyogs 'doms pa'i bla/ /gang gis kun bya sa nā tu ram̐ dza ga di rda ye nā nu kaspraspa rda pu byeḥko pi sa dzā ya te rmongs sdug bsngal gyis gzir 'gro ba 'di ni rjes su brtse ba'i gnas/ /bsod nams dag gis blo ldan ma ti ma tī saṃ sā ra bā maḥ sha maḥ / / itru ghā bee mbi sā raste ni rnams kyi zhi ba ci yang 'khor ba'i g.yon der 'gyur/ /zhes brjod gzugs can snying po des snye/ /'od tā be ṇa ba nā shra oṃ/ / sa pra shā saṃ bha ga ba te tabye ṣṭha rnya n+ya be da ma'i tshal gyi gnas khrid nas/ /rab tu btud byas bcom ldan la/ /de yis chabyung ba'i mtha' rnams yata / /u dru ya rto pi su ga tā kā ram̐ su tsi ra tsinta tai/ /bi gsol—/ /bde gshegs rnam pa mthong gyur nas/ /dga' bas yun ring ④bsams byas te/ /bdag lo kya hasgo dādma sna kṛ ta kṛ tya ma ma n+ya ta/ /pra ṇa ma bya gra shi ra sā nyid bya ba byas par gyur 5/ /u dru ya na yis kyang bsams/ /mgo bos 37phyag 'tshal gyis byel ba⑦ / /saṃ sā rastso di nī ta no/ /pa bā ta bha ga ba sprusbyosta gya pra bra bye yā sa de yi lus la/ bcom ldan gyesazhe// /gzigs pa 'khor ba gcod byed ni/ /rab byung nyid dang lhan cig ha / /bhikṣu bhā ba ma thā sā rya pā tra pā ṇiḥs ṭī ba rī/ /na ga re piṇḍa babs 9 —/ /de nas dge slong dngos po thob/ /lag na chos gos lhung bzed ⑨ ldan/ /grong khyer du ni pā tā dhī tsa kā ra dza na bee sma yo / / pra dzāḥ shi kha ṇḍi dha mbi ṇa pā bsod snyoms bslangs/ /skye bo ya mtshan ldan par byas/ /gtsug phud can gyi 1skrerab dang blos/ /95—482

la yi tā pra sa nda dhīḥ / / yā ta kā le na kā lu 6 ma dha sthā bhe ra chos kyis skye rgu lho bskyangs byas nas/ /dus kyis chos min mngon 'dod cing / /rnyog pa dag dang ldan tophobha ba ta/ /ka lu ṣe kāñtsa na ru tsa bya tta birlubee lā si dī/ /na ka par grur/ /gser 'od gsal ba'i glog dag ni/ /rnam par ro' pa'i sprin 'phreng nabazhin/ /phun sum gya ku ru de lakhrorme gha mā le ba mā na saṃ/ /a nā yatrī ma hā ma hyerte ru ko bye tshogs pas su yi yid/ /dri ma can du byed ma yin/ /te ru ka dang bhi ru ka /blon chen dag gis chos ru kabya tai/ /a dhadzre kand+ra ni ra tai krurghaṃ ta tya dza tuḥpra hūṃ/ /tata pa de bee hi to min gyi/ /las la dga' zhing dbang ma gyur/ /khro ldan jo bo de btang gyur/ /de nas gnas su/ rgyal po rā dzñā sa tsi bo daṇḍa muṅga ro/ / tsiṭwā nu dṛtta ku sha lo swe ram̐ sasto ta yis—/ /dbyug pa tho ba blon por bcug /sems kyi rjes 'jug mkhas pa yis/ /dman par chags pa mu tsa tuḥ / / pra dzā rañdza na saṃ saghā rā dza dordza n+ya bā di naḥ / /de la smras/ /skye rgu sngurnams la mdza' bas yang dag chags/ /rgyal po gzhung ngan dag tu smra bar byed/ /swa ya sha ཿ khyu sa nā yi ba dzā ya rnye dhū rta ma dhri ṇa ཿ / / na dha nd+ra g.yon can blon po rnams kyis 5rang nyid kyi/ /grags pa rab tu sgogs par byed pa yin/ /gang zhig rje na su khaṃ nārja na kirta ye na dzre bi tai/ /ga ṇa yarnyi pra sgo raze te j-i tyā bha bo'i don du ni/ /chos la mi rtsi bde la min/ /don min grags min 'tsho ba min/ /de dag mchog tu bya bhakta yaḥ/ /nā khaṇḍi tā kṣa yi tā na tabhā nā su rpā ḍi tā/ /kuzlant+rabee gus pa'i g.yog /nges par til mtshungs skye rgu 6rnams/ /rgyal po'i don byed ma bcag pas/ /ma yin kri yā rā dzñāste la tu spyoḥ ki la pā dzāḥ / / i nyi bru bā ṇi to rā ma nyams pas kyang min/ /ma gdungs pas min ma gzir min/ /zhes sma sa 7de dag rgyal srid kyi/ /dzñā ni yukṣiṃ rā bye tsinta ṣpe/ /lo bhāta pra bṛsto dudṛ to habye niḥsha ra ṇaḥpra bsam pa la ni rgyal pos bskos/ /chags las (she spyod tshul ngan pa yis/ /skyabs med skye rgu 9 gzhom par 95byed483

dzāḥ / /nirngi tsa re du rā tsā re ku ma to thra thi bī pa to/ /lupta sa bye ma hā mā zhugs—/ /sa yi bdag po blo gros ngan/ /rnam par mi spyod spyod tshul ngan/ /sna chen bden pa nyams bye pra dzā rghaṃ dzī bi te ku taḥ/ /u dā ya rto tha tsi re ṇa ka dā dzibyu ṇi dzee pa thi/ /pa'i tshe/ /skye rgu lkurnams ni ga la 'tsho/ /de nas nam zhig yun ring 1na/ /lam du u dru ya na yis/ /ni dza de shā ga tai bā: sa pratstsha dṛ pa rabye yoḥ/ /so ba dadre ba ku sha li rang yul nas 'ongs tshong pa la / /mi bdag yul 'khor gtam dag dris/ /de yis smras pa lha khyod kyi⑦/ /su tasta ba ma tī pa tiḥ/ /kintu sadmarnyi ra hi taḥku madhri ba sha mā ga taḥ/ /sras pos 3sa yi bdag po dge/ /'on kyang dam pa'i blon chodang bral/ /blon po ngan pa'i dbang du song / /ta tra pra dzā dzā bee ta to pa tā paḥko pi bra thrattaḥpra bhu shā sa ṣpe na/ /ye nārya tadku྾ der ni 3jo bo'i bka' yis skye rgu ⑦rnams/ /nye bar gdung ba rab rgyas ci yang gyur/ /gang gis da lta ta de sha dzadma di bā ni shaṃ sho tsa ti po ra lo kaḥ/ /ya tra dhwarnyi sri dza de ni yul ngan skyes/ /grang sheba'i 'jig rten nyin dang mtshan mor gdung / /gang na nyi mas mun pa spro ti ta ra ṇirya tra tsabyeghi badhī ya tro de ti pra ka ṭa ma mṛ tā duṅka ṭaḥkā la ku ṭaḥ/ /byed gang na zla ba me char 'bebs/ /gang na bdud rtsi las ni rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rab gsal skye/ /ya tra tā tā ha ra ti dṛ pa tiñdzu ba bṛkṣiṃ pra dzā rmā ta tā kāsdo pra thra ta bi pu lo pa gang na skyob byed mi yi bdag pos skye rgu rmyernams kyi srog 'tsho 'phrog /nyer 'tshe ⑩ che ba rab rgyas de na cho bla be kaḥsh-i ḍo ti/ /i tyā sakta dṛ pa yā sa khinda sngarbhe ma yi ba tsaḥ/ /nge dag ni su zhig nyan/ /mi bdag gis gdungs skyo la gcags skye / /tshong pa'i tshig ni bzod dka' ba/ /duḥs ha ba ṇi dzaḥkhru twa sa ta spru tse 1 pā ni byeḥ/ /maṅgi rā tā mi to ga gdung ba'i rang bzhin de thos nas/ /brtse ba'i gter des de la smras/ /bdag gi tshig gis 'di nas tā tūṇḍi mā shā sa ya pra dzāḥ / / sthā pa yi byā mya haṃ dhadzre swa ya me khyod—/ /song la skye rgu 1snyedabugs dbyung mdzod/ /nga ⑫nyid 'ongs nas gtsug phud can/ /chos la rab 95byed484

ṇaḥsha shī sbra bi raḥs rā bye sgothi mitstsha ti/ /ṭī ba rojisna gā tra su ba brtan ri bong can nyams 1bzhin/ /de ni rgyal srid spyod par 'dod/ /lus ni chos gos kyis skyo zhing / /ra ba sthā bye lā ṣi ṇaḥ / / dzā tā su mu ṇḍi te mū dhri raspyo ka mu ku ṭa gos mchog mngon par 'dod ldan 'di/ /mgo zlum la ni rin chen gyis/ /mtshan pa'i cod pan 'dod smṛ hā / / ratna ha bye 6 na ba tā sasto ga bi bha bo bye ba / /tya ghā par gyur2 / /rin chen khang par /7gas/ra pa yi/ /longs spyod 'byor bas rnam jebaskrun pa'i/ /rtse bi lā saṃ sā yā saṃ pa na bā paṃ sa he ta kaḥ / /mṛ du sha ya na su dga' btang nas/ nags kyi gnas/ /ngal/ dub ldan pa su yis bzod/ /ri dwags rmig pas rtsub cing khārta ye ka rja she ra te te ha ri ṇa khu rakha roryatpa ṇḍa kā su sba lbo 6/ /tsher ma bltams 5pa'i thang kha 6la/ /gang zhig 'jam pa'i mal stan bder 'os pe de dag ji ltar nyal/ /ma dhu bi dhu ka ra shī tai yadzre rpā tai ka tharnye ba na dza ga dza ma doṣṭi tikta ma gang gis/ zla zer ltar bsil chang 'thungs de dag nags skyes kyi/ /glang po'i chang gis dro zhing kha ba'i chu ni mbhaḥpi brnyi/ /a dhu ṣpe ba ta ba sanda pra ba sa bi ṣa ma sbi taḥ/ /ā ryasma tai ji ltar 'thung / /khyod la mi bzang bgrod pa ni/ /da lta nyid du nye bar gnas/ /lugs shes rnams na ya bi dā ma rā dza pu tra ni pā ta rna/ /tasmra da nā ga to rā dzā pūthru ba rgyasta kyi dang ngo/'i gros/ /rgyal sras nges par lhung byed pa'o/ /de slad rgyal po ma 'ongs pa'i/ /sngon du jo bo ba pra sgo/ /dī paṃ harnyi pa tai go hi na dastebye ta sa mā ba tan/ /ta yo ri ti khyod kyis gsod/ /phye ma leb ni 'bab pa dag /gal te ma bsregs mar me 'joms/ /zhes pa de dag gi rā kṣi pra ma jubyu pa ti rā ku laḥ/ /kha la me s+hoḥka lu ṣa hūṃ bhā tai ka gya na tshig gis ni/ /sa bdag myur du 'khrugs par gyur/ /mi bsrun pa9sprin gyis su yi yid/ /dri ma ldan par mā na saṃ/ /sa to ba bhā ṣe sā shi kaḥkra ka tsa spyu ra hūṃ ga taḥ/ /bā dhaḥbyed mi 'gyur/ /dogs bcas sog le bzhin du ni/ /rtsub mor gyur des der smras pa/ /bdag dang 95—486

sā dhwa ra e bā yo yu ba yorma ma tsā gra taḥ/ /bha baddhā me ba bi na yo khyed gnyis mdun du ni/ /gnod pa 'di ni thun mong nyid/ /khyod kye gnyis nyid kyis khyad par gyis2 / /pā ya bi shānta yā dhi yā/ / bi tsārya kārya tā tpa bye yarlu shā taji bye yā tshul dang thabs la gnas pa'i blos/ /bya ba'i de nyid rnam dpyod lakasna/ /gang rigs de ni sgrub 4par tī / /i ti rā dzñā kṛ ta sotpa hā to bi sre rje shu ghā ta kān/ /u dru ya mdzod—/ /ces te rgyal pos spro bar byas/ /de dag gis mgyogs gsod byed btang / /gsad 5phyir u ṇa myu gra pa rja ba dhwa yi ba ba banta tuḥ/ /so bi bra dzā pa ri tā ṇi ni yohūṃ dru ya na yi byu/ /mdun gye lam ni rab tu bsdams/ /des kyang skye rgu ) yongs bskyab beed/ /bu 'a/ bsgo 8pu tra murya taḥ/ /bha ga ba tai sa ma bye tya bra dzā mbi ti bya dzi dzñā pata/ /bar brtson pa yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs te/ /bdag 'gro 'o zhes zhu bar rmyebyas/ /sarba snye nā dhya nu dzñā taḥrba gre tai bhu dzre tā mi nyi/ / kand+ra pā sha sa mā rang gis byas pa spyod mdzod ces/ /thams cad mkhyen pas rjes gnang nas/ /las kyi zhags pas yang kriṣṭaḥ sa ya yo ro ru shaṃ pu ram̐/ / ta maze dzarnyi ni rgyu dza mā tsā ra mi dag drangs/ /de ni sgra sgog 1 grong khyer song / /lam du zol 1byemed 'ong ba de/ /blon po gdug pas ba durdza nāḥ/ /dubye mā tya pra yuktasta dzasprutthazla ni ghā ta kāḥ/ / ta gya bskos pa yis 1rta/ /gshed ma de dag rnams kyis bsad/ /skye bo ngan pas kun spyod bzhin/ /bsad pa ṭī ba ra pā tā dī bṛ tī tā ni ha te su te/ /n+ya be da yan kṛ tai dī hye rā de yi chos gos dang / /lhung bzed sogs bzung de dag gis/ /blon po dag la mgu ba'i slad/ /rgyal dza kārya ma mā tya yoḥ/ /ta taḥbā ba bra z-iṭwā rgyu dzra pasthā rgyu pra dadhi tai/ /dṛṭwā po'i bya ba byas pas 8 smras/ /sdig pas rab dga' de dag gis/ /mi yi bdag la rab tu bstan/ /pha mu mo ha sa ha sā raghālto ṭī ba ram̐ bee tuḥ/ / sa labye saṃ dzñā sha na kaiḥyi chos gos khrag gis ni/ /sbags mthong 'phral la rmongs par gyur/ /dal gyis ki'adu shes thob pa des/ /95—487

shu sho tsa na ta thā gu sum̐/ /ya thā pa ti ta māza rna gho re na ra ka ga hwa re/ /ji ltar bdag nyid dmyal ba ni/ /'jigs rung gting du lhung ba yis/ /rgya ngan de bzhin bla ma'i min/ /sophob dbo ta saṃ pā bye pha lo kha la dza nādma yā/ /e shārya ma dhu lubye na des smras dbang phyug sbrang rtsi skyachags/ /sdig par lhung ba ma mthong ba/ /bdag gis skye bo mi bsrun khyepā ba pā ta ma ba shya tā/ /a ho pa ta ni rā lambi gho re na ra ka saṃ las—/ /kye ma 'bras bu yang dag thob/ /kye ma kye hud rten sa med/ /'jigs rung dmyal ba'i gting ka ṭi / / unda tā ro hi rde sa ryaḥ pa ta shaṃ kha la saṅga tai / /du ni/ /mthon por 'dzegs rnams mi bsrun ldudang / /'grogs pas 'phral la lhung byed 'gyur(5/ /kṛ ta me tata ma hata pā paṃ duṭwā mā tya bye yā ma yā/ /pa ti ta su ma me dā bhā pā gdug pa blon po'i blo gros kyis/ /bdag gis snyig chen 'di dag byas/ /da ni lhung bar gyur pa ④bdag /ba ko pi na pā ba kaḥ/ /tu lya pi tusthārta tabya ba dhe kā ma ma niḥkṛ tiḥ/ /gtsang byed kyis kyang gtsang mi byeg /menyam du pha dang dgra bcom dag /bsad pa bdag ni su yis sgrol//rpā tai ya tra ma yi kasmin pā tre sa da ha āoṃ bi ṣe/ /thradhe pi ta ri niḥshaṃ gang du bdag gi 'usnod gcig tu/ /dug ni sreg byed ldan pa 'thungasa3 / /dogs med yab ni rgan po ka sha ma pra bra bye lā shri te/ /swa tsibho ni shi tai shaste lo bhābye pa ri tai ma dag /rab byung zhi ba bsten pa la/ /chags las bdag gis rang gi sems/ /mtshon ni rnon po'i bya ba yā / /yahūṃ tsinta ta me ba kadza dza na shaṃ sho rtu na tarsha kya te dṛṣṭi byas / /gang zhig bsams pa nyid na 'dar ba skyed byed de ni thos par yongs 67mi bzod/ /gang zhig yartse ka ro ti sho ka ka la dzā nibye ta nā nā ma pi/ /ya tra kaurya ma pi mthong nas sems med rnams kyang mya ngan dag la rab tu bcags la9snapar byed/ /gang la 'gyod pa drag pra yā ti mṛ du tī tī drwa nu tā pāghi nā ta tā pi pra sa rarnyi nispyo ṇa bye po'i me yis ma rungs rnams kyang 'jam po nyid 'gyur ba/ /de la'ang brtse med blo ldan rnams ni ral gri 95—‘ 88

yī niste sha tīṣṭhaḥkri yāḥ/ /i trughā duḥkha santabeeḥpra lā sa mu kha rā na rnon po'i bya ba rab tu sgosasti/ /zhes brjod sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa2/ /bzhin ni cho nge'i sha mu cor naḥ—/ /n+ya pā ra yatta yoḥko pāta pra bee shaṃ duṣṭa man tri rtoḥ/ /gu rjanta ram̐ ba ri dzñā ya ldan—/ /ma rungs blon po de dag ni/ /nang du 'jug pa khro bas bzlog /yon tan khyad par yongs bhi ru ka te ru shaṃ tsa mān swa bhā ba sha ra khā yis—/ /de yi ma la mngon phyogs smras/ /lha mo khyod sras dpal dang ldan/ /rang bzhin gyis ni bsam sha yaḥ/ /rā bye rakṣ-i na dzwa nā ti swa dza notstsha da karka shaṃ/ /pi tā pra pra dzi to pa drang / /nang mi rab gcod rtsub mo yis/ /rgyal srid bsrung ba yongs 'umi shes/ /pha ni rab tu byung su su rā rdzu hartu mu pā ga taḥ/ /ā bā dzñā pra sha oṃ mbi tasta tra kā nā ma ba yang / /'di yi rgyal srid 'phrog tu 'ongs/ /bdag cag rnams ⑥kyis rab zhi byas/ /de la ci zhig bā tsu ta/ /bhā ta tarjo ba pand+ra bye ta kra mo ya mo shu bha kra maḥ/ /rā dzñā bye brjod par bya/ /gal te lugs kyi rgyud ldan pa'i/ /rim par ྅dge ba'i rim min na/ /dge slong de lā ṣi tā bhi sgosta sthā pi sa ka tha kra maḥ/ /ā rpā pi kṛ ba dha kro dhwata bā re yang rgyal srid ni/ /mngon par 'dod de ji ltar rim/ /sa bdag pha bsad khros pa yis/ /bdag cag to bhū bhu dzā pa dāta/ /swa ya ma tyā pi sho ke na ki mi byā pa ri shu 6 te/ /gnas nas rnam par bskrad/ /rang nyid da (dā lta'ang mya ngan /dngos po kun la g.yog po rnams//95—489

tya e ba pra rā dhi naḥ/ /ga tai sho tsa ti ki rā dzā yaskṛ tai ta me ba tata/ /gnod pa nyid dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal po 'das la ci zhig 'gyod/ /gang byas de dag byas pa nyid/ /u pe kṣa te twa yā de bi kasthāñtsiddhā kṛ sha su taḥ/ /tā bhya mi sgo di tai khru tā lha mo bsam pas ring ba'i bu/ /khyod kyis ci slad btang snyoms byed/ /de dag gis ni khye brjod thos nas//sa rā dza dza na byā sha naiḥ/ /khru tse ta ra li kā nā ma tabye kya bi hi tā da rā/ /ā de dag tshig la gus pas bsgrubs/ /ta ra li ka zhes pa yi/ /rgyal po'i ma des dal bus smras/ /khyod dzunantarya mi rda kand+ra dwa yo na gya sho shaṃ pi tro ba 'di ni mtshams med gnyis su 'gyur rī/ /'di yi pha bsad las skyes pa'i/ /mya ngan bdag gis bzlog byebye paṃ/ /artarja sgodhū baṃ duḥkhaṃ bha baddhā ma pi bārya tsā/ /i ti par bsangs de/ /95—497

shu muṣṭi ni pā na nāta/ /pra tyā sanda bi bā hā ha mi ti bhā ta ra māha sā/ /phyag dar rdul par lkugator ba las/ /bdag ni bag mar gyur pa la/ /nye zhu zhes ming po la des smras/ /ta ta sta gya pra bā de na bi kṣi burba rā rjabee ye/ /spyudhī pra hye ka budhe de nas de yis 5gtam dag gis/ /bag mar 'gro 'dod gzhon nu ma/ /rgyags pas rang sangs rgyas su ra rdzu se thra bhā kā n+ya kāḥ/ /ghra rja kṣa ra pra thraste na pra tya phe na bee rnams kyi/ /mgo bo la ni rdul rnams gtor/ /srin thubus zos rjes yi ge la/ /rab zhugs yid ches mo hi tā ཿ / /nimbi tsā ra pra ba rtadhe bee rudhe ṣṭa pi ba stu 6/ / pra kyis rmongs pa/ /rtog dpyod med rnams 'gal ba yis/ /dngos po la yang rab tu 'jug /shesdig dṛ tta pā ta kā tsa ra ta smi na bu dhe bu dhwa bhi bye / /spyod la zhugs de yi tshe/ / 'jigs pa rtogs shing khong chud pas⑥/ / burtse sogs kyi bod skad tshig rkang gcig pu 'di ni ba ra rde kṛ ha pa tī ka rma ṇa sta su tsa kra tu ཿ / / mee ba chad pa 'dar los bsgyur/7 las de khyem bdag mkhas pa dang / /sad pa zhes pas bzlog pa byas/ /bu mo ka sde na ra pa tiḥshi khaṇḍi pā pa byā ga j-ita/ /pra bā de kaṭwā daddhā tā bhi khyoḥde nyid gtsug phud can/ /mi bdag sdig pa ldan par gyur5/ /de yi ming po gtam sgogs kyang / /dge kā tyā ya no gya yo/ /dzā to kṛ ha pa ti rū bye duṣṭa tsa rirni bā ra shāta/ /pu ro pa slong kā tyā ya na 'di/ /ngan spyod dar ba bzlog pa las/ /khyem bdag de dag skyes pa ni/ /he ru ka tā pa nirmulto he ru bye ru kabya to/ /i ti bha ga ba taḥkhru tā bā kyi dang bhe ru ka /grong khyer nye bar gdungs 97las thar/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gsung thos dge slong rnams bi tsā rya tsa dzhakṣa baḥ pha la pa ri ṇa ti dzñā tā tsi hūṃ shu bhā shu bha ka nd+ra ni rnam par dbeed nas kyang / /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams 'bras bur yongs gyur bkra ba rab shes rde / / kha la dza na ba tsastu khye sha hūṃ bi tsā ra sa rma gu zu su nas / /mi bsrun snartaskye bo'i tshig mtshungs dgra dang rtog dpyod dang mnyam bla ma dang / /legs byas tso1 95—500

kṛ ta sa dṛ shaṃ bantu lo ke na kiñtsa na me ni re/ /e ti kṣe mend+ra bee ra tsi dang mtshungs gnyen ni 'jig rten dag na ci yang med par sems/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas tā yi bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yā mu dā ya shā ba dā na me pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las u dru ya na'i rtogs pa brjod ka tsa tā ri shaḥpabee waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste zhe kyetregacig pa'o// //yabye pā la bi shā la dā na bi bha ba probye ta pu rgyu bye ka dā na gang zhig sa skyong 'byor pas rab bskrun rgya cher sbyin pa'i bsod nams las/ lhag pa/ /dam pa'i snga ti kṛ sha gya satpa la bha ra pāsgo tya lo du rga taḥ/ /shubye sre ba bi z-ibye dharma 'bru yi grukhur ni dbul ba rirnams kyi sbyin pa shin tu chung bas 'thob4/ /chos dkar rnam par 'phel la dha ba la shra ddhā sa mṛdhyāmbi tai niḥsaṃ sā ra bi dzre bhi te ta du tsi tai tsitta dad pa phun tshogs dang ldan 'khor ba med pa ni/ /rnam par 'phel byed de ni sems dang nor dag dag pa su bitta gya tsa/ /dzi na dze ta ba nā rā ma bee hā ri ni ma hā dha naḥ/ /dhī nyid la rigs pa yin/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal/ gyi ni/ /kun dga' ra bar bzhugs tshe sngon/ /mnyan rā bhe jo naḥshra bsgyu ma bhudṛ ha pa ti pu rā/ /ta su paṇḍi ta nā mā dhū ta yod du ni khyim bdag dag /brtan depa zhes bya nor chen byung / /mkhas pa zhes bya de yi bu/ /legs phu traḥsu kṛ ta paṇḍi taḥ/ /a khaṇḍi ta ya shaḥpu bye dā nā waṃ kā ra maṇḍi byas cedag la mkhas pa byung / /nyams pa med pa'i grags pa dang 7/ /bsod nams nor gyi rgyan gyis taḥ / /sa bā la e ba bhekṣu rde rā dzāhaind+rant+ra sgo dza naiḥ/ /shā ri pu tra pra dhwa spras—/ / 'di ni 8byis pa kho na nas/ /shā ri'i bu sogs dge slong rnams/ /rgyal/ po la 'os gos zas nā nā tsa kā rā ti thi sa྾ yo/ / ta taḥ ka dā tsi dakhye ṇa durbhekṣa kṣa kyis—/ /mgron yodu gnyer zhing bsnyen bkur byed/ /de nas nam zhig mi bzad pa'i/ /mu ge skye bo 95—501

yi te dza ṣpe/ /yā tsu yā tsa ka tu lya twa piṇḍatstsha dobee nā ma bhuta/ /bhekṣu rde saṃ zad byed pa/ /babee nga bya slong byed mtshungs pa nyid/ /slong ba'i 'tsho ba chad pa byung / /dge slong rnams ka ṭi ta smin kā le ba ra ma dā ru bee/ /paṇḍi ta su ga tā snu taḥpra tasbe dze ni nyam nga ba/ /mchog tu mi bzad dus der ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas mkhas pa ni/ /bos nas rgyal ta kā na rna/ /tai pra bra dzaste tu re ge na kāñtsa nā dā na sho bhi na/ /ā tsurngi byed tshal du chas/ /gser kyi phreng bas spras pa yi/ /rta yis bgrod par byed de la/ /yon tan rab ṭāḥ sa ma byetya gu khotpa ha sa hiju baḥ/ /arja sarjarba na kalpa thrakṣastergyas mi bzod 1 pa'i/ /g.yo can sngon 3 du phyogs nas smras/ /slong ba'i don mthun slong ba yi bye/ /di kṣu bi khru ta ཿ / / sha tā ni pa ñtsa saṃ pra bhā sta mu byi shā sha ya dpag bsam shing khyed phyogs su grags/ /bdag cag lnga brgya khyod la ni/ /bsam pa gtad la ④yang ba yo/ /a lo kā dzā shu ka yu ge pra hye ka naḥs mbi hi tai/ /a dhu ṣpe bā bi lambi dag 'ongs/ /rgyan dang gos ni zung re dag /bdag cag so so yang dag 'dod/ /gal te phod na da lta na dī ya tī ya di shākya te/ /i sgoktasteḥs dā tsā raḥso ba tīrya tu ram̐ nyid—/ /thogs pa med par gnang bar mdzod/ /de yis 'di brjod dam pa yi/ /spyod ldan de ni rta ga man/ /sā dhu pū dza bi dhwa ye ྾ dhī mārpā ṇa ma tsi ta ya ta/ /bha ga las babs/ /de rnams legs par mchod byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas skad cig bsams/ /gal te banta ma dṛbye ba gatshwa mi swa kṛ haṃ ya di/ /ā sand+ra mṛ ta pā na su tai birgyu bcom ldan ma mthong bar/ /rang gi khyem du phyin pa na/ /bdud rtsi 'thung la nye ba yis/ /gegs shede ka tha mudma he/ /a da twa thra ya mabee snga bra dzā mi ya di nisnga paḥ/ /ka bdag gis ji ltar bzod/ /slong rnams 'dod pa ma byin par/ /gal te khrel med phyin pa na/ /sbyin dzee ka ro mi dā na gya hūṃ swa yo pra ta khaṇḍa dzā/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta su bhi tā bhū pa'i brtul zhugs rang nyid kyis/ /nyams pa 'di yang ji ltar bya/ /de ni de ltar sems pa na/ /klu yi 95—502

mo sa muṅga taḥ/ /nā ga rā dzaḥswa yi she ṣaḥpā dā dārja sa mbi nyi tai/ /rgyal po lhag ma rang / /sa gzhi brtol nas yang dag 'thon/ /slong 3rnams 'dod pa rab tu byen/ /daja ni nā ga rā dze na basthā rgyu bha ra shā ni tsa/ /sa te bhyaḥpra ti yātyā shu ya yo klu yi rgyal pos byen pa yi/ /gos rnams dang ni rgyan rnams kyang / /de dag rnams la byin nas de/ /zug ni ཿ sha lya tā mi ba / / te bi dṛ ṭī ta dā byarya pu ju su ga ta rngu med bzhin mgyogs par song / /des kyang ngo mtshar de mthong nas/ /bde gshegs bsgoms 27pa'i bhā ba dzā/ /sarjarja sadza ta sispyi dzā dza na dī me ba me ni bya/ /dzā ta bsod nams ni/ /don kun phun sum tshogs pa dag /'grub pa'i ma nyid yin par sems/ /de nas tsitta pra sā dā sna ste te ni bas hi tāsta taḥ/ /bha ga brnya ya pradrebye bee na sems ni rab dang skyes/ /zhe sdang sdig pa rnam par nyams/ /de dag de dang lhan cig nyid1/ /bcom sha dwo ṣa kasma ṣāḥ/ /bha ga banta ma lokyasta tāḥku mā raḥ pra ṇa tā na ldan 'das la blta ④ ru song / /de nas bcom ldan mthong gyur nas/ /gzhon nus bzhin ni rab btud naḥ—/ /utyā da padma ra dza sā dha n+yabya sru la la ṭi rmā/ /tā ram̐ pu rabya de—/ /de nas kruzhabs kyi pad rdul gyis/ /skal ldan dpral bar thig le byas/ /ston pa'i zhabs gnyis ra ṇa yoḥshāstuḥsha shi ka ro dzwa lo/ /bi n+yaste pra ṇa tā na gre sa tā nā smirya mdun du ni/ /do shal zla 'od rab 'bar ba/ /bkod nas mdun du rab btud pa/ /de dag de yis be da yata/ /dhand+ra de sha na yā te ྾ bha ga bān dzñā na badzra byeta/ /bhi tā de la gsol/ /bcom ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /de dag rnams la chos bstan pas/ /'jig 6tshogs sadku ya dṛdzñā dṛ sho taḥpābye pha lo bya dhwata/ /dṛṣṭa pa bye 6 yā te 6 ta lta ba'i ri phug nas/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsgrubs/ /de nas bden mthong de dag rnams/ /taste 6 pra ṇa mya hūṃ/ /ku mā re paṇḍi tai spru tyā bha ga bān swa ya ma bhā de la phyag 'tshal song ba'i tshe/ /gzhon nu mkhas pa dag la ni/ /bcom ldan dgyes pas mngon gsungs 95—503

ṣata / /patpa pu bye ra wasto pi par yābhe su kṛ hūṃ shri yo/ /dubhi kṣu ba pa—/ /bsod nams dag gis bu khyod ni/ /legs byas dpal 'byor yongs rdzogs thob/ /mu ge'i bar pi bhikṣu rde ku ru sgo dzñā bye bā sa mbi/ /pa ri gra ho me bhekṣu rde sha du dge slong rnams/ /zas la lhag par gnas pa mdzod/ /bdag gis dge slong brgya phrag ni/ /phyed tā n+ya rje tra yo da shaḥ/ /a bye tsadzre 6 kṛ sgoṭwāḥsaṃ bi bhasthā sta yā dang bcu gsum yongs bzung la sna/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis grong pa27khyer btsal/ /'o brgyal gzer la bgo pu re/ /i ti khrutā bha ga ba taḥpaṇḍi taḥpra mo dā ku laḥ/ /bhasgyu saṃ bshar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di thos nas/ /mkhas pa rab tu dga' bar khyedakrigs/ /ji srid gha gya bee da dhe yā basbyi baṃ ni mant+ra rde/ / ta taḥsra kṛ ha ma bye tya 'tsho bar gus pa yis/ /dge 'dun mgron du gnyer bar byas/ /de nas rang gi khyem song ste/ /dge rā dzārte sgyikṣu sasma teḥ/ /saṃ budhe pra mu khaṃ saṃ rghaṃ pa dā rbha byi ra pū dza yata/ /slong rab bzhed rgyal po la/ /'os pa'i zas kyis rtag tu ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs dge 'dun mchod//da ri dru na da ri dwobya yādhyā na bi tsa yā tsa kān/ /a tra shaṃ byādma bi da dbul dang dbul ba min rnams dang / /bslang bya dang ni slong byed dang ④/ /brtse bas 'os pa rnams la bye dā ṣpe nā sdezlu kai pi naḥ/ /she ṣān kṛ pa na saṃ ghā tān sotri 6 des—/ /sbyin pa zas kyis 5brtse ba bsgrubs/ /lhag ma thu'ajungs pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /snying rje'i chu ka ru rjambu dhīḥ/ /ratna rā shi da do te bhyo dorga rya ti mi rā sa haṃ/ /gter des btsal nas/ /de dag rnams la/ rin chen tshogs/ /dbul ba'i rab rib 'phrog pa byin/ /sa ratna ni ka ra ste ྾ dza gā mā gā ra rā shi tsā/ /dṛ hūṃbyā gyu ni ratna ni ma rin chen tshogs de de dag la/ /sol ba'i phung po nyid du gyur7/ /gang phyir nor bu rdo rang bzhin/ /ṇa yo he gā ta yaḥ/ /te ta mū tsuḥs ma bye ta swasna dṛṣṭa dha nā i ba/ /ratna rin chen mi rnams skal pa'o/ /de dag 'ongs nas de la smras/ /rmi lam nor ni mthong ba bzhin/ /rin 95byed504

nāsthā twa yāsmra kai sa dasto gā ra sañtsa yaḥ/ / dha na lā bhe na ma ha tā chen ming gi sol phung de/ /khyod kyis bdag cag rnams la byen/ /skye bo nor chen rnyed pa yis/ /'phral saryaḥpābhonda tisnga naḥ/ /tahūṃ khya yāta kṣa bee ṣpe ba pa ri bhrasbyo na dzi ba ti/ /i nyi la mthon po thob gyur pa/ /skad cig kho nas de zad shelas/ /yongs su nyams pa mi 'tshor/ /zhes pa te ྾ ba tsaḥkhru tā paṇḍi taḥka ru ṇa ni byeḥ/ /tadma tse pu rgya tī nā dzā de dag tshig thos nas/ /mkhas pa snying rje'i gter dag gis/ /der smras bsod nams dman rnams la/ /ratna tyā lnga tya ratna hūṃ / /yubye bherna kṛ taḥpūrde mo hākhru kṛ ta sañtsa rin chen rin chen min nyid 'gyuraḍa27/ /khyed kyis sngon ni rmongs pa la sa/ /legs byas tshogs ni ma byas ya / /te nā yi ratna rā shidzeeḥpra yā to gā ra sa ra hūṃ/ /ratna ni yatna ni hi pa—/ /des na rin chen phung po 'di/ /khyed la sol ba'i phyung por gyur/ /rin chen rnams ni 'bad ta n+ya pi yārnyi dū re pu sgo kṣa yā du ba na yādhi tsa bha gya yo gta/ /nas bzung yang bsod nams zad pa las/ /ring du 'gro zhing skal ba ldan pa las kyang nye bar 'ongs/ /biṭwā rdza āoṃ pa ti ta sho ka ni mitta ma ba bitrī hi tsitta mu tsi ti su pra nor rnams sgrub pa dag ni rgya che mya ngan mtshan ma nyid/ /nor ni legs byas dag la rab zhugs rigs pa'i kṛ ta dṛtrī/ /tasmrasgo bidhisgo rje ya byekṣu saṃ sgo bye bā gya tī/ /sgo ga saṃ sems nyid do/ /de slad khyed kyis dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun zas la sta gon mdzod/ /longs spyod phun bhā ra sa ma dhī ma haṃ saspa da ya mbi ba ཿ / /i trukta ste na ta dha tta sum tshogs pa'i tshogs/ /bdag gis khyed la phun tshogs bgyi/ /zhes brjod de yi 1nor dang zas/ /bitta sgo dza na saspa dā/ /te bubye pra mu khaṃ saṃ rghaṃ di na me ka ma pū dza phun sum tshogs pa byin pa des/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dge 'dun rnams/ /de dag gis ni nyin gcig 4 yan / /saṃ gha ya thā ba da bhyabyo pra ṇi dmā na ma kā ri te/ /mā ka dā mchod—/ /dge 'dun ji lta bzhin mchod nas/ /skad cig smon lam de dag gis/ /bdag cag rnam lta95byed505
