tsan dā ri bye snga dasmra ka mi ti kṣa rṇa/ /ta taste paṇḍi ta gi rā ga tā da dṛ shu yang dbul por ni/ /ma gyur cig ces bya ba byas/ /de nas mkhas pa'i tshig dag gis/ /de dag song ra gra taḥ/ /ta me rpā gā ra ni ka ram̐ pra yā tai ratna rā shi tsā/ /bha ba rgo paṇḍi bas mdun du ni/ /sol phung de nyid rin chen byi/ /phung po nyid du gyur pa mthong / /de nas mkhas ta tyā tha ku mā ra su pra bha ba taḥ/ /bi j-iṭwā nā ni dhwa nā ram̐ nimbi pa gzhon nu ni/ /mthu dang ldan pa'i khyim nyid du/ /rnam par bzhag pa'i gter dag ni/ /gegs ①med snasha ta mu rya yo/ /sa pra se na dzi te rā zlo dharma dzhaḥsbi ti rakṣa rjata/ /da brgya dag byung bar gyur/ /chos shes de yi lugs bsrung slad/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal nyid la ni/ /gter do ni dhwa na ṣaddhā gi sa tsā sum̐ gā ra tā ma gāta/ /ku mā ra sri ba su kṛ tairsā gyi drug cha phul de yang / /de la ldusol ba nyid du gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid kyi bsod nams kyis/ /gter gyo ya ni bye sañtsa yaḥ/ /i tyanta rīkṣutpa tsa na ta taḥshu shā ba bhū pa tiḥ/ /gyi tshogs 'di spyad bya yin/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di ldubar snang las/ /de nas sa yi bdag pos thos/ /ku mā ra sri ba sāmbi dhwa ni ni bye ni dhi tsā/ /bu naḥpāsthā ni sābyuryaḥgazhon nu nyid kyi tshig gis ni/ /gter rnams dag ni gter nyid du/ /slar gyur ngo mtshar bcas pa yis④//pra hi notta kṛ haṃ dzra paḥ/ /ta tasta da khi lo birghaṃ bi tīrya bi su khā sha yaḥ/ /mi bdag gis ni de khyim springs/ /de nas nor rnams ma lus pa/ /gzhon nu bsam pa yongs ⑤pa yis/ /ku mā raḥsadza dzā tsa kre spru ti durga ta tse me su/ /a tha niḥsā ra saṃ byin nas phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /dbul po'i khyim du gnas par byas/ /de nas 'khor ba snying po yā ra bi tsā ra bee ra ta spri haḥ/ /a ni tya tā sa saṃ tsi tya dhī raḥpi ta ra med—/ /rnam par dpyad phyir chags bral ba/ /brtan pa de yis mi rtag nyid/ /yang dag bsams nas ma pra bīta/ /a tra dzā mbi hi rmā tā bta gabye tā ta ta po ba āoṃ/ /i mā pha la smras/ /yab gcig 6dka' thub nags su bdag /'gro ba re zhig gnang bar mdzod/ /skye ba 95—506

dzadma sha tosbyi ṣṭha ma ma bi bhu ta yaḥ / / tre lo kya sa spa hūṃ pā byerya brgya yi lhag ma yi①/ /'byor pa nyid kyis 2bdag nyon mongs/ /'jig rten gsum gyi phun tshogs thob/ /smind+ra dza ti sgo gya hūṃ/ /ta di rda sadzee bhū tā dzñā mā yuṭwā dza na malpa shaṃ/ /shī te gang du spyad bya nyid 'gyur ba/ /'byung po kun gyi tshe yi ni/ /snod 'di shin du chung ba nyid/ /gang zhig ya gya ka ro mi saṃ ta ta mṛ du spabye gu kaihrū ha rde saṃ tā pe ra tsa yā grang la rgyun du bdag gis reg bya 'jam pa'i gos kyis g.yogs khrubya zhing / /gang zhig gdung la bdag gi 2 mi ya gya shi shi ra shri khaṇḍa tsa—rtsa rna/ /ya suze bi ṣa shasnga ba ha ni bhu dza dpal gyi dum bu bsel ba'i byugs ⑤pas byug pa bya/ /gang gi 6don du dug mtshon me dang lag 'gro'i ga zwa tā tpa ram̐ me bha yo pā ptaḥ so pa ma pā ya taḥ pa ri kṛ to tyā yā tshogs las mchog tu 'jigs pa 'thob⑦ / /bdag gi lus 'di gnod pa dag las yongs su bsrungs kyang ti kā yaḥkṣa rmā/ /sgo gāju rakṣa pra bra dzñā mā dā ya da yi tsā ba ṣpe/ /'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /longs spyod las ni chags bral bdag /dga' ba'i rab byung blangs nas ni/ /bi ha rā mi ha rambitrī tsi tā tabee su tse ta saḥ/ /i tyāghā pa ri tya nags su gnas shing bsam pa yis/ /gdungs pa sems kyi gzir ba 'phrog /ces brjod yab kyis khas bye bi ṣa yaste ha brnya rna/ /kṛ tā ju pa ga maḥpi tā shā ri pu tā shra blang phyani/ /byas shes kye yul la chags pa yi/ /'ching ba de yis yongs btang nas/ /shā te ri'i bu yi oṃ ya yo/ /ta tra pra krā dzi taste na pa tra pā ṇiḥs ṭī ba ro/ /ta sri bā nu gnas su song / /der ni de yis rab phyung ste/ /lag na lhung bzed chos gos can/ /de yi rjes 'brang tsa ra byu tā bi tsa tsā ra ma ta bra taḥ / / sa dṛ ṭwā ha rṣa kai bā ri nyid gyur nas/ /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams rnam par rgyu/ /zhing pa rnams kyis bstan pa yis/ /zhing kṣajasnye hūṃ barbhe tī/ /nirdibhe ya thā yadhe bi sma yā di tya tso ta yata/ /nas zhing la 'jug pa'i chu/ /lam nas bgrod pa de 0/ mthong nas/ /ya mtshan las ni 'di ltar bsams/ /95—507

a ho pi hi ta marge ṇa gastso tā ma gya tse ta saṃ/ /dza khā dzā kand+ra saṃ sidhitri kye ma sems med chu rnams kyang / /bsgrubs pa'i lam nas bgrod pa yis/ /las ni yang dag sgrub mthong bye te na tu de hi dzā / / saṃ bi hye hi pra dza nda gre dṛ ṣṭa ste—/ /lus can rnams la ma yin no/ /zhes bsams bgrod pas mdun du ni/ /mda' mkhan dag gis gyasbyi kṛ re/ /sa ta bee mi 6 ka re ṇa pra da gho rnyi ma tā sba raḥ/ /mda' bsros shing / /drang por byed pa mthong gyur nas/ /blo ldan mchog des ①rab tu bsams/ /tā sand+ra gu ṇa tā me te yārnyi ni bye ta nāḥ sha raḥ / / na tu saṃ sā mda' ni sems med 'di dag rnams/ / gdung bas khyedrang po nyid 'byur te/ /lus can 'khyog po ra saṃ tapta ma pi basthāḥsha ri ri ṇaḥ/ /i ti ghā ya na bi lo kyā pre ta rnams dag ni/ /'khor ba'i gdung bas kyang ma yin/ /zhes sems mdun du shing mkhan gyis/ /shing dzñā sha ka ṭa tsakra dzā/ / byā tā ni dṛ zwa rū pā ṇi pu nishyihūṃ sa mā rta'i 'khor lo nyid byas pa'i/ /brtan pa'i gzugs rnams mthong gyur nas/ /slar yang yang dag sems ya yo/ /a ho nu rya shwe nā yo gāta yābye kasthā rgya tsā kṣa ṇata/ /nibye ta nā ni dā par gyur/ /kye ma sems med shing rnams ni/ /bzo yi sbyor bas skad cig las/ /las su rung ba nyid rū ṇi na tsiṭwā ni sha rī ri rde/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya saṃ yā taḥsu dha nd+ra 'gyur te/ /lus can rnams kyi ④/sems ma yin/ /'di dag bsams shing yang dag song / /chos ni ya mā da raḥ/ /batpa lo pi ta ra pu tra i bā tsārya mu bā tsa sa/ /bzang nges pa la gus pa/ /de yis slob dpon la smras pa/ /mnyes gshin pha la bu yis bzhin/ /ārya e ba pri yā twa rya pa ṇḍa rpā tā ye maskṛ te/ /a haṃ ru bha ba 'phags pa nyid ni bsod snyoms la/ /de 5ring bdag gi ched du gshegs/ /khrod kyi ⑥ bstan pa rang tā di ṣṭi tsarnyi yā mi ni dza bra tai/ /i tru pā dhyā ya bhyabye bhakta kṛ tyā nyid kyi/ /brtul zhugs bdag gis bsam par bgyi/ /zhes te zas kyi bya ba ni/ /mkhan po la gsol 95—508

be da yāta/ /sa mu rya ta mya ta snga tha bhigru sgo dza na sidhe ye/ /shudhe ya dag la phul/ /de nas dad pas dge slong gi①/ /zas ni bsgrub khyapar brtson gyur pa/ /snying stobs shudhe satwa gya sha kro bhū da nu sā dhu kaḥ/ /di gya barṇa ra sā mo de sgo bye sha dag pa de yis (kyeni/ /rjes su sgrub byed brgya byin gyur/ /mdza' bo brgya byin gzugs bsgribs pas//kre ṇa sā bye te/ /spru tyā pratstshanda rū pe ṇa bhikhye le bhe na durga taḥ/ /lha yi bza' ba kha dog dang / /dri dang ro ldan bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /dbul pos dge slong rnyed ma gyur//bhe bhu nyi mā hi to gābyeḥpund+ra pu ra ni bā si bhiḥ/ /saṃ bhe ni madhri te duḥ'abyor ldan longs spyod phyug pa yis④/ /grong pa rnams kyi khrusngon du ni/ /dge slong mgron gnyer sdug khāta durga to martu mu rya yo/ /kri pa yā ta su bha ga bān swa ya ma bsngal la/sa/ /dbul po 'chi ⑥ba rtsom par gyur/ /de la brtse bas bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs tshu bye tya kā shya paḥ/ /shudha sidhi pa ri dzñā ya tsakre sgo dzre pra ti gra ha/ /rang nyid mngon phyogs te/ /dag cing grub pa yongs mkhyen nas/ /zhal zas rab tu blang ba mdzad//a ho haṃ bha ga ba to sgo byo pra yasgo mi ti byu bhu dzā/ /pra yatnadmā bee bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal zas bdag /dbul zhes rgyal pos nor rnams kyisaldu/ /rab tu 'bad pas to gyarja ṣpe bā ma n+ya ta durga ta ཿ / / gu ṇa dra bee ṇa saṃ pūṇḍi shā gso' btab kyang / /dbul pos nges par khas ma blangs/ /de nas bcom ldan mchod byas te/ /de ma spyi ti pra sā da āoṃ/ /bha ga banta ma thā bhyabyo pra ṇi dhwa na tsa kā ra saḥ/ /yis smon lam rab tu btab/ /yon tan nor ni yang dag rdzogs/ /dbul la drin par bdag gyur cig/swā shra oṃ kā shya pe yā ḍi su rend+ra tsa ga to di baṃ/ /durga ta gya kṛ haṃ sabye di 'od srungs rang gi gnas gshegs shing / /lha dbang mtho ris song ba'i tshe/ /lha yi rin chen thams cad kyis/ /bya ratna ma pū ra yata/ /bi shwa ka1 ta tasta su bi da dhe shakra shā sa nāta/ /bha dbul po'i khyem ni khengs par gyur/ /de nas brgya byin bka' las ni/ /de yi khang pa skyed tshal mdzes/ /bi 95—512

ba na ru tsi ro byā rna ratna ste bha bee bhu ṣi tai/ /saṃ pābee bi ma le shwaryaḥs hi shwa karmas rin chen gyi①/ /ka bas rnam par brgyan pa byas/ /dri med dbang phyug yang dag thob/ /de yis tai sattha bhikṣu bhiḥ/ /saṭwā haṃ bee bha baisgo geḥs kā shya pa ma pū dza yata/ /zhag bdun 'od srungs ni/ /dbe slong kun dang bcas pa dag /'byor pa longs spyod rnams kyis mchod//kṣukhyi me ga ṇa mabee bheḥpa ri hri ta dā ram̐ ru da dā ra kai ge haṃ ni: la kadzdza lā gang gi khyim ni bud med bkres pas (ṭwārid cing bu tsha du la slong rnams kyis/ /sgo ni dzuyongs dor khri stan sre n+ya pi tha rī ko ṇatstsha ṇadmā kṣi kā/ /tsullī supta bi ḍā la bā la ma pa re ya snga bha mog phreng ldan g.yo med zur na sbrang bu sgogs/ /byi ba'i rīphrug gu dag ni thab tu nyal zhing ngu 'bod gzhan bā ro rā baṃ shrīsba sri ba oṃ pasmṛ hāspa da ta yā tsa mru na ka su swa yo/ /te pa bzhin gyur pa/ /de yi dpal ni mi bdag chags pa'i gnas nyid dag gis su zhig mtshar thumi byed/ /sbyin na dā na pra bhā been suddhā shudhe na durga taḥ/ /dzadmānta re paṇḍi ta tā mi bāspyorta pa'i mthu ni bdud rtsi ltar/ /dag pa de yis dbul po ni/ /skye ba gzhan du mkhas pa ni/ /thob 6nas dgra twa mā ga taḥ/ /i ti baṇḍi ta pūza dzadma brta ka thi tai sadzdza bi dā gu rja da re ṇa/ /bcom nyid du gyur/ /de ltar kun rig 7jeyon tan la gus pas/ /mkhas pa'i skye ba snga mar byung ba gsungs//a ba dharya bi shudha dā na pu bye ku sha khārtaḥpra sha saṃ sa byekṣu saṃ ghaḥ/ /i rnam dag sbyin pa'i bsod nams dge la 'os/ /nges par bzung nas dge slong tshogs des bsngags/ /zhes ti kṣe rngend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī paṇḍi tā pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ba dā āoṃ nā ma dī tsa tā ri shaḥpalla baḥ// //mkhas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //sa two na srurya ru tsa yasta ma si sgu rabye dhazle ṇa ratna ni tsa yā snying stobs kyis ni nyi ma'i 'od zer mun pa la bzhin gsal/ /chos dag gis ni rin chen tshogs 95—513

na bha saḥs tarnyi/ /byerle ṇa sadzee bi pa dāḥpra sha oṃ bra dzarnyi dā ṣpe rnams mkha' las 'bab par 'gyur/ /brtan pa yis ni rgud pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gro/ /sbyin na sgo ga su bha gāḥ ka ku sgo bha badhi / /bha ga bārlu ga taḥpūttha shā pa yis ni phyogs rnams longs spyod skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon//bahūṃ dze ta kā na ṣpe/ /ku sha lā dzā pra band+ra ram̐ bi da dhe dhand+ra de sha bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /dge ba rab tu rdzogs rnams la/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa dzā / /pūzla kaspranta ra dza de tsa pa nāṣṭa yu tā yu ṣi/ /shrī mārko na ka mdzad—/ /sngon gyi dus ni gzhan dag la/ /skye ba (7tshe lo brgyad khri'i tshe/ /dpal ldan gser mdog baṭwā khro ba byu ba thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /ka na ka khya pu rī ta gya sha kra gye bā ma ces bya ba'i/ /sa yi bdag po byung bar gyur/ /de yi grong khyer gser zhes pa/ /brgya byin 'chi med rā ba tī / / sand+ra lo ke shwa ra snga pi ba sa tidzeebee bhā bha ba ti/ /ldan bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbang yin kyang / /bzhugs gnas yid du 'ong bar gyur//nā ya kahaṃ ya shaḥ shu rja tsā ru bṛ tta gu rṇa tsi tai/ / j-i da ye yaḥ'adren par 'os shing grags par 37 dkar/ /mdzes par zhugs shing yon tan rigs/ /gang gis mu nyig pra dzā kāṅgi muṣā hā ra mi ba ba hata/ /pra dzā kasmra bi bā ke na pu re pa do shal bzhin/ /skye rgu'i snyebya ba snying la bzung ④/ /skye rgu'i ⑤las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /char med ra ma dā ru shā/ /a dṛṣṭa ra bha batta tra sarba bhū ta bha ya pra dā/ /sābyerya mchog tu mi bzad cing / /skye rgu 67rnams la 'jigs ster ba/ /de yi grong khyer dag tu byung / /snying hā ri bhā sand+ra lo ka saṃ tā pa kā ri ddhā/ /a bṛṣṭaḥpra ya yo byu j-ita mā stobs ldan )pa 'phrog byed cing / /thams cad yongs su gdung byed pa/ /char med de ni sa 'dzin gyis//na sā ya sa he tu dzñā/ / kuṇḍa sathru pra tī kā raḥ sa tsind+ra sba mi tai yid ni yongs gdung rgyu nyid gyur/ /bcos thabs thams cad nyams pa des/ /blon po'i gtso bo'i dkyil 95—514

pu raḥ/ /u bā tsa su tsi ra dhyā tā pra dhwa nā mā tya maṇḍa lo/ /a bsgo 'khor ni/ /bsam pas g.yo ba med mdun du/ /shin tu yun ring tso7bsams nas smras/ /bcos thabs pa ni pā to yo pra dzā āoṃ niḥpra ti kṛ yaḥ/ / ka ro ti me yatna kṛ tai med pa'i char med ni/ /nye bar lhung 'di skye rgu 2 rnams/ /bdag gis snye'abad pas yongs bskyang ba//niphe lo pa ri pā la āoṃ/ /ni bṛtta bsteḥka ku sgo bha baṃtya bha ba swatstsha kāḥ/ /byas pa 'bras bu med par byed/ /sa spyod sdig pas skye rgu byernams/ /mchi ma'i char ni rab 'bebs shing //pra thratta ba tpa ba rṣabya pra dzā pā pe na byu bhā dzee/ /tā ṇa ma ha bye yo 'byor med gsal byed phyogs rnams kyizhwa/ /char ni nges par 'chad par 'gyur/ /skye rgu 6'jigs pa che rā dza pra dzā dzā na ka ro ti yaḥ/ /ta susbaṣṭi na ṭa phye ba ki rī ḍa mu ku la gang / /rgyal pos skyob par mi byed parape/ /de yi zur phud cod pan 'dzin/ /gsal bar zlos gar ṭa gra haḥ/ /ta dā kṛ ta yu shaṃ lo ke ya dā rā dzā pra dzā hi taḥ/ /ta dā ki la lta bu yin/ /gang tshe rgyal pos 'gro la phan/ /de tshe 'jig rten rdzogs ldan dus/ /gang tshe rgyal pos ka lirlo ke ya dā rā dzā pra dzā hi taḥ/ /durbhekṣa kṣa pi tā bi sakṣa ba ta na pra tyakṣa 'gro mi phan/ /nges par 'jig rten rtsod ldan dus/ /mi bdag rnams kyi sdig pa dā' sa ni skyabs med skye la zlu kṣa ya ro go bye ga sa mā hi tā ཿ thra thu ta ra kle shā ba rgu shakyemu ges nyen gyur cing / /mi mthun phyogs lhung mngon sum mtshon pas 'jig cing nad dang sdug lī bitstsha khāḥ/ /hā hā kā ra bi shri kha lāḥkha le ta ri ra tyardi tā balla byeḥbasngal nye bar gnas/ /zab 0rgyas nyon mongs dag gis shin tu nyam thag ma bsdams kyi hud ces pa sgrogs//sho tsiṣṭhaḥpra ṇa yi pra yī tya sha ra shāḥpā pedṛ pā rde pra dzāḥ/ / tasmratpa shin tu mi bsrun hu1mdza' bos bslangs rnams mya ngan byed cing mdza' gcugs med par 'gyur/ /de slad ma sta ko ṣe ṇa rakṣa dhī yā ma yā pra dzāḥ / / rā dzñā pra dzā pa ri tā bdag gis skye rgu ཿbyernams/ /mtha' dag mdzod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /rgyal pos skye rgu )yongs skyob pa//95byed515

ta taḥpa pā tā khi la bye bye dṛṣṭi riṭwā pra dzā rna byu bi sabee rā tram̐/ /dhwa tyā di bṛṣṭasta de nas zhag bdun sa la skye rgu rte1rnams/ /'dod pa'i kha zas ma lus char du 'bab/ /de yi snye'og tu da na nta ram̐ tsa ratna di bṛ ṣṭa : ta ta ཿ kra me ṇa / / i ti sa ka na 'bru la sogs pa'i char/ /de nas rim byis garin chen tshogs char yang / /de ltar legs byas phun ka baṇḍi kṣa pa nyispyo ba tī rmā mu ku ṭa ma ṇi ri bo rtswaddhā dzamā naḥpra dzā āoṃ/ /tshogs la dga' sa yi bdag po dag /gser mdog de ni sa bdag kun gyi cod pan nor bu bzhin//a kṛ ta su kṛ ta samyuttha ṇi naḥpā ṇa rakṣu pra bha ba nyi hi pa rabee sadzdza na mchog tu mdzes shing skye rgu pyarnams kyi srog ni bsrung bas mdzes/ /gang phyir skye bo dam pa'i mthu ni gzhan rmā pra bha ba/ /bhu pa tiḥka na ka baṇḍi e ṣa yaḥso ha me ba ba pu ṣādma nā dhu rmā/ /don rab sgrub byed/ /gang zhig sa yi bdag po gser mdog de/ /da lta nga nyid sku yi bdag nyid 'di//i kyu dīrya bha ga bāñdzi naḥs tī dhī ma hūṃ bya bye ta dhand+ra de sha rghaṃ/ /i ti de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan rgyal ba yi5/ /blo ldan dam pa rnams la chos bstan mdzad/ /ces pa kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā yī sgo bye sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dzee ka dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las na kā ba dā rghaṃ tri tsa tā ri shaḥpalla waḥ// //gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //pa ro ba kā ra pra ṇa yi pra bhā baḥsasbo pa dzre bya ma ha tī bee bhū tiḥ/ /pu dhyā gzhan la phan pa 6sgyu'ajibs pa'i mthu dang ni/ /kun kyi nyer 'tsho 'byor ba chen po ste/ /'bras bu ku ro ha gya bhā hūṃ bi shā la pha lārta rnge tattha tha oṃ hi putpam/ /dzi na dze ta cher 'os 'di dag dge rnams kyi/ /bsod nams myu gu'i 'bras bu dang po 7yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gyi ba nā rā ma bi hā rā bye me ta pu rā/ /shā babye de ba se nā khyaḥshrī mā kun rar sngon⑧/ /rgyal ba bzhugs shing sngon 9 7dgyes tshe/ /dpal ldan khyim bdag lha yi sde6/ /zhes 95—517

nā sbobye hā bye paḥ/ /ti ra ju pa ṇista snga bhu ta pu traḥsahphu tra mā ni naḥ/ /ya pa mnyan yod dag na gnas/ /bu khyod kyis ni khengs ldan de'i/ /bu ni gser gye lag gyur te/ /gang su he ma ma yo dzā tī pā ṇi dī ta ya madhū tai/ /rū pya lakṣu dwa yo ta su pā taḥgi lag gnyis rmad byung ba/ /gser gyi rang bzhin dag tu 'gyur/ /de yi (1snalag gnyis dag la dngul//pā ta ka ra dwa ye/ /pā du rā satpa ye na dbee rmā kalpa pā da saḥ/ /ta snga dro snga dro 'bum phrag gnyis/ /rab tu skye ba gang gis ni/ /slong ba'i dpag bsam shing du gyur/ /de su byakta bee bee ke na pa ri pā ke na khyu ya sā/ /ka le ku sha la mū lā rmā dzi yi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /dus kyis yongs su smin gyur pa/ /rab gsal dben pa chen po yikhu/ /rgyal ṣpe bhasti ra dzā ya ta/ /a tha dze ta ba rmā ga tā bha ga banta ta thā ga tsā/ /sa ba la ni gus pa skyes/ /de nas rgyal byed tshal du de/ /song nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /mthong dṛbye bid dhe na gya sā nandaḥpā da banda nā ma/ /bha ga bā na pi saṃ sā ra tā ste kun dga' ldan pa yis/ /de yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal byas/ /bcom ldan gyes kyang 'khor ba yi//pa pra sha ma tsadhri shaṃ/ /su dha sa kho di de shasmi dri shaṃ ku sha la dru ti shaṃ/ /gdung ba zhi byed zla ba'i 'od/ /7pabadud rtsi'i grogs po dge ba yis nga7/ /pho nya gzigs pa de la gtad//sa shasturdarsha nai bee ba saṃ mo ha ti mi rodzhai taḥ/ /ba bhā ṣe srurya ki ra ṇa ston pas gzigs pa nyid kyis de/ /kun rmongs rab rib rab spangs pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis padmo ni//pra budha ka ma yo pa maḥ/ /bha ga bān bee da dhe ta gya ta taḥsadhand+ra de sha rab tu rgyas pa lta bur mdzes/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /de la dam pa'i chos bstan ( 5ram̐ / /ya yā dhadzre ma yo tsakṣu rakṣu ṇḍa lo ka mu rya yo/ /pāku sgo pa mdzad / /gang gi 6chos kyi rang bzhin can7/ /mi dman snang ba rab tu bsgrun rde7/ /sngon gyi bsod ri rja me na dze ta bee ra gya bā pa naḥ/ /pra ṇa mya bee ma la pra dzñāḥsanams yongs smin pas/ /chags bral bag chags sad gyur pa/ /shes rab dri ma med pa des/ /phyag 95—518

sand+ra dzha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /sha ra rgya sha ra ṇasta su bha ga bān bha ba ha ri 'tshal kun mkhyen la gsol ba/ /bcom ldan skyabs thob skyabs su 'os/ /nyon mongs ma lus nyams pa'i ṇi / /a she ṣa gre sha nā shā ya pra bra dzñā me bi dhi yā tsā/ /tsa pa lo bra slad—/ /srid pa 'phrog pa'i rab byung ni/ /bdag la rab tu sgrub ①par mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi (2 ṇi nā mā yusta to pi na ba yo ban/ /bi byu da tsa la na bi khāsta to bye tā bi tshe srog g.yo/ /lang tsho gzhon pa de bas kyang / /glog ni 'khyug pa bzhin du g.yo/ /de bas kyang ni bhū ta yaḥ/ /i ti ta gya bra bā ṇa gya su ga tā nu gra ho di hūṃ/ /pa pā ta bī 'byor pa 'di/ /zhes pa smra zhing chags bral ba/rte7/ /de yi lus la bde gshegs kyis/ /rjes su bzung ba ta ra dza saḥpra bra dzñā ba pu ṣi swa yi/ /rakta ṭī ba ra su byaste bi sthā las skyes pa'i/ /rab byung rang nyid lhung bar gyur/ /chos gos dmar pos rab gsal ba'i/ /chags ṇaḥs bi rakta dzā/ /pa tra gra he ṇa ta kyā dza pu naḥsaṃ sā ra pā tra rmā/ /bral nyid ni de yis bzung / /lhung bzed bzung bas beer yang ni/ /'khor ba'i snod nyid rab tu btang //ta gya tā ma da byu tai seddhi pra tyakṣ-i bīghra bhi kṣa baḥ/ /tadruttha bṛ.āoṃ pa prasgorbha dge slong rnams kyis de yis ④ni/ /rmad byung grub de chomangon sum mthong / /de yi sngon byung bcom ldan ga brnya sa tsā bra bīta/ /bā rā ṇa gya pu ra rā dzā kṛ tīrtswa ma ta thā ga la—/ /dris shing des kyang rab gsungs pa/ /rgyal po kṛ tī khuzhes pa sngon/ / wā rā ṇa sīr krude bzhin te—/ /kā shya pā khye bha ga ba ti pra yā ti pa ri nirde ti/ /sha ri ra ma gshegs—/ /bcom ldan 'od srungs zhes bya ba/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das gyur tshe/ /de yi gdung ni gya saskṛ ta stu paṃ ratna ma yo bya dhwa ta / / swa nā ba gā ta na thra rte rab sbyangs nas/ /mchod rten rin chen rang bzhin dag /mtho ris snyog kyenus bsod nams ni/ /mūrbhe pu rgya mi bonda tai/ / tasmind+ra ro bya mā zla yī yabyu pū dza pa ri gra gzugs can bzhin du mtho ba byas/ /de la mchod pa yongs 'dzin cing / /bya ru 'dzugs pa ⑨byed pa'i 95—519

he / /ki ta tsaḥkanda lo nā ma ni da dhe rū pa ka dwa yo/ / tsitta pra sā tshe—/ /bzo bo kan ta la zhes pa'i hūṃ/ /gzugs can ⑤gnyis ni rnam par bkod/ /dang ba'i sems ni debyedhe na te na bu bye na bhu ya sā/ /hi ra ju bā ṇiḥpāsto rya ma ha tīsmṛ ha dhī dag pa yis/ ③/ /bsod nams shin tu che ba des/ /da lta gser gyi lag pa ni/ /'dod par bya ba chen ya hūṃ / / bha ba ti bi bha ba sgyu go da yaḥ sa mo gra gu rte bye bi ta ཿpo thob/ /'jig rten du ni rab tu grags pa 5dkar po bdud rtsi'i zer kyis byespun drung dang ༅//pra sha ra ti ya shaḥku kle lo ke surghaṃ shu sa ho da ram/ /pa ri ṇa ti pa de pu gtong ba'i yon tan drag bo dang ldan 'byor pa rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /chung ngu gang zhig yongs bsngo'i bye dhaste ya dalpa ma nalpa hūṃ bee ma la ma na saḥshrabye shuzlo ta de ba bi dzo bhe gnas la bsod nams chung ngu nyid min gyur/ /de nyid kho na dri med yid kyi dad pa dag pa'i (mekun spyod tai / /i ti pra bhā baṃ ka thi haṃ dzi ṣpe na pu dhyā nu byā ba gya hi ra sgo pā ṇiḥ/ /khru two yin / /bso/da nams mthu ldan gser gyi lag pa yidā/ /mthu ni de ltar rgyal bas bshad pa dag /thos pa ba harṣa da ra bisma yā dzā sa rbhakṣu saṃ ghaḥpra ṇa yī ba bhu ba/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra nyid na dge slong she—dge 'dun te1 / /dga' dang gus dang ya mtshan dbang du gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī hi ra bye bā dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod nga/ 11dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser gyi khya bā dā rna tsa tuṣṭa tā ro shaḥpalla baḥ// //'a ga pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //dudzdza na duḥs hā bi ṣa dha ra dī ṣa ṇa ta ra ti mi ra ba ti tā rmā/ /srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog rgyal ba dran pa ni/ /skye bo ngan pa nye2bzod dka' dug 'dzin dang //ā lodza rna dza na rgo bha ba bha ya ha ra rṇa dzi nasma ra rṇa/ /pu re rā shin tu 'jigs rung khron par lhung gyur pa'i/ /skye bo rnams kyi rten sar gyur pa yin/ /grong khyer rgyal 95—520

dzā kṛ hābhi khye bha ga bānd+ra j-i taḥpu rā/ /ka ṭa ke kṛ dhra ku ṭa gya bi dza po'i khab ces par/ /sa 'dzin bya rgod phung po yi/ /ngos la sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin hā ra tathā ga taḥ/ /tasminda ba sa re rā dzā beembi sā raḥpu ta pri yaḥ/ /gshegs pa bzhugs par gyur/ /skabs der bu la byams pa yi/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po nyid//a dzā ta sha tru ṇa ta tra pu hre ṇa kru ra kā ri ṇa/ /su hri daḥpā pa ka sre ba de de yi bu ni ma skyes dgra/ /gdug pa byed par gyur pa yis/ /grogs po sdig pa dang ldan pa/ / lha sbyin 3ba datta su sasma tai/ /gho rāndha bandha nā gā ram̐ niḥsaṃ tsā ram̐ pra be shi taḥ/ /saddhāḥgyi ni gros bzhin du/ /'jigs rung mun can btson khang ni/ /rgyu ba med par rab tu bcug /bkres pra bee shi tai ta mya brnya ṣpe gru bhā sgo dza rna/ /dzñā tā sa ta ṅgha yā hūṃ khye pas nyen pa de la ni/ /btsun mos zas dag btson khang du/ /gsang nas rab tu 'jug par byas/ /grukhyo ma su n+ya bā ra yata/ /rū kṣaḥkṛ sho ni ma li naḥso bha babye thi bī pa tiḥ/ / des gsad ⑤'dod des shes nas bzlog /sa yi bdag de shin tu rid/ /sngo zhing dri ma ldan par gyur//a ka la kā la me ghā rtaḥkṛṣṭa sa kṣa i bend+ra yaḥ/ / sarko ṇḍa ba sa si dus min sprin nag gis gzir ba'i/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi zla ba bzhin/ /phal cher mnyes gshin sems tā baḥpra yaḥpe sha la tse ta sī/ /ka ro tyā li gā rna thra ṭwā gā bhā pra ṇa ldan lathu/ /mchog tu rgud pa'i mdza' mo ni/ /gdung bcas sred dang ldan rajebazhin du/ /shin tu dam yi nī ba mata/ /sa sa muju shya sho kārtaḥsu ga tā zlu ṣi hūṃ di shaṃ/ /par 'khyud par byed/ /bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i phyogs su ni/ /mya ngan gyis gzir der 57phyogs te//kṛ tā ñdza lirna ta shi rāḥkṣu ma swa ra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /na mastu bye bha ga ba thal mo sbyar te spyis btud nas/ /skad gdangs zhan par rab smras pa/ /dman pa 'don pa la brtson te ma hārta ya ma hā rta te/ / dī noddhā ra ṇa sa nāddhā samyakshi bo bye pa—/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rin chen dgra bcom chen po nyid/ /bcom ldan khyod la 95—521

tsirti se/ /na ma ste gho ra saṃ sā ra ma ka rā ka ra se ta bee/ /dzi nā ya dza phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba skye tshogs skye ba yi①/ /nyon mongs rab tu zhi ba'i rgyu/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba na tā dzadma kle sha pra sha ma he ta bee/ /na mo ni tya pra buddhā ya sattha rgya mtsho yi/ /zam stegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid rnam par dag /snying rje sa two ka bandha bee/ /bi shudhe dhwasne budhe ya ka ru shā mṛ ta sendha bee/ /i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ste/ /sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu2/ /rtag tu sad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ti bhasti su dhwa seskra su ga ta shra ba ḍo tsi hūṃ / / pu ju pu tpa pra sā pa bsod nams me tog las/ /'khrungs shing gus pa'i bdud rtsis bran/ /bstod pa'i dog pa bde ba dī sa tsakra stu ti oṃ dza rī ma/ /sarba dzha sta gya bi dzha ya kā ya kle sha gshegs kyike —/ /snyan du 'os pa de yis byas/ /de yi nyon mongs ④sdug bsngal gyi/ /rang bzhin skabs ma yī da shaṃ/ /bandha nā gā ra bi ba rā lo kai ro snga ya rna bya dhwata/ /a dzā mkhyen kun mkhyen gyis/ /'ching ba'i khang pa'i bu ga yi/ /snang ba dag gis tshim par byas/ /de ltar ta sha trusta tho trī dzñā tā shaṃ kā ku laḥpi tuḥ/ /a bā ra yadma ddhā kṛ he gyur pa ma skyes dgras/ /shes nas dogs pas 'khrugs gyur te7snye/ /pha yi btson khang dag gi ⑥ni//su srughra bi ba rā rgya pi/ /ta tasta gya ta dā de shāta kru ra banta na rakṣiṇaḥ//bug pa shin tu chung ba'ang bkag /de nas gdug pa'i btson srung gis/ /de yi ⑦bka' las spu gri yis//kyu re ṇa gā bye ba ndha su pā da yostaju karta rna/ / sa ti bra bee sha sa dam du bcings pa de yi ni/ /rkang pa rnam par bcad par byas/ /drag po 8 sdug bsngal nyon mongs kle sha bya thi ta ཿ sābee ba ཿ pa ra / / na mo bu ddhā ya bu ddhā ye tya nti kyis—/ /mchog tu gzir ba'i sa bdag des/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /gdung ba'i sa kranda bya dha ta/ /bha ga bā na tha sarba dzhaḥpu raḥpra tya kṣe tai ga taḥ/ /cho nge ldan pas brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /mdun du mngon sum nyid gshegs te//95—522

sha kra datyā sa nā sī naḥkā ru rgya tta ma bhā ṣi ta/ /rā dzan ki kri ya brgya byin gyis bshams gdan la bzhugs/ /thugs rje nyid kyis der bka' sprul/ /rgyal po ci bya mi te hrū ra kand+ra khaṃ ga ti ri dṛ shi/ /shu bhā shu bhā sa mubye tai nā julte bzad pa'i/ /las kyi lugs ni 'di 'dra yin/ /dge dang mi dge nyarab bsgrun 'bras/ /spyad pa kṣa ya te pha lo / / rā ga dwo ṣa bi ṣa sa ghā nā nā bya sā na duḥmin pa yongs mi mdzad1/ /chags sdang dug gis dkrigs gyur cing / /sna tshogs gdung ba bzod pa ha/ /e baṃ ba dhe bā niḥsā re saṃ sā re duḥkha sā ra tā/ /saṃ kle she ka li dka' ba/ /snying po med pa'i 'khor ba na/ /sdug bsngal/ 'di lta snying po nyid/ /rgyad pa rgyas pas nyam le kā le bi pa ta saṃ pa ta saṃ ka ṭi/ /byerlu me ba pa ri tā rde bee rā thag cing / /kun nas nyon mongs rdzogs dus su/ /'khrugs krupa med pa'i chags bral lam/ /brtan rgya ba ni rā ku lo/ /saṃ sā ra gho ra ga ha nānta ra j-i bhā mā naḥ duḥkhā pa kho na yongs skyabs ⑤yin/ /'khor ba 'jigs rung nags kyi nang na rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /sdug na la bya ti ka riḥpra thra te ra seghāḥ/ /dhū moṅga me ri ba pu naḥsu kṛ to bsngal me yis ⑥gdung ba 'phro bas 3/rab rgyas du ba bzhin/ /slar yang reg par gyur pa min pa legs tsi tā dzā bābye bu bind+ra ka li lā na dṛ sho bha banta/ /bha dza swa dherya duḥbyas ldan rnams kyi'u/ /mig ni mchi ma'i chu yi thigs kyis rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po 'o ngas spyod re kha smin sgo gā rghaṃ tya dza bhū pa tai/ /pa ri zla ma bi ro dha n+yaḥsadzee saṃ ba thong / /sdug bsngal 'di la brtan 1 pa brten/ /'khor ba'i spyod tshul thams cad ni/ /yongs su sā ra bṛtta yaḥ/ /a dhu ṣpe ba ta thā sanda de hānta ku sha la spru tiḥ/ /i trughā gyur pa 2)'gal ba can/ /lus kyi mjug tu da lta nyid/ /khyod la dge ba nye bar gnas/ /zhes brjod tai sa mā shwa gya bha ga bārlu pa rda ya yo/ /bi mbi sa ro pi de hodhe de ni dbugs phyung ste/ /bcom ldan rang gi gnas su gshegs/ /gzugs can snying po'ang lus kyi mthar/ /95—523

tasmirje ba kṣa ṇi di bi/ /a byudzdza narṣa sgo nā ma shrī mā྾ shra ba ṇatpa dzaḥ/ /de dus nyid na mtho ris su/ /dpal ldan rnam thos sras kyi bu/ /rgyal ba'i khyu mchog ces par gyur//a dzā ta sha trurdza na rka dzha tā bi ga ta dzre bee tai/ /sha rī ra ma su saskṛ tya ni pha ni srog dang bral ba dag /ma skyes dgra yis shes gyur nas/ /de yi lus ni rab sbyangs te/ /rang ninda ni dza duḥkṛ tai/ /ta snga ti tī bra pā pārte tsitta dudṛtta du ṣi tsā/ /gis snanyes par byas pa smad/ /de sems drag po'i sdog pas gdungs/ /spyod tshul ngan pas sun phyung ste//pabyutta paghi pa ta rna pā yashyitta mi dā ka rota/ /so badma ta sasmo hā de shwarya phyi chonas gdung ba'i me la der/ /dag pa'i bya ba byed pa bzhin/ /des bsams kye ma kun rmongs las//ma da lubha dhīḥ / / dubyetta pā ta ka shwa bye pa ti to ha ma sgo mu dbang phyug gis rgyags sred ldan blo/ /tshul ngan bdag ni kha sbub dukye/ /sdig pa'i g.yang la lhung bar khaḥ / /shu ta pradzñā da ri dru rde ni dza ni dā su kha mo hā/ / tsiddhā da ha gyur—/ /thos pa shes rab kyis dbul zhing / /rang nyid bde bas ④rmongs gyur pa/ /mi bsrun sngags thuti gā tā ṇi kha la maddhā nu ba rbhe rghaṃ/ / pa ti ta snga tsa sanda gya pā rjes zhugs pa rnams/ /bsam pas lus ni gdung bar byed/ /rten sa med pa'i sdig pa yisakhye //pa saṃ ke bra mā da niḥ/ /a nā lalba rna tā rde dzi na saṃ sma ra ṇa ma ma/ /'dam du lhung zhing nyams gyur pa/ /bag thumed bdag la rgyal ba ni/ /yang dag dran pa skyabs su 'gyur//i ti saṃ tsi tya su tsi ram̐ sa ga tā su ga tā rnyi shaṃ/ /dzu gubee mā naḥku de ltar yu na ring 8 bsams nas der‘9 / /bde bar gshegs pa'i drung song ste/ /ngan pa byas la smod kṛ tā ta pa ra saṃ ko tsa mā ya yo/ /ta tra pa bi tra mādmā āoṃ ma n+ya mā naḥbyad 1 cing / /mchog tu yang dag zhum par gyur/ /der ni bdag nyid mi gtsang bkye/ /khas len khrel sa sa tra paḥ/ /pra ṇa nā ma dzi āoṃ du rāta bā pa sparsha bha yā di ba/ /sā dang bcas pa des/ /sdig la 1rtareg pas 'jigs pa bzhin/ /ring nas rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal/ /ngan 95—524

khru ṣpe tra pa ri tā rṇa sa sattha pta bya dza dzñā yata/ /sa kaspaḥkā ya saṃ satta byas lus la yang dag chags/ /gsal bar byed bzhin (ṭwā'adar ldan pas/ /mig ni mchi ma dang bcas bi dhu stsombi ba du ཿ kṛ tai / / bha ga bān kṛ ta pā bo ha mā sa nda des—/ /kun mkhyen la ni yongs skyobs kruzhus/ /yongs gdungs 1sdig pa byas pa bdag /dmyal ba'i na ra kā na laḥ/ /santaptaḥka ru zla se: tā me ba sha ra khaṃ ga taḥ/ /mā me ni nye ④bar gnas/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod nyid la ni skyabs su song / /grwa mi yo sho ṇa paryaddhā dṛṣṭaste puṣka ra pra bhā/ /pu rgya smṛ sha tu gaṅge ba ma la gnyis dmar ba khyod kyi spyan/ /padmo'i 'od ldan gang gā bzhin/ /dri ma 'khru bzod dag byed pa/ /'di pra kṣu la na kṣa mā/ / kha la mant+ra pra bṛ ste na dudṛste na pra mā di yis bdag la reg pa khrumadzod/ /mi bsrun 6gros kyis rab zhugs shing / /bag mod spyod tshul ngan pa nā / /mā yā bi bhā ba lubye na pā pe na ni ha taḥpi tā/ /i ti pra khā pi nasta su ba can—/ /sdig can 'byor pa la chags pa/ /bdag gis pha ni rnam par bsad/ /ces pa cho nge ldan de yi//tsaḥ khru tā ta thā ga taḥ / / sa sardzastand+ra pa ra dzaḥ shurnyo pu ju sa ra tshig thos de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /de yi sdig rdul dag bya'i slad/ /bsod nams dbyangs can rab swa ṭī/ /rā dzanda tsi titā pā paḥkha le ṣpe ba swa kadzre ṇa/ /pre ri ta ste pi tu spros/ /rang las kyis bzhin mi bsrun )pa/ /rgyal po gnod pa ma bas mas pa/ /khyod ni pha bsad la dṛ ba dhe pa ti taḥpā pa saṃ ka ṭi/ / duḥkhantabye na sgokta bye pābhā kilbi bskul te/ /nyam nga'i sdig par lhung bar gyur/ /sdug bsngal de des spyad bya zhing / /khyod kyis kyang ni ṣe twa yā/ /ta ba ta gya sa bhū pā la tu le ṣā bha bee ta bya tā/ /ni dza kadzre sa sdig pa thob/ /sa skyong de dang khyod kyi 'di/ /stsong bar bya ba mtshungs pa nyid/ /rang gi las ni rab mudhī ddhā lā la ṭa ta ṭa btī dzā/ /shi lā sha ka la le khe ba nibya la ni yā tidṛ bkod pa/ /dpral ba'i ngos la gnas pa dag /rdo yi dum bu'i ri mo bzhin/ /mi rnams kyis 7ni g.yo 95—525

ṇam / /kuttha tā ka lu ṣe kand+ra kha la sre ra ṇa ya twa yā/ /pra tyā sand+ra mṛ ma yin/ /khyod ni mi bsrun skyapas bskul nas/ /sdig pa'i las ni byas pa yis/ /dge legs bdud rtsi ta gre yaḥ swa ha ste na ti raskṛ tai/ /a tyā pi ya di te pā paṃ habye nye ba ni/ /rang gi lag pas 'phangs par gyur/ /gal te khyod la da lta yang / /sprug gzhom phun tshogs zwabeeñtsa sadza rda/ /rpā.āoṃste tabyu rum ti pu khyu bā pa sha mā rādma ṣpe/ /dī ba thob 'dod pa/ /yod na bsod nams blo gros mdzod/ /de yang zhi las bdag nyid la'o/ /mar me'i thrakhyo su khaṃ sru te dzre ba ya tyādzdza lo ya shaḥ/ /a mṛ ta su pra ka ro yo spyod tshul bde ba skyedañtsha/ /'tsho byed grags pa rab tu 'bar/ /bdud rtsi'i rab tu byed pa 'di//su thra tta ཿ sa sa mā ga ma ཿ / / ba byaṭwā pā sni pā te na sā dhu ni legs pa dang 'grogs dam pa'i spyod/ /rjes su 'gyod pa'i mes gdungs shedang / /dam pa rnams dang saṅga men tsa/ /sī tīrta ṣpe na dā ṣpe na pā pi na byu ti de hi ram̐/ /'grogs pa dang / /yang dag bsgrags dang sbyin pa yis/ /lus can rnams kyi thusdig nyams byed//bā tram̐ ba bi tra ya ti ṣpe ba gu rjaspyo rto tiste haṃ na saṃ ha ra ti nā pi ma lo snod ni gtsang byed yon tan sdong bu nges par zad mi byed/ /mdza' ba'i snum ni mi 'phrogs ⑤dri ma yang ni pra sru te/ /do ṣa ba sā na ru tsi rabya la hūṃ na dhadhe sahūṃ ga maḥsu skyed mi byed/ /skyon mtshan mjug tu rab mdzes g.yo ba nyid ni 'dzin mi byed/ /dam pa dang 'grogs kṛ ta sadma ni ko pi dī paḥ/ / gu ṇi ga ṇa pi padhī kṣu kṣa ya kṣa ṇa legs byas khang par mar me ci yang yin/ /yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs la rgud pa 'doms mkhas mtshan sambi bhaḥs ka la na ya na byā pā rā rde dza nā ni ni ro dha keḥ/ /a mo'i skad cig mtshungs/ /skye bo'i 'dren byed rnams kyi bya ba mtha' dag rab tu 'gog par byed/ /shin sa ma bi ṣa mā yā sā bā saḥpra kā shaṃ pa ri kṣa yāta su dza ti hi ma hā mo hasgo tu mnyam dang mi mnyam gnas la gnas shing snang ba yongs zad las/ /rmongs pa chen po'i thu'abyung ba 95—526

oṃ ta maḥkha la saṃ ga maḥ/ /pra hye ka budhaste rā dzan kā le na khye ṇa bskyed de ① mun pa dang ni mi bsrun grogasakye/ /rgyal po dal bu dal bu yis/ /dus kyis sdig pa zad kilbi ṣaḥ/ /bha bi 6 pi bi be ke na kṛ tā lo kaḥsha ṣpeḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /i ti ta gyur nas/ /dben pas snang bar byas pa yi(zu/ /rang sangs rgyas su khyod 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa bcom mya da yā swā saṃñtsa kā ra bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /pa ti te ṣṭa dhi ka santaḥldan rgyal ba yi④/ /brtse bas de ni dbugs dbyung mdzad/ / lhung las ltalhag par dam pa rnams//ka ru ṇa sdirja lo tsa nāḥ/ /ta taḥpra ṇa mya su ga tai pra yā taḥswā pa rda dṛ snying rje byams pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /de nas bde gshegs la btud de/ /mi bdag rang gi 67gnas su paḥ—/ /ma ha taḥpā pa bhā ra gya bi be de la ghu tā mi ba/ /tasmind+ra yā te sattha song / /sdig pa'i khur po chen po ni/ /yang ba nyid bzhin rnam par rig /dge slong rnams kyis de song dzhaḥthraṣṭasta gya kand+ra kau tu kāta/ /bhikṣu bhiḥkṣi tai pā la su pūzla bṛtta ma tshe—/ /de yi las kyi dge mtshan las/ /sa skyong gi ni sngon byung mtha'/ /dris shing bcom ldan kyegyis bhā ṣa ta/ /bā rā ṇa sde ni rā yā sa bi lā sa bya ba sā yi naḥ/ /tsa twa raḥgrekhye bka' stsal/ / bā rā ṇa sīr klutshong dpon gyi/ /bu bzhi dag ni byung gyur te/ /dpal ldan bsdams pa ta na yāḥb bhu buḥshri bi phru kha laḥ/ /te ka dā tsikhru kha spyi bā ma thiḥka dag bral zhing / /gdung med rtse dga' la brtson pa'o/ /nam zhig bde bas myos gyur cing / /phan tshun li ka thāspru tāḥ/ /pra hye ka budha mā yārnyi da dṛ shurlo ba nodhe tāḥ/ /kyal ka'i gtam gyis gnas/ /lang tshos 'phyar ba de dag gis/ /rang sangs rgyas ni byon pa mthong //tai dṛṭī dzā ta bi dī ṣaḥsha ma sa ya ma ninda kāḥ/ /dzreṣṭha su punda ra ko nā ma sthā de mthong rnam par sdang ba skyes/ /zhi dul smod byed phu bo ni/ /sun da ra ka zhes pa yis/ /'dzum trend+ra bā tsa sa smi taḥ/ /a yo tsi ba ra pā tram̐ kaḥpā ṣpe na ga ta dzre bi bcas spun zla rnams la smras/ /btung bas nyes 67pas dge slong ni/ /chos gos lhung bzed rtags can 95—527

skṛ bhā ཿ pa ram̐ dṛ pa sha ba ཿ sa ma dā bha ba rnye / / bye ṣṭha gre ṣṭha ཿ su ta ཿcing / /mchog tu tshim pas mi yi phyugs rnams rgyags dang bcas par gyur/ /sdig las tshong dpon bu thu pā bā tas e brta dzadma ni/ /sha riryā nā bhi dhaḥshākyaḥbī tā ma rya bi pa rya ta/ /bo—/ /de nyid skye ba gzhan la ni/ /shākya shā ri rgya zhes pa/ /chang 'thungs nas ni nyams par gyur//dī tī yo pi ma harja ma shākya sto ye kṣa yi ga taḥ/ /tram̐ hūṃ ya: bu tre ṇa byasto rā gnyis pa yang ni shākya dag /ming chen chu la shi bar gyur/ /gsum pa rgyal po gsal rgyal yang / /bu dzā pra se na dzi ta / / bi dza sā ra tso tu rjo sau dṛ ta pu tre ṇa yis sna bskrad nas bsad par gyur/ /bzhi pa gzugs can snying po 'di/ /bu yis btson 2—du bcings ba dha ṣpe/ /pra yuktandha na— baṅka nd+ra bhu bye te hi sa bṛrnyi shaṃ/ /mo hā ha nas bsad/ /skyed gedang ldan pa'i nor bzhin du/ /las ni rab ldan spyod par byed/ /de ltar rmongs tai re ha ha sa ddhi ra sa sbo re rpā ni ཿ sha dzre ka nd+ra sa ha mee ba bee dzñā pas bcom pa'i dam pa dam min rnams kyis 'dir/ /bde ba med pa'i las ni 'phral nyid rnam par ya te yata/ /bāṣkambu sgoṇḍi na ya ṣpe ra na yo ba bhā ta masto ka sho ka bi bsgrubs pa gang nga// /tshul min nye bar gnas pa de ni mchi ma'i chu dag gis/ /mi 5rdzogs mya ngan mi ba she ra nu byu ya te tra/ /su ga ta ka rja ta me tahphuzla dzadma pra thradzhai chung dbang dang bral bas spyod par byed/ /gzugs can snying po'i skye ba snga mar rab zhugs byung ba'i tshul / /bee ṣa bee ṣa ma bi bā shaṃ bo bi sā ra gya dṛdzhai/ /bi bi dha sa da si bhikṣuḥmi bzad dug gi rnam smin 'di dag bde gshegs kyis gsungs pa/ /mdun 7sar dge slong rnam mang dag spa ṣṭa mā ka rdzu me ṣpe bya sa na sha ta ni mirghaṃ dru ṣi ta tsitta me ba / /gis gsal bar thos gyur nas/ /gdung ba brgya yi mtshan mas 7sun phyung sems nyid yin par sems/ /i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos shebyas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bas/ma gyi 'khri shing 95—529

ma dzā ta sha tru pi tre dro hā ba dā na pañtsa tsa tā ri shaḥpalla baḥ// //las ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //arnyi kṛ to pi sa dṛ shā ta ma sā kha le na lasmre bi hā ra bi ra he bi ni mi bsrun rmyemun pas 'phral la long bar byas gyur cing / /dpal 'byor rnam par gnas dang bral pā ti to pi/ /kṛddhā da shā mi ba ni shā ma ni bā khya padmaḥswā me ba saṃ pa da mu bar rab bskrun kyang / /nyam nga'i gnas skabs mtshan mo 'das nas padma bzhin/ /sbar yang yon tan bai ti pu na rgu shā ḍūḥ / / shra bahūṃ su ga te dze ta ba no byā na bi ldan pas rang gi 2snaphun tshogs thobakye/ /bde gshegs mnyan yod rgyal byed kyi/ /skyed mos tshal na hā ri ṇi/ /de ba dattaḥpa ri dre ṣa bā di byāsto byā tsinta yata/ /tu lyaḥbazhugs pa'i tshe/ / lha sbyin byeyongs su sdang ba yi/ /rtsod pas khyab pas rnam bsams pa/ /shākya'i sa mā no me bhra tā ma nu 6 shākya baṃ sha dzaḥ/ /pābeeḥpu ju pra bhā be rigs las skyes pa'i mi/ /bdag ni spun dang mtshungs shing mnyam/ /bsod nams mthu yis 'gro gsum na tri dza gahphu rje tī dzi naḥ/ /dzre bi to z-itta ye tasmra ta ta gya yasne ka ro mya haṃ/ /gyis—/ /mchod bya nyid ni rgyal bas thob/ /de slad de yi 'tsho ba ni/ /rab tu gzhom la bdag 'bad bya/ /na byu na ste ga te bhā no pa ra te dzaḥpra kā sha te/ /bi dzñā ṣpe nā nu bhā be na gang phyir nyi ma ma nub tshe/ /gzhan gye gzi byin gsal ba med/ /yid ni nga rgyal gyis mtho bas⑤/ /bi rya yā ta pa sī shri yā/ /pa ra pra karṣa sa ha te na hi mā nonta rnam shes dag dang mthu dang ni/ /rigs dang dka' thub dpal dag gis/ /pha rol khyad 'phags bzod tadma naḥ/ /bo ṣi ni dza na khā gre 6 dhri tā ta su pra shā ma kṛta/ /sa tsā ra yā mi ma yin/ /dug ni rang gi sen rtse la/ /bzung 'unas de la phyag 'tshal te/ /brtan par rkang pa la dha nisgosgo bya ṣpe tsi ḍaḥpā da bī ḍa naiḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsind+ra ka lu ṣe bi dzwa ṣaḥbi mnan pas/ /nges par phug la gtang bar bya/ /de ltar sdig pa bsams byas nas/ /sdang ba'i dbang 95—530

ba shaḥkha laḥ/ /sa ti 6 pra mu khā ṣpe tya bāndha bā ni da ma bhya dhwata/ /hrū raḥgyur mi bsrun ①pa/ /de yis skar rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /gnyen rnams la ni 'di skad smras/ /de ring kṛ tā pa ka ro haṃ su ga ta snga rya pā da yoḥ/ /sa ra la su pra sā dā ya bde gshegs gzu bo yisashe/ /zhabs la rab tu dang ba'i slad/ /gdug pa gnod pa byed pa yigu/ /ba tā mi gu ru pā ta kaḥ/ /i ti bra bā ṇasteḥsabyeḥsu datna nu ma taiḥs ta/ /sdog pa lci meldan bdag gtug go/ /zhes smra gdug pa'i blo can de/ /rjes mthun ster byed de dag rnams//dzi rna dze ta ba nā sbo dzwa dṛṣṭi duṣṭa ma tirya yo/ /bha ga bārnyi bi lo kyā kun dang lhan cig rgyal ba ni/ /rgyal byed tshal bzhugs blta kyiru song / /der ni bcom ldan mthong gyur bhutta tra yā batpa sasba saḥ/ /tā bsdesgo ha mi tyāsgyu ra ṇajo bee tsa ra zla ba nas—/ /ji srid ⑥nye bar des phyin pa/ /de srid bdag ni bsregs so zhes/ /rkang pa sprug cing sgra cher data / /ho sā saṃ kalpa pā pe na badzre ṇi ba sa mā ha taḥ/ /sa shi rī ram̐ kṣa ṇi smras—/ /'tshe ba'i rnam rtog sdig pa ni/ /rdo rje lta bus yang dag bcom/ /skad cig de la dmyal ba'i ta smin na ra kasgo pa sā ta saḥ/ /sarbha dzñā sa ha sā dṛbye tai gho ra na mer—/ /lus dang bcas pa lhung bar gyur/ /'jigs rung dmyal bar lhung ba de/ /'phral la kun ra ke tsū tai / / u bā tsa shu ta ta bye tta bi smi hūṃ bhe hūṃ sadza da/ /mkhyen gyis gzigs nas/ /de brjod thos pa'i gyeya mtshan pa'i/ /phun tshogs dge slong la gsungs pa/ /e ṣa kilbi ṣa do ṣe ṇa pa ti taḥgre sha saṃ ka ṭi/ /tī bye sbri tai mi re mṛ te sdig pa dag gi skyon gyis nikye/ /nyon mongs nyam ngar lhung bar gyur/ /gang phyir dri ma ldan pa'i yid/ /sattha thā ma li nasma naḥ/ /na garyā ba ti sgo ṣa yo ra ti so ma gya ju pa teḥ/ /kun tu rab rib drag po skyed tsu7/ /grong khyer dge ba'i dbyangs su ni/ /sa yi bdag po yid bzang la/ /kṛ ta rnyertswa kṛ ta dzñā: pu rā pu tre ba ju ba tuḥ/ /kṛ ta dzñāḥkṛ pa yābee bhyaḥbyas shes dang ni byas mi shes/ /bu gnyis sngon tshe byung bar gyur/ /byas shes brtse bas slong rnams la/ /95—531

kalpa thra kṣa i bā ni shī/ /ni dza bi mu tsa pra da do raṭwā bha ra ṇa rtag tu dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /rang gi rin chen rgyan gyi ⑨ tshogs/ /rnam par bkrol khyanas rab sañtsa yo/ /a bee bhakta pi tudzra bye sarde sā dhwa ra ma bye yoḥ/ /ba dadri tya kṛ ta tu ster/ /bgos pa min pa pha yi rdzas/ /thams cad 'u cag thun mong yin/ /zhes smras byas mi shes zlo pi te na datta dza hā ra tata/ /ta taḥshā sgyu ya ba tsa sā ma ti gho ṣā bhi kyis kyang / /de yis byin pa de dag phrogs/ /de nas mi bdag blo gros dbyangs/ /zhes pas byas shes bho dṛ paḥ/ /dza na ka sthā ṇi rmā nā ma kṛ tā dzha ya su tī da do/ /swa ya me bsngags 'os la/ /skye bo dge shem zhes pa yi/ /bu mo ④tshig gis byin par gyur/ /rang nyid kyis bārdzi tai biñtsa dzā ḍū dzā ta ma no ra thaḥ/ /ā ru ro ha pra ba ha khaṃ kṛ ta rja tha bsgrubs byin pa yizhe/ /yid la re ba de la skyes/ /de nas chu gtor khyechen por ni/ /byas shes gzings ma ho da kau/ / ratna rdza kau ya tai dī ṣa marnyi tā da raḥ / / ta me la zhon par gyur/ /sdang zhing 'gran pas gus 'phel ba/ /ngan pa byas mi shes pa yang / /rin chen bā nu ya yo lo bhā da kṛ ta pta bi durdza naḥ/ /saṃ sgoṇḍidza ni dzi sādzeesta sgrub brtson de nyid kyi/ /rjes su chags las song bar gyur/ /de nas tshong pa'i don mthun gyis/ /taḥpra ba ha khaṃ sha naḥ/ /ā nu ku bye na ma ru tā ma bā pa dī pa mismi yongs gang gzings ni dal bu yidzwa/ /rjes su mthun pa'i rlung dag gis/ /'dod pa'i gling du phyin par tā / /tasminda pra nyi ni thrabhe tha swa de shaṃ gabye mu rya te/ /ratna rā shi gyur—/ /tshong pa rnams kyi rdesnakun rtog bzhin/ /rin chen tshogs kyis kun tu khengs/ /de nas de ni bye rā pūṇḍi saṃ kaspe ba ṇi dzā mi ba/ /kṛ ta snyoḥthra thi bī mū bye ratna āoṃ sha ta slar log nas/ /rang gi phyogs su 'gro brtson tshe/ /sa gzhi ri ba'i rin po che/ / brgya phrag po7lnga ni byas pañtsa kai/ /ā dā ya gradzre parbhe na ba baddhā shu ka pabee bee/ /ratna bhā shes kyis/ /blangs nas gos kyi yal 'dab la/ /ras ma yis ni mdud par khya3/bcings/ /de nas 95—532

ra pa ri shārnya ta taḥbra ba ha khaṃ ma ha ta/ /a bha dzñā ta ma hā bā tai ri gzings chen rin chen gyi/ /khur gyis yongs su ngal ba de/ /rlung chen dag gis zhig gyur te/ /tshul shwarya mi ba duṇḍi yeḥ/ /ta taḥpha la ha kā bāst+ri kṛ ta dzñāḥpāpta dzi bi taḥ/ /ngan rnams kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /de nas shing dum bzung ba yisasnasna/ /byas shes kyis ni 'tsho ba thob/ /a kṛ ta dzñā ni madzdzarnyi dṛkhye na sa ma ta ra yeta/ /tā ri taḥkṛ pa yā rgyab kyis byas mi shes dag ni/ / byengs par ༷2snagyur pa yang dag bsgral/ /'jigs rung chu srin 'byung bhā tā sa sgo ra ma ka rā ka rāta/ /a sa thra da tsa le ta gya ru tsi re gnas las/ /brtse bas bsgral ba'i spun zla des/ /de yi thu bo (sgodag la ni/ /rin chen yid 'ong ratna sañtsa yo/ /sa ta mya ratna lo bhe na dre ṣe tsa ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /sa mu bsags pa mthong / /de yi rin chen la chags dang / /sdang ba'i dbang du gyur pa des/ /rgya mtsho'i dra tī re shranta su bhatri dro ha ma tsinta yata/ /ta gya ni dru ni lbo na gya shaste 'gram du ngal ba yi/ /spun ya je'akhu ba bsams par gyur/ /de ni gnyid du song ba la/ /mig dag notyā rgya lo tsa ṣpe/ /kṛ tī tā ratna ni tsa yo kṛ ta bhanaḥs ye yo dza bāta/ /kru mtshon gyis rab phyung nas/ /rin po che yi tshogs bzung ste/ /byas mi gzo de mgyogs par song / sgra re shāñtsi kṛ taste na rā hu ṇi ba di ba ka raḥ/ /lo ko pa kā ra bee ra hata duḥgacan gyis ni nyin byed gyebazhin/ /gdug pas long bar byas pa des/ /'jig rten phan pa bra' ba las/ /khi taḥso gya tsinta yata/ /a dhu nābee pra dā ṣpeze byadhī bhū te ma no ra the/ /sdug bsngal ldan pa des kyang bsams/ /da 6ni slong la sbyin don du/ /yid la re ba don med gyur/ /kisma mānta su ba sgo dzre bi te na pra yo dza rgo/ /a pāpta bi dha yaḥpā zla long ba bdag gi 'tsho ba ni/ /'bras med dag gis dgos pa ci/ /gal te dus la ma bab pas/ /srog na pra yārnyi ya dikṣa yi/ /ta da saṃ ga ta po yo gaḥkle sha shārnyi kṣa ya kṣa maḥ/ /ni 'jig par mi 'gyur na/ /de la grogs med dka' thub kyi/ /sbyor ba nyon mongs zhi 'jig bzodarngu/ /95—533

spyi ṇi dha ṣpe dza ṣpe dī ṣe mā ṣpe bai ka lya bee hwa le/ /pū bye sum̐ sī sa me ṣpe ba nor zad skye bo sdang gyur cing / /khengs pa dang bral 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /skyes bu rnams ni ①na tshod 'jug /she ṣa mya tsa ya so bya yaḥ/ /i ti sañtsi tya sa sha ṣperba dzan sābee na tā ri zhi bas zad pa mchod par 'os/ /de ltar bsams shing dal bus delngo/ /'gro ba don mthun dag gis taḥ / /a bā pa na ga ro pārnyi ma ti gho ṣa gya bhū pa teḥ/ /go pā la bha ba bsgral—/ /sa bdag blo gros dbyangs kyi ni/ /grong khyer dag dang nye bar phyin/ /ba lang skyong ba'i khang ṣpe ta tra sa kiñtsiṭwā la mā sbi taḥ/ /u byā na ya tā ga ta yā rā dza pu rngu bi lo pa der/ /cung zad dus ni de yis bsdad/ /rgyal po'i bu mo /1skyed mos tshal/ /rnam par lta zhing 'gro ki taḥ/ /tai dṛṭīndha ma pi byakta rā dza lakṣa ṇa lakṣi ta/ /pāstsadma pre ba yis/ /long yang rgyal po'i mtshan rnams kyis/ /gsal bar mtshan pa de ④mthong nas/ /skye ba snga ma ba dhe na sa bhi lā ṣā ba bhū ba sā/ / ta ta ཿ swa ya swa ra bi bye ma'i zhemadza' bas bcings/ /de la mngon par dga' bar gyur/ /de nas ⑥yab kyi bka' las ni/ /sā kṛ tā sa sha na྾ tuḥ/ /rā dzñā mā dhya mā nā bye brtse bi ga ta lo tsa rang nyid mchog 'dam de yis byas/ /rgyal po rnams kyi (ñdzunang nas ni/ /mig dang bral ba bos te 8 / /byu mi pā lā nu ri tya bye bṛ to phondha pā pa yā twa yā/ /uste ti pi gdams—/ /sa skyong rnams ni yongs btang nas/ /sdig ma khyod kyis long ba gdams/ /zhes brjod pa tā ko pe na ni ra sthā ba hi shu bhā sā/ /u tyā ṣpe sā ni dhwa yārghaṃ yasne ni khros pa yis/ /dase/ ma de ni phyi rol bskrad/ /mdza' gcugs — nyer bsags gus pa can/ /de nā kṛ tya sgo dza rgo/ /sa dā tasmi da do pre ma pra ṇa yo pa tsi tā da rā/ /yis long ba skyed tshal du/ /bzhag nas 'bad pas kha zas dag /bslangs 9nas ster zhing rtag tu gnas/ /ka dā tsirghaṃ tsi rā yā tā mā hā rā ba sa re ga te/ /u bā tsa rā dza ta na yaḥnam zhig zas kyi skabs 'das tshe/ /yun ring lon nas 'ongs de la/ /bkres pas bzhin ni yongs 95—534

pa risthā nā na naḥgru jo/ /a sa mbi kṣi ta kā ri sgyu twa yā ke ba la nyams pa'i/ /rgyal po'i bu yis rab smras pa/ /khyod 1ni kun tu ma brtags spupar/ /byed mas g.yo ba tsa pā lāta/ /dṛ te ha mandhaḥsaṃ tya bye dṛ pādzre pu la lo tsa nān/ /'ba' zhig las/ /mi bdag yangs pa'i ②spyan ldan rnams/ /yongs btang bdag ni long ba 'damasatshoshe/ /pabyatna pe na byu rna two ma yi parlu ṣi tā da rā/ /a dhu nā tā ddhā baṃ presnaḥkhyod ni phyi nas 'gyod pa yis/ /bdag la gus pa dman gyur te/ /da ni mdza' ba zhan pa nyid/ /ston pra darsha tu mu rya tā/ /andha sandarsha nobyighā su rū pā lo ke no mu khāe/ /par brtson pa ma yin nam/ /long ba lta bas yid byung ste/ /gzugs bzang blta 57la mngon par phyogs/ /ā hā ra kā le ti krārnyi tsi re shā hā twa mā ga ta/ /i kyughra pa ru ṣe te na de ring zas kyi dus 'das te/ /ring mo zhig na 7cesnakhyod 'ongs so/ /de yis rtsub mo 'di smras te/ /kadza mā nā la te ba pā/ /u bā tsa rgu dzadma dhu pa gre ddhā ma dhu ka ra bā 'dar ba dang ldan 'khri shing ni/ /sgra sgrog 4bung ba'i 'phreng 2ldan bzhin/ /snyan par smras 7she)byed des di mbi/ /nā tha mi bye ba me shaṃ kā na ko pāṅkand+ra marta se/ /bāghā ṇa pā smras pa/ /mgon po khro bas bdag la ni/ /log pa'i dogs pa bgyid she —mi 'os/ /mdza' bas mnyes tai sa ha te na tse taḥspru ti pe sha lo/ /two me ba de ba tī dzā na ya rya haṃ gshin sems kyis ni/ /tshig gi mda' lhung mi bzod do/ /khyod ni lha nyid du shes la/ /gal te bdag shudha mā na sa/ /te na ba bye na sā lo ka me shaṃ na ya na mastuta/ /i tyāste gi yid dag na/ /bden pa de yis khyod kyi mig /gcig /—1ni snang ba ldan gyur cig /ces pa rke5snying sa twa shā li tyā ta yā ta snga shu lo tsa lda/ /utpabee ka ma khā kā ra me kai bi ma stobs ldan ma des/ /brjod tshe myur bar de yi rtsenaspyan/ /rab rgyas padma'i rnam pa can/ /gcig ni dri la tsā ya yo/ /ta myuḥb tya bra bhā bee na saṃ dzā ta thra thu bisma yaḥ/ /pa tya pra med nyid du gyur/ /de yi bden pa'i mthu yis ni/ /ya mtshan chen po yang dag skyes/ /bden pa'i yid 95—535

tya ya sond+ra haḥkṛ ta dzhasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bhā tā te nā kṛ ta zlo na pā ṭi te lo tsa ches spro ldan pas/ /byas shes kyis ni de la smras/ /spun zla byas mi shes de yis/ /mig gnyis dag ni na dwa ye/ /tasmimbi kā ro bee re bā na ni kā ro gya byu ta ma ma/ /swastso te nāstu ba phyung gyur pa'i/ /gnod pa de la bdag la ni/ /khon nam rnam 'gyur ma skyes na/ /bden pa de yis hye na dī tī ya ma pi lo tsa nam/ /i sgoste ta 1 ṇi nā gya spaṣṭañtsa kyu gnyis pa yi nyusna/ /mig kyang rnal du gnas gyur cig /ces brjod de yis skad cig la/ /de ni gsal ra laghra ta/ /ta taḥka li ta bṛ tādhe kṛ ta dzha mu tsi tai pa two/ /pra z-iṣṭa dza ba'i mig gis mtshan/ /de nas byung ba'i mtha' bshad pa'i/ /byas shes bdag por 'os pa ni/ /skye bo dge na ka spyo ṇi ga twa pi tre n+ya bee da yata/ /pū dzitaḥswa shu re rja tha sa ratna ga dza bā dzi ma rab mgu bas/ /song nas pha la nges par bshad/ /de nas de ni gyos po yis/ /rin chen glang po rta yis bhiḥ / /shri ye ba kānta yā sārnyi dza ga ma na ga dzi pi tuḥ/ /sa ta tra pi tā mchod—/ /dpal dang bzhin du mdzes ma dang / /lhan cig yab kyi grong khyer song / /zhabs la cod pan gyis z-iṣṭi na tsa ra zla lbo na she kha raḥ/ /dza nā nu rā ga shu bha ge yo ba rā bye pa de dṛ gtugs te/ /rab tu mgu ba'i pha yis der/ /skal bzang skye bo rjes chags pa/ /rgyal tshab dag gi gnas la taḥ / /a kṛ ta zlo pi nirladzdzaste pra sā da yi tro sha ṭhaḥ/ /bi tsi tya pā da sa ta ṣpe ta bkod—/ /ngo tsha med pa byas mi shes/ /de la rab tu dang ba'i g.yos/ /zhabs la gtugs te de la ni/ /su dro hi sa mā ya yo/ /udma nārta tu mā tī ti sa tai ku ṭi la tseṣṭa taḥ/ /'khu ba'i bsam pas yang dag 'ongs/ /sgyu yis de ni gsad thu'adod pa'i/ /gya gyu'i bsam pa ldan pa de//hā hā da sgo smi da sgo llī tru ste ba na ra ke pa ta ta / / sa e ba de kyi hud bdag bsregs bdag bsregs zhes/ /brjod pa kho nas dmyal bar lhung / /de nyid lha sbyin 1ba dasto sau kṛ ta dzha bya ha me ba tsa/ /dzadmānta rā nu badhe na dwo kho gya na ni 'di yin te/ /byas shes de yang nga nyid do/ /skye ba gzhan du rjes 'brel bas/ /'di yi sdang ba yongs ④ 9khya —536

brta te/ /sattha dzha bhā ṣi ta mi ti pra tsu ro pa kā ram̐ tasde ba datta tsa ri tai mi zlog /de ltar kun mkhyen gyis gsungs lha sbyin ⑨gyi ni spyod pa de/ /yongs su gdung ba byed pa gnod pa ri tā pa kā ri/ /dzadmānta ro pa tsi ta pā ta ka sinda barghaṃ khru tā ba pa ⑤rab mang dang ldan zhing / /skye ba gzhan du nye bar bsags pa'i sdig pa rjes 'byel ba/ /dge slong bhū ba bi ma khā i pa bhekyu saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye tshogs kyis thos nas yid ni byung ba bzhin du gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dzee kṛ ta dzñā ba dā dzee ṣa ṭa tsa sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las byas shes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab tā ri shaḥpalla baḥ// //ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //dā ṣpe ka tā na ma na saṃ dṛ thu sa tā bhā dzā mund+ra ha mā na gu ṇa sgo snying stobs che bsten yid ni sbyin la gcig tu nges rnams kyi/ /spyo dang mchod dang yon tan longs ga bi bhū ti pū taḥ/ /pāklu rgya sañtsa ya ma yaḥku sha lā dī dhwa na kā spyod 'byor pa skyed byed pa/ /sngon gyi bsod nams bsags pa 'a sa/ byung dge ba mngon brjod pa'i/ /le pha la tya bi ka laḥki la kalpa bṛkṣaḥ/ /kau sha lend+ra gya bhu bhaspru shā dpag bsam shing ni nges par dus su ma tshang med 'bras skyed/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba mnyan yod na/ /sa bsgyu bha ga bān pu rā/ /bi dza hā ra ba ro byā dzre sa ha dzhaikṣu ga ṇi re dzi naḥ/ /bdag ko sa la dbang gi/ /skyed tshal mchog na dge slong gi/ /tshogs dang thabs cig mngon 1bzhugs tshe//ā di ma dhyānta ka spyo rṇa bha bā rnyi bha ba te pu dzee/ /sa di de sha sa randhadzre tre thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /srid pa zil gnon mchog gi chos/ /'jig rten gsum po dge ba la/ /lokya ku sha lo rya taḥ/ /a tānta re nā ga rā dzaḥpu tāḥsā ga ra bā si naḥ/ /sbyor ba de yis rab tu bstan/ /skabs der klu yi rgyal po'i bu/ /rgya mtsho dag tu gnas pa bzhi/ /95—537

tsa tā raḥ su ga to diṇḍi sa dhahma sa ra mā mṛ tai/ /a bhi ra tya khyu stobs dang shin tu stobs dang ni/ /dbugs dang dbugs chen zhes bya ba/ /sring mo mngon dga' zhes yā swa pā pre ri tāḥsho tu mā sa byaḥ/ /te ba khā ti ba khā shā sa ma hā shā pa yis/ /bskul nas de dag mnyam du ni/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs dam pa'i chos/ /mchog gi sā bhe dhwaḥs oṃ/ /kra kukhru nda gya su bye yaḥkā le bha ga ba taḥbu rā/ /bdud rtsi nyan du 'ongs/ /sngon gyi dus na bcom ldan 'das/ /blo bzang 'khor ba 'jig dang ni/ /ka na kā khya su tsa mu ṣpeḥkā shya pa su tsa yerta taḥ/ /nā dzagluḥsthā su khā sa kyāḥgaser thub ces ni bya ba dang / /de bzhin dgra bcom 'od srungs ṭwāl/ /nyan du sring mos bskul gyur sgo hūṃ ya swā bee tā a pi / / te pu rgya pa ri rja me na pā bee ཿkyang / /dpal gyi bder chags 'ongs ma gyur/ /de dag bsod nams yongs smin nas/ /shākya thub shākya mu naḥpu rāḥ/ /te 6 pra ṇa mya shāsnra ram̐ tsa ra shā lbo na mo li 6/ /bi ṅgā ya pa'i sngon 27du 'ongs/ /de dag mi yi lus bsgrubs te/ /ston pa la ni phyag btsal nas/ /zhabs la mgo mā nu ṣe rū paṃ mu sa bi ṣṭi pa rṣa di/ / sa dha nd+ra ma ya yo gro hūṃ kau yis gtugs byas te/ /'khor der nye bar 'dug pa'i tshe/ /gsal rgyal ko sa la yi dbang / /dpal sha lend+raḥ pra se na dzita/ /lasmre ma dasmi tatstsha yo ni bārlu tstsha tra tsā ma 'byor rgyags 'dzum mdzes pa yi de/ /gdugs dang rnga yab bzlog nas ni/ /dam chos nyan du yang dag ram̐ / /shāstuḥpā da pra zla mā ya bi sha tasta su saṃ sa di/ /a ba kā shaṃ na tābya 'ongs—/ /ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal slad/ /tshogs su zhugs pa de la ni/ /mi yi bdag la gus pa kruḥ sasbo dṛ pa ti go ra bāta/ / ta snga bhe rna rya mā na su baṇḍi shra ma las—/ /kun gyis ngabatud cing go skabs phye/ /rig snyeganas bla ma mi rnams kyis/ /mngon par dga' gu rodzra bhiḥ/ /nā ga rā dza su tābya krurtswa ba kā shaṃ na saskṛ tai/ : /ta ya : de dag dregs pas khengs pa dang zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/'u bar byas de la/ /klu yi rgyal po'i bu rnams kyis/ /go skabs bkur ste ④byas ma grur/ /de dag dregs 95—538

darba na mā bye ba dzi na gya bi na ye na tsa/ /mā ni no dṛ pa ti rantand+ra rgyuḥpas khengs pa dang / /rgyal ba la ni gus pas kyang / /khengs ldan mi bdag khro ba ni/ /nang du rab tu bratstshanda hūṃ ya yo/ /sa saṃ dzha yā mā di shya ni dza pa ri dza rgo pu raḥ/ /ga ma ṣpe bsgribs par gyur/ /de yis rang gi 'khor la ni/ /'gro tshe sngon du de dag rnams/ /tshar bcad brda ni gra haṃ te ྾ nimbi kā ra i ba bha ba ta / /bha ga bā na bi sadzee yis bskos byas nas/ /rnam 'gyur 2med pa bzhin du gyur/ /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /dzhasta gya nitso yo dzha to/ /ryasgro pa de sha paryadhe sngo bā tsa ra tsi tasmi taḥ/ /de yi nges pa mkhyen gyur nas/ / chos ni nye bar bstan pa yi/ /mjug /3snatu 'dzum mdzad rab gsungs pa/ /na bi dī ṣa ra dzaḥpūṇḍi ma no ma li na dadzee ṇi/ /bha ti dhasgro pa de sha gya pra yid kyi me long dri ma can/ /sdang ba'i rdul gyis gang ba la/ /chos ni nye bar bstan pa yi sna/ /gzugs ti bi sba pra ti gra haḥ/ /a bi ta sa ma tā rghaṃ ko sa mo ha ha tā dzā brnyan 'dzin pa mdzes ma yin/ /mnyam pa nyid dang bral zhing khro dang rmongs pas bcom rnams la/ /kṛ sha ma pi ku sha waṃ shaṃ no ba de shaḥka ro ti/ /na hi ba hu ta ra do ṣe shudhi tī nyer bstan gyis ni dge ba'i cha shas chung ngu yongs jimi byed/ /gang phyir blo gros blun po rnams kyi rab mang ṣpe sha rī re bra dza pra ma tī rmā bhe ṣa dzee bhe ṣa dza twam/ /i ti yuthi bha ga ba skyon ldan lus/ /dag pas dman pa dag la sman ni sman nyid mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa bcom ldan rigs pa nā hi ta muktasma byā ba tiḥ/ /shu tāpi na tsa ta tyā dza nā ge 6 bi ma yis—/ /phan pa gsung ba thos gyur kyang / /klu rnams la ni sdang ba'i yid5/ /sa yi bdag pos btang naska tamra/ /bha ga brnyi pra ṇa mā tha pra yā te swa pa rda dṛ paṃ/ /nā gāsta྾ ni kā ma gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan la btud nas/ /mi bdag rang gi gnas song tshe/ /de yi dpung gis lam ba dhe mārga byo ma sa thā yāstaḥ / /te bee tsiñtsa swa bha ba ṣpeghra sakṣa ya bkag pas/ /klu rnams mkha' yi lam nas song / /khyim du de dag gis bsams te/ /sa bdag gzhom 95—539

shā listasthātstsha dzā ya te/ /di bya sā nānda sadzabhi ཿ pha la taṅka su kand+ra sdong po bur shing sdong por 'gyur①/ /lha yi bza' btung phun sum tshogs/ /de dag las ni gang gi ṇaḥ / /i ti thraṣṭaḥpra ṇa yi nā bhekṣu zla bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /u bā tsa 'bras—/ /dge slong gus pas dris pa 'di/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po'i longs khru ya hūṃ rā dzhaḥkā ra rde sgo ga salba dzā/ /kau sha rngesmiñdza na sa da khaṇḍa spyod phun tshogs kyikhru/ /rgyu ni rab tu mnyen par mdzod zu/ /ko sa la yi ljongs 'di ru/ /bur shing khyu gu ḍa karṣa kaḥ/ /da do pra bye ka buddhā ya pūttha mikṣu ra so darna/ /bhuste ṣpe kṣu zhing pa dum bu zhes/ /bya bas rang sangs rgyas la sngon/ /bur chu dang ni zas dag byin/ /de yi bsod ra sdedzre na te na bā ta ga dā sdo ta ཿ / pra hye ka bu ddhā sta hphu bye ཿnams rnams dang ni/ /bur chu gzan 4dag gsol ba des/ /rlung nad kyis nyen chorang sangs rgyas/ /pra sanda swasbya hūṃ ya yo/ /rā dzā pra se na dzi྾ yi pu bye bān gu ḍa karṣa kaḥ/ /rab dang dri med nyid du gyur/ /bur shing zhing pa bsod nams can/ /de ni rgyal po gsal/ rgyal 'di/ /te na pu ju pra bhā bee na sgo ga bhā gī bi rā dza te/ /u pa kā ra kṛ ta dzha dzā bsod nams de yi mthu yis ni/ /longs spyod skal ldan rnam par mdzes/ /byas/ shes rnams la phan pa dang //ni kā raḥhrū ra tse ta shā/ /su kṛ hūṃ shabya sā dhu nā maspo byā yā tya nalpa gdug sems can la gnod pa dang / /dam pa rnams la legs byas ni/ /chung yang chung ngu nyid min hūṃ / / sand+ra zlo ṣpe ti ka thi te pūnd+ra pu rgya ma tī pa teḥ/ /ba byu 'gyur—/ /sa bdag sngon gyi bsod nams ni sne/ /kun mkhyen gyis ni gsungs pa'i tshe/ /legs byas ba su kṛ toṅkarṣa bhikṣu rābyarya nibya laḥ/ /a tha bhabhyaḥbha ga ba taḥkṛ twa mchog tu gyur pa las/ /dge slong ngo mtshar g.yo med gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan la gus pas/ /rgyal rā dzā dhi bā sa ram̐/ /u pā ni bye swa yaddhāddhā su rārghaṃ sgo ga sadza do/ /pos lhag par gnas byas nas/ /longs spyod phun tshogs lha la 'os/ /de de rang gis nye bar bkod/ /95—541

pa ro pa tsā ri ru tsi re radzre te kāñtsa nā sa ṣpe/ /su khā ya biṣṭi sro bā tsa mchog tu mdzes pa'i rim gro yis/ /mchod de gser gyi khri la ni/ /bder bzhugs de bzhin gshegs pa na ra nā thasta thā ga tai/ /bha ga badme bha barbha tta bi bhakta su kṛ ta la—/ /mi yi mgon pos rab smras pa/ /bcom ldan khyed rmyel gus pa yis/ /legs byas dpal ni rnam shri maḥ/ /tsa yaḥku sha la spru khā nā ma si mubhyo bha bi 6 ti/ /bi na yātyābee rgyas pa/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yis/ /bdag ni grol 'gyur ⑤ srid lags sam/ /bsod nams bee ṣpe ti puṇḍi pu sgyu bhe mā ni nā/ / thra ṣṭa ཿ smi ta se tā lo rka dza rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal 1can/ /sa yi bdag po gus pas 'di/ /dris la bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /gā da su ga taḥthra dzan/ /rā dzā na saṃ sā rā mārga ya ma nā di ni dha na 'dzum dkar snang ba spyo zhing gsungs/ /rgyal po 'khor ba dag gi lam/ /thog mtha' med par 'jug pa baḥ / /he lā lo bhyaḥka dzee sum̐ sā ma pāpta kle sha saṃ kṣa ya/ / tsi ra 'di—/ /nyon mongs kun zad ma thob par/ /skyes bus bde bar ji ltar 'gongs/ /yun ring rngub ri tsi tai: krā bste ra sakta ga tā ga tiḥpra kṛ ti ga ha naḥsaṃ sā ro yongs 'dris 'khor lo bskor ⑤bzhin rgyun du 'ong dang 'gro ba yis/ /rang bzhin gyis zab 'khor ba 'di yo su khe na na lo gha te/ /a pa ti hi bi nā yo gyu sgyu saṃ kṣa ya ki la karma la bde blag 'gongs ('upar mi nus te/ /sbyor ba goms pa med cing las rnams nges par zad pa min pa ⑦ rde sbu ṭa pha la tai ti dhembi su smi— brnya na tsā gtaḥ/ /sarba to bi ni thratta su ni—/ /rgya che 'bras bu gsal ba'i chos kyang 'dir ⑤ ni 'ching ba nyid du gyur/ /sbyin la goms pa chen po dā nā sgyu se na bhu ya sā/ /ma mā pi dhand+ra saṃ sā ro ba khyu ba bhu bi dzadma yis—/ /kun las rnam par log gyur pa/ /bdag kyang sa la skye ba bzung / /chos kyis 'khor ba nyid du kṛta / /dha ni ko nā ma dha na bān bā rā ṇasnga ma bhūhphu ra/ /ta po sa ha pha gyur—/ /nor can zhes pa shesnanor dang ldan/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑩ sngon byung grur/ /gdung ba 'phrog cing 95—542

la sde tarja yā bṛ kṣa i bābee rmā/ / dubyekṣa kṣi pi te lo ke bi ṣa ma 'bras bu rgyas/ /slong ba rnams kyi grib shing bzhin/ /mu ges 'jig rten brlag gyur cing / /mi bzad kle sha bi hwa le/ /sgo bye pra hye ka buddhā dzñā sobee teḥpañtsa byeḥsha taiḥ/ /sa nyon mongs kyis 'khrugs tshe/ /rang sangs rgyas ni lnga brgya yis/ /de la 'tsho ba bslangs par gyur/ /mi tai ྾ pa ra sgo gārti dusgokṣu pa bye dza āoṃ/ /a kalpa ya da na mya shrīḥchung dpal des bang ba yilku/ /khang bdag la bgros de dag la/ /mchog tu longs spyod 'os pa'i zas/ /koṣṭha gā rī ka sasma te/ /sha ta pañtsa ka saṃ gha tai sgo hūṃ ta gya kṛ haṃ ta taḥ/ /pra mu ge dag gi mthar thug sbyar/ /de yi khyim du gsol/ ba la/ /brgya phrag lnga ni 'tshogs 3gyur te/ /de māttha hye ka buddhā rmā sa ha sra dwa ya mā ya yo/ /ta gya ta ta pu sgo bā se na nas rim gyis rang sangs rgyas/ /stong phrag gnyis ni byung bar gyur/ /skyes tshe 'bras bu'i dpal thob pa/ /dzā tā khāpta pha la shri yā/ /durbhakṣa dā na yi taḥko sha ra na kle sha ā kṣa yatu/ tshe /: skyes tshe 'bras bu'i sogs sgo ka gcig gi rkang pa bzhi pa'i skad dod na kle sha sogs tsheg bar drug dang / bde ba brgyud pa sogs sgo ka gcig gi rkang pa dang ngo/ dang / gnyis pa 'i skad dod su khaṃ sogs tsheg bar bcu drug /rkang nga gsum pa 'i zhi ba 'dir yin gsum gyi skad dod shand+ra sogs tsheg bar bzhi rnams kyi rgya skad chad nga 'dar los gsar du bcug pa beer dbeed/3/bsod nams btab pa de yis ni/ /mu ge'i sbyin pas de yi mdzod/ /zas kyi nyon mongs zad ma gyur/ /su khaṃ sa nā ta āoṃ pu rgya sgo gya two tai badhwa na btu/ /shaddhā st+ya yo sa re shā haṃ bde ba brgyud /④pa bsod nams kyis/ /spyad nas nor can de nyid ni/ /nga yin zhi ba mchog gis 'dir//samyakshi bo dhi mā shri taḥ/ /pu bye na pā pe na tsa bee ṣṭi te yo saṃ sā ri khaṃ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsten/ /'khor ba pa yi las 'bras 2'jug pa 'di/ /'ching byed thag kadzre pha la pra dṛttaḥ/ /se tā si tā bandha na raspru ṣā ta ta saṃ kṣa ye mo pa dkar dang dkar min ni/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag gis rnam par bcings/ /de zad pa la thar kṣa pa thadza darnyi/ /i ti kṣi tī shaḥka thi tai dzi ṣpe na mo ha bya pe ye na ni sha mya pa'i gnas zhes brjod/ /de ltar rmongs pa zad pas thar par ni/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa sa dbang gis 95—543

mo kṣ-i/ /gre sha kṣa yārta sha ma me ba ma tā pu rgyu bhi mā āoṃ shi thi lī tsa kā thos nas/ /nyon mongs 'dzad 'os ①zhi ba kho nar nges/ /bsod nams mngon pa'i nga rgyal lhod par ra / / i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yo bo dhi sa tā ba da na kalpa byas / /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi la tā dzee shā liste bā ba dā na sapta tsa tā ri shaḥpalla baḥ// //'khri shing las sā la'i 7kyesdong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //swārja pra bṛbho bee ga tasmṛ ha rde pā ro pā kā re sa ta to rya tā rmā/ /rang don la 'jug chags pa dang bral zhing / /gzhan la/ phan par rtag tu brtson rnams kyisarte —/ /gre she ṣā ddhā tā bya sa ṣpe ra mbi tā biste ra spru ḍa ka ma re ti sedhiḥ/ /grub pa nyon mongs rnams la mi 'jigs shing / /gdung dang gegs 4bral gzir byed min par gyur/ /shā babye bha ga bārnyu rde dzi no dze ta ba ṣpesbi tāḥ/ /dhasthā khyu na pra saṃ ge na mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon/ /bzhugs pa bcom ldan rgyal ba yis/ /chos 'chad pa yi zhar la ni/ /bhekyu shaṃ hā ma byā ṣa ta/ /ā sī da khi la byu pa khā mo li lā li ta shā sa naḥ/ /dge slong tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ /sa bdag sa rnams kun gyi bdag /don grub ces pa legs byas ldan//seddhāsgo nā ma su kṛ tī sāzla dngha mo ma tī pa tiḥ/ /sā ga rā khya gya na ga su su nurdza sa skyong kun gyi mgo bo la/ /bka' ni rnam par rtse bar gyur/ /chu yi gter la gnas gyur pa/ /rgya mtsho la bye bā si naḥ/ /sasthārja sidzhaḥpu tra hūṃ pra ya yo ta gya bhū pa teḥ/ /sa bhā dra kalpi zhes bya ltasnaklu yi bu/ /don kun grub pa sa bdag ni/ /de yi bu nyid dag tu gyur/ /snying stobs rab tu ko bo bye sa twoḥ sa two dzwa la pra bhaḥ/ / dzā ta mā traḥkṣi ti ta labyakre 'bar ba'i 'od/ /skal bzang byang chub sems dpa' de/ /skyes pa tsam gyis 'u sa gzhi ni/ /rang gi pūṇḍi swa ṛdhi bhi/ /tagya pra bzlu mā na gya dhand+ra phye ba sa mu rya yo/ /sa mapta 'od kyis rgyas par byas/ /de ni che bar skyes gyur pa'i/ /grags pa lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ /srid pa 95—544

bhu ba na byā se bi bu dhwa bhyargyu tai ya shaḥ/ /sa ka dā tsidma ro rya āoṃ gyanda ṣpe mtha' dag khyab pa ni/ /chos kyi bzhin du yang dag rgyas/ /skyed tshal mchog tu dar ma de/ / nam zhig na yu bā bra dzan/ /da darsha dṛdhi pu ru ṣe de ba tā nimbi ta bu raḥ/ /tai bi shing rtas 'gro ba na/ /⑫)mdun du lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i/ /skyes bu rgan po mthong bar gyur/ /rga bas lo kya dza rā dzreṇḍi dzā ta bee rā gya bā sa naḥ/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba ni sā ram̐ sa 'khogs pa de mthong nas/ /chags bral gyi ni bag chags sad/ /'khor ba bzhin du lus dag ni/ /sha rī ra ma ma n+ya ta/ /urya rmā yā tra bi ra saḥsha ṣpeḥpra ti ni bṛ tya snying po med par de yis bsams/ / skyed tshal blta 2ba'i chags bral te/ /dal gyis log nas 'ong ba kaḥ —/ /dā ri dra bi dru tasgo ya na drukṣuskṛ pa khyobee thi/ /dṛsnye tā ma des 1—/ /lam du dbul ba nyid kyis ni/ /mdzes bral phongs par gyur pa mthong / /snying rjes drangs su kha kliṣṭa nu ka ru ṇa kṛṣṭa mā na saḥ/ /a tsinta ya da ho duḥkhaṃ sa pa'i yid can des/ /bde med nyon mongs de mthong nas/ /bsams pa sa la dbul po rnams/ /kye ma hadhe bhu bi durga tāḥ/ /a dā na pra bha ba duḥkhalba dadhe ti bi saṅga tāḥ/ /sdug bsngal bzod par byed/ /rin chen gyis gang sa gzhi na/ /gzhan la bslangs dnghapas nyer 'tsho zhing //thra thi bye ratna pūrṇa yī pa ra piṇḍi pa dzre bi naḥ/ /i da me bā bi saṃ bā di phongs gyur 'di dag sdug bsngal ni/ /sbyin pa min la sa skyes par smra/ /skyes bu bkren pa 'di dag rnams//tsidzee ka lu ṣa karma rde/ /dī nā ya de te ya tsabye pu ru ṣe pu ru ṣāḥpa ram̐/ /skyes bu gzhan la slong ba gang / /'di nyid kho na mi bslu bar/ /sdeg pa'i las rnams dag gi yertags/ /a ho du྾ ta me te ṣā ma ba j-i tā ཿpa de pa de/ /ya de te mārga gnas dang gnas su smad 67gyur cing / /'di dag slong bas yid byung la/ /babeengs par gyur kyang kho dīghā bhekṣi tā pi bu bhu kṣi tāḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsint+ra pu tsi ra bi sha kle sha bkres pa na/ /kye ma 'di dag nyes byas nyid/ /de ltar yun ring / mebasams byas nas/ /kun gyi nyon 95byed545

kṣayo rya tāḥ/ /a da ri dra dza gaṅge hūṃ raṭwābee dza la dhi ya yo/ /mongs gzhom brtson pas/ /'gro ba dbul min bya ba'i slad/ /rin chen don gnyer rgya mtshor song / /ka thañtsi di ba saṃ saktaḥs pi tā dṛ zwa ni: yaḥ/ /sa ma ru khya pra ba ha pha yis ji (rmyezhig ltar stes krunyid/ /rjes gnang nges pa brtan pa de/ /gzings la yang dag zhon byas khaṃ ratna dī pa ma bāpta bān/ /ta tra pra ba ha rja byu rnyen ba ṇi dziḥs ha nas—/ /rin chen gling du phyin par gyur/ /der ni tshong pa she gzings dag la/ /zhon nas lhan cig yā yi naḥ/ /so bra bī ta kṛ ya tī kā oṃ yudmā bhihma ṇi saṃ gra haḥ/ /e 'ongs rnams la/ /de yis smras pa khyed cag (dngharnams/ /rin chen 'dod pa bsdu bar mdzod/ /thun teḥsā mā n+ya rasnestu ma ma nāste bra yo dza 8/ /ka sha ma hārnyi bhā swarnyi mong rin chen 'di dag gis/ /bdag la dgos pa yod ma yin/ /bdag cag mdzod na rin chen mchog /sarnyi rasdotta mā ni naḥ/ /kintu tsiddhā ma ṇi pāste bi pu lo yasma mo rya maḥ/ /'od khrudang ldan pa mang po yod/ /'on kyang yid bzhin nor thob slad/ /bdag gi rtsom pa chen po 'di/ /te na bee dru ta rā ri bye kakhyo metshwa mi me di byā/ /shu tasma yā nā ga rā dzaḥsā de yis 'us ni dbul ba nyid/ /nyams pa dag tu bya bar 'dod/ /rgya mtsho zhes bya klu yi rgyal/ /chu ga rā khyu ma ho da dhi/ /ba sa tyaste kṛ he ta gya tsinta tārba bra do ma ṇiḥ/ /bi gter che la rab tu gnas/ /bsam ⑦pa'i don ster nor bu ni/ /de khyim na yod bdag gis thos/ /mi lo ghra bi ṣa masmrarga ta mā dā hūṃ bra dzā mya haṃ/ / nāste byerya sa hā yā bzad lam ni bgrod byas teldu/ /bdag ni de nyid len du 'gro/ /brtan pa'i grogs ldan 'bad rtsol rmā durga mi bya ba sā yi rmā/ /na tsamaji ra ho ki tsita bya sa rna bo dang / /ldan pa rnams la bgrod she dka' med/ /bdag gi ke/ 7legs byas rtsom pa 'di/ /gal te 'thob bha bi 6 ti/ /sa tya me ba pā rārba yo ya di me su kṛ to rya maḥ/ /i na bden nyid du/ /bdag dang bral bas khyed cag rnams/ /ci yang gdung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 95byed546

rākṣa sa dī pa muṅka ṭi/ /ta dzee ba bi ga ta kru ra bi kā ri steḥs pū dzi taḥ/ /nyam nga srin po'i gling du phyin/ /rnam 'gyur gdug bral de dag gis/ /de bzhin nyid du mchod nas de/ /bhusto kṣa pe ṇa ni kṣiptaḥkṣa ṇand+ra gend+ra sa mu ni/ /sa ta tra dīpta bee bha dpung pas blangs te skad cig gis/ /klu yi dbang po'i khang par 'phangs/ /lha yi dga' bde la 'os be di byotpa ba su kho tsi taḥ/ /a shri ḍodhīrgha duḥkhārte ta ta mā ro da na pa'i / /snang ba 'byor ldan der ni des/ /sdug bsngal chen pos gzir byas pa'i/ /cho nge'i sgra ni thos gha ni/ /sa ta mā kabye sobye gaḥpra kṛ hye ba da yādre byeḥ/ /ki me ta di par gyur/ /de yis de thos chags bral can/ /rang bzhin brtse bas brlan pa'i blos/ /mdun du klu yi 6ti sa pratstsha dṛṭī gre nā ga ka n+ya hūṃ/ /sā tai ba bhā ṣe saṃ sakta sho koṣṭha pi shu ṣpermu bu mo dag /mthong nas 'di dag ci zhes dris/ /yang yang mya ngan la chags pa'i/ /dro ba gsal byed hund+ra huḥ/ /smra ni na yadzñā ni shā meembi sthā dha ra da lakṣa ti/ /gu ṇa shugs rings kyis/ /bim pa'i mchu 'dab rimadzes pa dag /dri mar byed des de la smras/ /yon tan bānd+ra ga rā dza su pu traḥka ma la lo tsa naḥ/ /byeṣṭhaḥsazarba seddhā khyaḥthra yo pañtsa twa ma ga ldan pa padmo'i spyan/ /klu yi rgyal po dag gi bu/ /thu bo don kun grub ces pa/ /gces pa lnga pa nyid du taḥ / /ta twaḥsnga ta bi ga tā na nī pi thratta su khotpa be/ /gha no nā ro gyur—/ /de yi sdug bsngal dag gis ni/ /kun dga' dang bral bde dga' spangs/ /khang pa 'dir ni da ṣpe nāsminda babye bha ba ṣpesbi tiḥ/ /i ti ta suḥb tsaḥkhru tā sontaḥpa ram̐ tsi cho nge dag /stug po nyid kyis gnas par byas/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /rang yul mthong bas tsā ba han/ /swa de sha darsha na pāsto nā ga rā dzādhi shaṃ ya yo/ /nā ga rā dzasta dga' ba des/ /nang du yongs 'dris 'dzin byed cing / /klu yi rgyal po'i drung du phyin/ / klu yi rgyal po namā yārnyi pa ri dzñā ya thra yā sa ha ཿ / /e bye nyi pu tre ti ba dan dga' ma dang / /bcas pas de 'ongs 4yongs shes nas/ /bu gcig ‘sritshur shog tshur shog ces/ /95—548

ma bhū ba nanda bi hwa laḥ/ /maṭwā dzadma ka rja te na swalnga ga ma na kā brjod cing kun dga' 'khrugs par gyur/ /mi yi skye ba'i 17 gtam dang ni/ /rang nyid 'ongs pa'i shergyu ra khaṃ/ /shu tā ni be di tai nā ga ba ri ṣṭa bye dza gā da tai/ / tsirnya ma ṇi ra dag kyang / /de yis bshad pa thos gyur nas/ /klu yis yongs 'khyud de la smras/ /bu gcig yid bzhin yo pu tra ma ma mo li bee bhū ṣa rde/ /kṛ khya hūṃ ta ba saṃ ka dzeen barghaṃ kaspru nor bu 'di/ /bdag gi mgo bo nyid kyi largyan/ /long zhig khyod kyi brtag pa ni/ /'bras med byed par mutpa he/ /de yaḥkṛ ta dza gaskṛ tro ma me bā yo su nasta yā/ /i hphuktasme da do mi spro'o/ /'gro ba'i bya ba byas nas 'di/ /khyod kyis bdag la sbar sbyin bya/ /zhes brjod gtsug gi rin di bya tsū ḍa rarja bee mu tsu saḥ/ / tsi ddhā ma ṇi sa ma dā ya ku mā rasta ra chen mchog /de yis bkrol nas de la byin/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma'i 'od/ /yang dag blangs nas ṇi pra bhe/ /dṛṣṭaḥpra ṇa mya nā gend+ra ya yo pra ba ha rjarnyi shaṃ/ /samu dra gzhon nu ni/ /dga' bas klu dbang la btud de/ /gzings dang nye ba dag tu song / /de yi gtam de ba tā ta tra tai dṛṭwā shu ta tatpa thā/ /u bā tsa shī dṛ shaḥsā sgo shāsta byeddhā thos rgya mtsho yi 4/ /lha yis der ni de mthong nas/ /dge ba khyod kyis thob pa yi5/ /yid bzhin nor ma ṇi sta yā/ tshe /te ṣpe yo kā sha bākya me dhwa mi thu ri dzre te na tsa/ /padma pā ṇiḥ: de yi sa ga sal ba ra 'di ba rjod tshe sog sa blo ka ga nyi sa kyi rgya skad chad pa za hor gyi bsde sa sdeb sbyor kha sgo ta yang mar ba kod pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus da ga byed/ / sgo bu ci 'dra smros/ /de yis gsal bar 'di brjod tshe/ /zol med bsam pa drang po des/ /lag pa'i padma pā nā su two de sha tsiddhā to mā ṇi shaṃ/ / tya ste nd+ra ṣṭa ra sgoṭwā ma tī bye rab gdengs nas/ /yid bzhin kyi ni nor bu bstan/ /rin chen mchog de des mthong nas/ /phrag gant+raḥsaṃ kalpa tsa/ /tya yosgo dza sha ye nāñdza spyo sgo hūṃ ta ranta pa bye/ /dog dri ma'i bsam pa yis/ /de yi lag pa 7lag pa yis/ /thal mo (khyebasnun nas chu gter dor/ /95—549

sa mu dre pa ti tai dṛ ṭī rarja kṛsgo ta rārdzi lta / / sa dza gā ma dṛ shin tu dka' ṭwābs bsgrubs pa yi3/ /rin chen rgya mtshor lhung mthong nas/ /rtsom pa brten 0pa 'bras phyo byo ga bai pha lobye ga ni: laḥ/ /a ho gu rṇa tsi tā kā rā pra ṇa yādhri du bā med pa'i/ /mya ngan g.yo med des smras pa/ /yon tan la 'os rnam pa can/ /mdza' bas 'jam par smra rda mbi/ /bi dwo ṣa ka lu ṣa kadzre kṛ tā hūṃ na bi rā dza se/ /pa roṅkakṣe 6 saṃ byed pa/ /kye ma sdang bas sdig pa'i las/ /byas pas khyod ni mdzes ma yin/ /gang zhig pha rol khyad gha rṣa sho ka kle sha mu bee ti yaḥ / / shī ta khā a pi ta sri tā dzā khā 'phags la/ /'gran dang mya ngan nyon mongs gyur/ /de la phyogs ni 'di dag rnams/ /bsel yang ba la yi ta di shaḥ/ /sa rond+ra haṃ thra ya ya su ta gya sa twa ma ho da dheḥ/ /'bar bas dkrigs par gyur/ /gang zhig gzhan byi spro bas mgu/ /snying stobs chu gter chen po des bya/ /kasthā ra dha ba lo dhaste tri lo tī ti la shaṃ ya shaḥ/ /de bi pra yatstsha me rarja masma grags pa ga bur lta ra dkar ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyi thig le 'dzin/ /lha dag bdag gi rin chen stsol//dri ra ma pā ta kāta/ /a ba sā de tu dzee kand+ra na sā sgo ra bye ro ha sdig pa 'di dang bral bar mdzod/ /dam pa rnams kyi la sa dag ni/ /smad pa dag dang 3mtshungs mi nyi / /lo bhāttha mā dābye ṣabye rasne tserja pra yatstsha pi/ /sho ṣa yā bye ṣa dza 'gyur / /chags sam bag med sdang ba las6/ /gal te rin chen mi stsol na/ /de lta na ni khyod ñdzukyi la dhi ta di me te sa mā gra yi/ /i rkyughā gya sa kṛste na sā ratna nda da gnas—/ /chu gter 'di ni bdag gis bskam/ /zhes pa lan mang des smras kyang / /gang tshe rin chen do ya dā/ /sa ta dā swa pra bhā bee na sho ṣa yābyeḥs murya yo/ /dhyā ta mā tram̐ des ma byin/ /de tshe rang gi mthu yis de/ /chu gter bskam phyir rab tu zhugs/ /mig stong ldan pa'i sa ha pā kṣa ba tsa pā mi shwa kand+ra shā/ /nismi tai sa ha sā gya pā tra mā bi ra tshig gis ni/ /bi shwa kamos sprul pa'i snod/ /bsams pa tsam gyis de yi ni/ /lag tu 'phral la byung 95—550

bhūṅka re/ /sa te nā gast+ya tsu lu kā kā re rde bhaḥs yo da dheḥ/ /anta rī kṣe ma mukṣi bar gyur/ /bskam par brtson des ri byi yi/ / khyor ba'i rnam pa de yis ni/ /mechu gter dag las chu su bi kṣe pakṣa ma kho rya taḥ/ /kṛ te tre bhā ga she ṣesgo te nā tya bye ta kā blangs nas/ /bar snang la ni rab tu gtor/ /shin tu rmad byung byed pa des/ /chu gter sum cha lhag ri ṇa/ /su ba bherbha྾ tā bhā tā de ba tāsmi ma ṇirda do/ /nisto dza dīpta byas te/ /lha rnams kyis ni smad 5pa yis/ /'jigs nas lha yi kyenor bu byin/ /rin chen rnams sa ha saṃ ra tna nā mi ba ta twa ta ཿ / / pra bhā baṃ bee ti ma ha hūṃ bzhin bdag nyid che/ /sngags rnams dang ni dka' thub kyang / /zol med gzi byen che rnams kyi④ / /maddhā ṇanta pa sāñtsa kaḥ/ /sthā rastu ba da pā ra bā ri bi ra sa byā sā pā mthu yi (khyade nyid su yis 'u rig /rin chen 'byung gnas rang ྅rgyas pha rol med pa de srid chu yis ra he khā ba khāta kakhro khā ba lī yo ghi hūṃ ba ra ta yā ratna ka raḥkhru ya te/ /dkrigs gyur cing / /byed po'i bde blag stobs las rba rlabs 'phreng blubs mkha' la 'god pa nyid du thos//gasnyi raḥpu na ra pra me ya ma hi mā ko pi pra bhā baḥs hūṃ yasmin bisma ya dhwambi tsinta dam pa rnams kyi mthu ni chen po'i bdag nyid gzhal med ci yang zab pa ste/ /ya mtshan gnas gang bsam na bi dhwa bi ṅgā badhe sla badhe bye yaḥ/ /ta ta1ddhā ma ṇi labha ni dza sāze na pa'i cho ga dag la blo ni mtha' ru rgyal bar byed/ /de nas yid bzhin nor thob ste/ /rang gi don mthun sa ga taḥ/ /rā dza sru nuḥsru na ga ra pā ba pūṇḍi ma no ra thaḥ/ /kṛ ta kṛ tya dang 'grogs nas/ /re ba rdzogs pa rgyal po'i bu/ /rlung gis grong khyer dag tu phyin/ /rab tu mgu ba'i praṣṭadhe na sa pi tā ta tra sgo dzi taḥ/ /dhwa dzā gre ratna mā jo ya dza gā da dza pha yis der/ /mchod sbyin kyebya ba byas pa des/ /rgyal mtshan rtse la rin chen btags/ /skye bo'i mdun na saṃ sa di/ /pa rārja e ba yasne yo nādmāthorya di rnge kwa tsatpa/ /sar rab smras pa/ /gal te 'gar yang bdag 'bad 'di/ /gzhan don kho na bdag don min/ /95—551

te na pa bye na lo ke yo sadzre yā twa da ri dra tram̐/ /i hphuste sa twa ni bden pa de yis 'jig rten 'di/ /thams cad dbul med nyid gyur cig /dman la brtse ldan snying dha nā te na dī da ya lu nā/ /ratna dṛ ṣṭa ra pa ryan tā ni pa pā ta stobs kyishā/ /gter des de skad brjod pa na/ /rin chen char pa mtha' med ni/ /sa gzhi dag la ma tī ta le/ /te na ratna sa mū te ṣpe dikyu sazla su bhā swa tā/ /ya yo babs 2par gyur/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rin chen tshogs/ /'od dang ldan pa de yis ni/ /skye bo dza na su dā ri dhya ma yi niḥshe ṣa ṭwā ta maḥ/ /ā shā pa sha ba ྅ ba khāhphu dbul ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /myun pa lhag med nyid du gyur/ /re ba'i zhags ldan stobs kyis dpal ldan bee sha tā bā dhyā ga rde shrī ma tsā dāḥsthā ghā ta ba tī mu hurbi tsa lā tsā dā ro rnams kyi khang mdun phyi rol dag tu 'jug /sgo bas brdegs 1ldan yang yang rnam par g.yo zhing sgo yi da re sī da hūṃ / /dīsgo niḥshwa sa hūṃ shu tsā ni pa ta hūṃ de ha kṣa yaḥkhongs su/ nyen gyur la/ /shugs rings dang ldan mya ngan dag gis 'gyel zhing lus ni 'jig pa ④/'dod hūṃ kṣa tā dī nā ram̐ ma ṇi rā shi rasmi sha ra laḥshrī saṃ ga maḥko su bhūta/ /tatshwa gyur pa/ /bkren pa rnams la nor bu'i phung po 'od zer drang po'i dpal tshogs ci yang byung / /'jig sa nā du ra ga nā ya ka me ba yā te tsiddhā ma ṇi bi ga ta de n+ya di rten phongs pa'i thunyin dang bral zhing yid bzhin nor bu yang / /de yi bka' las lto 'phye'i 'dren pa nyid ṣpe tsa lo ka /sand+ra tra dā na ra si ka su dza na gya tse taḥsabyebee sābee bi ra du gyur pa'i tshe/ /kun tu sbyin pa la zhen skye bo dag gi sems rnams ni/ /slong ba'i don mthun kun dang tā ku li tsā ba bhū ba/ /saddhārja sidzhaḥkṣi ti pā la su nurlo bhū ta mee bā ha mi hā bral bas 'khrugs pa nyid du gyur/ /don kun grub pa 6sa skyong sras por ni/ /gang gyur de nyid nga yin n+ya de haḥ/ /khru two ti z-itrī ka thi tai dzi ṣpe na te bhikṣa bstadma ya tā ma lus gzhan 'dir/ /zhes pa'i sngon byung rgyal bas gsungs thos nas/ /dge slong de dag de nyid sems 95—552
