bā suḥ/ /i ti kṣe mind+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam la tā dzee saddhārja siddhā ba dā na maṣṭha tsa tā ri shaḥpalla waḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las don kun grub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //maste bha rku sgostso ku tsā bhi ra māḥkaspru ra hā dzā shu bi lā sā hā sāḥ/ /spru nu ma mngon dga' glang chen myos bum mtho/ /ga pur do shal 'od zer ༄1rtse dga' dgod/ /dar nyi pra dāḥpu rgya kṛ hūṃ bha brnyi thra dhwa yu ba rya: bi byu ta ya:/ /ta thā la babs 3 pa'i na chung 'byor pa yang / /bsod nams byas pa rnams la dga' ster yin/ /de bzhin ga te bha ga ba ti shā ba hūṃ ba na tsā ri ṇi/ /a bha bahphu pra buddhā khyuḥgashegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /mnyan yod nags na rgyu ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khyim gyi bdag po sngon//shrī mān kṛ ha pa nyiḥpu rā/ /ba byu ba hasta ko nā ma ta tyā ti da yi ta su taḥ/ /pūddhārdzi legs par rab sad ces pa byung / /shin tu sdug pa de yi bu/ /glang po can zhes bya bar gyur/ /sngon tā dzā pū rgya nā sā kā ra i ba pañtsa yaḥ/ / ta gya dzadma di ṣpe dzā tabya bsgrubs bsod nams dag gi tshogs/ /rnam pa dag dang bcas pa bzhin/ /de ni skyes pa'i nyin par la//mi ka ra ma yo ma hān/ /e shī bhū da i bātsorya pra dzaḥpra ba ra kuñdza rab mchog glang po chen bo nisnye/ /gser gyi rang bzhin skyes gyur te/ /ngo mtshar tshogs ni gcig gyur raḥ / /sa ga dzend+raḥku mā rabya tatpa tubya ma no ra thaḥ/ /lo ka kau tu ka kobya bzhin—/ /glang dbang de dang gzhon nu dang / /de yi pha yis ngare ba dang / /'jig rten ltad mo mdzod shā puṇḍi hūṃ tu lya ma ya yuḥ/ /sa sha shī ba shi shu kā lā ka lā ni la ya tā rnams kyang / /mtshungs pa nyid du gang bar gyur/ /ri bong can bzhin byis pa de/ /dus la sgyu rtsal cha se ga taḥ/ /ru tsu tse ru tsi mān sadrwa lo ka lo tsa na bāndha baḥ/ /sa sha ṣpeḥpū gnas gyur/ /'jig rten kun byi mig gi gnyen/ /'od zer ldan zhing rab tu mdzes/ /dal gyis de ni 95—553

ri tā sgo ga bhū dzastambha bi bhū ṣa khaṃ/ /le bhe ma no bha bā ra bha bha ba rna kho lag rdzogs/ /dpung ba'i ka bas rnam par brgyan/ /yid las byung ba rtsom pa'i gnas/ /lang tsho na ba yo ba dzwa/ /ka dā tsi da tha bhū bakhyoḥs pra se na dzi taḥsu tī/ /ta nu tsi gsar pa thob par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig de yis ni/ /sa yi bdag po gsal rgyal gyi/ /bu mo lus ba ra tsi sno na sa ha dze na bee rā dzi tī/ /ka tyā ṭī ba ra ka tyā khye lā ba rgya ni 17chos gos kyi/ /rtags dang lhan skyes blurnam mdzes ma/ /chos gos bu mo zhes bya ba/ /mdzes shing la li tā na dzā/ /u byā na darsha nā yā tsā da dasgye ya ta lo tsa nā/ /a yid 'ong bzhin ras can/ /mig yangs gzhon nu ma dag ni/ /skyed tshal lta ru 'ong ba mthong / /nyams kliṣṭa rū pa mā lokya tā ma ya parlu ṣita tyā to/ /bisma yasma ra yostu khye sa pa med pa'i gzugs ldan zhing / /mdzes pa 7mi dman de mthong nas/ /da kruni 'phral la ya mtshan dang //ya yo sa ha sā ba shaṃ/ /so tsinta yata a ho kānta mi rda na tyadhū tai 'dod pa'i dbang du mnyam par gyur/ /des ⑤bsams kye ma lus 'di ni/ /shin tu rmad byung mdzes ba pūḥ/ /ya smiddhā ti mu kha byā dzā da do ṣa bi sha daḥsha shrī/ /lā ba 5 ma prati pa ste/ /skyon bral dri med ri bong can/ /gang du bzhin gyi zol gyis mdzes/ /gzugs can mchu ni brtse ma me ṣa bee bharbhe taṣṭha ba ntu ka ba ntu ra dha ro ma dhu ra swa bhā baḥ/ /ka gnyen yid 'ong rang bzhin can/ /'di ni do zla med pa'i mdzes sdug rnam par 'dzin byed cing //dro ho rya ta ཿ sa ra sa bi dru ma pabee bā rmā bi dza pra bhā pra sa bha bi rlan ldan byu ru'i yal 'dab dag la 'khu bar brtson pa dang / /bim pa'i 'od kyis ༄ 'urnam 'phrul dag ni bhra ma band+ra kā raḥ/ /brja na kṣa ma te ma rda sha sha z-i taḥklishā ti kārnyiḥsu 'phral la 'bras med byed/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyags pa bzhin gyi skumi bzod mdzes pas bdud rtsi dman dhwa muhphu khrotpa la kā na na su ku ru te dṛṣṭaḥ pra bhā bhaṭwā rgo/ /ma bye byed cing / /utpal rab tu rgyas pa'i nags tshal 'od ni mig gis rab tu nyams par byed/ /yid srubs 95—554

madma tha saṃ ga mo tse ta ta noḥsā saje dī ti pra dā lbo khā gyaḥs ha sā bi 'grogs 'os lus can 'di yi 'jo sgog 'gran zla dag la 'jigs ster bas(1/ /dga' ma'i 'asnarol rtsed rba ( 1lā sa la ha rī sho ṣe bi dhaste ra teḥ/ /uzlo te ka ṣṭha ṇi sa yo dha ra yu ge na rlabs dag ni 'phral la nyid du skems par byed dam snyam/ /kye ma gang gi 'o ma 'dzin pa zung ni rab tu dzu shyadri be ke tsa ram̐ ya snga do ṣa ma ye su ho gu ṇa bā tā hā re ṇa ba sgye sra mkhregs dben pa nyams/ /skyon gyi rang bzhin yin yang yon tan ldan pa'i do shal dag gis gnas spru tiḥ/ /a susminda ba la ba te3mbu dza bye yā ro lalba re khā mu khe lo lā ghraḥpar byas/ /bzhin 'di la yang bung ba'i 'phring 'arnams chu skyes blo yis nye bar brtan 67pa dang / /g.yo ki ma pi pra shārnyi na ya rna lī rna mu byā nādma naḥ/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta ldan mig gi 'dren byed thub pa'i yid kyang ci yang chags shing nyams par byed/ /de ltar sems pa de yi gya ba puḥputpa sha ro pa oṃ/ /bi lokya byu pa nyi su tā ba bhū bābyarya nistsa lus—/ /me tog mda' can lta bu dag /mthong nas sa bdag bu mo ni/ /ngo mtshar g.yo ba med par khā / /dṛ te larghaṃ shu ke na suḥsma re ṇa smi takā ri tā/ /pra tya gra pu la kā tīrte gyur—/ /dran pa 'dzum par byed pa yis/ /de yi ngo tsha'i gos phrogs te/ /gsar du spu long rgyas pa yis//ba puḥspa ṣṭa na dṛ shya ta / /ruddhā na bā bye lā ṣe ṇa bee laghra ṇa ni lus ni gsal bar mthong ma gyur/ /mngon 'dod gsar pas bkag gyur kyang / /skyengs pa yis ni phyir baṭī ta/ /ma nasta tre ba ni kṣi pya sā shu bye pa sha ṣperya yo/ /rā dza dha dī sa mā bzlog ste/ /yid ni de nyid la bzhag nas/ /de ni stong bzhin dal gyis song / /rgyal po'i pho brang phyin sa rya ladzdza bisma ya madma dzeeḥ/ /mbi li te ba ni lbo ṣpe ba pa pra ṣi te ba gyur nas/ /ngo tsha ya mtshan yid srubs kyis/ /zum pa bzhin dang zhum pa bzhin/ /bcom pa bzhin du byu ba sā/ /ku mā ro bee swa bha ba ṣpe sa murtsu ta ma no bha ba/ /tā me bend+ra mu khāe de gyur to/ /gzhon nu yang ni rang khyim du/ /yid las byung ba yang dag rgyas/ /mdun du zla bzhin ma 95—555

ma gre saṃ kadzee ra li kharlu huḥ/ /sa tā mā na sa bhadzre sri sma ra bee tyā mi de nyid/ /kun tu rtog thu pas yang yang drisari / /de yis yid kyi nor mchog de/ /'dod pa'i rig pa ba sma ran / / pra da rmyo durla sgosma tā ta na yī tsakra ba tī naḥ / /bzhin dran cing 1/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bu mo nirngu / /rnyed par dka' bas ⑤shes nas bsams//dzadmānta re ta nurya gya ta paḥpa ri tsi tā tsi ram̐/ /dha n+yaḥs tā ma bā sno skye ba gzhan la gang gi lus/ /yun ring dka' thub yongs 'dris pa/ /skal ldan de yis snesnalegs byas ti la tsā su kṛ ta shā khāe naḥ/ /ra mya pra dā na pu bye na tardorsha na ma kyis—/ /shing gi 'khri shing de thob (7'gyur/ /dga' ba rab sbyin bsod nams kyis/ /de mthong ba ni bā su te/ /na dzā ṣpe tā ni pu rgyu ni ye ྾ ta྾ ga maḥpha lo/ /tadmaghra thob gyur te/ /gang zhig de 'grogs 'bras ldan pa'i/ /bsod nams de dag yongs rmye mi shes/ /de yi shī ta ki ra ṇa sma ra ḍo tpa be na ta snga byu du rla bha ta yā bzhin ras bsel ba'i zer ldan dran pas dga' ba dang / /de yang rnyed dka' nyid kyis 'bral ba'i bi ra hoṣṭha rja me/ /no beedme ki j-i ti ri yo ki ma yi bi mo hoḥki dzī bi tai gdung ba dag gi bdag /brtan pa 'di ci rmongs 'di ci zhig 'tsho ba nyid phyo ni ci/ /srog dang lhan ki ma su bhiḥs ha bi pra yo gaḥ/ / tadmaghrastsa dzi taḥpra sa hra bha dza te kṣe cig rnam par bral 6lam ci yin yongs mi shes/ /de gdong chu skyes dag gis 'phral la bcom pas mtshan bye kṣa pā babee bhā gya byu bee bhra ma lalja ti tsa bi na ti paste dha nu smradma mo'i yid 'ong nyams pa bsten/ /de yi /nyasmin ma'i rnam 'phrul dag la ngo tsha yid srubs gzhu ni gug thu par thi / / ta gyaḥ pa bee ba se sha li byu ti mu ṣā sho shā dha re shādi te gyur—/ /yid 'ong yal 'dab mdangs 'phrog shā1de yi mchu sgros dmar ba dag gis gzir gyur te//nu rna pā pya bi rakta tī ba na ma ṭī bimbi sa mā laspa te/ /i nyi pūrtend+ra ba da nā chags bral nyid thob bisbra dag ni nags kyi sa la yang dag brten 1stanam snyam/ /de ltar zla nya'i bzhin ras 95—556

ba da na dhyā na ni : la ཿ / / ni shī nda nā ya saṃ tya kta ཿ se dhya can—/ /bzhin la bsam gtan g.yo med kyis/ /gnyid kyis phrag dog can gyis bzhin/ /gtang stiye ba na ni dra yā/ /ka tyā darsha na thraṭwārnye ta taste na ni bee di tai/ /khru ba de yis mtshan mo 'das/ /mdzes ma mthong bar gyur pa'i mtha'/ /de ni de yis bshad pa dag /pha tā pi byu gya saṃ krānta tsint+ra pa ri tsi to3 bha bta/ /sa ta mu tsa ba yo pu tra rā yis thos nas de yis ni/ /bsam pa 'phos shing yongs 'dris gyur/ /de la de smras bdag cag bu//rnyo pya pu ra bā si naḥ/ /sa ka dzee he du hi ta ram̐ tsakra brti pra dā gya ti/ /rgyal po'i grong khyer gnas pa'ang min/ /'khor los sgyur de bu mo ni/ /khyod la ji ltar ster bar 'gyur//ā shākyi nai ba kutthadhi sa mbi hadhe na durlu sgo/ /a saṃ bha bye na bhā ṣasta mā mkhas pa bkur ba 'dod pa rnams/ /mi nus pa nyid byed ma yin/ /rnyed par dka' ba 'dod ma yin//na kā mā ma bee ṣi ṇaḥ/ /tsū ta tsadza kallī 6 swā dhī na pu ni rā da raḥ/ /tsinta mi bden pa no smra ma yin/ /'khri shing tsū 5ta tsam pa ka /rang dbang rnams la mi gus par/ /yongs yand+ra ri dza ta gya la hūṃ shu 6 ti ṣatpa daḥ / / ta ba ta sthābya sadzantaḥ'adu'i 'khri shing sems pa na/ /rkang drug pa nyid bskam 1par 'gyur/ /gal te khyod dang de gnyis kyang //pāgyudma bi nyi to ya di/ /ta da ba bye bha ba hye ba niḥpra yatna pha lo da yaḥ/ /skye ba snga mar 'byel bsgrubs na/ /de yi 'bras bu 'bad med du/ /nges pa kho nar rgyas par 'gyur//ā shā sā shi ra nā kṛṣṭi bee tsā ri ra ka habee tai/ /pra yātna bha ri ra shārnya re ba'i zhags pas ma bkug cing / /rtog dpyod dag gis ma gzir la/ /'bad pa'i khur gyis ma ngal bi dhaste bha bee ta bya tā / / i tyā ka sbya pi turpā kyi ta tta the ti bi bar—/ /nges par myong bya grub pa nyid/ /ces ④pa pha yi tshig thos nas/ /de de bzhin zhes rnam tsinta yan/ /na tse taḥkānta kā nī tai pra tyāde nyu sha shā ka saḥ/ /sa ga bsams te/ /sems ni mdzes mas bzung (4ba dag /beer yang zlog pa snedes ma nus/ /de song 95—557

tā danta yu ga lo ya yā tse he ma kuñdza ram̐/ /na ba saṃ darsha ṣpe rā dzñāḥdī ti yo gser gye glang po la/ /rgyal la gser nyudu phrad pa yis/ /dga' bar 'os phrad skyes su ni/ /gser gye gya mu pā ya āoṃ/ /puju babye na ka ri rja darghaṃ danta yu shaṃ ta taḥ/ /mche ba zung dag blangs/ /de nas lag ldan bsod nams kyis/ /mdza' bas byin pa'i mche ba zung //sa he ma ma ya mā dā ya drabye byu mi pa ti ya yo/ /sa ratna ru tsi re pā gya gser gyi rang bzhin khyer nas de/ /sa yi bdag po lta ru song / /de yis rin chen gyis mdzes pa'i//bha ba āoṃ thra thi bī pa te/ /pra bi shya pra ṇa taḥdī hye he mandanta dwa yo sa yi bdag po'i khang par phyin/ /nang zhugs rab btud mdza' ba'i slad/ /gser gyi nyamache ba gnyis da do/ /byu bhu dza bi khru ta gu ṇaḥpra sā de nā bhi nandi taḥ/ /ba ram̐ kṛ hā ṇi po byin/ /rgyal po rab tu dang ba yis/ /yon tan gyis grags dga' bar byas/ /mchog ni long zhes kyukta bya sa na dza grwa ha kiñtsa na/ / ta su de n+ya byubya kre mā na ma bhya brjod gyur kyang / /de yis ci yang blangs ma gyur/ /mdzes pa dman min de la ni/ /rgyal pos lhag bye shaṃ dṛ paḥ/ /au tsi tya tsā ru tsa ri taḥpri yaḥka su na ni smṛ haḥ/ /sa sa par bkur ba byas/ /rigs shing mdzes pa'i spyod zhupa can/ /chags pa med la su mi dga'/ /rtag tu dā darsha ṣpe rā dzhaḥkañtsa dzā gā ni darnyi rgo/ /pu nardza ta na rpā ge na daṭwā ni rgyal la phrad tshe des/ /gsar du so ldan la skyes pa/ /gser gyi rang bzhin mche ba rnams/ /dga' ba'i pri ta ye da do/ /ta mu ba tsa ma tī pā laḥse ba pra ṇa ya yadhri taḥ/ /dru beed du rab tu byinace/ /yid rab dang ba'i pho nya ni/ /bzhin ras mdzes pa 'dzin byed cing / /bsten tī sma naḥ pra sā da gya ba da na byu ti mutpa ha na/ / pra byu ta he ma pa'i mdza' gcugs (ltekyis bsdams pa'i/ /sa skyong gis ni de la smras/ /rab mang gser tshogs barming /4)saṃ bhā rā gumbi se bā mbi mā ma haṃ/ /na sa he po ra brge hi bha ra bhā ba yis/ /bsten 'di bdag gis yongs pemi bzod/ /gang phyir grong khyer ba yi tshogs/ /sa bdag 95—558

yo ma tī bye tsā/ /saṃ bee bha bye dza nā bhā taiḥkā spru tizla ma kāñtsa ṣpeḥ/ /te rnams kyi ①rgyas bya nyid/ /skye bos bgos skal phul ba yisakhye/ /gser gyi dga' ba bdag la ci/ /rin ba nargha gu rja mūsne ri ya me ba ma ma bri yā/ /lo bhaḥpu ru ṣa rasne 6 chen yon tan khyod kyi ni/ /gzugs 'di nyid la bdag dga'o/ /gser dang rin chen rdo ba'i tshogs//byu ṣa rjarte pra sho bha te/ /rā dhī ko she 6 sī darnyi he ma ratnathra pañtsa yāḥ/ /mdzod rnams na gnas rgyal po ni/ /rgyan du 'os pa'i skyes bu dag /rin chen rnams la chags na mdzes//sa mbi hi ta ta oṃ tu bye ki pra yatshwa mi ka bya hūṃ/ /niḥshe ṣa ko ṣa dā ṣpe pi na khyod la 'dod pa'i mchog dag ni/ /bdag gis ci sbyin smra bar mdzod/ /ma lus mdzod ni byin gyur kyang //nā mā nu sha yostu me/ /rā dzñā treka pū ta mā tre ṇa pā gyadhe ya di na shri nges par bdag ni 'gyod mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i spyan zur lhung tsam gyis/ /gal te dpal 'byor ma thob yaḥ—/ /ta da nadzee ga tābee tyā korjaḥpābee ba gye ba yā/ /i truktaḥkṣi ti pā na—/ /don gnyer don med nyid gyur pas/ /sa bdag bsten pa'i don ni ci/ /de skad sa skyong gis le na ku mā raḥka li tsā dza liḥ/ /ta ma bhā ṣa ta bhū pa la dā tu marta ti ko pa smras tshe/ /gzhon nus thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /de la smras pa sa skyong dgakhye/ /ster bar 'os pa gzhan pa raḥ—/ /a nabee te na ratna ni bi bu dhe bhyaḥpra yatstsha tā/ /ta dundi dro saṃ mu dra su—/ /mkhas pa rnams la rin chen ni/ /don du ma gnyer stsol mdzad pa/ /khyod kyi rgya mtsho'i grags pa khru mu dri tai bha ba tā ya shaḥ/ /ma hā tā pi pra dā ṣpe na srurya te na ma hā sha ya//ni—/ /rab rgyas de dag rgya yis btab/ /rab tu hye ba sha rī ri rde/ /batta yā banda de hi ti tā badzha ba ti balla bhaḥ/ /yon tan yongs rdzogs kyang / /ji srid bslang zhes ma brjod par skye/ /de srid snying du sdug pa yin//i ti khyu pa tiḥkhru twa ba tso do la ba lambi naḥ/ /ta mu bā tsa ma hā zhes pa khye/sa bdag khyogs la ni/ /nges par bstan chapa'i tshig thos nas/ /blon po chen pos gnas mā tyaḥsaṃ tsidhyā ba sa ro tsi tai/ /a nā lo tsi ta paryantaḥpra tya gra sa ra skabs su/ /'os pa bsams nas de la smras/ /rje bo dag gi blo gros rnams/ /bgros pa min pa'i ④sā da rāḥ/ /swa bhā ba ra bha swa e ba bha badhi pra bhu budha yā/ /a mthar thug cing / /gsar du chags ldan gus pa dang / /rang bzhin gzu lums ldan pa yis⑤/ /sred shakyārja na yā te na lubye ṣpe ba gu rdo da yaḥ/ /rā dza se ba pra dṛste na ldan mi nus don gnyer bas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas bzhin du ni/ /rgyal po'i g.yog la rab zhugs des//he ma hast+ri bi nā shi taḥ/ /bā tsu sau bha ba tā swe ram̐ ka tyāsthā pu na rā ga taḥ/ /gser gyi glang chen rnam par bcom/ /bu mo slong ba slar 'ongs tshe/ /khyod kyis ⑥dal bus 'di brjod bya//he ma haste na mā ru khya pābeeḥpāsbya si me su tai/ /te nota kṛttaḥswa haste na gser glang zhon te 'ongs pa na/ /bdag gi bu mo thob par 'gyur/ /de yi ⑦rang lag gis bsad nas//ku tasta gya sa kuñdza riḥ/ /na tsā sau tabyi ra hi taḥpu na rā yā ti ladzdza yā/ /i tya de la glang po ga la yod/ /de dang bral ba'i ngo tsha yis/ /beer yang khye'ong bar ⑨mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa mā tya gya ba tsa sā dṛ pa tirlutta mā shri taḥ/ /pāste ku mā ra ma bye drusta blon po'i tshig gis ni/ /nyin gzhan gzhon nu 'ongs pa la/ /lugs la brten pa'i mi bdag gis//de bā bhi mu kho ba datpa/ /ku mā ro bi kṛ ha ga tā bi bā ho tsi ta oṃ ga leḥ/ /mngon du phyogs te de nyid smras/ /gzhon nu yang ni khyim song nas/ /bag ma len 'os lhobye bkra shis kyis//hai ma dri ra da mā ru hra swadza ṣpe na sa hā ya yo/ /swaṇḍi bā ra ṇa dru gser gyi so gnyis la zhon te/ /rang gi mi dang lhan cig 'ongs/ /gser byi glang chen la zhon nas//95—562

ṭwānta mā yanti ma tī ba tiḥ/ /bi lokyābyarya bi bha ba me ṣpe pu rgya ba hūṃ ba 'ong ba de ni sa bdag gis/ /mthong nas ngo mtshar 'byor pa can/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mchog tu ram̐ / /kau tu kā da tha bhū sa laste ga dzee he ma bee gra haṃ/ /ā du ro ha ma hodmā shes—/ /de nas rgyal pos dge mtshan las/ /glang po gser lus can de lashe/ /spro ba chen pos lhun po khyaḥsu me ru mi ba badzra bhrita/ /ā dru bye thra thi bī pā le na tsa tsā la sa kuñdza raḥ/ /la—/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhin du zhon/ /sa skyong gis ni zhon pa'i tshe/ /glang po de ni mi g.yo zhing //pra sa saza ku mā re ṇa pu nartswa lo kṛ tā sa naḥ/ /tasma tā dṛ pa ti re stan 6)ni gzhon nus brgyan pa'i tshe/ /slar yang rab tu g.yo bar gyurage/ /mi bdag gis de ltar shes baṃ tattha bhā bee na bee smi taḥ/ / dha byosmre ti ba daṅka dhyā da do tasmi sma shing / /de yi mthu yis ya mtshan pas/ /bdag ni rīskal bzang zhes brjod cing / /bu mo 'dod dpal ra shri yi/ /a bhyabyo ka tyā rasne na dṛ pa tiḥpu ru ṣetta oṃ/ /hastsotpa ba sa muju de la byin⑪/ /rin chen bu mos skyes bu mchog /ma nor mchod nas mi yi bdag /spro dga' yang dag taḥsu dhwa sin dhu ri bā ba sgo/ / ta taḥ ku mā ra da yi tā mā dā ya rgyas gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas gzhon nus mdzes ma ni/ /blangs nas swa kṛ haṃ ga te/ /sa pha lo byu da rgo ga gya kārmu ka karṣa ṇa shra maḥ/ /na bee rang gi khyim song ste/ /lus med gzhu ni drangs pa yisathu/ /ngal ba 'bras bu yod par gyurarngu/ /lang tsho ba ya saṃ sgo gārte na ba kānt+ra sa mā ga mo/ / ta sā bhūbee bha bo dā raḥgasar pa longs spyod 'os/ /mdzes ma gsar pa shedang 'grogs te/ /'byor pa rgya ches rtag tu des spu//sa dā na ba na bakhro baḥ/ /ta taḥka dā dzibyu bā khāḥkṛ ta kṛ tyaḥpra se na dzita/ /gsar pa gsar pa dga' bar 'gyur/ /de nas nam zhig sa skyong ni/ /bya ba byas pa gsal rgyal gyis//pu rgya pra bhā baṃ dzā mā tuḥka la yadma ma tsinta yata/ /a ho di byaḥpra byā bo sau bsod nams mthu ldan mag pa dag /yid la gcags nyu shing rab bsams pa/ /kye ma lha yi mthu 'di ni//95byed563

ku mā rā su pra dṛ shya te/ /na hi sā mā n+ya pu rgyu dzā sā ko bha ba ti gzhon nu dag la rab tu mthong / /gang phyir thun mong bsod nams rnams/ /de ltar min ①par 'gyur tabee dhaḥ/ /ku lo lasmri habye tri ta sha shi ma dā rū pa ra ha li ba yaḥsaṃ sgo ma 37yin/ /rigs ni dpal 'byor khang bzang gzugs kyi rba garlabs zla ba'i dregs pa 'phrog /lang tsho gāhaṃ gu ṇa pa ri tsa yo byu ṣa ṇa tsa yaḥ/ /ya shaḥpu byo rya na pra thra longs spyod 'os dang yongs su 'dris pa'i yon tan rgyan gyi tshogs/ /grags pa bsod nams skyed tshal rab ta ku su molbā sa sa tsi baṃ na bidmaḥ ka snga yi ku sha la pa ri shā ma 'khrungs me tog rab tu bkram pa'i grogs/ /'byor pa 'di ni dge ba ④yongs smin ci yi 'bras bu yin sthā bee bha baḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsinta su tsi ram̐ sa saṃ dzā ta ku tū ha laḥ/ /par yongs mi shes/ /dge mtshan yang dag skyes pa des/ /de ltar yang dag (snyebasams nas ni//sand+ra dzñā darsha nā brja mā ru ro ha ma no ra tha/ /sa dzā mā ta ra mā hu ya sangs rgyas blta thub la btags pa'i/ /yid kyi shing rta dag la 'dzegs/ /mag pa bu mo bos nas ni//su tai tsa sa tsi beeḥs ha/ /bha ga brnya ya yo dṛṣṭi ma na sā pra thā oṃ ga taḥ/ /yā blon po dag dang lhan cig tu/ /yid ni sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la lta ru song / /rgyal te dṛṣṭi pa rja dze ta ba ṣpe saṃ tya bye ba ha rgo/ /u pa mṛ tya dṛ pa paspyo bha byed tshal ni mig lam du/ /gyur tshe bzhon pa yang dag btang / /rkang pas nyer btud mi bdag gis//ga ban tai bya lo ka yata/ /sa tai pra ṇa mya ta ha pā da padma khyu ti shi khā ma bcom ldan 'das la rnam par bltas/ /der btud de yi zhabs pad kyis/ /gtsug gi nor bu ⑦g.yo ba ṇiḥ / /su tsā dzā mā ta ralngasmi na mro nā: n+ya bee da yata/ /u pa biṣṭa 6 sarbe 6 des—/ /bu mo mag pa btud pa dag /de la ming gis rnam par bshad/ /thams cad 'khor zhing /rde7pra ṇa mā na ta mo li 6 / / sa pratstsha rā dza sa ttha dzha bha ga ba nta phyag 'tshal te/ /kun nas mgo bo dud pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pa la/ /thal mo sbyar 95byed564

kṛ tsā dza liḥ/ /a yo gu ṇa ga rto pe taḥku mā raḥshri mā hūṃ ba raḥ/ /he nas rgyal pos dris/ /bcom ldan las ni ci zhig gis/ /gzhon nu dpal 3ldan rnams kyi mchog /yon me na danti nā yā tsā bha ga brnye na kand+ra shā/ /i yo ṭī ba ra ka tyā tan tshogs ni rgyas pa 'di/ /gser gyi glang pos 'gro ba lags/ /'di yi gre bag gsar bdag gi ni//tsa mkhru ta gya na bā baju/ /ke na pu sgyu bi pā ke na dzre bi tā da bye pabee bhā/ /bu mo gos kyis mdzes ma 'di/ /bsod nams gang gi rnam smin gyis/ /srog las lhag par snying du sdug/i ti thraṣṭaḥkṣi tī she na sadrwa bibye ga bān dzi naḥ/ /ta mu tse bhū pa te sum̐ sī sa yi bdag pos 'di dris tshe/ /kun rig bcom ldan rgyal ba yis/ /der gsungs skyes bu'i 'byor pa pu stso dhū tā bee bhū ta ya ཿ / / ya du dā ram̐ ya du tsi te ya ddhā rnams / /sa bdag bsod nams dag las byung ṭwā/ /'jig rten na ni 'dod bya gang / / rgya che gang dziju mabye tsā / / smṛ ha ddhā yi tsa yaglo ketta hphu rgya sa mu bye baṃ / /dang 'os pa gang / /cemadzes pa gang dang rmad byung gang / /de de bsod nams nyid las 'byung //bi pa bye bha ga bān pūdzee su ga taḥ sa ha bhikṣu dzhaḥ/ /tsa tsā ra lo bcom ldan bde gshegs rnam par gzigs/ /dge slong dag dang lhan cig sngon/ /rgyal po gnyen ldan ka kṛ pa yā rā rnyo brnyu ma taḥpu re/ /tasminda ba sa re ta tra ku mā tyā sa ha grong khyer du/ /'jig rten la ni brtse thu bas rgyu/ /gnas skabs der ni khye'u zhig /gzhon nu ma dang dā ra kaḥ/ /bee spri ḍā band+ra ni pu raḥkṛ twa dā ru ma yi ga dzee/ /to bee lo kya sa 'grogs nas ni/ /shing gi rang bzhin glang po byas/ /lam gyi mdun der rnam par rtse/ /btso ma dzambu na mā yārnyi ddhā ta dzee byu na da byu ti/ /phulla padma da lā kā ra ka ru bhā sdidzre da'i 'od/ /pad 'dab rgyas pa'i rnam pa can/ /yid 'ong snying rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /bcom ldan byon pa lo tsa rna/ /bha ga brnye sa mubye ta tarbhatta pa ra sorlu kho/ /spri ḍā ga dzee ni de dag gis/ /mthong nas de la gus pa rgyas/ /rjes su chags pas mngon phyogs te/ /de la rtse cha glang 95—565

nistsa lā/ /yā kṛṭwā pa ri beeji tā bi gha ṭi tā sngond+ra ṭi tā lo ṭi tā nij-iṣṭa ka na shaḥgayo ba med/ /gang zhig dge ba rnams kyis bkug dang yongs su dkris dang rnam par gsal ba dang / /kṛ tā pi ku sha lenai ba pra yā tikṣa yo/ /kāntaḥkā ye ba ha ti ma rab bcad gcus dang nges par brdar dang phye mar byas kyang zad pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig zla ba li rna do ṣa bihūṃ ya i na duḥspyu rā kā raḥki ra ṇa dza ṭi lo yadma ṇi mdzes pa'i lus la skyon gyi stithig le nag po dang / /gang zhig ma rungs rnam pa'i sbrul nag nor bu 'od kṛṇḍa sazlaḥ/ /nā nā rū beeḥsha bal tsa ri tai de nyi rna darsha yast+ri se yo zer ral can 'dzin/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis bkra ba'i ④spyod pa lus can rnams la ston byed pa/ /tsi tra kra ma pa ri ṇa tā kadzre nirmā ṇa re khā/ /a byudṛ ha pa tiḥbyuzla 'di ni bkra ba'i rim pas yongs smin las kyi 1sprul pa'i ri mo yin/ /gzhal du med pa'i nor skyed ④karba ṭi khe ba ṭā bhi dhaḥ/ /a pra me yadhe notparnyirba hu pu tra ka la tra bān/ /cing / /bu mang chung ma dang ldan pa'i/ /khyim bdag kha ba ṭa zhes pa/ /kar pa ṭar ni sngon byung gyur/ /a bi bhakta dha na sta gya ju tā dwo mā tī kaḥshi shuḥ/ /mugha nā mā kṛ he ta sbo de yis mdza' bas bskyangs pa yi⑤/ /byes pa mug dha zhes bya ba/ /nor ma bgos pa'i spun zla ni/ /bātpa sthārte na pā li taḥ/ /ka dā tsi— kṛ ha pa ti kā li kā nā ma babee bhā/ /ma mi gcig pa de khyim gnas/ /nam zhig khyim bdag de la ni/ /khyim bsam gtam gyi bar skabs su/ /u bā tsa ku ṭi khā swe ra kṛ ha tsinta ka thānta re/ /marya pu tra twa yī ge he sha ra chung ma nag mo zhes bya ba/ /gya gyu can byus dal bus smras/ / rje yi 'usras po rmongs pa las/ /bag med le nā pra mā di na/ /mo hā da so da ro bhā tā bi ṣa bṛsgo bi brnyi taḥ/ /a ko drang por khyod kyi (7 ni/ /khyem du ma mi gcig pas 2stespun/ /dug gi ljon pa rnam par bskyed/ /'god se pa hu su tra snga bya yi na sta ba nirgya yaḥ/ /a bi bhagha dha nā darja bral gcig pu (khya'adi yis kyang / /'god ldan bu mang khyod kyi ⑫ni/ /bgos pa min pa'i nor dag las/ /95—624

n+ya ye ṣpe ṣa ha ri 6 ti/ /a su byā sgo ra bee dha khya ba dha e bā rya mo ṣa khyed ①ni tshul gyis len par 'gyur/ /nad bzhin 'phel ba 'di la ni/ /gsad pa kho na sman gyi khu rghaṃ—/ /bentu tstsha dā dra pi dzu rde dha ṣpetstsha do hi duḥs haḥ/ /ge dī mchog /gnyen ni gcod pa dag las kyang / /mi rnams nor gcod bzod 1par dka'/ /zab mo'i khye rā ya bya yā ram̐ bha saṃ sā ro tsi ta dzadma rmā/ /bi senda pā to ma ha tsā dī send+ra 'du 'god rtsom pa yisakhye / /'khor bar skye ba 'os gyur pa/ /chen po rgud pa ⑥lhung gyur na/ /gnyis pa ta no pa maḥ/ /i ti ta sngaḥb tsaḥkhru tā hrū ra muṅkambi hā sha yaḥ/ /'thung dbang po 'gyel ba bzhin/ /zhes pa de yi gdug pa'i tshig /thos nas bsam pa rab 'dar zhing / /sā ta mu bā tsa pra ṇa yāta ste ha pā sha ba shi kṛ taḥ/ /hi ta myukṇi twa yā mdza' ba'i zhags pas dbang byas de④/ /de la gtsugs ldupas rab smras pa/ /re zhig khyod kyis phan pa tā bta ki tī ta da nyi pā ta kai/ /sa ha dza taḥtstshanda bye ga ba hi re ga dha brjod—/ /'on kyang 'di ni shin tu sdig /phyi rol yan lag nor thob slad/ /lhan skyes yan lag su nāpta ye/ /na yukta barba saghra nā marjaze pā pa tsinta rna/ /kṣa bee nā zhig gcod/ /nor la chags rnams nor don du/ /sdig pa bsam pa rigs ma yin/ /nor rnams yārnyi bi tta ni rakṣi tā n+ya bee saṃkṣa yi/ /mu huḥ kasgro mbi saṃ re bha bsrung bar ⑨gyur mod kyang / /skad cig gis ni brlag par 'grur/ /yang yang las rlabs rtsom pa yis/ /saṃ bha batho bha bi bhra māḥ/ /gatstsha juḥke na ba spyernye shi la ku spyo i rab skyed ⑫'khrugs pa'i rnam 'phrul can/ /dpal rnams ri gzar chu bo bzhin/ /bgrod pa dag ni su ba shi yaḥ/ /tasmranda me su snru ju tro tro he pra brta te ma naḥ/ /bitta yis bzlog⑪ /de slad ⑪smin legs bdag gi yid/ /spun zla gsod la yongs ⑫mi 'jug /nor bye she ste me bṛtrīdṛtta rja she tu kā ga tiḥ/ /i ti ta su bru bā ṇa gya nyams ⑫bdag ni 'tsho ba yod/ /spyod tshul nyams na 'gro ba gang / /zhes smras ⑫ bdag po de yis ⑩yid/ /95—625

nā nā yutta ni darsha naiḥ/ /sha ṣpeḥsā ni de bhe pa kyuḥpā ta kā bhi mu khasma sna tshogs rigs pa nyer bstan nas/ /dal gyis ①sdig pa dag la ni/ de yid ①mngon par phyogs par naḥ / /badhi tābee hu bhaḥste haiḥs ha dzand+rasgo dzā ni ba/ /stso tā ha rarnyi byas—/ /mdza' snum mang pos bskyed pa yisarju / /lhan skyes spyi bor skyes pa bzhin/ /bud med spu gri'i sa hasā gru ra dha rā kha rāḥste yaḥ/ /ba krā pa ram̐ spyu ra ta rā kri yā so rnon gyis/ /'phral la bcad nas 'dor bar byed/ /rmongs pas bcom pa'i blo dang bud med ni/ /su pra brta nā yi ba dṛṭwā bhi yo ga /sā pā ni bā tā ya bha ba tya bye mo hā ha tā rgo 'khyog cing gzhan la rab gdug bya min la/ /'jug pa'i slad du brtan pa sngon ④sbyor zhing / /sdig pa ⑤yu ba ti dzre tibya/ /ba ndha mi tra bi raghra rgo swa su kha kṣi ba tse ta nges par lhung rjobar byed pa nyid/ /gnyen dang grogs la chags bral zhing / /sems ni rab bdes stsos tsā / /shrī yu tā nā ma ba nā taḥsdi dzi nā rmā ma tiḥku taḥ/ /a tha ju tar gyur pa/ /dpal ldan rnams la dud pa bzhin/ /bud med rgyal la blo gros gang / /de nas de yis ⑦mā byu ya dī twa pusgostso yā ya saḥ/ /n+ya ba dhī da khru tā kranda ma sma nā bi dza ṣpe spun zla ni/ /me tog btu slad la spyodrangs nas/ /mi med nags su rdo ba yis/ /cho nge thos pa med par ba ṣpe/ /a ha me ba tatyā paṃ bhukta pūbye 6 dzadma su/ /ba hā mya byā pi she ྾ bsad—/ /de nyid nga yin sdog pa de/ /skye ba snga ma rnams ⑨spyad nas/ /mthe bong snad pa'i mtshan nyid sha oṃ guṣṭha kṣa ta lakṣa khaṃ/ /sārja bā horja datta byuḥpūṇḍi pra ba ha ṇaḥcan—/ /da lta'ang lhag ma'i cha shas 'dzin/ /ded dpon don byin zhes bya ba/ /gzings ni gang bar pu rā/ /sa ba na snga nu ku bye na ratna dī pānd+ra mā ya yo/ /dri tī ya gyur pa sngon/ /rjes su mthun pa'i rlung dag gis/ /rin chen gling nas yang dag 'ongs/ /de nas ded sārja ba ho tha naṭwārba ste sa mā shrī taḥ/ /dwo ṣānd+ra ba ha ṇi stso tra pratstshanda dpon gnyis pa ni/ /don nyams de la brten gyur pa/ /sdang bas gzings la sbas pa yi/ /'ug ⑩pa 95—626

kakhyo murya yo/ /a tha driṣṭiphorba daste na bārya ma naḥpu naḥpu naḥ/ /pā bya bar rab tu brtsams/ /ci ste don byin gyis mthong nas/ /yang dang yang du zlog 37grur kyang / /sdang pa pra yatnasnye ṣārnyaḥkṣa rde na bi ra rā ma saḥ/ /ta taḥsārja pa tiḥko sāddhā bas long de sdig pa yi/ /'bad las skad cig log ma gyur/ /de nas don mthun bdag khros nas/ /māstsarya bi mo nyi taḥ/ /tī bra shasti pra hā re ṇa tsa kā ra ga ta dzre bi tai/ /khro ldan rnam par rmongs pa de/ /mi bzad shatta 'asnarab bsnun nas/ /srog dang bral ba nyid du byas/ /a haṃ sa tatpa dmāsthā pa pha lo bhughā n+ya dzadma su/ /ba hā mya tyā pi she ྾ de nyid nga yin de bsad las/ /sdig 'bras skye ba gzhan spyad nas/ /lhag ma'i cha shas da lta yang / /shaṃ tsa ra ṇi kha di ra bra khaṃ/ /pra tya ka budheḥpiṇḍa ya pā tra pā ṇi da yādzra rkang par seng ldeng rma 'dzin no/ /lag na kyelhung bzed brtse ba yis/ /brlan pa'i blo ldan rab ngu dhīḥ—/ /bi be sha kā shi na ga rī mu pā riṣṭa bhi dhaḥpu rā/ /sa pūṇḍi pā tu sangs rgyas/ /u pa riṣṭa zhes pa sngon/ /ka shi'i grong du bslang slad zhugs/ /de yi 'a7lhung bzed yongs mā lo kya ta gya bi dī ṣa du ṣi taḥ/ /mu dhwa tsa pa la ko nā ma pā ṇi na pā ta pabyu khengs pa/ /mthong nas sdang bas sun phyung ba/ /'bras med g.yo ldan zhes pa yis/ /lag pa yis ni sa bi / /a haṃ sa pā pantabyektatstsha dottha ba hu dzadma su/ /bhughā pi pha la she ṣe la pho/ /de nga khuzas bcad las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sdig de skye ba mang por ni/ /spyad kyang 'bras bu lhag ṇa pra yā tāḥshu n+ya pa tra hūṃ/ /ba shiṭī khyaḥpu rārta two pābee tsitta pra sā da ma yis/ /lhung bzed stong pa nyid du gyur/ /ba shiṣṭha zhes bya bar 7‘sngon/ /dgra bcom nyid thob sems bān—/ /u bā pa pra mā rā me bi hā re po ra kalbi te/ /bhra tā pra bri dzi rab dang / /rab zhi'i dga' tshal grong pa yis/ /byas pa'i gtsug lag khang na gnas/ /de yi srun zla ta ta gya bha ra dhū dza pa do di taḥ/ /bi lo kya dza na sāṭwā ram̐ ya yo bi dī ṣāsni rab byung ni/ /bha ra dhwa dza skye bo yis/ /bkur ste rtag rgyas de mthong nas/ /sdang ba'i me yis 95—627

tapta tsā/ /gu ṇi nāsmra na ma lokya pra yatna ntabee nā sha ṣpe/ /dza naḥgadungs par gyur/ /yon tan can rnams bkur mthong nas/ /de nyams beed du skye bo rnams/ /rab tu ka ro te na tātpa gu ṇa dhwa na sa mu rya me/ /ma hārta basthā yu ga lo ṭwā tre 'bad byed bdag nyid ni/ /yon tan gzung phyir brtson ma yin/ /chen po la 'os gos zung zhig /bhatta dza nādzre tai/ /tasmi ba shiṣṭhaḥpra da do dī tyā sa ra la mā na saḥ/ /ta skye bo gus pas phul ba ni/ /drang po'i sems ldan khyeb shiṣṭha/ /mdza' bas spun zla de la byin/ /de ④dā dā ya gu ṇa dī ྾ na bee rā bi ra rā ma saḥ/ /no pa kā rerne tsa dī blangs yon tan la sdang de/ /khon dang bral ba nyid ma gyur/ /phan pa rnams dang mdza' bas kyang //tya ni dza yā ti durja naḥ/ /a kādhe sa sa mā byu ya bi hā ra pa ri tsā ri rmā/ /ngan pa rang gi (1mi 'gyur ro/ /de yis gtsug lag khang skyong ma/ /dben par yang dag bos nas ni/ /da tā sri bant+ra yu ga la dza gā da kṛ ta saskṛ tiḥ/ /i rda twa yā basthā yu shaṃ pa ri gos ni zung dag de la byin/ /bkur ste byas nas rab smras pa/ /gos zung 'di ni skyed skyi bzang ma/ /jo ya su ma dhya me/ /ba shikhye nādzre ta mi ti prasne bā tsuḥsha ṣperdza naḥ/ /i ti sīkhyod kyis gyon la skye bo dag /'dri ⑤na ba shiṣṭha yis ni/ /byin zhes dal gyis smra bar bya/ /de skad des kṛ tya te noghā ba dā diṣṭi tsa kā ra sā/ /ye nā bha babo shiṣṭha su dza no bi bee ba brjod de yis kyang / /khas blangs de yis bstan pa byas/ /gang gis khyab shiṣṭha la ni/ /skye bo slong bar oṃ ki taḥ/ /shī la bai ka lya bā de na so tha po ri ra pū dzi taḥ/ /du ram̐ dgos ⑦par gyur/ /tshul khrims ma tshang brjod pas des/ /de nas grong pas ma mchod de/ /ring du ya yo ma hā to hi saṭwā ra bye sha dhī ra baḥ/ /so ha māryā sa bā de na song gyur chen po rnams/ /bkur ste nyams pas 'jigs pa nyid/ /bhā dur dhwa dza de bdag ste/ /bha ra dhū dzo n+ya dzadma su/ /bhughā gya pu bye tatstsha ṣāhphundaryā rya mṛ ṣārdi 'phags la smad pas skye gzhan la/ /bsod nams min spyad de lhag las/ /mdzes mas ding yang rdzun 95—628

taḥ / /brahma bee ṣpedhya yā pūrde bā rā rja sde ma yā mu ṣpeḥ/ /duzla de na ha tā gyis smad/ /bdag sngon bram ze'i phrag dog gis/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ① thub pa ni/ /blo ldan mngon shes lnga tīntiḥpa.āoṃ bhi snyo su dhī ma taḥ/ /bā ra rja snga ma bhund+radzee bha dru nā ma bā pa yis①/ /grags pa phrag dog dag gis bcom/ /me tog gzhu can grags pa yi/ /ba dan ltar mdzes dzā ga na/ /bai shā ya shaḥpa tā ke ba kāddhā ku su ma dha na naḥ/ /shā ka dā smad 'tshong ma/ /bzang mo zhes bya bud med mchog / bā rā ṇa sīr rngusngon byung gyur/ /g.yo ldan gya tsi1 shā la khyo bi ṭaḥku ṭi la beṣṭi taḥ/ /dṛṭī ta sri da do rā tri sgo gā yo shu ka gyu'i bsam pa can/ /pad rtsa zhes pas nam zhig de/ /mthong nas mtshan mo spyad pa'i slad/ /gos dang byu ṣa rde/ / ta tasta ra la rā gā yāḥ sandha yaḥsaṃ ga morlu khe/ /rgyan dag de la byin/ /de nas g.yo ba'i chags pa can/ /mtshams la 'grogs par mngon phyogs pa'i/ /ga ga ram̐ ga ṇa baryadhe ladza mā ṣpe di bā ka re/ /ga twa swa bha ba rgo bha dru nyin mor byed pa nam mkha' yi/ /khyams kyi mthar ni babs pa'i tshe/ /bzang mo rang gi khyim song nas/ /pu྾ shu ka bi khyu ṣa ṇiḥ/ /khā ba rgya bha rā ṇa tsa kre pu na tuste pra sā dha āoṃ/ /me tog gos dang rgyan rnams kyis/ /mdzes pa nyid kyi rgyan la ni/ /beer yang zlos pa'i rgyan dag byas/ /a lakta ke pā da ta lā ba saste kakhye ba lambi n+ya pi hā ra hā khye/ /smrag rtsi rkang pa'i mazil la rab chags shing / /do shal mchog ni chomagrin par dpyangs (byenas kyang / /kāryābee ni dam ṇa saṃ myu khāe sā ca kā ra bai shā tsa ri tai ya thārja/ /kaṇḍi n+ya bya ba don gnyer me long la phyogs te/ /smad 'tshong spyod pa'i don bzhin de yis byas/ /mgrin pa la da n+yadma da ṣpephon+ya dokhye ba bhā ra ta rtswa z-i da ye ta thā n+yatpa/ /sā bhū ṣa rde gzhan bzhin gzhan mchu la gzhan/ /de bzhin gzugs can ma des snying la gzhan/ /rnam bkra rang gi lo bha na me ba sum̐ sī murghaṃ swa kaste bya mi bā ti tsi tram̐/ /ka li ta ta bya ba gzugs brnyan ⑥bzhin/ /skyes bu chags byed nyid kyis mergyan rnams bzung khya/ /yid skyes ⑨rgyal 95—629

ru ṇa rā gārja ga rā gā ba rbha pā ti mi ra sha ba la sarmya bobee saju pa dhu ba'i grags pa zla ba'i gzugs ni dang po bzhin/ /lan bu thig le'i ri mo sa sti'ajo sgeg ldan par rab spras miḥ / /ma na si dza dza ya kirtswa murbhe mā tyā mi beesdo ra la ka til ka le khye lī shing / /rab 'phro bdug ①pa'i du bas rab rib thun mtshams bzhin bkra ba/ /chags pa dar byas yan la yā sru tra yaṭī/ /ta taḥpra bi shya twa ri tā dā sī ma kā ri kā bhi dhwa/ /lag dang bcas chags pa de rab mdzes/ /de nas g.yog mo chu srin ma/ /zhes pa myur bar rab zhugs te/ /ta myu tse kṣa ṇa saṃ gādhī ba nyi rāste yu bā na baḥ/ /kārṣa pa shā dzā tre ṇa der smras skad cig 'grogs 'dod pa'i/ /gzhon nu gsar pa phyi na sdod/ /kākhyo 1pa ṇi brgya phrag lnga/ /babee tīrya sha ta pañtsa kai/ /pra bi bye ba bi nirlu te so yandi dhi ra sa taḥ/ /rtswa ④bzhin du ni ster bar byed/ /'di ni khyod kyi gter zhing khye 'ongs/ /nang zhugs nyid ni phyi rol thong spyo/ /pra bhū ta dra bi ṇa snga gī bya gra tā da tsi rasbi tiḥ/ /tstshanda kā maḥkṣa mbi rab mang nor ldan gtong phod can/ /byel bas yun ring mi sdod pa/ /'dod bsgribs ④'dod ldan kā mbi su bha ge la bhya te ku taḥ/ /i ti ta gyeḥb tsa shu tā bha dru thra bā bzod pa can/ /skal ba bzang mo ga la thob/ /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /yon dang chags pa'itsa sa mi tā/ /kṣa rde do lā ya mā ṣpe ba ma bye dākṣi ju lo bha yaḥ/ /ka bar du khyeni/ /skad cig 'phyang ⑨mo yug pa bzhin/ /bzang mos 'dzum bcas rab smras pa/ /gzhan dzee ra bye ga de bā ha ma n+ya smra dā tu bee ta nā/ /gatstsha mi prabee tā n+ya su las gla ni blang ba kyedag /lam srang dag gi bud med bzhin/ /de dus don gnyer gzhan la ni/ /lag taṇḍa noṭwā na pā ṇi tai/ /pra dzā nā mi ba sazla gya swā dhī nā nā ma pi kṣa khaṃ/ /bzed nyid du ji ltar 'gyur/ /skye rgu 11rnams bzhin thams cad kyi/ /dbang du gyur kyang skad cig ni/ /pūzla me bā bṛ tā ye na sa swā mbi bee sha yo ṣi tsā/ /e kai be yo mṛ shā gang gis sngon nyid 'thams pa de/ /smad 'tshong bud med rnams kyis ⑫bdag /mtshan mo gcig pu 'di 95—630

le na 1 tā rā triḥki mu hye te/ /pa raḥpra taḥs mā yā tu na ba re ghāḥs dā nyid ni/ /pad rtsas nyos la ci zhig brjod/ /gzhan kyis ①snga dro 'ong du chug /bdag cag rtag tu ba yo/ /i kyukta bha dā yā kṣu dru ma dhu lubye ba sā sa ra/ /saghā gsar pa rtsom/ /bzang mos 'di brjod chung ngu des/ /mtshog tu sbrang rtsi la chags bzhin/ /gsar pa na ba na bā swā de ku pi tā tā ma bha ṣa ta/ /na ga taḥpra ta rā gaddhā pra taḥgasar pa'i ror chags shing / /khros pas de la rab smras pa/ /gal te 'ong ba (②btang gyur na/ /song saṃ tya bye te ya di/ /bhā gyesgo ba ti bai shā rmā ba ni dzā tsa ba hu kra yaḥ/ /ba nang par 'ong mi 'gyur/ /smad 'tshong rnams dang tshong pa la/ /skal bas nyo ba mang bar 'gyur/ /i taḥki tsi di taḥki tsiñtsi na ṭī rmā di bā ni shaṃ/ /bee shā dzā po du ṣe lā 'di nas cung zad 'di nas dang / /cung zad nyin mtshan du gsog 1pa/ /smad 'tshong rnams kyi skyes bu bhaḥku su mā ba tsa yo pa maḥ/ /na dhand+ra ya na kā mā ya dha nā yi na pra yis—/ /rnyed pa'i ④me tog 'thu ⑤ba bzhin/ /smad 'tshong ma la rtag tu mdza'/ /slong ba rnams kyi sā rgya te/ /bee shā yā tsa ka bi bye ba ba hu pra ṇa yi mbi sa dā/ /nā yā rig pa bzhin/ /chos kyi slad min 'dod slad min/ /nor nyid beed du rgyas par byed/ /mang dang tya shu tsi hūṃ bai shā pra ta ma snga na lu bye te/ /bha dza te ba hu saṃ ge na pra 'grogs pas smad 'tshong ma/ /mi gtsang ba nyid mi 'gyur zhing / /'di yi brtul zhugs mi nyams te/ /kyu tā bhyarba byā ya tsā / / niryātya bye bi shakhye bye pra tī ghradhe ba hi slar la don du gnyer byar 'gyur/ /gzhan dag phyir 'thon gzhan na sh-i'ajug /gzhan dag phyi nas rab ba re/ /ya sgyuḥpa sho bhya te be byā sa bhā bhū mi pa te ri ba/ /doddhā rgya pa lta ba'i/ /smad 'tshong gang de mdzes pa ste/ /sa yi bdag po'i mdun sa bzhin/ /tshong pa dbul po'i ju kā mi tyā ki ma n+yand+rasbya to bye kai/ /tu le ba kṣi ṇa ba ṇi dzaḥshu tyā sī da ti srang bzhin du/ /stong par khyim na gang 'dug pa/ /smad 'tshong rnams la 'di las ni/ /lhag pa skal 95—631

yasgo he/ /a bhā gye spyo ha kā bhā bee ga ṇi kā sru tyā shā yi —/ /mi byā baṇḍi ngan gzhan pa ci/ /skal ngan gyis ni 'dzin byed med/ /'phyon ma stong par nyal ba ni/ /snga dro 'dod ya ti pra taḥkā mu kaittha bhañdza nā/ /sa byāḥkra ya pa ri kyā gā du ra ldan rnams kyi skra/ /rdzun gyi 'khrug khyepar grub ①par byed/ /'phral la nyo ba yongs btang nas/ /ring batrī pra tī kṣa yā/ /mā khā i bā shu shu 6rnyi bee shāḥpa ju pra sā ra ke/ /na gnas la bsgugs dzu pa na/ /zong 'grems sa ru smad 'tshong ma/ /'phreng ④ba bzhin du myur du bskam⑤/ /e ṣa kau tu kā mā tādhī kārya bya gro ba hu pra daḥ/ /pra bi bye ba bi niryā ti 'di ni dge mtshan tsam don gnyer/ /bya bas brel zhing mang du ster/ /nang zhugs nyid na phyi rol 'gro/ /kā kṣa ta gri khya tānta āoṃ/ /khru two tand+ra hi tai bha dru ta dzee ti pra tya sa rya ta/ /ci nyams nor ni blang bar ⑥mdzod/ /phan pa 'di thos bzang mo des/ /de bzhin zhes te kha yis blangs/ /lo bhaḥswa bhā ba bai shā na mo tsi hye dza na rañdza rgo/ /kṣa mya hūṃ kṣa ṇa mā hūṃ ga dzwa/ /yā tu dhwa mbi mi ba sashyata ba khā shaṃ sgothi muhphu kai/ /tsā shing ltogs pas gzir/ /srin mo bzhin du bu tsha dag /za bar 'dod pa mthong bar gyur①/ /de dṛṭī ka ru ṇa krāddhā sā kṣa khaṃ sa ma tsi ta yatra/ /a ho swa de ha bhe he na ma tiḥmathong snying rje rgyas gyur pa/ /de yis skad cig yang dag bsams/ /kye ma rang lus la chags pas/ /blo pā bee pra brta te/ /a gya sgo dza na mā hakhyo bra dzā mi swa kṛ haṃ ya di/ /ta di ni sdig la rab tu 'jug /'di yi zas ni len du bdag /gal te rang gi khyim song na/ /bkres pas yi kyutpa ri kṣu ma bha ghra ya hye ba dā ra kai/ /a tha bā shi shu mā dā ya ya di yongs su nyen pa 'dis/ /bu ni nges par za bar 'gyur/ /yang na bdag gis bu khyer nas/ /gal te gatstsha mi mandi re/ /ta de ṣā kṛ sha tsā yā tā sa ryast+ya dza ti dzre bi tai/ /i ti khyim du phyin pa na/ /'di ni bkres pa nyid gyur te/ /'phral la 'tsho ba gtong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar saṃ tsiṣṭha da yā yā tarmind+ra bha ya saṃ sha ye/ /dza ga྾ tā ra shā ye bha pra ṇi gnyis ka the tshom dang / /ldan pa de la brtse bas bsams/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i sbad nyid du/ /de yis jo āoṃ bi ṅgā ya sā/ /stso tā ta yo pa dī te na shi na shaste ṇa nibya lā/ /ni smon lam btab byas te/ /de yis gtad pa'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /g.yo ba med par bcad nas ni/ /de dzee sta na yu ge ta gye da do dzi bi ta dmā ra khaṃ/ /tre lokya spri shi sābyarle ta su la rang gi nu ma zung / /'tsho ba yi ni zung ⑫la byin/ /de nas de grags ngo mtshar can/ /'jig rten ya sha se bi khru te/ /bi pra rū pe ṇa sha kre ṇa ta taḥthraṭwā sa me tya sā/ /gsum reg grags pa'i tshe/ /brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs kyis ni/ /mngon du phyogs te de la dris/ /a bee testa na dā ṣpe na ma no bi kṛ ti mā ya yo/ /i ti thraṭwā pa tī sa tya bā di khrod ni ṭwānu ma byin pa yis/ /yid la rnam 'gyur ma byung ngam/ /zhes dris de la dag pa dang / /bden nī tai dza gā da sā/ /ya di me nā bha batpa byeta bi kā dzā sha sta nārba ṇi/ /te na smras pyaldan pa des smras pa/ /nu ma byin la rnam 'gyur cha/ /gal te bdag la 'ga' ma gyur/ /bden 95—640

na ya āoṃ sha ṣpeḥ/ /utyā byotyā rgya tuṇḍi na thratpa sardza pu naḥpu naḥ/ /'gro ba'i mkhar bgrod ①kyis/ /mchu yis phyung zhing rab phyung nas/ /yang dang yang du rab tu btang / /dherle nibya la sabye gaḥs dṛṭī pi smi tai kha shaṃ/ /u bā tsa bhu ghā niḥshaṃ ka brtan zhing yan lag kun mi g.yo/ /de yis ya mtshan bya mthong nas/ /smras pa dogs med nyid du zo/ /nai ba hūṃ dhwa ra yā mya haṃ/ /niḥsā ra bi ra saḥkā yaḥsā pā yolhayi kṣa ṇa kṣa nga yis khyod ni yongs ⑤mi 'dzin/ /ro bral snying po med pa'i lus/ /gnod bcas skad cig 'jig pa yī—/ /pa ro pa kā ra le she na yā ti saṃ sā ra pā ra tsā/ /gre da gyandi 'di—/ /gzhan la phan pa'i cha shas kyis/ /'khor ba'i snying po nyid du gyur/ /mi rnams lus ni mi ni nindi te pra ti pa rda shā sakṣaṇa sandi ni sde haḥko3ya ma pā ya jo sdi ma la ṣpe mi gtsang zag cing so so'i gnas su smad gyur dri ma can/ /gnod pa'i gnas su gyur cing dbugs dus g.yo byā sha rī re dṛ rdeḥ/ /e kai ba smṛ ha bhā ya tā mya ya di dam pu byeḥkwatsiṅka la log par chags pa 'di ni ci/ /gang zhig bsod nams rnams kyi ④'ga' zhig dag tu 'ga' la 'ga' gya tsita kiñtsa da bī ghra ka dā tsi dānti sha ma na tā rja ya sanda khya ti/ /tshe 'ga' mthong nas/ /gdung ba zhi byed skyob la zhugs gyur 'di nyid gcig pu 'di yi dga' bya nyid/ /i ti ta gya bru bā ṇa gya grukhye miḥpakṣi bhiḥkṣa shāta/ /bha ghra mā ṇa gya bi kṣi su byā taḥces pa smra ba de yi lus/ /bkres pas nyen pa'i bya rnams kyis/ /za zhing 'phangs pa'i spyoskad cig la/ /kā yo da sbi she ṣa hūṃ/ /ma hā shā la su kā le na zwahma ṇa ta gya pu tra tsā/ /yā rus pa'i lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /dus kyis de ni bram ze dag /sā ⑤la chen po'i bur skyes te/ /bden taḥs tya pra to nā ma ba byu ba dza na sasma ta/ /a bāstu khi la bi rya su pa'i brtul zhugs zhes bya ba/ /skye bo dag gis bkur bar gyur/ /rig pa ma lus thob gyur cing / /ka ru shā sakta tse ta saḥ/ /ta gya shārnyi ra ta snga bhūji bā ha bi mu khasma naḥ/ /snying rje dag la chags pa'i sems/ /zhi bar dga' ba de yi yid/ /khyim thab las ni phyir phyogs gyur/ /95—642

ku le dzadma gu ṇa bāstebee bee kā lo kṛ ta ma tiḥ/ /sattha byu ta da yā rigs su skyes shing yon tan thob/ /blo gros dben pas rab brgyan cing / /'byung po kun la brtse zhing mi ṭī lakṣa rde bu ju kadzre bhā/ /bai rā gyu bhi ra tig tā sa yu bee ba byams—/ /bsod nams las kyi mtshan nyid yin/ /gzhon nu de nyid chags bral gyis/ /dga' zhing ta po ba rna / / da tta bra to ma ha rṣa rgyu bhe dze bee shārnyi mā shra dka' thub nags song ste/ /drang srong gnyis kyis brtul zhugs byin/ /bste gnas su ni ngal gso (1rime—/ /ta taḥkā le na si ta pta bee ma la dzñā na lo tsa naḥ/ /ā sanda pra sa rpā byu bsten—/ /de nas dus kyi ye shes spyan/ /dri med shin tu rno ba yis/ /stag mo btsa' la nye ba dag /spyu sa dṛṭwā sa ma tsinta yata/ /pra sa bophosngaḥgru dhwarta yā sabhā ha na bha mthong nas de yis yang dag bsams/ /bkres pa yis ni gzir ba 'di/ /zhag bdun dag na btsa' bi 6 ti/ /spri hā tsotpaṣṭha te tī krā ni dza po ta ka bhakṣa bee/ /i nyi saṃ tsi tya bar 'gyur bu/ /rang gi bu ni za ba la/ /skom pa drag po'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsams de yis 1ta druḥkhaṃ mu ni dzñā bi bee rya saḥ/ /tsa kā ra tattha ti kā re kā ru sdug bsngal ni/ /thub pa dag la bshad nas des/ /snying rje chede ni phyir bcos pa'i/ /yid la re ba bye na ma no ra baṃ/ /ta taḥpra ya te sasthā he byā spyu garbha bha rā la sā/ /ba tū byas par gyur/ /de nas zhag bdun 'das pa'i tshe/ /stag mo mngal gyi khur gyis dub/ /zas chag pa bā sa santadzñā kṛsgo ṇa pū ta po ta kān/ /ni dza sho ṇi ta gadhe na dzā ta mang pos gdungs gyur pa/ /dka' las chen pos bu tsha btsas/ /rang gi khrag gi dri yis ni/ /sred pa tī pra ta ra smṛ tī/ /sa tya bra tasta mā lo kya da yādzraḥs ma tsinta yatro/ /drag po rab skyes ⑤pa/ /de mthong bden pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ /snying rjes brlan pas yang dag bsams/ /i rda ba rā tī kṣudruḥkhā du rya tā po ta bha kṣa ṇi/ /a ho ba tā sngaḥswāze na sdug ma 'di ni bkres pa yis/ /sdug bsngal dag las bu zar 6brtson/ /kye ma 'di ni rang don gyis/ /95—643

pu tra sne hopho pi bi smṛ ta ཿ / / sa dzee ཿ swa duḥ kha sa nta ptaḥ pa ra bu la chags pa'ang brjed par gyur/ /rang sdug bsngal bas thams cad gdung / /bzhin ①gyi yongs su sadhwa pa shi laḥ/ /pi she ṣāstoḥpa ra sngasto bi ra lo dzā ya te dza naḥ/ /da tā sha rī gdung bas bsel/ /skye bo 'ga' zhig gzhan gdung la/ /khyad par du ni gdung ba skye/ /bu dang bcas ram̐ raghra mi byā spyi me tsā pa shā ba tī/ /na pa he duḥkha me te ྾ sarlurnye pa'i stag mo 'di/ /lus byin nas ni bdag gis bsrungs dhi/ /srog la the tshol yongs rdzogs pa/ /'di pā ṇa saṃ sha ye/ /pa ra zwa ṇa tā ṇi dṛ ṇa ka pa la yā tyakta ba pu ྾ dag blusdug bsngal yongs mi bzod/ /gzhan srog skyob ④la lus ni rtswa ⑤ bzhin brtags pa spyogatong ba ya sha ཿ kā yaḥ sthā yī bha ba ti thra thu pu byo da ya ma yaḥ / /rnams ⑦dag gi/ /rgya che bsod nams rgyas pa'i rang bzhin grags pa'i lus ni brtan par 'gyur/ /pra shaspyo pā yophoyo pra sa ra da ni lā lo la na li mbi da lo྾ ga bye gadzdza la la ba su gnod pa rab chags srog gi thigs pa 'di ni rab g.yo rlung dag gis/ /g.yo ba'i pad ldan 'dab ma'i z-isnro bee ta ka ṇaḥ / / dhyā te ti n+ya sa ta dhyā sgyu ཿ sa pu raḥ ka ru khong duganas g.yo ba'i chu zigs dag gi grogs/ /'di bsams snying rje'i gter de yis/ /'byed pa'i ṇa ni byeḥ/ /sa la dulte ga le kṛ twa kṣa ta bee dha sha lā ka ya/ /thur mas mgrin pa la/ /khrag zags (perma ni gtod ⑩byas nas/ /stag mo'i mdun du 'gyel bar gyuratse/ /ā sand+ra tā ṇa sa ra saṃ na hi nā ma ma hātpa rmā/ /sa ha te pa ra sarsā nges par bdag nyid che rnams kyis/ /yid ni snying rjes /rtemanyen pa dag /nye bar bskyabs ⑫la chags pa ka ru ṇa ko ma lo ma na ཿ / / ra ghā bhi lā ṣa ni shi tā ni bcas 4byepas/ /gzhan gyi spyoyongs gdung bzod ma yin/ /de nas g.yo med de yis snying ga ⑩rab tu pa pā ta ta su byā spyo ta taḥpra ta ta bakṣa pi ni: la su/ /ā:rya rgyas pa la/ /stag mo khrag la mngon par 'dod pa rnon pos rab tu mchongs/ /dga' dang 'dzum skyes 95byed644

mārya tsa ri ta mya dza gahphu dzā ta harṣa smi tai ri ba na khaṃ shu bhe rulli khadzñā/ /sen mo'i 'od zer dag gis 'gro ba la/ /'phags pa'i spyod pa'i ngo mtshar rab tu 'bri bar byed pa bzhin/ /me ṭī ba slu li tī kṣa me ṇa ku kṛ hūṃ pra zlo ba tsirnyi tsa yata duḥkhand+raḥbyams pas 'khrul bzhin bzod pas nyes byas bzhin dang shes rab kyis ni bsam tshogs bzhin/ /sdug sa ha bi sla ba j-i ti ri ba kle shaṃ ta pa shrī ri ba / / ta bsngal bzod dka'i bslad pa brtan ①pas bzhin dang nyon mongs dka' thub dpal byus bzhin/ /brtse su byā ghra ba dhū ni pā ta bi ṣa ma hrū rā bhe ghā tolpa ni se he mūnti ra tsañtsa le ba bas de yi ①lus ni snying stobs sa gzhi g.yo ba med pa de nyid kyis/ /stag gi chung mas btab cing mi da ya yā sā sa twa bhū misgo ram̐/ / byā dmā na khā ba li bi lā sa bi bzad drag por mngon 'joms gsal ba'i khur dag bzod/ /stag mo'i 2sder mo 'phreng lgosnaba'i rol pas lu pya sā nā tsakṣeḥdzre lī kṣa ṇa ma lakṣa ta bi kṣa tā gyaḥ/ /re māñtsa rnam par bcom gyur pa/ /de yi snying ga'i khyegazhi ni rnam par nyams pa skad cig mtshon/ /lus ni spu long tsadzre ta ta no stu hi rmā shu shu bhra sa twa pra kā sha ki ra rde ku ra gis byugs bsil zer can ltar dkar ba yisaspyo/ /snying stobs rab gsal 'od zer myu gus khengs par pū ri te ba/ /ta snga mi ṣa ha ra ṇa sho ṇi ta pā na maddhā byā nd+ra sa harṣa gyur pa bzhin/ /sha dag za zhing khrag 'thung stsos par gyur pa'i stag mo ni/ /dga' dang bcas pa mthong ma ba lo kya ya tabya kā ra/ /dispyo pra pā sa sā ma yā ku li tā mu tūrta kakhye nas 'gro ba de yi rang gi srog /'tsho ba dag ni ring du 'gro ba'i dus su bral gyur pa(pe/ /yud tsam zhig ba ladza na dhri ti ni dza dzre ba thratrīḥ/ /treṣṭha pra dakṣi ṇa bi lā sa ga tā na ⑧mgrin pa nyid la brten te brtan par byas/ /sred pa'i rjes mthun rtse dga'i 'od dang 'gro ba dag ga te na ladzdza ba shā di ba z-i shaṃ bi na tā na ṣpe ba/ / ta gyaḥka ro gis ni/ /ngo tsha'i dbang las bzhin ni mchog tu rnam par dud yo7 pa bzhin/ /khyim ⑪ thab las ni phyir 95—645

da pi bi bā ha pa rādru kha gya pā ṇi gra ha pra ṇa yi bee z-i da yotpa ba phyogs gyur kyang de yi lag pa dang ① / /de yis bzung nas mdza' zhing gcugs ltar snying ni dga' bar sā / /modhri ba bee tra ma bi kā ra mu dā ra sahūṃ sau dza n+ya pu rgya ta ṭi nī byas—/ /byams pas dag cing rnam 'gyur med pa rgya che'i snying stobs dang / /lugs bzang bsod nams bhu ba ṣpe 6 tīntiḥ/ /bha byātpa rmā bha ba ti bhuta hi ta swa bhā ba swa dhī chu bo 'jig rten rnams su grags pa dang / /'byung por phan pa'i rang bzhin dman la snying rjes brgyan na dī na ka ru ṇa bha ra rde tsa tse ta ཿ / / ta tta su sa twa pa'i sems/ /rang dbang nyid du gyur pa legs ldan bdag nyid rnams kyi gyeyin/ /stag mo'i sder mo'i ma tu waṃ tsa tu rand+ra rā shi bai khā bi khā sa ra sa nā ba su dhwa pu ra:/ /byā rtse mos bshig pa de yi snying stobs dag /mtshungs pa med pa de mthong 'phral la nor 'dzin bu mo ni/ /rba zhu.āoṃ na khā gra da li ta gya bee lo kya sa ryaḥpā ṇa kṣa ya kṣa ṇa bhi ye ba tsi rlabs rol pa dang ldan chu gter bzhi yi ske ④rags can/ /srog ni zhig pa'i dus na 'jigs ⑤pa bzhin ram̐ñtsa kaspe/ /sa tya bra taḥs ka ru shā ni ra tophoha me ba smṛ tā swa du ring zhig 'dar/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs snying rje khyerab dga' de ni nga nyid do④ / /da lta 'dir ni bṛtta mi ha saṃ pra ti dzā ta hā sa/ /shu two nyi pūttha tsa ri tai ka thi tai dzi ṣpe na sha kraḥrang gi spyod tshul dran nas bzhad gad skyes/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa 'di ni thos gyur nas/ /sa bisma ya ma naḥste mi tā na no bhūtpa/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra pi ra tsi tā ya mtshan yid ldan brgya byin de ni bzhin ras g.yo med kyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang yī bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī rugla ba tā ba dā na me ka pa.āoṃ shaḥchub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser ldan byi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal balla waḥ// //'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //95—646

abee nāsba na ga tophosi balka lī yaḥka ro tya bi ra tai kṛ tārja tsā/ /kairna gang zhig nags song shing shun ldan gyur kyang / /slong rnams rgyun du don byas nyid du byed/ /spyod tsā ru tsa ri ta sa tsabyo te ta su tsinta na ta robyu martse tiḥ/ /bee ha ranta ma tshul mdzes ldan de dang tsan dan gyi/ /ngo mtshar dag ni su yis bsam mi bya/ /de ni ①dka' thub nags thā n+yasmin bha ga bantanta po ba ṣpe/ /sa pratstsha sasmi tai sha kro bismi taḥgazhan na/ /bcom ldan bzhugs shing 'dzum ldan la/ /brgya byen ya mtshan ldan pa yis/ /'dzum pa smi ta kā ra rde/ /thraṣṭaḥpra ṇa yi na te na sabyu snyosta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /asminde nyid kyi rgyu mtshan dris/ /de yis gus pas dris pa'i tshe/ /de la kun mkhyen kyis gsungs pa/ /mig stong she sa ha sra kṣa pudzee thrarghaṃ smṛ lta ma yā/ /ma dhū da kā khye na ga re pu rā su ldan pa gnas 'dir ni/ /sngon byung ba dag bdag gis dran/ /ma dhū 'a7da ka zhes pa yi/ /grong khyer lha ra pa ro pa me/ /a dī na pu rgya nā ma bhū ta bhū pa tispyo ṣa khaṃ bhu baḥ/ /ka ru grong lta bur sngon/ /bsod nams mi dman zhes bya ba'i/ /sa bdag sa yi rgyun zhu du gyur/ /snying rje ṇa mu di to pe kṣa mi ṭī sa sakta tse ta saḥ/ /u pā sedhyā ba tī ba shrīrya dga' dang btang snyoms dang / /byams pa sems la yang dag chags/ /phrag dog can bzhin gang gi sngabee dza na bee shā su/ /ka dā tsitsu ri tai ta su khru tā dza ga ti bi gru dpal—/ /slong ba'i skye bo ④khang par gnas/ /nam zhig de yi spyod pa ni/ /'gro la grags pa thos gyur ta—/ /ta mā ya yo bra hma dattasmra pa tibee dzi gī ṣa yā/ /ta taḥka ri nas—/ /sa yi bdag po tshangs pas byin/ /rgyal bar 'dod pa de can 'ongs ye/ /de nas glang po'i gha ṭwā ba mee rārnyi kṛ ta di ganta raḥ / / tsa kā ra na ga rā ba ddhā tshogs gtams pas/ /phyogs mtshalas dag ni mun par byas/ /de ni rjes su bcing ba'i slad/ /de yi khye ma nu bant+ra ya ta gya sāḥ/ /sa tā nu kasbyi dṛ pa tirna sha tru kṣa ya mitstsha ti/ /grong khyer bcings par ④byas/ /snying stobs brtse ldan mi yi bdag /dgra ni brlag par mi bzhed do/ /95—647

dhyā two ta nirya yurloju ma nushrī bā su madhri ṇaḥ/ /brta mā no ra ṇi tasmin zhes bsams de yi blon po ni/ /ma brjod g.yul la phyi rol 'thon/ /glang po rta dang shing rta rnams/ /ga dza pā dzi ra tha kṣa ye/ /a dī na pu rgyaḥka ru rgya pi pisna sa ma tsinta rlag byed g.yul ni rgyas pa der/ /bsod nams mi dman snying rje yis/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa ①yang dag ya ta/ /bi ṣa maḥkṣa tra dhasthā ya ma dhand+ra sha ta sasmi taḥ/ /yasmin pā bsams—/ /mi zad khurgyal rigs ④chos 'di ni/ /chos min brgya phrag dag dang ldan/ /ma rungs srog ṇi ba dha kroryabhazla i tya rnyi dhī ya te/ /dhighahma ru bye rā dibhi kṣa tri yā chags gsod /dnghapa ni/ /gang du chos zhes ma nor ⑤brjod/ /khrag gis bsgos shing dri ma can/ /rgyal rde ma lbo ma yi/ /kṛ te ya gya pra yahpho ya tasnro bi ta ma shā shwa tai/ /rigs rnams kyi chos 'di smad/ /gang gi ched du rab 'bad pa'i/ /'tsho ba de yang rtag pa min/ /sā pā ya gya bya pa na pa ra ṇi shirya mā ṇa sru ni bye duḥkhosgo baiḥpra ti ha ta bde nyung blo ⑥yis bzod bya 'di ni skyes bu rnams kyi nyon mongs smin/ /gnod pa dang bcas gdung ba'i dhri teḥsma rya mā ṇa gya pabhā ta/ /so yi sa khyaḥsu kha la ba dhi yā gre sha sā lam du rtag tu nyes ⑦pa nyid gyur cing / /phyi nas dran pas sdug bsngal shugs rings dag gis brtan pa ka gya sum̐ sī sgo ga gyaze ba ta ba ta pa ra pā ṇa ho sā pra yatnaḥ/ /tasmra di 'joms byed pa/ /longs spyod don du kyi hud kyi hud gzhan srog 'tshe la rab tu 'bad/ /de slad 'tshe rda pa ri tya bye ho sā : pā pa ni ki ta na/ / tshe chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyi skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/ a dharma bā hu rā dzre yam̐ dang sdig pa'i gnas/ /chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid 'di/ /yongs su btang la bdag nyid ni/ /ta pa sristha na ga mya na/ /rā dzñā ma dzñā na mū ṭwā nāsba dha banta na sha dka' thub nags su 'gro bar bya/ /rgyal po mi shes rmongs rnams kyis/ /gsod ⑧dang 'ching ba brgyas tārdzi tī/ /kā laḥ ka pa la ya hye ba lasmri ma kṣi ṇi kilbi ྾/ /a bsgrubs pa'i/ /sdig pa mi bzad dpal 'byor ni/ /dus kyis khams su yo)byed pa nyid/ /'khor bar 95—648

tsintuḥsaṃ sā re ba hu la ta ra mo hā ha ta bye yo sbi ri rā shā brnyibi ṣa ya su kha dus min dag tu bsam yas dus ni stobs dang ldan pa 'dis/ /skyes bu so so dag la bskal ①pa'i mtha' dzā lo ka la ya tsā/ /a kā le kasprarnyi pra ti pu ru ṣa me ṣa pra ti di shaza ni so sor ster byed cing / /shin tu che ba'i rmongs pas blo bcom re ba'i 'ching ba brtan po yis/ /yul lī kā laḥsum̐ sbo ki la bi la se tai saṃ ka la ya ti/ /i ti saṃ tsint+ra dṛ pa tiptagyi bde ba'i tshogs la sems byed skyes bu rnams kyi rtse dga' 'joms/ /zhes pa bsams nas mi bdag ni/ /sā sa pa dzā mu khaḥ/ / daṇḍa babee la mā dā ya ya yo ni shi ta po 'tshe ba'i nyon mongs las phyir phyogs/ /dbyug pa shing shun bzung nas ni/ /mtshan mo dka' thub nags ba āoṃ/ /ta tastaṅga ma āoṃ khru tā lo ke pratshwa rya madhri ṇaḥ/ /yu dhya mā na ma su song / /de nas blon po g.yul zhugs pas/ /de ni song ba thos gyur nas/ /'jig rten la bsgribs do da gra ri sum̐ gardzanta mū tsi re/ /ga te na matta mā tai ga ma kṛ thā ga la dgra bo ni/ /sgra sgrogs rgyags pas 'char dzul smras/ /nags su glang chen stsos pa dag /drag po'i sgra ni gardzi tai/ /gha na shasda kṛ tā kṣurnyi ni ba sa tya tra ke sha rī/ /i ti bru bā ma sgrogs shig /'dir ni seng ge sprin gyi sgra/ /bzod pa min pa rnam par gnas/ /zhes smra brtan pa de zlaḥs ma re dhī rā yu yu bye re pa ram̐/ /te gha na swā mi sadmā na sand+ra ha tstshanda bi dag gis/ /rje la khye bya dga' stug po dang / /go chas lus ni rab g.yogs te/ /g.yul du g.yul ni gra hāḥ/ /a tādhe ra ko sha le 6 krāhma ṇaḥka pi khā bhe dhaḥ/ /hi ra sgo band+ra rja rab tu bskrad④/ /skabs der ko sa la dag tu/ /bram ze ser skya zhes bya ba/ /rgyal po dbyig gi go cha rā dzñā dha na daṇḍi na rpā ḍi teḥ/ /bandha nā gā ra bi nasta sa mabee su ta yisa'atsho —/ /nor kyi chad pas gzir bar gyur/ /ma lus nor byin dbul ba las(khye/ /mang po byin (dzwab nta baḥ/ /daṭwā she ṣa dha no bhū rī dā ri rgyadī tu ma kṣa maḥ/ /par mi bzod pa/ /bu dang gnyen rnams mtha' dag ni/ /btson kye khang nang du rnam par bkod/ /95—649

raḥ—/ /ta taḥs sha na kaiḥpā su pu ro pānta ta so ba āoṃ/ /da dand+ra chas(7—/ /de nas de yis ⑪dal bu yis/ /grong mtha' 1 dka' thub nags su phyin/ /mi bdag shing dhwa pa ri shāntaḥsaṃ bī tai babee lodṛ paṃ/ /na ra nā tho pi tai dṛṭī kyu྾ los yongs dkris (5pa/ /lam gyis ⑤yongs su dub pas mthong / /bkres skom ngal bas gzir ba de/ /pā shā mā tu ram̐/ /sa dṛsgo ka ru ṇa senturdu dru ga ma nā kā ra rte/ /mi bdag gis kyang mthong gyur nas/ /snying rje'i rgya mtshos ring po nas/ /'ong ba yi ni rgyu mtshan dris/ /sa tasmi ni dza bṛttanta muṣa shā ni shā sa sru tsi tai/ /ni bee rya bantu saṃ ro dha de la de yis rang gi spyod/ /shugs rings tsha bas gsal byas pa/ /bshad nas gnyen rnams bcings pa duḥ khārta pu na ra bra bī ta / /ā yā to haṃ ha ri sgyu dhī ba ntu ba rnya yi—/ /sdug bsngal gyis gzir slar yang bshad/ /gnyen ni bcings pa dgrol ba'i beed/ /mi bdag na mukta ye/ /ā bṛ na pu bye dṛ pa ti drikhye mabee su ra dru me/ /slong ba ⑨lha yi shing / /bsod nams mi dman blta ⑦ba la/ /gser don gnyer ba bdag 'ongs so/ /lo ka nā thaḥs me shrī mān ka ru rja puṇḍi mā na saḥ/ /sa ryaḥsandarsha thugs ni snying rje dārdzogs gyur pa/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po de/ /mthong ba nyid kyis ⑨'phral ṣpe nai saṃ kadzee pū ra yi 6 ti/ /asmra rgo gre sha saṃ tā bai ra ba mā ṣpe ra la ni/ /bdag gi brnag pa rdzogs par gyur/ /nyon mongs gdung bas ⑩nyams mi byed/ /smad pa yis dru ṣi ta/ /a parlu ṣi ta kā lawaṃ pha lo sru te ma hā dza naḥ/ /da ra dru ni sun mi 'byin/ /dus ni rnying nyu1pa ma yin par/ /skye bo chen po 'bras bu bskyedaspe5/ /skye rgu ⑫rnams tī bra ti mi rā sa ha rakru dzā ram̐ tī tī pra kā sha bi bha bai ཿ pa ri kyi dbul ba'i rab rib mi bzad 'phrog byed cing / /grags pa rab tu gsal ba'i 'byor pas phyogs pū ri tā shāḥ/ /a byulla saji ma la mā na sa harṣa bantu stu saṃ ha ri rnams yongs su 'gengs/ /dri med yid ni mngon par rengs ⑫byed dga' ba dag gi gnyen/ /sa spyo yi 95—652

6 ti sa me ba su ṅgā su dzñā shuḥ/ /khru te ti te na kā thi hūṃ bya dhi taḥpre bdud rtsi'i zer des bdag gi gdung ba 'phrog par 'gyur/ /zhes pa de yis bshad thos nas/ /sa yi thi dī pa ti/ /saṃ krānta nispra ti ka ra saṃ tā paḥs ma tsinta yata/ /bdag po gzir bar gyur/ /bcos thabs med pa'i gdung ba dag /'phos pa yis ni yang dag bsams/ /a hophonu tyakta rā byephoha ma kā le smidhī dzadma nā/ / tsinta taḥkṣutpa kye ma bdag gis stirgyal srid btang / /dus min 'dir ni gnyis skyes kyis/ /bsams te bkres pas rī te na shushī bṛkṣa i bā dhwa ni/ /dru rā dhwa shra ma bee pha lya santa pa pra nyen pa las kye/ /lam gyi shing ni skam po bzhin/ /slong ba rnams la lam ring gis①/ /ngal ba 'bras ④da mabee dzā/ /saṃ mo ha dza na dzee dhidhī mṛ ga treṣṭha dza lo pa oṃ/ /mu khāthra med gdung ba ster⑤/ /ri dwags sred skyed khwa7chu lta bu/ /rmongs pa skyed byed bdag smad do/ /kha la rdo pā tā tu bye na mūr khyu tā nā mi bābee rmā/ /ā shā rghaṃ ge na gu ru hūṃ bsnun mtshungs pa yis/ /brgyal bar gyur pazhin don gnyer rnams/ /re ba nyams pas lam du ni/ /pra yā tya dhwa pa ri shra maḥ/ /a haṃ sa rā dzā sant+rakta rā byeḥkā na na shri taḥ/ /yongs ngal lci ba nyid du gyur④/ /rgyal po de ni bdag yin te/ /rgyal srid btang nas nags tshal bsten/ /i ti khru tī pa bi pro yo sa ryast+ya dza ti dzre bi tai/ /rā dzadhwa mbi mi to ga tā zhes 2pa thos nas bram ze 'di/ /'phral la srog ni gtong bar 'gyur/ /'di nas rgyal po'i gnas phyin mā ma pra su bi tsirnyi tai/ /ki ka ri 6 ti saddhā pā da yo bhasna ma no ra te / /bsam ⑨pa dag ni ma thob natubye / /yid la re ba nyams pa 'di/ /gdung bas ci zhig byed par thaḥ—/ /dzre ba bye kaḥki la sa ku sha li kle sha kā le na rā hūṃ shā bhya—tta 'gyur—/ /slong rnams phyir zlog ⑫bzhin legs khyastetsha ba'i shugs rings khyestedag gis gdung byed cing / /sgu ra nyi sa ha sā yaḥpa ri tā ṇa ba nt+raḥ/ / pra tyā khyu nādma li na kun tu rtogs ⑨pas lus dman chung ngur byas shing gang las mi 'gro ba/ /nyon mongs dus su mi rnams 95—653

ba da nastabee bi shā sa shu 6ta saṃ kasprasthā kṛ ta na ta ta nurlu ti yāsmranda sems la 'phral la rab tu gsal ba gang / /dge ldan yongs su skyob gnyen bsngags 'os gcig pu de nyid tsārji / /byestsadma kṣu ra sesgoḥpa thi ka dza na thra thudzñā sa ni rdagha bṛdhe stu pa 'tsho ba yin/ /rang nyid rab bsrungs gdung ba'i nyams myong shes shing ri byi'i lto ba'i phug tu blugs byas yo lha bee bra dzā nā ha ra ti ra bee ṣa rma tī bra tre : sa te / /smin byed me yis nywa rab tu gdung ba'i byed pas khyab cing 'tshed pa'i bya ba yongs su 'dris gyur mutthaḥ / /dzñā tā swā do pya gasto da ra ku ha ra lu ṭhadzdza ṭha raghi pra tā pa byā pā ra kyang / /slong ba'i tshogs kyi sred pa drag pos bskyed pa'i mi bzad gdung ba 'phrog pa min pa gang / /byā gya ma na kwa tha na pa ri tsi ta swa pra mā tha bya thā rmā / / i skye bo 'gon 27po'i shugs rings che ba 4bskol zhing 'phel bar 'gyur byed rgya mtsho'i skye ba smad/ /de ti saṃ tsirgyu dṛ pa nyiphokṛ tā ti byaḥpha waṃ bu nā/ /ta mu bā tsā bri yā khya na dhī ta ltar skad cig bsams byas nas/ /chu dang 'bras bu snyemagron byas te/ /mi snyan smra bas 'jigs 'jigs dī ta i bākṣa ṇa / / bra hma nda dī na pu byopho haṃ rā dza sha tru ba bye bzhin—/ /mi yi bdag pos de la smras/ /bsod nams mi dman rgyal po dang ⑥/ /bram ze dgra gsod ⑦rya me/ /ho sā bi raktaḥsaṃ tya bye rā rdzu bi dza na mā shri taḥ/ /ho sā sbyor ba'i tshe/ /'tshe 87las chags bral rgyal srid ni/ /yongs su btang nas dben pa bsten/ /sa skyong pha la ma tī pā la sgo shaṃ bhū dzha ga rghaṃ gu re/ /pra tya gra ru bye rā dirghaṃ kra byā longs spyod 'tshe ba'i 'bras/ /thran 'khyog lta bur mi brtan pasgo9 / /gsar pa'i khrag gis sbags pa ni/ /da i ba ghu ñdza te / /ki ka rudza pa da sgo ha ma kā le twa mu sā ga srin po bzhin du longs spyod byed/ /gnas min 'dug des 3— ci zhig bya⑪/ /khyod ni dus min nye bar taḥ / /yantu sha kyi ma yā ki tsinta da yo tho ta mu tsu tsā/ /i ti rā dza ba tsa 'ongs—/ /cung zad bdag gis nus pa gang / /de ni bsdams pa med par brjod/ /ces pa rgyal po'i 95—654

na ka thi no da ti bi sma ye na / / ha rṣa smṛ sha ཿ ki ma pi nā ka spyod tshul sems dpa' rab 'bar thos nas ya mtshan rgyas pa yis/ /dga' bas reg par gyur pa mtho pa terba bhū ba ro mā tsa pa tra ra tsa nā ru tsi re sha ri ram̐/ /i ti ris bdag po'i lus la ni/ /spu long 'dab ma mdzes pas spras pa ci yang byung bar gyur/ /zhes ①/pa dge kṣe mend+ra bee ra tsi tā yī bo dhī sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yā ma dī na ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bsod pu sgyu ba dā na dā padzi shaḥpalla waḥ// //nams 5mi dman pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //suttaḥkaṇḍa bi brta nā gu ru na ti mo lo shu tra sho tra yoḥs bye ni tya ma nā ma legs bshad mgrin par rnam gnas bla ma la 'dud mgo dang rna bar thos pa dang / /zhal ni rtag tu yo tsa ba da ṣpe bibospriyo bhū ṣa rde/ /rasgo dā ra su bhā ra hā ra ra tsa nā skyon med bden pa dang ldan mkhas pa rnams ni dga' ba'i rgyan/ /rin chen yid 'ong rab gsal do shal tsi tre ṇa dhabhe ta ram̐ sadho ṣe sa bi she ṣa be ṣa ba ni ta be she na she bkod pa bkra ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa/ /chas ldan bud med chas kyis snyeskye bo lhag ma rnams ni mchog kho dza naḥ/ /sha kra rja n+ya tra bha ga bān sa smi taḥsmi ta kā ra khaṃ/ /thraṣṭasta tu tshim pa skyed47/ /gzhan du bcom ldan 'dzum ldan pa/ /brgya byin bsam pa shes pa yis/ /'dzum dā sha ya zlo na saza dzhaḥpu na ra bra bīta/ /su bhā ṣi ta ga be ྾ pa'i rgyu ni dris pa na'e/ /thams cad mkhyen pas yang gsungs pa/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑥ mi yi bdag /ti bā rā ṇa snga ma bhūj-i paḥ/ /ya gya dzā tru dzā la tīrbhe mā le ba bi ba legs bshad 'tshol khyab zhes pa byung / /gang gi 'a7grags pa dri med rigs/ /dpal gyi 'phreng ⑨ba rbha shri yaḥ/ /su thraste gu ṇa se yuste z-i di saste bi bee tī rmā/ /a bzhin du mdzes/ /yon tan skud ldan legs spyod zlum/ /dben ldan rnams kyi snying la chags/ /mu 95—658

bhūd bhu ṣa ṇa a bārji yaḥsruste na tu motta ke/ /ni tya mabee 6 muṭwā tig ma yin lku legs bshad kyi/ /rgyan nyid gang zhig don gnyer gyur/ /gang gi snemadzod dpal slong pi ko sha shrīrya gya nibya lā/ /tīrbhe gu rja ni ba ddhā pi dru rād dru ra rnams la/ /rtag tu btang yang g.yo ba med/ /grags pa yon tan la btags — 7kyang / /ring las shin ta re ga tāḥ/ /sa rā dzā haṃ sa pa ri dṛ taḥ ka bi ba riḥs dā/ /tu ring bar 'gro/ /rgyal po'i ngang pa'i (gyesnyan ngag mkhan/ /nyams ldan mchog gis rtag bskor te/ /bi dma tpa bhā ka ma li mbi sgo ga sau bhā gya na bhū ta / / u pa de sha mkhas pa'i mdun sa pad ldan la/ /longs spyod skal bzang ldan par gyur/ /nye bar bstan la rab pra britta gya sa gu shāsta gya srukta yaḥ/ /dza na gya mo ha ti mi ra dza hrudwo pa shi khā i zhugs pa/ /de yi legs bshad yon tan can/ /mar me'i rtse mo lta bu yis/ /skye bo rmongs pa'i rab rib ba / /sa ka dā tsitpa bhā sī naḥsu bhā ṣi ta ka tsā ta re/ /su ma phrogs—/ /nam zhig mdun sar blo bzang de/ /'dug pas legs bshad gtam gye ni/ /mjug tu blo tiḥsu ma nyi nā ma pra dhwa nā mā tya ma pra bīta/ /sā dhu shasda pa dā rū dzhairgu shā lam̐ bzang zhes pa yi/ /blon po'i gtso la rab smras pa/ /legs pa'i sgra dang tshig la zhon/ /yon tan rgyan ka rā shā li bheḥ/ /sa bhā bha bedzharbha hye ṣā bha ra tī ba su bhā ṣi taiḥ/ /dang yang dag ldan/ /khyed rnams dag gi legs bshad kyis/ /mdun sa 'di ni 5bkang bzhin mdzes/ /a gyañtsiṣṭa ni satyā ka ra sa brnyi na bā ni tsa/ /su bhā ṣi tā ni bha ba legs par smin zhing 9thuro dang ldan/ /legs par bshad pa gsar pa ni/ /me tog lta bu 'ga' zhig ni/ /tā ku su mā byā ba ka ni tsita/ /sruspri rghaṃ pra ti bhā nāñtsa mañdza rī rde tsa dzrembha khyod ()7kyis rnyed par gyur tam ci/ /legs bshad rnams dang mthun kye7rnams dang / /dog pa rnams kyang tai / /na ba me ba ma no hā ri nā rī rja mi ba yo ba dzwa/ /sa ra sa rgyas pa ni/ /gsar pa kho na yid 'phrog ste/ /bud med rnams kyi lang tsho bzhin/ /ro dang ldan yang 95—659

su bhā ṣi tai/ /shu te tya mā tya gya ba tsaḥkṣi tī shaḥs tai sa mudṛ bye bi thra bye yis legs bshad blangs/ /zhes pa blon po'i tshig thos sa bdag gis/ /mdun sa pa bkye mdun sa rab sa tyan/ /antaḥpu ram̐ gupta mu pe tya rū paṃ tsa kā ra sa mā n+ya dza nā nu rū ṭī/ /btang nas/ /sbas pa'i gzugs kyis pho brang 'khor song ste/ /thun mong skye bo'i rjes su mthun par byas/ /pa raspa ram̐ shu pra ti badha tā ram̐ bi sthā ra tā rā ni ka rā bye rā oṃ/ /hā re skar tshogs rgyas pa lta bur mngon dga' zhing / /phan tshun 'od zer rab tu gsal byed pa'i/ /do shal pa mā da ya su bhā ṣi tābeetstsha yā dri tī yaḥs ya yo ba nārnyi/ /sa ta bzung nas legs bshad don gnyer de/ /grib ma gnyis pa dang bcas nags mthar song / /de 41ni tra bā khā ni la tīrṇa pu྾ dṛkṣeḥkṛ tā ti thu i bā ba na mreḥ/ /a mbi nges par dud pa'i shing rnams kyis/ /me tog rlung gzhon 'a7gyis bkram mgron byas bzhin/ /de yis 6 yatna ta mṛ ga yā pra sarghaṃ gi resta be lubha ka mā sa sā da/ /tsā me na bā 'bad pas btsal bas rngon spyopa ni/ /rngon ④la rab chags ri yi ngos su rnyed/ /glang po rnams kyis bde oṃ ka ri rde su khā rmā bai badhya dīkṣu ra si ka mṛ gi rde/ /ba kra kra ma spyu ra ta ba'i mi mthun phyogs/ /ri dwags rnams la yug sas 'debs byed mkhas/ /'khyog ka7po'i rim pa bzhin re ka re ṇa tsā paṃ swa tsisto pa ma muddhā ha ste/ /ba bye ka da kṣe ṇa ba du ⑥ma rungs gzhu/ /rang sems lta bu lag pa g.yon pas 'dzin/ /rtag tu nags na gnas pa'i mi dakṣi ṇi na na kau ka sī ni tya ma dakṣi ṇa na/ /haste na bi n+yasta sa mabee haste mthun phyogs/ /gsod pa gcig pu la mkhas lag g.yas kyis/ /lag ldan sde rnams mtha' dag byang grol baṭwā pa brga bi shi khaṃ da dhwa rna/ /mā yu ra pakṣe ra ni nā ba te mā ta ram̐ la—/ /rnam par 'god pa'i mda' ni rab tu 'dzin/ /rtse mo rlung gis dal gyis bskyod pa yi/ /rma bya'i gi tā girbi hi totta ri yo/ /ṣpe tredzra gī rde pa ti dzre ba rahūṃ saṃ tā sa lo le ri sgo yi spyostod g.yogs bsgrubs gyur pa/ /skrag pa 'a7g.yo ba ri dwags rnams kyi mig /bdag po ⑨'tsho ba 95—663
