bye67/ /de la chos ni ci zhig shaḥ / /ma yi pā rā ba tyā spru tyā na dwo ṣa kartu marta se/ /na hi kā ra ṇa rā ge 'dra—/ /phug ron la ni byams pa yis/ /bdag la zhe sdang bya mi 'os/ /gang phyir khyod nyid lta bu ni/ /95—674

ṇa pra brtarnye bha bdwo joḥ/ /ya dzee bā yo ta dzee bā haṃ ko bi she khasta bā ba yoḥ/ /sgyu ldan chags pas 'jug pa min/ /ji ltar 'di nyid de bzhin bdag /khyed stil nged gnyis bye brag ci/ /sarba bhū ta sa maḥsantaḥkṛ sārja ka tpa kuttha te/ /i truste te na dṛ pa tidhī dam pa 'byung po kun la snyoms/ /gcig la brtse ba byed pa min/ /des 'di smras tshe mi bdag gi /dzwa ka ka na rā bī rja/ /ṣpe bha ta bya mi tī bā ha kha gi pratstsha rya pā ṇi lag pa gdub ①bu'i sgra ldan pas/ /'jigs par mi bya zhes smra bzhin/ /bya ni phyag gis rab bsgribs (1 nā—/ /sa ta taḥsnagha dzī rū ta sgo ṣa gaspyo ra ya mi ba/ /u bā tsa saza te—/ /de nas sems can gzir ba kun/ /yongs bskyab dus ni byas pa yisti/ /char sprin 'jam pa'i satātrī pa ri tā ṇa kṛ ta kṣa ṇaḥ/ /ma kṛ thaḥkṣa ṇa dṛ st+yadhī bee ṣa rma sgra dbyangs ltar/ /zab pa'i tshig gis rab smras pa/ /skad cig tshim pa don gnyer bas/ /mi bzad pā ṇi bai sha ma/ /tu mya bya thā bi kā ro yo pā ṇa sne haḥsha rī ri rghaṃ/ /srog chags gsod ma ⑤byed/ /lus can srog la chags pa yi/ /gdung ba'i rnam 'gyur mtshungs pa nyid/ /pa ra sru shā pa ha re ṇa yā dṛtiḥpa ri kasbya te/ /ni bṛkṣiṃḥgre ya sī ma gzhan gyi srog ni phrogs pa yis/ /gang zhig yongs su 'tsho byed pa/ /de yi dge legs ldog 'gyur te/ /nyi pā pa tā paṃ pra yatstsha te/ /a dhu nai wā pa ristsodzre ni dzetstsha sasma tā da re/ /gang phyir sdig pa'i gdung ba ster/ /da lta nyid du ma chad par/ /rang 'dod yang dag bzhed cing gus/ /kṛ khya tā ma sha rna yaryadma daza mu pa kalpi tai/ /khru te nyi rā dza ba tsa dzwa bdag gi ⑥ don du zas gang gang / /nye bar bsgrubs pa blang bar mdzod/ /ces pa rgyal po'i tshig thos pa ri rla nā na nāḥ shwa pa na / / ba ro ba bye ga bi ma nāḥ pra tya nas—/ /yongs su bzhin log shugs rings can/ /longs spyod mchog la yid byung ba'i/ /rngon pas bhā ṣa ta lubha kaḥ/ /na pa yo rā dza sgo gā rmā ra sā dzñā ba na bā se naḥ/ /lan ni rab smras pa/ /bdag cag nags na gnas rnams kyis/ /rgyal po'i longs spyod ro mi shes/ /95—675

na hi sha snga sha na nāsthā sā mo dadhe mo da kai mṛ gāḥ/ /a laddhā niju tram̐ ma 'bru zas nyams su ma stsong ba'i/ /ri dwags la dus dga' ma yin/ /tsher ma'i 'khri shing 'dab med mya ru pa ri tsi tsā kaspyo ka la tsā ba ṣpe sdisnya shā me ki ma pi ka ra bhaḥshu 6 ti shu ngan dag la yongs 'dris ma thob nas/ /nags tshal ljang zhing snum par khyernga mo mya ngan dag gis ci yang tsā—/ /na kā kaḥsatyā shaṃ ka ba la ya ti tsū tai bi ṣṭha/ mi ba swa bhā bā dzñā bhe skam—/ /tsū (27ta rab smin dug bzhin bya rog gis ni za bar mi byed de/ /rang bzhin dag gi ①dbye bas dā du tsi ta mi ha sattha su su kha rda/ /rā dzārta sgo gi bhughā rya zwa tasnyokta smi ki pu 'os pa 'dir ni kun la bde ba sterang/ /rgyal la 'os zas ding zos nas/ /nang par slar yang bdag ci naḥ / /tadhaste su kha mā dhadhe ya da n+ya byu na durla rghaṃ/ /ra so dā rā za—/ /gang zhig nyin gzhan rnyed dka' min/ /de dag zos na bde ba skyed⑤/ /rgya che ro ldan kha zas ha re na hi pa ri tsi tashā ti bi ra sanda tiṣṭha bye kā tī ba hu pa ri dza nā ram̐ bha yongs 'dris ro dang bral ba zad snyemi byed/ /'khor gye rtsom pa mang por lhung ⑦ rnams gcig pu nyid du ba ti tai/ /ra thā ru bhāḥpabhyo ma ma na sa ma ye sho tsa ti ta rā ma bābhārba bye gnas mi byed/ /shing rta zhon pa rkang pas 'gro ba'i dus na shin tu mya ngan byed/ /don thob nyams na mi shaḥka ṣa ti bi ṣa ma kle sha pa ru ṣaḥ/ /de ba twadṛ ṭwā dṛṭwā rmā sa ta tai bzad nyon mongs rtsub mor byeshin tu gdung bar byed/ /lha gadrug rmyergyal po la 'os zas/ /khrod kyi spyan bee ba durlu dzha/ /rā dzārta sgo dza rna ki tu dzadma pūrde na me pri yo/ /gyis gzigs rnams la/ /rtag tu rnyed dka' min mod kyang / /skye bar sngon med bdag mi dga'/ /mṛ ga yā bhi ha tai mādmā masthā kai dzī bi tā ya te/ /tagrwa de ha sa mu྾trī rngon pas mngon par bsad pa'i sha /bdag cag rnams kyi srog ltar spyod/ /des na rang lus rab chod la/ /kha shaṃ dī gu ṇa marbha tsā/ / tsitta ba ṣaṇḍaḥshu tī tarbe tsa rgo sa ha sā dṛ bya yi nyis ⑫'gyur sbyin par mdzod/ /mi bdag bsam pa 'khrugs pa yis/ /tshig de thos nas 'phral la 95—676

paḥ / /pra harṣahphulla na ya rmā sgo ru hasta ma bhā ṣa taḥ/ /kha ga gya ta ba tsa pā ni—/ /dga' bas spyan gyi chu skyes dag /rab tu rgyas pas de la smras/ /bya dang khyod kyi srog dag ni/ /zla rakṣu ma tu lya saṃ sha yi/ /ma mo pa diṭwāḥspasgo ya mu pā yaḥsu dhi yā twa bsrung slad mtshungs pa'i the tshom la/ /blo bzang khyod kyi thabs 'di ni/ /gsal bar bdag la nye bar yā—/ /u bha ya pā ṇa sande ha do lā ro ha ṇa bi hwa lo/ /twa ma ba j-i ti bstan—/ /gnyis ka'i srog la the tshom byisahu/ /khyogs la zhon pas 'khrugs gyur pa/ /bdag gi yid ni mā nī tai ba ya gye ṣpe ba me ma naḥ/ /twa dhriṣṭi pā sha ba sgo yo bi ha grogs kyis bzhin/ /khyod nyid kyis ni brtan par byas/ /khyod kyi 27mig zhags kyis bcings pa'i bya gaḥpra ti mu tsu hūṃ/ /madma meeḥkṛ ya tsā tā batro saṃ pra ti pā ṇa dhwa ra rde/ /'di rab tu gtang bar mdzod/ /da lta nyid du bdag gis 1shis/ /re zhig srog gi gzungs thag mdzod/ /rā dzñā sa tya pra ti zlo na ka ru rgya di byu dī ri nyiḥ/ /a mā tyā mu mu humbi ddhā rgyal po dam bcas 'den ④pa yis/ /snying rje las ni 'di brjod tshe/ /dug ldan mda' yis phug pa bee ṣa dighiḥsha ri ri ba/ /na dā nā ba sa re bā hye sa ci baidzre nyi tā nyi bzhin—/ /blon po rnams ni rmongs par gyur/ /sbyin pa'i skabs su phan mi phan/ /grogs kyis bdag la tā hi tai/ /i tya khyutpa ma yasta gya sha rī ra tyā ga ni: yaḥ/ /a tha bra bīnda brjod mi bya/ /zhes pa de yi dam tshig gis/ /lus ni gtong bar nges par gyur/ /de nas mi bdag ra pa ti stasmi pitrī pra yatstsha taḥ/ /tu lya mā ro pa ya nyi me rmā sa muthoṣṭha gis smras pa/ /gang zhig bdag gi lus las sha /bcad nas srang la ⑤'debs byed pa/ /de la nor ni yasta noḥ/ /hi ra sgo babhā ṇa rā dzñā sa mā tū tāsta to dza naḥ/ /ku kahma rab tu sbyin⑥/ /de nas rgyal po gser gyi char/ /'bebs klapas bos pa'i skye bo rnams/ /ngan pa'i ku ṇi ta bye yaḥpi dhwa ya shra ba ṇi ya yuḥ/ /e ka stu dā ru ṇa ma tir na: las kyi blo rmus phyin/ /rna ba bsgribs shing song bar gyur/ /gdug pa'i blo zhes bya ba gcig /ser skya'i 95—677

ka pi la dzi ga laḥ/ /a bhuṅka na ka mā dā ya sanda dheḥkru ra karma ṇiḥ/ /sa mig ni ser po yis/ /gser dag blangs nas gdug pa yi/ /las la chas su zhugs par gyur/ /gdug ra lahrī dā dakṣu rde ba krā rde tsa ni sarga taḥ/ /kra kā tsā nā mi ba kroṭwā ta pa'i las ni sog le bzhin/ /drang po gcod la mkhas gyur cing / /rang bzhin gyis ni 'khyog ① pa yi/ /ki ma kṛ hye du rādma dzā/ /na shast+ri shashrī yaju da 'a snye ti taṅge li pa tsa sā gdug pa'i bdag nyid ci mi byed/ /gang gi 37mtshon kyis mi nus de dag kyal ka'i tshig gis 'joms par na sha kyi ya dma hūṃ ki ma pi ku ru te ta tstsha sa ha sā/ / na sha kyi byed—/ /gang zhig brjod par mi nus ci yang de dag 'phral la sgrub ⑦par byed/ /gang zhig bya bar mi kaju yatta da pi kā la ya bye ba ma na sā kha laḥsathrubyaṅgi ki ra ti tsa ri tai nus de dag kyang ni yid kyis sems par byed/ /ma bsdams glang (chopo dag gi ⑤spyod pas ngo mtshar thams ra pra ti ha taḥ/ /sa pā rā ba ta mā ro pya tu khā ma tha ma hi pa tiḥ/ /dakṣi cad rgyas par byed/ /de nas de yis phug ron ni/ /srang la gzhal nas sa bdag gis⑥/ /byin pa ḍo rka sa muskṛ rghaṃ mābee tabhu lya mā da dhe/ / pra tha me ra tha bhū bhartuḥgayas pa'i sha dag ni/ /rab bcad de dang mtshungs par bkod/ /de nas sa yi bdag po yi⑦/ /khrag smṛṣṭa ru bye ra bind+ra bhiḥ/ /bizlaṇḍi mā nā su tsi re bi hwa le bā bha badma tī/ /zigs dang po reg pa yithu/ /'khrugs pa bzhin du sa gzhi ni/ /yun ring rnam par g.yos par gyur/ /pā rā ba te tha gu ru tsā mādzre tsa la ghu tsā ga te/ /dī ya tā mā n+ya duskṛṣṭha rmā sa de nas phug ron phyi ba dang / /sha ni yang ba nyid gyur tshe/ /sha ni gzhan dag rab chod la/ /byin zhes mi tyā ha byu pa tiḥ/ /kṛsto ru bhu dza rmā se bi na pāste kha gi tu bee hūṃ/ /sa yi bdag pos smras/ /brla dang dpung pa'i sha bcad kyang / /bya dang mtshungs pa nyid ma gyur/ /tre lo kya saṃ sha ya tu lā mā ru ro ha tu khādṛ pa taḥ/ /dzre pa to swa ya 'jig rten gyi ni the tshom dang / /mtshungs pa'i sang (sgo7 der mi bdag bzhugs⑩/ /mi bdag chu rgyus lhag 95—678

ma rū snye rtswa yu she ṣa ta kau tu dzee/ / ta tyā gā durga hoji ghā ya yo ma'i lus/ /rang nyid srang la 'dzegs pa'i tshe/ /de yi gtong ba bzung gyodaka' bas/ /yid byung tīrtardi garnya ram̐/ / tasmin kṣa ṇi kṣi ti pa te ra pa ri kṣa te nā bye bye grags pa phyogs mtshams khrusong / /de yi dus na sa yi bdag po dag gi brtan pa 'di sna/ /nyams pa med ṇa bisma ya ma yaste da shaṃ ga nā dzñā/ /masmabee mā lya pa ri pū ri ta pā ṇi padmaḥpas ya mtshan gyur pa'i lha yi bu mo rnams/ /gtsug phud 'phreng (dnghabar 'os pa'i padmos yongs gang lag pa pū dzā da raḥki ma pi tatstsha ri tā ba bhū baḥ/ /nimbi kā ram̐ sa mā lokya yis—/ /de yi stispyod tshul dag la mchod pa'i gus pa ci yang byung / /rnam 'gyur med par sa yi bdag /tu la rū zwa ma tī pa ti/ /spyu ra kā rī sa pa pratstsha pu ru ṣa ste sa sā yā saḥ/ /a srang la 'dzegs pa mthong gyur nas/ /skyes bu gdug pa byed pa po/ /skrag bcas 6de yis de la dris/ /lus ṣpe na de ha dā ṣpe na na dzā ṣpe ki ta pebee ti/ /sazla khā bha sa ma re bha sha rī rārja kyi sbyin pa 'di yis ni/ /khyod ni ci bzhed yongs 1mi shes/ /gang phyir lus can rnyed pa kun/ /yang dag hi de hi ram̐/ /sa bye bru hi ta nu tyā ge tsirghaṃ ya di na khaṇḍi tai/ /i ti rtsom pa lus kyi don/ /gal te lus ni btang la sems/ /nyams pa med dam bden par smras/ /zhes smras 8snabru bā rde haṃ rā dzā ba bhā ṣe sa smi tā na naḥ/ /na pā pya maste me kiñtsita lo kesmisko de la rgyal po ni/ /bzhin 'dzum ldan pas rab smras pa/ /'jig rten 'di na thob bya ni/ /bdag la ci yang twa nu tatta dzā/ /hi tā ya sarba dza ga hūṃ samyahūṃ bo bye marja ye/ /a khaṇḍi ta med mod kyi⑨/ /'gro ba kun la phan pa'i slad/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /gal te bdag gi mi rda tsitta ya di sa bye na te na me/ /astu pra kṛ ti mā pa.oṃ sha rī ra ma sems 'di ni/ /nyams pa med ⑫na bden pa des/ /lus ni yongs su ma nyams shing / /rang bzhin rdzogs pa ri kṣa tai/ /i sgo dī ri ta mā tre ṇa sa tya shī la su khyu pa teḥ/ /allī ba pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa brjod pa tsam nyid kyis/ /sa bdag bden pa'i ngang tshul gyisapa/—rta/ /lus kyi rma 95—679

tsand+ra ru tsi ram̐ rū bhā bra ṇa ma bhūdma suḥ/ /ta taḥpā rā ba te pa te lubha ke ni rab gsos 1 te/ /ma nyams zla ba ltar mdzes gyur/ /de nas phug ron rngon pa dag /song zhing sa ba ma hotpa baḥ/ /bhū pā la bhā swa du da ye pra kā sha bi bha po bha bta/ /sasbanda daḥskyong 'od ldan ni/ /shar tshe spro ba chen po dang / /rab gsal 'byor pa ldan par gyur/ /gang zhig nges kṣi ti pa tiḥki la yo ba byu bā so haṃ bi ṣe ga pu ru ṣaḥs mde ba dattaḥ/ /taj-itta par sa yi bdag po thams cad ster gyur pa/ /de nyid nga yin skyes bu ser skya de yang lha sbyin (ṭwāno/ /de yi saṃ sma ra ṇa ta ཿ pra mṛ ta smi to haṃ shu two ti shāstu rā ma rā bye pa sngon byung yang dag dran nas bdag gis 1'dzum pa spyos/ /zhes pa ston pa las thos 'chi med bdag po tinda nandan/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa dga' bar gyur/ /zhes 4pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag la tā yī satthanda dā ba dā rna pañtsa pañtsa shaḥpabee waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las thams cad ster ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //sandarsha ṣpe na ye ྾ dzwa ṣa bi ṣeṣṭha pra shārnyi mu pa yārnyi/ /a mṛ ta gang dag mthong bas zhe sdang dug gi ni/ /tsha ba rab tu zhi ba nyid gyur cing (5/ /bdud rtsi'i ro ra sa shī ta laste ka su na su dza nanda bo baddhā/ /dhwa rā mu kha surya kṣa gya bsel skye bo dam pa yi6/ /zla ba de dag su yi phyag 'os min/ /gnod sbyin kha rnon dag gi gnas/ /de sthā nā dadhirda tasta taḥ/ /kṣa shā da bā pa bha ga banda ga ram̐ ho gu marda āoṃ/ /bi las snang ba min gyur te/ /grong khyer hing gu ma da 7nar/ /skad cig gis ni bcom ldan byon/ /der na yāsbo dzi tasta dra bra hma daste na bhū bhu dzā/ / ta྾ da kṣi khaṃ tsakre dha ni sa bdag tshangs byin she gyis/ /dul ba yi she ni mchod pa byas/ /de yis yang dag rjes mthun par/ /tyā nā ma nu shā sa rna/ / ta tra po rāḥs ma bye tya bha ga brnyi bya dzreṇḍi skal ldan rnams la rjes bstan mdzad/ /der ni grong pa rnams 'ongs te/ /rgud pa kun tu lus can 95—680

6ཿ / /sand+ra sabee ni pa te 6 tā tā ram̐ sarba de hi dzā/ /bha ga bandaste rnams—/ /rnam par lhung la skyob mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das la rab gsol pa/ /grong khyer mtha' na ga ra tyādhe sā ṣā ṇasaza taḥ/ /ta tra go pā la ko nā gaḥhrū ro ba sa na bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo ba yi ni ri zhig yod/ /de na klu ni ba lang skyong / /drag po bzod par 7ti duḥs haḥ/ /sa pa shu āoṃ dzi nā nāñtsa sha snga nāñtsa ma hā sha niḥ/ /sadzaspyo dka' ba gnas/ /de ni phyugs dang skye bo dang / /'bru rnams kun gyi rdo rje che/ /phun sum tshogs nā ma bhā bā ya na bidmaḥke na nimbi taḥ/ /a dānta da ma na gyasminda shānta rnams dngos med slad/ /ca ⑫yis rnam sprul rig ma gyur/ /ma dul 'dul mdzad ma zhi ba/ /zhi mdzad sha ma na su te/ /u pa sarge kṛ pāsthā shaṃ shar ṇa sha ra ṇi ṣi ṇa ma/ /i khyod kyi brtse ba ni/ /nye bar 'tshe ba 'di dag la/ /bdag cag skyabs 'tshol (kyirnams kyi skyabs/ /zhes tyāghā te 6 dhwa te 6 bha ga bān ka ru rja ni byeḥ/ /antadngha ta pra bhā ma dhyāta ya brjod de dag song ba'i tshe/ /bcom ldan snying rje'i gter dag ni/ /'dus pa'i dbus las mi snang bar/ /yo pā ṣā ṇa khyu dha raḥ/ /ta gre bi saṃ ka ṭi ta su bha ban dī ma sgo gi naḥ/ /rdo ba'i sa 'dzin dag tu gshegs/ /de ngos shin tu snyug po na/ /'jigs rung gdengs can khang pa ni/ /sa da darsha bi ṣa shā so ri ba byā mbi kṛ to da rka/ /tsa larjasko ṣa nisbyi dug gi dbugs rnams dag gis nguchu/ /sngon por byas bzhin de yis mthong / /ral gri shubs med g.yo sha bi ṣa mormi ba nā ku le / / ta byā re bha ga bānd+ra dheḥ pa rlo ka sa ba yi/ /mi bzad rba ⑪rlabs kyis 'khrugs nags/ /de yi 'gram du bcom ldan gyis/ /skyil krung mu pā bi sha ta / / pra sa nd+ra lo ka na su jo ba sgo nā sni bha tsakṣu bcas te nye bar bzhugs/ /mnyes gyegashin spyan ni bdud rtsi'i gnyen/ /dang bas rab tu gzigs pa ṣa—/ /sa ni nā shu sa bi ṣe bi ṣe nidzre ṣa tā mi ba/ /dī dzee bu bimbi yis—/ /de yis myur bar dug bzhin du/ /dug dang bcas pa dug med thob/ /sku lus gser 'od 95—681

ta ta nu sa ba rbha ka na kablu tiḥ/ /ra birma ra ka tatstsha yi gā ha mā na i rpā ba mthing ga shā/yi/ /chu la snang bas de rab mdzes/ /ma ra ka ta ltar mdzes pa'i/ /mkha' la nyi ma 'gro ba re / /ti mi re nā ga bha ba ṣpe tahphu kā sha bi su tri tai/ /pa lā ya ma bzhin—/ /de yi snang bas rnam bcom pas/ /klu yi khang par rab rib rnams/ /'bros par byed pa n+ya byā lo la byā la dza lā tu dzee ya yo/ /nā ga rā dzasta 7nā lokya ru bye rā ru ṇa g.yo ba yi/ /sbrul gye tshogs dang mtshungs par gyur/ /klu yi rgyal pos de mthong nas/ /mig ni khrag ltar lo tsa naḥ/ /sa ha sā kā sha mā bi shya tsakre mee gha ma yo dza gatro/ /kro dhwasni dhū dmar ba yis/ /'phral la nam mkhar rab zhugs te/ /'gro ba sprin gyi rang bzhin byas/ /de yi khro ba'i ma na ba tai ri ba ta gya gha noṅga beeḥ/ /bi trulja hai ra kadzanta di gaḥpant+ra me yis ni/ /du ba'i tshogs bzhin stug po las/ /rab 'thon glog gi lce rnams kyis/ /phyogs rnams se tā i ba/ /gardzi taind+ratta me ghā dzā pra lā yā ram̐ bha gi si bhaḥ/ /skrag pa bzhin du 'dar/ /stsos pa'i sprin rnams dag gi sgra/ / 'jigs pa rtsom ⑤par sgrogs byed pas/ /gu hā ge hā n+ya bha khyanta dṛ da yā mbi ba bhū z-i hūṃ/ /ta taḥpiṣṭa kra ma sa 'dzin rnams kyi snying bzhin du/ /phug dang khang pa zhom par gyur/ /de nas rdo chen tshogs dkrigs bṛṣṭiḥklibhā dri sa ka lā ba lī/ /sā da pa pā ti ta dhri tiḥsnyu lo pa la char / /ri 'phreng mtha' dag nyon mongs shing / /brtan pa thong bye byed ljon shing ni/ /phye mar byed pa ku lā ku lā/ /bā duṣṭa bhu dza godṛ ṣṭa dṛṣṭi nd+ra ṣṭi ba tā yi naḥ/ /ya bab ‘5snapar gyur/ /lag 'gro gdug pas rab spros pa'i/ /char de skyob khyapas gzigs nyid na/ / rlung yo bā lā ni lo lalbā sa la pa ta ku su ma ba rṣa tī / /dṛ ṭī pra kā bzhon g.yo bas bskyed pa yis/ / 7me tog char pa nyid du gyur/ /der phyani rab gsal dri med nags bi ṣa da dā n+ya nu pa bla bā ni byusgo pa gī ta ku su mā ni ba nāni ta tra/ /harṣa tshal nye bar bslad pa med/ /bung ba glu dbyangs len pa'i me tog dang ldan mthong byur nas/ /dga' 95—682

smi ta pra sa ra nirdzi ta bhā ra hā rāḥspyu ram̐ pha bhānd+ra ma ba dasba na de ba'i 'dzum dkrigs do shal khur las nges par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /nags kyi lha yis gdug pa'i gdengs can ba tā sta / / sgoḥ kā la me gha ni kṛ ti pa ri muñtsa kiñtsaniṣka dza e dbang po de la smras/ /kye lags dus kyi sprin dag 1sternam 'gyur dag ni yongs su thobaX / /khyod lta bu ba ka na kā tsa la e ṣa ya gya/ /yuṣṭha dī dhwaḥpra la ya mā ru ta bha rnams 'jigs ② pa'i rlung gis bcom par gyur pa na/ /gang gi rked skabs phug gi rol pas rnyi skyabs su bye mā nā lī lā ni tadza ku ha ram̐ sha ra khaṃ pra yārja/ /ta taḥsarya pa ri kṣu ṇa ma daḥ'agro byed pa'i/ /gser gyi ri bo 'di la ci yang g.yo ba med pa nyid/ /de nas 'phral la rgyags pas 5snani/ /saṃ tya kṣa bi kṛ yaḥ/ /nā gaḥshāsta ram bye tya pra na nā ma kṛ tā ñdza yongs su zad cing rnam 'gyur btang / /thal mo sbyar nas mngon phyogs te/ /klu yis ston pa la phyag liḥ —/ / ta gya dza ta gya sha ra rde bha ga baṅka ru shā ni byeḥ/ /shikṣu 'tshal—/ /bcom ldan 'das ni snying rje'i gter/ /babeeb pa'i gnas dag rab byin ramupas/ /skyabs su pa da pra dbya kre ku sha khā gra ma nu gra haṃ/ /pra ṇa ya dbee taste na tsa ra rja song bar gyur pa de/ /dge ba mchog la rjes bzung mdzad/ /zhabs la mgo yis gtugs pa dedzwa/ /gus pa dzee na mo li nā/ /sa ta tai ta gya bha ga bān sa: bye bi da dhe dzi naḥ/ /tasminda yis ni gsol btab pa/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas rtag tu ni/ /de la yang dag nye bar mdzad/ /gnas skabs ba sa re ta tra pra saṃ gāpta mya shānta ye/ /yakṣa sre tsakra bha ga bān badzra pa ṇi der ni de nyid du/ /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dag /zhar la 'ongs pa zhi ba'i slad/ /bcom ldan 'das ra nu gra haṃ/ /bo ko pa tā pa ma sa ma bi ni bārya shāstu bistu ri tastu ti pa kyis rjes bzung mdzad/ /de nas 'jig rten gdung ba mi bzad rnam 8 zlog ston pa ni/ /rnam rgyas bstod daste da shā tsu mā naḥ/ /bhe dze ba nā ni bi ha randa tha pūnd+ra budhaḥpā pa'i tshig gis skabs gsum pa yis mchod gyur pa/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhabs pad dag dang mdza' 95—683

dāmbu dza pra ṇa ya sru ta shi lā ta lā niḥ/ / ta tra sandarsha nāsta ra su ba las/ /dag pa'i rdo ba'i gzhi ldan nags tshal rgyu zhing bsten par mdzad/ / de der tshu'adzum dang ldan pa ra rā dze na sa smi taḥ/ /smi ta gya kā ra khaṃ thraṣṭaḥsarba snyosta ma bhā ṣa las 7—/ /lha yi rgyal po ltar 'ongs pas/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu dris de la ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pas bka' sprul ta / /e te 6 pu ju pa li lā ma le ni dha re 6 ni ṣpe ra sa twa su bha ge pa / /dag byed dri ma med pa'i chu yi rgyun dang ldan gyur cing / /khon med sems can skal ①bzang 'khod pa 6 ta po pa ṣpe 6/ /dhasthā dhi bā sa ya ti mā na sa māsnga ṣpe 6 shādheḥpa de 6 dka' thub dag gi nags/ /chos ni lhag gnas sdom brtson rnams kyi yid ni dag byed pa/ /zhi ba'i gnas na ma yi ba kṛ ta bi hā raḥ/ /kra ku tstshandaḥshrī mān ka na ka mu ni ra 'di dag tu nga nyid kho nas rol byas min/ /seng ge'i nu 'og ri dwags phrug (byegu rgyu ba dben pa'i nags tre ba su ga taḥs samyashā budhaḥpa tsa bi ma li dhīḥkā shya pa mu niḥ/ /bi biste tshal 'dir/ /brgya byin dpal ldan 'khor ba 'jig khyedang bde gshegs gser thub de dang ri/ /yang dag smin sau hi sta na ta la tsa labye la ha ri ṇi ba ṣpe tsa kruḥshakra sbi ti ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dre med blo ldan thub pa 'od srungs te/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten gdung ba'i sman pa khi la lo kantibhe ṣa dzaḥ/ /i ti bru bā ṇaḥs mu pa ga ta mya sa pu ju bā rnams kyis 'di nyid du gnas mdzad/ /de nas de skad smras des gzigs nyid kyi/ /bsod nams smin ka da tha luddhā ka gya/ /sandarsha ṣpe ṣpe ba sha mandi de shaṃ shikṣu pa dāhaṃ sha ra rde ga ta la 6nye bar 'ongs pa yi/ /rngon pa dag ni skyabs su so nga ba la/ / bslab pa'i gnas 'os zhi ba bstan pa su / /bhā gya bān bha ga ba to nu gri ha taḥlubye kaḥku sha la luddhā mā na sa/ /mdzad / /skal ldan dge la yid chags rngon pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su bzung ba las/ /tand+ra diṣṭa na kha ke sha lāñtsha āoṃ ta tra tsi tya ma ka rodhri gā bye paṃ/ /i ti der ni mchod rten ri dwags bdag po dag / 77des gnas dbu skra sen mos mtshan pa byas/ /zhes pa 95byed684

— byedabyed———— — — ——kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā lnga go pā la dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las klu nā ga da ma rna ṣa ṣatpañtsa shaḥpalla waḥ// //ba lang skyong btul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //diklu nta shra ba kho tai pa tu lā ro pi ta saṅga shā ཿ / / te dza yarnyi phyogs kyi mdzes pa'i tshu/rna rgyan dang / /mtshungs par yon tan dam pa bkod/ /gang zhig grags dza ga bye ྾ ya shaḥtho bai bee rā dza te/ /bha ga bān tha sha kre ṇa ta tra pa'i mchod rten gyis/ /'gro mdzes de dag rgyal gyur cig /de nas der ni bcom ldan 'das/ /brgya pra ṇi dhi nābee ta ཿ / / pūza bu ddhā kṛ ta khyu po ni dzastu pa ma kā ra byen gus pas gsol btab pas/ /sangs rgyas snga ma'i mchod rten mdzad/ /rang gi mchod rten byed du yata / /kṛ te ratna ma ye ta smin de baiḥsrurya sha ta tī ṣe/ /dza gā ma dza bcug /lha rnams kyis der rin chen gyisan/ /rang bzhin nyi 'od brgya ldan byas/ /'gro ba'i rmongs pa ga hūṃ kā pi ma hā mo ha pa oṃ ta maḥ/ /ta tra ki na ra gan dharba na ra nā ga di chen po dang / /mtshungs pa'i mun pa ga shed song / /der ni dri za mi 'am ci/ /mi dang klu dang lha bo ka sī/ /dhasgo pa de sha bi na yo sa mā di shya ya yo dzi naḥ/ /pā ṣa ṇa pattha rnams la/ /'dul ba'i chos kyi man ngag ni/ /yang dag bstan nas rgyal ba gshegs/ /rdo ba'i ri la lha te de bai bya stastu pa tsa tu ṣṭa ye/ /bha ga bāpreñtsa oṃ stu paṃ pañtsa tho bee bya rnams kyis/ /mchod rten bzhi ni bkod pa la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sdepelnga pa yi/ /mchod rten mchod be sha yata/ /a tha bā lokṣa nā mā rna de shaṃ pā ptasta thā ga taḥ/ /shriṣṭi dzā rten lnga dag bkod/ /de nas bā lo kṣa zhes pa'i/ /yul du de bzhin gshegs pa byon/ /lus ngan rmis su pra budhe na ku bee re ṇi ba pū dzi ta ཿ / /di de sha dha dzre bi na yo bzhin tshong dpon ni/ /legs par rab sad ces pas mchod/ /gang zhig de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /95 685

tasmi ye na sa mā nu gaḥ/ /mo ha ni drukṣa ye na pābeeḥsu pra budhaḥpra 'dul ba'i chos ni de la bstan/ /rmongs pa'i gnyid sad legs par ky-i3ni/ /rab sad rab sad nyid budha tai/ /sa shā sa nāsgo ga ba taḥpu ju ni dza mi borja tai/ /ba lo kṣu thob gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' las des/ /rang gi bsod nams bzhin mtho ba/ /bā lo spyo zhuyī bye dha snru paṃ ratna dī paṃ n+ya be da yata/ /ḍadza ྈ krā ma mā sā rya sha ya zhes pa yis je/ /mchod rten rin chen 'bar ba byas/ /de nas (snyedal kyis de bzhin gshegs/ /ṣpe ra tha ta thā ga taḥ/ /bee nā ya ḍalba ram̐ nā ma yahūṃ shi kṣu pa da pra daḥ/ /ḍam ba ra yi grong du byon/ /gnod sbyin ḍal ba ra zhes pa/ /bslab gnas rab tu byen ⑥pas btul/ /tsaṇḍa la gā ma ma bye tya tsaṇḍa lī ma li kā bye jo/ /sa nyi hūṃ sapta rnyiḥpu trebee gtum po'i 7grong du mngon phyogs te/ /gtum mo ma li ‘nyaka zhes pa/ /bu bdun dag dang lhan cig nyid/ /na yonda tsā bya dhwa ta/ /te kadzre she ṣa saṃ prapta mā tai ga ku la dru ṣi 'dul ba yis ni mtho bar mdzad/ /las kyi lhag mas gtum po'i rigs/ /thub pas sun phyung de dag taḥ / /padmā ka ra i bā pā pūdzee ma lya dzi na darsha — ta/ /and+ra pra du ṣi rnams—/ /rgyal ba mthong las padma yipo7/ /'byung gnas bzhin du dri med gyur/ /tha shal skyon gyis ta ta re 6 dzu gu bee te 6 pā po pa tā pa bi pu la bya sa nārta re sun phyung smad pa dag tu 'os grur cing / /sdig pa'i nye bar gdung ba chen pos gdungs shing nyen ⑪ rnams 6 / /saṃ ta pra dṛtta ka ru ṇaḥku bi kalpa tī na dī nā ba lalba na ra la—/ /rnam rtog ngan pa dang bral snying rjes rab zhugs dam pa rnams/ /dman la dmigs pa'i rjes su sā da bye ka bha brnyi/ /a bā su pā ṭa la gā me sā nu gaḥsu ga tasta chags pas lhag par gyur pa yin/ /de nas bde gshegs rjes 'brang bcas/ /pā ṭa 17la yi grong khyer taḥ / / dha sde kṛ ha pa te: kre po ta lā khya gya saṅka tsā/ shikṣu byon—/ /dpal ldan khyim bdag gru 'dzin zhes/ /bya la legs pa'i gtam dag mdzad/ /bde bar 95—686

pa dā sta bee ma spyeḥsu ga tā nu gra he ṇa saḥ/ / taṅge sha na khye ka gya gshegs pas rjes bzung bas/ /bslab pa'i 1gnas thob dri med des/ /de yi dbu skra sen cha yis/ /ratna tho pa ma kā ra ya ta/ / ta tra sandarsha na yā tai bha ga bā nind+ra mtshan pa'i rin chen mchod rten byas/ / de ni bltar rngu'ongs dbang po la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bra bīta/ /mi lirjonā ma rā dzāsmin de she sa mbha paṃ ka ri 6 ti/ /i ti rab gsungs pa/ /rgyal po mi lin du/dra zhes pas/ /yul 'di thumachod rten byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar bha ga ba taḥsthā de sthā ṣpe da yādro bi lo ke nā da bha ba da khi lo lo kā gnas dang gnas su bcom ldan brtse bas brlan pas gzigs pa yis/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten rnams kyi sho ka pra mo ha bha yesbyi ta ཿ / / a bhi na ba kri ta stu po tstsha ga mya ngan rmongs dang 'jigs pa btang bar gyur/ /mchod rten mngon par gsar byas skyibs na nor bu'i twa ṇadma ṇi kiṅgi ṭwā ku la ka la ka la kṛ ḍā lo lā ba byu ba tsa me di bee/ /dril chung sgra sgrogs pa/ /dar dir tshogs kyi rtsed 57'jo dag gis sa gzhi'ang sred pa ldan par (67gyur/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī zhes (7pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing 1 pā ba dā rna sabee pañtsa shaḥpabee waḥ// //las mchod rten gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //a naddhā babyeste sa ka la ku sha lotpa tta ba su bye su bye siddhā mantarda rgud pa'i gdung ba zhi byed gzigs pa rab tu dang ba'i ro dag gis/ /skyes bu rnams ni nad dang jo ti ki la ye pū rṇa ka ru shā / / pra sa rja rā sa nda bya sa na bral mdzad srid pas zil mnan 'khrugs pa'i sman pa gang / /nges par dge ba mtha' dag bskyed pa'i sa ma nā lo ka ra sa ṣpeḥkṛ tā ro gya hūṃ sī bha ba pa ri bha ba kko bhe bhe ṣa dzaḥ/ /nor 'dzin grub pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /rdzogs pa'i snying rje nang du 'dzin pa de dag mi smad 7phyag byar 'os/ /95—687

na garja puṣka lā ba dhyā sa smi taḥsmi ta kā ra rṇa/ /pu ra rā dze na bha ga bān grong khyer padmo ldan pa na/ /bcom ldan 'dzum dang bcas pa la/ /lha yi rgyal pos 'dzum pa'i rgyu/ /dris thraṣṭaḥpu na ra bhā ṣa ta/ /shrī mān pu ju ba lo nā ma pu ra byudṛ thi bī pa tiḥ/ /nas beer yang rab gsungs pa/ /dpal ldan bsod nams stobs zhes pa'i/ /sa yi bdag po sngon byung ste/ /ya snga shī ti sa ha sru ṇi na ga rā rde pa ri gra haḥ/ /ha gya pu rgya ba ti nā gang zhig grong khyer stong phrag ni/ /brgyad cu yongs su 'dzin par gyur/ /de yi rgyal po'i pho brang ni/ /ma rā dza jo mbi bya rā dza ta/ /spa ṭi kā kā ra ru tsi rā byosgo ba ra dza bhā pa bsod nams ldan zhes bya ba ste/ /shel kyi rnam par yid 'ong zhing / /mtshan mo'i bdag po'i 'od bzhin te / /sa ka dā tsinda bo byā na yā tā yī ra tha mā taḥ/ /da darsha sa mdzes—/ /skyed tshal gsar par 'gro ba'i beed/ /nam zhig shing rta zhon pa des/ /lam du phan pa'i bya bi hā rā ta pa ti sbo danta mā tu re/ /ba haṃ dṛ ṭī pa ri sthā rgo zas bral bas/ /nad kyis gzir zhing nya 'dug pa mthong / /ring po'i nad kyis mnar ba yis/ /dī rgha ro ga na durga tai / / bee bya the ka ru ṇa krāddhā ཿ kranta khi la di yongs su nyams pa de mthong nas/ /phyogs mtshams ma lus gnon pa de/ /snying rjes zil mnan gdung ganta raḥ/ /santa bye pa ra mā la kya sa ryaḥsaṃ krārnya dadzee ṇaḥ/ /santaḥbar gyur/ /gzhan gyis yongs gdungs —mthong gyur na/ /'phral la 'phos te dam pa yi④ / /me long saddhā pa mā yābye srurya kānta ma yā i ba/ /sa mapta dā ra ra byā su sabye rnams ni gdung 'gyur te/ /nyi ma me shel rang bzhin bzhin/ /de yis grong khyer thams cad dang / /sgo 6 na ga re ṣā saḥ/ /ro gi rde pa kṣu bye ṣa bye shā la sha yā rya kā ra yatpa/ /dang srang rnams mtha' dag tu/ /nad pa rnams la zas dang sman/ /gnas dang mal stan la sogs byas/ /ā di de sha ta taste bhyaḥku sha khādru ri tsā ra kān/ /pra tha saṃ nyi tsi kedzee shaṃ de nas de dag rnams kyi slad/ /rim gro pa ni mkhas pa bskos/ /gang phyir dam pa'i rim gro pa/ /nad 95—688

byā dheḥsatpa ri tsā ra ka ra/ /ka ru shādzraḥkṣa maḥkṣuntashyi kitpa kā ma teḥspru gso'i yan lag dang po yin/ /bzod ldan lha snying rjes brlan zhing bzod/ /gso byed 'dod pa dag la taḥ—/ /sde hā da bi tsi kitpa: durla bhaḥpa ri tsā ra kaḥ/ /rā dzā ta taḥganas—/ /mdza' las khruthe tshom mi byed pa'i/ /rim gro pa ni rnyed pa dka'/ /de nas rgyal pos rim sa mā byu ya ni ya tārṣa ri tsa ra kā na/ /a ba daskṛ ya tī ro ge ba ri tsaryā di gro pa/ /dul ba rnams ni legs bos nas/ /smras pa nyin dang mtshan mor ni/ /nad pa rnams kyi rim ba ni shaṃ/ /rā dzārta shā la su kṛ ta ba ra shwa yā de kalpa nāḥ/ /ro gi gro mdzod/ /rgyal po la 'os gnas rnams su/ /mal stan mchog sogs phun tshogs byas/ /rin chen rde ratna so pā nāḥpadme n+yabya la lo da kāḥ/ /bhe ṣadzhai ṣa bye saṃ patrībee hi tā skas ldan padmo can/ /dri med chu ldan nad pa'i phyir/ /sman pa dang ni sman dag kyang / /phun tshogs tsa ma tī ya rpā/ /a dhu nā yuṣṭha dā yabho tatyā sbya mi ti me ma tiḥ/ /saddhā shin tu che ba bsgrubs/ /da ni de dag bsos gyur pa/ /khyed kyi gnyer zhes bdag gi blo/ /'jig rten paṃ sha ma ya tya tī bra shi shi riḥ shī tai su khe noṣṭha zla tre ṭwā shī ta dza 'dir ni rim gro pa dang brtan pa'i sman pa chos kyi 4gzhan du mi rnams kyi/ /yongs su gdung ba shin tu lermu hurmi ta hi tā hā ro ba tsā riḥkla oṃ/ /swasgo sī ti bye ti thra ye na bsil ba yis kyang gang (snye/ba dag ni bde ba'i dro ba yis/ /sred pa bsel ba'i chu yis dang ni ngal ba yang ba tsa pā he li kra me rja ra ti lo ke smidru ri tsā ra kaḥ spri ra bi yang chung ngu phan zas nyer bstabs pas/ /khyod gsos 7'u'agyur zhes bstan pa'i tshig snyan ku re'i rim pas ṣagharmaḥpa ra smi1 rde/ / tasmrabye ba bye stabhā dzā ro ga yo ge na sī da mi dga' ba ④dag zhi bar byed/ /de yi slad du khyed rnams kyisare / /nad kyis gdungs shing 'gyel hūṃ —/ /kāryā mu hurmu hurpā kye ri ya ma shwa sa na smṛ tiḥ / /bee byo rnams la/ /yang dang yang du tshig dag gis/ /dbugs dbyung po 'di ni dran par byasanya— / /sman pa 95—689

na ba ryaḥsu ga taḥpra sā dī dhaspo pa de shaḥpa ra mo ṣa dhañtsa/ /saṃ sā skyon med bde gshegs bka' drin dang / /chos kyi hūṃraman ngag dam pa'i sman dag kyang / /'khor ba ra dīsgo dzwa ra sho ṣi tā dzā pā rā ya khaṃ shārnyi ra pā ya nanta ta/ /i tyā ring po'i rims kyis snyebaskams rnams kyi/ /dpung gnyen zhi ba'i bcud len de dag yin/ /mi bdag di ṣṭa dṛ pa ti nā te te na ba su babhā zla/ /ga tā ya tho di tai tsakruḥnor gyi char 'bebs des/ /de dag rnams la de skad bstan/ /nad pa ma lus gsos ①bya'i slad/ /swāsbya yā khi la ro gi rmā/ /ta taḥku sha la ba de na te na taṅga ta mā na sān/ /song nas ji skad brjod bzhin byas/ /de nas nad grol de dag rnams/ /dge ba brjod pas de la yid/ /byā bye muktanda ra pa nyiḥswa yo trahūṃ bi nirya yo/ /sha krasta da pa raḥsong ba rnams la blta ba'i slad/ /mi bdag rang nyid phyi rol byung / /brgya byin gyis kyang de la ni/ /sha kra ta gya pu rgya sa mudzdza lo/ /ra dzee bee nind+ra me yulte ṣajantiḥpāṇḍa gnyis 'thung dkar po mche ba ni / /drug ldan gyis drangs shing rta dag /bsod nams rab 'bar rnam dī peḥ/ /su kha spazla ni khā lo la te ma ratna sa ro ru hā/ /z-iji ga par sprul/ /rin chen gser gyi mtsho skyes rnams/ /reg na bde ba'i rlung gis g.yos⑤/ /bung ba'i na no pa gī tā tsa di byā ka ma le nī pa thi/ /te 6 ratna sa ro dza 6 sbi tā mṛ chung glu len pa'i/ /lam du mchog gi pad ldan yang / /rin chen mtsho skyes de dag la/ /gnas sogs ta ka khā ku khāḥ/ /dru ra1 pa ti mā yanta su nāryaḥse ṣe bi re/ /bdud rtsi'i cha rdzogs pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyis ring po nas/ /mi bdag byon pa bstan ⑥par gyur/ /ta su satwa su dhwa sesgoḥ sa hūṃ dzñā rtu ma rutpa tiḥ/ /kṛ tā rnya rū ba snying stobs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de'i/ /snying stobs shes 'dod lha yi bdag /bdag nyid long ba'i mā dmā na ma bye ta ta ma bhā ṣata / / rā dzanda ya na tī no haṃ dzadmā gzugs byas nas/ /de la mngon du phyogs te gnas⑦/ /rgyal po mig gis dman pa bdag /skye bar 95—690

lo ka bi brdzi taḥ/ /sattha sa twa pa ri tā khaṃ sandaddhi tā mu pā ga taḥ/ /snang ba rnam par spangs/ /sems can thams cad yongs skyob par/ /zhugs pa khyod can nye bar 'ongs/ /e te ta ba pra bhā be na ro gi ṇaḥswāsgyu ma ga ta/ /twaṅgirbhe ba da mu kha rā: khyod kyi mthu yis nad pa ni/ /'di dag legs par gsos 37gyur nas/ /'od rte7ldan mdzes pas khyod kyi ra dhi ru tsi ra tī ṣa ཿ / / tā tu ma rta se rmā de ba du kha dī ni—/ /grags pa mu cor sgrog cing rgyu/ /sdug bsngal bkren 17dang long ba'i gnyen/ /lha yis rībadag ni nānta bānta ba/ /dakṣ-i rṇa na ya āoṃ ma hūṃ dī ya hūṃ ya di shakya te/ /i tyāktaste bskyab par 'os/ /bdag la mig ni g.yas pa dag /gal te phod na gnang bar 5mdzod/ /des 'di na dṛ pa tiḥ pra sanda ba da na byu ti ཿ / / santa ra shā ya dza ga tī brngod tshe mi bdag ni/ /rab dang bzhin ras mdzes pa yi(6sna/ /'gro rnams yang dag bsgral ba'i slad/ /samyakshi bo dhi sedhi ye/ /bra ṇi dhwa āoṃ sa mā dhwa ya sha ste rtotpa 6 lo rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /smon lam rab tu btab byas te/ /mig ni mtshon gyis rab tsa dzwa/ /da do dhebye ni byestasmi pu྾ rā bu ri taḥsu riḥ/ /ta snga da phyungs ⑦ nas/ /brtan pa'i gter gyis de la byin/ /lha rnams kyis ni me tog gtor/ /de yi rmad (87bhu ta da ṣpe na bi sma yā di ba sā tsa lnga/ /bee tsa tsā la khi la thra dī bi lo byung sbyin pa yis/ /ya mtshan nas bzhin sa gzhi ni/ /chu gter g.yo ba'i ske 97rags can/ /ri dang khāṇḍi ba me kha khā/ /dzā tā lo shaṃ ta mā lo kya ṣpe tre ṣpe ke na bhū pa tiḥ/ /i ti bcas pa ma lus 'dar/ /mig gcig gis ni snang ba dag /skyes pa de mthong sa yi bdag /sbyin pa'i dā na ra sa spru tyā dī tī yo dā tu murya yo/ / ta taḥsu ra pa ti sta su ro la rab dgyes pas/ /gnyis pa sbyin par brtson par gyuratsho 7/ /de nas lha yi bdag po ni/ /rang gi sa mā sbra ya ni dzee ba puḥ/ /swastha pi dhwa ya na ya ram̐ pra shaṃ shaṃ sā ti satwa tsā/ /lus su yang dag gnas/ /de yi mig ni bsos byas te/ /snying stobs mchog nyid rab tu bsngags/ /95—691

dā na kṣa ṇi swā ba ya bee pi ya su na dzā ya te sne ha la baḥka dā tsitra/ /kā nā ma gang zhig sbyin tshe rang gi yan lag la'ang / /nam yang chags pa chung ngu skye min pa/ /nges par snying ta spyodzhai ta sa twa sesgorja nā dī jo āoṃ ra dza si swa budhiḥ/ /sa dṛ pa tiḥstobs rgya mtsho rgyas de la/ /nor zhes brjod pa'i rtul skyal rang blo ci/ /de tshe mi bdag bsod nams pu sgo ba lo ha me ba ta dā bha baṃ dā na ra pābee bo byeḥ/ āspruryaz-itta sma ra ṇi na ta stobs grur te/ /nga nyid sbyin pa'i ro yis byang chub thob/ /de yi ngo mtshar spyod tshul dran pas na/ /su dzā na smi tastadma ya tā ma bāptaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī de yi rang bzhin nyid thob 'dzum pa mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa lā tā dzee pu sgo ba lā ba dā dzwa nā māṣṭaḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal pañtsa shaḥpalla waḥ// //'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //e kaḥpa e ba su kṛ to tsi ta tsakra btīḥsu byakta tīnti ti la kā gu shin tu rab gsal grags pa'i tshon ris yon tan rin chen rgyan/ /ma nyams sbyin pa'i me tog dang ṇa ratna bhū ṣā/ /asmra na dā na ku su mā kre ta sa tya tsartswa ya snga ba ldan bden pa'i byug pa byas/ /gang gi dpal ni tshul khrims gtsang ma'i hūṃdu gu las mdzes pa/ /de nyid bhā ti shu tsi shī la du ku li bhā shrīḥ/ /su rotta me pā ṭa li pu tra nāmbi ma tī gcig pu legs byas la 'os 'khor los sgyur ba yin/ /grong mchog pā ṭa 1li yi bu zhes pa/ /na chung sa yu ba tyāste la kā ya mā ṣpe/ /ya sho ni byeḥsaurya ku la ba tai saḥbye mā na sho kaḥkṣi gzhi 3thig le ltar gyur par/ /nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyan gyur grags pa'i gter/ /dpal ldan sa bdag mya ti po ba bhū ba/ /byubye sa kā mo pa ba de na kā mbi tsaṇḍi pa tsa re ṇa ta ngan med pa byung / /dang por 'u'adod ldan de 'dod nye tshig dang / /de nas rnon po ⑥gtum po'i nyer 95—692

tabya tīkyāḥ/ /dhasgo pa dā ṣpe na dza gā ma pa:ji ba ka pā ke ba ya bi pra sernyi ma/ /spyad ①dang / /phyi nas chos ni nye bar 'dzin pa yis/ /dben pa smin pa'i na tshod rab grags gyur/ /bra sanda pu byo pa ba na sba lī nā muddhinda sho bhā bha ra rja pa mā ṣpe/ /tasminda mya ngan med de rab dang bsod nams kyis63/ /nye ba'i nags tshal sa gzhi mdzes pas brgyan / /rgyas sho ke ku sha la bu ro hai ra sho ka hā me ba bhā ra lo kaḥ/ /mūdzdza sbi tsā taḥpar gyur tshe dge ba'i myu gu yis/ /'jig rten mya ngan med nyid nges par 'dzin/ /de yi bde skyed (4(lha pu ra punda rī hūṃ padmā ba tī ta gya su khā ya de bī/ /sabyetpa baṃ pu tra ma sru tra pu byesgyu mo padma ldan/ /pho ⑤brang 'khor gyi mdzes ma'i gtsug gnas pas/ /kun spro bu ni bsod nams dag gis gā nu gā shrī ri ba sā dhu bā rda/ /na rend+ra sru nuḥ ka na kā ba dā taḥbaskyed—/ /gtong ba rjes 'brang dpal kyi chu7 legs brjod bzhin/ /gser ltar dag pa mi yi dbang po'i shrī padme bhā padma pa lā sha ṣpe traḥ/ /hi mā tri haṃ sa gya ku khā la nā sna bu—/ /pad rdzing dpal kyi 97padma'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan/ /gser ri'i ngang pa ku lā ḍa87la zhes pa'iposna/ /stu bye kṣa rṇa bhūtpa ku nā la nā mā/ /bi byā ba dhū dzā bi ma khādma darshabye trotpa baṃ sattha mig mtshungs de ni ku lā 1 la zhes gyur/ /rig pa bu mo'i bdag mthong dri ma med/ /sgyu rtsal 'khri shing ka khā la tā dzā/ /sa sand+ra lo kā bhi ma to ba bhū ba tsarjo da yaḥtīrbhe ku rnams kyi dga' ba'i dpyid4me/ /grags pa ku mud ldan pa'i zla rgyas pa/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyi mudma tī dzā/ /tā rā bye po྾ ga mṛ go pa ma gya ta snga ya ta ṣpe dra sa ro dza mngon 'dod gyur/ /rgyu skar bdag po'i nang gi ri dwags bzhin/ /de yi mig yangs rtamatsho skyes zung yu shaṃ/ /sa bi bhra ma zla bhra ma rā bhi ra ṣe pa shyarja rend+raḥswa ya yo na tribee ma/ /dag ni/ /g.yo ldan smin ma'i bung bas mngon dga' ba/ /blta bas mi dbang rab tu ngoms mi 3na/gyur/ /nā nā gu zla lo ka ra zla ya tasmi kandathra mughra la ti kā ya mā nā/ /sa mapta sna tshogs yon tan rgyan ldan de la ni/ /mtha' dag phyogs dang gling gi sa yi bdag /skal bzang khengs 95—693

disnri pa pa rā bye nā thā dha n+ya bye mā ṣpe na da duḥswa ka tyāḥ/ /ta snga ya tā kṣi ta yi tā pas rang gi bu mo dag /'dod pa'i mu tig 'khri shing lta bu byin/ /skye bo rjes chags skyed 1pa mchog gi ba bhū ba tsand+ra na nā kāñtsa na mā/ /li kā khyu dza nā nu rā godha ba di bya gzugs—/ /de yi dga' mar mig yangs zla zhal ma/ /'dod pa'i dga' ma skye ba gzhan thob bzhin/ /mūrbherdzadmānta rāste ba ra tiḥsma ra gya/ /ta taḥka da tsimbi tu rarnyi kasgo tai bīkṣu gser gyi 'phreng (2ldan ma zhes bya bar gyur/ /de nas nam zhig pha yi drung gnas pa'i/ /gzhon nu de saṃ gha stha bi raḥ ku mā ra/ /ma te na rā ptaḥ swa ya sho bi hā re bi mthong dge 'dun gnas brtan gyis/ /rgyal po'i 'dod pas rang gi grags pa yi1/ /dben gnas bikta de shaṃ sha na kairna nā ya/ /sa ta gya kā le na bi nā sha mastodzñā tā ma byā ྾ gtsug lag khang du dal gyis khrid/ /rgan po mkhan po mngon shes drug ldan mchog /snying rje'i 'byor ( rnyiṣa ḍa bhe snyo tsarya/ /a ga mi duḥkhodha ra ṇa ya yo gī kā ru ju yo gī ta ldan rnal 'byor ldan pa des/ /dus kyis de yi mig dag nyams shes nas/ /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal gdon nu bā tsa bṛdhaḥ/ /i danta bā yā ta ni mittabhu tai pa shā mi tsitta bi bha bā bhū slad de la smras/ /khyod kyi sems ni 'byor pas zil mnan nas7/ /lang tsho me tog mtshon dang ldan pa'i tai / /ba yaḥ sa hā yo ku su mā yu dha gya ba pubya lī khā da li te nu tshogs—/ /rol pas zla ba'i dregs 'joms lus la spyoni/ /mtshan ma byung bar gyur 'di bdag gis dpaṃ / dzā hye ba tsakṣubya pa lā ki ma n+ya dasminda nā sbe ba su kho ba pabhiḥ/ /mthong / /mig ni rang bzhin gyis g.yo gzhan pa ci/ /'di la bde ba nyer bskyed (hūṃganas pa med/ /e te na kṛṭwāḥswa pa da pra na ṭwāḥsmṛ hā bhi dhwa ṣpe ku ha re pa tabye/ /i 'di yis ( sna/drangs pas rang gnas rab nyams te/ /'dod pa zhes brjod khung bur lhung ba nyid/ /nges rda hi byā lotpa la palla bā rghaṃ bi lo tsa rna nā ma dṛ rde bi shā lo/ /rā go ra gastso par mi rnams mig bzang yangs pa ni/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ma lta bu 'di/ /chags pa ltos 'gro'i 95—694

dra sa mu dra me ba ye ṣpedhri yā rgyu shu pa ri shra ban ti/ /dha tyā sgra e ba sa ma sa bug pa'i mtsho ①nyid de/ /gang gis myur du dbang po yongs ngal byed/ /tshul khrims mthu las gang dag twa dhī raḥshī la pra bhā bānda bha brnyi ye yī/ /lā ba sgo pā ṣpe na bee she rnams kyi mig /mdzes pa'i btung bas khyad par du ngoms shing / /rnam par (3 g.yo ba min pa de dag ṣa tribhā bi byuṇḍi mā nā ni bi lo tsa nā ni/ /i tyā di ta su pra sha pa panda nyid—/ /snying stobs brtan ①pa dang ldan skal ba bzang / /zhes sogs de yi tshig ni rab zhi ba/ /nye mā kaṇḍi bā kyanda ra nā tha su nuḥ/ /ta the ti kṛ tā ma na si pra sande kṛ ta pra ṇa maḥswa bar rdzogs pa mi bdag bus thos nas/ /de bzhin zhes de ngurab dang yid la byas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni pa dā dza gā ma/ /a tha ya yo j-iṅga ga kho pa gī tai sau dru ra byu rā pi ta ki shu ka shrīḥ/ /rang gi gnas su song / /de nas bung ba'i tshogs ni glu len cing / /ki khyashu ka dpal li khris rgyas pa 'dra/ /ma na sri nī mā na ba ṅgā nu brnyi ma dhu sa rasgo ra bha matta nā gaḥ/ /udmā khengs ldan ma yi khengs pa 'joms chas pas⑥/ /ston gyi ྅dris stsos glang bo cig du'ongs gyur/ /skyed na ballī na ba palla bā ram̐ bi yo gi nī tā pa bi palla bā dī/ /ba bhū tshal 'khri shing gsar pa'i yal 'dab dang / /'bral ba'i gdung ba rgud pa'i cha shas dag /gsar du bathradheḥs ha sā sa hai ba bra tya gra rā gasgo ma duḥs he ba/ /bā te ri chags pas rab bskyed bzod ba'i 'jig rten mig spro kyi hud bu/ /sdug bsngal skabs 'di khyod kyis ci beed bsten/ /bi lo ḍa ni takhru ra sunda rī hūṃ kwa lo tsa dzā sgo dza yu gi ga tai te/ /tsā dhīrya bhū me lha yi mdzes ma kwa sā bhi khyu tiḥka tsa durda ṣpe yo/ /na dīrya te me z-i da yi na dzā ṣpe ke nā su dattaḥku gar—/ /'byor de gang du gang du skabs ngan ①'di/ /bdag snying mi 'gas 'di la su zhig gis/ /rdo li sho ba de shaḥ/ /kā po dza nastaju bha ba nu sā rī ku khā nu byu po bha rje'i man ngag byin pa yongs ② mi shes/ /khyod 'byor rjes 'brang skye bo de gang du/ /khyod kyi chung ma g.yo ba ni: le yo/ /e kai ba sasbyi pa ri bā ra she ṣaḥkṛsgo pi sā bye ri pa byerya med gcig pu 'di/ /sdug kyang dam pa'i ①brtan pa'i spyod tshul bzhin/ /rigs kyi rjes mthun 'khor gyi dṛtrīḥ / /i tyā khru saṃ be ga bi shīṇḍi dhu lā pe nasta su ba tso ni sha bye/ /na tā ku lhag mar gyur/ /zhes pa mchi ma'i rgyun gyis yi ge nyams/ /cho nge smra ba de yi tshig thos nas/ /de yi phang mā rasta mu bā tsa dhī rasgruṇḍi ta rda kā da ba tīrya byu mo/ /bee muñtsa thra shrī pu ra snu las myur du sar babs te/ /gzhon nu brtan pas de la btud nas smras/ /sa yi brgya byin mya ngan rnam ta sho ke shu tsā bhi bhū tā na bha brnyi dhī rāḥ/ /kṣa yā ya dzā ganti na to nu bhā bā par thong / /mya ngan dag gis zil mnan brtan pa min/ /mtho dang dma' rnams brlag slad nges par me ṣa swa bhā bo bha bi ta bya tā yāḥ/ /i shwarya mābyarya su khā ba tai saṃ lā bsgo ni—/ /stsong bya'i rang bzhin 'di ni mel tshe byed/ /mi rnams dbang phyug ngo mtshar bde ba yi/ /rna rgyan lasmi ti la ke pa pu:/ /kṣa ṇi na yā hye ba kṛ tsā ta nadma kasmombi nind+ra kyis 'gro/ /gal te dngos med nyams stsong srid pa 'dir/ /dngos tshogs rang bzhin ya di bhā ba brgaḥ/ /sgru baṃ na kurlurmu na yasta de te saṃ tyakta sgo gī bai dza ṣpe bden par gyur pa na/ /thub pa n+ya be da ye lle kha ni bandha mamai ni dza sha ṣperte tra bee nā sha dṛrghaṃ/ /khru tī ba de la dal gyis spring yig dang 'byel pa'i/ /rang gi mig ni rnam par nyams tshul bshad/ /spyod ngan spyod marghaṃ dhī raḥku mā raḥpa—/ /de la phan la drin yang ji ltar yod/ /ces pa rab smra shugs 'byin gzir ba yi/ /yab la gzhon pi ta re dza ga da/ /ra dzanda me duḥkha la boste ka—ṭī pā pa kā ro bi na nu ma rgyu tā paḥ/ /ma naḥpra sa.oṃ ya di me dza na dzñā ye nod j-i te ba swa ka re ṇa ṣpe ba'i gdung ba min/ / mi bdag khye rang gi lag gis phyung ba bzhin/ /gal te ma la bdag yid rab dang tre—/ /tarte 'di skye ba gzhan la ni/ /ka shi'i 57grong khyer dag pā la pu tpaḥ/ /gu hā pra beeṣṭi hi ma batta ṭārnye laddhā mṛ gā rde sha ta pañtsa ka tu rngon par gyur/ /de yis gangs ldan ngos kyi phug ⑥zhugs pa'i/ /ri dwags lnga brgya dag ni thob gyur saḥ / /arghaṃ bi dhwa yākṣi bi pā ṭa ṣpe na ya tho pa byaste n+ya ba dhīttha me ṇa/ /nas—/ /mig dag ⑦ phyung nas long bar rab bsgrubs te/ /ji ltar nye bar 'khor (27ba rim gyis bsad/ /95—721

sgrub byed dag la gnas pa'i dbang gyur thob/ /dus kyi ④yang ba shābye bee 6 ti sha ṣpeḥkā le na saṃ budhe tā mi kyukṇisba bi re ṇa bhikṣu ni ba dag bsod nams dbang las dal gyi (perdzogs pa'i sangs yī sgo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la ta yī ku shā khā ba dā na byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam byi 'khri shing las ku lā ① /la'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i me konda ṣaṣṭha taḥpalla baḥ// //yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //i ha ka ṣa ti sha rī re kle sha rā shirna rā rde da ha ti tsa pa ra lo ke 'di (kyeni mi rnams lus dag nyon mongs phung pos rab tu gdungasagu / /'jig rten pha rol tu yang nā ra kaḥkru ra ba rjaḥ/ /sha ra ṇa ga ma na pu n+ya pābye shikṣu pa dā dzā mi bzad dmyal ba'i me yis bsregasarngu/ /skyabs 'gro'i bsod nams dang ni bslab pa'i gnas dag thob pra bha ba ti na tu de te duḥkha dā haḥ ka dā tsita/ / dha na nā mā sa rnams kyi/ /lus la nam yang sdug bsngal dag gis sreg pa'i mthu yod min/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' (snyeni nor mu drurnye nā go byudma hu bārnya baḥ/ /pha ṇa rahpho dzwa lā lo ka ka li ta zhes pa'i/ /klu ni gnyen mang ldan pa byung / /gdengs ka'i rin cen 67rab 'bar gyir7/ /snang bas pūsgo ba sa raḥ/ /pa pā tā harni shaṃ ta gya bha ba ṣpe tapta ba lu kā/ /ya sngon med nyin mor dābyas/ /de yi khang par nyin mtshan du/ /bye tshan dag ni babs zhe/7gyur te/ /gang lnga ge 6 bhu dzee gā mā ghā tī pra tā pa bya tsā bha ba ta/ /ka dā tsikhru dha no nā ma pu traḥgis lag 'gro rnams kyi lus/ /gdung ba drag pos nyen ⑫ par gyur/ /nor bzang zhes bya gces pa'i bu/ /pratstsha hūṃ pri yaḥ/ /su ku mā raḥpra kṛ bye pa bā lu kā pa ri rpā ḍi taḥ/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis rab gzhon pa/ /bye mas yongs su gzer gyur pas/ /nam zhig de la rab tu dris/ /kasma da ma ni yanta te bā pa te tapta bā lu kā/ /mand+ra mū la pra yo ge na ke yab gcig ⑪bye ma tsha ba 'dis/ /bdag cag ci slad gdung bar byed/ /sngags dang rtsa ba'i sbyor ba dag /ṣpe ya mu pa shā mya ti/ /asma da bhya bye kāḥke tsi dasmattha tya ba rāḥpa ci yis nye bar zhi bar 'gyuratuste/ /'ga' zhig bdag las lhag pa dang / /gzhan ni bdag las dman pa 95—723

re / /nā gāḥsarnyi sa mu dresmin duḥkhāṭwā ba ya me ba ṣpe/ /i ti thraṣṭaḥs pu tre yi—/ /klu ni ① rgya mtsho 'di na gnas/ /yu nyid sdug bsngal gyis gzir ci/ /zhes pa bu yis dris de la/ /ṇa ta mu bā tsa ma hā ma tiḥ/ /ya thā n+ya pha ṇi na pu tradhand+ra dzñā na ta thā ba yo/ /blo gros chen po des smras bu/ /ji ltar gdengs can gzhan gyi dzuchos/ /shes pa de ltar yu cag min/ /dhambi pa de sha shuddhā dzā shaddhā rmā sa tya bā di rmā/ /u pa tā po bha ba hye ba na chos kyi nyer bstan gyis dag pa/ /zhi zhing bden par smra rnams la/ /nges par nye bar gdung gyur pa/ /sha rī ro na mā na saḥ/ /na tā na smṛ sha ti saṃ tā paḥpurgya ratna tro yo lus la ma yin yid la'ang min/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs zhes pa/ /skyabs 'os bsod nams dkon bu dhwaḥ/ /ye budhe dhand+ra saṃ ghā khye sha ra bye sha ra khaṃ ga tāḥ/ /shi kṣa pa cog 1ni/ /gsum la skyabs song mkhas pa gang / /de la yongs gdung reg mi byed/ /gang gis nyon dā n+ya bābhā ni kle sha pra sha ma nā ni maḥ/ /te ṣā ma mṛ ta sighā rmā mongs rab zhi ba'i/ /bslab pa'i gnas rnams thob gyur cing / /bdud rtsis bran pa de dag la/ /sdig pā pa tā pa bha yo ku taḥ/ /shā bast+ya māsnyi bhag bān dzi no dze ta ba nā shu dang bya'ajigs pa gang la spyoda'u/ /shākya thub pa 'jig rten gyestso / /nyon mongs thams cad rab zhi'i yaḥrka/ /lo ke shākya mu niḥsattha kli sha pra sha ma bāndha baḥ/ /u pa de shaṃ shu gnyen—/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal gnas pa/ /mnyan yod na ni bcom ldan yod/ /snying rje zla ba'i 'od ni ba haiḥ satwa shu byerdza gattha ye/ / ka ru ṇa kau mu dī su ti ra mṛ bskyed de/ /sems dpa' ltar dkar man ngag gis⑦/ /'od zer tshogs kyis 'gro gsum du/ /bdud tai so bhe bste ti/ /dumbi bhā tā na rakṣurnyi pā pya shi kṣa pa dā ni ya/ /rtsi'i char pa mngon par 'babs3 / /gang zhig rnam par ma thul bas/ /babeeb pa'i gnas thob mi srung ba/ /tī pra tā sa ma yaste ྾ na ra ke ṣṭa kṣa ya kṣa yaḥ/ /i ti shu tā pi turpā kyi de dag dmyal bar mi bzad pas/ /gdab pa ⑨drag pos brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa pha dang ma yi yang / /95—724

dza na tyābyu bhu dzee ga maḥ/ /ā dā ya di bya puṣṭha ṇi pu rgya dze ta ba rna ya tshig dag thos nas lag 'gro ni/ /me tog mchog dag yongs bzung 77nas/ /dag pa'i rgyal byed tshal du yo—/ /su ga ta shra ma mā sā rya dhadzre shra ba ṇa saṃ ga hūṃ / /da darsha song / /chog shes sgor ni mngon phyogs des/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas phyin te/ /der ni chos parṣa rda ta tpa sa sarnyo ṣa mu khyorlu khaḥ/ / ta tā pa shya dzhai 8 kānta ba dag nyan pa la/ /tshogs pa'i 'khor dag mthong bar gyur67 / /bzhin ras mdzes shing spyan yangs pa/ /da rna dīrgha lo tsa rna/ /pūrjend+ra padma ba na yo ri ba mo ṭī su kha pra rda/ /zla ba nya dang pad tshal dag /'grogs pa bzhin du bde ster ba'i/ /rgyal ba der ni mthong bar gyur/ /u pa de sha kṛ tā byakta ma dha re shā pa rī kṛ tī / / ta rdza yanta mi nye bar ston byed mchu yis ni/ /chags ldan rnams kyi dmar ba nyid/ /rab rgyas dman pa nyid byas shing / /bo྾āoṃ rā ga brga gya rakta tsā/ /ni rā bha ra shā khā bā rgya kaṇḍi pā sha bi bhū gsal bar zil gyis gnon pa bzhin/ /rgyan dang bral ba'i mdzes sdug gis/ /rna ba'i zhags pa rab ṣi tai/ /darsha yarnye mi bo྾st+ri ni rā ba ra ṇa shu n+ya hūṃ/ /dhand+ra dī pa brgyan cing / /sgrib pa dang bral stong pa nyid/ /rab tu rgyas pa ston byepa bzhin/ /dpung pa chos kyi pyaka ro ba byu bi bhā rṇa dā na sho bhi to/ / pra bhā ba bha ba nastasgo shā gnyis 'thung lag⑪ /sbyin pas mdzes pa rnam par 'dzin/ /nus mthu'i khang pa dag gi ni/ /ka ba ta kumbha ma yā bi ba/ /di sharnye tsa ra ṇa tshwa yī ṭī ba rā bha ra rde bhū pa/ /laddhā pra gser gyi rang bzhin bzhin/ /chos gos rgyan dang ldan pa yis/ /zhabs kyi grib ma spro byed pa/ /sa gzhi sgo bye bi hi tā mi ba rā dzre bee taiḥ / / de hi kārnyi bi tā ṣpe na rtogs pa thob pa la/ /padma'i (zhwa grogs rnams kyis bsgrubs bzhin/ /lus kyi thumadzes pa rgyas pa ni/ /na ya nā mṛ ta babhā ṇa/ /saṃ sā ra ga ta saṃ tā pa bā ra yarnyi pa spyan gyi ④bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas/ /dam pa rnams kyis 'u'akhor ba yi/ /mya ngan yongs gdung 95—725

tā mi pa/ /tai bee lo kyai ba tatyā dza saṃ tā paṃ nā ga nanda naḥ/ /sazlutī bzlog pa bzhin/ /de mthong nyid na klu yi bu/ /yongs su gdung ba btang bar gyura'/ /bdag nyid do ṣa sha ma rna darsha āoṃ nyi ma hātpa ram̐/ / pra ṇa nā ma pa ti tīṇḍi che rnams mthong ba nyid/ /gdung ba'i skyon kun zhi bar byed/ /snyim pa me tog gis gang ba/ /de la saṃ pūṇḍi ku su māñdza liḥ/ /tatyā da padma spasgo na sa ryaḥshī tal tī ga taḥ/ /kṛ gtor nas des phyag btsala'asna/ /de yi zhabs pad reg pa yis/ /'phral la bsel ba nyid du gyur/ /de tī bha ga ba taḥpā su ga ta shi kṣa pa dā ni saḥ/ /tsakre kṛ hūṃñdza lista su yā nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ni/ /bslab pa'i gnas thob mkhas pa des/ /thal mo sbyar nas de la ni/ /ji babyā bā dhi bā sa rmā/ /tai ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān e ka sri bā bye bā sa nā/ /srid 'tsho bar lhag gnas byas/ /de la bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /thams cad rjes su gzung ①bya la/ /a nu gā bye 6 sarbe 6 yā badzdza banda yu bye te/ /i kyughā pra rja ya thra hye gcig nyid ④kho na'i lhag gnas ni/ /ji srid 'tsho ba ji ltar 'os/ /gus la dgyes pas de brjod nas/ /bha ga bādma ta tro rya taḥ/ /sha ṣpeḥpra taste saṃ kadzee sgo gi naḥpa ri pū de la brtson pas bcom ldan dege/ /gdengs can rnam par brtag pa ni/ /yongs rdzogs mdzad cing dal ra yan/ /kra me ṇa gatstsha tasta su bhigru saṃ ghā gra yā yi naḥ/ /pra bhā bāji da gyis chas/ /dge slong tshogs kyis ⑥ sna drangs nas/ /rim gyis byon pa de la ni/ /klu yi ⑦mthu las ④dhe nā gaḥ swa rga sho hūṃ pa de pa de / / te ma ra trī shu sha ba lāndi gnas dang gnas/ /mtho ris lta bur mdzes pa bsgrubs⑨/ /rin chen gser 'od bkra ba yi/ /mchog byadmo na ma no ha rān/ /sgo ga pa saṃ gra ha bya gra dā sa dā sbo ga ṇa gi skyed tshal mdzes pa dang / /longs spyod 'dzin pas byel ⑩ba yis/ /'bangs dang 'bangs mo'i tshogs thra tān/ /kaspru ra tsanda no dā ra hā ra pā lo ba byu ṣi tān/ /sthā ṣpe sthā de rgyas dang / /ga bur tsan dan rgya che yi/ /do shal 'phyang bas brgyan pa yis(7/ /gnas dang gnas su 95—726

bha ga wa taḥs bi hā rā na kā ra yatpa/ /ka landa ka ni pā sā khye pāpta bee na gtsug lag khang / /bcom ldan 'das la de yis byas/ /de nas ka lan da ka'i gnas/ /zhes pa 'od pa na ta taḥ/ /sa saza sgo ga saṃ bhā rirbha ga banta ma pū dza yata/ /te ma'i tshal du phyin/ /de yi ① longs spyod tshogs kun gyes/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas/ /der na mā pa tro ya ta tu sa saṃ ghaḥsu ga to ñtsi taḥ/ /u tse bismi ta mā nasdo hā ni de yis zla gsum du/ /dge 'dun dang bcas bde gshegs mchod/ /do shal rin chen 'od kyis bskor/ /ra ratna shu kaimbi taḥ/ /e ṣa kalpa sha ta ma tsū taḥpha ṇḍi sarba sgo ga su ya mtshan kun dga' ldan la gsungs/ /gdengs can 'di ni bskal pa brgyar mi g.yo/ /bde ba'i longs kha bhāgha bi 6 te/ /bo bye ma pya pa ra dzadma ni sgu ṭī ki ba su pra ṇi nyi taḥka spyod kun gyi snod du gyur2sna/ /'on kyang skye ba gzhan la byang chub kyang / /rab tu 'bad pas gsal bar ri 6 ti/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee byed par gyur3/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag nā ga ku mā rā ba dā rna ṣa ྾ ta maḥpalla baḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las klu gzhon nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu pa'o// //rū dha mya hasta pa ta to pi ni byeḥpra yā ti lasmro swa yo bha ba na me ti bi blun po'i lag tu gter dag lhung yang rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rnam dag blo ldan khyim du dpal ni shu ddhā bu dzhai ཿ / / dā ri dra tī bra nyi mi rā pa ha ra ཿ pra kā rma rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu dam pa ④rnams kyis yid ni (trerab tu dang ba dag /dbul ba'i purja bi byu ṣa ṇa ma ṇirma na saḥpra pā daḥ/ /shā pasbya swaste ko nā ma brahma ṇi nirbha rab rib mi bzad 'phrog pa'i rgyan gyi nor bu yin/ /mnyan yod du sngon bram ze ni/ /nor med bkra shis naḥpu ra/ /a shi shri yaskṛ sha pha lā ma sha tyā kṛ ṣi dzre bi rmā/ /sasnye 2 zhes bya ba/ /'tsho ba bral bas 'tsho ba'i thabs/ /'bras bu chung ba'i zhing las 63brten/ /zhing las la 95—727

kand+ra ni ra taḥshrī ta bā tā ta pakṣa taḥ/ /tsakā ra ha la kubyā la bhā ra bā chags grang ba dang / /rlung dang tsha bas nyen pa des/ /thong ba dang ni tog ①/rtse'i khur/ /khyer zhing tī ga tā gtai/ /sa ka dā tsitpa mā yādhe shā ba keḥs nyi tai pa thi/ /dzi 'ong dang 'gro ba byas/ /nam zhig chung ma dang bcas de'i2/ /lam du rgyal ba nyan thos dang / /lhan na dzā yā sa kho dṛ ṣṭa pra sā rda sa ha sa ya yo/ /pra panda ba da rmā bi rja cig byon pa mthong gyur nas/ /'phral la rab tu dang bar gyur/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams yongs zad las/ /sa dza gā da bi tsinta yan/ /dā ri dru duḥkha ma sa rmā dā na pu 5 pa ri dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /sems shing ( )de yis chung ma ni/ /rab dang bzhin ldan la kṣa yāta/ /ā bā sgyu me ṣa bha ga ban biṇḍa ke nā pi nartsi taḥ/ /ku ta smras pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni 5yu cag gis/ /rdog gcig gis kyang ma mchod las/ /bsod nams pu ju ṣa rde mā sthā dha na sadzadhi rā ba yo/ /jo ba hye ba mṛ to lo ke naṣṭa zong gis thob 6 pa'i nor/ /phun tshogs yu la ga la 'ong / /shi ba gson nyid 'jig rten na/ /grags tīrbhebee padma de/ /na sa dzre bo na niñdzu baḥsho bha te nindha no dza naḥ/ /rto nasbyo pa nyams pa shi ba nyid/ /nor med skye bo mdzes pa ni/ /gson la ma yin gshin la min/ /nor rigs ti sgo na bi byā dha na ndhasgo dha rna ya shaḥ/ /kirnya ṣpe na bi tī nā dzñā yādzñā nor ni rig 3/pa ste/ /nor chos nor ni grags pa yin/ /nor gyis dman zhing bslangs pa yis 'tsho bheñdzu tairgya ṇiḥ/ /pa ro pā kā rā rji bhū taiḥginda ri dra gya saṅga ṇiḥ/ /ba'i yon tan rnams kyis sheci/ /gzhan gyi nye mkhor gegyur pa yis/ /dbul po'i yon tan dam pas ci/ /kle shādzeezlu ri ka gye ba ma ṇi kāñtsa na byu ṣa ṇiḥ/ /da ri dro dā ri bye pra tha khur dub ba la ① ༄nor bu yis/ /gser rgyan ngal dub don gyis bzhin/ /dbul po sbyin pa dag dang bral sha ti pu na dī na bi ra hā da da ri draḥ pā pādma bha ba ti dha na le sthā bas beer yang dbul por rab tu 'dzud31/ /dbul po nor la chags pas gzhan dbang sdig pa'i bdag 95 ——728

pa ra ba shaḥ/ /da ri dru satshwa se mṛ ta i ti na tsā draste bi ma tir da ri dra nyid ①dag tu 'gyuradu/ /dbul po gyedabugs dang bcas kyang shi zhes 'di la khyad par blo gros med/ /gye bai tā ni dza dza na thi tī no da sha di shaḥ/ /a bhyatsu yā baḥsu ga dbul po phyogs bcu 'di dag rang gi khyeskye bo dag gis dman pa bzhin/ /de slad dman la mnyes gshin tai ta smradṛ pa ṇa batpa lo/ /a na rā bye ta buddhā rmā muddhā dzñā ku sha pa'i—/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas mnyes par ma byas pa'i/ /rmongs la dge ba lo ku taḥ/ /e ṣa padma da khā shākṣaḥkṣi pa tyā pand+ra bāndha baḥ/ /ya tro ya tug la yod/ /padma'i 'dab ma lta bu'i spyan/ /phongs pa'i gnyen 'dis gang gang du/ /spyan ni 'phangs dri shaṃ dzā ṣpe ta tpa ta tā shra ya shri yaḥ/ /i ti pa kyurba caḥshu tā zwahma pa de dang der/ /dpal ni gnas pa dag ⑤gis shes/ /de skad bdag po'i tshig thos nas/ /khyim du sthā pā da ra kṛ he/ /shu tsi pra dhī ta bi da dhe sgo byo bha ga ba taḥkṛ te/ /gus byas (skyobram ze mos/ /zas ni gtsang mar sbyar ba dag /bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du bsgrubs/ /bha ga bān pi sa rba dzhasta yo dzñā tā sa mbi hi tai / / pra ṇa yā rja bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /de dag bsam pa yongs mkhyan tshinas/ /gus pas ru7gsol ba na yā tsakre ta gya pū dzā pra ti gra haṃ/ /byakta dā ri dru duḥ kha su bhū 'debs pa de'i/ /mchod pa dag ni blang bar mdzad/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rab bsal pa/ /bdag yasma bi bha bobye baḥ/ /tsa kā ra dzi na pū dzādhe pra ṇi dhwa na mi ti dī dzaḥ/ /la 'byor pa 'byung gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam gnyis skyes kyis/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i mjug tu byas/ /a tha ga tā ni dzee kṣe tram̐ bi praḥs pya ya rpā kurān/ /sarpā na pa shyakau baṭwān sa de nas bram ze rang zhing ( padu/ /song bas 'bru nas myu gu ni/ /thams cad gser du mthong gyur nas/ /ha sā tyakta durga tiḥ/ / ta gya pu 5 sa mudhū tai dri ṭī he ma ma tī pa 'phral la nyid du dbul ba btang / /sa yi bdag po gsal rgyal gyis/ /de yi bsod nams las 'khrungs 95—729

ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī ka rṣa kā ba dā byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las zhing pa'i rtogs pa brjod na me ka ṣakhyu maḥpabee waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //uṭwā yu sgoṇḍi ja na kā na na sambi be she dzā ta: mju ti ma yaḥpu lug gis gang bar gyur pa'i skye bo'i nags tshal gnas dag tu/ /lang tshos long zhing bde ba la 'os ru ṣaḥs e kaḥ/ /ya sngandha yo ba na su kho tsi ta tsā ru be sha bee rā gya mā di mdzes pa'i chas ldan tshe/ /dben pas chags bral zhi zhing dag pa gang la rab byin pa/ /skyes bu de nyid sha ti shārnyi si tai bi bee kaḥ/ /n+ya gro dha ru tsi rā rā ma bi hā ri ṇi dzi ṣpe pu gcig pu ya mtshan rang bzhin rab hūṃtshotu skyes/ /rgyal ba sngon tshe n+ya gro dha'i/ /kun dga' ra ba mdzes par rā / /bā rā ṇasde kṛ ha pa tiḥsu pra busgye bhe bye bha bta/ /tyā go pa sgo bzhugs—/ / bā rā ṇa sīr snyekhyim bdag ni/ /legs par rab sad ces pa byung / /nor ni rgyas pa ga saṃ bhā ra bi bhū ṣi ta dha no da yaḥ/ /e shwarya yaḥku bee rā su kau gtong ba dang / /longs spyod tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /gang gi —snadabang phyug lus ngan bu4/ /sha lī dzwa n+ya mbi la yata/ / sa sattha su kha sadzasto nind+ra tuḥpu tra tsinta mdzod na gnas pa'ang zum par byed/ /bde ba thams cad phun tshogs te/ /bud demed bu yi bsam pa yā—/ /pa re santa pa mā ye de niḥsha lya ka su sadza daḥ/ /haṃ sho ka shi yis—/ /mchog tu yang dag gdung ba thob/ /phun tshogs su yi zug rngu min/ /de yi 6bsam pa )7khi sa nta bye bā rnya bā ba ntu ba tpa lo/ / u tsi re bee sa kta nta ta ñtsiddhā 'phos pa yis/ /yun ring yid 'khrugs deganyen rnams kyis/ /gnyen la gnyen ni ( mya ngan gyi ⑩/ /me batta mā na sāḥ/ /llī bo tsi tī kṛ ha pa te na tsidzñā kartu marta se/ /yis rab gdungs ⑪de la smras/ /khyem bdag ma ning la 'os pa'i/ /bsam pa bya bar mi rigs so/ /95—731

/rang las gzhan dbang 'jig rten 'di(she// /nges par g.yo ba med pa la/ /spru tai ka ro ti puṇḍa nyi ha ra nyi harnyi ka su kaḥ/ /swa kasgro pa na tai pā pya tu su yis su yi brtan pa dang / /rgyas dang 'phrog dang 'joms par byed/ /rang las nye ba 6 nyid thob nas/ /6 tya n+ya gya mugha dhī/ /swa lā lā la ba mā swā rya shwe ba shuṣka gya tsand+ra ṇaḥ/ /dṛkṣaḥblo gros blun po gzhan la tshim/ /rang gi kha chu'i cha myangs nas/ /khye ni pags pa skam la bzhin/ /shing pu tā rba daḥsum̐ sā mi tya tasbo rṣa bhā ṣi tai/ /dā ḍū shaktaḥs nā kā le pa tra gi 7bu nor skyes bu la/ /ster zhes 'di ni rmongs pa'i gtam/ /'dab ma tsam yang dus min du/ /de mā tu ma bi swa yo/ /ta da byeṣṭha tre de babye ta pū dzā lubhaḥka ro ti tata/ /pūṇḍi nyid rang la sbyin nus med/ /gal te de ni byen rlob lhas/ /mchod pa la sa hā ra pū dzā yī ki swa yi sre dza ti nādma naḥ/ /pāpta bye sthā bya ya di bā ghu shā kṣa nyid rang gis mchod pa ni/ /yo byad rdzogs pa cis mi spro/ /srin bu'i rjes ni yi ge bzhin/ /gang yang ra pa do pa oṃ/ /kā ka tā li yā sasthā daste darghaṃ ma n+ya te dza naḥ/ /pāpta bye yatpa la thob bya thob pa na/ /bya rog ta la ltar brjod pas/ /skye bo de yis byin par sems/ /gang zhig thob bya de pa ri ṣpe ba sra ya mu pa tsi lta sgo ga bha gī sa tasminde te min pa 'thob ma yin/ /gang zhig gang gis rang nyid kyis bsags longs spyod skal ldan de la ni/ /'di ṣpe taskṛ ta mi ti mu pā ma n+ya te mubha
