pā da pārnyi ldan pa'i gnyen gyis rab 'bad de/ /bskul nas gcig pu gsang ba yis/ /rkang 'thung gi ni drung du ke / /sa ku lbo ra sa mā dā ya n+ya gro dha ta ru ma bhya bhāta/ /pū dzā dzee mū la bha te song / /sta re brdung ②nas de yis ni/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing la smras/ /mchod pa'am rtsa ba gcod pa la/ /bā saljo haṃ tā mu sā ga taḥ/ /pu tu pra dā hūṃ pū dzabye ka ri tyā mya kṛ tī pa reḥ/ /ngas ①ni chas nas khyod can 'ongs④/ /bu dag sbyin na khyod la bdag /gzhan gyis ma byas mchod pa byed/ /na bye tā ma n+ya thāsbyi tā da ddhā pe ṣṭa yā mya haṃ / / i ti ta dwa tsa rnam pa gzhan du khyod bdag gis/ /bcad bsregs btags la chu bor 'phangs rngoke/ /zhes pa de yi tshig na shu tā de ba tā thra kṣa bā pi dī/ / sa ha se ba bha yodrighā kadza mā thos nas/ /lha ni shing la gnas pa dag /'phral la 'jigs pas 'khrugs gyur te/ /'dar bar byed nā bya tsinta yata/ /na ma yā ka bye tsikhru nubeerghaṃ bā datta mitstsha yā/ /dza cing rab bsams pa/ /'dod pa'i bu'am nor dag ni/ /bdag gis su la'ang sbyin spyopa med/ /rang 95 — 733

kwa tsita gatstsha tya bye mu khāḥ/ /te tram̐ ba bye pra lī yadhe ha tha rūrjaḥkha ra 'ga' zhig kha ni 'og phyogs gyur/ /g.yo rmongs mi bsrun ①brtul zhugs kyis/ /gzhan ni de nyid na bra taiḥ/ /ga tā nu ga nyi ka te na pra sedhi sha ra rto dza naḥ/ /sabyesti pa ri rab chags/ /song ba'i rjes su 'gro nyid kyis/ /skye bo grags pa la ston ②rnams/ /gdung ba thams hā rā ya mo dzha sthā me dhwa ba nyi / / usgre dzi tā pya haṃ tī bra dza ṣpe cad gzhom pa'i slad/ /rmongs pa bdag cag ④nyid du rgyug /skye bo blo gros mi gzo dubs/ /mi bzad nā kyu ta budhi nā/ /ta zu tyahūṃ na sha kyo mi taṅga ṇa brdzi ta sha yā/ /brnya kle gtses par gyur kyang bdag /bsam pa de yi yon tan la/ /chags pas shing ni gtong mi nus/ /dri la shaṃ bi sha ti ma dhu paḥpaṅga dza garnya lubhaḥpaṃ kā lta ka ga ṇa ya nyi bi sā chags pa'i bung ba 'dam skyes 'ching ⑤ba'i nyon mongs ldan par 'jug /pad rtsa'i ro myang ngang pa nyid ni swā da na ṣpe ba haṃ saḥ/ /shī tārtabya tya dza ti na dza naḥpā pa rka dhū ma dhū dzee 'dam gyi 'jigs pa rtsi mi byed/ /grang bas gzir ba'i skye bo du bas 'khrugs pa'i me ni yongs ④mi 'dor/ /tasmisdo ṣe sa ki la sa ha te ya su ye no pa yo gaḥ/ /ta smradṛkṣa bi yo garghaṃ tā gang la gang zhig nyer mkho de la de yi ④skyon ni nges par bzod⑧/ /de beed shing bral gdung ba las /tu marta si rmā bi sgo/ /sha rī ra tyā ga sa dṛ shaḥsba na tyā go hi de khyab bdag bdag ni bskyab par 'os/ /gang phyir lus can rnams kyi gnas/ /gtong ba lus ni gtong hi dzñā/ /abee ta pra ṇa ye ṣpe ti po lo mā ra masta yā/ /pu tu dang ⑨mtshungs/ /zhes pa de yi ⑩'bad pa yis/ /gsol gdab ⑪po lo mā dga' bas/ /khyim bdag khā sgo kṛ ha pa teḥkasthā yatta ma tsinta yata/ /a hūṃ ta re dṛ tu sha tūrde gis ni bu thob ⑫pa'i/ /las kyi dbang ni yang dag bsams/ /skabs der lha min dgra bo yis/ /ba pu tu tri piṣṭa ye/ /su ma tind+ra ma saṃ pāpta sgo ti kā lam̐ bya lo ka yata/ /mā skabs ⑫gsum pa yi lha yi bu/ /blo bzang zhes pa lhung ba yiske/ /dus la bab pa mthong gyur te/ /mi 95—735

lāsthā na mu pā ya yo kha la na ti kli ṣṭi tī rta na sa ta tshwa yā pā du ra bsrun huṣpel btud grags pa nyams pa bzhin du 'phreng (0ba dri ma gecan gyur cing / /dman gyur slong ba bhūtta maḥpa ri tsi tā yāsnyo ba de byo da ye/ /swa daḥpu 5 pa ri kṣa ye na ba bzhin du mdzes pa mun pa dag dang yongs 'dris byung bar gyur/ /bsod nams yongs su zad las gnod i bā pā ya kra kā rāspa rda ta snga khyu da ra ti sna pā ta pi shu ṇa sa dzwa pas bzhin du rdul gyis kyang ni gnas dag byas/ /zhe sdang skyon bcas blo bzhin de ni lhung ba gsal byed ṣa do ṣe ba byeḥ/ /gu ṇi naḥsu pra budha mya dṛ shrī bye pra thi ta shri yaḥ/ /su dga' ba min par gyur/ /legs par rab sang yon tan can/ /sa la dpal ldan grags pa yis/ /blo ma teḥpu tu tā me hi ta mityā ha su re shwa raḥ/ /so bra bītta tra rmā kā le shāstuḥshākya bzang bu nyid du song zhes/ /de la lha yi (gebadag pos smras/ /des smras ston pa shākya thub/ /bla med rgya mu ṣpeḥpu raḥ/ /shakta snga nutta ro dā ra dhand+ra tsakra pra brta ṣpe/ /pra bra che chos kyi (peni/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor mdzad pa'i/ /mdun du dus der gal te bdag /rab tu dzñā sa da nā ya two ya di saṃ bo dha yi 6 pi/ /ta da haṃ su pra budhe su bra dzā mi bhū byung ba 'dzin pa la/ /khyod kyis yang dag rtogs byed na/ /sa la legs par rab sad kyi/ /bu nyid du bi pu tu hūṃ/ /i rkyukta de ba pu tre ṇa sha kre khosto ta the ti tsa/ /rjotasmṛtasmradā ni bdag gis 'gro/ /lha yi bu yis 'di brjod las/ /brgya byin de bzhin zhes smras tshe/ /rjes gnang de rnyepta statpa sgyu ཿku kṣi mā bi shata/ /de ba tā swa pa da ga tā su pra budzha ni de nas 'phos/ /de yi chung ma'i dku ru zhugs/ /lha ni rang gi gnas song ste/ /legs par rab ma bhā ṣatra/ /pra bra dzñā bhe ra ta sā sgo bha bi 6 ti su tasta ba/ /i ti sad de la 0smras/ /rab tu 'byung bel mngon dga'i bu/ /dge ba khyod la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa shu tā kṛ ha pa tiḥpra hriṣṭaḥpra ya yo kṛ haṃ/ /pra bra dzhai bā ra yi sgyu mi pu tu thos nas khyim bdag ni/ /rab tu mgu nas khyim song ste/ /bu ni rab tu 'byung ba dag /bdag gis 95 736

gye ti bi tsinta yata/ /tataḥkā le na tatpasnri la li tā nā ma bā la kai/ /sabye ga bzlog par bya zhes bsams/ /de nas dus kyis de yi ni/ /chung ma rol pa ma zhes la/ /yan lag lakṣa rdo bee ta ma sru ta ka na ka dha tai/ / sattha ratna ma yo ta su thams cad mtshan nyid ldan/ /byes pa gser 'od can de bcasanya/ /de skyes nyid ni khurin chen ni/ /dzā te sri ba bya dzā ya ta / / sgo tram̐ mu sto mi bābyarya sprutta oṃ su kṛ kun gyi ⑦rang bzhin gdugs 'khrungs te/ /legs byas dpal ni bla med dang / /ngo mtshar gzugs dang ta shri yaḥ/ /sa ya sho dā bhi dha no bhūrya sho bṛdhyā pi tuḥpa re/ /bee ldan pa bzhin/ /mchog tu pha yis thugrags 'phel bas/ /rig ⑤pa sgyu rtsal 'byor pa rnams/ /tshogs byā ka khā bhe byu tī dzā sa mā ga ma kṛ ho pa maḥ/ /de ba tā ba tsa āoṃ smṛ tā pra bra bye pa'i khang pa lta bu stenya/ /grags sbyin zhes ni bya bar gyur/ /lha yi tshig ni dran gyur nas/ /de ni rab tu shaṃ ki taḥbi tā/ /ta gya tsa kre kṛ ha pu ra dā ra go pu ra rakṣa khaṃ/ /a thā bye byung dogs te/ /grong dang khang pa grong khyer gyi⑦ / /sgo rnams pha yis bsrung bar hūṃbyas/ /de nas brgya ta sa sha kre ṇa smra ri dzaḥpūttha sambi dā/ /ba bhū ba sha masaṃ biktaḥpra byin mngon phyogs te/ /sngon gyi 'gro ba brtan po7par byas/ /zhi bas dran pa rab byung la/ /mngon bra dzñā bhi mu khā da raḥ/ /sa ka da tshisdo dzorlu rna ra thā rū bhāḥsha nairba dzan/ /par phyogs shing gus par gyur/ /nam zhig rang gi ⑫skyed tshal du/ /dal gyis shing rta zhon 'gro des/ /da darsha dzi na mā yā rnye bha ga brnya ya dṛtstsha yā/ /dzdza da ya su kha saṃ sparsha bcom ldan rgyal ba ji zhig ltar/ /byon pa dag ni mthong bar gyur/ /snying la bde bas yang dag reg /bstedhe pra sha mā mṛ tai/ /tai bi lo kye ba sa ha pā ra thā da ba ta tā ra saḥ/ /rab zhi bdud rtsi'i char 'babs 17pa/ /de mthong nyid na 'phral la ni/ /shing rta dag las de yis babs//tai j-i da kṣi ṇi kṛ tya tatyā da na li na dwa yo/ /sa ba bande pra pā dādzra dṛ de la bskor ba gsum byas te/ /de yis ⑫ zhabs pad zung dag la/ /dang bas brlan pa de yis 7ni/ /95—737

sha te nā ba lo ki taḥ/ /bha ga ba rnyi pra ṇa myu tha pra sa.oṃ ta da nu spyan gyis gzigs pa des phyag btsal①/ /de nas rab dang bcom ldan la/ /rab btud de yi rjes rnye ya/ /dza gā ma ni dza mudmā rna sa ta me ba bi tsadha yata/ /rbhakṣu ma shwa dzi gnang gis/ /de nyid rnam par sems shing ①de/ /rang gi skyed mos tshal du song / /de nas bcom ldan lta shā ha bha ga bān na tha sa smi taḥ/ /e ṣernyi ke me rā tro ku mā raḥpra bra 'dzum ldan pas/ /dge slong rta thul la gsungs pa/ /bdag gi drung du gzhon nu 'di/ /mtshan mo rab dzi 6 ti / / i kyu ghā swa pa rda yā te su ga te sa ha bhi kyu tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs bde gshegs rang gnas su/ /dge slong rnams dang lhan cig bhiḥ / /sha kra nimbi ta ma dākṣi ta ku mā rāḥsdi ka la ba re/ /pū ya gshegs—/ /brgya byen gyis sprul bud med lus/ /gzhon nu yis ni mthong gyur te/ /brnags ①shing parlu ṣi tai kle da sī daskṛ mi ku lā ku la/ /sa dṛṣṭha sha ba mudmā ṣpe pobye gaḥrdul la mi gtsang ba/ /srin bu'i tshogs kyis 'khrugs shing gnas/ /skyed mos tshal gyi ro mthong nas/ /sa ma tsinta ya ta / /bi kā ra e ba tā ru bye ru pa lā ba rgya kānta chags bral ldan pa des bsam ④pa/ /dar bab gzugs ni mdzes pa dang / /sdug pa rnam par 'gyur ba yaḥ / /tsand+ra mā sa sa mu hā nā mi yi sā pra kṛ tirjo rja/ /lo khā lo tsa nyid / /pags pa sha tshogs mi rnams kyis⑤/ /rang bzhin de ni 'di nyid do/ /mig dag g.yo zhing nu na mumbi ṣadku tsa yu gaḥko ṣe sha shī ka tī ṣā me tattanda ba yo ba no da ya la pasthā ma zung ni rab rgyas ri bong can gyi 'od kyi mdzod/ /lus de lang tsho gsar pa dar bab mdzes sdug 'phro ba bye ga bye ba buḥ/ /yā haṃ pū ti ba sā ba pe ka pi ka la kla myata kṛ mi bar bgrang ba 'di dag ni/ /rul ba'i brlan gyis nges bran 'khrugs shing dman pa'i srin bu rnams kyis byā ku la kli nda klo ma ya kṛ bee tī ṇḍi sa ka la llī hā nt+ra ni rya nt+ra dkrigs—/ /ngan zhing (6༄rab mang bshang bas bsgos shing mtha' dag rgyu mchin (pe'akhrul 'khor med nyid 95 — —738

tai—/ /asmibye ga bi mo ha hā ri ta dṛ shaḥsarde ga saṃ gotpa bee saṃ lī nāsta gyur—/ /yan lag thams cad 'grogs par spro ba 'di la chags shing rmongs pas mig phrogs shing / /nu na maṇḍa le ha ta dhi yaḥ pra pūḥpa dzā nidṛ tai/ /yasma de ṣa ga ta ma'i dkyil 'khor la chags blo gros nyams pas mchog tu bde ba thob gyur pa/ /gang las wa skyes 'di ni spyo haḥka ba la ṣpe bai mu khya ba krā na naḥkle da mo da bi ṣā da kyu ṇi ta ma ti chags bral bza' ba dag las phyir phyogs bzhin 'khyog ①cing / /mi gtsang dri nga dag gis yid byung blo rdu ri ga to rdza bu kaḥ/ /i ti pañtsirgyu saṃ dzā targyu shwe bai rā gya bā gros rmus ⑤phyin ring du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsams ①chags bral bag chags ni/ /sbas pa yang dag sa naḥ/ /dza gā modmā na bi mu khaḥs sha ṣperti dza mandi re/ /a ṭwā ta rgyas gyur te/ /de ni skyed tshal las phyir phyogs/ /rang gi khang par dal gyis song / /skabs der nyin re di na smra ni khirjo bhūnd+ra sha madru khāḥ/ /bi ra saṃ lo ka bṛhūṃ tram̐ bi byed 'jig rten gyi④/ /spyod tshul ro bral mthong bas bzhin/ /skyo ⑤zhing rab zhir mngon phyogs te/ /lo kye ba di bā ka raḥ/ /a she ṣā yā sha pa ri tyā ga yo gyi pra sha me nyin par dag ni nyams par gyur⑥/ /ngal dub ma lus yongs gtong bar/ /'os pa rab zhir ⑦ 'gro yu ṣaḥ/ /sastsu ralnga lba ra dzu ṣaḥpra bra bye ba ra bee ra bhūta/ /lo 'dod cing / /thun mtshams mkha' yi gos dmar bsten/ /nyin mo rab tu byung bzhin gyur/ /nyi ma kotta ra pa rda yā te bhā no bhu ba na tsakṣu ṣi/ /bā sa ro pi pa ri tya bye srid pa'i mig dag ni/ /'jig rten pha rol gnas song tshe/ /'jig rten yongs btang nyin mo yang / /lo ka ta da nu go bha bta/ /ta taḥpra tya gra ti mi robye ga yo shaṃ dza gadzu ṣe/ /de yi rjes 'brang nyid du gyur/ /de nas 'gro bsten gsar pa yi'u/ /rab rib mya ngan sbyor ba dag /pra dī pa maṇḍa lā lo kaḥkṛ pa ye ba n+ya bā ra yata/ /a smin na ba sa sgron ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba yis/ /brtse bas ⑨bzhin du rab tu bzlog /skabs der ston pa rang nyid 95—739

ri shāstu ya sho da da ya yā swa yo/ /pu ra na byāḥpa ra pā re pābye sa mu ni—/ /grags sbyin dag la brtse ba yis/ /grong khyer klung 'gram pha rol tu/ /de 'thob ①beed du yang pā ya yo/ /ya sho de pi di nā ya sa tu la yā ka la yadru huḥ/ /saṃ sā dag gshegs/ /grags sbyin gyis kyang nyin par gyis/ /nyon mongs mtshungs pa yang yang du/ /'khor ba rā sā ra ta me ba shayā bha ba na mā bee shata/ /bi ṇa bī ṇa mṛ rda gā di bi no snying po med pa nyid/ /sems shing nyal ba'i khang par zhugs/ /gling bu rgyud mang rdza rnga sogs/ / rtse de nd+ra da ni za raḥ / / ta tā ba shyadma la khāḥ shra ma ni dā ni mbi li dga' la ④zhing gnyid log pa/ /mig zum rgyags pas 'khrugs pa yi/ /bud med rnams der de yis tāḥ—/ /bī rja bee n+yasta ba da nā sbo rda gādzre ta dorla tāḥ/ /kṣa ṇi ka mthong / /kha ni rgyud mang ①la bkod cing / /lag pa'i 'khri shing rdza rngar ④gtang / /bde ba skad cig tā su kha gye ba duḥkha dhyā na mu pa ga taḥ/ /bi lo kya shrasta ba da nāstu mṛ tā pa nyid kyis⑤/ /sdug bsngal bsam gtan la zhugs bzhin/ /gos ral shi ba bzhin du ni/ /g.yo med i ba ni: khāḥ/ /saṃ dzā tā bye ka bee rā gyaḥs tsi ram̐ sa ma tsinta yata/ /de dag mthong gyur nas/ /lhag par chags bral yang dag skyes/ /yun ring de yis yang dang bsams/ /a ho ba tā smimbi ṣa ye pa ryarnya bi ra pe ba re/ /e baṃ bi dhe ba byu kye ma yul ni 'di dag rnams/ /mjug tu mchog tu ro dang bral/ /bud med ces pa 'di lta la/ /nāsdi muddhā rmā ji sha mā da raḥ/ /bi byu dī la ṣi tā tyā su ma sakhru kha gha no da rmongs pa rnams ni mchog tu gus/ /mchog min bde ba'i sprin rgyas la/ /glog gi rtse dga' 'di dag yeske/ /suṭwā rmā tsa mṛ tā rmāñtsa ku྾ dzee kyu tsa baṃ khyu maḥ/ /shete kā tsi da sgo rnams—/ /gnyid log shi ba dag la yang / /rnam 'phrul gang na 'dzum gang na/ /'ga' zhig 'og tu kha mu khāe baṃ ba li tā thrakhye sgo tā suḥpa rā yā tā snge pi bi kā shi tā gya bi ba rā sarja ga bltas nyal zhing de yi rgyab ni gzhan du bzlog ste lhung / /gzhan yang gan kyal (7yan lag kun brkyangs ④ 95—740

muṭwā na tsā / /saṃ sā sakta mi bhakta mukta ka tsa rī kā kaidṛ te bā pa ra kha yi bu ga rnam par bye bar gyur/ /gzhan dag skra ni grol zhing dral bas phrag pa la chags bya rog babs pa bi bhā dme bha ba dzwa ni lbo na na ya naste rde dre shā nā ya te/ /a bzhin—/ /bdag gi khyim ni mig zum bud med tshogs rnams rnam 'dzin dur khrod lta bur spyod/ /deng ①ha ma bye ba niṣka mya bra bra dzñādhī pu dzā ta rāta/ /bha ga badhe bra dzā bye ba nyid rab byung don gnyer bdag /grong khyer nang las (kyephyir 'thon te/ /rmongs pa bzlog slad bcom drabye mo ha ni bṛ tta ye/ / bi tsibye ti sa mā dā ya ma hā ste ratna ldan 'das/ /nges par blta snyeru 'gro bar bya/ /zhes bsams rin gyethang che ba yilngoste/ /rin chen pā du ke/ /sha kra pra bha pātpa ya yā ba dzñā ta pu ra rakṣi taḥ/ / mchil lham zung khyanas de/ /grong srung rnams kyis ma shes par/ /brgya byin gyi muni mthu yis song / /a bhe niṣka mya na ga ra dā rāttha pya pa rirbe dzā/ /saṃ sā ra ma ruhūṃ krārnya tā paṃ grong khyer sgo las mngon par ni/ /byung ste chu klung mchog thob nas/ /'khor ba'i mya ngam ( te'aphos pa yisaldi/tya thi mo borya ta ཿ / / ta mā yādhe bi lo kye ba bha ga bānd+ra ta bha gdung ba gtong bar brtson pa bzhin/ /bcom ldan 'byung po dgongs pa yis/ /de ni 'ong ba gzigs ba taḥ/ /spru tyā saddhā ra rde ta su ya yo poṅkaṇḍi tā mi ba/ sa he ma gyur nas/ /dgyes pas de ni bsgral ba la/ /bzhed dang ldan pa bzhin du gyur/ /de yis rjes mthun baṇḍi mu da mya dakṣi rde dakṣa rte bhu dzee/ /de ha pra bhā ba pra kā she na rta maḥpa ri gser gyi mdog /phyag ni g.yas pa brkyangs ⑫mdzad nas/ /sku yi gzi brjid snang ba yis/ /phyogs kyi ha ran di shaṃ/ /e bye hi pāsnu hi pa rda ni ra pā ya ma nā ma yo/ /mun pa yongs phrogs ⑪shing / /tshur shog tshur shog gnod med la/ /nad med gnas ni khrod kyis 'thob/⑩//a bhya dhwa di ti tai du rāta me gha gho ṣa gha na swa raḥ/ /shu tā bha ga ba ces pa 'brug dbyangs ltar sdug sgras/ /ring po nas ni de la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyogasung 95—741

pu tram̐ bu raḥsbi tai/ /ta taḥkṛ ta pra ṇa ma gya ta snga bi bha ga bān pu mdun na ①gnas pa'i bu ma mthong / /de nas slar yang bcom ldan gyis②/ /rab tu btud byas de yi naḥ / /dharmya ya ka tha ya mo haṃ tī ṣa ta ma i bā ha ratu/ /tī bra mo hasta yang / /rmongs pa 1chos gtam rigs pa yas/ /'od kyi mun pa bzhin du phrogs/ /de nas rmongs bral taḥpu tram̐ sa driṭī bee ma la gyu to/ /shāstu: kā rā nu ma taḥpra ṇa yā da dhi de yis ④bu/ /dri med 'od ldan mthong gyur nas/ /rjes su 'dod cing gus pa yis/ /ston pa lhag par bā sa rmā/ /bha ga ba na tha tadṛ he kṛ tā pū dzā pra ti gra haṃ/ /tai pasnri gnas pa byas/ /de yi khyim du bcom ldan gyis/ /mchod pa rab tu blangs ste)mdzad nas/ /de ni 67chung sa hi lta tsakre shudha shikṣu pa do dzwa lo/ / ta to ya sho da sa cibābya mar bcas pa la/ / dag pa'i bslab kluganas rab 'bar mdzad/ /de nas grags sbyin grogs po ni/ /tā ra shrī madzñā bā rāḥ/ /bi ma khā khyaḥsu bā hubya pūṇḍi ko tha ga rpā pa tiḥ/ /dpal dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /dri med gang po lag bzang dang / /ba glang bdag ces bya ba bzhis//ya shaḥpra kā shi ta di shaṃ ya sho rda bha ga badru raḥ/ /brahma tsarya bra tā bcom ldan mdun na grags sbyin 'a7ni/ /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs la chags pa'i/ /grags pa phyogs su sa lte khru tā lta de sha gā ya yu/ / te ྾ ku sha khā pā ke na pā bhā rab gsal ba/ /thos nas gnas der 'ongs par gyur/ /dge ba smin pas thob gyur pa/ /de dag rmā bha ga bārlu naḥ/ /bi da dhe dhand+ra bi na ye shā sa rna shuddhā shā sa naḥ/ /rnams la bcom ldan 'das/ /dag pa'i bka' yis slar yang ni/ /'dul ba'i chos la bstan pa bsgrubs/ /ya sho daste tsa tsa tā ro bhikṣa baḥpañtsa tsā pa re/ /artatpa rda da sha pā pusta bzhi po de dag rmye grags sbyin dang / /dge slong gzhan pa lnga dag sterngu/ /bcu yis ⑩bcom ldan drung du ni/ /da bha ga ba tornyi ke/ / khru tā ya sho da thra ddhā tai dha tyāstatpa tsi bā dgra bcom gnas dag thob par gyuraspyo/ /grags sbyin spyod tshul thos gyur nas/ /de yi grogs po skal 95—743

na ni ya tai kā le na tyakta pi gra haḥ/ /so bha bahphu ma tirnu ma de pa pu tra de gsungs te/ / dus kyis lus ni btang byas nas/ /①blo bzang zhes pa lha yi bur/ /mtho ris su ni ñtsi randi bi/ /sa e ṣa pu stso bā na yaḥya sho daḥshe ya sā ni byeḥ/ /yun ring gyur/ /bsod nams ldan pa de nyid dang / /grags sbyin dge legs gter 5'di ste/ /su dzdza dā ma pi saṃ pāptaḥtīdhyā ku sha la se tu tsā/ /kṛ tīrtswa ma kṣi ti pa tiḥgrags pa yis ni grogs rnams kyang / /dge ba'i zam stegs nyid dag thob/ /sa bdag kṛ tī rnguzhes bya ba/ /ka shya pya snga ka rohphu rā/ /shāstuḥsha rī ra nityā ṇi ratna stu pa mu dā ra dhīḥ/ /rgya chen blo yis ⑦ston pa ni/ /'od srungs / musku dag myang 'das la/ /rin chen mchod rten sngon tshe byas/ /ya sha sī ra me ta na yast+ri tī yasta gya bhū pa teḥ/ /bhabyu tasmidma ṇitho pe sa yi bdag po de yi bu/ /gsum pa grags ldan dga' ba yis/ /nor bu'i mchod rten de la ni/ /gus ratna tstshahūṃ n+ya bee sha yata/ /te nā pi pūttha pubye na dzadma n+yasmidma ha ya shāḥ/ /pas rin chen gdugs dag bkod/ /de dang bsod nams snga ma yis/ /skye ba 'di la grags sbyin ni/ /dzā to ya sho dbyutre ṇa ratna dībhe na byu ṣi taḥ/ /i bye n+ya dzadma su kṛ to da grags chen rin chen 'bar ba yi/ /gdugs kyis brgyan pa dag tu skyes/ /de ltar skye ba gzhan la legs ya ba dhe mū la sodme ṣa e ṣa sha shi shu blu ya sho shu pu bee ཿ / / dha nd+ra byas rgyas pas rtsa ba bcings/ /zla ba ltar dkar grags pa'i 'od zer rgyas pa'i me tog can/ /dge ba de dru maḥthra thu ta raḥpa li tā gya sā bhoḥkhru two ti bisma ya ma bā pa sa bhekṣu yis 'uchos kyi ljon pa rab rgyas 'bras smin 'di/ /de skad thos nas dge slong tshogs des ya 7mtshan thob saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee sgo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam tā yo ya sho dā ba dā dzwa dā ṣakhyu ta ma ཿ pa bee waḥ / / //gyi 'khri shing las grags sbyin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste 3snadrug cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //95—745

sha kra bā yu ba ru rja da yaḥsu ra bi kri yārlu ni ba rā: yaskṛ te/ /brgya byin rlung dang chu sogs lha rnams dang / /thub mchog rnams kyang gang slad rnam 'gyur du/ /yārnyi tattha ra su khaṃ tri ṇa ya te ya su ka su na sa basmi yaspa rda/ /dī dzadmā mā ga dmā 'gyur ba'i dran bde rtswa ltar gcod (1 pa'i gnas/ /ya mtshan can de gang su rung ba'i 2min/ /ma ga jo gra me bi khru ta shri nd+ra hā stha le / / n+ya gro dha ka lpa nā ma byudma hā grong thang chen du/ /sā la chen po'i rigs 'khrungs pa/ /n+ya gro dha yi tog ④ces pa/ ) /gnyis skyes shā ya ku lobye baḥ/ /ta su bhāryā su rū pā khyu kṛ hodmā na bi ha ri khaṃ/ /a grags pa'i dpal ldan byung / /de yo chung ma gzugs bzang ma/ /zhes pa khang pa'i skyed tshal na/ /rol su ta su ta marmā dzha pispa la su ta ro ro dhaḥ/ /dzā ta mā tri su te tamind+rapta dzambu pas 5ljon shing pispa rdo6la'i/ /'og tu bu ni nyi 'od bskrun/ /gser gyi 'od zer rab 'bar ba'i/ bu na da byu tai/ /di bye shu shaṃ ya sha shu rja tasmand+ra pur byutta roḥ/ /sa pispa khā de skyes pa tsam nyid la/ /grags pa ltar dkar lha yi gos/ /shing de las ni rab tu byung / /pispa skyel ya no nā ma bā laḥka ma la lo tsa naḥ/ /bi byā ka lā ka li ta byergya bzlu ta sa ha skyes zhes bya ba/ /byis pa padma'i mig can de/ /rig dang sgyu rtsal blo sbyangs shing / /dpal dang lhan shri yā/ / sa pi tā pā bye no pi bi bā ha bi mu khaḥ sa da/ / ba bhū cig rnam par rgyas/ /de ni pha yis —7gsol btab kyang / /rtag tu khyim thab las phyir phyogs/ /yul la ba bi ṣa ya dwo ྾ bi bee ga bi ṣa dā sha yaḥ/ /baṃ shatstsha ta bha yā྾ tā sa sdang spyo ldan dben pa ni/ /dri med bsam pa ldan par tsho gyur/ /pha ni rigs brgyud chad ⑪pa yis/ /pu naḥpu na rarji taḥ/ /ta mu tse ro tsi te ma hūṃ nā sa ṇi gra ha brnya rmā/ /'jigs nas yang yang gsol btab ste4/ /de la smras pa khyem thab mukhru ka ka gyeṣṭi bha ba bandha rgo/ /bātpa su rya sa ta ta sa ṣpe ho ma dhū meḥnas ni/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba su zhig 'dod/ /dang por sbyin sreg du bas mchi ma rtag tu 'bab la kye rab pra thratrī ཿ pa tya grahpho rgya pa na sha ra ṇi tu lya ha stu dzee ṇi na / / saṃ tu 'jug /mtshungs par lag pa gtad pas gdung ba'i lam la 3bden par mdud pa mdzad/ /'phreng ( sā rā dzñā sa ma ya tsa la ṣpe brnya pas mngon par sbyar ba'i sgra grags ⑤thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'bad pa drag po yis/ /pha dang ma shlau tsa paḥ/ /ta ma ka bye sa mā dā ya ku sha leḥshidzee bhiḥkṛ hūṃ/ /saṃ la des smras nas/ /mdzes pas dran rmyepa dge mtshan gyisakhu/ /myu gu /4yang dag skyes pa bzhin/ /bzo dzāhūṃ krarnyi pikta su kau tu ka gye ba kanda sthā/ /kul bi tstsha da tsiṭwārghaṃ dhī raḥbo mkhas pas byas pa yi⑫/ /gser byi bu mo bzung nas ni/ /rigs chad bsams thupas gzir de la/ /pu na ru bā tsa ti/ /tu lya khā bārdzu barṇa su la bhya te ya di ka n+ya kā/ /brten ⑫pas slar yang rab smras pa/ /kha dog mdzes sdug 'di mtshungs pa'i/ /bu mo gal te rnyed gyur na//ka ro mi tīṅgi rā tā ta ta da haṃ dā ra saṃ gra haṃ/ /i ti bu tra ba tsaḥyab gcig spyokhyod kyi tshig gis ni/ /bdag gi bud med bzung ⑩bar bgyi/ /zhes pa bu yi ⑩tshig thos 95—747

shu tā tatū lya di bi durla dzha/ /krāhma ṇaḥka n+ya kāsma ṭwā na rā sho bhū da dho mu nas—/ /de mtshungs bu mo mtho ris su/ /rnyed dkar shes nas bram ze ni/ /re thag chad cing bzhin du kha—/ /bi ga ta nanda ni gyanda su hritstsha ru ra kā bi dhaḥ/ /tai bi praḥshu tā 'gyurahu/—/ /tsartso ka ra zhes pa'i grogs/ /bram zes gtam de thos pa yis/ /kun dga' dang bral g.yo thraṭwāntaḥsho ka kludha ma tā pa ta/ /pra yatna mā tra sā dhyaze na sho rka kastu marta med pa/ /mya ngan gyis nyen de la smras/ /rab 'bad tsam gyis ②bzod don la/ /khyod ni mya ngan byar serka/ /e ṣa bra dzā mya haṃ drahūṃ ka n+ya kā ka na ka pra sgo/ /i ti snasnya su su mi 'os/ /bu mo gser 'od ldan pa ni/ /blta /1ru nga nyid 'gro bar bya/ /zhes te mdza' ba'i grogs po hri daḥs kṛ tā byerya ma gra dzaḥ/ /ā dā ya he ma pra ti rmā ya yo dhī man di ni—/ /dang por skyes pas bstan byas nas/ /gser gyi gzugs brnyan bzung nas ni/ /blo ldan phyogs shaṃ ta ram̐/ / de ba hūṃ ladzi na tstsharja sa mā khye khru ka byu ṣi tai/ /rnams dag ④tu song / /'phreng sprib gos dang bcas pas brgyan/ /lha yi mtshan ma'i zol gyis ni/ /kṛ tī twa dikṣu ba bhra ma kan+ya pū bye mu dā ha ran/ /tahphudzo pa ga tāḥbazung nas phyogs su 'khyam byed cing / /bu mos mchod par ( bebya zhes smras/ /grong khyer grong dang lam ka sde na ga ra grwa ma baṭwā su/ /bi lo ka yadma pa ta ti na tabhu bee ma bāpta rnams su/ /de mchod du 'ong (7)bu mo rnams/ /rtag tu rnam par blta ⑧ba des/ /de dang mtshungs pa bān / /ta taḥka dā dzi1 shā bye ka pi la snga gra dzadma naḥ/ /ka n+ya mā pa shyadha rnyed ma gyur/ /de nas bram ze ser skya yis/ /bu mo gser gyi bu mo bas/ /'od lhag bzang mo zhes pa yi⑨ / /tā khye he ma ka n+ya bye ka pra rghaṃ/ /bi bā ha bi mu khāe kārnyi hūṃ bai rā gya bi be yangs pa can du nam zhig mthong / /mjos ma khyim thab las phyir phyogs/ /chags mabral dben pa dang ki rmā/ /sa tem shulke ka bi lo ya yā tsi ka thi tā nā yaḥ/ /lta ka n+ya ldan zhing / /gser rin ma da 11ser skya la/ /rjes 'gro bshad pa de yis babeengs/ /bu mo'i pha yis 95 ——748

dza n+ya kaḥshā ha sadku lo ku la bi khru tai/ /lo ke n+ya gro dha ka pra sgo go tra dzā ta der ①smras pa/ /'od srungs rigs skyes 'jig rten na/ /n+ya gro dha yi rtog pa yinaphu7/ /rigs mchog su kā shya pya/ /ki tu ka tyā pra yasne na dha na mambi 6 di ya te/ /rigs ni rnam par grags/ /'on kyang mdzes ma 'bad pa yis/ /nor ni brtags snye nas sbyin par bya/ /dā ri drotstsha pi nā pa ha pi turda ha ti mā na saṃ/ /pasnri ka la haṃ saṃ salto ka n+ya dbul ba'i shugs rings ldan ma des/ /pha yi yid ni gdung bar byed/ /chung ma 'thab mo la chags dang / /kā ni zlu na dri ta/ /bye ba no pa ha taḥsru nustabhā bye ta sa sru tsa bu mo nor med la sbyin ④dang / /bu ni gdung bas nyer bcom rnams/ /sems la khab bsregs khye lta bu yaḥ—/ /da tā shri yo dza la ni dhiḥpu ru khotta mā ya dzña tā tha ba ma na ta ram̐ ba li yāsnyo yin—/ /chu gter byi ⑥ni skyes bu mchog la dpal mo byin byas te/ /ci ste de ni stobs ldan la slong mi'u yā tai/ /a rya pi sakta ba ḍa bā na la ru pa sho kaḥsosgo sa e ba na bi thung shes nas/ /da lta'ang mya ngan la chags rta gdong me yi rang bzhin gyes⑦/ /gdung ba drag po shugs myuñtsa ta tī bra tā paṃ / / ta smraji trī sa ma bhe 6 dzñā tā ha ju bha rings bludang bcas nges par gtong mi byed/ /de slad nor ni btsal byas te67/ /de 'byor mngon mtho bo bonda to/ /da su maḥsadku le ka khye dha nā dhī na hi saṅga ṇaḥ/ /i ti ka tyā shes gyur nas/ /dam pa'i rigs la bu mo sbyin/ /dam pa'i yon tan nor gyi dbang / /zhes pa bu mo'i pi tuḥkhru tā tahphu tra ṇḍañtsa bha ṣi tai/ /ta je kyukta dī dzaḥbye yadku mā ra dza na pha dang de'i/ /bu rnams kyis kyang brjod thos nas/ /de bzhin zhes smras gnyis skyes ni/ /gzhon nu'i karnyi shaṃ/ /su paṇḍi lā ba rgyu shābhā shu tā ka bye ti tatpa tsaḥ/ /n+ya gro dha pha yi gan du song / /gser byi mdzes ma las lhag pa'i/ /bu mo thob ces de yi tshig /n+ya gro dha yi rtog kalpaḥshu tī pa ba bhū pā nanda ni rbha raḥ/ /brahma tsabye ṣi rde shu tā ka n+ya kā pispa lā pa yis⑪/ /thos nas kun dga' rgyas par gyur/ /bu mo tshangs spyod don gnyer ma/ /thos nas pispa la 95—749

yoḥ—/ /ba byu ba bi bha ba glu ni rā dzñā rbha gānda no bhu baḥ/ /paryā ye ṇi pa'i tshe/ /yid la (hūṃbyung ba'i bka' bcag pas/ /'byor pa dman pa nyid du gyur/ /de gnyis reg pa ka ni dru yī dzā gaskyo kaḥs mubyu ta/ /i ti to sparsha rakṣa ye tsakra tuḥsha ya bsrung ba'i slad/ /res kyi gcig ni gnyid log cing / /gcig ni langs nas mel tshe byed/ /ces pa nasbi ti/ / ka dā tsi da tha sha llī te kā la byā lam̐ bya lo ka yata/ /nyal ba'i rnam gzhag byas/ /de nas nam zhig mal stan mthar/ /de yi mig ni gnyid kyis rgyas/ /ni dru mu dra ti ṣpe tā dzee pispa khā ya naḥ/ /ta taḥs tarbha yātta gya dorla tā thebs tshe pispa la skyes kyis/ /sbrul ni nag po mthong bar gyur(glu / /de nas de lag 'khri shing ni/ /logs sārsha la mbi bhā / / sa da ya bya ma rā dhe na ra ra sgoblu pya bā sa su 'phyang snye/ba brtse ldan des/ /rnga yab mtha' dang gos dag gis/ /bsdus nas 'jigs pa de las pā—/ /sa ha sā bā ju tsa la na trasnra ha ri ṇa lo tsa nā/ /sā pa kadza bsrungs④—/ /'phral la lag pa bskyod (sripa yis/ /skrag pa'i ri dwags mig can ma/ /nu ma 'dar zhing ku tsā lo la hā ra pa ti ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ārya pu tra ka thi nā ma sa ma yaḥpa tya bā di do shal ni/ /g.yo ldan ma des khyo la smras/ /jo ⑥ yi sras po ji ltar na/ /nges par dam tshig brjed gyur naḥ—/ /bi smri tasta ba saṃ dzā to ya da yi tsitta bi sla baḥ/ /ladzdza ba hā bi cing / /bden par stismra ba khyod kyi thugs/ /gang 'di (shernam par bslad pa skyes/ /khyod kyi rnam 'gyur kā ra gya ke ya ma tyatta tā ta ba/ /tya dzarnyi bee ti marlu dzā byu dha ra na tu sā ngo tsha'i rgyun/ /shin tu che ldan 'di ni ci/ /sa 'dzin dag kyang brtan po7pa'i lugs/ /gtong gi dam pa dha baḥ/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥkhru tā tā mu bā tsa ba sa smi taḥ/ /bhū dre nāsbya yongs ⑩ ma yin/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /'dzum ldan de yis (1kṣede la smras/ /rmi lam na yang ba ma na saḥswasne pi ma ma bi bee baḥ/ /ki tre ṣa kṛṇḍa sakhro tra dī ṣa ṇaḥpa bdag gi yid/ /bzang mo nges par bslad pa ⑫med/ /'on kyang 'dir ni sgrul nag 'di/ /'jigs 95—751

ri ba tta te/ /ba huste sha ya nā lasbyi ddhā bye saṃ rakṣi to ma ya/ /su rung ba yongs su rgyu/ /khyod kyi lag pa mal stan '-itelas/ /'phyang du ba 'jigs nas bdag gis bsrungs/ /e tatpa kyuddhā tsaḥkhru twa te shaṃ kā dza ga da sā/ /diṭī tyab tyashī la su khyo yi tshig 'di thos gyur nas/ /(snyedogs btang dga' ba des smras pa/ /bden pa'i ngang tshul khyod kyi ④blo/ /na kā ma ma li na ma ti/ /sadzeeḥsā dhund+ra rā ko yam̐ bha yo rā go ra gātpa 'dod pas dri mar byas pa med/ /gdug pa'i sbrul ni khegs pa ste⑤/ /chags pa'i lto 'phyes mchog tu re / /e ka harnyi ti sum̐ sadzeeḥkā maḥkā ya sha tsā ta kṛ ta/ /rakṣa 'jigs / /sbrul gyis (67lus gcig 'joms pa ste/ /'dod pas lus rgo brgya mthar byed/ /de beed tasprubo kā ro yo mi trughā bi ra rā ma sā/ /tī bye tsa pra sha shaṃ sā sngaḥsaṃ rnam 'gyur 'di dag bsrungs⑩7/ /zhes smras de ni chags dang bral/ /de yi shin tu dul ba yang pispa ya oṃ pispa khā ya naḥ/ /n+ya gro dha kaspe kā le na sa bhārle tro di baṃ ge te/ /pra la skyes dag gis bsngags/ /dus kyi n+ya gro dha ⑧yi togadwa/ /chung mar bcas pa mtho ris song rab byu ta kṛ ha saṃ bhā ra tsiddhā bhā ra mu bā hā saḥ/ /ka dā tsitta la pā nā ya bṛ ṣā mang khyim gyi tshogs dag gis/ /bsam pa'i khur ni de yis blangs/ /nam zhig til mar btung ba'i slad/ /rde ti la rpā ḍa ṇi/ / te na bha dā sa mā di ṣṭa n+ya yulte pa ri ba ri khyu mchog rnams kyi til 'tshir la/ /bzang mos yongs su bstan pa yis/ /'khor rnams dag ni yongs kāḥ —/ /tāḥbi ḍi ta ti lāste la rku bhe 6 kṛ mi saṃ tsa yi/ /sgo tai su bskos (/ /til ni 'tshir ba de dag gis/ /til mar bum par ⑪srog chags tshogs/ / lhung zhing ⑫bi lo kya rpā danta mu tsuḥs ka ru ṇa mi thaḥ/ /a ho nu pā ba masmra ka ba hu nyams pa mthong gyur nas/ /snying rje bcas pas phan tshun smras/ /srog chags mang po yongs brlag pas/ /sthā ṇi pa ri kṣa yata/ /bha dru yāḥsattha me tabye pā ta ke yaṅgi rā kṛ tai/ /kye ma bdag kyang sdig pa can/ /yang na gang gi tshig gis byas/ /sdig pa 'di kun bzang mo la'o/ /95—752

tatstsha tā tad kṛ ha ga tā bha dā bai rā gya mā ya yo/ / tasmitre bakṣa ṇi bzang mo khyim nang ①'khod pa yis/ /de thos chags bral nyid du gyur/ /de dus nyid na bdag po ni/ /bhārta pra bi shyi ba tsa hūṃ ra haḥ/ /bha dre kṛ ha ma hā bhā ram̐ shrarnyo haṃ na pa te nang zhugs dben par de la smras/ /zhing las nyon mongs kyis gzir par 'u/ /khyu mchog srog chags 'tshe sa dā/ /kṛ ṣa kle shardi ta dṛ ṣa pra ṇa ho sā nu shā sa āoṃ/ /i māḥb ston/ /bzang mo bdag gi khyim gyi khyar/ /rtag tu yongs 'dzin yongs (1mi bzod/ /bde ba'i phun parlarnyanta bi ra sā niḥsā rāḥsu kha saspa daḥ/ /ā swā rya mā nāḥkuttharnyi na tshogs 'di dag rnams/ /mjug tu ro bral snying po med/ /myangs na 'dam bu'i 'dam ④ma bzhin/ /ḍa shā khā i ba byadhī/ /gre sha shi bā la dzā le 6 pā pa saṃ ke 6 beembinaḥ/ /gdung ba dag ni skyed par byed/ /khyim pa rnams ni sdig pa'i 'dam/ /nyon mongs nya phyibs dra ba can/ /a ba sanda kṛ te ṣe ba nisne ṣṭa ba dza raṅgabaḥ/ /tasmrasgo ha sa mā re khyim nyid du ni nyams 'gyur te/ /rlubs su glang ni rgan po bzhin/ /de slad khyem gyi rtsol ba 'di5/ /bha st+ya ga yo gyu yarma ba yoḥ/ /i hphukta nu ma taḥpatna shārnyoni: ya mā da bye/ /yu cag gis ni gtong khyabar 'os/ /zhes smras chung mas khas blangs pas/ /zhi ba la ni nges par byas/ /sa twa dha na mabee bye kṛ haṃ tsa sa pa ritstsha rda/ /nistsa krā ma sa mudrukta saddhā khyim dang yo byad bcas pa yinya/ /nor rnams slong la des byin nas/ /re ba'i zhags pas rkawī'aching ba kun//shā pā sha nanda naḥ/ /so thā kā shya pa go tā twa ta ma hā kā shya pa tsā ga taḥ/ /rnam par grol te nges par byung / /de nas 'od srungs rigs nyid phyir/ /'od srungs chen po nyid gyur te/ /taṭwā la samyakshi budhe kā shya pa sa mu pā ya yo/ /ba hu pu tā khya tsi tya su de dus yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od srungs drung du de song gyur/ /mchod rten bu mang zhes pa yi/ /mū lespru ta mu pe tya tai/ /tajatta dhadzre bi nā yaḥshurghaṃ bo bye ma bābee bān/ /rtsa bar gnas pa de can phyin/ /'dul ba'i chos ni des byin pas/ /dag pa'i byang chub thob par gyur/ /95—753

bha dru pi lapta bi na yā bai rā gyu diṣṭa bakhyu na/ /zwaklu rgya pa ri rja me na bzang mo yis kyang chags bral kyi/ /bstan pa'i lam gyi 'dul ba thob/ /sngon gyi bsod nams yongs le bye ku sha la mu dzwa lo/ / ma hā ka byu pa mā lo kya pā bye su ra smin pas/ /dge ba dri ma med pa bsten①/ /'od srungs chen po lha rnams kyis②/ /phyag 'os nyid thob ba bye hūṃ / / ta khru bye bi gru bhiḥdṛ ṣṭa stu nu ba tsa ta thā ga ta ཿ / /mthong nas de'igo/ /bsod nams dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /de bzhin gshegs pas der bka' stsal/ /pra bi rata ni khi lānda pa su kā le bi ṣa ma ta ra bi ni thratta piṇḍa pā te/ /zas dang 'bru rnams ma lus rab tu nyung ba'i dus/ /bsod snyoms rnam par log cing shin tu mi bzad tshe//kṛ ṣa dha na pu ru ṣe ṇa kā shi purya ta ga ra shi khāe ma hi taḥswa sgo dza ṣpe na/ /kṛ nor chung skyes bu yis ni kā shi ④grong khyer du/ /ta gar shi ṣā durang gi zas kyis legs par mchod/ / mi tī na ra pa ti nā kri te pi tsi bye ba ra ru tsi ra ratna tsi te ta dātpa dza:/ /yi (kyebadag po kṛ tīs dzabyas pa'i mchod rten ni/ /rin chen gyis spras mchog tu mdzes la de yi ⑧bu/ /ma ṇi ka na ka bi tsi tra mā ta pa tram̐ bya dha ti ma hā ta ku sha lā ya pu rgya bsod nams ngang tshul gyis kyang dge ⑨ba chen po'i beed/ /nor bu gser gyis ⑩rnam par bkra ba'i shī laḥ/ /dzadma dwa yo pa tsi ta pu rgya ma ho da ye na so sasma ho ba pa da kā shya gdugs dag bkod/ /skye ba gnyis su nye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams cher rgyas pas/ /nye ba'i gnas pa tā ma bāptaḥ/ /la sgonda tiḥka na ta ka la i ba pra bhā ba martatpa kyi ⑪'od srungs chen po nyid ni 'di yis thob/ /gser gyi ta la bzhin du mtho ba'i mthu ni thob gyur nas/ /rda ku sha la mū la ka lo bi bha nti / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu dgra bcom gnas ni rnam par 'dzin/ /zhes spyopa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i tsi tā yi sgo bye sa tā ba da na kalpa la tā yi ma hā kā shya pā ba dā na byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las 'od srungs chen po'i rtogs pa 95—754

ra kṣa —/ / ta ta ཿ ka da tsidzha ga bā bee nā rnye ta sko tu kā dhi kyu ga ldan 'das kyis bsrungs①/ /de nas nam zhig nags kyi ④mthar ni bcom ldan la/ /de yi dge mtshan ṇi na dṛ ṣṭa ཿ / / dza gā da da nta byu ti tsa dhri ka rnyi dmā pa ra dag las dge slong tshogs kyis dris/ /tshems kyi 'od zer zla ba'i 'od rnams dag gis ni/ /mchu yi ya rje ga mi bā dha ra su / / ya sho dha rā ma ju ra te ṇa ni hye dmar ba 'gebs ①par mdzad pa bzhin du gsungs/ /bdag dang bral bas rtag tu gzir bar gyur pa yi/ /ka ro ti yand+ra ha sa ma ha tā nti / / ha rarnyi bye oṃ be ta rani mo grags 'dzin ma ni gang zhig gzu lums 'di dag byed/ /brtan pa 'phrog cing rmongs pa rnam par ster ba ha me ṣa swa bhā ba ཿ sma ra bi bhra mā rde / / ma mā pi ta snga bi 'di—/ /chags pa'i rnam 'phrul ldan pa rnams kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /sngon gyi skye ba gzhan la de dang bral ra he pūj-i dzarja ta re mā ra bi mo hi te na / / saṃ sa kta saṃ tā pa ba yis④/ /'dod pas rnam par rmongs par byas te bdag gis kyang / /rgyun du yongs su gdung ba dag ni mitta ju taḥkhe daḥpra bhu ta bya pa no nu byu taḥ/ /pu rā dzi tā ma ra gi ⑤rgyur gyur pa/ /rab mang gdung khyepeba'i nyon mongs dag ni nyams su myong / /grong mchog haste na yi pu re mahphu re haste na su re/ /rā dza dha nā bi dhwa no bhūnde dhwa rna gu ṇa grong / /'chi med yon tan stithul bar sngon/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i gter/ /rgyal po nor saṃ pa dzā/ /bhu dze nā bo gi tā bhū miḥkṛ tā kabye sa ra swa tī/ /lallīḥzhes bya ba byung / /lag pa yis geni sa la 'khyud/ /dbyangs can dag ni mgrin par byas/ /ngag '-ikyegi pra sā bye tā ye na tīnti re ba pra bā se tā/ /rā mā lnga ta gya dzā yā lnga ta na dpal ni rab tu bstar/ /grags pa kho na rab tu bskrad/ /de yi btsun mo mjos ma la/ /bu ni nor yaḥsu dha nā bhi dhaḥ/ /a bha batpa ha saṃ dzā ta ni dhwa na sha ta bi shu taḥ/ /sand+ra bzang zhes bya ba/ /gter brgya dang ni grags pa dang / /lhan cig skyes pa byung bar gyur/ /rig gnas 95—756

bi byā ku mu di mbi bi kā sha ra si kaḥs dā/ /ka khā bāmbind+ra la tu tsiryaḥpūṇḍind+ra kun gyi ku mud can/ /rtag tu rnam rgyas byed la chags/ /dri med mdzes pa sgyu rtsal can/ /gang ba'i ①ri bā ba rbha/ /ba bhū ba ta su bhū baspruspyo pa tispyo mya nanta raḥ/ /mā shā zla ba lta bur mdzes/ /sa bdag de dang sa gzhi ni/ /bar med sa bdag byung gyur pa/ /khengs ldan ma hend+ra se nā khyuḥpra khyu ta thra thu bi kra maḥ/ /te na duḥs ha daṇḍi na dbang chen sde zhes pa/ /rgya che ldurnam par gnon par grags/ /dus yin chadus su brtag bya zhing / /sadzee sadzee swa hā ri rja/ /a kā la kā la kaspe na bī ḍa tāḥshu shu tsuḥkun gyi bdog kun 'phrog byed pa/ /bzod dka'i dpya dang ldan pa des/ /gzir ba'i skye rgus chomya ngan pra dzāḥ/ /ta snga dhand+ra pra bṛtta gya ni dṛtta su kṛ totpa be/ /tī bro pa tā paṃ tāste byas—/ /chos min la ni zhugs pa de'i/ /grong ni legs byas spro ba dag /log cing gdung ba drag po 6 su re na ba bṛ 6spyo nāḥ/ /pra nyi ku le ma hā pā le ta tra dubhi kṣa pi bla yis—/ /gdung bar sprin gyi char ma phab/ /sa skyong rjes su mi mthun pa/ /der ni mu ge'i nyen (lte'atshe paḥ—/ /ba bhu ba bya sa ṣpe ṣe ba bha brnyi bya pa no da yāḥ/ /ta taḥkle sha bi byung / /sdug bsngal can rnams kho na la/ /sdug bsngal rgyas par gyur pa yin/ /de nas nyon mongs kyis she ṣārtaḥsabye pu ra ni bā se naḥ/ /ku pa ti ba sa nobye gā de gī byu tā khyad gzir/ /bdag ngan gyis gdungs yid byung zhing / /grong nang skyeganas pa thams cad ni/ /gcig bya tsinta ya na / / rā dzñā do ṣa ka re ṇi yo ja ṇi na dza na tu 'tshogs ྅nas rnam par bsams/ /rgyal blun mtshan mor byed pa ni(87/ /gsar pa'i dpya zer ta pa ram̐/ /pra tya gra ka ra pa te na na li mbi ba ni mbi li tā/ /e ṣa 'bebs pa yis/ /mchog tu skye bo'i tshogs pa ni/ /padmo can ༷/snabazhin zum par gyur/ /rtag tu ngan durgya sa mbi ni tya ma sa tyā ma tya sasma taḥ/ /asmranda rpā ḍū pu : ti par zhen pa 'dis/ /bden med blon po'i gros dag gis/ /bdag cag bcir nas g.yo can dang / /95—757

bi ṭa tse ṭa ka gā yā ram̐/ / kabye ta tā su nā thra ṣṭaḥpā pa shā pe na byu bran dang glu mkhan rnams dag bsos0sna/ /de la'ang sa bdag sdog pa yi/ /dmod pas chad rngu med sdug pa teḥ/ /dubhi kṣa dza na byā dza tā dza na saṃ kṣa ya sā kṣi bhā/ /su tīkyāḥsmra bsngal ba/ /skye bo yang dag brlag pa'i dbang / /mu ge skyed par byed pa skyes/ /sa skyong shin tu rno zhing pā lāḥkha ra mu kha ra mūkhoḥpa sthāḥkā yasthā bee ṣa ma mu kha ro gāḥpra ku pi tāḥka baṃ santaḥmakhas—/ /zhabs drung gnas dang yig mkhan mi bzad kha skyon rab tu khros gyur pa/ /dman pa 'joms so bye kṛ pa ṇa da la no dā ru ṇa ga ṇaḥ/ /dha na shrī mān kṣi ti pa tiḥthra ya byed ma rungs tshogs pa 'di dag rnams ni ji ltar bzod/ /dpal ldan sa yi bdag po ni/ /nor gyis thu te rāṣṭa badzha naḥ/ /gatstsha mastadrur sosmran batpa laḥpha la yi 6 ti/ /yul 'khor skyong ba 6thos/ /bdag cag de grong song ba na/ /mnyes gshin de yis ⑦skyong bar 'gyur/ /a pa tyā mi ba rāhūṃ yaḥpa dā pa shya ti byu pa tiḥ/ /bi ṣa ye dzī bya te ta su dza na sa bdag gang gi yul 'khor la/ /bu bzhin rtag tu lta byed pa/ /de yi yul du pha yis (sheni/ /khyem du ka phye ba beethra ni/ /i ti nibya ya mā dhwa ya ya yusta haste nā bu ra/ /tyā byeḥbazhin du 'tsho bar bya/ /de ltar nges bsgrubs de dag rnams/ /haste na yi grong khyer song / /lus kyang kā yo pi sā pā yaḥki pu narda sha saṃ shra yaḥ/ /dzñā tā ma hedzre se no pi swa gnod bcas gtang bya na/ /yul dang gnas ni smos ci dgos/ /mi bdag dbang chen sde yis kyang / /pu re ni dza āoṃ dṛ paḥ/ /tī drwa nu tā paḥs mirde ma hā mā tyā na bhā ṣa ta/ /rang grong skye bo med shes nas/ /'gyod pa drag pos shesnakhro ldan pararme)/ /blon po chen po la smras pa/ /dha na su dha ni no rā dzñāḥpu rasmahphu ra ba se naḥ/ /pra yā tā i ba nirtswa rgyal po nor gyi grong khyer du/ /bdag gi grong gnas nyunyuskye reḥka thi tai gru bhā tsā ri bhiḥ/ /dubhikṣa khind+ra ya di te yā tā ma ma ri poḥpu ram̐/ /gsang nas ① rgyu ba dag gis smras/ /gal te bdag gi dgra grong du/ /de dag mu ges nyen 'gro na/ /tatpaza tra bha baṃ hye ba paryā yerde ba bi sla bīḥ/ /a tha bā rā dza do ṣe ṇa gnam gye nyer 'tshe thams cad du/ /re mos kyis ni 'byung ba nyid/ /yang na rgyal po'i skyon gyes ni/ /ga taste su kha rpātstsha yā/ /beṣṭa daṇḍa ka rodruktaḥka su rā dzñāḥpu re dza naḥ/ /bde ba 'dod pas de dag song / /rgyal po su yis (gye grong khyer kyi/ /skye bo las dang ‘kyedabee las grol/ /pā yaḥpa ri tsi ta dre ṣātpa dā na ba na bai ṣi ṇaḥ/ /dru rastha e ba sattha gya phal cher yongs su 'dris la sdang / /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa 'tshol jisna/ /ring na gnas pa thams cad sadzdza bha ba ti balla bhaḥ/ /asma da bhya dhi kaḥko sau ta su bhu mi pa tergu ni—/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong ba khyeyin/ /gang gis gzhan gyi skye rgu rathuni/ /rmongs pa chung ma bzhin du ṇaḥ / /pa re ྾ ha ra te ye na muddhā dzā yā i ba pra dzāḥ/ /u pā yabyergyu 'phrog /sa bdag de la yon tan ni/ /bdag las lhag pa ci zhig yod/ /re zhig de yi grags (shaṃpa ni/ /hūṃ tā batta gya dadzee pra shānta ye/ /sa mṛdhi kā ra rṇa yatstsha taji ghā to bi dhī rab gzhil thabs dag bsam par mdzod/ /gang yang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /de dag gzhom pa bsgrub ( ya hūṃ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsaḥkhru tā ma hā mā tya ba bhā ṣi re/ /thra ya tānde ba par mdzod/ /ces pa rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /blon po chen pos rab smras pa/ / lha gcig gang gi phyosnaye nā sau rā dza dha na dza nospru taḥ/ /bi ṣa ye nā ga rā dzoste tsi tro nā ma ba rgyal po ni rmye/ /nor dang skye bo dar ba pho7nyon/ /sa bdag de yi dar ba ni/ /gzugs can bsod nams tū da kaḥ/ /ta sukṣi ti pa te sbortaḥpu khyu ba dha i bo da yaḥ/ /a kā le sa mya kyis btags bzhin/ /yul na klu yi rgyal po ni/ /chu mang tsi tra zhes pa yod/ /de yi mthu yis dus min nibeetrīstend+ra bhā bee ṣpe dzā ya te/ /kṛ ṣi saṃ panti mū la: bhū bhū rdzu sathru du—/ /'bru ni phun sum tshogs par 'gyur⑫/ /sa bdag phun sum tshogs kun gyis0/ /rtsa ba zhing ni 95—759

saṃ pa daḥ/ /tasmabee rya ba khānd+ra gaḥs hahūṃ ya di shakya te/ /ta dā yārnyi phun sum tshogs1/ /de slad rig pa'i stobs dag gis/ /klu de gal te 'phrog nus na/ /de tshe de yi skye swa yo ta gya pra dzāsta me ba saṃ shra yo/ /dīpta mand+ra ba lo ki:ttasmra da bee 6 rgu '-irnams/ /rang nyid khyod la brten par 'gyur/ /de slad sngags stobs 'bar ba yi/ /sgrub pa po sā dha shaṃ/ /nā ga rā dza su ha ra ṇi kṛ ya hūṃ tūṇḍi mu rya ma/ /i tyā 'ga' btsal nas ni/ /klu yi rgyal po 'phrog pa la/ /brtson pa dag ni myur du ①mdzod/ /ces pa blon mbi tya ba tsaḥshu tā ta the tyā ha ma tī pa tiḥ/ /swa gu zla dha na bhe ka lā ba ra po'i tshig thos nas/ /pha ④bdag gis ni bden zhes smras/ /rang nyid yon tan nor nyams pa'i/ /mi do kho rya tāḥkha lāḥ/ /ta taḥpra bhū ta ka na ka pra dā na pa ṇa byo pa hūṃ/ /bsrung (snyepha rol skyon la sbyor/ / der ni ⑥gser ni mang po dag /rngan pa rab tu ster ba'i sgra/ /kṛ tā te mant+ra ṇiḥpāsgrurtswa ga bandha na madhri rde/ /sa taimbi byā dha ro nā ma su bsgrags nas gros pa rnams kyis ni/ /klu dag 'ching ba'i sngags pa thob/ /gser sbyin dam bcas de ba ṇḍi bee ṇa sa mbi dā / / pā bee ta shyi tra ma ṣpe rtu pra ya yo ha ste dag gis be/ /gsol gdab (sherig 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /de ni tsi tra blang ba'i slad/ /haste na yi grong nā pu re/ /ta tra kā na na baryadhe sdikta shā ma la pā da pe/ /bha ba rna khyer song / /der ni nags tshal dag gi stematha'/ /snum ljang rkang 'thung ldan pa na/ /gdengs can sgo gi rmā bhaspruḥs da darsha na bhaḥpra rghaṃ/ /tsa lab ku la mā khā yo bi la bti bdag po'i khang pa ni/ /nam mkha'i 'od can de yis mthong / /ba ku la yi 'phreng spyogayo zhing / /ti ka la ka shri yaḥ/ /ba na lasgra i ba parja maṇḍa nā ma ṇi dadzdza rde/ /bi lo la /3yi dpal rgyas pa/ /nags kyi dpal mo'i rgyan dag gi/ /nor bu'i me long nye ba bzhin/ /dri med kyā ma la dza saṃ smṛ ha ma li na mā na saḥ/ /mant+ra nu dhyā na sandadha ta se: chu de mthong gyur nas/ /chags pas nyams pa'i yid can gyisa.e/ /sngags kyi bsam gtan chas zhugs te/ /95 ——760

di sba ndha mā ba da de / / disba dhe bi hi tai te na pra te na tru gra te bsgrub slad phyogs ni bcing ba byas/ /brtul zhugs rab drag gzi ldan des/ /phyogs ni bcings pa dza sā/ /shi ro bya thā nā gā ba te ra byutta pta pa ṇa ma ṇiḥ/ /a thā dṛ bsgrub pa ni①/ /klu bdag gdengs ka'i nor bu ni/ /gdung zhing mgo bo gzir bar gyur/ /de nas ma shā sa mujo ya tai tre ṭī mand+ra sā dha shaṃ/ / kasbra mā naḥpha ṇi pa tizandha mthong yang dag langs/ /sngags ni bsgrub (kyepa de mthong nas/ /'dar zhing gdengs can bdag po ni/ /tā sa da tsinta yata/ /ba sgruzlushra khru sa pa la sta ḍiṅka pi la lo tsa naḥ/ / bcings pas skrag pas 1rab bsams pa/ /khro bo sma ra smin ma ser/ /lta byed ser skya glog lta bu/ /a kā le kā la saṃ kā shāḥku taḥhrū ro pa mā ga taḥ/ /ba ṣpe saṃ pra nyi dus min dus dang mtshungs pa yi/ /gdug pa 'di ni ga las 'ongs/ /da ni gdug pa'i bdag nyid disbarnyaḥkṛ to ṣpe na du rātpa nā/ /ba sgo bye ṣa na yā brja tā babyusti 'dis—/ /nags kyi phyogs ni bcings pa ④byas/ /ji srid 'dis bdag ma bcings pa/ /de srid kra ma ཿ kṣa ma ཿ / / ti ro bā dhe ba sa tya smidma ha bhā rbha bee lā ya rigs pa'i rim pa bzod/ /drang srong chen po shin ⑤shun can/ /'jug ngogs nye ba'i mtha' 'dir naḥ / /dzā ṣpe so si nā ma sā dhu pa ri tā bee pra galha te/ /ta tyā shra ma gnas—/ /bdag yongs bskyab pa dam pa ni/ /des kyang nus pa min par shes/ /gang 'di de yi bste ya de yo sau pa ri tsaryā sa raḥs dā/ /lubha kaḥpadma ko nā ma sa me saṃ rakṣa gnas na/ /rtag tu rim gro yongs bsgrub pa/ /rngon pa padma can zhes pasazhwa/ /de yis ༷77bdag ni ṇa kṣa maḥ/ /i ti nishyi tya ma na sā ga tā lubha kārnyi kai/ /swa bṛṭwārnye bsrung bar bzod/ /ces pa yid kyis da7nges byas nas/ /rngon pa ga la/ ba der song / /rang gi spyod ni biju smi bandha rakṣu ma yā tsa ta/ /sā dha ka gya ba dhwa yi ba nā gā rā dze na tshul bshad nas ni/ /de la 'chi ba bsrung 'ubar zhus/ /klu yi rgyal pos sgrub pa po/ /gsad kyepa'i slad 95—761

sobee taḥ/ / dha rtswa tai de sha ma bye tya mant+ra bī ram̐ bya lo ka yata/ /du gsol btab ste①/ /gzhu dang ldan pas gnas der phyin/ /sngags pas ④dpa' bo mthong bar byur/ /asminda ba sa re mand+ra sā dha ko pi hu ta na laḥ/ /ā kṛṣṭi nā ga rā dza su gnas skabs der ni sgrub pa po/ /sngags pa yis kyang sbyin sreg mes/ /bcing bar 'dod pas ④klu yi di//bi da dhe banta nokhru kaḥ/ /mant+ra kṛṣṭi pha ṇi sa to kṛ khaṃ tadha ba no da rka/ /rgyal po rab tu dgug par byas/ /gdengs can bdag po sngags kyis ④ni/ /drangs tshe de yi gnas kyi chu//bi ṣā da la ka ro de ba pro ryadkubyu da ga rda/ /saṃ tā sa bi hwa la bhu dzee chu yi chu bur rab dkrigs pas/ /mya ngan byed par brtson pa bzhin/ /lag 'gro'i chung ma kun tu skrag ga ba dhū bi ṣā da ni shā sa bee ga bi hi to dzwa la phe ṇi mā lo/ /pas 'khrugs pa'i mya ngan gyis(she / /shugs rings shugs kyis rab bsgrubs rab 'bar dbu ba'i phreng ba can//rakṣutha nā mi ba tsa kā ra ta re ga hasta salngañdza li pra tsa la kadza bi lo la rab tu 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i chu ni rba ⑥rlabs lag pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar byas bsrung ba don du gnyer bar me bhaḥ/ /ā ba rghaṃ bi byā ba khāste na nā ge ga ru ḍa te dza sā/ /saṃ byed pa bzhin/ /mkha' lding gzi byin dzeeldan pa des/ /rig pa'i stobs kyis ⑧klu bzung ste/ /'khums ko tse ku ṭi lnga sgoge kṣibye ba dza la bhā dza ṣpe/ /tai te ma lubha bā ṇi na tā sa saṃ disna shing gya gyu ldan pa'i lus/ /chu yi snod du btsal ba na/ /rngon pa yis ni gzhu bkang ste/ /dug gis lo tsa rna / / bi byā dha dha nu rā kṛ 6 bi ṣa di sne na lubha ka /byugs pa'i mda' dag gis/ /skrag pas mig ni nyams gyur cing / /gser la chags pas ⑨de la bsnun/ /ma sna pā rde tai ma bye tya bha ya tya kta ju dzee ga ma/ /kā rā la ka ra 'jigs spyopas lag 'gro btang gyur cing / /mda' zug ⑪de la mngon phyogs te/ /de yi ⑫'jigs rung bā le na bi shi raskoñtsa kā ra saḥ/ /sā bi byā band+ra ki ta gya lo bhā da byo pa ral gri yis/ /mgo bo dag dang bral bar byas/ /rmongs pa de yi rig ⑫pa ni/ /g.yem ma chags las 95—762

yo gī nī/ /a bhū྾ ddhā bi mubha gya swa bi nā shā ya ke ba lo/ /yulngaḥgazhan dag dang / /nye bar sbyor de grub mod ①kyang / /rang nyid brlag don 'ba' zhig gyur/ /blun pa ro pa tā pā ya bi byā bi bha ba shakta yaḥ/ /sa ha bee ba bi rū ṭwā dzā bi na po'i rig pa 'byor pa stobs/ /pha rol nye bar gdung ba'i slad/ /sbyor ba rnams ni 'phral la nyid/ /byurnyi sa hā su bhiḥ / / ta ta ཿ pra ha rṣa saṃ pūṇḍi ཿ kṛ ta ptaḥ pha ṇi nā srog dang lhan cig nyams par gyur/ /de nas rab dga' yongs rdzogs pa/ /byas shes gdengs can ya kaḥ/ /lta ni nā ya swa bha ba rna luddhā rka sne ha lubha dhīḥ/ /ta tra 'dren pa yis/ /rang gi khang par rngon pa de/ /mdza' (migacugs blo dang ldan pas bos/ /nor bu'i ratna la to byā na bi mā na ma ṇi baishra su/ /a tyargha mā nashyi tre ṇi ka khang pa gzhal yas khang / /rin chen 'khri shing skyed tshal der/ /tsi tra yis ①ni mchod byed cing / /de tsiṭwā la mu bā sa saḥ/ /ka dā tsi da tha nā ge na sgo bye mā na sa bisma yaḥ/ /yi dus ni 'ga' zhig gnas/ /de nas ya mtshan ldan pa des/ /nam zhig glog 'phreng (gelta bu yi/ /bi byubyā mo pa oṃ pā sha ma mo ghā khye da darsha saḥ/ /tai driṣṭa tatpa bhā baṃ tsa zhags pa don yod ces bya ba/ /klu yis ⑤mchod par byed pa mthong / /de mthong de yi ⑥nus mthu dag /shu tā nā ga ni bee di tai/ /yaṭwā tta darba rna tsakre luddhā ko luddhā mā nā klu yis ④bshad pa thos gyur nas/ /rngon pa chags pa'i yid ldan pas/ /de ni 'bad nas ④rab tu saḥ—/ /a dza tshe pa ma rodmo ge su rā shā ma se bandha rna/ /tai jo bi kā dhi bslangasape—/ /g.yul gyi sbyor ba mi pham zhing / /lha rnams kyang ni 'ching byed pa/ /srog las lhag pa de rka tasmi da do spru tyā pha bhā shwa raḥ/ /ta taste pā sha mā dā ya tsi tra mā mabye lubha de la/ /gdengs can dbang po dga' bas byin/ /de nas zhags pa de blangs nas/ /tsi tra la zhus rngon kaḥ—/ /udhīrya nā ga bha ba nāllabharjaḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /nā ga pra bhā ba saṃ taṭwā pa ni/ /klu yi khang pa las 'thon ⑫te/ /don thob rang gi gnas su song / /klu yi mthu yis thob pa yi/ /95—763

tsi ram̐ bhughā sa saṃ pa rda/ /pu tā yotpa khā khyu ya pā shaṃ da tā bya pa rya ta/ /phun tshogs yun ring de spyad she7nas/ /utpal can zhes bya ba yi/ /bu la zhags pa byen nas 'das/ /pā la yatri tu rā tsa ram̐ so pi lubha ku mā ra ka /mu ṣpesta mya ku la sbi tyā pa ri rngon pa gzhon nu de yis kyang / /pha yi spyod pa skyong byed cing / /rigs kyi lugs kyis ② thub pa de'i/ /tsaryā pa ro bha bta/ /ta taḥka dā tsitpa mu ṣpebee shānta su sbi taḥpu raḥ/ /rim gro byed pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas nam zhig thub pa ni/ /bzhugs pa'i mdun na gnas pa des/ /shu shā ba kā ka li gī tai tīṇḍi karṇa ra sā ya na/ / tsi tra n+yasta mi ba lo kya so shin tu phra zhing snyan pa'i glu/ /rna ba'i bcud len rgyas pa thos1/ /thub pa ri mo bkod pa bzhin/ /thratstshadri smi te mu no/ / ka ma lā ba ndha saṃ ruddhā ma dhu pa dhwa ni so da mthong nas ya mtshan des dris pa/ /padmo 7khongs su byung ba ni/ /yang dag bsdams pa'i sgra mtshungs raḥ / /ku to yo ko ki lā lā pa la li taḥthra ya te shwanaḥ/ /i ti lubha ka pu tre shing / /khyu lkubyug dbyangs ltar snyan pa yi/ /sgra 'di dag ni gang las thos/ /zhes pa rngon pa'i bu yis ṇa dṛṣṭaste mu ni ra bra bī ta/ /gā yan ti ma dhu rā khā pa me tāḥkinda ra ka ṣpe kāḥ/ /dris—/ /de la thub pas rab smras pa/ /mi'am ci yi bu mo rnams/ /snyan par brjod pa 'di dag len ⑥//dru ma gya kinda ra pa teḥka tyā ka tyā sha taibye tā/ /pañtsa byertswa ga bha ba na shrī ḍa bye mi 'am ci bdag ljon pa yi/ /bu mo yid 'phrog ma 'di ni/ /bu mo lnga brgyas yongs bskor nas/ /klu yi ṣā ma no ha rā/ /khru tī takau tu kā krāntaḥs pu narmu ni ma bhya ṅgāta/ /a pi khang pa dag na rtse/ /de thos dge mtshan gyis non nas/ /de yis tsuslar yang thub thul smras/ /mi 'am shagho pi pu ru ṣaḥpābye kinda ra ka n+ya shaṃ/ /ta tra bā tsa mu nirya gya bha betyā shaḥci yi bu mo dag /skyes bus thob 97par nus sam ci/ /thub pas der ⑩smras gang gi ni/ /lag rtser don ka rā gra gaḥ/ /a mo ghā khyaḥs shaldo ti karja kinda rā kā mi bhā/ /e ta yod ces bya ba'i/ /zhags pas song ste nyulnga'adod ldan ma/ /mi 'am ci mo blang bar nus/ /de nas de 95—764

dā kasbya sotyā ha ste pra ṇa myu tha lubha kaḥ/ /pra ya yo bā sha mā dā ya thos spro ldan pa'i/ /rngon pas ①de la phyag btsal khrunas/ /zhags pas gebazung ste gdengs can gyi/ /sgo gind+ra bha ba dzā ti ke/ /ta tra ke li bi lā sā shaṃ so pa shya ta kinda ra ga rte/ /dbang po'i khang pa dag tu song / /der des mi 'am ci mo'i tshogs/ /rtse dga' rol pas mtshan pa rgo/ /bi ju ṇa ma ni lā lo la he ma balli ba na shri yo/ /mju sthā no྾ hūṃ gser gyi 'khri shing nags kyi dpal/ /rlung gis bskyod pa 'dzin pa mthong / /de dag dbus su yid tā sī sa da darsha ma no ha dzā/ /sma ra gye ba tri ṣpe tāghi niddhā ṇa dza la 'phrog mas④/ /khrus byas langs pa mthong gyur te/ /dran pa'i mig gsum me dag gi5)/ /zhi byed chu yi de ba hūṃ/ /a āoṃ ga bi bhra ma ram̐ bha nirba rombi ṇi yo ba ṣpe/ /madzdza taḥlha mo bzhin/ /lus med rnam 'phrul rtsom pa yi/ /rba 6rlabs tshogs ldan lang tshor (sheni/ /gzhon nu ma shi sha ba phye ba kuddhā ṇa mi ba lalba rna/ /me kha lā badhe sanda dhe di byasba nyid bying ④ba yi/ /rten pa ⑨dag ni byed pa bzhinalku/ /yid 'ong lha yi gos bgos shing / /ske rags ra ma no ra rmā/ /dza la ke li ka la sakta sthā ra phe nā ba lī mi ba/ /dag ni legs par bcings/ /chu rtsed lnga4rol pas dbu ba yi/ /'phreng 8ba rab gsal chags pa bzhin/ /la ba rgya pra sru te ṣpe ba pra bā he na ma tī ya sa/ /ha raṣpe tā ra hā re ṇa sha mdzes sdug rab tu dkrigs gyur pa/ /do shal gsar pa'i ⑫rgyun dag ni/ /shin tu che bas thumatshan mo'i shī shu bhra ni shā shri yo/ / ka la yarnyo dza lo llī ṭwā lī lā pa tra la tī dpal—/ /zla ba ⑫dkar ba phrogs pa bzhin/ /rna rgyan rin chen 'od zer gyi/ /tshogs kyis 'gram ⑫pa pu naḥ/ /kashlau bha ra ṇa rasnro shu ka khā pe na ka po la yoḥ/ /kastu ri le dag la ni/ /rol pa'i pa ṭa ⑪'khri shing slar/ /chu yi dag pa bri /5ba bzhin/ /dpral ba'i rgyan du kha yā sa byu li khyu mā nā la 'a/ ṭi hūṃ/ /ka lo ka ka la na kli bye sha ma yo ti nyi ma grogs mo yi⑫ / /gla rtsi'i ri mo 'bri byed pa/ /bsil zer dri ma ldan pa yisad 7 / /skyengs pa zhi bar byed 95—765

ti ta bā ba bye ma hārnyadzre dha rmā ga maḥ/ /rpā hūṃ pā sha kṛ tā me hūṃ na chos dang ni/ /nor gyi tshogs chen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhags pas bsdams pa'i gdung ba ni(3)/ /sa he muñtsa ba ndha āoṃ/ / swa ya bra dzā mya nyi ta tra ya tra te bye mā tā bdag gis (snyemi bzod bcings pa thong / /gang du khrod 'gro mngon 'dod pa/ /der ni bdag rang nyid ga tiḥ/ /di ba muzlu tya gasgo mi na twa haṃ mukta ba ndha nā/ /yarja kyis 'gro/ /bcings pa btang bar gyur kyang bdag /mkha' la 'phur nas yongs (snye/mi 'gro/ /gang gi shādma ka tibyombi tsū ḍā rarja kṛ hā ṇa ta ta/ /i kyuktaḥs ta yā sā sru dbang gis mkha' la bdag /'gro ba'i gtsug gi rin chen bzung / /zhes des mchi ma dang bcas smras/ /pra yātaḥka ru ṇadro tī/ /tsū ḍā ma ṇi sa mā dā ya pā shaṃ mughā dza gā ma da snying rjes brlan pa nyid gyur des④/ /gtsug gi nor bu yang dag blangs/ /zhags pa bkrol nas de la hūṃ / /sa mā swa bee nyi ka spyo ṇi na sho ki kand+ra marta si/ /na nā ma nu smras—/ /dge ma dbugs ni dbyung bar mdzod/ /mya ngan bya bar yongs (snyemi 'os nges par 'os pa tsi tā ya tī pra yasgo mi ni dzetstsha yā/ /aste rā dza su taḥshrī mā na gu ṇa min la khyod/ /rang gi 'dod pas stsol mi bgyida'u/ /gang gi grags pa bdud rtsi yi/ /rba (dza7rlabs kyis ratna ma ho da byeḥ/ /pū ri taḥka ku bha sabye ye na tīshya mṛ tombi bhiḥ/ /sa bi ni phyogs kun khengs/ /yon tan rin chen chu gter che/ /dpal ldan rgyal po'i sras po yod/ /de ni byā ba da nā saktaḥ ka lā ke li bi byu ṣa rṇa/ /su thratta ཿsu dha rmā nā ma rig pa zhal la chags/ /sgyu rtsal rtsed 'jos rnam par brgyan/ /rang gi rigs kyi khyad par can/ /ni dza baṃ sha bi she ṣa kaḥ/ /sa te sa mu tsi taḥsu ju bee bhra mā bha ra rde bhu legs spyod nor bzang zhes pa'o/ /bde dga' dag gi dpal bzhin du/ /gtong dang longs spyod skal ba baḥ / /tya go pa sgo ga su bha gaḥsu khotpa ba i ba shri yaḥ/ /su ra kinda bzang / /rnam 'phrul sa yi rgyan gyur te/ /smin legs khyod la yang dag 'os/ /gang gi ⑦sa yi mtshan 95—767

ra gandhaza bi byā dha ra bi la se dzñā/ /yaḥkhidzee ku ru te gza muza ri shaza rī pa mo'i bdag /lha dang dri za mi 'am ci/ /rig 'dzin rnam par rtsen rnams kyi/ /khengs pa dag ni thung tiḥ / /i ti te na kṛ tā shā sa bantu brga bi yo gi nī/ /ku ra rī ngur byed/ /ces pa ①de yi dbugs phyung zhing / /gnyen tshogs bral ba'i yid 'phrog ma②/ /ku ra ri bā ti kā ru khaṃ pi la lā sa ma no ha rāḥ/ /a ṭwā ta re bindha ta ṭi mṛ ga ke li bzhin shin tu ni/ /snying rje rje skad cho nge bton/ /skabs der 'bigs byed ngos la ni/ /rngon snegyi rtsed kau tu ka/ / prasbi taḥsu dha no dha ghā sha ṣpe ste de sha mā ya yo/ /mo'i dge mtshan la/ /'phong mkhas nor bzang song gyur pa/ /rim gyis rjoganas der 'ongs par gyur/ /ra tha ṣpe mi swa ṣpesta su sra dzrerghaṃ shi khi maṇḍa li/ /ba na lasgyuḥkṣa rde le de yi shing rta'i mu khyud smras⑤/ /rma bya'i tshogs kyis gar byas nas/ /du ku dul nyid g.yo zhing sngo/ /bhe lo la dī la du ku la hūṃ/ /sa ka po la pra ṇa yi bhirba rbha swe do da band+ra nags kyi dpal mos skad cig thob/ /de ni rngul gyi chu thigs dag /'gram par chags pas rab mjos dzhaḥ —/ / saṃ krābye ཿ kuṇḍa la pānta mukta pha le ri ba sgo nyi / /gyanda pasag—/ /rna rgyan mtha' na rab mdzes pasakye/ /mu tig 'bras bu 'phos pas ⑨bzhin/ /mdun du so nā shwa khu rodhū tai danta dī pi ti bhiḥpu raḥ/ /ha randi ba ra dzaḥpuñdzi byā dza yi 'od zer gyis/ /shing rta'i rta rmig gis babeengs pa'i⑫/ /rdul gyi tshogs rnams 'phrog pa bzhin/ /hā ra sa sā ra tho/ /a ho ma no ra the ṣpe ba ra thā ni la la ra ha sā/ /dru kha lo pa la des smras pa/ /kye ma yid kyi shing rtas ⑪bzhin/ /shing rta rlung ltar mgyogs pa yis/ /rang ro༈ tā swa mee ṣpe na ki ya tī lo bhe tā kṣi tiḥ/ /e tā bā lā ni losthā pa lo sde ring du btang nas ni/ /ji snyed sa gzhi 'das par gyur/ /byang chub shing gi yal 'dab ni/ /rlung la pispa la pabee ba/ /ha radhi ha ra titshwa lnga ha ri shā bha ra ṇa bhu baḥ/ /gzhon gyis bskyod g.yo ldan pa/ /sa 'dis rgyan ni ljang gu yis7/ /ljang pa'i mdzes pa nyid dag 'phrog /95 768

e tā bā la pra bā lobye sta ba ka sta na bantu raḥ/ /soṅkakhye i ba rjo bhadhe 'khri shing gsar pa byi ①ru'i mchu/ /me tog phyun bu'i nu ma rgyas/ /snye ma rlung gis / 37dkrugs 'di dag /mañdzarluḥshwa sa nā ku lāḥ/ /i mā ma ra ka ta shā ma sha bo saṃ tsa ya ke tsu kāḥ/ /rā sred ldan bzhin du glal bar byed/ /ma ra ka ta ltar ljang ba'i/ /rtswa sngon tshogs kyi stod kor can/ /me dzadhe kau su ma ra dzo ra dzi tā ba na rā dza yaḥ/ /e ta bee tsa li tā sgyu bā ha tog rdul gegyis spras pa yi/ /nags 'phreng spyo'adi dag rab tu mdzes/ /skrag nas bros pa'i ri dwags mo/ /ri khyusthā sa bee dru tāḥ/ /tī lotpa la ba nā nī ba thra byedhi ta ra le kṣi taiḥ/ /'di dag mgrin pa 'khyog po yis/ /g.yo zhing blta ⑤bas utpal ni/ /sngon po'i nags tshal spro ba bzhin/ /e te ni shā ka ra ka dzee ku ra kānta daddhāḥpallī pa ti pra ṇa yi mbista na tu lya so ni mtshan mor khyebyed pa'i cha yi ⑦myu gu ltar mjos shing / /bum pa ri khrod ma bdag mdza' mo'i nu ma rku bhāḥ/ /pa bye ti darnyi shi sha paḥpa ri to ra dzee me ṣpe me swa nā sa z-i ta tsā dag dang mtshungs/ /rtsibs kyi sgras bcom rnam par g.yo ba'i rna blags khyaso ldan gyi/ /phru gu 'di dag pa la lī na kaṭwāḥ/ /e te nidzre la nazladā pa ri sa ra byā dzo bye ballī ba kun nas bdag gi shing rta dag la blta/ /sha ba ri yi rked skabs las 'phro rma bya'i 'dab 'phreng 97rol pas la dru sgo dā ma ma dhū tpa ba pra ṇa yi na ཿ spyi bā i ba byu ṇḍi tā ཿ / /bskyod pa yi/ /rtsed ⑩'jo'i rnam 'phrul cha yi 'ching ba rnams la chas par gyur pa 'bigs hūṃ1byed rlung / /sandajuḥs pa rī ni tasbra bi la sadmā yu ra pa tā ba li lbo lasdo la na nadzre bi dri med chu klung nar ma dā ngogs 'khri shing g.yo zhing rnam par rgyas pa yi/ /me tog sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston bhra ma ka lā beenda 6 bandha ni lāḥ/ /i ti bru ba ṇaḥka la ya na na lasmro dṛ rgyas pas rab bsgos 'di dag stsos pa bzhin du 'khyam/ /zhes pa smra ba'i mi bdag bu/ /nags kyi dpal batpa dzaḥ/ /shu shā ba nidzdza na kaṇḍi kindaryāḥka ru ṇa swa rgo/ /shu tī la spyod pa yis dku/ /skye bo med par mi 'am ci'i/ /snying rje'i sgra yis ra/rtagang ba thos/ /thos nas dge 95—769

ba kau tu kā kṛṣṭastatpa mbi paṃ kṛ pā ni dhiḥ/ /so hye tya sadku rja darshastunda darsha mtshan kyis drangs te/ /de dang nye ba shebartse ba'i gter/ /yon tan dam pa'i me long de/ /song bas ri mṛ gī tro shaṃ/ /yā tsa mā nā ba ri tā rṇa luddhā shaṃ sā sru lo tsa āoṃ/ /dwags mig de mthong / /mig tshur ①bcas pas rngon pa la/ /yongs su bskyab ①pa zhu byed cing / /ba ṣpe tsa ra kṣa yoju gā mi ba kā na na de ba tsā / /a dzwahūṃ lubha nags rgyu zad pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /ldan pa'i nags tshal lha mo bzhin/ /ri dwags mtshan pa'i ④kā kṛṣṭi swa oṃ ka mṛ ga mā ga tsā / /khind+ra mi ba ba na judhyā lasmre ba dpal mo ni/ /rab brtags ri dwags rngon pa yis(snye/ /drangs pa 'tshol ⑥du 'ongs gyur pa/ /nags ha ri ṇa laghra ṇaḥ/ /tī bi lo kya sa ābyarya rū pā ti sha ya bismi taḥ/ /su 'khyam zhing skyo ba bzhin/ /de mthong phul du byung ba'i gzugs/ /ngo mtshar bcas pas ⑦ya mtshan te/ /a bhi khā ṣa pa ṭi kṣi pre tsi tra n+yasta i bā bha bta/ /so tsinta ya da ho ra mya mngon par 'dod pa'i ras la ni/ /myur du ri mo bkod bzhin gyur/ /de bsams kye ma 'di yi bzhin/ /nisthā shā sgyu sa kā ri ṇaḥ/ /asmidru kha pa mulle khe re khā pa ri ṇa ti beebyeḥ/ /legs par 'bri la mdzes pa ni/ /rnam par sprul byed goms byas pa'i/ /byed po ri mo yongs su smin/ /durlu bhā sgo gi bha ba ṣpe mju lo ke ka bee ba kā/ /ma bye khā ba rgya mu dre gdengs can gnas na rnyed par (nya dka'/ /mi yi yul na gtam nyid ci/ /mdzes sdug rgya 'di mtho ris yo swarge ṣṭa dzha na bo di tāḥ/ /tā ru bye na ni rpā ta she sha ba ta yā su'ang / /gsar du mngon par 'khrungs sam snyam/ /gzhon nu ma nyid dar la bab pas 'thungs tso)pas sā rgo ga shri gā ri ju taj-i gyuḥsā ka dzee ga saṃ ga ma sa khāe rbha gi rna rpā lus med dang bcas sgeg ldan zhing / /lus phra mnyen ⑩lcug gsar du bstar (/1byas yan lag kun 'grogs gā kṛ tā / /niḥsaṃ ram̐ bha pa rā kra maḥthra thu ta rā ram̐ bhā dzha yo shaṃ bi grogs can gang gis ni/ /'bad med pha rol gnon la ⑩shin tu rgya cher rtsom pa'i mngon sbyor dang bral bar/ /95—770

nānd+rastsa bye dza ga hūṃ ya yā bi dza ya te de bo bi lā sā yu dhaḥ/ /i ti bisma ya 'gro ba'i rgyal srid che la rtse dga'i mtshon dang ldan pa'i lha ni rnam par rgyal/ /de ltar ya mtshan snying po can/ /gasgo ṇa sā bhi khā ṣe ṇa tsa kṣu ṣā/ /tsā bi banta mi bā bye hye pra ṇa mya pā ha lubha mngon par 'dod ldan mig gi (1sheni/ /de 'thungs (rte7mtshungs la mngon phyogs te/ /phyag 'tshal rngon pas kaḥ / /ku la kalpa dru ma gye yi dru ma gye da yi tā su tā/ /de ba kinda rab smras pa/ /mi 'am ci rgyal rigs kyi ni/ /dpag bsam ljon pa ljon pa yi/ /bu mo yid du 'ong ma ra rā dza su pā she nā pa kṛ tā ma yā/ /ā mbi tā twaskṛ te di bya ka bye ṣā pra ti 'di—/ /lha gcig bdag gi 1zhags pas drangs/ /khyod slad blangs pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /mchog 'di kṛ khya tsā/ /twa me bā gya gu kho dā ra bhaṭwā byu ba i bo tsi taḥ/ /ā rab tu gzung ④bar mdzod/ /yon tan rgya che khyod nyid ni/ /sa gzhi 'di yi bdag tu 'os/ /'di yi sngasgo ḍa ma ṇi ra yo ma yā swetshwa ga ti pra daḥ/ /kṛ tī tastabyi ra hi gtsug gi nor bu 'di/ /rang 'dod 'gro ster bdag gis (sheni/ /bzung ste de dang bral bas nikhya/ /tā ṣpe yo yā ti bi hā ya sā/ /rakhyo ma ṇi ra yo nāste daste smiṅgi ga mo na yā/ /i nam mkha' dag la 'gro ba med/ /nor bu 'di ni bsrung bya ste/ /'di byin 'di dang phrad pa med/ /bu tyākta mee da do ka tyā rarja rarja tsa lubha kaḥ/ /kṛ tī tā rā dza pu tre na sa ma mo rin chen rin chen yang / /de brjod de la rngon pas byin/ /sa yi ri dwags mtshan ma de/ /rgyal po'i tī mṛ ga lakṣa zla/ /su dhwa seṭī ba ta tyā dza swa de sha bi ra hā na lam̐/ /bu yis meblangs pa na/ /bdud rtsis bran bzhin rang yul dang / /bral ba'i me ni btang bar gyur/ /uṅkaṇḍi lo ka nā lo lā tai bā la ha ri bhā mi pa/ /ba bandha lubha ka tyashā 'dod ldan mig gis ①g.yo ba yi/ /ri dwags gzhon nu ma 'dra de97/ /rngon pas btang nas yid kyis ni//rāg bā gu ra yā ma naḥ/ /kinda ri ra tha mā ro bya rasne rā pūrya lubha chags pa'i rgya yis bcings par gyur/ /mi 'am ci mo shing rtar bkod/ /rngon pa rin chen rnams kyis 95—771

shaṃ—/ /harṣa pūṇḍiḥswa na ga ram̐ pra ta ste pārji bātpa dzaḥ/ /sa haste nā pu ram̐ pā bya ni bkang / /dga' ba rgyas pa'i sa bdag sras/ /rang gi grong khyer dag tu song / /haste na yi grong phyin testi//bee rya swa ka tsā pi tuḥ/ /harṣajisma yi bhā te na bi bā te gi hi totpa baḥ/ /rang gi gtam ni pha la bshad/ /dga' bas ya mtshan gyur pa des/ /bag ma yi ni dga' ston bsgrubs/ /su kṛ taisgo gya tsā yā tsā mūrta mi ba sha shi shri yo/ /antaḥpu ra pra ṇa yi shlau tsakre gzugs can ri bong can kyi dpal/ /dge bas spyad byar gyur pa bzhin/ /mi 'am ci yi bu mo ni/ /pho kinda ra ka n+ya tsā/ /da dha tā ma dhu pe ṣpe pa te nā dha ra ma dhu smṛ haṃ/ /brang 'khor du gnas par byas/ /mchu yi sbrang rtsir chags ldan pa/ /sprang rtsi 'thungs pas ④bzhin du des/ /smṛbyen ta mu khaṃ sgo dzā tsa ka spe na lbo mbi ba sā/ /mo ṣpe pa ka thi toṅkaṇḍi mu reg pas bzhin gyi chu skyes ni/ /dud cing padmo can de 'dar/ /smra ba bcad kyang sred pa 'chad/ /g.yo huḥ kasbe pi nibya waṃ/ /bai laghra bi sgra ṭa laghra ta suḥdī tsā ta tā na ba med kyang yang yang 'dar/ /skyengs par gyur kyang dpal mdangs gsal/ /de yi dga' ba de yis ①sāḥ / /sa sha ṣpe ra dhwa rā swā de da tā danta bee ddhā yi hūṃ/ /bi ni druṣṭa bsgrubs—/ /dal gyis ④mchu yi ro myang zhing phye/ /so yi 'jigs pa byin nas ni/ /chu skyes rgyas pa'i dṛ shasta gya mo na mu dā ma bā ra yata/ /byā bī mo kṣe ni ṣe dhe tsa da ma mig can de'igye/ /smra bcad rgya ni de yis khya)phral/ /gos mdud 'grol dang dgag pa la/ /khyo shug khyebhyoḥpā ṇi padma yoḥ/ /bi bā da i ba soṅkadza shaṃ ka ṇa swa na yo ra khyuta/ /sa lag pa'i padma 7she dag /rab tu 'dar ldan gdu bu'i sgra/ /rtsod pa 'u/ byed par gyur pa bzhin/ /rtse rā ga balla bsta gya bi mā pa smi ta pu྾ taḥ/ /kāddhā ku tsa pha khā ko dga' 'dzum gyi me tog rgyas/ /mdzes pa'i nu ma'i 'bras bu 7mtshan/ /chags bcas ⑫yal 'dab byu bye gyaḥ saṃ sgo ga bā da paḥ / / a tā nta re da kṣi ṇa khyo bi thra ka ldan pa de'i/ /longs spyod rkang 'thung spyad byar byur/ /gnas skabs der ni lho phyogs pa/ /bram ze 95—772

pi la puṣka ro/ /a dzagru tudṛnti kā mo dha na gya dṛ pa teḥs bhām/ /to ser skya puṣkar ①gnyis/ /rgyal po nor gyi mdun sar ni/ /'tsho ba 'dod pas 'ongs par gyur/ /rig bi byā ti sha yashā spyo po rā nyi tya ma bā pa tuḥ/ /ka pi laḥkṣi ti pā khā gya pa phul byung bsngags ⑤'os pa/ /de dag mdun na 'don gnyis guthob/ /ser skya dag ni sa skyong gi/ /rā dza pu tra ba tsa sa raḥ/ /ta yorlursha tsa badhe na sa dā bi bā da mā na yoḥ/ /rgyal po'i bu yis ④gzhan pa'o/ /de dag reg pas bcings pa yis/ /rtag tu rnam par rtsod byed cing / /e ka dra byā rnyi khā ṣe ṇa bi dwo ṣa sa ma dzā ya ta/ /dzwa ṣa do ṣe ṇa mā tai ga rdzas gcig mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /rnam par sdang ba khye yang dag skyes/ /glang po la 'os snun byed pa//yo gya nirgha ta yosta yoḥ/ /bi da dhe ma da le khe ba bi tyā ma li na tsā mu khe/ /ye de dag gdong gi rig pa ni/ /chang gi ri mo lta bu dag /zhe sdang skyon gyis nyams par bsgrubs/ /gang ྾ bstu bi bee ki — gu ṇa sa khāe lo ka pra kā shorlu khāe bi tyā dī pa shi gis spyorig pa mar me'i rtse mo dngos po rnam 'byed ⑦yon tan dag gi grogs/ /'jig rten rab tu gsal khā ka ro ti bi ṣa oṃ dī ṣārnya kā raḥpu raḥ/ /te mo ho sa ha tā bi tsā ra la mngon phyogs mdun du zhe sdang mun pa mi bzad byed/ /rmongs pas nyer bcom rtog dpyod dang bral dubi hi tā ཿ sau dza tyā hi tā daddhā byandan tsand+ra kānta ka ma la susdoṅga te gzhung bzang chung ma'i dgra bo de dag rnams/ /tsan dan zla ba chu shel padmo khu rngub las 'khrungs me yis nāghi nā/ /shu ti smṛ ti bi bā de 6 puṣka re ṇa pa de ba de/ /ni kṛ sreg par byed/ /thos dang dran dang ⑪rtsod rnams la/ /gnas dang gnas su puṣkar 71gyis/ /nges par khya mā ṇaḥ ka pi laḥko pa tā pā da tsinta yata/ /mand+ra tya saṃ dṛ ṭwā sgyu tshar bcad ser skya yis/ /khro ba'i gdung bas yongs su bsams/ /no zhing brtan par goms gyur pa/ /sast+rikyā st+ri bra ma dodha taḥ/ /sa dā saṃ sā rda mā me ba na ya hye ṣa bi mi bzad rgyags shing 'char ⑫ba 'dis/ /rtag tu goms pas zhan pa bdag skya /mdun sa dag tu skyengs 95—773

laghra hūṃ/ /pradzñā pañtsa ka dṛṭwā ya khru tai dadzee dzwa ra pa bā/ /dha rna dhasgro ni par byed/ /shes rab slu ①byed tshul dang ni/ /thos pa dregs pa'i rims dag dang / /nor ni chos dag ṣe dhwa ya bha ba tya dha ma tse ta sī/ /dṛptaḥpa ri bha bya tya ṣa rā dza 'gog pa'i slad/ /ma rabs sems ldan rnams la 'gyur/ /dregs ldan 'di yis rgyal sras la/ /brten pu tā shra yi ṇa rmā/ / tasmra dā shra ya e bā mya shrī rū le pra ha rā mya nas bdag ni ②yongs su 'joms/ /de slad 'di yis snerten nyid la0/ /dpal gyi rtsa ba bdag gis haṃ —/ /ni dha ṣpe rā dza pu tra gya yukyu pā ye ṇa kai ṇa tsita/ /yuktaḥgazhom—/ /rigs ⑤pa'i thabs ni 'ba' tshuzhig gis/ /rgyal po'i sras ni dgum pa la/ /bdag ni kahūṃ pra yasgo me mā na gā no ka baṃ paste/ /i tru gra pā pa saṃ kalpa ta 'bad pa bya bar 'os/ /khengs pa nyams pa ji ltar bzod/ /de ltar drag po'i sdig brtags ⑦pa/ /de gya dwo ṣātpa mu rya yo/ /nāste tatyā ta shaṃ lo ke yanda kuzarnyi matpa rāḥ/ /la snang ④bas yang dag sbyar/ /phrag dog gis gang mi byed pa'i/ /sdog de 'jig rten na yod min/ /ka dzee pa shya lta sa baṭwā pa pa dā bya thi tā sha yaḥ/ /datta na ya na yorle na tī gang gis mi bzad khro ba yi/ /dug gi mig sman mig tu stibatab/ /rtag tu bsam ⑩pa 'khrugs pa des/ /bra marṣa bi ྾ dza dzwa/ /rā shaṃ pā paṃ pa ra ma ma dhi kandadzee pā paṃ ta to pi kro dhwand+ra paṃ legs pa'i lam ni ji ltar mthong / /'dod chags mchog tu sdig cing de las kyang ni lhag par dregs pa dza ga ti na pa rā du ཿ sa haṃ lo bha pā paṃ / / yā bā ṣpe ṣa bya sdig /khro las sdig gzhan 'gro ba na med bzod dka'i sdig pa chags ⑪pa'o/ /gdung ba dang ldan 'gro pa ni ni dza ṣpe ga ju te pā pa brgaḥpā dzā sha gya smṛ sha ti na tu dzee so pi bi dwo na sdig pa'i tshogs ni ji snyed bgrangs gyur pa/ /des kyang rnam par sdang bas bskrun pa'i sdig pa'i cha la ṣa sru teḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsidme ghā khye ku rja kattha ṭa bā si rna/ /bi mtshungs reg min/ /de nas skenam zhig sprin zhes pa'i/ /gdug cing kar pa ṭar gnas pa/ /gnod 95—774

thraṣṭa mee n+ya haṃ tā ra sā manta ma pa kā ri rde/ /khru tā na ra pa tiḥko pa 'byed pa'i rgyal bran du gyis/ /dpung rnams springs pa gsod (snyepa dag /thos nas mi bdag khros pa bā stso tusgopā ya ni: ye/ /a mā tyā nā mā nu ma he ku mā ra mi da ma bra yis—/ /thabs ni bzhi par nges byas te/ /blon po rnams kyi 'dod pa yis/ /gzhon nu la ni 'di dag bīta —/ /ku mā ra ga mya tsā tūṇḍi myutstshantu ta ra sā ri hūṃ/ /kra mo sa smras—/ /gzhon nu stobs kyis ④dgra dag ni/ /myur du gcod du 'gro bar gyis/ /khyod kyis skyerim sasgo sā mra dzhai niḥsha lya mi da mastu te/ /a yi te sa ma rā ram̐ bye pra 'ongs rgyal srid che'i'u / /'di ni zug rngu med par 'gyur/ /g.yul gyi rtsom par khyod kyi ྅ni/ /dpung bhā bā bha ra rto byu dzaḥ/ /ā khā na ste bha tī yā tu dza gaju dza ya darnyi niḥ/ /pa mthu yis brgyan pa 'di⑤ / /'gro bar rgyal ba'i glang po dag /'dogs pa'i ka ba nyid du 'gyur/ /me bhe bhū z-idku khā krarnyi saṃ ram̐ bhā bhya dhi ko da yi/ /ha te ta ba pra ta pa gya sa 'dzin rigs ni non ⑨pa'i sprin/ /sdug cing lhag par rgyas pa dag /bcom na khyod kyi gzi byen gyis⑩//nirbi spyo ba ra shā di shaḥ/ / dudzee leḥki ha tai ra byeḥ sa manti ranta phyogs su sgrib ⑪pa'i bgegs med 'gyur/ /stobs med mtha' na gnas pa yi'u/ / /rgyal phran gzhan ni bā pi bhiḥ/ /dṛptaḥs e ba hanta byastabo dhe sattha sidha yaḥ/ /ki kau bsad pas ci/ /dregs ldan de nyid gzhom par bya/ /de bsad na skyeni thams cad 'grub/ /gang zhig tu shaṃ ya di ha riḥ ka ri tsakra pa lā mā harnyi de ba bi hi tai ni dza me cha yi ④rang zas nyid du rnam par bsgrubs ⑩pa yi/ /glang chen tshogs ni 'phrog byed kyis bcom dge mtshan ba sgo rdzu/ /pañtsa na rna ya di bhi natta na khāṣṭa hā saṃ tatta su po ru ṣa ka ci zhig yod/ /gal te sder mo'i gad rgyangs ldan pa'i gdong lnga mngon bcom na/ /de ni de yi skyes bu thā pa tha me ti shorlo/ /i ti pi dru sa ma diṣṭaḥs mbi nyi ta ra rṇatpa baḥ/ /rtul phod gtam gyi lam du 'gyur/ /zhes pa pha yis bstan pa na⑩/ /g.yul gyi dga' ston 'dod pa dang / /95—775

kinda rī bi ra hā lo laḥso bhūsdo lā ku lo kṣa rde/ /a tsi rā ga ma na khyu mi 'am ci 'bar g.yo bas denya// /skad cig khyogs la/la 'phyang bzhin gyur/ /yun ring 'gro ba min brjod ṣpe ryasne rā shwa gya babee dzñā/ /dza na sthā sī ra ma bye tya pra ṇi sa tya dza pas—/ /'bad pas chung ma dbugs phyung nas/ /de yi lam la mngon phyogs ste/ /phyag byas dal gyis gā da saḥ/ /du hi tā sha kra kalpa su kinda rend+ra gya mā ni rmā/ /pā spyo bi ra rab smras pa/ /mi 'am ci dbang brgya byin du/ /brtag bya'i bu mo khengs ldan ma/ /khyod kyis bdag la ha sho kātrī madmā tpa lya dhi lnga twa yā/ /a sngasgo ḍā ma ṇi ra yo rakhyuḥsretshwa byams pa'i blos/ /'bral ba'i mya ngan gyis gzir skyongs/ /'di yi gtsug gi nor bu ni/ /rang 'dod ga ti pra daḥ/ /da ta byaḥsarba thā mā ta nā n+ya tra mā ṇa saṃ sha yāta/ /i kyughā dza na 'gro ba ster 'di dag /srog la the tshom ma gtogs pa/ /ma ma ④kun tu sbyin mi bya/ /zhes brjod ma yi nī ha ste gārghaṃ kādzñā shi khā ma ṇi/ /ni kṣi pya sa ya yo tūṇḍi bee spyotshwa lag tu ni/ /mdzes ma mdzes ma'i gtsug gi nor/ /gtad nas dpung gi rjophyogs kyi sgo/ /sgrib cing de di ti didru khaḥ/ /ta su bā dzi bra dzosgru ta raḥpuñdza sna na do yaḥ/ /pra ya ni myur du song / /de yi ⑥rta tshogs kyis bslang ba/ /rdul tshub ⑦sprin ltar rgyas pa yis/ /ngang pa'i yo rā dza haṃ sā rmā saṃ tā sā yā sa he tu tsā/ /dru ra pra yā te da yi te bi ra he ṇa rgyal po skrag pa dang / /nyon mongs rgyu nyid dag tu gyur⑧/ /khyo ni ring ladu song ba na/ /'bral ba yis ma no ha rā/ /ba bhū ba bā la na li byā pa khā sha sha ya rā sha yā/ /soṅkakhye yā ni yid 'phrog ma/ /padma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma yis/ /mal stan la ni brten par gyur/ /sred ldan nyin di ba pa ga ṇa nā ram̐ bha ni tyā bhe yo ge saṃ khyu re khā sha ri ṇi ma ba no kadza par bgrang ba'i rtsom ṅkapa dag la rtag tu spyomangon sbyor zhing / /grangs kyi ri mo'i lam ni sa la 'dar zhing lo lo li khaṃ bhyaḥ/ /ta suḥpā ṇi ni pa ti ta ra ṇaṅge ka ṇi tā na be na kṣi pre muṣā g.yo bas 'dri ḍa/ byed pa/ /de yi lag pa phra ba nyid kyis sgra ldan gdu bu lhung ba la/ /mchi ma'i rgyun gyi mu 95 —776

ba la ya ka la nā ma shu dhwa rā tsa kā ra/ /dwo ṣaḥputpa sha re su khe ba mu kha tā tig gdub kor ①dag ni myur du gnas par byas(pe/ /me tog mda' ①can la sdang bde la phyir phyogs lus de he yi ni ste ha tā pa khyo dhyā na pa rā ya ṇa twa ma ni shā tand+ra ma masgo la'ang chags pa nyid ma yin/ /bdag po'i bsam gtan skyong zhing nyin mtshan du ni de yi ming gi gsang dza paḥ/ /sha yā byu mi ta lam̐ ta thā pi su ta nostu pa kṣa ti rtswa bha ba sngags zlos/ /mal stan sa gzhir byas te de lta na yang gzugs bzang gdung ba nyams ma gyur/ /'dod nu dzwa nibya la lī na rā ga ma na rmā muspri tsa tī pra bra taiḥ/ /lī nā chags g.yo med chags pa'i yid rnams brtul zhugs drag pos grol ba min nam ci/ /shel gyi ④khri stan la spa ṭi ka ba.oṃ kai ha ri tsan da na pāṇḍa rā/ /tsand+ra le khe ba sā ta āoṃ byosgo ma rgya ga 'dug cing / /ha ri tsan dan gyis skye ba/ /gzugs can ma de zla 'od kyi⑤/ /dbus song ⑥zla ris tā ba sgo/ /ka dā tsi da tha bhū pā laḥswasna darghaṃ na shi ki haḥ/ /pu ro bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas nam zhig sa skyong ni/ /rmi lam mthong nas dogs gyur pas/ /mdun na hi ti sa mā snu ya pa pratstsha ka pi li ra haḥ/ /dṛṣṭa ma rya ma yā swasne ni 'don ni ser skya dag /yang dag bos nas dben par dris/ /grong khyer dgra rnams kyis bkag cing / /rurghaṃ sha tru bhiḥpu ram̐/ /pā ṭi to da ra kṛṣṭi: ma mādhe pa ri beji tai/ /bdag gi lto brdol ⑦rgyu ma ni/ /drangs nas yongs su dkris pa yi⑧/ /rmi lam de ring bdag gis mthong / /swasna snga su bi pā karta pha lo bru hi ma hā ma te/ /bi tsinta ya shu sgo da blo gros chen po mi lam 'di'i/ /rnam byun 'bras bur 'os pa gsungs/ /dge bar yongs sgyur 1'os pa kā nu tsi tsā tsa pra ti kṛ lnga/ /i ti thraṣṭaḥkṣi tī she na kṣa ṇa mandaḥyis / /phyir bcos dag kyang bsam par mdzod/ /ces pa sa yi dbang pos dris/ /mdun na 'don pu ro hi taḥ/ /bhatta rda bha bye ta dhyā naḥs mbi hi ta ma tsinta yata/ /gyis skad cig ni/ /gus pa'i tshul 'chos ⑩bsam gtan bzung / /nang du mngon par 'dod pa bsams /95—777

kinda rī na durla ghā/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥshu tā spyu ram̐ pā ta ka ku ṇi taḥ/ /yod pas mi 'am ci mi dkon/ /zhes pa de tshig ma rungs pa/ /thos nas sdig pas rmus phyin cing / /dṛ shaṃ pa bṛtta saṃ trastastasta ma bhā ṣasgru pa tiḥ/ /ni dza dzi bi ta rakṣu yi gtum po'i spyod pas skrag gyur pa/ /sa yi bdag pos 3de la smras/ /rang gi srog ni bsrung slad du 7/ /ka dzee byā ba dha mupyo he/ /kinda rī bi ra he ba bye na tsa dzre ba ti me su taḥ/ /bud med gsod par khyeji ltar spro/ /mi 'am ci mo dang bral na/ /nges par bdag gi 47bu mi 'tsho/ /i nyi byu mi bhu dzā ta gya pra tyā khyu te sa mbi hi te/ /tai pā pā rbha ni bee she na su zhes te sa la spyod pas de'i/ /'dod pa phyir la bzlog pa na/ /mdun na 'don ni sdig pa la/ /mngon naḥpā ha pu ro hi haḥ/ /a ho rā dzanda dzā mbi ṣe dhī mā na bi dza naspru tai/ /tri par zhen pas yang der smras/ /kye ma rgyal po blo gros dang / /ldan yang skye ba'i (3‘lugs mi shes/ /sde brga sā dha rna tyā rdzu na ra rdzu na tsa dzre bi tai/ /arja i ba swa dza na gsum sgrub khye7byed rgyal srid dang / /srog kyang gtang rmyabar bya ba min/ /nor bzhin nang mi grogs po mi tra ka la tra pu tānaṣṭaḥsbi ta su pu ru ṣa gya pu narbha brnyi/ /utshwa sa mā tra chung ma bu dag chani/ /nyams pa skyes bu gnas na slar yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dbugs tsam bral zhing bi ra te ga ta dzī bi ta gya taṭwā la sadmā hitam su sa de ba sarde/ /tyā dzasti dzī bi srog ni song bar gyur pa lasakye/ /de dus nye bar gnas kyang thams cad med pa nyid/ /'tsho ba'i don du ta sngabee ni dza de sha pri yātpa dzaḥ/ /dzre bi tā da pa ram̐ rā dza na dzre bi lo rang yul dang / /gces pa'i bu yang gtong bar byed/ /rgyal po 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten na/ /srog las keste na pri yo/ /i ti dzre bi ta lo bha ya te na nā nā ni darsha ṣpeḥ/ /sha ṣpeḥgazhan ni gces pa med/ /de ltar de yi 37sna tshogs kyinyurta/ /dpe yis dal gyis brid pa na/ /rgyal po pra tā ri teḥ sā re rā dzā yukta ma ma n+ya ta/ / ta taḥsu saṃ bye tā ram̐ srog la chags pa yi①1 / /sdig la rigs par kha yis blangs/ /de nas phun tshogs rtsom me pa yis/ /95—779

bhe bra thraste ya dzha kand+ra ṇi/ /kṛ tā lnga puṣka ri rghaṃ tsa pushlau yī pa shu sho ṇi taiḥ/ /mchod sbyin las la 'jug byed cing / /phyugs kyi khrag gis gang ba yi/ /rdzing bu yang ni byas pa'i tshe /rā dzñā ka thi ta dṛṭwāddhā ni dza pasbyi swa yī ra haḥ/ /pu tra pra bā pa sho kāddhā dben par rang gi btsun mo la/ /rgyal pos rang gi spyod tshul bshad/ /bu ni byes bgrod mya ngan gyis/ /pā pa tra stu bya tsinta yata/ /a ho rūkhāe ta ro rā dzā mo hādhe na pu ro dha sā/ /gzir cing sdig pas skrag pas ①bsams/ /kye ma mna' ma gsod ②pa yi/ /sgrub byed sdig pa rgya che 'dir/ /sgru ṣā ba dha bi dhwa ṣpesmidzre ri taḥpri thu pā ta ke/ /yasne ra pa ri hāche mdun na 'don ni gti myug gis/ /long bas rgyal po rab rmongs bskul/ /'chi ①ba'i mtshams ni nges pi ni ba ste ni dha nā baṃ sgo / / pa ra pā shā pa hā re ṇa rū ṭwā bcad pa/ /'bad pas yongs 'phrog mi nus kyang / /gzhan gyi srog ni phrogs dhipa yis/ /blun po bāsbyi ti dzre bi tai/ /ya di jo bi ta lubye na muddhā mṛ ta ba dhū ri ba/ /rnams ni 'tsho bar 'dod/ /gal te srog la chags pa yis/ /bu mo bzhin bzang bdud rtsi 'dra/ /sgru ṣā pi ha n+ya nyi rā dzñā tiṅgi baghra mya haṃ su tai/ /mā tastu me yo bātpa myuta mna' ma yin yang rgyal po yis/ /bsad na bdag gis ⑤ci zhig smra/ /ma gcig khyed kyis mnyes gshin pā lya ma ma ma no ha rā/ /i kyughā su dha na sru nurga to ni kṣi su las—/ /bdag gi yid 'phrog ma 'di skyongs/ /zhes brjod bu ni nor bzang dag /bdag la chung ma me ba je/ /tasmrasgo ḍā ma ṇi mattaḥzwa pya byo rja pra yā tu pā/ /bha bi 6 gtad nas song / /de slad bdag las gtsug gi nor/ /thob nas ⑥de ni mkha' la 'gro/ /de ni 'tsho ti ta yā ba hphu jo baṃ tyā saṃ ga ma phu naḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya mā ga tā sā na bdag po dang / /slar yang phrad ṣṭapa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bsams mna' ma ga la bar/ /mig chur sru ṣpe tā snu ṣārnyi shaṃ/ /rā dzā dṛrghaṃ ni be byā sau soṅkaspra pu na ra pra bī ta/ /bātpa bcas pa de song nas/ /rgyal po'i tshul ni de la bshad/ /rab 'dar ldan pas slar smras pa/ /mnyes 95—780
