kra tuḥsidhiḥsā ha tā te na kinda rī/ /i ti mi byā ba tsa sta su rā dzā de des gsad/ /khyod kyi gyemachod sbyin bgegs med grub/ /ces pa de yi brdzun gyi tshig /rgyal po yis ② sa tya ma ma n+ya ta / / na ju dhe ku ṭi le rmu sgo ya nt+ra pu tta ka lbo ni bden par bsams/ /'khrul 'khor gzugs brnyan rtse ① dga' yis/ /rmongs rnams gya gyus gar la yā/ /pi turbha ba ṣpe ma bye tya khrirghaṃ harṣa ma no ha rā/ /n+ya bee da yetwa byed do/ /pha yi khang par mngon phyogs te/ /dga' ba ster byed yid 'phrog mas/ /snying la khyo ni bzung bṛtta rnyi ba hadhī palla bha z-i di/ /sā pi tuḥshā sa nādmaju saṃ ga po ra bha byas te/ /rang gi spyod pa'i mtha' rnams bshad/ /yab kyi bka' yis ④mi dang ni/ /'grogs pa'i dri shānta ye/ /he ma rku bha sha taiḥrtswa rgo pañtsa bhiḥpra tya haṃ pya dhwa ta/ /madhyā mo daḥpra ta ma zhi ba'i slad/ /gser gyi bum pa lnga brgya yis/ /nyi ma so sor khrus dag byas/ /bkrus pas mi yi dri ma byukṣu li tā yāḥsha ṣpe ya yo/ /su dha na sne ha saṃ yo ge na tu rā go mṛ gī ni—/ /rab tu chung ba nyid du gyur/ /nor bzang la ni mdza' gcugs ldan/ /ri dwags mig gi chags dṛ shaḥ/ /di byodmā no ba sgo ge 6 na pā nahṝ ti mā ya yo/ /a n+ya tra badhe rā gā pa min/ /lha yi skyed tshal longs spyod la/ /de ni dga' bar yongs ma gyur/ /gzhan la chags par gyur rde ra tiṭwā n+ya tra de hi rmā/ /sī kānta bee ra hā krāddhā ka dā tsibye ma gā pa yi/ sde / /lus can gzhan na 67dga' ba med/ /nam zhig mkha' la 'gro ma de/ /sdug pa dang bral nyon mi bhā/ /hūṃ nā ga bha ba no pānta ba nānta ba su ddhā ya yo/ /ta tā shra ma mongs shing / /klu yi khang pa'i nye 'khor de/ /nags mtha'i nor 'dzin dag tu song / /drang srong chen stha lī pa lte ma ha kṣi ba bee lā ya na / / a ba dhwa sa ma bye tya pra po bste gnas der(dzwa/ /gnas pa shing shun can de la/ /rab tu btud cing phyag btsal dute/ /dud spu rja ma bi na marlu khāe/ /lubha ka sro pa di sha tā bha ba tā ma ma brnya rna/ /twa cing mngon du phyogs pas smras/ /bdag ni 'ching ba rngon pa la/ /nye bar bstan pa khrod kyis ni/ /gal 95—782

me ba bru nyi bha ga ban ya di yukta mi rda kṛ tai/ /i ti ta snga ba tsaḥshu tā te rigs pas ①'di byas na/ /bcom ldan khyod nyid bdag gis bye gsungs/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas//kiñtsibeedzdza na tā na naḥ/ /tā mu bā tsa mu nirmuste ta bee ṣā bha bi ta bya tā/ /cung zad ngo tshas bzhin btud de/ /thub pas der smras bzhin bzang ma/ /'di ni khrod kyis myong bya nyid//a mo gha pā shasta sngaste tya dzñā tā ka thi tasma ya/ /u pa la bhya ka dzee dhwartahūṃ de la zhags pa don yod ni/ /yod ces bdag gis ma shes bshad/ /g.yon can rngon pas de yi ( 7gtam//pa bandha pa lubha kaḥ/ /duṣṭhadma rmā na dzā mbi maḥkau ṭi bye spyu ra tse ta shes nas khyod ni bcings par gyur/ /bden par smra ba'i mu cor can/ /rang bzhin drang ba bdag cag sā—/ /pa tya pra bā da mu kha rāḥsata bhya ba pa ra khā ba yo/ /i kyughā mu mi nā gis—/ /ma rungs bdag nyid gdug pa yi/ /sems kyi gya gyu yongs mi shes/ /zhes pa thub pas brjod ta rtswa pra ṇi yātta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bha ga baspyo mya tā me tabye lā ba tsa na de la/ /gzugs can ma yis gus pas ④ smras/ /bu mo'i tshig ni khyagayo ba 'di/ /bcom ldan gyis ni tsā pa lo/ /i dahūṃ bha ba ta ma gre yadma yā ki tsi du tsu te/ /la khā bzod par mdzod/ /khyed kyi mdun du bdag gis ni/ /gang 'di cung zad brjod gyur pa/ /dam pa'i su bha gaḥso yo pā dā tsā ra bya ti kra maḥ/ / duḥkhoddhā ra ṇa sanda ddhāḥspyod las 'gal ba 'di/ /bud med rnams kyi skal ba bzang / /sdug bsngal 'don la chas gyur cing / /santabhā dzā da ya la baḥ/ /kāryanta ra gāḥpā ye ṇa bha baṃ tya nu tsi te ṣa pi/ /yongs su gdung la brtse ldan rnams/ /'os pa min pa rnams kyi yang / /phal cher bya ba sgrub mdzad yin/ /pā sha ba nt+rabee mulnga haṃ lubha ke na pra lā se rmā/ / ni ba ddhā rā dza cho nge dang ni ⑥ldan pa bdag⑦ / /rngon pa'i zhags pas bcings las grol/ /'phrog byed mdza' ba'i pu tre ṇa sne ha pā she na ha ri ṇa/ /su bha gaḥsu dha nā khyo sau mju zhags pa yis/ /rgyal po'i bu yis nges par bcings/ /nor bzang zhes pa skal ba bzang / /bdag 95—783

yo gā na khā ku laḥ/ /a nu nā ya di marge ṇa sa me 6 te ta bārnyi rka/ /ta bral me yi gdung ba 'di①/ /gal te lam ni 'di nyid nas/ /khyod can nye bar 'ongs gyur na/ /snying di rda bha ba tā bātsuḥkā ru 5dma tsa sā ma ma/ /spri tā twabee ra sā yā pa niḥrje las ni khyod nyid kyis/ /bdag gi 'phrin ④'di smra bar byos/ /khyod bral gdung bas bde med cing / /su khā haṃ kṛ he pi tuḥ/ /uṅkaṇḍa ma nu rka pa rū sa ha dzā byā kṛ ta dzñā tsā/ /bdag ni yab kyi khyim na 'khod/ /'dun ①dang rjes su brtse ba 'am/ /byas shes lhan cig skyes pa yirjo/ /dākṣi bye bā pu raskṛ tya tūṇḍi mā ga mya tā mi taḥ/ /durga maḥkinda ra pu re mārgaḥrjes mthun mdun du bdar byas te/ /'di nas myur du 'byon par mdzod/ /mi 'am ci yi grong khyer lam//kle sha sha tā sha yaḥ / / a bhū mi re ba ma myu rmā malpa bī rya ba lo bgrod dka' nyon mongs brgya yi ⑤rten/ /brtson 'grus stobs gzi chung ba yi/ /mi rnams kyis ni sa dza shā/ /dībhā ta po ba nārnye smirlu dhwa nā ma ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /dṛ shya min nyid/ /dka' thub nags mtha' 'dir 'bar ba/ /bdud rtsi zhes pa'i sman chen ni/ /mthong ste te ha bi pā pa hūṃ pā ta byā sā swa yo twa yā/ /tand+ra bhā batpa muti rya kle zhun mar la btsos ⑥pa/ /khyod rang nyid kyis btung bar bya/ /de mthus snying stobs grogs ldan khrod/ /shaṃ sa twa sa hā ya bān/ /kai khā sa hā sa shu bye ṇa pa thā mahphu ra me bye nyon mongs rab tu sgrol 'gyur te/ /lam ni kai lā sa dgod ⑦ltar/ /dkar bas bdag grong phyin par piske/ /i rda tsa tasmi dā ta bye ma da bhi dzñā gu rī ya shaṃ/ /i trughā bi ṣa gyur(she / /bdag gi rtags mtshan sor gdub ni/ /'di yang de la sbyin par bya/ /zhes brjod de yis oṃ ba ṭwā ka tha yi tā kra me ṇa sā/ /bi sna pra ti kri yo pā yātpa nda mi bzad (7pa'i/ /lam ni rim pas bshad byas te/ /ngo mtshar rig ⑩pa dag gis ni/ /bgegs shya sprurya yusti bhe ཿ / / ā shā ba ndha bye ta pā ṇa ya yo da hūṃ gu byā rnams phyir bcos thabs bstan nas/ /re ba'i 'ching bas srog bzung ba/ /sor gdub byen nas song 95—784

ya ke/ /ta yā ka thi ta mā kasbya dru rā dhwa ta ra zland+ra tai/ /e gu rī ya bar gyur/ /lam ring sgrol byed rmad byung dag /de yis bshad pa thos gyur te/ /sor gdub dag ni ka mā dā ya ta de bā tsinta yazlu niḥ/ /a tānta re rā dza sru nurdzi tā me gha blangs byas nas/ /thub pa de dag nyid la sems/ /skabs der sa yi ①bdag po sprin/ /pham par byas ma tī pa ti/ /ā ya yo ko sha mā dā ya da yī tā darsha nokhru kaḥ/ /sa shing mdzod blangs nas/ /chung ma blta bar 'dod pa yika)/ /rgyal po'i bu ni 'ongs par gyur/ /rgyal bi bee sha swa na ga re pā manta tstshand+ra maṇḍa beeḥ / / phubee phe ṇa smi ta phran gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor byis/ /mkha' ni chu gtor kyilpu ba'i 'dzum/ /rgyas pa dag dang mtshungs sngarnyi ཿkuddhā ṇaḥs: bhanda bhaḥ/ /snu ṣā bai sha sha bṛṭwā nta ka tha na gre byed cing / /de ni rang gi grong khyer zhugs/ /de nas mna' ma'i nyes gyod kyi(two/ /lo rgyus 'chad la sha kembi tai/ /a thāntaḥpu ra ma bye tya dza na rka thra ṇa nā ma paḥ/ /a bho mu nyon mongs shing / /'dar ba'i pho brang 'khor song ste/ /de yi ⑤ yab la rab tu btud/ /'og tu bzhin khā khi la dza āoṃ sho ka sha bee ha totpa baṃ/ /pi tu rantaḥpu re dṛṭī sa bi pre phyogs skye bo kun/ /mya ngan zug rngus dga' ston bcom/ /yab kyi pho brang 'khor mthong nas/ /de ni ya ma shaṃ ka ta/ /a bi dzī ba ti ma ta rtswa bi ra hāṭwā ma no ha rā/ /dga' dang bral bar dogs/ /'bral bas gzir ba'i yid 'phrog ma/ /gzugs bzang ma de 'tsho 'am ci /i ti bru bā khaṃ nā ya dā ta mu tse kabya da thra ya/ /ta dā gā da dza na mbi pu tra dzre zhes smra ⑥de la su yis kyang / /gang tshe mi snyan ma brjod pa/ /de tshe ma yis rab smras pa/ /bu gcig ba ti te pri yā/ /ga tā tsū ḍā ma ṇi pā pya ki tu jo bee ta saṃ sha ye/ /i ti shu khyod kyi dga' ma 'tsho/ /'on kyang srog la the tshom tshe/ /gtsug gi nor bu thob nas song / /zhes pa thos tī ba sa ha sā ba pa pā ta ma tī ta le/ /tīṇḍi hā ra la hūṃ kuzladmā sru dhwa pa nyid na de/ /'phral la sa yi gzhi la 'gyel/ /do shal 'khri shing bkram pa'i lngas/ /mchi ma'i rgyun 'u795—785

rā mi pakṣi to/ /tu ṣa ra shrī ka rasma ra ha ri tsanda na bā bi bheḥ/ /sa laddhā ldan byed pa bzhin/ /kha ba'i thigs ①pa ltar dkar ba'i/ /ha ri tsan dan chu dag gis/ /dal byis saṃ snyoḥsha na kaimbi la khā pā sru gaṅga daḥ/ /a nā ka sha sha shaṃ ka shrī 'du shes rnyed pa des/ /mchi mas 'gar 'gar rnam par smras/ /mkha' ming (nyari bong can gyi dpal/ /ra mabye mṛ ta bā hi ni/ /a yatna ratna ba la dī kwa sā ku su ma dha bsrubs min bdud rtsi'i rgyun ①dang ldan/ /'bad med me tog gzhu can byis/ /rin cen (pyaganas de na naḥ/ /gu ru shā sa na yo tri te na dru ram̐ bra dza tā bātpa ni ruddhā lo tsa nā yāḥ/ /gang na yod/ /bla ma'i bkas ༄snyebacings ring du 'gro byed pa/ /bdag gi ④ri dwags mig can mchi ma yis//bi hi tā na dhri ti tind+ra yā mṛ gā ṣṭha kyu da yo me pa ti taḥsma rā bhi shā baḥ/ /de mig ni 'gags pa'i dga' ba ma bsgrubs pa/ /des na dran pa'i dmod 'di bdag la lhung / /yid hi pra ti ba tsaḥsu ju kwa ga tā pi ma no ha re/ /ma yā pra ma da spyu bye na 'phrog ma ni gang du song / /smin legs tshig gi ⑦lan dag sbyin⑧/ /bag med blun po bdag gis ni/ /ha ri shā kṣi na rakṣi tā / /tā tpa mā ga ma sau bhā gya shā gya gya su ra ri dwags mig can khyod ma bsrungs/ /khyod dang 'grogs pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /lha yi mdun sa ⑨saṃ pa di/ /ma me ba ma rtu lo ka gya twa byi yo ga sra kā dru ti/ /i bsngags par 'os/ /khrod dang bral bas mi yis ⑪ni/ /'jig rten bdag bzhin ci zhig mdzes/ /zhes ti bru pā ṇa sha na kaiḥkāddhā saṃ sgo ga sā kṣi 6/ /u byā ṣpe 6 pri ya ta rmā pa smra zhing dal bu yis⑪/ /mdzes ma'i longs spyod dbang gyur pa/ /skyed mos tshal du dga' ma mchog /bi tse hūṃ swa ya murya yo/ /bañtsa yi tā pa ri dza rde pa ra dza tyā ma la kṣi taḥ/ /'tshol ⑫du rang nyid song bar gyur/ /'khor gyi skye bo brid byas te/ /mtshan mo dag ni ma tshor bar/ /ga tā ba nārghaṃ bi ju ma pa me 6 bi ṣa me 6 tsa/ /tī bra rā ga pi nags mthar song nas mnyam pa dang / /mi mnyam rnams su rnam par 'khyam⑫/ /'dod chags drag po'i 95—786

shā tse na ma ha tā pa bi mo hi taḥ/ /udmatta i ba pa pratstsha tse ta nā tse ta sha za ni/ /chen pos rnam par rmongs pa des/ /smyon pa bzhin du sems ldan dang / /sems med la nā na pi/ /byu nyi sa khe shu ka shā ba ka sa khyaḥpā ṇa sa khāe ni khi yang rnam par dris/ /grogs po de ru'i phru gu grogs kyi grogs mo ni/ /srog mtshungs zla rdzogs bzhin ldan lend+ra mu kho tī/ /tasde sha natstsha da rā ga bi bhā ge bidza pha le stu pa dā ta de ni smra bar byos/ /de yi so yi sgrib byed dmar ba dag gi char17/ /bilnga'i 'bras bu rtag tu khyod kyi (27ba sgo gaḥ/ /haṃ ho haṃ sa mi hūṃ ga saṃ ga na li mbi lbo khā ba tai pa kyu te dṛṭwā longs spyod yin/ /kye lags ngang pa lus dkar dang 'grogs padmo can rol rna rgyan ltar mdzes pa mu sau ra bha padma padma ba da āoṃ ki kārnyi kakhro li ni/ /ya sngaḥrpā na pa yo dha rā gra tig tshogs ni rnam par g.yo ba gang gi 'o ma 'dzin pa rgyas pa'i rtser/ /ba spu'i 'khri ⑦shing ngang pa la ni nya bi lu thidrulnga ka lā pa gya sā haṃ sa gye ba bi bhā ti ro ma la ti kā shi bā lcibs 'khri shing lhung bzhin rnam mdzes pa/ /dri bzang khang pa padma'i bzhin ldan mdzes pa'i rba ④rlabs la ballīdzi tī/ /ta gye ti tī bra bya sa nā nu bant+rattha khā pi naḥpra st+ya la taḥcan de mthong ngam ci/ /de ltar sdug bsngal drag pos bcings pa las⑤ / /rab smre mnyam pa la yang sa mo pi/ /di shand+ra kā shaṃ da ya ye ba mārge sha ṣperja gā te ga ga rna si tsā 'gred de la/ /brtse bas lam ni rab gsal ster ba bzhin/ /dal gyis ⑥baṅgal zer can ni nam mkhar shuḥ —/ / shā mā pa te dzredma tha bān jo ba su kādhe sa dṛ ṣṭa sba ra 'dzegs④—/ /mtshan mo'i bdag po yid srubs gnyen gyi ni/ /gzugs mdzes mkha' la sbyar ba de tsumbi bimbi/ /sandasgo ta mind+ra mu khyu me ṣpe smi ta mu khaṃ byo mā bi mā na shri mthong nas/ /'dzum ldan zla zhal ma yis nam mkha' yi/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i steng nas bzhin bstan gāta / /mū shaṃ ka lo rmā ka ma bāṣṭa do ṣa ma bi bhra oṃ hā sa bi lā sa tī bsamasadu—/ /mi smra dri mas mtshan zhing ⑨skyon dag thob/ /rnam 'phrul med cing dgod dang rtsed ⑩'jos 95—787

bi lo lā la la nā ba ṭwādhe la te ba dṛṣṭa sta ba ka bhā pā/ /e na nu āoṃ can de 'khri shing bzhin du ni/ /nags mthar nags bdag khyod kyis ①mthong ngam ci/ /de ni sprin dang ba na kuñdza re ṇa sā rā dza re bhā pa ri re bha lo lātpa/ /ā kṛ6 nī tā gha na mtshungs pa nags tshal gyi/ /glang po 'di yis khuzla ba'i cha bzhin du/ /gser gyi chu shing yongs 'khyud la sadngha bhe na saṃsgo di tā bāsde sha shi naḥka le baḥ/ /i ti kā na na kubye 6 chags nas/ /blangs nas khyer ram bsgribs pa ma yin nam/ /de ltar nags tshal skyibs rnams su/ /ta srodmā da pra khā pi naḥ/ /sho kā di ba bi brjend+ra ba da nā ra dza bhā ya bla bcol rab brjod de yis ①ni/ /mya ngan gyis bzhin mtshan mo ni/ /zla ba'i bzhin ras mdog bral yo / /sa nā ga bha ba nā sanda tī ro pānta po ba rna/ /sha ṣpeḥpra bi song / /de yis ④klu yi gnas dang nye/ /ngogs 'gram dka' thub nags tshal du/ /dal byis zhugs te shya sa pratstsha ma habhā balka lā ya āoṃ/ /i ha bi ra hi bi tsiṭwā sho ka drang srong che/ /shing shun can la rab tu dris/ /'dir ni 'bral bas sems dman mya ⑤ngan shugs ni shā rūtstshadma da na da ha na dhū ma shya ma sakṇi ka bi bhā/ /i bi sha mi rings kyis spar ba'i⑥/ /'dod pa'i me yi du bas sngo chags lhas ma gcig pa can/ /ri bong can gyi ta sha shī kobyā ma saundarlu dasthā mu ni ba ra ha ri zla khye kinda rī kā pi dṛṣṭa/ /mdzes sdug dregs rgyas zhi byed ri dwags mig /mi 'am ci mo su zhig thub pa mchog gis gzigs sam ci/ /i ti kāddhā bi yu kta gya pāpta podmā ni ninda shaṃ/ /mu niḥshu tā ba tsa ta gya zhes pa mdzes ma dang bral zhing / /smyon pa'i skabs ni thob gyur pa/ /de yi tshig thos thub pa yis/ /pa ri dzñā ya ta ma bra rpātpa/ /sa mā shwa si hi bi shra mya sarja pasgyu bye tā ma yongs su shes nas de la smras/ /khyod ni ngal gso rdokyedabugs phyung la/ /yongs su gdung ba 'di gtang yi—/ /dṛṭwā sā ta ba ka spyo bhā ma yā mān sa tsadhri yā/ /yu tha bhraṣṭi ba mdzod—/ /khyod kyi dge ma yid kyi ni/ /zla ba'i 'od de bdag gis dumathong / /khyu nyams ri dwags mo 95—789

ha ri bhā ni se kṣu pi jo bi te/ /pā shā kṛṣṭi ba ka ri bhā dhwarya te sā twa dā bzhin du/ /'tsho ba la yang ltos ①pa med/ /glang mo zhags pas drangs pa bzhin/ /de ni khyod kyi bsam sha yā/ /pā rṇa she te ba da na ka ma lo pra sta re palla bā rmā tā pa klursā ta ra pas 'tsho/ /lag pa dag la bzhin gyi padma nyal zhing yal 'dab mal stan la/ /gdung bas nyan ②cing la ba tsa na shaṃ pi nī gā tra le khā/ /ā shā badhe j-i ti ri ba ma ti stabee g.yo ba'i tshig ldan ri mo kun du nyams pa'i ④lus/ /re ba bcas la brtan pa bzhin du ④blo gros khyod yo gā ku lā yāsta snga ṣpe pa ka tsi da pi ma naḥki tu bi shrī ti me ti/ /dru ma mya bral 'khrugs gyur pa/ /de yi yid ni 'gar yang ci yang ngal gsos ⑤nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /ljon pa mi kinda ra pa teḥsbi tā haṃ bha ba ṣpe pi tuḥ/ /ā ganta bye twa yā tūṇḍi mi ti hūṃ sandi 'am ci yi bdag /yab kyi khyim na bdag gnas so/ /khyod ni myur du shog cig ces/ /de yis dukhyod la de sha pā/ /bīrya sa twa ba lo pā ya bye rlotyā ha ba tā ma pi/ /yang dag bstan/ /brtson 'grus snying stobs stobs dang thabs/ /brtan ⑦dang spro ldan rnams kyis kyang //a ga mya kinda ra pu re kra mābozla sha shaṃ sa ba/ /i rda tsa twa1 te dadzhai bgrod ⑧min mi 'am ci yi ni/ /grong khyer ⑨lam yang rim pas bshad/ /gang gi 'od 'jam reg pa yis//ta mā ratrī gu byā ya ke/ /ya su ldisna pra bhā bye shodi sho yarnyi pi ṣe ga hūṃ/ /phyogs rnams ser po nyid 'gyur ba/ /rin cen ⑩sor gdub 'di yang ni/ /de yis khyod kyi ched du byen//i tya nanda su jo sakta musto byeryā ba lo ba rna/ /i gu rī yo da do zhes brjod kun dga'i bdud rtsi yis/ / dran bzhin brtan ⑪pa dag gi rten/ /sor gdub dag ni de la ta smidmā rge tsā ka tha yarlu niḥ/ / sa thā ta du pā diṣṭi na so pā ye phyin4)—/ /lam yang thub pas rab tu bshad/ /de yis bstan pa'i lam dag ni/ /thabs dang bcas na dṛ pādma dzaḥ/ /dhī raḥpra tsakra me ganti dha na dā byu ṣi hūṃ di shaṃ/ /pas mi bdag bu/ /brtan rkyu)pas nor 'dzin gnas pa yi⑫/ /phyogs su 'gro bar rab tu brtsams/ /95—790

saṃ sirghaṃ 1 tapā ke na su dzñā bee tā ma ho ṣa dhi/ /labharnyi ba la ma sman chen bdud rtsi legs grub pa/ /mar gyis smin pa 'thungs nas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag nyid hātūḥs yuddhāḥpra ya yo sha ṣpe/ /rirgyu sambi hi tai ta gya sasgo pa ka ra thob—/ /mtshon cha dang bcas dal gyis song / /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni lam du de'i/ /nyer mkho thams cad ṇa pa thi/ /a byutpa twa sa hā yā dzā swā dhī nāḥsidhi sadza daḥ/ /a nyer gnas gyur/ /snying stobs grogs dang ldan rnams kyi/ /grub pa phun tshogs rang dbang nyid()/ /de tha bee byā dha ra ba dhū bi lā sa ha si ta byu ti/ /hi ma banta ma ti kra mya nas rig 'dzin bu mo ni/ /rtse dga' dgod ④pa ltar mdzes pa/ /gangs can brgal khyanas de yis ni/ /ku ku khā dhri ma bā pa paḥ/ /pha lo pa hā re swo kṛ tya ta tra bā na ra yu tha paṃ/ /ba ku ku lā yi rjori la sleb/ /'bras bu'i skyes kyis khas blangs ⑤byas/ /der ni spre'u'i khyu yi bdag /rlung yu be shā khya mā ru khya ga tai shi la ma lo gha yata/ /a thā dza pa thā nā mān ma shugs zhes pa la zhon nas/ /ri bo de ni de yis 'gongs⑩/ /de nas lug gi lam zhes pa'i/ /sa nyi tsakrā ma bhū dha ram̐/ /ni ha tya dza ga ram̐ sgo ra bisna saṃ gha mi be 'dzin dag ni rab tu brgal⑦/ /'jigs su rung ba'i sbrul chen ni/ /bgegs kyi tshogs bzhin mda' ṣā ḍā/ /bī rja swā ṣperba shī kṛ tya rākṣa sī kā ma rū pā shlau/ /kā ma yis bsnun/ /'dod pa'i gzugs can srin mo ni/ /rgyud mang ⑧sgra yis dbang byas nas/ /'dod pa'i rū pā dri muwaṃ bhya pra ya yo kirja rī thra yaḥ/ /pā la bā na mu hu rā ghā ta ni gzugs kyi ri bo 'dasapo)/ /mi 'am ci mo'i bdag po song / /de nas rgyun gcig ①7ri bo la yang khā taiḥshasnga shaṃ ku bhiḥ/ /e ka dhwa ram̐ ta taḥshi lo mā ru ro hā ti sā ha paḥ/ /yang mtshon gye rtse mo yis/ /bsnun cing ⑩brkos pa dag gis ni/ /stobs ldan shin du rtul ⑪bas 'dzegs//a tho gra ta ra mā ru khya badzra kā khye sa sattha tai/ /kṛ dhra rū rpā sa mā lo kya rākṣa de nas rdo rje can zhes pa'i/ /ri bo rab bral /rkyede yis 'dzegs/ /srin mo sha ni 'tshol ⑩byed pa/ /bya 95—791

sī pi pi tai ṣa khro/ /pa ri thrabhe na saṃ tstshanda pa rmā sa mṛ ga tsand+ra rgod gzugs can yang dag mthong / /sha ldan ri dwags pags pa ni/ /yongs su bsgyur bas kun du shā—/ /sa pa da mū le ta snga dresta sbo nistsa la bi gra haḥ/ /rmā sa lupta ta mukṣi g.yogs| /ri bo de yi zhabs kyi rtsar①/ /de yi lus ni g.yo med 'khod/ /mtshan rgyu bya rgod gzugs gya kṛ dhra rū pā ni shā tsa rī/ /ni da dhe shi kha ra snga gre sgoste dī can ni/ /sha la chags pas de blangs nas/ /'jigs rung gzugs kyis bza' ba'i phyir/ /ri rtse'i ④ṣa ṇa bi gra hā/ /mṛ ga tsand+ra sta muskṛ dzu tsā ni ha tya pa bīrya bān/ /steng du rnam par bkod/ /brtson 'grus can gyi sneri dwags kyi/ /pags pa btang nas de bsad de/ /nī ranta kha di ra tīṇḍi pā pa kha di ra bhū dha re/ /pra bi shya taṅga hūṃ le bhe seng ldeng stug pos dhikhengs pa yi/ /seng ldeng sa 'dzin dag tu phyin/ /de yi phug zhugs rdo bsal bas/ /shi dzee bya su ma ho ṣa bye/ /shī tā ta pa ta maḥsaza rākṣa sā di bha yā pa haṃ/ /grang dang tsha dang mun pa sprul/ /srin po la sogs 'jigs pa dag /'phrog pa'i sman di chen po thob/ /sa yant+ra sattha to mā pya paṃ gha byeḥpā ṇa ha ri rṇa/ /yant+ra tī lo sha rā 'khrul 'khor ri gnyis rab bsdebs rjopas/ /srog ni ⑥'phrog par de yis sleb/ /'khrul 'khor phur pa gre ṇa tstsha tā tsakre bee ni : lo/ / yant+ra tī la sa mutstsha de ryant+ra dā mda' rtse yis/ /bcad nas g.yo ba med par byas/ /'khrul 'khor phur pa bcad rnams kyis/ /'khrul re bi dā rlu pa ཿ / / stso da rgo yant+ra tsakra gya ya nt+ra yukṣiṃ ta thā ya 'khor sgo ni des bcom zhing / /'khrul 'khor 'khor lo ⑦bcad de bzhin/ /lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor sbyar sauske/ /tī bra sra hā ro pu ru kho yant+ra ma kho tsa duḥs ho/ /yasgo gra ba'o| /drag ④tu snun byed skyes bu gnyis/ /bzod dka' lug gi 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ /de bzhin chu ⑨darnya ni bye yo ta thā ma ka ra rā kṣa sau/ /gho rāndha kā ra gi bhā gu srin srin po'i so'i/ /'khrul 'khor drag pos 'joms pa gnyis/ /'jigs rung mun pa zab pa'i phug /95—792

hā kyu pa bi lo gha tsa/ /hūṃ hūṃ pa ri ta mudhī rlu ha tā takhru la rākṣa khron pa gnyis kyang rnam par 'gongs/ /chu bo chen po yang dag brgalasti/ /de ngogs srin po rnams sān—/ /ā shī bi ṣa dhri ta dza dzee pa tai gā khyu ba nidza tsā/ /ro di mbi bsad nas/ /mche ba'i dug ldan gnas pa'i chu/ /pa ta gā ④zhes thur bgrod dang / /gang 'gram mi tsa na dī tī re ya sngaḥkinda ra tse ṭa kaḥ/ /kuzarnyi ro da na ra baibeergyu 'am ci dag gi/ /'bangs rnams ngu ba'i sgra dag gis/ /de 'gro'i sems la bgegs byed pa/ /klung ni taṅga ta tse ta sī/ /taju bye hā pi bhā nā ma hā sā pa kṛ ta tse ta rsā/ /di ngu ba can dag dang / /de bzhin dgod pa can zhes pa/ /dgod pas sems la gnod byed dang / /mi sharnyi pra li ṣpe ya snga bya pha āoṃ kindadzā ga ṇḍa/ /lo gha yi tā ba gā: n+ya 'am ci mo rnams dag gisadzee/ /gang gi 'gram du gdung ster ba/ /thur bgrod ④gzhan yang bzlas byas te//be ṭwā pā pya na dīnta taḥ/ /kyu la be tra lā tā lambi ta su ma tha ti tīrya ya/ /de 'og spa ldan klung ⑤can phyin/ /de nas de las thar 'dod pas/ /'gam phyi buspa yi 'khri shing bzung ④ //pa ba na bye ri hūṃ pā ra bai tra pakhra la bā pa saḥ/ /ta yā pā bya pa re pā re rlung gis bskul pas ⑧pha rol phyin⑨/ /spa yi 'khri shing de yis thob/ /re ba bzhin du rab ring ba/ /mā sha ye bā ti dīsgo yā/ /da darsha kinda ra pu re sbya ra spa ṭi ka mandi re/ /pra bi de yi pha rol 'gram du phyin/ /mi 'am ci yi grong khyer ni/ /rab gsal shel gyi khang pa mthong / /de yi shya pa sha byeḥpā pya kānd+ra ka na ka padme 1/ /ta byu ra ta ru mā ru khya dal bus nang du zhugs/ /gser gyi pad ldan mdzes par phyin/ /de yi ngogs kyi shing la 'dzegs/ /ta spyo ratna la tā thra taḥ/ / sa da dakhyembu dza ra dzaḥpuñdziḥsu ra bye rin cen ⑩'khri shing gis bsgribs nas⑪/ /der des chu skyes rdul tshogs kyis/ /dri bzang ser por gyur piñdza re/ /te ma rku byerdza lanta tra na yaṭīḥkinda dzā ga rmā/ /kum sgosnye pa'i chu/ /mi 'am ci mo rnams dag gis/ / gser gyi bum par len pa mthong / /nyesteder ni bum 95—793

pe shā māṭī ya sta tre ka sngaḥs ma bye tya saḥ/ /hasthā lasbe na ba hā yo kṛ tā 'degs ngal ba yis/ /gzir ba cig rmyecan des mngon phyogs/ /lag pas rten rgyanas grogs byas te/ /sa pratstsha shā sha ṣpeḥ/ /mā taḥka su kṛ te to ya mi rda yasne na byā ya te/ /yadzhasthā dal bu yis ni de la dris/ /ma ma su yi ched du ni/ /chu 'di 'bad nas len par byed/ /gang la gus ga sgo te nā yo bha ba tī bheḥpa ri shra maḥ/ /i ti te na pri ya gi rā pā pas (hūṃ khyed rnams ni/ /yongs su ngal 'di rtsi mi byed/ /de ltar tshig snyan gyis des drisapashe/ /mdzes priṭwā ta ma bhāṣa ta/ /mā dhurya dhurya saundarya bakṣa pā ta pa tī kṣa ṇḍata/ /mju mo sdug snyan sgra ldan pa yis cho/ /phyogs su skad cig gis lhung ma/ /de yis de la rab smras pa/ /mi yi dri nga dā sa no dā ya sa dā su ra bhi bā ri byeḥ/ /pi tuḥkinda ra rā dza sra gi rā rtswa dag bya'i slad/ /rtag tu dri bzang chu rnams kyis/ /mi 'am ci rgyal yab kyi bkas/ /yid 'phrog ma ni ti ma no ha rā/ /ta ye ti ka thi tai khru tā su ṅgā sekta i bakṣa ḍā ta/ /sa te ma khrus byed do/ /zhes pa de yis brjod thos nas/ /skad cig bdud rtsis bran pa bzhin/ /de yi rtags rku bhe bi kṣe ba ta da snyi dhī gu lbo ya shaṃ / / rtswa tyā sta ta sta da bhi mtshan sor gdub ni/ /gser gyi bum par de yis ⑪'phangs/ /de nas sor gdub mngon par 'phrog hā ri ma no ha rā yāḥrku bhātpa pā ta ku tsa rku bha yu go gu lbo yi/ /ya sde shu byed de ni bum pa las/ /khrus byed yid 'phrog ma yi nu ma'i bum pa zung la lhung / /gang gi gzugs ma ta pra ti ma ra tna ma yu kha le khāḥ kṣi sri na kha kṣa ta bi lā sa tu brnyan zer ldan rin cen pe'od zer ri mo yis 87/ /myur du sen mo 'debs pa'i rtse dga' dag dang lā ma bsduḥ/ /mūrghaṃ ta taḥswa ma nu rā ga mi bā ka la bo rarja gu li mtshungs pa thob/ /de rjes rin cen (snasor gdub lus med gtam dag nang song ba/ /rang gi rjes su ya ka ma rna ga ka thānta re shaṃ/ /sā kānta mā ga ta ma bee tya ku ta sta ye chags pa gzugs can bzhin du brtags byas nas/ /bdag po 'ongs par shes te 'di ni khyod kyis ⑪gang 95—794

tī tsakrantasto/ /ta taḥpratstshanda dṛṭwādhe ladzdza mā na ma no ha rā/ /bi gnyis dag gis byas/ /de rjes spyod tshul bsgribs pa ni/ /ngo tsha ldan pa'i yid 'phrog mas/ /bshad bee byā darsha ya྾ troḥpa ti byu mi ma no bha baṃ/ /ta taḥkinda rā rā dzaste ko pa pra sgu ri nas pha ma dag la ni/ /bdag po sa yi yid 'byung bstan/ /de nas mi 'am ci yi rgyal/ /de la khros pas tā dha raḥ/ /u bā tsa darsha na pa thi pa riz-i tyādma dzā ba teḥ/ /a ho pra mchu bskyod cing / /bu mo'i bdag ni mthong ba'i lam/ /yongs su btang ①nas rab smras pa/ /kye ma mi mā dā pa ti tā deb dā nu tsi te dza ṣpe/ /na bi mulca pi dudṛste kṣa lha mā nā 'os skye bo la/ /cha ①yis bag med lhung gyur pa/ /spyod tshul ngan pa bkrus kyang ni/ /chags pa nyid ni pi rakta hūṃ/ /yo ba nā ba ni lā ba bye smṛ ha bhā yī di bo ka mā/ /ba ta pra yā ta khyod mi gtong / /khyod kyi mdzes sdug lang tsho la/ /lha rnams kyis ni reg bya 'di/ /kye ma mi dang mdza' ma taste mju sne he na sho tsu hūṃ/ /u da gra go tro pra bha bā gha na yo ba ba yis/ /mya ngan bya 'os nyid du gyur/ /mthon po'i rigs las skyes gyur cing / /stug po'i lang tsho na nisgo rā/ /nisna ge khyo bha bi bhraṭwā yā tā se su ta rā ma dhaḥ/ /birja dubye rab rgyas pa/ /thur 'gro 'khrugs pas rnam nyams pa/ /khyod ni shin tu 'og tu 'gro/ /mkhas pa chags ga dza na bhā ku la bai laghra kā ri bhā/ /ma li na kha la bi bye ba sasma bral skyed byed cing / /rigs ni skyengs par byed pa mo/ /mi bsrun rigs ①bzhin dri ma can/ /khyod tā pi na ka gya tsita/ /byu pa mā tre ṇa tuṣṭa tha ya di mju ba shaṃ ga tā/ /taṅginda ni su yang mi 'dod do/ /gzugs tsam gyis ni khyod tshim nas/ /gal te mi yi dbang gyur na/ /gser ra matpa he ma ni dzre ṇa pu ru ṣa tī ṣa/ /pra bhā ba gu ṇa tī nā su las sprul pa ④skyes bu yi⑤/ /gzugs dang rtse dga' cis mi byed/ /mthu dang yon tan gyis dman pa/ /sum̐ sī: tu ta ra kṛ teḥ/ /ā le khyu pu ru ṣa sri ba saunda.oṃ bhisbyi re dza rna/ /skyes bu rab mdzes dbyebs can gyi/ /mdzes sdug ri mor bris pa yisde/ /skyes bu yi bzhin rtsig pa mdzes//95—796

ba bye me twatpa tiḥpā pe tī na sasbrandha ladzdza yā/ /mu khaṃ dṛṣṭi na shasgo mi 'brel dman ngo tshas sdig can ma/ /khrod khyo bdag gis gsad par bya/ /khyod slong la 'ongs lha rnams kyi//twatpa dzñāṣṭa di bo ka sī/ / sa tya mutyā hā yukta gya ku la phyonda ti shā bzhin ni bdag gis ①lta mi phod/ /bden par spro ba dang ldan zhing / /mthon por gyur pa'i rigs ke li naḥ/ /dza re bi ki la kā la ka tyā saṃ ko tsa kā ri hūṃ/ /i ti bā bhatī dag ni/ /bu mos 'khums par byed pa ste/ /dus ni nges par dga' bas bzhin/ /de skad pha yis (sgotā pi tā ta myu bā tsa na tā na nā/ /a sru tra hā re kuddhā rde ku tsa yorpāju smad gyur des/ /mchi ma'i beegs ④pa nu ma la/ /do shal skud med sgrig byed cing / /bzhin btud de bind+ra bhiḥ/ /ko pa da nu tsi tai tā ta ṣpe tarja bathi marta si/ /na thra la rab smras pa/ /yab lags khro bar mi 'os ⑪pa/ /de ⑥dag bdag la gsung 'os min/ /mthu yis rte7yarnye pra bhā pe na kinda rāḥkirja rā dhi kaḥ/ /ga ru ḍa sthā pi duzlo sgya mi mi 'am ci dag lasacha/ /lhag pa'i mi ⑨ma thos sam ci/ /mkha' lding gis kyang bgrod dka' ba/ /sa mā mudzee sgya yaḥkṣi to/ /pra bhā ba byu mi rā yā ti ma nu 6ཿsa ka tha bha beeta/ /'di gang gis bgrod gyur nas/ /'ongs pa mthu yi sa gzhi de⑪/ /mi nyid yin par ci 71ltar 'gyur/ /gu ṇa saṃ bā di mbi mūntirbha ba tya ya sha rī rā rde/ /ka ro tyā nanda saṃsthā rda lus can rnams kyi lus dag ni/ /yon tan yang dag rjod byed nyid⑩/ /bsel zer can gyi 'od zer ni/ /byu ti re ba hi ma tī ṣaḥ/ /dzā tyā ki kṛ ya te tā ta swa bhā bā nu gu rja gu kun dga' skyed par byed pa yin/ /yab gcig rigs kyis ⑪ci zhig bya/ /yon tan rang bzhin rjes su shāḥ—/ /purjend+ra ra mṛ ta gyadhī kā la kuṭa su so da raḥ/ /bha baṃ tyantargu ṇa 'brang / /zla rgyas bdud rtsi zag ④pa ni/ /nag po brtsegs pa'i spun spyozla nyid/ /kha cig nang na yon ke tsitstshanda do ṣā sta thā pa re/ / a pa rī ghra na ka rta bya ma dhī tan ldan/ /de bzhin gzhan ni skyon bsgribs pas/ /nor bu rnams kyi rin ⑩dag ni/ /ma brtags 95—797

ma dhu nā sa nda rsha yi tu ma rta se/ / a bhinda ba ṇḍi rū pā shā tu sthā 'phags dag /khyod kyis ①yang dag bstan par 'os/ /gzugs dang kha dog dbyer med cing / /rgyan bha ra ṇa ba ya pā/ /kinda rī rde sbi hūṃ ma bye gre hā ṇa ni dza babee rghaṃ/ /dang na tshod mtshungs gyur pa/ /mi 'am ci mo 'khod pa yi/ /dbus nas ④rang gi dga' ma zungs④/ /i hphuktaste na sa pu naḥkinda rī sha ta pañtsa rka/ /tu lha baṇḍi ba yo be shaṃ da zhes pa brjod nas de yis sbar/ /mi 'am ci mo lnga brgya dag /rdzogs pa kha dog lang tsho dang / /chas darsha bya gra ma gra taḥ/ /tā sāsma bye pa ri dzñā ya sa dza gā ha ma no ha mtshungs mdun du de yis dhimathong / /de dag dbus nas yid 'phrog ma/ /de yis ⑤yongs su shes nas dzā—/ /babee rī ba na saṃ tstshadzñā dzdza gasgo ta la tā mi ba/ /de bo ya mi bzung / /'khri shing nags kyis bsgribs 0pa yi/ /tsu ta'i 'khri shing bung bas bzhin/ /de nas mi 'am nyi nibye tya ta taste kinda re shwa raḥ/ /tuṣṭastasmi da do ni bya rasneḥs ha ma ci dbang gis/ /'di ni lha zhes nges byas nas/ /tshim pas de la yid 'phrog ma/ /lha yi rin cen dzeeno ha dzā/ /shra bhyo pa sgo ga bi bha baiḥpū dzi taste na mā da ram̐/ /dzā dang bcas byen/ /mchog gi longs spyod 'byor pa yis/ /gus dang bcas pas sgede yis mchod/ /de yā sa ha sta mā mkhyu ku mā raḥswa pu ri ya yo/ /ma no ha rā gra gi pāpta la zhus nas chung mar bcas/ /gzhon nu rang gi grong khyer song / /yid 'phrog ma sngon 'gro ba'i bu/ /pu tra mā lo kya bhū pa tiḥ/ /nā gend+ra darsha nond+ra taḥsu dhwambu bhi ri 'ong ba mthong nas sa yi bdag /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos glang po'i dbang / /mthong nas 'phyur ⑨bzhin bā barbha/ /pu tram̐ ta ta : ri ta tsand+ra se tā ta paste rā bye bhi ṣi tsu rnam par mdzes/ /de nas rgyal srid spyod tshul zla ba'i gdugs ⑩dkar ldan pa la/ /skye rgu'i ⑩gdung ba pa ri tā pa ha re pra dzwa rmā / / sa rnyo ṣa shī ta la bi be ka su 'phrog pa'i bu ni mngon par dbang bskur nas/ /chog ⑫shes bsil ldan dben pa'i bdud rtsis mngon 95—800

dhwa nyi ra oṃ tstsha yā ma se ba ta dṛ paḥpra sha ma dru ma suḥ/ /shābhā bhi par dga' ba yis①/ /rab tu zhi ba ldan snyepa'i grib bsel mi yi bdag pos bstanaspyo/ /nor bzang dbang ṣe kai su dha rna pra bhū te lta sapta raṭwā ni thra thu pra tā baṃ/ /na ba pra bhā bskur ④thob pa'i snga dro nyid/ /gzi byin khyergya che de la rin cen (kyebadun/ /gtso bo nyid gyur kye gsar pa'i ba pra bhu tā ba dī tyā se bā ni pa sārba mi bo pa dza gruḥ/ /sa bo bye mthus 'u 'jigs nas/ /g.yog la gnas pa'i don bzhin nye bar 'ongs/ /nor bzang byang chub sems satwaḥsu dha no ha me ba ya sho dha rā sā pi ma no ha rā bhūta/ /taji pra yo ga de nga nyid de/ /yid kye'aphrog mar gyur de yang grags 'dzin ma/ /de dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal mes bya sa nā na lābyāḥkā mā nu ba ndha dā ya ti ma yābhā/ / tasmraṭwā maḥ ka gdungs pa/ /'di snyed / pe 'dod pas bcings las bdag gis thob/ /de slad 1nye'adod pa padmo'i bzhin ma la ba da nā ṣpe tra paryanta bā sī brdzaḥsad bheḥsha ma mṛ ga pa dhū brnya ke liḥgyi mig gi mtha' la gnas gyur cing / /rab rgyas me tog las skyes rdul tshogs hā la hā la'i rtse mo can/ /ki rā traḥ/ /sgra dzākhrutpa pra pa ba dza ra dzaḥpuñdza hā lnga ha khā grirlo kaḥrmongs byed mya ngan gdung ba'i mda' yis ⑫gang gi 'jig rten 'bigs byed pa/ /rngon pa'i rtse dgas zhi sha ka bya pa na bi shi khermo haṣperya na bibyeḥ/ /i ti bhekṣu ga ṇa swa yo ba'i ri dwags 'ching byed dam pa rnams kyis spangs/ /de nas rgyal ba rang gis rang gi gtam/ /bshad dzi ṣpe na swa ka tsā tī bee ni bai di tai ni sha mya/ /sa ra baṃ thra thu mū la me ba me pa de ni ⑫ dge slong tshogs kyis thos/ /'dod pa ro ldan kho na srid pa ni/ /'dab brgya'i rtsa ba spom po ṣpe sha ta shā khā su ma no bha baṃ bha gya/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsa tā yi bo bye sa tā nyid du nges/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag ba dā na kalpa la tā yo su dha na kirjarya ba dā na tsa tuḥṣaṣṭi ta maḥpalla waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las nor bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //95—801

pāgyudmā sgyu sa lī nā da ti sa ra sa sa sabye pa nā rū la she ṣādzreḥlongs spyod rtse dga' dag gi dri yi tshogs kyis 1dbang po thams cad yongs su drangs gyur pa/ /shaṃ ka su pi dza noḥka ma la ka la na yā dzā ya te mā na se smin/ /rā gaḥchags ldan sbrang rtsi 'thungs (37rnams shin tu dam par ()'di nyid du ni gang gang 0'ching byed pa/ /skye ba paṃ sgo ga lī lnga pa ri ma la pa ṭa la kṛṣṭa sabyedhri yā rde ma tre bā a ti mā sngaragoms zhen cing shin tu chags bcas las byung bag chags rtsa ba'i lhag ma las/ /dogs pa med kyang tram̐ pa ra pa ma dhu li haṃ ba ndha rna yaḥ ka ro ti/ /n+ya gro dma rā ma ni skyebo'i yid 'dir padmo'i rjes zhesu mthun pa'i 'dod chags 'byung bar 'gyur('u / /shākya'i grong khyer dag ra tai pu ra shākya pu re dzi ni/ /bha ga brnyi sa mu pand+raḥpa pratstshabhikṣa baḥtu sngon/ /n+ya gro dha yi kun rar gnas/ /rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das la slar/ /dge slong yang dag tshogs su naḥ/ / pra bṛtta shāṅgi pa ri bṛtta bee shi ni bṛtta saṃ sā ram̐ bi kā ra pas zhus/ /zhi bar zhugs shing chas ni yongs su bsgyur⑦/ /'khor ba'i rnam 'grur spyod las zlog dupa bṛtrī / /antaḥpu ram̐ two dṛ pa tebee sharnya ya sho dha rā dīghra bi mu khya tī khyod—/ /mi yi bdag po'i pho brang 'khor 'jug pa/ /grags 'dzin mas mthong rnam par rmongs pa bzhin//ba/ /twadrwarsha ṣpe tiṣṭha ti sazla dzee ba bi bhū ṣi tā kādza ta ram̐ gi tī gī/ /sgo gyu khyod mthong nyid na kun du brgyan byas shing / /'dar zhing g.yo ba'i lus ldan rnam par gnas/ /lag na dhi bā se bha ba taḥka ro ti bi lo bha rna mo da ka pā tra hasta/ /nā byā bi shārnyi mu la du'i snod —/byebazung khyod kyis te snani/ /zas kyi lhag gnas dag la chags par byed/ /de yi yid kyi rnam bee nyi ta su ma no bi kā raḥs ba hu pra kā raḥ/ /twa dā na rgond+ra byu ti bi pra pukta 'gyur rnam mang ldan/ /da lta yang ni nye bar zhi mi 'gyur/ /khyod zhal zla 'od bral na shin tu de/ /sī dā tya lo sālbo ku murja tī ba/ /i ti bismi ta bhikṣu ga bee na thraṣṭaḥki tsita smi te nyamasade 11nyin par ku mud ldan pa bzhin/ /de skad mtshar las dge slong tshogs kyis dris/ /cung zad 95byed802

nā dha ra pabee ba tyā/ /pra trughā pha la bi dru mā sgo bi bee shya sho dzñā bha 'dzum pa ①mchu yi yal 'dab la/ /myu nyig 'bras bu khyorab spras byu ru'i 'od/ /mdzes ma 1'god cing ga bān ba bhā ṣe/ /ya sho dha rā bye ba bi kā ri yust+ri bi bharbhe ṣpe ta ma bhi bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /mngon 'dod rtse dga' rnam 'gyur ldan pa 'di/ /grags 'dzin ma ni ding rte7lā ṣa lī dzee/ /dzadmānta re pi sma ra bi blu mairme sā mo da kairlo bha ban me ba nyid 'dzin pa min/ /skye gzhan la yang 'dod pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /de yi la dus bdag la chags par tsakre / /kā shya paḥpu rā kā shi pu ri na rend+rabyuji ba dā ta dru ti tīrte rā sīta/ /a byas—/ /ka shi'i grong du mi dbang kā ⑤shya sngon/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i grags pa can/ /dgra sri ku shaḥsha tru ma da di pā dzā ma tīṣṭha thrattaḥpa ra la swa bhā baḥ/ /pu trobee myos gnyis 'thung lcags kyu yin mod kyang / /spyod tshul mi rno rang bzhin drang por gyur/ /dka' thub na sta gya ta paḥpra yasne re kai ba ka tyā na li bhā ba bhū ba/ /pā ya pra dzā pā 'bad pas bu don gnyer de la/ /bu mo padma ldan nyid gcig pu byung / /skye rgu ⑥skyong la g.yel ba dang la na sā ba le pāḥswaspra na ya e ba bha brnyi bhū pāḥ/ /antaḥpu re tsā pa ri warbha mā bcas pa'i/ /sa bdag phal cher rigs brgyud /⑦nyung bar 'gyur du/ /pho brang 'khor du de ni yongs rmā tsitta tsa tsidzñā dṛ pa ti bee tsā rya / / ā ju ya bi bo ttha mu khā bskyed cing / /sems 'bad bsams du/pa'o mi bdag gis spyad nas/ /mkhas pa la sogs blon po bos na mā tyān pra dzā ga ra gasta ra nyirdza ga da/ /bi steṇḍi shā khaṃ sbi ra badha mū nas ni/ /gnyid bral dga' ba nyams pas ⑩rab smras pa/ /lo 'dab rgyas shing rtsa ba brtan par zug /la makyunda tram̐ sattha dza no pa dzre bye/ /a the mi tu lya pra sa bā ba tī āoṃ ghra ṇa kṣa tai skye bo kun gyi nyer 'tsho shāmishin tu mtho/ /mtshungs par skye bas dman pa'i rgyal srid ni/ /srin bus zos bṛkṣa mi bā dhi ba bye/ /e kai ba ka tyā na li nī ma māste ba yaḥpra dā no tsi ta pa'i shing bzhin bdag gis ⑫rig /lang tsho / 0rab tu sbyin 'os bsten pa yis⑫/ /bu mo pad ldan gcig 95—803

mā shra yarnyi/ /ta bye pra yasne ṣpe ba rā྾ tā yā ma pa tya tā tai pra ṇa yo pi dru re/ /pu bdag la yod/ /de ni 'bad pas mag pa la byin tshe/ /bu tsha nyid dang de la byams pa'ang ring ①/ /pā ṇi pra dībee mi ba dī brto dhahūṃ na shasgo ti dza na swa ka tyā/ /n+ya pāza lag par sgon me'i sdong bu rab 'bar bzhin/ /skye bos rang gi bu mo bzung ①mi nus/ /gtams pa'i tu spyo pa rārba bhā yā tsirsā pha khā e ba ku la su ka tyā/ /na j-itya de yā nor bzhin gzhan la gtad bya ba/ /rigs kyi bu mo bsam pa'i 'bras bu nyid/ /g.yog la sbyin ①min na tsa po ra yo gyu dru ro tsi tā e ba na rend+ra ka tyā/ /a dzñā ta mi tya bā tsi ta gya dru grong pa la 'os min/ /mi dbang bu mo ring po nyid la 'os/ /de ltar kun spyad during po mi shes pas/ /ra mṛ ta mya yā ta mya tsa ko ni she ṣaḥ/ /tasthānd+ra yasne na ma ma sa kabye mā twa bhā be gu shi dang song ba dag la bye brag ci/ /de slad gang zhig bu dngos bdag nyid can/ /rang yul rab dhispangs ṇi bāmbi yo byeḥ/ /swa de sha muskṛ bye ma bee ba de she bi bhadhi yaḥpu tra bā bdag gi yul 'dzin pa/ /bdag gi mag pa'i dngos gyur 'ga' zhig de/ /yon tan ldan pa 'bad pas dhi pa tram̐/ /khru tasma yā dzasgo su tā pra bā ha pu sgyu pa dā te pu li no pa kabye/ /btsal dhibar bya/ /bdag gis thos pa gaṅgā dag gi rgyun/ /bsod nams dag pa'i ngogs dang nye ba na/ /sa hādzi byā nāsdi ta po ba nārnyi rā dzabyu rāste ki la kā shya sā khyaḥ/ /ta gya sgo snyim par bcas na dka' thub ⑦nags mthar ni/ /rgyal po'i drang srong ka ⑧shya pa gnas lo/ /de yi sa tai pra shra ba ṇi na bīrya de bo da yā dathra ni sarji tā gre/ /to yasmṛ hārta bon byu ⑨bas lhung gyur pa/ /lha yis bskyed las rdo steng ⑫dma' bar chags/ /chu 'dod kyis gzir ⑪ha ri bhā ni bī ya su baṇḍi baṇḍi su pra be ku mā re/ /bai na mṛ gāsta ri dwags mo yis ⑫'thungs/ /gser gyi mdog can gzhon nu btsas par gyur/ /de yi phas bzung ⑫su bi ba rnyi to sau pi tā kṛ hi to pi hi ta bra ta:/ /nā : pra sidhaḥnags su ri dwags de/ /rnam par bskyed cing brtul zhugs dag kyang bsgrubs/ /sor tshad rwa yis yang 95—804

shi shu re ka shiṅgaḥsaṃ laghra mā rmā gu la mā tro shriṅgaḥ/ /yu bā tsa tubye na pa rā dag mtshan gyur pas/ /byis pa rwa gcig pa zhes ming du grags/ /dar bab bsam gtan bzhi po skyong ya ṇabya sa brahma tsa rī bi ma la swa bhā ba/ /niḥsaṃ ga bā pa bi ṣa yā byed cing / /tshangs spyod dang bcas dri med rang bzhin can/ /yul ni mngon par mi shes grogs med na bhi dzñāsta tā ka tho rāstso tu tsistsa kāste/ /sā tsande li tyāḥpa te tā mu bai ti ta gnas—/ /der ni drag po'i nyi 'od lta bur mdzes①/ /de ni gal te pad ldan khrod nyid du/ /gyur nas de ṣa baṃ shaḥpra sha oṃ na yā ti/ /te dzo ni dhe rā na ya ṣpe tu ta gya bi tsind+ra rgyud ni durab tu zhi mi 'gyur/ /gzi brjid gter de rab tu 'gugs pa yisarngu/ /gnod med rigs ④pa hūṃ kā gya na bā ya yuttaḥ/ /shu te ti bā kyi dṛ pa te ra mā tyā bi tsārya sattha su tsi rātta ci yang bsam par mdzod/ /ces pa mi bdag tshig thos yun ring du/ /dpyad nas blon po kun gyis ⑤de mū tsūḥ/ /ta dā shra mo pānta ba ṣpe bi hahūṃ bi sre bye hūṃ saṃ pra nyi dzā dza pu tā/ /tabye la smras/ /da ni de yi bste gnas nye ba yi/ /nags su rgyal po'i bu mo rtse ru thong / /de tshig rjes su kya laddhā nu ma te na rā dzñā sā hi tābee bi ni bi rya sadzre/ /ya yo bi thraṭwā na li 'dod byas rgyal po yis/ /'dod pa'i don kun rnam par bshad nas ni/ /padmo can bsrings rab tu nī bi hahūṃ hahūṃ pra gaste ba mu ṣpeḥku mā raḥ/ /kāṭwā ba nārnyi sha na kai ra spobs pa bzhin/ /thub ⑥pa'i gzhon nu dbrog phyir rtse ru song / /mdzes mas nags kyi mthar ni dal bā sri lī khā bhi rā mā bi dza hā ra ta rtswa/ /bā khā ni le nā ka li gyis ④phyin/ /gzugs bzang rtsed 'jos mngon par dga' bas rol/ /mdzes pa'i mig can de ni rlung tā la te ba saṃ tsā ri bhā tsā ru bi lo tsa nā pā/ /bi khā sa pusthā ba tsa ye na ta su gzhon byus/ /bskyod pa'i 'khri shing bzhin du yang dag rgyu/ /de ni rol cing me tog 'thu chab yis ri shi gotta re shambi tsa ladku re shaṃ/ /ba na bi lo kya swa ta po ba nātpa dwags rwa rab g.yo zhing rnam bskyod pa'i⑨/ /nags mthong rang gi dka' thub nags tshal nas/ /dge 95—805

mā ya yo kau tu kabādku mā raḥ/ /sa sanda hūṃ gi ma ma nu 6 paṃ gasta ram̐ gī mtshan ldan pa'i gzhon nus yang dag 'ongs/ /mi yi grogs med padma ①ltar yangs mig /ya mtshan mig tā yo ba na bi bhra me ṇa/ /da darsha tsā piṣṭha ya nind+ra me baḥpuphrotpa laspyo ka ma ni 'dzum dang bral ba des/ /lang tsho'i rnam 'phrul gyis g.yo lus btud chacing / /utpal rgyas pa'i mig lā ya tā kṣaḥ/ /bi lo kya kādzñā mṛ ga lo tsa dzā hūṃ rā mā na bhi zlo pi mu nirdza can de mthong gyur/ /mdzes ma ri dwags mig can de mthong nas/ /dga' ma mngon shes med kyang thub harṣa—/ /na bās nā sgyu pa ni lbo na manta dza hā ti dzee tubee ṣa yā bhi lā ṣe/ /pa dga'/ /bag chags goms pas nang du zhen pa yi/ /yul la mngon 'dod 0skye bos gtong ma yin/ /su sdisna murghaṃ bi ni ba shya dṛṣṭi mṛ gī su ta stadma da nā ra binde/ /bi tyā dha ri dwags bu yi rab mdzes yid 'ong mig /de yi bzhin gyi padmar rnam bkod nas/ /rig 'dzin nam ④re bā mu ni bu tra kai bā bi dzñā ya hūṃ bye ti ba sārja bande/ /ya ti pra ṇa ni thub pa'i bu dag tu/ /shes nas mdza' ba'i dbang gis der phyag 'tshal/ /sdom brtson gyis btud mā ba na tā na nā yāsta sngaḥpra bā la byu ti nā dha re ṇa/ /āsgo rya mā no shu ba bzhin ras dud gyur pa/ /de yi mchu ni byu ru'i 'od ldan gyis⑤/ /'od zer tshogs kyis kun bsgribs do ṣpe na rā shaṃ dza grwa ha hā ro gya ma la swa bhā baḥ/ /tsā swe da sha sbo dasbyi la kānta kāddhā shal dag /dri med rang bzhin gyis kyang chags pa bzung khye/ /dril chung sgra snyan dag gis grogs kyi bzhin//muṅkambi tsā gī ma ba dadku mā raḥ/ /sa kho ko byā ma dhu ra swa re ṇa sma 'dod pa'i nye bar spyod pa gdams byas pa/ /rngul zags thig le dag gis mthar ⑦mjos shing / /rab ro pa tsā re 6 kṛ to pa de shaṃ/ /sgo swā ga tai te mu ni pu tra kashyitta po ba 'dar lus can de la gzhon nus smras/ /kwa ye thub pa'i sras khyed legs 'ongs sam/ /dka' thub nārnye ku sha lo sbo gā dzā/ /pa dā twa dā lo ke na nibya waṃ stha waṃ 6 ye ྾ bi ra laḥnags mthar ri dwags dge 'am ci/ /rtag tu khyod la lta zhing g.yo med pa/ /gang dag rnams ni thang la 95—806

pra tsā raḥ/ /i di bi lo kyā rya ta bā na ba bye di bya pra ta snga mṛ ta babhā dman par rgyu/ /brtul zhugs mchog ldan khyod gzugs bdud rtsi'i char/ /kha na ma tho med pa 'di rū paṃ/ /ba purdza ṭā balka li ram̐ mu mbi rmā shuṣka dru mā zla mi ba ta tstsha yā mi/ /mthong ba'i①/ /ral pa shing shun ldan pa thub rnams kyi/ /lus ni shing skam blubazhin du bdag rtog go/ /a yanta bsnagha dza ṭā ka lā baḥkṛ to pa kā raḥku su mirla tā bhiḥ/ /na bā 'khri shing me tog rnams kyis lduspras byas pa/ /khyod kyi ral pa'i tshogs ni mdzes pa 'di/ /sprin gser ④bha saṃ bhā ra bi dzi bha mā ṇa kānta ma yu ra pra ti bhā bi bharbhe/ /i rda ta tshogs la rnam par gdengs pa ⑤yi/ /rma bya'i mjug ma'i mdzes sdug rnam par 'dzin/ /khyod kyi brang ba shrī pha la yugru sho bhi bsgo bi ni kṣibee pa tā kṣa sru tram̐ / /a sru 'di dpal 'bras zung gis spras/ /bgrang 'phreng ⑥dkar po dag gis ④rnam par bcings/ /ri dwags tra yarjo la ku ram̐ ga ṣpe tra bai tsi tā mo tri ma na sa: kāste/ /ho maghi la ga na gzhon nu'i mig ltar bkra ba yis/ /yid la dga' ba skyed byed (shernam par mdzes/ /sbyin sreg me yi me spa ṭa bi spru li gā mo dzre da dha na na ba palla rpā tsā/ /ku tū ha lo stag gsal chags pa'i/ /ske rags 'dzin cing lus phra khya 'khri shing gzhon/ /yal 'dab gsar pas bā la la te ba ta dzñā ta nusta bee yo na ta no ti ka gya/ /thra hi pra sarja kwa ta mtshan 'dra khrod kyi lus/ /'di ni su yi dge mtshan rgyas mi byed/ / tha dag ṅku gang du g.yo ldan 'dab skyepo ba nārnye twatyā da bi bho pa bi kā shi nī bhiḥ/ /ya tra pra bhā bhiḥs ta tai bi bhā ti skyes ni/ /khyod zhabs bkod pas rnam par gsal byas pa/ /'od kyis rtag hu5 tu rnam par mdzes pa yi/ /saṃ tsā ri sthā paṃ ka dzi bee stha li 6/ /la khā nā na bhi dzha nā na bhi oṃ mṛ ga dka' thub nags mtha' gang yin dang bas smros/ /ri dwags rang bzhin thub pa'i gzhon nu ni/ /bud swa bhā baṃ ta ma bai tya bā lā/ /udṛ bye ladzdza ma bi shaṃ ka mā nā niryand+ra lī lā med mi shes de rig bu mo yis/ /ngo tsha rab btang spyornam par dogs rngumed pa/ /ma bsdams rtse dga' 95—807

bha ra ṇa ba khyu ba/ /ta tasta mā nanda ra sānd+ra tsiste sha ṣpe ba bhā ṣi mṛ du bhā dag ni ①rgyan bzhin gyur/ /de nas kun dga'i ros brlan sems ldan der/ /'jam par smra byed de ṣi bhā sa/ /ta bo ba na sthā sa mbi pa banti ma mā shra ma swa du pha la pra yis dal gyi ④smras/ /bdag gi bste gnas 'bras zhim me tog can/ /dka' thub nags tshal 'di dang sru naḥ/ /uste te khaṇḍi smi ta mo da kaiḥsā ta snga tha karbu ra sa ra ga nye bar gnas/ /zhes brjod ka ra'i 'dzum dang ga bur gyisakhye/ /nang tshangs ldan zhing yid 'ong ya gabyeḥ / /tsa kā ra mā parya tsa maskṛ yārtorngi lo bha āoṃ saṣka ṭi srukta tu byeḥ/ /mtshan ngos④/ /la du mkhas pa'i legs bshad mtshungs pa yi/ /de yis de ni rnam par chags par byas/ /udmā da keḥsā rā sa nā nu kyu lebyetta tpa dzeeḥpre ma ma yobee khā seḥ/ /de yi myos khyabyed ro 'dzin rjes mthun pa/ /sems dga' mdza' ba'i rang bzhin rtse dga' dang / /ba shlau mṛ tebya pra ṇa yotta ba rnyi stasthā gu ra bārya mṛ ga dza hā raḥ/ /bsngags pa bdud rtsi gus mchod ⑥ 'ching ba yis/ /'phags pa'i ri dwags de ni rgyas bzhin bcings/ /ta po ba nandarsha ya me ma hārta mi hphulla yarnyi ju dza balla ri rgyu/ /gā zwa pa cher ⑦ 'os dka' thub nags tshal bdag la ston/ /zhes brjod mig zum de la rgyal po yi/ /bu mos lag re gha bye ni mbi li tā kṣa me tī ti tai rā dza su tā dza gā da/ /tai pra sbi tai pa'i 'khri ⑧shing dag gis ni/ /dam du yongs 'khyud tshur shog ces pa smra⑫ / /chas shing cung zad rkang sā ka ti tsitpa dā ni ga tā pu na staṅga ma nā ya malja/ /ra baṃ sa mā ru khya bi sārya pā ṇi gis song de la/ /sbar yang de bgrod ⑫slad du bstar byas pa'i/ /shing rta la zhon lag pa brkyangs ⑪nas mā ro ha zla yi ba gi rā n+ya yuste/ /ra the tu ram̐ gān sa bi lo kya yuktadma des—/ /bzhon ⑫pa nyid ni tshig gis ⑫rab tu bskos⑩/ /shing rta 'dren pa'i rta dag des mthong nas/ /tā ku ram̐ gāmbi ga laji she ṣaḥ/ /mṛ gī du to haṃ na mṛ gā gra me basmṛ shā mi bye brag ma rtogs ri dwags yin par shes/ /ri dwags bu bdag ri dwags steng du ni/ /rkang pas mi reg 95—808

yāḥ—/ /shu two ti kanta j-i ta mā na su santa pa tso tā pi shu nāsma hakṣiḥ/ /gzir/ /zhes pa mdzes mas yid phrogs bu yis ①ni/ /gdung ba'i bsam pa go byed tshig thos nas/ /pu tra su ba rkyu ta paṣṭhanta rā ya ni pā ta dī tāḥsu tsi re pra da rmyo/ /kaṣṭi dka' thub bar chad gyur pas 'jigs pa yisal/ /drang srong chen po geshin tu yun ring bsamang) kye ta pa sī mṛ ga shā ba ko yi tī bre ṇa mughaḥsma ra lubha ke na/ /ba dzā ga nā ma dran pa'i rngon pa mi bzad pas/ /dka' thub can rbongs ri dwags bu 'di ni/ /bud med mchog tu bā gu rā yā ka ṭā kṣa ku ṭwā ba bā tī sa hā sā ni baddhāḥ/ /kṣa khaṃ bi tsibye mu nirma gyur pa'i rgya dag gis/ /zur mig gal du lhung bas khru'aphral la bcings/ /skad cig de bsams thub pa nī ྾ ma no pi kā ram̐ ta na ya gya hahūṃ/ /ta ma bra bīṭwā ma bhu dzee ga mukṇi bi ṣe mkhas pa yis/ /bu yi yid kyi rnam 'gyur dbrog kyepa'i slad/ /'dod pa'i lag 'gros dug btang yul ba hadhe pi ṣa yā bhi lā ṣe/ /na pu tra sā dhuḥs ma habhā sru nuḥsā sdi la ni/ /mngon 'dod 'dzin pa de la phas ⑦smras pa/ /bu de drang srong che sras legs pa min/ /de ni ma ṣpe dzand+ra bhu dzee ga bhū miḥ/ /ta tra sgo taṭī bra ta rā nu rā ga bi ṣa bya thā me bud ⑧med yid skyes lag 'gro'i sa⑨/ /der lhung rbongs pa shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /rjes chags dug gi '-ib bi bhanti rū bhāḥ/ /dza nāḥpra sast+ri dza na kā la ku ṭidzre sgyeḥsu tī byāsta ru bhā ka gdung ba rnam par 'dzin/ /mig sman nag po brtsegs chags na chung gi/ /zur mig rnon pos phug pa'i ṭā kṣeḥ/ /sho tsarnyi yo ṣindhu dza pā sha ba ddhāḥsaṃ sā ra kā rā pa da ṣpe pa do skye bo dag /skyon bcas bud med lag pa'i zhags pas bsdams/ /'khor ba'i btson ra dag tu mya ngan ṣāḥ—/ /gha na su saṃ mo ha ma lī ma sa gya ma bye ku ṭi lāḥsgra re tya kutthandi/ /byed—/ /kun rmongs dri mar ldan pa'i srid pa dag /sprin gyi dbus su gya gyur gsal byed pa/ /skad kāddhā sta ḍi taḥ kṣa ṇa nd+ra ཿ sum̐ rmā bi yo ge bye sha mandha kā re/ /e tā cig mtha' can mdzes ma'i glog 6spedag gis/ /bral tshe skyes bu mchog tu mun par byed/ /bud med 95 81 /

bhi ru྾ ka ku sum̐ bi ni bhi rudmā da rūsgo bi ṣa balla rī bhiḥ/ /spyo bhind+ra hā mo ha rnams ni mya ngan rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /smyo zhing brgyal byed dug gi 'khri shing ste/ /rbongs pa'i sha za chen mo pi shā tsi kā bhiḥsaṃ smṛ shya mā naḥku sha lī na lo kaḥ/ /swasthāsta e to ni ba sarnyi 'di dag gis/ /kun tu reg pa'i 'jig rten dge ldan min/ /bud med mig zur gdung byed zug rngu ni//santaḥsarnyo ṣa kārnyi gu ta po ba ṣpe 6/ /saddhā pa rna sdi na ya nānta sha sum̐ ye ྾ shi tai rnon po gang gis rmyesems la ma zug pa/ /chog shes kyis mdzes dka' thub nags tshal du/ /gnas pa'i tse ta bi nā ba sa.oṃ/ /i ti pra yatnadzdza na ke na testerbi be ka bā kyeḥpra ti bo rgya dam pa 'di de rnal du gnas/ /zhes pa 1dben pa'i tshig ni de dang des/ /pha yi 1'bad pas rab tu mā naḥ/ /na bu dhya ta so ma da nā nī te na lā ba rgya pā ṣpe nā ni gyushlau rtogs par byas/ /'dod pa dang ldan mdzes sdug btung ba yis/ /rnam par 'phrul pa de 5ni rtogs ma mā na/ /a thā sa re byurbi shwa kṛ tya kṛ to mu no pha le nd+ra ha ra bhā ya yā te/ /lbo lā gyur—/ /de nas nyin gzhan sna tshogs bya ba byas/ /thub pa 'bras bu yam shing len du song / /mi dbang ba ti lo bha yi tsu ku mā re na rend+ra ka tyā pu na rā dza grwa ma/ /dā sī ga ṇi nā nu bu mo 'jo sgeg ldan pa ni/ /gzhon nu chags par byed du beer yang 'ongs/ /'bangs mo'i tshogs rnams ga tā la tā dzñā pu bee smi tā dzā shri ya mā shra ya nta / / hūṃ shaṃ na rjes 'brang 'khri shing ni/ /me tog 'dzum ldan dag gis snodapal bsten cing / /lus can lus med rpā ga mi bai ka shri ga mā pā rya dzdzaṣṭha bi bha bo na hūṃ gī/ /di byo tsi tai gsar mtshungs rwa gcig can/ /'byor pas mtho ba'i lus ldan brtan pas phyin/ /bdag gi bste gnas kalpa la tā gra lo bi la hūṃ bhi rā oṃ ru tsi rā shra ma me/ /trahūṃ twa mā he tya dpag bsam shing rtse las/ /'phyang ba'i 'khri shing gis dga' lha la 'os/ /lta bar khyod kyis smras ⑥ zhes bhi dhwa ya sā tai ni nā ya tī ram̐ tri da shā pa gā yāḥ/ /sa ta tra rahpho dzwa la pi tsi tra brjod nas des/ /de ni gang gā dag gi ngogs su khrid/ /des der rin cen ⑦rab 'bar 'dab ma bkra//95—812

pa tra su baṇḍi ballī pha la puju ra bye/ /no bharnyi tai kṛ tri ma mā ka la yā su khā gser gyi 'khri shing me tog 'bras bu dga'/ /gru yi bzung ①ba'i bcos ma rnams brtags nas/ /dga' shra saṃ haste mi bā ru ro ha/ /saṃ sā ra tu bye na j-i taḥs te na sa rispra ba ba ma zhubazhin bde ba'i gnas la 'dzegs/ /'khor ba dang mtshungs zol gyi bste gnas der/ /chu bo'i te na ka pa ṭā shra me ṇa/ /a dzñā ta ta two pya nu rakta j-istirpā rā ṇa sī spru ti mi bā rgyun la de ni rab tu khyer/ /de nyid shes pa min yang chags tshul gyis1/ /mdza' bo can bzhin bā rā ṇa sa pā da/ /a bā pya kā shya su sa rā dza shlau ma hi ma hend+ra su ma hārta raṭwā/ /sīr ④phyin/ /de yi sa gzhi ⑤dbang chen kā shya yis/ /rin cen 'urin thang che ldan rgyal sar phyin/ /me ṣpe mu mbidzreḥka thi tai ka thā su swaṅgā ga rna troṣṭi pa dzee pra yā tsā/ /ta taḥpra thub dbang ⑦rnams kyi gtam la brobashad pa yis⑨/ /mtho ris gnas ni mig lam gyur par sems/ de mo dā ku li taḥkṣi tī shastasmi mṛ gā khye bi dhi nā bi bhi dzñāḥ/ /pra dakṣi shā brta bi lo nas rab dga' rgyas pa sa yi dbang / /sgrub shes tshogs de la ri dwags mig /g.yas skor bskor ba ⑫do ma hā re da do su tsā pūṇḍi ma no ra tha shrīḥ/ /na rend+ra ka tyā ka ra sakta pā shal g.yo ldan ma/ /bu mo re ba rdzogs pa'i dpal gyis ⑪byin/ /mi dbang bu mo ⑫lag par lag bkod ṇibee ba ha byā ba nyi tai hu tā sha dzwa/ /a ma snge tā ma n+ya ma tiḥku mā ra sta cing / /bag ma'i bsreg rdzas me la rnam par bkod/ /der ⑫ni gzhon nu blo gros gzhan pa med/ /sbyin tāsni ho tra su pa ram̐ pra kā ram̐/ /ma hotpa bond+ra ha ra sā ku le na pa pū bye mā naḥsreg ④rnam pa gzhan dag yin par sems/ /dga' ston che dang spro ba'i nyams rgyas pa/ /rgyal pos gus pra ṇa ye na rā dzñā/ /sbi twa ta paḥsaṃ ya ta e ba ta tra dzā yā sa khāḥsre pas rab tu mchod pa des/ /brtul zhugs dul /snyeldan nyid du der 'dug nas/ /chung ma dang 'grogs pra ya yo ba nārnye/ /dzā yā dri tī yambi dza ṣpe bra dzanta treṣṭa mṛ gī tai dza na rang gi nags mthar song / /chung ma'i grogs bcas ⑩ dbeen par bgrod pa de/ /ma ma ri dwags mos 95—813

byā pra z-iṭwā/ /mu ṣpe pra pā dapta ma nu 6 bā tsā ku tasta be yo la la ṣpe kyu bā mthong rab dga' ste/ /thub pa'i drin las mi yi tshig thos pas/ /gang nas khyod kyi bud med 'di zhes tsa / /sa tī pra ṇa mya pra ṇa yāṅga bhā ṣe mā tand+ra yā yo byu ti mān ba ya gyaḥ/ /shāptaḥsmras—/ /de la rab btud de yis gus smras pa/ /ma ma bdag gi ①mdzes ldan grogs mo 'di/ /rab pra yatna ta smṛ ha bhā ya rū paḥs khye na dīṭwā na la pā kṛ ke na/ /i 'bar me yi dbang can grogs med khyekyis/ /'dod par bya ba'i gzugs can 'bad pas thob ces ti khru bā rte ta ma be tya murghaṃ mṛ gī bi bā hā di ka thā nā bhe oṃ/ /pa ti bra tā smras ①bag ma la sogs gtam mi shes/ /rmongs pa de rig ri dwags mo de yis/ /khyo yi brtul zhugs nā ma tha tā pa sī rmā ta po ba rna sā sha na ṣperni nā ya/ /dhasthā nu ga te sa ha dka' thub can rnams kyis(pya/ /dka' thub nags tshal dag tu dal rmis khrid/ /chos rjes 'gro 'di khyod tsā ri bhā yo pa te twa ma gyaḥpa ti ri tya she ṣi/ /bi bā ha dṛrghaṃ ka thi ta sa tā bhiḥkyi rngulhan cig spyod/ /'di yi bdag po khyod ces ma lus pa/ /bag ma'i spyod tshul dag gi bshad pa de⑥/ /khru tā pri ya me bā bi bi da dzā yī/ /pi tā pra harṣa da pi kā shya pe na bi bā ha dha1 thos nas chung ma dga' ma nyid du rig /yab ni 'od srungs kyis kyang dga' ba yis/ /bag ma'i chos ni bi hi to pa de shaḥ/ /pra ṇa mya tai tabo tsa sā dza gā ma pu ram̐ sa bhāryaḥshwa su ra gya nye bar bstan pa bsgrubs/ /der btud de yi tshig gis ⑦chung mar bcas/ /gyos po rgyal po'i ④grong khyer rā dzñāḥ/ /dṛdhe na te na swa pa de sgyi ṣiktaḥs two dzwa lo shārnyi pa dzee shri te dag tu song / /snying stobs rab 'bar zhi ba'i ⑨lam bsten pa/ /rgan po de yi rang gnas la dbang na / /sha shā sa sa mānta ki rī ṭi bi shānta pā daḥs ma tī ma she ྾/ /bskur—/ /rgyal phran cod pan ngal gso'i ⑩gnas de yis/ /ma lus sa gzhi dag ni rab tu bskyangs/ /i shwarya mo hā na bhe bhū ta budhidhend+ra swa bhā bātpa la pa ju bee keḥ/ /dbang phyug rgongs pas blo gros zil mnan na/ /dben pa'i spyochos kyi rang bzhin las 'khrungs shing / /95—814

dza rā — to bhūṅga hu pu tra po tra pra bra bye yā shārnyi pa thā bhi kā laḥ/ /yo byudku mā rgan po bu dang tsha bo mang ldan desde/ /rab tu byung bas zhi ba 'dod par gyur①/ /thub gzhon rwa gcig ro mu ni re ka shri gaḥso haṃ na li bye ba la sho dha rā tsa/ /a byā pi dzadmānta ldan par ①gang gyur de/ /nga nyid pad ldan de yang grags 'dzin ma/ /ding thuyang skye ba gzhan gyi bag ra bā sa na snga bi lo bha nā ma ba mā rnyi yukyā/ /ni dza dzadmānta ra ka tsā dzi chags las/ /bdag la chags pa'i beed du mngon par sbyor/ /rang gi skye ba gzhan gyi gtam/ /rgyal ṣpe ṣpe tru pa baṇḍi tsā/ /ā kaṭwā bhikṣa baḥsabye ba bhū bu ste sa bismra yāḥ/ /bas rngunye bar bsngags pa 'di/ /thos nas dge slong de dag rnams/ /thams cad ya mtshan ldan par gyur//i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī me ka shrī gā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing ba dā na pañtsa ṣaṣṭi ta māḥpalla baḥ// //las rwa gcig pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //nā yā ti kā ya pa ri dṛrghaṃ sha taibee rā oṃ bi tstsha da me ti na dza bee na pa lā 'jig rten du ni skyes bu'i las lam grib ma bzhin/ /lus la lhan cig spyod 'di nges par mi yi ta su/ /lasmra na nā ma pa pu ṣaḥs ha tsā ri ddhā yo tshwa ye ba kasgro sha ra mtshon te/ /lus 'di yongs bsgyur brgya yi kyematha' mar mi phyin cing / /mgyogs par 3bros pa dag la ṇiḥpu ru ṣa gya lo ke/ /de ba datta shi lā pā ta pā dzā guṣṭha tā mṛ dzaḥ/ /rnam par 'chad mi 'gyur/ /lhas byin gyis ni rdo 'phangs te/ /zhabs mtheb snad nas khrag byung ba'i/ /kā ra rṇa bha ga pān thraṣṭi bhekyu bhesta na bhā ṣa ta/ /khru ya hūṃ ye na rgyu mtshan dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis der bka' sprul/ /mi zlog khon ni dran pa duddhā ra bai ra sma ra ṇa dzadma nā/ /ma ma kand+ra bi pā ke na pā dzā guṣṭhaḥpa las / /skyes pa'i las kyi rnam smin dag /gang gis bdag gi rkang pa yi/ /mthe bong yongs su snad ④95—815

ri kṣa taḥ/ /pa.āoṃ le 6 ma tī pā laḥrmā pi bye na ga re pu rā/ /a khyutpa tya ra to pa nyon/ /lnga len dag tu grong khyer rgo/ /ka ①bi beer sngon sa gzhi skyong / /bden dang chos la yang dag nā ma saṃ shra yaḥs tya dhand+ra yoḥ/ /ba bhū ba lakṣa rja nā ma pasnri ta gya su brten—/ /bden par dga' zhes bya ba byung / /skye rgu nāyang dag bsrung 'os pa/ /de yi btsun mo lakṣa shā/ /pra dzā saṃ rakṣa shārda su ya dza na gye ba dakṣi shā/ /dzee bātta mtshan nyid bzang / /mtshan nyid can zhes bya ba ni/ /mchod sbyin dag gi yon bzhin gyur/ /phywa 1las snga ma pu tā yī pu tā bye pre thi bī pa tiḥ/ /su dhasthā nā ma bai de ṭī mu pa ye de la bu med tshe/ /de yis ④gsol btab sa yi bdag /bu don gnyer bas lus 'phags ma/ /chos me ta pābee taḥ/ /pa rkyo gri ta bi bā he tha lakṣa shā sru ta da ra ke/ /bzang zhes pa khab tu blangs/ /khyo yis ‘snye/bag ma blangs pa'i tshe/ /mtshan nyid can la bu btsas te/ /mi byā sa sasbyi lā bhe na partswartswa pa mu pā ha tsa/ /so bhū da non maddhā khyaḥdon med chun (khyem thob pa yis/ /rjes su 'gyod pa dag kyang bzung / /de ni ma dud pa zhes bya/ /ku mā raḥbi tu rībee taḥ/ /bi byā bi na ya sadzandaḥka lā shāstant+ra pā gzhon nu pha ni rab tu dgyes/ /rig gnas dul ba phun tshogs shing / /sgyu ⑦rtsal bstan bcos mtshon ra gaḥ/ /su dhadzre dzee sa gabyu ya ma tha rā dza bya pa rya ta/ /saddhā re bha mthar phyin/ /de nas chos bzang mngal dag dang / /ldan pa'i tshe na rgyal po 'das/ /rtsom ⑦pa kun la spru rā sha dzñā de hi rghaṃ na sbi ra ta nuḥ/ /a mā hye ra bhi ṣistoḥta sngarnye lus can gyi/ /bsam pa brtan ⑨gyi lus mi brtananyu7/ /de nas de mthar blon rnams kyis/ /rgyal phran lakṣa ṇa su taḥ/ /na pophoku sha i bā byu rya st+rikyāḥsā manta darnyi rmā/ /glang lho1po'i lcags kyu ni/ /gsar pa bzhin du gang gyur pa/ /mtshan nyid can gyi bu dbang bskur/ /go bi ṣā ṇa bhi dha sta su ma hāmā tyā pri yo bha ba taḥ/ /go shri ga ku ṭi lā ya gya nī gang lugs ba lang rwa co ltar/ /gya gyu gzhan gyis 7mi shes pa/ /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /zhes pa de 95—816

tirna dzñā ya te sa riḥ/ /pratyā sa dzre su dhasthā yaḥkā le na sra sa bā ba sgo/ /garghaṃ yi mdza' bor gyur/ /dus kyis stichos bzang btsa' ba yi/ /mtshams dang nye bar gyur pa na/ /mtshan dṛ pārnya shā ha ni mitrī ka dzñāḥpu ro hi taḥ/ /a tha madhri gi rā rā dzā dzadma mkhan mdun na 'don dag gis/ /mngal gyi mi bdag mthar byed smras/ /de nas blon po'i phutshig gis ni//kṣa ṇa ba dhe shi shoḥ/ /ta dantaḥpu ra rakṣurdo na bi de sho rya tā pra dhwa na/ /tadri byis pa skyes tshe gsod pa la/ /de yi pho brang srung 'os pa/ /mtshon gyi sbyor ldan rgyal pos bskos/ /de dzñā ya su dhasthā pi se tra stu sha ra rde ya yo/ /ma hā mā hye bee dhwa tā dag shes nas chos bzang yang / /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /rang 'dod bzhin du byed pa las/ /ra mi ba swa tstshanda kā ri rde/ /pra bhu bhārle ti sā te na nildaṣṭa ta na ya bye yā/ /shin tu skrag nas skyabs su song / /de yi rje bo'i 2chung ma zhes/ /bstan des bu yi 'jigs pa la2 /saṃ dzwa tai su ta ma tyākṣiṅge bsto nāmbi ke ta ṣpe/ /ta ta e ba sa mā mbi hūṃ bu ni yang dag skyes pa dag /nya pa rnams kyi khang par bzhag /de nyid nas ni bu mo dag /de yis ta pā ka sdespra dadhi hūṃ/ /dzñā tā ṣpe mitrī ka ba tsaḥs tya dzre ṣpe na bhū pa tiḥ/ /blangs nas rab bstan pa/ /shes nas sa yi bdag po yis/ /mtshan mkhan tshig ni bden min bzung / /dhī mān ka bi ku mā rā khyuḥs ke brta kṛ he shi shuḥ/ /le bhe ya ta sta tadzñā nya pa'i khyim du byis pa des/ /rig pa bzo 'uganas sgyu rtsal dag /de de thos ྅pa gang des na/ /blo bi byā shismrabee tāḥka lāḥ/ /sa ta tra bā la kaiḥsārja shrī ḍā na ga ra kṛ ta pa ldan 3gzhon nu snyan dngags ⑪mkhan/ /byis pa rnams dang lhan cig der/ /lam du rtsed mo'i grong khyer thi / /rā dza ka lī pa ri tsa mabee dza hā ra ma hā ju dza/ /ya dṛtstsha yā ga byas—/ /rgyal po'i rtsed 'jo ⑫yongs 'dris la/ /dpung chen de ni rnam par rtse/ /der ni mtshan mkhan tasta tra ṣpe misbyi kā pu ro hi taḥ/ /tai dṛṭwā dṛ pa ma bye tya ba bhā ṣe mdun na 'don/ /'dod dga' dag tu 'ongs pa yis/ /de mthong mi bdag la phyogs te/ /gus par 95—817

bhakṣi sasma taḥ/ /de bai ka brta pa da ṣpe ma yā dṛṣṭaḥku mā ra kaḥ/ /ya mngon par 'dod pas smras/ /lha gcig nya pa'i khang par ni/ /gang gis khyod kyi rgyal srid dang / /srog e ba ka thi ta pūrde rā bye pā rja pa ha sta ba/ /shu two ti dṛ pa tiḥkro dag lha'aphrog par sngar brjod pa'i/ /gzhon nu bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /'di thos mi bdag khros pa pāmbirbhazlu pa ra mā ta re/ /go bi ṣa ṇi sa mā snu ya ma hā mā tya ma bhā ṣa ta/ /yis—/ /gzhan pa'i ma la rab smad de/ /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /yang dag bos nas rab smras khyepa/ /a ho ba tā ba tā pe na bha ba tā ma ma saṃ sha ye/ /rā dzñāsgo kaṇḍi dhwa re ṇa kau ri ba kye ma bdag gi the tshom la/ /rna ba 'dzin pa rab g.yel ba/ /khyod kyi rgyal srid chu gter la/ /gru bzhin shrī ru phe kṣi tā/ /tāsma ti n+ya sta tsitta gya su khaṃ ni dā bha badma ma/ /dpal la btang snyoms byas/ /khrod kyi blo la sems bkod pa/ /bdag ni ①bde bar gnyid gyur ④te/ /se bā rya pā ṇa saṃ de ha dzwa ra taṭī pa rda shrī hūṃ/ /gru zwa garbha pa ri tya de ring srog la the tshom gyi/ /rim gyi dbang gi gnas dag bsten/ /bdag gi ⑤mthar byed sbas pa'i bye kai brte 6 ma danta rka/ /pa dzdzaṣṭa pa ra mā tā me ga ṇa ya tre ba mngal—/ /nya ⑥pa dag la yongs gtad nas/ /rab tu dga' bas gzhan pa'i ma/ /nges par nyi ma bā sa rān/ /a byā pi tarja sgo pā ye twa yā yustirngi bye ya tī/ /nabagrang bar byed/ /da dung de ni gsad ④pa'i thabs/ /rigs dupa khyod kyis (pesgrub par mdzod/ /sen kha tstsha ju ku bye ro kā le nā yā ti kuste tī/ /rakṣa ti swā mi rāṣṭarja mos chod pa'i dus kyi ⑪ ni/ /sta re yis kyang nus mi 'gyur/ /rje bo yul 'khor nor dang rdzong / /durga mi nd+ra ba lo da yī/ /a mā tya bra kṛ tistasmrattha kṛ ti bhyo ga ri ya grogs dang dpung rgyas srung byed pa/ /de yi slad ⑪du rang bzhin las/ /blon po'i rang bzhin shin tu sī—/ /bya sa na sha ma na dhyā nā salngaḥ sa dā hi ta pā yi naḥpra ṇa brling / /blon po gdung ba zhi byed bsam gtan la chags rtag tu phan pa blos⑫/ /nyan rna ⑫dul ba'i 95—818

bye ni ya ta byasgyu bhatta pra tā ki la madhri ṇaḥ/ /a bhi ma ta pha la pāsthā sa byāḥtshul ldan gus pa'i brtul zhugs dag ni nges par 'dzin/ /mngon 'dod 'bras bu thob pas grub pa dag pra dadhi ta sidhe yaḥshu tsi pa ri tsa yo dā rā pu byerbha brnyi ma tī bhu rdzu/ /ni 'phral la rab tu ston/ /yongs 'dris 1dag cing rgya che sa bdag rnams kyi bsod nams dag gis thob/ /tūṇḍi gu ru ta rā re byerwa ra ko sau ni dārlu hūṃ/ /kā la tī naḥpra yahpho myur du rab phyi rtsom pa yis⑤ / /byis pa 'di ni rnam par chom/ /dus dang bral ba'i 'bad pa ni/ /ti pa:tyā pā ke ba lo/ /i ti rā dzñā sā mā diṣṭaḥpūdzre pe kṣu bi lakṣa rjes su gdung byed 'ba' zhig yin/ /zhes pa rgyal pos yang dag bstan/ /sngon gyi btang snyoms skyengs ⑦ dhīḥ / /ga dza bha dzi ra thā mbi kai ra mā tya pa hi to ya yo/ /a tānta re pa'i blos/ /blon po glang po rta dang ni/ /shing rta'i tshogs dang lhan cig song / /chos bzang ④gis kyang su dhasthā bi gru bye mā snu ya pu tra rka/ /tadmadhri ṇi ni pe byā smi ga mya tā mi kyu gnas skabs der/ /bu ni gsang nas bos byas te/ /gros de de la rnam par bshad/ /'gro bar mdzod bā tsa hūṃ/ /da tā tsū ḍā ma ṇismra tā sa bi sreṣṭa sta rā ku laḥ/ /bra dzan ces de la smras/ /ma yis gtsug gi nor byin nas/ /btang ba de ni rings pas ⑤'khrugs/ /rin cen ⑥ dru rā da ma tre na dṛsgo ratna bi bhū ṣi taḥ/ /rā dza pu traḥs e bā yo byu na gyis brgyan 'gro ba dag /blon po yis ni ring nas mthong / /rgyal po'i bu de ⑦gsad nas ni/ /bos pa gyu zwa pa lā ya te/ /i byughā gya ba dhwa yo gān sa se tyā grwa na tso de yatro/ /'di nyid ma yin nam/ /zhes brjod de yis de gsad ⑤slad/ /dpung gi sngon 'gro drag po bskul/ /dza bee na dra ba tsā te hūṃ mṛ ga bee shaḥs dru ra gaḥ/ /tsadza kā khya su nā ga su mgyogs pas de dag la 'bros shing / /ri dwags ltar mgyogs ring bgrod ⑨de/ /tsam pa ka zhes bya ba yi/ /madzdza ta bha ba dzā bha si/ /dṛṣṭa naṣṭi ta tastasmi starnyabye pra yatna bā na/ /pa da klu yi gnas kyi chu la byeng / /de nas mthong nyams de yi tshe/ /blon po chen po 'bad ldan pas/ /rjes su 95—819

kā khye ma hā mā bye brtswatsā ram̐ bi sreṣṭa bā na/ /tsū ḍa ma ṇi pra bhā bee na saṃ ste bhi de ni btsal ba'i slad/ /pa ta ka zhes nyan rna ①btang / /de nas gtsug gi nor bu yi/ /mthu yis rjochu ta dza lo ta taḥ/ /nā gaḥku mā ra mā shāgya sbyi ya tā mi tya bhā ṣa rta/ /bi smra ni rengs byas shing / /klu yis 1gzhon nu dbugs phyung nas/ /'dug cig ces pa rab tu smras/ /rgyal kya rā dza pu tārta pā da mu dru ba ṭī bhu baṃ/ /sbi lta nā ga gya bha ba ṣpe pa da kasta sras la 'os rkang pa yis/ /rgya ldan sa gzhi mthong gyur nas/ /klu yi gnas na gnas pa dag /pa da ka su tsa ya ta/ /a tha nā gend+ra bha ba rgo pa ri bārlu sa manta taḥ/ /a shā yis krude la brjod/ /de nas klu yi dbang po'i gnas/ /kun nas yongs su bskor nas ni/ /blon po ba yadma hā mā tyaḥpābee bā dzñā pha bhā shwa ram̐/ /dzā shu rnyiḥpū ra ya bye ṣa chen pos sa bdag bka'/ /gdengs can dbang la rab tu bsgrags/ /lag 'gro khyod kyi khang pa ni⑤/ /bha ba āoṃ te bhu dzee ga ma/ /dza lo sba lo bee lo shwa rja ka ro ti ku pi taḥpra bhuḥ/ /bdag gis rdul gyis spyekhengs par bya⑦/ /chu ni jo bo khros pa yis/ /thad dang gcong rong dag tu byed/ /bhu dzi gī sgo ga bi tstsha rda na tse ditstsha se tra swa yi/ /a hi ta rā dza rā dza gya rang nyid lag 'gro'i longs spyod dbang / /gal te 'chad par mi 'dod na/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po mi phan pa/ /rā dza pu tram̐ pa ri khya dza/ /i ti santardzi taste na nā ga thoṇḍi kṣa yā kṣa ṇi/ /rgyal po'i bu ni yongs su thong / /de skad de yis ①bsdigs pa narjo/ /mtshan mo'i ⑫dus su klu yis ni/ /ta tyā dza rā dza na bha baṃ bha ya sgo gyu hi rdza dza naḥ/ /pratstsharghaṃ rā dza pu tro myur bar rgyal po'i bu btang ste/ /srog chags rnams ni 'jigs dbang gyur⑪/ /de nas rgyal sras rab tha ra dza kā ba pa thāsbi taḥ/ /tsa rā ṇa tyā sa mu dru bhiḥpa ta ke no bsgribs te/ /'khrud mkhan dag gi khang par gnas/ /rkang pa bkod pa'i rgya dag gis/ /pa ta ka yis ⑫pa lakṣi taḥ/ /ta taḥpāste ma hā mā hye ra dza ke nā bi tarbha yāta/ /nye bar mtshon/ /de nas blon chen 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /des 'jigs 'khrud mkhan ⑫dag gis kyang / /95—820

lakṣe ṇa shwa khyu bā si nā/ /rakṣi taḥkṣi ti mā sā rya pakṣi banda bya pa rya g.yang sar gnas pas gzhon nu yang / /bsrungs te 'dab chags bzhin du ni/ /sa la phyin cing shi ma ta—/ /su dhasthā bi pa ti tsā khru tā pu tram̐ swa ni dha ṣpe ṣi ṭwā/ /su tā te jo ba gyur—/ /bu ni lhung thos chos bzang dag /rang nyid 'chi ba 'tshol ①ba ni/ /lha mo rnams kyis ②khyod tī rkyu ghā rakṣi tā di bya yo ṣi tā/ /ku mā ro pi kha la byā ghra gru ra kṣuṇḍi shi lā kyi bu/ /'tsho zhes brjod nas rab tu bsrungs/ /gzhon nu'ang stag rmig rnon po yis/ /rdo ba'i gzhi ni ta lo/ /ga dzā sredmatta shārdu la dā ru rde ba na mā bi shata/ /ta tra nyams byas shing / /glang po'i khrag gis stsos pa yis1/ /mi bzad stag ldan nags su zhugs/ /de ni sau ga la ka kṣi na lubha ke na ni bee di lta/ /mārga mā sā rya pu ru ṣe kṛ tta rngon pa mig ④ser can/ /zhes pa yis ni rab bshad de/ /lam ni thob pa'i skyes bu dag /lus kun gā tram̐ bya lo ka ya ta/ /bi lo kya dzata ka ru ṇa ste sa pra tstsha dṛ pātpa dzaḥ/ /ke ṣpe bcad pa mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong snyeng rje skyes pa yi/ /mi bdag bu yis ⑤rab tu dris/ /khrod kyi rmā bai sha ba hūṃ nī to pi bi dza ṣpe ba ṣpe/ /so byu bīnda ti dru re tra sdug bsngal gnas skabs 'di/ /mi med nags su ci yis ⑥thob/ /des 3smras ring po min 'di na/ /tsāṇḍa labyaṇḍa tseṣṭi taḥ/ /ni ba sa tyanta kaḥsum̐ sā su dā so nā ma duḥs haḥ/ /gtum po gtum po'i spyod tshul can/ /bzod dka' su dā sa zhes pa/ /skyes bu rnams kyi mthar byed gnas/ /ta su shaṃ kha mu kho nā ma pā ra me yoste dī ṣa ṇaḥ/ /pand+ra sbri sa ka la tīṭwā de la dung gi kha zhes pa/ /khyi ni 'jigs su rung ba sod da7/ /lam gnas mtha' dag gang mthong ye ṣpe tā bi hi tā di shaḥ/ /tasgo tsa rasgo ta gye ya oṃ gatstsha da sa mudzha ba —/ /gdon mi za bar rnam 'joms pa/ /de yi spyod tshul lhung gyur pa/ /yud tsam 'tsho ba'i lhag tshig rkang gnyis po 'di bod skad du ma bsgyur 'dug pa za hor ban des bsgyur ba mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/bā / /rū snurta shi ṣa dzre ba su bya thā me marma shā yi mbi/ /spyuddhāḥshaṃ kha ma can/ /bdag gi gnad bsnun zug rngu 'di/ /yan lag bcad las yang dag skyes/ /gtum po nyin 95—822

mu khoskṛrghaṃ kakhye nī sārba ga mi dzā/ /ma dhyā tna tapta byaṇḍa laḥpa dā gung gdung ba'i tshe/ /gdug pa dung gi kha dag gis/ /mgrin pa rab bcad don mthun rmi/ /khrag ni pi ba hi sho ṇi tai/ /i ti ta su ba tsa shu tā rā dza pu tro ni rā yurnyaḥ/ /rtag tu 'thung bar byed/ /ces pa de yis ①tshig thos nas/ /brtse ①bas yid ni phug gyur cing / /ki ka ro mbi ti kṛ pa yā pra da rmyo bee dha mā na saḥ/ /byaṇḍa ko tsaṇḍa maṇḍa laḥmatshon dang bral ba rgyal po'i bu①/ /ci zhig bya zhes rab tu bsams/ /drag rngupo gzhu yi dkyil 'khor can//a tha dza gā ma tsaṇḍa la/ /dikṣu kṣi pambi ba tro sha ba rā ha ru bye ratstsha ṭā/ /de nas gtum po 'ongs gyur te/ /phyogs su mig gis ①phag gi ni/ /khrag gi zer ma 'phen pa bzhin/ /tatpabye kra tsa spyu ra pa sha naḥshā gya dṛ byu te/ /pra tya gra sho ṇi tā sakta de yi ngos su khyi yang mthong / /sog le ltar rtsub so dang ldan/ /gsar pa'i khrag gis bsgos spyopa yi/ /na kha ko ṭi kṣa tā pa niḥ/ /i ga sgo ga ku ram̐ gā rde tsa ma rā rdeñtsa bā la sder ⑦mo'i rtse mos sa la 'brad/ /ri dwags rnams kyi yan lag 'joms/ /g.yag rnams dag ni du byis gra haḥ/ /sh-i gā khā ram̐ ku la byā dhiḥshu ka rā rde kṣa ya dzwa raḥ/ /mā pa'i gdon/ /ce spyang rnams kyi rigs kyi nang / /phag rnams nyams par byed pa'i rims/ /gtum tai ga pakṣa pa te na bi bye nā ba na ba zla ni/ /krorya dadzeeḥs si hā po'i phyogs su lhung ba yis⑨/ /byed pos nags kyi lam du ni/ /'tshe ba dag ⑩gi ngal dub bzhin/ /nā mā yā pa i ba nind+ra taḥ/ /ta myu tha n+ya ba dhū na bya ba dha bya bā dha dregs ldan gdug pa can de sprul/ /'gron po'i chung ma gsar du ni/ /yugs sa'i gdung ba sgrub byed bedha saḥ/ /hūṃ kā ra ghargha rā rā beerdu dru buḥkhaṅga dhe na baḥ/ /ta ma bhi dru ta ma kyu gra de'i / /hūṃ zhes ghar ghar sgra dag gis/ /bse ru drus ma rnam par 'bros/ /shin tu gtum po rbod pa yi(/nye//tsaṇḍa lakṣe ḍa saṃ dzha yā/ /dṛṭī ru ro ha bhū pā la sru nu ra ma la ka dru oṃ/ /tai bī brda yis mngon du 'ong ba de/ /mthong nas sa skyong bu yis ni/ /skyu ru ra yi shing la 'dzegs/ /shing la 95—823

do ṣa pra tsa ya ba pa ti darsha ya hye ba dru rāta ya sde gu stso ta nu ta ra ma ti byakta shin tu gsal bar mthong nas mdzub mo dag gis ①ston byed pa/ /kun las mtho bas snyerang rigs zla ba mā lo kya lo kaḥ/ /i ti tsinta ya tasta mya bi ṣa me pā ṇa saṃ sha ye/ /a de yi skye bar ma gyur cig /de ltar sems dpa' de yis ni/ /mi bzad (rīsrog gi the tshom la/ /bdag 5bhūnd+ra re kṣa yā de ba na sha rī rakṣa yadzha yo/ /a tā nta re di bya tro nyid nyams pas lus dag ni/ /'jigs pas 'jigs pa ⑪yongs ma gyur/ /skabs der thub pa rig pa shā dzñā tā bi tyā dha ro mu niḥ/ /ma tha raḥkṛ pa yā ta gya tī bra gre sha baṃ 'dzin—/ /ma tha ra yis kyelha mig gis/ /de yi gnas skabs mi bzad pa'i87/ /nyon mongs can zhes tīnda shī/ /khaṅga : pā ṇiḥs mā ya yo kha: khaspyom tī ta yoḥ/ /na sgo brtse ba yis/ /mkha' dang ⑪ral gri 'grogs pa yi/ /yon tan gcig nyid ston byed cing / /lag na : mkha' dang ral gri 'grogs pa yi zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bsgyur ba beer rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/ni sto sha yo mai ṭī me kā rū dzā pra darsha yan/ /so bye tya dī ṣa ṇa ta nuḥshubs med ral gri can/ /mkha' yi lam nas yang dag 'ongs/ /khros rṣashing shin tu sdug 13pa'i mig /kro dha spyu ra ta rekṣa ṇaḥ/ /tsaṇḍa la sru noshyistso da shi raḥshaṃ kha mu kha su tsa/ /'jigs rung lus can de 'ongs te/ /gtum po'i bu dang dung gi ni/ /kha yi mgo dag rab tu bcad/ /a tha swa mā shra oṃ nī tā ta mā shā su dṛ pāttha dzee/ /sa tasmi pra da do mā yā bi tyāḥde nas rang gi gnas su khrid/ /mi bdag sras de dbugs phyung nas/ /rdzu 'phrul che dang lhan cig des/ /sa ha ma harnyi bheḥ/ /ta taste mu ni rmā oṃ rngu mā bhā sha tru dzi gī ṣa yā/ /rā sgyu ma'i rig pa de la byin/ /de nas thub pa de la zhus/ /khengs ldan rgyal sras rgyal srid ni/ /bzhed bye kā maḥsha ṣpeḥpra yāta tsā pi bye pābee bātpa dzaḥ/ /pa ta pra narta tī rū cing dgra las rgyal 'dod pas/ /rmā pi lar ⑫ni dal gyis song / /de yis ⑫der ni gar mkhan ma/ /paṃ kṛ twa ra ti ma no ha dzā/ /la li tā narlo tai steḥsau ra lo ka ma to ṣa yid 'phrog dga' ma'i gzugs byas nas/ /yid 'ong yigar stabs de dang des/ /grong pa'i 'jig rten 95—825

yata —/ /khru tā na ra ba tista gya kau sha la dṛbhu nā tyā yoḥ/ /swa yo tshim par byas/ /de yi gar dang zlos gar dag /mkhas pa mi bdag gis thos nas/ /blon po dang drabye sa hā ma hā hyeḥpra ya yo nā rgya maṇḍa baṃ/ /sa ta tra kai shi tī lī la li tai bcas rang nyid ni/ /zlos gar khang par hurtelta ru song / /de yi de rnguni sgra can gyis④/ /rtse dga' yid tabye lo ka yatpa/ /a mṛ tā ha ra rja yā tai kānta byu pa mi bā sgo tai/ /ta 'ong de dag mthong / /mdzes ma'i gzugs su g.yo med ni/ /bdud rtsi len du 'ong ba ④bzhin/ /de snga bhe na ya ponda rlo bi tsārya dhwa ra sthā dha raḥ/ /shri gā rā swa da nakhye yi gar stabs mdzes sdug la/ /rnam par dpyad nas 'dzin ma 'dzin/ /'jo sgeg myang zhing ⑤myos gyur baḥpra dhwa nā mā tyā ma bra bīta/ /a ho saṃ pūṇḍi lā ba rgya dha tyā ba ra ta pas—/ /blon po'i gtso la rab smras pa/ /kye ma mdzes sdug kun rdzogs shing / /bsngags 'os lus nosta nuḥ / /i yo ha ra ti nabye tabye tā bhi na ya shā li mbi/ /mchog ldan pa'i lus/ /ngo mtshar gar stabs ldan pa nish-i/ /bdag cag rnams kyi yid 'phrog byed/ /i yo sā me na kā byu na swarga re ga bi la se nī/ /a n+ya thā na ba ṣpe pa byā mtho ris do ra'i rtsed 'jo mkhan/ /me na ka de 'di min nam/ /gzhan du gsar pa'i tshon ris dang / /ku taḥkarnye ya mā kṛ tiḥ/ /bhā bā bha bya ta ra swa bhā ba ra tsa nā bai tsi rgya tsā dbyibs mdzes 'di ni ྅ga la 'ong / /'gyur bag shin tu legs pa'i rang bzhin gyis spras rnam bkra mdzes ru kra mai rā mā rya su ra sa gya saṃ gha ta ta yā niḥpā da nā yo rya taḥ/ /pa'i rim pa yi/ /tshogs rnams nyid kyis 3shenyams su myong bya nyams rnams nges par rdzogs pa la brtson zhing / /nibeenda su mu huḥpra sā da na pi dhedzre dhya bru bā gī ti bhiḥsaṃ mūtstsha na mu ra rdzogs pa'i dbus su glu ⑦/yi 'gyur gyis ⑫yang yang rab tu dang ba sgrub byed pa/ /rdza rnga yang dag bsgrags dzo pa ram̐ dzi ta ma ho na bye ma naḥkarṣa ti/ /bā bhā pā ju pa ri gra te pas nye bar spros /1pa'i zlos gar kye ma yid dag khyarta'agugs/ /skad ni brjod pa yongs su 'dzin tshe yid 95—826

ba ri ṇa madhī ṇa swa nā mo di sa twa byasti bi bhatta kadza ta ra khā tā rorlu 'ong rgyud mang ①sgra yis dga' ldan pa/ /snying stobs gsal bar 'byed ldupas 'dar zhing g.yo ldan 'og khāe me kha lā/ /ā hārya ra tsa ya tya ha ryā tu tsi ram̐ sau rda rya re khā pag mdzes sdug ri mo'i grogs/ /gsang por brjod la mngon phyogs mi 'phrogs yid 'ong stabs dang ldan sa khāe ta bye khā su bi lā sa shi 6 ka ma rmā zla yugla mā se ba te/ /par sgeg par spras/ /gzugs bzang smin ma zung ni sgeg cing rol pa'i bslab pas spras pa kun tu bsten/ /i ti tabo da rmā sgo dza n+yasta ṣpe tra su byu pa teḥ/ /urya yo ba da na swe zhes te de gdong chu skyes la/ /mig bkod sa yi ①bdag po yi/ /bzhin kyi rdul gyis rngu bran pa yi/ /da seka to ma da na pā da paḥ/ /di dzñā te rarja saṃ pūṇḍi da tā sri pā ri to ṣi 'dod pa'i rkang 'thung yang dag skyes/ /de la tshim med nyin mo'i mthar/ /rin cen snyeyongs rdzogs byin kai / /antaḥpu ro da ram̐ ga twa ta me ba tsinta yan dṛ paḥ/ /a sa nas ni/ /pho brang 'khor gyi nang song ste/ /mi yi bdag pos bdag 'unyid bsams/ /'khor ba'i rgyus tya byu pā ta myuntarbi shānta kyu ṭa kā mi dī/ /tsa kre sa sā ra mā ya ba bzhin bden med gzugs/ /bcos ma'i 'dod ldan ma yis ni/ /sa bdag de yi nang dag tu/ /rnam sā mo haṃ ma tī pa teḥ/ /ā ni nā ya sa hūṃ swe ram̐ pa da āoṃ ma da nā tu raḥ/ /par gnas shing rmongs par byas/ /'dod pas gzir ba de yis de⑦/ /dal bu yis ni khyim du bos/ /pa ri ṇḍa ma bi ro dhi n+ya smṛ ha yadhe myu mubye baḥ/ /ya shaḥpubee pra kā yongs su gyur pa'i 'gal ba la/ /'chi bar 'dod rnams chags par byed/ /grags pa (8me tog rnam rā rde tri brga pha la shā khi dzā/ /pabye dṛ pa bṛkṣu shā midhri yā ṇa ma bkra zhing / /sde tshan gsum gyi 'bras bu can/ /mi bdag ljon pa rnams dag gis77 / /dbang po ma ni gra haḥ/ /ṣpe pā ba ṭi pa ta ti pā nyi ni yu tha nā thaḥsaṃ pūṇḍi dā na pa bsdams sta re yin/ /glang po rjes su chags pa drag po'i dbang du gyur pa la/ /gal te glang mo de yis spyo95—827

ri pū ri ta j-iṅga sāzaḥ/ /sā banta tī ya di ka ro ti na kuñdza ra mya gā ṭwā nu rā rmongs pa'i bslab pa ma byin na/ /yongs rdzogs sbyin pas bung ba'i don mthun yongs su dgyes byas pa/ /ga bi ba sha gya bi mo ha dispyo/ / ta taḥswe ra kṛ haṃ tā rā dzhabye ṭa khyu yi mgon po lhung ba'i g.yang la nges par lhung ba min/ /de nas dal gyes rgyal khab tu/ /bran khol kaiḥku ṭa kā mi bhā/ /tstshand+ra nu bṛsbyi mū byebee nā shā ya pra bee shi tā/ /blun po 'dun pa yi/ /rjes su 'jug pas brlag pa'i slad/ /bcos ma'i bud med rab tu bcug /bi bi ste tya kta bye rya su ta su gru ṭwā bi lā ṣi ṇaḥ / / ba byu ba dben par brtan pa btang byas shing / /gsang ba mngon par 'dod de la/ /dus ni mdzes ma'i kāddhā rū pe ṇa kā laḥkaste gra horlu khaḥ/ /ta tasta dīrgha ni dā ya sha gzugs dag gis/ /mgul nas 'dzin la mngon phyogs gyur/ /de nas gnyid ni ring po'i beed/ /gus yā mā rū bhā mā da rātro/ /bi hā ya narta tī rū paṃ ku mā raḥs ha sā pra bīta/ /pas mal stan 'dzegs de la/ /gzhon nu ①gar mkhan ma yi gzugs/ /spangs nas 'phral la rab smras pa//sgo gā nustso na bha ba tā sgyu j-i ste hā na pe kṣi bhā/ /sa ha sgo gya mi rda rā bye khyod kyo longs spyod la chags shing / /spun zla'i mdza' la ltos med pas du/ /lhan cig spyad bya rgyal srid ni①//ka tha me ke na bhu bye te/ /nirdo ṣaḥkle sha dza la sgokṣibye haṃ bi ṣa me twa yā/ /gcig pu yis ni ji ltar spyod/ /mi bzad nyon mongs chu gter du/ /skyon med nga ④ni khyod kyis 'phangs//swa kand+ra yo gā dudhīṇḍistattha tī kā ra tsinta kaḥ/ /uste ti ba nd+ra dṛ pa de yi le lan sems byed bdag /rang gi las ni sti sbyor bas thar/ /zhes brjod de yis ⑥mi bdag 1 bye rdzu rā bye ma ba mya saḥ/ /mubha pra paṃ sha ma baṃ tsakre dza na tā shā pa bcings—/ /rgyal srid rab tu rgyas pa thob/ /skye bo'i tshogs ni dbugs phyung ste/ /sred ldan rab tu zhi ṣpe na paḥ/ /sa saṃ pābye pa daste bro tsinta yan swa pa rā bha baṃ/ /shi dzee bar byas/ /gnas thob de yi ⑦rang nyid kyisasnyi/ /gnod pa drag po sems byed cing / /snga dro brtse med 95—828

pra bhā te bikṣe pa dṛ pa te1 rgyu ni/ /tsā bhā tri ba dha saṃ sakta rakta seghra mi ba khro ba yis/ /mi yi bdag la rdo ba 'phangs/ /spun zla bsad pas chags pa yi/ /khrag dang sbags bzhin shri yo / / bhu ghā ka bi ku mā ro pi de hā rnye na ra shaṃ ya yo / /dpal 'byor de/ /spyad nas gzhon nu snyan dngags mkhan/ /lus rmyekyi mjug tu dmyal bar song / /so haṃ barṣa sa ha pā ṇi bhustu taṅkand+ra pā ta shaṃ/ /pra khye ṇa kilbi kho snga rya pā de nyid nga yin stong phrag lor/ /las kyi sdig pa de spyad nas/ /sdig pa zad mod da lta yang / /rkang pa'i dzā gukhye pa ri kṣa teḥ/ / dzadmā ba rta kra ma pa ri tsa yiḥsanta taiḥpa tsu mthe bo (khyayongs su snad/sgo/ /skye ba'i 'khor mor rim gyis snguyongs 'dris rgyud dag gis ni smin byas shing //mā rna partswaspyo tai sba la dza la ta ru krā ba gaṭwānta re pi/ /taistend+ra nā ra sa phyi nas skam dang chu dang shing dang rdo yi ḍa3snying po'i dbus skyes kyang / /sna tshogs ro yi 6yo byad lus kyi pa ri ka riḥkā ya pā tre swa bhukṇi kaspra pā ma ra pi na pu ru ṣaḥkand+ra she sngo dza hā ti/ /snod ni de dang des kluspyad de/ /skyes bu'i las kyi lhag ma skal ba 8 gnod pa yis kyang gtong mi 'gyur/ /i tya n+ya dzadma tsa ri tai shu twa bha ga ba to rda tai/ /a lo rgyu me ni re de skad skye ba gzhan gyi spyod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs thos nas/ /dge slong kun gyis las kyi sadzee ra bhikṣa baḥkadzre santa tim/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye rgyud⑨—/ /bgom par bya ba min par nges/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā nā kalpa la tā dzee ka bi ku mā rā ba dā āoṃ ṣaṭa ṣakhyu dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gzhon nu snyan dngags mkhan gyi rtogs pa brjod ta maḥpabee waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa drug pa'o// //dha tyā te pa ri pūṇḍi pu 5 ni dha yaḥ saddhādzre saṃ po dha na dzñā no 'khor ba yangs pa'i mya ngam lam chen rab mang nyon mongs drag pos gdung byed pa/ /yongs su 95—829
