da gra gu rū pa de sha ma hi mā ya dhī pra bhā bo da yāḥ/ /ge ha rpā ga rdzogs pa'i bsod nams gter gyur dam chos rtogs shing ye shes mchog dang ldan/ /bla mas nyer bstan ṇa lbo la yā ba hu ta ra gre sho gra saṃ tā pa kṛ ta yiḥsaṃ sā ra se pā ri mā rab tu rgyas pa'i mthu thob bdag nyid chen po gang dag gis/ /khyim byi khyams ①su rtse ba lta bus yang dag ra ba ma hā mārgaḥs muwaṃ bhya te/ /pu rā bha bsgo ha pa tiḥshā ba bye budhe rakṣi rgal byed de dag bsngags dupar 'os/ /mnyan yod dag tu sngon byung ba/ /khyim gyi bdag po ①sangs rgyas taḥ —/ /abee sarbo pa ka ra rde gubyo ya gya kṛ ha shri yaḥ/ /yaḥpra srung ⑤/ /gang gi khyem gyi dpal sdug gyeni/ /slong ba'i tshogs kyis nyer mkhor ⑥gyur/ /gang zhig yid sanda ma no bṛtrīḥku sha lā ya pra sā di nā/ /kṛ taḥshikṣu pa do1ṣṭaḥshā ri putre spyod rab dang ba/ /dge ba'i beed du babeeb pa'i gnas/ /rab tu dang ba'i dge slong ni/ /shā ri'i bu ṇa bhikṣu shā/ /saṃ gha rakṣi ta nā mā byuta saṃ pūṇḍi gu ṇa lakṣa ṇaḥ/ /pu yis dag par byas/ /de sras dam pa'i kun spyod can/ /rig gnas kun ⑦la rnam par mkhas/ /yon tram̐sta su dā tsā raḥsaza bi byā bi tsakṣa ṇaḥ/ /tai ka dā tsisgo ha pa te shā ri tan mtshan nyid yang dag rdzogs/ /dge 'dun srung zhes bya bar gyur/ /nam zhig khyim du shā ri'i bu/ /pu tra pi tā bra bīta/ /twa mu pasthā ya kaḥpu tra garbha sgo gya pa tai khru taḥ/ /tasmrata 'ongs tshe pha yis de la smras/ /bu khyod mngal na gnas pa na/ /'di yi nye gnas su dam bcas/ /de da dhu nā sa bye kanghru marta si me ba tsa/ /pu byesgo brnyi sahphu tāḥpi tu slad da (sheni bdag gi tshig /de ni bden par bya bar 'os/ /pha la bu lon med byed pa'i/ /bu bzang pā dṛ sgo kā ri shāḥ/ /i ti pi tā sa mā diṣṭaḥpra z-iṣṭaḥsaṃ gha rakṣi bsod nams dbang gis bye'agyur/ /de skad pha yis phobyeyang dag bstan/ /dge 'dun srung 'di rab taḥ / /a nu gaḥshā ri pu tra su pa ri tsarya pa ro bha bta/ /ta taḥpra zwa dga' ste/ /shā ri'i bu yi rjes 'brang zhing / /rim gro yongs su skyong bar gyur/ /de nas de yis ⑪rab 95—830

dzi taste na sa mu dā tsā ra shikṣa yā/ /a dhyā pi taḥpa ni khi lo dhasthā ga ma tsa tuṣṭa phyung ste/ / kun spyod dang ni bslab pa la/ /①chos kyi lung ni bzhi po dag /ma lus de yis kha ton ②yi—/ /ta taḥka dā tsidma ṇi rdzu mant+ra shā tu lya dzadma rmā/ /sha taiḥpañtsa bye sbyangs—/ /de nas nam zhig tshong ①pa ni/ /mtshungs par skyes pa'i grogs po dag /brgya phrag lnga yis chu ram̐ sgo dhi ga ma ṣpe na sa hā nī taḥ/ /ā ru ro ha pra ba ha rde te gter la④/ /lhan cig 'gro bar gsol btab ste/ /de dag dge ba sems ⑤byed pas/ /'jigs pa ྾ ku sha la tsinta kaḥ/ /bha ye ṣṭa byerya dza na rna kṛ hi tā shā sa rgo gu roḥ/ /a dag la brtan bskyed pa/ /bla ma'i bka' ni bzung byas te/ /gzings la rab tu zhon par gyur/ /de thābhi ma bye saṃ rudhe tasmind+ra ba ha ṇi kṣa rde/ /saṃ kradhe ba ṇi rdzu sāze nas gzings de chu gter byi/ /dbus su yang dag 'gags gyur cing ⑪/ /tshong pa'i don mthun cho nge prortso tsā ra ba tso bha saḥ/ /ya di pra ba he ṇa snga gya mustirluṣṭha ka midzre dag /sgrogs tshe chu las tshig drag pa/ /gal te gzings 'di khyed cag rnams/ /grol bar 'dod pa de tā—/ /ta de ṣakṣi pya tī kṣi pre sa li le saṃ gha ra kṣi tāḥ/ /khru tī ta ta pā ṇa sande lta na/ /dge 'dun srung 'di chu la ni/ /myur ba nyid du 'phang bar mdzod/ /de thos srog la the tshom tshe//te te ṣā me kā bha badma nyiḥ/ /ba re ni dha na me bstu na tu sā dhu su z-idma dhaḥ/ /de dag rnams la blo 'di byung / /shi bar gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /dam pa'i grogs po gsod pa min/ /bi ṣa me saṃ sha ye te ྾ kṛ pa yā rakṣa khorya taḥ/ /bi kṣe pa swa ya mānd+ra rna de dag mi bzad the tshom la/ /brtse ba yis ni bsrung brtson pas/ /chu gter 'khrugs ⑦par dge 'dun kṣu ddhā sgo saṃ gha rakṣi ta ཿ / / sa nā ga ni la yo pā ptasta tra nā gi srung / /rang gis ⑧bdag nyid rab tu 'phangs/ /de nas klu yi gnas su phyin/ /de ⑨ ni klu yis 4 raṭwā nī taḥ/ /bee dhwa ya pūza saṃ buddhā dṛ dha tse tyā pi banda rna/ /gsol btab des/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la/ /mngon par phyag 'tshal mngon ⑪bsgrubs nas//95—831

dṛṣṭa shā sa ra da sparsha bi ṣā rde tsinta ya kṛ shaḥ/ /su tsa ri tā rnyi ma bsam pas phra des mthong dbugs dang / /so reg dug ldan de dag la/ /legs pa'i spyod tshul mngon tārnye ྾ bi da dha dhand+ra de sha dzā/ /tī bra ra ti sa mujusnaḥswa de sha ga 'dod pa'i/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa mdzad/ /chags bral drag po'i yid 'byung gis/ /rang yul ma norlu kaḥ/ /sa nā girba ṇi dzā me ba n+yastaḥpra ba ha ṇi kṣa zlata/ /'gro bar 'dod pa de/ /klu rnams kyis ①ni tshong pa yi/ /gzings la skad cig nyid kyis bkod/ /te pra j-iṭwāḥs mā sā rya pa ra lo kā di bā ga tai/ /pra tyā bṛtta pra ba 'jig rten gzhan las 'ongs pa bzhin/ /de dag dga' ba yang dag thob/ /gzings ni duphyir la log ha ṇa st+ri ram̐ pā pudzre ho da dheḥ/ /swa kṛ hoṅkaṇḍa ya te hūṃ bra dza tā ma ti gyur nas/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs su phyin/ /rang gi 'dod pas de dag rnams/ /shin tu rings par satwa ram̐/ /ni dā luzlu lu kā kyu le bi smṛ taḥsaṃ gha rakṣi taḥ/ /ga te sāze bgrod pa yis/ /dge 'dun srung ni bye ma yi/ /ngogs su gnyid du song ba brjed/ /de nas don mthun pra burnyo tha pra bhā te bi dza nā di shaḥ/ /pa shya rna su z-iju ra hi taḥpra da dzñā song tshe sad/ /snga dro mi med phyogs rnams su/ /lta zhing grogs dang bral ba yis⑦ / /chags bral blo can sa bi ṣaṇḍa dhīḥ/ /a ho dṛṭwābya naṇḍabya gandharbha na ga ro pa māḥ/ /bi mo ha des krubasams pa/ /kye ma mthong dang nyams pa can/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu yi/ /snying sdug gnyen yarnyi bi ra he su z-izentu sa mā ga maḥ/ /ta ru ṇa sa pa rodmā lā lo dang 'grogs pa dag /bral na rnam par rmongs par byed/ /sa khar ⑤nya gzhon 'phar ba lta bur rab tu khāḥpa ra pri ya saṃ ga mā bi da dha ti dṛ ddhā mā sgo mi jusbi ra sbi ti brnya g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug grogs/ /mi rnams dag la brdzun 'ugyi yid brtan brtan stipar gnas pa'i 'ching ba bhā / /swa dza na ra hi taḥshe te gasgo ta dzee ba bi pa rya te ba tsa ra ti sgrub(she—/ /rang gi skye bo dang bral mal du nyal zhing de bzhin nges par mchisahuste/ /kun tu chags pa dge 95—832

ste bha ku ḍā pha lā kā rān mārdza nī ratshu pambi bhān/ /kha ṭwā byubee kha la rtsig pa 'bras bu'i rnam pa can/ /phyags ma thag par mtshungs pa dang / /khri sogs gtun ni drag ①pa sbu dzee stantu she ṣadhī dhwa ga tān/ /sa tā dma twa ba tā ma gruḥsupta tse dang / /rnal ①ma'i lhag dang rnam gnyis gyur/ /nyal zhing sems ldan bde med pa'i/ /sems can tya n+ya niḥsu khan/ /sa tādzreṭī bra dzadngha ba pu bye pā pa ta po ba āoṃ/ /snying stobs mchog gis mthong / /de mthong 'gro ba de nyid kyis/ /dka' thub drag ldan thub pa ni/ /se ba hūṃ tī bra ta pa sī mu mbi rghaṃ pañtsa bhi sha taiḥ/ /te tai dru rātpa mā lo brgya phrag lnga yis ①bsten pa yis/ /bsod nams dka' thub nags tshal thob/ /de dag gis de ring po kya tsakri re nibyu yo mi thaḥ/ /a gya dā ta bya masmra bhirna sthā āoṃ na pri nas—/ /mthong nas phan tshun nges par byas/ /bdag cag rnams kyi 'di la gnas/ /'di dhisbyin snyan yasba tsaḥ/ /shākya shi 6 na saṃ ghā stso ba hu dzalpaḥswa bhā ba taḥ/ /i ti saṃ par smra mi bya/ /shākya'i slob ma rang bzhin gyis/ /mang brjod phebs par smra bye ⑤min/ /zhes pa'i gros bi da mā thā ya te tasbrasmo na ni pu ram̐/ /tai ra daṭwā shra yasta tra sa ba sthā ma ni rab bsgrubs ⑥te/ /thub pa de dag rab tu gnas/ /de dag gis der gnas ma byin/ /de yi nyin di na kṣa ye/ /badha kau sherbi naṣṭa sha baṃ ka dzee ri ba ṣatpa daḥ/ /mu mo zad tshe 'khyam④/ /'dam skyes mdzod ni bsdams pa yis/ /rkang drug re ba nyams pa bzhin/ /thub ni re kastu bā sā ya ta suḥshu tyā ku ṭi da do/ /twa yā mo na ba twa rā tre sthā ta pa gcig gis ⑧de la ni/ /mtshan mo khyed ni mi smra bar/ /gnas par bya zhes rab brjod nas/ /zhag bya mi ti saṃ bi dā/ /ta tra te ra kṛ tā ti bye taikṣa pākṣa ya kā ri rde/ /sar bste gnas stong pa byin/ /de dag gis der mgron ma byas/ /mtshan mo 'phen byed nyal gyur pa/ /spru tse sha yā na ma bye tya sha ṣpe rā shra ma de ba tā/ /utrīṣṭha sā bho sau dza tyāta de la bste gnas lha mo ni/ /mngon du phyogs te dal gyis smras/ /dam pa legs pa'i tshul gyis bzhengs/ /95—835

ku ru me dhand+ra de sha ram̐/ /sadha1 bā di āoṃ lo ke pra tha mo byu se me me chos ni rab tu bstan par mdzod/ /'jig rten dam chos smra rnams kyi/ /dang por khyod ni bdag gis taḥ / /i tyabee tasta yā mo bhā sa tsā pā ha la ghu swa naḥ/ /mā tambiṣka bkur—/ /zhes des gsol btab thub pa des/ / gcom bskyungs ①de la rab smras pa/ /ma ma khyod sa nā thā yi ba tambi ke nā pi nind+ra tā/ /a smidme mu ni nā mo rgo sa ma ya dang kho bo yisadzu/ /nges par 'byin pa ci slad sprul④/ /gnas der sdebadag la thub pa yis/ /mi smra ba saṃ shra ye z-i taḥ/ /nishī sa ya ti mā me ṣa tabye ti kra ma kā ri rṇa/ /i yi dam tshig byas/ /de las 'das par gyur na bdag /nges par 'di yis ⑤'byin par 'gyur/ /zhes ti bru bā ṇaḥpra ṇa yādma hu shaḥs ta yābee taḥ/ /drwahma ṇa nu ma tantand+ra smra ⑦de la gus pa yis/ /de yis memang du gsol btab ste/ /bram zes ⑤rjes su gnang ba yis(kye/ /muhūṃ sa mu ba tsakra me/ /ṣpe ba bra tā ni ta nu sho ṣa ṇa santa tā ni no pā ba nā chos ni smra bar yang dag brtsams/ /rgyun du lus ni gdung bar byed pa nges pa ṅghabartul zhugs min/ /skye ni bi dza nā ni ta po ba nā ni/ /sum̐ sā dza ṭā dzi na pa ri gra ha bo med pa'i dka' thub nags tshal dag par byed pa min/ /bzung ⑪dka'i ral pa pags pa yongs 'dzin du rga hā rde tse ta ཿ smṛ hā pa ri tsi tai pa ri sho ṣa ya rnyi / /skyes bu rnams dag gis⑫/ /chags pas yongs 'dris spyosems ni yongs su gdung bar byed pa yin/ /e te ba ṣpe pha la khyu dzaḥ ka pa yo na yulnga bṛkṣu ཿ sa balka la pa khā nags su 'bras bu za ba'i spre'u 'di dag rnams dang ni/ /ljon pa 'dab ma shing shun dang bcas ral sa dza ṭā dzha ṭābya/ /antardza la pra ṇa yi naste ma yabya tīze mi byā ta tshogs ldan pa dang / /'jug ngogs chu nang du chags nya mid rnams kyang 'gro rmyeb min/ /rab zhi spangs paḥpa ri ka raḥpra sha mordzu tā dzā/ /na bhū ti dha ba le ri bheḥs ba pa rnams kyis spyodaka' thub yo byad brdzun ⑪pa nyid/ /thal bas dkar ba'i glang po dang ni rlung dag 'thung 95—836

na pā yi bheḥsanda gadzee na bya sa ni dhimṛ giḥpa la la kaiḥsba lbo shā yi bheḥ/ /ba'i sbrul rnams dang / /nags na zhen pa'i ri dwags rnams dang thang la nyal ba'i gzungs mo dang / /pha la pra ṇa yi bheḥshu ṣpe ra pi ni rasbra rirlubha kai ra mukta bi ṣa ya sbri he ra bhe 'bras bu za ba'i ṣpe tso dang ni gos med rngon pa rnams kyis kyang / /yul la chags pa ma btang rab tu zhi ba ga tā pra shārnyiḥkwa tsita/ /i ti taṅku tsa na khru tā mu na yo pi sa bisma yāḥ/ /ta 'ga' yang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos te/ /ya mtshan bcas pa'i thub rnams kyang / /de mā dā rokhru khā sabye pa ri pā yaryā ba sbi re/ /so tsinta ya di yo parṣata la gus pas mngon phyogs te/ /kun gyis yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /de yi bsam ①pa 'khor bar ni②//saṃ sā ra pa ri btī nī/ /mi bye ba bra ta saddhā pa santa ta kle sha yongs su bskor ba'i ①tshogs pa 'di/ /nges par brdzun ④gyi brtul zhugs kyis/ /rgyun du nyon mongs mashu te/ /dṛ rja ma bi byā saṃ sthā rā bi dzñā rna nā ma rū pa tā/ /ṣa ḍā gdung ba spyod/ /mi rnams ma rig 'du byed dang / /rnam shes ming dang gzugs dang ni/ /skye mched ya ta na saṃ spasgo bee da nā pa treṇḍa yā/ /u pā dā lda bha bo dzā tidza rā ma drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba sred pa dang bcas dang / /len pa srid pa skye ba dang / /rga shi yis ni ra ṇa durga teḥ/ /e ṣa duḥkha ma yaḥskandhaḥsu ma hāza ri badhe te/ /a ngan par 'gro/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin phung po 'di/ /shin tu che bar yongs su 'phel/ /rab zhi pi byā di kra me ṇi ba pra shāddhā nāsma nī rde/ /e kai ka su ni ro dhe na la mkhas pa rnams kyis ⑤ni/ /ma rig la sogs rim pa yis/ /re re 'gags par gyur pa na/ /gzhan yi yā ti ba raspa raḥ/ /i ti nishyi tya ma na sā pa te ྾ tabee sgo pu raḥ/ /dang dhigazhan ni 'gag ④par 'gyur/ /de ltar yid kyis nges bya ④des/ /de dag mdun du de lta yis⑫//sad dhand+ra de sha rmā kṛ tā pu nastu ni da ma bra bīta/ /te ṣā ma sho rtsu dam pa'i chos ni bstan byas nas/ /slar yang de dag la 'di smras/ /gang dag yid ni byams pas ⑪ 95—837

dzā tsakre sadhend+ra de sha dzā/ /te tattha sā dā saṃ dzā ta bi ma la pra sha mo da yā/ /sattha dam pa'i chos ni bstan par mdzad/ /dri med rab zhi rgyas pa ni/ /de yi drin las skyes de dag /nyon kle sha bra hā rja rta pū bye twa mā ya yuḥ / / te bra dzā te 6 shāstu mongs thams cad gtong 'os pa'i/ /mchod 'os dgra bcom nyid du gyur/ /de dag song tshe ston pa la/ /ra ma thratstshahūṃ gha rakṣi taḥ/ /bha ga baṃ ste bha ku ṭwā di rū pā putpa pha dge 'dun srungs kyis ①rab dris pa/ /bcom ldan ka ba rtsig sogs gzugasadu/ /me tog 'bras bu lo pa māḥ/ /rā dzā bhāstanta she ṣābya dṛṣṭaḥ sa tā ma yā pa thi/ /mtshungs pa dang / /thag mtshungs snal ma'i lhag ma yang / /sems can bdag gis ①lam du mthong / /taste ྾ kand+ra ṇaḥka mya pha lo mo hā nu brnyi rmā/ /i ti ta nā da rābyeṣṭaḥrmongs pas bcings pa de dag ni/ /de dag las ni ci yi 'bras/ /zhes pa de yis ④gus pas dris/ /sattha dzhasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ba byu buḥkā byu pā khya su te shāstuḥshā ba kaḥpu rāḥ/ /de la kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa/ /de dag sngon tshe ston ⑤pa ni/ /'od srungs zhes pa'i nyan thos gyur/ /ste bha ku bye 6 taiḥbyeṣṭha pra kṣibye saṃ gha mandi re/ /ku ḍā ni saṃ gha z-ikṣe dge 'dun khang pa'i ka ba dang / /rtsig pa la des ngar snabs ⑥'phangs/ /gzhan gyis dge 'dun ljon bhyaḥpha la puṣṭha ṇi ṭī pa reḥ/ /bhigru sgo dza na pā ṣpe 6 dre ṣāji rgyu kṛ pa las⑦/ /me tog dang ni 'bras bu blangs/ /dge 'dun zas dang btung ba la/ /gzhan gyi sdang bas twophopa reḥ/ /saṃ gha khā bha pa rā bṛttabyekhyu shā ma pa reḥkṛ tā/ /te gegs ⑧dag byas/ /gzhan gyis ⑨dge 'dun rnyed pa ni ⑩/ /dge slong dag la yongs bsgyur byas/ /de taṅkand+ra bi pā ke na tatta dā kā ra tī ga tāḥ/ /i tyā khyu tai bha ga ba tā khru tā dag las kyi rnam byun des/ /rnam pa de de nyid du gyur/ /bcom ldan gyis bshad de thos nas/ /de so bhūtpa bi sma yaḥ / / pā pta ma rta tpa rda dṛ ṣṭa bhekṣa ba ཿ saṃ gha rakṣi ni ya mtshan ldan par gyur/ /dgra bcom gnas thob dge 'dun srungs⑪/ /dge slong rnams kyis mthong 95—839

tai / /dzi rgo taṅkand+ra pa prasgoḥdṛṣṭaḥs tsa dza gā da tān/ /e ka pra bra dzi taḥnas ni/ /las de rgyal ba dag la dris/ /dris pa des kyang de la gsungs/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa shāstuḥkā byu pā khya su shā sa rna/ /pu rā bi hā ra saṃ gha gya tse ya sre tya ka ro bha yi—/ /bstan pa la ni rab byung 7 'di/ /dge 'dun gtsug lag khang du sngon/ /zhal ta byed pa nyid du bta / /pañtsa ba gya sha tā tyā saṃ saṃ ga tā ni bi hā ri rde/ /pra ṇi dhwa rna sha rī dzā gyur—/ /gtsug lag khang na gnas pa ni/ /lnga brgya de yi grogs por gyur/ /lus kyi mjug tu smon lam te ku sha lā ya tsa kā ra saḥ/ /te nāsmiñdzadma ni sthā pa darta hūṃ saṃ gha rakṣi no—/ /dge ba'i slad du de yis (nyabyas/ /skye ba 'di la dge 'dun srungs/ /de yis shedagra bcom nyid taḥ / / ta de tahūṃ ga tai bā gya mu mbi rmā sha ta pañtsa shaṃ/ /rasteḥshu thob cing / /de dag thub pa lnga brgya po/ /'di dag de dang (dnghayang dag 'grogs/ /lus can rnams ni kli ra se ta sa bā le rde hi rmā kand+ra sru treshyi tā kā re bha ba ti ba hu shaḥpā dmar dang dkar dang gnag dang phra ⑤ba'i las skud kyi⑥/ /rnam par bkra ba skye ba'i gos kyis lan ④mang bṛ tai dzadma bant+ra/ /tyaste tyarmiñdza ṭha ra bhu dza ga smra na nisgo ka yusgyu tamee ba bye dag tu g.yogs par gyur/ /lag 'gro rgan po lkogs dman 'dor ba'i rigs zhikyepa dag gis de btang nas/ /bee sha ti ku sha lī yanda shi tai na tsoṣṭi / / i ti ta gya ni sha mya grangs med tsha ba med pa'i 'ba' zhig gang der dge ba ldan pa 'jug /ces pa de bzhin gshegs pa des sā da rāḥka thi tai te na ta thā ga te na/ /pra shaṃ shaṃ su ra na n+ya mā na gsungs pa/ /thos nas dge slong de dag gus bcas pas/ /dam pa'i sems ldan de yi spyod pa dag /pātso ri tai sañtsi ta su bhekṣa baḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yo bo dhi sa yid ni gzhan dang bral bas rab tu bsngags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems tā bā dā na kalpa la tā yī saṃ gha ra kṣi tā ba dā dzwa sabee ṣakhyu ta maḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dge 'dun srungs kyi 9)rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 95—840

palla waḥ// //'dab ste drug cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //ka nd+ra ṇi pū ttha bi hi tsā na hi tā ni tā ni kṛ ṭwā ni sgo phan dang mi phan las rnams dag ni ⑨sngon du bsgrubs gyur pa/ /longs spyod dus kyis shin tu ga sa ma yir ti bā hi tā ni/ /gatstshadhi rdza tu ṣa la sadku su mo pa mā ni 'das shing nyams par gyur pa dag /rab rgyas me tog mtshungs pas til rnams dag la bsgo ba bzhin/ /lbo 8 ti le ṣṭa na ni dhwa ya ni dzā pi saṃ/ /badzā sa ni badzra sa mā bye srog chags rnams la rang gi bag chags bzhag nas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i gdan la sangs rgyas bdud bant+ra da thobye te budha su dhwa ma yu kheḥ/ /sadzadma roḥṣaṭa bhe ra bāpta dībee rtsi'i zer/ /rdo rje ñtshating 'dzin bcings las bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /rab 'bar ye shes rgyas pa lo drug gis/ /dzñā no da ye byekhyi ga ṇista mū tsuḥ/ /twabyi yo gāldi saṃ ta bhā bha ga bādku kṣi ko thob pa de la dge slong tshogs kyis zhus/ /khyod bral me yis gdungs gyur pa/ /grags 'dzin ma yi dku da re/ /ni yī āoṃ su pra bhe garghaṃ ṣarnyi zladzeerya sho dha rā/ / ta smind+ra nang du/ /mngal ni chags par lngagyur pa dag /bcom ldan lo drug dag nas btsas/ /khyod mtshungs hu la kā bhi khye dzā te twatpa dṛ she shi sho/ /dzā tāḥku to ya mi tyā ha rā dzā shurnyo da byis pa sgra gcan 'dzin/ /zhes pa de ni skyes pa na/ /rgyal po zas gtsang khros pa yis/ /'di ni ga las naḥkru dhwa/ /sā ba bye ba su ddhā ni tā shā se ṣpe na ma tī pa teḥ/ /sa ddhā skyes ④zhes smras/ /sa bdag bka' yis de nyid ni/ /gsod pa'i sar ni khrid gyur pa/ /spring yig gis ta bai ba le khe na pra bhā be ṣpe ba rakṣi ta/ /tādhyā yā ma shi lorde ge ni bzhin khyod kyi dzumathus/ /dag pa de ni rab tu bsrungs/ /de nas khyod byon rdo nang du/ /de yis byis kṣibhe tha ta yā shi sho/ /tatpa tya yā tsa ṣpe nā sau sa li le 6 plu bi shi kā/ /sā dhī pa nges par bkod/ /de yis ⑥bden pa brjod pa yis/ /rdo ba de ni chu la ldengs⑦/ /mi g.yem dag 95—841

bra ta pa ri tā yāsta suḥshwa su ra ko pa dzaḥ/ /duḥkhā ba mā na santa paḥs pā pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de la gyos po khro ba skyes/ /sdug bsngal smad cing gdung ba de/ /las ni ci yi kāṅka gya kand+ra rjaḥ/ /i ti bhi gru ba tsaḥshu tā bha ga bānd+ra ti bhā ṣa ta/ /thra rnam smin lags/ /zhes pa dge slong tshig thos nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsungs pa/ /las ya tī ka1 shā ye na duḥkhaṃ le bhe ya sho dha rā/ /kambi bye na ga re rā dzā ni gang gis grags 'dzin ma/ /sdug bsngal thob pa rab tu nyon/ /grong khyer kambi ①la dag tu/ /sa yi brahma dattaḥpu rā bha bta/ /khyu ta lā khaṇḍa laḥshrī mādku mi nī ku su mā yu dhaḥ/ /brgya byin dpal dang ldan/ /'dod ldan ma yis ②me tog mtshon/ /rgyal po tshangs byin sngon byung gyur/ /khaṅga dhwa rā dha re ṇa rdo bhu dze na dzi na tiḥpa re/ /pra dza dzā la pra tā g.yul du ral gri'i rgyun 'dzin pa'i/ /dpung pa yis ni rab babyed pas/ /gang gi ①gzi byin me dag ni/ /pāldirya snga rā nyi ta maḥpra daḥ/ /sa kā da tsidma na dha dzñā mṛ ga ya ke li kau tu tī/ /dgra la mun pa rab ster 'bar/ /nam zhig nags su gzhu 'dzin des/ /sngon gyi rtse dga'i dge mtshan la//bi bee shā dru rā mi kā tī kṛ to shwe nā ti ram̐ ha sā/ /ta sgyurgha ki ra ṇi ta rnyi nā shin tu mgyogs 'gro rta yis ni/ /gcig pur byas te ring du zhugs/ /de yi 'gram par rngul gyi thigs/ /ka po le swe da binda baḥ/ /tsa kruḥkuṇḍa li mughā rmā pra ti bisba bi ḍasba nyi ma'i zer gyis rab bskyed pas/ /rna rgyan mu tig rnams kyi ④ni/ /gzugs brnyan ⑤dag dang mtshungs āoṃ—/ /mānā ga te na sa mu hutshu ga shā pa ke na ra myu ba lo ka na ku tū par byas/ /lam nas 'ong ba'i ri dwags phrug ⑥gu dge mtshan g.yo med kyis/ /yang dang yang du de la ha la ni: le na / / hā rā gra ratna sha ka la pra ti bi spa te na dka' ④bar kun tu lta byed cing / /do shal rtse yi rin cen ①dum bur gzugs brnyan snang byed pas/ /pā dā1 rde sa dṛ sha rū pa pa rda su ddhā shoḥ/ /ta myu nu rakṣa ha ri bhā skad cig bdud rtsi'i zer gyi gzugs kyi gnas dang mtshungs par gyur⑨/ /rjes su chags ldan ri dwags mo 95—842

ka ri rṇa pra sakta byā mbi li tīkṣa ṇa mṛ ga dī pa se bya mā na/ /dza dang glang mo la chags pa'i/ /mig zum ri dwags gnyis 'thung rnams kyis ⑨rab tu bsten labya ba/ /ri hphuḥshra māmbu sha ba rī ka ba rī ka khā ba putpa smṛ shaḥsu ra bhi matta ba nānta bā khrod ma yi skra tshogs me tog la reg dri bzang can/ /stsos pa'i nags mtha'i rlung gis ⑦de yi ngal ba'i chu tāḥ—/ /ambi nda ba sa re ka bye shārnyi lya su ma hā mu ṣpeḥ/ /pra sru ba pā na saṃ dag phrogs/ /skabs der thub pa chen po ni/ /shī ṭi bee yi gzhon nu ma/ /gci ba 'thungs pas mngal pāpta garbha mu kha mṛ gī su hūṃ/ /sa li lā ha ra shā yā tī khā ba ju mṛ ta bā hi rde/ /gyi sgo/ /thob pa ri dwags bu ④mo ni/ /mdzes sdug bdud rtsi'i rgyun ldan zhing / /chu ni len du 'ong ba dag/sa da dasgye shra ma sa rirtswa re ta ra la lo tsa rmā/ /ka ma dzee ka ma khā rā mig rab g.yo ldan bste gnas kyibu/ /chu klung ngogs su de yis ⑥mthong / /dpal mo padma'i dga' tshal la/ /ma spru hye ba ka ma khā ka ra/ /thra dzādzñā tsa ra ṇa tyā sa dzā taiḥka ma la maṇḍa li/ /dga' bas bzhin du padmo'i tshal/ /rkang bkod las skyes padmo yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag gis spro byed cing / /a byuza ko tu ka ba tī ṭī dṛṭī ma nu dze shwa raḥ/ /a ma ra twa mi ba pā ba sngon med dge mtshan ldan pa de/ /mthong nas mi yi dbang po ni/ /skad cig mig ni 'dzum bral bas /nimbi mo ṣe kṣa ṇaḥkṣa khaṃ/ /so cib ya da ho kā pi kārnye yo mu ni ka n+ya kā/ /ha lha nyid thob pa bzhin du gyur/ /des bsams kye ma mdzes ma 'di/ /thub pa'i bu mo su zhig yin/ /ri ri bhā ba ha ra hye ba snisna musnyembi lo ki taiḥ/ /se ba simbi ni bee se dwags mo bzhin rab mdzes shing / /yid 'ong lta bas yid 'phrog byed/ /padma can ni rkang pa nyed pa'i tā ka ma li nī sa byā ha ṣpe bā da yoḥsgortend+rasgo da na su lagla li khi tai g.yog gi mtshams la nges par bskos gyur cing / /zla ba nya ba ⑦bzhin gyi mtshan ma bris pa'i 1'bangs dā sa twa mā pā di taḥ/ /mā rasnye swa ya me ba bi shwa bi dza ye byu bi bhra maiḥsu khyu bā nyid rab tu thob par byas/ /byun legs smin ma'i rnam 'phrul rang nyid kun las rgyal bar rab tu rtsom ⑨95—843

kā saṃ nind+ra la kārmu kā ni ta la tā ṣpe rgu rgya mā lasba te/ /ki ra ti ba pa na/ /nges par 'dod pa'i gzhu yi 'khri shing dri med yon tan med pa nyid la brten/ /'di yi bzhin da na bi sba harṣa pe yu ṣa ma snga la li ta si ta ma yu kholle kha re khā kra gyi dkyil 'khor yid 'ong bsel zer can dag gis/ /bkod pa'i khye ri mo'i rim pas dga' ba'i bdud rtsi me ṇa/ /i ya ma ti sha ya mi ṭī ṣpe tra yoḥsho tra spru le na ba ku ba la rgyas par byed/ /mig dag rna ba'i rtsa bar shin tu byams par gyur pa 'di/ /utpal gsar pa rol pa'i ya lī lotrī sa kārnyiḥta no ti/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya pa sha ṣpe ra ba ru khya tu re ga rgyan gyis trīmadzes pa rab tu 'dzin/ /zhes bsams de yis dal gyis ni/ /rta las yang dag babs byas māta—/ /tā mu bā tsa sa ma bye te kau tu kā lo ka norlu khro/ /asthā na su te—/ /dge mtshan blta ①la mngon phyogs ma/ /de la btud de rab smras pa/ /legs byas rgya che mi kṛ to dā ra su re kaṇḍa gra ho tsi tā/ /bi dza ye ma ṇi mā le ba kā two ku ba dman pa'i/ /lha yi mgrin par gzung 'os ma/ /rnam rgyal ④ nor bu'i 'phreng ⑤ ba bzhin/ /utpal mig la ye kṣa ṣpe/ /a ya mā nanda sasdo ha sundi dī la li tā ta ba/ /na ka su can khyod ni su/ /khyod kyi mdzes sdug dga' ba yi/ /tshogs ni rgyas par byed pa 'dis/ /su yi yid ni ku ru te kārnyiḥkau tu kā kuñtsi tasma naḥ/ /byu nyi ka gya twa yā bye shuḥsha rartsond+ra dge mtshan la/ /'gugs pa nyid du byed ma yin/ /su yi rigs brgyud 67mu tig gisgo7/ /'khri shing rab ra dā ta yā/ /kā ma muspyo la bhe baṃ shāḥsaṃ bha be na bi byu ṣi taḥ/ /tu 'thob pa na7dag /ston zla ltar dkar she1khyod 'khrungs pas/ /rnam par brgyan pa rab tu smras/ /i ti te nā da rādṛṭwā dzñā tā lta mu ni pu tra shaṃ/ /a dzñā ta kā ma bṛṭwā pi sā zhes pa de yis ⑫gus pas dris/ /de ni thub pa'i bur shes nas/ /'dod pa'i spyod tshul mi shes kyang / /bye khā ṣā dza gā da pā/ /a ho padmā ba tī na ma pā do ryatpadma mā mngon par 'dod ldan de yis kṛnyasmras/ /rkang pas pad 'phreng spyorab bskyed pas/ /bdag ni padma can 95byed844

li kā/ /mṛ gi gabha sa mubyu ta shāṇḍi lya mya su tā mu ṣpeḥ/ /swā ga tai te mu ni zhes bya/ /ri dwags mngal skyes thub pa ni/ /shaṃ ṭi bee yi bu mo yin/ /thub pa'i sras khyod legs par su ta thra yo me ta ba darsha āoṃ/ /ma no ha ra ta re tsi tra babo lo ki mi 'ongs①—/ /bdag ni khyod mthong rab tu dga'/ /shin tu yid 'phrog bkra ba yi/ /shing shun brtul rda bra tai/ /bi bhū ṣi to yasmra yu riḥshi khaṇḍi ri ba pañtsa bhiḥ/ /su zhugs 'di ni ci/ /rma bya'i gtsug phud lnga dag gis/ /brgyan pa bzhin du khyod kyi ni/ /ral ( 7 tshogs rādzñā tīṇḍi ku su maḥsho bha te te dza ṭā bha baḥ/ /i ya mā ma la kabhyo la 'di dag lha las kyang / /me tog dag gis 1rgyas par mdzes/ /skyu ru ra ni rags pa yi/ /'bras bu kha pā le ya pha la ko dzwa laḥ/ /dīspyo kṣa sru tra mā la bhi kabye ba hu gu khaṃ ta ba/ /ā ba rab 'bar 'dra/ /bgrang 'phring 'phreng ④ba ring po yis/ /khyod kyi mgrin la yon tan mang / /'od sru tra ya ti te pā ṇibye treḥku sha pa bi tra kaiḥ/ /ku ṭi me bee rku daṇḍi smin ma'i dbyug pa 'khyog po 'dir⑤/ /yal 'dab gsar pa'i 'phreng ‘༅ ba la/ /khyod kyi lag pa ku sha yis⑦/ /bya la pabee ba mā li rmā/ /ra ma ddhā yā bra ta ba taḥka bye tsā kwa ta bā shra maḥ/ /dag byed bkra bas kun tu spras/ /legs pa bdag yid ri dwags nisgo 7/ /gang du ngal ni bses gyur pa⑨/ /ma no mṛ gā dzi na shārnyi me ti me ya tra sā dhu tsa/ /i nyi musna ba tsaḥdaga' bar rma bya'i ⑩ brtul zhugs can/ /khrod gnas gang rke7na yod pa sgos/ /zhes pa bzhin bzang ma swā du su ṅgādzra ba su dhwa dhi paḥ/ /ā sā rya da twa pā thre ya mo da ko ta yi tshig /snyan zhing bdud rtsis brlan pa dag /sa bdag gis myang lam brgyags pa/—rtakyi/ /la du byin ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ṣpe bāsmind+ra tsi tai su zla darbha su ṭī ra yā tsi te/ /su ku nas de la smras/ /byun legs khyod lus shin tu gzhon/ /shing dang rtswa ni bskams lku gyur cing / /ku sha'i mā ram̐ ta ba ba puḥ shu 6tta ru tri ṇi ba ṣpe / / i ta ཿ saṃ sgo ga yo khab kyi tshogs gtams pa'i/ /nags tshal 'dir ni 'os pa min/ /'di nas ha cang mi ring na/ /95—845

gyu shrīṭwā ti dru re ma mā shra maḥ/ /e baṃ bi dhwa bi shī ya rnye yasmi4 la pa ram̐ bdag gnas longs spyod 'os pa'i dpal/ /gang na rnam pa ① 'di lta yis②/ /'bras bu brgyud pa ①rgyas pa rāḥ/ /ni bā saḥkri ya tsā ta tra tsarya tī mādma baṃ ta paḥ/ /saṃ sgo ga pa yod/ /der ni rnam par gnas par mdzod/ /yid srubs ④dag gi dka' thub mdzod/ /skye bo mchog pa ri tsaryā su dza no yo ba ni yu bye tsā/ /asgyu྾ ga ba tai ga tai ga ta ni longs spyod kyis⑤/ /rim gro dag la rnam par sbyor/ /mig gsum rab tu khros tshe me yi lam du phye ma ba tast+yakṣa pra ko pa kṣa ṇi dzre bo sgyu da na me ta de ba bi bye nā ma bye na baṃ nismi tai/ /leb nyid gyur ldan pa/ /srog ni rab tu rdzogs pa ⑥byed pos gsar du sprul pa 'di nyid yin bsam ste⑦/ /kāntadhe ba su dhwa su dhwa ka ra ka lā ko shā nu kā rasba purlu ba sgyu di sa khrod kyi lus mdzes nor 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zer gyi cha yi mdzod kyi rjes mthun pa/ /yid las ⑧skyes pa'i hi i me ba a sa mā nā n+yadma no dzadma naḥ/ /i ti shu tā tu bikta su mdzes sdug mtshungs med dang po de ni 'di nyid gzhan ma yin/ /zhes pa sa bdag mdzangs ④pa'i tshig /muddhā bhū mi pa tettha tsaḥ/ /tsand+ra ba dā ta mā swā rya mo da kanta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bzhin bzang ma yis ⑪ thos nas ni/ /la du zla ba ltar dkar ba/ /myangs nas de la rab smras pa/ /tādhra tā nu bṛ tai bā haṃ ni ba pā mi ta ba shra me/ /pra tīkṣa swa kṣa khaṃ khyod kyi brtul zhugs rjes spyod pa⑩/ /khyod kyi gnas su bdag gnas bgyi/ /ji srid song nas bla ma'i yā baṅga tā dzñā maza ye gu roḥ/ /i ti sambi da ā sā dhwa ya sa mi tā ni dzā bka'—/ /don du gnyer la skad cig sdod/ /ces pa'i gros ni bsgrubs nas de/ /rang gi bste gnas shā oṃ/ /na bā bhi khā ṣa bi ba shā swa padhī mu ni ma bhya dhwata/ /dṛṣṭa dag tu song / /mngon 'dod gsar pas dbang bral bas/ /shugs ni 'byin cing thub la smras/ /yab stuta ba ṣpe ko pi ma yā mu ni ku mā ra kaḥ/ /pra sand+ra sa li la tshwa lags bdag gis ⑫thub pa yi/ /gzhon nu su zhig nags su mthong / /shing shun mtha' ni bkra ba dag /95—846

yā tsi tra paryanta balka laḥ/ /di bya ta dā shra mosgru tai pha la mā swā di tasma rab tu dang ba'i chu ltar mdzes/ /gang gi 'bras bu gzhan gyi tshogs/ /bsdom ①par yongs su rtog rjobyed yā / /ye nā n+ya pha la saṃ bha ro ni ya maḥpa ri kadzee taḥ/ /gasgo pa—/ /de yi gnas su rab 'khrungs pa'i/ /'bras bu mchog ni bdag gis ①stsong / /de yi dka' thub mi twa da nu dzñā tā kārnya ta gya ta po ba dzwa/ /tadmo dza ṣpe pra sakta me nā n+ya tra ra nags metshal du/ /khyod kyi rjes gnang ⑤bdag mchi'o/ /de yi gzhung bzang la chags pa'i/ /bdag blo ma te ma tiḥ/ /i ti tadma tsa dzwa khru tā bismi taḥsma ra sru tsa rka/ /tā gzhan na ⑥dga' ba med/ /ces pa de tshig 'dod pa ni/ /gsal byed thos nas ya mtshan zhing / /lang mu bā tsa mu nirmuddhā yo ba nodmā da shaṃ ki taḥ/ /dṛṣṭa sta yā bhu dza go sau ma n+ya tsho smyon par dogs pa yi/ /thub pas mdzes ma de la smras/ /khyod kyis ④mthong de lag 'gro ni/ /rin ratna bi byu ṣi taḥ/ /bha brnyi myu na yaḥpu tri na dī dzi hā na sgo gi na/ /chen gyis brgyan yin nam snyam/ /bu mo thub pa rnam dag ⑧ni/ /longs spyod can min lce gnyis min/ /sa sgo hargu ru bhiḥs rā pa ri ṇa to duḥkha pra desgro da kai rā yā to bi kha yo yul bzhin yongs su gyur tshe sdug bsngal rab ster ⑨snum bcas lci ba'i la du ni/ /shin tu dngar ⑩ba dag ra bā ti ma dhu riḥthra ti dṛ thā mā kṛ thaḥ/ /muste kā ma pha lā ni tā ni pa ra sī gis 'ongs pa la ni don med dga' bar yongs ma byed/ /mdzes ma 'dod pa'i 'bras bur ⑪ro ldan nyon tyā yā sa seghra n+ya lo ye ṣā me ba bi sngo pa me na dza na tā swā de na saṃ spru mongs dag gis ⑫bran pa gang de rnams/ /shin tu nges par dug dang mtshungs pa'i nyams su myong ba bskyed tstsha ti/ /e hi darsha ya me byu rā ṅka stu batpa mu ṣpeḥsu taḥ/ /i pas rgyal bar byed/ /tshur shog re shig thub pa'i sras/ /de su ring nas bdag la ston/ /zhes brjod kyughā ta ṭa bhā tī re ta yā sa ha ya yo mu niḥ/ /sa bi lo kya pa riṭī ra bra klung gi ngogs su ni/ /de dang ⑫lhan cig thub pa song / /de yis ⑫chu klung ngogs su ni/ /sa yi bdag95—847

hmadarghaṃ ma hi pa ti/ /yo gyi gu ṇa ga rto dā ram̐ dzā mā ta ra ma ma n+ya ta/ /dṛ po tshangs byin stimathong / /yon tan tshogs ni rgya che stekhye / /mag pa dag tu 'os par bsams mi po pi mu ni mā lo kya bai la ghra bi na tā na naḥ/ /dwo gu ṇi na pra zla me bdag gis kyang thub pa ni/ /mthong nas skyengs pas bzhin dud cing / /gnyis la'agyur rab tu btud na ni nā ye ba pra sanda hūṃ/ /ni dzo tsi te na bi bye nā mu ni nā pra ti pā di shā/ /pa yis/ /nges par rab tu dang ba thob/ /thub pas rang la 'os pa yi/ /cho ga yis ni rab tu byin/ /ta ta༈ harṣa pe yu ṣa ra ha li ma gra tīdzñā paḥ/ /nā sngaḥka dā tsiṅkarta de nas rab dga' bdud rtsi yi/ / rlabs de ④mi yi bdag pos blangs/ /nam yang khrod kyi ⑤tshig gzhan byo ma rtseḥpa ra gi rā twa yā/ /muddhā pā bye ya mi kyughā mu niḥsthā yādrwa gyis—/ /'di la khro bar mi bya zhing / /mdzes ma 'di ni bskyab ⑥bya zhes/ /brjod nas thub pa dzeerang mā shra oṃ/ /a tha harṣa mi bā ru khya ha yo dzā yā sa khaḥkṣa shātpa/ /rā dza gnas song / /de nas dga' bzhin 'u7 rta la zhon/ /chung ma dang 'grogs skad cig gis/ /rgyal sar dhwa no sa mā sā bya dṛ pañtsa kre ma hotpa baṃ/ /saddhānta pu ra dza na su yang dag phyin nas ni/ /rgyal pos dga' ston chen po byas/ /pho brang 'khor gyi sde kun rmi/ /gtsug tu mūdhri n+yasta ma tī bhu dzre/ /sa ya yo shi 6 tī pa hphuḥka lā kau sha la ke li 6/ /pā da sa bdag gis bkod de/ /sgyu rtsal mkhas pa'i rtsed 'jo la/ /bdag po'i slob ma nyid du gyur/ /de yi tyā baiḥka ma la ka li shaṃ bhu mi mā lo kya tasu de bī shasde dṛ pa pa ri dza rkang pa bkod pas sa gzhi padmas brgyan pa mthong gyur nas/ /der ni rgyal po'i 'khor gyi lha mo'i sgra dag ji nasta tra me ṣpe ya thārbaḥ/ /di byoṅkarṣaḥsu kṛ ta pa tsi baḥsru tsu te ke tu bhū taḥbazhin don can bzung 7)/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mchog tu khyad 'phags legs byas grogs ni rtogs sbyi tā byarlo ra ti sha ya ma ma rla kṣa ṇi ཿ bu rgya bhā rdzu/ / anta ཿgyur pa/ /ngo mtshar rgyas pa phul byung rang bzhin mtshan nyid rnams kyis lngo)gsal bar byed/ /pho brang 95—848

pu ra pu ra: 6 bi mu khe na ma tī bhu dzā/ /le bhe sau bhā gya sho bha pā ra ma 'khor byi bud med las/ /phyi rol phyogs pa'i sa bdag dang / /rtse zhing nu rgyas ldan pa des/ /skal ba mā nā gha na sta mbi/ /a tha kā le na sā garbha mā dhatta ba su ṅgā pa teḥ/ /bzang zhing mdzes pa thob/ /de nas dus kyis nor 'dzin gyi/ /bdag las de yis mngal bzung zhing / /tsiddhā sha bye tsa saṃ sakta mantaḥpu ra ba dhū dza naḥ/ /ā sanda pra sa pā pho brang btsun mo'i skye bo yis/ /bsam pas chags pa'i zug rngu yang / /de nas khyim du mdzes ma ni/ /muspyo ta tasta me tya mandi re/ /kau ṭi lya kru ra mātparya byu tser rdzu ga nā dza btsar nye de la mngon phyogs te/ /gya gyu gdug stipa'i phrag dog las/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams kyis naḥ / /pra sha ba su bi dhi musnye na dzā mbi ye dṛ po tsi tai/ /dza na bhā hi su ta sru smras—/ /mi bdag la 'os btsa' ba yi/ /cho ga rmongs ma khyod mi shes/ /ma yi mig ni gos dag gis/ /te parbhe na pi hi te kṣa khyo/ /i kyughā sā sa pasnri bhiḥthra bhā garbha bha rārdi bsgribs la bu ni btsa' bar bya/ /zhes pa btsun mo gzhan gyis spyesmras/ /mngal rgyas khur gyis zhugazir ba tā / /u tsi haṃ bha ba tī rbhasthā kri ya tā mi hphu bā tsa tā/ /ta tastu bhimbi des—/ /khyod kyis bdag la 'os pa ni/ /mdzod ces de dag rnams la smras/ /de nas de dag rnams ruddhā spyi dṛ bhā badhe na bā pa sā/ /sā sru ta bā la yu ga lo pra tapta kyis mig /ras kyis ④dam du bcings pas bkab/ /btso ma gser gyi 'od ldan pa'i/ /byis pa zung ka na ka pra sgo/ /j-i tā to bsta bi hi te mañdzu ṣe gru bhā mu dṛ te/ /gi ni de las ⑤btsas/ /gzhon nu de dag sgrom bur bcug /gos kyis dkris shing rgya spyobatab nas/ /bud gā dza le niḥka ru ṇaḥku mā ro bikṣipta ste yaḥ/ /kṛ tā raktakta ba da med snying rje med rnams kyis/ /gang klushā'i chu la gsang ste 'phangs/ /padma can gdong khrag gis ni/ /nā rū tsuḥpadmā ba ṭī tsa tāḥ/ /sha ka la dwa ya ma sudzee dzā tai te kṣibee oṃ bha se/ /bsgos te de dag gis smras pa/ /khyod la dum bu g.yo med gnyis/ /btsas pa dag ni chu la 'phangs/ /95byed849

ma tiḥ/ /sgo gārnyaḥpra bha baḥswa bhā ba su la bha shrī pi bhra mo྾ kha lāḥbar 'gyur/ /rje bo ①longs spyod kyis long rang bzhin byis smod ⑤dpal gyi rnam 'phrul ldan zhing 'phyar/ /sa tya bya tya ya bhū ma yo yu ba ta yaḥpu rgyu bhi tsā ra kri yāḥ/ /swa tstshand+rabyu na chung bden pa nyams pa'i sa gzhi bsod nams mngon par 'joms pa'i bya ba can/ /phra ma ldan pa dang ta bā da nabyu pi shu nāḥkhe tsi tra kasgro rya tā ya tre ka tra ba sarnyi ta tra pa ra 'dun ①rmad byung smra byed mkha' la ri mo'i las sbyor rnams/ /gang du nges par rnam par gnas pa der ④laḥsā dhuḥka the dzre ba ti/ /antarti ta ta no di byāḥkhrute ti ba tsa saṃ dṛ paḥ/ /ku ni dam pa drang po ji ltar 'tsho/ /lha mo lus ni ⑤mi snang ba'i⑥ / /tshig de thos nas sa bdag ni/ /khros pi ta ta su z-isnre tai sa pratshwantaḥpu dzā ga nāḥ/ /kro dhwa krānta gya dṛ pa te ste bra pas de yi byung tshul dag /btsun mo'i tshogs la rab tu dris/ /khro bas non pa ⑦mi bdag gi/ /bka' shā sa na shaṃ ki tāḥ/ /tā ni bi rya ya thā bṛrghaṃ ba bhū burbha ya bi hwa ni drag pos dogs khyegyur pa/ /de dag gis ni byung tshul bzhin/ /bshad nas ⑨'jigs pas 'khrugs lāḥ—/ /nirdoṣe da yi hūṃ dzñā tā pa pasbyi bañtsi tsā dṛ paḥ/ /ba dhya byu par gyur/ /chun mas bslus pa'i btsun mo ni/ /gsod sar rab tu btang ba dag /skyon med shes mi sa mudṛ ṣṭha shu sho tsā nu sha yā ku laḥ/ /rā ga kro sgo kṛ pā ladzdza sho nas mi yi bdag /'gyod pas gzir bas mya ngan byas/ /mtshungs par stobs rgyas chags dang khro/ /kaistu lya ba lo da yiḥ/ /sa mu humbi ha pa tsi baiṭwā gī kṛ ta i bā bha brtse bas ngo tsha mya ngan dang spyo/ /rmongs pa'i grogs kyis ⑪yang yang du/ /de ni bskal par byas bzhin bta—/ /hā thra ye tī na pu 5 su kwa pu naḥsaṃ ga masta yā/ /ma me gyur—/ /kyi hud dga' ma khyod dang ni/ /phyi nas bsod nams dman pa dgaspyo /gang du 'grogs pa kyughā na ra pa timbi pa pā ta ma tī ta le/ /a tha shaṃ gā pra bā sāste mdzi ṣe zhes brjod nas/ /mi bdag sa la 'gyel bar gyur/ /de nas gang spyogā'i rgyun thob pa/ /sgom du ④rgyal 95—851

dzā la dzre ba rnaḥ/ /ā dā ya rā dza mu dzā ka mā ya yurbhe ba rāḥs dzñā/ /po'i rtags mtshan can/ /nya pa rgya yis 'tsho ①rnams kyis/ /bzung nas mdun sar yang dag 'ongs/ /tairgyuste pu ra tasta smin sa ha sosnyo ṭi ta dzu paḥ/ /da darsha bā la yu ga lo de dag gis de mdun bkod cing / /'phral la mi bdag gis bye tshe/ /padmo gsar pa'i 'od ldan pa'i/ /pra tya ga ka ma la pra sgo/ /tu lya rū po dṛ pa gya mo sa ha 4 sho ri bā shi no/ /byis pa zung zhig mthong bar gyur/ /'od stong pa yi tha skar bzhin/ /gzhon nu 'di dag mi bdag gi/ /ku mā ro lakṣa ḍo dā do dzā tā bi ti dza na swa naḥ/ /ta taḥs bātpa gzugs mtshungs mtshan nyid rgya che bar/ /skyes zhes skye bos rab tu bsgrags②/ /de nas sa bdag mchi ta na yo kṛ tī hūṃ ke ma tī pa tiḥ/ /thra yā bi ra hā sho kārtaḥsaddhā pa ma ma dang / /btsas pas sras dag pang du blangs/ /dga' ma dang bral mya ngan byus/ /gzir ba'i gdung bye rka ya yo/ /a tha dīrgha ma tirtswa ma ma hā mā tyasta ma bra bīta/ /de ba dzre ba lhag par gyur/ /de nas blo gros ring zhes pa'i①/ /blon po chen pos de la smras/ /lha gcig khyod kyi ba ti pasbyi pa pasbyi dza na bañtsi tā/ /khru tī tatpa ha sā rā dzā laddhā dzre ba btsun mo ni/ /chun ma'i tshogs kyis bslus pa 'tsho/ /de thos 'phral la rgyal po ni/ /'tsho ba thob pa i bobyu ta/ /dṛṣṭaḥsandarsha ye tyāghā pra ya yo madhri mandi re/ /ta tra bzhin du langs/ /dga' bas ston zhes brjod nas ni/ /blon po'i khang par rab tu song / /der ni tsā duḥkhi hūṃ dṛṣṭha ma rgyu bi smṛ ta saṃ bhra rmā/ /a ba pā na sa mujurgyu dza gā da sdug bsngal ldan pa de/ /khro bas gus pa brjed gyur cing / /smad pas kun tu yid byung ma/ /mthong dza ga tī pa tiḥ/ /yi re ṣa bi ṣa maḥbye ṣaḥthra ye ta ba bi nimbi ta/ /nas 'gro ba'i bdag gis smras/ /gang gis mi bzad lhag ma ni(pya/ /dga' ma khrod la rnam sprul pa/ /e hi pa shā dhu zla te ྾ bi tsitra ba dha be sha saṃ/ /pra sī da tya dza saṃ tā tshur shog da ni de dag rnams/ /gsod ⑤pa'i sdug bsngal dka' la ltos/ /gdung ba thong la dang bar 95—852

paṃ mā mo nā bhi mu khi bha ba/ /i kyughā ni pa bā tā sngaḥpā da yoḥthra thi bī mdzod—/ /mi smra mngon ①du phyogs ma byed/ /ces brjod de yi rkang pa la/ /sa yi bdag po rnam par pa tiḥ/ /sā ba dbyetpa ṅgā ri nyi ṣi tsu mā nonda tasta mbi/ /na rend+ra mā kṛ thāḥko saṃ 'gyel—/ /nu ma rgyas pa mchi ma yi/ /rgyun gyis ④bran byed des smras pa/ /skye bo mi bzad gnod byed la/ /dza ṣpe tī zwa pa kā ri ṇi/ /pa hye bi thra ya kā ri ṭwā 6 dṛ pa te ma rgyurna mi dbang khro ba yongs ①ma mdzad/ /mi bdag bden par dga' dang bral bar byed pa rnams la bdag ni me bi rya te bai re hikṣa ma yi ba yā tru pa sha oṃ bai re ṇa taborbha te/ /khro yod min/ /nges par bzod pas dgra ni nye bar zhi 'gyur ④khon gyi de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sha bye nai ba bi bhuḥpa rā bha ba ba sgo bee po pa kā re su kṛta sadzre pākta na kadzre nimbi gnod pa bsgrub ⑤la dgra ni khyab bdag ma yin nges par grogs ni phan la min/ /lus can rnams kyi bde ta mi rda duḥkhā hi ka de he rmā/ /kṛ tā pa kā re bi pa rā bha borya dang sdug bsngal 'di dag thams cad sngon gyi las kyis ⑥sprul/ /gnod pa byed pa la yang gnod pa'i sbyor oṃ na nā ma kuryā da bi tsārya budhi mān/ /kru dhwa pa ram̐ kro dha bi ṣe bi ba dag /ma dbeed par ni blo gros ldan pas mi bya ste/ /khros pas mchog tu khro ba'i dug ni 'phel bar bsgo te na shārnyi me ti dzwa li toghi raldi nā/ /duḥkha saṃ tā pi tā tā 'gyur—/ /me nyid mnan ⑦ pas me ni zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /re zhig sdug bsngal gyis gdungs khyabadag /baṭwā ta gye be ta po ba rna/ /gasgo mi tarja tsaḥpūbye kā mi tyā na kṛ tasma yā/ /yab kyi dka' thub tshal nyid du/ /'gro de de tshig 'dod ldan ma/ /bdag gis sngon tshe yongs po7 ma byas/ /bā ri tā pi pa ratre na ma ma kā mā pha la smṛ hā/ /yo ba nodmā da do ṣe ṇa bdag ni 'dod 'bras la chags pa/ /de yis ⑩rab tu zlog ⑪gyur kyang / /lang tshos myos pa'i skyon gyis na ni bṛṣṭha ka ro mi ki/ /i kyughā ni shwa sarnyi sā bi li khaṭī pā dā bhu baṃ/ /ni⑫—/ /zlog par ma gyur ci zhig bya/ /zhes brjod de ni shugs 'byin cing / /rkang pa yis ni sa la 'bri//95—853

byedab byu ba na mra bad nā kṣa khaṃ mo nā ba lambi bhā/ /pra shā me nā pi dṛ pa skad cig bzhin ras dud pa yis1/ /mi smra ba la brten par gyur/ /mi bdag gis ni phyag byas kyang / /terna sā sthā pa sra panda tsā/ /sre: sha lya tu dzee dhaste mi byā do ṣa pa ri gra de ni rab dang nyid ma gyur/ /rdzun gyi skyon ni yongs bzung rtege/ba/ /mdza' ba'i zug rngu mtshungs par haḥ—/ /sā dhwa tu rakta ba sanā dza gā ma pi tu rā shra oṃ/ /bhu dzi ga ko ṭi 'dzin / /de ni dmar ba'i bzhin bzung nas/ /yab kyi bste gnas dag tu song / /khengs ldan rnams lo ma rgyusthā ni rmā sa hi duḥs haḥ/ /ā lo gya mā ṣpe ba la tā sa khri bhidhri kyi khro ba ni/ /lag 'gro gya gyu de bzod dka'/ /bung ba'i sgra yis dge legs brjod pa yi/ /'khri shing ga swa ṣpeḥswā ga ta ba di bhā bheḥ/ /pre: mṛ gī bhiḥpa ri barya mā ṇḍata ta po grogs mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /ri dwags rnams kyi mdza' bas yongs bskor zhing / /pha yi ba rna sā pi tu rā pa sā da/ /yā ti mu no pu rgya ni dho pra sandanta pa bi she ṣārdzi dka' thub nags su de phyin gyur/ /dka' thub khyad par gyis bsgrubs 'jig rten ni/ /dang bar thub ta me ba lo ke/ /dṛṭī shra oṃ shu n+ya ma dhwa ra bṛtta ཿpadmā ba tī mo ha pa bsod nams gter song tshe/ /bste gnas stong mthong 'tsho ba mi brtan ①pa'i/ /padmo can ni rmongs ha tā ba byu ba/ /bātpa lya mā dzadma ni lī na mantaḥswastha swa bhā ba mya pi tuḥpas bcom par gyur/ /rang bzhin rnal gnas pha yi mnyes ④gshin dang / /skye ba'i bar ni nang du sma rarnyi/ /shu tyā ste lo ki mi ba ma n+yamā nā bi ṣārdi te bā nyi ha te ba gcags pa dran/ /'jig rten gsum bzhin stongs ⑤par sems shing ⑥de/ /dug gis gzir bzhin sbrul sā byuta/ /ta de ba ta snga mu ni nā ba tī rna baṃ rna dza gā ma pri yo two gyis ( )bcom bzhin gyur/ /thub pas dman pas 2nags tshal de nyid ni/ /de la dga' ba dga' min kā le na/ /niḥshe ṣa ni spru ta sā ra bha brnyi ra ha swa bhā bā bi ra ha swa bhā nyid du gyur/ /dus kyi snying po ma lus 'thungs gyur pa'i/ /dngos po rnams ni 'bral ba'i rang bzhin 95 854

ba—/ /te ṣe ba de she 6 ma no ha re 6 te ṣi ba puṣka ka ra bā sa re 6/ /e ke yin / /yid 'phrog yul ni de dag kho na dang / /me tog 'byung gnas nyin par de dag nyid/ /su zhig na ke na pi bi nā dza na su saza bi ṣā dā spa da tā mu bai ti/ /bee shaṃ ta taḥpra gcig dang bral ba'i skye bo la/ /thams cad chags bral gnas nyid dag tu 'gyur/ /de nas sa gzhi dag bra dzi tā nu rū paṃ bi dhwa ya sā bhū ta la tsand+ra re khā/ /su khosgo ta dikṣu pa gi zla ris te/ /rab byung rjes su mthun pa'i chas bzung nas/ /bde bas btang ste phyogs su yongs ri bhra maṭī bā rā ṇa sī shārnyi mi bā pa pā da/ /ta tā tha rā dzñā kṛ tī nā mbi 'khyam ①zhing / /zhi bar ①bzhin du bā rā ṇa sīr laphyin/ /de nas rgyal po kṛ tī ④'dod ldan pas/ /gā kṣ-i pa prabye mā nā su bhi lā ṣa bhā dzā/ /ta paḥpra dīptasdi shi khe ba ta su saṃ der ni ri dwags mig de don gnyer yang / /dka' thub me lce 'bar bzhin de yis ⑤/ni/ /ji zhig ltar sparsha yo gyu na ka dzee tsi dā spruta/ /sā rā dza basbyi bhi ra ti pra yatna da sgyu tsu mā na tri da yang reg 'os nyid ma gyur/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams kyis rab 'bad nas/ /mngon par mchod cing shaṃ ga ṣpe ba/ /ta tra su thratta ni tsin ta yaṭī pa ti bra tā kā la mu pā sa lha mo bzhin du de/ /legs spyod sems shing ④bdag po'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /der ni cung zad dus ke tsita/ /tsā brahma dasto pi bi shiṣṭa tsā rasta tra sbi tā khyu mi pa timbi sha mya/ /shig nye bar gnas/ /'bral ba'i sdug bsngal mo yis sdesreg byed cing / /de ni de na gnas pa sa yi bdag /bi yo ga duḥkhā na la da hra mā naḥs mā ya yo brahma ṇa ku ṭa be shaḥ/ /a tshangs byen gyis kyang nyan rna bsrings las thos/ /bram ze'i chas su bcos nas yang dag 'ongs/ /de tha bra tā tshwa di ta tsā ru be shaṃ bi lo kya hūṃ shī la ya shaḥpa tā shaṃ/ /nas brtul zhugs mdzes pa'i chas kyis —)bsgribs/ /tshul khrims grags pa'i ba dan de mthong nas/ /pra sā da nā ya pra ṇa yā bhi pā rī dṛ paḥswa rū paṃ pra ka ṭī tsa kā ra/ /tī dang ba'i slad du mi bdag gus par ni/ /mngon du phyogs pas rang gzugs gsal bar byasaḍasgo/ /sa 95 —855

zwa pa sgo ha mi ti bru bā ṇi na ma tī pa to pā su tsi re ru ro da/ /ma na sri byā nā bdag bdag gi gnod pa mi bzad pa/ /zhes smra tshe na de ni yun ring tu7dus/ /khengs ldan rnams kyis ma ba khā na ma rgyu ru dī ra ṇi nā pi na ba twa me ti/ /gha nā khru dhwa rā pa ri hā ra kā rī smad pa'i khro ba ni/ /brjod pa na yang gsar pa nyid du 'gyuras7/ /stug po mchi ma'i rgyun ni yongs sel sma rend+ra re khaṃ sa pha lbo kṛ tā shaḥ/ /kānd+ra sha raṭwā la i ba pra pā rya zhing / /'dod pa'i zla ris phyogs su 'bras ldan byed/ /rgyal po ston dus lta bus mjos ma ni/ /dang ni nā ya rā dzā ni dza rā dza dhwa dī/ /pā dzā bu dza tyā pa pa ro dza mā lī bi yo ga bar byas nas rang gi rgyal sar khrid/ /rkang pa'i padmo 0bkod pa'i mtsho skyes 'phreng (pya/ /bral ba'i dus su kā le pra sha oṃ pā yā tā/ /pā durba bhu ba pri ya saṃ ga me sthāḥsaṃ sgo ga lasmro ri ba rab tu zhi grur pa/ /dga' dang 'grogs tshe de la rab 'khrungs te/ /chags pa drag po'i longs spyod dpal gā shwe rā gā/ /dzadmānta re pā ki la ka n+ya ke pa pra tya ka buddhā ya bi la sa padme/ /da 'byor bzhin/ /skye ba gzhan las nges par sribu mo des/ /rang sangs rgyas la rtse dga'i padma dag /phul twa pi lo bhāhphu na rā da de taji tsārya sho
