be sha bi she ṣa kṛta/ /sbri tai ba bandha sa hi taḥsha taiḥpañtsa bhi rarta tsā/ /khyad par 'god byed cing / /dgra bcom lnga brgya dag dang ni/ /lhan cig rab tu gnas par byasatsho)/ /ta tā kṣa yo bha ga ba taḥpambi be shya dhadzre kṛ twa bi hā ra ru tsi rā bha ra der ni mi zad ⑤bcom ldan chos dag rnam par bkod byas nas/ /mdzes pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rgyan dang rde dha ri ṭī/ /haṃ gadzha mā da na ta ṭorje ta laddhā sā ribyāspyo tsa kā ra na ldan pa'i 'dzin byed de/ /sgos ngad ldang gi ngos las blangs shing snying po thob gyur pa/ /gur gum gsar ba rku ku ma kanda z-i ndeḥ / / i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yā bo bye pa'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kyis zurab tu khyab par byas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee ma dhyarnyi kā ba dā na sa bee ti ta maḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las nyi ma 4gung pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste palla waḥ// //bdun cu pa'o// //shārnyi smṛ shaṃ bi ma la shī la du kyu la lbo lā sho bhā dzu ྾ bi zhi ba la reg dri med tshul khrims ras dkar rtse dga' yisakhru/ /mdzes pas bsten cing 'uyul dang ṣa ya bee ṣa pa rākhru khā dzā/ /ṭī dzā shu kaidzre li na shā ṇa ba ṭatstsha ri bā ṇi bā bhe chas las phyi rol phyogs rnams la/ /dar gos dag dang shā na'i gos hrul dri ma can gyis kyang / /mngon mā na ka la nā ni ba de n+ya bṛtrī ཿ/ /shā na ba sbo pu ra bhegru rgu ṇa par khengs pa skyed ④min dman pa nyid du bsgrub 3pa min/ /shā na'i gos can dge slong sngon/ /yon bārlu ru shā sa nā ta/ /dzi na shā sa na mā dhwa hūṃ ma thu dzā prasbi taḥtan ldan pa'i blu) bla ma'i bkas⑩ / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gzung ⑫/ba'i slad/ /grong khyer bcom brlag dag pu rī/ /pra bra dza pa thi shu shā ba mabee yottha da tombi thaḥ/ /pra baṃ tu zhugs/ /de ni lam du 'gro ba na⑫/ /'phags pa'i rang bzhin gyad gnyis dang nyu1/ /phan tshun rab 95—863

go pa gā tā me rū mārya mārya swa bhā ba yoḥ/ /ye bee ma la shi la ni la yāḥtu brjod pa yi①/ /zhar byung 'phags pa 'di dag thos①/ /dri med tshul khrims gnas dang thos pa yi /khru ta bi gru ta tsagru ṣaḥkṣa mā bantaḥ/ /tā ṣpe ba shā ṇa bā sbo ka tha ya ti rnyikhyi mig dang ldan par grags shing bzod pa can/ /dge sbyong de dag nyid ni sa gzhi la/ /dge slong shā na'i sgo bi shra ma shān/ /e ta dughā tha te nā pi ta de borghaṃ ni sha mya to/ /ta mū tsa gos can dag tu brjod/ /de brjod de nas de yis kyang / /de nyid brjod thos de dag gis/ /der tu sta me bā sau shā ṇa bā sbo na saṃ sha yaḥ/ /kasmradzwa shā ṇa bā sī ti su smras shā na'i gos can de/ /khrod nyid yin par the tshom med/ /ci slad shā na'i gos can zhes/ /blo ma te dikṣu bi shu taḥ/ /gā shaṃ sha yarnyi mu na yasta ba sadhend+rab di naḥ/ /bzang khyod ni phyogs su grags/ /thub pa dam chos smra ba rnams/ /khyod kyi tshigs su bcad pa sgrogs/ /sa dza gā da ma yā n+yasmirjadma tyā sha yā n+yasmi/ /pra hye ka su ga taḥswā thru des smras skye ba gzhan la bdag /smin 1pa gso bar byed pa yis thu/ /rang sangs rgyas ni snying nad kyis//dā to bai rya tsi kitpa yā/ /shā khaṃ shīrṇa ta ram̐ bā sasta gya dṛṭī ma yālpa shaṃ/ /gzir ba rab tu bsos par byas/ /de yi shā na'i gos dag ni/ /chung zhing rab tu rnyings rkyepa mthong //u pa dī tai pra ṇa yi nā rā dzārta ru tsi rā mā ram̐/ /sobra binda sa khe ma hūṃ rgyal po la/ 'os mdzes pa'i gos/ /bdag gis rab tu gus pas phul/ /de yis kyesmras pa grogs po dag /ro tsa te ru tsi dzā shu shaṃ/ /la bhya te pra sha ma shā sgyu sho bhā shā ṇa ni bā sa mdzes pa'i gos mul bdag mi sred/ /shā na'i gos zukyi rab zhi ba/ /bsngags ⑨par 'os shing mdzes pa sā / /e tya haṃ tadma tsaḥkhru tā dzreṇḍi shā rde shu kokhru kaḥ/ /sahūṃ ga thob—/ /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /shā na'i gos rnying 'dod pa bdag /dam pa'i grogs kyis ⑪ mā pta bee rā gya ཿ sa rbe nt+ra bi mu kho dzha baṃ / / kā le na ta gya chags bral thob/ /dam pa'i gros ⑪las phyir phyogs gyur/ /dus kyis (/rte de yi lus kyi mthar/ /mdzes 95—864

de hārnye ru tsi rā tsā bi jo yi nā/ /ma yā tabhu lya bhā bābye pra ṇi dhwa na ma nyiḥkṛ tā//pa'i mchod pa bsgrubs byas te/ /de mtshungs nyid ni thob pa'i slad/ /bdag gis smon lam blo gros byas//te nā haṃ pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na tatpa ma bhya dzñā ṣpe na tsa/ /sa shā ṇa bant+raḥsaṃ dzā taḥshā ṇa smon lam de dang de la ni/ /yang dag mchod pa yis kyang bdag /shā na'i gos dang ldan par skyes/ /shā bā rpā ti bi khru taḥ/ /i tyāghā sa sha ṣpergatstshanda bātpa ma thu dzā pu rī/ /na'i gos can zhes su grags/ /zhes brjod bcom brlag grong khyer du/ /phyin cing dal gyis ①'gro ba u ru muṇḍa bhi sgo she la mā ru ro ha ma horya maḥ/ /ta tro pa pi shya parlo des—/ /mgo chen zhes pa'i ri bo la/ /rtsom pa chen po dag gis 'dzeg— /der ni sa gzhi 'dar byed ka babye nā kambi ta kṣi tiḥ/ /bee dī ya beesna pandasgo nā go tu mu la pa'i(kye—/ /skyil krung bcas te nye bar 'khod/ /char chen 'bebs pa'i klu dag ni/ /bgegs la chas pa babhā ṇi/ /ma thu rā bā se no grebye su to na ṭa bhaṭwā bhilja/ /ā dā ya rnam par btul④/ /bcom brlag la gnas tshong dpon bu/ /na ṭa bha ṭa zhes bya ba/ /grogs kyi sbad du sa khya kṛ tyā ya sa bi hā re bi nind+ra me/ /rahpho dzwa la spa ṭi ka kāñtsa na ra mya bzung nas ni/ /de yi ⑤gtsug lag khang par sprul/ /rin cen 'urab 'bar shel dang gser gyi ba gam harmeḥparlo ka rpā tha ra tsa nā sha ya nā rnyi rā maḥ/ /sargo pa maḥswa bha dag dang ldan/ /khri dang khri'u mal stan dag gis spras shing mngon par dga'/ /mtho ris lta bu skal ga sgo ga ṇi bhebi hā raḥpu ju sbi tirna ṭa bha ṭa bhi dha e ba po byuṭa / /bzang longs spyod gter byi gtsug lag khang / /bsod nams gnas pa de ni na ṭa bha ṭa zhes par gyur/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī shā ṇa bā sthā ba dā na zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing me ka sapta ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //las shā na'i gos can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //95byed865

ma re ba yā ti bi ṣa ma ra bhi khā ṣa byu maḥsadzre dza naḥsma ra ra dzaḥpa ra skye bo 'dod pa'i rdul gyis mig ni yongs su gyenyams pa kun/ /yul ni gang dag nyid kyis khyemangon byu ta dṛṣṭiḥ/ /tai re ba pu sgo pa ri mārdza na shudhi bhā rdzu bai rā gya yo ga par 'dod pa'i sar byur parngu/ /de nyid kyis ni bsod nams yongs gtsang dag pa bsten pyarnams kyi//mu pa yā ti ma naḥpra shādhi ma/ /a bhuṅgabhā bhi dha na gya garnyi ka gya su yid ni rab tu zhi zhing chags bral ldan pa dag tu gyura'u/ /bcom brlag dag na gnas pa sngon/ /sbas pa taḥpu rāḥ/ /ma thu rā bā si na shrī māsgru pa gubhā i ti khru taḥ/ /ā dzā zhes bya spos 'tshong gi/ /bu ni dpal dang ldan pa dag /nyer sbas zhes par grags pa byung / /shā na'i taḥkalpi taḥpi tā sa bhekhyoḥshā ṇa bā se naḥ/ /a na yā yī ti ba tsa sā tadha tta gos can dge slong gi/ /rjes 'brang ngo zhes pha yi 67ni/ /tshig gis ྅ma skyes pa nas btagasadu/ /de ni ra to bha bta/ /bai rā gyu bhi mu khe ta sminda ba yo ba na shā li ni/ /bhasna ni de la gus ldan gyur/ /lang tsho gsar pa dang ldan de/ /chags bral la ni mngon phyogs tshe/ /bgegs bhesna ga rja rā bhashyi trī le bhe ma no bha baḥ/ /ha ri tsandan kastu ri karbu tshogs rtsom byepa nyams pa yis/ /yid dbyung gi 7ni bsam pa thob/ /pha yi tshig gis dus 'ga' zhig /rā ga ru bi kra yī/ /sa kañtsiṭwā ma ka robye ba hā ram̐ pi tugi rā/ /a tha ha ri tsandan gla rtsi dang / /a ka telngaru dang ga pur 'tshong / /tha snyad rnams ni de yis ⑫ byas/ /de nas bā pa ba daṭwā khyu gandha kra yā bi thraṣṭa yā/ /swa dā gya ka thi tai khru tā tai rū pa gu ṇa nor lhas byin zhes pas/ /spos ni nyo ru btang ba yis/ /rang gi 'bangs mos de yi gzugs/ /yon bi khru haṃ / / saṃ dzā ta rā ga saṃ bee gā ga ṇi kā saṃ ga tan grags pa bshad thos nas/ /chags pa'i tshogs ni rab rgyas shing / /'grogs pa ⑫ don gnyer smad mādhī bhā/ /bi thra dzñā bhi ma tā dru ṭī bhā bantasmi n+ya bee da yata/ /sa swe ra 'tshong mas/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i pho nya mo/ /btang nas de la bsam pa bshad/ /dal gyis ⑫pho nya 95—866

byedabyed— ——— — —— — —— ——— ————byed————sde— —mabee to dru tyā sasmi tastu ma bha ṣa ta/ /a yo nā bhe ma taḥkā lasta sngaḥsandarsha mas hu)don gnyer/ /'dzum ldan de yis der smras pa/ /de dang phrad pa'i dus 'di ni/ /bdag la ṣpe ma ma/ /a tha dru dhyā pra yā tā yī sobye shā ga ṇi kā bha ba ta/ /mngon par 'dod pa med/ /de nas pho nya mo 'ongs tshe/ /smad 'tshong chags bral ldan par gyur(khu/ /nā nu rā ge bī rā ge bā ni tha tidzee ṣa yo ṣi hūṃ/ /ka dā tsitpandi re tamyuḥrjes su chags pas chags bral ba/ /smad 'tshong ma la nges pa med/ /tshong dpon bu ni lang tsho ldan/ /sbi te yu ni ba niklu te/ /na ba sārba pa tiḥshrī mā nā dza gā motta ra pa nam zhig de yi khyim gnas tshe/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i don mthun bdagasne /byang gi lam nas gsar du thāta —/ /bi thraṣṭi rā tri sgo ga yi te na hesdi pa hūṃ shu kaiḥ/ /dza na tyā 'ongs—/ /de yi mtshan mo longs spyad slad/ /gos dang bcas pa'i gser dag springs/ /brkam chags pa nyi tā lukhyu ga ṇi kā sa ma tsinta yetpa / /e ṣa tā ba sbyi to ge he ldan ④pa'i smad 'tshong ma/ /ma dang bcas pas ⑤rab bsams pa/ /nor zad byas pa tshong pa'i bu/ /ba ṇi sru nuḥkṛ ta bya yaḥ/ /adhī ma hā dha nartswa n+yaḥki ka ro mi na bedme tatra/ /'di ni re zhig khyim na gnas/ /gzhan yang don gnyer nor chen ldan/ /bdag gis ( )ci bya de ma rig /bānta bitta ཿpu naḥkā mbi na bha ba tya bye ka pra daḥ/ /te na parlu ṣi te ṣpe 'dod ldan nor ni skyugs pa dag /phyi 7)nas lhag par ster mi 'gyur/ /'bras bu med par yongs rnyings ba kri ya te ni tpa le na ki/ /na ba sta bi na bokhru kyātpa za mu tsa tya par(kye—/ /gyur pa de yis 6)ci zhig bya/ /gsar pa mngon 'dod gsar pa las/ /ma bslangs par yang yā tsi taḥ/ /a pre ye pi pri yā swā rda ka ro ti pra tha mā da raḥ/ /ta smra thams cad ster/ /dang por gus pas ⑫mi mdza' yang / /mdza' ba nyams su myong bar byed/ /de slad ṅge ma su kri ya tā mantaḥpakta mya sha lya batra/ /a sgo ge na na yā bye ṣa kand+ra nang du zug rngu bzhin/ /zhugs pa 'di la ci zhig bya/ /las kyis 'ching bzhin 11rjes 'brang 'di/ /ma 95 867

bandhe ba a nugaḥ/ /nā smra ka me tadma ṇi rdzu rya bye te ya di beetta ban/ /bcad ①par ni 'gro ma yin/ /gal te nor ldan 'di btang nalngo7/ /bdag cag la ni tshong khe med/ /na dhasthā ya na kā mā ya ba ya marja ya nidzre tāḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsint+ra sā mā chos phyir ma yin 'dod phyir min/ /bdag cag nor gyi phyir du sprul/ /zhes bsams nor ni don gnyer tuḥsasma te dra bi ṇabee byā/ /ba rā pa be na n+ya ba dhwatpa bi ṣe ṇa ba ṇiklu tai/ /ma—/ /de yis ma yi gros kyis ni/ /chang mchog dug ldan blud pa yis/ /tshong pa'i bu ni rab tu bsad//ni kṣi su bska ra tsa ye ta tsa ye ta taste ga ta dzre bi tai/ /a bā bya bi pu lo bi.oṃ de nas srog dang bral ba de/ /phyag dar khrod kyi phung por sbas/ /ded dpon nang du rab bcug nas/ /sāttha ba haṃ pu ri shya pā/ /dṛṣṭaḥpra bisgo ga ṇi kā kṛ haṃ na bhu bi nirga taḥ/ /de yis 1nor ni rgya chen bye thob/ /smad 'tshong ma yi khang par ni/ /'jug pa mthong ste phyir 'thon min//i ti bantu bhe ra nī 6 bya su la sto ba ṇigru taḥ/ / ta tastadma dha saṃ zhes te gnyis ṭwārnams kyis btsal bas/ /tshong pa'i bu ni srog bral rnyed/ /de nas de bsad gdung ba tasteḥshā bi tastend+ra tī pa tiḥ/ /bee shā yāst+ri bra pā pārta mā di de sho gra ni can—/ /de dag gis ḍakhyagasol sa bdag gis/ /sdig drag la 'os chad pa ni/ /mi bzad smad 'tshong ma gra haṃ/ /sā ba dhya ba su bye dī tā mukta ke shī ni radza rā/ /ni kṛtta pā ṇi tsa ra la bstan/ /skra grol gos dang bral ba de/ /gsod sa yi ni sar khrid de/ /lag pa rkang pa rab bcad shā sbyinda shra ma ṇa nā se kā/ /bee biptadhī bya thā krāddhā ni dza sho ṇi ta garbha cing / /rna ba dang ni sna yang bcad/ /rang gi khrag gi 'dam la ni/ /gdung bas nyen cing 'dre ⑦ ldog me / /ni bārya mā ṇa kra byā dā dā snga tsu kro sha bantu tī/ /u pa guptasta byed—/ /sha za log kyecing 'phyon ma ni/ /'bangs mor bcas pa mya ngan byed/ /de nas de yi sdug tasta sngaḥshu twa bi ṣa ma bee sha saṃ/ /tabyi lo ka na kā lo ya mi kyughā tai bsngal ni/ /mi bzad nyer dzi7sbas kyis thos nas/ /de ni blta ba'i ⑩dus 'di zhes/ /brjod nas sa 95—868

byu baṃ ya yo/ /dā snga ni bi de tai dṛṭī ta mā yāhaṃ sha shadku ti/ /pūddhā gzhi de ru song / /zla 'od can de 'ong ba ni/ /'bangs mos bshad pa mthong gyur nas/ /sngon gyi byekhā ṣa she ṣe ṇa sā ladzdza ku ṭi lā bha bta/ /antaḥpra dṛṣṭaḥke nā pi bā mngon 'dod lhag ma yis/ /ngo tsha ldan zhing gyu gyur gyur/ /bag chags goms pa dag gis ①lam/ /pa nā bhya pa baṭwā na/ /na ka sri tsi da basthā dzee rā gasbya dza ti de hi 'ga' las nang du rab zhugs pa/ /lus can rnams kyi chags pa ni/ /gnas skabs 'gar yang btang ladzā—/ /dza gha nā ba ra khaṃ kṛ tā dā snga ba sa na palla baṃ/ /pā sta mi 'gyur/ /'bangs mo'i gos kyi 'dab ma yis/ /mdoms khruni rab tu bsgribs byas shing / /nu mar na n+yasta hasta tai ba bhā ṣe bi nī tā na nā/ /pra yasne nā pi ma ha tā nā lag bkod bzhin ras ni/ /rab dud ④de yis de la smras/ /bdag gis 'bad pa chen po yis/ /don yā taste ma yābee taḥ/ /a dhu na manda bhā gyu yāsta ba saṃ darsha ṣpe na ki/ /ya dā du gnyer yang khyod ma 'ongs/ /da lta skal ba zhan pa bdag /mthong ba yis ni khyod la ci/ /gang tshe ma yā bha ba sko pi bye gya sau bhā gya bi blu ma ཿ / / na da rsha na bdag ni longs spyad kyis⑤/ /skal bzang rnam 'phrul ci yang ldan/ /de yi tshe na khyod kyis ni/ /blta su kā lo ya mi hphurghaṃ bha ba tāta dā/ /kṛddhā gī ru dhi ra dhi rā diddhā sgo tā haṃ gre sha sā ba'i dus 'di yin ⑥zhes smras/ /yan lag bcad cing ⑦khrag gis bsgosaldu/ /nyon mongs rgya mtshor lhung ga re/ /kā laḥka ma la pa tā kṣi ki ma yandarsha na su te/ /i ti bru bā hūṃ bāspyo ba dag /lta ⑨ba yi ni dus 'di dag /padma'i mig can khyod kyis khyaci/ /zhes pa smra zhing mchi ma yi/ /busthā bya mā dzā shu rmā tsa dzee/ /sha na kai ru pa gupta ༈ sā nu tā pā ma bhā ṣa ta/ /chu yis gos kyi mtha' dag bslad/ /rjes su gdung ba can de la/ /dal byus nyer sbas kyis smras pa/ /kādhi byand+ra sa khāe su baṇḍi ka da lī khā ba rgya tso re ba putthakhye padma ni mbi mdzes sdug zla ba'i grogs dang lus ni gser gyi chu shing mdzes pa'i rkun po dang / /bzhin ras padmo zum 95—869

la dzee ku ba la ya gre bya pra de lo tsa ṣpe/ /naidzre mo da yi tai ma no ha ra ta re byed mig ni utpal dag la dman pa ster byed pa/ /shin tu yid 'phrog de dag rnams la bdag ni mi dga' ki tu pra yaṭwā da haṃ kā mā dzā pra kṛ 1 bi tsā ra bee ra sī drabye sa ma sgyu ga taḥ/ /'on kyang 'bad pas bdag /rnam par spyad na snasnaro dang bral ba 'dod pa rnams kyi rang bzhin lta ru 'ongs//bee bhū ṣa khaṃ shu katstshadzee ba ra sau ra bha bā se te/ /sho bhā ta bā bha baṭwā ye rgyan dang gos kyis rngozherab bsgribs shing / /dri bzang mchog gis rab bsgos pa/ /khyod kyi lus ni mdzes swa bhā baḥpu na rī dṛ shaḥ/ /ba ta ba ta ni ha tāste tīṇḍi ke shāsbi saṃ sbe pa dag /slar yang rang bzhin 'di 'drar gyur/ /skra dang rus pas gang ba'i dbyibs can rtag tu me pa te ta ma na la tā po tpa tsu mā nā khi waṃ ge / / ku ṇa pa ba yis ni/ /yan lag ma lus rab 'tshed rnag khrag dang ldan smad pa'i gnas/ /lus kyi ming can dur ti ra maṭwā ye dzu gudmā ni ṅgā ṣpe bya sa na ga ṇa ni dhwa ṣpe kā ya nāmbithra shā ṣpe/ /khrod sdug bsngal tshogs kyi gter dag la/ /gang gi ④dga' ba de dag kyi hud kyi hud brlag par 'gyur2 //ba ྾ndi ni du rā mo de bi kṛ ta spyo dā saṃ ku le/ /a ho mo hādma nu tyā rde kye ma rmongs las mi 6rnams ni/ /rnam par zag cing dri nga can/ /rnam 'gyur bug pas gang gyur pa'i//kā ye pi pri ya bhā ba nā/ /pā pā yaḥkā ya paspye ya mā yā bi ṣa ma saṃ shra lus po la yang dga' ba bsgom/ /bde gshegs nye bar bsten pa las/ /lus kyi rnam grangs gnod pa yaḥ —/ / duḥkha skandhaḥkṣa yo yā ti su ga to pā pa nā da yi/ /mo ha can—/ /mi bzad sgyu ma dag gi gnas/ /sdug bsngal phung po 'di zad 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa dhūnta di bā ka ra gya sa ka la kle shā ba bā sa sbyi daḥshāstuḥshā sa na saṃ shra ye pra ṇi hi tai dag gi nyin byed nyon mongs gnas skabs mtha' dag gcod byed pa/ /ston pa'i bstan pa'i gnas la gang ka spyo ṇa mi tra su meeḥ/ /ṣpe ba klinda pu naḥka ram̐ ka ka li le ṭwāṭwānt+ra dag gis ni dge ba'i grogs kyi smon lam btab/ /de dag lus zhes brjod pa'i dmyal ba dman pa'i keng 95—870

mu bā tsa kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /kṛ taḥkṛ tā pa rā dha gya twa yā ta du tsi tasma ma/ /pra sī thal sbyar de la rab smras pa/ /gnod pa byas pa bdag la ni/ /yang dag 'os pa khyod kyis byas/ /da ni da tya bye tāsma rgyu ra zlu nā haṃ twa dā shra yaḥ/ /a haṃ kṛ tā pa rā sgo pi su khyod la bdag brten pas/ /khro ba thong la bka' drin mdzod/ /bdag gis gnod pa byas mod kyang / /ga te na ma hādma rmā/ / a pi mbi ta ta raḥ sru nurdza na ke ṣpe ba bde gshegs bdag nyid chen po yis/ /bu ni rnam par ma dul 1snab/ /pha yis (dwa bzhin du rab tu rakṣi taḥ/ /bo bye rū le ma yā ta gya badzā sa na dzu ṣaḥpu ra/ /kṛ tā ni bsrungs—/ /byang chub snying por rdo rje'i gdan/ /bstan 1pa de la bdag gis ce3spon/ /gnod pa yi ni kā ra ni ka rāḥkṣadhi me ba tsa te na me/ /nā nā kā ra bi kā ra ka ri ṇi tshogs dag byas/ /de yis bdag la bzod pa nyid/ /byang chub ting 'dzin grub khyepa'i gnas der skyil ma yi pā kā ra hūṃ bi bhra tā tasmisgo bye sa mā bye sidhi bha ba ṣpe pa.oṃ ka bandha krung dag ni ⑥bcas nas gnas pa'i tshe/ /rnam 'gyur rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa bdag la ra ba nyid ⑦ni sbri to/ /kṣurnyi kṣu li ta ma rgyu nā bha ga ba tā busnye na shuddhātpa nā ten 'dzin byed cing / /khro ba bzod pas bkrus pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan dag pa nyid kyi bdag nyid can/ /dhyā na pa rā ya ṇi nā nā ma nā gudhī lo tai lo tsa rna/ /bha ba tā twa rya ka ru ṇa bsam gtan mchog tu skyong bar byed pa de yi zu spyan yang cung zad phye ma yin/ /khrod kyis ⑨ snying rje btang mudṛ dzñā haṃ kha lbo kṛ taḥ/ / sā pā rā dhe pi ma ha tī na ma rgyu ma li nas ding / /bdag ni rab tu smad par byas/ /gnod byed la yang chen po yisaḍa/sna/ /yid ni khro ba'i dri nasma naḥ/ /muñtsa me ku ṇa pā barghaṃ sbi to haṃ ta ba shā sa ṣpe/ /i ti ldan min/ /bdag la ro dag btags pa thong blu// /khyod kyi bka' la bdag gnas so/ /dul bas de bru bā ṇi bi na yā du pa guptasta ma n+ya dhwata/ /na ka ri byu pi tse de baṃ bhi kṣu rde bi skad smra byed pa/ /de la nyer sbas kyis smras pa/ /gal te slar yang nyer 'tshe khyod/ /dge slong rnams la 95—873

sla ba pu naḥ/ /ta de ba ta ba mudzi mi dṛ bye ku ṇa pa bandha rgo/ /i rda tsa bha ba tā mi byed na/ /khyod la brtan par bcings pa yi/ /ro 'di dag ni bdag gis dgrol/ /gus ldan bdag kābye pri yo pra ṇa yi no ma ma/ /a tī ta su ga tā kā ram̐ sandarsha yi tu la dga' ba ni/ /'di yang khyod kyis rab tu bya/ /'das pa'i bde gshegs rnam pa ni/ /khyod kyis yang ma rta si/ / dṛ ṣṭa ta ba ma yā sha tta rwa bye sa ddhā nu kā ri ṇaḥ / /dag bstan par 'os/ /kun gyi rjes mthun khyod kyis ni/ /zlos gar nus pa bdag gis mthong / /sa ndarsha ṣpe bha ga ba taḥpa ra muṅkaṇḍi to khya dzwa/ /dhand+ra kā yo ma yā dṛṣṭaḥbacom ldan 'das ni mthong ba dag /bdag ni mchog tu 'dod par gyur/ /bde gshegs kyi ni chos kyi sku//su ga ta sgyu khru tā dma nā/ /rū pa kā yastu rgo bā sau na ya nā mṛ tā thos pa'i bdag nyid bdag gis mthong / /nges par mig gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gzugs kyi sku de (lkum nirdzo raḥ/ /i nyi nirmukta ku ṇa saste noktaḥku su mā yu dhaḥ/ /ta spyu rtse sau yin no/ /zhes brjod de yi ro dag ni/ /bkrol ba me tog mtshon can gyis/ /de la smras pa bde ga ta rū paṃ tu bye karja na shā kya te/ / ta thā pi darsha ya bye ṣa twa dā gshegs kyi/ /gzugs dang mtshungs par byed mi nus/ /de lta na yang khyod kyi bka'/ /'dul ba la dzñā bi na ye spri taḥ/ /pra ṇa phye na pra ṇa myo haṃ na twa yā su ga tā kṛ tiḥ/ /gnas bdag gis bstan/ /khyod kyis rjebadag ni bde gshegs dbyibs/ /phyag 'os la yang phyag mi bya/ /i rkyughā su ga tā kā re saza kā ra su kha pra rda/ /sa sa udzdza ṣṭa ka na zhes brjod bde gshegs rnam pa ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bde ster zhing / /gser gyi snang ba rab tu spro/ /kā lo kai kānta ma darsha yata/ /dīrgha dhyā na ni lī na lo tsa na yu shaṃ niḥmadzes pa dag ni de yis bstan/ /spyan ni zung dag ring zhing bsam gtan la chags smin ma'i 'khri shing saṃ dhra ma zla la tai na sā baṃ sha ni sakta kānta ka na katstsha tro pa mā nā li rnam 'gyur bral/ /shangs kyi rgyud ni mdzes par chags shing gser gyi gdugs dang mtshungs pa'i mtshan ma 95—874

ke / /nizlu ṣā ya ta karje pā sha la li tī byā lasba bā hu dru oṃ bo rghaṃ can—/ /rgyan med snyan gyi zhags pa ring zhing mdzes la phyag gi ljon pa kun tu 'phyang / /sangs rgyas kyi ni rū pa ma beeghra nidṛ ti ra judzrebye ta nā nā ma pi/ /u pa gupta sta dā lo kya gzugs dag mthong na shebasam pa med pa rnams kyang dga' bar gyur/ /bcom ldan sku ni mdzes pa de/ /kānta bha ga ba to ba puḥ/ /sa bātpa pu la kā tīṇḍi: kre tatyā da banda āoṃ/ /mthong nas nyer sbas mchi ma dang / /bcas shing spu 'o nga rgyas pa yis/ /de yi zhabs la phyag dag byas/ /na nā ma pra ṇa myo haṃ mi ti ba di ni pa madma je/ /u pa guptasta ma ba nges par bdag gi naphyag 'os min/ /zhes pa yid srubs smra byed tshe/ /de la/ nyer sbas kyis smras pa/ /dattha ṇa myaste dzi nā kṛ tiḥ/ /kṛ tri me ṣa bi bidza 6 baddhā bha ga ba tasta rgyal ba'i rnam pa khyod phyag 'os/ /bcom ldan sku ni bcos ma yi/ /gzugs rnams la yang phyag byar nuḥ / /na sa mṛṭwāṣṭi dhwa tū dzñā pra shā maḥkri ya te bu byeḥ/ /i trukta 'os—/ /mkhas pa rnams ni sa shing dang / /khams la phyag de byed pa min/ /nyer sbas kyis ni 'di mu pa guste na shu tā mā raḥpra sanda dhīḥ/ /bi hā ya sau ga tai rū paṃ swabee buḥpra brjod pa/ /rab dang blo ldan bdud kyis thos/ /bde gshegs gzugs ni yongs btang ste/ /rang gi tya ya rya ta/ /te ṣpe bā tha sa mā tū tā bi mbi te na hi te ṣi shā/ /u gzugs su rab tu bstan/ /de nas dul zhing phan pa 'tshol4/ /de yis zheyang dag bos pa yi/ /grong ba gubhārnyi rka po rāḥb ddhādzre sgo tu ma ya yuḥ/ / ta sro pa de sha ka tha yā khyer ba rnams dam pa'i chos/ /nyan du nyer sbas drung du 'ongs/ /de yi man ngag gtam gyis ni/ /sa tya darsha na nidṛ taḥ / /lakṣu ju ṭwā da sha pā bhi rarta hūṃ su ra bā bden pa mthong zhing dga' ba yis5/ /grong khyer na gnas 'bum phrag ni/ /bco brgyad dgra bcom si rghaṃ/ /i ti sa sa ka la lo kā lo ka ka sthā ṇa kā rī bya bye ta ti mi ra hā rī nyid thob 'gyur(pe/ /de ltar 'jig rten mtha' dag dge ba dag gis snang byed cing / /rab rib 'phrog 95—875

dha nd+ra mā rgo pa de shaṃ / / bi pu la ku sha la mū la pā pta pu byo da par byed pas chos kyi lam gyi man ngag bsgrubs/ /rgya che dge ba'i rtsa bas bsod nams rgyas pa thob rnams yā rmā bha ba ti ki la ma harnyiryaḥb re ྾ hi tā ya/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi kyisashe / /rdzu 'phrul chen po gang de gzhan la phan pa'i don du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dzee mu pa gu bhā ba dā āoṃ byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las nyer sbas kyi rtogs pa dā sapta ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //a khaṇḍi tai shā sa na mā ya tā shrīrya shāstu ṣā dzā shu sha tā ba dā tai/ /nyams pa med pa'i bka' 5dang yangs pa'i dpal/ /grags pa bsel zer byed pa brgya ltar dkar//ā byarya tsaryā ru tsi raḥpra bhā baḥpha dzee sha le shaḥsu ga tābye na su/ /rā ngo mtshar spyod pas mdzes pa'i mthu dag ni/ /bde gshegs mchod pa'i 'bras bu'i cha shas yin/ /grong dzā shrī mā na sho ka bhūhphu re pā ṭa li pu tra ke/ /dra nārja nā ma bhūrya gya saṃ khyu khyer pa ṭa li pu trar/ /rgyal po dpal ldan mya ngan med/ /byung ste gang gis ḍa —sbyin pa don/ /grangs kyi shab da ri dra tā/ /tai ka dā tsitpa bhā rpā rgo ba ṇi dzo di pa gā mi naḥ/ /sand+ra sgra yis dbul bar gyur/ /nam zhig mdun sar 'khod de la/ /tshong pa gling du 'gro ba po/ /bdog nguswa nā khru sho kārbheḥs niḥshā sā bya jidzha yuḥ/ /de bi dīrgha bhu dzasgo ya bi kun nyams nga/'i mya ngan gyis/ /gzir cing shugs ring 'a tsholdan pas zhus/ /dpung pa'i grib ma ring po la//shranta bhu ba na su te/ / rā dzre na dṛ shya te ka—ñtsiddhā pa ddhā pi tā sha srid pa ngal gso 6 lha khyod kyisa3/ /rgyal srid dag na 'ga' zhig kyang / /re khyab bsam pas gzir ba yaḥ / /a smra ka tu pra ba ha rde rghaṃghā ratna dha rna z-i tai/ /ke ba mthong / / skal ba nyam 'uchung 'ba' zhig las/ /rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu rnams kyis/ /bdag cag 95—876

tya pa rāsgorya ta ma bhya dhwata/ /u pā yo sa ti byu pā la na dzisgo kaspru marta si/ /nam mkha'i lha mos mngon phyogs smras/ /sa skyong stithabs ni yod pa la/ /bsam pa bya bar mi 'os so/ /ye pū dza yarnyi dzi na mañdza li ram̐ dzi te na mūjo pra zla ma ba ri shā ma ma gang zhig phyag 'tshal yongs su bsngo bas cher 'os bsod nams can/ /spyi bo thal mo khyesbyar bas mtshan harta pu juḥ/ /te ྾ su ra a pi su bstu bi tsi tra sho bhā mā dzñā pra dzee bi pas rgyal la mchod byed pa/ /rnam par rgyal ldan de dag bka' yi 'phreng ①ba rnam bkra zhing / /dngos po dza yi dzā shi rā sā ba habye/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tiḥ pra ta sthā tā mchog gi ngamadzes pa lha rnams kyis kyang spyi bor 'dzin/ /de thos nang par mi bdag ni/ /khrus byas ⑤shu tsi pra ta ཿ / / si bye shu dhe na ma na sā dhya tā bu dhe sa ma bhya brtul zhugs gtsang ldan pas/ /dag pa'i yid kyis 'u sangs rgyas ni/ /bsams nas grub slad rab smras dhwata / /sa twa sme ram̐ sa ra sa ka ru rja kau mu dī pū ri tā shaṃ kādzñā shādhri pa ka la ta pa—/ /snying stobs kyis 'dzum ro ldan snying rje zla ba'i 'od kyis dzware ba skong / /mdzes shing mtha' dag me sī shukla sa kṣe ni biste/ /ni tyā nasdo pa ra ma ma mṛ tai nibee kā ram̐ thra mun pa zhi beed dkar po'i phyogs la rnam par gnas/ /rtag tu kun dga' rnam 'gyur med cing mchog gi dzadzha bee sdo tā pa pra sha ma su z-i rda bu dhe pū rte nd+ra bi mbi / /bdud rtsi rnam par spro/ /gdung ba rab zhi'i grogs po sangs rgyas zla nya'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsirghaṃ sa dā bi ṣa ya do ṣa pa rādru khā dzā ye yā dza she pra tsu ra pā ra mi tā gang zhig rtag tu yul gyi skyon la sa 2phyi rol phyogs gyur cing / /rab mang pha rol phyin la brten pa'i sems shra yā rde/ /te me pa re pa ra hi tī bhi ni bee sha bhā dzaḥsaṃ kalpa kalpa ni dbang gyur pa/ /gzhan phan dag la mchog tu mngon zhen rten cing kun rtog gi/ /dpag bsam ljon ta ra baḥku sha landi shaṃ tu/ /i ti bhatta bee dhwa ṣpe na pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na bhū ba pa de dag bdag la dge bar 97ster grur cig /ces pa sa yi bdag po yi/ /smon lam gus pa sgrub byed 95—878

— — — — — — —tiḥ / /sa ha pā 5 rta hūṃ ṣaṣṭhastuṇḍi dikhyuḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /a thejo bhekṣu kyis) —/ /dgra bcom stong phrag drug cu ni/ /phyogs rnams dag las myur bar byon/ /de nas dge slong rā kā ram̐ he oṃ ra mya ma kā ra ya ta / / sa dṛ shaṃ dṛ pa te re ke nā ga dbang po yis/ /gcig 2sgoni mi bdag mtshungs pa dang / /gzhan pa klu yi rgyal po yi/ /rnam pa gser rā dzasu bā ba ram̐/ /ta taḥkṣi ti pa tend+rantini na nā ma sha ṣpeḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /urja gyi rang bzhin byas/ /de nas dal bu dal bu yis / / /sa bdag gzugs ni dma' ba dang / /klu yi nā ma tsa nā gend+ra mūrnyibi smi ya kā ri rde/ /ya thā ya thā dṛ ba:kre sa dā dbang po'i gzugs dag ni/ /ya mtshan byed pa mtho rngo4bar gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar mi bdag gis/ /rtag tu ratna tra yā tsa rna/ /ta thā ta thā nā ga mūdhībee na nā mo rya yo pā rā/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod byas/ /de lta de ltar klu yi gzugs/ /dma' zhing gzhan pa mtho 5 bar gyur/ /a tha rā dzñāḥpu narla khe pra hi ta nā ga sum̐ ga bā/ /skant+rabee tā khi la ba ṇi de nas rgyal pos spring yig beer/ /springs tshe klu yi gang zag rnams/ /ma lus tshong pa'i rin chen khur/ /gratna bhā rāḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /ta da she ṣe na ra pa ti bee tīrya ba ṇi dzānta dzwa/ /phrag la bkod nas 'ongs par gyur/ /ma lus nor de mi bdag gis/ /tshong pa rnams la rab tu byen/ /bi sri bye nā gā na bha brji na shā sa na sā da raḥ/ /su bi dhwarlurta hūṃ pū dzā mu klu rnams btang nas rgyal ba yi/ /bstan la gus dang bcas par gyur/ /mi bdag la 'os nyer spyad kyis//pa tsā ri dṛ po tsi tai ཿ / / ba bhū pā na bee saṃ kaspe rbu dha sa nda rsha nokhru dgra bcom rnams la mchod pa bsgrubs/ /kun tu rtog pa mi chung bas/ /sangs rgyas blta 6 bar 'dod kaḥ —/ / durla bhe pa ri nirpā ṇa ni lī na dzi na darsha ṣpe/ /u pa gupta par gyur/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das gyur pas/ /rgyal ba mthong ba rnyed dka'i tshe/ /yon tan gyis ni nyer pa shu shā ba su ga ta pra ti me gu ṇiḥ/ /bi dhe yo bhasti yughā dzā dṛ paḥpra ṇa yi sbas dang / /bde gshegs mtshungs par de yis thos// /gus dab ldan nga/'i dbang gyur cing / /ma/dza' kwa/ ()5 ———87 /

batpa lo/ /u ru muṇḍa sbi tai dru tai ra ni nā ya ta mā da rā tra/ /tatpa mnyes gshin 'gro tshe na/ /gnas pa de ni mi bdag gis/ /gus pas pho nya dag gis bos/ /dam chos paryābee gaṭwāpta sadhand+ra ku sha lo da yaḥ/ /pa bhū ba sa ta tai rā dzā ratna dge ba rgyas pa ni/ /yongs rdzogs de yis mchod pas she thob/ /rtag tu dkon mchog gsum po ni/ /tra ya pa rā ya ṇaḥ/ /i ti dzi na sma ra ṇi na ma tī pa tiḥpra pa ba rgyal po'i dpung gnyen dag tu gyur/ /de ltar rgyal ba dran pas sa yi bdag po dag /rab 5rgyas bsod pu rgya ma ho da ya sadza daḥ/ /bi ṣa dzdza tā ma pi mo li 6 shā sa dzwa ku su nams che bar dar ba phun tshogs kyis1/ /bka' ni me tog 'phreng 4bar gyur pa'i rtse dga' dag /dug ma bā ma bi lā sa ma bābee ban/ /i nyi kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye satā 'dzin rnams kyi mgo bo la yang thob par gyur/ /zhes 57pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems ba dā na kalpa la tā yī nā ga dru ta pre ṣa shā ba dā rna tri sapta ti ta maḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing la sa klu la khyesprings pa'i rtogs pa bajod pa'i yal 'dab pabee waḥ// //ste bdun cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //pu bye pra rja ma pa tha me ti ka thanda te ྾ dā norya tāḥpa ya di gā mi ba lbo gang zhig sbyin la brtson pas 'phral la dga' ba glang chen bzhin/ /yan lag rdzogs shing mdzes la yi ba / / pū ṇḍi ga pū ṭwā ru tsi dzā thra thu ma dhya de shaṃ ye sdug rgyas la ) rgya che dbus kyi phyogs/ /sa ni rang gi mnyes gshin (8 dang bcas rab tu ster byed pa/ /྾ swa batpa sa hi tī pra ti pā da yadhi / /a thā sho kaḥkṣi ti pa tirwa de dag bsod nams 9 rab smin lam du ji ltar 'gro ma yin/ /de nas sa bdag mya ngan med/ /sbyin la nā sgyu se na byu ya sā/ /ā pa ga ta pra ṇa yi dzā pra ya yo kalpa bṛkṣa tsā/ /shin tu cher goms pas/ /slong ba phyogs nas 'ongs rnams kyi6/ /dpag bsam shing nyid dag tu gyur//95—880

rā dzo tsi tiḥs sa ta tai sgo dza nā bha ra bhādza riḥ/ /bhikṣu la kṣa tra yi ge he bhaste rtag tu rgyal po la 'os pa'i/ /zas dang gos dang rgyan rnams kyis/ /khyim du dge slong 'bum phrag gsum//pū tai ra snyu dza yata/ /he ma ko ṭi sha tai dā hūṃ sbri to khyurya su nishyi yaḥ/ /gus shing gtsang ba dag gis mchod/ /gser ni 1bye ba brgya ster baX 7/ /gang gi lugs la nges par gyur//sa twa me bākṣa ya ta rāḥko shaḥku sha la shā li rmā/ /sāstsa bye bhū ri bee bha baḥdage ba ldan pa'i snying stobs nyid/ /shin tu zad pa med pa'i mdzod/ /rgyal srid che la 'byor mang des/ /ṣast+ri shaddhiḥsaṃ batpa riḥ/ /hesnaḥṣaṇḍa ba ti ko ṭī rde do saṃ ghā ya sa twadhīḥ/ /ta snying stobs blo yis dge 'dun 'a / /lo ni sum cu drug gi gser/ /bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug phul/ /de taḥkā le na dṛ pa tirgyu bye nā glu ni mā ya yo/ /sbe rā ṇi su kṛ tā bye ba nas dus kyis 2mi bdag ni/ /nad kyis 4thebs pa nyid du gyur/ /lus can rnams kyi legs byas nyid//na sha rī rā bhā de hi ram̐/ /ta nu mā banda paryatai nibye tya thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /brtan ⑤pa yin gyi lus ni min/ /lus ni mtha' la nye ba nyid/ /des 6nas sa yi bdag po yis/ /bya bhikṣu bhyaḥ kuklu ṭwā rā me tra bi ṇi dā tu mu rya yo/ / ta hpho traḥ sadza dī gag kun rar 1dge slong la/ /nor ni 'bul bar rtsom par gyur/ /de yi tsha bo phun tshogs can/ /nā ma lo bhārjasta gya shā sa rna/ /dā nā bu rgya pra bṛtta gya ko shā dhya kṣe ra bā zhes pas chags /— slad mdzod srung rkel/ /bskos pas sbyin pa'i bsod nams la/ /zhugs pa de yi bka' ra yata/ /dā ṣpe ni ṣidhe po tre ṇa saṃghā ya thra bye bī pa tiḥ/ /bye ṣa dzñā dag bzlog /tsha hūṃ7bos sbyin pa bkag pa'i tshe/ /dge 'dun la ni sa bdag gis/ /rang skal nyid du ma la ka sthārghaṃ da do swa dzñā ga bha ba tai/ /dhī ma taḥsasma ṭwā nā tha ra bye gupta gya madhri gyur pa'i sman/ /skyu ru ra yi tshephye dag phul/ /de nas blon po blo ldan ni/ /mgu byed sbas pa'i gros dag ṇaḥ—/ /da do saṃ ghā yā ni khi dzee thra thi bī pri thi bī pa tiḥ/ /gi gāmbu hā ra ru tsi dzā tsa gis—/ /dge 'dun la ni sa gzhi dag /ma lus sa yi bdag pos phul / /gang gā'i chu yi do shal mdzes 95—881

tu ram̐mbu rā shi be lā bi shā la ra pa nāsma la yā ba tai sī/ /dā tā khi dzee ldan rgya mtsho bzhi yi ni/ /rba rlabs ste rags yangs shing ma la ya yi rna rgyan can/ /nor 'dzin ma nyid ma ba su ma tī pa ba mā sa sā da pu bye pra mā ṇa kal nā ra hi tai hi tā ya/ /lus byin nas phan pa'i slad du ni/ /bsod nams chad kyis snaphodapag dang bral ba de yis (snyeyang dag thob//pra spyo ta ṣaṇḍa ba ti ko ṭi bu baṇḍi dā ṣpe yā te di baṃ na ra pa tā ba tha ta gya po traḥ/ /de nas gser ni sgobye ba dgu bcu drug byin gyerab grags pa/ /mi yi bdag po mtho ris song tshe de yi tsha bo she ṣe ṇa madhri ba tsa pā kṣi ti mā dza hā ra spa ṣṭa kra yī ka na ka kau ṭi yis—/ /sa de gser byi lhag ma bye ba phrag ni bzhi rnams kyis/ /blon po'i tshig gis gsal phyebar rab tu tsa tuṣṭa ye na/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la nyos te blangs par gyur/ /zhes 5pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa tā yī thra thi bī pra dā āoṃ tsa tuḥ sa pta ti ta maḥ pa lla waḥ / / / /dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las sa gzhi phul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //sadzee ma bi tyā mū le saṃ sā ra ta ru pra kā ra bee tsi bye/ /dzñā rtu bahūṃ hahūṃ kaḥm rig pa yi rtsa ba can/ /'khor ba'i ljon pa rnam 7bkra kun/ /shis dang brjod dang gzhom 8 sha sto n+ya tra sa dzee dzñā ta / / shā ba sgyu swa ste mā na pū rde dzi no dze par ni/ /kun mkhyen ma gtogs rtesu yis nus/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal na sngon/ /bzhugs pa'i ta ba na sbi tiḥ/ /a she ṣa dadhi bha ga bān bhikṣu saṃ bha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rgyal ba dge legs can/ /ma lus gzigs pa bcom ldan gyis// /dge slong tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ /shri nu ta gre ya se dzñā nā lo ka nind+ra la mā na sāḥ/ /pra tī tya sa mutyā rda baḥye shes snang ba dri med kyi/ /yid can dge legs slad du nyon/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung bdag gis ni/ /ka tha yā mi ya thā kra ma/ /a bi byā bā pa ni bee yo duḥkha kandha su bhū ya saḥ/ /khyed la rim bzhin bshad par bya/ /ma rig pa yi bag chags 'di/ /'khor ba dug gi ljon pa ni/ /95—882

saṃ sā ra bi ṣa bṛkṣa su mū la baddhā bi dhwa yi dī/ /tahphu tya yāstu saṃ sthā raḥsdug bsngal phung po chen po yis snarte/ /rtsa ba 'ching ba sgrub par byed/ /de yi rkyen gyis 'du byed de/ /kā ya pādmā na pādma kāḥ / / saṃ sthā ro ttha ñtsa bi dzñā āoṃ ma na ཿ ṣakhye dhri lus ngag yid kyi bdag nyid can/ /'du byed kyis bsgrun rnam shes yid/ /dbang po drug po'i rte bdag yādma kamra/ / ta ttha tya yi nā ma rū paṃ saṃ dzñā sandarsha nā bhi sgo/ /ma naḥnyid can/ /de yi rkyen kyis ngaming dang gzugs/ /ming dang mthong ba zhes brjod pa'o/ /'di las ṣaṣṭidhri ya sthā ni ṣa ḍā ya ta na ma su taḥ/ / ṣa ḍā ya ta na saṃ bye ṣaḥdrug pa yid dag kyang / /dbang po la gnas skye mched drug /skye mched drug gis 5 yang dag sbyor/ /sparsha i tya bhi dhī ya te/ /ṣa ṭa sparsha nu bha bo ya: bee da nā sā pra tīrbhe tāḥ/ /reg pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /reg pa drug gi 6nyams myong gang / /de ni tshor ba dag 7tu grags//ta yā bi ṣa ya saṃ kle shābye ga tro: pra dzā ya te/ /kā mā di 6 ta bhū ta ma yul gyi pasnyekun nas nyon 9/mongs las/ /de yis rkachags sred rab tu skyed/ /de las byung ba'i len pa ni//sā dā rna pra ba rta te / / u pā dā no bye ba ཿ kā ma rū bā rū pya ma yo 'dod pa sogs pa /—1'jug par 'gyur/ /len pa las byung srid pa 'dod/ /gzugs dang gzugs med bha baḥ/ /nā nā yo ni pa rā thra tyā dzā tirbha ba sa mudhe bā/ /dza rā ma ra ṇa rang bzhin no/ /srid pa la sa byung sna tshogs kyis1na/ /skye gnas su 'jug skye ba'o/ /rga shi mya ngan la sho kā di panda tisbyo nyi saṃ shra yā/ /a bi byā di ni ro dhe na te ྾ bhu pa ra ma sogs brgyud4/ /skye ba la ni brten pa yin/ /ma rig la sogs 'gog pa yis/ /de dag rim bzhin zhi kra maḥ/ /pra tī khyo tyā do yo ba hu ga ti ra bi tyā dṛ ta pa daḥs tsind+ra yuṣṭha bar 'gyur/ /ma rig pas drangs lus mang 7rten cing 'bye'/ par 'byung ba'i gnas 'di ni/ /dben bhibi dza na ba na bi shā ma sha ma bhiḥ / / pa ri dzñā te sa myasbra dza ti pa'i nags su gnas shing nyu1zhi ba khyed rnams dag gis bsam par bya/ /yang dag yongs su/ shes na dus 95—883

ki la kā le na ta nu hūṃ ta nu two saṃ prapta su kha ta ra ni baryabya bha ba ti/ /kyis khye nges par phra ba nyid du 'gyur/ /phra ba nyid ni yang dag thob nas 75bde blag nyid du zlog par 'gyur//i ti kṣe mend+ra pi ra tsi tā yā bo bye sa tā ba bā na kalpa la tā yī pra tī tya sa zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing mu tyā dā ba dā 8 pa ñtsa sa bee ti ta ma ཿ pa lla wa ཿ / / / /las rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //kro dha ཿ sa rja hi ta ཿ pra ta pta ma na spru mbi sne ba shā ṭwā mi dzā 'dod ldan rab gdungs 1yid can rnams la phrag dog dbang gis 4khro ba nye bar gnas/ /khro bas kro dhwant+ra ni pa tarnyi tī bra ti mi ra shā bye ma ti bye pi naḥ/ /sa tra spyu ra ta ra long bzhin tsho5 blo gros nyams rnams mi bzad rab rib g.yang sar rnam par lhung / /der ni rab drag rnam pra kā ra na ra ka kle shoṣṭha mūtstsha dzu ṣā yā kadzee kṣu ra talla kalba bi ṣa mang dmyal ba'i 6 nyon mongs tsha bas rmongs pa rten byed cing / /bskal pa'i bar du spu gri ⑦mal stan du ya khyo bhā kṣa tā ram̐ kṣa ya ཿ / / na dī ma dzi ra ma tyā khyu shā ba sgyu brtags pa8 yul gyi sa gzhis bcom rnams brlag /bcom ldan rgyal bas she7mnyan yod kyi/ /chu klung bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /saṃ pābee sa twa ma dru khye ā bṛ tai bi kṛ tai dza beeḥ/ /khyams ldan zhes par ni/ /byon pas sems can rnam 'gyur can/ / skyo bos ⑫kun tu bskor ba gzigs//ma hā kā ya kṛ mi ku lerbhaghra mā ṇa pra ḍobye beeḥ/ /sru tsa yahaṃ bya thā rā beend+ra rma las byung ba /shwesrin bu yi/ /tshogs kyis nyan lus chen za byed cing / /gdung ba'i cho nges ⑫dmyal ba na//ra kasbri ti be pa paṃ/ /tai dṛṭwā dzā ta ka ru ṇaḥsattha dzhasta ṭi byā ta ṭi/ /gnas pa'i sdug bsngal gnas 6byed pa/ /de mthong thugs rje skyes pa yi/ /kun mkhyen chu klung ngogs su u pā bi shahpho ra dza ṣpe rā sa na pa ri kalpi te / / so ba tri kṛ tā ni—/ /grong khyer ba yi skye bo yis/ /yongs su bshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de yi rang bzhin ting 95—884

kā re dzā tyarghaṃ ma nyi kho yi/ /kṛ tā dzā tasma re pa ryasta dru pe ṇa sa 'dzin gyis/ /'phral la skye ba dran mdzad nas/ /dmus long rnam 'gyur rnam pa can/ /ma te mtshungs mā bye nā/ /a pi to pi du ra spyu ra kand+ra rde bhu bye te pha lo/ /a pi la des ①gsungs pa/ /bee du ra khyod mi bzad pa'i/ /las kyi 'bras bu longs spyod dam/ /tshul ngan dordza n+ya dza na bee sā ma ti smarya te twa yā/ /khru tī takhru ga te noshā sa ma nu skyed par chabyed pa yi/ /blo de khyod kyis 1dran nam ci/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs de thos nas/ /mi 6 gi rā pra bīta/ /tī bra pā pa gya bha ga bān byu bye te bi pu lo pha lo/ /i ti yi tshig gis des smras pa/ /bcom ldan mi bzad sdig pa yi/ /'bras bu rgya che longs spyod do/ /zhes pa ta su bru bā ṇa su dzā ti saṃ sma ra khyotpa re/ /ki me ta di ti pa pratstsha bhegru saṃ gha smra ba de yis (pyani/ /mchog tu skye ba dran pa las/ /skye bo mang pos 'di ci zhes/ /dge slong dge 'dun ma hā dza naḥ/ /ā:rya dṛtrī bha ga bān ā nande nā ba bhikṣu shā/ /taṅkand+ra ko dag la dris/ /de nas dge slong kun dga' bos/ /de yi las kyi dge mtshan las/ /ngo mtshar sngon byung tu kāsmṛṣṭaḥ sand+ra dzha sa ma bhā ṣa ta/ /udzdza ya tyā ma byund+raza bi du ro dris de la/ /bcom ldan kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa/ /sa bdag bi du ra zhes pa/ /mya ngan med bzhin nā ma khyu pa tiḥ/ /a sho ka i ba lo lākṣi tsa ra ṇa ha ti ko tu tī/ /sa mig g.yo mas/ /rkang pas bsnun pa'i dge mtshan can/ /'phags rgyal dag tu sngon byung gyur/ /nam ka dā tsidma dhū bṛṣpend+ra dhi ma dhu pa bāndha bee/ /bi la khā sā ni khā lo la zhig sbrang rtsi 'thungs pa'i gnyen⑤/ /dpyid dus rlung gi byugayo ba yis⑦/ /'khri shing yid 'ong nags la tā la li ta kā na ṣpe/ /tā byu mi pā li la la nāsta tra pusgotstsha yā ku lāḥ/ /tshal du/ /de ni bud med tshogs dang rtse/ /sa skyong bud med de dag der/ /me tog 'thu bas pashebyel bi tse ru byu pu rā rā ba ta ram̐ gi ta bi haṃ ga māḥ/ / : e kānta gyur pa/ /rkang gdub sgra yi spu'adab chags ni/ /rnam par bskyod cing rab tu 'khyam/ /der ni zhi ba la brten bzhin—/ / : dbeen par rnam par gnas pa yi zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/95—885

—— — — — — —— — — ——— ——— — —byedabyedatā bi ti ṣṭhabya kāddhāḥshādhe ri bā shra oṃ/ /pra hye ka budha martabyedrwa ṭwā shuḥpa ṛ dben par rnam par gnas pa yi/ /rang sangs rgyas ni dgra bcom gyis/ /yongs bskor mdzes bā ri tai / / sbi tai pa rlo ka ba dhe na dhyā na ste mi ta lo tsa rna / /ma rnams kyis mthong / /skyil krung bcas nas gnas gyur cing / /bsam gtan spyan ni g.yo med pa/ /tai dṛṭī sa ha mai bā saṃ bra sanda ma bha badma naḥ/ /dhyā nādhetā de shanta tai dhadzre de mthong 'phral la de dag rnams/ /yid ni rab tu dang bar gyur/ /bsam gtan mthar ni dag pa'i shu dhe mi bā mṛ tai / / pa ri tsā dro pa bi bi shu ཿ kṛ ta pa dā bhe chos—/ /bdud rtsi bzhin du ston de la/ /rkang par phyag byas de dag gis/ /yongs su bskor nas nye ba nda nāḥ/ /dṛ pa ste de sha ma bye tya ste rde dṛ ṭī ta durlu baṃ / /sha bar gnas/ /mi bdag yul der song ba yi1 / /bud med rnams der mngon phyogs mthong / /tshul rī ram̐ shubye shī khā rmā te ṣāṅgi gra ha mā di ta shata/ /te na bā be na bi pu lo kā la khrims dag ldan de dag gi/ /lus ni bcad pa rab tu bskos/ /sdig pa de yis 2 yangs pa yi/ /dus na ra ka saṃ ka re / / pa kyo yo bi kṛ tai ཿ sa tī rbhaghra mā rto du rā kṛ su dmyal ba nyam nga bar/ /rnams da 'gyur sems can gyis za zhing / /ngan pa'i dbyibs can 'di dag tiḥ / /a pā da masta kā ṣpe ka bi kā ri bra ṇa saṃ bha baiḥ/ /tīṇḍi kṛ mi ku leḥsmin—/ /mgo nas rkang bar du ma yi/ /rnam 'gyur rma las byung gyur pa'i/ /srin bu'i rigs kyis 5/kā yo pa shya tā su dzu gudzre tai/ / kaspradhe na ra ke bhughā tsaṇḍa ya twa mu pā khengs gyur pa/ /'di yi lus ni smad pa ltos/ /bskal pa'i mthar ni dmyal ba dag /spyad )nas ga ta ཿ / / pra bye ka bu dhe mṛ ga yā mbi shī lo yaṅgi ha ni byā ta / /gtum po nyid gyur te/ /rngon pa'i ngang tshul ldan pa 'dis/ /rang sangs rgyas ni gsod par 'gyur8 / /pu narna ra ka saṃ gre sha shīrya mā nā ya tā kṛ tiḥ/ /saṃ khyu tī te na kā le slar yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /lus can 9 rnam par nyams byed cing / /grangs las 'das pa'i ()5 88()

na pra yā mya ti ma nu 6 hūṃ/ /shāstu rutta ram̐ saṃ dzha gya ta taḥkṣa yi ta dus kyis ni/ /mi nyid rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /de nas sdog pa zad gyur te/ /nyon mongs me chen kilpi ṣaḥ/ /dīspyo kle sha na lojighāḥshā sa ṣpe pra bra dzi 6 ti/ /u byā de dag gis ni/ /yid byung ston pa ud ta ra/ /zhes pa'i bstan la ①rab 'byung 'gyur/ /de ni ④kā shi'i kā shi rā dza su kāddhā bhiḥpū dzi tasta taḥ/ /yīdhyā ko pe na sha rī ra la pāplu rgyal po yi/ /skyed mos tshal du mdzes mas mchod/ /phrag dog khro bas lus dag ni/ /chad pa drag pos tru gra ni gra haṃ/ /ta to gya tī pra duḥkhādzee ba ba pā lda bha bi 6 ti/ /i ti gcod par 'gyur/ /de rjes 'di yi sdug bsngal me/ /mi bzad rab tu nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa shāstudzee tsaḥkhru tā sazla bee rā gya ma ya thuḥ/ /ujughā nā ma tha bha ba bha ya ston pa'i gsung thos nas/ /thams cad chags bral ldan par gyur/ /de nas der ni ston pa'i gsung gi kle sha tsiddhā tu rā rde shā stu ཿ pū rje rā mṛ ta ba sa re ddhā dma ye sta rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgyun rdzogs pas/ /chags bral srid pa'i 'jigs pa'i nyon mongs bsam pas gzir tra te hūṃ/ /salnga ṭwā deḥku sha la pa li leḥpra bhya mā nā sha yā dzā tā baḥb de dag rnams/ /dga' ba dang ldan dge ba'i chu yis bsam pa rab tu rdzogs gyur cing / /rab zhi me kā pi pra sha maku su nā rā ma bhā dzee dza gā ma/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye tog dga' tshal ldan pa rnams kyi 1gdung ba ga shed song / /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī bi du rā pa dā rna ṣa ṭa sa pta chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bi du ra'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //'dab ste bdun cu rtsa drug pa'o// //kha loṅkasgo ṇa sattha gya gu ṇa laghā niḥpra dzā ya te/ /bha ba tya byu mi bsrun ④rab tu rgyas pa yis(sre/ /kun gyi yon tan nyams par byed/ /bdag nyid chen po'i 95—887

da yā yi ba pra bhā bstu ma hādma dzñā/ /ā tra mā yī ba no pādhe bha ga bārlu ga taḥmathu yis ni/ /mngon par dar ba nyid du 'gyur/ /ā tra mā yā'i nags kyi mthar/ /'byung po'i khang pu rā / / bhū tā ga ra gu hā ga rbha ta sbo dhyā na pā rā ya shā ཿ / /pa'i phug nang na/ /bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa sngon/ /bsam gtan rab tu skyong zhing gnas/ /ta tra tī zwa sha ni sgo ṭa nijuṣṭa dṛ ṣa karṣa kaḥ/ /te na dhyā na li ṣpe na gha der ni mi bzad lce 'bab pa/ /drag pos khyu mchog zhing pa bcom/ /des khya)ni bsam gtan la chags na shasdo pi na shu ta ཿ / / dhyā nārnye tha pra ba tsa dzwa shāstu nd+ra nd+ra ki rtswa pas| /sprin gyi sgra yang gsan 'a)ma gyur/ /de nas dal 'bab ge/ngogs su ni/ /bsam gtan mtha' ru ta ṭi/ /tsa tu raḥsgo tu mā dza grubyu hā rā dzā bhi dhwaḥpu ra/ /j-i ta rārgyu ston pa'i gsung / /nyan du rgyal po chen po ni/ /bzhi zhes brjod pa sngon pedu 'ongs/ /yul 'khor srung bi rū ṭwā khya bi rū pakṣa dha nā dhi pāḥ/ /te shīṇḍi ratna ku su māsta su pā do dang 'phags skyes po/ /mig mi bzang dang nor bdag go/ /de yi zhabs la de dag gis/ /phyag 'tshal pa ba ndi re/ /te bhyo hi tsārya dzā tī yo j-i ta rābye bi rū bhā kau/ /rin chen me tog gtor/ /de dag las ni 'phags pa'i rigs/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po//dā pa dhri ku rā dzā tī yo te ྾ swo tsi ta bhā ṣa yā/ /sadhedzre de sha ṣpe tsakre bha ga gzhan gnyis gdug pa'i rigs can te/ /de dag la ni dam chos dag /bcom ldan 'byung po dgongs pa bā rdzu ta bhā ba na ཿ / / ye na shā sa na dha rme 6 ba bhū pu ste bi shā yis—/ /rang la 'os pa'i skad kyis bstan/ /gang gis de dag bstan pa yi/ /chos la rab tu mkhas ra da ཿ / / shi kṣu pa da pra ṇa yi na ste ra tna tra ya mā bye tā ཿ / /par gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la rab brten cing / /babeeb pa'i gnas bzung de dag rnams/ /na tā bha ga ba taḥpā do bi ma ṣpe ste di baṃ ya yuḥ/ /te 6 yā te 6 bha ga bān bcom ldan zhabs la btud nas ni/ /gzhal med khang nas mtho ris song / /de dag song tshe bcom ldan 95 888

mthong zhing dga' bar gyur/ /de yi tsha bo shi la yang /pi ta dzee ba bi na yo shri taḥ/ /a nā gā mi pha lo dā re sa tya darsha na māpta bān/ /de bzhin 'dul ba la brten nas/ /bden pa mthong zhing rgya che ba/ /phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras thob 'gyur 11 //95byed889

to sā nu go bha ga ba taḥpra sande dhand+ra shā sa ṣpe/ /pra bra dzhai sa mu pā dā ya de dag 'khor bcas bcom ldan gyi/ /bstan pa'i chos la rab dang zhing / /rab tu byung ba blangs nas ni//shā bhya marta twa mā pa tu/ / ta tasta da ba shi ṭwā rmā tsa kruḥsu ga ta shā bsngags par 'os pa'i dgra bcom thob/ /de nas de yis 3/lhag rnams la/ /bde gshegs bka' yis 2)sa nāta/ /kahphi ṇaḥshā ri pu trabya moṅga spyo rtswarya de sha rmā/ /ma naḥbra pā da ma ka pi na/ /shā ri'i bu dang mo gal 1)byu/ /bu yis kyang ni bstan pa mdzad/ /kai na ④ya ka shi la ni(tha)/ /lo kya pa re kai ṣpe ya she ma yoḥ/ /tand+rattha pursā bha ga wān thrasgo bhigru bhi ra yid rab dang mthong de dag gis(6/ /sngon gyi bsod nams dge slong gis/ /dris shing bcom ldan 'das bhya dhwata/ /e to kṛ ha pa tī pūttha dzadma n+ya tsā ga nā bhi sgo/ /sa kṛ do dhand+ra kyis gsungs/ /sngon gyi skye bar ( 'di dag ni/ / bā rā ṇa sīr (2khyem bdag gnyis/ /ang ga a ga na ni ra to bā rā ṇa sngasbrarnya ba tuḥ/ /tsa ri ta bra hma tsasdu to kā shya pa sngarnyi ke zhes pa/ /grogs po chos la dga' bar gyur⑨/ /bla ma 'od srungs drung du ni/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad pu roḥ/ /paryanta pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na pā bhā sa rya pra shānta tī/ /ka thi ta mi ti de dag /mthar thug smon lam dag gis ni/ /da lta ⑪rab tu zhi nyid thob/ /de ltar thub mchog bsod ta thā ga te na pu bye mu ni ba ra yoḥ pra ṇi dhwa na dza ni ṣa mya/ /nams smon lam las skyes pa/ / de la 4stede bzhin gshegs pas bshad pa dag ni thos gyur nas/ /rab a bha ba da ba nyi ta pā shārnyi yusthā bha ba bhu dza gā bhe bha bā ya bhikṣu saṃ ghaḥ/ /tu zhi ba'i rigs pas srid pa'i lag 'gro ni/ /zil gyis ⑩mnan slad dge slong dge 'dun rtse gcig gyur//i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā sde bo bye sa tā ba da na kalpa la tā lnga kai ṣpe ya kā zhes 1shepa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing ba dā rna sa pta sa pta ti ta ma ཿ pa bee wa ཿ / / / /las kai ṣpe ya ka'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa bdun pa'o // //la95—890

uhūṃ ga shri ga ma pi ro ha ti ko tu ka su te ྾ pra bhā ba ma hi mā ma ha tai gang gi skabs gsum dbang phyug (she7la yang brtse 27ba dang ldan pa'i/ /mig ni zhi ba min pa zhi byed ma hārtaḥ/ /ye pā ta yi tya shi ba shaṃ pa ma na pra ga spyo treṣṭi da yā pra ṇi yo la dpa' lhung byed pa/ /chen po de dag rnams kyi mthu ni cher 'os chen po nyid/ /dge mtshan gyis ni rtse dī tri da she shwa re pi / / sa bhā sbo na ཿ pu rā sha kra ste di ba sgo mo shin tu mtho ba dag tu 'dzegs kyi/ /brgya byin mdun /zisar 'khod pa sngon/ /mtho ris nas lhung ti lakṣa ṇḍiḥ/ /spraṣṭa sau hā sa nohūṃ ge na ra nyi pra tya pa rya ta/ /su baṇḍi ru mtshan nyid kyis/ /reg cing seng ge'i gdan steng du/ /dga' ba rab tu thob ma gyur/ /de yi mgo la tsi rā ta su mo lo manda ra mā li kā/ / u pu byotpa nda tā ru ju shrī manda zhi7ra'i/ /phreng ba gser ldan mdzes pa ni/ /bsod nams ma yin 6bsgribs pa yis7 lang ri basthā na ṭwā ya yo/ /ya shaḥshubye bi lo pā ya ti la ka ta gya tsakri be/ /tsho'i dudapal bzhin nyams par gyur/ /de yi thig le grags pa ltar/ /dkar la nyams par bya ba'i sbad//a pa bā dā i ba na paḥpa rda swe do da binda baḥ/ /ā sande pa ta na snga rngul ⑨gyi chu thigs gsar pa yis/ /ngan smras bzhin du gnas dag byas/ /de ni ( 7sems ni bsams ⑪tha tsiste saṃ sakta tse ta saḥ/ /idhya ru ṣe ba pra ya yo ta snga dru ra ta ram̐ dṛ tiḥ/ /pa la/ /chags shing lhung la nye gyur pa/ /de yi bstan 15pa phrag dog gis/ /khros bzhin rab tu ring shu tsa ཿ pa ri tsi tai dṛ ṣṭa ta spru tse tsa ki tā sha ṭī / / ā bar song / /mya ngan yongs 'dris de mthong nas/ /'jigs pa'i sde 4snye sogs kyis smras pa/ /ltung ba pande sminde pa ta ṣpe tsint+ra tā ma ba ladza rna/ /a lo ggu nāste lo ke 6 na dag la nye ba ⑫'dir/ /rten ni rab tu bsam par mdzod/ /'jig rten rnams la rgud pa yis/ /pa dā mi ti nibya yaḥ/ /ta bā pi dza ga hūṃ pa kyurya di mā gre sha bi pru ṣaḥ/ /bgom lhoshebya min pa med ces des/ /gang zhig nyon mongs thigs pa 'di/ /'gro ba'i bdag po khyod la 95—891

sa sba thā kha lu bai mu khyu ཿ da bee tyā bee 6 ya tna ta ཿ / / ma ha dhi ཿyang / /nges par rnam kun phyir phyogs pas/ /'bad pa yis ①ni btsal bcal spyonas/ /lhang ba yon saṃ ga mitstsharnyi gu ṇa luddhā i bā ba daḥ/ /a ba tīrya swa yo tā bta dzee bu tan la sred cing / /chen po rnams dang 'grogs par 'dod/ /khyab ①bdag rang nyid 'dzam gling du/ /dī paṃ twa yā bi sgo/ /mṛ gya hūṃ shra ma ṇaḥkashyibye sa na rakṣa ṇa kṣa ma/ /re zhig bobs la khyod kyis ni/ /rgud pa bsrung bar bzod pa yi/ /dge sbyong ④'ga' zhig bstsal pebar pra bhā ba bi pu loṅka rṣaḥ khru yenta shra ma shā ཿ ki la / / yu 6nta ku mdzod—/ /gang dag dge bas bgrod spyobyed cing / /dge ba nyid kyis sbyor byed pa/ /dge sbyong mthu ni sha le re ba ye ྾ ku sha la gā mi naḥ/ /i ti thra yā ba tsaḥkhru tā ta the rgya che zhing / /khyad par 'phags pa rngo7 grags pa thos/ /zhes pa dga' ma'i tshig thos nas/ /de bzhin kyughā ma rubee ti/ /kṣi ta ma bye tya pa pratstsha shra ma shā kle sha saṃ kṣa yo/ /sha kra zhes smra dulha yi bdag /sa la mngon phyogs nyon mongs ni/ /'jil ba dge slong rnams la dris/ /brgya pra ṇa yi mā tre ṇa te pra bhā bā bhi mā ni niḥ/ /ba bhū bu ruñdza li bya grwastattha byin gyis ni dris ⑨/tsam gyis/ /mthu yis mngon khengs de dag gis/ /thal mo sbyar byas de nyid la/ /rja ma na tā na nāḥ / / te kuttha rnyi ka rja rakṣu mā me ba pra ṇa phyag btsal rngu bzhin ras btud par gyur/ /gang zhig bdag nyid la 'dud pa/ /de yi ji ltar srung marnyi ye/ /pa tidhyā te ti ma ru tā ma bhaghā shaḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /ta taḥbyed 'gyur—/ /zhes bsams ⑪lha yi bdag po ni/ /re ba nyams pas rang gnas song / /de nas de yi sa su ga tai dzñā tā saṃ pāpta pa ra mā mṛ tai/ /pra tyā sande ni pa ta ṣpe ba ri tā ṇa bde gshegs ni/ /mchog gi bdud rtsi thob shes nas/ /ltung ba spyorab tu nye ba ni/ /yongs su skyob pa ma ma tya ta/ /ind+ra mā la gu hā gasgo sbi tai po tha ta thā ga tai/ /te dzo dag tu bsams/ /de nas de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /dbang po'i phreng ba'i phug nang na/ /de bzhin 95—892

dhwa tu sa mā parghaṃ ya yo trahūṃ sa hā nu geḥ/ /gu hārnyi ka ma thā sā tyā pa ha gshegs pa me khams la/ /snyoms zhugs gnas lhapa lta ru song / /de nas bde sogs bdag po des/ /sha ṭī pa tiste taḥ/ /spru tse pañtsa shī khaṃ nā ma gandhasgo su ta mā da rā ha/ /te dzo 'phral la phug dang nye bar phyin/ /zur phud lnga pa zhes pa yi/ /dri za'i 2bu la gus pas smra①/ /de dhwa tu sa mā pa.oṃ bha ga badhe ta thā ga tai/ /swa ka khā kau sha le na hūṃ bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /me yi khams la snyoms zhugs pa/ /khyod ni rang gi sgyu rtsal la/ /pra bo dha yi tu marta si/ / u ba rlu rlu tya kā le yaḥ pra bhe pa tya ni mkhas pas rtogs pa pya bya bar 'os/ /gang zhig dus min nyer bgrod 'a7dang / /ma brjod par ni thunang be di taḥ/ /a nā sha ya dzñāḥs pa tā ma ba mā na su bhā dza rna/ /i tyāktaḥsu ra rā dze 'jug dang / /bsam pa shes pa min pa de/ /dam pa rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /zhes brjod lha yi na dhī mārgantarbha dā ra kaḥ/ /bai ḍūrya daṇḍa ma ka raḥjo rde su swa ra pār rde/ /rgyal po yis/ /blo gros ldan pa dri za'i ⑦bu/ / bai ḍūrya yi 87dbyug pa can/ /rgyud mang lkusgra snyan len du swa bhā ba ma dhu ro dha ra ra myu bheḥstu ti gī ti bhiḥ / / sa bi bo bcug /rang bzhin gyis snyan yid du 'ong / /bstod dbyangs dga' ba dang bcas pas/ /de yis ṅkurgya dzi rja tsakre darsha nā ba pa ram̐ ha reḥ/ /ta taḥpra bi shya su ga tai de bai sa ha rgyal ba sad byas te/ /'phrog byed lta ba'i go skabs bye/ /de nas lha dang bcas pa yi/ /mchod sbyin sha ta kra tuḥ / /da darsha ha ste dza nan ba rṣarnyi pra sha mā mṛ tai/ /brgya pa rab zhugs te/ /rab zhi'i lnga4bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa/ /dga' ba skyed byed bde gshegs sa pra shā maḥ shāstu na kha da dzee ṇa mādzā rna/ / tsa kā ra mo li ma nd+ra bltas⑫—/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu btud pa des /—lnga/ /mgo yi manda ra ba'i gosanyurta/ /ston pa'i zhabs kyi ra ma ka rande na bā da yoḥ/ /ta tasta gya pra biṣṭasu pra pā rda bi da dhe dzi naḥ/ /sen mo yi/ /me long dag ni rab tu phyis/ /de nas rab zhugs de la ni/ /gang gis bden pa mthong ba 95—893

sa tya darsha nābye na dhand+ra na tsakṣurba khyu ba paḥ/ /pa ri sgo taḥs sa ha la—/ /chos kyi mig ni 'byung gyur pa'isha1/ /bka' drin rgyas pa de yis chamadzad/ /yongs ltung de yi sā swa ya bee bā sa na māpta bān/ /te na pu rgya pra bhā be na pra shānta sgo 'phral la ni/ /rang gi stan nyid thob par gyur/ /bsod nams mthu ni de dag gis/ /skung ba'i mtshan nyi lakṣa ṇaḥ/ /ya bāsmyu baṃ sa su ga lta sha re bye sha ra rde ga taḥ/ /a ti nyid rab tu zhi/ /ji srid 'tsho bar bde bar gshegs/ /skyabs snyesgo'os de la skyabs su song / /bdag ni krādho ha mi trughā ta mā oṃ dngha ya yo di baṃ/ /la le tsā tumyu ru su hūṃ da do pañtsa rab thar ces brjod nas/ /de la zhus nas mtho ris song / /tum bu ra ④yi bu mo mdzes/ /zur phud shi khā ya baḥ/ /ri ṇa badku ru te tsiddhā mu pa kār ka ṇa pa tsā/ /shakra su lnga pa la des byin/ /dam pa rnams ni phan pa'i cha/ /bu lon bzhin du sems par byed/ /dge ba thob ku sha la bā smya pra tya gro sgye ta bi sma ma ཿ / / bhi kṣu bi rbha ga bāsmṛ ṣṭa ཿpas brgya byen ni/ /gsar du 'khrungs pas ya mtshan pa/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /sa ttha dzha stu na bhā ṣa ta / /sho bhā ba dhyā pu rā sho bhā khyaḥ thra thi bī thams cad mkhyen pas der gsungs pa/ /grong khyer mdzes ldan dag tu sngon/ /sa yi bdag po bskal pa tiḥ/ /kra kutstshanda gya shā ri rasgru paṃ shāstu ra kā ra yata/ /takhyuṇḍi pu rgya bzang gis/ /ston pa log par dad sel gyiye/ /sku yi mchod rten rab tu byas/ /de yi bsod nams pra ṇi dhwa na yo gā pābeeḥs rā dzā ti di be shwa ra two/ /dhadzre nu barghaṃ bha ga bambi smon lam rdzogs ldan pas/ /rgyal po des ( ni lha yi dbang nyid thob/ /'byor pa'i chos kyis ⑦bcings bhū ti mu ste ti bā rji ma na ya nd+ra shādhi / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra pi ra zhes gsungs nas ni/ /bcom ldan gsung ni rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee shakre tsā ba nā ba dā na maṣṭa pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las brgya byen ltung ba'i rtogs pa 95—894

sabee ti ta maḥpabee waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //sdi bhibi mo hi ta ma te 1 ti rākṣa sī bhiza tta pra thra tta ma na saḥ su bud med blo yi srin mo rnams kyis ) blo gros rmongs byas shing / /bde ba 'dod pa nyid kyis yid ni kha rpāñtsa ye ba/ /kle shaḥpa tanta sa ha sā pu ru ṣa su te te gatstsharnyi nā ma pa nor la zhugs gyur pa/ /skyes bu gang zhig rab zhi dang bral zhi bar mi bgrod pa/ /de de nges par 'phral bi nā pra sha oṃ sha mo ye / / shā ba hūṃ shā hma ṇa ཿ pū za jo ba sha sthā la nyon mongs dag tu lhung bar 'gyur/ /gang gis lan tshod byed dag ni/ /thos pa brjid rte cing tshangs bhi sgo bta/ /ba ya sondha khru tā dhyā yī bra hma tsa.oṃ tsā ra yaḥ/ /sa dza rā sha spyod spyad/ /bram ze 'tsho ba bde zhes pa/ /mnyan yod du ni sngon byung gyur/ /mdza' bas gnyen gyis ba lastsa khruḥste hādma: rnyi ra nī taḥ/ /dhadzre mārga nu ro dhe na bi da dhe dā ra saṃ gra haṃ//gsol btab pa'i/ /rgan po sma ra khra bo de/ /chos kyi lam gyi ngo dag tu/ /bud med rab tu bzung bar pasbyi ta ra li kā nā mā ta rā bhā ta ra lakṣe shā/ /na ba saṃ sgo ga lubha byas—/ /longs spyod gsar pa la chags de'i/ /chung ma g.yo ldan ma zhes pa/ /dar la bab cing mig gya ta snga ti da yi tā bhā bta/ /ta snga dzwa ro pa me tasminda ru ciḥsu ta rā ma bhūta/ /g.yo ma/ /shin tu yid 'ong nyid du gyur/ /de ni de la rim bzhin du/ /shin tu sred pa bamin par gyur//a bhakta rakta saṃ sakta bi raklu e ba yo ṣi taḥ/ /sā tsinta ya da rarlo yi bud med mi gus la chags shing / /yang dag chags la chags bral nyid/ /des (5)bsams kun tu mi dza rā shā ra shi ro ru ha ཿ / / ma ma yo ba na da bye smi nda pu byo 'phrogs pa'i/ /rga bas skra dkar ldan pa'i khyo/ /bdag gi lang tsho'i dregs 'di la/ /bsod nams pa naḥpa tiḥ/ /dṛdhe gya ta ru bhā sgo gaḥsha rī rakṣa ya sru tsa kaḥ/ /ke sha min pas nye bar gnas/ /rgan pos yegazhon nu ma spyod pa/ /lus ni nyams pa go byed dag /rga bas skra 95——895

tind+ra hiḥ/ /kṛ ha byā gā ra baspyosdi sand+rasta tārba saṃ pa daḥ/ /a bhū ṣa ṇa dga' zhing / /bud med khyim gyi bya bar chags/ /de ni hu 7don kun phun sum tshogs/ /las dang bral ba ma nasbra ra ma li na ko ṇa lbo dzā ga rna bi shīṇḍi sha ya nā sa na spu ṭi ta pā ri ṅgā rnams kyi khyim ni dga' ston longs spyod nyams gyur cing / /rgyan med gos med bud med dag ni zur phug dī gha ṭi/ /a dā sa ma nu pa ska re tsi ra ni thratta mand+ra swa sna kṛ haṃ bi ra ta dri ma can na zhen/ /khri dang mal stan rnam par nyams shing chu sgod chag ḍakyepa'i sgra dang ldan/ /'bangs ka dzre rṇa bha ba ti bha sna sgo go tpa baṃ / / i hphu kta ཿ sa ta sā bi praḥmed yo byad med cing yun ring kwazho srub sgra ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de yis de brjod bram ze de/ /nor pra tesbe dra bi khorlu kha/ /pa tarnyi bi ṣa ya shwa bye ṣṭa pi yo ṣidma shrī kṛ tāḥ/ /la mngon du thuphyogs te song / /bud med kyis ni dbang byas rnams/ /yul gyi g.yang sa dag tu lhung / /sa sā ga rāhaṃ ba su dzñā : hūṃ la bha pra nyi gra haḥ/ /kā le na swa pu dzā pā ya saṃ pūṇḍi de yis rgyanor 'dzin rgya 'umatsho'i mthar/ /'khyams nas sbyin pa thob gyur te/ /gser dang gos ni rdzogs ka na ka sba ra ཿ / / kṛ ho ṅka rko ṅka rā lnga nta ཿ pu ri gyur pa—/ /dus kyis )rang gi grong khyer song / /de nas khyim 'dod tshogs kyis de/ /song ba grong paryanta kā na ṣpe/ /sha rī ra mā tre she kho byubyā sru byermu ṣi to tha saḥ/ /a nasgo mtha'i nags tshal du/ /chom rkun pa yis bcom gyur nas/ /lus tsam lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /bde ba pārdzi to gyarjaḥsā maze na su khabee nā/ /ka ro tya nitstsha yā jo tuhma ru don gnyer nus pa yis/ /don med nor ni nyer bsgrubs kyang / /mya ngam chu yi thigs pa bzhin/ /byed bā ri ka ṇa dhi tai/ /so tsinta ya da ho yatna da bi beehaṃ ma yārdzi tai/ /po bzhed pa min pas byed/ /des bsams kye ma 'bad pa yis/ /bdag gis 2)nor ni bsgrubs gyur kyang //a bhā gya yo gā ya tai me swasna darsha na tu lya tai/ /shu n+ya pā ṇi dha nābee n+yaḥbadag ni skal dang mi ldan pas/ /rmi lam mthong dang mtshungs par gyur/ /nor ni don gnyer chung ma yi//95—897

pasbyiḥpā byā ha madhi rka/ /rgo dzre bā sba ba sā no gra bi ṣiḥpa ru ṣa bhā ṣi taiḥ/ /gan du lag stong bdag phyin na/ /smad pa drag po'i dug ldan pa'i/ /tshig rtsub brjod pas bdag mi 'tsho//tasthā di hai ba me sa ryaḥpā she nodmandha rgo hi tai/ /dā ri dro pa dra ba hrū re byā de slad bdag ni 'di nyid du/ /'phral la zhags pas bcings pa phan/ /dbul ba'i nyer 'tshe drag po shaste na sa te kṛ haṃ / /i ti saṃ tsidhya sa la tā pā sha kabye n+ya bee yis—/ /khyim du bud med mtshon mi bzod/ /ces bsams de yis tshutsho'akhri shing gi/ /zhags pa dag ni sha yata/ /tī pra gre sha bi ṣaṇḍa dzā ni dha rgo bantu saṃ ga maḥ/ /a tānta mgrin par bkod/ /nyon mongs drag pos nyen rnams kyis/ /gnyen dang phrad pa 'chi ba yin/ /skabs re kṛ pā sen dhu bha ga bān bhū ta bhā ba naḥ/ /duḥkhaṃ dzñā tā gya sattha der bcom ldan brtse ba yi/ /rgya mtsho 'byung po la dgongs pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pas de yis ⑤ni/ /snyosta dadzee ba na mā ya yo/ /da ya yā shā se taste na tyakta pa sha ma tha dwo dzaḥ/ /sdug bsngal shes nas nags su byon/ /de nas de yis khruganyis skyes ni/ /brtse bas dbugs phyung zhags ta sde rghaṃ ni dha mā dā ya tai pra ṇa mya ya yo kṛ haṃ / / ta su bhā ryā pa btang / /de yis byin krupa'i gter blangs nas/ /de la phyag 'tshal khyim du song / /de yi chung ma dha ṣpe nā pi na dza gā mā nu ku la tai/ /pa ra saṃ sparsha rā gi n+yastu rngu tyaze nor byus kyang / /rjes su mthun rgyapa nyid ma gyur/ /gzhan gyi reg pa la chags pa'i/ /bud med nor na naste yaḥ/ /sa kā le na ma hā re bha sgo ge pyubyisna ma na saḥ/ /a tsinta gyis tshim mi 'gyur/ /longs spyod rtsom pa che la yang / /dus kyis 'uyid ni chags bral des/ /bsam pa ya da ho nāste saṃ sā ra tai twa taḥsu khaṃ/ /dā ri dā tu bye ki mi bāste du khaṃ dha nā dzā ni kye ma 'khor ba na/ /de nyid du na bde ba med/ /dbul dang mtshungs pa'i sdug bsngal ci zhig yod/ /duḥkha ta re ta to pi/ /dha no pa sgo gaḥsu kha le sha dighaḥpa de pa de de bas kyang ni nor bsgrub (dzwarab sdug bsngal/ /nor gyi longs spyod bde ba'i chas bsgos pa/ /gnas 95—898

duḥ kha sha ta ni sru te / / bi rakta shyitta yi two ti sa ga tā dze ta dang gnas su sdug bsngal brgya phrag skyedahu // /de ltar chags bral rab bsams te/ /rgyal byed tshal du kā na rna/ /bha ga ba tai bha bostsodhri shāsta ram̐ sha ra rde ya yo/ /ta snga sha yi song nas des/ /srid pa bcad slad bcom ldan 'das/ /ston pa la ni skyabs su song / /de yi bsam sā nu sha yo tsa dhwa sum̐ dzñā tā ga nyi ta thā/ /bha ga bān dhand+ra bye ṣa rdzu bha ba pa bag la nyal/ /khams dang de bzhin 'gro mkhyen nas/ /chos kyi sman ni bcom ldan 'das/ /srid ro ga bhi ṣalda do/ /sa dṛṣṭa sa tyaḥpra bra dzhai sa mā dā ya pra sā dī rmā/ /pa'i nad kyi sman pas byin/ /bden mthong de yis rab byung ni/ /rab tu dang ba yang dag blangs/ /sand+ra kle sha pra harṣarja marta two sa ma bāpta bān/ /ta su tā madhū haṃ sesnye nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa'i slad/ /dgra bcom nyid ni thob par gyur/ /de yi grub pa rmad byung de//dṛṣṭa bi pu la bi sma yeḥ / / bhigru bhesgo ga bādṛ ṣṭa sta j-iṭwā nta ma bhā mthong nas ya mtshan rgyas pa yi bu/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /de yi sngon byung rab gsungs ṣa ta/ /pu rā ma hend+ra se no bhūbye rā ṇa snga na re shwa ra/ /ya sgo gā sadzee sa two gu da pa—/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ①mi yi dbang / /dbang chen sde ④ni sngon byung ste/ /sems can kun la gang gis ma ba da yi tā bha ba ta/ /ya dzu naḥpa ra de she bhyaste bye ku pa ti ni—/ /brtse ba mchog nyid yid 'ong gyur/ /bdag po ngan pas rab gdungs pa/ /yul gzhan nas dā bi taḥ/ /tstsha yā dṛkṣa mi bā bye tya sadmārgasbi ma shi shri yata/ /'ongs skye bo yisakhye)/ /lam gnas gang gi khye)grib bsil gyi/ /ljon pa bzhin du mngon phyogs bstan()7 / /ka dā tsittha ti pā madherni rudhe na ga ro pi saḥ/ /a kro dhaḥsattha ni dha ni na nam zhig pha rol rgyal phran gyi3/ /grong khyer dag ni bkag gyur kyang / /khro med de yis 1 g.yul dag ni//yuste bi da dhe dhi yo/ /tai bi dzñā ya ni rudmā haṃ bi raghā sattha marnyi ḍā/ /thams cad gsod la blo ma bsgrubs/ /de ni spro ba med shes nas/ /chags bral blon po thams cad kyis/ /95—899

lupta tra pi na mā dā ya ba bhū baḥsha tru saṃ shra yāḥ/ /a tha sthā ṇi ba byebye ga tyakta sred pas nor ni blangs byas te/ /dgra bo dag la brten par gyur/ /de nas srog chags gsod pa la/ /rā byeḥ sa bhu pa ti ཿ / / a la kṣi ta ཿ kṣa ma kṣe tra me kā ki kā na yid byung rgyal srid rab btang (1nas/ /sa yi bdag po bzod pa'i zhing / /gcig pu ma chor nags su āoṃ ya yo/ /pra bhu bhaste sa musmṛ bye sa two lalja tsa dudzdza nāḥ/ /a mā tyāḥpra ti sā song / /rje 37la gus dang sems can la/ /ngo tsha rab btang ngan pa yi/ /blon po chags pas ldong ④ mārnyi loddhāddhā : kri re dṛ paṃ/ /na ba snga dṛ pa ti pādhi na bā e ba dzee rnams kyis/ /pha rol rgyal phran rgyal por byas/ /mi bdag gsar pa'i ngos na ni/ /gsar pa nyid du dzrembhi re/ /swa sgyu mi tyā gi mbi lasne ma no tsi tya tu ke pa lo/ /te na ba gya kṣi rnam par 'phel/ /rang gi rje bo btang rnams la/ /'os pa min pa 'ba' zhig ldan/ /de dag sa bdag ti sa terwa rasbiddhā ri tā bye ram̐/ /khe dā dāttha na mubyi shya dza gurni shwa gsar pa yi/ /sgo srung ④rnams kyis yun ring bkag /skyo 2bas bdag nyid la mtshon te/ /shugs byung su ladzhai tāḥ/ /ma hend+ra se na paṃ tya bye pe sha lo su la dzha pra bye/ /pa ra ngo tshas glu blangs pa/ /rje bo mnyes gshin rnyed sla ba/ /dbang chen sde ni rab btang nas/ /sdig can ma dā ri pa yi pā pāḥshā pa tā saṃ sa hā ma te/ /tyakta shrī dza na kaḥsu rā bdag cag gzhan sgo na/ /dmod pa'i gdung ba bzod par byed/ /dpal ni skyed byed lha dang lha min mi su ra na ra byā kiṇḍi rahphoṅka ra sa swatstshaḥpa ya saṃ ni byeḥpre thu ta raḥshu tyā sha rnams rin chen tshogs kyis rgyas par byed/ /chu gter dri med shin tu rgya che de ni khog ⑥pa stong pa khyod ye na twa yā/ /he dī tworlu kha shaṃ kha mūkho ku pa te dā re dhu nā lo ba pe tū: ma shwa kha kyis btang / /da lta bdag ngan sgo la brten cing gyen du phyogs thob rmongs pa'i dud dag kye/ /kha la le na phuskṛ ta mu khasthā ram̐ ki mā kranda pi/ /na ba rā dzñā ta pi tī pra madhri brlang pos phud byas cho nge drag dza/po ci zhig la sgrogs mi smrar 'u'adug /de ltar rab gdung blon po rnams//95—900

ṇa mi tī sho tsi tsā/ /ma hend+ra se na tsand+ra su smṛ ha sandarsha ni bha bta/ /rgyal srid gsar pa'i tsha 1 gdung la/ /dbang chen sde yi zla ba ni/ /rab tu blta bar 'dod par gyur/ /asminda ba sa re rā snyoḥsha mā rā ma ba nasbi teḥ/ /sa mbi saṃ kau shi ko skabs der rgyal po zhi ba yi/ /dga' tshal nags na gnas pa dang / /nye bar bram ze slong ba yi/ /ko'u (snyenā ma drwahma rtobye sa mā ya yo/ /sa bi shāntaḥkṣa tā ti byaḥpha la mū lend+ra tī bhu dzā/ /shi ka zhes pa 'ongs/ /'bras bu rtsa bas sa bdag gis/ /mgron byas ngal bsos de la ni/ /de yis thraṣṭiḥsngo ba tsā bi na yātta dā ga ma na kā ra khaṃ/ /sabyebee pāzwa saṃ kalpa kalpa 'ongs pa'i ①rgyu mtshan dag /dul bas dris pa 'u rab smras pa/ /slong ba'i tshogs kyi kun rtog dugi/ /thrakṣasma hā pha waṃ/ /ma hend+ra se āoṃ gatshwa mi da ri bye dmā tsi rtu dṛ paṃ/ /'bras bu che ldan dpag bsam shing / /mi bdag dbang chen ⑥ sde la bdag /dbul ba yis ⑦ni slong du e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tista ma pra bhā ṣadruḥkhi taḥ/ /drwahmadma tend+ra se no 'gro—/ /de thos mi bdag sdug bsngal dang / /ldan pas de la rab smras pa/ /bram ze nga ni byadabang chen haṃ dhismrambi ra hi ta shri yā/ /bi pa rī te na bi bye nā mbi to haṃ bi pa rī ta tai/ /sde—/ /dpal dang bral bas bdag smad do/ /slong ba khyod ni phyir phyogs las/ /gang la gdung ba ster baimu khyu rya su saṃ tā sa madhī tī dā tu mā ga taḥ/ /ki niḥpha le na ba du 'ongs/ /sgrub byed phyin ci log las ni/ /phyin ci log nyid bdag gis thob/ /gang gi re ba nyams su ྾ shuṣka dṛsgo pa ma su me/ /ā shā bha ga ba ri smra lda mu khaṃ pa shya ti pa yi/ /slong ba'i bzhin log mthong gyur pa/ /shing skam ⑨lta bu bdag gi lus/ /'bras bu med pa dag yobee naḥ/ /i ti rā dza ba oṃ khru tā dī dzabyu: ma no ra thaḥ/ / tsi re ṇa gis ⑪ ci/ /zhes pa rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /rdo ba ⑪bsnun bzhin gnyis skyes ni/ /re ⑫thag chad saṃ dzñā mā pā rya shi khā ha ta mi bā pra bīta/ /a bhā godzre ma byu pā la bha bāmbi bha pas yun ring na/ /'du shes thob nas rab smras pa/ /bdag la skal ba med pa yis/ /sa skyong khyod 95—901

pra ti sā manta ste nā bhā tai ma tī pa ti/ /tabyeddhā tai tsa bi dzñā ya bi smi ta yis ①khrid pa de/ /pha rol rgyal phran dag gis mthong zhu / /de yi byung tshul thos gyur nas/ /ya mtshan pra sha shaṃ pa tai/ /sa bi pā ya dha rgo da tā swasgra ṣpe bhū mi pa ti saḥ/ /tsa ra khyo li gyur pas de la bsngags/ /bram ze la ni nor byin nas/ / : rang gi gnas su sa bdag de/ /zhabs la : rang gi gnas su sa bdag de zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bsgrigs pa slar rgya dpe rted na zhus dag byed/na mu ku ṭa ste pra sā rya n+ya bee sha yata/ /ma nu dza pa ti ra haṃ ma hend+ra cod pan gyis gtugs gyete/ /dang bar byas nas de yis shābakod/ /mi yi bdag po dbang chen sde ni nga se no dha na bi hi tasta ya e ya kau shi kodhīḥ/ /pu na ra pi ba sa e nyid de/ /gang 'dis slong ba ko'u ③shi ka'i nor dag skyebasgrubs/ /slar yang de nyid kho na 'tsho ba ba dzi ba shasthā tsa ri ta mi nyi swa pa dā hri tai dzi ṣpe na/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bee ra tsi tā bde ba'o/ /zhes pa'i spyod pa rgyal bas rang la dper brjod do/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā rna kalpa la tā yī ma he nd+ra se nā ba dā na mū pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dbang chen sde'i rtogs pa nā shi ti ta maḥpalla baḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //nobye ga mā yanta ka dbye mā nāḥshikṣa gra he ṇa pi hi haṃ ba darnyi/ / gdungs par tshugyur kyang yid 'byung mi 'gyur zhing / /bslab pa bzung ba yis kyang phan pa brjod//pa ro pa kā re 6 ha ṭha pra briṭwāḥsantaḥs hedhe ji sha mātpa rpā hūṃ/ /pu ra pu gzhan la phan pa dag la cher zhugs pa/ /dam pas mchog tu bdag nyid gdung ba bzod/ /sngon tshe randa raḥ shrī mān thra ya gya thra ya kā mya yā/ / sa khyurgandharbha rā dza su dpal ldan 'byer 'jig ni/ /dga' bar 'dod pas / nudaga' ba yi/ /grogs po dri za'i ⑨ rgyal po ni/ /95—903

su pri ya su kṛ haṃ ya yo/ /sa ta tra pū dzi ta te na ba hu mā ṣpe na bhū ya sā/ /rab dga' dag gi khang par phyin/ /de yis rmyeder ni mchod pa dag /shin tu che zhing mang bas mchod/ /āṭwā sa nasta ma ba dadre paḥpra ṇa yi batpa laḥ/ /e hi su pri ya gatstsha mdza' gcugs 37mnyes gshin ldan pa'i lha/ /stan dul 'khod des de la smras/ /rab dga' tshur shog sa baḥthra thi bī thra thi bī pa teḥ/ /dzā taḥshurjo da nā khya su pu traḥpu rgya ma la 'dong / /sa yi bdag po bsod nams kyi/ /chu gter chen bo zas gtsang zhes/ /bya ba'i sras su ho da byeḥ/ /pābhā sha mā mṛ tai te na dza ga tsā ku sha khā ya saḥ/ /tata saṃ rab 'khrungs pa/ /de yis rab zhi bdud rtsi thob/ /dge ba'i beed du 'gro la des/ /de ni yang dag bi bhā shaṃ ku ru te ka ri 6 tyā ba yo ra pi/ /ma yā saṃ ti pra bī shā yī yo dzi tā 'god par mdzad/ /yu cag la yang mdzad par 'gyur/ /da lta bdag gis rgyud mang ④la/ /glu gī ti sā ri zla/ /ka tha gatstsha mi partswaṅge duḥka ri ṣa bha bee 6 ti/ /dbyangs rgyun ni rab tu sbyar/ /ji ltar bdag 'gro phyin 2 nas ni/ /bdag la bya ba dka' bar 'gyur/ /i kyuktaste na ma gha bāmbi ma nāḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /bi ṣa yā sakta tsiṭwā zhes pa des 'ubarjod brgya byin ni/ /yid byung rang gi 3gnas su song / /sems ni yul khrul chags dzā ku sha khā bhe ra tiḥku taḥ/ /a ṭwā ta re martu lo ka ku shaṃ puzlo rnams la/ /dge la mngon dga' ga la yod/ /skabs der sdom brtson brtul zhugs can/ /rab bzang sa rasta ṭi/ /u dum ba ra ba na tasbo su bha dru khyo ya ti bri taḥ/ /byaste na mi yi 'jig rten gyi/ /ku sha'i grong khyer mtsho yi 'gram/ /u duswā spura'i nags na gnas/ /de yi u bairmu ku la kaiḥs dṛṣṭi dudza ra dru mān/ /bisma yohphulla na ya naḥsu tsi re dum bā ⑫ra'i shing / /me tog gsar pas khyab pa mthong / /mig ni ya mtshan gyis rgyas pas/ /shin tu sa ma tsinta yata/ /dzi na dzadma ni dza yadhe tsakra brturbha pe bi bā/ /yang dag yun ring bsams/ /u dum bā 1)ra'i nags tshal 'di/ /rgyal ba 'khrungs na me tog dpal/ /95byed90 4

a smand+ra dusba ra pa ṣpe nā n+ya thā mu ku la bhi yaḥ/ /ma mai ba pu bye 'byung zhing ①'khor los sgyur ba dag /'byung na yang ngo gzhan 1du min/ /yang na bdag gi bsod ra tha bā saṃ dzā ta mi da yasgru tai/ /su bha drashyinta yi te ti ba bhu bā nams kyis/ /rmad byung 'di ni yang dag skyes/ /zhes pa bsams nas ①rab bzang ni/ /kun dga' nanda nirbha raḥ/ /a thā mju pa ti ga twa su pri yo pu na ra bra bīta/ /rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /de nas slar yang 'chi med ④bdag /song nas rab dga' dag la smras/ /ni dza kāryā dhi godmo gāḥpa ra kābye 6 sa dha baḥ/ /e hi su thra ya gatstsha baḥdam pa rang gi bya ba bas/ /gzhan gyi bya bar brtson pa lhag /sa gzhi ⑤zla ba bde gshegs kyis/ /sgo ti kṣi ti ta lend+ra nā/ /sande sha rmā shu byend+ra shwa su ga te na pra kā shi lta/ /bstan pa 'od kyis duthams cad ni/ /rab tu gsal ba'i sa gzhi la/ /rab dga' tshur shog 'u cag tai pu thra yo ba dedrwa bi rpā zla lnga gī ti sā re shā/ /yo dzi to yasma yā 'dong / /de la rab dgas smras pa lha/ /rgyud mang ④la ni glu dbyangs rgyun/ /bdag gis rab tu sbyar pabyukhru ka rā ṇa bha bi bye ti/ /i tyā ka: ma ra pa tirya yo smra na ma no ra thaḥ/ /ba 'di/ /phyi nas bya ba sla mi 'gyur/ /zhes thos 'chi med bdag po ni/ /yid la re ba nyams par gyur//a yo tna pa na tai tī na pu ju ཿ pi ba rnyi nā mri tai / / uhphu lla 'bad med bdud rtsi nyer gnas pa/ /bsod nams dman rnams 'thung ba min/ /dus kyis ①u dum ku su mā mo da saṃ pū ri ta di ganta ram̐/ /kā le no drusba ra ba rna su bha dro pi bā ⑨ra'i nags/ /me tog rab rgyas dri bzang gis/ /phyogs mtshams kun tu khengs gyur pa⑪/ /rab bya lo ka yata/ /so tsinta yadzha ba bye tabyi kā se ku su saṃ da rna/ /bzang gis kyang mthong bar gyur/ /de yis ⑪bsams pa me tog gi/ /tshal ni rnam par rgyas pa 'di/ /dhadzre pra bste na shustudzdza ye nā tsakra btī naḥ/ /mahphu ju rna pra bha ba tā ni ston pa dam chos ston pa dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i ⑫rgyal la 'gyur/ /yang na bdag gi bsod nams 95—905

khi lo pu྾ tai ba rna/ /i ti tsiddhā ya tasta su dadzee dī ti ra dzā ya ta/ /mthus—/ /ma lus tshal ni me tog rgyas/ /zhes pa sems pa de la ni/ /dregs dang dga' ba rab tu skyes//a tha buddhā nyi sgo bye tya shra ma rjarta tā ma ga taḥ/ /ṛrje tsakre pa rā dzi bye tai de nas dge slong kleshedagra bcom thob/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya mngon phyogs te/ /de ni rdzu 'phrul gyis btul dzu pra pā da ma yo da yo/ / dza gaṭwā rya ta ta ཿ kṛ tā kā le na bha ga nas—/ /rab zhi rang bzhin 2rgyas par byas/ /de nas dus kyis (jibacom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas 'gro bāñdzi naḥ/ /kalpa ya na pa ri niddhā rde pabye me sha ya ṣpespri ta/ /pra da ba'i don mdzad nas/ /yongs su myang 'das la rtog cing / /tha ma'i gzims mal dag la gnas/ /re spyo bi ṣpe ye tā pā byi na yā bi be shi tā ཿ / / a ba shi ṣṭa ཿ su bha zhig gdul bya 'dul ba la/ /rnam par bkod byed snye7rab tu bsams/ /rab bzang dang ni dri za dag /dro me gandhadngha sa tsa su pri yaḥ/ /a gre she na su bha drastu bi na yo pra ti pa rya te/ /rab dga' de yang bdag gi thu lhag /rab bzang tshegs ni chung ngu yis/ /'dul ba rab tu thob par kṛ sgo nu shā spo ga dzha sgo stu ru ju bi bha bodma daḥ / / i ti saṃ dzi 'gyur—/ /dri za lang tsho 'byor pa yis/ /myos pa tshegs kyis tsosna'adul bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa bsams tya gandharbha pu ram̐ ga twa ta thā ga taḥ/ /garnyarbha rā dza ma pa re nimbi me tya nas de bzhin gshegs/ /dri za'i grong khyer dag tu byon/ /dri za'i rgyal po gzhan pa ni/ /mdzes pa lhag bye ka byu tai/ /sa ha sra taidhri bai ḍūrya dbye bī rde sa bā da yan/ /su par mngon par sprul/ /bee ḍūrya yi thudabyug pa can/ /rgyud mang ⑪rgyud stong steng byed cing / /'gran pri ya su ma da tstsha da spa rja ya ka spru murya yo / / kra me ṇa ta :tstsha pas 1 rab dga'i rgyags pa ni/ /nyams par byed la brtson par gyur/ /rim gyes ⑪rgyud ni bcad gyur de pi to sarba so ra rūtstsha nāḥ/ /darsha yo to pra bhā be na nimbi she ṣi ba bhū kyang / /de dag sgra dbyangs kun rdzogs pa/ /ston par byed la ⑪mthu yis ni/ /khyad par med pa dag 95byed906

thraṣṭa pro bā tsa sarba dzhaḥsha ṣpeḥpra ṇa yi batpa laḥ/ /kā shya pa gyasu dhīrtswa gus pas mnyes gshin kun mkhyen gyis/ /dal bu yis ni rab tu gsungasatsho)/ /ston pa 'od srungs dag ma shāstu rā sī du pā sa kaḥ / / ta ttha sā dā ptaṭwā dhe shikṣu pa da ni gi ni/ /dge bsnyen blo bzang zhes bya ba/ /de yi drin gyis bslab gnas ni/ /yongs rdzogs thob cing blo ṣaṇḍa dhīḥ/ /sa dṛṣṭa gī ti ku sha lo gārjarbhe ka ga rtotta oṃ/ /pra ṇi gnas gyur/ /de yi 'a7dri za'i tshogs kyi mchog /glu dbyangs mkhas pa mthong gyur nas/ /dri za'i (1)dhwa āoṃ pra bi da dhe gandhabhā bye pa tsā pra ti/ /sa te na pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na su pri ya twa bdag po nyid kyis ni/ /ched du smon lam rab tu bsgrubs/ /de ni smon lam de nyid kyis/ /rab dga' mu pā ga taḥ/ /saṃ pāpta dharma bi na yaḥshi kṣu pa da pa ri gā hāta/ /nyid du nye bar gyur④/ /bslab pa'i gnas ni yongs bzung nasa'u/ /'dul ba'i chos ni yang dag thob//su bha dra su pri yā bee to kṛ to ku sha li no ma yā/ /pa rā bhi ma ta kṛ hye 6 nisbya rab bzang khyerab dga' 'di dag ni/ /bdag gis dge ba ldan par byas/ /gzhan gyi mngon 'dod byas thāḥ sa za thā ba yi / / pū dzi to tsa ta saṃ zlo byu tna ga re swa rga pa la/ /kun tu bdag ni gdung ba med/ /grong khyer mchod 'os zhes bya ba/ /mtho ris ⑦dag dang sandi bhe/ /sha ta kra tu ri ba shrī mān bee dza yaddhā bhi dhe dṛ paḥ/ /ta mtshungs par ni/ /mi bdag dpal ldan brgya byen bzhin/ /rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa khyabyung / /bsod su pu rgya pra thratta su dhadzre mānā nu sā ri byeḥ/ /bra dzadzhaste di baṃ po reḥnams la ni rab zhugs de'i/ /chos lam rjes su 'brang ba yishe/ /grong pa mtho ris bgrod rnams kyis/ /pū dzi tā su ra byu ma yaḥ/ /rā dzā pu sgyu nu bhā bee na swarga mā pū ra tai na riḥ/ /lha yi ⑩sa gzhi khengs par gyur/ /rgyal po de yi lho1bsod nams mthus/ /mi yi mtho ris kun gang ba/ /dṛṭwā yukṣiṃ tsa kā ra su sa two dzñā tu su re shwa raḥ/ /tasta smirjambi tāḥku raḥs mthong nas lha yi dbang po yis/ /snying stobs shes 'dod sbyor ba byas/ /de nas brgya byin gyis sprul pa'i//95—915
