la tsa la ṣpend+rand+rakleshatstsha ṭā ma mṛ tī bu byeḥsu ra ga ṇa kṛ te tī tsā sā he pā sa bo bskyod pas bsrubs pa'i nyon mongs gzer 1ma de dang de3/ /lha tshogs ched du bdud rtsi'i chu gter khya ma hā sha yaḥ/ /bi ma la ma na sī kā yā pā yakṣa ṇi pya bi kā ri rde bsam pa chen pos bzod par byed/ /dri med yid ldan lus ni gnod pa dang bcas tshe yang rnam 'gyur pa ra hi ta bi bye sa nda sgye dzā bya thā pi su khā ya te / / i ti kṣe med—/ /gzhan phan bsgrub rmyepar chas pa rnams la gdung ba dag kyang bde bar spyod/ /ces pa dge ba'i mend+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee su bha dru ba dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las rab bzang gi dā na ma shī ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad cu pa'o// //kṣe tre su kṛṭwālpa ta ram̐ ya dubye kṛ haṃ kṛ ta dzñā gya hi tā yatstsha/ /sa legs rmos zhing la rab nyung gang btab dang / /byas shes dag la phan pa gang byas dang / /yon mabee ta yatstsha gu rtonda tā ya shā khā sa ha sprasta du pe ti bṛrghaṃ/ /shā bahūṃ tan dag gis mtho la gang byen pa/ /de ni lo ma 4stong phrag 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lags khruldan mnyan bha ga bān bha bya pu rā dze ta ba ṣpe dzi naḥ/ /ka thā pra bsgo sa ga ti bhe kṣu saṃ yod rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal du bcom ldan rgyal bas sngon/ /gtam kyi zhar la nyer 'dus pa'i/ /dge slong gha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bi pha lo sadzdza me ba ta swa sgo gā ya ya dardzu te/ /tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig rang gis spyad 'os pa/ /de dag thams cad 'bras bu bral/ /ta de ba sa pha waṃ lo ke yatpa mthi ta marta te/ /dakṣi rja dakṣi ṇa ta yā 'jig rten du ni dgra bcom la/ /gang phul de nyid 'bras bur ldan/ /dam pa'i snod la yon nyid kyis/ /satyā tra pra ti pā di tā/ /a saṃ khya gu ṇa tā me ti pahūṃ ga ti ri bākṣa yon ni rab tu phul ba dag /dad pā/pa'i grogs bzhin mi zad ljo)pas/ /yon tan grangs med ldan par 95—917

yā / /su rā pā ṭa li pu tā yī ba ṇi dzastsanda nābee naḥ/ /ma hā pra ba ha ṇa ru gyur 2 —/ /grong khyer pā ṭa li pu ṭa'i3—/ /tshong pa tsandan don gnyer sngon/ /gzings chen dag la zhon ṭwā :nda nā dī pā mā ya yuḥ / /go shīste tsanda na tsa yo sa mā dā ya ta nas 1ni/ /tsandan gling du phyin par gyur/ /de nas tsandan sa mchog sogasace/ /blangs nas dga' bas tasta taḥ/ /z-iṭwāḥpra ti ni dṛṭwāsbe pā pund+ra dhyasma ho da dheḥ/ /bi pu lā de dag rnams/ /de las phyir ni log gyur te/ /chu gter chen po'i dbus su phyin/ /rgya che dus min kā la bā ta li tsa li tombi ba le ra bhuta/ /ta tra pra ba ha ṇi kā la do rlung 'tshub kyis5/ /bskyod pa'i rba cerlabs stobs kyis der/ /dus kyi rtse dga' g.yo ba yis/ /la ke li bi shri kha lo/ / tā rjabee ba ṇi tsakre tro da shasto tra kā ri gzings ni bsdams pa med par gyur/ /skyob pa don gnyer tshong pa'i tshogs/ /lha la bstod pa byed pa'i ṇi / /a bye bye tā pra ba ha rde sa ha sārja ma no ra dzeeḥ/ /pu rgya se nā tshe—/ /don mthun yid la re ba dang 77/ /lhan cig gzings ni zhig par gyur/ /mi bzad srog la the bhe dhasta tra bi ṣa me pā ṇa sa sha ye/ /a tsinta yatpa ri tra ṇa sa kalpa sābee tshom der/ /don mthun 'dren pa bsod nams sde/ /zhes pa 'dar ba dang bcas pasarde7/ /yongs su nā ya kaḥ/ /aste mabyibya ni ka ṭi dhadzre bo bye ru pā sa kaḥ/ /he tutta bskyab pa 97rab tu bsams/ /bdag gi khyim dang nye ba na/ /dge bsnyen chos kyi byang chub yod/ /de ni oṃ kle sha kā le sto ti shāstu ra ma pa saḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsirmya ma na sā ta me nyon mongs dus dag tu/ /ston pa rgyu yi mchog nyid bstod/ /ces pa yid kyis rab bsams nas/ /de ba sha ra ṇa ga taḥ / / u tse sārja pa tiḥsra dhwa bha yā sa ga da ga nyid la ni skyabs song ste/ /ded dpon mchi ma dang bcas pas tsho 7/ /'jigs shing ngal bas ldab ldib daḥ / /te tutta mā ya ma ha te si buddhā yārta te na maḥ/ /ka stso ṇa kalpa smras—/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyu yi mchog /dge ba yi ni dpag bsam shing / /nyon mongs can kun 95byed918

ba pu:nda na tsadzre tai/ /te na hā ra tu ṣā ro gha sha shi shi to pa hā se nā/ /gus pa yis ni byugs khyepa byas/ /do shal dang ni kha ba'i tshogs/ /zla ba bsil bub dman byed pa/ /swasruḥswa tīkau shu bye ṇa tsanda de nā bha badzhai naḥ/ /tai na bu rsā nu bhā be na pu rgya grags pa ltar dkar tsandan des/ /rgyal ba rnal du gnas par gyur/ /de yi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /se na ཿ sha shi pra bhaḥ / / shrī māsba bhu ba sa rghaṃ ga thrartse tā byu ta sau dpal dang ldan pa bsod nams sde/ /zla ba'i 'od dang yan lag kun/ /rmad bhubyung dri bzang ④ldan ra bhaḥ/ /ta sutsanda na ratna di rjo ta yānd+ra ga rā bha si/ /tatpaze swa kṛ ho pātta par gyur/ /de yi tsandan rin chen sogs/ /rgya mtsho'i chu la gang lhung ba/ /de dag thams cad rang khyim kyu pa ma dhyātpa muṅga tai/ /ni dzee ni dzee sa da tā tha ba ṇi dza tsanda nā dang / /nye bar khron ⑤pa'i nang nas byung / /tshong pa rnams la tsandan sogs/ /rang rang dag la des di shaṃ/ /sgo bye ratna sba rirge haṃ saṃ bhi kṣu saṃ gha pū dza yata/ /a tha byin nas/ /zas dang rin chen gos rnams kyis/ /khyim du dge slong ⑨dge 'dun mchod/ /de nas sārja pa te di bya pra bhā bā bha ra rde shri yo/ /dṛspyo pa stha ya ke nā gre thraṣṭa ded dpon dag gis ni/ /mchog gi mthu yis brgyan pa'i dpal/ /mthong nas mngon du nyer gnas kyis//takhru kṛ tai dzi naḥ / /he tūtta mo tha bha ga bān sa smi tasta ma bhā de yis klulegs byas rgyal la dris/ /de nas bcom ldan rgyu yi mchog /'dzum dang bcas pas de la ṣa ta/ /pāpta shrīḥsaṭwā ba te nā lo pa tā tsanda ṣpe na rmā/ /kṛ tai su gsungs—/ /ded dpon gyis ni tsandan gyis/ /sa 9shel byugs pas dpal 'byor thob/ /bsod nams kṛ tai shī le nā pu ju se de na kand+ra tata/ /a mṛ ta tā ma bāpta su ya sri sdes sha97ni legs byas kyi/ /ngang tshul dag gis 1las de byas/ /bdud rtsi nyid ni rab thob ⑪pa/ /gang tā le shā bi sru ṣaḥ/ /pā ke ku sha la mū lā nā me ṣadzadma ni pabye me/ /pra bra gi 3/ 'di dag cha yi thigs/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba smin pa na/ /skye ba tha ma dag la 'di/ /rab byung bla med 95—920

dzñā nutta rā sa myakshi bo dhi sa ma bāsgra ti/ /tsanda na shrī ri ti khyu taḥpu rgya tsanda yang dag par/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bsod nams dag gi ①tsandan shing / /yangs na shā khi nāḥ/ /e ṣa spru le bi shā la gya bi 6 ti ta thā ga taḥ/ /i ti pa yi ni rtsa bar 'di/ /tsandan dpal zhes grags pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de skad te tūtta maḥpā ha bha ga bān dzñā na lo tsa naḥ/ /i kyuste shākya mu ni nā rnyikṣa bo bcom ldan rgyu yi mchog /ye shes spyan dang ldan pas gsungs/ /zhes pa shākya thub pa yis/ /gsungs bisma yi ya yuḥ/ /artasnyettha sa mdzee ṇḍa pa ri ṇa to bai rā gya lasmre pha laḥtshe dge slong ya mtshan gyur/ /legs byas can gyi dad pa'i sbyin pa'i cha yi myu gu lo 'dab brgya yis 'phel//shradha dā na ka rde ku raḥsu kṛ ti nā shā khā sha tettha rnyo te/ /ya su dgra bcom zhing la yang dag btab pa yongs su smin tshe chags bral phun tshogs 'bras/ /gang la skabs tāste da shā dhi pa tya bi ṣa datstsha tro da yāḥsalnga daḥpu sgyu garnya ma da pra mo da su gsum bdag po dri med gdugs can dar zhing bsod nams dri yis rgyags/ /rab dga'i grogs po phun j-i daḥ pra tya gra pusgodhe baḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo dhi tshogs 'di dag me tog gsar pa nyid du rab tu rgyas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee te tūtta mā ba dā na me kā shā ta ta sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las rgyu'i mchog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal maḥpabee waḥ// //'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //lo kaḥki pa ra lo ka dhīḥpra ku ru te pu tā ya mi byā smṛ hūṃ tahphu bye kṛ ya te 'jig rten pha rol blo ldan don med bu la chags pa ④ci slad sgrub/ /bsod nams gang rigs de ni swa yo ya du tsi haṃ nābyeḥkṛ tai bhu bye te/ /bu trastadri da dhwa ti kashyi da sa ma kru rang gis ①byas te gzhan gyis krubyas pa spyod ma yin/ /gang gis sdig pa'i las rnams ⑤ma lus rigs ni 95—921

ra kṛ thā ko bi daḥ sā swabye na ni sā ta bhasna ba da naḥ sā da tya she sngo rnam par lhung zhing bzhin dman nyams byed pa/ /de dag mtshungs med gdug pa'i bya ba la mkhas bu ni na yaḥ / / pu ra bha bi sgra ha pa teḥ shā ba hūṃ khru ta ba nd+ra ṇaḥ / /'ga' yi rnam pa ‘1bsgrubs/ /mnyan yod du sngon — khyim gyi bdag /thos pa'i go cha dag gis 1ni/ /dzā yā yā dza ya se nā yī bha ba badzre bhi dhaḥsu taḥ/ /to dadza tī shi sho tasmin badzha mā chung ma rgyal ba'i sde la bu/ /srid pa'i go cha zhes pa byung / /dal bu dal bus byis pa de/ /khyo shug de ṣpe sha ṣpeḥsha ṣpeḥ/ /ba shoṅkarṣa bi she ṣā shā bee ni be shaṃ pra tsakra tuḥ/ /dag gis bskyed de/ /rigs brgyud rikhyad 'phags khyad par gyis5)/ /re ba rnam par 'god pa byas/ /kā le na kā la ba sha ge dza na ka bha ba badzre ṇaḥ/ /dza na beeste ha mo hāṭwā dus kyis 6pha ni dus dbang du/ /song tshe srid pa'i go cha ni/ /mdza' zhing rmongs pas gzir ba yi/ /sasbarjan pa rā bha bātra/ /pā ti bai shya ba ya su na sa ha lā la la bi ma yis 7bskyed bsrings bskyangs par gyur/ /khyim mtshes 8snagrogs po dag dang ni/ /lhan cig rtse zhing ma shri kha lāḥ/ /yo ba nasbaḥs ba bhā ma ni ram̐ ku sha i ba dī paḥ/ /bra dzarnyi bsdams pa/ /lang tsho dag la gnas pa de/ /gnyis 'thung lcags kyu med bzhin 'khyam/ /lag 'gro rā dza mārge ṇa bhu dzee ga su bha ṭī ga nā/ /da darsha punda rī nā ma tai harmya brgya lam nas bgrod 97de/ /dpa' bo yi ni bud med dag /mdzes pa 1 zhes pa khang bzang gi/ /rtse mo shi kha rasbi tā / /sa te na sā bhe lā ṣe ṇa sa bi lnga sa bi lo ki tā/ /dag na gnas pa /1mthong / /mngon par sred dang ldan pa des/ /'jo sgeg ldan la ⑫rnam par bltas/ /utpa sardzasme ra mu khāe tarludhi thi su ma bra dza/ /ta yoḥs bee bhra mā ku tai sa bzhin 'dzum ma des de yi ni/ /spyi bor me tog 'phreng spe1ba 'phangs/ /khyem mtshes de yis thude dag gis7//dṛ ṭwā pra ti bi smi kaḥ / /saṃ sgo ga su tsa kai sabye sa saṃ ke ta ma ma bsam pa rnam 'phrul dang bcas pa/ /mthong nas longs spyod go byed pa'i/ /brda rnams thams cad rig 95—922

n+ya ta/ /sa ga tā tsa ki taḥsthā ha dza na bhāmbha ba ba nd+ra ṇa/ /su z-i par gyur/ /grogs la mdza' bas chags gyur cing khye7/ /gnod pa 'byung bar dogs pa yis/ /'jigs daḥsde ha saṃ saktaḥshaṃ ka mā naḥpa ra bha baṃ/ /su taste kṛ ta saṃ ke taḥspaṣṭi su bha ṭa pa de ni song gyur nas/ /srid pa'i go cha'i ma la smras/ /khyod kyi bu dang dpa' bo yi/ /bud med gsal yo ṣi tā/ /ra dza tyā ma bi — to rya spe ra tsa rī ga mi 6 ti/ /tsa rantaḥsaṃ ba'i brda dag byas/ /mtshan mo rnam par ma dul ba/ /dman min rgyu zhing 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mi yi ri sā ra bya sa na ga te na sminda ra mṛ ga j-i shaṃ sgo ga bya gā ni khi la su kha dwags 'khor ba sdug bsngal nags tshal 'dir ni rgyu byed cing / /mchog tu longs spyod kyis 'khrugs ma sha bye pra ṇa yi ṇaḥ/ /bi nā sha bya pā ri sma ra sha ba ra pā sha ni ba lus bde ba'i rtsa la chags gyur rnams/ /'jig 3)pa'i bya ba dang ldan rngon pa zhags pa dag tu ltung gyur te//ti tā la bharnye paryanta bi ṣa ni shi ta shastesbi sha sa ram̐/ /bā sa re rakṣi mjug latu dug ldan rno ba'i ④mtshon rnams dag gis pasnyebarlag pa thob par 'gyuracesna / /g.yo ba'i bsam pa tastu bta ma yā yi tsa pa lā sha yaḥ/ /rakṣa bhā yasta yā rā tā bi tyāghā dang ldan zhing / /re zhig nyin par bdag gis bsrung shaṃ/ /mtshan mo khyod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pa ya yo su dṛta/ /a thāntaspyo ha subee su pu tra gya dā ra shā yi byā/ /mā tā brjod nas grogs po song / /de nas khyim nang du nyal bu/ /sgo ru nyal ba'i ma rngokhyayis ni/ /mtshan mo ni shi pra busne ba saṃ rakṣa ṇa pa rā bha bta/ /bā ri sho tsā pa de she na yā tsa mā na rab tu sad bzhin du/ /kun tu bsrung ba la chags gyur/ /chu yi dag byed zol gyis ni/ /phyir 'byung gya nirga ma/ /na nirgi ḍū da do ta gya dza na byāsne ha mo hi tā/ /so tsinta zhu bar byed pa la/ /mdza' bas rmongs pa'i ma yis (( ni/ / phyir la 'than pa byin ( ma gyur/ /des ya da ho ra mya rā mā ratna sa mā ga ma/ /ke ṣpe yo bispyo dza na bee dza bsams kye ma dga' ba yi ye / /bud med rin chen dang 'grogs la/ /gegs ⑫ni skyed par byed pa yi/ /95—923

na byā ma ma nimbi tā/ /bha gend+ra dzan kastu badmo ba rna ni dha āoṃ ga taḥ/ /bdag gi ma 'di ci yi ①sbrul/ /re zhig skal bas ma ④ni bdag /lang tsho ldan zhing 'tsho '-ibar gyur/ /i yi twa pu byeḥrka kā lī kā la byā lī kṛ te sbi tā/ /gatstsha mye tsā sa muwaṃ bsod nams min pas sbrul nag ④ni/ /'jigs rung ma ni khyekhyim na gnas/ /gnyid dang bral ma 'di ghra ni tā bi ra hi tsā ya di/ / ta da suḥ ka la hā ma bairdza ni pi pra la ni/ /gal te bdag gis 'goms ⑥phyin na/ /'di yi 'thab mo'i smra stibarjod kyis/ /skye bo rnams ti bu dhya te/ /pā yaḥkṣa pā pa ri ṭī zla dru re kānd+ra ka ro mi ki/ /su kyang rab sad gyurazhu / /mtshan mo phal che khyayongs zad cing / /mdzes ma ring la bdag ci byed/ /skal la bhā bhā gya tī na su ka dzee sā su bha ga ma ma/ /harmyotpa ga ga tā bi lo ka na ra sanda ba dman pa bdag la ni/ /skal bzang ma de ji ltar mod/ /khang bzang nang du son zhing rnam par blta mā na no sgo ru hā prasta mya shra ba khotpa la sun ya nasgo yī di shaṃ tī pa te/ /ba'i ro las bzhin gyi chu skyes dud/ /rna ba'i utpal lhung bar gyur pas mig gi mdzes pa rna ba dag la ster//tā ḍi ka byu ti bhiḥka po la yu ga le pa tā ba li bi blu ṭī bhā gyesgo gya zu bi pra rna rgyan 'od zer dag gis 'gram pa zung la pa tra'i 'phreng ⑪ba rnam par 'dzin/ /mdzes ma de ni legs ya ti su bha gā bha bya gya sā sunda rī/ /i ti tsiddhā tu ram̐ dā re yā tsa ldan dag gis 1nyeskal ba rnams kyis spyad bya'i sa ru 'gyur/ /de ltar bsams ⑫pas gzir zhing sgo/ /mā na pu naḥpu naḥ/ /a tre ba kri ya hūṃ sho tsa mi ti mā tā ta ma bra bīta/ /a yang dang yang du slong byed pa/ /de la ma yis ⑫'di nyid du/ /gtsang ba mdzod ces rab tu smras/ /de tha mā tuḥshi ra: tā khazhe na pa ya yo dza bāta/ /rā go pa diṣṭa pā pā āoṃ ki nas ral gris ma yi mgo/ /bcad nas de ni mgyogs par song / /chags pa ⑫nyer bstan sdig bdag ma kābye du rādma dzā/ / rā tā ba ga rde tā yā saḥ sa ga tā punda rī nyid—/ /ngan pa rnams la bya min ci/ /mtshan mo ngal dub ma rtsis par1shā/ /mdzes ma'i khang par de 95—924

garbhasbi ta gya ni ta gya thra ta gya ta taḥsha: yu naḥsha ṣpeḥstha bi ra tā ma tha mngal du gnas dang skye dang de nas byis pa dag dang ni/ /dar bab ①de nas dal gyis ②rgan po sre shri ta su/ /nā sau tsa la tya tu la kā ga dzodzra tagya dzee toz-ishā la ka la nyid la brten gyur pa/ /skye bo mtshungs 1med dus kyi glang pos phyung ba dag gi ni/ /las skud 'di ni yā ki la ka nd+ra ta ntu ཿ / / shu rnyo da ṣpe na bha ga bān bha sgyu pūbaṃ pad skud tshul gyis 5nges par g.yo mi 'gyur/ /zas gtsang gis ni gus pas sngon/ /bcom ldan 'das ni madhri taḥ/ /bhikṣu bheḥs ha tabyukre ta sa sgo bye pra ti gra haṃ/ /bhustotta ni mgron du gnyer/ /dge slong rnams dang bcas pa yis/ /de yi zas ni rab bzhes mdzad/ /de nas ra ma thā rpā naḥpra yandaḥthra thi bī pa teḥ/ /a nu gra he ṇa bi da dhe pa shuddhāntadzre gsol rjes rab dang des/ /bzhugs te sa yi bdag po la/ /rjes su bzung bas dag pa yi/ /chos ni de sha āoṃ/ /ta tra takṣe ṇa dṛsgo pi shi shu nā rā hu le na saḥ/ /bhikṣu rab tu bstan pa mdzad/ /der ni de dus mthong ba la/ /byes pa sgra gcan 'dzin byus de/ /dge slong ma bye pa ri dzñā ya mo da ke nā ṭī taḥse tā/ /bha ga brnyi kṣa ṇi tasme dbus su yongs shes nas/ /yab ni la du dag gis mchod/ /de yi dus na bcom ldan la/ /byes pa pra ṇa tāḥsand+ra rghaṃkṣa baḥ/ /bā la pra ṇa ya mā lokya pa prasgoḥs ku byu ha khāḥ/ /gus pa mthong gyur nas/ /rab dud 'udage slong thams cad ni/ /dge mtshan dag dang ldan pas dris/ /ṣadhidzeedzee ra yo dzā taḥshi shuḥkukṣi ni rpā ḍi taḥ/ /ke na kand+ra bi pā ke las kyi rnam smin ci zhig pa⑩/ /khyod kyi gzugs can ④lus ldan pa'i(hūṃ/ /byis pa 'di ni lo drug dag /na pra ti bidza ba pusta ba/ /bhu ya sā garsā re ṇa pa ri dhū tā di pā ni dku ru nges par bsdams te skyes/ /ci slad lha mo grags 'dzin ma⑨/ /nyin dang mtshan mor mngal gyi shaṃ / /bī ḍā tsi ra ta ra se te kasmradre bī ya sho dha rā/ /sazla zlo bha ga khur—/ /shin tu che bas yongs mnan cing / /shin tu yun ring gdung bas bsten/ /dge slong rnams 95—928

bādhri ṣṭa ཿ pra ṇa yā di ti bhikyu bhiḥ / /tā nu bā tsakṣa ṇa dhyā tā khru kyis gus pas ni①/ /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen la dris/ /skad cig bsams nas de dag la/ /ya tā ma tra kā ra khaṃ/ /mi thi lā yāsbra de he 6 pubee de ba su byu pa teḥ/ /srurya gsungs pa 'dir ni rgyu dag nyon/ /lus 'phags kyi buni mi thi lar/ /sa bdag me tog lha la ni/ /nyi tsand+ra bhi dhi pu tre pu khyu shī lo bhū ba tuḥ/ /pi ta ri tri di baṃ yā ti to ta po ma zla ba zhes pa yi/ /bsod nams ngang tshul bu gnyis byung / /yab ni mtho ris song ba'i tshe/ /de dag ba na sa smṛ ho/ /sā ma rā bye bhā ra gra ha rto mi thabyakra tu narja rmā/ /dka' thub nags 'dod ldan/ /rgyal srid chen po'i khur 'dzin la/ /phan tshun zhu ba rab tu byas/ /rā bye srurle ṇa bai rā gyutpasba dzee ba sa murtsi tai/ /tsand+ra ka baṃ tsidzdza gā ha byeṣṭha rnam pa kun tu chags bral bas/ /nyi mas btang ba'i rgyal srid ni/ /phu bo'i bka' yis bsdams pa yis/shā sa na yadhri taḥ/ /sruryastu ga tā rādzarṣaḥsha ma shā rgyu ta po ba āoṃ/ /zla bas ji zhig ltar stes bzung / /rgyal po'i drang srong nyi ma de/ /zhi dge dka' thub tshal song nas/ /saṃ to ṣa rā bye su khi ta:kre ci ra ta ra ta paḥ/ /sa ka dā tsitpa rishāntaḥchog shes rgyal srid bde ba yis/ /shin tu yun ring ④dka' thub byas/ /nam zhig yongs su ngal gyur sarnya pta st+ri bra tro ṇḍa yā/ / ka ma ṇḍa sum̐ dza lo mo hā da nuste ba pa cing / /skom pa drag pos gdungs pa de⑤/ /thub pa khyayi ni bum pa'i chu/ /rmongs las ma brjod nyid po mu ṣpeḥ/ /sa sa dzā tasmṛ timbiddhā na daṭwā dā na bā ta shaṃ/ /ka la garla na ba du 'thungs/ /dran pa skyes nas mkhas pa des/ /ma byin len ni ④sdig pa la/ /rtog cing bzhin ni log da naḥ pa :sto pā da tsinta ya ta / / ka nd+ra pā sha saṃ mā karṣa bi ba gyur pas/ /'gyod pa ⑧las ni rab tu bsams⑨/ /las kyi zhags pas yang dag drangs/ /dbang shiḥs ma bā 6 te/ /a ni: ye ba su kṛ tai duḥkṛ tai ba sha rī ri bhiḥ/ /med lus can rnams kyis ni/ /mi 'dod bzhin du legs byas sam/ /nyes ⑩byas dag ni thob par 'gyur//95—929

/ka piñdza la gi yin—/ /de dag brtul zhugs lnga yis dag /ji ltar rgan pa 3mchod byed cing / /ba men tshig gis rā sabye sadhedzre sa ma yo shri tāḥ/ /i ti khru tā mu ṣpedzee kyi rā dzā dzā tā thams cad ni/ /dam chos dam tshig dag la brten/ /zhes pa thub pa'i tshig thos nas/ /mchog tu gus da raḥpa ram̐/ /sa sau rāntaḥpu rā mā tya stad ste dza bra ta pañtsa rka/ /ka piñdza skyes rgyal po ni/ /grong pa btsun mo blon bcas pas/ /brtul zhugs lnga po de dag bstan1/ /ba men nga lo ha me bā sau shā ri pu traḥsha sho bha bta/ /ka piñtsa muṅga khā pa tya ā nasdo ga dza yu tha nyid ri bong ni/ /shā ri'i bu 'di nyid du gyur/ /spre'u mo gal ④gyi bu/ /glang chen khyu bdag kun dga' paḥ / /tepra purjand+ra bai ma bye ya thā byeṣṭha kra mātstsha nā/ /tasmrattha zla ma pū dzā su bo—/ /de dag ji ltar rgan pa'i rim/ /mchod las chos ni dri med thob/ /de slad phyag dang mchod pa la//draṣṭa byaḥstha bi ra kra māḥ/ /khru two ti shasturbi na yo pa de shaṃ dzrejotstsha rna pā rgan pa'i rim pa rab brtag bya/ /ston pa'i 'dul ba nyer bstan de thos nas/ /rgan po mchod pa'i pya ta po bee she ṣe/ /sa go ra rpā barṣa di bhe kṣa bste pū dzā ya thā bridhi ka yi dka' thub khyad par thobargya/ /ji ltar rgan bzhin dge slong de dag gis/ /zhe sar bcas pa'i mchod pa 95—949

ba tsa kruḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa mdun kye)sar byas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa la tā yī ka piñdza khā ba dā rna ṣa ḍa shī ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las ba men gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'o// //yand+ra bye pa ra sazla dadzre bee ṣa oṃ spyu re tsa yadmā ka re ya stso kyuṅka ṭa kā gang zhig g.yo dang yongs khyab dregs pa mi bzad gang yang gdug pa rnam par bcas/ /gang yang la ku ṭa bee ka ṭā rnyo pa sbi ram̐ sthā ba ra/ / yā n+ya tyā ni tsi tā ni shin tu rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rtsom pa cher gnas brtan trepa dang / /gang dag gzhan yang bzod duḥs ha bee ṣā bye tī kri tā ni sgu ṭi bā spra rutya bi ṣa su taisgo tu la yā nā dka'i dug rnams gsal bar gcig tu byas pa de dag gis/ /tshig rtsub dug gi rno ba nyid la cha dang dper yādhi le sho ba rmā/ /shā ba st+yadmā na sā khya gya padma garbha ni bha pra bhaḥ/ /yang mtshungs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyem bdag yid ces bya ba'i bu/ /yon tan ldan pa mnyan yod du/ /a bhūsgo ha pa teḥsru nurgu ṇa bābeedma kā bhi dhaḥ/ /su shī la gye ba ni ya maḥsā padma'i snyeng po'i 'od mtshungs pa/ /padmo can zhes bya ba byung / /tshul khrims can gyi dul ba dang / /blo bho pa ri gu shā da raḥ/ /sorja ta kṛ he ta su bi be ka i ba dhī ma taḥ/ /ldan rnams kyi dben pa dang / /dam pa'i yon tan la gus bzhin/ /de yi mdun du de dngharab bskyed/ /sa na be yo ba nā ram̐ bhe rū pa kandadzee hā se rna/ /sgo gyodmo ga bi rā ge gzugs ni 'dod pa rgyas ‘zheldan zhing / /lang tsho gsar pa rtsom tshe de/ /longs spyod rtsom la chags bral na bai rā gyu bhe mu kho bha batro/ /u pa se nā bhe dhwa na khya sa bhe kkoḥkṣurnyi bas—/ /chags bral nyid la mngon phyogs gyur/ /dge slong bzod pa'i sems ldan pa/ /nye sde zhes ni tse ta saḥ/ /shā sa ṣpe pra sha ma shā rgyu pra bra rdzu sa mu pa da de/ /sa pā bya ba yi/ /bstan la ⑪rab zhi bsngags 'os pa/ /rab byung de yis yang dag blangs/ /'khor ba'i 95—950

tra pā ṇiḥsaṃ sakta ṭī ba raḥshu shu bhe pa ra/ /saṃ sā re pa kṣa bee rā gyubyi phyogs la chags bral bas/ /chags pa dang bral zla ba bzhin/ /lag na lhung bzed chos gos dang / /rakta i bā tsand+ra māḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsi de kā tī dza na tsā ri ka yā bra dzan/ /yang dag ldan de mchog tu mdzes/ /de nas nam zhig gcig pu nyid/ /ljongs ni rgyu zhing 'gro ba detsho1/ /bi hā rā rā ma ru tsi dzā ma thu rā ma sa sā da saḥ / / sa ta ta gtsug lag khang dang dga' 27tshal byus/ /mdzes pa'i bcom brlag dag tu kruphyin/ /der ni bsod pi ṇḍa pā tā bee na ba tā da na bye dzha yā/ / be shā yāḥ sha shi le khā nams kru don gnyer des/ /2gsar bu nyid phyir ma shes nas/ /smad 'tshong zla ba'i ri mo yi/ /khang yāḥdra bi be sha kṛ hūṃ ga rṇa/ /sā ta snga sa na saṅka ram̐ kṛ tā ku ba la ma kṣa shā/ /pa'i khyams kyi nang du zhugs/ /utpal mig can de yis ni/ /de la stan dang bkur ste byas/ /gzugs tai dza gā dā da ra ba tī rū pā lo kambi smi tā/ /i yi te ma li tā mūnti ni mthong bas ya mtshan zhing / /gus dang ldan pas de la smras/ /lang tsho gsar pa dang ldan pa/ /khyod na ba yo ba na shā li nī/ /ka ro tya mṛta saṃ sgo ga dīsthāṅka su na tsakṣu khoḥ/ /a kyi gzugs ni yid 'ong ldan6/ /su yi mig la bdud rtsi yi/ /longs spyod ston par byed ma yin/ /na smibee ya pi rū pe smin ke na kā ma bi ro bye nā/ /kaṣṭi sa mu pa diṣṭi tshod 'di dang gzugs 'di la/ /'dod pa 'gal zla su zhig gis/ /rgan po la 'os chags bral gyisatso7/ /te bee rā gyi sbra bi ro tsi tai/ /la la nā ra sa noṅkaste ku tsasparsha su kho tsi sdug bsngal yang dag nye bar bstan/ /chags ldan bud med nu ma ni/ /rab rgyas rig she pas bder 'os te—/ /pā ṇi saṃ sgo ga pā tra su pā tram̐ ta ba na sho bha te/ /a haṃ ku tsa pa—/ /longs spyod snod gyur khyod kyi ni/ /lag na rwartelhung bzed mdzes ma yin/ /nga ni nu ma'i khur gyis bha rā lnganta hūṃ tā ra ju ta ram̐ ga taḥ/ /u tsi tai bā ba yoḥbye tiḥsaṃ pā ti non—/ /khyod 4—)ni lang tshos rnam par g.yo/ /yu cag gnyis ni mdza' bar 'os/ /da ni brtul zhugs 95—951

kṣa ma hūṃ bra tai/ /udri dzñā ya ta lo tsa nā dha ra da la swā da pra mo dotpa baṃ bzod par mdzod/ /g.yo sgyus zhi dang dul ba goms pas longs spyod bdud rtsi dag la chags med cing / /saṃ sgo ga mṛ ta niḥsmṛ haḥsha ma da mā sgyu se na shābyā di ba/ /yaḥkāddhā mig yangs mchu yi sti yal 'dab rab myang khyerab dga'i dga' ston rab tu spangs pa bzhin/ /mdzes ma'i ku tsa rku ku rmā ki ta ru tsidhwaste na rā shaṃ dzdza di gre sha klinda pha khā se ṣpe dza na nu ma gur gum gyis mtshan mdzes pas snying la chags pa mi 'dzin gang / /skye bo'i nags su nyon mongs ba ṣpe dāddhā ya ta smi na maḥ/ /ya di me spru ti luddhā yā ba tsa nā nu dman rngo pa'i 'bras bu za ba'i dul ba de la 'dud/ /gal te mdza' la brkam pyachags can/ /bdag gi kā re 6 se/ /ta de tatta ba ba khā krārnyi pa shā mi ba da nāmbu dzee/ /e tshig 'di mi byed na/ /khyod kyi bzhin ras padma 'di/ /stobs kyis mnan te bdag gis btud/ /de ta dā kasbya saṃ trasta i ba kazlo pi dhwa ya saḥ/ /tsā ba tse no tsi hūṃ mā tand+ra ma jos kun tu skrag pa bzhin/ /rna ba bsgribs nas de la des/ /smras pa ma gcig bdag gis ni/ /bstan shā sa na dru ṣa rde/ /urghaṃ pa tā mu pa ga haṃ su ga ta pra tai su sa twa shri pa sun 'byen 'os pa min/ /bdag nyid kun gyis legs spyad rgyan ⑤ldan skyes bu la/ /bde gshegs yaḥshu tsi ta yā ti la kā ya mā āoṃ/ /saddhātpa nā su tsa ri tā bha ra ṇa gya sum̐ btul 'uzhugs cod pan nyid du rab gyur cing / /snying stobs dpal ni gtsang bas thig le nyid gyur pa/ /saḥshī lo pa oṃ na hi bi byu ṣa ṇa maste kiñtsi ta/ /i kyughā saṃ ya taḥshu n+ya pā tshul khrims mtshungs pa'i rgyan ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes pa brjod nas dul ldan de/ /gnod pa'i tra e ba dza gā ma saḥ/ /a pā ya sha lya bi ṣa rmā pū dzā mubye bye pa twa ra/ /a zug rngu mi bzad can/ /mchod pa rab btang myur ba dang / /bcas pa (rngusnod stong nyid du song / /de tha marja ba lānd+ra ma tsaṇḍa lī bi sha kā li mbi/ / ba shā karṣa di ni nas sngags stobs zhes pa yi/ /smad 'tshong gtum mo 'dod ldan ma/ /dbang dgug sogs la 'khrul 95—952

yant+ra mant+ra ta nd+ra di ta tpa dzā/ / ā byu ya bi ni be tyāsmi ni dzee sma 'khor dang / /sngags dang rgyud sogs de sbyor ma/ /bos nas de la rang nyid ni/ /chags pa'i zil gyis ra pa rā bha baṃ/ /ya yā te dha na saṃ tuṣṭi rā gārta thra yī saṃ ga oṃ/ /a mnan pa bshad/ /nor kyis tshim byas chags pa yis/ /gzir mas dga' dang 'grogs pa zhusalku/ /de tha mant+ra ba khāskṛ ṣṭa sta yā sa ya di padma kaḥ/ /bi ba shast+ri sa ma bye nas de yis 'phral la ni/ /sngags stobs kyis drangs padma can/ /dbang med de la mngon phyogs te/ /tya ki ka ro mbi tya bhā ṣaṭa/ /sā ta spru tse sha shi mu khāe bha dza pra ṇa yi dī mi rmā/ /bdag gis ci zhig bya zhes smras/ /de la des smras bsod nams kyis/ /nyer gnas mdzes ma zla bzhin ma//pu bye ru pa na hūṃ kādzñā dībee bā bsgo mā bee shata/ /padma ko bya ba da dṛṣṭa dzwa mdza' mo 'di ni rab tu bsten/ /yang na 'bar ba'i me la zhugs/ /padmo can gyi (47mdun du ni/ /me li tai pā ba ke pu raḥ/ /pā ta sadzdzaḥs mudhri bye bste sa twa si hūṃ 'bar mthong nas gos bzhag ste/ /snying stobs dkar ba'i gos can gyis/ /mchong bar chas nas rab shu kaḥ/ /bi shā mi sā ba ka dī sta rā gāsninda twa pā ba kai/ /sum̐ smras pa/ /gtsang byed 1'bar bar bdag 'jug gi/ /mi gtsang chags pa'i mer ma yinargya/ /chags sāsma da na daddhā ram̐ dā ho dzadma sha tā nu gaḥ/ /i ti ta gya ba tsa pas bsregs pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /skye ba brgya yi rjes 'brang sreg /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /shu tā tsaṇḍa lī khaṇḍi tā sha ya/ /a kārya ka ra nobyighā patsoṭwā pi sa mā ya yo/ /sa gtum mo re ba nyams gyur cing / /bya min byas pas yid byung ste/ /rjes su gdung ba dag tu gyur/ /de ta yākhyedhi ni la yaḥpra ṇa ye na pra sā di taḥ/ /bee shya yā tsa bai rā gya yi ⑤bzod pa'i gnas de la/ /gus pa yis ni dang bar byas/ /chags bral zhi zhing bsel ba yis byu blo sha ma shī ta la yā bye yā/ /bi da dhe dhadzre sa shubye ta yoḥsadhedzre de sha rmā/ /ldan smad 'tshong ma dag kyang / /chos kyis kun tu dag pa'i slad/ /de dag la ni chos bstan mdzad/ /95—953

te sadzee kle sha sha ma nārya yārta twa ma bā pa tuḥ/ /swa yo tsārta twa mā gang gis nyon mongs kun zhi nas/ /de dag gis ni dgra bcom thob/ /dge legs ldan pa padmo can/ /sā rya bha ga bahaṃ thā ga tai/ /padma kaḥpra ya yo drahūṃ shā baspyo swaste mā rang nyid dgra bcom rmyenyid thob nas/ /mnyan yod grong du bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa na su dī/ /dzi āoṃ dze ta ba nā sī āoṃ ta tra dṛṭī pra ṇa mya saḥ/ /kṛ ta lta ru song / /der ni rgyal byed tshal bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba des mthong phyag 'tshal nas/ /bya ba byas kṛ tyaḥswa dṛṭwā nti bhekṣu rja ma bra bīhphu raḥ/ /byekṣu bhisgo ga bādṛ ṣṭastahphu pa 2rang nyid kyi/ /spyod mtha' dge slong mdun du bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das la dge slong gis/ /de byo da ya beesma yāta/ /be shā padma ka tsaṇḍa lī pānd+ratta ma ba dadzre naḥ/ /yi bsod nams ya mtshan dris/ /smad 'tshong ma dang padma can/ /gtum mo'i sngon byung rgyal bas gsungs//rū ra bha ga ba taḥshāstuḥkā shya pā khya gya shā sa ṣpe/ /mi tra nā ma kṛ ha sngon tshe ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs zhes pa'i bstan pa la/ /khyim bdag bshes gnyen zhes pa tiḥpra bra rdzu sa mu pa ga taḥ/ /ta gya nand+ra su nanda tsa bhārya pra bra dzi ta pu naḥ/ /pa ni/ /rab tu byung ba nyid du gyur/ /de yi chung ma dga' mo dang / /rab dga' mo yang rab byung ste//bhatri tu spyo nu bhā be tu bi hā re tsakra tuḥsbi to/ /bākrā tu ṣe ṇa ma ha mthu ni bdag po dang mtshungs pa —/ /gtsug lag khang du gnas par byas/ /der ni de dag rtsod pa yi/ /tā ka la he bhekṣu tī ga ṇaḥ/ /tā sgyu mubye dzi tasta tra swa bhā baḥki la dust+ya tshig rtsub chen pos dge slong ma'i/ /tshogs ni yid dag byung bar byas/ /rang bzhin nges par gtang ④dzaḥ / /tsaṇḍa lī ba tsa ṣpe ṣpe kā bai shā bā da na tsa pa rā/ /bhikṣu bar dka'/ /gcig gis gtum mo'i tshig dang ni/ /gzhan kyis smad 'tshong mar brjod pas/ /dge tī nā ma dhi kṣe saṃ da twa pā ba ma bā pa tuḥ / /bāsdoṣā྾ ba tsaṇḍa slong ma rnams smad pa ltadag /byas pa'i sdig pa thob par gyur/ /de nyid gtum mo (zhengag skyon las/ /95—954

lbo dzā tā bee shā ta thā pa rā/ /pra bra dzñā yāḥbra bhā be naḥpu naḥku sha la mā shri te/ /de bzhin gzhan smad 'tshong mar skyes/ /rab tu byung ba'i mthu yis ni/ /sbar yang dke ba dag la/ brten//sa ta mi tro kṛ ha pa tiḥ padma ko yo ya ta bra taḥ / /bi bhā tya rta tpa khyim bdag bshes gnyen de yang ni/ /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams pad ldan 'di/ /tshul khrims gtsang dā bāphywa shu tsi shī la bi byu ṣa ṇaḥ / / po྾ kaḥ pu tpa se nā khyaḥ padma bas rnam brgyan ‘she cing / /dgra bcom gnas ni thob pas mdzes/ /pad can skye ba gzhan la yang me ko pya n+ya dzadma ni/ /ba bhū ba putpa ni tsa yeḥpū ri tābee dza naḥs dā/ /pra bye tog sde zhes me tog la(zhe7/ /me tog tshogs kyis slong ba yi/ /skye bo rtag tu khengs byed gyur/ /de yis ka pu rghaṃ so bhya tsu sgo ge na tstsha rya pā sa sā/ / ka ma lotpa la ka sthā rang rgyal longs spyod kyis/ /mchod nas gos kyis g.yogs byas te/ /padma utpal ka da ra/ /me tog ra ku su meḥs ma bā ki ra taḥ/ /te na pu bye na dzā to yo padma garbha pra bha ni bhaḥ//rnams kyis yang 1dag mchod/ /bsod nams sde jeyis padmo can/ /padma'i 5snying po'i 'od mtshungs 'di//padma kaḥ shā sa nārto me su kṛ to dā ra sau ra bhaḥ / / rū paṃ shī la bee legs byas rgya che'i dri bzang can/ /bdag gi bstan pa la 'os gyur/ /gzugs ni tshul khrims kyis byu ṣa ṇi shu tsi ya shabyabye ba dā tai ku lo tse taḥpā ka bee bee ka nind+ra la ta ram̐ saṃ sā brgyan grags pa gtsang zhing zla ba lta bur dkar ba'i rigs/ /sems 6dben pa ni yongs smin shin tu dri ra bā maḥ sha maḥ/ /e tahphu ju ma ho da ya da ya su kṛ ti dzā dṛṣṭi med 'khor ba'i g.yon phyogs zhi gyur pa/ /'di dag mkhas pa rnams kyi bsod nams cher dar mtshan nyid kṣa oṃ lakṣa khaṃ dzā tirnant+ra ta mā ma nabya ma li rna duḥkadzre tsitna dṛ rde/ /blta 3bar bzod pa yin/ /shin tu smad 'os rigs dang yid ni dri ma can yang mi rnams las ngan rtags//i ti saza dzha ka thi taiḥ kadzre pā kā ka thābye taiḥ/ /ba bhū ba ha rṣa saṃ zhes pa kun mkhyen gyis bshad pa'i/ /mod byung las smin gtam rngo dag gis/ /dge slong rnams ni dga' 9 95—955

spadhī byekṣu rde bisma yo da yaḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye ba yis/ /reg cing ya mtshan rgyas par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī pa dma kā ba dā na ཿ sa bhā shī ti ta dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las padma can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste maḥpalla waḥ// //brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //dṛṭī tī bra ta ram̐ ha rarnyi ni ya saṃ ṣpe bakṣu madhe she oṃ kadzre kṣi pra ma no shin tu drag po'i 'dul/ snab mthong nas 'phrog cing zhi ba nges par bzod mi byed/ /myur bar yid ra oṃ hi ma sa oṃ pa ryanta dā ha kṣa oṃ / / e tā bee bhra ti sa dzee dga' kha ba dang mtshungs mjug tu sreg par bzod pa'i las dag byed/ /bya min dag la 'jigs btang me ba bi ṣa ma ṣa ma swasdo pa oṃ bi bhra mi tyasgyu kārya bhi yaḥpra brta na bye maḥsaṃ blo gros rab 'jug 'khor ba'i grogs mo bud med kyir bye/ /rmi lam dag dang mtshungs pa'i rnam 'phrul mtshan sā ra sa khyaḥ ste yaḥ / / bi mbi sā ra su dṛ pa ti ཿ pu re rā dza kṛ nyid 'di dag thams cad nges par 'dzin/ /mi bdag gzugs can snying po yi/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i he pu rā/ / tsi tā khyo haste sha lbā ti pu tro bhūṅga dza se n+ya paḥ/ /sā rā dza tu khab tu sngon/ /nag pa zhes pa glang sde'i bdag /glang chen stan kyi bu ru gyur/ /rgyal po'i 'byor pa dang bye bi bha bee kṛ haṃ tsa sa pa ritstsha rda/ /tyakta yu bai ba pra bra dzñā bai rā gyu rnyi mtshungs khyim/ /yo byad bcas pa rab (4btang nas/ /chags bral la ni mngon phyogs des/ /gzhon nu mu kho gra tīta/ /pasnri ta gya su ru pā khyu pra sru tra bi bha bee kṛ te/ /bhadṛ nyid la rab byung bzung / /de yi chung ma gzugs mdzes ma 5/ /'byor pa rgyas pa'i khyim du ni/ /bdag sa sgo ga ra ti tā tsi ram̐ tsiddhā tu rā bha ba ta/ /a tha kā le na paryanta tsā po'i longs spyod dang bral bas/ /yun ring bsam pa 'khrugs par gyur/ /de nas dus kyis yongs 'dris 95—956

ri pa ri tsi tā da ra ta/ /sa tsi tra hasnyi shayā ti pu traḥswa pu ra mā ya yo/ /la—/ /gus pas mtha' ni rgyu byed pa/ /nag pa glang chen stan gyi bu/ /de ni rang gi khyim du song / /a sgyu ga ta gya ta spyo tha pā nu ga gya ni mant+ra rde/ /pū dzā su raḥs ram̐ tsakre de nas mngon du 'ongs de la/ /chung ma mdza' gcugs ldan ma des/ /rjes su 'brangs nas mchod pa ni//pasbyi pra ṇa ya shā li nī/ / sā tsinta yatta mā lo kya dru rā dhwa shra ma ṇiḥsngon du 'gro bas mgron gnyer byas/ /lam ring gis dub bde med desasna / /mthong nas de yis rab su khaṃ/ /a ho ba tā gya lā baṇḍi yo ba ṣpe bee ba dhwarya te/ /asmidru ya bsams pa/ /kye ma 'di yi mdzes sdug ni/ /lang tsho nyid kyis nges par bzung zhe(/ /na tshod longs spyod se sgo gārte pa ri tya bye kṛ ha shri yi/ /mi bye ba ki ma de nādmā nidzre tsā 'os 'di la/ /khyim gyi dpal ni / byeyongs btang nas/ /rnam par ma dpyad (sngu'adi yis ni/ /rdzun gyis re ṇa rpā ḍi taḥ/ /sne he she sngo su nā tyā pi dzān shāntasta pa sri naḥ/ /ge bdag nyid ci la gdung / /gang zhig phyogs lhung bcas pa yi/ /mig gis khyem la lta byed pa/ /dka' haṃ sa pa kṣa pā te na tsakṣu ṣā yambi rīkṣu te / /a tha bā bye rya me ba thub can ni mdza' ba'i lhagahūṃ7 /da dung zhi ba min par nges/ /yang na dang por brtan patsapa nyid/ /do pa ri kṣu byerya kā ra rde/ /a su dzā nā mi bai rā rgya tsa la mbi shānta yongs brtags brtan 7pa'i rgyu mtshan kyis/ /'di yi chags bral g.yo ba'am/ /brtan pa bdag gis me ba bā/ / kṛ he sgo ga ga ṇi ste ptaḥ sathruḥ kā na na mbi ha te / /shes par bya/ /khyim du longs spyod tshogs kyis tshim/ /thams cad nags tshal mngon par 'dod/ /bi dza ṣpe tu su kha bhaṣṭa mātpa na ma nu sho tsa ti/ /i ti saṃ tsi tya sā dben par bde ba nyams pa'i tshe(2// /bdag nyid rjes su gdung ba byed97/ /ces pa bsams te 1de yi ta su sgo dza nā ba sa re pu raḥ/ /swa yi ta tya dza ha dzee grwa tra sa shaste ni—/ /mdun du zas kyi gnas skabs su/ /sgra dang bcas par zangs kyi snod/ /ba gam rtse las rang 95—957

tā mra bhā dza rna/ /te na shasde na saṃ trasta i bā lo kya di shaḥkṣa khaṃ/ /ki me ta gis dor/ /sgra des kun tu skrag pa bzhin/ /skad cig phyogs su rnam par bltas/ /'di ci zhes pa nag di ti sa pratstsha tsi tratsū saṃ bhra morlu khaḥ/ /ta taḥsmi ta mu khāe ki tsita pa ti tai pa ni/ /'khrul pas mngon phyogs de la dris/ /de nas dar bab bzhin 'dzum ldan/ /de yis zangs tā mra bhā dza āoṃ/ /thra bhā ni bee rya sā tasmi harṣahphu na ra tsinta yata/ /a snod cung zad ni/ /lhung bar 1 de la bshad byas nas/ /dga' bas slar yang rab bsams pa re yo tā ba dā saṃ pāpta nimbi kā ra pa daspru tiḥ/ /shi thi la lī la ma ba zhig rnam 'gyur med pa yi/ /gnas la gnas pa 'dis ma thob/ /'di yi yid ni lhod pa dag /rtse gya tūṇḍi mā kṛst+ya te ma naḥ/ /yaḥpā tra shasda mā tre ṇa saṃ tā sa ku la tsā ga taḥ/ /dgas myur du khugs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig snod kyi sgra tsam gyis/ /kun tu skrag cing 'khrugs gyur pa//ki ki na kri ya te ta gya bee ṣa yi ra bi marṣaṇaḥ/ /sazaḥpra ṇa shya ti pa yo dha rnam dpyod bra' ba de la ni/ /yul gyis ci dang ci mi byed/ /ngang pa thams cad chu 'dzin dag gi sgra tsam ra shasda mā tra saṃ tā sa lupta j-i ti brnya na e ba haṃ saḥ/ /te sharnyi ke pi las / /skrag cing brtan ṣpepa nyams pas bcings nas 'bros par byed/ /gang zhig sprin tshogs ka ma lā sa na rā dza haṃ sā ye pūṣka rā gu ru pa gardzi ta niḥpraspalngaḥ/ /i ti nishyi bcings par 4sgrogs la g.yo med pa/ /pad stan ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni kha cig yin/ /zhes pa yid kyis tya ma na sā sā sha ṣpe mṛ du bā di mbi/ / ta mu bā tsa sa ma bye tya bhū la nges byas nas/ /byun ma'i 'khri shing rol rtsed can/ /'jam pa smra ba (shāde yis ni/ /de la mngon tā la su byā la yā/ /tre ṇa basmre pa ri tya bye twa yi dru ra ta ra ga te/ /sa phyogs dal gyis smras/ /bdag ni rtswa 6bzhin rab spangs nas/ /khyod ni ring du song ba'i tshe/ /bdag pasbyi bye ri bā krārnyi bi sadhiḥpa shya me kṛ haṃ/ /asminda pe ma hā ram̐ bha me gi khyim ni chun 77mas bzhin/ /rgud pas zil gyis mnan la ltos/ /rtsom chen 'byor pa 'di la yang / /95—958

saṃ sgo ga bee brdzi tā / / twasdersha nā sha yi bā haṃ dhri tā sa khye ba niḥsu longs spyod dag ni rab spangs pa/ /bde med bdag ni grogs kyis bzhin/ /khyod mthong re ba nyid kyis khā / /ya da su nu tsi te ba hūṃ duḥkhāsto di da mu tsu te/ /ba dadhi bzung / / gang yang sna brjod par mi 'os pa/ /'di ni sdug bsngal dag ༷2snagis brjod/ /mi smra 'dod mo na kā me yo dza ṣpe dzi hā pa ladzdza te/ /byu dzha kṛ hā bye pa ti nā patnaḥshī la kyang brjod pa 'di/ /lce yang rab tu ngo tshar shes/ /khyim bdag gis ni chung ma yi/ /tshul khrims babeed gya bi sla baḥ/ /dṛsgo su dzā tai bai rā gye ma kā le ka tha ma n+ya thā/ /i ti bismi mthong de la ni/ /chags bral skyes pa ma yin nam/ /gzhan du dus min ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa gzhan gyi tamu khaḥsazaḥpa raspa ra bee lo ka ṣpeḥ/ /ba datya n+ya gu ṇaglu ni ga rja na yon tan ni/ /nyams pa bgrang ba la mkhas pa'i/ /bzhin 'dzum skye bo thams cad ni/ /phan tshun ni su no dza na ཿ / / bi yo ga ta dzñā rmā lo ka ཿ swa sgra tsiste ti ma rnam par lta zhing smra/ /'bral bas gdungs pa —bdag la ni/ /'jig rten sems sos snguzhes par n+ya te/ /kle she 6 kliṣṭa rū pā haṃ tā ru ju su ka ro mi ki/ /kṛ he 'dzin—/ /dar ma nyon mongs dag la ni57/ /ma nyams gzugs dag dzi ci zhig bya/ /khyim du g.yog pa ri dza na: ye ma molja kha la hūṃ ga taḥ/ /a swā mi kā dzā nā ri ṇa 'khor 'di dag kyang / /bdag la shin tu ma bsdams gyur/ /bud med bdag po med rnams kyi/ /ma gre shā pi pra galha te/ /dā sa sru nudzre me bā ya mubyeṣṭi na bi batrī taḥ/ /mdun du khyi yang rab tu dgod dza/ /bdag gi lhag ma nyid kyis ni/ /rab tu bsos pa 'bangs phrug 'di//pa byā dzñā dā na ko pādme ke shā kaste ṇa mbi ha te / / i tyā ghā kṛ ta bka' bsgos khros pas bdag gi 8ni/ /skra nas 'dren par 9/'dod la ltos/ /zhes pa brjod nas brda saṃ ke tā ni dza dā sa pa rā bha baṃ/ /bhanghrubyetta bi kā rā ya pā pra tya kṣa byas te/ /bdag po'i sems ni rnam 'gyur slad/ /rang gi 'bangs kyis zil gnon pa/ /de yis 95—959

ma darsha ya tra / / smṛ hā ma kli ṣṭa rū pe ti bai kla bye ni ཿ su khe ti mngon sum nyid du bstan/ /ma nyams gzugs zhes chags pa dang / /bde ba med ces 'khrugs yo3pa tsa / /yīsgri dzā tā pa bā de nyi kru bye dā pārdi te tya pi/ /sa hūṃ bi dang / /smad pasnyepar gyur ces phrag dog dang / /'bangs kyis gzir zhes khro ba yang / /thob nas de la lo ka yadmā su saṃ tyakta bra ta yazlu ṇaḥ/ /tu bye saṃ sā ra do ṣā rde sabye lta byed cing / /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams btang ba de/ /mtshungs par 'khor ba'i skyon rnams ni/ /bye ba sha mā ya yo / / pā tra ṭī ba ra mu bye bye kha dza ā kṛ 6 dī thams cad dag gi dbang du 'gyur(she/ /lhung bzed chos gos rab btang zhing / /'jigs rung ral gri ṣa khaṃ/ /thra yā ni kā ra krorle ṇa sa dā saṃ he tu murya yo/ / pra ṇa phyung nas ni/ /dga' ma'i gnod pa la khros pas/ /de yis 'bangs ni gsod par zhugs/ /'bangs yābye ri taḥsasgyu pa dā sa ba dha bai ga sāta/ /lbo ram̐ pu naspyo ha su khaṃ bhe dze ni gsod pa'i sdig pa las/ /chung mas 'bad nas zlog cepa des/ /dgra las rgyal 'dod khyim gyis khyeni//dza na dzi gīste yā/ / so byu bye ga pa ri gra he ṇa la la nā saṃ sgo bde ba dman pa sgyu6slar yang bsten/ /de ni longs spyod yongs su bzung bas bud med longs spyod meskal ga sau bhā gya byurwa nā kā ra ni kā ra kā ra ṇa ka thā ti hye 6 ko pā bzang sa gzhir gyuraḍare / /rnam pa sna tshogs gnod pa'i gtam gyi rgyu las g.yog 'khor rnams la khro bas ku laḥ/ /kā maḥkarṣa ti saṃ ya rma kṣa pa ya ti kro dhaḥkṣa bee na kṣa rmā no mi 'khrugs—/ /'dod pas dul ba nyams byed khro bas skad cig nyid kyis bzod pa rlag par she7byed/ /rdzun byā bra ta sho ṣi te na ma na sā bai rā gya mā sā rya te/ /a tha ha ste gyi te brtul zhugs dag gis gdung ba'i yid kyis chags bral nyid ni 'thob 11ma yin/ /de nas rgyal pos ma hā mā tra pa rda rā dzñābee ta pu naḥ/ /ā sā rya bi bha bo dā raḥso byu glang chen gyi 1rta/ /sna chen gnas ni slar yang byen/ /'byor pa rgya chen ⑫ thob gyur nas/ /de nas lhag 95—960

ta bhya bye kodzha baḥ/ /a tānt+ra re piṇḍa pā ta mā dā ya na ga dzā ta dā ta/ /par rgyas par gyur/ /skabs der grong khyer nang dag las/ /dge slong rnams kyis bsod snyoms blangs//bha ga brnye ba nā sbo āoṃ dzi na ma bhe tya nyi kṣa baḥ/ /bee ṣaṇḍa ba da nāstasmi bcom ldan rgyal ba nags tshal na/ /gnas pa dag la mngon phyogs te/ /chags bral bzhin byis de la ni//pra ṇi ba tya n+ya be da yan/ /tsi tra gya haste shayā nyi pu tra snga nu tsi tai bra tai/ /phyag 'tshal glang chen stan byu bu/ /nag pa dag gi brtul zhugs ni/ /'os pa min pa rnam par bshad/ /bha ga bān tha sa ttha ཿ sa smi ta stu na bhā ṣa ta / / a sa —ba ku sha de nas bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /'dzum dang ldan pas der gsungs pa/ /de yi dase ba ma rmin le nai ba kṛ taste nabra ta gra haḥ/ /ye nitpanda bi bee ka pā ka ka la pas—/ /brtul zhugs 3 dag ni blang bar byas/ /gang zhig dben pa smin zhing sdogs pa'i brtag pas nā niḥsho ṣi tā shā la twaste nā yārnyi pu naḥpu rā ṇa bee ṣa yā swā da smṛ tedzee yid kyi 'khri shing bskams ༄27gyur pa/ /de dag phyi nas yul gyi nyams myong rnying pa dzudran pa'i dbang du shya nywa / /ye twarja pra nyi ṣiddhā gadzee shi thi la tyakta pra sakta da rāste ṣā 'gyur ma thuyin/ /gang zhig don gyis bkag cing khengs pas lhod la rgyun du gus pa rab btang ba/ /de manta ra sbosdi ka ma sha ma yordo lā ya mā rgo ma naḥ/ /dzadmā sgyu sa ni ṣakta dag 'dod dang zhi ba'i bar mtshams dag la/ yid ni 'phyang mo yug par byed/ /gang gis g.yang sar lhung e ṣa bi ṣa ya yasparsha bhi lā ṣaḥpa ram̐ bi dzñā so pi pa ri tya dzarnyi ni ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyang dul ba dag ni yongs gtong zhing / /chags pa'i dug rgyas rnal 'byor can ya oṃ ye nā pa ṭi pā ti tā/ /rā go da gra bi ṣā bi shadhi bi ṣa ma dzñā hūṃ rnams mi bzad smag 3)rum sa la 'jug par byed/ /skye bar goms pas chags shing yul gyi reg pa mchog bhu oṃ yo gi naḥkā maḥ ka su ka ro ti tīṇḍi bi shi khā sā re bi kā rekṣa tu mngon par 'dod gyur pa/ /rnam 'gyur mda' yi char drag dkrigs cha ‘67'dod pa 'di ni su la bzod 95—961

dattaḥpu ro hi taḥ/ /nitpanda bee na yo bi byā pu tre ta gya ba bhū ba tuḥ/ /'phrog byed kyis byin byung / /de la rig dang 'dul ba dag /rdzogs pa'i bu gnyis byung gyur te/ /ha ri dru ya ṇa i bye kasta thā ha ri shi khophopa raḥ/ / to bi be kāpta gcig ni 'phrog byed bu zhes dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa 'phrog byed rtse/ /de dag chags bral dben pa bai rā gya bha ba sgo ga ba rādru kho/ /ta bo ba ṣpe pa ri bra bye padzi bye dzñātwa thob—/ /srid pa'i longs spyod las phyir phyogs/ /dka' thub nags tshal yongs rgyu zhing / /mngon shes mā pa tuḥ/ /to byo ma tsā rī zlo rā dzñā pū bye mā kau dza ṣpe na tsa/ /lnga ni thob par gyur/ /rgyal dang skye bos mchod byed lkucing / /rab zhi bsngags par 'os pa yisarte)/ /pā ya tuḥpra sha ma shā bhyo mu mbi nām pi mā n+ya hūṃ/ /ka dā tsidhū ba bha ba mkha' la rgyu ba de dag ni/ /thub pa rnams kyi'ang mchod byar gyur/ /nam zhig sa bdag khang pa na/ /nasbi ti ha ri shi khe 1 paḥ/ /ka dhyā lā ba bye ba tyā khyu mū tsi disbi dza yorlu 'phrog byed rtse gnas mi bdag ni/ /phyogs las rgyal ba ( mngon phyogs pas/ /bu mo mdzes ldan zhes la khaḥ / /be྾ twa yā mu ṣpe re su go ra bee ṇa ga rī ya sā/ /pū rje su pū dza smras—/ /mnyes gshin khrod kyis gus pa ni/ /shin tu che bas thub pa dag /mchod bya 'di la mchod pa rna kārngu saṭwā rāho khya yasma ma/ /su tā mi ti sa mā di shya pra yā te thra thi bī pa bya thu—/ /'di ni bdag gis bkur ste sa7'os/ /zhes pa bu mo la bstan nas/ /sa yi bdag po rab song to / /rā dza pu ṭī su de bā bhūtra pū dzā pra ṇa yi mbi mu ṣpeḥ/ /he matstsha datstsha tshe—/ /rgyal po'i bu mo gus ldan mas/ /thub pa rtag tu mchod par gyur/ /gser bcad 'od ltar bi pa ri tsi hūṃ kārnyi oṃ ge da dhwa dzha tai ba shyast+ri ka ma la na ya rna mā bhe khā ṣā bha yongs su shes pa'i mdzes pa lus la 'dzin byed cing / /padma'i spyan dang ldan pa de mthong de ni mngon par ba ta sā/ /kā maḥkā oṃ ru tsi ra bi ṣa yā lalba naḥsaṃ ga mā ṇi pra tyā sred ldan gyur/ /lhan cig 'khod pas nges par mdzes pa'i yul la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa yis/ /95—963

sa tyā ki ma pi dzdza da ye ba dhe mū lā ka ro ti/ /sbo naḥ sha sadhisma 'grogs pa'i bsam pa snying la rtsa ba zug pa ci yang byed par 'gyur/ /rlung ky-igazhon dag gis bskyod pa'i ra saṃ bhra me ṇa bā khā ni le nā ka li tā ka te ba/ /saṃ ge ra saṃ ga 'khri shing bzhin/ /'dod pa'i rnam 'phrul shugs 'byin lus dag ni/ /dud pas de yi lus kyi kun gya mu ṣpe: kā ra ā nanda mā li ga na mā na tī shā/ /na ba hu ba mu kha lasne dga' dang / /bcas pas 37grogs med thub la 'khyud pa byas/ /de yi nu ma gsar pa'i rtser chags lus dzā ka rā ge ṇa ta sde z-i di ma da na dṛ pā dzñā le khya mu bye da dhwa naḥ/ /mu ni kyi tshon gyis ni/ /'dod pa rgyal po'i bka' yig rgya ldan snying la 'dzin byed cing / /de dus nyid na glo ra bha ba da kaṇḍi bye ya mā khā ba dzha gā da bhi na ba ma da li nohūṃ kha lastasgru ṇi na/ /bur du ni dul ba'i gdags thag chad/ /thub pa 'dod pa'i rtse dga' gsar pa dag la 'byor ṅku par gyur//bṛ ṣa bya yā yāmbi thu na kṛ yā dzee sa mu rya taḥkarka ta du rusgra he ṇa/ /sā rā khyu mchog nyams las 'khrig pa'i bya ba la/ /rab tu sbyor zhing sdig pas bzung ba bzhin/ /rgyal po seng dza sau ha su gra herna tu lyasta pā ya ka sde ga ma norlu kho khyuta/ /na madhri ge'i khyim du nyi mtshungs desgo/ /gdung slad bu mo 'a ni 'gro 'dod gyur/ /'khyud pa'i sgrub byed dag la rūtpa: na tsa ru tsi ma maḥshānt+ra ma ṇi bhind+ra yo gind+radhyā ṣpend+ra tsa sha ma bi she sngo lag 'gro ma rnams dug ni mi bzad pa/ /yang yang rgyal snyermongs 'jig byed rang bzhin lus la nges par ṣa bye ra meeḥ/ /mu hurmyatstsha mo ha pra la ya ma ya mā sthā ga na bi sgo bhu dzee zhugs pa dag /sngags kyis zhi ba ma yin 'od kyi rang bzhin bstan bcos nor bus min/ /sbyor min gī rmā byu āoṃ bi ṣa saṃ ge ni ba pa ti/ /ni pa ti ta spru ta ma yo mṛ gāṣṭha bsam gtan gyes min zhi ba'i khyad par sman kyi ro yis min/ /mdza' ba'i rang bzhin rkun po'i longs sa tsorya saṃ sgo ga ma ye ma ma dzdza/ / ma mbi ṣi zla ma gya bi bee ka spyod chur/ /ri dwags mig can gyis 'phangs de lhung ste/ /dban /tsho67pa med las skyes pa'i yid srubs 95—964

taste te ma z-i shā ra bya gra pā ṇi yu tsā mu niḥ/ /e tī nyi bi smṛ ta gser gyi chu snod kyis/ /lag gnyis byel she3ba de la ni/ /thub pa brtan pa brjod chapa yis /dhri tiḥpra sārya bhu dza ma bra bīta/ /ta mya sma ra bi kā ram̐ tai dṛbye ba ku bi to lag brkyangs rnyitshur shog ces pa smras/ /de yi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur de/ /mthong nas mi bdag rab dṛ paḥ/ /pā pa pra ti kri ya yo ge ni gra he bi da bye ma ti/ /spyu ra ko khros te/ /sdig pa'i phyir bcos sbyor ba la/ /chad pas bcad pa'i blo gros bsgrubs/ /drag po (rnyikhros pa paṃ pi tuttha khyedṛṭī lā ba rgya ba tya pi/ /kaṇḍi lambi mu ṣperbhaghra mi trughā gya pha yi bzhin/ /mthong nas mdzes ldan ma yis kyang / /thub pa'i mgrin par zas chags zhes/ /brjod da do pa yaḥ/ /pā pā batna ba bee tsi ṭwā pra tyātpanda gi raḥpa ra mā nas de la chu dag byin/ /bud med phur bu'i blo gros can/ /skabs su nyer mkho'i tshig dag ni/ /phyir yā ma yi bi ni ma ye thra haspa ti bye yaḥste yaḥ/ /du nyi tuzla tsa pā te na sa zlog sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sdig pa'i sgrib byed rnam par bkra/ /bu mo yi ni tshig de yis/ /'phral ha mee ba pra sanda tsā/ /dṛ baḥka ta ka tsūrje na dza la sha ya i bā ya yo/ /a tānta la nyid du mi yi bdag /ka ta ka yi bye ma yilta/ /chu yi gnas bzhin dang bar gyur/ /skabs der thub re mu ṣpesta gya byesgo bhā tā ba na sbi tiḥ/ /bi nabye di byadhidzñā tā luptadherga ga pa rdzu 'phrul bri/ /de yis ⑥mkha' la 'gro nyams pa/ /spun zla thu bo nags na gnas/ /lha yi spyan ldan na ga ti/ /duḥkhi taḥswa ya ma bye tya tai dī tāḥni dza mā shra ma/ /pañtsa gyis shes nas/ /sdug bsngal rang nyid mngon phyogs te/ /de ni rang gi gnas khrid nas/ /slar yang bhe rghaṃ pu na :kre tsa tu rje na pa rā ya rde/ / na ra pa ti ra pi dzñā bsam gtan bzhi bskyangs te/ /mngon shes lnga dang ldan par byas/ /thub pa chags pa'i chu gter du tā rā go da dho pa ti tai mu no bi ṣa ma bi ṣa ya kle shā baṭwāhphu na: bi nirga tai/ /ba lhung mi bzad yul gyis ⑩ni/ /nyon mongs 'khor lo dag las phyir phyung rab mang dka' thub kyi/ /gzi 95—966

hu ta ra ta paste dzo dagha sma ra smṛ nyi pā ta kai ru ṣa mu pa tsi shā tyaghā dhī mānd+ra yi khye'adod pa dran pa'i sdig bsregs shes nas khro ba'i tshogs/ /btang nas mi bdag blo ldan dag khya kyang pā da mu pā ya yo/ /ha ri drwa ya ṇa saṃ zlo sā bra ho me ba ta dā bha baṃ/ /tsi tro ha rab tu dang bar gyur/ /de yi tshe na nga nyid ni/ /'phrog byed bu yi ming can dethu/ /nag pa dag kyang ri shi khabyajutta sbyi ba dṛ pādma dzā/ / a bi ta shaṃ bra thi hūṃ swa ka thā 'phrog byed rtse/ /chung ma rgyal po'i bu mor gyur/ /de skad der ni mi bden ma yin rab grags pa'i/ /mi rmā ka baṃ ta bā ni nyi ta tra ta thā ga taḥ/ /sa ka la do ṣa ma ye na bha bee rang gi gtam 'di de bzhin gshegs pas bshad gyur te/ /gang gi 4srid pa mtha' dag skyon gyi rang ma nyiḥki ma pi ttakṣu ga ṇa gya ya yā bha ba ta/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra bzhin las/ /dge slong tshogs kyis 57blo gros ci yang zhugs ma gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī tsi tra haste sha yā tī pu tā ba dā na pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las nag pa glang po'i stan gyi rtogs maṭwā shī ti ta ma pabee baḥ// //pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //azlu ta bye ra ba gha nā ni la ni dzre to mbi saṃ pū ri tā khi la di 'jigs rung stug po'i rlung gis rab bslangs rba gyerlabs rnam sprul pas/ /ma lus phyogs kun ga nta ra gho ra gho ṣaḥ / / du sthā ra bā ri bi kṛ nyi dzre ka rā ka ro yongs ()'gengs de drag po'i sgra dang rab tu ldan/ /chu srin 'byung gnas bzlog dka' chu yi rnam 'gyur pi so byunta me nyi su ga ta sma ra ṇi na sum̐ sī/ /shā bsgyu swaste ye sazla can de yang / /bde gshegs dran pa'i mi rnams dag la mtha' ru gyur pa nyid/ /rgyal ba 'gro kun bde rnye dza ga tsā sa to rya te / / dzi na dze ta ba nā rā bi hā ra ni ra legs la/ /rtag tu sbyor zhing mnyan yod kyi/ /rgyal byed tshal gyi kun dga' ra/ /gtsug lag khang na 95—967

te pu rā/ /bi pu la dī pa yā tā yā mund+ra he na kṛ ta kṣa ṇaḥ/ /ratnabye ba sngon zhugs lkutshe/ /yangs pa'i gling du 'gro ba la/ /spro ba yis ni dus byas pa/ /rin chen don gnyer ni dzā sārjaste radzee ba ma ho da dheḥ/ /ta taḥpra ba ha zla rū bye sābee gu ru tshong pa yi/ /don mthun chu gter chu 'gram phyin/ /de nas gzings la don mthun ni/ /rab tu zhon tshe ta ram̐ bha ram̐/ /bi tsind+ra kaṇḍi dhwa rastu dru tse madzdza na saṃ ki taḥ/ /ke yo yuṣṭha phyi ba'i khur/ /dpyad nas bying du dogs pa yi2/ /rna ba 'dzin pas de la smras/ /khyed rnams rab tu ka mokhru kyā dā ro ha ṇa pa ram̐ pa rā/ /two ga tu ram̐ ga lnga go yo na kṛ hūṃ sred pa yis/ /brgyud mar zhon pa 'di ni ci/ /chu gter rba ka7rlabs rtse mo 'u'adi/ /khyim gyi khyams ni ga ṇa oṃ bu byeḥ/ /sa khyastu bahphu ba ha ṇi bha baddhiḥkṛ ya tsā bha raḥ/ /ratna yongs ma yin/ /re zhig khyod kyis 3gzings la ni/ /'tsham pa'i khur dag rab tu mdzod/ /rin chen rā shi na ka gyeṣṭaḥki twadhi rba hu bi sla baḥ/ /a n+ya trombi pra ba ntaḥkha phung po su mi 'dod/ /'on kyang chu gter 'tshe ba mang / /chu gter na ni gzhan na rba ⑥rlabs rab ra ma ka ra ku ka bya ku lo n+ya tra bee gaḥtīṇḍi n+ya tā nta rā drispri ra shi kha 'khrug gzhan na drag po'i chu srin tshogs dkrigs shugs/ /gzhan na nang gi ri bo brtan ⑦pa'i rtse mo stug ra gha noṅgha ta saṃ byā ha to ghaḥ/ /a n+ya tro ryaskṛ tai ta shwa si ta ta ra pas khyerab bsnun tshogs kyi kyergyun bkag 'thor/ /gzhan na rlung ni mthar byed dag gi dbugs ltar drag ma rutpani pā tai bhra mo nībyaṇḍi n+ya tā sbya kāṇḍa kṣa ya ni bi ḍa shi khā maṇḍa pa langs pas kun tu bsnun cing 'khor/ /gzhan na glo bur nyams byed rta gdong me ni rab brtan me lo bā ḍa bāsniḥ/ /khru two ti kaṇḍi dhwa re ṇa ka thi tai ru pa oṃ bu dheḥ/lce'i dkyil 'khor gtum pa yod/ /ces pa rna ba 'dzin pa yis/ /chu gter rang 7bzhin bshad thos nas//a ba ru khya ya yuḥke tsitta sbyaḥke tsidma hā sha yāḥ/ /ratna dī pa ma thā 'ga' zhig babs nas song bar gyur/ /bsam pa che ba 'ga' zhig 'khod/ /de nas rin chen gling phyin 95—968

gho ra su ṣpe tra yu.oṃ pra dṛ shya te/ /dā da sharko da ya raste srurya dwa ya 'char rtsom tshe/ /nyi ma zung ni shar ba bzhin/ /dus mtha' 'jigs rung 'di yi ni/ /mig ni zung dag mi bo di tai/ /a snga gya shwa bhra paryarnye shu bhra pa ri bā ri tā/ /ma hā rab tu mthong / /'di yi kha yi g.yang sa'i mthar/ /sprin dkar dag gis yongs bskor ba'i/ /ri rtse tri shri ga mā le ba lakṣu te da sha nā ba lī/ / pra ba te ṇa pra ba ha chen po'i 'phreng /37ba bzhin/ /so yi 'phreng khyab rab tu mtshon/ /'di yi kha ru lhung ba yi/ /rgyun gyis rṇa kṛṣṭa ma snga pya dzā ti nā/ /bi ṣa yā bhi mu khaṃ tsitta mi ba dhartunda shākya te/ /gzings ni drangs 1pa dag /yul la mngon par phyogs pa yi/ /sems bzhin gzung bar nus ma yin//smarya tsā de ba tai ki tsidzdzadmānta ra shu bha pra rda/ /pra ti kri yāsmind+ra ste ba ni dha 'chi ba las kyis sprul gyur pa/ /'di la phyir bcos yod ma yin/ /skye ba gzhan la dge ster ba'i/ /lha ṣpe kadzre nimbi te/ /i sgoste kaṇḍi jo re ṇa shu tā sabye ba ṇisba rāḥ/ /ni cung zad dran par mdzod/ /ces pa rna 'dzin gyis brjod pa/ /tshong pa'i tshogs (dnghakun gyis thos nas//na mo buddhā ya buddhā ye dre buḥsā kranda nā di naḥ/ /nā rda te ྾ bha yāṭwā dzā sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /cho nge'i sgra dang ldan pas smras/ /'jigs pas gzir ba de bha ga bān bhū ta bhā ba naḥ/ /di bya tho tre ṇa shu shā ba dzi no dze ta ba dag sgra/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal bzhugs 'byung po la dgongs pas/ /lha yi rna ba dag naspru teḥ/ /buddhā bye dhwa dzā shu te ba ta maḥpra sha ma dzwa nyi tiḥ/ /sha ṣpergya mbi la gis thos/ /mun pa zhi byed sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan thos nyid na sems can gyi/ /nyer 'tshe zhi sbad nya yadmakhye satwo pa sla ba shanta ye/ /saṃ thraṭwā phye sha beestasmind+ra ti bee sho gha bi mid kha/ /dal bu yis ni zum par gyur/ /dal gyis de ni kha bsgribs tshe/ /mi mthun phyogs 'gro rgyun sla bāta/ /kā la basthāttha ba ha khaṃ mutta ta ṭa mā ya yo/ /ta taḥku sha li naḥnyams pas/ /dus kyi kha las grol ba yi/ /gzings ni rang gi ngos su phyin/ /de nas mi bzad 'jigs 95—970

sand+ra ti ṭwāst+ri bra ta rāddhā yāta/ / shā bste ratna saṃ pu shlau bi shudhibee khru las thar/ /grags pa'i dpal ldan rin chen gyis①/ /khengs shing dge 2ba ldan pa kun/ /mnyan yod ta shrī yaḥ/ /te ga tā bhakta saṃ yughra bya san tā ṇa kā ri rde/ /dzi rna du ni rnam par zhugs/ /gus ldan de dag song gyur nas/ /gdung ba skyob par mdzad pa po/ /rgyal ba dze ta ba nā se āoṃ bha ga bārnye ba bandi re/ /te ta gya darsha ṣpe ṣpe ba stsonda saṃ bcom ldan rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal na bzhugs la phyag dag 'tshal/ /de dag de mthong nyid na ni/ /'khor sā ra bandha nāḥ/ /sa ryaḥpra sā da mā sā rya pra bra rjerta twa mā ya yuḥ/ /ba'i 'ching ba chad gyur cing / /'phral la rab tu dang ba thob/ /rab tu byung nas dgra bcom gyur/ /a bha badku shya pā khya gya shāstuḥshā sa na barbhe naḥ/ /e te dzadma ni pūzadzren 'di dag sngon gyi skye ba la/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa yi/ /bstan la zhugs par gyur to zhes/ /thra bā tsa bha ga bā ni ti/ /ti mo gi la gi li stasgo bista raḥs twa saṃ bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu gsungs bye/ /rgya mtshor ④nya mid mid pa yang / /sems can 'joms las dṛ te/ /pā pakṣa ṇi na tī:ghiḥkṣurṣa ta pā ṇa saṃ kṣa yo/ /klinda ka chags bral te/ /bkres pa'i me rdon gyis nyen cing / /skad cig gis ni srog zad thob/ /dri dang snye7 mi le ba re ta gya du rā mo dā sa histu bhiḥ/ /sobye gerba li bhirtswa giḥkṣibye dza bzod yid 'byung dang / /bcas pa'i klu ni stobs ldan gyis/ /de yi ro ni mi gtsang ba/ /chu gter la ni dhesta ṭa/ /sa shuṅgāsbi ma yaḥkā yaḥkā le na kṣa lo tembu byeḥ/ /tu ṣā dag gi ngogs su 'phangs/ /dus kyis lngarus pa skam po yi/ /rang bzhin lus de ༄ dnghachus bkrus pa/ /ri ra rā shi saṃ tstshandaḥshe la ku ṭa i bā ba bye/ /shā bahūṃ drwahma ṇa snga tha su madhoḥbo brtsegs pa kha ba yi/ /phung pos bsgribs pa bzhin du mjes/ /de nas mnyan yod bram ze ni/ /su pu tra hūṃ ga taḥ/ /mā tuḥs tsakre gasgo sbra st+ri bye kṣudruḥkha be da dzā/ /man tu yi bu nyid gyur/ /ma la bkres pa'i sdug bsngal tshor/ /mi bzad mngal gnas de yis byas/ /95—971

sa dzā tabyā sha tasta byeskṛbee nakhyi dhi to ya yo/ /sa sha ṣpesbasnya mā nabya saṃ skyes tshe bkres pa bud med ni/ /brgya yi 'o mas tshim ma gyur/ /dal byus skyed ① bsrings tshe na nikhye/ /bhū taispyo ri sgo dza ṣpeḥ/ /a trepyu pa ra mubyisnaḥs ga tā bhegru saṃ ga oṃ/ /zas tshogs shin tu mang bas kyang / /ma tshim mchog tu yid byung ba/ /de ni dge slong tshogs song nas/ /pra bra rdzu sa mu pā dā ya trobhenda pra pa piṇḍa kaiḥ/ /ba hu bhusbi khru taḥso tha bi pu rab tu byung ba nye bar blangs/ /bsod stoms dag gis tshil ma gyur/ /de nas cher bkres grags pa de/ /la leḥsaṃ gha sgo dza naiḥ/ /shraddhā ni mant+ra ṇistaspyond+ra kwa tsidhri pta mā ya yo/ /dad pas mgron gnyer dge 'dun gyi/ /rgya che mchod ston de dang des/ /gang du yang ni tshim ma gyur/ /a tā nta re kṛ ha pa ti ཿ shrī mānd+ra na bra tā bhe dhaḥ / / ni mant+ra zla skabs der khyim bdag dpal dang ldan/ /sbyin pa'i brtul zhugs zhes brjod pas1/ /dad pa yi ④ni ya bhikṣu rde shradha yā sa mu pa ya yo/ /saṃ bhe n+ya tra ga te sgohūṃ ta me ba dge slong rnams/ /mgron du gnyer slad nye bar 'ongs/ /dge 'dun gzhan du gsol ba la/ /gshegs ba hu sgo dza rgo/ /e ka me ba sa saṃ shā pya sgo rdzu tamee n+ya bee da yata/ /tasmin tshe mang za de nyid ni/ /gcig pu de yis yang dag thob/ /de la zas ni rab tu phul/ /skyes bu rab tu kṣa ṇi na byursā ṣpe pra byu ta pu ru ṣā sha rna/ /da do kṛ ha pa ti stasmi sa mapta saṃ gha mang ba'i zas/ /skad cig gis ni de zos tshe/ /mtha' dag dge 'dun mchod ston ni/ /khyer byi bdag sgo dza rna/ /anda gya sī ka ṭi te na julte bisma ya kā re rja/ /dī tyā pos de la byin/ /ya mtshan byed po de yis ni/ /bzan snyegyi phung po zos pa'i tshe/ /khyim byi bdag po kṛ ha pa tispyo taḥsaṃ kalpaḥs ma tsinta yata/ /a ho ma yā yo saṃ pāptaḥsu 'jigs pa yi(kye/ /'byung por brtags te yang dag bsams/ /kye ma rab gzhon chung ngu yi/ /zas ku mā rolpa kā sha naḥ/ /niḥshe ṣe bhukta me ke na ye na saṃ gha gya sgo dza dzwa/ /can 'di ni bdag gis thob/ /gang zhig gcig pus dge 'dun gyi/ /mchod ston dag ni ma lus zos/ /95—972

pra saṃ ge na na ya kko yo yā badmā ma pi khā da ti/ /da tā smi dakṣi ṇi tā ji srid gnod sbyin 'di yis ni/ /zhar la bdag kyang ma zos pas(1/ /de srid 'di la yon byin nas/ /badzdza bā da pa pā rā mya haṃ/ /i ti saṃ tsind+ra sā shaṃ kestamee da twa sa dakṣi bdag ni mgyogs par 'gro bar bya/ /zhes bsams dogs dang bcas pa de2/ /de la yon ni rab phul rde / /pabya dā ga ma na tā sārya yo bi tsa li tā na naḥ/ /ga tā bha ga ba te nas—/ /phyi nas 'ong ba la skrag pas/ /phyir mig rnam par blta zhing song / /phyin — nas de yi spyod tshul sarja taspriṭwārnye ni pa ryasaḥ/ /ko sau ya kko nu rakko bee tya thratstshakhru ga tai kun—/ /de yis bcom ldan la bshad de/ /'di ni gnod sbyin srin po 'am/ /ci zhes bde gshegs sngon ④ pu raḥ/ /bha ga bā na bi ta pā ha na sau yakhro na rākṣa saḥ/ /e ṣa dhand+ra du dris/ /bcom ldan gyis kyang der gsungs pa/ /gnod sbyin 'di min srin po min/ /dge slong chos ru tsi nā ma bhikṣu rarta twa me 6 ti/ /a tha dha1 ru tsi shāsta swa yi ni tā sred ces bya ba/ /'di ni dgra bcom nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas ston pa rang nyid kyis/ /chos sred mkha' bi hā ya sā/ /a darsha yandi dzee ta gya bi ka rā lo ka le ba ram̐/ /ta su paryanta la khrid nas ni/ /de la 'jigs su rung ba yi/ /rang gi lus dag rab tu bstan/ /'khor ba bzhin du ( 'u mā la kya saṃ sā ra mi ba dī ṣa rde/ /ki me ta di ti pa pratstsha khe dā dhadzre 'jigs rung ba/ /de yi mtha' ni mthong gyur nas/ /chos sred skyo nas rgyal ba la/ /'di ci zhes pa ru tsirdzi āoṃ/ / ta ma bo tsa ta sasgo dzhaḥki tsidme ta se tā na naḥ/ /rab tu dris/ /cung zad 'dzum dkar bzhin ras can/ /thams cad mkhyen pas der gsungs pa/ /a yi bha yi ka raḥkā yaḥshuṣka snyu lāspri pañtsa raḥ/ /bha dza dhadzre ru tsi 'jigs su rung ba'i lus 'di ni/ / bskams shing kyerags pa rus pa'i gzeb/ /chos sred rab tu zhi ba shārnyi tya dza bhā ba pa ri gra haṃ / / stha bi ya sī ta bai be yo dṛ ṣṭha sna bstan⑦—/ /dngos po ⑧yongs su 'dzin pa mthong 1 / /rgyab kyi tshigs rus lcags sgog 1 can/ /95—973

lāspru shrī kha la/ /khru tī takhru ga te nolto ka la yarlu yo kale ba re/ /rags pa 'di ni khyod kyi'o/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs de thos nas/ /rang gi lus la rtog byed cing //bha babhra me dhand+ra ru tsi pa rambirbe da mā ya yo/ /sau tsinta ya da ho mo ha chos sred srid par 'khyam pa la/ /mchog tu skyo ba nyid du gyur/ /de bsams kye ma rmongs pa yis① /māsgo saṃ sa ra tī dṛ rde/ /kṣa ṇa pra ti shra ye kā ye sabye dzñā ni dza bā sa nā/ /lam la rab tu bgrod pa'i mgronazhe7/ /mi rnams skad cig bsten pa yi/ /lus la rang gi nyid du chags//bee sasthāspru skyu naḥpra ka ṭa da sha nā gre ṇi bee ka ṭa ཿpra ṇaṣṭaḥkā yo yo kri lus ni rab nyams srin bu'i tshogs kyis rkang ni bug par byas gyur cing / /dbyibs bral rus pa'i ka gab mi ku la kṛtta tstsha dra na la kaḥ / /i māsthāḥ sā pā yāḥ pra la ya ma ya rab gsal so yi 'phreng ④ba 'jigs rung 'di/ /'jig pa'i rang bzhin sgyu ma la chags mi rnams dag gi mā yā pra ṇa yi dzā dzra rde ro hadzre hā sma ra sa bi ṣa yā swā da na ju bāḥ/ /i ti sred 'phel zhing / /chags bcas yul gyi nyams myong sa gzhi gnod pa dang bcas de dag go/ /de ltar saṃ dzā ta bai rā gya swa ka le ba ra darsha nātra/ /byozwa dzi nasta mā dā yā ya yo dze rang gi lus mthong bas5/ /chags bral yang dag skyes pa 6snade/ /rgyal bas blangs nas nam mkha' las//ta ba rgo pu naḥ/ /ha tā su tsakre bha ga bānda ya yā de sha rmā ya yā/ /slar yang rgyal byed tshal du song / /der ni de la bcom ldan gyirngu / /brtse bas bstan mdzad gang gis ni//sro taḥ sa kṛ dā gā mi na kra mā darta tā māpta bān/ / sasba kle sha bi rgyun dang lan gcig 87phyir mi 'ong / /rim pas dgra bcom nyid thob gyur/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam nirmuktaḥ sa pra ṇa mya ta thā ga tai/ /pāstsadma ni tsa ya smṛ tyā pra ya yo grol des/ /de bzhin gshegs la rdo1snaphyag 'tshal te/ /sngon gye skye ba'i tshogs dran nas/ /bzhin ni sa smi tā na naḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsi dā yā tai tai bhikṣu ga ṇa sambi sgo/ /'dzum pa dang bcas song cho/ /de nas nam zhig bcom ldan 'das/ /kun mkhyen dgyes pas dge slong gi//95—974

dza gā da bha ga bāmbi tyā sazla dzhabyenda bandha rna/ /tsi ra su ki nadzhand+ra ru tse ma ha tā su tshogs dang nye bar 'ongs pa yi/ /'ching ba bcad pa de la gsungs/ /chos sred nyon mongs lam dag ni//tsi re ṇa tsa/ /kle shā dhwa bi pu le kā le tsi rāñtsi ra ta re ṇa tsa/ /ñtsi ra saṃ tsā ra yangs pa'i dus la 47yun ring gi/ /shin tu ches kyang yun ring ba/ /yun ring las kyang yun ring bar37//saṃ tsi tai ཿ na bee : ye ta dha nd+ra ru tsi two / / tai ra pā ra pa ri tshe na bi sogs rgya skad tshig rkang dgu chad pa 'dar los gsar du bcug pa slar dpyad/yun ring rgyu bas bsags pa yi/ /pha rol med pa'i kun khyon mongs/ /bar med de yis chos sred khyod/ /kle shinda bi shāsto pi ni ranta riḥ/ /i ti dhand+ra ru ཿthraṣṭaḥsadzee zlo na sa tī pu raḥ//mi ngal 1lam ci cung zhig smros/ /thams cad mkhyen pas dam pa yi/ /mdun du chos sred la 'di dris/ /pāsprudmasmṛ ti dā tā re bha ga brnyi ma bhā ṣa ta/ / tsi ra gya tā badzha ga badma sngon skye chodran pa ster ba yi/ /bcom ldan 'das la des gsol pa/ /bcom ldan re zhig nyon mongs lam//ha tā su tsi re ṇa tsa/ /kle sha dhwa bi pu le kā le tsi rāñtsi ra ta re ṇa tsa/ /yangs pa'i dus la yun ring gi/ /shin tu ches kyang yun ring bar5/ /yun ring las kyang yun ring ba6//nā nā kā rirgu ru ta ra bha rirgarbha shayā ma dzee kaiddhāntaḥshāntashyi ra ta ra dhri rnam pa sna tshogs rab lci'i khur bu mngal gyi mal stan dri mas mtshan/ /lus kyi sbyar ma'i tshogs ni shin tu taiḥkā ya kabye sa mū haiḥ/ /hūṃ laddhā haṃ bya sa na ka ru zla bāndha band+raḥkhi yun ring bzung nas nga' zhing 'khyam)/ /sdug bsngal can rnams gdung la snying rje'i gnyen khyod rab tu tā dzā pā ptaḥ sa ddhā ba ra ṇa ra hi tsā ha nta bi shārja me tī / / i ti thob gyur nas/ /sgrib pa kun dang bral ba'i ngal gsos pe'adi ni kye ma bdag gis thob/ /de ltar der ni dhambi ru tsesta tra dzi na su tsa ka thānta re/ /kau tu kāddhikṣu bhiḥthraṣṭastaj-iste su ga chos sred dang / /rgyal ba'i gtam gyi kyemajug tu ni/ /mtshar nas tshul de dge slong gis/ /dris shing de to bhya dhwa ta / /pūsgo smindha ga bādku le kṣe ma nāmbi ma tī pa to/ /kṣe bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /sngon gyi bskal par grong khyer ni/ /dge ba can du sa yi bdag /dge 95byed975

su jo sikta ma nutta dzā/ /e ṣpe na ku sha le nā haṃ samyahūṃ bo bye māsgru sems can yang dag sgol la chags/ /bla med yang dag rdzogs byang chub/ /bdud rtsi bran pa thob gyur yāta / /sa ha sra yo bye te nokta me tā dā kabhya sā da raḥ/ /shā ba ko cig /de khye brjod de dag thos gyur nas/ /stong thub gus dang bcas pas bdag /khyod kyi nyan thos haṃ ta bai ba snga mi dre tse pra ṇi dhwa na bān/ /dhand+ra shī lasta ma ba da྾ pā pya dzñā nyid gyur cig /ces pa smras te smon lam btab/ /chos kyi ngang tshul ye shes kyikhru// /spyan ri thob pas de na lo tsa rgo/ /pra bhū ta pā paḥkṛsgo ṇa shā ba kāste bha bee྾ sa/ / ba hu kaste la smras/ /sdig pa rab tu mang ba khyod/ /tshegs chen dag gis nyan thos gyur/ /bskal pa mang po so nga ga te kā le bi shā la ku kṛ ta kṣa yāta/ /budhebhe dhwa na mā kardzu ku sha lo sa ma ba'i tshe/ /yangs pa'i dus la sdog zad nas/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ni thos pa na/ /khyod kyis dge ba thob pāplu si/ /dhand+ra shrī lo kṛ ha pa tiḥso ha me ba da dā bha baṃ/ /sa ha sra yo dhī yabya par 'gyur/ /khyim bdag chos kyi ngang tshul der/ /de yi tshe na nga nyid gyur/ /gang zhig stong thub tu bhūsgo yo dhand+ra ru tsibye rātra/ /dī tī ya katse bha ga bādhī pā khye thra thi bī gyur de/ /yun ring lon nas chos sred 'di/ /gnyis pa'i bskal par grong khyer ni/ /mar me can du sa pa tai/ /dī pa ka rā dha dhaḥ shāstu dī pa tyā ma bhūhphu ri/ / ta po yi bdag /mar me zhes la bcom ldan 'das/ /ston pa mar me mdzad ces gyur/ /nam zhig dka' ba na ru tsisgosthā ka dā tsibhe na bhū ju dzā/ /ni dzaḥpu ra pra bee shā ya sa ga thub nags dgyes de/ /rang gi grong khyer 'jug pa'i slad/ /sa bdag de yi 1gus pa yis/ /phyin nas tā swa yo mabee taḥ/ /pra ṇa ye dṛ pa to tasmin bātpa bye na pra sā di nā/ /su ga rang gis rab tu zhus/ /mi bdag gus pas nga de la ni/ /mnyes gshin rab tu dang ba yi(snye/ /bde bar te nā byu pa ga te saṃ bhā raḥs ma baṃ ta tra/ /sa rā dza kā shi na ga rī gshegs pas khas blangs tshe/ /bkod pa'i tshogs ni rab tu bshams/ / kā shi'i (rtse7grong khyer dag tu ni/ /95—977

bai rā gyutpantu bi mu khāe ya yo dī pa ba ṭī pu ri/ /ta tra lo kā ra ratna dzñā chags bral gnyen las phyir phyogs te/ /mar me can gyi grong khyer song / /der ni rgyan gyi rin chen rnams//kuze rṇa kra yo sha ṣpeḥ/ /sā mū lya shrī ta ku su moḥs dā tsakre su rāstso dzā/ /rim pa yis ni 'tshong byed cing / /rin gyis nyos pa'i me tog gis/ /de yis rtag tu lha mchod byas/ /su ma tirga ra bee da tā dakṣi shābye sa mbi hi tai/ /hi ra rgya she ṣe tatpatna nirdiṣṭi blo gros bzang gis yon thob pa/ /bzhed pa bla ma la phul nas/ /de yi chung mas bstan pa yi/ /gser swa ya ma tītra/ /ta snga me ba bi bhā ba yī swasnanda sha da darsha saḥ/ /pā 8 gyi lhag ma rang gis bzung / /de nyid kyi ni mtshan mo la/ /de yi shermi lam bcu mthong ste/ /bdud rtsi'i su khye sa mu dra su ga ma na ga ga ṣpe na tsa/ /tsaddhārna darsha rā dzñā mu mbi dzā rgya mtsho 'thung ba dang / /nam mkha' la ni 'gro ba dang / /nyi zla mthong dang rgyal po dang / /thub pa'i yo dza na ra dzee/ /shwe te bha haṃ sa sau hā dri shi kha ra ro ha rde ta thā/ /tshogs dang shing rta dang / /glang chen dkar dang ngang pa dang / /de bzhin seng ge'i kye7ri la 'dzeg /so tha pra budhaḥswasthā rna pha lo sgo tusma hā mu ṣpeḥ/ /dza gā ma palnga bhi pta su paṭwā de nas de ni rab sad de/ /thub chen mngon shes lnga ldan pa/ /lo ma gsal ba'i tshal du ni/ /rmi lam da su ta po ba rna/ /sa te na dṛṣṭaḥpro bā tsa twatrusthā dzā pha lo da yo/ /dzi no dzā nā 'bras bu nyan du song / /de yis dris la des smras pa/ /khyod kyi rmi lam 'bras bu rgyas/ /mar me can gyi ti bha ga bādhī pa ba dhyā pu ri sbri taḥ/ / tasgo tā su ma tostuṇḍi swa sna grong gnas pa/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba nyid kyis mkhyen/ /de thob thumyur bar blo gros bzang / /rmi lam byā ka ra rṇaspru kaḥ/ /sa hai ba ma ti nā bhā ya ya yo dī pa pa tī pu rī/ /tasminda lung bstan 'dod pa yis/ /mched ni blo gros dang 'grogs te/ /grong khyer mar me can du song / /skabs ba sa re rā dzñā dī pe na bi pu lotpa be/ /sā pra be sha bha ga ba taḥpu rī der rgyal po mar me yis/ /bcom ldan nang du byon pa yi/ /dga' ston che la grong khyer de/ /rin chen 95—979

raspyo ba dedṛ tā/ /tahphu dzā putpa saṃ bhā ri saṃ bṛ te ta tra bhū bhu dzā/ /kra ya dang ni gos kyis spras/ /de yi mchod pa'i me tog tshogs/ /der ni sa bdag gis bsgrubs tshe/ /nyo tshong bi kra ya bī bhā 6 ṣpe bā dṛ shya ta puju kai/ /ta taḥsā punda ri kā dhyā pu྾ dag gi rmyeganas su ni/ /nges par me tog mthong ma gyur/ /de nas bu mo mdzes ma de④/ /me tog rnyed durla bha tai ga tai/ /pū dza thratstsha da duḥkhārte mā lo kā ra ma ya tsa ta/ /dka' gyur pa'i tshe/ /mchod pa 'chad pa'i sdug bsngal kyis/ /gzir ba 'phreng ①ba mkhan la zhus/ /ta taḥsu ma ti pu bye dzñā pra bhā bā da su paṃ ka dza/ /hra de ba byu ba kasmishyittaṭwā de nas blo bzang bsod nams mthus/ /'dam skyes med pa'i rdzing bu ni/ /'ga' zhig tu yang de dus la ka ma lo bye ba ཿ / / tā ni rā dza bha yātta phye lubha ཿ pra sgo ryarmā nas④—/ /padmo dag ni 'khrungs par gyur/ /de dag rgyal po'i 'jigs pa yis/ /sbas nas sred pas li kaḥ/ /da do sā pya mbu kusgru ntarni kṣi su twa ri tā ya yo/ /su 'phreng khyamakhan gyis/ /de la byin cing de yis kyang / /bum chu'i nang bcug mgyogs par song / /blo ma ti ni dza pū dzā yi ku su mārja pa ri bhā ma na/ /hūṃ phubee padma ba da gros bzang po rang mchod slad/ /me tog don gnyer yongs 'khyams pas/ /padmo rgyas pa'i bzhin ras rmā da darsha pa thi punda rī/ /pu rgyu nu bhā bātta sri ba rku bhā bhyanta ra can—/ /mdzes ma dag ni lam du mthong / /de nas de yi bsod nams mthus/ /srog dang bcas pa saṃ dṛ taiḥ/ /sa dzre baṃ te ri ba mu khaṃ dargo tai ka ma lesta taḥ/ /arja dag gis bzhin/ /bum pa'i nang na rab bsgribs pa'i/ /padmo rnams kyis bzhin dag bstan/ /me tog mā nā hi ra bye na sā te na ka ma lābee nā/ /sā bhe lā ṣa pa ri dzñā ya sasmi don du gnyer ba des/ /gser gyis de la bslangs pa na/ /sred ldan ma yis yongs shes nas/ /'dzum tā ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /tyakta haṃ bha ba tā pūdzee ku su mā n+ya rya yā tsa se/ /ka bcas de la rab smras pa/ /khyod kyis bdag ni sngon btang nas/ /da lta me tog slong bar byed/ /dam 95—980

basthā:byeddhā ma tsā sañtsa ri ṭwā pu raḥ/ /sundaryā sā da rottha ṣṭi bhasthā bha ga zla ba'i mthar/ /mchod pa yang dag rgyu ba thob/ /bcom ldan mdun yodu dad pa yizhu / /mdzes mas gus ba te gra tsā/ /phulbā ra bandi yu ga lo ya yo kaṭwā ba lta pa hūṃ/ /dza ṭā ka pas 1rab gtor ba'i/ /padmo rgyas pa zung dag ni/ /snyan gyi rgyan nyid dag tu gyur/ /blo bzang rab ṭa praḥsu ma teḥsu ga te na pra shā mi naḥ/ /bi shīryata pa dā krāntaḥdu rā tu btud pa yi/ /ral pa'i tshogs ni bde gshegs kyi'7/ /zhabs kyis mnan pas lhung gyur cing / /de sbotta thā pa raḥ/ /laddhā kā sha ga to tasmin pra yā te kṛ ta kṛ tya tī/ /bzhin gzhan ni rab tu 'khrungs/ /de ni bya ba byas gyur cing / /mkha' la 'gro ba thob pa ni67/ /sh-i ṇa taḥ sattha lo ka gya ba bhā ṣe bha ga bābyā naḥ/ /samyakshi bo dhi mā 'jig rten thams cad nyan pa la/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /bla med yang dag rdzogs pa yi//sā rya su ma te twa ma nutta ram̐/ /lo ke shākya mu nirtswa ma bha bi 6 si ta thā ga taḥ/ /byang chub thob nas blo bzang khyod/ /'jig rten du ni de bzhin gshegs/ /shākya thub ces bya bar 'gyur//u dī ri te dzi ṣpe ṣpe ti pubee barṣa di babyu te/ /dza ṭā stu pa pra ti jo zhes pa rgyal bas rab gsungs shing / /mkha' la me tog char lhung tshe/ /mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i ma dza kṛ huḥ sattha madhri ṇaḥ / / bha ga ba stso ra ṇa krāddhā bhā tu dhri ṣṭa slad—/ /blon po kun gyis ral pa blangs(7/ /sa la mched kyi ral pa ni/ /bcom ldan zhabs kyis dza ṭāḥkṣi to/ /gro tri ya tā bhe mā ṣpe na ma tiḥko pā ku lo bha bta/ /ni bārya mnan mthong nas/ /nyan pa nyid du mngon khengs pas/ /blo gros khro bas 'khrugs par gyur/ /de yi su ma tista sra bi kā ram̐ mo ha saṃ bha baṃ / /te ṣpe ba sa hi taḥshāstuḥrnam 'gyur rmongs pa las/ /skyes pa blo gros bzang pos bzlog /de nyid dang ni lhan cig tu/ /ston pa'i pra bra rje ma gra tīhphu raḥ/ /ta taḥkā le na su ma tirde hādhe tu ṣi tā bhi dhe/ /mdun du rab byung blangs/ /de nas dus kyis lus kyi mthar/ /blo gros bzang gis lha yi gnas/ /95—982

a bā pa de ba ni la yo ma tistsa na ra kai ya yo/ /so haṃ su ma ti re dga' ldan zhes pa thob gyur te/ /blo gros dag ni dmyal bar song / /da lta blo bzang de nyid nga / /blo bā rya ma tistu ma ti bi sla bāta/ /a yi dhand+ra ru ཿkliṣṭaḥsunda rī sā ya sho dha rā/ /gros blo gros rnam '-i7bslad pas/ /nyams par gyur pa chos sred 'di/ /mdzes ma de ni grags 'dzin ma'o//tre tī ye bha ga bārkoste kra kutstshanda sta thā ga taḥ / / a nutta ra dzñā gsum pa'i bskal par bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig /bla na med pa'i ye shes ni ni byedzee pū dī pa pu rā bha bāta/ /ba bhū ba sa ma ye tambind+radzdza ya dhī ma hā gter—/ /'dzam bu'i gling du sngon tre7byung gyur/ /de yi dus na 'phags rgyal du/ /tshong pa tsandan byin dha naḥ/ /ba ni stsanda na daṭwā khyaḥpra khyu ta kra ya bi kra yaḥ/ /ta gya kā zhes pa/ /nor chen nyo tshong rngudag gis ni/ /rab tu grags pa byung bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma 'dod ma ba khā khyu yī dzā yī yī ma da na byu tiḥ/ /a shwa daṭwā bhi dhwa no bhūta pu traḥkā pa'i stobs/ /zhes la stsos byed ltar mdzes bu/ /rtas byen zhes ni bya ba dag /lus bzhin du ni dga' ya i ba pri yaḥ/ /aṭwāsthā sa dza gā mādhi pasbyi n+yasta kṛ ha sbi ti/ /dha ṣpe ba byung / /khyim lugs chung ma la bkod nas/ /nor don gnyer de rgya mtshor song / /lan tshwa yis ④nārja ni rmā tro: la ba de nai ba barbha te/ /tatpasnri pro ṣi te ba khyo yo ba bzhin nor can rnams/ /nor dag gis ni sred pa 'phel/ /de yi chung ma khye song tshe/ /lang tshos myos nodmā da mo hi tā/ /kṛ ha tsidzñā pa ri tya bye kā ma dhyā na pa rā bha bta/ /ku shing rmongs pa yis①/ /khyim gyi bsam pa yongs btang nas/ /'dod pa'i bsam gtan la chags gyur/ /mā rā ma shwa datrī sā ni dhwa ya dha na kand+ra ṇi/ /sa dā pā sā da harmya de yis nor gyi las la ni/ /gzhon nu rtas byen rnam 67bkod nas/ /rtag tu khang bzang ba gam du/ /sthā rā dza mārge bya lo ka yata/ /swe rā ra kā sha ra hi tā ba hu dṛ tya dzaṣpe gnas te ⑦rgyal po'i lam la bltas/ /g.yog 'khor mang po'i khyim du ni/ /rang dbang gnas skabs bral 95—983

kṛ he/ /thraddhā dhwa ṭī sa ma bye tya dīsgotshwa sā dza gā da sā/ /bi bha bee ba hu ba des/ /shugs rings phyung nas ma ma ni/ /rgan mo dag la mngon phyogs smras/ /khyim ni 'byor zhing sgo gesmind+ra dzñā dhī na dza no kṛ he/ /swe ra saspyo ra tī nā yā mā taḥs longs spyod mang / /skye bo bka' las khyenyan pa 'dir/ /rang dbang spyod pas dman pa yikhye) ma ma hye na me ra ti/ /nā dhi kā rarne saṭwā riṭwā lo kā rirna sgo dza ṣpeḥ/ /bi bdag la dga' ba med/ /skyes pa'i longs spyod med pa na/ /bud med dga' ba bsten pa ni/ /dbang nā pu byu ṣa saṃ sgo ge bha dzadhe la ṭa bhāḥsu khaṃ/ /tasthābye haṃ pa ri tya bye gis ma yin bkar stes min/ /rgyan gyis ma yin zas kyis min/ /de slad khyil ni yongs btang nas 2 / /gasgo mitstshanda tsā ri bhā/ /bā bye dzā taḥsu te sre ṣa na ste hā ya ta nasma ma/ /bdag ni 'dun pas rgyu zhing 'gro/ /gzhon skyes bu ni 'di la yang / /bdag ni chags pa'i dbang ma gyur//ku la kyu la twa yā ba dhe ba ntu ba ddhā na yo tra rde / / na sa ha dhe rigs kyi 'jug ngogs kyis bcings shing / /gnyen byu 'ching bas bsdams pa dag /bud med dga' ta ram̐ gi byo ra ti shī lā hi yo ṣi taḥ/ /i ti bru bā rde tā mū tse ba'i ngang tshul can/ /g.yo ldan dag gis bzod ma yin/ /zhes smra ④ de la ma ma ni/ /shin tu dhwa ṭī bātpa lya bi kla bān/ /ba྾ na ga ma na yutta tyakta su bee su mdza' bas 'khrugs pas smras/ /mnyes gshin shin tu yangs pa'i dpal/ /btang nas dzee shri yo/ /ba hu kṛ hye kṛ he twasmin gupta tsaryā na yu bye te/ /kṣa ṇi na 'gro ba rigs ma yin/ /bya ba mang pos khyekhyim 'dir ni/ /sbas pas (khyespyod pa mi sbyar te/ /gsang ba'i swe ra tsa ri tai rā dza mārge 6 dha bi ti/ /ka rja rakṣa se tsā ri tram̐ saṃ bhā yo ba spyod pa skad cig gis/ /rgyal po yi ni lam du rgyug /lang tsho tsha bas rab gdungs pa/ /khyod kyis spyod pa noṣṭha zla/ /ka tha gra ha ni dhwa niñtsa pā de nond+rarya gatstsha se/ /i taḥji ltar bsrung / /khyim gyi gter yang rkang pa yis/ /rab spangs khyod kyis ji ltar 'gro/ /'di nas 95—984

kā ma bi ṣa bee ṣāḥshwa blu pā taḥka zla di taḥ/ /asmind+ra bha ya sande he na 'dod pa'i dug 'beebs shing / /'di nas skad cig g.yang la lhung / /gnyis ka the tshom 'di la ni/ /dza ṣpe ki ka ri6 se/ /tā padmā ṇa pa bee nā pi tsa pa laḥs ku byu hla khāḥ/ /khyod kyis ci bya yongs mi ①shes/ /g.yo zhing dge mtshan ldan pa rnams/ /ji srid gos ni ma dor ①bar/ /pa raste yo pārja yadhen yā batpant+ra mu dzhati/ /na na ṣpe tai sa muṅkambi de srid srog gi zong gis kyang / /gzhan gyi bud med don du gnyer/ /'og pag gos nas drangs pa na//ra sa ram̐ shu ka karṣa ṇi/ /gasgo mi muñtsa mubye ti kwa ṇarnyi ka mya ṣpespru ma ma ma zhes 'dar byed cing / /bdag 'gro thongs shig thongs shig ①ces/ /sgra sgogs de ni ④su zhig tā / /dṛṭī bi ba sa dzā thratta karta byaḥsand+ra thā dza naḥ/ /ju dza pañdza ra 'dod—/ /rnam pa kun tu bya ba byas/ /skye bos gos med mthong nas ni/ /lag pa'i gzeb kyis saṃ rudheḥshu ka thra tyā pa khā ya te/ /ti mi re ra ti tso re ṇa kṣa zladdhā bsdams pa yis/ /de tso tshul bzhin 'bros par byed/ /mun par dga' ba'i chom rkun dang / /skad su kha saṃ ga maḥ/ /pu naḥ pra bi rā tā lo ke pa ra lo ke sa mā ga cig byed ni bde bar 'grogs/ /phyin khyenas snang ba rab spangs pa'i/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu maḥ —/ /sā na ṭwā nibee la klibye ladzdza ka ṭī da sgo mu khāe/ /ku mārge 'grogs—/ /bzhin smad ngo tsha'i sdug bsngal can/ /'bras med nyams shing dman pa de/ /tshul khrims hā pi tai yadhī shī la raṭwā mi bakṣe te/ /sā ro di ti pra mṛ ta dubya ri tā rin chen lam ngan du/ /stor bar gyur pa 'tshol khye)ba bzhin/ /dri med tshul khrims do shal 'dod pa'i ngal pa bā dā snyu lā sru bi nd+ra bhi ra manda bi ṣā da kadzee ཿ / / kā ma shra dub kyis chad cing / /mu tig 'bras bu sa gzhi yongs su khengs par byed pa bzhin/ /mi dman chags ma tru ṭi nind+ra la shī la hā ra mukyā pha le ri ba dha ram̐ pa ri pū ra yarnyi/ /bral du brtags mchi ma'i thigs pa rags pa yis/ /nyes spyod smad pa rab tu spros pa de ni ngu bar byed/ /95—985

bā la snga pi tu ṣā ra rand+ra ru tsi ram̐ saṃ gru ta yatyārmitai sthā yi tyāḥs ha sā byis pa'i 'dzum bu bsel zer can ltar mdzes pa la yang rab tu sems byed cing / /padma'i stan ltar lus ni mbi li ta ta noḥpadmā na nā yāḥpa ram̐/ /ge hāntaḥswa ka baṃ mi thaḥka tha no mchog tu zum zhing 'phral la rab tu nyams gyur te/ /khyem gye nang du phan tshun gtam rnams phyir ni rang ya tā mā kaṇḍi yo tyā ba hiḥswe rā gyuskṛ ṇa palla bee pi lu li te gatstsharnyi shaṃ kāsmanaḥ/ /gi gtam du thos gyur pa/ /'phyon ma rnams kyi yid ni rtsa yi 'dab ma bskyod pa la yang dogs par gyur①//rū pa da bye ṇa niryādhi ta ru sgo ཿ sa ti ba bye naḥ / / pa rtswatpa rī ghra gzugs kyi dregs pas gzhon nu mas⑤/ /khyo yi khyim las phyi rol 'thon/ /yongs rtog rnams kyi gabasod tya byedhe pu sgyu sthā ṣpe pa rī kṣa kaiḥ / / ta smrebye ha dzre tī yā ste ya thā nams kyis(ge/ /gnas la yongs brtags phyi nas dor⑤/ /de beed khyem na gnas pa khyod/ /ji ltar pu ru ṣa saṃ ga maḥ/ /lo ke bha ba tya bi dzñā tasta thā yukṣiṃ ba dā mya haṃ/ /skyes bu dang 'grogs shing / /'jig rten dag gis mi shes pa/ /de ltar rigs pa bdag ⑥gis brjod/ /a shwa datta ku mā rā sau ki tsi dā sanda yo ba naḥ/ /dza na snga shaṃ ka mbi ya khyod kyi gzhon nu rtas byin 'di/ /cung zad lang tsho dag la nye(lpi/ /skye bos dogs bya min pa'i slad/ / tāta su kha sgo gyaḥpa ram̐ ta ba/ /e bambi dhabya su mu khaḥkārnyi mā na pā pya te ku mchog tu bde ba longs spyod 'os/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i bzhin bzang dang / /mdzes sdug can ni ga las taḥ / /ni ra sā yaḥpra kā ro yo ya di tā battha brta te/ /i ti dhwa ṭī ba rnyed—/ /gal te re zhig rab bsgrubs na/ /'di ni gnod med rnam pa minaldu/ /zhes pa ma ma'i tshig tsaḥshu twa sā bee yukta ma ma n+yata/ /tī bra rā ga pra kā rāndhaḥsā pa pā tanda thos nas/ /de yis kyang ni rigs par bsams/ /chags pa drag po'i rnam pa yis/ /long bas sdog ltung ⑪pa shya ti/ /dhwa ṭī ta taḥku mā ra su rgyu sgo ga su khaṃ brta ram̐/ /swe mthong ma yin/ /de nas ma mas dal bu yis/ /bud med longs spyod bde bsngags pa⑩/ /bsgrubs 95—986
