ram̐ bi dhwa ya bi daste bi ṣa yā bhi mu khaṃ ma naḥ/ /ta ma bo tse ta sā ni tya shing bsgrubs nas gzhon nu'i yid/ /yul la mngon par phyogs par byas/ /rtag tu 'dod pa rab spros kṛ tā kā ma su tā ra rde/ /asnyi batpa twa du tsi tā kā dzisgo ṣi ta bhadṛ kṣa/ /nas/ /de la de yis rab smras pa/ /bu khyod la 'os 'ga' zhig ni/ /bdag po yul gzhan song ba yod//shu bye beethra ṣpe nidwo pe rā tro mo nāb lambi nī/ /ladzdza ba tī sā su ta dzā twa yā khang stong sgon ma med par ni/ /mtshan mo mi smra la brten te/ /shin tu ngo tsha ldan ma de/ /khyod 7dang saṃ ga ma mitstsha ti/ /i ti ta gya ba tsaḥkhru tā sā bhi lā ṣe ba ṇi ka su taḥ/ /yang dag 'grogs par 'dod/ /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /mngon par 'dod ldan tshong pa'i bus/ /sa dā gupta kṛ he bhe dze dza na sde ra ti saṃ ga oṃ/ /sa ta tai se ba mā nā yāḥrtag tu sbas pa'i khyim du ni/ /ma dang dga' mgur 'grogs pa bsten/ /rtag tu rab bsgribs khyim du ni//pratstshanda bha ba ṣpe ra 1/ /brja mā nāḥs ri ta snga rā gāsniḥpra sha ma ya yo/ /dga' mgur spyod ༷pa sten byed pa/ /de la chags pa'i ma rngudag ni/ /rab tu 'phel zhing zhi ma thugyur//sā tsinta ya di rmā ni bye pratshwa da na ka darja dzā/ /na se hai byu pa sgo ga su de yi ⑤bsams pa rtag tu ni/ /rab tu bsgribs pa'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /mi bzod gzugs kyi longs pra kṣa shaḥki la dzī bi tai/ /a byo n+ya ba da rmā sgo bi lo ka na ra saṃ bee nā/ /spyod la/ /snang ba nyid ni 'tsho ba lo⑥ / /phan tshun bzhin gyi chu skyes la/ /rnam par lta ba'i ro bral ba'i//na tsu sbra ṣpe na su ra te ka bye da ste su khotpa pa ཿ / / ta smrahphu sgo da 'o yi ④dga' mgur spyod pa la/ /bde ba'i dga' ston 'ga' duyod min/ /de bsgribs pa yi nyon nā yā pa ku mā ra gya pa yatna taḥ/ /dzhaghā pra sa bha sa sgo ge pra di shā mongs ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas bcom ⑨byas te/ /'phral la longs spyod gzhon nu ma/ /gsal bar mi pra gambha tī/ /i ti saṃ tsi na sā rā tro pra bhā te byakta bi gra ha/ /bdag gis bstan par bya/ /zhes pa mtshan mo rab bsams te/ /rab gsal ⑪ lus des gos dag ni//95—987

ya yo bsnga pa rā dṛtta yubhya ta gya pra kā sha tsā/ /sa ni dzee dza na 1 dṛṭī yongs su dzee ba'i rig pa yi1/ /nang par de la rab gsal gyur/ /de yis rang gis ④ma mthong nas//ritstshanda mū la i ba dru maḥ/ /pa pā ta pā ta ka bi ṣā bee she na bi ba shi kṛ taḥ/ /rtsa ba bcad pa'i ljon pa bzhin/ /sdig pa'i dug ni 'bebs pa yi①/ /dbang dang bral bar byas te lhung //ta yā shī tību nā sikta sa ṣpeḥsaṃ dzha ma bā pa saḥ/ /bi ma khā pa thra thu shwa bhra de yis bsil ba'i chus bran te/ /dal gyis 'du shes thob pa des/ /rgya che g.yang sar 'khyam ④pa la//bi bhra mā di ba duḥkhi taḥ/ /ta mu bā tsa pa ri khya bye bhu dzā dzñā kā ma mo hi tā/ /sdug bsngal gyur bzhin smre sngags phyung / /dmyal bar lhung ba'i pho nya mo/ /'dod pas rmongs ma de yis ni//zla la hūṃ sā sa mund+ra mya na ra kā pā ta dru ti rmā/ /mi byā ki ma ya smin ma'i 'khri shing gzengs bstod cing ⑪/ /lag pas yongs 'khyud de la smras/ /khrod kyi mya ngan bzod masthā ṣpe bi ṣā da sta ba duḥs ha/ /kinda dzā nā si nā rī shā ma sa tyarnya dka' 'di/ /gnas min rdzun pa dag la ci/ /bud med chos kyis bsdams pa rnams/ /mi bden khyod nd+ra yant+ra/ /natwa yotyā di tai duḥkhaṃ j-i swā ka gya tsidha rna/ /sā dhwa kyis mi shes sam/ /khyod kyi ⑥sdug bsngal yongs ma skyed⑦/ /su yi yang ni nor ma phrogs/ /thun mong ra su kha sgo gesmin ke yadhe bā pa bā sa nā/ /sa ratyā dmā ra zla nāryāsta ram̐ gi bde ba'i longs spyod 'dir/ /khyod la sdig pa'i bag chags ci/ /g.yo ldan bsdams pa med pa yi/ /chu dhī ni rarga lo/ /ya snga rnge ba pi tāsthā tasta sum̐ kind+ra rtswa ti ki su taḥ/ /ya klung bud med thun mong nyid/ /gang la pha yis khrus byas teblu/ /bu ni khrus byed min nam ci/ /lam thā ye na pi tā yāta ste na pu tro pi gatstsha ti/ /sā mā n+ya ga ma no e ba batta bhā gang nas ni pha song ba/ /de nyid nas ni bu yang 'gro/ /bud med brgya lam dag dang mtshungs/ /thun sambi bhāḥ ste yaḥ / /e ka sgo gye ba la la nā na pa rasba ra marta mong ba yis ⑪bgrod bya nyid/ /bud med gcig gis spyod ⑩ bya nyid/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyis 'os min hpha/ 95—988

ti—/ /yīsgo lu bhiḥkṛ tai kaishyi de tatpa ma yamā tra ka/ /ṣpe ba kā tsa da pa—/ /'di ni 'ga' zhig phrag dog dang / /ldan pas dam tshig byas pa tsam/ /dam pa'i don du dga' ga myuste ra tyarjaḥpa ra mārja taḥ/ /e ka pā tro pa sgo gyu hi bee tuḥpu tra gye mgu'i slad/ /bgrod par mi bya 'ga' yang med/ /pha dang bu yi snod gcig bzhin/ /bud med nye bar bste yaḥ/ /i ti yasne na sa ta yā saṃ sgo gā bye mu khaḥkṛ taḥ/ /sa dzā longs spyod bya/ /zhes te de yi hu7'bad pa yis/ /longs spyod la de mngon phyogs byas/ /'dod chags ta rā gaḥs ta tai shi ṣe bi dza na mbi pa shuḥ/ /ta taḥkā le na pi ta re pra skyes pas rtag par yang / /phyugs bzhin du ni ma nyid bsten/ /de nas dus kyis 6rtepha dag ni/ /chu tyā yā tai ma ho da dheḥ/ /sa gru bye pre ri to mā tā bi ṣe na bee da dhe gter che las slar 'ongs pa①/ /ma yis bskul ba des (byegasang nas/ /dug gis srog dang bral bar byaste / /ta taḥs rā ga thradhri ba ni rarga la su khi ṣi bhā/ /swe re ku byas—/ /de nas chags pa 'phel ba yisro)/ /ma bsdams bde ba 'tshol ⑥ba des/ /mdza' bas rmongs mā ram̐ pra ṇa yā du bā tsasne ha mo hi tai/ /sā ra dra bi ṇa nā dā ya niryant+ra pa'i gzhon nu la/ /mdza' bas dal gyes rab smras pa/ /ma bsdams bde ba thob pa'i slad/ /snying po'i ṇa su khāpta ye/ /e hi de shānta raddhā bta gatstsha baḥkaspyo kodzhai tai/ /i ti nor dag blangs byas la/ /tsher ma spangs pa'i yul gzhan du/ /'u cag re zhig 'gro bar bya/ /zhes pa tatpa tsa.āoṃ khru tā tsi ra kā la sa mbi hi tai/ /sā ra dra bi ṇa mā dā ya ya yo sa hi de tshig yun ring gi /dus su 'dod pa thob gyur nas/ /nor gyi snying po blangs byas te/ /de ni de dang tasta gya yā/ /de shānta re kṛ ta pa do pa re pratstshanda pā ta kau/ /dzā yā 'grogs nas song / /yul gzhan dag tu gnas byas te/ /sdig pas rab bsgribs de dag ni/ /chung ma pa ti hūṃ bi khyu su to nibee tai ma bā pa tuḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsittaṅge haṃ swa de sha pratya khyo bo nyid du grags/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig khyim der ni/ /rang gi yul 95—989

bhi snyo yā/ /dzha gruḥpa ri tsi to bye tya bātpa sthātta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /par mngon shes pas/ /yongs 'dris hudage slong mngon phyogs te/ /mnyes gshin las ni de la smras//kañtsibye ku sha lasmra tuḥkastsodzdzadma ma ṭī mu huḥ/ /tyast+ri yashyihūṃ ya tashyirghaṃ khyod kyi ma ni dge ba'am ci/ /skye ba btang las ④yang yang du/ /bsam ①pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems//nā pā tya nu sha ya bya tsā/ /i ti bhispyottha tsaḥkhru tā shi la ye ba sa tā ḍi taḥ/ /'gyod gdung med par gyur tam ci/ /zhes pa dge slong tshig thos nas/ /rdo ba yis ④ni bsnun pa bzhin//pra tya bhi dzñā na tsa ki hūṃ ste hūṃ yukta ma tsitta yatu/ /sa mā tra sa ha 'dri shes bdag khyegis 'jigs pa des/ /rigs pa de de rab bsams pa/ /gros byed 'jigs ⑥pas saṃ ma tya mant+ra bhe da bha yā ku laḥ/ /bhi gru mantandi ryand+ra ste shant+ra ṇa 'khrugs pa des/ /ma dang lhan cig bgros byas nas/ /dge slong de ni mgron gnyer te/ /ma bsdams kṛ he ba dhī ta/ /arta ddhikṣu ba dhe pya gya nā kaspatpa nādma naḥ/ /mtshon gyis khyim du bsad/ /dge slong dgra bcom bsad la yang / /de yid lag kyang bdar ba ④yin/ /dṛ shaṃ sāḥbā ta kairyārnyi badzā da dhi ka zo ra tsā/ /dhasmra dri sh-i gā gra pa ri tsu tā gtum po rnams ni sdig pa yis/ /rdo rje las lhag sra bar 'gyur⑧/ /ngos med g.yang sar chos kyi ri rtse yi/nām dho mu khā nā ma ta pa ba ṭi 6/ /ba hu blu ma shwa bhra shwa tā ha tā āoṃ bha ba tya steng nas kha ni thur ltas py-ilhung gyur cing / /'khrul mang bya skyibs rgya ⑪ yis bsnun pa rnams/ /nges par lam̐ pā ta pa ram̐ pa ri ba/ /su te na ra ma mā nā pi sā saṃ sgo ga pa rā ya rja/ /rgyun ⑪ma dag tu lhung bar 'gyur/ /bu dang rol par byed mod kyang / /longs spyod dag la chags pa des//punda rā khye ba ṇi ka pu tram̐ dṛṭī bhūta ta tra sa smṛ hā/ /ra ti pa ri tsi taisgo gāsgyu mdzes pa zhes bya tshong pa'i bu/ /mthong nas de la chags ldan gyur/ /dga' mgur spyad pa yongs 'dris ⑫ meeḥs ra pa ri ba rja te ki ma pi bha dza te lo bhaḥthra rnyi pra bṛdha dha no goms pas longs spyod dag ni mchog tu 'phel/ /nor ni rab 'phel dar bas chags pa stug po ci yang 95—990

da yaḥ/ /la ba ṇa sa li khā pā ṣpeste: pra yā tya ti tī pra hūṃ dzwa la ti bi sten par byed/ /lan tshwa'i chu dag 'thungs pas shin tu mi zad 1sred pa skye bar 'gyur/ /chu ni rgya che me pu la dzā khā lī tairdza lerba ḍa bān ཿ/ /hūṃ gu shwe saṃ ga hūṃ te na te na rā gi bhā lces myangs pas rta gdong me ni rab tu 'bar/ /'dod ldan gsar pa de dang ni/ /chags ldan ma de na ba kā mi nā/ /dṛṭī sho dattaḥkhaṅge na dza ghā na dza na nī kru dhwa/ /ā gsang 'grogs pa/ /rtas byin gyis mthong khros pa yis/ /ral gri dag gis ma nyid bsad/ /mtshams narnya:ste bhiḥpā pa bhā riḥs gu ru hūṃ ga taḥ/ /nishī si taḥpu rāta tūrṇa de ba tā pre med gsum gye sdig khur gyis/ /de ni phyi ba nyid du gyur/ /skye bo lha yis bskul rnams kyis/ /myur du ri tairdza naiḥ/ /sa dzā tā nu sha ya ste ze ga tā bhikṣu ga khyobee jun/ /grong khyer dag las byung khye// /'gyod pa drag po skyes pa dezu/ /song nas dge slong tshogs mang la /duḥkhārya yā tse pra bra dzhai pa ti tā ya da do ya dā/ /ta dā da dā ha pa dwo ṣāta subye sdug bsngal las ni rab byung zhus/ /gang tshe sdig can la ma byin/ /de tshe de yi zhe sdang gis/ /dge slong bhikṣu ga rde ni shi/ /e kastu bo bye sahūṃ shwa bhikṣu sta gya da yārtu dhīḥ/ /tshogs nyal mtshan mo bsregs/ /de la brtse bas brlan pa'i blo/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' che/ /ta bā di de sha pra pra dzhai shikṣu pa da bi brji hūṃ/ /shikṣu pa dā ni nizlantaryā gcig gis de tshe bslab pa'i gnas/ /spangs pa'i rab tu byung ba byin/ /rab tu 'bad cing nan tan tsa mā na pra ya tna ta ཿ / / bhikṣu sta mū tse nārto si shikṣu pa da pa gyis—/ /bslab pa'i gnas ni zhu byed pa/ /de la dge slong gis smras khyod/ /bslab gnas 'dzin pa ri gra he/ /na mo buddhā ya buddhā ye bye ta de ba sa dā ba da/ /dzi yongs ④mi 'os/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di nyid rtag tu brjod/ /rgyal nā bhe jo na shu tī ba kaspradhe mutta me 6 si/ /a thā shwa datta de hadhe ba'i mtshan ni thos nyid kyis/ /dus kyi mthar ni khrod grol 'gyur/ /de nas rtas byin lus kyi mthar/ /95—991

gho randa ra ka mā bi shata/ /ya snga gre pra ba lotta la shī ta khāḥpra la yā na 'jigs su rung ba'i dmyal bar zhugs/ /gang mdun rab tu nyam nga ba'i/ /grang ba 'jig pa'i me ldan laḥ —/ /so yandhand+raru tsiḥdṛṣṭa tsi ra gye ti tsi rādma yā/ /a bhi dhwa ye nyi pa—/ /de nyid chos sred yun ring gi/ /yun ring las zhes bdag gis dris/ /zhes pa brjod nas bcom bha ga bān bi ra rā ma ta thā ga taḥ/ /bā tā lī dza na byā ta re ga ta ra khā niḥldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bzhugs/ /rba ①rlabs ltar g.yo ma yi rlung 'tshub ②dag la saṃ ka mā lo gi tā pā pya thra rnyi ma darsharna sa dza na kaste dzi ni byeḥ/ /dogs pa med par rab tu 'khyud/ /dar ba thob nas pha ni gzi byin gter de snang ba min pa dag tu bkod//arta tpa twa pa da pra kā sha bi bha ba st+ri bra kra me khyo ha to dhū me nā ti dgra bcom sems can 1/gnas ni rab tu gsal ba'i 'byor pa mi zad ngurim pas bcom/ /du ba shin tu ma lbo ma se na na pa ram̐ ki ki kṛ ta duḥkṛ ta maḥ/ /i haṃ kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dri ma can gyis mchog tu nyes byas ci dang ci ma byas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee dhand+ra ru tsu ba dā lda me kānda ba ti ta maḥsems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam byu 'khri shing las chos sred kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab pabee baḥ// //ste brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //ma naḥshudhi pi dhwa ṣpe na dā ṣpe nā ti lasbyi ya sā/ /bha baṃ tya lo sgyuḥsaṃ kalpaḥyid ni dge ba'i sgrub byed can/ /sbyin pa shin tu chung ngu yis/ /snying stobs can la phun tshogs ni//saṃ pa da sa twa shā li dzā/ /bu rā thra dzi 6 bai shā spyo marka ṭā khyu dru mārnyi ke/ /brtag pas bgom par 'a7bya mi 'gyur/ /bṛ dzi'i yangs pa can du sngon/ /spre 'u'i rdzing zhes bya ba'i 'gram/ /ku ṭā gā ra kṛ hā bā se dzi ṣpe bha ga ba ti spru te/ /ba bhū ba dha ni ko nā khang pa brtsegs pa'i khyim gnas na/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /yon tan mtha' dag ldan 95—992

ma shri yā kṛ ha pa tidṛ taḥ/ /sa ma gra gu ṇa saṃ yo gāhphu ru sngotta ma tsā pa las/ /skyes bu mchog nyid du gyur pa/ /khyim bdag dpal gyis bskor ba ni/ /nor can zhes pa byung ga taḥ/ /pasbyi dhand+ra sa khāe ta su shī la bi tya bhi dhwa bha bta/ /ba da tyā khyastsa bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma chos kyi grogs/ /ngang tshul can zhes bya bar gyur/ /bu ni gtong phod can zhes ta na yaḥsnu ṣā sa tya ba tī ta thā/ /saṃ gha tāḥs ma yo ta tra tsa krudzee shā dang / /de bzhin mna' ma bden ldan ma'o/ /yangs pa can pa'i bram ze rnams/ /'tshogs stinas li kā dī dzāḥ / / ni ma nt+ra nī yo bha ga bā dma bye ཿ saṃ byu ya nā der ni nges par byas/ /thams cad 'tshogs ②nas bcom ldan 'das/ /mgron du gatrer bya gzhan du n+ya thā/ /e ka tsi ta ku ru te bitta ma dālja na ni mant+ra khaṃ/ /sambirnirka sa min—/ /nor gyis ④rgyags pas gcig gis ni/ /gal te rgyal ba mgron gnyer byed/ /gzhan gyis ④nī yo yo ba re yānta1 bi snan kṛta/ /te ྾ sa ma ya ma dzñā tā pu chos kyi bgegs byed pa/ /de ni kun gyis dbyung bar bya/ /de dag nges pa ma shes na⑤/ /nor can bye bārsā ni kāḥswa yo/ /di bya sadza da yu ta:kre ga tā dzi na ni mant+ra khaṃ/ /mchog gi phun tshogs ldan/ /bsod nams ldan pa rang nyid kyis/ /song nas rgyal ba mgron ⑥gnyer byas//sa bhasti mā na bha ga bāsgo hā bhe ga ma ṣpe swa yi/ /sa saṃ bhe nā byu pa ga te bcom ldan rang nyid ⑦dge 'dun dang / /lhan cig khyim du gshegs par ni/ /zhal gyis bzhes tshe gus dṛṣṭaḥswa bha ba rde ya yo/ /sa ta tra di bya bi bha baḥsaṃ bhā re ste di bo ldan de/ /dga' bas rang gi khyim du song / /der ni de yis lha la 'os/ /mchog gi 'byor pa'i tshogs tsi taiḥ/ /ratna sa no pa ka ra rde saṃ dzñā sgo bye byu baṃ bya bhātro/ /a tārnya re rnams kyis/ /rin chen stan dang yo byad dang / /zas kyi sa gzhi bstar ba byas/ /skabs der gnyis dī dzāḥ sa bye ga tā bha ga ba twa rnyi ga / saṃ bhū ya kṛ ta saṃ bhā skyes thams cad ni/ /'dus nas yo byad tshogs bsgrubs pas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung song nas/ /95—993

ra tsakrurbhasgyu ni mant+ra khaṃ/ /tā nu bā tsā tha bha ga bānd+ra pā da bi sha dā sha gus pas mgron du gnyer ba byas①/ /de nas de la bcom ldan 'das/ /rab dang dri med bsam pas yaḥ —/ /pūzla me ba sa saṃ sgo haṃ dha ni ke na ni madhri taḥ/ /e ta gsungs—/ /sngon du dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ /nor can gyis ni mgron du gnyer/ /de dag thos dā kaṇḍi ya te 6 te 6 swa bha ba rna sha ṣpeḥ/ /pu re pra tīghra mā ṇi 6 nas bcom ldan 'das/ /mchod pa sngon gyi nyin par la/ /rab tu rtog cing de dag rnams/ /rang gi di rna bha ga ba torbha ṣpe/ /dha ni kaḥswa kṛ haṃ ga tā bha ga bābee ha bhikyu bheḥ/ /khyim du song ba'i tshe/ /nor can khang par bcom ldan 'das/ /dge slong rnams dang bcas byon nas/ /di byābyu tarbhe saṃ bhā re tsakre sgo bye pra ti gra haṃ/ /e bye dru ra ṣi tatpa snri lha yi rmad byung phun sum tshogs/ /mchod ston rab tu bzhes pa mdzad/ /de yi chung mas nyin gzhan yang //tabhu lya bi pu khā shri yaḥ/ /di byo pa sgo ga saṃ bha ri rbha ga banta ma pū dza de mtshungs yangs pa'i dpal gyis ni/ /mchog gi longs spyod tshogs rnams kyis/ /bcom ldan 'das la ya2 / /tahphu tre ṇa dṛ tī yeji tsa tuze snu ṣa yā dzi naḥ/ /ā:rya mchod pa byas/ /gsum pa'i nyin la de yi bus/ /bzhi par mna' mas rgyal ba ni/ /ngo mtshar 'byor bi bha bā sgo kai ru pa rbha gerni madhri taḥ/ /a labha bru dzā ba sa raḥpa'i longs spyod kyi/ /nyer spyad rnams kyis mgron du gnyer/ /yangs pa can pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /shāstubye shā le kau ga shāḥ/ /dha ni kā ya pra kruspyo: tsakrunishī sa no rya oṃ/ /ston pa mchod pa'i skabs ma thob/ /nor can la ni rab khros te/ /gnas nas dbyung ba'i rtsom pa byas//shā sa nākhru ga ta snga tha dha ni ka na dī dzāsta taḥ/ /na ma yā dza ta de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bkas/ /gnyis skyes de dag rnams la ni/ /bdag gis ma shes zhes i byughā te dha ni ka pra sā di tāḥ/ /sa pasnri ko tha dha ni kaḥs pu tabyusnu brjod nas/ /nor can gyis ni dang bar byas/ /de nas nor can chung mar bcas/ /bu dang bcas shing 95byed994

gatstsha maḥki bha bi 6 ti/ /i ti te sa ma yo kṛ hūṃ bste ṇa ta ma dhwa dzan/ /tahphu du mi 'gro ci 'byung 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i dam tshig de dag gis/ /byas nas gos kyis de la mchod/ /de yi rgya pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na dha ni ko yo sa mā mi kaḥ/ / dzā to di bya pra bhā bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /'phreng ①rgyud mkhan 'di sde nor can 'di/ /chung ma bu dang mna' mar bārjaḥpasnri pu trasnu ṣā nī taḥ/ /sattha zlo ni ti ka thi tai khru tā saṃ sa ldan—/ /lha mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ /ces pa tshogs su kun mkhyen byus/ /bshad pa thos nas di rnyikṣa baḥ/ /me ni re tsitta bee ma lya mū lā dā na pha la shri yo/ /ta taste zwa dge slong rnams/ /sems ni dri med rtsa ba dag /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu'i dpal du sems/ /de nas bram hma shāḥ sabye saṃ bhū ya shu tsi sgo dza ṣpeḥ/ /bha ga parnye sa ma bhya tsu ba ze de dag rnams/ /kun 'tshogs —gtsang ba'i zas dag gis/ /bcom ldan 'das ni yang dag mchod/ /bhu buḥku sha lo dzwa lāḥ/ /te lāspru tai ratna dha rna tro zla gro shrasgye ba tāṇḍi tre ṇa dge ba rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ /dman byin rin chen nor ni rtswa yi rtse/ /dad pas byin pa'i rtswa yang ma pyanarghaṃ/ /a ṣpe ka sho bhā nu bha baṃ na biṣṭi tsitta ni mitrī shu sgo saṃ bha bā rmā/ /rin thang med/ /mdzes pa du ma'i nyams stsong nor yin ④te/ /dge ba 'byung ba'i rgyu ni sems nyid do/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee dha ni zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing kā ba dā narja ba ti ta maḥpabee waḥ// //las nor can rmi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu pa'o// //su bhā ṣi tai sa tya pa thā pra kā sha rna ka ro tya nā lo ka pa de 6 di snang ba med pa'i gnas rnams dag tu sgon me (zhi7bzhin/ /legs par bshad pa bden pa'i lam ni pa bta/ /sa do pa kā rā da ta e ba balla tai bi bee ka tsa tsā su ma hādma gsal bar byed/ /de nyid phyir ni 67 rtag tu nye bar mkho ⑦ba las/ /bdag nyid che rnams dben pa spyod 95—996

nā ma pi/ /ku shi sudzñā bha ga ba tā ya dā malla dza nā sba de/ /artatpa la yid du 'ong / /gang tshe gyad kyi skye ba'i gnas/ /ku sha'i grong du bcom ldan 'das/ /dge ba 'tshol ①rda bhikṣu ga ṇaḥpā pi taḥku sha le ṣi shā/ /ta dā ka tha ya tā dhadzre nyikṣu bas dge ba'i 1tshogs/ /dgra bcom gnas la bkod gyur pa/ /de tshe phan tshun snyan par chos smra rde ma dhu rasmi thaḥ/ /swa yi shu shā ba su ga taḥspru nyi yuktaḥsu bhā ṣi byed dge slong rnams dag gis①/ /legs bshad bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /dgyes pa dang ldan rang gis tai—/ /su bhā ṣi ta bya sa ni hūṃ tī dṛṭī ta su bhikṣa baḥ/ /ta mū tsusta ba gsan—/ /de yi legs bshad la gcags ④pa/ /de mthong dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /de la gsol ba sarba rnye ka tha masmraṅga tsaḥthra yi/ /i kyuste bhikhyu saṃ ste na bha ga bā na kun mkhyen nyid/ /nged kyi tshig la ji ltar dgyes/ /dge slong tshogs kyis de brjod tshe/ /bcom ldan rgyal bhya dharji naḥ/ /dzadmānta re ṣṭa pi pa ra balla bha me su bhā ṣi tai/ /shi ba bas bka' stsal pa/ /bdag ni skye ba gzhan du yang / /legs bshad dag la mchog tu dga'/ /grong khyer ba dhyā pu rā pu.āoṃ shi bind+ra ma na re shwa raḥ/ /ba khyu ba saza bhū tā ram̐ da yā da yi ta zhi ldan dag tu sngon/ /mi dbang shi bi zhes bya ba/ /'byung po kun la brtse ba yi/ /yid 'ong gnyen du bāndha baḥ/ /tahphu rgya shā sa nā sī ṣpeḥswaspyo mā pū ri tai dza ṣpeḥ/ /dṛṭī gyur pa byung / /de yi ⑤bsod nams bkar 'uganas pa'i/ /mi yi kyematho ris kun gang ba/ /mthong sha ta kra tu dzñā hūṃ swa two ta gya sa mā ya yo/ /ratna pā sā da shi kha ra nas de yi snying stobs ni/ /rtag tu mchod sbyin brgya pa 'ongs/ /de ni rin chen khang bzang rtser/ /krārnyi dṛ pa ti me bhya saḥ/ /rakṣe rū dzā bi dhwa yo gre ta da grwa bhe mu 'dzegs pa'i mi bdag can song nas/ /'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs bsgrubs te'u7/ /de yi mdun du kho bra bītro/ /a ni tyāḥsashā rāsta ra la ta ra bi byubyu ti ni bhaḥs mngon phyogs smras/ /'du byed mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba'i glog rab mdzes pa dag dang mtshungs/ /rab tu 95—997

mutparjotpanda pra la ya pa ri khyo ma pra ṇa yi naḥ/ /su bhā ṣi tārbha mi tyāghā tūṭī mā skyes shing skyes shing 'jig pa'i ①yongs su 'gyur ba dag la chags/ /zhes pa'i legs bshad phyed brjod setpa rā kṣa saḥ/ /tai pra ṇa myakṣi ti pa tiḥkṛ hūṃ dza li ra pra bhā ṣaṭa/ /nas—/ /srin po de ni mi smra gyur/ /sa yi bdag pos thal sbyar nas/ /phyag 'tshal de la rab smras pa/ /sā sgo su bha ṣi ta sngarghaṃ she ṣe sa ma naḥsu khaṃ/ /ba bhā bo dhyaṅga bhā hūṃ dge ba legs par bshad pa'i phyed/ /yid bde lhag ma gsung bar mdzod/ /byang chub yan lag gyur hūṃ shi khyo byu tā sh-i rto mya haṃ/ /i ti bru ba khaṃ bi na yāta dṛ paṃ pro bā tsa rākṣa skad de/ /slob mar gyur nas bdag nyan no/ /dul bas de smra mi bdag la/ /srin po yis ni rab smras saḥ / /twa yā shi bye ṇa rā dzend+ra niphe le na ka ro mi ki/ /pi pā sa pa ri bhū to haṃ pa—/ /rgyal dbang slob ma 'bras bu med/ /khyod kyis bdag la ci zhig bya/ /skom pas bdag ni yongs khyuṇḍa ku kṣirbu bhukṣa yā/ /ṣpe tatpa me dzre tai rā dzaṅge ba lo gu ru go nyen cing / / bkres pas sku 5ni yongs su nyams/ /rgyal po bdag ni bla ma yi/ /zhe sa 'ba' zhig 'di ra baṃ/ /kṣutū : byā ku la ta yā yasko tsittha la bā mya haṃ/ /she ṣe bahūṃ mi 'dod/ /bkres skom dag gis gzir gyur pas1/ /gang zhig cung zad bdag smra'o/ /lhag ma brjod na shagho mi mā kṛ tā me ka brja dzā/ /mā dhurya dhurlu ṇi ra so tsi tā na par yongs pyami nus/ /bdag la sdug bsngal ma mdzad cig /snyan pa'i gdangs ldan ro ni 'os pa can/ /sadzadzha mā nā ni su bhā ṣi tā ni/ /ṣpe baṃkṣu sgo nakṣa pa yarnyi tū: me tā ni j-ibee legs par bshad pa rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /tshim la bde ba ster byed 'di dag ni/ /nges par bkres dang su su kha pra dā ni/ /khru tai gī tai kā bye shra ma pa ri tsa yaḥkau tu ka bi dhi skom pa za byed min/ /thos dang glu dang snyan dngags ngal bas yongs 'dris dge mtshan sgrub byed dang / /ma ṇidzñā rna byu ta gra ha ga da bi khodmā da sha ma dzwa/ /dṛ rde bhū j-itpa bā dza la nor bu shes dang 'byung po gdon nad dug dang skyo snyeb zhi byed dang / /sa 'dzin bsten dang chu gter sgol 95—998

dhe ta ra ṇi he ma ka ra khaṃ ta de tatpa ryarnye ga ni ta ma khi lo sgo dza na bar byed dang gser 'gyur dag dang lkurtsis/ /'di dag ma lus mthar thug 'bras bu mi rnams dag gi pa lo/ /sa ryaḥkṛtta su ru bye ram̐ rmā sī tsa ma ma tarba khaṃ/ /a ho bza' ba yin/ /'phral la bcad pa'i sha dang ni/ /khrag dag bdag la khutshim byed pa/ /'tshe ②med sna bandha rgo ya mātwatta sta da ti durla sgo/ /gatshwa mi yā tsi nyu ki tsita sdom pas bcings gyur pa/ /khyod las shin tu rnyed par (4dka'/ /khyod dang nye bar bdag ci byed/ /twatpa mbi pe ka ro mi ki/ /spri ḍāḥka thā: sho bharnye tu spyo hā ra bi hā ra yoḥ/ /'ga' zhig la ni slong du 'gro/ /zas dang gnas ni mtshungs pa yi/ /rtsed mo dang ni gtum ⑤dag mdzes/ /i hphuktaste na dṛ pa tista ma bhā ṣa tai mā da raḥ/ /ni dza de ha sa myuskṛtrī zhes des brjod tshe mi bdag ni/ /gus dang bcas pas de la smras/ /rang gi lus ni rab bcad pa'i/ /sna mṛ.oṃ saṃ da dā mi te/ /two pra tī tya sa mutyā da pūnd+ra dā ra mu dā ha ra/ /nittha khrag dang ⑥sha ni khyod la sbyin/ /rgya che blo gros ldan pa khyod/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung dang po'i sgo/ /khyod ṇa na ga ra snga gruḥpadzeesta ba su bha ṣi tai/ /i truste rā dza tsande ṇa ta kyi legs bshad myang 'das kyi/ /grong khyer gyi ni lam gyi mchog /rgyal po zla bas 'di brjod tshe/ /myu bā tsa kṣa pā tsa raḥ/ /shā ya tī su ma te tuṇḍi dzā ya tī tsa pra ti khru tai/ /mtshan mo rgyu bas de la smras/ /blo gros bzang po myur du nyon/ /dam bcas pa dag sbyin par mdzod/ /a ni tyāḥsaṃ sthā rāsta ra la ta ra bee byuju ti ni bhaḥs mutparjotpa nda pra 'du byed mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba'i glog rab mdzes pa dag dang mtshungs/ /rab tu skyes shing skyes shing dzeel ya pa ri shā ma pra ṇa yi naḥ/ /ta dubye dzee tu rmā bhra ma ṇa pa ri brtaḥshra ma ba tsā ni 'jig pa'i yongs su 'gyur ba dag la chags/ /des bskyed 'khor zhing yongs su sgyur bas srog chags dag ro dhwaji shrirnyi di shi ti bi ba shā nā mu pa sha maḥ / /e ta ni dbang bral zhing / /ngal dub ldan pa rnams la nyer zhi 'gog pas ngal gso ster bar byed/ /de dag 95—999

su re shwa raḥ/ /pra sa rya dṛ pa ti yā tā dṛṣṭa sa te sha ta kra to/ /atsinta rab tu bsngags/ /brgya byin snying stobs ldan pa ①yis/ /mi bdag la ni dang byas so/ /de yis (3 yakhru ṅgā swa rda byu pa tistahphu bhā ṣi tai/ /shi birna re shwa raḥso ha ma legs bshad bdud rtsi yi/ /nyams myong sa yi bdag pos bsams/ /nga nyid sngon gye skye ba la/ /mi bha baṃ pūbyu dzadma ni/ /i nyi pra ṇa ba ṣpe nā byubyella rbha me su bhā ṣi tai/ /dbang shi bi der gyur nasasku/ /de ltar srog gi zong gis bdag /legs bshad la ni dga' bar gyur/ /ta thā ga te ba ka thi tā dzadmant+ra ra ka tsā ni dzā/ /ā kasbya bhikṣa baḥsabye pra rang gi skye ba gzhan gyi gtam/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa dag /thos nas ya mtshan ldan pa yi/ /shaṃ suḥs bi sma yāḥ/ /dṛṣṭa dṛṣṭa su khe su bhā ṣi ta ru tsisthānāḥpra bhā dī dge slong kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /mthong dang ma mthong bde la lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgon pa ya ta saṃ bā de na su bhā ṣi tā mṛ ta ra sa ཿ spru ti pa ram̐ ba ste ma lta bur spyod/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba'i char dag ti / /sadzee zlo pi su bhā ṣi tārja bi ṣa ye ryarja mbi yabee rmā tasmrand+rasnyi su bhā ṣi 'bebs—/ /legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyur/ /te na sa dṛ shaṃ ki tsi tpa tī ba bee bha ma / / i ti kṣe de slad dam pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī shi bi su dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las shi bee'i legs bhā ṣi tā ba dā na me ka na ba ti ta maḥpalla baḥ// //bshad kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //gu rū ṇa ma su gre gu ru ta ra pa de se ba ma ha tī sa dā saddhiḥpū dzñā bla ma rnams kyi mdun dag tu yang shin tu bla ma'i gnas su che/ /'byung po rnams ni 'dzin byed 95—1001

tri da sha ta ṭi bhā pā ba na ta nuḥ/ /dha ri ṭī hūṃ tā āoṃ sa ka la ra sa sā ra mtha' dag ro yi snying po rab tu bsgrun/ /lus ni mdza' gcugs bzhin du rgyas byed skabs gsum chu bo pra sa tsi nā sha ri ram̐ pu: tri pra ṇa ya mi ba mā tā na ba su dhwa/ /shā bahūṃ gtsang ba'i (3༄lus/ /ma de nyid ni rtag tu mkhas pas mchod 37bya yin byi nor 'dzin min/ /mnyan yod bi sta randhand+ra dze ta ba ṣpe ra me dzi naḥ/ / pra ti sā rya pu nabhikṣu saṃ dag gi rgyal byed tshal/ /dga' bar rgyal bas rgya che'i chos/ /rab tu bstan nas mdor bsdus pa/ /spyo saṃ kṣibee ma bra bīta/ /pi ta ro pa ra oṃ brahma dzee ga maḥpurgya saṃ ga slar yang dge slong tshogs la gsungs/ /pha ma mchog tu tshangs pa ste/ /g.yo ba'i bsod nams dag gi maḥ / /ku lā ni tā ni dhya tyā ni ye ṣāntahma sta dastso ni/ /pa tro grogs—/ /gang zhig de mchod chos ldan pa'i/ /rigs de bsngags par 'os pa yin/ /'jig rten pa oṃ nāste ta paste lokyā na kwa pya ho sā sa dṛ shoste dhand+raḥ/ /gu rurga gsum na bden rngumatshungs dka' thub med/ /'tshe med mtshungs pa'i chos ni gang na'ang med/ /bla ma lci rī yānda pi tuḥpa roste mā tuḥpa ram̐ de ba tā maste nā n+yata/ /se bi tai pra ba bha bha ttab pha las gzhan yod min/ /lha yi mchog ni ma las gzhan pa min/ /gang zhig lhag par gus pa rab nirbha riḥpā da puṣka ram̐ yu ga gu rarjo maḥ/ /te pa ram̐ dzee la ru rtsa ba ke ba lo rgyas pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi padma zung mi bsten ce/ /de dag mchog tu chur sred 'ba' zhig gis/ /sarbha tīrja ga ma ṣpe pi niphe lāḥ/ /bai byaḥsu khe ra bi mu khaḥs ta tai kṣa mā 'jug ngogs kun tu song yang 'bras bu med/ /bde bas bsten bya phyi rol mi phyogs rtag tu bzod pa bye dhī bra bra tā di ni ya mi ra tsi tī ṇḍi sho ṣaḥ / / aspe pya na lpa 'dzin—/ /drag po'i brtul zhugs la sogs nges pas 2/gdung ba ster mi byed/ /gus pa'i rim gro chung ngu pha la daḥpra ṇa yo pa tsā re mā tuḥpi tubya na sa mo ste gu ruskṛ tī yaḥ/ /ā tsāryaḥl yang mi chung 'bras bu ster/ /pha dang ma dang mnyam pa'i bla ma gsum pa yod ma yinasdi1/ /legs byas 95—1002

su kṛ tārba de sha ka ta yā kairtswa bhi na ryaḥs dā sthā shā rghaṃ dza na kaḥka dzee na dza na kaḥdon ston byed pas slob dpon rtag tu su yis mngon par dga' mi bya/ /srog rnams skyed byed bla ma rnams pū bye gu ru hūṃ gu ruḥ/ /ta tā bi kṣa ṇa garbha ddhā ra ṇa bha ra gre sha su mā tuḥkyi bla ma pha ni ji ltar mchod mi bya/ /de bas kyang ni mchog tu skad cig mngal gyi khur bzung ma yi ngal dub pa ram̐ ke nā dṛ rgya bi dhwa na pu khyu ni tsa ye nā sārya te nidṛ tiḥ/ /mā la—/ /bu lon dag par 4)sgrub byed bsod nams tshogs ni ci yis dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /dbeen pa turji kā ra ka la ma su bee bee ka pā ka saṃ pāpta sā taka ku laḥki la yaḥka ro ma smin sdeg pa'i tshogs ni ④yang dag thob gyur pa/ /gang gi khya)ma la smod pa'i cha yang nges par sgrub byed ti—/ /ta su dzwa ladzdza la na dzā la shi khā ka khā paḥpā pa bra te bha ba ti mūddhā dza ṭā pa—/ /sdig pa'i brtul ④zhugs de yi spyi bor ral pa'i tshogs dag ni/ /rab 'bar me yi dra ba'i rtse mo'i ka ṭa yuḥ/ /ni kā ra kā ri rja mā tudzre yā su ba ra dzadma ni/ /pā pa tshogs pa dag tu 'gyur/ /skye ba gzhan du ma la ni/ /smod par byed pa bdag gis kyang / /sdig dmod shā pa ma yanta paḥpāptaḥpa ryāpta bai sha paḥ/ /bā rā ṇa sri kṛ ha pa rang bzhin mi 'dod pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i gdung ba thob/ / bā rā ṇa sī thudag tu sngon/ /khyem timai tro nā ma pu rā bha bta/ /ba sunt+ra rā nā ma ta myu i ti bhū da ti balla bhā/ /dzwa bdag mdza' bo zhes pa byung / /de yi chung ma nor 'dzin ma/ /zhes pa shin tu yid 'ong gyur/ /de yi bu ta mā tre 6 pu tre 6 ta sngaḥsthāste 6 pañtsa tī/ /pashyi me ba ya pi shrī mā ṣpe ka sgo rnams skyes tsam nadu/ /lnga pa nyid ni thob pa'i tshe/ /na tshod mtha' ru bu dag ni/ /dpal dang ldan pa nu ra dzā yatu/ /bi pa ti dī tya ta snga pi ka tyā khyu ma ka ro྾ tā/ /mi gcig btsas gyur/ /de yang 'chi bas 'jigs pa yisasgo3/ /pha yis bu mo zhes par btags/ /de yi rnyitra ka n+ya kā nā ma sau te nā byubyi shu taḥshi shuḥ/ /sa mu dra ga ma ṣpe ta su dza na ke ni mdza' bo'i bu mo zhes/ /byis pa de ni grags par gyur/ /de yi pha ni rgya mtsho ru/ /song zhing shi bar gyur 95—1003

dha rna ga te/ /e ka pu tre ba dza na — ni dhi tu bye tsa rakṣa hūṃ/ /ku la tra pa'i tshe/ /bu gcig pa nyid ma yis ni/ /gter dang mtshungs pa dag tu bsrungs/ /rigs kyi rim pas mā ga tā ta su dī pa yā ṭwā ni brle sa/ /ā di de sha swa de sha haṃ swalpa bi kra ye 'ongs pa yis⑫/ /gling du 'gro ba bzlog nas des/ /de la 'tsho thabs rang yul du/ /'os pas khyechung dzī bi rmā/ /kārṣa pa ṇa tsa tuṣṭa pūdzre yo bi kra yodma.oṃ/ / ta to dī ngu 'tshong (gab bstan/ /dang por tshong las skyes pa ni/ /karṣa pa ṇa bzhi dag dang / /de nas nyi ma gu ṇa ma n+yasmin ndi ṣpe pya tha tsa turgu khaṃ/ /ta tartswaṣṭa gu khaṃ lā dzha sarde smragazhan la ni/ /de las nyis 'gyur bzhi 'gyur dang / /de nas brgyad 'gyur dag kyang rnyed/ /thams tra n+ya bee da yata/ /ku lo tsi hūṃ dī pa yā dzā khru tā bhū da tha sokhru kaḥ/ /sa cad de yis ma la phul/ /de nas gling bgrod rigs la ni/ /'os pa ④thos nas 'dod ldan gyur/ /rgya myu dra ga ma nā ram̐ bha saṃ bhā ra ra pa pā da raḥ/ /sa mā ṭwā barya mā kho mtshor 'gro ba rtsom pa yi/ /tshogs la chags shing gus ldan de/ /ma yis bzlog par gyur mod kyang / /pi nā ma n+ya ta ni brta rna/ /ta taḥb pā da ba ti hūṃ dza na shlau sho ka bi hwa dzee/ /bzlog snyepa nyid du khas ma blangs/ /de nas ma ni mya ngan kyis/ /'khrugs shing rkang pa la 'gyel bas/ /duṣṭaḥshri ya mi botpa rya tsa ra ṇi na bi nirya yo/ /pe yu ṣeslu li tā rja gdug pa de yi ⑥dpal bzhin du/ /rkang pas rab tu spangs nas song / /dang por byis pa 'khrul zhing klub ṇḍi la li tā khā bee shi shuttha rṣa ti spru ti sbyi ta ma no ra thotpa ba sha yi ge phyed brjod yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i char dag 'bebs/ /de nas dul ba'i du yid la re ba'i dga' ston tairjaste ba ni yasta taḥ/ /pabyatpaṅka ṭa yo ba noṣṭha bee ka ṭā ṭaṅgā ra bī dī pa ṭu duḥrgyas pa brgya yis dga' ba 'dzin/ /phyi nas mi bzad lang tsho'i krotsha ba drag pos brlang po dag tu smra byed pu tra ཿ sgu ṭa kā la kyu ṭa ka ṭu kaḥ ka ṣṭha ka ro ti bya tsā / /mkhas—/ /gsal bar nag /1 7po brtsegs pa ltar rtsub ngan pa'i bu yis sdug bsngal gdung bar byed/ /95byed1004

bi pu lo dza na byā sho ka mi ba pā bye sa sā ga ram̐/ /sa mā ru khya pra ba ha rṇa rin chen bsgrub ①par 'dod pa de/ /ma yi mya ngan yangs par bzhin/ /rgya mtsho'i drung du phyin nas ni/ /ya yo ratnardza nokhru kaḥ/ /ma ka ra spra ra na kha ra kru ra kra ka tsā dā ri tsā/ /gzings ⑤la rab tu zhon te song / /de nas de yi gzings chen ni/ /rab rno (kyechu srin sen mo yi/ /ta taḥta su pra ba ha rde ku le pā bye ma bha bye ta/ /ta sro྾kta ma termā tu rā sog le drag pos dral bar byas/ /'jug ngogs dag tu zhig par gyur/ /blo gros rab 'phyar de yis ni/ /shā sgo ga gu rorbha bta/ /bhabhe pra ba ha ṇi tasmidmo teḥshā pa i bā bha bta/ /ma yi bsam bcom khur phyi bas/ /gzings ni zhig par gyur pa des/ /dmod pa bzhin du rmongs pa thob/ /ta taḥpha la ha kā bāsthā sha naiḥsaṃ dzñā ma bā gya saḥ/ /tī ra mā sā rya dza la byerdza de nas shing gi tshal pa thob/ /dal gyis 'du shes thob pa des/ /chu gter gyi rgyani ngogs phyin nas/ /gā he ga ha rde ma hata/ /e kā tī hā ri ta dhri tiḥs bra dzambi dza ṣpe tsi nags tshal chen po'i nang du zhugs/ /gcig pu brtan snyenyams 'gro ba des/ /skye bo med par yun rāta / /ra bye ra ma ṇa ke nā ma na ga ram̐ di bya mā bha bta/ /abee ro bhitso ring na/ /grong khyer rtse dga' can zhes pa/ /dga' ba mchog ni thob par gyur/ /bzhin ras zla zer ta sre bhirba da dend+ra tī ྾ tsa yiḥ/ /byosgo pu re kṛ dza: bhiḥkṛ tā ti byaḥs sā tshogs rnams kyis/ /zla ba'i 'od ni spro byed pa/ /lha yi bu mo bzhi dag gis/ /gus bcas mgron ni byas da re/ /he ma puṣka ri bhā tī re ra mya rarja la tā ba ṣpe/ /ma ṇi mandi ra pa de/ /gser gyi rdzing bu dag gi 'gram/ /rin chen 'khri shing dga' ba'i tshal/ /nor bu'i khang pa khri shayā su ta tra saṃ sgo ga bān bhū ta/ /bi pa daḥsu kha paryaddhāḥkle sha spru stan can/ /der ni longs spyod ldan par gyur/ /rgud pa dag ni bde ba'i mtha'/ /phun tshogs nyon tāstsa sadza daḥ/ /ā batrī byo bha baṃ hye ba paryā ye ṇa sha rī ri rde/ /ra mongs dag la mdza'/ /lus can rnams la re mos kyis/ /nges pa nyid du 'khor ba yin/ /dga' 95byed1005

ti sgo ga pra ju yi ṇa taste na ha ri ṇi kṣa rde/ /ra ma mā rjashyi re pā pūsgo mgur spyod pa la chags pa'i/ /ri dwags mig can de dag rnams/ /de dang rol pas yun ring du/ /skal gya gya kṛ tārja āoṃ/ /na ga re dakṣi ṇaḥband+ra brdzuḥsadzeedma nā twa yā/ /bzang don byas nyid dag thob/ /khyod kyis grong khyer lho yi lam/ /bdag nyid kun gyis spang bya zhes/ /i tyāktaste bhe ra dhi ke so bhūtta ṅga ma nokhru kaḥ/ /kā oṃ no ya ma bā ma sra de dag gis brjod tshe na de/ /lhag par de ni 'gro 'dod gyur/ /rang dbang mngon par mi 'dod cing / /swā dhī nā na bhe lā ṣi ṇaḥ/ /pā ye ṇa barbha te dzedhombi ṣe dha nā dhi ka nges par bsdams pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /srog chags rnams ni bkag pa la/ /phal cher gus pa lhag da raḥ/ /ta taḥkau tu kā kṛṣṭaste na dakṣ-i ṇa baṭwā nā/ /bra dzaswā paḥpar 'phel/ /de nas dge mtshan gyis drangs de① / /lho yi phyogs kyi lam de nas/ /song bas rtag tu sa dā matrī nā ma de bya pu ra pa ram̐/ /aṣṭa babee ra pasta tra tadmasgo gya twa mā myos snyezhes pa/ /lha yi grong khyer gzhan pa thob/ /der ni de bzhin lha mo brgyad/ /spyad bya nyid du gyur gra tā/ /ta spyo pa tsā ra ra tsa dzā tsi ram̐ tsakrusta snga bye kā/ /tā rnyiḥkra me ṇa rnams kyis/ /de la rim gro'i bkod pa dag /de las lhag pa yun ring byas/ /de dag rnams kyis rim te ṇi ba ni ṣidhi dakṣi ṇi dhwa ni/ /sa kau tu kāṅga taḥpā pa dṛ tī yo nanda pa des/ /lho yi lam ni bkag pa na/ /de ni dge mtshan las song bas/ /grong khyer gsum pa dga' rna pu re/ /ṣe ḍa shābee ra sasta gya ra ti sgo go pa sgo gya tsā/ /ta tra kra me ṇa te byed thob/ /der ni rim pa de nyid kyis/ /rtse dgas rnam par rol de la/ /lha mo bcu drug dga' mgu ṣpe ba ya yudhī lā bi lā pi naḥ/ /tā bhirje ṣidhe na pu nardakṣi ṇi na pa thā bra yis(snye—/ /longs spyod spyad bya nyid du gyur/ /de dag gis kyang bkag pa yi/ /lho yi lam nas song gyur dzan / /bra dmotta rā khya pā sā da mā sa bā da sa sā da raḥ/ /dā tri sha da tha pa—/ /gus bcas de yis khang bzang ni/ /tshangs pa'i mchog ces bya bar phyin/ /de nas der yang ④95—1006

saṃ mā pya ta tā pyathra ra saḥpa rāḥ/ /saṃ sgo ga su bha gastadmarya yo dakṣi lha mo gzhan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis longs spyod kyisasti / /skal bzang gis ni yang dag thob/ /de bzhin lho ṇa baṭwā nā/ /sa dra dzanda ga ram̐ pā pa durga zwa ya ma yo ma oṃ /yi lam nas song / /de ni song bas mi bsrun zhupa'i/ /grogs bzhin nyon mongs tshogs kyi gnas/ /pa ru ṣe kha la po hārda mi bā yā pa tsa yā shra yo/ /ta gya ta tra pra biṣṭa lcags kyi rang bzhin rtsub po yi/ /grong khyer ngan 'gro mang po shethob/ /der de nang du zhugs pa na/ /gya kra mādī ra ṇi bhū mi 6/ /ke nā pi pi hi tā ni ba ya yudhī sabye bandha rim pas sa la sgo rnams ni/ /su zhig dag gis bsgribs pa bzhin/ /mtshams med bsdams pa nyid du dzā—/ /ta danta re ma hā kā yo so pa shyahphu ru ṣe sbi tai/ /sa ka la kle sha do ṣā gyur—/ /de yi nang na skyes bu ni/ /lus chen gnas pa de yis mthong / /mtha' dag nyon mongs skyon rde bist+riṇḍi mi ba bhā dza na/ /dzā lnga bee la yi tai tsakre ta gya mūdhri pa ri rnams kyi/ /sgod ni shin tu che ba bzhin/ /bcings shing rgyun du khrag rgyun 'bab/ /de yi spyi bor bhra mata/ /tī āoṃ da darsha badha gya saste ratta pra bā hi ṇaḥ/ /swa shi 'khor lo ni/ /skon po 'bar bas dkrigs pa dag /yongs su 'khor ba mthong bar gyur/ /rang gi raḥpra su taiḥpū ya sho ṇi tibee hi tā sa dzā/ /tai dṛṭī tī bra ṇirbe dā mgo las zags pa yi/ /rnag khrag gis ni zas bsgrubs gyepa/ /de mthong drag po'i ⑤yid byung nas/ /da ba dadme tra ka n+ya kaḥ/ /kaste spyu ra bya thā krāntaḥka sre rda kadzre ṇaḥpha lo/ /mdza' bo'i bu mos rab smras pa/ /gdung ba drag pos non khyod su/ /'di ni las dag ci yi 'bras/ /thraṣṭaste ṣpe ti ka ru sgyuta pu ru ṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /mā tuḥkṛ tā pa kā ro haṃ zhes des snying rjes dris pa na/ /skyes bus ⑥de la rab smras pa/ /bdag ni sngam la gnod byed do/ /ta gye rda kadzre ṇaḥpha lo/ /e ta dā kasbya so pya bīṣṭha pa sasthād shaṃ ki taḥ/ /'di ni las de nyid kyi 'bras/ /de dag thos nas de yang ni/ /sdig pa dran nas dogs par gyur/ /de 95—1007

su nā mi ba kṣi ti mi rmā pa shu rā ga tosmi kabhā tya lam̐ ba la tī bha bi 6 ta khyi ①rnams la bzhin sa 'di nyid du phyugs dag 2'ongs par gyur/ /gang na 'di yi las kyi 'khri shing cha bya tai yā/ / kṛ ṣṭa sta yi ba tsa bi sha tya ba sho ma nu 6ཿ ya tra su yis yongs bsgrubs pa/ /dus kyis yongs smin spyad bya nyid du gyur pa mdun na gnas/ /nges par spyad tiṣṭha ti pu raḥpa ri sā ka sgo gyu/ /kle sha sgo gā ba bho kā laḥki yādmā tuḥbya stobs ldan 'di yis mchog tu 'gugs par byed/ / ma la gnod pa byas rnams kyisatshoje/ /nyon mongs kṛ tā ga rpā/ /a byā ga mi 6 ti na baḥkashyi dasmabyi bye dza na / /i spyod mtshams ji snyed dus/ /skye bo kha cig bdag lta bu/ /gsar du 'ong ba ye'agyur ram ci/ /zhes pa ti dzwa la te tsalnga gra dīrya mā na gya de hi naḥ/ /tasngasto su ba tsaḥkhru tā pu lus can 'khor lo ni/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i rtses bcom zhing / /gzir ba de yi tshig thos nas/ /skyes ru ṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ṣaṣṭi rbaste sa ha sru ṇi ṣaṣṭha rbaste sha tā ni tsa/ /a gya kle bus de la rab smras pa/ /lo ni stong phrag drug cu dang / /lo ni brgya phrag drug cu dag(gye / /nyon mongs nye sho pa sgo gya su na ya tiḥpā pa kand+ra rde/ /i hā pa rā ṇi bhi ṣa ṇa paṃ ti sthā bar longs spyod 'di/ /sdig pa'i las can rnams la nges/ /ma la gnod pa byas pa yi/ /sdog can nā na pā pi dzā/ /mā tuḥkṛ tā ga sā ma n+ya ye sā me byurnyi tabyi dhwaḥ/ /rnams la 'di na gnas/ /'jigs su rung ba gzhan she7dag yod/ /gzhan yang de ltar (bye'ong bar 'gyur/ /khru tai tadruḥs ha ta ram̐ te nolte mo tra ka n+ya kaḥ/ /su bya thā duḥkha sa des brjod shin tu bzod dka' de/ /mdza' bo'i bu mos thos gyur nas/ /rab gdung sdug bsngal myong swā dātpa rārbhe da ya yā ba datro/ /a dhu nā ye sa me 6rnye na rāḥpā ta ka kā ba las/ /gzhan dag gzir la brtse bas smras/ /da ni sdog pa byed pa'i mi/ /gang zhig khyarab tu 'ong ri ṇaḥ/ /te ṣā mabee ma mai bee rda tsakṛ tiṣṭha tu masta ke/ /ka dzee me sa 'gyur ba/ /de dag don du 'khor lo 'di/ /bdag gi mgo la gnas gyur cig /'di lta'i gdung ba 95—1009

hadhe tī bra dīrgha me baṃ bi bye bya tsā/ /e kasri ba bya tha me tu sabye drag cing ring / /de dag rnams kyis ji ltar bzod/ /bdag nyid gcig pu gdung gyur la/ /thams nidṛ tu nirgya thāḥ/ /pa rābee dhwa ra yi byā mi tsakre bhuspyo pha lo ni cad gdung med gnas gyur cig /'khor lo rang gi 'bras bcad nas/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag gis dzee—/ /pa ra bya tsā bi dzā nā nyi na dza naḥswa bya tsā bi nā/ /i kyu stebazung / /skye bo rang nyid gdung med pas/ /gzhan gyi gdung ba yongs ①mi shes/ /sems can phan ka ru shārte na te na sa twa hi tai ṣi rja/ /sahūṃ kalpa bra bhā be na tartso kra ma ga tshol snying rje yis/ /gzir ba de yis 'di brjod tshe/ /dam pa'i kun rtog mthu yis ni/ /de yi 'khor manda bhāḥ/ /tā paṃ pabee bi tā ni harnyi ta nu te shu bye ya shaḥpu— lo mkha' la song / /yal 'dab dag ni gdung ba 'phrog cing me tog grags snyan dkar po rgyas par byed/ /tā sa ryaḥsau ra bha bha bya sgo ga su bha shā lakhyembi dhaste pu naḥ/ /ka ru rgyudro 'phral la dri bzang legs ldan longs spyod skal bzang phun sum tshogs pa beer yang 'dzin/ /dam pa'i kun ta yā ya de ba dzdza da ye saddhiḥs mā ro pi tā sa྾ kalpa la tā sa de ba sa ra rtog 'khri shing snying rje'i brlan ldan dam pa rnams kyi snying la ni/ /gang tshe yang dag btab pa de tshe ro ldan saṃ ki ki na su te pha lo/ /kā ru dhyāhphu rgya ma hābyutta1 rja1 ta kilpi ṣaḥ/ /'bras bu ci dang ci mi 'uskyed/ /snying rje'i bsod nams bdag nyid kyis/ /skad cig de la sdig zad de/ /sa pa bhu ba pa ri tya bye de haṃ de baḥsu ra la ye/ /so ha me bā bha baṃ pūbye lus ni yongs su btang nas de/ /lha yi gnas su lhar gyur to/ /nga nyid sngon tshe byams bdag nyid/ /mi rgya1 mai rngu ka n+ya kaḥ/ /pā de nond+ra ra ṇasthā tuḥpāptaspyo duḥkha btī mdza' bo'i bu mo nyid gyur te/ /ma ni rkang pas 1rab 'phangs pa'ingu / /sdug bsngal gnas skabs de 1—/ /kārṣa pa shāza tuḥpu dzā krāptartswabee ra saṃ pa rda/ /i lje tse bha ga bān dag thob/ /karṣa ⑤pa ṇas ma la ni/ /mchod pas lha mo'i gnas kyang thob/ /de skad ma yi srid zhu ni/ /95byed1010

mā tro shu khru ṣe dhabyu myutta saṃ/ /mā tā saṃ ga la mā li kā gu ṇa ma ྾ bā se n+ya mo liḥchos kyi mchog tu bcom ldan gsungs①/ /ma ni bkra shis phreng ba yon tan dang ldan pa ni mnyes kye gshin pi tā to ye yī shi ra si thra yā ya ku ru taḥpā dāmbu dzā ro pa ṇa/ /sarpā cod pan te/ /de dag dgyes slad gang gi spyi bor zhabs kyi padmo rab tu 'god byed pa/ /phyogs kun shā pa ri pū ra rtotpa ta ya shaḥsalbattha kā sho da yā ste pu rgyu bha ra zlaḥpra yārnyi yongs su 'gengs par brtson pa'i grags pa phun tshogs rab tu gsal ba rgyas/ /rtag tu dga' ston bsod dza ga hūṃ ni trotpa baḥpū bye tāmra/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye sa nams rgyan ldan de dag 'gro ba'i mchod bya nyid du 'grur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī mai rngu ka n+ya kā ba dā dzwa dā na ba ti chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mdza' bo'i bu mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i ta maḥpalla waḥ// //yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //myu/ shā sgyu dza yarja dzi na bhatta bee she ṣa bhā dzee shraddhā su bye pra pa ra nizlo gang gis mchod 'os mchod par bsgrub rngul me tog la sogs te/ /sems med rnams kyang 'os pa'i ra shī ka rāste/ /nibye ta no byu tsi ta tse ta na tā mra yi ti yiḥsems dang ldan pa nyid du 'gyur(je/ /rgyal la 3gus pa'i khyad par bsten pa rnams la bsngags 'os shing / /pū bye pū dza na bi tho ku su mā di brgaḥ/ /shri bahūṃ bi dza nā mbi ni dad pa rab rgyas bdud rtsi'i rgyun thigs de dag rgyal gyur cig /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon/ /dzi rna dze ta ba na pu rā/ /a nā tha piṇḍa do bhe tya bha ga banta ma bha ṣa dben par bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba de la mngon phyogs te/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis ta —/ / twa sgo tta ri ba sadzdza tra ma hā rta gu ṇa bi shu tā / / bha ga gsol pa/ /bcom ldan khyod kyi gus pa bzhin/ /kun tu khyer ⑪ 'os yon tan grags/ /bdag gi bu mo 95—1011

baspro bye mā yā tā ka n+ya ma ma su mā ga dhra/ /shri ma taḥsārja nā tha sa na ga re puṇḍa ma ga dha/ /bzang mo dar la bab par gyur/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel gyi/ /dpal ldan don mthun barbha ṣpe/ /sru nudṛ ṣa bha daṭwā khyastadmā ṇi gra ha mbi ha te/ /ka dzñā da dā mgon po'i bu/ /khyu mchog byin zhes bya ba ni/ /de yi lag pa 'dzin par 'dod/ /bcom ldan gal te mi tī tasmi bha ga babee di ma n+ya pe/ /twa da dhī na dha na pā ṇasta dā dzñā nu sha ra kho bzod na bdag /bu mo de ni de la ster/ /nor srog khyod kyi dbang gyur bdag /khyod kyi bka' yi rjes khya hūṃ/ /i kyuste te na bha ga bān bātpa lya bi ma khā sha yaḥ/ /ko do su 'brang / /de 17'di gsol tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /dri med mnyes gshin bsam ldan pas/ /ci skyon ṣasta na yā tasmi di ya tā mi tya bhā ṣa ta/ /shāstuḥshā sa na mā dā ya pā da ra bu mo de la ni/ /sbyin par khumadzod ces bka' stsal pa1/ /ston pa'i bka' ni rab bzung nas/ /de la pra ṇi pa tya tai/ /a nā tha piṇḍa daḥshrī mān pra ya yo ni dza mānda ram̐/ /ta gus par ④phyag 'tshal te/ /dpal ldan mgon med zas sbyin ni/ /rang gi khang par rab tu song / /de taḥsu mā ga dhe ka dhyā bi bha been ma tī ya pā/ /arta ya sa da do tamee bhu ri nas 'byor pa che dang bcas/ /bu mo ma ga dha bzang mo/ /rin chen gos mang rab ster des/ /'os pa ratnalnga ra pra daḥ/ /daṭwā dru ra ta ram̐ de sha ma tha yāju su mā ga dhwa/ /bha ga de la rab tu byin/ /de nas byin pa'i ma ga dha/ /bzang mo thag ring yul bgrod cing / /bcom ldan bāñdza ra ṇa smṛ tyā sa bātpa na ya nā bha bta/ / tsi ri ṇa sā sa mā pā rya na ga 'das kyi zhabs dran nas/ /mig ni mchi ma dang bcas gyur/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du/ /yun ram̐ puṇḍa barbha rna/ /shu thra ṣā bhe ratā pakṣaḥpa dā bhadṛ kṛ he bha bta/ /ka ring zhig na des sleb nas/ /rtag tu khyo ⑤yi khyem du ni/ /bdag po'i bkur ste la chags gyur/ /de dā tsi da tha hūṃ shwa thra sgo bye saṃ bha ra kā ra bhā/ /u bā tsa dha na ba tyā khyu nas nam zhig sgyug mo ni/ /grangs las 'das pa 'god brtson zhing / /zas kyi tshogs rnams ster khye byed 95—1012

saṃ khyu tī bya yorya tā / /pū byo pa ka ra rde saljo ku ru sadzre su mā ga pa—/ /nor can zhes pas de la smras/ /ma ga dha bzang mchod pa yi/ /yo byad thams cad chas dag dhe—/ /kṛ haṃ naḥpā ta rā gaddhā dza gahphu dzñāḥgu ḍo dza naḥ/ /gu ra bo go mdzod—/ /'gro bas mchod bya yon tan can/ /skye bo nang tso7par bdag khyim 'ong / /bla ma skye bo thams ra ba pa rda pū dzñāḥsadzee dza na gya te/ /sa me 6dhi kṣa pa ṇa kāḥsasmo ha kṣa pa cad kyis/ /zhe kyesa'i gnas su mchod bya ba/ /kun rmongs zad sbyor zad byed pa/ /de dag rnams ni kho rya tāḥ/ /i kyughra pā ta yā ta tra ba bhu bā ram̐ bha tatpa rā/ /dzñā tā 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zhes des brjod pa der ni des(kye/ /dge slong tshogs la mchod pa dekru/ /yongs su bhegru ga shā yi ba tsā pū rdzu pa ri kalpa ṭī/ /a thā pa re lbo bi bee shund+raghāḥkṣa brtag ⑤par shes gyur nas/ /rtsom pa de la chags par gyur/ /de nas nyin gzhan khyim du ni/ /skra dang ba ṇa kā kṛ haṃ/ /uwaṃ tsi ta ka tsa thra thra saṃ kle sha ni shi ta bra tāḥ/ /sma ra rab 'bar ⑥zhing / /dka' thub drag pos kun nyon mongs/ /gcer bu zad byed pa rnams zhugs/ /tā na lardzo na ba pā nā na b.lokya su mā ga jo/ /mā ṣa shayā sha nā sgyu sā pi ma he sran ma rtswa yi zas/ /goms pas rags par gyur pa bzhin/ /gos med ngo tsha med de dag /ma ga ba rādma hi ṣā ni ba/ /lalja tā bā sa sātstsha rya ba da rna gu ru sarnyi sgo/ /khe da dha bzang gis mthong nas/ /bla ma'i drung du ngo tsha ste/ /bzhin ni gos kyis rab bsgribs nas/ /skyo dang nibye da pi na tā shu thra dza na ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a ho ba tā ya mā tsā raḥchags bral gyis dud pas/ /sgyug mo'i skye bo la smras pa/ /gang 'dir phyogs gos rnams kyi yang / /su tsi rā da ba lo ki taḥ/ /di gasba rā rja ma pya gre ya dī haste ba dhū dza naḥ/ /e mdun du bud med skye bo 'khod/ /kye ma kun tu spyod pa 'di/ /shin tu yun ring lon nas mthong / /mi te bha batho he dānta bhuñdza te shri ga brdzi tāḥ/ /a mā nu ṣa tā rja tai min rwa dang bral gyur pa/ /dul ba 'di dag khyod ⑩ 7 kyi ni/ /khyim na — 7gsol byed 'di dag la/ /bud 95—1013

྾ lasgoste byu na oṃ ga nāḥ/ /a sthā ṣpe bha ba tā bhāktaḥko ya mudṛ kha laḥkra maḥ/ /na med ngo tsha med dam ci/ /gang gis kha zas ma btang ba/ /de yis gos ni ji ltar btong / /ma bsdams tyakta ma sha ni ye na sa ka dzee bsta mudzha ti/ /ke shorlu la na karma ṇi ba ni rim pa 'di ni ci/ /khyed ni gnas min dag la gus/ /skra ni rab tu 'bal ba'i las dag nyid kyis ①shi tai noste ju mo be di tai kau bī rmā shu ka brdza ṣpe na sa dza ṣpe shī la su bsne brtse ba med pa drag po bstan/ /skye bor bcas la 'doms khru dkris gos dag spangs pas tshul khrims kyi ni ba kā/ /rda bhā ram̐ bha bha yo ka re tsa pa da ṣpe kro dhaḥ swa yi lasba te gtam nyid ci/ /tshul 'chos rtsom pa dang ldan 'jigs byed bzhin la khro ba rang nyid rnam par bsten/ /naghā nā ma sha ṣpe ṣi tā ni ya mi nā me ྾ pa shu nā mi ba/ /ya tre te dul ba dang ldan gcer bu 'di dag phyugs rnams bzhin du zas dag 'tshol 2/bar byed/ /gang na phyugs pa sha baḥpū rje ta trond+raryā bha brnyi ke/ /a tha pā de sho do kho yo ga tā nu ga ti kāsbi 'di mchod byed pa(bye / /de na spang bar bya ba su/ /yang na 'di ni yul gyi skyon/ /song ba'i rjes su 'gro taḥ / /i ti bru bā rde tī shra shubee ṣaṇḍi pra tya bhā ṣa ta/ /pi tuste bha ba ṣpe ba'i lugs/ /zhes smra ⑤chags bral dang ldan ma/ /de la sgyug mos lan smras pa/ /bzang mo khyod kyi yab bha tre pu dzñārnye ba de kā dṛ shāḥ/ /sā ba dadma྾ turde he pū bye te bha ga bāñdzi kyi ni/ /khang par ci chu'adra mchod pa spros/ /des smras bdag gi pha khyem du/ /snying rjes 'gro ba thams naḥ / /kā ru sgyutpattha dza ga tī ku sha lā nyi sha yo rya taḥ/ /dhyā nā rpā cad ni/ /khyad 'phags dge ba la sbyor ba'i/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba mchod par byed/ /bsam gtan la naḥsnyi mi ta na ya naḥpūrṇa khā ba ju sentund+ra sā baṃ shaṃ bi pu la sa ra lo pe tu chags g.yo med spyan ldan mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ /shangs kyi rgyud ni yangs shing drang po zam ju tai da dma naḥ/ /bhu ṣā shu tyā pra mṛ ta ru tsi maṅkaṇḍi pā shā bhi rā maḥstegs dag tu gyur pa yin(77/ /rab brkyang mdzes ldan rgyan gyis stong pa'i snyan byi zhags pa mngon dga' ste//95—1014

kā: ba sau ki ma pi pi du ྾ shārnyi mantasta no ti/ /shi ra pi sa ha dza pā dzñā mdzes pa nyid kyis mkhas rnams nang du zhi ba ci yang rgyas par byed/ /zla zer ltar mdzes de ni lag gnyis lo ka pra se ka ma yo ma ṇi ka ri pa ti karā kā ro bā hu mṛ hūṃ ka ka ru byu nyiḥ/ /glang chen lag pa'i rnam pa dang / /snang ba rab rgyas dbu la lhan skyes rab bkrus rang bzhin nor bu dang / /ka ra ta la ga tsā le khaṃ shaṃ kha dhwa jo bu dza mā li shaṃ sha ma ma ya ma hā sāstsa lag mthil du son ri mo dung dang rgyal mtshan ste skyes 'phreng ba dang lku/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin rgyal srid chen dzñāhaṃ bi bhanti sa lakṣa ṇi/ /ta snga dzha lā ṣa dza na ka mya ma hā mu bhā rmā saddhā po la 'os mtshan nyid rnam par 'dzin/ /thub chen rnams kyis ṅkumangon par 'dod pa skyed byed de yis (kyeni/ /bye lā ṣa ka pa nā ra hi taḥswa bhā baḥ/ /naḥshe ṣi ta smṛ ti bhu baḥrang bzhin mngon par 'dod pa'i rtag pa kun dang bral ba nyid/ /dran pa'i sa gzhi bag med gnas ni pra ma dā sha ya gya rā gadzha ta gya su ta rā ma dha raḥpa rā gaḥ/ /mustornirbha lhag ma med par byas/ /chags pa rab tu btang ba'i mchu ni rab 5tu dmar dang bcas/ /grol ba lhag ra saṃ ga ma pra ṇa yi mbi mi ṭī ma naḥshā yi nī kṣudhistadma ya kā ri bhā z-i par 'grogs pa'i mdza' gcugs dang ldan byams pa dag ni yid la nyal/ /bzod pa de yi rang bzhin di da yā gā bye sa mā bye ṣi bhā/ /sasthā shā bha ra ṇa gya bhu ri da yi tā sakta byed cing brtse ba snying la dam du mnyam par sbyor/ /yid 'ong mang po la chags kun gyi bsam pa rgyas byed su saṃ lakṣu te ta sthā pūttha mu ṣpe ra na n+ya ma hi mā bai rā gya gasgoḥsha maḥ/ /sngon med thub pa ni/ /de yi zhi ba sngon med bdag nyid chags bral snying po can ni legs par mtshon/ /smu dzuḥs bha ba nasmra shaṃ ya su pra bra bye yā sa hūṃ/ /dhaste shi la du ku khā rmā tshul khrims du ku la dang ldan/ /dam pa rnams yid sgrib bral nyid/ /gang gi rab tu byung bar 'u'adzin/ /ni rā ba ra ṇa tasma naḥ/ /bi shwa rakṣasma ṇirya gya smṛ tyā pi bha ba sgo de dag bdag cag khyim du mchod/ /thams cad bsrungs pa'i zhwanor bu gang / /dran pa yis kyang srid 95—1015

gi nā/ /rā ga dī sngo gra rdaṣṭi ṇa bā dhya te na pu nardza naḥ/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥpa'i sbrul/ /chags sdang drag po'i mche ldan pas/ /slar yang skye bo la gnod med/ /ces pa de tshig rna shwa shā khru tā gro tra ra sā ya rgo/ /sa ryaḥpra sā da bi ṣa dā tsā dza gā da pra mo di ba yi/ /bcud len thos nas sgyug mo ni/ /'phral la rab dang dri ma med/ /dga' mgu ldan pas de la mbi / /a pi ta dmā rsha no pā yaḥ kashyi daste ba rā na ṣpe / /a pi smras—/ /de ni blta hūṃ7ba'i thabs 'ga' zhig /mchog gi bzhin ldan yod dam ci/ /khrod kyi bsod twahphu ju sa sba ddhādma ya ma pya mṛ ta spa rda / /i ti sā nu na yo shwa khru nams 'brel pa las/ /nged kyang bdud rtsi'i gnas thob bamatso)/ /zhes pa sgyug mos gus ldan blo(sgo/ /ṣā sa da ra dhi yā nī tā/ /tai baḥsandarsha yā mbi ti ba bhā ṣe bhatta mā ni mbi/ /tshul dang mthun par de la zhus/ /bdag gis khyed la de bstan zhes/ /gus dang bkur ba ldan mas smras/ /ma hā pra nyi dzha saṃ bhā ra bha ra nirbha ha nai ṣi ṭī/ /sā pi sha ya tu khā dam bca' chen po'i tshogs kyis rnguni/ /khur dag khyer ba 'u'adod pa yiskye/ /srod la mal stan srang la rū ṭwā kṣa khaṃ dhyā na pa rā bha ba ta/ / ta taḥpā pā da mā ru khya bha ga 'dzegs—/ /skad cig bsam gtan bskyangs par gyur/ /de nas khang bzang la 'dzegs te/ /bcom ba྾ ba hūṃ di shaṃ/ /pra ṇi pa tya thra dzatru rje pū dzārta ku su māñdza li/ /ldan bstan mepa'i phyogs su ni/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bya mchod 'os pa'i/ /me tog snyim pa rab tu gtor/ /putpa dhu po da kai ra༈ pā kṛ tātta sa dozlu khāe/ /ā nanda bātpa baṃ rudha de yi gnas su mngon phyogs des/ /me tog bdug pa chus mchod nas/ /yangs pa'i mig ni kun dga' bi st+ri ṇḍi na ya nā ba da ta / / a nu kai bai ba bha ga ba nd+ra tna tra yildu—/ /mchi mas 'gags pas rab smras pa/ /bcom ldan thugs rje 'os pa bdag /dkon mchog ya bi brdzi tāḥ/ /ta bā shra ma mṛ gī bā haṃ du ra de sha mi oṃ ga tā/ /gsum po rnam ke9 spangs te/ /khyod kyi gnas kyi ri dwags bzhin/ /shin tu thag ring yul 'dir phyin/ /95—1016

twatyā da padma yu ga lo sha ra rde pra padzñā du ram̐ sbi tā ma pi dṛ shā smṛ sha rmā da khyod kyi zhabs kyi padma zung gi skyabs ni thob pa bdag /ring du gnas par gyur kyang spyan gyis reg mdzod yā lo/ /bātpa lya pe sha la bye yī ma hā tai pra bā dru rī kṛ ga te 6 ka ru brtse ba can/ /mnyes gshin gnyen pa'i blo ldan chen po rnams kyi thugs rje ni/ /yul gzhan ring por zla na ta nu twa me ti / / bha ga ba nda sa su ta yā two ma yā rya phyin pa rnams la chung ba nyid mi 'gyur/ /'bangs kyi bu mo dag gis 1deng / /bcom ldan khyod ni ni madhri taḥ/ /pā ta rā ga ma ṣpe ṣpe ba mā dzā bi ta ra me bee sgo/ /i mgron du gnyer/ /nang par byon pas bdag la ni/ /khyab bdag khengs pa gnang bar mdzod/ /ces kyu dī rya ta yodṛ bye bi tsi tra ku su mā ba lbo/ / sa dzre bee te ba pra pa brjod nas des 'phangs pa/ /rnam par bkra ba'i me tog 'phreng ldu / /gus pa'i pho nya srog bcas ya yo na bha sā bhatta dru ti kā/ /sā shwe ta rakta ha ri tā se ta putpa pā lbo khe bzhin—/ /nam mkha' las ni rab tu song / /dkar dang dmar dang ser dang sngon po dag gi me tog dhū pa dhū ma sha ra khā sha na kaiḥ pra yādhī / / bā lāmbu da pra ṇa yi 'phreng ①/ /bdug pa'i du bas bkra ba dal gyis mkha' la 'gro ba de/ /bde sogs bdag po'i gzhu yi dī su tsi re tsa kā she saṃ tsā ri tsā pa la ti ke ba sha tsā bye pa gya/ /a 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba ni/ /chu 'dzin gzhon nu dag la rab tu chags shing ceyun ring mdzes/ /de nas tha dze ta ba rna pā pya kṣa ṇi na ku su mā ba lbo/ /sa bhasti shā li mbi shāstuḥrgyal byed tshal song nas/ /skad cig gis ni me tog 'phreng khye/ /gus pa dag dang ldan pa de/ /ston pa pā ta tsa ra khyobyā yoḥ/ /bha ga bā na pi sattha dzhaḥsadzee dzñā tā pa mbi hi tai/ /pa'i zhabs pad dag la lhung / /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /ma ga dha ni bzang mo yi /su mā ga jo yāḥ ka ru dhyā dānanda ma ba dahphu raḥ/ /pā targanta bya 'dod pa kun mkhyen thugs rje yis/ /kun dga' bo la sngon ltesnadu gsungs/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 95—1017

stso na bha bo hi duḥs haḥ/ /a nā di kā lo pa tsi tāḥkle sha dzadma dza rā da dman pa'i dngos po bzod par ①dka'/ /thog stimed dus su bsags pa yi/ /nyon mongs skye dang rga 7snyeyaḥ—/ /tantu pa yasneḥshākyarnye pāpta mṛdhi pa da ki yata/ /i ti tsinta ba sogs/ /'bad pa can gyis gzhom nus na/ /rdzu 'phrul gnas ni thob dnghal ci/ /chags bral drag ya tasta su tī bra saṃ bee ga yā dhi yā/ /pā du rā sbo1 ṇi ṣpe ba ma hādhiḥshudhe po'i blo gros kyis/ /de ltar sems shing dag pa yisanya / /sems ldan de la skad cig gisasnye / /rdzu 'phrul tse ta saḥ/ /a tha rā spya bya tī tā yī pra bhā te sand+ra byekṣa baḥ/ /nā nā tri chen po rab tu skyes/ /de nas mtshan mo 'das gyur te/ /snga dro dge slong thams cad ni/ /sna tshogs lha da sha bee she na bi mā ṣperna bha pā ya yuḥ/ /a tā nta re ma hā ram̐ bha yi chas ldan pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang nas mkha' la gshegs/ /skabs der rtsom pa chen po la(khyaste/ /saṃ bhā ra pa ri pū ra te/ /su mā ga dhwa bhadṛ gre te bha ga bsdersha nokhru tshogs kyis yongs su gang gyur pa/ /bdag po'i khyim du (shebacom ldan 'das/ /lta 'dod ma ga dha bzang kā / /sa ha pā pā da mā ru khya shwa shu ra bha dṛ bhiḥ/ /tasbo ku su mo—/ /me tog bdug pa'i mchod pa yi/ /bkod pa 'dzin la mngon phyogs shing / /sgyug mo gyos po khyo ma dhū pa dzñā ra tsa rna saṃ gra horlu khāe/ /bhikṣu rā dzñā ta kauṇḍi n+yasta to rnams dang / /lhan cig khang bzang khye la 'dzegs 'khod/ /de nas rta yi shing rtar lku gnas/ /dge shwa ra ṭha ma sbi taḥ/ /di byarja bi bi bhā:rya pra tha ma pra tya dṛ shyata/ /tai slong kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya/ /rnam mang ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul ni/ /mchog ldan dang po nyuskyerab tu mthong / /nyi dṛ ṭī saṃ kā shaṃ bi smi tā ཿshwa shu rā da yaḥ/ /u tsūḥsu mā ga dhwa spru ma dang mtshungs de mthong nas/ /ya mtshan gyos sogs dga' ba yis/ /ma ga dha bzang la smras pa/ /tyā ki me ṣa bha ga bā ni ti/ /sā ba dadzha ga bānd+ra yo dṛ shya te ta ra ṇi pra bhaḥ/ /bcom ldan zhes pa 'di 'am ci/ /des smras 'di ni bcom ldan min/ /dge slong kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya/ /95—1019

a ya mā dzñā ta kauṇḍa ju rnyikṣu rakṣaṇḍi dī dhi tiḥ/ /ā ya tarlu kra me shā tha 'od zer dman pa min pa 'di/ /nyi ma dag dang mtshungs par mthong / /de nas rim gyis shing rta yis/ /ra the ṣā shwa shu rā da yaḥ/ /ki ma yi ki ma yo bha dre bha ga bā ni ti tsā dza guḥ/ /byon pa'i tshe na gyos sogs kyis/ /bzang mo bcom ldan 'di 'am hu)ci/ /'di 'am ci zhes rab tu smras/ /sā bra bīsne ba shāstu ya me te tasgo sa no tsi tāḥ/ /bhikṣa baḥpra sha ma bla des smras 'di ni ston pa min/ /'di dag de yi bka' la 'os/ /dge slong rab zhi bsngags par 'os /sgyusta po dīpta ta ra tī ṣaḥ/ /yaḥkānta he ma dru ma ra mya shi la shri gā bi dru bhāḥpu ra dka' thub rab 'bar 'od zer (snyecan/ /gser ljon mdzes pas dga' ba ri yi ni/ /rtse mo la zhon sngon to ju bee ti/ /ā:rya kṛnd+rasto i ba pra bhā baḥshrī mādma hā kā shā pa e ṣa la byon pa gang / /ngo mtshar byed pa mthu ni gzugs can bzhin/ /dpal ldan dge slong 'di ni 'od byekyuḥ—/ /pa.āoṃ na na gyanda na mā sbi to yaḥpa to ya dzre mū ta shaṃ dhī ra gho ṣaḥ/ /srungs che/ /chu ldan char sprin zab mo'i 'brug sgra ldan1/ /gdong lnga ④shing rta dag la gnas pa gang / /byo: sa ma bye ti gu ṇiḥpra ddhā taḥs e ṣa bhikyu ju bi shā ri pu traḥ/ /ā ru mkha' la sngon ⑤du byon pa'i dge slong 'di/ /sa la yon tan gyis bsgrags shā ri'i bu/ /gnyis 'thung so hra kai la sha mi bā ti shu bye dī paṃ tsa turdanta ma nanta kārnyiḥ/ /ā yā ti yaḥpu bzhi kai la sha bzhin du/ /rab dkar la zhon mtha' yas mjos pa gang / /byon pa'i dge slong de ⑥ni ju ba hūṃ dza gahphu moṅga lya nā mā pa ra e ṣa bhigruḥ/ /bai ḍūrya nā lo ka na kā ra binda 'gro rnams na/ /bsod nams ldan mchog mo gal ⑦bu zhes bya/ /gser pad bai ḍū rya yi yu ba can/ /mā ru hra raspyo ku ra ke sha dzā shaṃ/ /u pe ti yaḥsau ra bhā pū ri tā shaḥs e ṣa bhikṣuḥrin chen myu gu ge sar gyis mtshan zhon/ /phyogs ni dri bzang gis 'gengs byon pa gang / /dge slong de pra thi to ni ru ddhāḥ/ /pand+ra ma rā gre ga ru ḍā dhi ru zwaḥpakṣu ni lotpa ri nyid ma 'gags pa zhes grags/ /gang zhig 'a3mkha' lding la zhon gshog rlung gis/ /chu 'dzin rab tu 95—1020

da sha dā ra pa tha pu ra tatpabhu bee ma ṣṭha de sha mūrbhe bai ba/ /pra bi shya sgo lam bco brgyad ldan pa der/ /mtshungs pa'i sgu ni bco brgyad hūṃ7dang bcas pas/ /rab zhugs ma ga tsa kre sha shi kārnya ratna shi la ma yo beedre su ma ga dhwa yāḥ/ /a bhyañtsi tai ta tra ba hu pra dha ni bzang mo'i khyim/ /zla shel rin chen rdo yi rang bzhin byas/ /der ni yo byad rdzogs pa rnam mang gis/ /kā riḥpūṇḍi pa tsā riḥpra ṇi pa tya sabyeḥ/ /ā pū dza yahpho ra dzaḥs mānta dzre hi: mngon par mchod cing kun byus phyag 'tshal te/ /grong pa'i skye bo dag gis kun nas mchod/ /rtsig par bhisti pra ti thimbi bhānta/ /su mā ga dhwa yā da ya yā da yā luḥpū dzi kṛ tī tā gzugs brnyan snang de phyi nas kyang / /bcom ldan brtse ldan dge 'dun dang bcas pas brtse bas bha ga bādma saṃ ghaḥ / / a nu gra hā lo ka na sa mbi bhā giḥ sa bāndha mchod pa blangs nas rjes bzung ⑤ ni/ /gzigs pa'i cha yis ma ga dha bzang mo/ /gnyen dang bcas pa bā yā bi da dhe pra sā rda/ /su mā ga dhwa sa shwa shu rā di brga sa hā pa riḥbo ra dza rnams la bka' drin bsgrubs/ /ma ga dha bzang gyos sogs sde dang bcas/ /grong pa'i skye bo kun dang na: sazaḥ/ /shāstusta dā de sha na yā ba byu baḥshuddhā sha yīsta1 ṇa dṛṣṭa satyāḥ/ /bcas pa yang / /de tshe ston pa'i bstan pa dag gis ni/ /de dus bden mthong bsam pa dag par gyur/ /su mā ga dhwa yāḥku sha khā nu badhe pu ju pra bhā baṃ bi pu lo bi lokya/ /te nyikṣu dge ba ①rjes 'brel ma ga dha bzang gi/ /bsod nams mthu ni yangs pa mthong gyur nas/ /dge slong de bsta tra ku tū ha le na pa prasgo ra snga dzi na mā di bṛtrī/ /thraṣṭaḥs taiḥsaṃ sa di dag gis der dge mtshan las/ /de yi sngon byung rgyal ba dag la dris/ /ma ga dha bzang dge ba'i rgyu dag saza daṅgi su mā ga dhwa yāḥku sha la su te rtu/ /danta pra bhā bhiḥka ku bhā mu khe 6 ni—/ /tshogs su de dag gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /kun gzigs de yi (gyechems kyi 'od rnams kyis/ /di shand+ra kā sha bha ga bādru bhā ṣe/ /bā rā ṇa snga ma jund+rarde kri kriḥkānta su byu ba phyogs sgor snang ba byin cing cho rab gsungs pa/ / bā rā ṇa sī yidag tu sngon/ /sa bdag mdzes pa kri kri ( shaṃ95—1023

sa mo ho pa ha tāḥpa ram̐/ /bo bye ga muspyo prasba gya sathi praste na bi kra yo/ /bcom pa de dag byang chub kyi①/ /yan lag mu tig bye gang ②ni/ /phye bye gang ①la 'tshong bar 'gyur/ /nyispyo bā kya ku dā rū ṇi budha bhā ṣi ta tsanda ṣpeḥ/ /sā mā n+ya mā pā mu stegs tshig ni shing ngan dang / /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs tsan dan dag /rmongs las khyad par mi da yi 6rnyi mokhye da bi she ṣi ṇaḥ/ /kwa tsidha dro sa mā sā rya bi nī tai bhikhyi shes pa/ /de dag gis ni mtshungs byed 'gyur/ /dul ba'i dge slong glang po che/ /bzang po thob nas kuñdza re/ /duḥshi la ka la sgo bhigruḥsparja yā dhi ka ka ri 6 ti/ /tsā 'ga' zhig tu/ /dge slong khrims 'chal glang phrug gis/ /'gran zhing smod par byed par 'gyur/ /g.yo pa khā shu tsi li dzñā gaḥ su shī la ddhi gru ma rga ṭa ཿ / / a nu lispa na ba'i bumi gtsang gis byugs lus/ /dge slong spre 'us khrims ⑤bzang rnams/ /rang gi skyon gyis sgo byed swa do ṣe ṇa ka ri 6 tyādme saṃ ni bhān/ /paṇḍa ka myu bhi ṣe kastsa bha bi byu ti cing / /bdag nyid mtshungs pa spyobyed par 'gyur/ /spre'u bzhin du rigs 'khyal ba/ /mngon par ka pe ri ba/ /saṃ budhe shā sa na pa ṭi kṛ 6 mā rna na rde kṣa ti/ /dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yi/ /ras yug drangs pas nyams mi 'gyur/ /saṃ gha dra bya pha lā rā me ṣṭa pi yā sudhi tso ra tsā / /mi thaḥ ka la dge 'dun rdzas dang ⑦'bras bu yi/ /dga' tshal dag kyang rku bar 'gyur/ /phan tshun skyon nas brjod ⑧ha shī la: bha bi 6ṣṭha pa pā dī naḥ/ /ta ba swasna bi pā kādhe pha lā bye tā byed cing / /'thab ⑨mo'i ngang tshul dag tu 'gyur/ /khyod kyi rmi lam rnam byun mthar/ /'bras bu 'di ni bhū ta le/ /i ti shāstuza tsaḥkhru tā bismi to byudma tī pa tiḥ/ /sā nu ga dag sa las byung ⑩/ /zhes pa ston pa'i tshig thos nas/ /sa yi bdag po ya mtshan gyur/ /de nas ston myu tha dṛ pa teḥs shāstu dharma de sha dzā/ /kṛ tā kāñtsa na mā khā dzee des mi bdag ni/ /rjes 'brang bcas la chos bstan pa/ /mdzad nas gser 'phreng khyanyucan ma la/ /95—1026

di de sha ku sha lārta tsā/ /dzadmānta re tsa kā rā ༈stu pe nā ram̐ ga mā la yā/ /dge ba 'os pa nyid dag bstan/ /skye ba gzhan du mchod rten la/ /nā rang ga yi 'phreng ①bas mchod/ /sā te na su kṛ te ṣpe ba dzā ta he ma sra rdzu ki tā/ /se yo su mā ga dhwa legs byas de yis de nyid ni/ /gser 'phreng khyadag gis mtshan par skyes/ /ma ga dha ni bzang mo 'di/ /pu sgo pra bhā bee na ma tī ya sā/ /pābhā rya dza na kā ya gya saṃ myaklu sha la gya tu de nyid bsod nams mthu chen gyis/ /yang dag dge ba'i zam stegs nyid/ /de ring skye bo'i tshogs kyis hūṃ / /a bhi dhwa ya ti bha ga bānda bha sā bhikṣu bhiḥs haḥ/ /ru tsā thob—/ /ces gsungs bcom ldan rgyal ba ni/ /dge slong rnams dang bcas pa dag /mdzes pas saṃ pu ra yand+ra shā ya yo dze ta ba sna dzi na ཿ / / sum̐ sā sa dku la phyogs rnams yongs 'gengs shing / /mkha' las rgyal byed tshul du gshegs/ /skyes bu rnams kyi rigs bhū ta ye ba la ba tī mi bye ba su tra smṛ hā sru nubye da bu ṇa sta de ba bi ka lo mchog 'phel slad stobs ldan bu la chags pas brdzun 7pa nyid/ /gal te bu la yon tan med na de tshe taṅginda sarde ku lo/ /sā ka tyā ki la dzā ya te gu ṇa ba tī pu rgya pra bhā bā rigs kun nyams pa min nam ci/ /gang gi bsod nams mthu yis 'khor ba'i chu klung (byebadag po che la gru rya yā saṃ sā ro ru pa ritpa to ku la yu shaṃ nā bee bā saddhārya te/ /i ti bzhin du/ /rigs zung yang dag sgrol byed yon tan ldan pa'i bu mo de dag nges par 'byung / /zhes pa kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī su ma ga dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ma ga dhwa ba dā rgo tri na ba ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //ta ra la ta ra ta ram̐ goddhā ra shaṃ dī ra to ye da dha ti dza ga nyi ke tsittapta hūṃ skal ba nyams pa kha cig rab g.yo rba thu rlabs skyed pa yi/ /zab mo'i chu ldan 'gro ba dag tu gdung 95—1027

bhasna bhā gyuḥ/ /kha ra ma ru pa ri tā pe ke tsi dutpakta pu rgyaḥs ha dza ba nyid 'dzin cing / /bsod nams rgyas pa kha cig mya ngam drag pos ①yongs gdung la/ /lhan skyes chu sa li la sā rist+ri bra z-iṣṭi tya dzarnyi/ /shra bahūṃ pu khyu mi tra su sru nuspyo ha ba te yi tshogs kyi ①mi bzad sred pa gtong bar byed/ /mnyan yod du ni khyim gyi bdag /bsod nams bshes ra khyu tra/ /ya sho mi tra i ti khyu ta pra ti mā āoṃ ya sha sri rgo/ /ta su gnyen dag gi bu/ /grags pa'i bshes gnyen zhes ①bya ba/ /grags pa can byi tshad gyur byung / /bdud dzanma kṣa ṇi pu byeḥbee yu ṣa ki ra ṇa tī ṣaḥ/ /a bṛji pra bha bā bā rnyiḥsha rtsi'i zer gyi ④'od zer can/ /de skyes tshe na bsod nams kyi/ /chu yi ⑤char med las skyes pa/ /mi shā ma bi ṣa mā bi bta/ /pra sa bee ba ba shī ga tā bha ba sgo ga pa rādru khaḥ/ /bzad rgud pa zhi bar gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid la dbang gyur cing / /srid pa'i longs spyod las phyir phyogs/ /dzi rna dze na ba nā sī rna se ṣe be ku sha lo rya taḥ/ /dhand+ra de sha na yā shastuḥdage la brtson pa de song nas/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal bzhugs bsten/ /ston pas chos ni bstan pa yis/ /pra bra byerta tpa do shri taḥ/ /tu lya kāñtsa na bā ṣā ṇaḥso khyuṣṭhakta thra rab byung dgra bcom gnas la brten/ /de ni gser dang rdo mtshungs shing / /dga' dang mi dga' yā bri yaḥ/ /rdaṭī rgyu sa ra saṃ ta gya dru ta spa ṭi ka nind+ra lo/ /shu shā ba tsā ri ye btang bar gyur/ /de yi mche ba dag las chu/ /ro ldan dri med shel gyi ni/ /khu ba zags pa gang zhig nā sau bī tasngaṣṭaḥs dā bha bta/ /ka dā tsibyekṣa paḥsattha bha ga brnye ku gis—/ /de ni rtag tu sred bral gyur/ /nam zhig dge slong thams cad kyis/ /dge mtshan las ni tū ha khāta/ /dṛṇḍa byu pa ra me ta su ba pradzraḥpu rgya kā ra rde/ /so bra bīṭwā bcom ldan la/ /de yi sred ⑪/pa bral ba yi/ /bsod nams rgyu ni rab tu dris/ /des gsungs kā shi'i shya pā khya gya shāstuḥkā shi pu re pu rā/ /a bhūnd+ra dzi taḥgreṣṭha su taḥsu na da ra kā grong du sngon/ /mdzes pa zhes bya tshong dpon bu/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa yi/ /rab tu byung ba nyid 95—1028

bhi dhaḥ/ /sa ka dā tsidhri ṣā krāntaḥsaddhā pa klanta bi gra haḥ/ /ni dā bhe tsā du gyur/ /nam zhig skom pas gzir gyur cing / /gdung bas nyen pas ①lus can des/ /so ga'i tsā ①ta ka i ba na kwa tsidzdza la māpta bān/ /shu n+ya hūṃ to ya pā tā ṇi ku pa nirdza ta ka bzhin du/ /'gar yang chu ni thob ma gyur/ /de yi bsod nams ma yin pas/ /chu snod stong pa la ta ma pi/ /sgo hūṃ si sa ha pā sho ṣe ta snga pu byeḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /de ha nyid dang 1ni/ /khron pa yang ni chu med dang / /'jug ngogs 'phral la bskams ④par gyur/ /de nas tyā go rya ta snga tha ta gya dṛṭwā pra khā pi naḥ/ /u pā sgye ye na pa li lo dadzhai sthā yā da skom pas cho nge smras/ /lus ni gtong bar brtson de la/ /mkhan pos chu ni byin pa dag /mthong ba dṛ shya tram̐/ /shā sa nāṭwā shya pa snga tha pa shāsturdza la bhā dza rgo/ /akṣa ya min pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas de yis ston pa ni/ /'od srungs bka' yis chu yi snod/ /mi zad pa nyid twa mi bā yā tai saṃ bhe tsi ra ma tsā ra yā tai/ /kā ru jutta gya bha ga bānadku shya paḥbazhin gyur pa/ /dge 'dun dag la yun ring ⑪brims/ /de yi chu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs gre ya sambi dhiḥ/ /pra sanda pā ṇi padme na tsa kre bā ri pra ti gra haṃ/ /dṛṭī dge legs dag gi gter/ /rab tu dang bas thugs rje nas/ /phyag gi padmos rab bzhes mdzad/ /der sa bisma yasta tra dza na saṃ gha sa mā ga maḥ/ /to ya ma kṣa ya hūṃ ya tai ni skye bo'i tshogs 'ongs pas/ /chu ni zad pa med gyur pa/ /mthong nas ya mtshan dag dang bcas/ /sa tya darsha na māpta bān/ /tatru ju pra ṇi dhwa ṣpe na so yi ku sha la mū la bden pa mthong ba thob par gyur/ /de yi bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /grags pa'i bshes gnyen dge bān—/ /ya sho mi traḥshri taḥshārnyi rdatthabye ta pa yo bha raḥ/ /i ti dzadmānta rtsa ldan/ /zhi ba bsten 'di mche ba las/ /chu yi tshogs ni 'khrungs par gyur⑥ / /de ltar grags pa'i ra darghaṃ ya sho mi tra su sā da rāḥ/ /dzi ṣpe na ka thi tai shu tā bhekṣa bo bshes gnyen gyis/ /skye ba gzhan la byin pa ni/ /rgyal bas gsung thos gus pa yis④/ /dge slong 95—1029

bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /saṃ sā ra ma ru pa ri bhra ma troṭwā tā paṃ tya dzasti dzi na se baṃ/ /rnams ni ya mtshan gyur/ /bde ba dri med chu ① gang zhi ba ni/ /kha ba'i rlabs ldan rgyal ba bsten pa dag /su kha bi ma la sa li la ka li lo sha ma nyi ma kakhro lindi pā su/ /i thob nas 'khor ba mya ngam sdethang la ni/ / yangs 'khyam srid pa'i ①gdung ba gtong bar byed/ /ces ④ ti kṣe mend+ra bee ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee ya sho mi tā pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ba dā rna tsa tund+ra ba ti ta maḥpabee waḥ// //grags pa'i bshes khyaganyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //und+rarya pā pa bi byu lo nyi mi rā ba tā ram̐ sa ryaḥpra tīṇḍi ka ru rja ki ra rgya che sdig pa'i mun par 'jug pa dag ni rab spangs nas/ /'phral la snying rje'i 'od zer snang ba ṇa pra kā shaḥ/ /do ṣā pa ha: pa ri tā pa ha rabyu ko pi sadmarga mā rab tu rgyas pa yis/ /skyon sel ci yang yongs su gdung ba dag kyang 'phrog byed pa/ /sangs rgyas 'od di sha ti bubye sa ha sra raṭīḥ/ /pu ri pu rā rā dza kṛ he bha ga bādre khu kā stong ldan pas dam pa'i lam ni ston par byed/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab na sngon/ /ka lan da ka'i gnas na ṣpe/ /ka landa ka ni bā sā khye bi dza hā ra ta thā ga taḥ/ /tasmizlu zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal na bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bzhugs/ /grong der ⑥re sārja pa te ratna datta su dā ra kau/ /a byu tsā ni shi tā khyu yī dzā yā yī ded dpon don byin gyi/ /chung ma rdon ྅mo zhes pa la/ /bu gnyis /8snadag ni dus gcig tu/ /mtshe ma yu ga parya yo/ /to shaṃ ku sharnyi daṭwā khyo yā te bi ta ri pañtsa tsā/ /kṣ-i nyid du byung bar gyur/ /pha ni lnga pa nyid gyur cing / /nor dang 'khor ni zad pa'i tshe/ /shang ku ṇi dha ṣpe pa ri dza ṣpe mā tā kṛsgo ṇa brja to/ /to mā tudzee tsa sā bā lo sha na mtshams byin zhes bya ba/ /de dag ma yi ⑨tshegs kyis bskyed/ /ma yi tshig gis chom rkun la/ /rab 95—1030

kaiḥpra ti beethra ram̐/ /tsorya pra bṛkṣiṃ swasprarja bhāṇḍa dzā tsakra tuḥkṣa yo/ /zhugs byes pa de dag gis/ /khyim zla dag gi nor chung dang / /snod rnams dal gyis brlag par byas/ /mā tuḥpi tu: ni ya me na bha brnyi yo gyuḥshwa bye ba tai tya bi na ye ta du nge ma dang pha yi dul ba yi ①ni rung ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /de yi btang snyoms nyid kyis 'dul ba min pa'i kṣa ma ba/ /pūsbo di ta swa dza na bā sa na yi ba bsgye bā khāste khā i ba g.yang la lhung / /rang gi skye ba sngon bskyed bag chags dag dang 'byel ba las/ /byis pa rnams di til pa ra pra kṛ ti bha dzadhe/ /kra rnge na brja mā no to sro bhā tso ra twa mā ga bzhin gzhan gyi rang bzhin sten par byed/ /rim gyis de dag cher skyes te/ /chom rkun dar bab nyid du to / /ulladza sarnyi tstsha dā byeḥpo rā rghaṃ dza snu turbha dzwa/ /a dzā gyur—/ /'dzeg dang mtshams 'bigs la sogs kyis/ /grong khyer ba yi nor rnams blangs/ /de dag bya ta sha tru shā rā dzñā tsā rimbi dzñā ya taskṛ yī/ /bee kṛṣṭi ba dhya ba su dhwa to mā tā sa hi ba nyan rna yis/ /shes nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras/ /de dag ma dang bcas pa ni/ /skad cig nyid kyis to kṣa ṇḍatu/ /yabyu bye te pa ra dha ṣpe na ni sni ya te yashlau byu sha yā bi ṣa ya gsod par springs/ /gzhan gyi nor gyis ⑤/gang zhig za byed gang zhig 'thung bar byed/ /bde ba'i bsam baṭwā bi gā khya te yata/ /ta snga bi tsā ra ra ma ṇḍi ya su khā da ra gya pas yul gyi lam ni gang zhig nyams myong byed/ /ma dpyad dga' bar byed pa'i dubade la gus pa de nyid ni/ /pra shā ba shā na pa ṇa dā ru ṇa e ba pā gāḥ/ /saṃ dzā ya te bi ṣa ya pā na smin par gyur pa srog ni nyams byed mi zad buzong dag yin/ /yul byi btung bas rgyags shing 'khrugs pa ma dā ku khā dzā yastsorya dā ha ba dha labha bha ṣpe na rā gaḥ/ /niryā tya rnams kyi chags pa gang / /rku dang sreg dang gsod pas thob pa'i nor gyis rab bskyed pa/ /de ni yongs sau pa ri ṇa taḥka ra pā da bhe da shu khā dhi ro ha ṇa pa ri shu ta rakta smin rkang lag bcad dang gsal shing la zhon pas/ /yongs zags khrag gi rgyun gyis phyi rol dag tu 'byung 95—1031

byu reḥ/ / ta tasto ba rgya mā waṃ kau bhā la raghra sbra ra thra to/ /pre bar 'gyur/ /de nas gsod pa'i 'phreng ①bas mtshan/ /sngon dmar gos kyis g.yogs de dag /lta ru kṣa ga ta dza nā tīzlo ba dhya sthā na mu pā ga to/ /dzñā tā da yā bādmabyu rnyeḥ'ongs pa'i skye bos bskor2/ /gsod pa'i gnas su nye bar song / /brtse ldan kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen nas//swa ya ma bye tya hūṃ bhu baṃ/ /pra sā dā nu gra te ṇi ba tsakre bi ga ta rang nyid sa der mngon phyogs te/ /rjes su bzung gaba'i bka' drin gyis/ /bcings pa dag dang bral brnya no/ /sazla dzñā dzha yā rā dzñā to tyakṣiṃ mukta pā pa ta kau/ /pra bra bar mdzad/ /kun mkhyen bka' yis de dag ni/ /rgyal pos btang zhing sdeg pa grol/ /bcom ldan bye yā bha ga ba taḥshā sa ṣperta twa mā pa tuḥ/ /dza na nā si hi to dṛṭī to dzñā na 'das kyi bstan pa la/ /rab tu byung nas dgra bcom ④thob/ /ye shes 'byor 'bar de dag ni/ /ma bi bha bo dzwa lo/ / ta ṅka tsā kau tu kādṛ ṣṭi bhegru rnyiḥ su ga to bhya dang bcas pa mthong byur nas/ /dge slong gis dris dge mtshan las/ /de gtam bde bar gshegs pas jota—/ /ma ye ba rakṣ-i tā be to pūzasmi: pi dzadma ni/ /e ta yordza gsungs—/ /sngon gyi skye ba dag la yang / /'di dag bdag gis rab tu bsrungs/ /de tshe 'di dag nyid na nī byā spyo gho ra rū pā ta dā bha batpa/ /tasmidku yo kṛ pā bantusgo bye sa twa kyi ma/ /stag mo 'jigs rung gzugs ldan grur/ /de dus byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /brtse bas lus sha rī ri rde/ /a haṃ ka ru ṇa re ṭā khyaḥkṣi ti pā la su to bha baṃ/ /ka dā tsi can rnams kyi gnyen/ /snying rje'i rdul zhes bya ba yi/ /sa skyong bur ni nga nyid gyur/ /nam zhig bkres de tokṣu1 mā po ta kau sgothi mu rya tā/ /swa sha rī rasma yā da tā byā gi sā tu ni pas nyen pa yis/ /phrug gu 'di dag za rtsom pa'i/ /stag mo de ni rang gi lus/ /byin nas bdag gis bā ri tā/ /a rya tā bee ba tso ra two kahma she ṣā du sā ga to/ /ma yā saṃ rnam par bzlog /las kyi lhag mas lad lta yang / /'di dag chom rkun nyid du gyur/ /stag mo de ni ma 95—1032

rakṣi to byu 1 mā tā so be ya me ta yoḥ/ /i kyughā ka ru zla senturbha ga bāndhu 'di ste/ /'di dag bdag gis rab tu bsrungs/ /zhes gsungs bcom ldan thugs rje yi ①/ /rgya mtsho ta bhā ba naḥ/ /rnyikṣu saṃ ghi na sa hi taḥpra ya yo dze ta kā na dzwa/ /'byung po la dgongs pa/ /dge slong tshogs dang bcas pa dag /rgyal byed tshal du rab tu gshegs/ /a mṛ ta ra sa thraṣṭa riṣṭa dṛṣṭa ra ni ṣṭa pa hā pa tā dza ye ti/ /pa ti bdud rtsi ro yi char bzhin mi 'dod sel/ /'dod pa dam pa'i gzigs pa gang lhung bas/ /lhung ba tai ba pa ti ta ma bi yā ku ru te pu byond+ra ta shā sgyamra/ /i ti kṣe rnams kyang bsod nams kyis mtho ba'i/ /bsngags par 'os par mdzad pa rgyal gyur cig /ces pa dge mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī byā sgya ba dā ram̐ pañtsa ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las stag mo'i 5 na ba ti ta maḥpalla waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //dmā daḥsha shāṅka su ra beḥpra kā shastu paḥkṛ shā noḥpa ba na su be gaḥ/ /pa ro pa zla ba'i 1kun dga' nyi ma'i rab gsal dang / /me yi tsha ba rlung gi mgyogs pa dang / /snying rje la kā raḥkā ru ṇa ra tā dzā ma hā dza nā dzā sa ha dzaḥswa bhā baḥ/ /udmā ṣpe ke dga' skye bo che rnams kyis④/ /gzhan la phan pa lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ /'phags rgyal skyed mos li ra si kaḥshrī mā nu da ya naḥpu rā/ /a baṭī bi dza yo rā dzā bi dza hā ra tshal du sngon⑤/ /rgyal po dpal ldan 'char byed ni/ /rtse dga'i ro dang ldan pa dag /btsun mor ba dhū pa khaḥ/ /ta gya pusgostso yā saghraḥkāntaḥku ba la ye kṣa shāḥ/ /ya dṛbyu bcas pa rnam par gnas/ /de yi mdzes ma utpal mig /me tog 'thu (blul chags pa rnams/ /thub pa yā ga tedṛ ṣṭa mu nī rghaṃ pañtsa bhiḥsha taiḥ / /tā spri yā n+yastu na ya nā brgya phrag lnga rnams ni/ /'dod dgar 'ong ba lngodag gis mthong / /phrag dog khro ba skyong ba des/ /95—1033

sgyutpa bya tho bha bta/ /dru rātpa le la mā da ya sa haste na ma tī ya sā/ /tā na bī ta ba dang bcas gyur/ /chu dang rtsa ba 'bras ster des/ /ring po ring po dag nas chu/ /lag pa shin tu che tre: na bi da dhe pa yo mū la pha la pra daḥ/ /te ṣpe ba sa ta haṃ pri tyā nirdaṣṭa pā ṇa dha bas blangs/ /de dag skom pa dang bral byas/ /de yis dga' ba ①rtag tu ni/ /srog gi zungs 2dag ra ṇaḥ/ /bi shārnyi ta tra te pā puḥpra shānta bi pu la shra māḥ/ /kā le na tyakta nges par bsten①/ /rgya che ngal ba rab zhi ba/ /de dag der ni ngal bsos thob/ /de nas dus kyis so de ha su ta taste ta mya darnyi naḥ/ /kṛ twa sha rī ra saṅgā ram̐ pū dzā tsagruḥsu ro ldan pa/ /lus ni btang ba de nyid kyis④/ /lus dag sbyangs nas de dag gis/ /lha la 'os pa'i mchod tsi hūṃ/ /kuñdza re ṇa ma yā ra ju ta e te madhriṇaḥpu rā/ /kṛdzñā྾ tā ri pa byas/ /dgon par bdag ni glang po yis/ /snyug bsngal de las blon po ni/ /sngon bsgral de dag da sri tā stasmrarlu na yartswa bya bee sha sāta/ /i kyughā bha ga bābeezla satwa saṃ tā lta yang / /thub pa de dag ⑥mi 'dod las/ /zhes pa gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can ra ṇa bra ta ཿ / / pūbye mā no mu ni ga ṇi rdza gā ma swa ta po ba kun sgol brtul zhugs can/ /thub pa'i tshogs kyis mchod byed cing / /rang gi dka' thub nags su rna—/ /a khaṃ la su kha ku sha la dru tī bha ba ma ru saddhā pasgo ya/ /dza ya gshegs—/ /ston pa'i thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu bo ni/ /ma lus bde dang dge ba'i pho nya ste/ /srid pa'i nyi dza na ni ba dza na dī kā ru shā mṛ ta bā hillī shāstuḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra mya ngam dzeegadung bsel grib ma dang / /ma bzhin skyed par byed pa rgyal gyur cig /ces pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ha st+ya ba dā rna dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las glang po'i ṣaṇḍa ba ti ta maḥpabee waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //95—1035
