bi dre ṣa do ṣa bi ṣa dru ṣi ta mā na sā ram̐ yaḥsā dhu bā dha na bi sgo ni rnam sdang skyon gyi dug gis yid ni sun phyung ①gyur rnams kyisarjo/ /dam pa dag la gnod pa bsgrub ④shi taḥpra yatnaḥ/ /sngañtsitta du dzwa la gu shā nu kṛ to sa e ba tasko bha beedṛ la 'bad pa rab rno gang / /de nyid gal te de yi yon tan rab 'bar rjes byed par/ /gyur nas sdesrid thu pa rā bha ba bārpā beesmin/ /dzi ṣpe rā dza kṛ ho pānta bee rku kā na na tsā 'dir su zhig rgya cher gnod dang ldan par gyur⑤/ /rgyal ba rgyal po'i khab dang nye/ /'od ma'i tshal na rgyu ri ṇi/ /bi dre ṣāddhā ba datta na pre ri tā stu pa sāḥpu rāḥ/ /zla rghaṃ ga ba na/ /lhas sbyin 'ugyis ni sdang bas sngon/ /rab tu bskul ba'i dka' thub pa/ /de yis byin pa'i dī ma ba da nāstajatta bi bi dhwa yu dhwaḥ/ /a sgyu dra brlu saṃ raddhā kro dha bi mtshon cha can/ /smin 'khyog 'jigs su rung ba'i bzhin/ /khro bas dul ba nyams gyur pa'i/ /rtsom pa khyasta saṃ ya māḥ/ /pañtsa bhistu pa sa sha taiḥte ྾ kṣiptastedṛṣṭa yaḥ/ /chen pos mngon par gtses/ /brgya phrag lnga yi dka' thub can/ /de dag gis 'phangs mtshon gyi char/ /ya yurbha ga btaḥkā ya kā ya ka ma lotpa dzā lashā/ /ni shi tā n+ya bi shasthā ṇi shra bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la ni/ /padma utpal tshogs nyid gyur/ /dam pa rnams la rnon po yi/ /mtshon yadhi sakhru mārda baṃ/ /bi dī ṣa bi ṣa diddhā ni na tu tsiṭwā ni pā pi āoṃ/ /pā yang 'jam pa sten byed de/ /sdang ba'i dug gis byugs gyur pa/ /sdig pa can gyi sems ni min/ /ston du rā sīdma ṇi ma yo ku ṭā gā ra na bhaḥpra sgo/ /sha rī ra sgo da oṃ shāsturna pa'i sku ni sgrib byed pa/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin khang pa brtsegs/ /nam mkha'i 'di ④ni rab 'khrungs te/ /tu dṛṣṭa ni bā ra khaṃ/ /ta taste ta pa sā shāddhā ladzdza ba na mi tā na nāḥ/ /lta ba dag ni bzlog ma gyur/ /de nas dka' thub can de dag /ngal zhing ngo tsha bzhin dud pas/ /ni pe tuḥpā da yoḥshāstuḥkṣa mā sirjoḥpra sā di naḥ/ /bha ga bān pi pu bzod pa'i rgya mtsho rab dang bas1/ /ston pa yi ni zhabs la gtugs/ /bcom ldan gyis kyang bu la 95—1036

tā shā mi ba te ྾ pra sā di byā/ /ni kā re khyo pi nind+ra rtsebee da dhe dhadzre de sha bzhin—/ /rab tu dang ldan de dag la/ /gnod byed la yang khro med pas/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa rmā—/ /a khyo bha bee bhra ma su khaṃ sha ma mā shri tā ni pu rgya kṣa mā sa mi mdzad—/ /chen po'i ①yid ni 'khrugs ①pa'i rnam 'phrul med pa yis1/ /bde dang zhi ba la brten la nind+ra la shī ta lā ni/ /na mā na sā ni ma hā tā hi ta hi pra bṛttantattha bsod nams bzod pa dag gi chu/ /dri med bsel ba dag dang ldan pa phan min 'jug pa min dngha/ /de gya ma rgyu ra dza pā ka lu ྾ bha ba rnyi / / dha nd+ra de sha na yā shāsthāḥthob khro ba'i rdul gyis rnyog pa dag tu yongs ⑤mi 'gyur/ /ston ⑥pas chos bstan rab byung gis/ /bra bra byodmārdzi tā sha yāḥ/ /te sadrwa shra ba nirmukta marta hūṃ pra ti pe di re/ /bsam pa rab phyis de dag gis/ /zag pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /dgra bcom nyid ni rab tu thob/ /a tānta re sa mā yā taibhikṣu snyiḥshu ta taṅka dzeeḥ/ /ki me ta di ti sābya:ཿskabs der 'ongs pa'i dge slong ni/ /gtam de thos shing ngo mtshar dang / /bcas pas 'di ci zhes pa thraṣṭastu na ba dalja naḥ/ /kṛ tā pa kā rāḥsu ta dzā pudzeesminda pi dzadma ni/ /dris—/ /rgyal bas de dag la gsungs pa/ /sngon gyi skye ba dag la yang / /shin tu gnod byas 'di dag la//ma li te nidzre kā re ṇa pra sā dā da ba lo ki tā/ /i te sa mu dra ya dra yī rnam 'gyur med pa bdag gis ni/ /rab tu dang bas nges par bltas/ /rgya mtsho dag tu 'gro ba la/ /ba ṇi dzaḥkā shi de sha dzāḥ/ /bhasne pra ba ha ṇi pā puḥpu rā dzre bi ta saṃ da sha yo/ /gzings ni chag par gyur tshe sngon/ /'di dag kā shi'i yul skyes pa'i/ /tshong pas srog la the tshom thob /katstsha pe na ma yā ta tra thraṣṭha mā ro su tā ri tāḥ/ /pā ra mā sā rya bi shārnyi de la bdag ni rus sbal gyi④/ /rgyab tu bkod nas rab tu bsgral/ /'tsho ba thob cing pha rol tu/ /ste dzi re labha dzre bi tāḥ/ /uja ra ṇa pa ri shārnye ma yi ni dru z-i te phyin nas ngal gso ⑧rnam par bsten/ /rab tu bsgral bas yongs ngal te/ /bdag ni skad cig gnyid 95—1037

kṣa rṇa/ /madme sī hā ra kā mā ste sattha rmā hantu murya yuḥ/ / ta log tshe/ /bdag sha za 'dod de dag rnams/ /thams cad bdag ni gsod par brtson/ /rdo yi char dudṛṭwāthra thrabye bi ma ha tyā piṇḍi tā kṛ teḥ/ /kā ye dṛ bhā ka bā ṭa su na me chen rab spros kyang / /khog pa rab tu brtan ①ldan zhing / /gong bu'i dbyibs can bdag gi ni/ /lus kā tsi da bhūṭwā ti ཿ / / ta ta stu— tpa ri kṣa mādhri ṭī haṃ ka ru ṇa ni nam yang khyenyams ma gyur/ /de nas bkres pas yongs nyen de1/ /mthong nas snying rjes bdag ku laḥ/ /swa yo te byesta rnu da tā pra yā taḥkṛ ta kṛ tya hūṃ/ /ta e te 'khrugs pas/ /rang gis ④de dag rnams la khyelus/ /byin nas bya ba byas nyid gyur/ /sngon gyi tshong pa ba ṇi dzaḥpūzla ma rya tā ba sahūṃ ga tāḥ/ /kṛ tā ga po pi kā ru rgyudmā bitaḥku de dag ding / /dka' thub can ni 'di dag gyur/ /gnod pa byas kyang snying rje yis/ /bdag gis dge —sha lo ma yā/ /te shāstuḥshā sa ṣpe pūrde kā shya pa su ma hādma naḥ/ /pra pra dzhai ba dag la bkod/ /de dag sngon tshe bdag nyid che/ /ston pa 'od srungs bstan pa la/ /rab byung thob pā gya saṃ dzā tāstatpa la snga rya bhā gi naḥ/ /ta thā ga te na ka thi tai khru two rda nas de yi 'bras/ /da lta skal ldan dag tu skyes/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa 'di/ /thos nas taddhi kṣa baḥkṣa rmā/ /pra sha shaṃ puḥpa ram̐ ta gya kṣa mā mi bha rakṣa rmā/ /ye dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /de yi bzod pa sa gzhi bzhin/ /khur dag bzod pa rab tu bsngags/ /gang ྾ nind+ra la shī la shī ta la dza khā satā sha yā shā si bee ni tram̐ bai ra ra dzaḥpra zhig tshul khrims dri med bsil ba'i chu ldan sems can bsam pa dbugs 'byin byed/ /khon gyi rdul ni mārdza na na dī kṣurnyiḥsbi tā tse ta saṃ/ /duddhā rā ri ni kā ra ko pa da ha rab tu dag byed bzod pa'i chu bo sems la rtag gnas pa/ /de dag zlog ⑥dka' dgra yi gnod la khro ba'i na dzā lā ba lī bi bla ba blo ṣertse ta thra thu bya thā ba re tsi tsā nā yārnyi me 'bar 'greng ⑦bas rnam bslad pas/ /bsreg ⑧par rab bskyed rgya cher gdung bas yongs 'dris 95—1038

te bi kri yām/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba rnam 'gyur dag tu 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dā na ka lpa la tā dzee ka tstsha pa ba dā rna sa pta na ba ti ta ma ཿrtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las rus sbal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu palla waḥ// //rtsa bdun pa'o// //akyunda te 6 shi kha re 6 ku khā tsa khā rmā nisne 6 tsā shu tsi tsa yā ba ka rigs kyi ri bo dag gi rtse mo shin tu mtho ba dang / /dma' zhing mi gtsang tshogs dang phyag dar khrod roṅka re 6/ /ā lo ka e ṣa ni pa ta tya bi ṣe she bṛ tya tu phyo pa kā kyis gang bar yang / /nyin mo 'dren pa'i snang ba mtshungs par phan byed bdag nyid can/ /'di ni bye ra ma hi mā di na nā ya ka su/ /dzi na bi rku ba nā rpā rna pu re rā dza brag med par 'jug par nges par bab ①pa nyid/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu sngon/ /'od ma'i tshal kṛ he pu rā/ /dubhi kṣe kṣutpa ri kṣu mā masmraḥsha ra ṇa mā ya yuḥ/ /da tā bzhugs rgyal ba la/ /mu ge'i tshe na bkres pa yis/ /yongs nyen gyad rnams skyabs su song / /snying rje'i bye ma ta mā hā ram̐ ka ru ṇa kalpa pā da pa ཿ / / du rda shā shānta dpag bsam rkang 'thung gis/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i zas byin nas/ /gnas skabs ngan pa zhi ba'i ye te ྾ bi da dhe dha1 de sha dzā/ /a nu gra hābye ga ba taḥsaṃ pāpta ku slad—/ /de dag rnams la chos bstan mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes bzung (kyegis/ /dge ba sha lo da yāḥ/ /artatpa rda sa mā sā rya te dza gand+ra bye hūṃ ya yuḥ/ /rgyas pa thob pa rnams/ /dgra bcom gnas ni thob gyur nas/ /'gro bas mchod bya nyid du gyur/ /nī tsā nahphunda ti pā tāj-iṭī tāṣpe ra bā se naḥ/ /ba bhū bund+ratpa raste ྾ ni dman pa shin tu mtho ①gyur pa/ /de mthong grong khyer gnas pa rnams/ /rtag tu de dag rigs la ni/ /95—1039

thra te kle shādma lbāḥ saṭwā ri tā ma ya/ / e te bra dzi tā ཿ shastuḥ kā 'khor ba yi/ /nyon mongs dag las bdag gis bsgral/ /'di dag rnams sngon ston pa ni/ /'od shya pa sngarnyi ke pu rā/ /ba bhu buḥka ṭa kā khā yā yā tāste nā rya malla hūṃ/ /i srungs drung du rab byung ste/ /rgyal po'i gnas su gnas par gyur/ /de yis da lta gyad nyid gyur/ /ces ti pāgyudma dṛṭwārnya malbā rghaṃ sadzee dargonā/ /shu two di tai bha ga ba tā rnyikṣa pa gyad rnams dag gi ni/ /skye ba sngar byung bcom ldan 'das/ /thams cad gzigs pas gsungs pa dag /po bisma yi ya yuḥ/ /ti mi ra bha ra ni mbi li tā rmā sa dza nā rmā bee budha thos nas dge slong ya mtshan gyur/ /gza' yi bdag pos she7snang bas rjes bzung 'bas/ /mun pa'i she ṣa rārta two / / a pi bha ba ti saṃ ka dzā nā mā lo ka nu gra tshogs kyis ④rnam par zum gyur pa'i/ /'dam skyes chu dang bcas pa rnams dag kyang / /mkhas pa'i hāsgra hā dhi pa teḥ/ /i tikṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba cod pan du 'os nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa dā na ka lpa la tā yī tā pa bā ba dā na ma ṭwā na ba ti ta ma ཿbrjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dka' thub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa palla waḥ// //brgyad pa'o// //myu/ kā yi ka ha ra ti mā na saṃ ta thā de hi dzā bha ba ma yi ma hā ma yo/ /lus can lus dang de bzhin yid kyis (geni/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin nad chen 'phrog byed pa/ /budha e ba bha ga bān su ṅgā ni byeḥsand+ra lo ka ba ra lo ka bāndha baḥ/ /'jig rten kun gyi 'jig rten pha rol gnyen/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan bdud rtsi'i gter nyid do/ /shā ba bye bha ga bāzlu rde ro gā krārnyi dza rna dzi na ཿ / / bi da bye mnyan yod du sngon bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba'i gzigs pa bdud rtsi yis/ /skye bo nad kyis gzir 95byed1041

hi tasti miḥ/ /ta rja se no pa yuste na sabye te pu ra bā si naḥ/ /sa ha shin tu chen por gyur/ /de yi sha ①ni nyer sbyar bas/ /grong khyer na gnas de dag kun/ /bdud rtsi so ba ya yuḥswāthre ma mṛ te ṣpe ba pū ra tāḥ/ /ta e ba bhi kṣa bo yu ya ma rya yis ni bkang ba ①bzhin/ /'phral la bsos pa nyid du gyur/ /de nyid dge slong khyed rnams te/ /de ro gāttha yorje tā ཿ/ /ro ga tā ṇi na satā rmā sa de bā hambi ra ma ring bdag gis nad las bsgral/ /sems can rnams kyi nad bskyabs pas/ /rtag tu bdag ni nad dang yaḥ—/ /saṃ sa ra byā dhi bai bye na su ga te ṣpe ti bhā ṣi tai/ /swashrī ste bral—/ /bde gshegs 'khor ba'i nad kyis ni/ /sman pas de skad gsung ba spyodag /dge slong bsos bhi kṣa baḥkhru tā hasgotyā haṃ pra pe di re/ /a bi ra ta pa ra hi ta ma pa de dag gis/ /thos nas dga' mgu rangs pa thob/ /shin tu chung ba'i rtswa dang mtshungs pa yis/ /na sī ko pi sa tā bi kā shaḥ/ /ta nu ra bi ta nu ta ra tro ṇa tu la ya dasto lus dang sbyin ④pa gang la rtse dga' can/ /gzhan phan yid dang bral ba min rnams kyis/ /snying stobs ya tra bi khā saḥ/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba bcas pa ci yang rnam par gsal/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs dā na ka lpa la tā ṇḍa pa dma kā ba dā dzā na ba na ba ti ta ma ཿpa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las padma can kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu snyepalla waḥ// //rtsa dgu pa'o// //myu/ swa two da byeḥko pi sa baṃ da nī yaḥka ro ti pu bye ra mṛ tā gra dru ti/ /ya gang gi bsam par bla med byang chub 'dod/ /bdud rtsi'i pho nya dang po zla tshes bzhin/ /bsod snga sha ye nutta ra bo bye rpātstsha shī tsā shu le khe ba na bā ba tā re/ /dzi rna dze nams kyis ni gsar du 'jug byed pa/ /snying stobs rgya mtsho su zhig der phyag 'os/ /rgyal byed tshal 95—1043

ta ba nā sī na pa pratstsha pra ṇa taḥpu rā/ /kau tu ka pra ṇa yī shrī mān ko sha lend+raḥbazhugs rgyal ba la/ /dpal ldan ko sa la yi dbang / /gsal rgyal dge mtshan la chags shing / /rab pra se na dzita/ /bha ga bāṅka ju tī kasmind+ra tha rma te thra thu byu teḥ/ /pūrbe tu btud pas sngon zhus pa/ /khyod kyi yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub bag chags dang po ni/ /sngon dzadma ni saṃ dzā tā samya4 bo dhi bā sa nā/ /bha ga bā ni ti bhū pe ṇa gyi skye ba gang las ①skyes/ /'od zer rgya che bcom ldan gsungs/ /sa bdag gis 'di dris de la/ /thraṣṭa ste pratya bhā ṣa ta/ /shu tsi mā na sa haṃ sā mā ⑫ darsha yanda sha tshems kyi 'od zer yid kyi rdzing / /gtsang ma'i ngang pa'i 'phreng zhuston cing / /bcom ldan 'das kyis na byu ti/ /puzlo pu rā pra bhā ba dhyā pra bhā so byu bhu dza ni byeḥ/ /ya dā slar gsungs pa/ /grong khyer 'od ldan dag tu sngon/ /rab gsal sa bdag gter du ni/ /gang tshe ham bha baṃ samya kshibo bye dhīsgre ta dā bha bta/ /ka ri bhā pre ma bā she na sa mā bdag gyur de tshe bdag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub blo gros gyur/ /glang po chags ldan glang mo la/ /dga' kṛṣṭaḥs kuñdza raḥ/ /ya dā bi gā khya ga ha lda rā gī pu na ru pā ga taḥ/ /ba'i zhags pas rab tu drangs/ / nags su 'khyam 1nas gang gi tshe/ / de tshe ④nye bar 'ongs gyur pa/ /ta dā haste ma hā mā traḥsaṃ dzā tasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pra tyā yā taḥkṣi ti pa te kuñdza raḥde tshe glang chen sna chen po/ /kun tu bgrod kyis de la smras/ /sa bdag bdag gi bslab pa yis/ /glang shī kṣa yā ma ma/ /e ṣa rā ga sa mā kṛṣṭaḥkā yo bismi ta saṃ ya māḥ/ /po dag ni rab tu 'ongs/ /'dod chags kyis ni yang dag drangs/ /dul ba brjed pa'i glang po 'di/ /dza gā ma bi kṛ yī ha ste bi shwa sta gu ṇa ma ṇḍa laḥ / / a sruryāspru yon tan dkyil 'khor yid brten glu pa/ /nges par rnam 'gyur dag tu gyur/ /lus 'dzin 'dod chags tā tā paḥkṣa taḥdhri ti ra shā pastsa ni ra yasta martswan byakyārghaṃ bi ṣa ma bi ṣa ma dra dran pas rab bskyed dran 'phrog brtan ⑥pa 'joms pa ni/ /me dang nyi ma min pas gdung zhing dmod pa 95byed1044

bya bhu dza ge/ /a ma ryakṣ-i ba two ni pa ta na ma nirghaṃ ta nu j-i tā ma byu min pas dmyal bar byed/ /long dang mtshan mo min pa'i rab rib lag 'gro'i rdzas min mi bzad dug /tastsosgo daḥsma ra dza ni ta rā gaḥsmṛ ti ha raḥ/ /saṃ yā te ṣpe nyi ka thi te chang min myos byed dma' min lhung byed 'byung po min pa'i sbyo byed do/ /zhes pa kun bgrod kyis smras tshe/ /dṛ pa ste pra tya bhā ṣa ta/ /a suste rā gaḥsaṃ sāre kashyibyi ṣa ya ni thra haḥ/ /de la mi bdag gis smras pa/ /chags bral yul la chags med pa/ /'ga' zhig 'khor ba na yod dam/ /i ti thraṣṭaḥkṣi tī she na saṃ yā te sta ma bo tsata/ /niḥsaṃ sā rā dza ga tyasmin zhes pa sa yi bdag pos dris/ /kun tu bgrod kyis de la smras/ /'gro ba 'di na de bzhin gshegs/ /bī ta rā gāsta thā ga tāḥ/ /satyā tā rde gu ṇa ba hūṃ saza sa two pa kā 'khor ba med pa 'dod chags bral/ /dam pa'i snod dang yon tan can/ /sems can kun la phan ra rghaṃ/ /rā dzand+radha pra dī pā dzā ru tsā bi shaṃ pra kā sha te/ /e ta dā mdzad pa/ /rgyal po sangs rgyas sgon ma yi/ /'od kyis thams cad gsal bar mdzad/ /de dag thos kardzu bhū bhakhyoḥpa ri tsitta pra sā di naḥ/ /pra durba bhū ba z-i da ye sa ryaḥnas sa yi bdag /mchog tu rab dang sems ldan pa'i/ /snying la rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi/ /bag saṃ bo dhi bā sa nā/ /pūza pu ju pra bhā bee na saṃ pāpta ku sha lo da yaḥ/ /chags 'phral la rab tu 'khrungs/ /sngon gye bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /dge ba rgyas pa yang dag thob/ /samyakshi bo dhi lā bhā ya pra ṇi dhwa rna tsa kā ra saḥ/ /so byudṛ ha pa tirna ma ku khā la de yis yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub thob slad smon lam byas/ /de ni sngon gyi skye ba la/ /rdza mkhan pūbyu dzadma ni/ /sne hairgu ḍo da ṣpeste nakṣe byeḥsaṃ pū dzi to dzi naḥ/ /tahphu khyim bdag ces par gyur/ /de yi ①dbul tshe gus pa yis/ /bu ram gzan ②gyis rgyal ba mchod/ /de rgya pra ṇi dhwa de na ta sngapta su pra bhā sa tī/ /bo dhī re ku ri tā tsitta pha li te yi bsod nams smon lam gyes/ /rab gsal nyid thob de yi ni/ /sems la byang chub myu gu bsgrun/ /da 95byed1045

si pu tra ke ti gā dngha sa ram̐ ṣṭa bye ta mū tsa tusto/ /ā rā bye to bhatta sa parya yi ba ris khyod 'gro zhes/ /de dag gis ni de la dam 'khyud smras/ /bu khyod me yi sbyin sreg la dga' zhing / /bla nirgyu dza mā baṃ gu ru de ba te na/ /twa yāsni ho tā bhi ra te pu tra sa hye na te nāstu ma'i lha dang ldan pas bdag cag ni/ /zol med gus pa'i mchod pas mnyes byas pa'i/ /bden pa des bha bādzre sha lhaḥ/ /i trukta mā tre ka ru shārti satya satwo pa sarje ba tsa na khyod zug rngu med gyur cig /ces pa bla ma dag gi snying stobs rdzogs/ /snying rjes gzir ba'i bden tshig gu ru rgyu/ /sha kraḥs ma bye tya su dhwa pra se kai ra dzre ba yarjarbi pa ram̐ ku brjod tsam la①/ /brgya byin mngon phyogs bdud rtsis bran pa yis/ /gzhon nu rma dang bral zhing bsos mā re/ /shā mā ka nā mā sa muṣpeḥku mā rasta dā bha baṃ tabyi na ya bra to haṃ/ /par byas/ /bdag ni de tshe der gus brtul zhugs can/ /thub pa'i gzhon nu sngo bsangs can der gyur//tā bee ba me shākya ku lodzha bee pi pū bye su pū byi pi ta ro pra yāṭwāta/ /i ti shākya'i rigs 'khrungs mchod bya bdag gis kyang kye/ /'bad nas mchod bya pha ma de dag go/ /de ltar bi bi dha dhand+ra mū lo ga di tai su ga te na bhi kṣa baḥshu tā/ /gu ru se rnam mang chos kyi rtsa ba ni/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs dge slong gis thos nas/ /bla ma bstan lkupa'i bā bra ta sa dṛ shaṃ nā mya ma n+ya nta sa bye trī / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra brtul zhugs dang mtshungs pa/ /dam pa'i spyod pa gzhan dag med par sems/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī byā ma kā ba dā na pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las sngo bsangs can gyi me kā bye ka sha ta ta maḥpabee baḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa gcig pa'o// //dā ṣpe na dī na dza na tā bya sa rna ni hadhi shī le na to ṣa ya ti sadzdza dman ④pa'i sbyin pas skye bo dman pa rnams kyi gdung ba sel/ /tshul khrims kyis ni skye bo dam pa'i 95byed1052

na mā na pā ni/ / pradzñā ba le na tsa ha ra tya bi be ka mo haṃ bīrle yid dag tshim par byed/ /shes rab stobs kyis kyang ni dben pa dang bral gti mug 'phrog /brtson ṇa bā ra ya ti dī ru bha yā ni dhī raḥ / / shā ba hūṃ sa twa ku sha lo 'grus kyis ni 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa zlog ①par byed/ /chos kyi bka' yis mnyan yod na/ /di shaṃ tai dhadzre shā sa ṣpeḥ/ /dzi rna dze ta ba nā sī rna pa prasgorbhekṣa paḥpu rā/ /dge ba sems can la ston cing / /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal bzhugs la/ /dge slong rnams kyis sngon dris pa//bha ga bān bha ba tā sha kro bimbi shā rabya bhū pa tiḥ/ /rnyikṣurtswa dzñā ta kauṇḍi n+yaḥbacom ldan khrod kyis brgya byin dang / /sa bdag gzugs can snying po dang / /dge slong kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya//pra pi tāḥs tya darsha āoṃ/ /laghra dā yo de ba tā dzā ta thā yu ta tsa tuṣṭa yo/ /bden pa mthong ba dag la bkod/ /de yi zhar la lha rnams ni/ /'bum phrag gnyis dang de bzhin du/ /tattha saṃ ge na saṃ pāste satya darsha na bā tra hūṃ/ /swa bhā baḥs ha dzo bā yi khri phrag bzhi yis bden pa ni/ /mthong ba'i snod nyid rab tu thob/ /kun la phan mdzad khyod kyi 'di/ /gu ṇaḥpu rgyu na yo pi bā/ /dzadmā bhyasta pra sā do bā ta ba bee sho pa kā lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin nam/ /yon tan bsod nams rjes 'gro'am/ /skya (dā bar goms pa'i ri ṇaḥ / / i kyu lte bhikṣu bhiḥ shu tā bha ga bānd+ra tya bha ṣa ta / /rab dang yin/ /dge slong rnams kyis 'di brjod gsan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis beer gsungs pa/ /sa hā dza ba ga mā sgyu satpa re pa kṛ ta me ma tiḥ/ /asprurjadma ni ki tsi tram̐ bdag gi blo gros gzhan phan la/ /goms pas lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /skye ba 'dir bdag sems can la//ma ma satwa hi te ra tiḥ/ /a su bhū ta pa dā sgyu satrī ha hasgyu di dzadma su/ /phan par dga' ba ci zhig mtshar/ /rtag tu goms pas seng ge dang / /glang sogs skye ba (cho 'di la gyur⑤//da kṣi zla tyāḥ pu rā sārja bā hā gā bye gra hā ste yaḥ / / dzagludza la sngon tshe ded dpon lho phyogs pa/ /drag por skye'abrangs pa'i bud med dang / /don mthun 'bum phrag 95—1053

ni dhist+ri ram̐ sārja lakṣa dwa yā nu gāḥ/ /tasmidku le dza gabye sa bya graḥkā la gnyis rjes 'brang / /chu gter dag gi ngogs su phyin/ /de dus dus ni gzhan pa bzhin/ /'gro ba za i bā sa raḥ/ /a bhū ta dza ga rodha raḥphe pā khyaḥsthā ra bi gra haḥ/ /te lta ba la chags pa/ /'jigs rung lus rgyas sbrul chen ni/ /pham pa zhes pa byung bar gyur/ /skye bo ①kun sand+ra dza na yā saṃ paṃ tā sa mi ba duḥs haṃ/ /bi naṣṭa dherya dṛṣṭha ba ba bhū burgha gyi nyon mongs kyi/ /skrag pa bzhin du bzod dka' de/ /mthong nas brtan pa rnam par nyams/ /de ṭi tā i pa/ /sgo ge na sgo gi nā te na sa maṭwā byeṣṭi ta pa thi/ /dag dkrugs pa bzhin du gyur/ /gdengs can de yi lus kyis ni/ /lam dag kun nas bskor ba'i tshe/ /nisteṣṭaḥkā la baghra gra banti naste pra bra kru khruḥ/ /te ྾ ma she ṣa tri da sha bsam bral dus kyi kha sgor gnas/ /de dag rnams kyis cho nge bton/ /ma lus lha rnams bstod pa yis//sta baiḥsha ra ṇa rā bi shā/ /ā krandaḥsattha disgyu rpā prorya yo ka ru ṇa swa naḥ/ /skyabs pa'i sgra ldan de dag gis2/ /cho nge phyogs kun khyab byed pa/ /snying rje'i sgra ni rgyas par gyur/ /ya shaḥke sha ra saṃ je tha dzi haḥshe la gu hā shra yaḥ/ /tai shasde manda raḥde nas seng ge khyeri phug gnas/ /grags pa'i ral can zhes pa dang / /de yi grogs po glang po che/ /khru tā tadma ya pabyakuñdza raḥ/ /ā sanda tā ṇa sandarnyo ka ru rja kṛṣṭa mā na sau/ /dhī man dha ra yis sgra de thos/ /rgud ④pa skyob pa la chas ⑤shing / /yid ni snying rjes drangs gyur pa/ /don rā bā dzagla tuḥsārja saṃ rakṣa ṇa kṛ tra kṣa mo rte/ /ta taḥmo haḥs mā tu khya ga dzerja mthun skyob la dus byas pa'i/ /brtan ⑥pa de dag 'ongs par gyur/ /de nas glang chen ri bo yi/ /lus gi ri bi ga haṃ/ /bee gārje pa tyā dza ga re tsa kā ra ga ta dzī bee tai/ /can dag la seng ges stizhon/ /shugs kyis bsnun nas sbrul chen ni/ /srog dang bral ba dag tu byas/ /pā ṇa pra bā sa sa ma yata su ni shā sa ma ru taḥ/ /tsa ka ra da ha no bhā rī de yi srog ni 'gro dus su/ /dbugs kyi rlung ni sreg byed dag /rab tu 'bar bas seng ge dang / /95—1054

bhāsma sāta sau ha kuñdza ro/ /ta yoḥsha rī ra pū dzā yi ta taste sārja nā ya kāḥ/ /glang po dag ni thal bar byas/ /de nas ded dpon de rnams kyis/ /de dag lus la mchod pa'i slad/ /tho paṃ bi dhwa ya pra ya yurdi shastadma sha pā pa ha/ /a ha me ba ta dā sau mchod rten byas nas de dag gis①/ /grags pa dang 'grogs phyogs su song / /nga nyid de tshe don mthun haḥsārba pā ṇa pra do bha baṃ/ /ma hā hirde ba dasto sau shā ri pu trabya kudzi raḥ/ /la—/ /srog ster seng ge dag tu gyur/ /lhas byin dag ni sbrul chen te/ /shā ①ri'i bu ni glang po che/ /tatta su sa twa sha shi naḥsu kṛ ta pra kā shaṃ bi sho ba kā ra tsa tu re tsa ri tai ma snying stobs zla ba de yi spyod pa legs byas rab tu gsal/ /kun la phan par byed mkhas grags shing chen po hāhaṃ —/ /shu tā dzi ṣpe na ka thi tai pra tha mā harṣasta rnyikṣa baḥpra ti pa dag tu 'os/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa de dag thos nas dga' ba thob gyur pa'i/ /dge slong de dag rnams de pra sha shaṃ su re ba / / i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā dzee bo bye kyis tshig gis ①so sor rab tu bsngags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī dzi hā ba dā rna bye bye ka sha ta ta maḥrtogs ④ pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las seng ge'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste palla baḥ// //brgya rtsa gnyis pa'o// //tā ra hā ra ba ra bant+ra she kha ra tstshand+ra tsā ma ra pi ta smi tāḥshri yaḥ/ /do shal rab gsal gos mchog cod pan dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab dkar pos 'dzum pa'i dpal/ /di bya sgo ga su bha gāḥsu khotpa beeḥsru tsa yarnyi su kṛ tai ma hātna rmā/ /mchog gi longs spyod skal bzang dga' ston gyis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i legs byas gsal bar byed/ /pra thradha dhand+ra bi bha ba pra bhā bodzha ba darsha nāta/ /bismi tai bhi grusaṃ gha tai ba chos kyi 'byor pa rab rgyas pa'i/ /mthu ni rgyas pa ⑤ mthong ba las/ /ya mtshan dge slong tshogs la ni/ /95—1055

bha ṣe bha ga bān pu ra/ /a pābhā nutta ra dzñā na ma hā so gya n+ya dzadma ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sdon gsungs pa/ /skye ba gzhan la bla med kyi/ /ye shes gzi byin ma thob kyang / /ba byu bund+ra ma sābyaryāḥsu kṛ ta bye dza nāḥshri yaḥ/ /badzra ba tya bhi bdag la ngo mtshar bcas pa'i dpal/ /legs byas gsal bar byed pa byung / /byang gi phyogs kyi grong dhwa nā yī na garyā mutta rā pa thi/ /badzra tsaṇḍa bhi dho rā dzā badzra pā ṇi ri bā bha bta/ /khyer dag /rdo rje can zhes bya bar ni/ /rgyal po phyag na rdo rje bzhin/ /rdo rje gtum po zhes par gyur//gaṅgā bye pa bye na ga re me sum̐ dzi tā ma tī pa ṭī/ /tatru tsā ro hi bhā nā grong khyer gang gā'i bdag po ⑫ ni/ /sa bdag lhun po btul nas de'i/ /bu mo snar ma zhes bya ba/ /ma swa su bye shu ri bābee bān/ /ta snga ma dzre dza nahphutram̐ sa mi tra sa dṛ shaṃpra dzha/ /des khyethob bdud rtsi'i zer gyis bzhin/ /de yis de la bu dag ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs pa bskyed//tsi tra ya gya ma ṇitstsha tram̐ sa ha dzā lta bya rā dza ta/ /ta su pu ju pra bhā bee na sa gang la nor bu'i gdugs dag ni/ /bkra ba lhan cig skyes pas mdzes/ /de yi bsod nams mthu yis ni//kalpo pa na taḥs dā/ /di byā bha ra ṇa sgo gā nu sgo ge byuhphu ra bā se dzwa/ /rtag tu bsams pas nyer gnas pa/ /lha yi rgyan dang longs spyod dag /grong khyer ba yis nyams myong gyur//sgo ga piṇḍi ཿthra yiste na yasma྾ pū ri tai pu re/ /tasmraspri ya piṇḍa khyaḥlongs spyod dga' ba'i gong bu des/ /gang phyir grong khyer yongs btang ba/ /de phyir sa bdag sras de ni//smra pa te rabha bahphu taḥ/ /pi tu ram̐dhe sa saṃ pāpta rā dzñāḥpā bye ya sha di dga' ba'i gong bu zhes par gyur/ /pha yi mjug tu rgyal srid thob/ /grags pa rgyas des ① phyogs rnams shaṃ / /di de sha sasba bhū tā dzā swestso yo sgo ga sadza rda/ /dund+ra ti dudzre su—/ /'byung po kun la rang 'dod kyi/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa bstan/ /blon po blo ngan blo tī nā mā madhī ta su bi rakṣa tī/ /pra ya yo gu ṇi bibye ṣaḥswa bhā be hi du ngan zhes/ /bya ba de la chags bral grur/ /yon tan can la sdang ba ni/ /bdag nyid ngan pa'i rang 95—1056

rātpa rmā/ /me zu mā tā ma haṃ ta gya gyu bhā le khiḥs bhu pa ti/ /pūṣṭha sa kā bzhin yin/ /de yi ma mes sa bdag ni/ /lhun po'i spring khyeyig rnams kyis des/ /sngon gyi gnod pa rasmi hye pa tsa kā ra rasma rodru khaṃ/ /sa dru taiḥs ha sobyebyeta ma rtse pra dzwa li dran pa yis/ /g.yul la mngon par phyogs par byas/ /khro ba mchog tu rab 'bar ba/ /'phral la rgyas taḥs ram̐/ /pandi de sha ba lotpa kāsgo hi tram̐ ni dhano rya taḥ/ /do hi shing gsod brtson desakhye/ /stobs rab rgyas pas pho nya springs/ /bu mo'i bu la rab bstan pa/ /bu mo'i traḥsha tru pu traste twata pi tā du rātpa nā/ /maṇḍa lo khaṇḍa tsā nī tā dṛ tā khrirti bu khyod dgra yi bu/ /bdag nyid ngan pa khyod kyi phas/ /dkyil 'khor nyams pa khyod byas nas/ /grags ri bātpa dza/ /ākhyund+ra muttha rā me tsā pa pratstsha swetstsha yā na tseta/ /swa pa bzhin du bu mo phrogs/ /ma nyams sa 'di rang 'dod kyis/ /stsol cig gal te ma yin na/ /rang ya ma bye tya ka ro mi pra tyanta sha ra rja ti tho/ /mā tā ma he na pandeṣṭa nyid 'ongs khyod mtha' 'khob tu/ /skyabs pa'i mgron du bdag gis bya/ /ma mes kyis ni rab bstan pa//me ta dā kardzu khyu pa ti/ /dza na saṃ kṣa ya kā ru sgyurghaṃ pra sā da yi rtu ya yo/ /sarnyi de dag thos nas sa yi bdag /skye bo rlag la snying rje bas/ /de la dang bar byed du song / /dmag pi gra ha sandadhaḥs no dzhartsu ra se ni kaḥ/ /ma tā ma haṃ pu ra pā sa dpung ring zhing g.yul gyi ni/ /sdums la chas des gru dag gisarmye/ / /gang gā'i 'gram na gnas pa yi//shaṃ gā bu li na saṃ shra yo/ /sā mā tya bye tya brga gya ta gya saṃ kalpa lbo la yā/ /udhū ma mes grong khyer dag tu phyin/ /blon po g.yog sde dang bcas pa/ /de yi kun rtog rtse dga' yis/ /lha tai di byā mā hā re dṛṭī me ru ma tī pa tiḥ/ /de bo ya mi ti tā ma tā ta darnyi yi zas ni rab 'khrungs pa/ /sa bdag lhun pos mthong gyur nas/ /'di ni lha zhes nges byas te/ /rang ka swa yo ga tā/ /kaste gra hotstsha byetpaḥsaza rasne ra pū dza ya ta/ /nyid de yi drung song nas/ /mchi ma zag cing mgren par bzung / /rin chen kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /95—1057

pra ṇa yārja ṇi taste na ga twa swa na ga rī ni rdzu/ /di bya sgo godzha po da gre dzee byu dī de yi ①gus pas mchod pa des/ /rang gi grong khyer phyin nas ni/ /'dzam gling skye bo lha yi ni/ /longs pa dza rgo bya bhāta/ /tastso tai dzi na thrasgo bhekyu rnyiḥsadza daspra ti/ /spyod rab rgyas stilhag par bsgrubs/ /de spyod phun tshogs la mtshon te/ /dge slong gis dris rgyal ba ni//sazla zlo pya ba daste 6 ta su sadzati kā ra khaṃ/ /bā rā ṇa sde sa bee pro kun mkhyen gyis kyang de dag la/ /de yi phun tshogs rgyu mtshan gsungs/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ①skye gzhan de//bhūnd+ra li kā khyo n+ya dzadma ni/ /te na pra hye ka budhe ro ga glu na su dzhai ṣa dza/ /bram ze rtsa ba can zhes gyur/ /de yi ④ nad kyis gzir ba yis/ /rang sangs rgyas la sman dag ni//swāsthā ba dhī kṛ tai ya tra tstshahūṃ tsā dhri ta mā ta pe/ / tahphu sgyu tstshand+ra bsos pa'i mtshalas la thug par byas/ /gdung ba gang la gdugs kyang bzung / /bsod nams des rgyal bānd+ra dza so bhūdhi byo pa sgo ga bhāka /pre ya thraṇḍi ha me bā sau de ba dattabya gdugs can de/ /lha yi longs spyod snod du gyur/ /nga ni ⑤dga' ba'i gong bu de/ /blo ngan de yang dund+ra tiḥ/ /shu te kyuste bha ga ba tā bhikṣa bo bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /yabyisma lhas byin no/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /thos nas dge slong ya mtshan gyur/ /kye ma gang yā ba ha ma ho bi bha ba pra bhā ba di byo ba sgo ga su bha gi byu ba nā dhi zhig yon tan 'dzin dang 'byor pa'i mthu dang ni/ /lha yi nye bar longs spyod skal bzang srid pa'i bdag pa hye/ /dīrgha sa mā bra ya gha na bya sa nā ba sanda sasru ha nodha ra ṇa pu 5 po dang / /yid ⑥du gnas shing sdug par gyur pa'i gdung bar lhung ba dag /skyob cing yongs su 'don bi j-i bhi tai ta ta / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi tā yī pa de dag bsod nams rnam 'phrul yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī thra ya piṇḍa ba dā rna rgya dhi ka sha ta ta maḥrtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dga' ba'i gong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste 95—1058

pabee baḥ// //brgya rtsa gsum pa'o// //sadmārga saṃ j-i ta ma no ra tha sidhi su taḥshā ghraḥs tai su kṛ ta nidzre legs pa'i lam la yid la re ba rab rgyas grub gyur cig① /dam pa'i legs byas dri med 'jug la tī bye plu ta ཿ / / saṃ sā ra gho ra ma ka rā ka rā se tu byu ta ཿngogs gtsang ma bsngags par 'os/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i chu srin 'byung gnas dag gi zam stegs gyur//sata saṃ ga e ba shu bha sarga ni sarga dru taḥ/ /shā bahūṃ ka ma khā khya gya pu tram̐ kṛ ha pa dam pa'i grogs nyid dge ba spro ba'i rang bzhin pho nya yin/ /mnyan du yod pa dag tu sngon/ /khyim bdag teḥpu rā/ /haṃ sā bhi sgo bha ga ba tā yasne nārta ta pa de j-i tai/ /dṛṭī padma zhes pa'i bu/ /ngang pa zhes bya bcom ldan gyisakhya/ /'bad pas dgra bcom gnas la ni/ /rab pra pā da bi ṣa deḥka ru shā lo ka nā mṛ taiḥ/ /a nu gra hā gra ha bya dang dri med snying rje yi/ /gzigs pa bdud rtsis bzung mthong nas/ /rjes 'dzin brtson pas byel 'di gre ta ma bhā ṣanta bhi kṣa baḥ/ /bha ga bādku la pu tro yi pra bra rje pi kṛ la—/ /dge ①slong rnams kyis rab gsol pa/ /bcom ldan rigs kyi bu 'di ni/ /bag chags lhag ma horlu khaḥ/ /ba bhū ba bā sa nā she ṣā da shānta bi ṣa ya smṛ tiḥ/ /sa pra dag gis ④yul/ /dran pa ma zhi rab byung yang / /khyim la mngon par phyogs par 'gyur3/ /de ni rab yasne na bha ga ba tā bi ṣpe ya bi na yo dzi taḥ/ /a ho ma hā nu gra he ṇa sasmo ha 'bad bcom ldan gyis/ /'dul ba dag la rnam par sbyar/ /kye ma rjes khya/bzung chen po yis/ /kun ra hi taḥ kṛ ta ཿ / / usto ha rṣa mṛ ta seste mbi smi te ri ti bhigru rmongs dag dang bral bar mdzad⑦/ /de skad dge slong ya mtshan zhing / /dga' ba'i bdud rtsis ④bran bhiḥ —/ /tā na bhā ṣa ta sazi rja bha ga bāsgokta batpa laḥ/ /pūdzee pas zhus/ /gus la mnyes gshin bcom ldan 'das/ /thams cad mkhyen pas der gsungs pa/ /sngon 95—1059

ma gye ṣa ku sha la ma yā yaṭwāmbi bi shi taḥ/ /ta po ba ṣpe mu ṣpe ra sau su yang bdag gis dge ba la/ /'di ni 'bad nas rnam par bkod/ /sngon 'di ①dka' thub nags su ni①//bra tā khyaḥpu rā bha bta/ /tasmiṅgā le sgu ṭa lā paḥsha sha ko haṃ ta dā shra me//thub pa brtul zhugs bzang zhes gyur/ /de dus de yi gnas su bdag /ri bong gsal bar smra byed pa//taṅka thā a tā ba shra bhaḥbye ti mā na ba si sa dā/ /a thā dṛṣṭi ha te de yi gtam la yid gcugs skyes/ /mdza' ba dang ldan rtag gnas gyur/ /de nas char med kyis bcom kā la shuṣka mū la pha lo da ke/ /sa bhūrlu nizla nobye gāṅgā mānta ga ma ste—/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu chu bskams ①tshe/ /nags su yid byung thub (ṭwā pa de/ /grong mthar 'gro bar nokhru kaḥ/ /sa ma yā pra ṇa ye noktaḥsā bho ta ba bee pabye taḥ/ /ta bo 'dod par gyur/ /bdag gis gus pas sharkyede la smras/ /dam pa khyod ni rnam par mkhas/ /dka' thub ba na pa ri tyā gaḥka baṃ yukta sta bo dha na/ /bi yo ga bee bhobye ga ni nor can dka' thub kyi/ /nags ni yongs btang ji ltar rigs/ /rnam mang bral ⑥ ba'i mya ngan du//masna dza na shaṃ ku khāḥ/ /gra ha mo ha kṛ hā yā sa saṃ gra hā gā ma byu ma yaḥ/ /bying ba'i skye bos gang ba'i khyem/ /rmongs pa'i gdon gyi nyon mongs kyis/ /bzung bar gyur pa grong gi sa//byā shri kha lā mu kha ra duḥs ha pu tra pā sha j-i tyā ku lā ni bi ḍi bārgyu ba bud med lcags sgrog mu cor bzod dka' bu yi zhags pa dang / /g.yog 'khor gyis dkrigs brtan pa'i bantu pā lo/ /tyarghaṃ pu naḥ smṛ sha ti kaḥkha la saṃ gha ro shaṃ dhī māsgo gnyen gyi dra ba dang / /mi bsrun ⑦tshogs pa'i nad dang blo ngan gyis bcings mun chen can/ /btang haṃ ku ma ti banta ma hāndha kā ram̐/ /bi da dha ti mu husmo haṃ nā nā bi ba'i khyem la blo ldan su zhig slar yang reg par byed/ /sna tshogs 'bral ba'i mya ngan stug pos duyang yang yo ga gha nāḥshu tso dra ba ṇa la ba shā hā riskṛ: pa re ba ri pasgo te/ /bi rmongs pa skyed par byed/ /nor ni lan tshwa'i zas rnams dag gis sred pa mchog tu yongs su spel/ /mi 95—1060

ṣa ma bi ṣa ya ste hā sgyu sordza ḍi kṛ ta tse ta sī bra dza ti ku sha lo gre sha kṣe tra kṣa bzad yul la chags pa goms pas sems ni blun par byas gyur pa/ /nyon mongs zhing gi khyim na gnas pa yi ba sa tī kṣa yo/ /na dhīdzre da bi byuṇḍi tā bi ṣa ya sgo ga rā gā sa rnams kyi dge ①ba zad par 'gyur/ /skye bo med pa'i nags su zhi ba'i khyad par dag gis tshim pa rnams//beend+ra bātpa ka li la dṛ shaḥthra ya bi yo ga dhū moṅga mi/ /na dā ha ni ba ha yul gyi ⑦longs spyod la chags chang gis blo gros myos shing g.yo mi 'gyur/ /mdza' bo dang bral du ba rgyas bya thāḥka la ha ko ba tā porpā bairbha parnyi bi dza ṣpe ba ṣpe sha ma bi she ṣa pas mig ni mchi mas 'khrugs ① mi 'gyur/ /gzir dang 'thab mo khro dang gdung ba'i tshogs rnams dag saṃ to ṣi rde/ /gā ma smṛ hā ba nobee ga gā mobye gābo na smṛ tiḥ/ /gis sreg mi 'gyur/ /nags las yid phyung ngugrong la chags/ /grong las yid phyung ⑤nags tshal dran//sum̐ sī pra sa ma bai mu byuttha saṃ ge ṣpe ba dzā ya te/ /grwa me ni ya bā me skyes bu rnams ni rab zhi las/ /phyir phyogs zhar las ⑥'byung ba yin/ /grong dzeegi dul ba'i g.yon la tī mā kā ye ma ti parya kṛ thāḥ/ /pā ge ba bi ṣa yaldi gha nasnro ti gā ma saṃ khyod / /dus min blo gros yongs ②ma byed/ /grong dang 'grogs pas yul la ni/ /chags rnams thog ma ga ti/ /i hai ba ta ba kā le na pha la lā sgo bha bi 6 ti/ /shudzhaiḥnyid du 'ching / /dus kyis 'di nyid du ni khyod/ /'bras bu thob pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi sha saṃ pra ti madmā meeḥkri ya hūṃ pā khyo bhā ra ṇi/ /i kyughā haṃ sa mā bande bsgo ni ba ti ni dag pa yis/ /da ni srog gi zungs pyadag mdzod/ /ces pa brjod nas bdag gis ni/ /nye ba'i me taḥswa yi/ /sa tsa tūṇḍi sa murnyi pya pa ri ṣṭa bye dza gā da rmā/ /ki la rang nyid mchongs/ /des kyang myur du rab blangs nas/ /yongs su 'khyud de bdag la smras/ /gzu me tatpa ha saṃ tī ze bi rurghaṃ bha ba tā kṛ tai/ /na gasgo mi ba nā dasmaṭwātrī lums drag sti/ po'i 'gal ba 'di/ /khyod ni ci yi slad du byed/ /nags 'di las ni bdag mi 'gro//95—1061

tirla bhya te ku taḥ/ /pra ṇa yā di tai te noste byosni tsā lo ki te ma khyod mtshungs mdza' bo ga las rnyed/ /de yi gus pas ①de brjod cing / /bdag gis mkha' la bltas yā—/ /pa pā ta thraṣṭiḥs ha sā sa pha lā khyu ra bhūdma yā/ /pa.āoṃ bhi dzñā pa'i tshe/ /'phral la char ni rab babs pa/ /gang gis sa gzhi 'bras bcas gyur/ /de nas gus bcas twa mā sā ryaḥs ta ta ཿsā da ro mu niḥ/ /mā mu tse shudha sa two na ki ma ṣpe na twa ma tī thub pa des/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob nas/ /bdag la smras pa dag pa yi/ /snying stobs 'di yis ya se/ /pra ṇa yā di tra tai nā haṃ thraṣṭasta tasta ma ba da na/ /a ṣpe na khyod ci bzhed/ /ces pa de yis gus pas dris/ /de nas bdag gis de la smras/ /bdag ni spyod pa tsa ri te nā haṃ samyakshi bo bye marja ye/ /saddhā ra shā ya dza ga tī dzi naḥsnga 'di dag gis/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /skye ba gzhan la 'gro ba rnams/ /bsgral slad ma n+ya dzadma ni/ /ma ye kyus+ho sa ma mā ha bha bo 6 si ta thā ga taḥ/ /rgyal bar bdag gyur cig /ces brjod de yis bdag la smras/ /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs par 'gyurage//ya dā tu sa mya kshi bu ddhā sa ttha pta ste bha bi 6 se / / ta dā ma mā gang tshe yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mkhyen par khyod gyur pa/ /de tshe bdag gi 1lus n+ya de ha gya karta byo nu gra hasta yā/ /e tatta gya ba rtsa sā dhoḥsgo ha rda gī kṛ gzhan ni/ /khyod kyis ④rjes su bzung dzubar bya/ /dam pa de yi tshig 'di ni/ /mdza' bas bdag gis kha tasma yā/ /saṃ pābeeḥsha sha kaḥso ha masmiñdzadma ni budha tī/ /su bra tā khyo mu yis blangs/ /ri bong de nga skye ba 'dir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag thob/ /khyim bdag bu ni dad niḥsā yo haṃ so kṛ ha pa tiḥsu taḥ/ /pūdzee smṛ hye pra yasne na pā bi taḥku sha pa 'di/ /thub pa brtul zhugs bzang zhes pa/ /de yin sngon gye rab 'bad ni/ /dran nas ༷bdag lasma yā/ /pra panda batpa le ṣpe ti ka thi tai sattha dargo rmā/ /dzi rgo gis dge la bkod/ /de ltar gus la mnyes gshin pa/ /thams cad gzigs pa rgyal ba yis/ /rang gi 95byed1062

na ni dza thraddhāhaṃ khru tā te bisma yi ya yuḥ/ /a bi ka la ku khā la pha la sngon byung gsungs pa dag /thos nas de dag ya mtshan gyur/ /rdza mkhan ①bzhin du ma tshang med pa'i pra sa ba shu bha tsa ri teḥs ha bā saḥ/ /di na pa ti pa ri tsa ya ni tsi ta ru 'bras—/ /skyed byed dge ba'i spyod pas 'di na duganas/ /nyin mo'i bdag dang yongs 'dris btang tse ཿ shrī ra sa mā hi ma bha sa ཿ / / i ti kṣe me nd+ra bi ra tsi gyur pa/ /bsil zer mdzes pa'i dpal ni mtshungs med bzhin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī sha sha kā ba dā 8 tsa tu ra bye ka sha ta ta byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs ldupa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod ④pa'i maḥpabee baḥ// //yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa bzhi pa'o// //krobye ṇa ya dī ra sa nāḥshu tsi tseṣṭa tā rmā mi byā pa ba da bi ṣa oṃ bi ṣa lce gnyis gang zhig khros pas kun spyod gtsang ma rnams la ni/ /rdzun gyi skyon brjod mi bzad dug ni muskṛ dzarnyi/ /te pā pa shā pa pa ri tā pa pa re pa rāṭwāst+ri bra bya lī rab tu spro byed pa/ /sdig dmod ⑤yongs su gdung ba rgyud 4)mas gzir ba de dag ni/ /mi bzad 'dod ka ti mi re bi pa ram̐ bi sharnyi/ /pu rā ri ba ti ko nā ma kashrī ri 6 shu tsi bra taḥ/ /bya min pa'i rab rib khung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /kha cher ri yi gnas su ni/ /ri ba ta ka zhes pa sngon//bhigruḥ shi la bi hā re bhūtpa ttha byu ta da yā shra yaḥ / / ta ru twa tsaḥ'abyung po kun la brtse ba'i gnas/ /dge slong brtul zhugs gtsang ④ba byung / /nam zhig de yi bum nang ka ṣā ye ṇa sa ka dāñtsi gha ṭanta re/ /thi bikta kā na nodre sha tsakre ṭī ba ra du—/ /shing shun ngur smrig dag gis ni/ /nags tshal dben pa'i phyogs ⑧su ni/ /chos gos kha ni rañdza rna/ /a tānta re dhe nu batpa ndaṭwā nasbraju mā ya yo/ /zwahma ṇaḥpi bsgyur ba byas/ /skabs der drus ma'i be'u nyams/ /bram ze phra ma can zhes pa/ /skye bo ba glang ⑨za 95—1063

shu ṣpe nā ma go bhakṣa dza na shaṃ ki taḥ/ /sa dru rāsgyu ba rasgo tha pā ke balbo bar ni/ /dogs khya pa dang ldan 'tshol ①du 'ongs/ /de yi ri las khyaring po nas/ /chos gos tshos khu sa muṅga tai/ /sadzee te dhū ma mā lo kya baṣṭha pa ka ma ma n+yata/ /ta taḥ'atshed ④pa yi/ /me las skyes pa'i du ba dag /mthong nas be'u btsos par bsams/ /de nas mtshon shi lo sa mā ru hra sa hi taḥshant+ra pā ṇi bheḥ/ /a bye tya ri ba tai bhekhye pa pratstsha bee cha lag rnams dang / /lhan cig gnyis skyes ri la 'dzegs/ /dge slong ri ba ta la ni/ /mngon phyogs na yā dhī dzaḥ/ /ki me ta dārya kṛ ya te thraṣṭaste ṣpe ti go ra bāta/ /dul bas rab dris pa/ /'phags pa 'di dag ci zhig mdzad/ /ces pa de yis ④gus pas dris//bha dra ṭī ba ra rā go ya mi ti tai re ba to bra bīta/ /asminda ba sa re ta snga pūttha kadzre bzang po 'di ni gos 'tshed ces/ /ri ba ta yis de la smras/ /gnas skabs der ni sngo spyomed kyi/ /de bi pā ka taḥ/ /go rmā saṃ rakta sa li la sa pā kaḥs ma ba rya taḥ/ /su kha yi las kyi rnam smin byis⑦/ /'tshed pa de ni ba lang gi/ /sha khrag chu dang bcas par gyur/ /sgrub byed duḥkha twa mā yā ti shukla ma gye tikā la hūṃ/ /bi sgo bi dhu ra tsā yā te 'khrugs ④par gyur pa na/ /bde ba sdug bsngal nyid 'gyur zhing / /dkar po dag kyang nag por 'gyur//dharmo byā yā tya dhand+ra tsā/ /mi byā bā ba pra ka ṭa rna dza na ko paḥpa da sgo tiḥ/ /chos kyang chos min nyid du 'gyur/ /rdzun gyi ⑨sdig pa gsal byed dang / /skye bo khro dang gnas ⑩nas lhung //a pū rgya pa ri pā kā nā me tattha tya kṣa la kṣa rde/ /do ṣaḥs mumbi 'di dag bsod nams ma yin pa/ /yongs smin mtshan nyid mngon sum yin/ /skyes bu rnams kyi ⑩nyes ṣa ti yā ti gu ṇaḥpra shā shaṃ kārlo pi parya ya mu bee ti bi shīrya te dhīḥ/ /byas sngon bsgrubs ⑫smin pa'i dus su ni/ /skyon rnams rab tu rgyas shing yon tan dag ni nyams par sum̐ sī pū rā bi hi ta duḥkṛ ta pā ka kā le ke ke na nā ma ni pa tarnyi ma hā 'gyur⑫/ —/ /bya ba phyin ci log 'gyur blo gros rnam par bslad par 'gyur/ /mngon par 'joms pa chen 95—1064

bhi ghā tāḥ/ /bee ruddhā mi ṣa gadhe na ru dhe re ṇa tsa shaṃ ki taḥ/ /so pa byepos nges par su dang su mi ltung / /'gal ba'i sha yi dri dang ni/ /khrag gis kyang ni bsgos ①pa yi/ /bram ze byehma ṇaḥkuste ṭī ba ram̐ rmā sa tai ga ta/ /pra tyaspyo do ṣa mā lo kya sa kro dha bi de yi bum par ni/ /chos gos sha nyid gyur par 1 bltas/ /skyon ni mngon sum mthong gyur nas/ /khro ba'i kṛ tā kṛ tiḥ/ /ta ma bhā ṣa ta nirbhaṣṭha tī bra bai sha sha shaṃ pi taḥ/ /a rnam 'gyur dbyebs ldan zhing / /mi bzad sdig pas 'dar ba des/ /smod cing de la rab smras pa/ /kye ho ba ta pā dā tsā raḥsbi to yi bi dza ṣpe ba ṣpe/ /ya gye dṛ shā ni kand+ra ṇi na kabya ma dam pa'i kun spyod ldan/ /mi med nags su gnas pa 'di/ /gang gi las ni 'di 'dra ba/ /'dir di ha pa shya ti/ /pra bra dzñā ram̐ dzi taḥkā yaḥkṛ yāsletstsha dza no tsi tā/ /dzā nā ni su yang mthong ba med/ /rab tu byung bas lus bsgyur 1 cing / /bya ba kla klo'i skye bor 'os/ /sdig pa ④tisgonda pā pā rmā kaḥku ṭa bra ta shārnya tai/ /i kyusto te na sā kṣe pa bsgribs pa'i rdzun gyis ni/ /brtul zhugs zhi nyid su yis shes/ /zhes des smod ⑤bcas brjod pa'i tshe//ri ba taḥs ma tsinta yata/ /do ṣe pra tyakṣa lakṣesmiṅgi bra bī mi ni rutta raḥ/ /ri ba ta yis rab bsams pa/ /skyon ni mngon sum mtshon 'di la/ /lan med bdag ni ci zhig smra/ /ma ma de bo pa ghā to ya mi kyukta go nu ma n+ya te/ /hā snga ya ta na bdag gi 'di ni lhas bcom zhes/ /brjod kyang su zhig bden par 'dzin/ /mngon sum gsang ba'i skye tā me ti pra tyakṣu patna bī dza naḥ/ /u pa sbi tai sa he saj-i mo na mā la bya ke bo buni/ /bzhad gad dag gi gnas su gyur⑦/ /mi smra 'ba' zhig la brten te/ /nye bar gnas pa kun ba lo/ /a yi me niḥpra tī kā raḥs li lā dasni rurji taḥ/ /do ṣe gu rja ti bzod bya/ /bdag la bcos su med pa 'di/ /chu las me ni rab tu 'khrungs/ /skyon la yon tan phul sha ya mā shu gu ṇi bi do ṣi bee yu ṣa jombi bee ṣa ma bya mṛ haṃ bi ṣeb/ /sandarsha byung myur du yon tan dag la skyon/ /bdud rtsi'i gnas la dug dang dug la yang ni bdud rtsi ste/ /nges 95—1065

ṛrnyi pra dbye pra ya yo ri ba taḥs ha bhigru bhiḥ/ /a sa tya do ṣe rdzu 'phrul bstan nas ①ri ba ta/ /dge slong rnams dang lhan cig ④song / /bden med skyon byis ④bye ṇa bi ṣa yusgyu pra tyakṣu kṣa ta la kṣa ṇi na / /a lo ki taḥ sā dhū dza brag rig rjopa ni/ /mngon sum du mtshon mi nyams mtshan nyid kyis/ /brlang pos zil mnan skye bo dam naḥkha le na ki bsti bi spri ta i baṃ tya de sha/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā pa ni/ /yul gzhan dag tu btsongs bzhin ci zhig brjod/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ri ba tā ba dā āoṃ paspyotta ra sha ta ta chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ri ba ta'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal maḥpalla baḥ// //'dab ste brgya rtsa lnga pa'o// //bi dzi gī ṣa ba la i ba ta ra sā duḥs haḥsaṃ sā ra sha bye ba lo ha rgyal bar 'dod rnams bzhin du stobs kyis ni/ /bzod dka' 'khor ba'i dgra yi stobs bcom tā —/ / ri pu ā sā da yarnyi dhī rāḥ pā dzhai sa dha dzre sāpta rdzu/ /nas / /dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid chen po ni/ /rgyas pa brtan 2pa rnams kyis thob par 'gyur/ /ya dā sru tram̐ bha ga ba tā byā byu tai na ga ro pa oṃ/ /ta dā sa kau tu kādṛsgo gang tshe grong khyer lta bu'i mdo/ /bcom ldan gyis gsungs de yi tshe/ /dge slong rnams kyis ⑥dge mtshan bhigru bhistu na bha ṣa ta/ /a khyu ta ka na ka ba tyā khyu dza na swarga pra bhā las| /dris pa de yis dzeerab gsungs pa/ /grong khyer gser can zhes pa ni/ /skye bo mtho ris 'od pu rī/ /ta snga mā sīnda ra ba tirgyu ti māṅka na kābhi dhaḥ/ /ta su pra ldan byung / /der ni mi bdag 'od dang ldan/ /gser zhes bya ba byung bar gyur/ /de yi dga' ba brje mā nā yāḥspru te rā ya ta rna pa re/ /pu traḥka na ka basmra bhūrlu tā ba ka na ka pra mchog tu ni/ /rab tu rgyas pa dag gi gnas/ /bu ni gser gyi go cha dang / /bu mo gser 'od dag tu 95byed1069

bhā / /kā le na yo ba nā rū ṭwā stan sta pa ka sho bhe byā/ /la te ba sā gyur—/ /dus kyis lang tsho la 'dzegs ①shing / /nu ma'i me tog phun bus mjos/ /mdzes pa de mdzes ba rbha kānta ba santa la li tā kṛ tiḥ/ /bā la spru tyā pa ri tsi ta st+ri madhri dpyid kyi ni/ /yid 'ong dbyibs can 'khri shing bzhin/ /gzhon la mdza' bas yongs 'dris pa/ /blon ta na yo yu bā/ /kā ma sā rā bhi dheḥsī ra ma kā ma yata kā mu kaḥ/ /po'i bu gzhon 'od ldan 37 ni/ /'dod pa'i snying po zhes pa yis/ /de la dal gyis 'dod pa bsten//pra dṛste putpa sa ma ye byerya hā ri ṇi yo ba ṣpe/ /j-i gaḥpra saṃ ga pañtsa me tog dus su rab zhugs shing / /lang tsho can gyi brtan 'phrog tshe/ /snye ma dang 'grogs bung ba ni/ /rī mañdzaryāḥke na bārya te/ /ta na yī naṣṭa tsa ri tai dzñā tā mā byā ma tī pa tiḥ/ /tu yang dag rgyu ba su yis zlogs/ /bu mo spyod tshul nyams pa dag /shes nas sa bdag khengs ldan ni/ /mi sum̐ bi bee sha bi ṣa ma sho ka kro ṅgā na la dwa yo/ /ka tyā bi tī nā ni su bzang mya ngan khro ba yi/ /me gnyis dag la mtshungs par zhugs/ /khengs pa bsten pa rnams la bsod lā ni pu byerbha brnyi mā tyā n+ya nyi mā na bhā rdzu/ /a yā tsu yastso ba mu khaṃ nams kyis/ /mchod 'os rigs ni bu mos dman par gyur⑦/ /bslang bya min par ④slong ba'i gdong kṣa ṇi na ku lo hi ga tyā ma li bee ka ro ti/ /shā sa nā da tha byu bhakhyoḥka tyā madhri bzhin du/ /skad cig gis ni bu mos rigs nyams byed/ /de nas sa yi bdag po'i bkas/ /bu mo blon su ta: paḥ/ /ā kṛ 6 ba dhya ba su dhwa mbi to shā sa na kā ri bheḥ/ /ya tsa po'i bu de yang / /bka' ni byed pa rnam 37dag gis/ /blangs nas gsod pa'i gnas su khyen/ /de nas mā no pa ri tā rde ta tasto ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /rā dza pu traḥswa na ga rāndi nā ya na ga skyabs ni zhu byed pa/ /de dag snying rje rgyas pa yi/ /rgyal sras kyis ni rang grol las/ /grong khyer gzhan pa ram̐ pa ra/ /ta taḥkru dhaḥkṣi ti ba tiḥpu tram̐ sha tru mi boṅka ṭi/ /niṣka su dag tu khrid/ /de nas sa bdag brtse med cing / /khros pas dgra ni drag po bzhin/ /bu ni nges par 95—1070

niḥ kṛ pa bya kre pra tya nta ma ha nā ti tho/ / pi tā ni rastaḥ satā rab bskrad de/ /mtha' 'khob nags kyi mgron ①du byas/ /snying stobs chu gter phas bskrad detso3/ /sgo rsā tā tī rba ba nā ba no/ / ra myodmā nā ñdzi kārnye pu re pā pa sa 'jug ngogs nags tshal sar 'khyams nas/ /dga' ba'i skyed tshal padma (ṭwācan/ /mi med grong khyer nirdza rna/ /da darsha kā ki bhā ta tra bha gi byā ka na ka pra dzñā/ /khidzñā dza na bee mdzes pa thob/ /der ni sring mo gser gyi 'od/ /skye bo dang bral skyo ba ni/ /grong khyer dag gi lha mo yo ge na na ga ra pa sri ba de ba tsā/ /swa sthā ta ram̐ pa ri dzñā ya thra tyā bāṣṭhambu bzhin—/ /gcig pu nyid ni mthong bar gyur/ /de yis stong pa'i rgyu thu dag dris/ /de yis ming por pabhā dhī/ /shu n+yata kār hūṃ te na bṛṣṭa tai pra tya bhā ṣata/ /bhā tarjerdza yongs shes nas/ /mdza' bas mchi ma'i char 'bebs shing / /de la lan ni rab smras pa/ /ming po n+ya gro na hūṃ mbi haṃ bu ra me tattha hā ri bheḥ/ /ṣakhye saṃ khyehma hā nasne rya kṣertsu gro dha brten pa'i/ /gnod sbyin stobs chen snun byed pa/ /drug cu'i grangs kyi ⑤grong khyer 'di/ /skye bo dha so shra yiḥ/ /saṃ pra tya smin kṣa ye she ṣa ba haṃ madhri su ta: saḥ/ /a dhū nā med pa dag tu byas/ /'di brlag lhag ma da lta ni/ /bdag dang blon po'i bu de ste/ /da ni khyed kyi twabye hu ba la bra bhā baṭwā ṇa me ba no/ /i ti swa sund+ra tsaḥkhru tā rā dza pu dpung pa yi/ /stobs mthus bdag cag skyob rmyepa nyid/ /ces pa sring mo'i tshig thos nas/ /rgyal po'i tra ཿ sa mā ga tī / / e ka ya kṣu ba she ྾ tsa kre ya kṣa ba lo sha bu yis mda' rnams kyis/ /gnod sbyin 'phreng ④)ba 'ongs pa dag /gnod sbyin gcig gi 7lhag mar riḥ / /sa yakṣaḥko ṭa ro nā ma ta me ba sha ra khaṃ ga taiḥ/ /pra sanda dā sa bhā bā byas—/ /gnod sbyin ko ṭa ra zhes pa/ /de nyid la ni skyabs song zhing / /'bangs kyi dngos po thob pa su bi da dhe dza ya gho ṣa rde/ /pu naḥpo riḥs mā tīrte pu re tasmin bi plu des—/ /de yi rgyal ba bsgrags pa byas/ /beer yang gang ⑨de grong khyer bas/ /khengs shing 'tshe ba med 95—1071

bee / /dṛ paṃ rā dza su tabya kre madhri sru rnu swa saḥpa ti/ /pu tra bhā rpā pa na/ /sring mo'i bdag po blon po'i bu/ /rgyal sras kyis ni rgyal por byas/ /ngo mtshar dang bcas bu sābyaṅgi khru tā tsā rirni bee di tai/ /ka na kaḥgrwa pa tirle kha pra ṇa ye na ni yi mthu/ /nyan rna dag gis bshad thos nas/ /sa yi bdag po gser gyis ni/ /spring yig dag gis ①nā yā tai/ /sa ba dhe mu ku ṭa ཿpi tāhphu ba rā dzaḥpra tā pa bān/ /'bad pas bos/ /yab kyis cod pan bcings gyur cing / /rgyal tshab gzi brjid ldan gyur pa/ /ba she ba byend+ra yabyakre tsa tudī pa ba tīsma ṭī/ /shrī mānd+ra dza ku mā ro sā dbang po dbang gyur de yis sa / /gling bzhi ldan pa dbang du byas/ /'khor ba bzhin du dgra yi sde/ /ba ha me ba ta dā bha baṃ/ /saṃ sā ra sri ba ya: kre sha tru brga su saṃ kṣa yo/ /gang gis kun tu brlag byas pa/ /dpal ldan rgyal po'i gzhon nu der/ /nga nyid de yi dus na gyur/ /und+ra hā du pa bi shya sa twa ru tsi re sa dha nd+ra sau hā sa ṣpe shī la : snying stobs mdzes ldan dam chos seng ge'i khri la spro ba zhuyis ni nyer bzhugs ⑦shing / /tshul khrims gtsug ṣa ba tā bi pe ka sa li la pābhā bhi ṣe ka shri yā/ /ha tā sha tru pa tor dang ldan dben pa'i chu yis mngon par dbang bskur dpal thob pas/ /mi bzad ⑤rgya che srid pa'i ram̐ pa dzā thra thu bha ba kle shā ba lī ma kṣa yī sā labha pra sha me na bi shwa dza yi nyon mongs 'phreng ba brgyud khyamar gyur pa'i dgra bcom nas/ /rab zhi thob cing kun las rgyal ba dag gis nā nidrwa ṇa bhūzlu bye te/ /na ga ro pa ma ma ma la ta re nidzā ṇa yakṣa sambi myang 'das sa de spyod par byed/ /gnod sbyin dang mtshungs nyon mongs brlag byas nas/ /shin tu dri med bhādme shān / / kṣa pa yi tā bye kaishyibye ga ba nuste ti bi ra rā ma grong khyer lta bu yi/ /mya ngan 'da' ba 'ga' zhig dag gis thob/ /ces pa gsungs nas bcom ldan rnam par saḥ —/ /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā gnas—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 95—1072

dzee ka na ka basthā ba dā na ṣa ḍa dhi ka sha ta ta maḥpabee baḥ// //'khri shing las gser byu go cha'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa drug pa'o// //gu ṇḍi smṛ hā na dra pi ṇi ka dā tsidmo ge bhi yo gaḥpra sa rghaṃ na sgo ge/ /bsod nams rab 'bar bsam pa dri med rnams/ /yon tan la chags nam yang nor la min/ /pu byo dzwa lā rna bi sha dā sha yā ṣpe ra dzo bi rā gā rnyi ra tirna kā me/ /pu rnal 'byor la sbyor longs spyod dag la min/ /rdul gyi chags bral la dga' 'dod la min/ /bsod sgo pra bhā baṃ bha ga bārlu rgya shi lasta thā ga taḥ/ /ba bhā ṣe dīkṣu bhiḥnams ri bo bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsho7bsod nams mthu/ /de yi bsod nams la gus thraṣṭastahphu sgyu da ra bismi teḥ/ /bā rā ṇa sri ma ṭī rā rnyi brahma dbye pra shā pas—/ /ya mtshan dge slong gis dris gsungs/ /bā rā ṇa sīr khyergyal po ni/ /tshangs byin dag gis sa sa ti/ /shurnyo da ṣpe kṛ ha pa toza byu ba dhwa na do pa maḥ/ /ta myu bsrungs kyetshe/ /khyim bdag zas ni gtsang ma dag /nor sbyin dang ni mtshungs pa byung / /rgya mtshor bee kalpa dṛkṣa gya sa mu dra ga ma nārdzi teḥ/ /ma ṇi mosti ka saṃ bhā riḥ'agro bas rab bsgrubs pa/ /nor bu mu tig tshogs rnams kyis/ /slong ba dag gi dpag bsam shing / /pa ri pūṇḍi ma byubye haṃ/ /ratna dī pānta rā yā taḥs ka dā tsidma tī pa ho/ /de yi khyim ni yongs gang gyur/ /nam zhig rin chen gling gzhan nas/ / 'ongs pa de ni sa bdag la/ /④drabye ya yo sa mā dā ya mughāhā ra mu pā la rna/ /pra kyuṅga te na pra ṇa yādma ni taḥskyes su mu tig do shal dag /khyer nas blta ru song bar gyur/ /sa bdag sngon du langs byas nas//sa ma tī bhu dzā/ /tā ram̐ hā re da do tasmi lī khā hā sa mi ba shri yaḥ/ /gus pas mchod pa de yis ⑤ ni/ /dpal gyi rtse dga' dgod pa bzhin/ /gsal ba'i do shal de la phul//sa ra smi sru tra saṃ sakta tā ra kā ni ka ro pa maḥ/ /bhu mi bhakhyorgu bhā hā 'od ldan skud par yang dag chags/ /rgyu skar gyi ni tshogs lta bu/ /yon tan ldan pa'i do shal gyis/ /95—1073

rabya kā ra z-i da ya gra haṃ/ /asminda ba sa re rā dzhaḥsu ta bā la sa ra swatī/ /sa bdag snying ni bzung ba ①byas/ /gnas skabs der ni rgyal po yi②/ /bu mo gzhon nu dbyangs can ma//su bhā ṣi tai bha bya shaṃ rā ha smo saṃ ga tā dza go/ / srushā kṛ ha pa ba gam can byi nang song bas/ /legs ldan tshig gis legs bshad blangs/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'dod pa tiḥshu tā shra ba rja mṛ ta mbispru tai/ /pra la hūṃ ku ri tā kā rastasmadma yaḥswa kṛ yi1—/ /legs bshad khyim bdag gis thos nas/ /sru long myu gu'i rnam pa can/ /de yi rang bzhin haṃ ya yo/ /tyakta hā ra bi hā ro tha su bhā ṣi ta z-i tā sha yaḥ/ /rang khyim song / /de nas zas dang rtse dga' btang ④/ /legs bshad kyis ni bsam pa phrogs/ /ni dā da ri draḥswa kṛ he ba tsi re ma tsinta yata/ /a ho nu rā dza pu gnyid kyis dbul ba de yis ni/ /rang gi khyim du yun ring bsams/ /kye ma rgyal po'i bu mo des/ /byutta gī tai sā dhu su bhā ṣi tai/ /a paryā lo tsi te nā pi ye nā mṛ ta mi bādzre legs pa'i legs bshad glur blangs pa/ /gang de 31yongs su ma spyad kyang / /bdud rtsi dag ni byin pa tai —/ /ma yā dā da sha bhirbakhyorbi pu lo ratna sañtsa yaḥ/ /saṃ pāptaḥbazhin—/ /bdag gis lo ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rin chen tshogs ni yangs pa dag /thob de legs srukta radzee tu na ku ta— du pārdzi tai/ /rasneḥki mathra gu ru bhiḥ pra bshad rin chen ni/ /'ga' zhig las kyang nyer ma bsgrubs/ /'bad pa brgya yis bsags pa yi/ /rdo yatna gu ru saṃ tsi taiḥ/ /sadmārga lo ka ṣpe rarja tabyi dhantu su bhā ṣi tai/ /lci rin chen rnams kyis ci⑥/ /dam pa'i lam ni gsal byed pa'i/ /legs bshad de ltar rin chen yin//i ti saṃ tsi tya pu ru ṣe bi thra bye dṛ pa mandi ram̐/ /sa tsakre rā dza du zhes pa ④tebasams nas mi bdag gi'u3/ /khang par skyes bu rab btang ste/ /legs bshad rgyal po'i bu mo hiḥtu srukta yadzñā ma yā tsa kaḥ/ /sā ba bhā ṣesmi ta mu khāe sus+ho mu le las—/ /slong ba po min de yis basbangs⑪/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan des smras pa/ /legs bshad rin 95—1074

na la bhya te/ /ta myurgha tu lhi dra bi khaṃ dī ya tsā ya di shākya te/ /yā bdī gyis thob par 'gyur/ /de yi rin dang mtshungs pa'i nor/ /gal te nus na sbyin par mdzod/ /ji srid dasha bhezasgoste na sad ratna saṃñtsa yaḥ/ /ni hi taḥsatya shī le na pa rgyuho lo ni bcu gnyis su/ /bden pa'i ngang tshul de yis ni/ /rin chen dam pa'i tshogs bsgrubs pa/ /rin sau sa madzre hūṃ/ /e tadhū pā la du hi tuḥsande shaṃ rū ta bhā ṣi tai/ /shu tā du 'os pa de sbyin mdzod/ /sa skyong bu mo dag gi 'phrin/ /'di dag pho nyas bshad pa ni/ /thos pas khye kṛ ha pa tiḥsattha raṭwā tyā dā ya sā dā raḥ/ /swa yo rā dza kṛ ha ga tā khyim bdag gus bcas pas/ /rin chen thams cad blangs byas nas/ /rang nyid rgyal po'i khyim song ste//da tā sau tri ṇa lbo la yā/ /srukta rarja ta dā dā ya pa pā joṅkaṇḍa to mu huḥ/ /de la rtswa yis 1rtse dga' byen/ /de tshe legs bshad rin chen thob/ /dga' bas yang dang yang du brjod//yadmaṅgi tsikhru kha ma nu pa oṃ bā khya mā bhyanta ram̐ bā yo yaḥsatwa pra sa pa bi la gang gang phyi 'am nang gi bde ba dpe med chung lduzad dag dang ni/ /gang gang snying stobs kyis bskrun ④ ya sabyisma yaḥsernyi yo gaḥ/ /ye ye j-i: pra sha ma bi ma khā santa tā nanda lā bhāḥmatshan rgyas pa grub ⑤ pa'i sbyor ba dang / /gang gang sred pa rab zhi dri med rgyun du dga' ba thob pa dag /pā ko྾kta sa sa pha la bha raḥpu ju kalpa dru ma khru/ /oṃ dārya ni dhi nā de des bsod nams dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu smin cing rgyas pa'i khur/ /rgya cher gyur pa'i gter de te na sadzee ratna su bhā ṣi tai/ /kṛ tī tai dṛ pa ti khru tā tai pa pratstsha sa yis—/ /rin chen kun gyis legs bshad ni/ /blangs pa thos ⑥nas mi yi bdag /ya mtshan bcas pisma yaḥ/ /raṭwā ni kasmra duskṛ bye srukta mā tra mi rda twa yā/ /kṛ pas dzeede la dris/ /ci beed rin chen rab btang nas/ /legs bshad tsam ni khyod kyis rbobazung / /bu tī tai bā li kā bā kya sa ra laḥpra tya yībyen/ /pūdzā su bhā ṣi tespyo mirja āoṃ mo 'di ⑨yi tshig dag la/ /drang po khyod ni yid ches ldan/ /legs bshad kyi ⑪ ni sa gzhi gang / /nor 95—1075

kṛsgo ṇa la bhya te/ /na bhakta bi ra te bhulte sruste na ke na tsita/ /ni tshogs chen dag gis 'thob/ /zas dang bral na su zhig gis/ /legs bshad dag ni bza' ①bar nus//i ti shu tā kṛ ha pa tiḥsgo ha duktasma tī bhu dzā/ /srukta lā bhe na ma zhes pa 1sa bdag mdza' ba yis/ /brjod pa khyim bdag gis thos nas/ /legs bshad rnyed pa chen po ha ta su tuṣṭasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzasko kri ya te rasneryatna rakṣu bi nā shi yis—/ /tshim pas de la rab smras pa/ /gang gis ①sbrul bzhin skyes bu la/ /chags sdang dug ni skyed bhiḥ—/ /sasthā khyo mi ba maḥsum̐ shā rā ga dī ṣa bi kho da yaḥ/ /bai ma spyo byed pa/ /rgyal po 'bad bsrungs spyonyams pa yi/ /rin chen dag gis ci zhig bya/ /legs bshad nor ba tsi tī ru tsi ra tsa ya taḥsadmārga dī po pa rmā bha byā āoṃ dzdza da ye su bhā ṣi ta bu dhilegs ldan rnams kyi snying gar ⑥brtan pa'i yon tan gyis brtags shing / /dam pa'i lam gyi sgron ④ma ṇi ṭwā dhe gu ṇa la mbi na ཿ / / pā ko dhī ṇḍi su ba ṇḍi su nda ma dang mtshungs dri med rgyas pa'i 'od zer spro byed pa/ /'tshed pa las thar gser bzang mdzes pa'i ra pa da shāpta pra brtsesbri taiju bye sā ga ra me kha khā ba su ma tī pā dzā sha ko gnas la rab sbyar gnas pa thob pa yi/ /rin de ⑧nor gye blo gros rgya mtsho'i ske rags dang ldan rkang pa'i pya bya ka/ /i ti shrī masgo ha pa tiḥmbi ga tya ku sha lo rya taḥ/ /su baṇḍi cha la'ang chung / /zhes te dpal ldan khyim bdag ni/ /dge la brtson ldan phyir thos rjonas/ /gser gyi pa tra li khi tai srulti dikṣu n+ya bee sha yata/ /shusgo da no kṛ ha pa tiḥso ha me glegs bu la bris te/ /legs bshad phyogs rnams dag tu springs/ /de yi tshe na nga nyid ni/ /khyim bdag ba ta dā bha ba / /srusteḥpu byo pa de shābee sabye na nā bi pā da zas gtsang der gyur te/ /legs bshad bsod nams nyer ston pa'i/ /don la bdog kun btang bas raḥ—/ /shā ri pu tro pya yo dzhaigruḥsā bhū pa ti su tā bha pata/ /i kyu bā tsā khi la gus—/ /dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di yang / /sa bdag bu mo der gyur to/ /zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa 95—1076

dza gadku sha lā ya ta thā ga taḥ/ /āryaḥkandaḥku sha la na li byā rū la yis—/ /'gro kun dge ba'i slad du gsungs/ /dge ba'i padmo can ni rtsa ba btsugs nas rab skyed ①dang bandha pra sru teṭwā nā sadzanda ba na ba la tā saṃ bha bo tyā na khyu miḥ/ /tro: po'i rgyu/ /sna tshogs phun tshogs gsar pa gsar pa'i 'khri ñtshashing rab skyed kyeskyed tshal sa/ /sred pa'i tā pa pra sha ma na hi ma sme ra shaṃ gā pra bā haḥsadmānā gra pra ka ṭa na pa ṭuḥpu gdung ba rab tu zhi byed kha ba'i 'dzum ldan gang gā'i rgyun/ /dam pa'i lam mchog gsal bar byed mkhas rgya me ba pra kā shaḥ / /i ti kṣe mend+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā snang ba dag ni bsod nams nyid/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs ba dā na kalpa la tā dzee shurnyo da nā ba dā rna sastotta ra sha ta ta maḥpa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las zas gtsang ma'i byartogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste palla baḥ// //brgya rtsa bdun pa'o// //e ṣā dzi ṣpend+ra bi hi to ru bi hā ra tsa ye tsi dhyā ga ṇi ka na ka rgyal ba'i dbang pos bsgrubs pa gtsug lag khang chen dag gi tshogs/ /mchod rten khyams ⑪su tsi tra gu hā kṛ he 6/ /ṣpe tra mṛ ta pra tsi ta le pya ma yī ba bhū ba buddhā gser gyi ri mo'i phug gi khang par ni/ /sangs rgyas rtogs brjod rnam mang rmad byung dpag bsam 'khri ba dā na bi bi dhwa bye ta ka lpa ba lli / / bee bee yo ku shing 'di/ /mig gi bdud rtsi rab skyed ⑥yi ge'i rang bzhin dag tu 'khrungs/ /legs byas kyis gang sha khā ya pūṇḍi su kṛ te tsi tre bi hā re sa tram̐ kṣe mende ṇa bi she ṣa tsi tra ra bkra ba'i gtsug lag khang du dam pa rnams ni dge ba'i slad/ /khyad par byis ni bkra bar bkod cing tsa nā ra myu ba dā nā ba lī / / ā ka dzee pra ti mā sa ha dga' ba'i rtogs brjod 'phreng ⑦ ba gzugs can 'a7/dag /stong phrag rnam gsal bsod nams rab sbyar 95—1077

sra bi ka sahphu sgo pra bsgo dzwa la mā bhūtta byi ra hā ku lo dza ga di ti byashā pra 'bar ba de nyid dge ba'i dbang po yis/ /bskal pa'i bar du 'gro ba de bral 'khrugs par ma gyur cig tijo pi tā/ /sastotta ra sha ta me taste na kṛ lta bo dhi satwa tsa ri tā rmā/ /ces gsal bar bkod/ /de yis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod/ /brgya rtsa bdun po 'di dag byas/ /maṅga la sa khyu pū ra ṇa me kai kārja pra yasne na/ /so mend+ra nā mā ta na yo tha ta bkra shis grangs ni rdzogs pa la/ /gcig ni rab tu 'bad pas bya① / /de nas zla ②dbang zhes pa de yi bu//gya ka bitstshandaṅgā ba rā nā ma dhe yaḥ/ /asmidzdza no dā re ka thā pra badhe saṃ pū ra ming gzhan nā ko ḍa1zhes brjod snyan dngags mkhan/ /rgyal ba'i gtam rgyud rgya che sbyar ba 'dir/ /rtogs yi 6 tya ba dān —she ṣe/ /bandhaḥke ra la kā mi mbi ka tsa bha rā kā raḥpa ram̐ pa brjod pa lhag ma skong byed gyur④/ /mtshams sbyor ke ra la yi bu mo'i skra tshogs rnam pa mchog tu yang saṃ ha taḥhūṃ rī kānta ka po la ko ma la ta raḥko pi pra sā do da yaḥ/ /kādzā dag 'byel/ /ci yang rab tu dang ba rgyas pa ke ri'i mdzes ma'i 'gram pa shin tu mnyen/ /ro yi gter ṭī na ya natstsha ṭā pa ri tsi tā karṇanta rā saṃ gi mbi sgo girya gya ta re gi ddhā ra sa ni gyur gang gis rkye'akhyog tshig g.yo ldan karṇa ṭa ma'i mig gis 'uzer/ /yongs 'dris rna ba'i bar du 'grogs dhettha byeḥs srusto da dhiḥ/ /oṃ kā radku ṭi la twa me ba pa ra oṃ maḥshikshi tai ldan legs bshad chu gter de ni phyag byar 'os/ /gang gis oṃ yig dag las gya gyu kho na mchog tu bslabs nā pa ram̐ ye hūṃ swasnyi ba rda ka dā tsi da pi na smṛṣṭi mu khāmbirga hūṃ/ /kro kyis gzhan pa ⑦yin/ /gang gi kha nas swaste'i tshig ni gsal ba nam yang nges par mi 'byung zhing / /khro dhwa sgyu ta ta yā thi baṇḍi ba da nā tī drwa pa rā bye pa yo te bi byā ni dha maḥb 'bar bas bzhin ni mdog bral mi srun rig khyabyed gter gyur de dag gis/ /drag po'i gnod pa ka dzee thra thu ka baṃ kā bye kṣa madhe kha khāḥ / / kṛ te mā ma ba dā na bzhin du rgya che gtam gyi snyan dngags dag ni ji ltar bzod/ /dge dbang zhes pa'i snyan dngags mkhan 95—1078

kalpa la ti hūṃ kṣe mend+ra nā mā ka biḥsadhadzre pra ṇi dhwa na me ta da dhu nā dhaste gyi rtogs brjod ①dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di byas nas/ /da ni dam pa'i chos kyi smon lam 'di dag blo bye yādhī dha naḥ/ /pu bye yatpa mu pārdzi tai dzi na gu zla khyu ṇa pra bandhadma gros nor ldan blo yis 'dzin/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan sgogs byed bsdebs las bdag gis bsod nams gang yā bhū yaste na sa mapta satwa ku sha le ni rkyo rya to yo dza naḥ / /zhig nyer bsgrubs pa/ /de yis spye skye bo 'di ni sems can mtha' dag dge la rtag tu brtson gyur cig /saṃ sā ro ru pa ri shra ma gya da dha taḥkā mā pa ba kṣi ba two mo hasmra ha ta mo ni 'khor bas che bar yongs su ngal zhing 'dod pa'i chang gis stsos pa nyid 'dzin la/ /gti mug rgyas pa'i sbo li ta dṛ shaḥsupta gya lubee smṛ teḥ/ /sandadhe dza ga taḥpra bo dha na mun pa dag gis mig zum nyal zhing dran pa nyams pa yipya/ /'gro ba rab tu rtogs par bsgrub ④la chas bi sgo niḥshe ṣa do ṣā pa haṃ bhā swarnyi bha ga banta me ba sa ta tai burghaṃ pra shing skyon rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /'od dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan sangs rgyas rab tu sad pa nyid budhanda maḥ/ /ā nanda bantu ma sa kṛsmṛ thu mā na sā dzā srulte shu bhind+ra la rtag tu bstod/ /kun dga'i gnyen gyur lan cig min par rgya che yid can la/ /legs bshad 'od kyi ⑤hi ta sabye su kho pa de shaṃ / /kṣe mend+ra mu dzwa la ni dzā dzhai dza bde ba kun gyi nye bar bstan pa sgrub/ /dri med rang rig khye)chu gter dag gi zla ba dge ba'i ⑦dbang / /nādhi tsaj-i tīrnyipra kā sha dza na kai dza na shaṃ na mā mi/ /bākrā ka pū ba na ni dhwa na grags pa gsal ba skyed byed yab la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa dag byed tshig dzi nā ba dā na nisthā ṇa bu rgya ka la nā ku sha lā bhi yo ge/ /asmri1 ni smin pa'i gter/ /sprul byed bsod nams rtag du pa dge ba'i mngon par sbyor ba 'di/ /bla ma legs taḥsu kṛ ta nā di sha tā ni yo shaṃ saṃ pū ra shā ya gu ru rja ma ma saṃ bi bhā byas ldan pa bka' ni rab tu sbyin mdzad pas/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i beed du bdag la skal ba'i cha shas 95—1079

gaḥ—/ /ye ྾ su barṇa pra ti ma pra tā nā dzi nā ba dā nā n+ya bha brlu hā mdzad—/ /gang zhig phug tu rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dang / /gser gyi gzugs brnyan rab tu rgyas par su / /saṃ sakta ṣpe tā mṛ ta tsi tra tsi tāḥkā le na te te pi ga tā bi hā rāḥ/ /gyur—/ /mig gi ①bdud rtsi bkra ba'i ri mo chags/ /de ni gtsug lag khang ni dus kyis 'da'②//sa ra tī tū li ka yā bi tsi tra baṇḍi kra mai rulli khi tā ba dā naḥ/ /tā te dbyangs can pir gyis rnam par bkra ba yi/ /rtogs pa brjod pa ①yi ge'i rim pas bris/ /gang 'di na yo yo bi hi to ma hāzeḥsandanda na pu rgya ma yo bi hā raḥ/ /na ta bsod nams rang bzhin gtsug lag khang / /don chen dam pa dga' byed yab kyis bsgrubs/ /phyogs su su nā shoste yu ga kṣa ye bi dza khā na lolla se pa ri bla bee na/ /dikṣu po ti'i 'phreng ④ba rab bkod pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan tshogs ni brtan pa ⑤ rab chags pa/ /de ni chu pra tijo bye ta pusta kā lī sbyi ra pra sakta pra ti mā ga ṇa mya/ /tasmidma yā gya dang mes bskyed nyer 'tshe yi/ /dus bzhi 'jig kyang nyams pa yod ma yin/ /de la rtogs brjod gcig kṣa ya pu5 lo bhā de kā ba dā na pra ti māmbi te yo/ /ma hādma rmā gi gzugs brnyan 'di/ /mi zad bsod nams la chags bdag kyang 'god/ /bdag nyid chen po der pro snya pa dā nu sā rī swaspo bya yasne na ma ha twa me ti/ /mā dhurya dhurya ma gnas ⑥rjes 'brang ba/ /shin tu chung yang 'bad med chen por gyur⑦/ /thos pa'i skyogs kyis btung mra ta khru ti shutta pe ya mā mo da padma mu kha padma pa de dhwa naṭī/ /j-iṅgāṅga bya'i bdud rtsi snyan pa dag gi rgyun/ /dri bzang khang pa bzhin gyi padmo'i gnas su sgrogs byed pa/ /bung nā mi ba pi tuḥpra ṇi pa tya bā shlau saṃ pū ra yā mi thra thu kā bya bi shi ṣa ba'i na chung dang mtshungs yab kyi skad la btud nas ni/ /snyan ngag ④rgya che'i khyad par lhag ma bdag gis she ṣa ma/ /kādzñā byu ta na saṃ ga motpa ba ba tī di bya pra bhā bi shri yo tā rdzogs par byas/ /mdzes ma gsar du 'grogs (7pa'i dga' ston can dang lha yi mthu ldan dpal dang ni//95—1080

ru sgyu bha ra rto pa sgo ga la ha ri tyakta tro ṇa gī ḍa yā/ /pā shā tā ṇa dar bab rgyan kyi nye bar longs spyod rba ①rlabs rtswa yi rtse dga' btang byas nas/ /gus bcas gang dag bi sgo pa ra su kṛ pa yā kund+rarnyi ma sā da rā nisto dzā ni dza de ha dā na ma tsa khāstu brtse bas gzhan gyi srog ni bskyab par bsgrub la rang gi lus/ /zol med sbyin par byed (kyel g.yo ba med pa ṣpe ba band+ra ma hai / /ba bhū ba kañtsa na pu re shrī mabyu rya dha re shwa de la bdag cag phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang / /sprin gyi tog ①ni sprin bzhin ra—/ /dzī mū ta ke tuñdzu mū ta i ba tā pa ha robee dzā/ /ya gya kalpa du—/ /slong ba'i gdung ba 'phrog pa dag /grong khyer gser du byung bar gyur/ /gang gi dpag bsam dru modhū tāḥpa dā na ba na bāḥshri yaḥ/ /tsa kā shi re ye shaḥpubyeḥpuju shing las 'khrungs/ /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal/ /grags pa'i me tog bsod nams kyi/ /dri sau ra bhā nirbha rāḥ/ /dzī mū ta bā ha nasta gya pu trabyand+ra i bo da dheḥ/ /a bzang rgyas pa rnam par mdzes/ /chu gter la ④ni zla ba bzhin/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa de yi sras/ /shin bhū da kyu gra pu sgyu bhā pra tya gra i ba sañtsa yaḥ/ /gu ṇa bādzre na ye ṣpe ba tu lhag pa'i bsod nams rnams/ /gsar du tshogs pa bzhin du gyur/ /dam pa'i skye bo legs byas dang / /tyā ge ṣpe ba bi bhū ti mān/ /sa ba sgo te na pu tre ṇa su kṛ ta ṣpe ya sadzdza naḥ/ /yon tan ldan pa dul bas ⑪dang / /'byor pa ldan pa gtong bas bzhin/ /de ni sras po de yis mdzes/ /kalpa dru mo sa sā ma rā bye pu tā ya pra ti pā rya saḥ/ /ta pa se shārnyi ni de yis bu la dpag bsam shing / /rgyal srid che dang bcas btang ⑥nas/ /dka' thub sbad du zhi ba'i la yi bi bee kā ma la yo ya yo/ /dzā yā sa khe shri yo tyaghā yā te tā te ta gnas—/ /ma la yar ni dben pas song / /yab ni btsun mo dang 'grogs te/ /dpal btang dka' po ba āoṃ/ /dzre mū ta bā ha naḥpāpta bi bha baḥs ma tsin ta yata/ /gu ru se thub nags song tshe/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa 'byor pa dag /thob pa yis ni rab bsams pa/ /bla ma bstan 95—1081

bya bi yukta khru ma ma niḥsu kha tsā ga tā/ /i yo shrīrne tra tī na gya tsi trag le ba pa dang bral ba/ /bdag la dpal ni ⑨bde med gyur/ /mig gis dman pa dag la ni/ /ri mo'i gnas niḥpha khā/ /tā ta gya pā da pa ta ṣpe na kha radre mā khā bi bhra dza mān dag 'bras ④med bzhin/ /yab kyi zhabs la gtugs tshe sen mo'i 'od kyi 'phreng ①ba yis/ /rnam par mu ku ṭa gya ya thā pu rā byuta/ / tatshwa sa na shra pa ṇa kuṇḍa la maṇḍi mdzes pa'i cod pan dang ldan de yi ④bka' nyan pa'i/ /rna rgyan gyis brgyan dpal ni ji ltar bdag la ta su no tsa kra brnyi bi bha be rya ta thā ma ma shrīḥ/ /i tya saṃ tsi tya sa sngon gyur pa/ /da lta 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'byor pa dag la de lta med/ /ces bsams de yi ⑤'jig rten rgo rdza kṛ tā ka na ka bakṣi rṇa/ /sabyu lo ko pa bā rā ya sandarghaṃ kalpa ni—/ /kun la phan slad rang nyid kyisakhye/ /dpag bsam rkang 'thung gser gyi char/ /'bebs pa dag pā da paṃ/ /pā rdzu sāṭwā bye musmṛ bye pra ya yo pi tu rā shra ma/ /tram̐ lokya tu bstar byas nas/ /rgyal srid chen po rab btang ste/ /yab kyi bste gnas dag tu song / /'jig rten sā ra mi shwarya tre rde bi pu la tse ta sī/ /tasmidmāsdu bye mudṛ dzu pra yā te gsum gyi snying po yi/ /dbang phyug sems yangs rnams la rtsa④/ /rgyal srid chen po btang nas de/ /ma ma la yā tsa lo/ /tesnra kalpa dru maḥthra bhā pa ri pūrya di baṃ ya yo/ /la ya yi rir song tshe/ /dpag bsam ljon pas sa gzhi ni/ /gser gyis yongs bkang mkha' la song / /gi re dzi spru ta bā ha naḥpā su shrī khaṇḍa maṇḍa dzwa/ /bi yo ga tā pa ta tā dzi bi sprin gyi bzhon pas ri bo ni/ /dpal byi dum bus brgyan par phyin/ /pha ma'i zhabs pad bsten pa yis/ /troḥpā dābyā se ba yā/ /a tānta re tsanda na babee rī hūṃ di de sha bā 'bral ba'i gdung ba rab tu btang / /skabs der tsandan 'khri shing rlung gzhon ⑤gyis/ /bskyod cing lā ni la lo la tī rmā/ /utshwa bi ni nā ma bhi khā ṣa thra.āoṃ dzo bhā dzu shugs ring ⑨glal ba bsten rnams la/ /'dod pa'i grogs por gyur pa dpyid kyis no/ /mngon par 95—1082

ṣe kā ma su j-idma santaḥ/ /a dakṣi ṇa pro ṣi ta kā mi — rmā ba po mu hurdakṣi ṇa 'dod pa'i spyod tshul rab tu bstan/ /khyo bral 'dod ldan ma yi mi mthun phyogs/ /lho phyogs rlung ni yang mā ta ri shaṃ/ /dza gadzdza yā ye ba dzha ṣa dhwa dze na bā ya bya maste sa ha sru pra yang rab tu ldang / /'gro la ①rgyal slad nya yi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rlung gi mtshon ni 'phral la rab sbyar yuste / /a sru tra ṇiḥṣarja da maṇḍa khā rna gha na pra sru ṣpergu ru tī pra yā tāḥ/ /tsū bzhin / /rkang drug dkyil 'khor dag gis ma spras pa/ /stug pos khyergyas pas lci ba nyid gyur pa'i/ /tsū ta dru māstsakru ra bhinda mu drwa badhe na yu nā ma bhi lā ṣa dīṣṭha/ /ba santa ta'i shing gis mi phyed phyag rgya bcings/ /lang tsho can la mngon 'dod babeeb pa byas/ /dpyid kyi dpal lakhro shra ba ḍā ba tai pābya kā shi ri la ta ṭī khya sho kāḥ/ /pā da pra hā ri ri ba nā ga rī mo dag gi rna ba'i rgyan/ /ri bo'i ngos la mya ngan med pa mdzes/ /grong khyer ma yi rkang pas rab bsnun hūṃ saṃ krānta rā gā na ba palla be bhu/ /dha n+ya su kāṭwā ba da nā ba bee na pas—/ /yal 'dab gsar pa dag la tshon 'phos bzhin/ /mdzes ma'i kha yi chang gi ⑦dga' ldan pa/ /ma mo ba ra myaḥsma ra do ha de yo/ /i tī ba dzā tā ba ku la dru ma su harṣasmi ta shrīḥ'adod pa'i thabs ni ④ skal ldan bdag nyid la/ /zhes te ba ku la shing me tog gi/ /zol gyis dga' zhing ku su ma hwa la na/ /mā dzwa sa mudzdzabye bee hā ya mo 8 pā da pra shā me na 'dzum pa'i dpal skyes bzhin/ /khengs ldan ma rnams khengs pa rab btang zhing / /mi smra spangs nas ma na sī nī bhiḥ/ /pra sā rya mā nānda yi tāmbi lokya dza hā sa pu྾ ri ba sind+ra bā rkang pa ⑤rab btud de/ /mdza' bo dag la dang bar byed mthong nas/ /ṅgand+ra bā ra me tog gis dgod ⑥raḥ / /ba santa dzi ha gya pa lā sha pā lī ba byesgu raṅge sha ra bhā ra bhā dzaḥ/ /bzhin| /ge sar rgyas pa'i khur bsten pa lā sha'i/ /'phreng ⑦ ba mdzes pa dpyid kyi seng ge yis//ma na sri nī mā na ga dzā dzñā ghā ta raghā ba sighā na kha rā ba byā ba/ /karje khengs ldan ma yi khengs pa glang po la/ /bsnun pa'i khrag bsgos sder mo'i 'greng ①ba bzhin/ /rna bar 95—1083

kwa ṇasko ki la kā mi mbi bhiḥspasgo shi rī kho dṛ shi kaṇi kā riḥ/ /ghra ṇi pa ra ta ke snyan sgogs khu byug bu mo yis/ /reg las ①shi ri ṣas mig kaṇi kar/ /sna la ge sar rdul tshogs rgyas pa sha re rku pū rirba barṣa harṣa ku su mā ka ra shrīḥ/ /tambidma dhu khye ba bi gyuṇḍi yisti—/ /me tog 'byung gnas dpal byi 1dga' char phab/ /bung ba'i na chung rnam 'phrul longs spyod mā na dzdzadzñā ga na bhra ma sgo ga kā le/ /uhphulla babee 6 pa nastha le ldan—/ /sbrang rtsis myos shing rnam par 'khyam dus der/ /me tog rab rgyas 'khri shing tshal gyi gzhir/ /6 tsa tsā ra bi byā dha ra rā dza sru nuḥ/ /sa ta tra he ma pra ti badhe josdi sernye pra rig 'dzin rgyal po'i sras ni rnam par rgyu/ /des der gser las bsgrubs pa'i khang par ni/ /grub pas tijo pa ti ratna mūṭī/ /a bhya tsu go rī mu pa bī ṇa yaṭī da darsha ka dzñā ka li rab tu gnas byas rin chen gzugs/ /go rī ④mchod nas rgyud mang ⑤glu len pa'i/ /zla ba gsar pa lta kā me besdoḥ/ /gorluḥs mā ra dha na sambi mā na badha sbi tai madma tha dzre ba nā ya/ /bu'i ⑥bu mo mthong / /yid srubs 'tsho slad go ri mnyes pa yi/ /sgrub byed la ni rab tu gnas byas pa/ /bi lo kya tsākā ma ba dhū mi bā bye dzre rū ta bā haḥthra thu bisma yo byuta/ /sha ṣpe ra 'dod pa'i chung ma gzhan bzhin de mthong nas/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa ya mtshan rgya cher gyur/ /de nas ri tsā kā da ba tārba bī rde gī tā ba sā ṣpe ha ri zla ya tā kṣi/ /lardzo na tā dwags mig yangs ngo tsha yis/ /dud pas glu mthar rgyud mang ④phang ba nas/ /dal gyis phab pas rig tyakta sa ra sma rā sgo da darsha bi byā dha ra rā dza pu tram̐/ /pa raspa rā lo 'dzin rgyal po'i bu/ /mda' bzhag 'dod pa dag dang mtshungs pa mthong / /mig zer mdzes pa'i rgyan ka na bi bhra me ṇa ṣpe ṭwā shu sho bhā bha ra rto bhi lā ṣaḥ/ /ga tā ga tā bhā ba ldan mngon 'dod des/ /phan tshun lta bar byed pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /yid ni nye bar ⑧mtshams sbyor ta yobya kā ra ma bye ma naḥsarnyi ni badha du taḥ/ /sā kā ma padmā ka ra rā dza haṃ sī pho nya bzhin/ /de dag bar du 'gro dang 'ong ba ⑨byas/ /gsar mthong la yang phyogs su lhung bcas ⑩pa//95—1084

sa pakṣa pā tā na ba darsha ṣpe pi/ /dzadmānta rā sgyu sa ra sā di bā gya swatstsha ma hadmā 'dod pa pad mtsho'i ngang pa'i rgyal mo des/ /skye ba gzhan du goms pa'i ro las bzhin/ /de yi yid mtsho na sa mā bi bee sha/ /sha shaṃ ka rarja bi ma la sha shī ba ka tyā ku lo laghra mi che zhing dngas par ①zhugs/ /rin chen zla bas dzudri med ri bong dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis (1 'ben la basma re 6ཿ/ /ta sngaḥs rā shaṃ sa bi bee sha tsitta mindindi raḥphulla mi bā ra bisdo/ /dran pa'i mda'/ /rab rgyas padmo dag tu bung ba bzhin/ /chags ldan de yi ④sems la'ang de zhugs gyur//a bye tya tsā bā la sa khye dī tī yī lardzo ni madzdzanda ba kā ma dzee sgo/ /bi tyā grogs mo bu mo'i gnyis pa dang bcas der/ /'dod pa gsar skyes ngo tshas snun byed cing / /brtan yang dha rend+rarngi dza ṣpe dza gā da dhī ro pi rū pārtse ta kṛ6 mā ṇaḥ/ /saṃ rmad byung gzugs kyis drangs gyur pa/ /rig ⑤'dzin zla bas dben par mngon phyogs smras/ /smin bhā ṣa ṇin kri ya te na kasmrakhru zla twa yā sgyug ta saṃ bi bhā gaḥ/ /bi bharbhe legs ci sbad sngon du 'ong ba spyol/ /phebs smras bkur ba'i cha ni khyod mi byed/ /dam pa'i kun spyod bha byā bhi dza nā nu rū paṃ byu paṃ sa dā tsā ra gu ṇi na sho dzñā/ /i rda na pā yon tan gyis mdzes gzugs/ /legs ldan rigs kyi rjes mthun rnam par 'dzin/ /kha na ma tho med lo ka ra ṇi sma ra gya ta bā na ba bye gi sha shaṃ ka kārnyi/ /di bye ba puḥka gya sa munda lus khyod lus mchog /dran pa'i rgyan ni gsar pa zla ba ltar/ /mdzes pa mu tig nor bu nyid 'di ni/ /ta su baṃ sha su mughra ma ṇi tā ma bāste/ /ta bā tha bā sunda ri darsha ṣpe na ba yo su dhwadzre rab tu mtho ba'i rigs min megang las thos⑪/ /yang na mdzes ma khyod ni mthong gyur pa/ /bdud rtsis ṇa kṛ to pa tsā rāḥ/ /ka ro ti khā ba rgya bi tīṇḍi harṣa saṃ bhā ṣa rde ka su sha brlan pas ⑨nged la rim gro byas/ /mdzes sdug dga' ster ri bong gis mtshan pa'i/ /ri mo su la phebs shī ka le khā/ /i rda tu naḥkau tu ka mā tra me ba bri tyā bee ṣpe hūṃ bha ba tī pra par smra bar byed/ /'on kyang dga' bas nged kyi dge mtshan tsam/ /gsal ba'i slad du spyod kyis 'dir ⑩95—1085

bītaske/ /satpakṣa pā tā bhi mu khe na dhwa tra ka gya nā ya snga bha ra bhā kṛ tā smros shig /dam pa'i phyogs lhung mngon phyogs byed pa yi①/ /su yi rigs ni khyod kyis brgyan ①par pi—/ /khru te nyi bi tyā dha ra she kha ra mya ba tsasta dokhru kya bi bhā ba garghaṃ/ /kri byas—/ /zhes pa rig 'dzin cod pan dag gi ①tshig /'dod dgongs snying po can de thos gyur nas/ /ngo yā bha bāta mo na ba tī ya dā sau ta dā sa khi ma ta li kā dza gā da/ /ku mā ra bi byā dha tshas de ni mi smra ldan gyur gang / /de tshe grogs mo ma ta li kas smras/ /gzhon nu rig bu'adzin rgyal rigs ra rā dza baṃ sha su dhwadhi tsand+ra sta mi ha pra sedheḥ/ /asmahphu re sedha bi lā si nī bdud rtsi yi/ /chu gter rmi ni zla ba khyod 'dir grags/ /nged kyi grong na grub pa'i rtse dga' mas/ /nyiryadhī ya se bi gra ha bā na dzwa gaḥ/ /pra khyu ta kalpa dru ma dā na li lo gu ṇa pra bhā lus med lus ldan khyod ni glu len byed/ /dpag bsam shing sbyin rtse dgas rab grags pa/ /khyod kyi bā bha ra rde ya sha ste/ /a snga: mi tā ba su nā nu dze na kadzā pa tai tsā ki ta grags pa yon tan mthu yis brgyan⑤/ /zla ltar dkar ba 'di yi rna rgyan du/ /ming po nor gyi bshes mind+ra shu bye/ /sa twasma hā satwa ka dzee ka thārtaḥthra phyo pa tsā ra kri ya ⑪ ba gnyen dag gis byas/ /sems dpa' chen po de khyod grogs mos gtamaspyo / /dar ma'i nyer ⑦spyod bya bas sa khyuḥ/ /bha brnyi madzdza bi dzi ta swa bhā bā bi she ṣa to gre ma ha tsā nyi ka n+ya kāḥ/ /ji ltar 'os/ /khyad par tshe rnams mdun ①du bu mo ni/ /ngo tshas rnam par thul ba'i rang bzhin 'gyur//siddhā nā yī sgo dhi su dmā ka ra gya bi shā ba soḥsidha pa teḥsu te yi/ /urba na ke li bu mo 'di ni grub rigs chu gter gyi/ /zla ba grub bdag sna tshogs nor gyi ste/ /gang gi ⑨mdzes pa skyed 6 ka ro ti ya sngaḥs de ba kārnyiḥku mu dā ba bo bye/ /na ba ma la ya dza balla rī ba tshal du rtse tshe/ /rtag pa nyid du ku mud rgyas par byed/ /ma la yar skyes 'khri shing gsar bzhin phra/ /ta rtswa pra tha ma sa muṅga ta pabee bā tu rtodhī/ /i ya ma mṛ ta ma yi su rā su rā shā dang por 'khrungs gyur yal 'dab ltar dmar mchu/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ma la ya can 'di⑩/ /rtag 95—1086

ma la ya ba tī sa ta tā bhi khā ṣa bhū miḥ/ /i ti ta sde khru bā shā yī spru bi ro bye tu lha dang lha min mngon 'dod pa①/ /zhes des smras par gyur pa na/ /nyug ⑤rum rgan po mngon phyogs tya shaṃ bu tī/ /satwa rā ga ma nodzñā saḥsthā ha sesgye bye pādma rdzu/ /ka spyo ṇi te—/ /myur bar 'ong ba'i ①shugs bcas pas/ /grub bdag bu ma ④la smras pa/ /dge ma nor gyi mi tā ba su nā sa hi tontaḥpu rasbi taḥ/ /twabyi bā ha ka thā saktaḥsi tā hūṃ bshes gnyen dang / /lhan cig pho brang 'khor na 'khod/ /khyod kyi bag ma'i gtam la chags/ /yab ni dranghru mitstsha ti/ /i hphulnga sa ha sā te na sa ha sa khyu lo tsā nā/ /khyod la lta bar 'tshal/ /zhes pa de yis brjod pa'i 'phral/ /grogs mo dang bcas mig bzang ma/ /dzre mū ta ba ha na n+yasta mā na sā sā shaṣperya yo/ /ta sde pabya sbyi ta sa khāe yid ni sprin gyi bzhon pa la/ /rnam par bkod nas dal gyis song / /grogs mo phyi na 'khod de la⑤/ /ka thā byā dzeeḥpu naḥpu naḥ/ /kārnyi ni rīkṣu mā nā yī bra rdza tyā ma la beeḥpa de/ /gtam gyi zol gyis yang dang yang / /mjos pa rjornam par lta byed cing / /le lo'i gom ⑦pas 'gro ba'i tshe//tatpa the datta na ya naḥ ku mā raḥ sa ma tsinta ya ta / /na boṅka ṇḍa mngon 'dod gsar pa la brten cing ske/ /phrag dog gis bzhin brtan pa ⑨ btang / /lam der mig ni shra yo j-i tyā tya bye mā na i beedhya yā/ /a ho nu mṛ ga sha basthā bra rdza tyāḥpi tu gtad pa yi/ /gzhon nu yis ni rab bsams pa/ /kye ma ri dwags phrug gu'i mig /pha yi drung du 'gro rarnyi ke/ /sa rā gi tadha ye ṣpe ba ma yi tyā se kṛ tasma naḥ/ /shā sā byed ma/ /de yis 'jigs bzhin chags bcas kyi/ /yid ni bdag la gtams par byas/ /dbugs kyi yā sa ni ro dha yatna ni ra tā niḥsha sda sasthā di bhā soṅka sthā bi dza ṣpe ngal dub 'bad pas 'gog la chags shing sgra med dag tu rnam par gnas/ /mthong ba'i 'jigs las shin ya darsha na bha yā da hye ta shaṃ kā ku lā/ / ta nī madma tha mārga tu dogs pas 'khrugs shing dben pa ru ⑫yang rab 'dar bcas⑪/ /yid srubs dag gi mda' yis rab 95—1087

zla ti ba ta ṣpe bai lakṣu lī nasbi tirto dzā no ka ta me na sā ma ma pa thā tso rī tu bsnun tshe skyengs pa yi ①ni chags shing gnas/ /lus phra chom rkun ma de bdag yid la zhugs lam gang pra biṭwā ma
